papers.title: ϕ-RIE: From Photorealistic Reconstruction to Interactive Environments
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) can reconstruct a captured scene photorealistically, but the resulting representation does not by itself support physical interaction. Robot simulation instead requires object-level change, \textit{i.e.}, objects must move independently, make contact, and reveal previously occluded surroundings. This gap arises because object appearance may remain entangled with the background, while hidden object geometry and occluded background content may be unobserved. To address this challenge, we present φ-RIE, a Gaussian-native pipeline that converts selected objects into movable simulator assets while preserving the remaining reconstruction. Our key observation is that asset construction and source removal should be coupled, \textit{i.e.}, one object identity should define the movable asset and the scene content to remove and complete. Accordingly, Scene Observation supplies shared evidence to Coupled Scene Construction, which creates registered assets and completed background Gaussians for simulator-driven rendering in an Interactive Environment. This coupling preserves unedited Gaussians while aligning visual and physical state. On 50 ScanNet++ scenes, evidence-based selection and registration retry increase matched F1 at 20\,mm from 0.336 to 0.383 at fixed retention. Further tests demonstrate asset executability, manipulation gains over a single-generator baseline, and the visual cost of conversion. Together, these results demonstrate that \name\ enables interactive scene conversion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: φ-RIE 是把 3DGS 场景中选定物体转成可移动仿真资产的 Gaussian-native 流程，核心是把资产构建与原场景内容移除、背景补全耦合到同一物体身份上。在 50 个 ScanNet++ 场景上，基于证据的物体选择加配准重试使 20mm 匹配 F1 从 0.336 提到 0.383（固定保留率），并展示资产可执行性与相对单生成器基线的操控增益。
Motivation: 3DGS 照片级重建不支持物理交互：物体外观与背景纠缠、被遮挡几何与背景未被观测，机器人仿真需要物体独立运动、接触并露出原先遮挡区域。
Method: Scene Observation 提供共享证据，Coupled Scene Construction 据此同时生成配准的可移动资产与补全后的背景 Gaussian，供仿真器驱动渲染；同一物体身份既定义资产也定义要移除并补全的场景内容，未编辑的 Gaussian 被保留。
Result: 在 50 个 ScanNet++ 场景上，基于证据的选择加配准重试在固定保留率下把 20mm 匹配 F1 从 0.336 提升到 0.383；进一步测试展示资产可执行性、相对单生成器 (single-generator) 基线的操控增益，以及转换带来的视觉代价。
Conclusion: 资产构建与源移除应当耦合，这样能在保留未编辑重建的同时对齐视觉与物理状态，实现交互式场景转换。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HARMONY: Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for MONocular Image-to-Scene Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Compositional 3D scene reconstruction has recently been explored from two directions: agentic reasoning that provides semantic understanding of spatial relationships but lacks precise alignment with input images; and visual geometry foundation models that predict dense point maps from input images but the reconstruction quality is limited. Therefore, recovering a complete 3D scene from a single monocular image with accurate inter-object relationships and high-fidelity reconstruction quality remains challenging. In this paper, we present HARMONY, a hierarchical chain-of-thought framework that leverages both agentic reasoning and visual geometry foundation. Given an image of an indoor scene, starting from an empty 3D floorplan, HARMONY first calibrates the camera against the reference image to establish a semantically-grounded spatial frame, then uses agentic VLM reasoning to recover the 3D room layout and an initial placement order. It then places the objects in a hierarchical order, from wall-mounted elements, free-standing furniture, to dependent decorations on top of furniture. We also use depth-first traversal for furniture so each placement conditions on previously resolved structure and a reflective feedback loop to avoid error accumulation. After each object placement by VLM, we use the point cloud estimations to perform geometry-based refinement so that the rendered image aligns better with the input. HARMONY can produce 3D scenes that are semantically consistent and perceptually aligned with the reference image, extending single-image compositional reconstruction to complex indoor scene images. Experiments on synthetic and real-world images demonstrate that HARMONY outperforms the evaluated reconstruction baselines, while qualitative comparisons with GPT-6 Astra suggest more faithful object arrangements and better preservation of scene details.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HARMONY 用分层 chain-of-thought 把 agentic VLM 推理与视觉几何基础模型串起来，从单张室内图重建组合式 3D 场景：先标定相机建立语义空间坐标系，再按墙面挂件、独立家具、家具上摆件的层级顺序放置物体，家具内部用深度优先遍历让每次放置以前序结构为条件，并在 VLM 放置后用点云估计做几何精修以对齐输入图像。合成与真实图像实验中优于所评估的重建基线，与 GPT-6 Astra 的定性比较显示物体排布更忠实、场景细节保留更好。
Motivation: agentic reasoning 有语义空间关系理解但与输入图像对齐不精，视觉几何基础模型输出稠密点图但重建质量受限，单图恢复物体间关系准确且高保真的完整 3D 场景仍然困难。
Method: 分层 chain-of-thought 框架：从空 3D floorplan 出发先对参考图像标定相机建立语义空间帧，再由 agentic VLM 推理恢复 3D 房间布局与初始摆放次序；按墙面挂件、独立家具、家具上装饰的层级依次放置，家具用深度优先遍历使每次放置以前序结构为条件，并加反思反馈回路抑制误差累积；每个物体由 VLM 放置后用点云估计做基于几何的精修，使渲染图与输入对齐。
Result: 在合成与真实图像实验中优于所评估的重建基线；与 GPT-6 Astra 的定性比较显示物体排布更忠实、场景细节保留更好。产出的 3D 场景与参考图像语义一致且感知对齐。
Conclusion: 把 agentic 语义推理与几何精修按层级顺序结合，可把单图组合式重建扩展到复杂室内场景图像。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DreamStream: Towards Policy-Oriented Generative Simulation for End-to-End Driving
papers.abstract_en: Faithfully evaluating end-to-end driving policies in simulation requires observations that are not merely photo-realistic, but preserve the scene features a policy relies on to make decisions. Existing platforms, however, exhibit a sim-to-real visual gap that corrupts policy perception, undermining their ability to assess a policy's closed-loop decision-making. To this end, we propose DreamStream, a generative, closed-loop simulator that achieves policy-oriented fidelity using a simulator-grounded autoregressive video model. Our video model is distilled from a large pretrained video model via traffic layout guidance, varying visual appearance while preserving policy-relevant features such as scenario layout and the temporal consistency of dynamic objects. We further observe that perceptual metrics like FID misrank how well these features are preserved. To tackle this, we introduce FD$π$, a new multi-representation metric that measures the sim-to-real gap as the Fréchet distance over scene-context features from public E2E policies. Under FD$π$, DreamStream improves over the strongest prior closed-loop simulator by $1.6\times$ on nuScenes and $4.7\times$ on NAVSIM, and induces the least perturbation to policy's perceptual observability. Based on DreamStream, we construct Navhard-CL benchmark, which turns non-reactive real-world benchmark NAVSIM into interactive testing environments with adversarial driving behaviors and weather variations. This benchmark exposes many failure modes of driving policies, such as scorer bias and lack of recovery behaviors, that prior closed-loop benchmarks overlook. Code and data are available at https://github.com/VAIL-UCLA/DreamStream.
papers.comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026. Project page: https://vail-ucla.github.io/DreamStream/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DreamStream 是面向自动驾驶策略评估的生成式闭环仿真器，用从大型预训练视频模型蒸馏、受交通布局引导的自回归视频模型改变外观同时保住策略相关的场景布局与动态物体时序一致性。它提出基于公开端到端策略场景上下文特征的 Fréchet 距离指标 FDπ，指出 FID 这类感知指标会误判特征保留程度；在 FDπ 下比最强既有闭环仿真器在 nuScenes 上好 1.6 倍、NAVSIM 上好 4.7 倍。
Motivation: 现有闭环驾驶仿真平台存在 sim-to-real 视觉鸿沟，破坏策略的感知输入，因而无法可靠评估策略的闭环决策能力；而 FID 等感知指标会误判策略相关特征是否被保留。
Method: 提出 DreamStream：以 simulator-grounded 自回归视频模型为核心，从大型预引入预训练视频模型经 traffic layout guidance 蒸馏，在改变视觉外观时保留场景布局与动态物体时序一致性；同时提出 FDπ 指标，计算公开端到端策略场景上下文特征上的 Fréchet 距离来度量 sim-to-real 差距。
Result: FDπ 下 DreamStream 相对最强既有闭环仿真器在 nuScenes 提升 1.6 倍、在 NAVSIM 提升 4.7 倍，并对策略感知可观测性引入最小扰动；作者观察到 FID 等感知指标会误排序这些特征的保留程度。基于它构建的 Navhard-CL 把非反应式 NAVSIM 变成含对抗驾驶行为与天气变化的交互测试环境，暴露 scorer bias 与缺乏恢复行为等既有闭环基准遗漏的失败模式。
Conclusion: 面向策略的保真度应以策略自身特征（FDπ）而非通用感知指标（FID）来度量；把非反应式基准改造成含对抗行为与天气变化的交互环境，才能暴露驾驶策略的 scorer bias 与恢复行为缺失。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Decentralized Partially Observable Team Decision Methodology with Delayed Information Sharing
papers.abstract_en: We study decentralized partially observable team decision problems with low-rank latent dynamics and unknown system models. The proposed framework combines team-theoretic equivalence with low-rank model representations to address cooperative decision-making in partially observable Markov decision processes without prior knowledge of the transition model. Each team member makes decisions based on local private information and delayed common information shared across the team. Using only this available information, each member learns an approximate low-rank Markov decision process and applies least-squares value iteration to compute its policy. This yields a fully decentralized learning and planning algorithm that requires neither a centralized coordinator nor centralized training. We show that the resulting member-side solutions approximate the centralized team solution: despite partial observability, unknown dynamics, and delayed common information, each member recovers the corresponding component of an approximate team-optimal policy. We further establish finite-sample performance guarantees and derive a corresponding sample-complexity bound for the proposed algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在低秩隐状态动力学且转移模型未知的分散式部分可观测团队决策问题中，各成员仅用本地私有信息与带延迟的共享信息，独立学习近似低秩 MDP 并用 least-squares value iteration 求策略，无需中心协调者或集中训练。证明成员侧解逼近集中式团队最优策略的对应分量，并给出有限样本性能保证与样本复杂度界。
Motivation: 部分可观测 MDP 下的团队协作通常需要已知转移模型或中心化训练/协调，而现实中模型未知、观测局部、共享信息有延迟，集中式方案不可行。
Method: 结合团队理论等价 (team-theoretic equivalence) 与低秩模型表示：每个成员基于本地私有信息和延迟的共享信息学习近似低秩 MDP，再用 least-squares value iteration 计算自身策略，构成完全分散的学习与规划算法。
Result: 在部分可观测、未知动力学与延迟共享信息条件下，每个成员恢复近似团队最优策略的相应分量；建立了有限样本性能保证并推导了样本复杂度界。
Conclusion: 无需中心协调与集中训练，仅凭本地信息与延迟共享信息即可逼近集中式团队最优解，前提是隐动力学具有低秩结构。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: SpeakerMem-R1: Speaker-Centered Dual-Track Memory for Multi-Party Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Long-term conversational memory in multi-party settings requires more than retrieving relevant content from long-term conversations: it must distinguish who said what, whom each statement concerns, how individuals perceive one another, what information is shared by the group, and how states change over time. Recent studies on multi-party dialogue benchmarks show that existing general-purpose LLM memory systems tend to lose person and group relations or struggle to integrate clues distributed across members, groups, and time. Together, these issues reveal two core bottlenecks: message attribution and relational understanding in multi-party dialogue, and state reconstruction from interleaved histories. To address both, we propose $\textbf{SpeakerMem-R1}$: its dual-track memory stores speaker-labeled verbatim messages and derived states organized into person-level and group-level views, then combines evidence from both tracks by entity, event, and time at query time. To reduce attribution and update errors during structured memory construction while enabling local deployment, we train Writer-R1 with SpeakerLevenshtein and speaker-conditioned GRPO. On GroupMemBench, SocialMemBench, and EverMemBench, SpeakerMem-R1 achieves binary accuracies of 47.9%, 69.2%, and 61.9%, respectively. On the publicly reported EverMemBench leaderboard from EverMind-AI, we achieves 62.33%, the best reported result among the latest state-of-the-art frameworks. It also achieves 70.85% on all 1,986 LoCoMo questions, which we use as a two-person long-term conversation boundary test. In a controlled evaluation of 305 questions, RL raises the SFT Writer's mean accuracy from 57.38% to 68.20%. We report both binary accuracy and token-F1, and ablations show that the verbatim and structured tracks, as well as person-level and group-level views, are complementary under the standardized evaluation interface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpeakerMem-R1 用双轨记忆（说话人标注的逐字消息 + 派生状态，按 person-level 与 group-level 组织）在查询时按实体、事件、时间融合证据，解决多方对话中的消息归属与状态重建。GroupMemBench、SocialMemBench、EverMemBench 二值准确率分别为 47.9%、69.2%、61.9%；RL 将 S Writer 平均准确率从 57.38% 提到 68.20%。
Motivation: 多方对话中通用 LLM 记忆系统丢失人物与群体关系、难以整合跨成员与跨时间的线索，瓶颈在消息归属、关系理解与交错历史的状态重建。
Method: 双轨记忆分别存说话人标注逐字消息与派生状态，按 person-level 和 group-level 视图组织，查询时按 entity、event、time 融合两轨证据；训练 Writer-R1，用 SpeakerLevenshtein 与 speaker-conditioned GRPO 减少结构化构建中的归属与更新错误，支持本地部署。
Result: GroupMemBench、SocialMemBench、EverMemBench 二值准确率 47.9%、69.2%、61.9%；EverMemBench 公开榜 62.33%，为所报告最新 SOTA 框架中最佳；LoCoMo 全部 1,986 题 70.85%（两人长期对话边界测试）；305 题受控评估中 RL 将 SFT Writer 平均准确率从 57.38% 提至 68.20%；同时报告 binary accuracy 与 token-F1，消融显示逐字轨与结构化轨、person-level 与 group-level 视图互补。

papers.title: CliffCompaction: Cost-Efficient Compaction for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agents often work on complex problems that require millions of tokens of context, which necessitates compacting across sessions due to limited context windows. We develop CliffCompaction, an autocompaction technique that reduces cost by up to 50% under a bounded context while maintaining or improving performance on Terminal-Bench and achieving new levels of efficiency for test-time scaling and state-of-the-art results on KernelBench. The per-rollout savings of CliffCompaction make the performance--cost trade-off of test-time scaling more efficient, adding over 10 percentage points on Terminal-Bench for less than the cost of two full-context runs. Under parallel test-time scaling, CliffCompaction lets Kimi K2.6 match Opus 4.7, and exceed Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.3 Codex at lower cost. The key to CliffCompaction's effectiveness is that it keeps compacted information faithful by only truncating or dropping content, never rephrasing or rewriting it. We never compact a compaction---each pass operates only on original content, and prior compacted output is discarded, preventing context drift from accumulating. These properties sustain continual learning over sessions exceeding a million tokens: on KernelBench, CliffCompaction reaches CUDA kernel speedups of $2.23\times$ after 200 steps and $3.58\times$ after 400 steps, surpassing specialized search algorithms and trained agents despite being a general-purpose compaction technique. We open-source a scaffold-agnostic API-proxy implementation of CliffCompaction usable with Claude Code, Codex and other harnesses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CliffCompaction 是一种自动压缩 (autocompaction) 技术，在有界上下文窗口下只截断或丢弃原始内容、绝不改写，且从不压缩已压缩内容，从而阻止上下文漂移累积。它把成本降低最多 50%，在 Terminal-Bench 上保持或提升性能，并在 KernelBench 上以 200 步 2.23×、400 步 3.58× 的 CUDA kernel 加速超过专用搜索算法与训练型 agent。
Motivation: 长程 coding agent 需要跨会话携带数百万 token 的上下文，而上下文窗口有限，必须压缩；改写式压缩会让上下文漂移随压缩次数累积，推高 test-time scaling 的成本。
Method: CliffCompaction 作为有界上下文下的 autocompaction：每一轮只对原始内容做截断或丢弃，不重述、不重写，且从不压缩上一次压缩结果（never compact a compaction），旧压缩输出直接丢弃；实现为 scaffold-agnostic 的 API proxy，可接入 Claude Code、Codex 等 harness。
Result: 成本最多降低 50%；Terminal-Bench 上性能保持或提升，每 rollout 节省使 test-time scaling 以不到两次全上下文运行的成本多拿 10 个百分点以上；并行 test-time scaling 下 Kimi K2.6 追平 Opus 4.7 并以更低成本超过 Opus 4.6 与 GPT-5.3 Codex；KernelBench 上 200 步 CUDA kernel 加速 2.23×、400 步 3.58×，并取得 SOTA 结果。
Conclusion: 只要压缩保持忠实且从不压缩压缩结果，通用压缩技术就能在超过百万 token 的跨会话学习中持续累积收益，让 test-time scaling 的性能-成本权衡更划算。

papers.title: SWE-Serve: Benchmarking Agentic Engineering For Production Inference Serving
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SWE-Serve, a benchmark for evaluating agents on production inference engineering tasks. Implementing an inference feature can require coordinating multiple changes across the serving stack, including model support, runtime execution, and public APIs. Existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of production inference engineering: repository-level software engineering benchmarks do not target inference, while general terminal-agent benchmarks include only a few inference tasks. Dedicated inference benchmarks, meanwhile, focus primarily on isolated kernel generation or performance optimization rather than repository-scale production feature implementation. SWE-Serve provides 53 repository-grounded tasks derived from recent production changes to SGLang, spanning six inference engineering families. Each task executes on either CPU or a single GPU (H100) and is evaluated with hidden functional and regression tests, including, where applicable, end-to-end (E2E) serving tests and calibrated performance gates. Executable no-op and oracle controls, adversarial verifier review, and closed-book execution support task validity and evaluation integrity. Across 11 models and 31 model-effort configurations, the best-performing configuration achieves 75% mean pass@1. SWE-Serve exposes a substantial gap between completing tasks locally and achieving production correctness. On 19 tasks with end-to-end coverage, model-serving E2E tests reject roughly one-third of patches that pass every other test (45.9% under the verifier versus 69.4% with E2E tests excluded from scoring), with pass rate increasing for each model's best-performing configuration. By making the production correctness gap directly measurable, SWE-Serve enables the field to track whether future agents move beyond completing tasks locally to achieving production correctness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-Serve 是面向生产推理服务工程的 agent 基准：53 个源自 SGLang 近期生产改动的仓库级任务，覆盖六类推理工程，用隐藏功能/回归测试与 E2E serving 测试评分。11 个模型、31 个 model-effort 配置中最佳配置平均 pass@1 达 75%，但在 19 个有 E2E 覆盖的任务上，E2E 测试会拒掉约三分之一本可通过其他测试的补丁（45.9% 对剔除 E2E 后的 69.4%），说明本地完成任务与生产级正确性之间存在实质差距。
Motivation: 仓库级 SWE 基准不针对推理，通用 terminal-agent 基准只有少量推理任务，专用推理基准又局限于孤立 kernel 生成或性能优化，生产级推理特性实现（模型支持、运行时执行、公共 API 协同改动）没有可测的评测口径。
Method: 从 SGLang 近期生产改动构造 53 个仓库级任务，分属六个推理工程族；每个任务在 CPU 或单张 H100 上执行，用隐藏功能与回归测试评分，适用处加入端到端 serving 测试与校准过的性能门槛；另配可执行的 no-op 与 oracle 对照、对抗式 verifier 审查和闭卷执行来保证任务有效性与评测完整性。
Result: 在 11 个模型、31 个 model-effort 配置上，最佳配置平均 pass@1 为 75%。在 19 个有端到端覆盖的任务上，模型 serving E2E 测试拒掉约三分之一通过其他全部测试的补丁：verifier 口径下通过率 45.9%，剔除 E2E 测试后为 69.4%；各模型最佳配置下通过率均上升。
Conclusion: 本地跑通任务不等于生产正确性，这个差距可直接量化，领域得以据此追踪未来 agent 是否真正跨过生产正确性门槛。

papers.title: StableVQ: Practical Guidelines for Stable Vector-Quantized Tokenizer Training
papers.abstract_en: Vector Quantization (VQ) is fundamental to discrete visual tokenizers that power modern autoregressive and masked image generation models. While recent shared-projection codebook methods have substantially advanced codebook utilization, training stability remains a critical and underexplored challenge. We argue that the root cause lies in the entanglement of the Encoder--Decoder and Codebook training: because neither module can reliably fulfill its own responsibility in isolation, the system can only function when the two subsystems happen to cooperate---a fragile condition that breaks down precisely when training is most stressed. We propose StableVQ, which revisits the proper learning objective of each module and resolves the problems that arise when each is trained to fulfill its own role independently. Concretely, (1) Dynamic STE corrects the instability in the Encoder's learning objective, enabling it to robustly optimize the reconstruction space under discrete regularization even when codebook utilization is low. (2) Region VQ Loss reconceives the Codebook's learning objective so that it can independently guarantee full tracking of the encoder output distribution, without relying on encoder oscillations to drive activation. (3) Decoupled Schedule recognizes that the distinct responsibilities of the Encoder--Decoder and the Codebook demand distinct optimization dynamics, and assigns each an independent learning rate schedule to ensure robust system-level behavior. Built on top of shared-projection codebooks, StableVQ is lightweight and introduces no learnable parameters. Experiments on ImageNet demonstrate consistent improvements in training stability, codebook utilization, and reconstruction quality across diverse codebook sizes and initialization settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StableVQ 把 VQ tokenizer 训练不稳归因于 Encoder–Decoder 与 Codebook 训练目标纠缠，提出 Dynamic STE、Region VQ Loss 与 Decoupled Schedule 三项解耦准则，让两个子系统各自独立履责。在 ImageNet 上跨多种 codebook 大小与初始化设置，训练稳定性、codebook 利用率与重建质量一致提升，且不引入可学习参数。
Motivation: 共享投影 codebook 已大幅提升利用率，但训练稳定性仍是关键且少被研究的问题：Encoder–Decoder 与 Codebook 互相依赖，训练受压时系统容易崩溃。
Method: 三项解耦设计：Dynamic STE 修正 Encoder 在离散正则下的学习目标，使其在 codebook 利用率低时仍能优化重建空间；Region VQ Loss 重设 Codebook 目标，使其独立完整追踪 encoder 输出分布；Decoupled Schedule 为 Encoder–Decoder 与 Codebook 各配独立学习率调度。整体构建于 shared-projection codebook 之上，轻量且无可学习参数。
Result: 在 ImageNet 上，跨多样 codebook 大小与初始化设置，训练稳定性、codebook 利用率与重建质量均一致改善。
Conclusion: VQ 训练不稳的根因是 Encoder–Decoder 与 Codebook 目标纠缠，让两者各自独立履责并配独立优化动态即可在不加参数的前提下稳定训练。

papers.title: A2M: Trace-Optimized Agent Hijacking in the MCP Ecosystem
papers.abstract_en: Agents using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) rely on semantic matching to select tools from third-party servers, exposing a semantic supply-chain risk through attacker-controlled metadata and outputs. We introduce A2M (Attraction-to-Manipulation), a two-stage black-box framework for hijacking MCP agents. The Attraction phase optimizes tool metadata to increase invocation probability; the Manipulation phase uses execution traces to refine adversarial tool returns that steer agents toward attacker-desired outcomes. On LiveMCPBench, direct attacks optimized and evaluated on GLM-4.6 achieve a macro-average malicious tool invocation rate of 93.6% across four scenarios, increase weighted token costs to 32.4$\times$ the benign baseline under Cognitive Denial of Service, and attain a mean attack success rate of 74.4% across Information Exfiltration, Environment Integrity Compromise, and Reasoning Derailment. Transfer to four other models without re-optimization yields corresponding macro-averages of 63.6%, 2.7$\times$, and 24.5%. These findings motivate stronger tool vetting and runtime isolation in MCP ecosystems. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Lilaizhen/A2M.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: A2M 是针对 MCP 生态的两阶段黑盒劫持框架：先优化工具元数据提高被调用概率，再用执行轨迹精修对抗性返回值把 agent 引向攻击者目标。在 LiveMCPBench 上以 GLM-4.6 优化并评测，四场景宏平均恶意工具调用率 93.6%，Cognitive Denial of Service 下加权 token 成本达良性基线 32.4×，三类攻击平均成功率 74.4%；不重优化迁移到另外四个模型后分别降至 63.6%、2.7× 和 24.5%。
Motivation: MCP agent 靠语义匹配从第三方服务器选工具，攻击者可控的元数据与输出构成语义供应链风险，现有工具选择机制缺少对这类劫持的防护。
Method: 两阶段黑盒框架 A2M（Attraction-to-Manipulation）：Attraction 阶段优化工具元数据以提升调用概率，Manipulation 阶段利用执行轨迹精修对抗性工具返回值；在 LiveMCPBench 上针对 GLM-4.6 做攻击优化与评测，覆盖 Information Exfiltration、Environment Integrity Compromise、Reasoning Derailment、Cognitive Denial of Service 四场景。
Result: GLM-4.6 直接攻击：四场景宏平均恶意工具调用率 93.6%，Cognitive Denial of Service 下加权 token 成本为良性基线 32.4×，三类攻击平均攻击成功率 74.4%。不重优化迁移到另外四个模型，对应宏平均为 63.6%、2.7× 和 24.5%。
Conclusion: 语义匹配驱动的 MCP 工具选择可被元数据与返回值协同操纵，作者据此主张加强工具审查与运行时隔离；攻击效果在跨模型迁移时明显衰减。

summary_sections.conclusion: 语义匹配驱动的 MCP 工具选择可被元数据与返回值协同操纵，作者据此主张加强工具审查与运行时隔离；攻击效果在跨模型迁移时明显衰减。

papers.title: Grow the Harness, Not the Context: From Strategy-Free Scaffolds to Reusable Specialist Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents often handle streams of related tasks, yet standard harnesses repeatedly ask the model to reconstruct the same control decisions inside each task's context. We study whether task feedback can instead turn recurring control into reusable executable code, while reserving LLM calls for task-specific semantic reasoning. We introduce Growing Harness, a failure-guided training paradigm that learns the agent harness itself from a strategy-free scaffold that exposes fixed model and tool interfaces but encodes no task-solving controller. Function-level execution traces localize each failure to a bounded code surface, an optimizer repairs a window of failures jointly, and a success-first held-out gate rolls back repair sequences that harm prior capability. Accepted edits accumulate in one shared harness, allowing its control structure to emerge from task feedback. Across BrowseComp-Plus and WebArena-Verified with three deployment models from 4B to 120B parameters, Growing Harness achieves the highest mean success in five of six benchmark-model settings and trails the best mean by 0.7 pp. in the sixth. Relative to a Tool-Calling agent, it reduces LLM calls by 76.0-91.8% and deployed-agent inference cost by 74.4-98.6%. On WebArena-Verified, its success remains 44.7-45.3% across model scales, whereas Tool-Calling falls to 6.7% with the 4B model. Ablations show that trace-local edits, joint repair, and gate-based rollback each improve final success. These results show that persistent program growth can move recurring control out of model context and into low-cost code, yielding reusable specialist agents that remain effective with smaller deployment models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Growing Harness 用失败引导的训练范式把 LLM agent 反复在上下文里重建的控制决策固化为可执行代码：从无策略脚手架出发，按函数级执行轨迹定位失败、联合修复一个失败窗口、用 success-first 保留集门控回滚有害编辑，接受的编辑累积进共享 harness。在 BrowseComp-Plus 与 WebArena-Verified、4B 到 120B 三个部署模型上，六个 benchmark-model 组合中五个取得最高平均成功率，第六个仅落后 0.7 pp；相对 Tool-Calling agent 减少 76.0-91.8% 的 LLM 调用与 74.4-98.6% 的推理成本。
Motivation: LLM agent 处理相关任务流时，标准 harness 在每个任务上下文里重复重建同样的控制决策，浪费上下文与调用成本，且小模型难以独立承担这些控制。
Method: 提出 Growing Harness：以暴露固定模型与工具接口、不含任务求解控制器的 strategy-free scaffold 起步；函数级执行轨迹把每次失败定位到有界代码面，优化器联合修复一个失败窗口，success-first held-out gate 回滚损害既有能力的修复序列，被接受的编辑累积进单一共享 harness，LLM 调用只保留任务特有的语义推理。
Result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus 与 WebArena-Verified、三个 4B 到 120B 部署模型上，六个 benchmark-model 设置中五个取得最高平均成功率，第六个落后最优均值 0.7 pp；相对 Tool-Calling agent 减少 76.0-91.8% 的 LLM 调用与 74.4-98.6% 的部署推理成本；WebArena-Verified 上成功率跨模型规模稳定在 44.7-45.3%，而 Tool-Calling 在 4B 模型上降至 6.7%；消融显示轨迹定位编辑、联合修复与门控回滚各自提升最终成功率。
Conclusion: 持续的程序生长能把重复控制从模型上下文移入低成本代码，得到在更小部署模型上仍然有效的可复用专家 agent。

papers.title: Type-Safe Is Not Error-Free: A Constrained Decision Head Follows the Option Name, Not the Rubric Bound to It
papers.abstract_en: Typed decision models are built for settings where model outputs are consumed directly by software. Instead of generating free-form text, they return a decision over a predefined set of options. By construction, every output conforms to the required schema. Yet this guarantee does not tell us whether the model interprets the options as intended. We study Jev and two Jev-like models with open weights by changing how option names are assigned to rubrics. Each option consists of an option name and a textual rubric that defines what the option means. We change only which option name is assigned to each rubric; the question, state, rubric wording, and set of option names remain exactly the same. On 1200 workflow decisions with task-specific rubrics, renaming the two options from 0/1 to no/yes changes 70.4 more answers per hundred (95% CI: [67.6, 73.1]) and shifts AUC from .94 to .23, revealing a systematic reversal in the decision ranking rather than simple uncertainty. The same operation has little effect with neutral option names. This pattern holds across all 4 predicates, where the effect is at least 7.4x larger than under the neutral control, and becomes stronger as the number of options increases. The effect also depends on the read-out geometry: a second model family that mean-pools over the full option span flips 4.1x less often. The hosted model exhibits the same behavior: the swap changes AUC from .8146 to .5806 and produces 24x as many answer flips as its test-retest floor. In contrast, replacing the option names with random character strings returns all model families to the neutral-control regime without reducing accuracy. The failure therefore depends on the semantic polarity of the option names rather than on the renaming operation itself. Across all conditions, the type-error rate remains 0%, even when decision accuracy degrades substantially.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 类型安全的决策头只保证输出落在预定义选项集内，不保证模型按 rubric 语义理解选项。把选项名从 0/1 改成 no/yes（rubric、问题、选项名集合都不变）会让 1200 个 workflow 决策中每百题多出 70.4 个答案翻转（95% CI [67.6, 73.1]），AUC 从 .94 掉到 .23，出现系统性排序反转；换成随机字符串则回到中性对照水平且精度不降。
Motivation: 类型化决策模型被直接接入软件流水线，schema 合规被当作可靠性保证，但选项名与 rubric 的语义绑定是否被遵守从未被隔离检验。
Method: 在 Jev 及两个开放权重的 Jev-like 模型上做受控干预：只交换分配给各 rubric 的选项名，问题、状态、rubric 措辞与选项名集合保持不变；对照条件为中性选项名与随机字符串，并跨 4 个谓词、不同选项数与两种 read-out 几何（含对全选项跨度做 mean-pool 的第二模型族）比较，另测 hosted 模型的 test-retest floor。
Result: 1200 个 workflow 决策上，0/1 改为 no/yes 使每百题多 70.4 个答案改变（95% CI [67.6, 73.1]），AUC 从 .94 降至 .23；4 个谓词上效应至少是中性对照的 7.4 倍，且随选项数增加而增强；mean-pool 读出的模型族翻转少 4.1 倍；hosted 模型 AUC 从 .8146 降到 .5806，答案翻转量为其 test-retest floor 的 24 倍；随机字符串选项名让所有模型族回到中性对照区间且精度不降；全部条件下 type-error rate 恒为 0%。
Conclusion: 失败源于选项名的语义极性而非改名操作本身：类型错误率为 0% 与决策精度大幅退化可以并存，因此 schema 合规不能作为决策可靠性的证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FleXray: Universal Clinical X-ray Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: X-ray is medicine's most widely used imaging modality, yet remains among its least quantitative. Unlike volumetric modalities like CT or MRI, X-ray collapses 3D anatomy into a 2D projection, causing structures to overlap and anatomical boundaries to be ambiguous, even to experts. As a result, labeling X-ray databases for training general-purpose segmentation systems is impractical, leaving morphometric and functional X-ray analysis confined to narrow anatomical regions and applications. To this end, we present FleXray, a generalist model for anatomical segmentation across the entire body in clinical X-rays. Instead of curating large, manually annotated X-ray datasets, we build a scalable, physics-based generative X-ray data engine. Using existing 3D whole-body CT segmentation datasets and generative image-editing models, we simulate fully-annotated 2D X-rays with diverse appearances, physiological properties, and imaging geometries. Trained on these simulations, FleXray accurately segments 60 anatomical structures across unseen research datasets and in-the-wild X-rays. We further show that FleXray makes X-rays directly amenable to quantitative analysis, enabling automated measurements for disease grading, robust navigation during X-ray-guided interventions, and data-efficient learning of pathological targets. We release the model, code, a full-body X-ray segmentation dataset, and a local, easy-to-use browser-based tool at https://flexray.csail.mit.edu .
papers.comment: 35 pages, 12 figures, 10 tables. Code, models, data, and a browser-based demo at https://flexray.csail.mit.edu
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FleXray 是全身临床 X 光通用分割模型：不人工标注 X 光，而是用 3D 全身 CT 分割数据集加生成式图像编辑模型，物理仿真出带标注的 2D X 光来训练。训练后能在未见研究数据集与真实 X 光上准确分割 60 个解剖结构，并支撑疾病分级自动测量、X 光引导介入导航与病理目标的数据高效学习。
Motivation: X 光把 3D 解剖压成 2D 投影，结构重叠、边界模糊，人工标注数据库代价过高，导致形态与功能分析局限于少数解剖区域。
Method: 构建基于物理的生成式 X 光数据引擎：以现有 3D 全身 CT 分割数据集为条件，用生成式图像编辑模型合成带完整标注、外观/生理属性/成像几何多样的 2D X 光，再在仿真数据上训练 FleXray 通用分割模型。
Result: 在未见研究数据集与真实 (in-the-wild) X 光上准确分割 60 个解剖结构；下游支持疾病分级自动测量、X 光引导介入中的稳健导航、病理目标的数据高效学习；发布模型、代码、全身 X 光分割数据集与浏览器工具。
Conclusion: 用物理仿真替代人工标注可以训出跨全身的通用 X 光分割模型，并把 X 光变成可直接做定量分析的模态。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: EquivSVA: A Formally Verified Dataset of Behavioral Assertions Across Equivalent RTL Implementations
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to generate SystemVerilog Assertions from natural-language specifica- tions and register-transfer-level designs. Existing datasets and benchmarks support important goals such as large- scale training, formal evaluation, specification-to-assertion generation, and mutation-based testing. A complemen- tary need is to study whether a generated assertion cap- tures externally observable behavior or depends on inci- dental details of one RTL implementation. We present EquivSVA, a formally verified dataset organized around behavior families. Each family contains four structurally distinct RTL implementations of the same externally ob- servable behavior, shared interface-level gold properties, three controlled mutants, and formal-validation evidence. EquivSVA contains 120 behavior families across 12 cat- egories, 480 reference RTL implementations, 914 gold properties, and 360 mutants. Every final family passes a fixed 17-job validation suite covering RTL equivalence, gold-property proofs, property reachability, mutant dis- tinguishability, and gold-property checks on mutants. We also provide fixed family-safe train, development, and test splits. As a small demonstration of the analyses en- abled by the dataset, we evaluate the publicly released, Apache-2.0-licensed Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct model on the held-out test split. Of 293 interface-only generated properties, 93 are formally sound, and the number of sound properties varies across equivalent implementations for 14 of 24 test families. These results illustrate how behavior-family organization can support controlled stud- ies of assertion-generation robustness without requiring changes in intended functionality. The dataset, generators, validation scripts, and case-study artifacts are publicly released at https://github.com/aditigupta96/EquivSVA.
papers.comment: EquivSVA is a 9-page paper by FNU Aditi introducing a formally verified dataset of 120 behavior families, 480 RTL implementations, 914 gold properties, and 360 mutants across 12 categories, featuring 2 figures, 5 tables, and a case study evaluating Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EquivSVA 是一个按行为族组织、经形式化验证的 SystemVerilog 断言数据集：每个族含 4 个结构不同但外部行为等价的 RTL 实现、共享接口级 gold properties、3 个受控 mutant 与形式化验证证据。共 120 个行为族、12 个类别、480 个 RTL 实现、914 条 gold properties、360 个 mutant，全部通过固定的 17-job 验证套件。用 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 在留出测试集上做演示：293 条仅接口生成属性中仅 93 条形式化可靠，且 24 个测试族中有 14 个族的可靠属性数随等价实现而变化。
Motivation: 现有断言生成数据集与基准关注训练、形式评估与变异测试，但无法区分生成断言捕获的是外部可观察行为，还是某一份 RTL 实现的偶然细节。
Method: 按行为族组织数据集，每族给出 4 个结构互异的等价 RTL 实现、共享接口级 gold properties、3 个受控 mutant 与形式化验证证据；每个族通过固定 17-job 验证套件，覆盖 RTL 等价性、gold property 证明、性质可达性、mutant 可区分性及 mutant 上的 gold property 检查，并提供 family-safe 的 train/dev/test 划分。演示部分在留出测试集上评测 Apache-2.0 许可的 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct。
Result: 数据集含 120 个行为族、12 个类别、480 个参考 RTL 实现、914 条 gold properties、360 个 mutant，每个族通过 17-job 验证套件。Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 生成的 293 条 interface-only 属性中 93 条形式化可靠；24 个测试族中有 14 个族的可靠属性数量在等价实现之间不一致。
Conclusion: 行为族组织能在不改变预期功能的前提下，支撑断言生成鲁棒性的受控研究：同一行为的等价实现会让模型生成的可靠断言数量发生变化，说明生成断言可能依赖单一实现的偶然细节。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 数据集含 120 个行为族、12 个类别、480 个参考 RTL 实现、914 条 gold properties、360 个 mutant，每个族通过 17-job 验证套件。Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 生成的 293 条 interface-only 属性中 93 条形式化可靠；24 个测试族中有 14 个族的可靠属性数量在等价实现之间不一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 行为族组织能在不改变预期功能的前提下，支撑断言生成鲁棒性的受控研究：同一行为的等价实现会让模型生成的可靠断言数量发生变化，说明生成断言可能依赖单一实现的偶然细节。

papers.title: Metrics Failure in LLM-Based Code Vulnerability Repair: An Empirical Study and a Change-Aware Screen
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to the automated repair of C/C++ security vulnerabilities, and compile rate is a commonly reported proxy for progress: whether the generated patch compiles. We argue that compile rate is a scientifically unreliable metric for single-function vulnerability repair, and we support this with five controlled experiments over 203 vulnerable functions from Big-Vul, three open-source code LLMs (350M to 6.7B parameters), and three prompting strategies. Compile rate (i) barely responds to an intervention that substantially improves the generated code; (ii) is dominated by evaluation-harness and dataset artifacts rather than model quality, with about 64% of compile failures not attributable to the model, a share that is nearly invariant across models; (iii) shifts by 1.8 to 2.7 times on identical patches under a single compiler-standard flag, with zero regressions; (iv) ranks the three models in the opposite order to reference-similarity metrics; and (v) rewards non-repairs when used as an optimization target, since a compiler-feedback loop raises compile rate while similarity to the human fix falls, with manual inspection finding deletion- and placeholder-style non-repairs among the newly compiling outputs. The natural fallback, whole-function CodeBLEU, also fails: an unchanged copy of the vulnerable input outscores every model. We also examine diff_F1, a change-aware screen that scores only the edited region. It gives exactly zero credit to a no-op and near-zero credit to some, though not all, of the deletion-based gaming patches we observed, while still crediting genuine partial edits, so it may serve as a cheap screen before deeper, execution-based analysis. It is not a repair-quality metric, and we report where it falls short. Our findings argue for change-aware, execution-grounded evaluation of LLM-based vulnerability repair.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/OmNepal/llm-vulnrepair-metrics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用 203 个 Big-Vul 漏洞函数上的五组受控实验证明：单函数漏洞修复中 compile rate 是不可靠指标——约 64% 的编译失败与模型无关，换一个编译标准 flag 就让同一补丁的 compile rate 变动 1.8 至 2.7 倍，且作为优化目标会奖励删除式非修复。作者提出只对编辑区域打分的 diff_F1 作为廉价筛查器，并主张改用 change-aware、execution-grounded 的评估。
Motivation: LLM 漏洞修复领域普遍用 compile rate 汇报进展，但它可能主要反映评测框架与数据集伪影而非模型质量，导致模型排序与优化方向都出错。
Method: 在 Big-Vul 的 203 个漏洞函数上做五组受控实验，覆盖三个开源代码 LLM（350M 到 6.7B 参数）与三种 prompting 策略；对照 reference-similarity 指标、whole-function CodeBLEU，并检验以编译反馈为优化目标的循环，另用人工检查新通过编译的输出，提出只对编辑区域打分的 diff_F1。
Result: 五组实验显示：compile rate 对显著改善生成代码的干预几乎无响应；约 64% 的编译失败不可归因于模型，该比例在各模型间近乎不变；单一编译标准 flag 使相同补丁的 compile rate 变动 1.8 至 2.7 倍且零回归；compile rate 给三个模型的排序与 reference-similarity 指标相反；编译反馈循环提高 compile rate 而与人工修复的相似度下降，人工检查发现删除式与占位符式非修复。whole-function CodeBLEU 下，未改动的漏洞输入副本得分高于所有模型；diff_F1 对 no-op 给恰好零分，对部分但非全部删除式补丁给近零分，同时仍给真实部分编辑以分数。
Conclusion: compile rate 与 whole-function CodeBLEU 都不能度量漏洞修复质量，评估应改为 change-aware 且以执行为依据；diff_F1 只是进入深度执行分析前的廉价筛查器，不是修复质量指标。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Automatic depth-based local center clustering via $β$-integrated local depth and adaptive grouping
papers.abstract_en: Clustering is an unsupervised learning technique that partitions unlabeled data into groups. Most existing methods require user-specified parameters, such as the number of clusters or neighborhood size. Conversely, we propose automatic depth-based local center clustering (A-DLCC), a fully data-driven method that eliminates numerical parameter tuning. A-DLCC uses the $β$-integrated local depth to identify stable exemplars, points consistently central across multiple locality levels, termed local centers, which are ranked by their representativeness. Each local center induces a group of similar points, with group-level similarity measured by a proposed nonparametric metric called group-level local similarity. To guide merging, we incorporate the bottleneck path idea from graph theory, which forms the basis of our adaptive merging criterion. Based on this criterion, we design a single agglomeration rule in which a group is either absorbed by a neighbor it reaches better than itself or bonded to a neighbor that both sides find more reachable than their own background, every merge being additionally required to be carried by a contact stronger than a configuration-model null expects. The rule automatically estimates the number of clusters and decides when to stop merging. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that A-DLCC produces interpretable clustering results without parameter tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出完全数据驱动的聚类方法 A-DLCC：用 β-integrated local depth 找出跨多个局部尺度都居中的稳定样本点作为 local center 并按代表性排序，每个 local center 带出一组相似点，再用图论 bottleneck path 导出的自适应合并规则决定吸收、成键与停止。该规则同时自动估计簇数，无需用户指定簇数或邻域大小等数值参数；合成与真实数据实验显示结果可解释且全程免调参。
Motivation: 多数聚类方法需要用户指定簇数或邻域大小等数值参数，调参负担重且结果依赖人为选择。
Method: A-DLCC 分三步：以 β-integrated local depth 在多个 locality level 上识别稳定 exemplar（local center）并按代表性排序；每个 local center 诱导一组相似点，组间相似度用提出的非参数度量 group-level local similarity 衡量；合并由图论 bottleneck path 导出的自适应准则引导，单条 agglomeration 规则规定组要么被自己比它更易到达的邻居吸收，要么与双方都比各自背景更易到达的邻居成键，且每次合并还须强于 configuration-model null 的预期。
Result: 在合成数据与真实数据上的实验显示 A-DLCC 产出可解释的聚类结果，且全程无需参数调优；簇数由规则自动估计。
Conclusion: 聚类可以做成完全数据驱动、免数值调参的过程，簇数估计与停止时机由基于 bottleneck path 的合并规则内生决定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diffusion-Induced Spatial Attention Overlapping Community Detection
papers.abstract_en: Detection of overlapping communities is essential for modelling networks in which nodes participate simultaneously in multiple structural or functional groups. Existing graph neural network approaches commonly rely on local message passing, which can obscure community boundaries through smoothing and limit the representation of structurally relevant long-range dependencies. We introduce Diffusion-Induced Spatial Attention Community Detection (DISCO), a deep-learning framework that combines a structural prior derived from influence spreading dynamics, sparse multi-head attention, and non-negative community-affiliation learning. The prior identifies candidate interactions beyond immediate graph neighbours and biases attention according to their structural proximity, while a Bernoulli-Poisson edge-reconstruction objective enables overlapping community inference from node attributes and structural profiles, or both. Benchmark experiments show that DISCO performs competitively against established graph convolutional and graph attention approaches across different input configurations. To demonstrate its practical applicability, we present a proof-of-concept cybersecurity use case in which changes between community assignments inferred from consecutive communication-network snapshots provide an interpretable anomaly signal. Temporal community similarity identifies structural deviations, while node-level contributions help locate the devices associated with them. DISCO therefore provides both a flexible method for overlapping community detection and a foundation for analysing structural change in dynamic networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DISCO：用影响力扩散动力学生成结构先验，找出图邻居之外的候选交互并据此偏置稀疏多头注意力，再以 Bernoulli-Poisson 边重建目标学习非负的重叠社区归属。基准实验显示其在不同输入配置下与图卷积、图注意力方法表现相当，并在通信网络快照上用社区分配变化给出可解释的异常信号。
Motivation: 现有 GNN 社区发现依赖局部消息传递，平滑会模糊社区边界，也难以表达结构上相关的长程依赖，重叠社区推断因此受限。
Method: DISCO 由三部分组成：由 influence spreading dynamics 导出的结构先验（给出即时邻居之外的候选交互并按结构邻近度偏置注意力）、稀疏多头注意力、以及非负社区归属学习；训练目标为 Bernoulli-Poisson 边重建，可只用节点属性、只用结构画像或两者结合做重叠社区推断。
Result: 基准实验中 DISCO 在不同输入配置下与既有的图卷积 (GCN) 和图注意力 (GAT) 方法表现相当；在网络安全概念验证里，用连续通信网络快照之间社区分配的变化作为异常信号，时间社区相似度定位结构偏离，节点级贡献定位相关设备。
Conclusion: DISCO 同时给出灵活的重叠社区发现方法和分析动态网络结构变化的基础，其异常检测路径依赖社区分配的时序差异而非单快照指标。

papers.title: Evaluating the Semantic-to-Geometric Gap in Adversarial Defenses Against Vision-Language Model-Based Plagiarism
papers.abstract_en: The rapidly advancing capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) present a systemic challenge to academic integrity. VLMs now allow students to bypass meaningful engagement by capturing and submitting graphical problems as singular images, a practice we define as trivial plagiarism. To provide educators with actionable data on VLM limitations, we investigate the efficacy of heuristic adversarial image transformations designed to degrade model performance while remaining human-interpretable. Through a two-phase evaluation of introductory assessments, we manually assess baseline VLM performance on circuit diagrams, followed by an automated large-scale evaluation of topological structures (logic gates) and coordinate geometry (Karnaugh maps). We find that while highly capable VLMs can exhibit appreciable robustness, all models suffer vulnerability to adversarial perturbations. We conclude that while visual perturbations act as a viable near-term stopgap, long-term assessment security requires educators to reapproach assessment design given continually increasing VLM performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对学生把图形题拍照上传的“trivial plagiarism”，用启发式对抗图像变换扰动 VLM 输入，两阶段评测电路图、逻辑门拓扑与 Karnaugh 图坐标几何。所有被测模型都对扰动出现脆弱性，作者据此把视觉扰动定位为近期止血手段，长期解法是重新设计考核方式。
Motivation: VLM 让学生跳过真实作答、直接提交图形题截图，形成对学术诚信的系统性威胁；教育者需要知道模型在哪些视觉任务上失效。
Method: 两阶段评测入门级题目：先人工评估 VLM 在电路图上的基线表现，再用自动化大规模评测覆盖逻辑门拓扑结构与 Karnaugh map 坐标几何，并施加保持人类可读的启发式对抗图像变换。
Result: 高能力 VLM 表现出可观鲁棒性，但所有模型都对对抗扰动存在脆弱性；评测对象为电路图、逻辑门与 Karnaugh map 三类图形题，论文含 3 figures、2 tables、10 pages。
Conclusion: 视觉扰动是可行的近期止血方案，但 VLM 性能持续上升，长期考核安全必须回到考核设计本身。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ASTRA-SR: Atmospheric Seeing and Turbulence Restoration for Astronomical Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Ground-based planetary imaging suffers from atmospheric turbulence, sensor noise, and limited sampling, making restoration a joint denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution problem. We present ASTRA-SR, a blind single-frame restoration framework trained on a physics-grounded synthetic dataset. High-dynamic-range spacecraft RAW observations serve as clean sources, and paired LR inputs are synthesized using measured layer-integrated turbulence strengths, propagated moving phase screens, exposure-averaged spatially varying PSFs, and sensor noise.ASTRA-SR first estimates a noise-suppressed but blur-retaining LR image, then restores spatial structure through multiscale processing and reconstructs HR detail with serial spatial-amplitude refinement. It yields a 0.49 dB foreground PSNR gain over the strongest baseline approaches.
papers.comment: 4 pages of main text plus references, 4 figures. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASTRA-SR 是面向地基行星成像的盲式单帧复原框架，把去噪、去模糊与超分联合处理：先估计一个抑噪但保留模糊的低分辨率图像，再经多尺度处理恢复空间结构，最后用串行的空间-幅度细化重建高分辨率细节。在物理驱动的合成数据集上，它比最强基线高出 0.49 dB 的前景 PSNR。
Motivation: 地基行星成像同时受大气湍流、传感器噪声和采样不足影响，去噪、去模糊、超分被割裂处理时难以联合求解。
Method: 以高动态范围航天器 RAW 观测作为干净源，用实测层积分湍流强度、传播的移动相屏、曝光平均的空间变化 PSF 与传感器噪声合成配对 LR 输入；ASTRA-SR 先估计抑噪保模糊的 LR 图，再经多尺度处理与串行空间-幅度细化 (spatial-amplitude refinement) 重建 HR 细节。
Result: 在物理驱动的合成数据集上，前景 PSNR 比最强基线高 0.49 dB。
Conclusion: 把合成链路的湍流与 PSF 物理先验嵌入盲式单帧复原，可在地基行星成像上取得可测的前景 PSNR 增益。

summary_sections.result: 在物理驱动的合成数据集上，前景 PSNR 比最强基线高 0.49 dB。

papers.title: GAD-MambaUNet: Direction-Group Mamba with Gradient-Adaptive DINOv3 Distillation for Lightweight Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we proposed GAD-MambaUNet, a lightweight medical image segmentation network that combines efficient local modeling, direction--group state-space interaction, and training-time foundation-model supervision. To improve contextual modeling in compact segmentation networks, we introduced Direction-Group Graph Selective Scan (DG-GSS), which treated scan-direction and channel-group responses as graph nodes and enabled structured information exchange before multi-directional fusion. We further incorporated DINOv3-GAD supervision, where a frozen DINOv3 teacher provided semantic guidance during training, and Gradient-Adaptive Distillation dynamically regulated the distillation strength. GAD-MambaUNet achieves a favorable accuracy--efficiency balance compared with representative lightweight and general segmentation methods. Ablation studies further verify the effectiveness of DG-GSS and training-time DINOv3-GAD supervision. In future work, we will explore more flexible teacher--student alignment strategies and extend the proposed framework to more diverse medical segmentation scenarios, such as multi-class and multi-modal segmentation tasks.

Motivation: 紧凑分割网络的上下文建模能力受限，需要在保持轻量的同时引入结构化方向交互与基础模型语义监督。

papers.title: Does AI Save Time on Product Design? A Randomized Controlled Experiment of AI Prompt-to-Design Workflows
papers.abstract_en: AI tools for digital product design now offer prompt-to-design capabilities, allowing designers and their non-designer colleagues to create prototypes through conversational workflows with large language models (LLMs). While these tools promise time savings, experimental evidence in product design remains limited compared with evidence from software engineering. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 50 product designers and 50 product managers to evaluate prospective time savings from leveraging Figma Make in design work. Participants attempted three standardized design tasks with or without access to Figma Make. Among participants who completed the study tasks, access to Figma Make was associated with approximately 20% shorter completion times, with larger gains among product managers. Our findings suggest that prompt-to-design tools may enable product managers to further contribute to design work, while the benefits for professional designers may be task dependent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 一项随机对照实验让 50 名产品设计师与 50 名产品管理者各完成三项标准化设计任务，随机分配是否可用 Figma Make 的 prompt-to-design 工作流。在完成任务的参与者中，使用 Figma Make 与约 20% 的任务完成时间缩短相关，且产品管理者的提速更大；对专业设计师的收益则取决于具体任务。
Motivation: prompt-to-design 类 AI 工具宣称能节省时间，但相比软件工程领域，产品设计方向的实验证据仍然有限，无法判断节省是否真实、对谁更明显。
Method: 随机对照实验 (RCT)，招募 50 名产品设计师和 50 名产品产品经理共 100 人，各自完成三项标准化设计任务，处理组可用 Figma Make，对照组不可用，比较任务完成时间。
Result: 在完成全部研究任务的参与者中，可用 Figma Make 与约 20% 更短的完成时间相关；产品管理者 (product managers) 的提速幅度大于专业设计师 (product designers)。
Conclusion: prompt-to-design 工具整体上能缩短设计任务时间，但收益分布不均：它可能让产品管理者更多分担设计工作，而对专业设计师的收益是任务依赖的 (task dependent)。

papers.title: The Sirens' Song: When Proximal Background Context Overshadows Distant Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Long-context LLMs focus on retrieving distant evidence from extensive context, yet existing work has largely focused on overcoming distance alone. In this work, we identify the Proximity Trap, insufficient attention to distant evidence often arises less from distance itself than from cumulative competition with abundant, task-irrelevant proximal background. To address the Proximity Trap, we introduce LYRA (Long-context heavY-tailed Relevance Alignment), a t-distributed directional matching mechanism that reshapes the context retrieval distribution, directing more attention mass toward task-relevant evidence, while preserving the relative positional information encoded. Extensive experiments on LongBench-v2, RULER, and LongBench demonstrate consistent improvements across context lengths and task categories. We further introduce ProxBench, a multi-level fine-grained benchmark for evaluating distant evidence utilization under increasing proximal background interference. Project page: https://xiaoyuyoung.github.io/LYRA/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 长上下文 LLM 检索不到远处证据，主因不是距离本身，而是大量任务无关的近端背景累积竞争注意力（Proximity Trap）。提出 LYRA：t 分布方向匹配机制重塑检索分布，把更多注意力质量导向任务相关证据并保留相对位置信息，在 LongBench-v2、RULER、LongBench 上跨上下文长度与任务类别一致提升，并发布逐级增加近端干扰的 ProxBench。
Motivation: 现有长上下文工作主要对抗距离本身，但远处证据失效往往源于近端无关背景的累积注意力竞争，缺少衡量这种干扰的评测手段。
Method: 提出 LYRA（Long-context heavY-tailed Relevance Alignment），用 t 分布方向匹配重塑上下文检索分布，在导向任务相关证据的同时保留相对位置编码；并构建多层级细粒度基准 ProxBench，逐级增大近端背景干扰以评测远证据利用。
Result: 在 LongBench-v2、RULER、LongBench 上，LYRA 在不同上下文长度与任务类别中均带来一致改进；ProxBench 用于在递增近端背景干扰下评测远证据利用。
Conclusion: 远证据检索问题应归因于近端背景竞争而非单纯距离，重尾方向匹配的注意力重分配是可行解法，并需要专门的干扰分级基准来度量。

papers.title: TraceVIC: Causal Reasoning over Code Evolution for Identifying Vulnerability-Inducing Commits
papers.abstract_en: Software vulnerabilities are often discovered long after they are introduced, making it difficult to identify the vulnerability-inducing commit (VIC) responsible for introducing the underlying vulnerable condition. Existing VIC identification techniques largely rely on git blame to trace vulnerable code through revision history and use positional heuristics, such as selecting its earliest or most recent modification. However, the true VIC may occur anywhere within this history, and vulnerable behavior may depend on code that evolves across multiple revisions. We therefore argue that VIC identification requires reasoning about how vulnerability-relevant code evolves, rather than simply where a candidate commit appears in the revision history. We present TraceVIC, a temporal graph-based approach for identifying and ranking VICs by reasoning over code evolution. TraceVIC first localizes likely root-cause lines and traces their histories across revisions, constructing graph representations that capture program structure within each revision and the evolution of vulnerability-relevant code across the history. It reasons over the resulting revision history, using temporal edges to preserve correspondences between program elements across consecutive revisions, and directly ranks candidate commits according to their contribution to the vulnerable condition. Ablation results show that modeling the full revision history improves F2 from 0.637 to 0.814. TraceVIC improves F2 by up to 28.7% over state-of-the-art methods and identifies a valid VIC for 78 of 79 vulnerabilities across four unseen C/C++ projects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TraceVIC 用时序图对代码演化做因果推理来定位引入漏洞的 commit (VIC)：先定位疑似根因行并跨版本追踪其历史，构造刻画单版本程序结构与跨版本漏洞相关代码演化的图，用 temporal edge 保持相邻版本间程序元素的对应关系，再直接按各候选 commit 对漏洞条件的贡献排序。建模完整版本历史使 F2 从 0.637 升到 0.814，F2 较现有方法最高提升 28.7%，在四个未见过的 C/C++ 项目上对 79 个漏洞中的 78 个识别出有效 VIC。
Motivation: 现有 VIC 识别多依赖 git blame 加位置启发式（取最早或最近修改），但真正的引入 commit 可能在历史任意位置，且漏洞行为取决于跨多个版本演化的代码，位置启发式会指错 commit。
Method: TraceVIC 是基于时序图的方法：先定位可能的根因行并跨版本追踪其历史，为每个版本构造刻画程序结构的图，再用 temporal edge 连接相邻版本间的程序元素以保留漏洞相关代码的演化对应，最后在版本历史图上推理并直接对候选 commit 按其对漏洞条件的贡献排序。
Result: 建模完整版本历史把 F2 从 0.637 提高到 0.814（ablation）；F2 较 state-of-the-art 方法最高提升 28.7%；在四个未见过的 C/C++ 项目上，79 个漏洞中有 78 个识别出有效 VIC。
Conclusion: VIC 定位应当推理漏洞相关代码如何跨版本演化，而不是靠候选 commit 在修订历史中的位置；把完整版本历史纳入图模型能同时抬高 F2 并覆盖几乎全部漏洞。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Train Where the Quantized Model Goes: On-Policy Distillation for Low-Bit Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Quantization-aware distillation (QAD) restores much of the short-form question-answering performance lost to sub-3-bit quantization, yet leaves mathematical and code reasoning substantially impaired. Long generations often degenerate into repetitive loops, exhausting the decoding budget without completing a solution. We trace this gap to quantization-amplified exposure bias: QAD trains on fixed corpus prefixes, while quantization-induced deviations compound along the model's own autoregressive trajectories. To address this mismatch, we introduce an on-policy distillation (OPD) stage that places teacher supervision where the quantized model actually goes. Starting from a QAD checkpoint, the student generates through the quantized forward path used at deployment and receives feedback from a frozen full-precision teacher on its own prefixes, combining dense token-level guidance with task-verifier rewards. Across four models at 2.79 and 1.88 effective bits, OPD raises average BF16 performance retention from 35% to 70% on MATH-500 and from 66% to 91% on HumanEval while preserving short-form performance, with reasoning gains substantially exceeding those of continued teacher-forced QAD in matched-budget comparisons. By coupling QAD's stable low-bit initialization with OPD's on-policy reasoning recovery, our framework provides a comprehensive sub-3-bit solution that preserves broad capabilities while restoring long-form reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 sub-3-bit 量化后数学与代码推理崩坏、长生成退化为重复循环的问题，提出在量化前向路径上做 on-policy distillation (OPD)：从 QAD checkpoint 出发，学生按部署方式自回归生成，冻结全精度教师在其自身前缀上给出稠密 token 级引导加任务验证器奖励。在 2.79 与 1.88 有效比特的四个模型上，MATH-500 平均 BF16 性能保留率从 35% 升到 70%，HumanEval 从 66% 升到 91%，且短句性能保持不变。
Motivation: 量化感知蒸馏 (QAD) 只在固定语料前缀上训练，而量化引入的偏差沿模型自身自回归轨迹累积，导致 exposure bias 被放大：短句问答能恢复，数学与代码长推理仍严重受损并陷入重复循环。
Method: OPD 以 QAD checkpoint 为起点，学生经部署所用的量化前向路径自行生成，在其自身前缀上接收冻结全精度教师的反馈，结合稠密 token 级引导与任务验证器奖励 (task-verifier reward)，并与等预算的继续 teacher-forced QAD 对比。
Result: 在四个模型、2.79 与 1.88 有效比特设置下，MATH-500 平均 BF16 性能保留率 35% → 70%，HumanEval 66% → 91%，短句性能保持；同等预算下推理增益明显超过继续做 teacher-forced QAD。
Conclusion: QAD 的稳定低比特初始化加上 OPD 的 on-policy 推理恢复，构成 sub-3-bit 的完整方案：既保住广泛能力，又把长推理拉回可用水平。

papers.title: Optimal Sequential Annotations for Off-Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning and off-policy evaluation evaluates dynamic treatment rules based on retrospectively collected data prior to deployment. In recent AI applications, state and reward information is recorded as complex text or image, which recent AI advancements such as LLM-as-a-judge can label with unknown bias. Expert annotation may be available but at a higher cost. For example, safety classification via cheap but imperfect classifiers vs. expensive expert review. We show how a limited budget for ground-truth data-annotation can be used via doubly-robust OPE with missing rewards, and we optimize variance-optimal annotation probabilities for sequential off-policy evaluation, where the target policy value is estimated from annotated data. We characterize the optimal annotation probabilities for sequential forward-monotone annotation protocols, and provide a feasible batch-adaptive implementation. Our work is motivated by a collaboration with a homelessness services nonprofit that writes casenotes for individuals over time. Our method can be used to unlock trustworthy inference from casenote data and answer new inferential questions such as: how does expanding outreach effort over time affect progress towards a housing application and improvement in housing placement? In simulations and on two real datasets - casenotes from the nonprofit and human-preference votes from LMArena - we see reductions in RMSE of 34-65% for housing placement and 17-68% for progress towards a housing application at budgets of 40% of full annotation and above, and by 55-62% at every budget on LMArena.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在离线强化学习/序贯策略评估中，奖励缺失且只能标注有限预算时，该工作为前向单调 (forward-monotone) 标注协议推导方差最优的标注概率，并给出可实施的 batch-adaptive 版本，配合 doubly-robust OPE 从已标注数据估计目标策略价值。在 40% 及以上全标注预算下，住房安置 RMSE 降低 34-65%、住房申请进展降低 17-68%；LMArena 上在每个预算档都降低 55-62%。

papers.title: When are bosonic Gaussian states classical to learn?
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental question in physics is: When does classical behavior emerge from quantum systems? Bosonic Gaussian states provide a natural setting to explore this quantum-classical boundary, as they capture both the classical field behavior and the intrinsic quantum nature of light. Here, we address this problem from a learning-theoretic perspective by asking: When are bosonic Gaussian states classical to learn? That is, under what conditions (if any) can an n-mode bosonic Gaussian state be learned with as few samples, and with operations as simple, as are needed to learn a classical 2n-variate Gaussian distribution? We establish a smooth crossover in learnability governed by the state's thermal fluctuations: - Cold Gaussian states are non-classical to learn: When the covariance matrix satisfies $Σ\le(\frac12+O(\frac1n))I$, i.e. close to the vacuum covariance, tomography under single-copy (i.e., non-entangled) measurements fundamentally requires $Ω(n^3)$ copies, strictly exceeding the sample complexity $Θ(n^2)$ of learning classical Gaussian distributions. We show that this hardness persists even when few-copy entangled measurements are allowed. - Warm Gaussian states are classical to learn: When thermal fluctuations exceed the vacuum noise, parameterized by $Σ\ge(\frac12+ν)I$ for any parameter $ν>0$, we prove that single-copy tomography requires $N=Θ\left(n^2\min(n,1+ν^{-1})\right)$ copies. This bound is tight and is achieved by simple, non-adaptive, unentangled heterodyne measurements. Crucially, for $ν=Ω(1)$, the sample complexity drops to $Θ(n^2)$, matching the classical case. Our results tightly characterize a quantum-to-classical crossover in the learnability of bosonic Gaussian states, reveal a novel connection between fundamental physics and statistical learning theory, and have implications for real-world sensing experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从学习论角度判定 n 模 bosonic Gaussian state 何时像经典 2n 维高斯分布一样好学：冷态（Σ≤(1/2+O(1/n))I）在单拷贝测量下层析需 Ω(n³) 份拷贝，严格超过经典的 Θ(n²)，且允许少量少拷贝纠缠测量时硬度仍在；暖态（Σ≥(1/2+ν)I，ν>0）只需 N=Θ(n²min(n,1+ν⁻¹))，ν=Ω(1) 时降到 Θ(n²) 与经典持平，且由非自适应、非纠缠的 heterodyne 测量即可达到。
Motivation: 量子-经典边界缺少可量化的学习论判据：一个高斯量子态在什么条件下能用与经典高斯分布同样少的样本和同样简单的操作学会。
Method: 以协方差矩阵相对真空噪声的热涨落 ν 为分界参数，给出 bosonic Gaussian state 层析的样本复杂度上下界；区分单拷贝（非纠缠）测量与允许少拷贝纠缠测量两种模型，并构造 heterodyne 测量方案达到上界。
Result: 冷态 Σ≤(1/2+O(1/n))I 时单拷贝层析需 Ω(n³) 份拷贝，严格大于学习经典高斯分布的 Θ(n²)，且该硬度在允许少拷贝纠缠测量时仍成立；暖态 Σ≥(1/2+ν)I 时 N=Θ(n²min(n,1+ν⁻¹))，界是紧的，由非自适应非纠缠 heterodyne 测量达到；ν=Ω(1) 时样本复杂度降至 Θ(n²)，与经典情形相同。
Conclusion: bosonic Gaussian state 的可学性随热涨落平滑地从量子非经典过渡到经典，把基础物理与统计学习理论联系起来，并对真实传感实验有含义。

papers.title: Beyond Repeated Sampling: Learning Search Policies for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly tackle hard reasoning problems by spending more test-time compute, yet the dominant strategy remains naive repeated sampling: draw many independent solutions and hope one is correct. Because such sampling explores only through local decoding noise, it tends to produce many near duplicate attempts rather than genuinely different ideas. We ask whether exploration can instead be steered at a semantic level, by first sampling problem specific concepts, hints, or strategies and then conditioning answer generation on them. We refine this into a simple, more exploratory procedure that emits many diverse concepts in a single trajectory, and evaluate it on hard problems where repeated sampling struggles. We then go a step further and make concept generation trainable: a small concept generator is optimized with reinforcement learning so that its concepts maximize the downstream success of a larger, frozen answer generator. On hard mathematical reasoning problems, the trained concept generator substantially improves the answer generator's pass@k over naive repeated sampling at the same answer generation allocation, surpasses concepts drawn from much larger untuned models, and transfers to answer generators it was never trained against, including a model from a different family. A small model can thus be trained into an effective, reusable search policy for a much larger one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 困难推理中重复采样 (repeated sampling) 只靠解码噪声、产生大量近重复解法的问题，把探索上移到语义层：先采样问题相关的概念/提示/策略，再以此为条件生成答案，并用强化学习训练一个小的概念生成器，使其概念最大化冻结大答案生成器的下游成功率。在困难数学推理上，训练后的概念生成器在相同答案生成预算下显著提升 pass@k，超过来自更大未调优模型的概念，并能迁移到未参与训练的答案生成器（含不同模型家族）。
Motivation: 困难推理任务的主流测试时计算策略是独立重复采样，只靠局部解码噪声探索，容易得到近重复尝试而非真正不同的思路。
Method: 先按语义层采样问题特定的 concepts、hints 或 strategies，再条件化生成答案；进一步把概念生成做成可训练模块：一个小的概念生成器用 RL 优化，目标是让其概念最大化一个更大且冻结的答案生成器的下游成功，答案生成器本身不训练。
Result: 在困难数学推理问题上，训练后的概念生成器在相同答案生成分配下相对朴素重复采样 substantially 提升答案生成器的 pass@k，并超过来自大得多的未调优模型的概念；同时迁移到它从未训练过的答案生成器，包括来自不同模型家族的模型。
Conclusion: 小模型可以被训练成可复用的搜索策略 (search policy)，为大得多的冻结模型在测试时计算分配下提供语义层面的探索，且跨模型家族可迁移。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: DIFTA-3D: Depth-Consistent Instance-Level Feature Transfer and Adaptation of DINOv3 for 3D Detection
papers.abstract_en: RGB-D 3D instance detectors benefit from visual semantics, but the task-specific Faster R-CNN/ResNet branch used by IIFNet3D couples feature extraction to a separately trained 2D detector and its image-domain labels. Replacing that branch with a frozen vision foundation model removes this task-specific dependency, but may introduce occlusion noise and a mismatch between patch features and geometry-aware detection features. In this work, we investigate this replacement through an adaptation of DINOv3 to the instance-level fusion pipeline of IIFNet3D. At the core of our approach is a depth-consistent feature pipeline that projects scene points into calibrated RGB-D frames, applies a metric depth-residual check, averages the accepted DINOv3 features into an offline point cache, and aggregates the cached features inside proposal-aligned RoI grids. The geometric and bidirectional instance-fusion paths are preserved, while Conservative VAID is evaluated as a low-strength, support-weighted semantic distillation recipe applied only to positive RoIs. We conduct extensive evaluations on ScanNetV2 to assess the proposed transfer recipes. On ScanNetV2, our DINOv3 control achieves mAP scores of 76.15 and 60.93 at IoU thresholds of 0.25 and 0.50, respectively. The Conservative VAID setting achieves mAP scores of 76.59 and 62.16, corresponding to numerical gains of 0.44 and 1.23 points over the control, respectively, in this checkpoint-level recipe comparison. The reported IIFNet3D result of 75.7/63.8 is used only as an external reference because the visual branch and processing protocol differ. Accordingly, we interpret these results as evidence for a controlled transfer recipe rather than as a causal estimate of the individual contributions of VAID or depth filtering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 IIFNet3D 的任务专用 Faster R-CNN/ResNet 视觉分支换成冻结的 DINOv3，并用深度一致特征管线（点投影到标定 RGB-D 帧、度量深度残差检查、离线点缓存平均、RoI 网格聚合）接入实例级融合。在 ScanNetV2 上，Conservative VAID 弱强度语义蒸馏相对 DINOv3 control 把 mAP@0.25 从 76.15 提到 76.59、mAP@0.50 从 60.93 提到 62.16，即 +0.44 与 +1.23 点。作者把这解读为受控 transfer recipe 的证据，而非 VAID 或深度过滤的因果贡献。
Motivation: IIFNet3D 依赖单独训练的 2D 检测器及其图像域标签，特征提取被任务耦合；直接换成冻结基础模型又会引入遮挡噪声与 patch 特征和几何感知检测特征的错配。
Method: 把 DINOv3 适配到 IIFNet3D 的实例级融合管线：场景点投影到标定 RGB-D 帧，做度量深度残差检查，把被接受的 DINOv3 特征平均进离线点缓存，再在 proposal 对齐的 RoI 网格内聚合缓存特征；保留几何与双向实例融合路径，并只在正 RoI 上施加低强度、support-weighted 的 Conservative VAID 语义蒸馏。
Result: ScanNetV2 上 DINOv3 control 的 mAP 为 76.15（IoU 0.25）与 60.93（IoU 0.50）；Conservative VAID 为 76.59 与 62.16，分别高出 0.44 与 1.23 点。IIFNet3D 报告的 75.7/63.8 仅作外部参考，因视觉分支与处理协议不同。
Conclusion: 冻结 DINOv3 加深度一致特征管线配合 Conservative VAID 是一个有效的受控 transfer recipe，但这些数字不构成对 VAID 或深度过滤各自贡献的因果估计。

papers.title: Measuring the Serving Stack Instead of the Model: Hidden Confounds in Local Tool-Use Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: A coding agent must emit a valid tool call--a parseable invocation of a tool in the provided schema--before the harness can execute its chosen action. We study how local serving stacks affect this protocol step and show that measured outcomes can depend on the serving layer rather than model behavior alone. In Ollama, the default tools= request is gated per model by a static template flag: some models are accepted and return calls as text, some return native tool_calls, while Phi-3 and Gemma-3 are rejected before inference. In our harness, rejection and retry exhaustion are not preserved as structured failure metadata, so downstream analysis can misclassify them as model non-calls and naively report 0% fidelity. Adding a text tool list while retaining the native channel recovers much of the measured fidelity for accepted models, whereas a uniform text protocol reduces fidelity for Llama-3.2, which has native tool-call support. Cross-stack probes on Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, and SGLang show different handling of the same request. Constrained decoding removes parse failures but can induce non-termination, and turn-pooled versus per-instance estimates differ by up to about 55 points. We conclude with a checklist for treating serving behavior as part of the evaluation protocol.

TL;DR: 本地工具调用评测测到的其实是 serving stack 而非模型本身：Ollama 用静态 template flag 按模型放行 tools= 请求，Phi-3 与 Gemma-3 在推理前就被拒绝，而 harness 不保留拒绝与重试耗尽的结构化元数据，于是下游会把它们误判为模型不发调用并报出 0% fidelity。给已接受的模型补一份文本工具列表可大幅找回 fidelity，但对原生支持 tool-call 的 Llama-3.2 改用统一文本协议反而降低 fidelity；跨 Ollama、llama.cpp、vLLM、SGLang 的探针显示同一请求处理不同，constrained decoding 消除解析失败却可能不终止，turn-pooled 与 per-instance 估计相差最多约 55 个百分点。
Motivation: 本地 serving 层对 tool-call 协议的处理差异会污染 agent 评测结论：拒绝与重试耗尽被当成模型不发调用，fidelity 指标因此失真，读者无法区分模型能力与服务栈行为。
Method: 在 Ollama 上检查 tools= 请求的静态 template flag 门控，记录各模型返回文本调用、原生 tool_calls 或推理前被拒；在自建 harness 中追踪拒绝与重试耗尽的元数据处理，并对比补文本工具列表、统一文本协议、constrained decoding 等配置；再用同一请求跨 Ollama、llama.cpp、vLLM、SGLang 做探针，比较 turn-pooled 与 per-instance 两种估计。
Result: Phi-3 与 Gemma-3 在 Ollama 推理前被拒；拒绝与重试耗尽被下游误判为模型 non-calls 并可报出 0% fidelity；补文本工具列表可为已接受模型大幅找回 fidelity，而统一文本协议降低 Llama-3.2 的 fidelity；constrained decoding 消除 parse failure 但可诱发 non-termination；turn-pooled 与 per-instance 估计相差最多约 55 个百分点；跨 Ollama、llama.cpp、vLLM、SGLang 对同一请求处理不同。
Conclusion: serving 行为必须作为评测协议的一部分来处理，作者以一份 checklist 收尾，要求把服务栈差异显式纳入本地 tool-use 评测。

papers.title: PROSWIN: Probabilistic Solar Wind Speed Forecasting Using Deep Distributional Regression From Solar Images
papers.abstract_en: Accurately predicting fast solar wind conditions is challenging, as uncertainties are large and unquantified by traditional single-value prediction models. In particular, the risks of high-speed solar wind streams (HSSs), which can cause damage to technological infrastructure, cannot be reliably assessed without probabilistic forecasts. We present PROSWIN, a probabilistic machine learning model that forecasts the hourly solar wind speed (SWS) at Earth with a four-day lead time. The approach combines solar images and magnetograms using a deep neural network coupled to a distributional regression algorithm. Because standard error metrics underweight the relevance of HSS peaks, we further introduce the prediction score, a model-selection metric that jointly rewards timeline and HSS peak accuracy. On 14 years of data, our forecast achieves very well-calibrated uncertainties (<1% average deviation). Using the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS), a metric that assesses distributional accuracy, we obtain a timeline CRPS of 41.0 km/s, an HSS peak CRPS of 45.3 km/s, and a prediction score of 42.3 km/s. We find that the 171 Å channel is an important complement to the typically used 193 Å and 211 Å channels and that the prediction score for model selection improves the applicability of the model. Compared to selected models from the literature, ours is the only one that is accurate for both timeline and HSS peak values, rather than trading one off against the other. These results support the advantages of probabilistic over single-value solar wind models. The introduced methods are also transferable to other forecasting problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PROSWIN 用太阳图像与磁图经深度神经网络接分布式回归 (distributional regression)，输出地球处逐小时太阳风速的四天提前期概率预报，并新提出同时奖励时间线与高速流 (HSS) 峰值精度的 prediction score 作模型选择指标。在 14 年数据上不确定性校准平均偏差 <1%，时间线 CRPS 41.0 km/s、HSS 峰值 CRPS 45.3 km/s、prediction score 42.3 km/s；与文献模型相比是唯一在时间线和 HSS 峰值上同时准确、而非互相取舍的一个。
Motivation: 传统单值模型无法量化太阳风预报的大不确定性，高速流 (HSS) 对技术基础设施的风险因此无法可靠评估；而标准误差指标又低估 HSS 峰值的相关性。
Method: 把太阳图像与磁图 (magnetograms) 送入深度神经网络，再接分布式回归算法，输出地球处逐小时太阳风速 (SWS) 的四天提前期预报分布；同时提出 prediction score 作为联合奖励时间线与 HSS 峰值精度的模型选择指标。
Result: 在 14 年数据上，不确定性校准极好（平均偏差 <1%）；时间线 CRPS 41.0 km/s，HSS 峰值 CRPS 45.3 km/s，prediction score 42.3 km/s。171 Å 通道被发现是常用 193 Å 与 211 Å 通道的重要补充；相比文献中选定模型，本模型是唯一同时在时间线与 HSS 峰值上准确的。
Conclusion: 概率式太阳风模型优于单值模型，且用 prediction score 做模型选择能提升适用性；所引入的方法可迁移到其他预报问题。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: From Alignment to Access Control: A Framework for GenAI Policy Enforcement
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI (GenAI) applications have flourished enabling users to chat with large language models, and to create agents to act on their behalf for a variety of tasks. The pace of development of capabilities in this field is incredibly fast with security and safety taking a back seat. Unfortunately, the slower pace at which security and safety mechanisms have evolved has led to real incidents. Policy enables the definition of desirable behavior of applications, and for that reason, it is a cornerstone of making systems secure and compliant. Policy however means different things to different practitioners creating confusion and siloed solutions that are not adequate for compliance. This paper takes a tour of the good, the bad and the ugly when it comes to policy enforcement in GenAI applications. We propose a methodology to systematically analyze and dissect existing approaches to define and enforce policy found in the wild. Based on this principled analysis, we provide recommendations and call for action for the community to address. This paper is a companion extension of USENIX Security 2026 Enigma talk titled "From Alignment to Access Control: A Unified View of GenAI Policy Enforcement" by the author Nathalie Baracaldo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一套方法论，用于系统拆解野外 GenAI 应用中定义与执行 policy 的现有做法，指出 policy 一词在不同从业者含义不同导致方案割裂、不足以支撑合规，并基于该分析给出面向社区的建议与行动呼吁。
Motivation: GenAI 能力发展远快于安全与安全机制的演进，已造成真实事故；同时 policy 概念在从业者间含义分裂、方案各自为政，无法满足合规需求。
Method: 提出一套方法论，系统分析与拆解野外发现的 policy 定义与执行方法；基于该分析给出建议。论文是 USENIX Security 2026 Enigma talk 同名演讲的扩展配套文。
Result: 给出对 GenAI policy enforcement 现有做法的结构化梳理（good/bad/ugly 分类）与基于原则性分析的社区建议；摘要未给出实验数字。
Conclusion: GenAI 的 policy 需要从 alignment 统一到 access control 的共同视图，社区应据此收敛定义与执行方式以支撑安全与合规。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Spectral Theory of Grokking: Weight Decay induces Feature Learning
papers.abstract_en: In grokking an early fit to the training data separates from a much later improvement in generalization. During this delay, training can move from a fixed neural tangent kernel (NTK) regime to one in which task-relevant kernel eigendirections continue to evolve. We provide a quantitative theory for how this transition from lazy to rich learning can produce delayed generalization. For homogeneous networks trained with squared loss and $L_2$ weight decay, we show that a finite residual remains after memorization, with larger residual fractions in target components associated with smaller NTK eigenvalues. These residuals feed back into the dynamics of the NTK itself, and projecting the resulting dynamics onto task-relevant spectral directions yields a reduced system in which residual-driven kernel growth competes with weight decay. This system predicts that the grokking timescale is controlled by the product of learning rate and weight decay, that feature learning slows logarithmically near a critical decay above which task-aligned NTK structure can no longer support generalization, and that stronger decay can prevent fitting altogether. We test these predictions in modular addition. In a homogeneous MLP, task-aligned Fourier structure continues to emerge in the NTK after training accuracy has saturated, and an 84$\times$90-grid of trained networks across varying learning rate and weight decay recovers the predicted phase geometry and inverse-product scaling of the generalization time with learning rate and weight decay. A one-block Transformer shows similar macroscopic phase structure in a 42$\times$45-grid, as well as the same transition-time scaling despite violating exact homogeneity. Together, these results provide a mechanistic derivation connecting post-fit feature learning to both the onset of generalization and its phase structure in the learning rate and weight decay plane.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 grokking 给出谱理论：同构网络配平方损失与 L2 权重衰减时，记忆化后仍留有残差，残差反馈驱动 NTK 沿任务相关谱方向增长，与权重衰减竞争，从而产生延迟泛化。理论预测 grokking 时间尺度由学习率与权重衰减的乘积控制、在临界衰减附近特征学习对数变慢、更强衰减会阻止拟合；modular addition 上 84×90 与 42×45 的网格复现了该相图几何与反比乘积标度。
Motivation: grokking 中训练精度早早饱和、泛化却大幅滞后，缺少把 lazy 到 rich 学习转变与泛化出现时刻定量联系起来的机制理论。
Method: 对同构网络 + 平方损失 + L2 权重衰减，证明记忆化后存在有限残差（NTK 特征值越小的目标分量残差比例越大），把残差驱动的 NTK 动力学投影到任务相关谱方向，得到“残差驱动核增长 vs 权重衰减”的约化系统；在 modular addition 上用同构 MLP 与单块 Transformer 检验。
Result: 同构 MLP 中训练精度饱和后 NTK 仍持续涌现任务对齐的 Fourier 结构；84×90（学习率×权重衰减）网格复现预测的相几何与泛化时间对学习率×权重衰减的反乘积标度；单块 Transformer 在 42×45 网格上给出相同宏观相结构与相同转变时间标度，尽管它不满足严格同构。
Conclusion: 拟合后的特征学习可机制性地导出泛化的起始时刻及其在学习率–权重衰减平面上的相结构，且该标度对违反严格同构的架构仍成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MAGIC: Mixed-Granularity Agent Graphs via Incremental Construction with Dense-Reward Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Collaboration topology shapes both the performance and execution cost of LLM-based multi-agent systems. Because tasks differ in complexity and required capabilities, recent approaches generate task-specific collaboration graphs that specify agent participation and information flow. However, representative topology generators use either individual agents or predefined groups throughout an organization, overlooking differing collaboration needs across subtasks. Our key insight is to select granularity locally for each functional role, combining fine-grained control with reusable collaboration patterns within one organization. Learning such organizations requires exploring a combinatorial construction space with limited intermediate feedback from final-answer rewards. Therefore, we propose MAGIC, a dense-reward reinforcement learning framework for mixed-granularity graph generation. Specifically, MAGIC constructs a mixed-granularity agent graph by sequentially selecting a functional role, instantiating it as a single agent or reusable group, and connecting it to existing units. We directly optimize the construction policy using returns from trajectories sampled under the current policy and use potential-based reward shaping to provide intermediate feedback from probe-based utility and structural signals while preserving the cumulative task reward. MAGIC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across eight benchmarks and demonstrates strong inference efficiency in our efficiency study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAGIC 用稠密奖励强化学习逐单元构造混合粒度多智能体图：每步先选功能角色，再决定实例化为单个 agent 还是可复用 group，最后接入已有单元；用 potential-based reward shaping 把 probe-based utility 与结构信号转成中间反馈，同时保持累计任务奖励不变。在八个 benchmark 上超过 SOTA 基线，并在效率研究中表现出强推理效率。
Motivation: 现有任务特定协作图生成器要么全程用单个 agent、要么全程用预定义 group，忽略不同子任务对协作粒度的差异需求；而构造空间是组合式的，最终答案奖励提供的中间反馈又极少。
Method: MAGIC 是面向混合粒度图生成的 dense-reward RL 框架：顺序执行「选功能角色 → 实例化为单 agent 或可复用 group → 连接到已有单元」的构造动作；直接用当前策略采样轨迹的回报优化构造策略，并用 potential-based reward shaping 注入 probe-based utility 与结构信号作为中间反馈，同时保持累计任务奖励。
Result: 在八个 benchmark 上优于 SOTA 基线，并在效率研究中展示出强推理效率（abstract 未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 按功能角色在组织内局部选择粒度，把细粒度控制与可复用协作模式放进同一组织是可行的；稠密塑形奖励能在保留累计任务奖励的前提下缓解组合构造空间的中间反馈稀疏问题。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 按功能角色在组织内局部选择粒度，把细粒度控制与可复用协作模式放进同一组织是可行的；稠密塑形奖励能在保留累计任务奖励的前提下缓解组合构造空间的中间反馈稀疏问题。

papers.title: Longitudinal Retinal Vascular Remodeling in Myopic Children Treated with Orthokeratology or Defocus Lenses: A Two-Year Comparative Study
papers.abstract_en: Purposes: To characterize longitudinal retinal vascular changes in myopic children treated with orthokeratology (OK) or multifocal defocus lenses (Defocus) and to examine their association with axial elongation. Methods: In this retrospective cohort study, 43 myopic children underwent comprehensive clinical examination and fundus photography at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Axial length (AL) and spherical equivalent refraction (SER) were recorded at baseline, 6, 12, and 24 months. An automated segmentation model extracted vascular parameters, main vessel angle (MA), branching angle (BA), bifurcation edge angle (BEA), crossover point (COP), and terminal vessel count (TVC). Repeated-measures ANOVA assessed temporal changes. Pearson or Spearman correlations evaluated associations between AL and vascular metrics. Results: Over 24 months, the OK group exhibited significantly slower axial elongation than the Defocus group (0.214 mm and 0.522 mm, p < 0.01). In the OK group, MA and BA decreased modestly, BEA in arteries declined gradually, but COP and TVC remained relatively stable. The Defocus group demonstrated more pronounced decreases in MA and BA, an increase in BEA, and significant reductions in COP and TVC (p < 0.05). Correlation analysis revealed stronger associations between AL and vascular parameters, especially COP and TVC, in the Defocus group at all time points, whereas only BA and BEA correlated with AL in the OK group. Conclusions: OK lenses mitigate axial elongation and induce milder retinal vascular remodeling compared to Defocus lenses. Distinct temporal patterns of vascular metrics changes were observed between the two interventions, and correlate differentially with axial growth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 43 名近视儿童两年随访显示，角膜塑形镜 (OK) 组眼轴增长 0.214 mm，显著低于多焦点离焦镜 (Defocus) 组的 0.522 mm (p < 0.01)；OK 组视网膜血管参数 (MA、BA、动脉 BEA) 仅轻度下降且 COP、TVC 稳定，而 Defocus 组 MA、BA、COP、TVC 显著下降、BEA 上升 (p < 0.05)。结论是 OK 在延缓眼轴的同时只引起更温和的视网膜血管重塑。
Motivation: 近视干预会改变眼轴，但两种主流光学干预下视网膜血管的纵向重塑轨迹及其与眼轴增长的关联尚不清楚，无法判断血管指标能否作为眼轴进展的伴随标志。
Method: 回顾性队列，43 名近视儿童在基线、12、24 个月做眼底照相，基线/6/12/24 个月记录眼轴 (AL) 与等效球镜度 (SER)；用自动分割模型提取主血管角 (MA)、分支角 (BA)、分叉边缘角 (BEA)、交叉点 (COP)、终末血管计数 (TVC)，重复测量方差分析检验时间变化，Pearson/Spearman 相关评估 AL 与血管指标关联。
Result: 24 个月 OK 组眼轴增长 0.214 mm vs Defocus 组 0.522 mm (p < 0.01)。OK 组 MA、BA 小幅下降、动脉 BEA 渐降、COP 与 TVC 基本稳定；Defocus 组 MA、BA 降幅更大、BEA 上升、COP 与 TVC 显著减少 (p < 0.05)。AL 与血管参数的相关在 Defocus 组各时点均更强（尤其 COP、TVC），OK 组仅 BA、BEA 与 AL 相关。
Conclusion: OK 镜片在延缓眼轴增长的同时只引起比离焦镜更轻的视网膜血管重塑，两类干预的血管指标时间模式不同且与眼轴增长的关联方式也不同。
