papers.title: Discovery-Driven Integration of Disjoint Tables via Text
papers.abstract_en: Integrating heterogeneous datasets within data lakes is a critical challenge, particularly for semantically related tables that lack the explicit attributes needed to be joined. We study Discovery-Driven Integration, where the relevant sources and their missing relational structure must be discovered before integration. In this setting, unstructured text provides the evidence that connects otherwise disjoint tables. The fundamental challenge is to discover the relationships at a fine-grained level that connect individual rows from different tables through specific sentences. We formalize this task as Text-Mediated Join Path Discovery and propose a horizontal bidirectional cross-attention architecture called LOKI Latent-space Optimization for Knowledge Integration) that learns contextualized representations of table rows and sentences. Through a global table-text contrastive objective, fine-grained row-sentence associations emerge without explicit local supervision. Existing multi-modal discovery methods largely retrieve coarse-grained column-text associations, whereas integration systems assume supplied row-text links, schemas, or queries. LOKI instead transforms these implicit associations into explicit, interpretable join paths, organizes them into relation-consistent groups, and materializes them as typed integrated tables with sentence-level provenance. Comprehensive evaluations on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that LOKI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-modal data discovery approaches, and materializes typed integrated tables with 0.982 macro typed-pair precision while being up to 40 times cheaper in LLM API cost than direct prompting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Text-Mediated Join Path Discovery 任务与 LOKI（Latent-space Optimization for Knowledge Integration）：用横向双向交叉注意力学习表行与句子的上下文表示，靠全局表-文本对比目标让细粒度 row-sentence 关联自发涌现，再把隐式关联转成显式可解释 join path 并物化为带句子级 provenance 的类型化集成表。在真实基准上宏类型对精度达 0.982，LLM API 成本比直接提示最多低 40 倍。
Motivation: 数据湖中语义相关但缺少可连接属性的异构表难以集成：现有方法要么只做粗粒度列-文本检索，要么假设已给出行-文本链接、schema 或查询，细粒度行级关系无从发现。
Method: 形式化 Text-Mediated Join Path Discovery 任务，提出横向双向交叉注意力架构 LOKI，学习表行与句子的上下文表示；用全局表-文本对比目标 (global table-text contrastive objective) 在无局部监督下诱导细粒度 row-sentence 关联，再将关联组织为关系一致的分组并物化为类型化集成表。
Result: 在真实世界基准上持续优于 SOTA 多模态数据发现方法；物化的类型化集成表宏类型对精度 (macro typed-pair precision) 为 0.982，LLM API 成本比直接提示 (direct prompting) 最多低 40 倍。
Conclusion: 细粒度行-句子关联可以在无显式局部监督下通过对比目标涌现，并被转成显式、可解释且带 provenance 的 join path，从而在远低于直接提示的成本下完成类型化表集成。

papers.title: Context-Adaptive Thresholding for Conditionally Representative Monitoring and Classification
papers.abstract_en: Commonly, classifiers and monitoring procedures are trained from labeled data by optimizing an objective such as the misclassification rate. This may lead to unrepresentative conditional distributions of the outcome (the labels) given important external variables, different from the conditional laws in the population. We show how to modify any given threshold-type classifier resp. monitoring rule to achieve representative conditional label prediction by using adapting the threshold to a covariate $Z$ (the context) to distribute sensitivity while maintaining the false alarm rate. In case that the alarm event is unknown, this approach also allows to (approximately) infer the event in terms of a thresholding rule. The approach is implemented by a computationally cheap nonparametric estimation procedure, and its properties are studied in terms of nonasymptotic error bounds and asymptotic distribution theory including empirical process theory. These results allow to construct uniform confidence bands, functional hypothesis tests and change-detection procedures. For the well known FICOS credit scoring example, often used in interpretable machine learning, threshold adaptation leads to an easily interpretable decision rule which can compete with state of the art methods including transformers, in terms of common classification metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把任意阈值型分类器或监控规则的阈值改成协变量 Z 的函数，在保持误报率不变的前提下重新分配灵敏度，使给定外部变量的标签条件分布逼近总体条件分布。理论给出非渐近误差界、渐近分布与一致置信带，可导出函数型假设检验与变点检测；在 FICUS/FICO 信用评分示例上，阈值自适应得到的可解释规则在常用分类指标上可与含 transformer 的先进方法竞争。
Motivation: 按误分类率等目标在标注数据上训练的分类器与监控程序，会让标签给定重要外部变量的条件分布偏离总体条件分布，即条件代表性缺失。
Method: 对给定阈值型分类器或监控规则做阈值自适应：阈值随上下文协变量 Z 变化，以在维持误报率的同时分配灵敏度；报警事件未知时可用阈值规则近似推断该事件。实现用计算量小的非参数估计程序，理论分析走非渐近误差界、渐近分布理论与经验过程理论 (empirical process theory)。
Result: 由这些结果可构造一致置信带 (uniform confidence bands)、函数型假设检验与变点检测程序；在常用于可解释机器学习的 FICO 信用评分示例上，阈值自适应给出易解释的决策规则，在常用分类指标上可与含 transformer 在内的先进方法竞争。
Conclusion: 阈值随上下文自适应即可在保持误报率的条件下修复条件代表性，且得到的规则仍可解释、性能可对标先进方法。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: ROAM-ASD: Robust Open-World Active Speaker Detection with Flexible Multimodal Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Active speaker detection (ASD) requires reliable association between visible faces and acoustic speech, yet existing systems often degrade under challenging domains or incomplete observations. We introduce ROAM-ASD, a robust audiovisual framework that jointly models audio, full-face, and fine-grained mouth representations. A unified joint self-attention mechanism processes all input streams together with modality-agnostic query tokens, enabling direct interaction among available modality inputs. Modality dropout further improves robustness when input streams are unavailable. ROAM-ASD achieves state-of-the-art performance across five ASD benchmarks: 98.8% mAP on WASD, 87.9% on UniTalk, 96.5% on AVA, 99.3% on ASW, and 98.2% on Talkies, improving over previous best systems by 5.1, 4.7, 0.9, 1.0, and 2.1 mAP points, respectively. ROAM-ASD also substantially improves zero-shot cross-dataset generalization and remains robust to missing observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROAM-ASD 用统一的 joint self-attention 与 modality-agnostic query token 联合建模音频、全脸与细粒度嘴部表征，配合 modality dropout，使缺失模态时仍能关联可见人脸与声学语音。在五个 ASD 基准上取得 SOTA：WASD 98.8%、UniTalk 87.9%、AVA 96.5%、ASW 99.3%、Talkies 98.2% mAP，较此前最好系统分别高 5.1、4.7、0.9、1.0、2.1 mAP 点。
Motivation: 现有主动发言检测 (ASD) 系统在困难域或观测不完整（模态缺失）时性能明显退化，人脸与语音的可靠关联不稳定。
Method: ROAM-ASD 框架联合建模音频、全脸与细粒度嘴部三路表征：统一的 joint self-attention 用 modality-agnostic query token 一次性处理全部输入流，让可用模态直接交互；训练中加入 modality dropout，随机丢弃输入流以提升模态缺失时的鲁棒性。
Result: 五个 ASD 基准 mAP：WASD 98.8%、UniTalk 87.9%、AVA 96.5%、ASW 99.3%、Talkies 98.2%，较此前最佳系统分别提升 5.1、4.7、0.9、1.0、2.1 mAP 点；零样本跨数据集泛化显著提升，并在观测缺失时保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: 统一的多模态联合注意力加 modality dropout 能同时拿到 SOTA 的 ASD 精度、零样本跨域泛化与缺失模态鲁棒性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Statistical Rates for Entropic Optimal Transport in the Discrete to SubGaussian Regime
papers.abstract_en: We study statistical rates in entropic optimal transport in the semi-discrete regime where one measure has finite support and the other is subGaussian. Our main result establishes parametric convergence rates for the empirical dual potentials to their population counterparts, with no dimension dependence in the leading term. Our result relies on tailored strong concavity analysis of the semi-dual objective, coupled with specialized bounds for the semi-discrete potentials. As a consequence, we obtain fast rates for downstream quantities derived from the optimal coupling. Chiefly, the empirical barycentric projection achieves a squared-error rate $n^{-1}$, matching the fully compact case and improving over the less favorable $n^{-1/2}$ rate known for fully subGaussian settings. Altogether, these results may indicate a lower complexity adaptation phenomenon whereby the statistical complexity of the barycentric projection is governed by the discrete measure. As an application, we analyze Sinkhorn-EM, an EM-type algorithm in which the E-step is replaced by an entropic optimal transport problem. In a well-specified and balanced two-component Gaussian mixture model, we prove $\sqrt{n}$-consistency of the empirical iterates to their population counterparts for any fixed number of iterations, matching classical EM rates up to a $\sqrt{\log n}$ factor. Simulations support the theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究半离散熵最优传输（entropic optimal transport）的统计速率：一测度有限支撑、另一测度 subGaussian 时，经验对偶势以无主项维数依赖的参数速率收敛到总体，重心投影平方误差达 n^{-1}，优于全 subGaussian 情形的 n^{-1/2}。在良设定且平衡的两成分高斯混合上，Sinkhorn-EM 经任意固定迭代次数后经验迭代量对总体 √n-相合，仅差 √(log n) 因子。
Motivation: 半离散与全 subGaussian 混合设定下，对偶势与由最优耦合导出的下游量（如重心投影）的统计速率此前缺少无维数依赖的参数级刻画。
Method: 对半对偶目标做定制的强凹性分析，配合对半离散势的专门界，推导经验对偶势的参数收敛速率；作为应用，分析把 E 步替换为熵最优传输问题的 Sinkhorn-EM 算法，并在良设定、平衡的两成分高斯混合模型中证明固定迭代次数下经验迭代量的 √n-相合性。
Result: 经验对偶势到总体的收敛为主项无维数依赖的参数速率；经验重心投影平方误差速率 n^{-1}，与全紧支撑情形一致，并优于全 subGaussian 情形已知的 n^{-1/2}；Sinkhorn-EM 在两成分高斯混合上任意固定迭代次数后 √n-相合，与经典 EM 速率仅差 √(log n) 因子；辅以模拟支持理论。
Conclusion: 重心投影的统计复杂度可能由离散测度主导，呈现一种更低复杂度的适应现象；半离散结构使熵最优传输的下游量获得比全 subGaussian 更快的速率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 研究半离散熵最优传输（entropic optimal transport）的统计速率：一测度有限支撑、另一测度 subGaussian 时，经验对偶势以无主项维数依赖的参数速率收敛到总体，重心投影平方误差达 n^{-1}，优于全 subGaussian 情形的 n^{-1/2}。在良设定且平衡的两成分高斯混合上，Sinkhorn-EM 经任意固定迭代次数后经验迭代量对总体 √n-相合，仅差 √(log n) 因子。
summary_sections.motivation: 半离散与全 subGaussian 混合设定下，对偶势与由最优耦合导出的下游量（如重心投影）的统计速率此前缺少无维数依赖的参数级刻画。
summary_sections.method: 对半对偶目标做定制的强凹性分析，配合对半离散势的专门界，推导经验对偶势的参数收敛速率；作为应用，分析把 E 步替换为熵最优传输问题的 Sinkhorn-EM 算法，并在良设定、平衡的两成分高斯混合模型中证明固定迭代次数下经验迭代量的 √n-相合性。

papers.title: The Delegation Blind Spot: Auditing Product Decisions from Agent Choices
papers.abstract_en: Successful agent execution need not identify which future product improvement its user would value. We present a decision-specific audit that maps a declared observation channel and product-value contrast to compatible intervals and witness populations. Its foundations are established identification and decision theory; the contribution is an executable measurement workflow and a controlled study of its limits. A frozen experiment makes 4,800 requests to two pinned model snapshots on shared synthetic tasks. All 36 conservative primary intervals remain unresolved despite different execution accuracy. An exploratory 2,400-call follow-up records supplied preferences and resolves three of nine comparisons per model. A deterministic extractor resolves seven of nine without model calls or calibration observations, exposing unnecessary uncertainty introduced by model-generated reports. A further 14,400 controlled multinomial simulations distinguish structural ambiguity from weak identification and finite calibration precision. We propose a source-labeled decision receipt and provide an offline viewer for inspecting the audit. These results motivate preserving decision-relevant structured input and diagnosing why a decision is unresolved before collecting more telemetry. The study contains no human participants or real customer outcomes. Full proofs, raw model provenance, controlled experiments, and reproducible analyses accompany the report.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures. Computational technical report with proofs and synthetic-task experiments; no human participants. Code: https://github.com/shi1720/delegation-blind-spot
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种针对 agent 执行结果的决策审计流程：把声明的观测通道与产品价值对比映射为兼容区间与 witness populations，判定某个产品改进决策能否被数据识别。冻结实验对两个固定模型快照发 4,800 次请求，36 个保守主区间全部 unresolved；探索性 2,400 次调用补上 supplied preferences 后每个模型只解开 9 个对比中的 3 个，而无需调用模型的确定性 extractor 解开 7/9，说明模型生成的报告本身引入了不必要的不确定性。
Motivation: agent 执行成功并不意味着知道用户会看重哪个未来产品改进；现有依赖模型生成报告的度量流程会把本可识别的决策变成 unresolved，需要先诊断决策为何未决再收集更多 telemetry。
Method: 基于既有的 identification 与 decision theory，构建可执行的测量工作流：把观测通道与 product-value contrast 映射为兼容区间和 witness populations；冻结实验在共享合成任务上对两个 pinned model snapshot 发 4,800 次请求，另有确定性 extractor（不调用模型、不用校准观测）与 14,400 次受控 multinomial 模拟，用以区分 structural ambiguity、weak identification 与 finite calibration precision；提出 source-labeled decision receipt 并附离线 viewer。
Result: 36 个保守主区间在执行准确率不同的情况下全部 unresolved；探索性 2,400 次调用记录 supplied preferences，每个模型各解开 9 个对比中的 3 个；确定性 extractor 无模型调用解开 7/9；另有 14,400 次受控 multinomial 模拟区分结构性歧义与弱识别、有限校准精度。研究不含人类参与者与真实客户结果。
Conclusion: 决策未决往往来自不必要的报告不确定性而非数据不足，应保留决策相关的结构化输入，并在收集更多 telemetry 之前先诊断决策为何 unresolved。

papers.title: Diffusion Drafts, AR Verifies: Accelerating Document OCR with Self-Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive OCR vision-language models accurately convert document images into text and structured markup, but require one sequential decoding step per output token, limiting inference speed. Unlike open-ended text generation, OCR outputs are strongly grounded in the input image, making diffusion-based parallel generation promising. However, when several tokens are predicted in one diffusion step, each is predicted before the others are known. Committing them directly can therefore introduce errors. We therefore introduce GravityOCR, a parameter-shared AR-block-diffusion model jointly trained for parallel drafting and causal AR verification. Verifying drafts before commitment lets the model commit multiple output tokens per round without a separate drafting network. The causal AR path also enables GRPO with sequence- and structure-level OCR rewards, avoiding diffusion-trajectory likelihood estimation while updating the shared drafter parameters. On OmniDocBench v1.6, AR-path GRPO improves the Overall score from 94.92 to 95.16 without reducing diffusion drafting efficiency, while the final model remains close to the original GLM-OCR score of 95.48. In an SGLang serving deployment, GravityOCR commits an average of 9.7 output tokens per forward pass and achieves a $3.94\times$ decode-only speedup on region crops and a $1.32\times$ end-to-end page-processing speedup over AR decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GravityOCR 把参数共享的 AR-block-diffusion 模型同时用于并行起草与因果 AR 校验，草稿先校验再提交，从而每轮提交多个 token 而无需独立起草网络。在 OmniDocBench v1.6 上 AR 路径 GRPO 将 Overall 从 94.92 提到 95.16，SGLang 部署中每次前向平均提交 9.7 个 token，解码阶段在区域裁剪上提速 3.94×、整页端到端提速 1.32×。
Motivation: 自回归 OCR VLM 每个输出 token 需一次串行解码，推理慢；而 OCR 输出强依赖输入图像，扩散可并行生成，但同一扩散步内各 token 彼此未知，直接提交会引入错误。
Method: 提出参数共享的 AR-block-diffusion 模型 GravityOCR，联合训练并行起草与因果 AR 校验，草稿提交前先校验；用因果 AR 路径做 GRPO，奖励含序列级与结构级 OCR 信号，绕开扩散轨迹似然估计，同时更新共享起草参数。
Result: OmniDocBench v1.6 上 AR-path GRPO 使 Overall 从 94.92 升至 95.16，且不损失扩散起草效率，最终模型接近 GLM-OCR 的 95.48；SGLang 部署中每次前向平均提交 9.7 个 token，区域裁剪解码阶段 3.94× 加速，整页端到端 1.32× 加速（对比 AR 解码）。
Conclusion: 先校验后提交的自投机解码 (self-speculative decoding) 让单个共享模型同时承担起草与验证，可在保持 OCR 精度的同时把解码速度提上去。

papers.title: Capable yet Parsimonious: Extracting and Characterizing Hidden Chain-of-Thought in Frontier Models
papers.abstract_en: The rapid capability gains of frontier language models are widely attributed to improved reasoning abilities, yet this cannot be verified as raw CoT traces in closed-source systems are hidden. By registering a simple custom tool through a standard API feature, we induce frontier models to externalize intermediate reasoning. Because these traces may reflect post-hoc rationalization rather than genuine reasoning, we first evaluate against native CoT on open-source models and extend to closed-source frontier models including GPT-6 Astra. We find that the extracted reasoning matches native reasoning performance and substantially outperforms no-reasoning baselines, across competition mathematics, science, and code generation. We then characterize how frontier models structure their intermediate reasoning. Across token efficiency, reasoning-step types, and induced reasoning trees, we identify systematic differences in how models externalize, compress, and organize reasoning. We find that Astra exhibits token-efficient directed reasoning, selecting a correct trajectory earlier, while resolving elementary steps internally and externalizing only crucial reasoning. These findings provide a behavioral lens on frontier-model reasoning beyond benchmark scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通过在标准 API 上注册一个自定义工具，诱导闭源前沿模型把隐藏的中间推理外化出来，得到可提取的 hidden chain-of-thought。抽出的推理在竞赛数学、科学与代码生成上匹配开源模型的原生 CoT 性能，并大幅超过不外化推理的基线；GPT-6 Astra 表现出 token 高效的有向推理，更早选中正确轨迹、把初等步骤留在内部。
Motivation: 前沿模型的能力提升被归因于推理变强，但闭源系统的原始 CoT 被隐藏，无法直接验证；且外化痕迹可能是事后合理化而非真实推理。
Method: 通过标准 API 特性注册一个简单自定义工具，诱导模型外化中间推理；先在开源模型上与原生 CoT 对照以检验痕迹是否反映真实推理，再扩展到含 GPT-6 Astra 的闭源前沿模型；随后从 token 效率、推理步骤类型、诱导出的推理树三个维度刻画外化结构。
Result: 抽出的推理匹配原生推理性能，并在竞赛数学、科学与代码生成上大幅优于 no-reasoning 基线；Astra 展现 token 高效的有向推理，更早选出正确轨迹，把初等步骤在内部解决、只外化关键推理。
Conclusion: 自定义工具诱导出的 hidden CoT 可作为观察前沿模型真实推理的行为学透镜，其外化、压缩与组织方式存在系统性模型差异，比单看 benchmark 分数提供更多结构信息。

papers.title: Laryngeal Structure Segmentation in High-Speed Videoendoscopy Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Laryngeal high-speed videoendoscopy (HSV) offers an effective means of observing the motion of different laryngeal structures along with vibratory behaviors of the vocal folds under various voicing conditions. Segmentation of laryngeal tissues enables analysis of different tissue structures and their dynamics, helping characterize the involvement of laryngeal muscles in voice production. Given the large number of HSV frames, automating this task is imperative. While deep learning-based methods have been implemented in previous studies to segment laryngeal structures, they have not been applied to HSV data during connected speech, which poses significant challenges due to excessive tissue movements and image quality limitations associated with fiberoptic image acquisition. The application of deep learning to connected speech data is critical for capturing nonstationary laryngeal behaviors and identifying anomalous patterns associated with voice disorders. The present study aims to address these gaps by training U-Net models to detect the aryepiglottic folds and arytenoid cartilages, vocal folds, epiglottis, and glottal area, using HSV data from both sustained vowel phonation and connected speech obtained from normophonic and disordered voices. Image pre-processing techniques, including noise removal and histogram equalization, were applied to improve the quality of the training HSV images and enhance network performance. Finally, to evaluate the accuracy and reliability of the networks, quantitative performance metrics were used alongside qualitative visual inspection of the test images. The high performance of the developed networks, with overall accuracies exceeding 95%, establishes their potential as reliable tools for automated laryngeal image analysis, quantitative characterization of laryngeal dynamics, and future detection of anomalous laryngeal behaviors in clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 U-Net 对喉高速视频内窥镜 (HSV) 图像分割杓会厌襞、杓状软骨、声带、会厌与声门面积，覆盖持续元音与连贯言语、正常与病变嗓音数据。网络总体准确率超过 95%，说明深度学习可自动化连贯言语下的喉部结构分割，用于后续量化喉部动力学与异常行为检测。
Motivation: 既往深度学习分割未用于连贯言语 HSV 数据，而连贯言语中组织大幅运动、纤维内窥成像画质差，且帧数庞大，人工分割不可行；自动化是捕捉非平稳喉部行为与嗓音疾病异常模式的前提。
Method: 训练 U-Net 模型分割杓会厌襞、杓状软骨、声带、会厌与声门面积，训练数据取自正常与病变嗓音的持续元音和连贯言语 HSV；预处理含去噪与直方图均衡化，评测用定量指标加测试图像目视检查。
Result: 所训练网络的总体准确率 (overall accuracies) 超过 95%，覆盖持续元音与连贯言语、正常与病变嗓音的测试图像。
Conclusion: U-Net 在连贯言语 HSV 上可作为可靠的自动喉部图像分析工具，支撑喉部动力学的定量刻画与临床异常行为检测。

papers.title: Label-Efficient Learning for Ground-Based Sky-Image Classification: A Benchmark of Transfer Learning, Active Learning, and Pseudo-Labeling on GCD
papers.abstract_en: Accurate ground-based cloud classification is important for atmospheric monitoring, solar-energy forecasting, aviation weather assessment, and climate observation systems. However, reliable sky-image annotation is time-consuming, especially when cloud types are visually similar or mixed. We study the label efficiency of deep learning for ground-based cloud classification using the Ground-based Cloud Dataset (GCD). Rather than proposing a new architecture, we benchmark three practical strategies under limited annotation budgets: supervised transfer learning, uncertainty-based active learning, and high-confidence pseudo-labeling. An ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 is used as a common frozen backbone, with experiments repeated over five random seeds for label budgets from $1\%$ to $100\%$ of the training labels. Supervised transfer learning is already highly label-efficient: test accuracy increases from $0.635 \pm 0.018$ with $1\%$ labels to $0.730 \pm 0.002$ with $40\%$ labels, approaching the full-label result of $0.735 \pm 0.003$. Active learning and pseudo-labeling are competitive with supervised sampling and provide small improvements for some metrics and budgets, but neither gives a large or consistent aggregate gain. Diagnostic analyses show that accepted pseudo-labels are reliable, with accuracy from $0.946$ to $0.977$, but biased toward easier high-confidence sky-type groups. In contrast, uncertainty sampling preferentially queries visually challenging groups, including Mixed and the confusable Stratocumulus and Cumulonimbus groups, but these targeted acquisitions yield only modest gains. Overall, transfer learning substantially reduces annotation requirements for GCD, while simple active and semi-supervised strategies provide limited additional benefit over a strong supervised baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GCD 地面云图分类上系统对比三种省标注策略：以 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet50 为冻结骨干，监督迁移学习在 1% 标签即达 0.635±0.018 测试准确率，40% 标签达 0.730±0.002，已接近全量 0.735±0.003；主动学习与高置信伪标签相对强监督基线只有小幅且不一致的增益。结论是云型分类的标注需求主要由迁移学习解决，主动与半监督策略额外收益有限。

Method: 在 Ground-based Cloud Dataset (GCD) 上，用 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet50 作统一冻结骨干，基准测试三种策略：监督迁移学习、基于不确定性的主动学习、高置信度伪标签；标签预算从训练标签的 1% 到 100%，每个设置重复 5 个随机种子。

papers.title: On Basis Function Selection for Sparse Gaussian Process Regression
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Gaussian processes achieve $O(N)$ inference by replacing the kernel with an appropriate expansion in a fixed basis $\{φ_j\}$ on the input space. Given a compute budget $M \ll N$, practitioners conventionally truncate the basis to its first $M$ entries. Nothing in the formalism, however, prevents one from selecting only those $M$ basis functions that matter for the data at hand. This would avoid spending budget on basis functions where there is no signal, but it requires a criterion for ranking the candidates. We propose three such criteria derived from an information-theoretic view of the basis-function selection problem. Each criterion matches a different state of knowledge at selection time: a no-data state, a no-prior state, and an in-between state. We then study the performance of truncation versus selection strategies on six UCI regression benchmarks across three basis families: Hilbert-space Gaussian processes (HSGP), variational Fourier features (VFF), and variational inducing spherical harmonics (VISH). We observe that the no-data criterion is a safe default, matching or improving on truncation for HSGP, VFF and VISH, with substantial gains for VISH and improvements over a recently developed selection heuristic for that basis family. The data-aware no-prior and in-between criteria provide substantial gains over truncation specifically for HSGP, which is the most broadly used of the three families in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 稀疏高斯过程用固定基函数展开替代核以实现 O(N) 推断，但惯例总是截断前 M 个基函数。本文提出三种基于信息论的基函数选择准则，分别对应无数据、无先验与中间三种知识状态；在六个 UCI 回归基准、三种基族（HSGP、VFF、VISH）上，无数据准则对三族都持平或优于截断，对 VISH 增益显著并超过该基族近期的选择启发式，无先验与中间准则的增益则集中在 HSGP 上。
Motivation: 给定计算预算 M≪N，稀疏 GP 惯例按索引截断基函数，会在无信号方向上浪费预算；缺少一个为当前数据排序候选基函数的准则。
Method: 从基函数选择的信息论视角导出三条准则，分别对应选择时的 no-data、no-prior、与中间知识状态；在 HSGP、VFF、VISH 三种基族上比较截断与选择策略。
Result: 在六个 UCI 回归基准、三种基族上：no-data 准则对 HSGP、VFF、VISH 均持平或优于截断，对 VISH 增益显著并优于该基族近期的选择启发式；no-prior 与中间准则相对截断的实质增益集中在 HSGP（三族中实际应用最广的一族）。
Conclusion: 基函数应按数据相关性挑选而非按索引截断：no-data 准则是三族通用的安全默认，数据感知准则在 HSGP 上收益最大。

papers.title: A Data-Interventional Framework for Auditing Privacy and Fairness in Generative Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based synthetic data generation offers a promising route for sharing medical imaging data without releasing sensitive patient records. However, generative models face a fundamental tension between privacy and fairness: they may memorize rare training samples, leading to privacy risks, or fail to reproduce underrepresented features, resulting in unfair synthetic distributions. While prior work has largely focused on either memorization or fairness in isolation, their interaction remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce a data-interventional framework to systematically analyze privacy and fairness in diffusion models. We discuss synthetic anatomical fingerprints (SAFs), rare and manually injected image features, as controlled probes to study whether models generalize sensitive attributes across identities, memorize training samples, or suppress rare signals entirely. Across multiple conditioning modalities, we observe a consistent behavior: models either forget these fingerprints or memorize the entire image in which they appear, but do not generalize them to novel images. To support large-scale auditing where explicit sample extraction is infeasible, we further introduce the indicator metric t', which estimates a model's susceptibility to memorization by exploiting the internal structure of the diffusion process. By comparing conditioning signals of varying surprisal, we reveal a clear relationship between conditioning rarity and memorization behavior. Highly surprising conditioning signals act as retrieval keys that amplify memorization, whereas low-surprisal conditioning signals systematically suppress rare features, even when these appear repeatedly in the training data. Our findings provide actionable insights and concrete mitigation strategies for safe and fair synthetic medical data sharing. Code is available at https://github.com/MischaD/Privacy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出数据干预式框架审计扩散模型的隐私与公平：用合成解剖指纹 (synthetic anatomical fingerprints, SAFs) 作为可控探针，并给出利用扩散过程内部结构的指标 t' 估计记忆倾向。跨多种条件化模态观察到一致行为——模型要么遗忘指纹、要么整图记忆，不会把指纹泛化到新图；高 surprisal 条件信号充当检索键放大记忆，低 surprisal 条件信号则系统性压制稀有特征。
Motivation: 扩散合成医学数据共享中，隐私（记忆稀有样本）与公平（漏掉代表性不足特征）的交互作用此前理解不足，且大规模审计时逐样本提取不可行。
Method: 以 SAFs（稀有且人工注入的图像特征）作为受控探针，跨多种 conditioning modality 检验模型是泛化敏感属性、记忆训练样本还是完全压制稀有信号；再提出指标 t'，通过比较不同 surprisal 的条件信号在扩散过程内部结构上的表现来估计记忆易感性。
Result: 跨多种条件化模态观察到一致行为：模型或遗忘指纹、或记忆整图，但不向新图泛化；条件化信号 surprisal 与记忆行为呈清晰关系——高 surprisal 信号放大记忆，低 surprisal 信号系统性压制稀有特征，即便该特征在训练数据中反复出现。
Conclusion: 记忆与压制是同一机制的两端，由条件信号的 surprisal 决定；t' 可在无法逐样本提取时做大规模审计，并给出面向安全公平医学合成数据共享的缓解策略。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Greedy Decoding Is Not Precision-Invariant: Cross-Precision Output Divergence in LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Greedy decoding from large language models is commonly treated as deterministic. We show it is not precision-invariant: the same model, prompt, and decoding algorithm produce different outputs in BF16 versus FP16 on identical hardware. Across our evaluations of six models (1.1B-7B parameters, four families; divergence additionally characterised at 12B) and three benchmarks, 49-100\% of prompts diverge; a single token flip often cascades into trajectory-level divergence. We develop an empirical error-propagation analysis and find that 22 layers of accumulated body error do not distinguish flipping from non-flipping steps; the outcome depends primarily on the top-two logit margin at the LM head relative to the directional perturbation between the top-two candidates. The analysis makes five testable predictions about intervention outcomes, including that applying more FP32 compute (broader scope) makes agreement worse. The experiments match all five predictions. The best-performing low-overhead intervention we evaluate, selective FP32 LM head recomputation, triggered only when the margin falls below a threshold, delivers +22-36 pp exact agreement on A10G (+12-21 pp on L4 and A100) at less than 4\% latency overhead in low-batch (batch size <=4) single-stream inference. We map the applicability boundary across six models and four batch sizes, and hypothesise that training-time precision stability is a determining factor. The method is a partial mitigation rather than a universal determinism guarantee: its benefit vanishes when body-originated error dominates, including at batch size >=8 and under end-to-end FP8 in our tests.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 贪心解码并非精度不变：同一模型、提示与解码算法在 BF16 与 FP16 下产生不同输出，六个模型（1.1B–7B，另在 12B 上刻画）与三个基准上 49–100% 的提示发散，单 token 翻转会级联成整条轨迹分歧。翻转与否主要由 LM head 处 top-2 logit margin 与 top-2 候选间方向扰动的相对大小决定，而非 22 层累积 body error。仅在 margin 低于阈值时用 FP32 重算 LM head，A10G 上 exact agreement 提升 +22–36 pp（L4 与 A100 为 +12–21 pp），低批量（batch size ≤4）单流推理下延迟开销低于 4%。
Motivation: 贪心解码通常被当作确定性行为，但跨精度（BF16 vs FP16）输出发散意味着同一部署在不同硬件精度下不可复现，评测与部署的可重复性因此受损。
Method: 在相同硬件上对比 BF16 与 FP16 的贪心解码，覆盖六个模型（1.1B–7B，四个模型家族，另在 12B 上刻画）与三个基准；提出经验性误差传播分析，考察 LM head 处 top-2 logit margin 与 top-2 候选方向扰动的相对关系，并给出五条关于干预效果的可检验预测；评估的干预包括 selective FP32 LM head recomputation（仅当 margin 低于阈值时触发），并映射六个模型与四种 batch size 的适用边界。
Result: 49–100% 的提示在 BF16 与 FP16 间发散；22 层累积 body error 无法区分翻转与未翻转步；五条预测全部被实验匹配，其中增加 FP32 计算（更宽作用域）反而使一致性更差。selective FP32 LM head recomputation 在 A10G 上带来 +22–36 pp exact agreement（L4 与 A100 为 +12–21 pp），低批量（batch size ≤4）单流推理下延迟开销低于 4%；在 batch size ≥8 与端到端 FP8 测试中收益消失。
Conclusion: 跨精度发散由 LM head 处的 top-2 margin 主导而非逐层累积误差，因此低开销的按需 FP32 LM head 重算是部分缓解手段而非通用确定性保证，其收益在 body-originated error 占主导时消失；作者假设训练时的精度稳定性是决定因素。

papers.title: GeoComposer: Geometry-Grounded Photographic Composition Instruction
papers.abstract_en: Photographic composition aims to provide visual guidance for improving the framing, viewpoint, and spatial arrangement of an image. Early methods primarily rely on image cropping to enhance composition, which is restricted to the viewpoint and spatial arrangement of the input image. Recent methods have explored image understanding and editing to improve composition, but they mainly focus on instruction following and aesthetic quality, overlooking the importance of 3D scene geometry consistency for photographic composition. In this work, we propose GeoComposer, a novel geometry-grounded photographic composition framework that analyzes the composition of a given image to generate textual guidance and synthesizes a visual exemplar that enhances the composition of the given image. To promote geometry-grounded composition, we propose a geometry-aware representation learning mechanism that leverages geometric priors from a visual geometry foundation model to shape the intermediate representations of the composition editing model. This mechanism preserves both global structural relationships and local fine-grained correspondences for geometry-grounded composition. Furthermore, we propose a reinforcement learning strategy guided by a hybrid reward that jointly optimizes instruction following, aesthetic quality, and geometric consistency. This enables the model to generate visual exemplars that faithfully follow the composition instructions while remaining visually appealing and geometrically consistent. Extensive experiments show the superiority of our approach over state-of-the-art methods, highlighting its effectiveness in generating visually appealing and geometrically consistent composition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoComposer 把 3D 场景几何一致性引入摄影构图：先分析给定图像的构图并生成文字指导，再合成提升构图的视觉范例。用视觉几何基础模型 (VfM) 的几何先验约束构图编辑模型的中间表示，并以指令遵循、美学质量、几何一致性的混合奖励做强化学习，实验显示其优于 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 早期构图方法只能裁剪、受限于输入图像的视角与空间安排；近期理解加编辑的方法只追指令遵循和美学质量，忽略了 3D 场景几何一致性这一构图关键。
Method: 提出 geometry-grounded 构图框架：几何感知表征学习机制用视觉几何基础模型的几何先验塑造构图编辑模型的中间表示，同时保住全局结构关系与局部细粒度对应；再用混合奖励（指令遵循 + 美学质量 + 几何一致性）引导的强化学习策略优化生成。
Result: 大量实验显示该方法优于 SOTA 方法，在生成视觉美观且几何一致的构图上有效；摘要未给出具体指标数值。

papers.title: MMAP: Multimodal Missing-Aware Pretraining for Longitudinal Alzheimer's Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Clinical decision making heavily relies on predicting the disease progression trajectory by seeking to understand patient's health status which is characterised by multimodal medical data. AI holds great potential for learning useful representations from multimodal medical data to predict disease progression and aid clinical decision making. However, development of predictive AI models is constrained by missing modalities and incomplete tabular data frequently occurring in medical datasets. In addition, disease labels alone may only provide limited supervisory signals for learning representations from high-dimensional multimodal data. Here, we present MMAP, a novel Multimodal Missing-aware Alignment Pretraining method for learning image-tabular representations from incomplete data. An image encoder is pretrained with efficient sigmoid contrastive learning combined with generative reconstruction. A tabular encoder is built upon a tabular foundation model. A missing token generator enables the two encoders to take incomplete data as input, enabling the model to be robust against missing modalities, either with missing images or missing tabular data. We evaluate the clinical usefulness of the learnt multimodal representations on two challenging longitudinal clinical tasks for Alzheimer's disease: predicting disease stage conversion and predicting amyloid status. The proposed method outperforms strong multimodal and unimodal baselines.
papers.comment: To be published in the proceedings of the 2026 MICCAI Workshop on Multimodal Learning with Medical Tabular Data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MMAP（Multimodal Missing-aware Alignment Pretraining），用缺失感知对齐的预训练从不完整的图像-表格数据学表征：图像编码器配合高效 sigmoid 对比学习与生成式重建，表格编码器建在表格基础模型上，缺失 token 生成器让两侧都能直接吃缺失模态输入。在阿尔茨海默病阶段转化预测与淀粉样蛋白状态预测两项纵向任务上，学到的多模态表征超过强多模态与单模态基线。
Motivation: 医学数据集常缺模态、表格不完整，直接训练预测模型受限；仅靠疾病标签作为监督，对高维多模态数据的表征学习信号也不足。
Method: 图像编码器用高效 sigmoid 对比学习 (sigmoid contrastive learning) 加生成式重建预训练；表格编码器基于表格基础模型构建；缺失 token 生成器使两个编码器可接受缺图或缺表的输入，实现缺失模态下的对齐预训练。
Result: 在两项纵向阿尔茨海默病任务（疾病阶段转化预测、淀粉样蛋白状态预测）上评估，所学多模态表征优于强多模态与单模态基线。
Conclusion: 把缺失感知机制放进预训练阶段，可以从不完整的图像-表格数据中学到对纵向阿尔茨海默病预测更有用的表征，优于依赖完整模态的强基线。

papers.title: Foundation model embeddings capture pre-diagnostic changes on screening mammograms
papers.abstract_en: Foundation model embeddings of screening mammograms may encode pre-diagnostic tissue change without task-specific adaptation. We tested whether embeddings move faster along a data-derived "cancer direction" in women later biopsied for cancer than in matched screen-negative controls, and whether this depends on pretraining domain. We studied 1,773 biopsied women (785 malignant, 988 biopsy-negative) and 1,773 matched controls, each with at least two annual screening exams before their index exam. An identical pipeline was applied to four 2D models: Mammo-CLIP (MC, out-of-distribution mammography), HOPPR (in-distribution mammography), MedImageInsight (MII, general medical imaging), and BiomedCLIP (biomedical vision-language pretraining on literature figures). Breast-level embeddings quantified longitudinal movement along the cancer direction. We compared cases and controls using a between-patient design with complementary mixed-effects analysis, and biopsied versus healthy contralateral breasts within patients. Under matched modality in MII embedding space, malignant cases drifted significantly faster than controls in the first two screening intervals preceding the index exam; biopsy-negative cases showed significance only in the first. MC differences were significant in the first interval for both biopsy groups. Within-patient comparisons showed a broadly similar pattern, with MC significance extending to the second interval in both groups and HOPPR showing significance at interval 1. BiomedCLIP showed no significant differences in either design or biopsy group. Overall, directional embedding velocity emerges as a property of clinically grounded rather than general biomedical pretraining, showing that foundation model embeddings can encode pre-diagnostic mammographic change without task-specific adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 1,773 名后续活检女性（785 恶性、988 活检阴性）与 1,773 名匹配筛查阴性对照上，乳腺影像基础模型 embedding 沿数据驱动的 cancer direction 的纵向移动速度在确诊前筛查间期显著快于对照。该现象依赖预训练域：临床落地的乳腺专用模型（Mammo-CLIP、HOPPR）与通用医学影像模型（MedImageInsight）出现显著漂移，而文献图表训练的 BiomedCLIP 在两种设计与两组活检人群中均无显著差异。
Motivation: 基础模型 embedding 是否在无需任务特定微调的情况下编码癌症确诊前的组织变化尚不清楚，且这种编码是否依赖预训练数据域（临床影像 vs 文献图表）未被检验。
Method: 对四个 2D 模型（Mammo-CLIP、HOPPR、MedImageInsight、BiomedCLIP）套用同一流水线：在 embedding 空间数据驱动地定义 cancer direction，量化乳腺级 embedding 沿该方向的纵向移动速度；用患者间设计（匹配对照）加混合效应分析，并辅以同一患者患侧与健康对侧乳腺的患者内比较，比较 index exam 前两个筛查间期。
Result: 在 MII 空间（匹配模态）恶性病例在 index exam 前两个筛查间期漂移速度显著快于对照，活检阴性组仅第一间期显著；MC 在第一间期对两组活检人群均显著。患者内比较模式大体一致：MC 显著性延伸到两组的第二间期，HOPPR 在间期 1 显著；BiomedCLIP 在任一设计或任一活检组中均无显著差异。
Conclusion: 方向性 embedding 速度是临床落地预训练（而非通用生物医学文献预训练）的属性，说明基础模型 embedding 无需任务特定适配即可编码确诊前的乳腺影像变化。

papers.title: Towards Hierarchical GNNs for multi-grid power flow: generalization across operating scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical latent communication improves the generalization of a multi-grid power-flow model to new operating scenarios. The module exchanges information through two reduced graphs within a GENCO-based corrective network. We compare Kron-derived transports, a same-anchor Quotient construction and a flat backbone in preliminary trainings of 200 epochs on three grid topologies, with three initialization seeds per model. Evaluation uses 200 newly generated, preselected scenarios per grid. On the training topologies, Kron reduces the macro family-balanced voltage error from 5.660 +- 0.899 to 0.851 +- 0.110: an 85.0% reduction relative to Flat GENCO and 31.0% relative to Quotient, which reaches 1.235 +- 0.225. Both hierarchical models outperform a per-bus mean fitted on training solutions on every training topology in all three seeds. These results demonstrate generalization across operating scenarios within the studied topologies, with one set of learned parameters shared across grids. Evaluation on two additional topologies distinguishes this achievement from cross-topology generalization: the current models do not yet outperform the fitted reference in that calibrated- transfer setting. This preprint presents the architecture and preliminary evidence for hierarchical communication as a component of multi-grid power-flow learning, with generalization to unseen topologies as the next development objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GENCO 类校正网络中加入层级隐通信模块，通过两个约简图（Kron 导出的传输与同锚 Quotient 构造）交换信息，使多电网潮流模型在训练拓扑内对新运行场景的泛化显著变好。训练拓扑上 Kron 方案把宏族平衡电压误差从 5.660 ± 0.899 降到 0.851 ± 0.110，相对 Flat GENCO 降 85.0%、相对 Quotient 降 31.0%；但在两个额外拓扑的校准迁移设定下，模型尚未胜过 per-bus 均值参考，跨拓扑泛化是下一步目标。
Motivation: 多电网潮流学习需要在未见过的运行场景下保持精度，而平坦骨干网络在场景变化时电压误差大；作者要区分“场景内泛化”与“跨拓扑泛化”这两个常被混为一谈的目标。
Method: 在 GENCO-based 校正网络中嵌入层级隐通信模块，通过两个约简图交换信息：Kron 导出的传输 (Kron-derived transports) 与同锚 Quotient 构造 (same-anchor Quotient)，并以平坦骨干 (Flat GENCO) 作对照。预训练 200 epochs，覆盖三种电网拓扑，每个模型 3 个初始化种子；评估用每电网新生成并预选的 200 个场景，参考基线为在训练解上拟合的 per-bus 均值。
Result: 训练拓扑上，Kron 将宏族平衡电压误差从 5.660 ± 0.899 降至 0.851 ± 0.110，相对 Flat GENCO 降低 85.0%，相对 Quotient 降低 31.0%；Quotient 为 1.235 ± 0.225。两个层级模型在全部三种训练拓扑、全部 3 个种子上都优于 per-bus 均值参考。在两个额外拓扑的校准迁移设定下，当前模型尚未胜过该拟合参考。
Conclusion: 层级通信在已见拓扑内能以一组共享参数跨电网实现运行场景泛化，但跨拓扑泛化尚未达成，作者把 unseen topology 泛化列为下一阶段目标。

papers.title: Unlocking Cross-Scenario Physical Layer Security: A Mixture-of-Experts Framework with Generative Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: The future 6G networks are expected to incorporate a proliferation of wireless services in diverse environments, which presents a significant challenge for information security. Conventionally optimization always requires recalculation and learning strategy often suffers poor generalization, which are thus incapable for the security provisioning with wide scenario coverage. In this paper, we propose an adaptive and robust learning framework that leverages a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture to achieve cross-scenario physical layer security guarantee. Specifically, we first select a few representative scenarios and establish the scenario-specific generative diffusion model (GDM)-based experts for secure transmission beamforming with artificial noise. The diffusion nature of experts learns the overall probability distribution of security strategy solution landscape and the Transformer-based denoising process enhances the ability to generalize across varying network configurations. Then, a lightweight gating network is constructed to identify the scenarios by engineering the channel features and select the most relevant experts. Finally, an attention-based combiner is introduced to synthesize the security proposals from the top-rated experts to produce a high-fidelity security strategy to cover the unseen scenarios. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed GDM-based MoE framework can accurately recognize the scenarios and properly select the experts, maintaining near-optimal secrecy rates across a continuum of wireless scenarios and outperforming traditional single-model paradigms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 6G 跨场景物理层安全，提出 GDM-MoE 框架：用少量代表性场景训练基于生成扩散模型 (GDM) 的专家做安全波束成形与人工噪声，轻量门控网络按信道特征选专家，注意力合成器融合 top 专家覆盖未见场景。仿真显示该框架能准确识别场景并正确选专家，在连续无线场景上保持接近最优的保密速率 (secrecy rate)，优于传统单模型范式。
Motivation: 无线服务场景多样，优化方法每次都要重算，学习策略又泛化差，难以覆盖广场景的信息安全供给。
Method: 先选少量代表性场景，各建一个 GDM 专家，用扩散过程学习安全策略解空间的概率分布，Transformer 去噪提升跨网络配置泛化；再用基于信道特征的轻量门控网络识别场景并选专家，最后用注意力合成器融合 top 专家的安全方案，输出覆盖未见场景的高保真安全策略。
Result: 仿真中框架能准确识别场景、正确选择专家，在连续无线场景上保持接近最优的保密速率，优于传统单模型范式。
Conclusion: 把场景专属扩散专家与门控、注意力合成结合，可在不重训的前提下跨场景保住接近最优的物理层安全性能。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 把场景专属扩散专家与门控、注意力合成结合，可在不重训的前提下跨场景保住接近最优的物理层安全性能。

papers.title: GTR: Gated Token Recurrence for Efficient Dense Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Self-attention-based vision backbones perform well on dense prediction, but the quadratic computational cost of global softmax attention limits their efficiency as image resolution increases. We introduce Gated Token Recurrence (GTR), a softmax-free recurrent vision backbone that combines gated linear attention, alternating spatial scan directions, and spatially enhanced SwiGLU blocks. GTR is distilled from a detection-specialized DINOv3 teacher using only final-layer patch-token alignment through a linear projection and squared $\ell_2$ loss, without masked-token prediction or intermediate-layer supervision. With Objects365 detector pre-training, GTR-L achieves 58.9 box AP on COCO \texttt{val2017} with 1.908\,ms median batch-one latency under compiled FP16 execution on an RTX~4090. The same backbone also transfers to instance segmentation, pose estimation, oriented detection, semantic segmentation, and monocular depth estimation. In an isolated kernel benchmark, our specialized chunkwise CUDA operator is $4.0\times$ faster than FLA v0.5.0 at 1.6K tokens on RTX~4090. TensorRT deployment on DRIVE AGX Thor achieves 2.282--8.769\,ms median batch-one latency across the evaluated models. These results show that recurrent token mixing can provide an efficient alternative to global softmax attention for high-resolution dense prediction and edge deployment.Project page: https://intellindust-ai-lab.github.io/projects/GTR/

TL;DR: GTR 是无 softmax 的循环视觉骨干，用门控线性注意力、交替空间扫描方向与空间增强的 SwiGLU 块做 token 混合，并从检测专用 DINOv3 教师蒸馏。GTR-L 在 Objects365 预训练后于 COCO val2017 达到 58.9 box AP，RTX 4090 编译 FP16 下中位 batch-one 延迟 1.908 ms，专用 chunkwise CUDA 算子比 FLA v0.5.0 快 4.0×。结论是循环 token 混合可作为全局 softmax attention 的高效替代，用于高分辨率稠密预测与边缘部署。
Motivation: 自注意力骨干的全局 softmax attention 计算量随图像分辨率呈二次增长，限制了高分辨率稠密预测任务上的效率。
Method: GTR 由门控线性注意力、交替空间扫描方向 (alternating spatial scan directions) 和空间增强的 SwiGLU 块组成；蒸馏只用最终层 patch token 经线性投影对齐加平方 l2 损失，不做 masked-token 预测或中间层监督；检测预训练用 Objects365，另配专用 chunkwise CUDA 算子。
Result: GTR-L 在 Objects365 预训练后 COCO val2017 box AP 58.9，RTX 4090 编译 FP16 中位 batch-one 延迟 1.908 ms；专用 chunkwise CUDA 算子在 1.6K tokens 上比 FLA v0.5.0 快 4.0×；TensorRT 部署到 DRIVE AGX Thor 上各模型中位 batch-one 延迟 2.282–8.769 ms；同一骨干可迁移到实例分割、姿态估计、旋转框检测、语义分割与单目深度估计。
Conclusion: 循环 token 混合在高分辨率稠密预测与边缘部署上可作为全局 softmax attention 的高效替代。

papers.title: Polyak-Type Extragradient Methods for Monotone Root-Finding Problems
papers.abstract_en: We study Polyak-type step-size selection for extragradient methods for solving deterministic and stochastic monotone root-finding problems. We show that the known projection-type correction for deterministic extragradient arises from minimizing an upper bound on the distance to a solution, paralleling the classical Polyak step-size construction. Using this viewpoint, we provide a unified deterministic analysis of the Polyak-type Extragradient Method (PolyakEG), based on a local critical condition controlling the variation of operator $F$ along the extrapolation direction. This analysis does not require global Lipschitz continuity, and covers sublinear convergence under broader conditions such as Hölder continuity or $(L_0, L_1)$-Lipschitzness and linear convergence under additional strong monotonicity, all through a single framework. We then study the stochastic extensions of this approach. We first prove convergence of a direct stochastic variant, PolyakSEG, when all stochastic component operators share a common solution. We also show that, without this condition, PolyakSEG with nonvanishing step-sizes may fail to converge to a zero of the mean operator. To address this limitation, we propose DecPolyakSEG, which combines decreasing step-sizes with Polyak-type updates, and establish a sublinear residual convergence result without requiring a common solution across the component operators. These results parallel recent developments in stochastic Polyak step-sizes from the convex minimization literature and establish an analogous research avenue in the broader root-finding regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把确定性 extragradient 的投影型步长修正统一到 Polyak 步长框架下，提出 PolyakEG、PolyakSEG 与 DecPolyakSEG 三个算法。PolyakEG 在局部临界条件下无需全局 Lipschitz 连续即可覆盖 Hölder 连续与 (L0,L1)-Lipschitz 下的次线性收敛、强单调下的线性收敛；PolyakSEG 在分量算子共享公共解时收敛，否则非零步长可能不收敛到均值算子的零点，DecPolyakSEG 用递减步长在无公共解时仍得到次线性残差收敛。
Motivation: 确定性 extragradient 的投影型步长修正缺少统一推导，随机扩展在分量算子无公共解时直接套用 Polyak 步长会失效。
Method: 把投影型修正解释为最小化到解距离的上界，据此给出基于局部临界条件（控制算子 F 沿外推方向变化）的 PolyakEG 统一分析；随机侧先证 PolyakSEG 在公共解假设下的收敛，再提出结合递减步长与 Polyak 型更新的 DecPolyakSEG。
Result: 单一框架覆盖 Hölder 连续与 (L0,L1)-Lipschitz 下的次线性收敛，以及强单调下的线性收敛，均不要求全局 Lipschitz 连续；证明 PolyakSEG 在分量算子无公共解且步长非零时可能不收敛到均值算子的零点；DecPolyakSEG 在无公共解条件下建立次线性残差收敛。
Conclusion: Polyak 型步长可从凸极小化的随机步长理论平行移植到更广的 root-finding 体制，但随机版本必须配递减步长才能摆脱公共解假设。

papers.title: Receptiveness, Not Sycophancy: Distinguishing Engagement from Deference in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A central concern with language models is sycophancy: their tendency to defer to users' views at the expense of independent substantive judgment. In parallel, work on social sycophancy has focused on behaviors such as validation and positivity that may signal inappropriate deference. Yet the markers of social sycophancy are also characteristic of conversational receptiveness, a construct from social psychology shown to improve interactions across disagreement. We argue that this overlap creates a construct-validity problem for social sycophancy evaluations. Using a popular moral-advice dataset, we find that responses classified as more socially sycophantic are also more receptive. Further, increasing the receptiveness of human-written responses---while preserving their substantive conclusions---causes them to be classified as more socially sycophantic. This tight coupling raises the possibility that social sycophancy evaluations inadvertently penalize desirable behavior. In a preregistered experiment comparing substantively equivalent responses, participants prefer the more receptive responses, expect users to be more likely to listen to them, and are more willing to seek advice from their authors. The same overall pattern persists even among participants who believe the original question asker is in the wrong. Finally, we introduce a simple approach that substantially increases receptiveness without increasing substantive deference, demonstrating that conversational receptiveness and substantive independence can be achieved together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出把社会性谄媚 (social sycophancy) 等同于顺从会误伤对话接纳性 (receptiveness)：在道德建议数据集上，被判更谄媚的回应同时更接纳；把人工回应的接纳性调高而保持实质结论不变，会被判得更谄媚。预注册实验显示受试者更偏好更接纳的回应，且即便认为提问者有错这一模式仍成立；作者给出一种能提升接纳性而不增加实质顺从的做法。
Motivation: 社会性谄媚的常用标记（肯定、正面情绪）同时也是社会心理学中改善分歧对话的接纳性特征，谄媚评测因此存在构念效度问题，可能惩罚有益行为。
Method: 在流行道德建议数据集上检验谄媚判定与接纳性的关联，并对人工撰写的回应提升接纳性同时保持实质结论不变，观察判定变化；再用预注册实验比较实质等价的回应，测量受试者偏好、对用户倾听意愿的预期与向作者求助的意愿。
Result: 被判更社会性谄媚的回应也更接纳；提升人工回应的接纳性（保持实质结论）使其被判更谄媚；预注册实验中受试者偏好更接纳的回应、认为用户更可能听进去、更愿向其作者求助，且在相信原提问者有错的受试者中整体模式仍保持；提出的方法显著提升接纳性而不增加实质顺从。
Conclusion: 社会性谄媚评测把接纳性误判为顺从，对话接纳性与实质独立性可以同时实现，评测应把两者分开测量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Radiomics--Foundation Fusion for Interpretable RCC Classification: Internal Benchmarking and Exploratory External Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Accurate preoperative subtype classification of renal cell carcinoma (RCC) from contrast-enhanced CT remains clinically challenging because clear cell RCC (ccRCC) and non-clear cell RCC often show overlapping imaging appearances. This study evaluates whether foundation representations reduce reliance on handcrafted radiomics, or whether radiomics remains complementary for interpretable tumour characterisation. We compared radiomics, conventional CNN features, MedicalNet-pretrained features, MedVAE representations, and fusion variants for binary ccRCC classification on KiTS23, reporting area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) with bootstrap confidence intervals and average precision (AP) as a complementary class-imbalance-sensitive metric. We further assessed branch-removal ablation, TCGA/AIMI external transfer, and interpretability using radiomics permutation importance and gate-level analysis. Internally, 3D MedVAE gated fusion achieved the best performance, with an AUC of 82.7% and AP of 92.2%. On the external TCGA cohort, the same model achieved an AUC of 79.5% and AP of 98.9%, although specificity remains uncertain because only two external non-ccRCC cases were available. Gate analysis showed a radiomics-dominant fusion regime, suggesting that foundation representations acted as case-dependent refinement signals rather than replacements for structured tumour descriptors. These findings support radiomics as a complementary and clinically interpretable component of CT-based RCC characterisation in the foundation-model era.
papers.comment: Accepted for an oral presentation at CaPTion 2026, a MICCAI 2026 workshop. 11 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 KiTS23 上比较手工 radiomics、CNN、MedicalNet、MedVAE 及其融合做 ccRCC 二分类，3D MedVAE gated fusion 内部 AUC 82.7%、AP 92.2%，外部 TCGA AUC 79.5%、AP 98.9%。门控分析显示 radiomics 主导，说明基础模型表征是逐例微调信号而非替代结构化肿瘤描述子。
Motivation: ccRCC 与非透明细胞 RCC 在增强 CT 上影像表现重叠，术前亚型分类困难；需要判断基础模型表征能否减少对手工 radiomics 的依赖，或 radiomics 是否仍具互补的可解释价值。
Method: 在 KiTS23 上对比 radiomics、常规 CNN 特征、MedicalNet 预训练特征、MedVAE 表征及多种融合变体做二分类，用 AUC 加 bootstrap 置信区间与对类别不平衡敏感的 AP 评估；辅以分支移除消融、TCGA/AIMI 外部迁移，以及 radiomics 置换重要性和门控层级 (gate-level) 分析。
Result: 内部 3D MedVAE gated fusion 最优，AUC 82.7%、AP 92.2%；外部 TCGA 同模型 AUC 79.5%、AP 98.9%，但外部非 ccRCC 仅 2 例，特异度不确定。门控分析呈 radiomics 主导的融合机制。
Conclusion: 在基础模型时代，radiomics 仍是 CT-based RCC 表征中互补且临床可解释的组成部分，基础模型表征起逐例细化而非替代作用。

papers.title: Beyond End-Task Success: How to Audit Visual Experience Retrieval in Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Robots that store past experiences must select which one to reuse in a new scene. Most systems select by visual similarity, and most evaluations report only the success of the selected experience. That number does not show whether the selection was good: a rule can score well by repeatedly using one broadly transferable experience, or poorly because its preferred experience is weak. Since robots increasingly adapt by reuse rather than retraining, a score that describes the library rather than the rule misleads what the field builds next. We contribute an audit methodology: execute every stored experience in every query scene, over two manipulation tasks, three reuse mechanisms, and libraries of $K=3$, $10$, and $50$. Because every alternative's outcome is known, a score can be traced to per-scene selection or to library quality. The audited rules select by nearest-neighbor distance in five visual embeddings, from raw pixels to CLIP. (1) One fixed experience, chosen with hindsight, captures 30-58% of the gap between random selection and an oracle; per-scene selection competes for the remaining 0.07-0.15 in success rate. (2) At $K\ge10$, visual rules concentrate on one experience 1.5-3 times more than the oracle does, and their scores then follow that experience's quality. (3) Wherever a rule differs significantly from a shuffle that keeps its selection rates but pairs them with scenes at random, the rule is worse, for every learned image policy. (4) Visual distance predicts well whether a given pair will succeed (AUROC up to 0.96), yet ranks the candidates within one scene no better than chance for four of five embeddings at $K=50$ (AUROC 0.45-0.52). Exhaustive execution is usually infeasible, so the audit reduces to two cheap reports any study can give: the distribution of selected experiences, and the success of the best single experience in hindsight.
papers.comment: Accepted to the IROS 2026 Workshop on Embodied Neuro-Symbolic AI for Reliable and Safe Robotics (ReS AI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 机器人经验复用系统普遍用视觉相似度选经验、只报被选经验的成功率，该分数衡量的是库而不是选择规则。作者提出审计方法：在两个操作任务、三种复用机制、K=3/10/50 的库上穷举执行每个经验于每个查询场景，把分数拆成逐场景选择与库质量两部分。结果发现固定单经验事后最优即可吃掉随机与 oracle 之间 30-58% 的差距，而五个视觉 embedding 中有四个在 K=50 时场景内排序 AUROC 仅 0.45-0.52（接近随机），尽管配对成功预测 AUROC 最高可达 0.96。
Motivation: 只报被选经验的成功率无法区分选择规则好坏：规则可能靠反复使用一个通用经验得高分，也可能因偏好经验本身弱而得低分；在以复用代替重训练的趋势下，这种描述库而非规则的分数会误导领域下一步该建什么。
Method: 提出审计方法学：在两个 manipulation 任务、三种 reuse 机制、K=3/10/50 的经验库上，把每个存储经验在每个查询场景中全部执行，使每个备选结果已知，从而把分数追溯到逐场景选择或库质量；被审计规则是基于五种视觉 embedding（从 raw pixels 到 CLIP）的最近邻距离选择，并与保持选择率但随机配对场景的 shuffle 对照。
Result: 事后选定的单个固定经验可捕获随机选择与 oracle 之间 30-58% 的差距，逐场景选择只竞争剩余 0.07-0.15 的成功率；K≥10 时视觉规则比 oracle 集中于单个经验的倾向高 1.5-3 倍；凡规则显著偏离 shuffle 的地方，对每个 learned image policy 规则都更差；视觉距离预测配对是否成功 AUROC 最高 0.96，但在 K=50 时场景内候选排序对五个 embedding 中的四个 AUROC 仅 0.45-0.52。
Conclusion: 穷举执行通常不可行，因此审计可归结为两份廉价报告：被选经验的分布，以及事后最优单经验的成功率；端任务成功率本身不足以评价经验选择规则。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quantum-Aided Active Device Detection in Energy-Harvesting Symbiotic Radio Networks
papers.abstract_en: Massive connectivity in next-generation networks demands energy- and spectrum-efficient solutions for large-scale Internet of Things (IoT) deployments. Symbiotic radio (SR) enables passive IoT devices to communicate by backscattering existing cellular transmissions. A key challenge in uplink SR is active device detection (ADD), which directly affects decoding reliability, interference management, and system throughput. We propose an energy-harvesting code-domain non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-SR system in which IoT devices harvest energy from ambient uplink signals and backscatter information using low-density spreading (LDS) codes. To reduce the complexity of ADD, Grover's quantum search algorithm is employed, providing a quadratic reduction in oracle-query complexity over exhaustive maximum-likelihood (ML) search. Numerical results show that the proposed approach closely approaches ML performance while substantially reducing the number of search iterations, demonstrating its potential for scalable ambient IoT systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在能量收集的共生无线电 (symbiotic radio) NOMA 上行系统中，用低密度扩频 (LDS) 码承载反向散射，并以 Grover 量子搜索替代穷举最大似然 (ML) 做主动设备检测 (ADD)。相对穷举 ML 搜索，oracle 查询复杂度获得二次方 (quadratic) 降低，数值结果表明检测性能接近 ML，同时搜索迭代次数大幅减少。
Motivation: 大规模 IoT 部署要求能耗与频谱高效，上行共生无线电中的主动设备检测直接决定解码可靠性、干扰管理与系统吞吐，而穷举 ML 检测复杂度过高。
Method: 提出能量收集的 code-domain NOMA-SR 系统：设备从上行信号 harvest 能量并用 LDS 码反向散射信息；ADD 用 Grover 量子搜索算法替代穷举 ML 搜索，以 oracle-query 复杂度衡量搜索代价。
Result: Grover 搜索相对穷举 ML 的 oracle-query 复杂度为二次方降低；数值结果中所提方案性能接近 ML，同时搜索迭代次数显著减少。
Conclusion: 量子辅助搜索可在基本不损失 ML 检测性能的前提下大幅压缩 ADD 搜索开销，适用于可扩展的 ambient IoT 系统。

papers.title: The Disciplinary Language Transfer Problem: How Psychological Vocabulary Produces Governance Failures in AI Agent Deployment
papers.abstract_en: The vocabulary used to describe AI agents in governance contexts -- learning, memory, values, compliance, identity, trust -- is borrowed from psychological and organizational science, contributing to systematic failures in how organizations deploy, oversee, and hold agents accountable. This paper argues that the problem is not merely terminological but epistemological: psychological vocabulary carries an "invisible grammar" of its home discipline into governance discourse, calibrating frameworks to a metaphysical entity that does not exist in current AI architectures. We call this the disciplinary language transfer problem. Drawing on Wittgenstein's concept of language games, Kuhn's paradigm-laden observation, Haraway's situated knowledge, and Star and Griesemer's boundary object theory, we show that the transfer operates at three levels (epistemological assumptions, theoretical constructs, and surface vocabulary), each requiring a different remediation. We characterize six foundational epistemological assumptions embedded in Western psychological governance discourse, trace their origin in specific philosophical traditions, and show why each fails when applied to systems without developmental continuity. The paper's practical output is an actionable Disciplinary Audit: a six-question governance document scan operationalized through a translation taxonomy of thirty-seven terms mapping operational constructs to agent-appropriate replacements, presented here in abridged form and openly archived in full. The vocabulary reform proposed here is not merely terminological; it is the condition of possibility for governance frameworks that correctly identify what they are governing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出“学科语言迁移问题”：AI 治理文本借用心理学词汇（learning、memory、values、compliance、identity、trust），把治理框架校准到当前 AI 架构中并不存在的心理实体，从而系统性地导致部署、监督与问责失败。作者给出可操作的 Disciplinary Audit（六问治理文档扫描）与 37 个术语的翻译分类表，把操作性构念映射为适配 agent 的替代词，主张词汇改革是治理框架正确识别其治理对象的前提条件。
Motivation: AI 治理话语把心理学的“不可见语法”带入治理语境，使框架针对一个在现有 AI 架构中不存在的形而上实体来设计，造成部署、监督与问责的系统性失效。
Method: 以 Wittgenstein 的语言游戏、Kuhn 的范式负载观察、Haraway 的情境知识、Star 与 Griesemer 的边界对象理论为分析框架，把迁移拆成认识论假设、理论构念、表层词汇三层；刻画嵌入西方心理治理话语的六条基础认识论假设并追溯其哲学来源，再产出六问 Disciplinary Audit 与 37 术语翻译分类表（摘要中为节选，全文公开存档）。
Result: 识别出三层迁移机制与六条认识论假设，给出六问治理文档扫描和 37 个术语的操作构念到 agent 替代词映射；论断为这些假设应用于缺乏发展连续性（developmental continuity）的系统时失效。
Conclusion: 问题不止是术语问题而是认识论问题：只有改革词汇，治理框架才能正确识别自己在治理什么；对没有发展连续性的系统，心理学式假设不成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vision Foundation Models with Synthetic-Only Training for Monocular Spacecraft Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We present an improvement on previous spacecraft pose estimation architectures that results in the lowest published mean rotation errors we know of on the SPEED+ lightbox and sunlamp test sets for a known, non-cooperative spacecraft. By using a previously established heatmap-based pose estimation architecture and adapting a large self-supervised ViT foundation model (DINOv3) in place of the smaller convolutional and ViT encoders of previous work, we show that pose estimation accuracy improves from 300M to 840M parameters with no saturation yet observed. We also evaluate our 840M model on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB, measuring single-pass network inference at 133.8 ms per crop with a board draw of 32.0 W. These measurements demonstrate embedded inference feasibility on a processor family with orbital flight heritage. Our resulting model outperforms previous models across lightbox and sunlamp domains while training only on synthetic data. Our best model, using DINOv3 840M adapted with LoRA as the encoder (rank 64, three-seed ensemble with four-rotation test-time augmentation), results in $1.56^\circ$ mean rotation error on sunlamp and $1.17^\circ$ on lightbox, compared to the previous best mean rotation errors we know of on these test sets, $2.66^\circ$ and $1.75^\circ$ by EagerNet.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. A shorter version was accepted to the IROS 2026 Space Robotics Workshop (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 DINOv3 840M（LoRA rank 64）替换小型卷积/ViT 编码器，接到既有 heatmap 位姿估计架构上，仅用合成数据训练即可在 SPEED+ 的 lightbox 与 sunlamp 测试集上取得已知最低平均旋转误差：sunlamp 1.56°、lightbox 1.17°，对比 EagerNet 的 2.66° 与 1.75°。840M 模型在 Jetson Orin NX 16GB 上单次 crop 推理 133.8 ms、板级功耗 32.0 W，说明该规模的模型在有轨道飞行 heritage 的处理器系列上可嵌入部署。
Motivation: 非合作航天器单目位姿估计在合成到真实的域迁移下精度受限，且以往工作未验证大模型能否在星载嵌入式处理器上实时运行。
Method: 沿用已有的 heatmap-based 位姿估计架构，把编码器换成自监督视觉基础模型 DINOv3，用 LoRA（rank 64）适配；推理时用三 seed 集成与 four-rotation test-time augmentation，训练数据仅为合成数据，并在 Jetson Orin NX 16GB 上测单次推理。
Result: 最佳模型（DINOv3 840M + LoRA）平均旋转误差 sunlamp 1.56°、lightbox 1.17°，对比 EagerNet 的 2.66° 与 1.75°；编码器从 300M 增至 840M 参数精度持续提升且未观察到饱和；840M 模型单 crop 推理 133.8 ms、板级功耗 32.0 W（Jetson Orin NX 16GB）。
Conclusion: 在纯合成训练下，把大自监督 ViT 基础模型以 LoRA 接入 heatmap 位姿架构即可同时刷新 SPEED+ 已知最低旋转误差，并在有飞行 heritage 的嵌入式处理器上具备推理可行性。

papers.title: Neutral-Atom-based Quantum Optimization for Resource Allocation in NOMA Networks
papers.abstract_en: In wireless communication networks, many resource optimization problems are nondeterministic polynomial-time hard (NP-hard) due to their combinatorial nature and high computational complexity. Recently, neutral-atom-based quantum computing has emerged as a promising platform for efficiently solving such problems by leveraging quantum superposition and entanglement. However, its application to wireless communication optimization problems remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate the use of neutral-atom quantum platforms to solve the maximum access problem (MAP), formulated as a mixed-integer programming task that jointly considers admission control, user clustering, channel assignment, and power allocation in a non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-enabled uplink network. To reduce the computational burden, the MAP is equivalently reformulated as a maximum independent set (MIS) problem in graph theory. This reformulation enables the use of the neutral atom platform based on Rydberg atom arrays, where the MIS problem is naturally encoded into the physical geometry and blockade constraints of the quantum system. Numerical results demonstrate the feasibility and potential of this approach for addressing large-scale wireless resource optimization problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 NOMA 上行网络的最大接入问题 (MAP)——同时含准入控制、用户聚类、信道分配与功率分配的混合整数规划——等价改写为图上的最大独立集 (MIS)，再映射到 Rydberg 中性原子阵列，用原子几何排布与 blockade 约束直接编码该问题。数值结果展示了该方案在大规模无线资源优化上的可行性与潜力。
Motivation: 无线资源优化因组合性与高计算复杂度多为 NP-hard，而中性原子量子平台在该类通信优化上的应用基本未被探索。
Method: 将 MAP 表述为混合整数规划，等价重构为 MIS 问题，再在基于 Rydberg 原子阵列的中性原子平台上按物理几何与 blockade 约束自然编码求解。
Result: 数值结果表明该中性原子方案在解决大规模无线资源优化问题上具备可行性与潜力。
Conclusion: 把 NOMA 资源分配改写成 MIS 后，Rydberg 原子阵列可作为求解大规模无线资源优化的可行平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-judge enables evaluation across diverse tasks, but inference cost and confidence reliability become critical at scale. We study whether a decision-only judge can provide an economical first pass and identify when stronger evaluation is needed. Comparing jev-as-a-judge with sixteen generative and reward-model judges, with blinded human adjudication, we find it within three percentage points of a state-of-the-art LLM judge, our strongest comparator, on ordinary preference and evidence-grounded factuality at 0.36% of the comparator's fee. Larger gaps arise when judgments require checking a derivation or resisting an elaborately written wrong answer. On several benchmarks, JEV's gap to this comparator is concentrated in low-confidence decisions. A frozen cascade that accepts confident verdicts and escalates uncertain ones retains 99% of the comparator's accuracy at lower cost.

TL;DR: JEV-as-a-Judge 用决策式 judge 做廉价首轮评审，自信时接受、不确定时升级到更强模型。与 16 个生成式/reward-model judge 及盲评人类裁决比较，普通偏好与证据事实性上距最强 LLM judge 3 个百分点以内，费用仅为 0.36%；冻结级联保留 99% 准确率且成本更低。
Motivation: LLM-as-a-judge 规模化后推理成本与置信度可靠性成为瓶颈，需要一个经济的首轮评审并识别何时需要更强评估。
Method: 提出决策式 judge JEV-as-a-Judge，与十六个生成式 judge 和 reward-model judge 对比，并以盲评人类裁决作参照；再用冻结级联 (frozen cascade) 按置信度分流：自信判定直接接受，不确定判定升级到更强 comparator。
Result: 在普通偏好与证据接地事实性 (evidence-grounded factuality) 上，JEV 距最强 LLM judge 3 个百分点以内，费用为该 comparator 的 0.36%；需要检查推导或抵抗精心撰写的错误答案时差距更大；多个基准上差距集中在低置信度判定；冻结级联保留 comparator 99% 的准确率且成本更低。
Conclusion: 决策式 judge 可作为经济首轮评审，按置信度升级的级联能在大幅降本的同时保住绝大部分准确率，短板在推导核验与诱导性错误答案。

papers.title: Latent Commonality Expectation-Maximisation for Box-supervised Tree Crown Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Individual tree crown segmentation from aerial imagery underpins tree-level carbon accounting, biodiversity, and restoration monitoring at landscape scale. However, existing models are predominantly trained on dense canopy forest imagery and degrade in savannah and drylands, where tree crowns are sparse, of variable appearance, and underrepresented in annotated benchmarks. These models also typically depend on costly polygon annotations. We introduce LACE (LAtent Commonality Expectation-maximisation), a box-supervised instance segmentation model, evaluated on 0.1 m/px aerial RGB tree crown imagery. LACE uses a frozen DINOv3-web ViT-L/16 encoder, applied at four spatial offsets and interlaced into a denser feature grid, with a lightweight CenterNet-style detection head trained solely on bounding boxes. We use expectation-maximisation to separate recurring appearance, the "treeness", within bounding boxes from surroundings. On the OAM-TCD benchmark test set, LACE reaches a mask AP$_{50}$ of $0.663 \pm 0.001$ (3 seeds) trained on 900 box-annotated images and without mask annotations, above the 0.626 scored by Restor's released mask-supervised Mask R-CNN, which was trained on the full ~4.2k image set. On a sparse-canopy holdout set, mask AP$_{50}$ rises to $0.691$ versus $0.612$ for Detectree2, a mask-supervised baseline. On NeonTreeEvaluation, using the official evaluation code, LACE reaches $0.728 \pm 0.003$ F1@0.4 (5 seeds) from 23,424 hand-annotated RGB boxes alone, matching the authors' DeepForest model's published 0.719, using under 0.1% of its training annotations and none of its LiDAR-derived 30M-crown pretraining set. By leveraging frozen self-supervised features, LACE matches or surpasses fully-supervised specialist baselines from boxes alone, removing the need for polygon annotation in tree crown instance segmentation for sparse-canopy environments where labelled data is scarce.

TL;DR: 提出 LACE：用冻结 DINOv3-web ViT-L/16 编码器四偏移交错加密特征网格，配合轻量 CenterNet 式检测头，仅用边界框训练，并以期望最大化 (EM) 从框内外分离反复出现的“树性”外观做实例分割。在 OAM-TCD 上以 900 张框标注图像达到 mask AP50 0.663±0.001（3 seeds），高于 Restor 用全量约 4.2k 图像训练的 mask-supervised Mask R-CNN 的 0.626；稀疏冠层 holdout 上 0.691 对 Detectree2 的 0.612，NeonTreeEvaluation 上 F1@0.4 达 0.728±0.003（5 seeds），匹配 DeepForest 的 0.719。

papers.title: Topology-Stratified Materials Discovery with A Flow-Based Generative Model
papers.abstract_en: Accurate generation of crystal structures is the foundation to the discovery of high-performance materials for extreme-environment applications, such as aerospace, additive manufacturing, and fusion energy systems. Although generative modeling has emerged as a promising approach for crystal design, its performance remains limited by the complex crystal structures and diverse chemical compositions. In this work, we develop UFO-MGen, a universal flow-based generative model that learns topological features of Wyckoff representations and leverages this information to accurately generate crystals across vast structural and chemical spaces. Compared with state-of-the-art generative models, UFO-MGen achieves the highest crystal generation success rate under a rigorous multi-stability evaluation framework, the highest SUN (stable, unique, novel) rate, and a remarkable extrapolation capability that has not been reported by previous models. Furthermore, a fine-tuning module is implemented to UFO-MGen for property-constrained crystal generation, enabling the inverse materials design toward target properties. The UFO-MGen opens a new avenue for accelerated materials discovery and providing a foundation for universal materials intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 UFO-MGen：基于流的晶体结构生成模型，学习 Wyckoff 表示的拓扑特征，在结构与化学空间中生成晶体。在多稳定性评估框架下其生成成功率与 SUN（stable, unique, novel）率均为对比生成模型中最高，并具备此前模型未报告的外推能力；微调模块支持面向目标性质的逆向材料设计。
Motivation: 晶体生成建模受限于复杂晶体结构与多样化学组成，高性能极端环境材料（航天、增材制造、聚变能）的发现需要更准的结构生成基础。
Method: UFO-MGen 是通用流式生成模型 (flow-based generative model)，学习 Wyckoff 表示的拓扑特征并据此生成晶体；另加一个微调模块实现性质约束的晶体生成，用于面向目标性质的逆向设计。
Result: 在严格的多稳定性评估框架下，UFO-MGen 取得最高的晶体生成成功率与最高的 SUN（stable, unique, novel）率，并展现此前模型未报告的外推能力；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把 Wyckoff 拓扑特征引入流式生成模型可提升跨结构与化学空间的晶体生成质量，并为性质约束的逆向材料设计提供路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Notes on Fourier-Bessel wavelets
papers.abstract_en: These notes develop the mathematical foundations and construction of a Fourier-Bessel wavelet family inspired by the disk harmonics of Shaqfa et al.[9]. We begin with the relevant properties of Bessel and modified Bessel functions and introduce the wavelet properties required for the construction. We then derive the Fourier-Bessel disk harmonics as solutions to the Helmholtz equation on the unit disk subject to a Neumann boundary condition. Building on this basis, we construct a wavelet family by applying a Gaussian spatial envelope and introducing a zero-mean correction for the zeroth angular order. We derive the corresponding normalisation constants for $L^2$-based applications and discuss $L^1$-based normalisation for frequency-domain peak consistency. Finally, we derive a closed-form Fourier-domain representation of the resulting wavelets. The main motivation is the approximately linear spacing, which converges to $π$ between consecutive radial eigenvalues. Rather than replacing the conventional dyadic organisation of wavelet families, this construction lays out the foundation to explore whether a more uniform radial frequency allocation can be useful for applications in which broad and balanced frequency coverage is desirable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出 Fourier-Bessel 小波族的完整数学构造：以单位圆盘上 Neumann 边界条件的 Helmholtz 方程解出 Fourier-Bessel disk harmonics，叠加高斯空间包络并对零阶角向模加零均值修正，导出 L2 归一化常数与频域闭式表达。相邻径向特征值间距近似线性并收敛到 π，作者主张它不取代二进 (dyadic) 小波组织，而是为需要宽带、均衡频率覆盖的场景提供更均匀径向频率分配的候选。
Motivation: 传统小波按二进尺度组织，径向频率分配不均匀；对需要宽带且均衡频率覆盖的应用，缺少一种径向特征值间距近似恒定的替代构造。
Method: 受 Shaqfa 等人的 disk harmonics 启发，先给出 Bessel 与 modified Bessel 函数性质，再推导单位圆盘 Helmholtz 方程在 Neumann 边界下的 Fourier-Bessel disk harmonics；施加高斯空间包络并为零阶角向分量加零均值修正，导出 L2 归一化常数与 L1 归一化（用于频域峰值一致性），最后给出频域闭式表达。
Result: 构造出的 Fourier-Bessel 小波相邻径向特征值间距近似线性并收敛到 π；给出 L2 归一化常数、L1 归一化讨论与 Fourier 域闭式表示这些解析结果。
Conclusion: 该构造不取代传统 dyadic 小波组织，而是为进一步检验更均匀的径向频率分配在需要宽带均衡覆盖的应用中是否有用奠定数学基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: REFLEX with Jev for Efficient Selective Control in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents often use generative models for bounded decisions, raising the question of when these decisions can be handled more efficiently without reducing task success. We study REFLEX, an agent architecture that uses Jev as a fast, typed decision layer and calls a strong LLM when confidence is low, or generation is required. On a frozen 100-task benchmark, REFLEX achieves 95% success with 72.7% fewer strong-model calls than a strong-only agent, with reductions persisting across three fallback families. Controlled interventions show that reliability depends on action-set size and near-valid alternatives near authorization boundaries. External BFCL and $τ$-style evaluations reveal limited advantages over a cheap generative cascade when ordinary routing is already highly accurate. These findings identify when selective control with Jev can reduce computation and where its benefits are limited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REFLEX 用 Jev 作为快速、带类型的决策层，仅在置信度低或需要生成时才调用强 LLM，在冻结的 100 任务基准上达到 95% 成功率，同时比纯强模型 agent 减少 72.7% 的强模型调用，且在三类 fallback 机制下都能保持降幅。但外部 BFCL 与 τ-风格评测显示，当普通路由本身已很准确时，相对廉价生成级联 (cheap generative cascade) 优势有限。
Motivation: LLM agent 常用生成模型处理有界决策，问题是这类决策能否在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下更省算力，以及省算力的边界在哪里。
Method: REFLEX 架构：Jev 作为快速类型化决策层，置信度低或需要生成时回退到强 LLM；在冻结的 100 任务基准上测试，并做受控干预改变 action-set 大小与授权边界附近的近似合法替代方案，另用外部 BFCL 与 τ-风格评测对照廉价生成级联。
Result: 冻结 100 任务基准上成功率 95%，强模型调用比纯强模型 agent 少 72.7%，该降幅在三类 fallback 家族中保持；受控干预表明可靠性取决于 action-set 大小与授权边界附近的 near-valid alternatives；外部 BFCL 与 τ-风格评测显示相对廉价生成级联优势有限。
Conclusion: 选择性控制 (selective control) 加 Jev 能在路由本身不够准的场景显著省算力且不掉成功率，但当普通路由已高度准确时收益受限。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 选择性控制 (selective control) 加 Jev 能在路由本身不够准的场景显著省算力且不掉成功率，但当普通路由已高度准确时收益受限。

papers.title: A Semiotics-Aware Framework for Evaluating Fidelity and Coverage in Natural Language Generation
papers.abstract_en: When two texts describe the same expression, standard metrics based on lexical overlap or whole-text similarity may fail to detect meaningful differences in how that expression is framed. We propose a framework to evaluate semiotic alignment between texts, where a semiotic profile encompasses both the contextual meaning and the discourse references made salient by a text. Our approach yields two scores, Semiotic Fidelity and Semiotic Coverage, estimating how much of one text's profile is supported by the other and how much of the other's profile it recovers. Experiments show that coverage is typically lower than fidelity, and that alignment between LLMs and human-curated data is highest at low sampling temperatures, while higher temperatures reduce this alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出符号学感知的文本评估框架，用 semiotic profile 同时刻画语境含义与被凸显的话语指涉，输出 Semiotic Fidelity 与 Semiotic Coverage 两个分数，衡量两段文本的符号对齐程度。实验显示 coverage 普遍低于 fidelity，且 LLM 与人工数据的对齐在低采样温度时最高、随温度升高而下降。
Motivation: 两段文本描述同一表达时，基于词面重叠或全文相似度的常规指标可能检测不到框架方式上的实质差异，需要能刻画语境含义与话语指涉的对齐度量。
Method: 为文本构建 semiotic profile（含语境含义与被凸显的话语指涉），据此计算两个分数：Semiotic Fidelity 估计一方 profile 有多少被另一方支持，Semiotic Coverage 估计它恢复了对方 profile 的多大比例；在 LLM 生成文本与人工整理数据之间、跨不同采样温度做实验。
Result: 实验显示 Coverage 通常低于 Fidelity；LLM 与人工整理数据的对齐在低采样温度下最高，温度升高会降低该对齐度。
Conclusion: 词面重叠之外需要符号层面的双向度量，且采样温度是影响 LLM 输出与人工数据符号对齐的直接因素：低温更对齐。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Virtual Encoders in Multimodal Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal language models traditionally rely on dedicated perceptual encoders to construct task-usable representations. More integrated architectures have recently emerged, which instead expose the shared transformer to lightly projected patches, audio frames, or discrete visual tokens. Where does this encoding happen when such representations are not provided? We find that the transformer can internalize this missing computation, constructing task-usable perceptual representations within its own early-to-middle layers before the downstream language model. We call this computational structure a Virtual Encoder. Across linear probing, similarities to perceptual encoders, and causal analyses, we identify signatures of this structure in models that receive perceptual tokens without continuous encoder-derived features. These analyses also suggest that the boundary between perception and language processing need not coincide within an architectural module. Instead, encoder-like computation can emerge as a functional regime within a shared transformer, providing a new perspective for understanding where and how multimodal models process perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在把 patch、音频帧或离散视觉 token 直接喂给共享 transformer 的多模态模型里，感知编码并非缺失，而是被模型内部化：早期到中层自行构造出任务可用的感知表征，作者称之为 Virtual Encoder。线性探针、与感知编码器的相似度以及因果分析三类证据都指向这一结构，说明感知与语言处理的边界不必对应某个具体架构模块。
Motivation: 一体化多模态架构不再提供连续的编码器特征，那这类模型的感知表征究竟在哪一层产生、由什么承担，缺少可检验的刻画方式。
Method: 在只接收感知 token、没有连续 encoder 特征的模型上做三类分析：线性探针 (linear probing)、与既有感知编码器的表征相似度比较，以及因果分析 (causal analysis)，用这些信号定位 Virtual Encoder 所在的层段。
Result: 在接收感知 token 而无连续编码器特征的模型中识别出 Virtual Encoder 的结构签名，位置在共享 transformer 的早期到中层、位于下游语言模型之前；三类分析一致支持该结构存在。
Conclusion: encoder 式计算可以作为共享 transformer 内部的一种功能域 (functional regime) 涌现，感知与语言的分界不必落在架构模块边界上。

papers.title: Do Vision Model See Like the Brain? A Comparison Across EEG Encoding Model
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers are both used to model the human visual system, but whether the two architectures diverge at a specific point in network depth is unclear. We compared six CNNs and two vision transformers by computing the Pearson correlation (r) between each model's predicted and measured EEG response at every layer or block, in ten participants viewing 200 natural images. For the transformer models, we also tested four token representations, from the classification (CLS) token alone to CLS combined with all patch tokens. CNNs showed strongest correspondence at the earliest layers, weakening at deeper layers, particularly later in the post-stimulus response. Transformers instead sustained strong correspondence at their deepest blocks, though not at their earliest ones. This advantage depended on token representation: pooled representations gave weaker peak correlations (r approx 0.48-0.51) than representations retaining all patch tokens (r=0.640 for CLIP-ViT-B/32, r=0.656 for DINOv2-ViT-B/14). Controlled comparisons showed architecture, not training objective, drove this effect: MoCo-v1 and ResNet-50 (matched architecture) performed nearly identically (r=0.673, 0.670), whereas CLIP-RN50 and CLIP-ViT-B/32 (matched objective) diverged until patch tokens were preserved. We propose that CNN training's classification bottleneck compresses brain-relevant information at depth, unlike transformers' self-attention and non-classification objectives. A spatial topography analysis showed a common occipital-dominant pattern across all models, indicating these differences reflect signal strength and persistence rather than distinct brain regions. Patch-preserving transformer representations sustain brain-predictive correspondence where CNNs collapse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 EEG 编码模型比较六种 CNN 与两种 ViT 在人脑视觉表征上的对应度：CNN 在浅层相关最强、随深度衰减，而 ViT 在最深 block 仍保持强对应，且这一优势取决于 token 表示——保留全部 patch token 时 r 达 0.640（CLIP-ViT-B/32）与 0.656（DINOv2-ViT-B/14），池化表示仅约 0.48–0.51。架构而非训练目标驱动该效应。
Motivation: CNN 与 ViT 都被用来建模人类视觉系统，但两者是否在网络深度的某个特定位置开始分歧尚不清楚。
Method: 在 10 名被试观看 200 张自然图像的 EEG 数据上，逐层/逐 block 计算模型预测与实测 EEG 响应的 Pearson 相关 (r)；对 ViT 额外测试四种 token 表示（从仅 CLS 到 CLS 拼接全部 patch token），并用架构匹配（MoCo-v1 vs ResNet-50）与目标匹配（CLIP-RN50 vs CLIP-ViT-B/32）的受控对比分离架构与训练目标的作用，另做空间拓扑分析。
Result: CNN 最强对应出现在最早层、随深度减弱，尤其在刺激后反应的较晚时段；ViT 在最深 block 仍维持强对应（但最早层不强）。池化表示峰值 r 约 0.48–0.51，保留全部 patch token 时 CLIP-ViT-B/32 r=0.640、DINOv2-ViT-B/14 r=0.656。架构匹配的 MoCo-v1 与 ResNet-50 几乎一致（r=0.673 与 0.670）；目标匹配的 CLIP-RN50 与 CLIP-ViT-B/32 在保留 patch token 前一直分化。所有模型均呈枕叶主导的共同空间拓扑。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CNN 的分类瓶颈在深度上压缩了与脑相关的信息，而 Transformer 的自注意力与非分类目标使其保留；patch 保留的 Transformer 表示能在 CNN 塌缩之处维持脑预测对应，且差异反映信号强度与持续性而非不同脑区。
