papers.title: Gap-Free Streaming PCA Beyond Rank-One Updates: Near-Optimal Rates and Applications to Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Streaming principal component analysis (PCA) seeks to recover a leading spectral subspace in a single pass over a data stream. We give a new analysis of the ubiquitous Oja's algorithm [Oja82] for the most general, gap-free variant of this problem, where no eigengap assumptions are made on the underlying mean matrix, complemented by a nearly-matching lower bound. Prior works achieving near-optimal rates for streaming PCA either required gap assumptions [JJK+16, HNWW21], or were limited to rank-one updates [AZL17, Lia23]. Our proof only uses a second moment bound on the individual stochastic updates, bypassing the almost sure bounds needed by prior near-optimal analyses, and the analogous offline matrix Bernstein bound. We also extend our result to a Rayleigh quotient notion of approximate PCA, addressing an open question of [JJK+16]. As our main application, we give gap-free differentially private PCA guarantees for sub-Gaussian data, settling Conjecture 1.1 of [Bro26] up to logarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对无特征间隙 (gap-free) 的流式 PCA 给出 Oja 算法的新分析与近匹配下界，证明只需单次随机更新的二阶矩界即可达到近最优速率，突破以往要么假设 eigengap、要么仅限 rank-one 更新的限制。结果还扩展到 Rayleigh quotient 意义的近似 PCA，并作为主应用给出次高斯数据下的差分隐私 PCA 保证，除对数因子外解决 [Bro26] 的 Conjecture 1.1。
Motivation: 以往流式 PCA 的近最优分析要么依赖特征间隙假设，要么只覆盖 rank-one 更新，无法处理一般数据流且无 eigengap 的最普适设定。
Method: 对 Oja 算法做新分析：仅用单次随机更新的二阶矩界，绕开先前近最优分析所需的几乎必然界与离散时间 matrix Bernstein 界；配以近匹配下界，并把结论扩展到 Rayleigh quotient 形式的近似 PCA。
Result: 在无 eigengap 的最一般流式 PCA 变体上得到近最优速率并给出近匹配下界；扩展到 Rayleigh quotient 近似 PCA，回应 [JJK+16] 的公开问题；对次高斯数据给出差分隐私 PCA 保证，除对数因子外解决 [Bro26] 的 Conjecture 1.1。
Conclusion: 仅凭随机更新的二阶矩界就足以支撑无间隙流式 PCA 的近最优分析，且该框架可直接转化为差分隐私 PCA 保证。

papers.title: The Ethics of Artificial Intelligence in Military Operations
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning systems now mediate military decisions to use force, yet their internal logic resists inspection, their evaluation practices are gameable, and their deployment fractures accountability across dispersed stakeholders. The ethical challenge posed by these systems is fundamentally epistemic: not just whether autonomous weapons should be permitted to kill, but whether the conditions for responsible human judgment can survive when critical functions are delegated to opaque algorithms. We show that this epistemic condition produces a concrete accountability gap: responsibility diffuses across designers, operators, and policymakers while International Humanitarian Law presupposes capacities for judgment that current AI systems lack. To address this gap, we propose a governance framework that proceduralizes ethical constraints through named accountability roles, adversarial auditing with undisclosed benchmarks, tiered deployment thresholds, and a proposed NATO evaluation standard. Counterfactual analysis of eight documented cases (1988-2025) shows that each governance mechanism addresses a documented class of failure, but no single safeguard suffices in isolation: effective governance of military AI requires not only technical constraints but the institutional infrastructure to keep human judgment meaningful.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把军事 AI 的伦理问题定位为认识论缺口：关键功能交给不透明算法后，责任在设计者、操作者与政策制定者之间扩散，而国际人道法 (IHL) 预设的判断能力是当前 AI 不具备的。为此提出一套治理框架——具名问责角色、用未公开基准做对抗性审计、分级部署门槛、以及一项拟议的 NATO 评估标准；对 1988–2025 年八个案例的反事实分析显示每个机制只覆盖一类已记录的失败，单独任何一个都不够。
Motivation: 深度学习系统已介入武力使用决策，但内部逻辑不可检、评估可被博弈、部署使责任分散，导致 IHL 所要求的人类判断条件无法成立。
Method: 提出治理框架，把伦理约束程序化：具名问责角色 (named accountability roles)、配未公开基准的对抗性审计 (adversarial auditing with undisclosed benchmarks)、分级部署门槛 (tiered deployment thresholds)，以及一项拟议的 NATO 评估标准；并用反事实分析检验八个已记录案例。
Result: 对 1988–2025 年八个已记录案例的反事实分析显示：每个治理机制对应一类已记录的失败，但没有任何单一保障措施单独起效。
Conclusion: 军事 AI 的有效治理必须同时具备技术约束与维持人类判断有意义的制度基础设施，缺一不可。

papers.title: Semantically-Guided Domain Randomization for Industrial Object Detection in Low-Image-Budget Regimes
papers.abstract_en: Retraining visual perception pipelines in High-Mix, Low-Volume (HMLV) automotive manufacturing must be carried out under tight annotation, energy, and time budgets, yet most Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) strategies still operate in the thousands of images. This work evaluates Semantically-Guided Domain Randomization (S-GDR), an annotation-free adaptation pipeline that couples Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based semantic captioning of a small unannotated real reference set with diffusion-based background synthesis (Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) conditioned by ControlNet and IP-Adapter) and mask-based object composition. On an automotive multi-object detection benchmark and with a fixed budget of 200 synthetic training images, S-GDR reaches mAP50-95 = 0.739 on a real held-out test set, outperforming a domain-randomized render baseline (mAP50-95 = 0.697) as well as brightness filtering, perceptual hashing, CycleGAN style transfer, and unguided diffusion variants sharing the same 200-image budget. These initial observations position S-GDR as a promising annotation- free alternative for extreme data-scarcity regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S-GDR 在仅 200 张合成训练图像的预算下，用 VLM 对少量无标注真实参考集做语义描述，再以 SDXL（ControlNet + IP-Adapter）合成背景并按 mask 拼接目标，实现免标注的工业目标检测适配。在汽车多目标检测基准的真实留出测试集上 mAP50-95 达 0.739，高于同预算的域随机化渲染基线 0.697，也高于亮度过滤、感知哈希、CycleGAN 风格迁移与无引导扩散变体。
Motivation: 高混合低产量 (HMLV) 汽车制造中重训视觉感知管线受标注、算力与时间预算严格限制，而现有合成数据生成 (SDG) 策略通常仍需数千张图像。
Method: S-GDR 是免标注适配管线：先用 Vision-Language Model (VLM) 对少量无标注真实参考集生成语义描述，再用 Stable Diffusion XL（由 ControlNet 与 IP-Adapter 条件化）合成背景，最后按 mask 做目标拼接，产出固定 200 张合成训练图像。
Result: 在汽车多目标检测基准、200 张合成图像预算下，真实留出测试集 mAP50-95 = 0.739；域随机化渲染基线为 0.697；同预算下还超过亮度过滤、感知哈希、CycleGAN 风格迁移与无引导扩散变体。
Conclusion: 作者将 S-GDR 定位为极端数据稀缺场景下有前景的免标注替代方案，但结论基于初步观察。

papers.title: Deep Generative Crystal Structure Prediction: A Benchmark Study and a Controlled Test of Prototype Dependence
papers.abstract_en: Deep generative models are widely reported to enable de novo crystal structure prediction (CSP), but their capability has not been measured consistently against template-based methods. We evaluate 12 representative generative CSP models, spanning latent-variable, diffusion, flow-matching, autoregressive, and manifold random-walk architectures, against TCSP 2.0 on 180 test structures and a leakage-controlled subset of 46. All methods use identical structure-matching, symmetry, and consensus criteria. Template retrieval is the strongest single method, reaching 68.3% top-1 success; symmetry-aware EquiCSP (66.4%) and Uni-3DAR (62.9%) form the next tier. However, comparison with TCSP 2.0 shows that most structures correctly predicted by generative models are also correctly predicted by template substitution. Thus, the set of structures uniquely reachable by generation is small, limiting its practical advantage for discovering structures outside existing prototype libraries. To test the source of this performance, we removed entire stoichiometric prototype families from the training set and retrained the strongest generative model. Accuracy declined by 50-78% across four families, establishing that performance is substantially prototype-dependent. A small minority of structures survived removal of their prototype family, demonstrating a real but limited retrieval-independent predictive capacity. Present generative CSP models therefore function largely as implicit, softer-edged prototype libraries rather than genuinely de novo predictors. Enlarging this residual capacity, rather than aggregate match rate alone, is the central open problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 12 个深度生成式晶体结构预测 (CSP) 模型与模板法 TCSP 2.0 在 180 个测试结构（含 46 个防泄漏子集）上统一评测：模板检索以 68.3% top-1 成功率居首，EquiCSP 66.4%、Uni-3DAR 62.9% 次之，且生成模型答对的多数结构模板法也能答对。移除整个化学计量原型族并重训最强生成模型后，四族准确率下降 50–78%，说明现有生成式 CSP 实质是隐式原型库而非真正 de novo 预测器。
Motivation: 深度生成式 CSP 被广泛宣称可 de novo 预测晶体结构，但从未与模板法在统一评测协议下一致比较，其相对模板检索的真实增益不明。
Method: 评测 12 个代表性生成式 CSP 模型（覆盖 latent-variable、diffusion、flow-matching、autoregressive、manifold random-walk 架构），与 TCSP 2.0 在 180 个测试结构及 46 个防泄漏子集上对比，统一 structure-matching、对称性与 consensus 判据；再从训练集整族移除化学计量原型并重训最强生成模型以检验性能来源。
Result: 模板检索 top-1 成功率 68.3% 为最强单法，对称性感知的 EquiCSP 66.4%、Uni-3DAR 62.9% 次之；生成模型正确预测的多数结构亦被 TCSP 2.0 模板替换命中，仅生成可达的结构集合很小；移除原型族重训后四族准确率下降 50–78%，仅极少数结构在原型族移除后仍存活。
Conclusion: 现有生成式 CSP 主要充当边缘更柔和的隐式原型库，而非真正 de novo 预测器；扩大那部分检索无关的残余预测能力才是核心开放问题，而非继续抬高总体匹配率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Radiomics-Conditioned Modulation of RenalCLIP Features for Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Classification
papers.abstract_en: Radiomics provides quantitative descriptions of tumour appearance that may complement disease-specific foundation models in small labelled cohorts. We investigate this complementarity for computed tomography-based classification of clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Our framework uses radiomics to modulate RenalCLIP features through feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), while retaining a direct radiomics contribution. Internal testing and external validation compare it with conventional fusion strategies and reference classifiers. The FiLM model achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.804 internally and 0.854 externally, with the highest mean AUC among the evaluated RenalCLIP fusion strategies in both cohorts. Pathway ablations examine the contributions of conditional modulation and the direct radiomics residual, while feature permutation highlights the role of tumour texture. These findings support radiomics as a useful complement to RenalCLIP in a small labelled cohort and identify FiLM as an effective approach to integrating their representations for robust renal tumour classification.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 7th International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis (MICAD 2026). 10 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在小标注队列的 CT 透明细胞肾细胞癌 (ccRCC) 分类中，用 radiomics 经 FiLM 调制 RenalCLIP 特征并保留 radiomics 直接残差通路，内部测试 AUC 0.804、外部验证 0.854，均为所评估的 RenalCLIP 融合策略中最高。通路消融与特征置换指出条件调制、直接残差和肿瘤纹理各自有贡献。
Motivation: 疾病特异的影像基础模型在小标注队列上可用标签有限，radiomics 提供的定量形态描述可能补足其表征，但两者如何有效整合缺少验证。
Method: 用 radiomics 通过 feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) 调制 RenalCLIP 特征，同时保留 radiomics 的直接残差通路；与常规融合策略和参考分类器对比，做通路消融（条件调制 vs 直接残差）与特征置换分析。
Result: FiLM 模型内部测试 AUC 0.804、外部验证 AUC 0.854，在两个队列上均为所评估 RenalCLIP 融合策略中最高 mean AUC；通路消融显示条件调制与直接 radiomics 残差均有贡献，特征置换突出肿瘤纹理的作用。
Conclusion: radiomics 可作为小标注队列中 RenalCLIP 的有效补充，FiLM 是整合两者表征以实现稳健肾肿瘤分类的有效方式。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: When Recursive Models Finish Computing
papers.abstract_en: Recursive models can continue updating their latent states beyond their nominal inference budget, so an incorrect output at that budget does not show whether computation is unfinished or has entered a persistently unsuccessful regime. We study the dynamics of completion in attention- and MLP-based Tiny Recursive Models (TRMs) on 1,000 hard Sudoku puzzles. Extending recurrence from the nominal 16 steps to 512 steps increases cumulative exact-solve accuracy from 59.2% to 87.5% for the attention model and from 74.4% to 91.9% for the MLP model, solving more than two-thirds of the puzzles unsolved in the nominal budget. Across both architectures, latent-state motion drops sharply after the first exact solution. Completed states are typically locally contractive along the trajectory direction, even though the same local Jacobian retains strongly expanding directions. We characterize this phenomenon as trajectory-conditioned anisotropic stability. Perturbation experiments confirm this directional stability across both models. The multi-step fate of the maximally expanding direction differs: it is absorbed within 16 steps in the attention model but persists longer in the MLP model. The anisotropic-stability pattern also holds for a second attention checkpoint. Together, these results distinguish nominal-budget failure from completed computation and identify a common dynamical signature of completion across two recurrent architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 递归模型在名义推理预算之外继续更新隐状态，因此预算处的错误输出无法区分算力未用尽与已进入持续失败态。在 1,000 道困难 Sudoku 上把 TRM 递推从 16 步延长到 512 步，注意力模型累计精确解题率从 59.2% 升到 87.5%，MLP 模型从 74.4% 升到 91.9%；作者把首次精确解后隐状态运动骤降、沿轨迹方向局部收缩的现象命名为轨迹条件各向异性稳定性 (trajectory-conditioned anisotropic stability)。
Motivation: 名义预算处的错误无法判断是计算未完成还是已陷入持续失败状态，递归模型缺少一个可辨识的“完成”信号。
Method: 在注意力与 MLP 两种 Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) 上研究完成动力学：把递推从名义 16 步延长到 512 步，测量累计精确解题率与隐状态运动，并用局部 Jacobian 分析轨迹方向与最大扩张方向，辅以扰动实验验证方向性稳定性。
Result: 1,000 道困难 Sudoku 上，递推 16→512 步使注意力模型累计精确解题率 59.2%→87.5%，MLP 模型 74.4%→91.9%，超过三分之二在名义预算内未解出的题目被解出；完成态沿轨迹方向局部收缩但同一 Jacobian 保留强扩张方向，最大扩张方向在注意力模型中 16 步内被吸收、在 MLP 模型中存续更久，该模式在第二个注意力 checkpoint 上同样成立。
Conclusion: 名义预算失败与计算完成是两回事，两种递归架构共享一个完成的动力学签名：轨迹方向局部收缩而正交方向仍可扩张。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Not Quite My Tempo: Voice Activity-aware Speech Synthesis for Lip-Synchronous Dubbing
papers.abstract_en: Automatic lip-synchronous dubbing requires a speech synthesis model to generate alternating voice and silence patterns in the target language that match the timing of the source clip precisely to ensure an optimal viewing experience. Prior works address this problem by conditioning the speech synthesis process on lip movements extracted from the video signal. In this work, we condition the speech generation on a binary voice-activity signal, which has a lightweight representation and can be produced in multiple ways. We show that the model follows the voice-activity signal with high accuracy while maintaining natural prosody and semantically appropriate pause placement within sentences, as demonstrated through extensive objective and subjective evaluations. By randomly masking this condition during training, we make the feature entirely optional during inference, allowing editors to enforce or relax lip-sync constraints when desired.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用二值 voice-activity 信号 (binary voice-activity signal) 作为条件驱动语音合成，使生成的目标语言语音在停顿与发声时序上精确对齐源视频，从而实现唇同步配音。模型对该条件的跟随准确率高，同时保持自然韵律与句内合理的语义停顿；训练时随机掩码该条件，使其在推理阶段完全可选，剪辑师可按需收紧或放松唇同步约束。
Motivation: 自动唇同步配音要求合成语音的发声与静音模式精确匹配源片段时序，而以往做法依赖从视频提取的唇部运动，条件表示重且不便按需开关。
Method: 以二值 voice-activity 信号作为语音生成的条件（该信号表示轻量、可多种方式产生），取代唇部运动条件；训练时对该条件做随机掩码，使其推理时可选；通过客观与主观评测验证跟随精度、韵律与停顿质量。
Result: 模型以高准确率跟随 voice-activity 信号，同时保持自然韵律与句内语义恰当的停顿，结论由大量客观与主观评测支撑；随机掩码训练使该特征在推理时完全可选。
Conclusion: 轻量的二值 voice-activity 条件足以驱动唇同步配音的时序控制，且可按需开关，让剪辑师在收紧与放松唇同步约束之间自由选择。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: From Token Importance to Conditional Removability: Rethinking Visual Token Pruning in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Training-free visual-token pruning often uses token importance, redundancy, or related selection criteria as proxies for safe removal. We show that these signals alone do not fully characterize removability, which is conditioned on both representation depth and the surrounding deletion set. Controlled interventions demonstrate that removing the same tokens at different depths produces substantially different downstream perturbations, while changing only the deletion context at a fixed depth alters candidate marginals and pruning-boundary decisions. These findings show that token importance alone cannot determine when a token is safely removable or how its removability changes under joint deletion. Motivated by this perspective, we propose CoRePrune, a training-free two-stage framework. Progressive Perturbation-Aware Visual Pruning refreshes deletion effects as visual representations evolve, while Set-Conditioned Refinement reevaluates candidate rescue benefits under the current deletion set after visual--text interaction. Across five multimodal large language model backbones covering standard images, high-resolution inputs, and video, CoRePrune preserves performance under aggressive token budgets. On Qwen3.5, with a final budget of 128 visual tokens, it retains 90.3% of dense-model performance while reducing aggregate prefill time by 51.0%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoRePrune 指出视觉 token 的可移除性由表示深度与当前删除集合共同决定，单靠重要性或冗余度做 training-free 剪枝会误判；其两阶段框架在激进 token 预算下保住性能，Qwen3.5 上 128 视觉 token 保留稠密模型 90.3% 性能、预填充总时间降 51.0%。
Motivation: training-free 视觉 token 剪枝普遍把重要性、冗余度当作可安全删除的代理信号，但这些信号没有刻画可移除性对表示深度和删除上下文的条件依赖，导致在激进预算下误删。
Method: 提出两阶段 training-free 框架 CoRePrune：Progressive Perturbation-Aware Visual Pruning 随视觉表示演化刷新删除效应，Set-Conditioned Refinement 在视觉-文本交互后按当前删除集合重新评估候选的拯救收益；用受控干预验证深度与删除上下文的作用。
Result: 受控干预显示同一 token 在不同深度删除产生显著不同的下游扰动，固定深度只改删除上下文就会改变候选边际与剪枝边界决策。在覆盖标准图像、高分辨率输入与视频的五个 MLLM 主干上，激进 token 预算下保持性能；Qwen3.5 最终预算 128 视觉 token 时保留稠密模型 90.3% 性能，聚合预填充时间减少 51.0%。
Conclusion: token 重要性本身不足以判定何时可安全删除，剪枝决策必须条件于表示深度与联合删除集合；CoRePrune 按此重构剪枝可在 128 token 预算下兼顾性能保留与预填充加速。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FeatLens: Feature-Guided Dynamic Code Graph Construction and Retrieval for Repository-Level Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent code generation research has moved from isolated function completion toward repository-level generation in existing codebases. To implement a target function correctly, an LLM must identify reusable repository dependencies such as existing functions, APIs, and cross-file definitions. Existing retrieval methods provide such context through code similarity search, persistent whole-repository graphs, or LLM-driven graph exploration, but often incur high graph construction, reasoning, and token costs. Feature-oriented methods offer a natural view of software functionality, yet they mainly support requirement decomposition, planning, or feature editing rather than code dependency retrieval. This paper presents \textbf{FeatLens}, a feature-guided dynamic code graph construction and retrieval approach for repository-level code generation. FeatLens builds a feature index that links natural-language feature descriptions to function-level code entities. Given a generation task, it dynamically constructs a task-specific seed graph from the feature index and applies semantic-structural graph reasoning with personalized PageRank to select a compact reasoning graph. This design replaces persistent whole-repository graph maintenance and LLM exploration with deterministic and lightweight dependency retrieval. Experiments on DevEval and EvoCodeBench show that FeatLens achieves the best DR@15 among sparse, dense, and graph-based baselines (0.501 and 0.460). On DevEval generation, it obtains the highest DIR@1, reaching 52.91\% with DeepSeek-V3.2 and 53.58\% with GPT-5-mini, while maintaining competitive Pass@1 and producing shorter code. Compared with the strongest graph-based baseline, FeatLens reduces graph nodes by 61.0\%, edges by 86.2\%, and total token overhead by 45.9\%, with no LLM tokens used during retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FeatLens 用 feature index 把自然语言功能描述映射到函数级代码实体，按任务动态构建种子图，再用 personalized PageRank 做语义-结构图推理选出紧凑依赖图，替代全仓持久图与 LLM 探索。在 DevEval 与 EvoCodeBench 上 DR@15 达到 0.501 与 0.460（sparse、dense、graph 基线中最佳），DevEval 生成 DIR@1 用 DeepSeek-V3.2 达 52.91%、GPT-5-mini 达 53.58%；相对最强 graph 基线节点减 61.0%、边减 86.2%、token 开销降 45.9%，检索阶段不消耗 LLM token。
Motivation: 仓库级代码生成需要跨文件复用函数、API 与定义，而现有检索靠代码相似度、全仓持久图或 LLM 驱动图遍历，构图、推理与 token 成本都高；feature 视角目前只用于需求拆解与编辑，未被用于依赖检索。
Method: FeatLens 先建 feature index，把自然语言 feature 描述链接到函数级代码实体；给定生成任务后从该索引动态构建任务专属 seed graph，再以 personalized PageRank 做 semantic-structural graph reasoning，选出紧凑 reasoning graph，检索过程不调用 LLM token。
Result: 在 DevEval 与 EvoCodeBench 上 DR@15 分别为 0.501 与 0.460，在 sparse、dense、graph 三类基线中最佳；DevEval 生成任务 DIR@1 用 DeepSeek-V3.2 为 52.91%、用 GPT-5-mini 为 53.58%，Pass@1 保持竞争力且生成代码更短；相对最强 graph 基线，图节点减少 61.0%、边减少 86.2%、总 token 开销降低 45.9%。
Conclusion: 按 feature 引导的动态小图加确定性 PageRank 推理，可以在仓库级代码生成中以远低于全仓图与 LLM 探索的开销拿到最好的依赖检索与生成指标。

papers.title: PP-Net: A Hybrid Physical-Prior Neural Network for Scattered Light Removal in Biomedical Images on Embedded Devices
papers.abstract_en: Scattered light is common in biomedical images, yet its removal remains challenging. The difficulty arises from three aspects: first, aligned scattered-light-free biomedical ground truth is often unavailable; second, scattering is coupled with weak illumination and sensor-induced noise; and third, many learning-based restoration models are computationally expensive for embedded devices in Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) scenarios. To address these issues, this paper proposes PP-Net, a hybrid physical-prior neural network for biomedical scattered light removal. The proposed method consists of three components: DFN-Net suppresses sensor-induced noise, ASAP estimates the scattering map and recovers a physics-based prior map, and GF-Net refines the prior map by fusing it with the denoised observation. To reduce the dependence on paired biomedical ground truth, a progressive synthetic training and cross-domain transfer strategy is developed. Experiments show that the physical-prior branch improves the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) by up to 1.26 dB on paired synthetic benchmarks. Under joint noise-and-scattering degradation, PP-Net improves PSNR by more than 10.8 dB and the structural similarity index measure (SSIM) by more than 0.62 compared with representative baseline methods. On real W2S biomedical images, the proposed method reduces the average Natural Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) score by 43.3\%. Edge deployment with RKNN conversion and INT8 quantization achieves an average inference latency of approximately 200 ms per $512\times512$ image over 360 test images. These results demonstrate that PP-Net provides an effective and deployable solution for microscopic imaging, endoscopic inspection, and edge-assisted biomedical analysis in IoMT scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PP-Net 用物理先验分支做生物医学图像散射光去除：DFN-Net 压传感器噪声，ASAP 估计散射图并恢复物理先验图，GF-Net 把先验图与去噪观测融合精修，配合渐进合成训练与跨域迁移减少对配对真值的依赖。联合噪声-散射退化下相对代表性基线 PSNR 提升超 10.8 dB、SSIM 提升超 0.62，真实 W2S 图像 NIQE 平均降 43.3%，RKNN INT8 量化后 512×512 单图延迟约 200 ms。
Motivation: 生物医学图像散射光去除缺少对齐的无散射真值，且散射与弱照明、传感器噪声耦合；现有学习式复原模型对 IoMT 嵌入式设备算力开销过大。
Method: 三组件流水线：DFN-Net 抑制传感器噪声，ASAP 估计散射图并导出基于物理的先验图，GF-Net 将先验图与去噪观测融合精修；训练采用渐进合成训练加跨域迁移策略以降低对配对真值的依赖；部署用 RKNN 转换与 INT8 量化。
Result: 物理先验分支在配对合成基准上使 PSNR 最多提升 1.26 dB；联合噪声与散射退化下，相对代表性基线 PSNR 提升超 10.8 dB、SSIM 提升超 0.62；真实 W2S 生物医学图像上平均 NIQE 降低 43.3%；360 张测试图上 512×512 图像 RKNN INT8 量化平均推理延迟约 200 ms。
Conclusion: 物理先验与学习式复原结合可在缺少配对真值的条件下提升生物医学图像去散射质量，并通过 RKNN INT8 量化达到 IoMT 边缘设备可部署的延迟。

papers.title: Complementary Roles of Radiomics and Foundation Representations in Renal Cell Carcinoma Classification: A Comparative Study of 2D and 3D CT Encodings
papers.abstract_en: Accurate preoperative subtype classification of renal cell carcinoma (RCC) from contrast-enhanced computed tomography remains clinically challenging. Radiomics provides structured tumour descriptors, whereas foundation representations offer transferable image features. However, it remains unclear whether radiomics still adds value beyond pretrained representations, and how 2D and 3D MedVAE encoders compare in this setting. We compared handcrafted radiomics, 2D MedVAE, 3D MedVAE, and their fusion for binary clear-cell RCC versus non-clear-cell RCC classification on KiTS23 under a unified preprocessing pipeline. Concatenation, cross-attention, and gated fusion were evaluated as representative integration strategies, and radiomics feature importance was analysed to support decision-centric interpretability. Fusion consistently improved discrimination over image-only MedVAE branches. The best overall performance was achieved by 3D gated fusion, with an AUC of 82.7\%, outperforming the best 2D fusion model (79.6%), the radiomics baseline (74.4%), and the single-modality MedVAE branches. Ablation analysis further showed clear gains of the full fusion model over both image-only and radiomics-only variants, indicating complementary contributions from radiomics and image representations. These findings suggest that radiomics remains relevant for RCC CT classification in the presence of foundation representations, and that its integration with MedVAE is more effective in the 3D setting. More broadly, the study supports a complementary role for radiomics and foundation representations in clinically meaningful imaging decision support.
papers.comment: Accepted at Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA 2026). 15 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 KiTS23 上比较手工 radiomics、2D/3D MedVAE 及其融合做透明细胞 RCC 与非透明细胞 RCC 的术前二分类，3D gated fusion 取得最高 AUC 82.7%，优于最佳 2D 融合 79.6% 与 radiomics 基线 74.4%。融合在各配置下都稳定优于纯图像分支，说明 radiomics 在基础模型表征之外仍有增量价值，且 3D 编码下集成更有效。
Motivation: 增强 CT 上 RCC 亚型术前分类仍困难；基础模型预训练表征已可迁移，radiomics 是否还有超出预训练特征的增量价值、2D 与 3D MedVAE 编码孰优尚不清楚。
Method: 在统一预处理流程下对比手工 radiomics、2D MedVAE、3D MedVAE 及其融合，融合策略取 concatenation、cross-attention、gated fusion 三种；并分析 radiomics 特征重要性以支持决策层面的可解释性，另做消融比较完整融合与纯图像、纯 radiomics 变体。
Result: KiTS23 上二分类（clear-cell vs non-clear-cell RCC）：3D gated fusion AUC 82.7%，最佳 2D 融合 79.6%，radiomics 基线 74.4%，均高于单模态 MedVAE 分支；消融显示完整融合相对纯图像与纯 radiomics 变体均有明显增益。
Conclusion: radiomics 在基础表征存在时对 RCC CT 分类仍然有效，且与 MedVAE 的集成在 3D 设定下更有效，两者作用互补。

papers.title: Reproducible AI Requires Reproducible Randomness
papers.abstract_en: Pseudorandom number generators (PRNGs) constitute indispensable computational tools across multiple scientific domains, including Monte Carlo simulations, stochastic computing, and artificial intelligence (AI). The reproducibility of such applications critically depends on the ability of PRNG implementations to generate identical sequences across software environments when initialized from the same internal state. These algorithms enable the simulation of stochastic processes while providing deterministic and repeatable behaviour, thereby facilitating reproducible experiments. Modern PRNG implementations may be initialized through either a seed or, more accurately, an initial state that exceeds the capacity of a conventional integer seed. However, reliance on a simple seed alone frequently proves insufficient to ensure consistent program execution traces across different implementations. A natural assumption is that transferring the complete internal state of a generator should guarantee identical outputs regardless of the software library used. This study examines the validity of this assumption by investigating whether complete initial states can ensure cross-library fidelity and portability of PRNG streams. We focus on two widely deployed generators, Mersenne Twister and Philox, and evaluate their implementations across four major Python ecosystems-Random, NumPy, PyTorch, and TensorFlow. We compare the sequences produced by these implementations against those generated by the original reference algorithms under identical initialization conditions. Our results demonstrate that reproducibility cannot be assumed from PRNG state transfer alone, even when implementations claim to follow the same underlying algorithm. While fidelity was successfully achieved for several implementations, significant discrepancies were observed in others. Most notably, the Philox implementation in PyTorch exhibits fundamental incompatibilities with the reference algorithm, preventing exact reproduction of generator outputs across environments. These findings challenge the common expectation that access to a full internal state of a PRNG is sufficient to ensure reproducibility across software stacks. They further highlight that implementation-specific design choices can introduce hidden barriers to experimental replication, particularly in AI workflows that rely on multiple frameworks. This work shows that implementation fidelity of a PRNG is a necessary condition for scientific reproducibility and makes two primary contributions. First, it identifies practical guidelines for achieving reliable PRNG usage and reproducibility within the Python scientific and AI ecosystem. Second, it evaluates the extent to which cross-library portability and fidelity can be recovered through user-level techniques, without requiring modifications to library source code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文检验「把 PRNG 完整内部状态搬过去就能跨库复现」这一假设：对 Mersenne Twister 与 Philox 在 Random、NumPy、PyTorch、TensorFlow 四个 Python 生态中与参考算法逐序列比对，发现仅靠状态转移无法保证可复现，PyTorch 的 Philox 与参考算法存在根本不兼容。作者据此给出 PRNG 使用的实践指南，并评估用用户级技巧（不改库源码）能在多大程度上恢复跨库可移植性与保真度。
Motivation: AI 实验跨框架复现依赖 PRNG 输出一致，但仅凭整数 seed 或完整内部状态并不足以保证不同软件栈产生相同执行轨迹，隐藏的实现差异会阻断实验复现。
Method: 选取 Mersenne Twister 与 Philox 两种广泛部署的生成器，在 Random、NumPy、PyTorch、TensorFlow 四个 Python 生态中，将各实现与原始参考算法在相同初始化条件下生成的序列逐一比对，评估跨库保真度与可移植性，并测试用户级恢复技巧。

papers.title: Can We Predict Anomaly Detection Performance from Embedding-Space Geometry?
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection systems are often trained using normal data alone, while model selection and evaluation typically require labeled anomalies. We study whether anomaly detection performance can be predicted without access to anomalous data. For kNN-based detectors, we derive a lower bound on the area under the ROC curve (AUC) that relates detection performance to the separation between inlier and outlier scores and to their respective variances. Under a local scaling model, we use this bound to characterize how density variation, intrinsic-dimensional heterogeneity, and cross-domain mismatch contribute to score variability. We then investigate anomaly-free model selection and show that inlier score variance alone does not reliably predict performance across different representations. To address this limitation, we introduce simple pseudo-anomaly probes that provide a reference for estimating relative score separation. Experiments on the DCASE 2022-2025 benchmarks, spanning four embedding models and 208 candidate systems, show that pseudo-anomaly-based estimators substantially improve anomaly-free model selection. In particular, diverse pseudo-anomalies enable anomaly-free model selection to outperform conventional development-set selection under domain shift. These results show that embedding-space geometry contains predictive information about anomaly detection performance while also highlighting the representation-dependent nature of inlier-only performance estimates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 kNN 异常检测器，论文推导出一个 AUC 下界，把检测性能与 inlier/outlier 分数的分离度及其方差联系起来，并据此做无异常数据的模型选择。在 DCASE 2022-2025 基准、4 种 embedding 模型、208 个候选系统上，伪异常探针 (pseudo-anomaly probes) 显著改善无异常模型选择，多样伪异常在 domain shift 下超过常规开发集选择。
Motivation: 异常检测通常只用正常数据训练，但模型选择与评估需要带标签的异常；在拿不到异常样本时，无法判断哪个候选系统更好，尤其在 domain shift 下。
Method: 对 kNN 检测器推导 AUC 下界，用 local scaling 模型刻画密度变化、内在维度异质性与跨域失配对分数方差的贡献；发现单靠 inlier 分数方差无法跨表征预测性能，于是引入简单伪异常探针作为估计相对分数分离度的参照，用于无异常模型选择。
Result: 在 DCASE 2022-2025 基准上，覆盖 4 种 embedding 模型与 208 个候选系统，基于伪异常的估计器显著改善无异常模型选择；使用多样伪异常时，无异常模型选择在 domain shift 下超过常规开发集选择。
Conclusion: embedding 空间几何确实包含预测异常检测性能的信息，但 inlier-only 的性能估计依赖于所用表征，因此需要伪异常探针提供分数分离度参照。

papers.title: Code Plans, Diffusion Renders: Open-Ended Generative World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \textbf{CoDeR}, a new paradigm for world modeling. Unlike existing video world models that implicitly represent world dynamics through visual observations, our system explicitly constructs an executable world with code and employs video generation models for visual realization. Specifically, we coordinate five complementary roles to translate high-level concepts into structured world rules, executable dynamics, and perceptual observations. This design enables \textit{long-term memory}, \textit{open-ended interactions}, \textit{autonomous world evolution}, and \textit{multi-agent scenarios}, where multiple entities can act, interact, and evolve persistently beyond the current observation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework substantially extends the capabilities of existing world models, enabling long-term memory, open-ended interactions, autonomous evolution, and persistent multi-agent dynamics, while achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple evaluation settings. Code and model weights will be made publicly available. Project Page: \href{https://becauseimbatman0.github.io/CoDeR}{CoDeR}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoDeR 把世界建模范式改为用代码显式写出可执行的世界规则与动力学，再用视频生成模型渲染视觉观测，由五个互补角色把高层概念翻译成规则、动力学与感知。它带来长期记忆、开放交互、自主演化与持久多智能体交互，并在多个评测设置上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型只通过视觉观测隐式表达世界动力学，难以支撑长期记忆、开放交互、自主演化与多实体持续互动。
Method: 系统用代码显式构建可执行世界，配合视频生成模型做视觉实现；五个互补角色分别把高层概念转成结构化世界规则、可执行动力学与感知观测。
Result: 在多个评测设置上达到 state-of-the-art，实现长期记忆、开放交互、自主演化与持久的多智能体动力学；代码与模型权重将公开。
Conclusion: 把世界动力学显式写成可执行代码、再由生成模型渲染，能实质扩展现有世界模型的能力边界。

papers.title: Recursive self-improvement of AI research agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are beginning to automate research and development across the AI stack, from improving training efficiency to optimizing inference. A natural next step is to improve the research efficiency of the agents themselves. When an AI research agent's own code is the object of optimization, each accepted rewrite becomes the agent that the next round edits. We refer to this loop as recursive self-improvement. Its significance lies in a long-standing trend, in which increased cumulative spending on R&D yields diminishing returns. Sustained self-improvement offers a way to counter this trend. We present AIDE^2, a system that implements this loop for a frontier AI research agent. It proposes changes to its own code, benchmarks modified versions of itself on a suite of AI R&D tasks, and keeps the changes that perform best on hidden evaluations. In an autonomous 8-day run, AIDE^2 discovered seven successive improvements, ranging from a new search policy to memory mechanisms that compress and manage the agent's growing context. These gains generalize to four held-out benchmarks spanning machine learning engineering, heuristic algorithm engineering, and physics-based weather forecasting, the last of which is out of distribution from the selection tasks. On all four, the strongest discovered agent matches or exceeds a human-engineered production research agent that ranks among the strongest on FML-Bench. On a separate held-out task family, the discovered agents also exhibit reduced reward hacking, a property the loop never explicitly optimized for: the rate falls from 55% to 32% during the run, 7 percentage points below the human-engineered agent. Together, these results show that an AI research agent can improve its own research efficiency through recursive self-improvement, and that these gains transfer to tasks and domains the loop never encountered.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIDE^2 让 AI research agent 改写自己的代码并在隐藏评测上保留最优改动，8 天自主运行发现 7 项连续改进，泛化到 4 个 held-out 基准（含分布外的 physics-based weather forecasting），reward hacking 率从 55% 降到 32%，比人工工程 agent 低 7 个百分点。
Motivation: AI agent 已在自动化训练效率与推理优化，但 agent 自身研究效率的提升仍靠人工；同时 R&D 累计投入递减回报是长期趋势，需要一种可持续的自我改进机制来对冲。
Method: AIDE^2 实现递归自我改进 (recursive self-improvement)：agent 提出对自身代码的修改，在一套 AI R&D 任务上 benchmark 修改版自己，并只在 hidden evaluation 上保留表现最好的改动；每次被接受的重写成为下一轮被编辑的对象。
Result: 8 天自主运行发现 7 项连续改进，涵盖新的搜索策略与压缩/管理增长上下文的 memory 机制；改进泛化到 4 个 held-out 基准（机器学习工程、启发式算法工程、physics-based weather forecasting，后者相对选择任务为分布外），在全部 4 个上最强发现 agent 匹配或超过在 FML-Bench 上排名前列的人工工程生产 agent；在另一 held-out 任务族上 reward hacking 率从 55% 降至 32%，比人工工程 agent 低 7 个百分点，而该性质循环从未显式优化。
Conclusion: AI research agent 可以通过递归自我改进提升自身研究效率，且这些增益能迁移到循环从未遇到的任务与领域，包括分布外的 physics-based weather forecasting。

papers.title: A Practical Guide on Graphical Model Validation
papers.abstract_en: This manuscript formalizes the most popular model validation tools used in general insurance actuarial modeling. These include graphical tools like calibration plots, actual-vs-expected plots, lift charts, Murphy diagrams, as well as classical statistical tools such as Bregman losses, deviance losses, elementary losses, Murphy's decomposition and Gini scores. Particular emphasis is placed on whether calibration and discrimination are studied under a policy-weighted or an exposure-weighted population measure. This distinction is crucial in ensuring that premium schemes are calibrated on the correct scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把一般保险精算建模中最常用的模型验证工具形式化：校准图、实际-预期图、lift chart、Murphy diagram，以及 Bregman 损失、deviance 损失、elementary 损失、Murphy 分解和 Gini 分数。核心论断是校准与区分度必须明确在保单加权 (policy-weighted) 还是风险单位加权 (exposure-weighted) 总体测度下研究，选错测度会使保费方案校准在错误的尺度上。
Motivation: 保险定价模型的验证工具散落在文献中且口径不一，尤其校准与区分度常在未指明的加权口径下报告，导致保费方案校准到错误的总体尺度。
Method: 对图形工具（calibration plot、actual-vs-expected plot、lift chart、Murphy diagram）与统计工具（Bregman loss、deviance loss、elementary loss、Murphy's decomposition、Gini score）逐一形式化，并在每个工具上区分 policy-weighted 与 exposure-weighted 两种总体测度。
Result: 给出一套形式化的验证工具体系，其中心结论是校准与区分度的结论随加权测度（policy-weighted vs exposure-weighted）而变，该区分决定保费方案是否校准在正确尺度上。
Conclusion: 模型验证报告必须显式声明所用的总体加权测度，否则校准与区分度结论不可比，保费方案可能校准在错误尺度上。

papers.title: Mammo-LIFE: Longitudinal Mammographic Imaging and Clinical Feature Enrichment for Post-Radiotherapy Outcome Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) systems have substantially improved breast cancer screening, diagnosis, and prognosis. Comparatively, postradiotherapy outcome prediction using paired longitudinal mammograms has received considerably less attention. This is largely due to the limited availability of well-annotated longitudinal datasets. Longitudinal mammograms, coupled with paired pre- and post-treatment information, provide a unique opportunity to characterize treatment-induced breast tissue changes following radiotherapy. The resulting learned representations can serve as a valuable asset for advancing personalized radiotherapy planning and post-treatment management. In this context, we propose Mammo-LIFE, a patient-level multimodal framework for post-radiotherapy outcome prediction that combines longitudinal mammographic features with patient-level clinical variables. The imaging branch processes paired pre- and post-treatment mammograms acquired from the four standard views using a mammography-specific encoder adapted via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Within each view, preand post-treatment representations are explicitly compared through a longitudinal comparison module to capture treatment-related changes. The resulting view-level embeddings are then aggregated using learned view-attention pooling to form a unified patient-level mammographic representation. Selected clinical variables are subsequently combined with the image-derived prediction probability through a late-fusion strategy. To evaluate the effectiveness of combining paired longitudinal mammograms with clinical information, experiments were conducted on an in-house clinical cohort using patient-level stratified five-fold cross-validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mammo-LIFE 是患者级多模态放疗后结局预测框架：用 LoRA 适配的乳腺专用编码器处理四个标准位的治疗前后配对钼靶，经纵向比较模块显式对比前后表征，再用视图注意力池化聚合成患者级表征，最后与临床变量晚期融合。在自建临床队列的患者级分层五折交叉验证中检验了配对纵向钼靶与临床信息结合的有效性。
Motivation: 放疗后结局预测依赖配对纵向钼靶与治疗前后信息来刻画放疗引起的乳腺组织变化，但标注良好的纵向数据集稀缺，该方向得到的关注远少于 AI 辅助乳腺癌筛查与诊断。
Method: 影像分支用经 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 适配的 mammography-specific encoder 处理四个标准位的治疗前后配对钼靶；每个位内用 longitudinal comparison module 显式对比前后表征，再用 learned view-attention pooling 聚合成患者级钼靶表征；选定的临床变量与影像预测概率按 late-fusion 策略结合。
Result: 在自建临床队列 (in-house clinical cohort) 上以患者级分层五折交叉验证 (patient-level stratified five-fold cross-validation) 实验，检验配对纵向钼靶与临床信息结合的有效性。

papers.title: One-Step Generative Surrogate Models via Block-Triangular Joint Drifting
papers.abstract_en: Drifting provides a direct route to one-step generative models, but applying it directly to stochastic transition modeling requires multiple samples of the next state conditioned on the same current state. Standard trajectory data, however, typically provide only one realized next state for each observed current state and therefore do not provide an empirical approximation of the corresponding conditional distribution over possible next states. We introduce block-triangular joint drifting, which instead applies a projected drift field to the empirically accessible joint distribution of consecutive states. Importantly, the block-triangular architecture preserves the current-state marginal while making its second component a direct sampler of the conditional distribution of possible next states. The resulting surrogate generates stochastic trajectories with one model evaluation per time step, without auxiliary generative steps between time steps. Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate marginal and trajectory-dependent statistics and favorable accuracy-cost tradeoffs compared with deterministic, diffusion-, flow-, and distillation-based generative surrogate models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对随机转移建模中同一当前状态只有一个实现下一状态、无法估计条件分布的问题，提出 block-triangular joint drifting：把投影 drift field 作用在相邻状态的联合分布上，块三角结构保持当前状态边缘分布不变，同时让第二分量直接采样下一状态的条件分布。生成随机轨迹每时间步只需一次模型评估，无需步间辅助生成步骤，并在数值实验中给出准确的边缘与轨迹依赖统计量，相对确定性、diffusion、flow 与蒸馏类生成代理模型呈现有利的精度-成本权衡。
Motivation: 直接把 drifting 用于随机转移建模需要同一当前状态下的多个下一状态样本，而标准轨迹数据每个当前状态通常只有一个实现，无法经验逼近条件分布。
Method: 提出 block-triangular joint drifting：对相邻状态的可经验访问联合分布施加投影 drift field (projected drift field)，块三角架构保持当前状态边缘分布并使第二分量成为条件分布的直接采样器；每时间步一次模型评估生成轨迹。
Result: 数值实验显示生成的随机轨迹在边缘统计量与轨迹依赖统计量上准确，并相对确定性、diffusion-based、flow-based 与 distillation-based 生成代理模型呈现有利的 accuracy-cost 权衡。
Conclusion: 对联合分布而非条件分布做 drifting，可在保持边缘分布的前提下用单步、无辅助生成的评估得到随机轨迹代理，精度-成本优于现有生成式代理路线。

papers.title: Latent Dataset Distillation for Human Motion Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Dataset distillation (DD) compresses a large training set into a compact synthetic set while preserving downstream training utility. Although DD has been widely studied for images and recently extended to time-series forecasting, its application to human motion prediction remains largely unexplored. Human motion is high-dimensional and structurally coupled, and gradient matching (GM) in the original motion space optimizes many correlated variables without a prior on pose plausibility or temporal dynamics, which frequently yields implausible and unstable synthetic motions. To address this limitation, we propose a latent DD framework that regularizes distillation with a learned motion prior. Motions are first compressed by a residual-quantized variational autoencoder (RVQ-VAE), and distillation then updates only a learnable latent bank through the frozen quantizer and decoder. The pretrained decoder restricts synthetic motions to its output space, while residual quantization progressively refines the latent approximation across multiple codebooks and alleviates the representational bottleneck of single-stage vector quantization. Experiments on Human3.6M, CMU, and 3DPW with two prediction backbones show that the proposed framework outperforms direct GM in 27 of 30 evaluated settings and random subsets in every setting, and produces visibly more plausible synthetic motions in qualitative comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把数据集蒸馏 (dataset distillation) 搬到人体动作预测时，原始动作空间的梯度匹配 (gradient matching) 缺少姿态合理性与时间动态先验，会生成不合理且不稳定的合成动作。该框架先用残差量化 VAE (RVQ-VAE) 把动作压进潜空间，蒸馏只更新可学习 latent bank 并经冻结的量化器与解码器还原动作，使合成动作被限制在预训练解码器的输出空间内。在 Human3.6M、CMU、3DPW 上用两个预测 backbone 评测，30 个设置中 27 个胜过直接梯度匹配、全部胜过随机子集。
Motivation: 数据集蒸馏已在图像与时序预测上被广泛研究，但人体动作高维且结构耦合，原始动作空间的梯度匹配对大量相关变量优化时没有姿态合理性与时间动态先验，常产生不合理、不稳定的合成动作。
Method: 提出 latent DD 框架：先用残差量化变分自编码器 (RVQ-VAE) 把动作压缩到潜空间，蒸馏阶段只更新一个可学习的 latent bank，前向经冻结的量化器与解码器得到合成动作；预训练解码器把合成动作限制在其输出空间，多码本的残差量化逐级细化潜表示近似，缓解单级向量量化的表示瓶颈。
Result: 在 Human3.6M、CMU、3DPW 三个数据集、两个动作预测 backbone 上，共 30 个评测设置中，该框架在 27 个设置上超过直接梯度匹配 (direct GM)，在全部设置上超过随机子集 (random subsets)；定性比较中合成动作明显更合理。
Conclusion: 把动作预测的数据集蒸馏放进带学习先验的潜空间、只更新 latent bank，可以在保持下游训练效用的同时让合成动作更合理稳定，优于在原始动作空间直接做梯度匹配。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Source of Disturbance Matters: External, Internal, and Control-Generated Noise in Adaptive Regulation
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive regulation can itself perturb the state it is intended to stabilize. In replicated simulations of an adaptive agent, we compare external disturbance, persistent internally generated disturbance, and control-generated disturbance under regulation-first and disturbance-first ordering. Persistent internal disturbance produces the largest exposure and regulatory burden within the tested parameter grid. When positive controller updates generate an immediate disturbance cost, increasing that cost produces a nonmonotonic response: effective disturbance initially rises, variability across stochastic runs increases over an intermediate range, and corrective activity becomes strongly suppressed at higher costs. The results show how disturbance source and timing shape exposure and controller burden in this model. They motivate testing adaptive agents with distinct disturbance sources and assessing regulatory activity alongside exposure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自适应调节 (adaptive regulation) 的复制仿真中对比三类扰动源——外部扰动、持续的内部生成扰动、控制生成扰动——并按「调节优先」与「扰动优先」两种时序排列。持续内部扰动在所测参数网格内产生最大的暴露与调节负担；当正向控制器更新立即带来扰动成本时，提高该成本导致非单调响应：有效扰动先升、随机运行间变异度在中段增大、高成本下纠正性活动被强烈抑制。
Motivation: 自适应调节本身可能扰动它试图稳定的状态，而扰动来源与施加时序如何影响暴露和控制器负担此前缺少对照。
Method: 在自适应 agent 的复制仿真中，把外部扰动、持续内部生成扰动、控制生成扰动三类来源与 regulation-first、disturbance-first 两种时序组合，在参数网格上比较暴露与调节负担，并扫描正向控制器更新的即时扰动成本。
Result: 在所测参数网格内，持续内部扰动产生最大的暴露与调节负担；提高正向更新的即时扰动成本时，有效扰动先上升，随机运行间变异度在中段范围增大，高成本下纠正性活动被强烈抑制，整体呈非单调响应。
Conclusion: 扰动来源与时序决定暴露与控制器负担，测试自适应 agent 应区分不同扰动源，并把调节活动与暴露一起评估。

papers.title: DeepFEAv2: Deep Learning for Transient Finite Element Analysis Beyond Structured Meshes
papers.abstract_en: Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is widely used for transient mechanical simulations, but its high computational cost limits real-time and high-resolution applications. Deep learning surrogate models can reduce this cost; however, many existing approaches are restricted to steady-state prediction or cannot jointly predict Node- and Element-based Outputs (NEO) over time. The state-of-the-art DeepFEA framework has addressed these issues but remains limited to structured finite element (FE) meshes. To overcome this limitation, this study proposes DeepFEAv2, a deep learning surrogate framework that enables prediction of transient FEA simulations across different FE mesh topologies and element types. The main contributions of DeepFEAv2 are: (a) a module that uses the FE connectivity matrix to organize input features by element and arrange them into an input sequence guided by the mesh topology; (b) a novel neural network architecture designed to process the input sequence and jointly predict NEO over time; and (c) a FEA-informed optimization strategy for regularizing these NEO predictions. DeepFEAv2 was evaluated on structured and unstructured 3D linear elastic datasets, as well as on a pressure-driven aortic valve dataset. DeepFEAv2 achieved R^2 values up to 0.99 and normalized errors as low as 0.38%. Compared with DeepFEA, it achieved up to 38.0% relative increase in R^2 and up to 87.1% reduction in normalized error. DeepFEAv2 also performed inference up to three orders of magnitude faster than traditional FEA. These results demonstrate that DeepFEAv2 can efficiently model transient FEA simulations across increasingly complex FE settings, providing a scalable surrogate framework for transient FEA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepFEAv2 是面向瞬态有限元分析 (transient FEA) 的深度学习代理框架，用 FE 连接矩阵按单元组织输入并按网格拓扑排成序列，配合专门的网络结构联合预测节点与单元输出 (NEO)，再用 FEA-informed 正则化约束这些预测。在结构化与非结构化 3D 线弹性数据集及压力驱动主动脉瓣数据集上，R² 最高 0.99、归一化误差最低 0.38%，相比 DeepFEA 的 R² 相对提升最高 38.0%、归一化误差最高降低 87.1%，推理比传统 FEA 快最多三个数量级。
Motivation: 瞬态 FEA 计算成本高，难以支撑实时与高分辨率应用；已有深度代理模型多限于稳态或无法随时间联合预测 NEO，而 SOTA 的 DeepFEA 又只能处理结构化网格。
Method: 三个组件：用 FE 连接矩阵按单元组织输入特征并按网格拓扑排成输入序列的模块；处理该序列、随时间联合预测节点与单元输出 (NEO) 的新神经网络架构；以及对 NEO 预测做正则化的 FEA-informed 优化策略。
Result: 在结构化与非结构化 3D 线弹性数据集和压力驱动主动脉瓣数据集上，R² 最高 0.99，归一化误差最低 0.38%；相对 DeepFEA，R² 相对提升最高 38.0%，归一化误差最高降低 87.1%；推理速度比传统 FEA 快最多三个数量级。
Conclusion: 把网格拓扑与 FE 连接信息直接编码进序列输入和损失，可让瞬态 FEA 代理跨网格拓扑与单元类型扩展，成为复杂 FE 设定下的可扩展代理框架。

papers.title: QuantWM: Temporally Consistent 2-Bit KV Cache Quantization for World Models and Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: KV cache memory has become a major deployment bottleneck for video generation and world models, which motivates low-bit quantization study for efficiency. Existing 2-bit KV cache quantization methods can achieve nearly lossless performance on video benchmarks such as VBench, however, we find that they still cause severe temporal flickering and visual degradation. Meanwhile, deeper investigates show that Key quantization produces smaller reconstruction errors than Value, but surprisingly leads to much larger output degradation. We trace this discrepancy to attention: small Key perturbations can change the attention logits, i.e., QK^\top, and shift the temporal-spatial tokens selected by Queries. These observations motivate us to explicitly preserve attention logits and temporal-spatial token selection during KV cache quantization to alleviate the visual degradation problem. To address this issue, we present QuantWM, a training-free and strictly causal 2-bit KV cache quantization framework. QuantWM introduces two complementary techniques to mitigate the attention shifts. Firstly, quantization-sensitivity-aware clustering (QSAC) jointly considers historical Query sensitivity and residual ranges to select INT2-friendly Key centroids, which reduces quantization errors in channels that are more critical to attention. In addition, principal-subspace attention compensation (PSAC) restores the remaining Key errors along the dominant Query subspace using low-rank projections, which provides a direct and efficient correction to stabilize attention logits. Extensive experiments on Causal-Forcing, LingBot-World-v2, HY-World 1.5, Matrix-Game-2 and Longcat-Video demonstrate that QuantWM significantly improves visual quality and temporal consistency, while outperforming existing methods across image and video quality metrics with up to 6.20x KV cache memory compression and limited additional overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuantWM 是面向视频生成与 world model 的免训练、严格因果 2-bit KV cache 量化框架，核心是保住 attention logits 与时序-空间 token 选择：QSAC 联合历史 Query 敏感度与残差范围选 INT2 友好的 Key 聚类中心，PSAC 用低秩投影沿主 Query 子空间补偿剩余 Key 误差。在 Causal-Forcing、LingBot-World-v2、HY-World 1.5、Matrix-Game-2、Longcat-Video 上显著改善画质与时序一致性，KV cache 压缩最高 6.20×。
Motivation: 现有 2-bit KV cache 量化在 VBench 等视频基准上近乎无损，却仍造成严重时序闪烁与画质退化；且 Key 量化重建误差更小却带来更大输出退化，根源是小的 Key 扰动会改变 attention logits (QK^⊤) 并移动 Query 选中的时序-空间 token。
Method: 免训练且严格因果的 2-bit KV cache 量化框架 QuantWM，含两个互补技术：量化敏感度感知聚类 (QSAC) 联合历史 Query 敏感度与残差范围选择 INT2 友好的 Key 聚类中心；主子空间 attention 补偿 (PSAC) 用低秩投影沿主导 Query 子空间恢复剩余 Key 误差以稳定 attention logits。
Result: 在 Causal-Forcing、LingBot-World-v2、HY-World 1.5、Matrix-Game-2 和 Longcat-Video 上，QuantWM 显著改善视觉质量与时序一致性，在图像与视频质量指标上超过现有方法，KV cache 内存压缩最高达 6.20×，额外开销有限。
Conclusion: 2-bit KV cache 量化的关键不是最小化 Key 重建误差，而是显式保持 attention logits 与时序-空间 token 选择；据此可在免训练、严格因果约束下同时拿到高压缩比与更稳的时序一致性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Sample, Simulate, Select: Physics-in-the-Loop Text-to-Motion for Humanoids Without Training
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-motion models generate plausible human motion but do not model a robot's dynamics; whole-body tracking controllers execute robot references reliably but cannot replan an infeasible one. Recent language-to-humanoid systems bridge this gap by training. We measure how much of the gap closes with no training at all, by putting the deployment controller itself in the loop. Sample-simulate-select (S$^3$) draws $N$ motions per prompt from a frozen text-to-motion model, retargets each to a Unitree G1 by direction-matching inverse kinematics, rolls all of them out under full rigid-body dynamics with the pretrained SONIC tracking policy, and keeps the candidate the policy executed best. Because the verifier is the deterministic simulator itself, S$^3$ attains the any-of-$N$ ceiling by construction; what we measure is where that ceiling lies and what falls short of it. On 200 stratified HumanML3D test prompts with $N=8$, upright execution rises from 83.5% to 89.5% and hardware-gate passes from 33 to 85; on the complete test split (4,184 prompts) it rises from 80.5% to 89.5%. A kinematic verifier that predicts falls well (AUROC 0.90) recovers only a quarter of this gain: ranking a prompt's own candidates is harder than classifying the population. What selection cannot fix is one class, prompts that lower the pelvis, which a generator trained on retargeted robot data does execute. We further score the semantic fidelity of the executed motion with the standard text-motion evaluator, with a real-mocap control that attributes the loss to the robot projection, ablate the retargeter against GMR (complementary failures: the any-of-8 ceiling rises to 95.0% over both), and execute all 177 gate-selected clips on the real G1: every one completes standing, with hardware tracking error matching simulation ($r=0.94$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S³（sample-simulate-select）在零训练下把部署控制器 SONIC 放进生成回路：每个 prompt 从冻结 text-to-motion 模型采 N 条动作，方向匹配 IK 重定向到 Unitree G1，全刚体动力学仿真后保留策略执行最好的候选。200 条分层 HumanML3D 测试 prompt、N=8 时直立执行率 83.5%→89.5%，硬件门通过数 33→85；完整测试集 4,184 条上 80.5%→89.5%。
Motivation: text-to-motion 模型不建模机器人动力学，全身跟踪控制器又无法重规划不可行参考；现有语言到人形方案靠训练弥合，本文要测完全不训练能弥合多少。
Method: S³ 流程：冻结 text-to-motion 模型按 prompt 采 N 条动作，用方向匹配逆运动学 (direction-matching IK) 重定向到 Unitree G1，在全刚体动力学下用预训练 SONIC 跟踪策略 rollout，保留策略执行最好的候选；验证器即确定性仿真器本身，另用运动学验证器（跌倒预测 AUROC 0.90）与重定向器对 GMR 做消融，并用标准 text-motion 评估器打语义保真度、配真实 mocap 对照。
Result: 200 条分层 HumanML3D 测试 prompt、N=8：直立执行 83.5%→89.5%，硬件门通过 33→85；完整测试集 4,184 条：80.5%→89.5%。运动学验证器只收回约四分之一增益；重定向器消融中与 GMR 互补失败，any-of-8 上限升到 95.0%。177 条门选片段全部在实机 G1 上完成站立，实机跟踪误差与仿真相关 r=0.94。
Conclusion: 零训练的选择式回路即可逼近 any-of-N 上限并大幅提高可执行率，但选择修不好生成器本身不会产生的动作类（如下蹲降低骨盆的 prompt），这类要靠在重定向机器人数据上训练的生成器。

papers.title: Reliability Theory for AI Control
papers.abstract_en: Reliability theory gives a mature language for layered systems, but its formal tools are not yet standard in frontier AI control. We apply them to Google DeepMind's defenses against rogue deployment. The same control stack can have cubic, quadratic, or linear rare-failure suppression depending on its failure domains. Birnbaum importance identifies which component improvements buy the most nominal reliability, while prevention changes the population on which recovery is demanded. These results give concrete guidance about what to separate, improve, measure, and test.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把可靠性理论 (reliability theory) 的分层系统工具形式化地套到 Google DeepMind 防范 rogue deployment 的控制栈上：同一控制栈按其失效域 (failure domains) 划分不同，稀有失效抑制可呈三次方、二次方或线性三种标度。Birnbaum importance 用于定位哪个部件改进最能买到标称可靠性，而 prevention 会改变 recovery 所作用的总体。
Motivation: 分层系统的可靠性理论已有成熟语言，但其形式化工具尚未成为前沿 AI 控制 (frontier AI control) 的标准做法，导致难以判断控制栈中该分离、改进、测量与测试什么。
Method: 将可靠性理论的形式化工具应用于 Google DeepMind 防范 rogue deployment 的控制栈：按失效域结构推导稀有失效抑制的标度律（三次方/二次方/线性），用 Birnbaum importance 做部件级可靠性归因，并区分 prevention 与 recovery 所作用的总体。
Result: 同一控制栈可实现三次方、二次方或线性三种稀有失效抑制，取决于失效域划分；Birnbaum importance 指出哪些部件改进带来最大标称可靠性收益；prevention 改变 recovery 被需求的总体。
Conclusion: 控制栈的失效域结构决定稀有失效的抑制标度，因此应据此决定分离什么、改进哪个部件、测量与测试什么。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SuperPCA: subspace analysis and an efficient algorithm for high-dimensional PCA
papers.abstract_en: Principal component analysis (PCA) is a fundamental tool to reduce the dimensionality of the data in many applications. PCA finds a few signal directions that contain most of the variability of the data by computing the eigenvectors of the sample covariance matrix. In this work, we focus on the spiked covariance model, in which the data vectors are defined by a few orthogonal signals plus an isotropic Gaussian noise, and our goal is to estimate one or more of the leading signals. Our main theoretical finding is that the subspace spanned by several leading eigenvectors of the sample covariance matrix contains significant information about the desired signals long before the individual eigenvectors converge to the population principal components. To prove this, we derive a posteriori bounds for the angle between the subspace spanned by the desired population signals and the subspace obtained from the sample using perturbation theory for singular vectors. This leads to a new algorithm, SuperPCA (SUbsPace subsamplER PCA), which capitalizes on an approximate eigenspace of the sample covariance matrix to find the leading signals far more efficiently and accurately than classical PCA in the high-dimensional, multi-signal setting. SuperPCA exploits only a small number of subsampled coordinates of the data, which can lead to tremendous savings in data acquisition cost, especially when the signals are approximately sparse. For the same number of measurements, SuperPCA can offer a factor $10$ improvement in accuracy compared to the classical PCA method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SuperPCA（SUbsPace subsamplER PCA）利用 spiked covariance 模型下一个关键事实：样本协方差矩阵若干前导特征向量张成的子空间在单个特征向量尚未收敛到总体主成分之前，就已包含关于目标信号的显著信息。作者用奇异向量扰动理论导出目标信号子空间与样本子空间夹角的后验界，并据此只用少量子采样坐标高效恢复前导信号；在相同测量数下，相比经典 PCA 精度提升可达 10 倍。
Motivation: 高维多信号设定下，经典 PCA 需要单个特征向量收敛才能可靠恢复信号，收敛慢且需采集全部坐标，数据获取成本高，尤其当信号近似稀疏时。
Method: 在 spiked covariance 模型（少量正交信号加各向同性 Gaussian 噪声）中，用奇异向量扰动理论推导目标信号子空间与样本协方差前导特征向量张成子空间之间夹角的后验界；据此提出 SuperPCA，仅利用数据的少量子采样坐标，从近似特征空间出发恢复前导信号。
Result: 在相同测量数下，SuperPCA 相比经典 PCA 精度提升可达 10 倍；核心理论结论是样本协方差多个前导特征向量张成的子空间在单个特征向量收敛到总体主成分之前就已携带目标信号的显著信息。
Conclusion: 子空间收敛早于单个特征向量收敛，因此可绕开完整特征分解、用子采样坐标在高维多信号场景下更高效准确地估计信号，并显著降低数据采集成本。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: OMatG-flash: An All-Atom Flow Map with Reinforce Adjoint Matching for Scalable Materials Discovery
papers.abstract_en: The discovery of novel inorganic materials drives technological breakthroughs in critical fields such as computing and energy storage. Generative AI has promised to accelerate the materials discovery pipeline, but state-of-the-art flow and diffusion models remain bottlenecked by the cost of proposing candidate materials. To address this, we introduce OMatG-flash, an all-atom flow map for inorganic crystal structure prediction (CSP) and de novo generation (DNG). OMatG-flash is a Pareto-optimal inference engine for materials, sampling candidate materials with an order of magnitude fewer inference steps and less wall-clock time than existing flow and diffusion models while demonstrating benchmark performance on par with the state-of-the-art. To enable post-training fine-tuning we apply Reinforce Adjoint Matching to flow maps, further improving match rates and RMSE on the unconditional CSP task. OMatG-flash showcases the potential of flow maps to accelerate generation of high-quality candidate inorganic materials and demonstrates a step forward in sample throughput necessary for data-hungry materials discovery workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OMatG-flash 把无机晶体结构预测 (CSP) 与从头生成 (DNG) 的流模型压成单步 all-atom flow map，推理步数比现有 flow/diffusion 模型少一个数量级、墙钟时间更短，同时基准表现与 SOTA 持平；再用 Reinforce Adjoint Matching 做后训练微调，进一步提升无条件 CSP 的 match rate 与 RMSE。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 加速材料发现的瓶颈在于候选材料采样成本高，flow/diffusion 模型推理步数与墙钟时间拖慢了数据饥渴型材料发现流程。
Method: 提出 OMatG-flash：面向 CSP 与 DNG 的 all-atom flow map 推理引擎；后训练阶段对 flow map 施加 Reinforce Adjoint Matching 以支持微调。
Result: 推理步数比现有 flow 与 diffusion 模型少一个数量级、墙钟时间更短，基准表现与 SOTA 相当；Reinforce Adjoint Matching 微调后无条件 CSP 的 match rate 与 RMSE 进一步改善。
Conclusion: flow map 可以在保持 SOTA 级生成质量的同时大幅提升采样吞吐，是数据饥渴型材料发现流程的可行推理引擎。

papers.title: Double Descent and Malign Overfitting in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Conventional wisdom in deep learning holds that overparameterization---having more parameters $p$ than training samples $n$---is benign: larger models generalize better and, even without regularization, interpolating models generalize well, the test error following a double-descent curve. One might expect the same benign overfitting for diffusion models, whose training reduces to regression, i.e. to minimizing a quadratic score-matching loss. Yet the opposite is observed: overfitting here is catastrophic, driving the model into a memorization regime. We resolve this paradox by combining experiments on U-Nets trained on CelebA with a random-features model for which we derive closed-form learning curves. We show that with a fixed number $m$ of noise realizations per training sample, an interpolation peak does occur, but at $p\sim nm$ rather than at $p\sim n$ as in standard regression. The rise of the test loss, however, sets in much earlier, at $p\sim n$, independently of $m$. This overfitting is malign because, although the implicit regularization of training is fully at work, it drives the model toward the empirical score, which memorizes the training set, rather than toward the true score. A bias-variance decomposition pinpoints the mechanism: the bias of the score estimator starts to grow at $p\sim n$; past the peak the variance decays, as in regression, whereas the bias keeps growing and both saturate at a large value. Since diffusion models are trained with $m\gg1$, the peak is pushed to very large model sizes, and therefore sit on the rising branch that precedes it, where malign overfitting is already in play. Nevertheless, overparameterization remains beneficial when paired with regularization: in the random-features theory and in U-Net experiments, optimally regularized large models---via a ridge penalty or early stopping, respectively---outperform any unregularized models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散模型训练虽可化为二次 score-matching 回归，却出现灾难性过拟合而非良性双下降：固定每样本噪声实现数 m 时，插值峰移到 p~nm，但测试损失在 p~n 就开始上升且与 m 无关。偏差-方差分解显示 score 估计器的偏差在 p~n 起涨、峰后方差下降而偏差持续增长并饱和于大值，模型被隐式正则推向记住训练集的经验 score；配 ridge 惩罚或 early stopping 的最优正则化大模型仍优于任何未正则模型。
Motivation: 深度学习常识认为过参数化是良性的、测试误差走双下降曲线，但扩散模型（训练等价于回归）观察到的却是灾难性过拟合与记忆化，这一悖论需要机制解释。
Method: 结合两路：CelebA 上训练 U-Net 的实验，以及可推导闭式学习曲线的 random-features 模型；用偏差-方差分解定位机制，并比较 ridge 惩罚与 early stopping 两种正则化。
Result: 插值峰出现在 p~nm（标准回归为 p~n），但测试损失上升早在 p~n 就开始且与 m 无关；score 估计器偏差在 p~n 起涨，峰后方差如回归般衰减而偏差继续增长、二者饱和于大值；在 random-features 理论与 U-Net 实验中，最优正则化的大模型优于任何未正则模型。
Conclusion: 扩散模型的过参数化本身是有害的，因为隐式正则把模型推向记住训练集的经验 score 而非真实 score；但过参数化与正则化结合（ridge 或 early stopping）仍然有益，且 m≫1 使实际模型落在峰前的恶性过拟合上升段。

papers.title: TimeInteract: Towards Real-Time Interactive Intelligence for Streaming Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Real-world time series evolve continuously, with meaningful changes potentially emerging at any moment. However, existing time-series language models (TSLMs) remain inherently static. They either receive complete sequences for offline processing or alternate between streaming input and response generation, which prevents processing of new observations during interaction. We introduce a new regime, Time-Series Interaction: a model continuously perceives incoming time-series observations and user intent, autonomously decides when to remain silent or respond, and continues processing new observations during response generation. To realize this, we develop TimeInteract with three key designs: a dual-view streaming TS encoder that captures local variations and historical dynamics, a response control mechanism that learns when to trigger a response, and a decoupled streaming inference mechanism that separates control from response generation to avoid blocking subsequent observations. We further formulate a hierarchy of interaction capabilities, progressing from Understanding to Adaptivity. Based on this hierarchy, we construct StreamTSI-34K, a large-scale streaming TS interaction dataset with 34,588 episodes and 77,505 responses across synthetic and real-world time series in single- and multi-turn settings. Across all four interaction levels, TimeInteract consistently outperforms existing LLMs, VLMs, and TSLMs, with gains of up to 23.92 points on challenging tasks. It also improves response triggering while achieving near-zero stream stall and up to $2.15\times$ inference speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TimeInteract 把时间序列语言模型从离线整段输入改成持续感知流式观测与用户意图、自主决定何时沉默何时回复的交互范式，靠双视角流式编码器、响应触发控制与解耦推理三个设计实现。在自建 StreamTSI-34K（34,588 episodes、77,505 responses）上，四个交互层级全面超过现有 LLM、VLM 与 TSLM，困难任务最高提升 23.92 点，同时接近零流停顿、推理加速最高 2.15×。
Motivation: 现有时间序列语言模型要么整段离线处理，要么流式输入与生成交替进行，交互期间无法继续消化新观测，无法应对随时出现变化的连续时间序列。
Method: 三个核心设计：双视角流式 TS 编码器同时刻画局部变化与历史动态；响应控制机制学习何时触发回复；解耦流式推理把控制与响应生成分离以免阻塞后续观测。并构建 StreamTSI-34K 流式交互数据集，覆盖合成与真实序列、单轮与多轮，按 Understanding 到 Adaptivity 的能力层级组织。
Result: StreamTSI-34K 含 34,588 episodes、77,505 responses。在全部四个交互层级上 TimeInteract 均超过现有 LLM、VLM、TSLM，困难任务增益最高 23.92 点；响应触发改善，流停顿接近零，推理加速最高 2.15×。
Conclusion: 让模型在生成回复的同时继续处理新观测是可行的，解耦控制与生成可同时换来交互质量提升与近零停顿、2.15× 加速。

papers.title: On the Lexical Superstition of Large Language Models for Code Comprehension: Re-evaluation on Code of Low Lexical Quality
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have made them widely used for code-related tasks. Identifier names are statistically informative in naturally occurring code, but their information is not always reliable. We investigate whether current LLMs assign disproportionate weight to lexical cues when renaming preserves program structure. We introduce Face/Off, a semantics-preserving identifier-renaming framework, and evaluate progressive naming conditions across multiple models and code-comprehension tasks. Within this framework, lexical overemphasis is pervasive across the evaluated models and primary tasks: performance generally decreases as identifier information is removed or made misleading, and outputs are often directed toward the meanings suggested by misleading names. The pattern persists under representative prompt- and fine-tuning-based interventions, suggesting that lexical overemphasis is an entrenched problem. A type-inference control confirms a boundary: naming effects are smaller when the answer is locally recoverable without the target name. These results do not imply that identifiers are unhelpful; rather, they reveal a systematic vulnerability in how current LLMs balance lexical cues against program structure. Our findings motivate evaluations and modeling methods that preserve the benefits of natural code regularities while keeping conclusions grounded in accurate, formalized code semantics.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables. Submitted to an ACM journal in September 2025. Preprint; manuscript under review. Corresponding author: Ming Li
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出语义保持的标识符重命名框架 Face/Off，在保留程序结构的前提下逐级移除或扭曲标识符信息，检验 LLM 代码理解是否过度依赖命名线索。跨多个模型与主要代码理解任务，性能随标识符信息被移除或误导而普遍下降，输出常被误导性名称的含义带偏，且该模式在 prompt 与微调干预下依然存在。
Motivation: 自然代码中标识符命名具有统计信息量，但这种信息并不可靠；若 LLM 把词法线索置于程序结构之上，其代码理解结论就建立在不可靠的表面信号上。
Method: 设计语义保持的标识符重命名框架 Face/Off，在保持程序结构不变的条件下构造渐进式命名条件（信息被移除或被误导），在多个模型和多类代码理解任务上评测；另设 type-inference control 判断答案能否在不依赖目标名称时由局部类型推断恢复。
Result: 在所评测的模型与主要任务上，性能随标识符信息被移除或扭曲而普遍下降，输出常被误导性命名的含义带偏；该模式在代表性 prompt 与微调干预下持续存在。type-inference control 显示当答案可由局部信息（不依赖目标名称）恢复时，命名效应变小。
Conclusion: 词法过度依赖是当前 LLM 代码理解的系统性脆弱点，而非标识符无用；评测与建模方法应在保留自然代码规律收益的同时，把结论锚定在准确、形式化的代码语义上。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning to Defer with Guidance on Real World Medical Data
papers.abstract_en: Medical image interpretation is high-volume and time-consuming, and while AI interpretation can reduce workload, fully autonomous deployment carries potential safety concerns and low specificity may in practice lead to increased clinician workload. Learning to Defer (L2D) addresses this by selectively routing cases between autonomous prediction and human experts by learning from input features and AI model and human performance. While theoretical guarantees have been proven for L2D, its performance has not been validated on real-world medical datasets with human reader annotations. We evaluate the predictor-rejector formulation of two-stage L2D, where the AI predictor model is fixed and separate from the trainable routing or rejector model, on Collab-CXR, a multilabel chest X-ray dataset with multiple human annotations per case. This is the first work to look at L2D in the context of real-world medical imaging data with human annotations. We further introduce a new setup, L2D with Guidance, where the decision space is extended to three choices: predict autonomously, defer to a human expert, or defer to a human expert and provide AI guidance. We compare multiple rejector architectures and loss functions, and different input feature availabilities. This is reproduced on two larger datasets, VinDr-CXR and CheXpert. Our results show that two-stage L2D with Guidance outperforms classic two-stage learning to defer, as well as human-alone, AI-alone and AI-guided human baselines. Notably, this performance is achieved with simpler loss functions compared to formally defined L2D surrogate loss functions in current literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Collab-CXR、VinDr-CXR、CheXpert 三个真实胸片数据集上验证两阶段 Learning to Defer (L2D)，并把决策空间从两选扩到三选：自主预测、转交人类专家、转交专家并附 AI guidance。带 Guidance 的两阶段 L2D 超过经典两阶段 L2D 以及 human-alone、AI-alone、AI-guided human 三类基线，且用的是比文献中形式化 L2D surrogate loss 更简单的损失函数。
Motivation: L2D 已有理论保证，但此前未在带人类读片标注的真实医学数据上验证；同时低特异性的 AI 全自主部署可能反而增加临床医生工作量。
Method: 采用 predictor-rejector 两阶段 L2D：AI predictor 固定不训，只训练路由 rejector；在 Collab-CXR（每例多个人类标注的多标签胸片数据集）上比较多种 rejector 架构、损失函数与输入特征可用性，并把决策空间扩展为三选（自主预测 / 转交专家 / 转交专家并给 AI guidance），随后在 VinDr-CXR 与 CheXpert 两个更大数据集上复现。
Result: 带 Guidance 的两阶段 L2D 在 Collab-CXR 上优于经典两阶段 L2D、human-alone、AI-alone 与 AI-guided human 基线，并在 VinDr-CXR 和 CheXpert 上复现；该优势用的是比现有文献中形式化定义的 L2D surrogate loss 更简单的损失函数。
Conclusion: 真实医学影像数据上，给转交决策加上 AI guidance 这一第三选项即可超过经典 L2D 与人机各半的基线，且不必依赖复杂的形式化 surrogate loss。

papers.title: MAVP: Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies for Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Successful mobile manipulation requires coordinated base and arm motion while maintaining accurate spatial positioning. However, demonstration-trained policies can struggle to realise the intended base motion reliably, leading to spatial misalignment and subsequent manipulation failures. We present MAVP (Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies), a framework that improves execution reliability by predicting explicit base-pose targets and tracking them using localisation feedback. MAVP reconstructs a static map from teleoperated demonstrations and expresses demonstrated base trajectories in a shared map frame, providing consistent spatial supervision across demonstrations. At execution time, the policy receives RGB observations, joint states, and the robot's current map-frame base pose, and jointly predicts target base poses, arm actions, and gripper actions. A low-level controller tracks the predicted base targets using feedforward motion and pose error feedback, enabling correction of execution deviations. We additionally use pose-noise augmentation during training to improve robustness to errors in the policy's pose input. Across six real-world manipulation tasks and three policy families, MAVP achieves higher task success rates than unanchored velocity control in all tasks. Videos and additional results are available at https://123qwedsa123.github.io/mavp/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAVP 从遥操作示教重建静态地图，把底盘轨迹统一到地图坐标系，让策略显式预测目标底盘位姿并由底层控制器用定位反馈跟踪。在 6 项真实移动操作任务、3 类策略族上，任务成功率全部高于无锚定的速度控制。
Motivation: 示教训练的策略难以可靠复现预期底盘运动，导致空间错位并连带操作失败。
Method: 从遥操作示教重建静态地图，把底盘轨迹表达在共享地图坐标系以提供一致空间监督；策略输入 RGB 观测、关节状态与当前地图系底盘位姿，联合预测目标底盘位姿、手臂动作与夹爪动作；底层控制器用前馈运动加位姿误差反馈跟踪底盘目标，训练时加入 pose-noise augmentation 提升对位姿输入误差的鲁棒性。
Result: 在 6 项真实移动操作任务、3 类策略族上，MAVP 的任务成功率在全部任务中都高于无锚定的速度控制 (unanchored velocity control)。
Conclusion: 把底盘运动显式预测为地图系目标位姿并用定位反馈闭环跟踪，比直接输出速度控制更能保证移动操作的空间对齐与执行可靠性。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把底盘运动显式预测为地图系目标位姿并用定位反馈闭环跟踪，比直接输出速度控制更能保证移动操作的空间对齐与执行可靠性。

papers.title: FairMean: Promoting Fairness in Distributed Learning under Label Poisoning Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Fairness-aware distributed learning prioritizes clients with large losses to reduce performance disparities, but label poisoning can create large losses, thereby inducing a fairness--robustness conflict. We propose FairMean to manage this conflict. FairMean weights client gradients using a bounded, nondecreasing function of local loss. The increasing weights prioritize high-loss clients to promote fairness, while the upper bound prevents excessive loss-induced amplification of poisoned-client gradients. In the absence of label poisoning, we show that minimizing the FairMean objective is more conducive to solution fairness than minimizing the standard average-loss objective. Under label poisoning, we establish an average-stationarity bound whose attack-dependent term is proportional to the square of the poisoned-client fraction. Experiments show that FairMean promotes fairness by reducing accuracy variance while improving worst-client accuracy.
papers.comment: Extended version with complete proofs and additional experimental results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FairMean 用局部损失的有界单调函数给客户端梯度加权：递增部分优先高损失客户端以提升公平，上界抑制标签投毒客户端梯度被过度放大。理论上无投毒时比标准平均损失更利于解的公平性，有投毒时平均平稳性界中攻击相关项正比于被投毒客户端比例的平方；实验中降低准确率方差同时提高最差客户端准确率。
Motivation: 公平感知的分布式学习按大损失优先客户端以缩小性能差距，但标签投毒本身会制造大损失，从而引发公平与鲁棒的冲突。
Method: FairMean 对客户端梯度按局部损失的有界非递减函数加权，递增段优先高损失客户端、上界限制被投毒梯度的放大；并给出无投毒时相对标准平均损失目标的公平性论证，以及有投毒时的平均平稳性界。
Result: 无投毒时最小化 FairMean 目标比标准平均损失目标更利于解的公平性；有投毒时平均平稳性界的攻击相关项与被投毒客户端比例的平方成正比；实验中准确率方差下降、最差客户端准确率提升。
Conclusion: 用有界递增的损失加权可以同时兼顾公平与标签投毒鲁棒性，攻击影响随被投毒客户端比例平方衰减。

papers.title: KwaiMind Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Commercial image editing requires product identity preservation, accurate text rendering, and user appeal alongside general editing quality. We present KwaiMind, an image editing system combining general capabilities with e-commerce specialization. An agent-based data engine maintains approximately 1.8 million high-quality editing pairs. Built on a multimodal diffusion transformer, KwaiMind undergoes continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, followed by preference optimization and online reinforcement learning. A general-purpose vision-language judge and specialized rewards for click-through rate (CTR), text rendering, and product consistency guide specialized policies, which are consolidated through on-policy distillation. We introduce Ecom-Bench, covering 11 commercial editing tasks with task-specific visual evaluation and CTR-based ranking. KwaiMind achieves the strongest overall scores among evaluated open-source editors on ImgEdit, GEdit, both language splits of REDEdit, and Ecom-Bench visual quality, and the highest aggregate CTR ranking score among compared systems. Offline, CTR-guided optimization increases the proportion of generated images whose predicted CTR exceeds that of the original product image from 12.16% to 37.41%. In an online A/B experiment, CTR-based selection of product main images yields an approximately 2.44% relative increase in actual CTR. These results demonstrate the value of domain-specific data and reward-driven alignment for commercial image editing.

TL;DR: KwaiMind 是面向商业图像编辑的多模态 diffusion transformer 系统：agent 数据引擎维护约 180 万对编辑数据，经继续预训练、SFT、偏好优化与在线强化学习，用 CTR、文字渲染、商品一致性等专用奖励对齐策略并经 on-policy 蒸馏合并。离线使预测 CTR 超过原商品主图的图片占比从 12.16% 升到 37.41%，线上 A/B 中 CTR 选主图带来约 2.44% 的实际 CTR 相对提升。
Motivation: 商业图像编辑除通用编辑质量外还要求商品身份保持、文字准确渲染与用户吸引力，通用编辑模型与公开基准都不覆盖这组需求。
Method: 以 agent 数据引擎构造约 180 万高质量编辑对，在多模态 diffusion transformer 上做继续预训练与 SFT，再做偏好优化和在线强化学习；奖励包括通用 vision-language judge 与 CTR、文字渲染、商品一致性专用奖励，多个策略经 on-policy 蒸馏合并。同时提出 Ecom-Bench，覆盖 11 类商业编辑任务，含任务专属视觉评测与 CTR 排序。
Result: 在被评测的开源编辑器中，于 ImgEdit、GEdit、REDEdit 两个语言切分及 Ecom-Bench 视觉质量上取得最强综合分，并在对比系统中拿到最高聚合 CTR 排序分；离线 CTR 引导优化使预测 CTR 超过原商品主图的图片占比从 12.16% 升至 37.41%；线上 A/B 中按 CTR 选商品主图带来约 2.44% 的实际 CTR 相对提升。
Conclusion: 领域专属数据加奖励驱动的对齐能把商业图像编辑的视觉质量与实际点击率同时做上去，CTR 作为奖励可直接转化为线上收益。

papers.title: GitScholar: A Dataset for Predicting AI Research Impact from GitHub Engagement
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid pace of AI research and the hundreds of daily new publications, staying up-to-date with the latest developments has become increasingly difficult. For researchers, quickly identifying impactful work is essential, yet manually reviewing each new publication is impractical. Automated impact prediction methods help address this challenge, usually by combining various information sources available, such as a paper's content or citation history. In this work, we propose using GitHub engagement as an additional source and demonstrate that it provides both a timely and accurate signal. To this end, we introduce GitScholar, a novel dataset that links GitHub activity from 444,000 repositories to over 558,000 AI arXiv papers. Our experiments show that GitHub reactions improve early prediction precision by up to 12% over a strong academic baseline. Additionally, we find that GitHub signal offers near-complete coverage of high-impact AI papers, and consistently correlates with future academic success. GitScholar is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/huawei-csl/GitScholar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GitScholar 把 444,000 个 GitHub 仓库的活跃度与 558,000+ 篇 AI arXiv 论文对齐，用 GitHub engagement 作为论文影响力早期预测的额外信号。实验显示加入 GitHub 反应使早期预测精度相对强学术基线最多提升 12%，且该信号对高影响力 AI 论文近乎全覆盖、与未来学术成功稳定相关。
Motivation: AI 论文每日新增量大，人工筛选不可行；现有自动影响力预测依赖论文内容与引用历史，而引用历史滞后，缺少及时且准确的早期信号。
Method: 构建 GitScholar 数据集，将 GitHub 仓库活动与 AI arXiv 论文链接（444,000 仓库 / 558,000+ 论文），把 GitHub engagement 作为额外特征加入影响力预测实验，并与强学术基线对比早期预测精度。
Result: 加入 GitHub reactions 使早期预测精度相对强学术基线最多提升 12%；GitHub 信号对高影响力 AI 论文实现近乎完全覆盖，并与未来学术成功持续相关。
Conclusion: GitHub engagement 是论文影响力早期预测中既及时又准确的补充信号，可与内容、引用历史等来源结合使用；数据集已在 Hugging Face 公开。

papers.title: PACT: From Credit Assignment to Critic Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become a central component of large language model (LLM) post-training, yet token-level credit lacks a generally accepted mathematical definition, leaving its relationship to commonly used training signals unclear. We formulate three regularity conditions, namely Completeness, Prefix Consistency, and Neutrality, and prove that they uniquely determine token-level credit. This characterization provides a unified basis for explaining phenomena across existing algorithms and guides the development of an improved actor-critic training procedure. Through this lens, an ideal teacher in On-Policy Distillation (OPD) acts as an implicit critic, yielding an expected policy gradient proportional to that induced by token-level credit. Response-level REINFORCE Leave-One-Out (RLOO) signals match the expected policy-gradient contribution of token-level credit despite their coarser granularity. We further establish approximate credit sparsity under bounded outcome rewards and show how intermediate critic errors in Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE) can become comparable to the underlying credit. These motivate Policy Aligned Critic Training (PACT), which adopts an Actor-then-Critic update order to apply importance sampling correction to critic training and better align the critic with the updated policy. In agentic mathematical reasoning, PACT achieves 72.87% average accuracy across four benchmarks, outperforming GRPO and PPO by 8.80 and 13.16 percentage points, respectively. On SWE-bench Verified, PACT achieves a pass rate of 67.4%, outperforming PPO, GRPO, and SAO by 2.4, 2.0, and 3.8 percentage points, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACT 用三条正则条件（Completeness、Prefix Consistency、Neutrality）唯一刻画 token-level credit，并据此把 actor-critic 训练改为 Actor-then-Critic 顺序、对 critic 训练加重要性采样校正。在 agentic 数学推理四个基准上平均准确率 72.87%，超 GRPO 8.80、超 PPO 13.16 个百分点；SWE-bench Verified 通过率 67.4%，超 PPO/GRPO/SAO 2.4/2.0/3.8 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM 后训练里 token-level credit 缺乏公认数学定义，与常用训练信号（OPD、RLOO、GAE）的关系不清，critic 与更新后 policy 的错位也未被刻画。
Method: 提出三条正则条件并证明其唯一决定 token-level credit；在此框架下证明 OPD 的理想 teacher 等价于隐式 critic、RLOO 的 response 级信号在期望梯度上与 token-level credit 一致，并给出有界结果奖励下的近似 credit 稀疏性与 GAE 中间 critic 误差可比于 credit 本身的结论；据此设计 PACT：Actor-then-Critic 更新顺序 + 对 critic 训练施加重要性采样校正。
Result: agentic 数学推理四个基准平均准确率 72.87%，比 GRPO 高 8.80 个百分点、比 PPO 高 13.16 个百分点；SWE-bench Verified 通过率 67.4%，比 PPO、GRPO、SAO 分别高 2.4、2.0、3.8 个百分点。
Conclusion: token-level credit 可由三条正则条件唯一确定，且按 Actor-then-Critic 加重要性采样校正能让 critic 对齐更新后的 policy，从而在数学推理与 SWE 任务上稳定优于 GRPO、PPO、SAO。
