papers.title: HYDRA: Proactive Android Malware Drift Adaptation via Hierarchical Graph Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Concept drift, driven by the rapid evolution of Android malware, severely degrades the performance of machine learning detectors. Current adaptation strategies are often reactive, responding only after performance has dropped and imposing a significant manual annotation burden, or they are proactive but rely on unstable adversarial training and incomplete, single-level graph representations. To overcome these limitations, we propose HYDRA (Hybrid Drift Adaptation), a proactive adaptation framework that learns drift-invariant representations from hierarchically structured data. HYDRA first models applications using a hybrid graph structure, combining fine-grained Control Flow Graphs (CFGs) and coarse-grained Function Call Graphs (FCGs) to capture comprehensive behavioral patterns. It then introduces a novel cross-domain contrastive learning objective that aligns historical (source) and new (target) data distributions. By generating pseudo-labels for unlabeled target samples, our method pulls representations of semantically similar applications together, regardless of their domain, within a single, stable optimization process. This approach unifies feature learning and domain alignment, eliminating the need for complex adversarial objectives. Extensive experiments on large-scale, time-ordered malware datasets demonstrate that HYDRA achieves substantially lower False Negative and False Positive Rates than state-of-the-art baselines while requiring up to 87.5% fewer labeled samples. Our work thus offers a robust and efficient solution to combat concept drift in security applications.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACM CCS 2026. Author's version with full appendix. 17 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HYDRA 用 CFG 与 FCG 组成的混合层次图表示 Android 应用，配合跨域对比学习目标对齐历史与新数据分布，并为目标域无标签样本生成伪标签，在单一稳定优化中同时完成特征学习与域对齐。在大规模、按时间排序的恶意软件数据集上，其假阴性率与假阳性率显著低于 SOTA 基线，且标注样本需求最多减少 87.5%。
Motivation: Android 恶意软件快速演化造成概念漂移，现有适应策略要么等性能下降后才反应、需大量人工标注，要么依赖不稳定的对抗训练和不完整的单层图表示。
Method: HYDRA 先用细粒度 Control Flow Graph (CFG) 与粗粒度 Function Call Graph (FCG) 组成混合图建模应用行为，再用跨域对比学习目标对齐 source/target 分布，并为目标域无标签样本生成伪标签，把特征学习与域对齐放进单一优化过程，去掉对抗目标。
Result: 在大规模、时间排序的恶意软件数据集上，HYDRA 的 False Negative Rate 与 False Positive Rate 均大幅低于 state-of-the-art 基线，同时所需标注样本最多减少 87.5%。
Conclusion: 作者主张：以层次化混合图加跨域对比学习做主动漂移适应，可在安全场景中同时降低误报漏报与标注负担，是对抗式适应的稳健替代。

summary_sections.result: 在大规模、时间排序的恶意软件数据集上，HYDRA 的 False Negative Rate 与 False Positive Rate 均大幅低于 state-of-the-art 基线，同时所需标注样本最多减少 87.5%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张：以层次化混合图加跨域对比学习做主动漂移适应，可在安全场景中同时降低误报漏报与标注负担，是对抗式适应的稳健替代。

papers.title: TransBERT: A Framework for Synthetic Translation in Domain-Specific Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: The scarcity of non-English language data in specialized domains significantly limits the development of effective Natural Language Processing (NLP) tools. We present TransBERT, a novel framework for pre-training language models using exclusively synthetically translated text, and introduce TransCorpus, a scalable translation toolkit. Focusing on the life sciences domain in French, our approach demonstrates that state-of-the-art performance on various downstream tasks can be achieved solely by leveraging synthetically translated data. We release the TransCorpus toolkit, the TransCorpus-bio-fr corpus (36.4GB of French life sciences text), TransBERT-bio-fr, its associated pre-trained language model and reproducible code for both pre-training and fine-tuning. Our results highlight the viability of synthetic translation in a high-resource translation direction for building high-quality NLP resources in low-resource language/domain pairs.
papers.journal_ref: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025, pages 19338-19354
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TransBERT 用纯合成翻译文本预训练领域语言模型，并发布 TransCorpus 翻译工具包；在法语生命科学方向上，仅靠合成翻译数据即可在多项下游任务达到 state-of-the-art 表现，同时开源 36.4GB 的 TransCorpus-bio-fr 语料与 TransBERT-bio-fr 模型。
Motivation: 专业领域中非英语语言数据稀缺，限制了低资源语言/领域组合上 NLP 工具的开发。
Method: 提出 TransBERT 预训练框架，仅使用合成翻译文本做预训练；配套 TransCorpus 可扩展翻译工具包，聚焦法语生命科学领域，并发布预训练与微调的可复现代码。
Result: 在法语生命科学领域，仅用合成翻译数据在多项下游任务上达到 state-of-the-art 表现；发布 TransCorpus-bio-fr（36.4GB 法语生命科学文本）与预训练模型 TransBERT-bio-fr。
Conclusion: 在高资源翻译方向上，合成翻译足以构建低资源语言/领域对的高质量 NLP 资源。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Hyperbolic Residual Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Residual Vector Quantization turns continuous representations into discrete, multi-level token sequences. Yet most methods operate in Euclidean space, despite the coarse-to-fine structure of the resulting codes and the latent hierarchies present in many data domains. Hyperbolic geometry offers a natural alternative for hierarchical representations, but naive hyperbolic extensions introduce geometric inconsistencies: non-associative hyperbolic addition prevents consistent residual aggregation, while standard straight-through gradient estimation ignores the geometry of the latent space. We propose a geometry-aware hyperbolic residual quantization that addresses these issues in both the forward and backward passes. In the forward pass, Hyperbolic Residual Aggregation restores the telescoping behavior of residual quantization on the Poincare ball. In the backward pass, a discounted Hyperbolic Straight-Through Estimator routes the reconstruction gradient through the quantizer as a single geometric block, avoiding unstable recursive gradient transport across residual stages. Evaluations on hierarchical prediction, recommendation, image tokenization, and neural audio coding tasks show that our method improves the stability and structural organization of hyperbolic residual codes over naive hyperbolic baselines. At the same time, we observe a clear structure-compression trade-off: Euclidean residual quantization remains preferable for pure compression, while geometry-aware hyperbolic quantization is most useful for hierarchically organized discrete latent spaces.
papers.comment: 14-page main paper (30 pages total with references and appendix), 3 figures, 8 tables. Accepted at the Beyond Euclidean Workshop, ECCV 2026 (Oral)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把残差向量量化 (RVQ) 搬到 Poincaré 球上时，前向用 Hyperbolic Residual Aggregation 恢复残差的 telescoping 结构，反向用 discounted Hyperbolic Straight-Through Estimator 把重建梯度当作单一几何块回传，避免跨残差阶段的不稳定递归梯度传输。在层次预测、推荐、图像 token 化与神经音频编码四类任务上，该方法比朴素双曲基线更稳定、双曲残差码的层次结构更清晰；同时存在明确的结构-压缩权衡：纯压缩仍以欧氏 RVQ 为优，几何感知双曲量化只在层次化离散隐空间上最有用。
Motivation: RVQ 生成的码本天然是由粗到细的层次结构，但主流实现都在欧氏空间；朴素搬到双曲几何会因双曲加法不满足结合律而破坏残差聚合，且标准 straight-through 估计忽略隐空间几何，导致训练不稳。
Method: 前向：Hyperbolic Residual Aggregation 在 Poincaré 球上重建 RVQ 的 telescoping 行为；反向：discounted Hyperbolic Straight-Through Estimator 把量化器作为单一几何块传递重建梯度，取代跨残差阶段的递归梯度传输。
Result: 在层次预测、推荐、图像 token 化、神经音频编码四类任务上，该方法相对朴素双曲基线提升了双曲残差码的稳定性与结构组织度；同时观察到结构-压缩权衡，纯压缩场景下欧氏 RVQ 仍更可取。
Conclusion: 双曲 RVQ 的收益取决于隐空间是否本身有层次结构：层次化离散隐空间用几何感知双曲量化，纯压缩任务继续用欧氏 RVQ。

papers.title: On the Role of the Projector in Contrastive Self-Supervised Learning: Last-Layer Rank Dynamics Drive Representation Quality
papers.abstract_en: The dimensional collapse of representations in self-supervised contrastive learning is an ever-present issue. One notable technique to prevent such a collapse of representations is using a multi-layered perceptron network called Projector. In several works, the projector has been found to heavily influence the quality of representations learned in a self-supervised contrastive pre-training task. However, the question still lingers. What role does the projector play? Assuming the projector mitigates dimensional collapse, what prevents the terminal layer of the base encoder from functioning as the projector in the absence of an explicit multi-layer perceptron (MLP) head? In this work, we intend to study what happens inside the projector by examining the rank dynamics of the same and the encoder through empirical study and analysis. Through mathematical analysis, we observe that the effect of rank reduction predominantly occurs in the last layer. Motivated by this insight, we propose a weight regularization strategy applied specifically to the last layer. We demonstrate that this targeted approach yields better performance than applying orthogonal weight regularization across the entire network (WeRank), both with and without a projector. Our method improves Top-1 accuracy by more than 1% on SimCLR on the ImageNet100 dataset and consistently outperforms baseline SimCLR variants on CIFAR datasets, supporting our interpretation of the projector's role.
papers.comment: Under review at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通过实证与数学分析指出，对比自监督学习中 projector 的降秩效应主要发生在最后一层，因此只对最后一层施加权重正则即可。在 SimCLR 上该方法比全网络正交权重正则 (WeRank) 更好，ImageNet100 Top-1 提升超过 1%，并在 CIFAR 数据集上稳定优于各 SimCLR 变体。
Motivation: 对比学习的维度坍缩 (dimensional collapse) 常被归因于 projector，但 projector 究竟起什么作用、没有显式 MLP head 时编码器末层为何不能替代它，一直没有明确答案。
Method: 对 projector 与 encoder 的 rank dynamics 做实证分析与数学分析，定位降秩主要发生在最后一层；据此提出只作用于最后一层的权重正则策略，并与全网络正交权重正则 WeRank 在有无 projector 两种设置下对比。
Result: SimCLR 在 ImageNet100 上 Top-1 accuracy 提升超过 1%；在 CIFAR 数据集上一致优于基线 SimCLR 变体，且在有无 projector 时都优于 WeRank。
Conclusion: projector 的作用可由末层的秩动力学解释，针对性地对最后一层做权重正则比全网络正交正则更有效。

papers.title: Disaggregated Quantization: Specializing LLM Prefill and Decode
papers.abstract_en: Prefill and decode reward different approaches to quantization: low-precision arithmetic accelerates prompt processing, while compact weights reduce memory traffic during generation. We propose "disaggregated quantization" (DQ), which specializes computation formats, weights and storage placement to both of these phases. On Qwen 3 and Gemma 3, removing activation quantization specifically on decode improves accuracy on decode-heavy tasks without increasing inference cost. Training separate compute-native prefill weights accelerates prompt processing relative to weight-only inference while matching or exceeding its accuracy at 2-3-bit decode on both decode-heavy and prefill-heavy tasks. With released Qwen3.8-27B GGUF decoders, training an NVFP4 prefiller improves 1-bit accuracy by 32.5 points on MMLU-Pro and 35.3 on MMMU-Pro without modifying the decode checkpoint. To accommodate the additional checkpoint on a single device, offloaded disaggregated prefill (ODP) streams its weights from SSD, amortizing loading over prompt length. On the same 27B model, ODP delivers a 1.78x time-to-first-token speedup over the weight-only baseline at 8K prompt length in llama.cpp. We evaluate accuracy under disaggregated serving in vLLM and further validate shared-weight format disaggregation through post-training quantization on models up to 2.8T parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 disaggregated quantization (DQ)，把 prefill 与 decode 两阶段分开选计算格式、权重与存储位置：decode 去掉激活量化以保精度，另训 compute-native prefill 权重加速提示处理。在 Qwen3.8-27B GGUF 上，NVFP4 prefiller 不动 decode checkpoint 即把 MMLU-Pro 1-bit 精度提高 32.5 点、MMMU-Pro 提高 35.3 点；SSD 流式加载的 ODP 在 8K prompt 下于 llama.cpp 中取得 1.78x 首 token 加速。
Motivation: LLM 推理中 prefill 是算力受限、decode 是访存受限，单一量化方案无法同时兼顾提示处理速度与生成阶段的权重访存，且额外 checkpoint 放不进单卡。
Method: DQ 为两阶段分别定制：decode 移除激活量化，另训 compute-native prefill 权重（如 NVFP4 prefiller）；offloaded disaggregated prefill (ODP) 把 prefill 权重放在 SSD 上按 prompt 长度摊销加载，精度在 vLLM 分离式 serving 下评测，并用 post-training quantization 验证共享权重的格式分离。
Result: Qwen 3 与 Gemma 3 上，decode 去激活量化在不增加推理成本的前提下提升 decode-heavy 任务精度；2-3-bit decode 下训练的 prefill 权重相对 weight-only 推理加速且精度持平或更高。Qwen3.8-27B GGUF 上 NVFP4 prefiller 使 MMLU-Pro 1-bit 精度 +32.5 点、MMMU-Pro +35.3 点；ODP 在 llama.cpp 8K prompt 下较 weight-only 基线 TTFT 加速 1.78x；格式分离在最高 2.8T 参数模型上经 PTQ 验证。
Conclusion: 把 prefill 与 decode 的量化格式和存储位置解耦，可在不改 decode checkpoint 的情况下同时改善精度与首 token 延迟，额外权重靠 SSD 流式加载即可单设备部署。

papers.title: Error Bounds for Statistical Estimators in BTL Model with Parametric Multivariate Utility Functions
papers.abstract_en: We study preference elicitation under the Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) model where the true partworth vector is unknown and has to be estimated as a parameter with elicited preference information. The set of selected pairwise queries is non-uniform, deterministic, and arbitrary over a collection of alternatives, provided that it satisfies a joint identifiability condition. We focus on understanding when the canonical maximum likelihood estimator (MLE) is finite and admits sharp error bounds without explicit compactness constraints on the feasible set or external regularizers. To this end, we derive minimax lower bounds under the standard bounded dynamic range condition, and find that the same Fisher-information geometry in the classic Cramér-Rao lower bounds underpins the finite-sample difficulty of the estimation problem. By combining a non-asymptotic expansion of the likelihood score equation with a fixed-point localization argument, we identify a design-dependent sample size threshold above which the unconstrained canonical MLE exists and is unique with high probability. The same expansion yields a decomposition of the estimation error into a linear stochastic term, an explicit second-order bias, and a higher-order remainder. A refined analysis gives sufficient sample size conditions under which the canonical MLE attains the minimax rates up to logarithmic and constant factors. These results provide a unified non-asymptotic theory for parametric utility elicitation and reveal when the inference is determined by response data alone rather than by external regularization. Preliminary numerical results are consistent with the theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 BTL 偏好 elicitation 中，对非均匀、确定性的成对查询设计，推导无约束 canonical MLE 有限且唯一的样本量阈值，并给出 minimax 阶的误差界。阈值由查询设计决定的 Fisher 信息几何控制；误差被分解为线性随机项、显式二阶偏差与高阶余项，样本量足够时 MLE 达到 minimax 率（差至对数与常数因子）。数值结果为初步且与理论一致。
Motivation: BTL 模型中 partworth 估计通常要靠紧致可行集或外部正则化保证 MLE 有限，缺少不加这些约束时何时存在、误差多大的非渐近刻画。
Method: 在标准 bounded dynamic range 条件下推导 minimax 下界，指出其与 Cramér-Rao 下界的 Fisher 信息几何同源；对似然得分方程做非渐近展开，配合 fixed-point 定位论证，得到设计依赖的样本量阈值与误差分解（线性随机项 + 显式二阶偏差 + 高阶余项）。
Result: 得到设计依赖的样本量阈值，超过该阈值无约束 canonical MLE 以高概率存在且唯一；在更强的充分样本量条件下 MLE 达到 minimax 率，差至对数与常数因子；初步数值结果与理论一致。
Conclusion: 参数化效用 elicitation 的有限样本难度由查询设计决定的 Fisher 信息几何决定，推断何时只由响应数据而非外部正则化决定，可由该阈值与误差分解统一刻画。

papers.title: Leveraging Vision-Based Point Cloud Map Priors for Camera-Based 3D Object Detection and Online Vectorized HD Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Camera-based 3D object detection and online vectorized HD mapping provide compact scene representations for autonomous driving, but both depend on accurate metric geometry and remain limited by depth ambiguity. Over long-term deployment, observations from repeated traversals can be accumulated into persistent point cloud priors that provide geometric context beyond the current observations. Existing explicit point cloud prior approaches, however, rely on LiDAR-based map construction and therefore require expensive 3D ranging sensors. We propose a framework that constructs a static point cloud prior map from previous camera traversals using Pi3X and augments each point with DINOv3 features. At runtime, a local prior patch is retrieved using global localization, encoded with a sparse voxel backbone, and fused in bird's-eye view (BEV) with lifted multi-view camera features. Task-specific sparse transformer heads then predict 3D objects and vectorized map elements from the fused representation. On Argoverse 2, the vision-based prior improves a strong baseline from 0.287 to 0.299 CDS and from 0.669 to 0.750 vectorized mapping mAP. Ablations show that semantic DINOv3 features are particularly important for vectorized mapping. These results demonstrate that vision-built geometric-semantic priors provide an effective form of long-term scene memory for camera-based perception, improving both tasks without LiDAR for prior-map construction or online inference.

papers.title: TriWorldBench: A Tri-View Consistency Perspective on Embodied World Models
papers.abstract_en: Embodied world models predict the outcomes of robot actions to support learning and planning. For robots equipped with head and wrist cameras, this requires complementary views: the head view captures the overall task, while wrist views reveal local gripper-object interactions. However, evaluating these views independently cannot determine whether they describe the same action and object state. We introduce TRIWORLDBENCH, a benchmark for evaluating embodied world models through synchronized head, left-wrist, and right-wrist videos. It contains 500 episodes across 50 bimanual manipulation tasks and uses 19 metrics to assess tri-view consistency, task alignment, physical and 3D coherence, motion quality, temporal consistency, and visual quality. By combining cross-view checks with measurements tailored to each camera, the benchmark evaluates whether plausible individual videos also form a consistent prediction of the intended task. We summarize overall performance with TWB-Score and retain per-view results to identify where predictions fail. This extends world-model evaluation beyond single-view visual quality. Code, data, and metric definitions are available at https://github.com/TriWorldBench/TriWorldBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TriWorldBench 用同步的头部与左右腕三视角视频评测具身世界模型，判断各视角单独合理的预测是否真的一致地描述同一动作与物体状态。基准含 50 个双臂操作任务的 500 条 episode、19 项指标，覆盖三视角一致性、任务对齐、物理与 3D 连贯性、运动质量、时间一致性与视觉质量，并用 TWB-Score 汇总、保留分视角结果以定位失败点。
Motivation: 头部视角看全局任务、腕部视角看夹爪-物体局部交互，但各视角独立评测无法判断它们是否描述同一动作与物体状态，世界模型评测因此停留在单视角视觉质量。
Method: 构建同步 head、left-wrist、right-wrist 三视角视频基准，500 条 episode 覆盖 50 项双臂操作任务；用 19 项指标把跨视角检查与各相机专属度量结合，汇总为 TWB-Score 并保留 per-view 结果，代码、数据与指标定义在 GitHub 开源。
Result: 基准规模为 500 条 episode、50 个双臂操作任务、19 项指标，输出 TWB-Score 总分与分视角结果，指标覆盖三视角一致性、任务对齐、物理与 3D 连贯性、运动质量、时间一致性与视觉质量六个维度。
Conclusion: 具身世界模型的评测应从单视角视觉质量扩展到跨视角一致性：单视角看起来合理的视频未必构成对预期任务的一致预测，且需保留分视角结果定位失败来源。

papers.title: PreGS: A Parameter-Transfer-Based Multi-Expert Graph Neural Network for Node Classification
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks have achieved strong performance in node classification by aggregating information from graph neighborhoods. However, a single aggregation mechanism may be insufficient to capture diverse structural patterns across graph datasets. Moreover, independently training multiple structural branches can introduce substantial overhead without necessarily producing stable node representations. To address these issues, this paper proposes PreGS, a parameter-transfer-based multi-expert graph neural network framework. PreGS first pretrains a multi-head graph attention network (GAT) and transfers the linear transformation weights of its first-layer attention heads to multiple GraphSAGE experts. The transferred experts are frozen and used as complementary structural branches. The fused raw node features, GAT head representations, and GraphSAGE expert representations are fed into a multilayer perceptron (MLP), whose output is further fused with the pretrained GAT logits. Based on PreGS, we further develop PreGSv2, which introduces source-level weighting and a structural gating mechanism for adaptive multi-source feature integration. Experiments on eight public graph datasets show that PreGS and PreGSv2 achieve competitive performance against representative graph neural network baselines. Ablation, parameter-transfer, sensitivity, aggregator, visualization, and training-time analyses further validate the effectiveness and stability of the proposed framework. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/LH-Czc/PreGS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PreGS 用参数迁移把预训练多头 GAT 第一层注意力头的线性变换权重转给多个 GraphSAGE 专家并冻结，作为互补结构分支，再与原始特征、GAT 头表示一起经 MLP 融合、并与 GAT logits 二次融合；PreGSv2 进一步加源级加权与结构门控。在八个公开图数据集上相对代表性 GNN 基线取得有竞争力的节点分类性能。
Motivation: 单一聚合机制难以覆盖图数据集上多样的结构模式，而独立训练多个结构分支开销大且节点表示不稳定。
Method: 先预训练多头 GAT，把第一层各注意力头的线性变换权重迁移给多个 GraphSAGE 专家并冻结；融合原始节点特征、GAT 头表示与 GraphSAGE 专家表示输入 MLP，输出再与预训练 GAT logits 融合。PreGSv2 增加源级加权 (source-level weighting) 与结构门控 (structural gating) 做多源特征自适应整合。
Result: 在八个公开图数据集上，PreGS 与 PreGSv2 相对代表性 GNN 基线表现有竞争力；消融、参数迁移、敏感性、聚合器、可视化与训练时间分析支持框架的有效性与稳定性。
Conclusion: 把预训练 GAT 的注意力头权重迁移给冻结的多专家分支，是节点分类中兼顾多样结构模式与训练开销的可行路径，门控与源级加权可进一步做自适应多源整合。

papers.title: Target alignment, dilution and forecast selection when cross-sectional forecasts share a common target
papers.abstract_en: Forecasters often score the same units per date against one standardized realized outcome. We show that every standardized forecast splits exactly into a component aligned with this common target and a component uncorrelated with it. Three consequences follow: forecast-error correlation largely mirrors forecast correlation and is therefore a poor measure of diversity; an equally weighted combination beats a no-information forecast only when average alignment is large relative to the combination's dispersion; and the gain from adding a forecaster separates into genuine improvement and mere dilution, which equal-weight admission can mistakenly reward. We develop a cautious selection rule, study it in simulations, and apply it to language-model forecasts of US equity rankings and mechanical signals ranking exchange-traded funds. Selection removes most dilution losses, but no combination beats the no-information forecast.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 当多个预测者按同一日期对同一标准化实现结果打分时，每个预测可精确分解为与共同目标对齐的分量和与之不相关的分量。由此推出：预测误差相关基本镜像预测相关，因而是很差的多样性度量；等权组合只有在平均对齐相对于组合离散度足够大时才胜过无信息预测；新增预测者的收益可拆成真实改进与纯稀释，而等权纳入会误奖稀释。作者据此提出审慎的选择规则，在仿真与美国股票排名、ETF 信号数据上，选择规则去掉了大部分稀释损失，但没有任何组合胜过无信息预测。
Motivation: 多个预测者对同一批单位、同一日期按同一标准化结果打分时，误差相关被当作多样性依据、等权组合默认有益，但这两点在共同目标结构下并不成立，新增弱预测者会以稀释形式损害组合。
Method: 证明每个标准化预测精确分解为与共同目标对齐的分量和不相关分量；据此推导等权组合胜过无信息预测的条件（平均对齐相对组合离散度）与新增预测者收益的改进/稀释分解；提出一条审慎的预测者选择规则，并在仿真中研究该规则。
Result: 在仿真、语言模型对美国股票排名的预测、以及对交易所交易基金 (ETF) 排名的机械信号三类设置上应用选择规则：选择去掉了大部分稀释损失，但没有任何组合胜过无信息预测。
Conclusion: 误差相关不能当作预测多样性度量，等权纳入会奖励纯稀释；按对齐与稀释做审慎选择可保住组合不因稀释受损，但在这些数据上组合仍无法超过无信息预测。

papers.title: CompKV: Compensation-Aware KV Selection for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Despite their strong performance, large language models (LLMs) are bottlenecked by KV cache memory traffic during long-context inference. Sparse attention is widely used to accelerate LLM inference by computing exact attention over a selected subset of tokens. To recover the contribution of tokens excluded from exact attention, recent methods apply coarse-grained compensation to the omitted attention tail. However, existing methods typically select tokens based on attention mass and only then compensate for the unselected tokens. This decoupled design overlooks their interaction: selection should prioritize tokens that would leave the largest compensation error if omitted. To address this limitation, we introduce CompKV, the first compensation-aware sparse attention framework that divides tokens into blocks and explicitly optimizes selection for the downstream compensation mechanism. Our theoretical analysis shows that the residual left by block-level mean compensation is governed by both block attention mass and within-block logit variation. We approximate this residual using compact block-level statistics, yielding a deployable selection criterion. We further develop an efficient asynchronous implementation. Experiments on RULER and LongBench-Pro show that CompKV performs best among the evaluated sparse baselines while delivering up to a $6.85\times$ self-attention speedup over full attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompKV 把补偿误差直接写进稀疏注意力的 token 选择目标：按块划分 token，理论分析表明块均值补偿的残差由块注意力质量与块内 logit 波动共同决定，据此用紧凑的块级统计量构造可部署的选择准则，并给出异步实现。在 RULER 与 LongBench-Pro 上，CompKV 在所评估的稀疏基线中表现最好，相对全注意力自注意力最高加速 6.85×。
Motivation: 长上下文推理被 KV cache 内存流量卡住，现有稀疏注意力先按注意力质量选 token、再对未选部分做事后补偿，这种解耦忽略了选择与补偿的交互，选出的恰是遗漏后补偿误差最大的 token。
Method: 提出首个补偿感知 (compensation-aware) 稀疏注意力框架 CompKV：把 token 分块，显式针对下游补偿机制优化选择；由理论分析得到块均值补偿残差同时受块注意力质量与块内 logit 变化控制，用紧凑的块级统计量近似该残差作为选择准则，并实现异步执行。
Result: 在 RULER 与 LongBench-Pro 上，CompKV 在所评估的稀疏基线中表现最佳，相对全注意力取得最高 6.85× 的自注意力加速。
Conclusion: 选择应以遗漏后的补偿误差为准而非单纯注意力质量，把补偿机制纳入选择目标可在长上下文稀疏注意力中同时保住精度与速度。

summary_sections.result: 在 RULER 与 LongBench-Pro 上，CompKV 在所评估的稀疏基线中表现最佳，相对全注意力取得最高 6.85× 的自注意力加速。

papers.title: ForeDrive: Foresight-Guided End-to-End Autonomous Driving with a Planning-Relevant Latent World Model
papers.abstract_en: Existing latent world models are typically optimized for future predictability, yet the resulting representations are not necessarily useful for planning in autonomous driving. Predictions are commonly used for pretraining or auxiliary supervision rather than as direct conditioning signals for trajectory generation. We propose ForeDrive, which learns a planning-relevant latent representation and couples it asymmetrically to a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) planner. The planner consumes multi-horizon latent future representations learned with a JEPA-style world model; planning gradients update the shared online encoder, while stop-gradient routing trains the latent predictor with forecasting losses only. Because predicted futures have varying reliability across horizons and BEV trajectories are misaligned with image tokens, we use gated visual fusion, future-status injection, and Trajectory-Adaptive Bias (TAB) to inject future latents as guidance without overriding the current observation. Trained with pure imitation learning and using only the current front-view image as visual input at inference, ForeDrive attains 89.9 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.0 one-stage EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, without reinforcement learning or an external trajectory scorer.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures; 8 pages supplementary with 4 figures

papers.title: On the security and privacy of LLMs in Mobility
papers.abstract_en: The mobility sector is undergoing a paradigm shift driven by advances in Generative Artificial Intelligence. With a global market valued at approximately 2.9 trillion dollars annually, considering only cars, the integration of these technologies has the potential to impact more than 1.5 billion vehicles worldwide. As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in mobility, concerns about cybersecurity, privacy, and reliability emerge. Accordingly, this paper surveys current applications and assesses these challenges. Since the European AI Act classifies transportation AI as high risk, we derive nine technical classes from its requirements to assess current research and future deployments. Our findings show that research mainly studies GPT and Llama models (over 50\% of reviewed works) and traffic applications while largely neglecting security, privacy, and reliability. This gap extends to AI Act compliance: among 35 reviewed works, only one includes a partial vulnerability assessment and one a partial risk management system. We identify a clear gap between strong optimization performance and regulatory adherence, suggesting compliance is limited less by technology than by a focus on static performance over lifecycle safety, and underscoring an urgent need for security-by-design in safety-critical intelligent transportation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述 LLM 在出行 (mobility) 中的安全与隐私：从欧盟 AI Act 对交通 AI 的高风险要求推出九个技术评估类，据此审查现有研究。35 篇被审工作中仅 1 篇含部分漏洞评估、1 篇含部分风险管理体系，超 50% 集中在 GPT 与 Llama 及交通应用，安全、隐私与可靠性被系统性忽视。
Motivation: LLM 在出行领域快速落地，但研究集中在优化性能而非生命周期安全，与 AI Act 的合规要求之间出现明显落差。
Method: 以欧盟 AI Act 对交通 AI 的高风险条款为依据推导九个技术评估类，用该框架综述现有 LLM 出行应用并评估安全、隐私、可靠性与合规状况。
Result: 被审 35 篇工作中仅 1 篇含部分漏洞评估、1 篇含部分风险管理体系；超 50% 的被审工作研究 GPT 与 Llama，且集中于交通应用。全球仅乘用车市场规模约每年 2.9 万亿美元，涉及超 15 亿辆汽车。
Conclusion: 合规瓶颈更在于研究偏重静态性能而非生命周期安全，安全关键智能交通系统亟需 security-by-design。

papers.title: Dual-Frontier: When Can an Agent Trust Its World Model?
papers.abstract_en: Learned world models are becoming essential to general-purpose agents: by predicting action consequences, they support planning and decision-making while reducing reliance on costly trial and error. This reliance creates a fundamental ambiguity: when a world-model-guided decision fails, the trajectory alone may not reveal whether the agent's decision rule or the world model caused the loss. We formalize this failure-attribution problem as a counterfactual decomposition of return loss and prove that its components are not identifiable from passive interaction, even for finite-horizon planners. This obstruction motivates Dual-Frontier, a learning principle that admits a world-model-guided decision only when its predicted advantage exceeds a certified bound on decision-relevant world-model error; otherwise, evidence is allocated to world-model verification. Action-conditioned value bounds and a closed-loop extension guarantee non-decreasing return for admitted decisions. Calibrated gates and simultaneous confidence sequences support adaptive evidence reuse, with sufficient and necessary verification bounds. Controlled learned-model experiments validate the predicted failure modes and certification behavior, while cross-backbone tool-use benchmarks instantiate the same verify-then-promote rule in realistic agent world-model pipelines, consistently improving decision quality and reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dual-Frontier 把世界模型引导决策的失败归因形式化为回报损失的反事实分解，并证明其成分在被动交互下不可辨识。其学习准则是：只有当预测优势超过世界模型误差的认证上界时才采纳该决策，否则把证据分配给世界模型验证；动作条件价值界与闭环扩展保证被采纳决策的回报不下降。
Motivation: 世界模型引导的智能体决策失败时，仅凭轨迹无法区分是决策规则还是世界模型导致损失，这一归因歧义使盲目信任世界模型变得危险。
Method: 提出 Dual-Frontier：以回报损失的反事实分解刻画归因，证明被动交互下不可辨识；用动作条件价值界与闭环扩展约束决策准入，配合校准门控与同时置信序列 (simultaneous confidence sequences) 实现证据的自适应复用，并给出验证界充要条件。
Result: 受控学习模型实验验证了所预测的失败模式与认证行为；跨骨干 (cross-backbone) 工具使用基准在真实智能体世界模型流水线中实例化同一 verify-then-promote 规则，一致提升决策质量与可靠性。
Conclusion: 世界模型引导的决策应按“先验证再晋升”的规则准入：预测优势须超过认证误差界，否则转去验证世界模型，由此保证回报不下降。

papers.title: Learning to Fluctuate: Statistical Foundations for Causal Tabular Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Causal tabular foundation models amortize effect estimation across synthetic mechanisms, but latent-effect supervision rewards posterior shrinkage instead of directly encoding the repeated-sample response needed in a fixed deployment population. We introduce fluctuation-supervised pretraining (FSP): each synthetic table is labeled by its average treatment effect plus its efficient influence-function fluctuation, while deployment remains a single frozen forward pass. Along the path $T_{λ,P}=θ(P)+λP_nψ_P$, we prove an endpoint transition: every fixed $λ<1$ retains label ambiguity of order $(1-λ)^2/n$, whereas full fluctuation makes the Gaussian label observable and reduces optimal finite-stratum causal label-prediction risk to order $n^{-2}$. One finite-pretraining bound combines label, network, episode-sampling, and optimization errors; its resulting sampling defect controls fixed-mechanism bias, mean squared error, variance, Gaussian approximation, and, with variance-head accuracy, studentized coverage. Complementary lower bounds separate the local $n^{-1}$ ATE risk that deployment observations cannot erase from the $\log N/M$ excess risk of a generic finite-dictionary episode-learning problem. Experiments trace the learned sampling response. With a raw-row/column backbone, FSP reduces large-effect-shift RMSE by 69.8% relative to latent supervision and by 39.5% relative to a released CausalPFN checkpoint on matched tables. Continuous-covariate experiments, known-effect semisynthesis and two randomized-study evaluations separate sampling-law fidelity from point-risk shrinkage and expose weak-overlap errors in both learned heads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 fluctuation-supervised pretraining (FSP)：合成表格同时标注平均处理效应 (ATE) 与 efficient influence-function 波动，部署时仍是一次冻结前向传播。沿 $T_{λ,P}$ 路径证明端点转变——固定 λ<1 保留 $(1-λ)^2/n$ 量级的标签歧义，完整波动使高斯标签可观测、最优有限分层因果标签预测风险降到 $n^{-2}$；大效应偏移 RMSE 相对 latent supervision 降低 69.8%、相对 CausalPFN checkpoint 降低 39.5%。
Motivation: 因果表格基础模型用合成机制摊销效应估计，但 latent-effect 监督奖励后验收缩，而不是编码固定部署人群所需的重复样本响应，导致大效应偏移下点风险收缩。
Method: FSP 给每张合成表标注 ATE 加 efficient influence-function 波动；沿 $T_{λ,P}=θ(P)+λP_nψ_P$ 证明标签可观测性转变，给出合并标签、网络、episode 采样与优化误差的有限预训练界，其 sampling defect 控制固定机制偏差、MSE、方差、Gaussian 近似与（配合 variance head）studentized coverage；另给下界分离部署观测无法消除的局部 $n^{-1}$ ATE 风险与 $
log N/M$ 字典超额风险。实验用 raw-row/column backbone，另有连续协变量、已知效应 semisynthesis 与两项随机研究评估。
Result: 大效应偏移 RMSE：FSP 相对 latent supervision 降低 69.8%，相对 released CausalPFN checkpoint 降低 39.5%（matched tables）。理论量级：固定 λ<1 标签歧义 $(1-λ)^2/n$，完整波动使风险降至 $n^{-2}$，局部 ATE 风险 $n^{-1}$，字典超额风险 $
log N/M$。连续协变量与 semisynthesis 实验分离 sampling-law fidelity 与点风险收缩，并暴露两个 learned head 的 weak-overlap 误差。

papers.title: EADC: Evaluation of Advanced and Deep-level Compliance in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used in various industries. However, ensuring their compliance with complex laws and regulatory frameworks remains a great challenge. Existing evaluation paradigms mainly rely on static benchmarks that suffer from three severe limitations: First, the compliance rules being used do not comply with the requirements of Artificial Intelligence (AI) laws and regulations; Second, they only handle apparent, explicit compliance risks, leaving implicit and covert compliance risks undetected; Third, they fail to track the systematic propagation of risks along logical dependency chains or evaluate compliance within nuanced, context-based real-world scenarios. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce EADC, a novel advanced evaluation benchmark of LLMs based on an AI compliance knowledge graph and AI compliance legal experts. By mapping abstract legal rules into structured logical multi-relational graphs, our framework enables automated, evolving agents to distill and synthesize highly sophisticated adversarial scenarios. This compliance benchmark is reviewed and corrected by human AI legal experts throughout the whole process. The resulting dataset (4,435+ QA pairs) provides an extensive, multi-dimensional taxonomy covering critical regulatory frontiers, including bias and discrimination, fairness, personal privacy protection, and values. Crucially, our compliance dataset moves beyond shallow string-matching by incorporating contextual long-horizon interactions and logic-driven hazard chains, capturing deeply embedded compliance anomalies that bypass traditional filters. Experiment evaluations demonstrate that our framework exposes critical regulatory blind spots in state-of-the-art LLMs, offering a rigorous, AI laws and regulations-aligned benchmark to safeguard high-level and deep compliance in the application of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EADC 是面向 LLM 法规遵从的评测基准，用 AI 合规知识图谱与法律专家智能体把抽象法条映射为多关系逻辑图，自动生成沿逻辑依赖链传播的对抗性问答。数据集含 4,435+ QA 对，覆盖偏见歧视、公平、隐私与价值观等维度，并含长程上下文交互与 hazard chain。评测显示主流 LLM 存在关键监管盲区。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 合规评测依赖静态基准：所用规则不符 AI 法规要求，只查显性风险，且无法追踪风险沿逻辑依赖链的传播或评估真实情境下的合规。
Method: 构建 AI 合规知识图谱，把法律规则转为结构化多关系逻辑图；由自动化、可持续演化的智能体蒸馏合成复杂对抗场景，全程经人类 AI 法律专家评审修正；数据集采用多维分类法并纳入长程上下文交互与逻辑驱动 hazard chain，而非浅层字符串匹配。
Result: 数据集含 4,435+ QA 对，覆盖偏见与歧视、公平、个人隐私保护、价值观等监管前沿；评测显示该框架暴露出 SOTA LLM 的关键监管盲区。
Conclusion: 以合规知识图谱加法律专家评审构建的基准能捕捉绕过传统过滤器的深层合规异常，可作为与 AI 法规对齐的 LLM 高层与深层合规评测工具。

papers.title: FIRE: Failure-Informed Runtime Engineering for Reliable Language-Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents often reach a working solution and then fail to consistently deliver it. We study runtime policies: targeted natural-language instructions and action denials applied by the agent harness at states that preceded observed failures, without changing model weights or the user prompt. With this, keeping capability constant, we observe a meaningful unlock in delivered reliability. Across the complete 87-task Terminal-Bench 2.1 suite, with two attempts per task, policies increase repeated success (pass^2) in all three GPT-5.6 tiers: 50.6% to 54.0% for Luna, 55.2% to 60.9% for Terra, and 64.4% to 73.6% for Sol. Sol's best-of-two success changes by 1.2 points while repeated success rises by 9.2, showing that policies chiefly convert reachable solutions into dependable delivery. We further cover 14 tasks under Terra's frozen portfolio. Policy-guided Terra reaches 71.4%, compared with 64.3% for unassisted Sol, at about half the cost, demonstrating how engineering around models could unlock dependability for a use case. To isolate the mechanism we run a randomized five-arm experiment: real policies reach 61% on eligible tasks, versus 39% without a policy, 36% with a timing-matched sham, and 39 to 43% with generic verification or reconsideration. The intended corrective behavior appears in 22 of 24 coded policy attempts, against at most 14 in any other arm. Runtime policies are therefore a practical reliability layer: they make capabilities an agent already possesses substantially more repeatable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FIRE 在 agent harness 层面对先于失败出现的状态注入定向自然语言指令与动作拒绝，不动权重也不动用户 prompt。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 全部 87 个任务、每任务两次尝试下，三个 GPT-5.6 档位的重复成功率 pass^2 全部上升（Luna 50.6%→54.0%、Terra 55.2%→60.9%、Sol 64.4%→73.6%），随机五臂实验中真实策略 61% 对无策略 39%。
Motivation: 语言模型 agent 常已能解出题目却无法稳定交付：能力到位而可靠性不足，改权重或改 prompt 的常规手段代价高，需要在不改模型的前提下提升重复成功。
Method: FIRE 学习运行时策略：在观测到失败之前的状态上，由 harness 施加定向自然语言指令与动作拒绝（action denial），保持模型能力与用户 prompt 不变；用随机五臂实验隔离机制，含无策略、时间匹配的 sham、通用 verification/reconsideration 对照，并对策略尝试编码其预期纠正行为。
Result: Terminal-Bench 2.1 全 87 任务、每任务 2 次尝试下 pass^2：Luna 50.6%→54.0%，Terra 55.2%→60.9%，Sol 64.4%→73.6%；Sol 的 best-of-two 仅变 1.2 点而重复成功升 9.2 点。在 Terra 冻结策略集覆盖的 14 个任务上，策略引导的 Terra 达 71.4%，超过无辅助 Sol 的 64.3%，成本约为其一半。五臂实验中真实策略在 eligible 任务上 61%，无策略 39%、时间匹配 sham 36%、通用验证或重新考虑 39–43%；预期纠正行为在 24 次编码策略尝试中出现 22 次，其他臂最多 14 次。
Conclusion: 运行时策略是一层实用的可靠性工程：它把 agent 已具备的能力变成可重复交付，且能在较低档位模型上以约一半成本超过更高档位的无辅助表现。

papers.title: Canonical locks that encode part-whole hierarchies
papers.abstract_en: One of the challenges in representational learning is how to encode part-whole hierarchies in a neural net. Prior works rely on flattening tree-like structures into string-like sequences and training a sequence-to-sequence model via autoregression. While such a representation works for parse-trees in NLP, it is not entirely clear how to make it work for images. Thus, we propose a geometric primitive called canonical locks. The key idea is that parts/wholes can be modelled as higher-dimensional vectors ($d \geq 4$), and information can be encoded in their relative phase differences. Inductively, the net consists of positionally-bound bottom-up and top-down neural fields, which drive each other to achieve a state of thermal equilibrium. Additionally, we show the existence of a few symmetrical configurations in the net. The computational iterations taken to break these symmetries depend on the angle between parts/wholes arranged on a disk (or more precisely a ring) in higher dimensions. It also appears to have connections to the psychological phenomenon of mental rotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出几何基元 canonical locks，用 d≥4 维向量的相对相位差编码部分-整体层级，替代把树结构摊平成序列的自回归做法。网络由位置绑定的自下而上与自上而下神经场相互驱动至热平衡态；对称构型的破缺迭代数取决于部件在高维环上的夹角，并与心理旋转现象相呼应。
Motivation: 把树状部分-整体层级摊平成字符串再用 seq2seq 自回归训练的做法在 NLP 解析树上可行，但迁移到图像上如何成立并不清楚。
Method: 以 canonical locks 把部分/整体建模为 d≥4 维向量，信息编码在相对相位差中；网络归纳地由位置绑定 (positionally-bound) 的自下而上与自上而下神经场构成，二者相互驱动达到热平衡态，并分析其中的若干对称构型。
Result: 证明网络中存在若干对称构型，打破这些对称所需的计算迭代次数取决于部件/整体在高维圆盘（更准确地说环）上的排列夹角；该现象被指出与心理旋转 (mental rotation) 存在联系。
Conclusion: 部分-整体层级可以直接用高维向量的相位差与神经场的热平衡动力学来编码，对称破缺的难易由几何夹角决定，为图像上的层级表征提供一条绕开序列自回归的路径。

papers.title: EMERGE: Resolution-Agnostic Point Cloud Generation with Equivariant Graph-Based Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Point cloud generation has emerged as a crucial task for accurately capturing and reproducing the complexity of the physical world. However, existing generative approaches, predominantly relying on Transformers and Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), frequently ignore the continuous, non-grid topologies inherent to 3D spaces. Although the integration of graph-based structures has yielded significant benefits in related discriminative vision tasks, such geometric architectures remain noticeably absent from 3D generative modeling. To address this gap, we introduce EMERGE (Equivariant Multi-scale GNN for Resolution-agnostic point cloud GEneration), the first fully $SE(3)$-equivariant graph-based diffusion backbone explicitly designed to generate point clouds while preserving continuous spatial symmetries. Our framework bypasses the rigid resolution dependencies of standard generative pipelines, enabling zero-shot inference at multiple, arbitrary spatial resolutions. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that EMERGE achieves State-of-the-Art generation quality across standard metrics, while the strong inherent geometric inductive biases enable significantly faster training convergence compared to existing baseline methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMERGE 用完全 SE(3) 等变的多尺度 GNN 扩散骨干直接生成点云，绕开标准生成管线对固定分辨率的依赖，可在任意空间分辨率上做零样本推理。在标准点云生成指标上达到 State-of-the-Art 生成质量，几何归纳偏置使训练收敛显著快于现有基线方法。
Motivation: 现有 3D 生成方法以 Transformer 和 VAE 为主，忽略 3D 空间的连续非网格拓扑；图结构虽在判别式视觉任务中有效，却缺席于 3D 生成建模，且标准管线受固定分辨率约束。
Method: 提出 EMERGE（Equivariant Multi-scale GNN for Resolution-agnostic point cloud GEneration）：以多尺度 GNN 作为完全 SE(3) 等变的图扩散骨干生成点云，保留连续空间对称性，并绕开标准生成管线的刚性分辨率依赖以支持任意分辨率零样本推理。
Result: 在标准点云生成指标上达到 State-of-the-Art 生成质量；强几何归纳偏置带来比现有基线方法显著更快的训练收敛；支持在多个任意空间分辨率上零样本推理。
Conclusion: 把 SE(3) 等变图扩散作为 3D 生成骨干，可同时换取分辨率无关的推理与更优的生成质量和训练效率。

papers.title: xWhyL: Causal Interactive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Explanations are central to causal reasoning, and cognitive science has long established that the human drive to explain is itself a mechanism for learning about causality. Despite this, learning from those abductive signals is largely ignored in artificial intelligence. While explainable AI (XAI) increasingly draws on causal models to generate explanations, the converse direction about what explanations can do for causality remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we propose xWhyL, a formal framework connecting causality and XAI by learning causal models from explanations. We develop a mathematical theory that translates explanations into a learning signal complementary to observational data, and demonstrate how it enables overcoming the limits of observational causal discovery. As explanations can be derived from incorrect beliefs and clash with data, a tension we call the Causal Tug-of-War, we prove conditions under which our framework rejects misspecified explanations rather than absorbing them. Our practical instantiation, Causal Interactive Learning (CIL), shows how expert explanations can efficiently support causal discovery and distinguish correct from incorrect explanations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: xWhyL 提出从解释中学习因果模型的形式框架，把人类解释当作与观测数据互补的学习信号，并给出数学理论说明它如何突破纯观测因果发现的限制。针对解释可能来自错误信念、与数据冲突的 Causal Tug-of-War，论文证明了框架拒绝错误设定解释而非吸收它们的条件；其实例化 Causal Interactive Learning 展示专家解释能高效支持因果发现并区分正确与错误解释。
Motivation: 认知科学早已确立解释本身是学习因果的机制，但 AI 中从这类溯因信号学习基本被忽略；XAI 单向借用因果模型生成解释，反方向（解释如何反哺因果学习）几乎空白，纯观测因果发现因此受限。
Method: 提出 xWhyL 形式框架，建立把解释翻译为与观测数据互补的学习信号的数学理论；针对解释与数据冲突的 Causal Tug-of-War 证明拒绝错误设定解释的条件；给出可操作实例 Causal Interactive Learning (CIL)，让专家解释迭代参与因果发现。
Result: 证明了在给定条件下框架会拒绝 misspecified 解释而非将其吸收；CIL 展示专家解释可高效支持因果发现，并能区分正确与错误的解释。
Conclusion: 解释可作为独立于观测数据的学习信号用于因果发现，且在所证条件下对错误解释具有鲁棒性；因果与 XAI 是双向关系。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Hyperbolic Restricted Boltzmann Machine Neural Quantum State
papers.abstract_en: We construct the first type of non-Euclidean non-autoregressive neural quantum state (NQS) in the form of the hyperbolic Restricted Boltzmann Machine (HRBM), which is studied in the variational Monte-Carlo (VMC) setting of the Quantum Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (QSK) model whose ground state exhibits volume-law entanglement. Across a 512-fold increase in the Hilbert space dimension corresponding to a system size increase from $N=14$ to $N=24$, HRBM NQS robustly outperforms its Euclidean version, the RBM NQS, in terms of better ground state energy optimization as well as lower Renyi-2 $S_2$ and von Neumann $S_{vN}$ absolute entanglement entropy reconstruction errors. More importantly, for all QSK system sizes, HRBM NQS demonstrates a superior expressivity in faithfully reproducing the entire entanglement spectrum of the QSK model from the top eigenvalues down to the tail end across 15 orders of magnitude, while RBM NQS consistently overestimates the sub-dominant modes. This work furnishes a proof-of-concept demonstrating that hyperbolic non-autoregressive NQS ansatzë, thanks to the exponential volume of the hyperbolic geometry underlying their constructions, might be more natural at representing volume-law quantum systems than conventional Euclidean NQS. Furthermore, an interesting byproduct of this work is the polynomial scaling result of RBM-type NQS ansatzë in the QSK volume-law system as the Hilbert space increases exponentially.

papers.title: CQ4OE: A benchmark for assessing LLM-assisted ontology generation from competency questions
papers.abstract_en: Ontology generation from Competency Questions (CQs) is a central yet labor-intensive phase of Ontology Engineering. While large language models (LLMs) offer promising automation capabilities, current evaluations remain fragmented. Task formulations are heterogeneous, gold standards often lack fine-grained CQ provenance, metrics conflate lexical overlap with structural and logical adequacy, and reference ontologies are not always explicitly designed around the evaluation CQs. Here, we address these limitations with CQ4OE, a benchmark for the systematic and reproducible evaluation of LLM-based ontology generation from CQs. For each ontology in the benchmark, we build a CQ-driven gold OWL ontology with explicit provenance linking each CQ to the classes, properties, and axioms required to answer it. From this resource, we define two complementary evaluation tasks. CQ2Term supports term-level evaluation of CQ-specific class and property prediction over 99 CQs, and CQ2Onto supports ontology-level evaluation over 118 CQs, including hierarchy, property modeling, and axiom-level structure. We demonstrate CQ4OE with experiments using nine LLMs under zero-shot, iterative, and multi-agent generation strategies, showing that LLMs recover explicit vocabulary terms more reliably than creating ontologies, particularly in property modeling, hierarchy construction, and axiom generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CQ4OE 是评测 LLM 从 Competency Questions 生成 OWL 本体的基准：为每个本体构建带 CQ 溯源的金标准 OWL 本体，并定义 CQ2Term（99 个 CQ 的类/属性词项预测）与 CQ2Onto（118 个 CQ 的层级、属性建模与公理级结构）两项任务。用 9 个 LLM 在 zero-shot、迭代与多智能体三种生成策略下演示，结果显示 LLM 恢复显式词项比真正构造本体可靠得多，短板集中在属性建模、层级构建与公理生成。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 本体生成评测碎片化：任务定义不统一、金标准缺少细粒度 CQ 溯源、指标把词面重叠与结构/逻辑充分性混为一谈，参考本体也未围绕评测 CQ 设计。
Method: 对基准中每个本体构建 CQ 驱动的金标准 OWL 本体，显式标注每个 CQ 到应答所需类、属性与公理的溯源；据此定义 CQ2Term（词项级）与 CQ2Onto（本体级，含层级、属性建模、公理结构）两项互补任务，并用 9 个 LLM 在 zero-shot、迭代、多智能体三种生成策略下做实验。
Result: CQ2Term 覆盖 99 个 CQ，CQ2Onto 覆盖 118 个 CQ；9 个 LLM 的实验显示它们恢复显式词项比构造完整本体更可靠，弱点在属性建模、层级构建与公理生成。
Conclusion: LLM 辅助本体生成的瓶颈不在词汇对齐而在结构性建模，评测必须把词项级与本体级（含公理）指标分开并保留 CQ 溯源。

papers.title: REVE: Efficient Hallucination Correction for Large Audio-Language Models via Reused Encoder States
papers.abstract_en: Large audio-language models may mention acoustic events that are absent from the input. A separate audio event detector can verify these mentions, but doing so requires a second audio encoder and a separate forward pass. We propose Reused Encoder States for Verifying Events (REVE), a lightweight method that uses states already computed by the target model. One readout summarizes class scores across audio frames, while another uses pooled states from four consecutive frame intervals. Class-aware score fusion combines their outputs to verify generated event mentions without encoding the audio again. On AudioSet, REVE removes 92.9% of label-unsupported mentions under a faithful-mention recall constraint. With fewer added parameters and no second audio-encoding pass, REVE achieves a reduction comparable to those of CED-Tiny and CED-Base. Its complete verification latency is about 1/18 of the CED-Base path. Results on controlled DESED mixtures and different target-model architectures further confirm the effectiveness of encoder-state reuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REVE 复用大音频语言模型已算出的编码器状态来核验生成的声学事件提及，无需第二个音频编码器与第二次前向：一个读出汇总各帧类别分数，另一个对连续四帧区间做池化，再用类别感知分数融合判定。在 AudioSet 上，在忠实提及召回约束下移除 92.9% 无标签支持的提及，验证延迟约为 CED-Base 路径的 1/18。
Motivation: 大音频语言模型会提及输入中不存在的声学事件；用独立音频事件检测器核验需第二个音频编码器和一次额外前向，带来参数与延迟开销。
Method: REVE（Reused Encoder States for Verifying Events）复用目标模型已计算的编码器状态：一个读出跨音频帧汇总类别分数，另一个对四个连续帧区间做池化状态读出，再以类别感知分数融合 (class-aware score fusion) 判定生成的事件提及，不重新编码音频。
Result: 在 AudioSet 上，于忠实提及召回 (faithful-mention recall) 约束下移除 92.9% 无标签支持的提及；新增参数更少且无第二次音频编码，削减幅度与 CED-Tiny、CED-Base 相当，完整验证延迟约为 CED-Base 路径的 1/18；在受控 DESED 混合音频与不同目标模型架构上也得到一致结论。
Conclusion: 复用目标模型自身的编码器状态即可完成事件提及核验，在削减幅度可比的同时把验证延迟压到 CED-Base 路径的约 1/18，跨架构与受控混合数据均成立。

papers.title: MICRO: Multi-Fidelity Active Search for Severe Error Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Human feedback can vary in cost and informativeness. Strong feedback can reveal severe errors but is costly, so cheaper quality ratings can help decide which items to annotate. We propose MICRO (Multi-Fidelity Impact Clustered Rollout), an active search framework that allocates a shared budget to these feedback types to maximise confirmed severe error discoveries. MICRO jointly models ratings and annotation losses conditional on item features to steer acquisition. It clusters acquisitions by their predicted impact on severity probabilities to select diverse candidates, then uses rollout to estimate their discovery value. Experiments on WMT20 English-German show that ratings improve both loss reconstruction and severity prediction. MICRO achieves the highest mean discovery count across four budget and rating cost settings, with similar performance to adapted MF-ENS in one and significant gains over all six comparison policies, including two rollout controls, in the other three $(p<.001)$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MICRO 把强标注（能确认严重错误但贵）与廉价质量评分两种反馈放进同一预算，联合建模评分与标注损失，按对严重度概率的预测影响聚类选多样候选，再用 rollout 估计发现价值。在 WMT20 英德翻译上，四种预算与评分成本组合中 MICRO 的平均确认严重错误发现数均为最高，其中三种相对全部六个对比策略（含两个 rollout 对照）显著提升（p<.001）。
Motivation: 人工反馈成本与信息量差异大：强反馈能确认严重错误但昂贵，如何在共享预算下在两类反馈间分配以最大化严重错误发现数是一个未解的采集决策问题。
Method: MICRO（Multi-Fidelity Impact Clustered Rollout）为 active search 框架：联合建模质量评分与标注损失在 item 特征条件下的分布以驱动 acquisition；按对严重度概率的预测影响做聚类选出多样候选；再用 rollout 估计候选的发现价值。
Result: 在 WMT20 English-German 上，评分同时改善损失重构与严重度预测；MICRO 在四个预算与评分成本设置中平均发现数均最高，其中一个设置与改造的 MF-ENS 相当，另外三个设置相对全部六个对比策略（含两个 rollout 对照）有显著提升（p<.001）。
Conclusion: 把多保真反馈的联合建模、影响聚类与 rollout 结合，能在翻译严重错误的主动搜索中更有效地花预算确认严重错误。

papers.title: Reciprocal Collaboration: how lessons from convergence in GLAMs can enhance interdisciplinary AI research
papers.abstract_en: The need for collaboration between diverse fields of research is increasingly recognised as important by research funding agencies. A significant driver of this need is the current revolution in artificial intelligence (AI) and related technologies. There is a growing interest in the potential impact of AI in different fields including the methodologies they use and the resulting advances in new knowledge, new access and enhanced productivity. However, there is also a corresponding increase in concern about the fundamentals of AI technologies and the way in which trans and/or interdisciplinary research is approached. The resulting collaboration too often ends up as a one-way street where the domain partner acts only as an information provider. For example, the contribution of the AHSS partner might be limited to providing insight about ethics and/or the technology partner may only provide a service to build applied AI-based solutions. In response to this problem, we propose a reciprocal approach to collaboration where both partners seek to understand, cooperate and identify jointly significant impacts. In this paper we explore this relationship between cultural heritage institutions (GLAMs), Arts, Humanities & Social Sciences (AHSS) research and technology-led AI research, especially the impact of current technological advances in AI. Drawing from the history of convergence in GLAM studies, we propose five key practices to form a framework for greater understanding across this divide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文针对跨学科 AI 合作常沦为单向关系（领域方只当信息提供者、技术方只交付工具）的问题，提出互惠式合作取向，并从 GLAM（galleries, libraries, archives, museums）研究与 AHSS、AI 技术的融合史中提炼五项关键实践，构成一个促进双向理解的框架。
Motivation: 资助机构推动跨学科 AI 合作，但实际合作常退化为单向关系：AHSS 伙伴只提供伦理洞见，技术伙伴只交付 AI 工具，双方缺乏共同理解与共同定义的影响力。
Method: 以 GLAM 研究、AHSS 与技术主导 AI 研究之间的关系为分析对象，回顾 GLAM 领域融合的历史经验，从中提出五项关键实践并组织为跨学科理解框架。
Result: 提出一个由五项关键实践组成的互惠合作框架，应用于 GLAM、AHSS 与 AI 研究三方关系的分析；论文为 19 页、含 1 图的论述性工作。
Conclusion: 跨学科 AI 合作应从单向的信息提供/服务交付转向互惠模式，双方共同理解、协作并识别共同重要的影响，GLAM 融合史提供了可迁移的实践来源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: BOBA: Dynamic Bayesian Optimization through Bayesian Active Inference
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic black-box optimization presents significant challenges for Bayesian Optimization (BO), as the objective function evolves over time, causing optimal locations to shift continuously. Existing dynamic BO (DBO) methods using standard acquisition functions such as Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) fail to explicitly account for temporal variations, leading to suboptimal sample allocation and poor tracking of moving optima. Here, we propose BOBA (Bayesian Optimization through Bayesian Active Inference), a novel acquisition function inspired by free energy principles from active inference that explicitly minimizes predictive uncertainty about future states in dynamic environments. BOBA extends traditional acquisition functions by incorporating a forward-looking uncertainty quantification that estimates uncertainty in function changes, enabling more informed exploration-exploitation trade-offs in non-stationary settings. We evaluate BOBA on synthetic dynamic benchmarks, comparing against state-of-the-art DBO methods. Our experiments demonstrate that BOBA significantly improves regret in query-restricted settings, while remaining competitive in time-limited settings. We further analyze variants of BOBA with different exploration strategies, showing how the exploration-exploitation balance can be tuned for different types of dynamic functions. This work contributes both a free energy-based acquisition function for DBO and insights into how active inference principles can enhance optimization in non-stationary environments, with implications for real-time applications requiring continuous adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BOBA：把 active inference 的自由能原理引入动态贝叶斯优化 (DBO) 的采集函数，显式最小化对目标函数未来状态的预测不确定性，从而跟踪移动最优点。在合成动态基准上，BOBA 在查询受限 (query-restricted) 设置中显著改善 regret，在限时设置中保持竞争力。
Motivation: 动态黑盒优化中目标函数随时间演化、最优点持续移动，标准采集函数如 UCB 不显式建模时间变化，导致采样分配次优、对移动最优点跟踪差。
Method: 提出采集函数 BOBA (Bayesian Optimization through Bayesian Active Inference)，基于 active inference 的自由能原理，加入前视的不确定性量化来估计函数变化的不确定性，以改善非平稳环境下的探索-利用权衡；并分析不同探索策略的 BOBA 变体。
Result: 在合成动态基准上与最先进 DBO 方法对比：BOBA 在查询受限设置中显著改善 regret，在限时设置中保持竞争力；不同探索策略的变体显示探索-利用平衡可按动态函数类型调节。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把自由能式的前视不确定性项加入采集函数，可在非平稳目标上改善查询受限场景的动态贝叶斯优化表现，且探索-利用权衡可按函数类型调节。

papers.title: The Dynamics of Quasiregular Neural Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many learning problems combine a dominant regularity with systematic exceptions. Motivated by U-shaped learning in language acquisition, we study this interaction in controlled quasiregular regression problems where regular and exceptional solutions are explicitly known. Neural networks can partially acquire exceptions, subsequently regress toward the dominant regularity, and finally recover. This overregularization becomes substantially stronger when exceptions are rare, despite their early acquisition, but does not emerge equally across all regularities considered. Our results isolate a simple form of competition between regularities and exceptions during neural learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在正则与例外解显式已知的 quasiregular 回归任务中，神经网络先部分习得例外、随后向主导正则回退 (overregularization)、最后再恢复，形成 U 形轨迹；例外越稀少，这种过度正则化越强，尽管例外是先被习得的，且该现象在不同正则之间出现得并不一致。
Motivation: 语言习得中的 U 形学习表明规则与例外在神经学习中相互竞争，但这一竞争在可控、正则与例外解已知的回归设定中尚未被隔离出来观察。
Method: 构造 quasiregular 回归问题，其中正则解与例外解显式已知，用神经网络学习并追踪其在正则与例外之间的取舍轨迹；系统改变例外的稀有程度与正则类型以分离竞争效应。
Result: 神经网络呈现三阶段 U 形轨迹：部分习得例外、向主导正则回退、再恢复；例外稀少时过度正则化显著增强，尽管例外被更早习得；该现象在所考察的不同正则之间出现程度不一。
Conclusion: 神经学习中存在正则与例外之间的一种简单竞争机制，其强度由例外的稀有度与正则类型共同决定，可解释语言习得的 U 形曲线。

papers.title: Compiling Sufficient Governance Context from Declared Losses and Reachable States: Exact Observation-Contract Synthesis with Cardinality and Cost Objectives
papers.abstract_en: We call the object this paper derives and certifies a minimal sufficient governance context: given a finite reachable-state model, a deterministic declared verdict, and candidate observable attributes, we compute sufficient observation sets, distinguish attributes that are individually indispensable from contracts that are jointly sufficient, and select among sufficient contracts under a cardinality or declared-cost objective. An observation contract is a set of candidate attributes whose values determine the declared verdict on every reachable state; an authority contract is one selected under an objective and bound to a gate schema. We synthesize every inclusion-minimal sufficient contract where exhaustive enumeration is affordable, and a minimum-cardinality or minimum-cost contract by SAT/MaxSAT encoding otherwise, checking sufficiency directly. On a constructed code/cloud domain, the individually-indispensable core is not sufficient as an observation contract and two distinct reducts exist; a preregistered cost model separates them exactly. On a second, larger, constructed domain, the same pattern recurs, but that domain's cost model does not separate the alternatives: a fully explained cost tie, reported as found. We measure discernibility-family scaling where exhaustive enumeration is confirmed infeasible within a registered timeout, while SAT/MaxSAT synthesis solves in well under a second; MaxSAT showed no measured cardinality advantage over plain SAT. AuthorityBench compares four baselines across three domains; the declared-only baseline is not exactly sufficient on any. Every selected contract is checked for sufficiency, with a counterexample on failure and a check summary, not a portable certificate, on success -- the compiler-focused scope of a two-scope table; an independently specified end-to-end case study is registered follow-up work, not claimed here.
papers.comment: Code, data, preregistration tags, review record, and independent reproduction (repository issue #3): https://github.com/besanson/sarc-authority-derivation. Artifact DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22884173
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有限可达状态模型上做观测契约 (observation contract) 的精确综合：用穷举枚举求全部 inclusion-minimal 充分契约，不可行时改用 SAT/MaxSAT 编码直接检查充分性并求最小基数或最小成本契约。在构造的 code/cloud 域上，单独不可或缺的属性核并不构成充分契约且存在两个不同 reduct；SAT/MaxSAT 在穷举被注册超时判为不可行的规模上仍远低于 1 秒求解，MaxSAT 相对普通 SAT 无测得的基数优势。
Motivation: 只凭声明的 verdict 无法判断哪些可观测属性真正足以在每个可达状态上复现该 verdict，也无从在多个充分契约间按基数或成本客观取舍。
Method: 定义 observation contract 为在所有可达状态上决定声明 verdict 的属性集合，authority contract 为按目标选出并绑定 gate schema 的契约；可穷举时枚举全部 inclusion-minimal 充分契约，否则用 SAT/MaxSAT 编码并直接检查充分性，失败时给出反例，成功时给出检查摘要。
Result: 构造的 code/cloud 域中，individually-indispensable 核不构成充分契约且存在两个不同 reduct，preregistered 成本模型恰好区分二者；第二个更大构造域复现该模式但其成本模型无法区分（完全解释的 cost tie，按原样报告）。在穷举被注册超时判为不可行的 discernibility-family 规模上，SAT/MaxSAT 远低于 1 秒求解，MaxSAT 未显示相对普通 SAT 的基数优势。AuthorityBench 在三个域上比较四个基线，declared-only 基线在任何一个域上都不精确充分。
Conclusion: 单独不可或缺不等于联合充分，充分契约须按基数或成本目标显式综合并逐个检查；成功时只给检查摘要而非可移植证书，端到端案例研究是已注册的后续工作而非本文主张。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VideoX-Qwen: Data-Centric Instruction-Based Video Editing
papers.abstract_en: Progress in general-purpose video editing depends on constructing large-scale paired supervision and effectively adapting video-generation backbones to instruction-driven editing. Unlike video generation, video editing must execute a requested transformation while preserving unrelated subjects, scene structure, motion, and temporal continuity. We present VideoX-Qwen, an integrated data-construction and model-training framework for general instruction-based video editing. Our scalable production pipeline organizes specialized generation and understanding models into complementary routes for addition, removal, replacement, and attribute editing, followed by quality screening and instruction enrichment. It produces more than 1.2 million directional video-editing records, including over 400,000 records in each major task group, with an automatic acceptance rate of 89%. The resulting corpus provides broad and structured coverage of common editing operations through a unified source-instruction-target interface. We further develop a unified Qwen-Wan editor that combines multimodal semantic conditioning with dense source-video latent guidance. A progressive image-video training strategy aligns the multimodal instruction interface, adapts the video generator to source-conditioned editing, and refines output quality with selected high-resolution data. In a 100-example comparison with UniVideo and Kling O1, VideoX-Qwen achieves the best mean result on nine of eleven reported metrics, including instruction following, editing quality, content preservation, structural and perceptual similarity, and video-distribution quality. Together, the large-scale data-production system and unified training framework provide a practical foundation for more capable instruction-driven video editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoX-Qwen 是一套面向指令式视频编辑的数据构建与训练框架：用分工的生成/理解模型组成增、删、换、属性编辑四条生产路线，经质量筛选与指令扩充产出 120 万条以上方向性编辑记录，自动接受率 89%。统一的 Qwen-Wan 编辑器结合多模态语义条件与稠密源视频 latent 引导，采用渐进式图像-视频训练；在与 UniVideo、Kling O1 的 100 例对比中，于 11 项指标中的 9 项取得最佳均值。
Motivation: 通用视频编辑依赖大规模成对监督，但视频编辑须在执行指令变换的同时保持无关主体、场景结构、运动与时序连续性，与视频生成的监督构造方式不同，缺少可规模化的数据与训练路径。
Method: 可扩展生产流水线把专用生成模型与理解模型组织成 addition、removal、replacement、attribute editing 四条互补路线，再做质量筛选与指令富集，统一为 source-instruction-target 接口；模型侧为统一 Qwen-Wan 编辑器，融合多模态语义条件与稠密源视频 latent 引导，用渐进式图像-视频训练先对齐多模态指令接口、再适配源条件编辑、最后用精选高分辨率数据精修画质。
Result: 产出超过 120 万条方向性视频编辑记录，每个主要任务组超过 40 万条，自动接受率 89%；在与 UniVideo 和 Kling O1 的 100 例对比中，于 11 项报告指标中的 9 项取得最佳均值，涵盖指令遵循、编辑质量、内容保持、结构与感知相似度以及视频分布质量。
Conclusion: 大规模数据生产系统加上统一训练框架，为更强的指令驱动视频编辑提供了可实践的基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Skytopia: Monocular Drone Navigation with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Monocular drone navigation requires reaching a goal in an unseen environment from a single forward-facing camera, which offers few cues for depth and scale. World models address this by modelling how observations evolve under actions, but they are built to be executed: the prediction is produced at deployment and fed back into action generation at every control step. We argue that what a policy needs from a world model is not the prediction but the representation required to produce it: in flight the executed action explains almost all of the change between observations, so prediction reduces to reprojecting a static scene under a known displacement. We therefore introduce skytopia, a policy built on an action-conditioned latent world model, and the 3D Gaussian Splatting platform on which it is trained. A forward objective predicts the representation of the next observation from the intended motion, and an inverse objective recovers that motion from the predicted transition. Because the prediction never reaches action generation, the predictor is discarded and one policy serves point-goal, image-goal, and goal-free navigation. Simulation experiments show that skytopia outperforms every baseline under all three specifications, attaining 57.8%, 66.0%, and 49.0% success rate, while discarding the predictor removes 59.4% of the inference cost. The same policy is subsequently deployed on a physical drone without fine-tuning and reaches goals in indoor, open outdoor, and woodland environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Skytopia 是单目无人机导航的动作条件隐式世界模型 (action-conditioned latent world model)：策略只需要产生预测所用的表征而非预测本身，因为飞行中已执行动作几乎解释了观测间全部变化，静态场景预测退化为已知位移下的重投影。前向目标从预期运动预测下一观测表征、逆向目标从预测转移恢复运动，预测器训练后丢弃，一个策略同时服务 point-goal、image-goal 与无目标导航；在 3D Gaussian Splatting 平台仿真中三种设定成功率分别为 57.8%、66.0%、49.0%，超过全部基线，丢弃预测器去掉 59.4% 推理开销，且零微调部署到实体无人机。
Motivation: 单目前视相机缺少深度与尺度线索，而现有世界模型在部署时每步都要生成预测并回灌动作生成，推理开销大且通常一种设定一个策略。
Method: 在 3D Gaussian Splatting 平台上训练动作条件隐式世界模型：前向目标由预期运动预测下一观测的表征，逆向目标从预测的转移中恢复该运动；预测结果不进入动作生成，训练后丢弃预测器，只保留策略，覆盖 point-goal、image-goal、goal-free 三种导航设定。
Result: 仿真中 skytopia 在三种设定下成功率分别为 57.8%、66.0%、49.0%，超过每个基线；丢弃预测器移除 59.4% 的推理开销；同一策略随后零微调部署到实体无人机，在室内、开阔室外与林地环境到达目标。
Conclusion: 策略需要的是产生预测的表征而非预测本身，丢弃预测器即可同时降低推理开销并让单一策略跨三种导航设定复用，并直接迁移到实体机。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 在 3D Gaussian Splatting 平台上训练动作条件隐式世界模型：前向目标由预期运动预测下一观测的表征，逆向目标从预测的转移中恢复该运动；预测结果不进入动作生成，训练后丢弃预测器，只保留策略，覆盖 point-goal、image-goal、goal-free 三种导航设定。
summary_sections.result: 仿真中 skytopia 在三种设定下成功率分别为 57.8%、66.0%、49.0%，超过每个基线；丢弃预测器移除 59.4% 的推理开销；同一策略随后零微调部署到实体无人机，在室内、开阔室外与林地环境到达目标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 策略需要的是产生预测的表征而非预测本身，丢弃预测器即可同时降低推理开销并让单一策略跨三种导航设定复用，并直接迁移到实体机。

papers.title: SE-MSB: End-to-End Unpaired Speech Enhancement using Mamba Schrödinger Bridges
papers.abstract_en: Speech enhancement (SE) models typically rely on supervised learning with paired data examples where clean speech is synthetically degraded. This paradigm limits performance in real-world scenarios where the target environment's specific acoustic characteristics are unknown. We propose a fully unpaired SE framework that uses principled Diffusion Schrödinger Bridges (DSB) to learn a stochastic transport process between a clean and a degraded speech distribution. Algorithms for learning transport maps are computationally heavy since they require simulating differential equations during training, usually at each training step. Therefore, we propose using a high-efficiency Mamba Diffusion Model designed for end-to-end waveform processing. We compare against state-of-the-art methods for speech enhancement, both paired and unpaired, as well as a classical signal processing algorithm. Experimental results show that we are on par or better than the baselines while being orders of magnitude faster during inference. Furthermore, we show that the flexibility of the DSB formulation allows our model to generalize across SE tasks, offering a robust and efficient solution for real-world speech restoration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SE-MSB 用 Diffusion Schrödinger Bridges (DSB) 在干净与退化语音分布之间学随机传输过程，实现完全非成对 (unpaired) 的端到端波形语音增强，绕开合成退化配对数据的监督范式。传输映射训练需逐步模拟微分方程，作者改用高效率 Mamba Diffusion Model 直接处理波形。实验中与成对、非成对 SOTA 及经典信号处理算法相比表现持平或更好，推理快若干数量级，并能跨 SE 任务泛化。
Motivation: 监督式 SE 依赖合成退化的配对数据，目标环境真实声学特性未知时性能受限；而 DSB 类传输映射学习每步都要解微分方程，训练代价过高。
Method: 提出完全非成对 SE 框架：用 Diffusion Schrödinger Bridges 学习干净/退化语音分布间的随机传输过程，配一个面向端到端波形的高效率 Mamba Diffusion Model 替代逐步微分方程模拟。
Result: 对比成对与非成对 SOTA 及一个经典信号处理算法，结果持平或更优，推理快若干数量级 (orders of magnitude faster)；DSB 形式使模型可跨 SE 任务泛化。
Conclusion: 非成对 DSB + Mamba 波形模型可作为真实场景语音修复的稳健高效方案，兼顾跨任务泛化与推理速度。

papers.title: Theory for groupoid equivariant neural networks: an approach for steerable CNNs on bounded domains
papers.abstract_en: Equivariant convolutional neural networks are usually built from a group acting globally on the space of signals. This hypothesis is inappropriate for many bounded or stratified domains: an ambient rigid motion may be admissible only on part of the domain, and the boundary introduces geometric types that are invisible to a transitive group action. We develop a theory of groupoid-equivariant neural networks in which the symmetry datum consists of a groupoid, a selected pseudogroup of local bisections, a measure, and input and output representation bundles. For integral channels on the object space, we prove a bisection-equivariant kernel theorem: equivariance is equivalent to a transport constraint on the two-point kernel, and its solutions are classified by one joint-stabilizer intertwiner on each orbit of pairs. As a case study we apply the theory to bounded planar domains. The resulting architecture is implemented through offline nullspace bases and sparse gather--transform--scatter operations. A Poisson--Dirichlet kernel study is used separately to assess boundary-aware inductive bias; the exact inverse is shown to preserve the global symmetries of the rectangle but not general proper local bisections. The numerical results show that the proposed architectures provide significant advantages when symmetries cannot be globally implemented by group actions and provide an accuracy improvement of at least one order of magnitude with respect to the models tested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把等变 CNN 的对称数据从群推广到群oid（groupoid），证明 bisection 等变核定理：等变性等价于两点核上的传输约束，其解按点对轨道上的 joint-stabilizer intertwiner 分类。在有界平面区域上经离线 nullspace 基与稀疏 gather--transform--scatter 实现，数值上相对所测模型精度提升至少一个数量级。
Motivation: 群在信号空间上的全局作用假设不适用于有界或分层域：环境刚体运动可能只在部分区域被允许，边界引入的几何类型对传递群作用不可见。
Method: 对称数据取为群oid、局部二分 (local bisections) 选定伪群、测度以及输入/输出表示丛；对对象空间上的积分通道证明 bisection 等变核定理。以有界平面域为案例，架构用离线 nullspace 基与稀疏 gather--transform--scatter 算子实现，并单独用 Poisson--Dirichlet 核研究评估边界感知归纳偏置。
Result: 数值结果显示所提架构在对称无法由群作用全局实现时具有显著优势，相对所测模型精度提升至少一个数量级；Poisson--Dirichlet 精确逆保持矩形的全局对称但不保持一般的真局部二分。
Conclusion: 群oid 等变框架把可实现的对称从全局群作用扩展到局部二分，是有界域上等变 CNN 的可行理论与实现路径；精确逆的对称保持范围限于矩形全局对称。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Interweaving Marginals into Multivariate Sample Paths: Training-Free Dependence Construction for Probabilistic Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide coordinate-wise predictive distributions, but these marginals do not determine a joint distribution over multivariate future trajectories. We study training-free coupling of frozen TSFM marginals into multivariate forecast sample paths. Our primary evaluation fixes the empirical marginal sample multiset at every channel--horizon coordinate across methods, isolating the effect of coupling alone. Historical temporal and channel relations substantially improve their corresponding dependence diagnostics. The same pattern persists when the fixed-marginal constraint is removed and paths are sampled directly, and remains present under native multivariate backbone inference. These results support treating dependence reconstruction as a distinct post-processing problem for probabilistic TSFMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 概率时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 只给出逐坐标边缘分布，多变量未来轨迹的联合分布并未被确定。论文提出免训练 (training-free) 的耦合方法，把冻结 TSFM 的边缘样本交织成多变量样本路径；固定每通道-预测坐标的边缘样本多重集后，历史时间与通道关系仍显著改善相应的依赖性诊断指标，去掉固定约束直接采样以及在原生多变量 backbone 推理下该模式依然成立。
Motivation: 概率 TSFM 输出的逐坐标边缘分布不足以确定多变量未来轨迹的联合分布，依赖结构缺失使多变量样本路径无法直接使用。
Method: 对冻结的 TSFM 边缘做免训练耦合，交织成多变量样本路径；主评估在每个通道-预测坐标上跨方法固定经验边缘样本多重集，从而把耦合本身的作用单独隔离出来。
Result: 在固定边缘约束下，引入历史时间与通道关系显著改善对应的依赖性诊断；去掉固定约束直接采样路径、以及改用原生多变量 backbone 推理时，同一模式仍然保持。
Conclusion: 依赖性重建应被视为概率 TSFM 的一个独立后处理问题，而非边缘预测分布自带的性质。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Faithful Faithfulness Evaluations: Challenges & Pitfalls Learned from a Breast MRI Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Saliency maps are widely used to explain deep learning predictions in medical imaging, yet visually plausible explanations do not necessarily reflect a model's true decision process and may therefore mislead clinicians. We investigate this problem using a Vision Transformer-based breast MRI classifier trained on the ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge dataset and evaluate multiple saliency methods, including Last-layer Attention, Attention Rollout, Grad-SAM, Gradient Attention Rollout, GMAR, Grad-CAM, and HiResCAM. Our study highlights two often-overlooked challenges in perturbation-based faithfulness evaluation. First, method rankings depend strongly on the perturbation strategy, varying across intensity-based perturbations and transformer-based attention masking. Second, benchmarking saliency methods requires distinguishing between class-specific and class-agnostic explanations. To enable fair comparisons, we introduce non-class-specific variants of gradient-based methods and evaluate both settings separately. Across protocols, Grad-CAM and Gradient Attention Rollout consistently emerged as the strongest class-specific methods, although their relative ranking depended on the evaluation design. These findings expose important limitations of current saliency-based explainability approaches and highlight the need for more robust and standardized evaluation frameworks for trustworthy clinical AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ODELIA 乳腺 MRI 挑战赛数据集上训练的 Vision Transformer 分类器中，扰动式显著性图 (saliency map) 忠实性评测的结论随扰动策略而翻转：基于强度的扰动与基于 transformer attention masking 给出的方法排序不同。作者据此把 class-specific 与 class-agnostic 解释分开评测，并为梯度类方法引入非类别特异变体；在各协议下 Grad-CAM 与 Gradient Attention Rollout 是最稳的 class-specific 方法，但二者相对名次仍取决于评测设计。
Motivation: 显著性图看起来合理不等于反映模型真实决策，可能误导临床医生；而现有扰动式忠实性评测本身受扰动策略与是否区分类别特异性影响，排名不可比，缺少标准化评测框架。
Method: 用 ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 数据集训练 Vision Transformer 乳腺 MRI 分类器，评测 Last-layer Attention、Attention Rollout、Grad-SAM、Gradient Attention Rollout、GMAR、Grad-CAM、HiResCAM 等显著性方法；比较强度扰动与 transformer attention masking 两种扰动策略，并提出梯度类方法的 non-class-specific 变体，将 class-specific 与 class-agnostic 两种设置分开评测。
Result: 跨各评测协议，Grad-CAM 与 Gradient Attention Rollout 稳定居于最强的 class-specific 方法，但二者相对排名随评测设计变化；方法排序对扰动策略（强度扰动 vs. attention masking）高度敏感。
Conclusion: 显著性方法的忠实性排名不是方法固有属性，而由扰动策略与是否区分类别特异性共同决定，因此临床 AI 的可信度评测需要更稳健、标准化的框架。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: NAWE: Digital Watermarking with Neural-Assisted Watermark Extraction
papers.abstract_en: NAWE (Neural-Assisted Watermark Extraction) combines an explicit signal-processing watermarking construction with a pretrained neural host predictor. A periodic, perceptually masked watermark carrier provides synchronization, Polar coding supplies redundancy, and denoising followed by subtraction extracts the embedded watermark. The denoiser remains frozen, without watermark-specific training. A one-factor-at-a-time study compares Wiener, BM3D, DRUNet, and GS-DRUNet host estimators. Comparisons with TrustMark, SSL Watermarking, PixelSeal, and WAM show NAWE's lowest geometric and photometric class BER and strong message recovery, while filtering and noise remain limitations consistent with the non-adaptive selection of the watermark extractor. The comparison retains the systems' different payloads and coding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NAWE 把显式信号处理水印构造与预训练神经宿主预测器结合：周期性感知掩蔽载体提供同步，Polar 编码提供冗余，冻结的去噪器经去噪后相减提取水印，且不做水印特定训练。对比 TrustMark、SSL Watermarking、PixelSeal 与 WAM，NAWE 取得最低的几何与光度类别 BER 和强消息恢复能力；滤波与噪声仍是限制，源于提取器的非自适应选择。
Motivation: 神经水印方法与显式信号处理水印各自存在宿主估计与鲁棒提取的缺口，需要在不重训去噪器的前提下把两者结合，并在统一比较中看清滤波与噪声下的失效边界。
Method: NAWE 用周期性、感知掩蔽的水印载体做同步，Polar 编码提供冗余，先去噪再相减提取水印；去噪器保持冻结、不做水印特定训练。用 one-factor-at-a-time 设计比较 Wiener、BM3D、DRUNet、GS-DRUNet 四种宿主估计器，并与 TrustMark、SSL Watermarking、PixelSeal、WAM 对比。
Result: NAWE 在几何与光度类别上取得最低 BER 与强消息恢复，优于 TrustMark、SSL Watermarking、PixelSeal、WAM；宿主估计器比较覆盖 Wiener、BM3D、DRUNet、GS-DRUNet。滤波与噪声下性能受限，且比较保留了各系统不同的 payload 与编码方案。
Conclusion: 显式水印构造加冻结神经去噪器即可达到最低类别 BER，但非自适应提取器选择使滤波与噪声成为当前瓶颈。

summary_sections.result: NAWE 在几何与光度类别上取得最低 BER 与强消息恢复，优于 TrustMark、SSL Watermarking、PixelSeal、WAM；宿主估计器比较覆盖 Wiener、BM3D、DRUNet、GS-DRUNet。滤波与噪声下性能受限，且比较保留了各系统不同的 payload 与编码方案。
summary_sections.conclusion: 显式水印构造加冻结神经去噪器即可达到最低类别 BER，但非自适应提取器选择使滤波与噪声成为当前瓶颈。

papers.title: GRIP: Gaussian Rendering as a Cross-Modal Bridge for Image-to-Point Cloud Registration
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces GRIP, a pose-conditioned refinement framework for pixel-to-point matching and 2D to 3D registration. Given an initial coarse pose estimate, GRIP addresses the structural mismatch between grid based image descriptors and unordered point cloud descriptors by softly rendering learned 3D point features onto the image grid through Gaussian feature splatting. The rendered point derived feature map is then fused with image features by a pixel aligned transformer, enabling visual semantic and geometric cues to interact in a shared 2D representation. The refined features are decoded and propagated to finer resolutions for dense correspondence estimation and final pose refinement. Experiments on RGB D Scenes V2 and 7 Scenes demonstrate state of the art inlier ratio and competitive registration recall, with stronger performance under stricter evaluation thresholds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRIP 是一个位姿条件化的图像到点云配准精化框架：用 Gaussian feature splatting 把学习到的 3D 点特征软渲染到图像网格上，再与图像特征做像素对齐融合，从而在共享 2D 表示中同时利用语义与几何线索做稠密对应与位姿精化。在 RGBD Scenes V2 与 7 Scenes 上取得 state of the art 的 inlier ratio 和有竞争力的 registration recall，且在更严格的评测阈值下优势更大。
Motivation: 网格化的图像描述子与无序点云描述子之间存在结构性错位，直接做像素到点的匹配难以同时利用视觉语义和几何线索，粗位姿之后的精化因此受限。
Method: 给定初始粗位姿，先用 Gaussian feature splatting 将学习到的 3D 点特征软渲染到图像网格，得到点派生特征图；再用 pixel aligned transformer 将其与图像特征融合，随后解码并传播到更细分辨率，输出稠密对应估计与最终位姿精化。
Result: 在 RGBD Scenes V2 与 7 Scenes 上报告 state of the art 的 inlier ratio 与有竞争力的 registration recall，且在更严格的评测阈值下表现更强。
Conclusion: 以高斯渲染作为跨模态桥接、在共享 2D 表示中融合图像与点云特征，是精化 2D-3D 配准位姿的有效路径，优势在严格阈值下最明显。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GeoPair: Geometry-Preserving Cross-Layer Factorization for Training-Free Transformer Compression
papers.abstract_en: Transformer architectures exhibit cross-layer redundancies, yet post-training compression pipelines typically optimize layers in isolation or rely on heuristic grouping strategies that disregard layer-specific activation geometries. We introduce a principled, training-free framework that sequentially optimizes cross-layer weight pairings and shared-dictionary factorizations. Rather than forcing weights of adjacent layers to share a basis or heuristically merging activation statistics, our approach identifies structurally compatible projections and learns a shared representation that better preserves each layer's distinct calibration geometry. Coupled with structured sparsity, this yields highly efficient weight decompositions without sacrificing functional fidelity. Across diverse architectures, scales, and modalities, our method achieves state-of-the-art results, consistently outperforming independent structured weight decompositions and alternative pairwise weight factorizations, which operate under heuristic grouping strategies. By replacing heuristic engineering strategies with a convergent, optimization-driven pipeline, we establish a theoretically grounded foundation for scalable, transformer compression across different modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoPair 是一个免训练的 Transformer 跨层压缩框架：顺序优化跨层权重配对与共享字典分解，选出结构上兼容的投影并学习共享表示以保留各层自身的激活几何，再配合结构化稀疏。作者称其在多种架构、规模与模态上达到 state-of-the-art，稳定优于独立结构化权重分解与启发式分组的成对分解。
Motivation: 现有后训练压缩流程逐层独立优化，或依赖忽略各层激活几何的启发式分组，导致跨层冗余未被结构化利用。
Method: 免训练框架顺序执行两步：先优化跨层权重配对（识别结构兼容的投影），再做共享字典因子分解，使共享表示保留每层各自的校准几何；最后叠加结构化稀疏得到高效权重分解，整体是一个收敛的优化驱动流程。
Result: 在多种架构、规模与模态上取得 state-of-the-art 结果，一致优于独立的结构化权重分解以及采用启发式分组的其他成对权重因子分解方法；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 用收敛的优化流程取代启发式分组，可以在不牺牲功能保真度的前提下实现跨模态、可扩展的 Transformer 压缩，并为该问题提供有理论依据的基础。
Relevance: 0
