papers.title: Exploring Solver-Level Warmstarting for Neural Network Verification
papers.abstract_en: Neural network verification has become a key tool for providing formal guarantees on the behaviour of neural networks. However, many verification problems remain computationally intractable in the worst case: even for common adversarial robustness specifications, verification is NP-complete. Here, we explore the application of solver-level warmstarting for neural network verification to exploit information from previous solutions. We study the effect on running time as several properties are modified, including perturbation radii, input data and the networks themselves, using a pipeline that is generalisable and potentially adaptable to state-of-the-art verifiers. Our results show that warmstarting can significantly reduce verification time in most cases. Moreover, warmstarting enables the successful verification of instances that could not be solved from scratch within the given time limit.
papers.comment: to be published in the postproceedings of WORKSHOP ON SECURE AND TRUSTWORTHY AI (2026) co-located with the European Conference on Machine Learning and Principles and Practice of Knowledge Discovery in Databases
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把求解器级 warmstarting 引入神经网络形式化验证，复用先前解来加速 MILP/SMT 类求解过程。在扰动半径、输入数据与网络本身逐级变化的设置下，多数情形验证时间显著缩短，并能在给定时限内解出从零开始无法求解的实例。
Motivation: 神经网络验证在最坏情形下是 NP-complete，即便常见对抗鲁棒性规格也难以在时限内求解，需要利用先前解的信息降低计算开销。
Method: 在求解器层面做 warmstarting，把先前验证问题的解作为热启动信息注入当前求解；通过一条可推广、可适配到现有 SOTA 验证器的 pipeline，系统改变扰动半径、输入数据与网络本身，考察运行时间变化。
Result: 多数情形下 warmstarting 显著缩短验证时间；并使部分实例在给定时限内被成功验证，而这些实例从零求解无法在该时限内解出。
Conclusion: 求解器级 warmstarting 是提升神经网络验证可行性的有效手段，尤其能救回时限内从零不可解的实例，且该 pipeline 可推广到现有验证器。

papers.title: CausalLoss-Fin: Attributing Financial-Agent Loss to Decisions and Infrastructure Faults
papers.abstract_en: When an agent handling a payment exception loses money, the agent-step attribution methods this paper compares against will name one of its actions. They will do so even when a settlement message was dropped and the agent never had a chance: they intervene on agent actions and do not expose infrastructure faults as intervenable variables, so every dollar they explain is charged to a decision. We take a benchmark whose fault process is explicit and replayable, decompose each episode's realised delivery schedule into named, individually repairable messages, and intervene on both the agent's choices and the infrastructure's. A telescoping identity splits any policy's loss exactly three ways: an infrastructure effect, a policy differential against the best implementable policy, and a reference-policy residual. Two of the three can be negative, so none is a share; Shapley then divides the first into signed allocations over individual messages. One result is structural and needs no corpus: an agent-only baseline identifies no infrastructure cause, because its model contains no variable that could name one. What 545 planted episodes across 3 policies measure is the size of that consequence. It misfiles 100% of infrastructure episodes and charges $114,383.40 to the agent. Repairing what it names recovers 0.0% of the available loss; repairing a minimal sufficient set recovers 100.0%. Scoring messages one at a time is not merely imprecise: 27.8% (95% CI: 23.3--32.3%) of episodes do not decompose additively. We evaluate deterministic programmatic policies rather than language-model agents, which is what makes replay exact and which limits external validity to stochastic agents. The prevalence figures are properties of this generator, not field rates.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/abhisheksharma2411/causalloss-fin
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CausalLoss-Fin 把支付异常智能体的损失用可伸缩恒等式精确三分：基础设施效应、相对最优可实施策略的策略差、参考策略残差，再用 Shapley 把基础设施项按带符号份额分摊到单条结算消息上。在 545 个植入故障、3 个策略的回放基准上，只干预智能体动作的基线把 100% 的基础设施故障错记为决策、向智能体记账 $114,383.40，修复它指认的对象只挽回 0.0% 损失，修复最小充分集挽回 100.0%。
Motivation: 现有 agent-step 归因方法只干预智能体动作，把基础设施故障（如结算消息被丢弃）当成决策责任，导致修复方向完全错误。
Method: 在故障过程显式可回放的基准上，把每回合实际交付调度分解为具名、可单独修复的消息，同时干预智能体选择与基础设施变量；用 telescoping identity 把任意策略损失精确拆成基础设施效应、相对最优可实施策略的策略差、参考策略残差三项，再用 Shapley 把第一项分摊为对单条消息的带符号份额。评估对象是确定性程序化策略而非语言模型智能体。
Result: 545 个植入故障回合、3 个策略上，agent-only 基线错记 100% 的基础设施故障回合，向智能体记账 $114,383.40；修复其指认对象挽回 0.0% 可得损失，修复最小充分集挽回 100.0%。逐条打分的消息分解并非只是不精确：27.8%（95% CI: 23.3–32.3%）的回合不满足可加分解。结构性结论无需语料：agent-only 基线识别不出任何基础设施原因，因为其模型不含可命名该原因的变量。
Conclusion: 归因模型必须把基础设施故障作为可干预变量，否则损失会被全额错记给决策；流行率数字是该生成器的属性，外部效度限于随机策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Analysis of trade-offs in urban heat mitigation using a Bayesian Optimization framework for an urban canopy layer model
papers.abstract_en: To mitigate the challenges of climate change and intensifying heat stress in urban areas, local adaptation strategies are discussed and introduced in cities worldwide. To understand processes and potential trade-offs of these strategies a Bayesian optimization and surrogate modeling framework was employed to investigate urban parameter ranges of heat mitigation strategies with focus on three thermal metrics: daytime air temperature, Universal Thermal Climate Index (UTCI), and nighttime air temperature. Based on an urban street canyon configuration, it was shown that heat mitigation measures that reduce daytime air temperature and UTCI are often associated with higher nighttime temperatures. This results in a curved Pareto front that reflects the trade-off between daytime and nighttime thermal comfort. Under identical forcing conditions, different urban configurations, varying in geometry, vegetation, and surface characteristics, are shown to alter peak canyon air temperature by up to 5.2~$^\circ$C during the day and 2.6~$^\circ$C at night, while UTCI varies by up to 7.9~$^\circ$C, demonstrating that favorable urban configurations can substantially mitigate microclimatic heat stress. These findings suggest that combining multi-objective Bayesian optimization and surrogate modeling can help bridge the gap between computationally intensive climate simulations and practical decision-making in urban planning. An interactive visualization tool was developed to explore these trade-offs, making the often opposing relationships between urban parameters and the three thermal metrics directly accessible to planners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在城市街谷 (urban street canyon) 热缓解配置上用贝叶斯优化加代理模型搜索参数空间，发现压低白天气温与 UTCI 的措施往往抬高夜间气温，形成弯曲的 Pareto front。相同强迫下不同几何、植被与地表配置使街谷峰值气温白天相差最多 5.2 °C、夜间 2.6 °C，UTCI 相差最多 7.9 °C，说明选配置要同时权衡昼夜热舒适而非单看白天降温。
Motivation: 城市热缓解策略的昼夜效应相互冲突，而高分辨率城市冠层气候模拟计算代价高，规划者缺少能在参数权衡中直接比较方案的工具。
Method: 以街谷构型为场景，用贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian optimization) 与代理模型 (surrogate modeling) 搜索几何、植被、地表特征等城市参数范围，目标为三个热指标：白天气温、Universal Thermal Climate Index (UTCI)、夜间气温；多目标优化给出 Pareto front，并配套开发交互式可视化工具供规划者探索参数与指标的对立关系。
Result: 相同强迫条件下，不同城市配置使街谷峰值气温白天变化达 5.2 °C、夜间达 2.6 °C，UTCI 变化达 7.9 °C；白天降温与 UTCI 改善的措施常伴随更高夜间气温，呈弯曲的 Pareto front。
Conclusion: 多目标贝叶斯优化加代理模型可在昼夜热舒适权衡中筛选城市配置，缓解高代价气候模拟与实际规划决策之间的落差；选方案时须同时核对白天与夜间指标。

summary_sections.method: 以街谷构型为场景，用贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian optimization) 与代理模型 (surrogate modeling) 搜索几何、植被、地表特征等城市参数范围，目标为三个热指标：白天气温、Universal Thermal Climate Index (UTCI)、夜间气温；多目标优化给出 Pareto front，并配套开发交互式可视化工具供规划者探索参数与指标的对立关系。
summary_sections.result: 相同强迫条件下，不同城市配置使街谷峰值气温白天变化达 5.2 °C、夜间达 2.6 °C，UTCI 变化达 7.9 °C；白天降温与 UTCI 改善的措施常伴随更高夜间气温，呈弯曲的 Pareto front。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多目标贝叶斯优化加代理模型可在昼夜热舒适权衡中筛选城市配置，缓解高代价气候模拟与实际规划决策之间的落差；选方案时须同时核对白天与夜间指标。

papers.title: Bridge of $Ψ$'s: Quantum Circuit Optimization with Schrödinger Bridges
papers.abstract_en: Quantum circuit optimization replaces a circuit with an equivalent one of fewer gates and lower depth, reducing execution cost and error rate. We ask whether a generative model can learn this transformation directly from examples, rather than selecting from a fixed rewrite library or rigid algebraic routines. We present Bridge of $Ψ$'s (BOPS), a generative model based on Schrödinger bridges, using a custom denoiser architecture, that learns a transformation from a source circuit into an equivalent optimized circuit. We train it on data constructed to be hard for existing optimizers, by applying rewrite rules backwards so that each input has a known lower-cost target. On held-out 8 qubits $\times$ 64 depth Clifford+$T$ circuits, BOPS reduces gate count by $2.46\times$ and depth by $2.45\times$ in geometric mean, outperforming all nine baseline optimizers. This constitutes the first generative model bridging quantum circuits and frontier machine learning methods, opening up the quantum compilation stack to learned optimization along multiple axes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BOPS 用 Schrödinger bridge 生成模型直接把源量子线路映射为等价的优化线路，而非从固定重写库中挑选。训练数据由反向应用重写规则构造，使每个输入都有已知的更低成本目标；在留出的 8 qubit × 64 depth Clifford+T 线路上，几何平均门数降 2.46×、深度降 2.45×，胜过全部九个基线优化器。
Motivation: 量子线路优化目前依赖固定重写库或刚性代数例程，难以直接从样例学习这一变换，而门数与深度直接决定执行成本和错误率。
Method: 提出基于 Schrödinger bridge 的生成模型 BOPS，配自定义 denoiser 架构，学习从源线路到等价优化线路的变换；训练数据通过反向应用重写规则构造，保证每个输入有已知的更低成本目标。
Result: 在留出的 8 qubits × 64 depth Clifford+T 线路上，几何平均门数降低 2.46×、深度降低 2.45×，优于全部九个基线优化器。
Conclusion: 生成模型可以直接学习量子线路优化这一变换，并在该设置下胜过现有优化器，把量子编译栈的多个轴开放给学习式优化。

papers.title: Towards Systematic Qualification of Vision-Language Models for Automotive Perception Systems
papers.abstract_en: The field of Artificial Intelligence has been adopted for many application domains. Vision Language Models are one of the recently advanced AI techniques that have been explored to support automotive features such as vehicle perception, and safety assurance. However, such language models are prone to hallucinations, posing a potential threat to the safety of automotive systems that may incorporate them. Within the automotive domain, VLMs could not only hallucinate traffic objects, but could also fail to identify traffic objects that are actually present, which may potentially lead to dangerous situations. Though we have observed a growing body of literature that proposes verification and validation techniques for safe and trustworthy AI, these methods are often studied in isolation, focusing either on run-time or design-time phases. Such isolated techniques could be insufficient in safety-critical, realistic contexts such as automotive perception systems. In this paper, we analyze design-time and run-time verification and validation techniques based on a taxonomy presented by Huang et al. We present an automotive study in which a design-time qualification workflow is proposed to complement run-time monitoring. This workflow combines a fixed safety-relevant ontology-based structured annotation system together with a synonym-based evaluation process to statistically evaluate three state-of-the-art VLMs against data from the nuScenes dataset. We observed that the proposed technique enables deterministic and repeatable quantification of the hallucinations VLMs generate in automotive perception-related tasks. The proposed workflow supports model comparison and deployment-oriented engineering decisions within the design-time verification and validation process and will contribute to a holistic verification strategy that strives towards trustworthy automotive perception systems

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对车载感知中视觉语言模型 (VLM) 幻觉难以系统化资格认定的问题，提出设计时 (design-time) 资格认定工作流：固定的安全相关本体结构化标注加同义词评估，统计评测三个 SOTA VLM 在 nuScenes 数据上的幻觉。结果是该技术能确定性、可重复地量化 VLM 幻觉，支撑模型对比与部署决策，与运行时监控互补。
Motivation: VLM 既可能幻觉出不存在的交通目标，也可能漏检真实存在的目标，威胁行车安全；现有安全可信 AI 的验证确认技术多孤立研究，只覆盖设计时或只覆盖运行时，在汽车感知这类安全关键场景中不足。
Method: 先按 Huang et al. 的分类体系分析设计时与运行时 V&V 技术，再提出设计时资格认定工作流：固定的安全相关本体 (ontology) 结构化标注系统 + 基于同义词的评估流程，用于统计评估三个 state-of-the-art VLM，数据取自 nuScenes 数据集，定位为运行时监控的补充。
Result: 在 nuScenes 数据上对三个 SOTA VLM 的评测中，该技术实现了对 VLM 在汽车感知相关任务上所产生幻觉的确定性、可重复量化；工作流支持模型对比与面向部署的工程决策。
Conclusion: 设计时的结构化标注加同义词统计评估可与运行时监控互补，构成通向可信汽车感知系统的整体验证策略的一部分。

papers.title: Destination Support Restoration for Finite-Set Multimodal Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Robots operating around pedestrians often reason over a finite set of predicted human futures. Repeated online updates can concentrate this limited prediction budget on dominant destinations and leave plausible alternatives underrepresented or absent, removing those alternatives from the finite representation available to downstream decision making. We introduce Destination Support Restoration (DSR), a causal post-selection operator that repairs destination support without retraining the host predictor or increasing the maintained set size. At a repair step, DSR evaluates a temporary destination-stratified candidate bank from the observed prefix, converts candidate evidence into integer target counts, protects representatives of active modes, and reallocates redundant surplus hypotheses to deficient modes. The maintained and returned sets retain exactly $N$ hypotheses, and DSR replaces at most $\lceilρN\rceil$ entries. Protected representatives preserve current categorical support; lineage-aware particle filters also preserve surviving resampling ancestors. Each replacement reduces the allocation mismatch to the evidence-driven target by one. On the complete 3,719-trajectory Edinburgh protocol over three seeds, DSR reduces MIF weighted ADE and FDE by 13.36% and 13.30% at $N=64$. Paired integrations with CLiFF, PPT, causal GDTS, Social Informer, and PECNet improve both metrics in every evaluated pair. These results show that finite-set support allocation is a useful prediction-side control point when a fixed hypothesis set serves as the interface to downstream systems.
papers.comment: Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSR 是一个因果的后选择算子，在不重训宿主预测器、不扩大假设集的前提下修复多模态轨迹预测中的目的地支撑缺失：由观测前缀建临时目的地分层候选库，把候选证据转成整数目标计数，保护活跃模态代表，再把冗余假设重分配给欠代表模态，集合始终恰含 N 个假设且最多替换 ⌈ρN⌉ 个条目。在 3,719 条轨迹的 Edinburgh 协议、三个随机种子上，MIF 的加权 ADE/FDE 在 N=64 时分别下降 13.36% 和 13.30%。
Motivation: 机器人在行人环境中只能维护有限的预测假设集，在线反复更新会把预算集中到主导目的地，使其他合理目的地在有限表示中缺失，下游决策因此看不到这些备选未来。
Method: DSR 作为宿主预测器之后的因果后选择步骤：从观测前缀构建临时的目的地分层候选库，将候选证据量化为整数目标计数，保护各活跃模态的代表条目，把冗余的过剩假设重新分配给不足的模态；维护集与返回集始终恰为 N 个假设，单次替换至多 ⌈ρN⌉ 条，每次替换把分配失配相对证据驱动目标降低 1；lineage-aware particle filter 还保留存活的重采样祖先。
Result: 在完整的 3,719 条轨迹 Edinburgh 协议、三个种子上，N=64 时 MIF 的加权 ADE 与 FDE 分别下降 13.36% 与 13.30%；与 CLiFF、PPT、causal GDTS、Social Informer、PECNet 的成对集成在每一对评估组合中都同时改善这两个指标。
Conclusion: 当固定假设集是与下游系统的接口时，有限集的支撑分配本身就是一个有效的预测侧控制点，可在不重训、不扩容的条件下修复被在线更新挤掉的模态。

papers.title: Certified Against Which Oracle? Execution Labels Set the Reported Risk of Conformal Abstention for Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: A conformal abstention certificate for text-to-SQL is only as truthful as the correctness labels it is calibrated on. The uncertainty pipelines that read confidence off execution consistency take those labels from the single database a benchmark ships, an oracle known to be lenient. We run a preregistered intervention on Spider-Realistic, swapping that database for the benchmark's distilled multi-instance test suite. Across four SQL-specialist checkpoints and two split schemes, the swap raises the certificate's held-out risk 2.73 to 10.23 points above the risk its own labels report. Neither oracle reports the risk experts assign. Under blinded labels from two SQL experts, a certificate calibrated at a nominal 0.10 carries 20.0 and 17.2 points of risk on two checkpoints. The stricter oracle errs in both directions: most of the answers it rejects are not judged wrong, and some of those it accepts are. An AI-assigned census of what it rejects finds a semantic error in a quarter to a third of them, depending on the population. It attributes most of the rest to underspecified questions, synthetic instances or suspected reference-query defects, a flag supported by a preregistered blinded expert audit. The oracle also decides how a confidence score is judged. Every execution-consistency score looks better under the labels of the oracle that built its clusters, in 16 of 16 combinations. Under expert labels, building such a score on suite clusters instead of shipped-database clusters raises its area under the ROC curve (AUROC) by 6.96 points on one checkpoint and 1.53 on the other. On the second, the expert interval excludes the 8.3 points the suite labels report. A certificate should be reported with both oracles, and an oracle-relative difference read as semantic risk only after the benchmark is audited. A consistency score should be evaluated under an oracle that did not build it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Text-to-SQL 的 conformal abstention 证书风险完全取决于校准用的执行标签来源：把 Spider-Realistic 自带数据库这一宽松 oracle 换成蒸馏多实例测试套件后，证书的留出风险从自报值高出 2.73 点升到 10.23 点。两个 oracle 都不等于专家判定的风险——名义 0.10 的证书在两个 checkpoint 上实际带 20.0 与 17.2 点风险。作者主张证书同时按两个 oracle 报告，且一致性分数应在未参与构建其聚类的 oracle 下评测。
Motivation: 从执行一致性读出置信度的不确定性管线，其证书真伪取决于校准标签，而基准自带的单一数据库是公认宽松的 oracle，导致报告的 conformal 风险与真实语义风险脱节。
Method: 在 Spider-Realistic 上做预注册干预，把校准标签从基准自带数据库换成蒸馏多实例测试套件，跨 4 个 SQL-specialist checkpoint 与 2 种 split 方案比较；再引入两名 SQL 专家的盲评标签作为参照，并用 AI 标注普查与预注册盲审专家审计分析被拒绝答案的错误构成。
Result: 换 oracle 使证书留出风险相对自报值的超出量从 2.73 点升到 10.23 点；名义 0.10 的证书在两个 checkpoint 上按专家标签带 20.0 与 17.2 点风险。执行一致性分数在构建其聚类的 oracle 下总是更好，16/16 组合成立；改用 suite 聚类在专家标签下使 AUROC 在一个 checkpoint 提高 6.96 点、另一个提高 1.53 点，而后者的专家区间排除了 suite 标签所报的 8.3 点。AI 普查发现被严格 oracle 拒绝的答案中约四分之一到三分之一含语义错误，其余多为问题欠指定、合成实例或参考查询缺陷。
Conclusion: 证书必须同时按两个 oracle 报告，oracle 相对差异只有在基准经过审计后才能读作语义风险；一致性分数应在未构建其聚类的 oracle 下评测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Calibrating Retrieval Geometry: Reliability-Guided Training-Free Aggregation for Visual Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Frozen visual foundation models provide transferable features for visual place recognition, but fixed aggregation can suppress useful distinctions in new environments. We introduce TFA, a reliability-guided, training-free aggregation method requiring neither place labels nor task-specific weight updates. Our key observation is that reproducible retrieval need not be discriminative: independent codebooks can consistently retrieve a few database hubs. TFA combines cross-codebook agreement, retrieval coverage, and spectral statistics to control residual assignment, spectral shaping, and global-feature fusion. Its spectral kernel exactly recovers original descriptor similarity at zero intervention. Database-only TFA fixes its rules before accessing queries; TFA-C64 uses 64 disjoint unlabeled target images to calibrate retrieval for subsequent queries. Across 20 ground protocols with a fixed DINOv2-B backbone and matched resolution, database-only TFA improves Recall@1 over AnyLoc by 17.39 percentage points on MSLS-val and 9.55 on SPED. C64 mitigates failures of database-only calibration in driving environments. Across eight aerial/cross-view protocols, TFA achieves the highest Recall@1 among compared training-free heads in 14 of 16 DINOv2/DINOv3 backbone-protocol combinations. In a separate native-system comparison, DINOv2-G-based TFA-C64 reaches 91.46% Recall@1 on Pitts30k and 76.29% on VPAIR, outperforming the displayed training-free comparators on all five benchmarks. papers.title: AT3D-AD: Anomaly Type-Aware 3D Anomaly Detection via Hierarchical Point-Language Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Detecting and localizing 3D point-cloud defects is essential for industrial inspection. However, existing methods often suffer from imprecise localization due to the lack of anomaly supervision and reliance on single-granularity representations. To address these limitations, we propose Anomaly Type-Aware 3D Anomaly Detection (AT3D-AD), a unified framework for joint detection, localization, and classification. Specifically, we first design the Physics-Driven Parametric Anomaly Synthesis (PDPAS) module employing multiple parametric functions to generate synthetic anomalies, providing explicit anomaly supervision. Then, we propose the Hierarchical Global-Local Anomaly Alignment (HiGLA) module to align global and local representations within the normal and anomalous groups. Finally, we propose the Semantic-Geometric Anomaly Classification (SGAC) module to jointly learn localization and classification, yielding spatially precise and type-discriminative anomaly representations. Extensive experiments establish new state-of-the-art performance on all four benchmarks. AT3D-AD achieves Object/Point AUROC scores of 98.1\%/98.9\% on Anomaly-ShapeNet and 95.0\%/95.2\% on Real3D-AD, while reaching 74.2\% Macro-F1 for anomaly-type recognition on Real3D-AD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AT3D-AD 是面向工业检测的 3D 点云异常检测框架，用物理驱动的参数化异常合成 (PDPAS) 生成带显式监督的合成缺陷，再以层级全局-局部对齐 (HiGLA) 和语义-几何分类 (SGAC) 联合做检测、定位与类型分类。在四个基准上达到新 SOTA：Anomaly-ShapeNet Object/Point AUROC 98.1%/98.9%，Real3D-AD 95.0%/95.2%，Real3D-AD 异常类型 Macro-F1 74.2%。
Motivation: 现有 3D 点云缺陷检测缺少异常监督、且只用单一粒度表示，导致定位不精确，也无法区分异常类型。
Method: PDPAS 模块用多种参数化函数生成合成异常以提供显式监督；HiGLA 在正常组与异常组内对齐全局与局部表示；SGAC 联合学习定位与分类，产出空间精确且类型可分的异常表示，三者构成统一的检测-定位-分类框架。
Result: 四个基准全部刷新 SOTA：Anomaly-ShapeNet Object AUROC 98.1%、Point AUROC 98.9%；Real3D-AD Object AUROC 95.0%、Point AUROC 95.2%；Real3D-AD 上异常类型识别 Macro-F1 74.2%。
Conclusion: 用参数化合成异常补上监督、再以层级全局-局部对齐配合语义-几何分类，可同时拿到精确的缺陷定位与类型判别表示。

papers.title: Conditional Tensor Diffusion: Distributional Counterfactual Learning and Inference
papers.abstract_en: Causal inference guides operational and managerial decisions but remains challenging in high-dimensional panel or tensor settings, where decisions may depend on the joint conditional distribution of missing control outcomes. We develop \emph{Counterfactual Tucker Diffusion} (\CFTDiff), which integrates the treatment mask and latent Tucker structure into conditional diffusion to recover this distribution given observed control outcomes through efficient nonlinear score learning in a low-dimensional core. The masked Tucker score preserves dependence across tensor modes while reducing the dimension of nonlinear score learning from the product of mode dimensions to the much smaller product of Tucker ranks. We establish high-probability error bounds for conditional score estimation that depend on the Tucker ranks, largest mode dimension, and the factor-strength-adjusted number of missing outcomes, and show how these bounds translate into recovery guaranties for the conditional distribution of the missing control outcomes. Across missing rates, simulations show more accurate point recovery than common causal panel and matrix/tensor completion methods; comparisons with nested diffusion specifications further demonstrate the gains from masked conditioning and Tucker dimension reduction. In Norway's iFlex experiment, \CFTDiff recovers missing outcomes more accurately than competing methods; when applied to causal analysis, its estimated conditional distributions yield counterfactual prediction intervals and target-attainment probabilities, allowing pricing interventions to be evaluated by demand-reduction magnitude and reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Counterfactual Tucker Diffusion (CFTDiff)，把处理掩码与 Tucker 潜结构一起嵌入条件 diffusion，在高维面板/张量中恢复缺失控制结果的联合条件分布。非线性 score 学习降到低维 core 上，维度从各 mode 维数之积降到 Tucker 秩之积；模拟中点恢复精度超过常见因果面板与矩阵/张量补全方法，挪威 iFlex 实验中也更准，并给出反事实预测区间与达标概率。
Motivation: 高维面板或张量结构下的因果推断中，决策依赖缺失控制结果的联合条件分布，而该分布在维度升高时难以恢复。
Method: CFTDiff 将 treatment mask 与 latent Tucker 结构并入 conditional diffusion：在低维 core 上做高效非线性 score 学习，masked Tucker score 保留张量 mode 间依赖；给出条件 score 估计的高概率误差界，依赖 Tucker 秩、最大 mode 维数与因子强度调整后的缺失结果数，并转化为缺失控制结果条件分布的恢复保证。
Result: 模拟中在各缺失率下点恢复精度高于常见因果面板与矩阵/张量补全方法，且相对 nested diffusion 消融显示 masked conditioning 与 Tucker 降维带来增益；挪威 iFlex 实验中缺失结果恢复优于竞争方法，其条件分布给出反事实预测区间与目标达标概率，可按需求削减幅度与可靠性评估定价干预。
Conclusion: 把处理掩码与 Tucker 低秩结构一起放进条件 diffusion，可以在高维面板/张量中恢复缺失控制结果的条件分布，并直接支撑带不确定性的反事实干预评估。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Toward Responsible AI-Augmented Cyber Defense: Pattern Recognition, Defense-in-Depth, and the Case for Human-AI Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Cybersecurity literature has extensively documented the operational benefits of artificial intelligence (AI) for threat detection, incident response, and prevention, while raising qualitative concerns about over-automation, algorithmic bias, and analyst-skill erosion. What remains largely absent is a formal, falsifiable model connecting three constructs that recur across this literature: Defense-in-Depth Theory, the Artificial Intelligence Theory of Pattern Recognition, and human-AI collaboration in security operations. This paper develops such a model. We formalize layered defense as a Bernoulli detection cascade in which AI augmentation enters multiplicatively across layers; we formalize each layer's pattern-recognition behavior as a Neyman-Pearson/Bayesian detector with a derived closed-form optimal threshold; and we formalize human-AI triage as a capacity-constrained cascade with an explicit, quantifiable trade-off between detection probability and false-alarm ("alert fatigue") rate. A Monte Carlo/analytical simulation evaluated at illustrative but realistic operating points shows that (i) AI augmentation compounds across defense layers, delivering its largest marginal gains exactly where traditional layering saturates, and (ii) full human review of AI-flagged alerts is not optimal: increasing analyst capacity toward 100% coverage cuts false alarms by roughly 20-fold but simultaneously lowers system-level detection probability, because imperfect analyst accuracy is then applied to every alert rather than a filtered subset. These results give the widely repeated qualitative recommendation of "balanced human-AI collaboration" a precise, testable form and suggest an interior-optimum capacity ratio as a concrete design target for security operations centers (SOCs), including those securing IT/OT-converged critical infrastructure.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Original theoretical and modeling contribution. Simulation code: https://github.com/nawaralseelawi/ai-augmented-cyber-defense
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把纵深防御写成 Bernoulli 检测级联、把每层模式识别写成 Neyman-Pearson/Bayesian 检测器并推导闭式最优阈值、把人机分诊写成容量受限级联，得到检测率与告警疲劳之间的显式权衡。蒙特卡洛/解析仿真显示 AI 增益在各防御层复利叠加、恰在传统分层饱和处最大；分析师容量趋近 100% 全覆盖时误报降约 20 倍，却因不完美的分析员准确率作用于全部告警而拉低系统级检测概率，故最优解是内部最优的容量比而非全量人工复核。
Motivation: 安全运营文献对过度自动化、算法偏误与分析员技能退化只有定性告警，缺少把纵深防御、AI 模式识别人机协作三者连起来的可证伪形式模型。
Method: 将分层防御形式化为 AI 增益按层相乘的 Bernoulli 检测级联；每层模式识别建模为 Neyman-Pearson/Bayesian 检测器并推导闭式最优阈值；人机分诊建模为容量受限级联，显式刻画检测概率与误报（告警疲劳）率的权衡，再用蒙特卡洛与解析仿真在示意但现实的工作点上评估。
Result: 仿真给出两条结论：AI 增益跨防御层复合，在传统分层饱和处边际收益最大；分析师容量提高到 100% 覆盖使误报下降约 20 倍，同时系统级检测概率下降。
Conclusion: “均衡的人机协作”这一常见定性建议可给出精确、可检验的形式，并落到一个内部最优容量比作为 SOC（含 IT/OT 融合关键基础设施）的具体设计目标。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Beyond Scalar Sensitivity: Activation-Aware Mixed-Precision LLM Quantization with Cross-Layer Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-precision weight quantization is commonly formulated as a Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problem (MCKP), yet existing solvers rely on scalar sensitivity proxies that collapse each weight matrix's Hessian into a single number and treat every module independently. We prove that even the optimal scalar proxy incurs multiplicative distortion up to $\sqrt{κ(\mathbf{A})κ(\mathbf{B})}$ relative to the full activation-aware quadratic, where $κ(\mathbf{A})$ and $κ(\mathbf{B})$ denote the condition numbers of the input- and output-side Hessian factors. This bound varies from $10^1$ to $10^{13}$ for typical LLM modules, making inter-module sensitivity ranking unreliable. To address these limitations, we propose Cross-layer Activation-aware Sensitivity Allocation (CASA), a two-phase method. In Stage 1, the scalar proxy is replaced by an activation-aware metric derived from the Kronecker-factored Hessian, reducing the MCKP to a form whose continuous relaxation admits a closed-form solution. In Stage 2, a cross-layer-aware local search evaluates bit-width updates using the end-to-end model loss. Experiments on multiple LLMs across different bit budgets show that CASA achieves lower perplexity than the latest scalar-proxy baselines, especially at ultra-low bit-widths ($<3$ bits per weight). Moreover, the performance gain in zero-shot accuracy tracks the per-model average condition-number over modules, confirming the distortion bound as a practical indicator of scalar-proxy failure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 混合精度 LLM 重量量化常被写成多选背包问题 (MCKP)，但标量敏感度代理把每个权重矩阵的 Hessian 压成一个数，作者证明即使最优标量代理相对完整 activation-aware 二次型也有最高达 sqrt(κ(A)κ(B)) 的乘性失真，典型 LLM 模块上该界跨越 10^1 到 10^13，使跨模块敏感度排序不可靠。提出的 CASA 两阶段法（Kronecker 分解 Hessian 的 activation-aware 指标 + 端到端损失的跨层局部搜索）在多个 LLM、不同 bit 预算下困惑度低于最新标量代理基线，<3 bits/weight 时尤其明显，zero-shot 精度增益随各模型跨模块平均条件数增长。
Motivation: MCKP 求解器依赖把 Hessian 压成单个数的标量敏感度代理，并把各模块独立处理；标量代理的乘性失真可达 10^1–10^13，导致跨模块 bit 宽度排序不可靠，超低比特下损失放大。
Method: 提出 CASA 两阶段法：Stage 1 用 Kronecker-factored Hessian 导出的 activation-aware 指标替换标量代理，使 MCKP 化为连续松弛有闭式解的形式；Stage 2 用跨层感知局部搜索，以端到端模型 loss 评估 bit-width 更新。

papers.title: AURA: Angular Update Rate Adaptation for training complex-valued neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Complex-valued neural networks (CVNNs) are increasingly adopted for complex-valued data; however, they are often trained with first-order optimizers inherited from the real-valued case. The efficiency of these methods depends largely on the step size, and their step-size rules ignore the angular information available in the complex plane. We address step-size adaptation in the complex domain by introducing AURA (Angular Update Rate Adaptation), a per-parameter step-size adaptation that can be added on top of any first-order optimizer, and removed from it, without altering its update direction. AURA measures the agreement between consecutive updates of each complex parameter, in length, alignment, and sense of rotation, and enlarges the step when they are consistent and reduces it when they are not. It requires no additional gradient evaluations and only inexpensive vector operations per step. We combine AURA with Adam and Muon and compare the resulting methods with well-known first-order optimizers on four test cases of increasing complexity, ranging from the approximation of scalar complex functions to physics-informed training. Fully connected neural networks are used throughout this work. All hyperparameters other than the step size are held fixed across test cases; for one case, we also tune the hyperparameters of each optimizer under the same budget. Our empirical tests show that AURA improves the convergence of its base optimizer in most cases with a small per-step overhead, and we identify the conditions under which it fails to do so.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AURA 是叠加在任意一阶优化器上的复数逐参数步长自适应：用相邻更新在长度、方向对齐与旋转方向上的一致性放大或缩小步长，不改变更新方向也不需额外梯度计算。与 Adam、Muon 组合后在四个递增复杂度的测试（标量复函数逼近到 physics-informed 训练）上多数情形改善收敛，且给出其失效条件。
Motivation: 复数神经网络 (CVNN) 沿用实数情形的一阶优化器，步长规则完全忽略复平面自带的角向信息，导致步长选择低效。
Method: AURA 度量每个复参数相邻两次更新在长度、对齐与旋转方向 (sense of rotation) 上的一致性，一致则放大步长、不一致则缩小；可加在任意一阶优化器上也可移除，不改变更新方向，每步只做廉价向量运算、无需额外梯度。与 Adam 和 Muon 组合，测试用全连接网络，除步长外所有超参数跨测试固定，另在一个测试上按同等预算调各优化器超参。
Result: 在四个复杂度递增的测试用例（从标量复函数逼近到 physics-informed 训练）上，AURA 在多数情形改善其基座优化器的收敛，每步开销小；同时识别出它不改善收敛的条件。
Conclusion: 复数域的角向一致性信号可作为通用、低成本的步长自适应依据，但其收益依赖条件，并非在所有测试上都成立。

papers.title: NaCR: Visual Localization via NeRF-aided Camera Ray Regression
papers.abstract_en: Visual localization (VL) is a fundamental technology for vision applications such as virtual reality. Recently, a novel VL paradigm, Camera Ray Regression (CRR), has emerged, which maps 2D image patches to 3D camera rays, but its accuracy is limited. To improve CRR accuracy, we notice a compelling duality: the inverse of this mapping is inherently performed by the novel view synthesis model, \ie, Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF). While NeRF renders image patches from camera rays via differentiable ray marching, CRR predicts the rays from image patches. Motivated by this complementary relationship, we propose NeRF-aided Camera Ray Regression (NaCR), a unified framework that seamlessly bridges NeRF and CRR at the ray level. First, NaCR incorporates three simple yet effective enhancements into the CRR baseline. Second, leveraging a pre-trained NeRF, NaCR augments the training data by synthesizing novel views tailored for efficient, patch-level consumption. Finally, exploiting the differentiability of NeRF, NaCR forms a closed-loop supervision pipeline where photometric rendering errors are back-propagated to optimize the predicted camera rays. To ensure stable convergence within the highly non-convex image space, we introduce a two-stage training curriculum. Extensive experiments across indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate that NaCR achieves competitive accuracy. Comprehensive ablation studies validate the efficacy of each proposed component.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NaCR 把 NeRF 与相机射线回归 (Camera Ray Regression, CRR) 在射线层面对接：用预训练 NeRF 合成新视角扩充 patch 级训练数据，并把光度渲染误差反传回预测的相机射线，形成闭环监督，配合两阶段训练课程稳定收敛。在室内与室外基准上取得有竞争力的定位精度，消融验证各组件有效。
Motivation: CRR 这一新范式把 2D 图像 patch 映射到 3D 相机射线，但精度受限；而该映射的逆过程恰由 NeRF 的新视角合成天然完成，两者互补关系此前未被利用。
Method: NaCR 在 CRR 基线上加入三项增强；用预训练 NeRF 合成面向 patch 级消费的新视角来增广训练数据；利用 NeRF 可微性把光度渲染误差反向传播以优化预测射线，构成闭环监督；为在高度非凸的图像空间中稳定收敛，采用两阶段训练课程 (two-stage training curriculum)。
Result: 在室内与外景基准上的大量实验表明 NaCR 达到有竞争力的精度 (competitive accuracy)，综合消融研究验证了每个提出组件的有效性。
Conclusion: NeRF 与 CRR 的互补性可以在射线层面统一：闭环光度监督加数据增广能提升 CRR 精度，且需两阶段课程保证非凸空间中的稳定收敛。

papers.title: BAS-OPD: Budget-Aware Selective On-Policy Self-Distillation for Fine-Grained Multimodal Perception
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle with fine-grained visual perception when processing complete images, as critical evidence may only appear in local regions. On-policy self-distillation (OPD) enables transferring privileged visual knowledge from informative views to full-image policies, but querying the teacher for every rollout introduces substantial supervision costs. In this work, we propose BAS-OPD, a budget-aware selective OPD framework that allocates teacher supervision under limited query budgets. Instead of querying all rollouts, BAS-OPD selects informative samples while maintaining full-batch student generation. We explore random, uncertainty-based, and learned utility-based selection strategies, where the learned selector estimates query value from detached rollout statistics and online utility signals derived from student--teacher agreement and teacher confidence without additional student forward passes. BAS-OPD only changes training-time supervision allocation and preserves single-pass full-image inference. Experiments on fine-grained multimodal perception benchmarks demonstrate that BAS-OPD achieves strong performance while substantially reducing teacher supervision costs, highlighting the effectiveness of selective OPD under constrained budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BAS-OPD 在预算受限的 on-policy 自蒸馏 (on-policy self-distillation) 中只对信息量高的 rollout 查询教师，同时保持学生全批次生成与单次全图推理。学到的 utility 选择器用脱离计算图的 rollout 统计与师生一致性和教师置信度构成的在线 utility 信号估计查询价值，无需额外学生前向。在细粒度多模态感知基准上以显著更低的教师监督成本取得强性能。
Motivation: MLLM 处理整图时关键证据可能只在局部区域，细粒度视觉感知易失败；on-policy 自蒸馏能把特权视图知识传给全图策略，但对每个 rollout 查询教师带来高昂监督成本。
Method: 提出预算感知的选择性 OPD 框架 BAS-OPD：在查询预算下选择信息量高的样本而保留全批次学生生成；比较 random、uncertainty-based、learned utility-based 三种选择策略，学到的 selector 从 detached rollout 统计与由 student–teacher agreement、teacher confidence 导出的在线 utility 信号估计查询价值，不增加学生前向；只改训练期监督分配，推理仍是单次全图。
Result: 在细粒度多模态感知基准上，BAS-OPD 取得强性能同时大幅降低教师监督成本，体现受限预算下选择性 OPD 的有效性。
Conclusion: 在受限查询预算下按 utility 选择性分配教师监督，可以在不改推理路径的前提下保住 on-policy 自蒸馏的细粒度感知收益。

papers.title: Risk-Aware Online Conformal State Probing
papers.abstract_en: AI-based autonomous agents, typically hosted at data centers, must acquire state information from robots or edge devices in order to issue informed control decisions. Managing uncertainty about the state is particularly consequential in safety-critical settings, in which average-case guarantees are insufficient. In this context, we study a sequential decision maker process that jointly decides which actions to take and when to probe given access to an arbitrary state prediction model. We propose online conformal state probing (OCSP), an action and probing policy that certifies worst-case reliability levels without relying on distributional assumptions. OCSP is designed to provably control the missed query error (MQE), i.e., the fraction of instances where probing would have been beneficial, while minimizing the probing rate. OCSP can be applied to existing pre-trained value-based control policies without requiring retraining or fine-tuning. We validate OCSP through numerical simulations to verify theoretical guarantees and to assess performance trade-offs as a function of the calibration of the state predictor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在线共形状态探测 (online conformal state probing, OCSP)：在任意状态预测模型之上联合决定动作与何时向机器人/边缘设备探测状态，无需分布假设即可保证最坏情形可靠性，并把漏查询误差 (missed query error, MQE) 控制在给定水平同时压低探测率。可直接套用到已预训练的基于价值的控制策略上，无需重训练或微调。
Motivation: 数据中心托管的 AI 自主智能体依赖机器人或边缘设备上报的状态做控制，安全攸关场景下平均意义的保证不够，需要最坏情形可靠性且要少探测以省通信。
Method: OCSP 是一个动作与探测联合策略：给定任意预训练状态预测模型，用 online conformal 框架在无分布假设下认证最坏情形可靠性，显式约束 MQE（本应探测却没探测的样本比例）并最小化探测率；可直接套用到现成的 value-based 控制策略，无需重训练或微调。
Result: 通过数值仿真验证理论保证，并考察性能权衡随状态预测器校准质量的变化；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: OCSP 说明在安全攸关序贯控制中，最坏情形可靠性可以在不依赖分布假设、不改动既有控制策略的前提下被认证，代价由探测率与预测器校准共同决定。

papers.title: LoRango: It Takes Two LoRAs to Unlock Hidden Behaviors in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Users commonly combine multiple Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters to personalize images with different subjects, styles, and visual attributes. Yet inspecting adapters individually does not establish the safety of their composition. We identify and characterize a pair-conditioned attack in text-to-image diffusion: individually useful and benign-appearing adapters redirect image generation when co-loaded with a specifically matched partner, whose identity serves as the trigger. We introduce LoRango to realize this attack through complementary Signature and Payload adapters. The Signature writes a pair-specific code into intermediate carrier representations, while the Payload uses code-selective responses and opposing signal/reference branches. These branches approximately cancel for standalone adapters and mismatched pairs; matched code-reader alignment breaks cancellation within native GEGLU blocks and releases the programmed action. Both adapters are exported as ordinary static LoRA files compatible with standard loaders, requiring no prompt trigger or base-pipeline modification. LoRango achieves matched-pair attack success rates of 97.9\% on SD v1.5 and 98.7\% on SDXL, compared with 2.8--4.6\% when implanted adapters are loaded individually. Further experiments evaluate pair selectivity, standalone fidelity, robustness to deployment variations, and applicability across denoiser architectures. These findings show that individual-adapter inspection is insufficient to assess the security of multi-LoRA personalization and motivate auditing adapter compositions.

papers.title: Delving into Asymmetric Information Dynamics for High-Fidelity Virtual Try-On
papers.abstract_en: Virtual try-on (VTON) requires precise pixel-level fidelity, yet mainstream Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) often suffer from texture degradation and structural drift. We identify symmetric interactions in standard joint-attention mechanisms as a source of these failures. Although such interactions support semantic flexibility in general-purpose editing, they allow stochastic noise to corrupt deterministic garment features in VTON. We analyze this problem through asymmetric information dynamics and introduce two diagnostic indicators: Conditional Attention Entropy (CAE) for feature unbiasedness and Injected Information Flux (IIF) for injection effectiveness. Our analysis suggests that symmetric bidirectional attention can corrupt conditional features and attenuate the conditional signal. To address these limitations, we propose RealFit, a framework that combines Unidirectional Information Flow (UIF) with Decoupled Timestep Modulation (DTM). UIF isolates the garment condition from stochastic noise to preserve garment identity, while DTM optimizes the modulation scale to maintain a strong conditional signal. The resulting time-invariant condition branch enables a conditional KV cache that reduces inference time by approximately 75%. RealFit offers a principled approach to conditional generation with state-of-the-art fidelity and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 虚拟试衣 (VTON) 中 DiT 的对称 joint attention 让随机噪声反向污染确定性的服装特征，导致纹理退化与结构漂移。RealFit 用单向信息流 (UIF) 隔离服装条件与噪声、用解耦时间步调制 (DTM) 保持强条件信号，得到时间不变的条件分支并支持条件 KV cache，推理时间约降 75%。
Motivation: 通用编辑所需的对称双向注意力在 VTON 这类条件生成任务里会让随机噪声破坏服装特征并削弱条件信号，造成纹理退化和结构漂移。
Method: 先提出两个诊断指标：条件注意力熵 (CAE) 衡量特征无偏性、注入信息流 (IIF) 衡量注入有效性；再提出 RealFit，结合单向信息流 (UIF) 与解耦时间步调制 (DTM)，构建时间不变的条件分支并启用条件 KV cache。
Result: 诊断分析表明对称双向注意力会破坏条件特征并衰减条件信号；RealFit 声称达到 state-of-the-art 的保真度与效率，条件 KV cache 使推理时间约减少 75%。
Conclusion: 条件生成应采用单向条件注入并优化调制尺度，而非对称 joint attention，这样既能保住服装身份又能大幅省推理时间。

papers.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of SechKAN on 1D Data
papers.abstract_en: The connection between the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem (KART) and neural network design has led to the development of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), with applications ranging from STEM problems to AI tasks. In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of a KAN variant, SechKAN, which relies on hyperbolic secant (sech) functions as basis functions, with a 1D projection to reduce the number of parameters to a level comparable to MLPs. We evaluate SechKAN on three 1D classification datasets: UCI Human Activity Recognition (UCI HAR), ElectricDevices, and Crop, and compare it with several effective networks, including EfficientKAN, MLP, CNN1D, ResNet1D, and DSCNN1D, using approximately comparable parameter budgets. The results indicate that SechKAN achieves competitive performance across the three datasets, with particularly strong performance on Crop. Ablation studies further show that grid size and normalization affect performance, suggesting that SechKAN's effectiveness depends on the dataset and architectural choices. Our source code and experimental implementation are publicly available at: https://github.com/hoangthangta/SechKAN_1D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SechKAN 用 hyperbolic secant (sech) 作 KAN 基函数并加 1D 投影把参数量压到与 MLP 相当，在 UCI HAR、ElectricDevices、Crop 三个 1D 分类数据集上与 EfficientKAN、MLP、CNN1D、ResNet1D、DSCNN1D 对比后表现有竞争力，Crop 上尤其强；消融显示 grid size 与 normalization 会改变性能，即其有效性取决于数据集与架构选择。
Motivation: KAN 变体通常参数量高于 MLP，需要在可比参数预算下检验其在 1D 序列分类任务上是否真有竞争力。
Method: 以 sech 函数为基函数构建 SechKAN，用 1D 投影把参数量降到与 MLP 可比；在 UCI HAR、ElectricDevices、Crop 上以近似相同参数预算对比 EfficientKAN、MLP、CNN1D、ResNet1D、DSCNN1D，并做 grid size 与 normalization 的消融。
Result: SechKAN 在三个 1D 分类数据集上取得有竞争力的表现，在 Crop 上尤其强；消融显示 grid size 与 normalization 影响性能。
Conclusion: SechKAN 的有效性依赖于数据集与架构选择（grid size、normalization），并非普遍占优。

papers.title: Neural Approximation by Function Composition: Rigidity and Doubly Exponential Convergence
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks approximate functions by composing affine maps with nonlinear activations, but how composition itself creates approximation power is not yet fully understood. We investigate a fundamental mechanism: geometrically weighted sums of iterates of a single scalar generator function. This mechanism underpins the classical tent-map construction of the function \(x - x^2\) and related recursive representations used by Yarotsky, W. E, et al., to analyze the approximation powers of deep neural networks. First, we establish a rigidity theorem: for continuous piecewise linear generators with a finite number of segments, any \(C^3\) function that can be represented in this way is at most quadratic. For non-affine quadratic functions, the geometric factor is at least $1/4$. This result both reveals limitations of the tent-map approach and complements existing methods based on hierarchical bases and recursive polynomial constructions. Second, using an exact remainder identity as guidance, we construct a smooth generator whose iterates yield doubly exponential error decay in total depth for square approximation and, through multiplication modules, for each fixed polynomial. For power series with absolutely summable coefficients on \([-1,1]^d\), distributing depth according to monomial degree yields a uniform approximation error of order \(O(e^{-cL^{1/d}})\) on each interior cube. These findings demonstrate how generator dynamics and remainder estimates govern depth allocation and approximation rates of deep neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究单个标量生成函数迭代的几何加权和这一复合机制：证明分段线性生成元只能表示至多二次函数（刚性定理），非仿射二次函数的几何因子至少 1/4；再构造光滑生成元使平方逼近误差随总深度双指数衰减，多元幂级数在内部立方体上达到 O(e^{-cL^{1/d}})。
Motivation: 深度网络通过仿射映射与非线性激活的复合获得逼近能力，但复合本身如何产生逼近力尚不清楚；tent-map 构造等经典分析工具的表达范围存在内在限制。
Method: 以单个标量生成函数迭代的几何加权和为对象：先对有限段连续分段线性生成元建立刚性定理，再以精确余项恒等式为指导构造光滑生成元，并通过乘法模块 (multiplication modules) 扩展到各固定多项式，按单项式次数分配深度处理 [-1,1]^d 上绝对可和幂级数。
Result: 刚性定理：有限段分段线性生成元所能表示的 C^3 函数至多为二次；非仿射二次函数的几何因子至少 1/4。构造的光滑生成元使平方逼近误差随总深度双指数衰减，对每个固定多项式同样成立；按单项式次数分配深度时，[-1,1]^d 上绝对可和系数的幂级数在每个内部立方体上一致逼近误差为 O(e^{-cL^{1/d}})。
Conclusion: 生成元动力学与余项估计共同决定深度分配与逼近速率，tent-map 路线存在本质表达上限，需用分层基与递归多项式构造等方法补充。

papers.title: AgenticSizing: A Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Framework for Analog Circuit Sizing
papers.abstract_en: Analog circuit sizing remains a challenging and time-consuming task due to the large design space, strong performance trade-offs, and increasing circuit complexity in scaled technologies. Although recent large language model (LLM)-based methods show promise in improving sample efficiency and interpretability, existing approaches often lack explicit circuit-topology understanding and are mainly evaluated on relatively simple analog building blocks. This paper presents a multi-agent LLM-based framework for complex analog circuit sizing. The proposed framework first analyzes the circuit topology and decomposes the netlist into functional blocks and substructures. It also extracts lightweight design knowledge for reuse. Based on the extracted topology and knowledge, a planner coordinates multiple role-specialized sizing agents to update design variables and achieve global performance specifications. This workflow mimics the collaborative process of an expert analog design team and provides a structured, interpretable, and simulation-driven optimization procedure. The framework was validated on eight circuits, with the largest design containing up to 55 transistors and 60 sizing variables. Notably, for the LDO benchmark, the proposed method achieved a 60\% success rate with an average of 83 iterations, where classical optimizers failed to find feasible solutions. Further, ablation studies demonstrate that topology understanding, design-knowledge infusion, and agent specialization provide complementary benefits. The source code is available to support reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgenticSizing 用多智能体 LLM 框架做复杂模拟电路尺寸设计：先解析电路拓扑并把网表分解为功能子块、抽取可复用的轻量设计知识，再由 planner 协调多个角色专精的 sizing agent 迭代更新设计变量以满足全局性能指标。在 8 个电路上验证，最大设计含 55 个晶体管、60 个尺寸变量；LDO 基准上达到 60% 成功率、平均 83 次迭代，而经典优化器找不到可行解。
Motivation: 模拟电路尺寸设计空间大、性能权衡强、先进工艺下复杂度高；已有 LLM 方法缺少显式电路拓扑理解，且主要在简单模拟积木电路上评测。
Method: 框架先分析电路拓扑并把网表分解为功能块与子结构，抽取可复用的轻量设计知识；基于拓扑与知识，planner 协调多个角色专精的 sizing agent 更新设计变量，形成结构化、可解释、由仿真驱动的优化流程；并做消融考察拓扑理解、知识注入与 agent 专精的作用。
Result: 在 8 个电路上验证，最大设计含 55 个晶体管、60 个尺寸变量；LDO 基准上成功率 60%、平均 83 次迭代，经典优化器未能找到可行解；消融显示拓扑理解、设计知识注入与 agent 专精带来互补收益。
Conclusion: 把拓扑分解、知识复用与角色分工的多智能体 LLM 工作流用于模拟电路尺寸设计，可在经典优化器失败的复杂电路上找到可行解，且三个组件的作用互补。

papers.title: TV-AudioRemover: Joint Text-Visual Guided Sound Removal with Multi-Task Hard-Mixture Curriculum
papers.abstract_en: Visual object removal can eliminate a target from video frames, yet its acoustic trace persists in the soundtrack, causing obvious audio-visual inconsistency. Existing video inpainting models operate solely on pixels, while audio editing models, especially for the sound removal task, are typically driven by text and therefore rely on limited single-modal control, which is less effective than multimodal guidance that provides stronger semantic grounding and temporal synchronization cues. In this paper, we present Text-Visual Guided Sound Removal (TV-AudioRemover), a target sound removal framework that leverages the visually edited video together with a natural-language instruction to suppress the sound associated with the removed visual object from the original audio mixture. To acquire high-quality training data, we devise a pipeline to construct a million-scale dataset of single-object audio-visual aligned samples, from which we synthesize mixture-target pairs customized for model training. To effectively leverage visual context and follow instruction intent, we augment the model architecture with task tokens, generalizable instruction modeling, and modality-specific global guidance. We further adopt multi-task training to strengthen task-role comprehension, and employ a hard-mixture curriculum that leverages semantically similar acoustic mixtures during fine-tuning to enhance fine-grained source discrimination. To support evaluation, we present AV-Remove-Bench, a comprehensive audio-visual object removal benchmark, along with dedicated objective metrics and an MLLM-based evaluation protocol. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both subjective and objective metrics. Project page: https://yjx-research.github.io/TV-AudioRemover/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TV-AudioRemover 用「已编辑视频 + 自然语言指令」双模态引导，从原始音频混合中抑制被移除视觉对象对应的声音，缓解画面与音轨不一致。构建百万级单物体音视对齐数据集与混合-目标对，配合任务 token、多任务训练和难混合课程 (hard-mixture curriculum)，在自建 AV-Remove-Bench 上主客观指标均达 SOTA。
Motivation: 视频 inpainting 只处理像素，被删物体的声音仍留在音轨里，造成音画不一致；现有声音移除模型多为纯文本驱动，单模态控制语义锚定弱、时序同步差。
Method: 以视觉编辑后的视频加自然语言指令为双模态引导，模型加入任务 token、可泛化指令建模与模态特定全局引导；训练侧构建百万级单物体音视对齐样本并合成 mixture-target 对，采用多任务训练强化任务角色理解，微调阶段用语义相近声学混合的 hard-mixture curriculum 提升细粒度源判别。
Result: 构建百万级单物体音视对齐数据集与 AV-Remove-Bench（含专用客观指标与基于 MLLM 的评测协议）；实验显示该方法在主观与客观指标上均取得 state-of-the-art 表现。
Conclusion: 文本与视觉联合引导比单模态文本控制更适合目标声音移除，配合多任务训练与难混合课程可达到当前最优的音画一致去除效果。

papers.title: MatchFusion: Explicit-Implicit Instance Matching for Spatio-Temporal Multimodal Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Sparse instance representations provide a compact interface for spatial LiDAR-camera and temporal past-current interaction in multimodal perception and E2EAD. Effective interaction requires reliable instance correspondences despite geometric discrepancies and heterogeneous semantic representations. Attention-based methods exploit contextual semantics but often require specialized representation alignment, increasing computational overhead. In contrast, association based on structured object states is efficient and interpretable but lacks contextual evidence to resolve ambiguous matches. To combine these complementary strengths, we propose MatchFusion, a learnable instance matching and fusion module for spatio-temporal multimodal autonomous driving. MatchFusion initializes pairwise affinities using geometric similarity and category consistency, then selectively refines structurally plausible associations using instance embeddings. The resulting soft matchmap guides a common residual aggregation operator for adaptive information exchange. This unified matching-fusion formulation supports spatial LiDAR-camera and temporal past-current interaction, using multi-view image-plane geometry and motion-compensated BEV geometry as the respective structural priors. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate consistent perception gains across diverse front-end configurations. Compared with a prior instance-centric fusion method, the MatchFusion-equipped system achieves higher perception accuracy while reducing FLOPs by 55.3% and GPU memory usage by 39.3%, with the matching-fusion module accounting for only 3.7% of total perception latency. Integrating temporal MatchFusion into SparseDrive further improves perception within an E2E framework without additional supervision. These results establish explicit-implicit matching as an effective and efficient mechanism for spatio-temporal instance interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MatchFusion 把显式结构先验与隐式实例嵌入结合做时空多模态实例匹配：先用几何相似度与类别一致性初始化成对亲和度，再用实例嵌入选择性细化，得到的 soft matchmap 引导统一的残差聚合算子完成信息交换。在 nuScenes 上，相比先前的 instance-centric 融合方法，感知精度更高，同时 FLOPs 降低 55.3%、GPU 显存降低 39.3%，匹配-融合模块只占总感知延迟的 3.7%。
Motivation: 稀疏实例表征需要可靠的实例对应关系，但几何差异与异构语义让匹配变难：纯注意力方法要额外做表征对齐、算力开销大，纯结构化状态关联高效可解释却缺乏上下文证据来消解歧义匹配。
Method: MatchFusion 是可学习的实例匹配与融合模块：以几何相似度和类别一致性初始化 pairwise affinity，用 instance embeddings 选择性细化结构上合理的关联，输出 soft matchmap 引导一个公共残差聚合算子做自适应信息交换；空间 LiDAR-camera 交互用多视图 image-plane geometry 作结构先验，时间 past-current 交互用 motion-compensated BEV geometry 作先验，同一公式同时覆盖两种交互。
Result: 在 nuScenes 上，配备 MatchFusion 的系统相对先前 instance-centric 融合方法感知精度更高，FLOPs 降低 55.3%，GPU 显存降低 39.3%，匹配-融合模块仅占总感知延迟的 3.7%；在多种前端配置上均有一致的感知增益，且把 temporal MatchFusion 集成进 SparseDrive 后在 E2E 框架内进一步提升感知，无需额外监督。
Conclusion: 显式-隐式匹配是时空实例交互既有效又高效的机制，可在不牺牲精度的前提下大幅削减融合开销，并可无额外监督地嵌入端到端自动驾驶框架。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Prediction Is Not Detection: Evaluating Pre-Recognition Claims in Longitudinal Clinical AI
papers.abstract_en: Clinically useful early detection requires validated pre-recognition lead time. Yet event-based evaluations of longitudinal clinical AI can treat recognition-mediated care-process signals as shortcuts and recognition-dependent endpoints as reference standards, inflating apparent performance and lead time while undermining cross-center transport. Such results may serve prognosis without establishing detection before recognition. We define an interval-censored pre-recognition transition, an independent as-of reference standard, and a prespecified recognition proxy to make the claim testable.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, 1 box; includes Supplementary Note
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 纵向临床 AI 的事件式评估把「被识别后才产生的诊疗流程信号」当作捷径、把依赖识别的终点当作参考标准，从而虚高表观性能与提前量、破坏跨中心可迁移。论文把「识别前转变」定义为区间删失 (interval-censored) 事件，配独立的 as-of 参考标准与预先指定的识别代理，使「在识别之前完成检测」这一主张可被检验。
Motivation: 临床早期检测需要经过验证的识别前提前量 (pre-recognition lead time)，但现有事件式评估会把预后能力误当成识别前检测能力，结果无法跨中心迁移。
Method: 定义区间删失的识别前转变、独立的 as-of 参考标准 (reference standard)、以及预先指定的识别代理 (recognition proxy)，三者共同把「识别前检测」主张转成可检验的评估设定。
Result: 论文给出该评估框架的定义与可检验性主张，配套 27 页正文、1 图、3 表、1 box 及 Supplementary Note。
Conclusion: 只有把识别前转变、独立参考标准与识别代理同时固定下来，纵向临床 AI 的提前量主张才可检验，否则结果只支撑预后而非识别前检测。

papers.title: Less Is More in the Long Tail: Stage-Adaptive Sample Selection for Annotation-Efficient Dense Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning performance generally improves with increasing training data, yet this scaling is fundamentally constrained by annotation cost in large-scale dense prediction tasks with long-tailed category distributions, where pixel- or voxel-level annotation is prohibitively expensive. We propose SASS (Stage-Adaptive Sample Selection), a stage-adaptive data-selection framework for pool-based active learning in long-tailed dense prediction. SASS combines three components: label-free self-supervised gradient scoring, prior-guided category rebalancing with validation-driven feedback, and stage-adaptive acquisition aligned with model training dynamics. This design avoids candidate ground-truth masks during gradient scoring while making acquisition responsive to long-tail imbalance and evolving representations. We evaluate SASS on a multimodal 3D medical segmentation testbed comprising over 100,000 samples spanning 108 anatomical structures. SASS recovers 98.3% of full-dataset performance with a 40% training-pool annotation budget, outperforming BADGE by 5.1 percentage points. Moreover, SASS exhibits a statistically supported less-is-more pattern, surpassing full-dataset training at the Hard-group level and, at the structure level, for the pancreas and gallbladder. More broadly, SASS shows that annotation-efficient learning depends not only on which samples are selected, but also on how the annotation budget is distributed across categories and when model-derived scores begin to guide selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SASS 是面向长尾稠密预测的池式主动学习框架，用无标签自监督梯度打分、先验引导的类别再平衡（带验证反馈）与随训练动态调整的采集策略三步选样本，且梯度打分阶段不依赖候选样本的真值掩码。在超过 10 万样本、108 个解剖结构的多模态 3D 医学分割测试床上，用 40% 训练池标注预算恢复全量数据 98.3% 的性能，比 BADGE 高 5.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 大规模稠密预测在长尾类别分布下，像素/体素级标注成本过高，标注预算成为数据规模扩展的硬约束。
Method: SASS 组合三部分：无标签自监督梯度打分（避开候选真值掩码）、带验证驱动反馈的先验引导类别再平衡、与模型训练动态对齐的阶段自适应采集 (stage-adaptive acquisition)，使采集同时响应长尾失衡与表征演化。
Result: 在含 100,000 以上样本、覆盖 108 个解剖结构的多模态 3D 医学分割测试床上，SASS 以 40% 训练池标注预算恢复全量数据集 98.3% 的性能，高出 BADGE 5.1 个百分点；并呈现统计上支持的 less-is-more 模式，在 Hard-group 层级超过全量数据训练，在结构层级对胰腺 (pancreas) 和胆囊 (gallbladder) 亦超过全量训练。
Conclusion: 标注高效学习不仅取决于选哪些样本，还取决于预算如何在类别间分配、以及模型派生分数何时开始引导选择；在该测试床上，少而对的标注可超过全量训练。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Optimizing the Score, Losing Sight of the Task: Reward Hacking Across Weights, Selection, and Prompts
papers.abstract_en: A higher evaluation score does not always mean a better language model system. When optimization exploits an evaluator's mistakes, measured progress can conceal unchanged or deteriorating task performance. This failure can arise through parameter updates, selection among generated outputs, or revisions to persistent prompts. We develop a comparative framework for reward hacking across these three optimization substrates: weights, selection, and text. Building on the Proxy Compression Hypothesis and research on inference-time and in-context reward hacking, we examine how reachable behavior, optimization budgets, and persistent adaptation shape exposure to proxy error. We formalize a distance-dependent upper bound on evaluator disagreement and a capacity ordering for nested policy classes, then show why distance alone cannot establish a universal ranking of vulnerability. An exact finite-output illustration demonstrates how the location of a scoring defect changes the behavior favored by each method. We also map representative defenses across substrates, identifying which mechanisms transfer directly and which offer only functional analogies. Persistent prompts receive particular attention: their contents are inspectable, but the behavior induced by a small textual change may be difficult to anticipate. The formal analysis, numerical illustration, and published evidence together provide a basis for comparing optimization methods and identifying the conditions under which their defenses transfer. The resulting framework connects optimization choices to verification requirements: reliable improvement depends on controlling accessible failure modes and preserving evidence of task quality independent of the score being optimized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出跨三种优化载体（权重、输出选择、持久 prompt）比较 reward hacking 的框架：当优化利用评估器缺陷时，分数上升而任务表现不变或变差。形式化给出距离相关的评估器分歧上界与嵌套策略类的容量序，并用精确有限输出例子说明评分缺陷的位置决定哪种方法更易被 hack；结论是可靠改进取决于控制可达失效模式，并保留独立于被优化分数的任务质量证据。
Motivation: 同一 reward hacking 现象可经参数更新、输出选择或改写持久 prompt 三种途径产生，缺少统一框架比较其对 proxy error 的暴露程度与防御可迁移性。
Method: 构建跨 weights、selection、text 三载体的比较框架，基于 Proxy Compression Hypothesis 与 inference-time / in-context reward hacking 研究，考察可达行为、优化预算与持久适应如何影响暴露；形式化距离相关的评估器分歧上界与嵌套策略类的容量序，并用精确有限输出例子演示评分缺陷位置的作用，再映射各载体的代表性防御及其迁移性。
Result: 给出距离相关的评估器分歧上界与嵌套策略类的容量序两个形式化结果，并证明仅凭距离无法确立普遍的脆弱性排序；精确有限输出例子显示评分缺陷的位置改变各方法偏好的行为；形式分析、数值示例与已发表证据共同支撑防御迁移条件的判定。
Conclusion: 优化选择直接决定验证需求：只有控制可达失效模式并保留独立于所优化分数的任务质量证据，分数提升才等同于真实改进；防御机制跨载体迁移时需区分直接迁移与仅功能类比。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 优化选择直接决定验证需求：只有控制可达失效模式并保留独立于所优化分数的任务质量证据，分数提升才等同于真实改进；防御机制跨载体迁移时需区分直接迁移与仅功能类比。

papers.title: Visual Jev: Accurate and Efficient Decisions from Shared Visual Context
papers.abstract_en: Many vision applications ask several independent, forced-choice questions about the same image. Visual Jev encodes the image and public context once, executes isolated question suffixes as a batch, and reads candidate probabilities from the backbone's language-model head. Across four benchmarks, answer-supervised post-training raises equal-weight macro accuracy from 70.6% to 76.1%, with the gain concentrated on the two task families represented in training. At N=32 questions per image, shared batched execution is 8.9x faster in warm amortized time than independent serial execution and remains 3.4x faster than an already-batched baseline that recomputes the prefix, at the cost of higher peak memory. A matched typed-head control offers no consistent accuracy advantage over the language-model-head readout. The supported design is therefore simple: adapt the backbone for quality, retain the existing readout, and share execution for efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Visual Jev 把同一张图的公共上下文只编码一次，把多个独立选择题的题干后缀批量执行，直接从 backbone 的 language-model head 读候选概率。答案监督后训练把四基准等权 macro accuracy 从 70.6% 提到 76.1%，增益集中在训练覆盖的两类任务；N=32 时共享批量执行比独立串行快 8.9 倍，比会重算前缀的已批量基线仍快 3.4 倍。
Motivation: 同一图像上多个独立 forced-choice 问题若逐条串行推理，图像前缀被反复编码，既慢又贵；而多模态模型的读出头选择（typed head vs. language-model head）对精度的影响并不清楚。
Method: 图像与公共上下文单次编码，问题后缀作为 batch 一起执行，从 backbone 的 language-model head 读取候选概率；在此之上做答案监督的 post-training，并用 matched typed-head control 对比读出方式。
Result: 四个基准上等权 macro accuracy 由 70.6% 升至 76.1%，增益集中在训练中出现的两个任务族；N=32 问题/图时共享批量执行在 warm amortized 时间上比独立串行快 8.9 倍，比重算前缀的已批量基线快 3.4 倍，代价是更高峰值内存；typed head 对照相对 language-model head 读出没有一致的精度优势。
Conclusion: 支持的设计是：用后训练提升质量、保留现有 language-model head 读出、共享执行换效率；代价是峰值内存升高。

papers.title: Metric-Bench: Exploring In-context Spatial Metric Reasoning in VLMs for Indoor Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Metric reasoning is a critical and challenging task for Vision Language Models (VLMs), playing a pivotal role in embodied AI tasks such as robotic manipulation and autonomous navigation. However, current spatial reasoning remains bottlenecked by rigid pixel-level supervision; such localized optimization often compromises general multimodal intelligence, triggering performance degradation or catastrophic forgetting of broad reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce Metric-Bench, a focused benchmark designed to guide metric-spatial reasoning using contextual information. By incorporating in-image reference objects with known physical dimensions, Metric-Bench guides models to implicitly learn the 2D-to-3D mapping without camera intrinsics. We further present MetricReasoner, a task-adapted reinforcement fine-tuning recipe for reference-grounded metric reasoning, using structured prompts and verifiable numerical rewards. Extensive experiments on Metric-Bench demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances spatial metric understanding, outperforming existing and even larger proprietary models by 43.1\%, while improving downstream embodied performance over a spatial-specialized counterpart by 30.4\% on RoboSpatial overall accuracy and 9.3\% on ERQA, and additionally delivering consistent gains on general benchmarks (15.9\% on V$\star$Bench, 88.9\% on BLINK), indicating that the proposed adaptation does not necessarily compromise general VLM capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Metric-Bench 用图内已知物理尺寸的参照物引导 VLM 在无相机内参下隐式学 2D 到 3D 的度量映射，并配以 MetricReasoner 强化微调（结构化提示 + 可验证数值奖励）。在 Metric-Bench 上相对现有乃至更大专有模型提升 43.1%，下游 RoboSpatial 总体精度提升 30.4%、ERQA 提升 9.3%，同时通用基准 V★Bench 提升 15.9%、BLINK 达 88.9%，说明这种度量适配不必然牺牲通用能力。
Motivation: 当前空间度量推理受制于僵化的像素级监督，局部优化损害通用多模态智能，导致性能退化甚至灾难性遗忘。
Method: 提出 Metric-Bench 基准：在图中放入物理尺寸已知的参照物，引导模型在无相机内参条件下隐式学习 2D-3D 映射；并给出 MetricReasoner，一种面向参照锚定度量推理的强化微调配方，使用结构化提示与可验证的数值奖励。
Result: 在 Metric-Bench 上超越现有及更大专有模型 43.1%；下游具身任务相对空间专用对照模型在 RoboSpatial 总体精度提升 30.4%、ERQA 提升 9.3%；通用基准上 V★Bench 提升 15.9%、BLINK 达 88.9%。
Conclusion: 以参照物锚定的度量强化微调能同时抬高空间度量理解与具身下游表现，且不必然损害通用推理能力。

papers.title: Gaussian Flow-Matching Schedules: Implications for Sampling and Training
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching schedules affect both sampling dynamics and the variance of the regression target. For centered commuting Gaussians, we show that a direction-dependent schedule decomposes into two independent design choices: a variance path, which fully determines the intermediate laws and probability flow, and a factorization, which leaves this flow unchanged while controlling irreducible regression variance. On the sampling side, we analyze finite-step Euler accuracy and derive a necessary drift bound for exact N -step sampling, connecting the geodesic and the logarithmic path. On the training side, for any fixed path, we derive closed-form factorizations that either minimize time-averaged regression variance or make it constant along the path.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在中心化高斯且协方差可交换的设定下，方向相关的 flow-matching schedule 被分解为两个独立设计维度：决定中间分布与 probability flow 的 variance path，以及不改变该 flow 但控制不可约回归方差的 factorization。采样侧给出有限步 Euler 精度分析与 N 步精确采样的必要 drift 界，训练侧对任意固定路径推出使时间平均回归方差最小或沿路径恒定的闭式 factorization。
Motivation: flow-matching 的 schedule 同时影响采样动力学与回归目标方差，但两者如何被独立设计缺少刻画；在可交换高斯这一可解析情形下，需要说清哪些选择改路径、哪些只改训练噪声。
Method: 对中心化可交换高斯证明方向相关 schedule 分解为 variance path 与 factorization 两个独立设计选择；采样侧分析有限步 Euler 精度并推导 N 步精确采样的必要 drift 界，联系 geodesic path 与 logarithmic path；训练侧对任意固定路径给出闭式 factorization，分别最小化时间平均回归方差或使其沿路径恒定。
Result: 证明 variance path 完全决定中间分布与 probability flow，而 factorization 在不改变该 flow 的前提下控制不可约回归方差；给出 N 步精确采样的必要 drift 界，并得到最小化时间平均回归方差与方差沿路径恒定的两类闭式 factorization。
Conclusion: 在可交换高斯情形下，采样路径与训练方差可以分开设计：先定 variance path 再选 factorization，即可在不改采样动力学的情况下压低或抹平回归方差。

papers.title: Identity-Centric Video Summarization via Hierarchical Fusion of Biometric, Appearance, and 3D Body Features
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a video summarization algorithm based on multi-object tracking and person reidentification. We integrate facial embeddings, 3D body-shape features, and visual appearance into a unified tracking framework. These representations enable hierarchical identity assignment and tracking through bidirectional anchoring, which robustly recovers trajectories under severe occlusion or low visual quality. From these stable trajectories, we generate a compact set of summaries for each identity. We select keyframes using a multi-factor weighting scheme that optimizes biometric clarity, social interaction, and motion dynamics, while Adaptive Non-Maximum Suppression ensures temporal diversity. Evaluation on a custom dataset demonstrates tracking stability, achieving an IDF1 of 97.89% and a MOTA of 95.79%. Compared to Top-K selection, our algorithm also increases visual diversity by 146%, temporal coverage by 89%, and information retrievability by 3.5%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以身份为核心的视频摘要算法：多目标跟踪与行人重识别结合，把人脸 embedding、3D 身体形状与外观特征分层融合，通过双向锚定做身份分配与轨迹恢复，在严重遮挡或低画质下仍能重建轨迹，再从稳定轨迹为每个身份生成紧凑关键帧摘要。自建数据集上 IDF1 达 97.89%、MOTA 95.79%，相对 Top-K 选择视觉多样性提升 146%、时间覆盖提升 89%、信息可检索性提升 3.5%。
Motivation: 多目标跟踪在严重遮挡与低视觉质量下身份易断裂，而常规关键帧选择只按分数取 Top-K，导致摘要缺少身份覆盖、时间多样性与可检索性。
Method: 在统一跟踪框架中融合人脸 embedding、3D 体型特征与视觉外观，做分层身份分配与双向锚定 (bidirectional anchoring) 的轨迹恢复；从稳定轨迹出发，用兼顾生物特征清晰度、社交互动与运动动态的多因子加权选关键帧，并以 Adaptive Non-Maximum Suppression 保证时间多样性。
Result: 自建数据集上跟踪稳定性 IDF1 97.89%、MOTA 95.79%；相对 Top-K 选择，视觉多样性提高 146%、时间覆盖提高 89%、信息可检索性提高 3.5%。
Conclusion: 把身份轨迹作为摘要的组织单元、再在轨迹内做多因子关键帧选择，能在遮挡与低画质条件下同时拿到稳定跟踪和更高多样性、覆盖度与可检索性的摘要。

papers.title: In-Context Guidance: Learning Inter-Task Synergies via Numerical Foundational Models for Few-Shot Multitask Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task optimization (MTO) addresses a set of optimization tasks simultaneously, often suffering from inaccurate inter-task relationship estimation under limited evaluation budgets, leading to negative transfer. This paper introduces In-Context Guidance Multitask Optimization (ICG-MTO), a novel framework that leverages numerical foundational models to improve inter-task coupling estimation in few-shot scenarios. Unlike conventional methods that rely solely on scarce observed data, ICG-MTO employs a frozen foundational model to infer auxiliary guidance through in-context learning. The framework operates through three stages: constructing an algorithm-specific in-context query from evaluated solutions, using the foundational model to infer a guidance signal characterizing predictive relationships among tasks, and translating this signal into algorithm-specific guidance for maximum-a-posteriori coupling estimation. This approach provides regularization during the early, data-scarce stages of optimization and gradually relinquishes control as task-specific observations accumulate. We instantiate the framework in multitask Bayesian optimization as ICG-MTBO, using directional fitness-class queries to guide inter-task coupling estimation, and further instantiate it in MFEA-II using decision-space-overlap queries to guide random mating probability estimation. Experiments across synthetic benchmarks and a real-world robot arm control problem, together with evaluations under different acquisition functions and evolutionary multitasking, demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of ICG-MTO for few-shot multitask optimization.
papers.comment: In Submission to IEEE Transactions on Evolutionary Computation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ICG-MTO：用冻结的数值基础模型 (numerical foundational model) 通过 in-context learning 推断辅助引导信号，做 few-shot 多任务优化中的任务间耦合估计，早期数据稀缺时作正则、随观测积累逐步放手。在合成基准与真实机械臂控制任务上，分别实例化为 ICG-MTBO（多任务贝叶斯优化，directional fitness-class query）与 MFEA-II 版本（decision-space-overlap query 引导随机交配概率估计），验证其有效性与通用性。
Motivation: 多任务优化在有限评估预算下任务间关系估计不准，容易产生负迁移 (negative transfer)，而常规方法只能依赖稀少的已观测数据。
Method: 三阶段流程：从已评估解构造算法特定的 in-context query；用冻结的基础模型推断刻画任务间预测关系的 guidance signal；把该信号转成算法特定引导，用于最大后验 (MAP) 耦合估计。框架分别实例化为 ICG-MTBO（多任务贝叶斯优化）和嵌入 MFEA-II（decision-space-overlap query 引导随机交配概率）。
Result: 在合成基准与真实机械臂控制问题上实验，并在不同采集函数 (acquisition functions) 与进化多任务 (evolutionary multitasking) 设置下评测，显示 ICG-MTO 对 few-shot 多任务优化有效且具通用性。
Conclusion: 用冻结基础模型的 in-context 引导替代纯数据驱动的耦合估计，可在优化早期数据稀缺阶段抑制负迁移，并随观测积累自动让出控制权。

summary_sections.result: 在合成基准与真实机械臂控制问题上实验，并在不同采集函数 (acquisition functions) 与进化多任务 (evolutionary multitasking) 设置下评测，显示 ICG-MTO 对 few-shot 多任务优化有效且具通用性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用冻结基础模型的 in-context 引导替代纯数据驱动的耦合估计，可在优化早期数据稀缺阶段抑制负迁移，并随观测积累自动让出控制权。

papers.title: PartLLM: A Unified Multimodal Foundation for 3D Part Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Part segmentation is a fundamental problem in computer graphics and 3D vision. Recent works have expanded 3D part segmentation beyond fixed taxonomies, but existing approaches typically only address a specific setting, such as text-guided part segmentation or point-based interaction. In this work, we argue that these settings can be unified as an intent-conditioned generative problem, where different prompts specify the desired part decomposition. To this end, we introduce PartLLM, a unified multimodal model that formulates 3D part segmentation as autoregressive semantic decomposition. Conditioned on an input shape and a user prompt, PartLLM autoregressively generates semantic part hypotheses as queries for mask prediction and feeds them to a decomposition-aware decoder that jointly predicts coherent part masks. This unified design supports text-guided part segmentation, interactive segmentation, and full-shape semantic decomposition with controllable granularity within a single model. Extensive experiments across these task settings show that PartLLM consistently outperforms task-specific baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of unifying 3D part segmentation under an intent-conditioned generative formulation.
papers.comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (ACM Transactions on Graphics). Project Page: https://czvvd.github.io/PartLLMPage/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PartLLM 把 3D 部件分割统一成意图条件下的自回归语义分解：由形状与用户 prompt 自回归生成语义部件假设作为 mask 查询，再送入分解感知解码器联合预测连贯部件 mask。单一模型同时支持文本引导分割、交互式分割与全形状语义分解且粒度可控，在这三类任务设定上均稳定优于各自的任务专用基线。
Motivation: 现有 3D 部件分割方法各自只覆盖一种设定（文本引导或点交互），缺少能在同一模型内按用户意图切换并控制分解粒度的统一形式。
Method: 将部件分割表述为 intent-conditioned 的自回归语义分解：给定输入形状与用户 prompt，自回归生成语义部件假设作为 mask 预测的查询，再输入 decomposition-aware decoder 联合预测连贯部件 mask，覆盖文本引导、交互式与全形状三种任务设定。
Result: 在文本引导部件分割、交互式分割、全形状语义分解三类任务设定上的大量实验中，PartLLM 均一致优于任务专用基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 3D 部件分割的多种设定可以统一在 intent-conditioned 生成式表述下，用一个模型覆盖并保持对任务专用方法的优势。

papers.title: Sometimes You Gotta Run Before You Can Walk: Run-then-Walk Scheduling Strategy for VLM Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Recent VLM-based autonomous driving planners adopt GRPO-style reinforcement learning to optimize driving performance. However, existing GRPO recipes either optimize driving efficiency, risking progress-seeking but unsafe behavior, or enforce early safety constraints, leading to overly conservative behavior; both require lengthy training. To solve these problems, we first reveal two distinct RL regimes: a progress regime (Run-GRPO) that aggressively explores high progress, and a safety regime (Walk-GRPO) that restores safety under stable progress. Based on this finding, we propose $\textit{Run-then-Walk}$, a simple yet effective two-stage reward scheduling strategy for GRPO, achieving both better performance and faster convergence. Unlike one-stage RL, which may focus on progress, safety, or a mixture of both within a single training phase, this schedule explicitly separates progress discovery from safety repair. In the $\textit{Run}$ phase, we focus on progress, allowing the policy to escape the conservative bias and discover high-progress modes. In the subsequent $\textit{Walk}$ phase, we introduce endpoint and safety strategy to repair unsafe behaviors from the Run phase. This reversed schedule overcomes the conservatism of Walk-first methods and the unsafe progress-seeking of joint optimization. We validate it with various VLM-based planners on multiple benchmarks: NAVSIMv1, NAVSIMv2, Navhard, and nuScenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved driving performance while requiring 40--50\% fewer RL training epochs than the baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLM 自动驾驶规划器的 GRPO 训练被拆成先进度后安全的两阶段奖励调度 Run-then-Walk：Run 阶段用 Run-GRPO 激进探索高进度以摆脱保守偏置，Walk 阶段用 Walk-GRPO 引入终点与安全策略修复 Run 阶段产生的不安全行为。在 NAVSIMv1、NAVSIMv2、Navhard 与 nuScenes 上验证，驾驶性能提升且比基线少用 40–50% 的 RL 训练 epoch。
Motivation: 现有 GRPO 配方要么只优化驾驶效率、冒着追求进度但不安全的风险，要么过早施加安全约束导致过度保守，且两者都需要漫长训练。
Method: 识别两种 RL 体制——激进探索高进度的 Run-GRPO 与在稳定进度下恢复安全的 Walk-GRPO——并据此设计两阶段奖励调度：先 Run 阶段只关注进度以发现高进度模式，再 Walk 阶段加入 endpoint 与 safety strategy 修复不安全行为，显式分离进度发现与安全修复。
Result: 在 NAVSIMv1、NAVSIMv2、Navhard、nuScenes 多个基准上验证多种 VLM 规划器，驾驶性能提升，同时比基线少用 40–50% 的 RL 训练 epoch。
Conclusion: 先进度后安全的反向调度能同时克服 Walk-first 方法的保守性与联合优化的不安全进度追求，比单阶段 RL 收敛更快且性能更好。

papers.title: Protocol before progress: leakage-aware evaluation of AIS trajectory prediction
papers.abstract_en: Reported gains in vessel-trajectory prediction from Automatic Identification System (AIS) data are credited to new architectures, but the evaluation protocol is rarely measured as a source of error reduction. We build a leakage-aware protocol with vessel-, time- and region-disjoint splits and apply it to two corpora with different traffic: 31 days of Danish national AIS traffic and 30 days of US Gulf coast traffic off Houston and Galveston. On both, we audit TrAISformer, GATransformer, and controlled AISFormer-inspired reconstructions. Three protocol effects appear in both corpora. First, TrAISformer's best-of-16 oracle decoder lowers error by a factor of 2.1-3.2 relative to greedy decoding. Second, a split that shares vessels lowers its greedy error by 23-25% at one hour, against 2% or less for a compact 0.43 M-parameter encoder. Third, a region-disjoint split raises TrAISformer's one-hour error from 2.2 to 24.6 km on the US corpus, because 99.9% of the test contexts fall in longitude bins never seen in training; the encoder built on local offsets is unaffected by this. Architectural mechanisms matter less: GATransformer's graph attention gives no measurable benefit on either corpus, while its waterway feature is worth 12-22%. The effect of a time-disjoint split is not stable across corpora (13% versus 2%). We release the splits and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 船舶轨迹预测的性能提升常被归功于新架构，但用泄漏感知协议（vessel/time/region 三重不相交划分）审计后，误差下降主要来自解码器与划分泄漏：TrAISformer 的 best-of-16 oracle 解码比 greedy 低 2.1–3.2 倍，共享 vessel 的划分让 greedy 误差降 23–25%（1 小时），而 region-disjoint 划分把 1 小时误差从 2.2 km 抬到 24.6 km（99.9% 测试上下文落在训练未见经度格）。架构机制反而次要：GATransformer 的图注意力无可测收益，waterway 特征值 12–22%。
Motivation: AIS 轨迹预测的论文把误差下降归给新架构，但评估协议本身（划分泄漏、解码器 oracle）从未被当作误差来源度量，导致增益不可归因。
Method: 构建泄漏感知协议：vessel-disjoint、time-disjoint、region-disjoint 三类划分，应用于两个语料（31 天丹麦全国 AIS、30 天美国墨西哥湾 Houston/Galveston 沿岸），审计 TrAISformer、GATransformer 与受 AISFormer 启发的受控重建，并对比基于局部偏移的紧凑 0.43 M 参数编码器。
Result: 在两个语料上：TrAISformer best-of-16 oracle 解码相对 greedy 降低误差 2.1–3.2 倍；共享 vessel 的划分使 greedy 误差在 1 小时降 23–25%，而 0.43 M 参数编码器仅降 ≤2%；region-disjoint 划分使 TrAISformer 美国语料 1 小时误差 2.2 → 24.6 km（99.9% 测试上下文经度格训练未见），局部偏移编码器不受影响；GATransformer 图注意力在两语料无可测收益，waterway 特征值 12–22%；time-disjoint 划分效应跨语料不稳定（13% vs 2%）。
Conclusion: 轨迹预测报告的增益中有相当部分来自解码器 oracle 与划分泄漏而非架构；应先固定泄漏感知协议再比较模型，并公开划分与代码。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CogenPVG: Cognitive-Enhanced Reflective Multi-Agent Framework for Persuasive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Persuasive video generation (PVG) is a valuable yet under-explored research topic. Despite the significant advances in multimodal content generation, AI-empowered automated creation of human-made-like videos with substantial persuasiveness remains a formidable challenge. In this paper, we propose CogenPVG, a novel Cognitive-Enhanced reflective multi-agent framework tailored for Persuasive Video Generation task. Given the topic and stance from the user, we decouple the sophisticated generation process into four sequential stages: argument reasoning, storyboard planning, asset creation, and post-editing, imitating the workflow of human video producers. To ensure high persuasiveness, each stage is equipped with a pair of generator and critic agents, following a reflective refinement scheme grounded in a solid psychological theory of persuasion, the Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM). In the argument reasoning stage, we generate highly logical and credible reasoning thoughts under the guidance of critical thinking theory, enabling cognitive enhancement via the central route of the ELM. For the other three stages, we generate and optimize multimodal assets, assembling them into a persuasive video guided by theories of heuristics, as the peripheral route of the ELM. To the best of our knowledge, CogenPVG is the first work focused on general persuasive topics, without being confined to commercial purposes. Extensive experiments and comprehensive analysis demonstrate that our framework achieves the best persuasion performance, thereby proving the effectiveness of our proposed multi-agent framework for the PVG task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CogenPVG 把说服性视频生成 (persuasive video generation) 拆成论证推理、分镜规划、素材生成、后期剪辑四个阶段，每阶段配生成器与批评器双 agent，按 Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM) 中心路径与外围路径做反思式迭代优化。实验显示该框架取得最佳说服表现，是首个面向通用说服话题而非限定商业用途的 PVG 工作。
Motivation: 多模态内容生成虽有进展，但让 AI 自动产出具有强说服力、接近真人制作的视频仍是难题，且 PVG 缺乏面向通用话题的系统化方法。
Method: 输入用户给定的话题与立场，四阶段流水线（argument reasoning、storyboard planning、asset creation、post-editing）模仿人类视频制作流程；每阶段由 generator-critic agent 对做 reflective refinement，论证推理阶段用批判性思维理论走 ELM 中心路径，其余三阶段按启发式理论（外围路径）生成并优化多模态素材后合成视频。
Result: 实验中该框架取得最佳说服表现（abstract 未给出具体数值），并自称首个面向通用说服话题、不限于商业用途的 PVG 工作。
Conclusion: 把说服心理学理论（ELM）嵌入多 agent 反思式流水线，可有效提升说服性视频生成的整体说服力。
Relevance: 0
