papers.title: Beyond Reconstruction Error: Analytical and Data-Driven Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Discrete action tokenization is central to autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models, yet action representations are often evaluated primarily through reconstruction fidelity. We ask which representation properties actually matter for closed-loop control by comparing fixed analytical, data-driven linear, and nonlinear neural representations under a unified tokenization interface. Across rate-distortion analysis, sequence-modeling diagnostics, and 3,500 LIBERO rollouts, representation rankings change with the evaluation criterion. PCA achieves lower nominal reconstruction error than Temporal-DCT, but produces less predictable token sequences and 3.0 percentage points lower mean seen-task success across three policy-training seeds, with the policy ordering reversing in one seed. In a matched seed-42 ablation, an autoencoder further reduces reconstruction error yet does not yield the strongest policy and exhibits greater sensitivity to discrete token perturbations. These findings show that reconstruction fidelity alone cannot reliably select action representations for autoregressive control, motivating joint evaluation of geometric fidelity, sequence predictability, decoder stability, and closed-loop performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一 tokenization 接口下比较固定解析 (Temporal-DCT)、数据驱动线性 (PCA) 与非线性神经 (autoencoder) 三类动作表征，发现按重建误差排序与按闭环控制表现排序不一致：PCA 重建误差更低但 token 序列更难预测，三个训练种子上平均 seen-task 成功率低 3.0 个百分点，且在一个种子上策略排序反转。作者主张选动作表征时要联合看几何保真、序列可预测性、解码器稳定性与闭环性能，而不是只看重建误差。
Motivation: 自回归 VLA 模型的动作表征长期只用重建保真度评价，但重建好不等于闭环控制好，缺少能真正指导表征选择的评价准则。
Method: 在统一 tokenization 接口下对比固定解析 (Temporal-DCT)、数据驱动线性 (PCA) 与非线性神经 (autoencoder) 表征，结合 rate-distortion 分析、序列建模诊断与 LIBERO 上的闭环 rollout；策略训练用三个种子，另做 seed-42 匹配消融与离散 token 扰动测试。
Result: 共 3,500 次 LIBERO rollouts。PCA 名义重建误差低于 Temporal-DCT，但 token 序列可预测性更差，三策略训练种子上平均 seen-task 成功率低 3.0 个百分点，且在一个种子上策略排序反转；seed-42 消融中 autoencoder 进一步降低重建误差，却未带来最强策略，且对离散 token 扰动更敏感。
Conclusion: 重建保真度单独不足以可靠筛选自回归控制的动作表征，评价必须联合几何保真、序列可预测性、解码器稳定性与闭环表现四项。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 在统一 tokenization 接口下比较固定解析 (Temporal-DCT)、数据驱动线性 (PCA) 与非线性神经 (autoencoder) 三类动作表征，发现按重建误差排序与按闭环控制表现排序不一致：PCA 重建误差更低但 token 序列更难预测，三个训练种子上平均 seen-task 成功率低 3.0 个百分点，且在一个种子上策略排序反转。作者主张选动作表征时要联合看几何保真、序列可预测性、解码器稳定性与闭环性能，而不是只看重建误差。

summary_sections.method: 在统一 tokenization 接口下对比固定解析 (Temporal-DCT)、数据驱动线性 (PCA) 与非线性神经 (autoencoder) 表征，结合 rate-distortion 分析、序列建模诊断与 LIBERO 上的闭环 rollout；策略训练用三个种子，另做 seed-42 匹配消融与离散 token 扰动测试。

papers.title: MorphoSHAP: Rethinking the Unit of Attribution in Explanation for Deep Visual Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual attribution methods typically explain predictions using pixels, superpixels, or regular patches. These representations can localize important regions, but provide limited information about their structure. We introduce MorphoSHAP, a model-agnostic post-hoc method that instead uses morphological shapes as the players of a Shapley attribution game. Using the Tree of Shapes, each shape is described by its scale, geometry, and signed contribution, providing explanations of where the evidence lies, what type of structure carries it, and how strongly it affects the prediction. This shared morphological vocabulary enables spatial, textual, and global class-level explanations beyond image-specific heatmaps. To the best of our knowledge, MorphoSHAP is the first SHAP-based image attribution framework to combine these different forms of explanation. Across five diverse datasets and three architectures, MorphoSHAP achieves strong insertion/deletion performance and outperforms competing attribution methods on several benchmarks. Finally, a user study shows that MorphoSHAP provides explanations that are easy to use and are preferred over standard attribution baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MorphoSHAP 把 Shapley 归因游戏的玩家从像素/超像素换成形态学形状，用 Tree of Shapes 把每个形状表示为尺度、几何与带符号贡献，从而同时给出空间、文本与全局类别级解释。在五个数据集、三种架构上取得强 insertion/deletion 表现，并在若干基准上超过竞争归因方法，用户研究中也更受偏好。
Motivation: 像素、超像素或规则 patch 这类归因表示只能定位重要区域，几乎不提供该区域结构类型的信息，解释停留在热图层面。
Method: 模型无关的 post-hoc 方法：以 Tree of Shapes 提取形态学形状作为 Shapley 归因的玩家，每个形状用尺度、几何和带符号贡献刻画，据此生成空间、文本与全局类别级解释。
Result: 在五个多样数据集与三种架构上取得强 insertion/deletion 表现，并在若干基准上优于竞争归因方法；用户研究显示其解释易用且比标准归因基线更受偏好。
Conclusion: 以形态学形状而非像素块作为归因单元，可以一次框架内同时回答证据在哪、由何种结构承载、影响多强，作者称其为首个结合这几种解释形式的 SHAP 图像归因框架。

papers.title: CacheDyG: Decoupling Temporal Propagation for Efficient Dynamic Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic graphs are widely used to model time-evolving relational systems in real-world applications. Dynamic graph neural networks provide an effective framework for capturing both structural dependencies and temporal dynamics in such data. However, they typically intertwine temporal graph propagation with every optimization epoch and often maintain large trainable representations for each node-time pair. This design repeatedly recomputes largely unchanged historical structures, leading to substantial training and parameter overhead. To address this critical issue, we propose CacheDyG, a Cache-refine framework for efficient Dynamic Graph learning. Specifically, it decouples temporal propagation from routine parameter updates by constructing a time-ordered temporal dependency cache that stores graph-aware node-time representations in non-trainable buffers. During standard training epochs, CacheDyG reads from the cache and updates only a lightweight cache refiner, an adaptive residual gate, and the link predictor. Selective cache refresh further keeps cached representations aligned with the supervised objective while avoiding epoch-wise sparse propagation. Experiments on five dynamic graph benchmarks show that CacheDyG adopts substantially fewer trainable parameters and lower runtime to obtain more competitive predictive performance than baselines. These results demonstrate that cache-based decoupling provides an effective principle for scalable dynamic graph learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CacheDyG 把动态图神经网络中每个训练 epoch 都要重做的时序传播抽离出来，缓存到不可训练的时序依赖 cache 中，训练时只更新 cache refiner、残差门与链接预测器，并用选择性刷新对齐监督目标。在五个动态图基准上，它以更少可训练参数和更低运行时取得比基线更有竞争力的预测性能。
Motivation: 动态 GNN 把时序传播与参数更新绑在一起，并为每个 node-time 对保留大量可训练表示，导致反复重算几乎不变的历史结构，训练与参数开销大。
Method: 构建按时间排序的时序依赖 cache，以不可训练 buffer 存储 graph-aware 的 node-time 表示；标准训练 epoch 只读取 cache 并更新轻量 cache refiner、自适应残差门 (adaptive residual gate) 和链接预测器，配合 selective cache refresh 避免逐 epoch 稀疏传播。
Result: 在五个动态图基准上，相比基线使用显著更少的可训练参数和更低运行时，同时获得更有竞争力的预测性能。
Conclusion: 基于 cache 的传播与参数更新解耦是扩展动态图学习的有效原则，能在降开销的同时保持或提升预测表现。

papers.title: Multi-View Fair Clustering Guided by Cross-View Sensitive Information Discrepancy
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view clustering (MVC) aims to uncover latent cluster structures by exploiting complementary information from multiple views. Despite substantial progress in clustering performance, fairness remains an important concern when MVC is applied to socially sensitive scenarios. Recent fair multi-view clustering methods have introduced fairness constraints into representation learning or clustering assignments. However, these methods generally treat different views under a largely uniform fairness mechanism, without explicitly distinguishing their varying levels of sensitive dependence during cross-view learning. In practice, different views may encode substantially different levels of sensitive information. Ignoring such cross-view discrepancy can allow highly sensitive-dependent views to influence less sensitive-dependent ones during cross-view learning, potentially degrading both clustering performance and fairness. To address this issue, we propose a novel multi-view fair clustering framework guided by cross-view sensitive information discrepancy. Specifically, we estimate the sensitive dependence of each view and develop a bias-ranked asymmetric alignment mechanism that encourages views with higher sensitive dependence to learn from those with lower sensitive dependence, while cross-view discrepancies are further exploited to adaptively regulate the alignment process. Moreover, fairness regularization is imposed on the consensus soft assignments to further promote group fairness. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a favorable balance between clustering quality and group fairness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出由跨视图敏感信息差异引导的公平多视图聚类框架：先估计每个视图对敏感属性的依赖程度，用偏序排序的非对称对齐让高敏感依赖视图向低敏感依赖视图学习，并用跨视图差异自适应调节对齐强度，同时在共识软分配上加公平正则。在基准数据集上，该方法在聚类质量与群体公平之间取得有利平衡。
Motivation: 现有公平多视图聚类对各视图施加统一的公平机制，忽略视图间敏感信息依赖程度的差异，导致高敏感视图在跨视图学习中污染低敏感视图，同时损害聚类性能与公平性。
Method: 逐视图估计敏感依赖度，设计 bias-ranked 非对称对齐机制使高依赖视图向低依赖视图学习，并利用跨视图差异自适应调节对齐过程；在共识软分配 (consensus soft assignments) 上施加公平正则以促进群体公平。
Result: 在基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在聚类质量与群体公平之间取得有利平衡。
Conclusion: 跨视图敏感依赖差异应被显式建模并用于非对称对齐，而非对所有视图施加统一公平约束，才能同时保住聚类质量与群体公平。

papers.title: You Only Need 2/3 of the Chosen Experts: An Empirical Study of Dynamic Expert Pruning in Fine-Grained MoE LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures have become a mainstream design for open-weight LLMs, with hundreds of experts and increasingly many selected per token. This shift makes dynamic expert pruning an attractive route to cheaper inference. Yet existing evidence comes largely from coarser architectures and likelihood-scored multiple-choice benchmarks, leaving three central questions open in the fine-grained regime: how redundant per-token expert selection is, how effectively existing pruning methods exploit that redundancy, and what governs a model's sensitivity to pruning. We fill this gap with a systematic empirical study of twelve fine-grained MoE checkpoints spanning nine architecture families, with a core suite of eleven benchmarks covering knowledge QA, mathematics, code generation, and general reasoning. We find that expert selection is far more redundant than the field's operating points assume: uniformly retaining about two thirds of the selected experts preserves 98.8% of unpruned performance on average, requiring only a one-integer change and delivering 1.2-1.7x measured speedup across two serving backends. This simple baseline leaves little room for dynamic allocation at conservative budgets: even the best published rules differ from it by under 1% at matched expert budgets. Their value emerges under aggressive pruning, where the best rules recover up to 3.0% over uniform truncation, with gains concentrated in the generative tasks that suffer the sharpest degradation. Sensitivity to aggressive pruning also depends on the model: larger and thinking models are more resilient, whereas multimodal models are more vulnerable. Together, these findings reveal how much expert computation fine-grained MoEs can dispense with, and establish when dynamic allocation earns its complexity, informing both practical deployment and future pruning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 12 个细粒度 MoE checkpoint、11 个基准的实证研究显示：每个 token 只保留约三分之二被选专家（uniform truncation）即可保住平均 98.8% 的未剪枝性能，只需改一个整数，并在两个 serving 后端实测加速 1.2–1.7 倍。在保守预算下已发表的动态分配规则与该朴素基线差距不足 1%，只有激进剪枝时最好的规则才比均匀截断多恢复至多 3.0%，且收益集中在退化最狠的生成任务上。
Motivation: 细粒度 MoE（数百专家、每 token 选多个）已成开源 LLM 主流，但动态专家剪枝的证据多来自更粗的架构和 likelihood 打分的多选题基准，per-token 专家选择的冗余度、现有剪枝方法能否利用该冗余、以及什么决定模型对剪枝的敏感度，三个问题都悬而未决。
Method: 系统实证研究 12 个细粒度 MoE checkpoint、覆盖 9 个架构家族，核心评测套件为 11 个基准，涵盖知识 QA、数学、代码生成与通用推理；对比 uniform truncation（只保留约 2/3 被选专家）与已发表的动态分配规则在 matched expert budgets 下的表现，并在两个 serving 后端测速。
Result: 均匀保留约三分之二被选专家平均保住 98.8% 的未剪枝性能，实测加速 1.2–1.7 倍（两个 serving 后端）；保守预算下最好的已发表规则与该基线差距不足 1%；激进剪枝下最好的规则比均匀截断最多恢复 3.0%，收益集中在生成任务；对激进剪枝的敏感度随模型而变，更大、带 thinking 的模型更耐剪，多模态模型更脆弱。
Conclusion: 细粒度 MoE 每 token 的专家计算有约三分之一可直接丢弃且代价极小，动态分配只在激进剪枝预算下才值得其复杂度；模型规模、是否 thinking 与是否多模态决定剪枝敏感度。

papers.title: Auditing Proxy-Based Validation Across Text Spans
papers.abstract_en: Evaluation scores are often validated by their agreement with inexpensive proxy labels. When the score and the proxy are computed from the same text span, however, that agreement can arise from surface evidence the two share rather than from the semantic construct the proxy is meant to represent. We make the distinction explicit by declaring the score, its span, the proxy and the target construct as a validation contract, then re-evaluating that proxy rule strictly outside the scored span. In a controlled HotpotQA correctness experiment varying only the shared text boundary, the score agrees with its proxy far better than with correctness at a 50-character prefix: the gap is +0.184, collapsing to at most +0.045 from 120 characters onward. At that short prefix the score still predicts whether the answer string appears later (AUC 0.634) while an equivalence test places its agreement with correctness at chance, so the reported proxy agreement does not establish that the score ranks correctness. On OR-Bench, suppressing each model's recurring opening templates removes most of the score's association with the refusal proxy, while matched-volume deletion removes almost none and construct agreement stays at chance. Only three of eleven external contracts support the off-span control, and none of the routing studies we sampled released the generations it needs. We therefore ask that a proxy-based validation claim declare the span each label is read from, report the construct agreement beside the proxy agreement, and release the generations that let the proxy be re-read off the scored span.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把「评分-文本跨度-代理标签-目标构念」形式化为 validation contract，并要求在被评分跨度之外重新检验代理规则。HotpotQA 受控实验中，50 字符前缀下评分与代理的一致性比与 correctness 的一致性高 +0.184，到 120 字符起差距缩到至多 +0.045；作者据此要求声明标签跨度、并列报告构念一致性并公开生成结果。
Motivation: 评分常靠廉价代理标签验证，但当评分与代理读自同一文本跨度时，一致性可能只来自共享的表面证据，而非代理声称要测的语义构念。
Method: 把评分、其跨度、代理与目标构念声明为 validation contract，并在评分跨度之外严格重测代理规则；在 HotpotQA 上做只改变共享文本边界的受控 correctness 实验，另在 OR-Bench 上分别抑制模型开头模板与做等量删除，并审计 11 个外部 contract 与采样的 routing 研究。
Result: HotpotQA 中 50 字符前缀下评分与代理的一致性高出与 correctness 的一致性 +0.184，120 字符起差距缩至至多 +0.045；该短前缀下评分预测答案串随后出现的 AUC 为 0.634，而等价性检验显示其与 correctness 的一致性处于随机水平。OR-Bench 上抑制各模型反复出现的开头模板去掉大部分评分与拒绝代理的关联，等量删除几乎去不掉，构念一致性仍处随机。11 个外部 contract 中仅 3 个支持 off-span 控制，采样的 routing 研究无一公开其所需的生成结果。

papers.title: When Are Aggregate Agent Traces Diagnosable? Traffic-Governed Interpretation and Calibrated Abstention
papers.abstract_en: Runtime traces can appear transparent, but a closed-loop policy determines which states are visited and which failures become visible. We study a simulated hotel-pricing agent mapping time, inventory, and market state to discrete price actions under varying demand regimes. A fault may leave no aggregate trace when the policy rarely visits affected cells. We treat entry into aggregate-only fault interpretation as a diagnosability decision preceding scoring or localization. A reference-map gate requires repeated clean-policy support; a matched runtime gate then requires joint support in clean and current streams. Signal analysis occurs only after both pass. We calibrate false admission on a disjoint clean stream at the physical-component level and model detection by affected clean traffic rather than nominal cell coverage. In a frozen one-shot heldout, 55/72 (76.4%) regime-component units were reference-admitted, representing 20 physical components; 54/55 passed matched runtime admission, while the rejected unit abstained. Stable false admission was 0/20, with a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 0.1391, meeting the frozen 0.20 criterion. Across 540 repeated unit-arm rows nested in those 20 clusters, affected clean traffic reduced negative log likelihood by 29.3% relative to cell coverage, a gain of 0.1264 nats per row (cluster-bootstrap 95% interval [0.0593, 0.1918]). Adding mask family and its interaction improved log loss by 0.0015 nats per row (one-sided upper bound 0.0066), below the frozen 0.01 practical-sufficiency margin. A development audit found that exact minimum hitting set and greedy selection chose identical supports in 12/12 scenarios because singleton evidence had resolved the conflicts. The result is a bounded rule for interpreting aggregate agent behavior: first establish exposure, then score change, and abstain when the trace cannot support the claim.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. The reproducibility artifact is linked in the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出：对闭环策略产生的聚合 agent trace 做故障解释前，必须先判定可诊断性——先用 reference-map gate 要求 clean-policy 重复支持，再用 matched runtime gate 要求 clean 与当前流联合支持，两者都通过才进入打分与定位，否则 abstain。在模拟酒店定价 agent 上，55/72（76.4%）regime-component 单元被 reference 准入，54/55 通过 runtime 准入；稳定 false admission 为 0/20（单侧 exact 95% 上界 0.1391，满足冻结的 0.20 判据）。
Motivation: 闭环策略决定访问哪些状态，故障可能因策略很少访问受影响 cell 而在聚合 trace 中完全不可见；直接对聚合 trace 打分或定位会把无暴露的证据当成结论。
Method: 两道门：reference-map gate 要求 clean-policy 的重复支持，matched runtime gate 要求 clean 与当前流的联合支持，均通过后才做信号分析；在 disjoint clean 流上按 physical-component 层面校准 false admission，并用 affected clean traffic（而非 nominal cell coverage）建模检测能力。评测为 frozen one-shot heldout，540 行重复 unit-arm 数据嵌套于 20 个 cluster，用 cluster-bootstrap 给区间。
Result: 55/72（76.4%）regime-component 单元被 reference 准入（对应 20 个物理组件），54/55 通过 matched runtime 准入，1 个被拒单元 abstain；稳定 false admission 0/20，单侧 exact 95% 上界 0.1391，低于冻结的 0.20 判据。affected clean traffic 相对 cell coverage 使负对数似然下降 29.3%，每行增益 0.1264 nats（cluster-bootstrap 95% 区间 [0.0593, 0.1918]）；加入 mask family 及其交互仅改善 0.0015 nats/行（单侧上界 0.0066），低于 0.01 的 practical-sufficiency 余量。开发审计中 exact minimum hitting set 与 greedy selection 在 12/12 场景选出相同支持，因 singleton 证据已解决冲突。
Conclusion: 解释聚合 agent 行为应遵循有界规则：先确立 exposure，再打分变化，trace 不足以支撑结论时 abstain；检测建模应基于受影响的 clean traffic 而非 cell 覆盖率，mask family 的额外收益低于实用充分性阈值。

papers.title: The Tasteful Agent: Measuring and Improving Taste in Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly work on long-horizon tasks, and the decisions they make along the way, such as which hypothesis to test or which implementation to build on, determine the outcome of the whole run. Making these decisions well is becoming a key capability for both engineering and research agents. We refer to the ability to make good long-horizon decisions as the taste of an agent. While existing benchmarks measure the end-to-end success of agents on long-horizon tasks, none of them measures the taste of an agent. To address this problem, we build Taste-Bench, a benchmark of taste questions constructed automatically from trajectories that agents produced in engineering and research tasks. Each question presents a decision fork, a point in a trajectory where multiple directions are available and one of them leads to a better outcome, and the evaluated model chooses among these directions without seeing what happens after the fork. We mine these forks automatically from parallel attempts at the same task and from detours inside a single trajectory, without needing human annotation. We evaluate frontier models on Taste-Bench and find that the best model answers only 59.7% of the questions correctly. We further find that forks whose deciding evidence appears later in the trajectory are much harder for every model, and that a larger reasoning budget does not improve the accuracy. Finally, we show that taste can be trained. We distill the judgment of a teacher that has seen the outcome into a student model, and the student makes better decisions on unseen tasks and improves end-to-end success on held-out SWE-bench Pro tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Taste-Bench：从 agent 在工程与研究任务的轨迹中自动挖出决策分叉（decision fork），让模型在看不到后续结果的情况下选方向，以此度量长程任务中的“品味”。前沿模型最好只答对 59.7%，且决定性证据出现越晚越难、加大推理预算不提升准确率；把见过结果的 teacher 判断蒸馏给 student 后，student 在未见任务上决策更好并在 held-out SWE-bench Pro 上提升端到端成功率。
Motivation: 现有长程 agent 基准只测端到端成功与否，无法度量中途决策质量，而这些决策决定整轮运行结果。
Method: Taste-Bench 从同一任务的多次平行尝试与单条轨迹内的绕路（detour）中自动挖掘 decision fork，无需人工标注；每个问题给出分叉点与多个方向，被评模型在看不到后续的情况下选择。随后把见过结果的 teacher 判断蒸馏进 student 模型。
Result: 前沿模型在 Taste-Bench 上最好仅答对 59.7%；决定性证据在轨迹中出现越晚的分叉对所有模型都明显更难；加大推理预算不提升准确率；蒸馏后的 student 在未见任务上做出更好决策，并在 held-out SWE-bench Pro 任务上提升端到端成功率。
Conclusion: 长程决策品味可被自动度量、且可通过结果监督的蒸馏训练提升；难度主要由证据在轨迹中的位置决定，而非推理预算。

papers.title: LiFR v2: Completion-Augmented Event Propagation for High-Rate Dense Prediction
papers.abstract_en: High-rate dense perception in dynamic environments is limited by the low update rate of RGB cameras, as rapid scene changes can occur between frames. Event cameras offer temporally dense but spatially sparse measurements, complementary to spatially dense RGB observations. Direct fusion cannot fully exploit this complementarity, while event-guided propagation fails on newly appearing or disoccluded regions without valid RGB support. We present LiFR v2, a unified propagation-completion-memory framework for causal anytime and streaming dense prediction from an RGB keyframe and events. LiFR v2 introduces an Event-Guided Completion Module (EGCM) to recover task-relevant representations where propagation is unsupported, and a History Retrieval Module (HRM) to reuse completed representations across successive queries. The framework supports semantic segmentation, monocular depth estimation, and multi-task dense prediction, and we further introduce SHF-Emerge to evaluate rapid object emergence and disocclusion. LiFR v2 achieves 74.37% mIoU on DSEC and 56.13% on SHF-Emerge, improving LiFR-Seg by 1.85 percentage points on the latter, while reducing SHF-Emerge depth RMSE from 1.564 m to 1.118 m over the propagation baseline. It also exceeds 100 FPS for both segmentation and depth, demonstrating accurate and efficient high-rate perception beyond RGB frame rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiFR v2 把 RGB 关键帧与事件相机流统一成传播-补全-记忆框架，用 Event-Guided Completion Module (EGCM) 在传播失效的新出现与去遮挡区域补出任务相关表示，再用 History Retrieval Module (HRM) 跨连续查询复用已补全表示。在 DSEC 上语义分割 mIoU 74.37%，新基准 SHF-Emerge 上 56.13%（比 LiFR-Seg 高 1.85 个百分点），深度 RMSE 从传播基线的 1.564 m 降到 1.118 m，分割与深度均超 100 FPS。
Motivation: RGB 帧率低，帧间快速场景变化跟不上；事件相机时间稠密但空间稀疏，直接融合吃不到互补性，而事件引导的传播在新出现或去遮挡、没有有效 RGB 支持的区域直接失效。
Method: 统一的传播-补全-记忆 (propagation-completion-memory) 框架，做因果 anytime 与流式稠密预测：EGCM 在传播无支持处恢复任务相关表示，HRM 在连续查询间复用已补全表示；支持语义分割、单目深度估计与多任务稠密预测，并提出 SHF-Emerge 基准评测快速物体出现与去遮挡。
Result: DSEC 语义分割 mIoU 74.37%；SHF-Emerge mIoU 56.13%，比 LiFR-Seg 高 1.85 个百分点；SHF-Emerge 深度 RMSE 从传播基线 1.564 m 降到 1.118 m；分割与深度均超过 100 FPS。
Conclusion: 在传播失效处补全并跨查询记忆事件引导的表示，可以在超过 RGB 帧率的同时把快速出现与去遮挡场景的分割和深度精度一起抬高。

papers.title: Latest Exact Match Attention
papers.abstract_en: We introduce latest exact match attention (LEMA), an attention variant for transformers where queries and keys are binarized and each query attends only to the latest exactly matching key. We prove that LEMA transformers with chain of thought can simulate word-RAMs, as was recently shown for the less restrictive rightmost hard attention. In contrast to prior hard attention variants, the restriction to exact matches enables an efficient converse direction: word-RAMs can simulate LEMA transformers at a cost per token independent of the context length. Together, these results yield a close correspondence between the two computational models in terms of both compute and memory. Beyond the theory, we propose a training method for LEMA transformers that handles their non-differentiable operations with a straight-through estimator for the binarization and a soft attention surrogate annealed towards LEMA. On a synthetic associative recall task, LEMA models trained this way use their growing state to store and recall a large number of associations, outperforming gated DeltaNet (GDN) with its fixed state size. As a first scaling test, we train LEMA language models with up to 834 million parameters. They match softmax transformers of around half their size in loss and, on repeated rare phrases and a needle-retrieval task, remain behind softmax transformers but recall across longer distances than GDN models of comparable size. Finally, we implement dictionary-based inference for LEMA transformers and show constant generation speed comparable to GDN despite their growing state, with the dictionaries residing in main memory rather than VRAM. Code is available at https://github.com/moritzbroe/latest_exact_match_attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LEMA 注意力：query 与 key 二值化，每个 query 只关注最新一个完全匹配的 key。证明 LEMA+CoT 可模拟 word-RAM，且 word-RAM 反向模拟 LEMA 每 token 代价与上下文长度无关；训练用二值化 straight-through 估计与退火到 LEMA 的软注意力代理。834M 参数 LEMA 语言模型损失匹配约一半规模的 softmax 模型，长距离召回优于同规模 GDN，但重复短语与 needle 检索仍落后 softmax。
Motivation: 硬注意力变体此前只有单向模拟结果，缺少从 word-RAM 到注意力的高效反向模拟；同时固定状态的线性注意力（如 DeltaNet）在长距离联想召回上受限，需要一种状态可增长且推理开销可控的注意力机制。
Method: LEMA 将 query/key 二值化并只允许关注最新精确匹配的 key；理论上给出 LEMA+CoT 模拟 word-RAM 与 word-RAM 反向模拟 LEMA（每 token 代价与上下文长度无关）的双向对应。训练用二值化的 straight-through estimator 加上向 LEMA 退火的软注意力代理；推理用基于字典的实现，字典放主存而非 VRAM。
Result: 在合成联想召回任务上，LEMA 借助增长状态存储并召回大量关联，优于固定状态的 gated DeltaNet (GDN)。训练了参数量最高 834M 的 LEMA 语言模型：损失匹配约其一半规模的 softmax transformer；在重复罕见短语与 needle-retrieval 任务上仍落后 softmax，但比同规模 GDN 召回更长距离。字典化推理实现与 GDN 相当的恒定生成速度，尽管状态不断增长。
Conclusion: 精确匹配限制使硬注意力与 word-RAM 在计算和内存上形成紧密双向对应，同时让状态可增长的注意力在保持恒定生成速度的前提下取得比固定状态线性注意力更长的召回距离，但在重复短语与 needle 检索上尚不及 softmax。

papers.title: When Point Clouds Outperform Pixels: Rethinking Zero-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection commonly assumes that RGB and point cloud modalities are equally reliable and can contribute uniformly to anomaly localization. We challenge this assumption. Using a set of recently proposed stringent metrics that penalize false anomaly responses in normal regions, we find that point clouds are substantially more reliable than RGB under zero-shot category shift. Motivated by this observation, we propose WOOPS (\textbf{W}hen P\textbf{o}int Cl\textbf{o}uds Out\textbf{p}erform Pixel\textbf{s}), a reliability-aware zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection framework. To strengthen the more reliable geometric modality, we design a Multi-view Information Decoupling module to suppress heterogeneous information from multi-view point cloud projections and enhance point cloud feature quality. To avoid unconditional fusion, we further introduce a Modality Reliability Calibration module to adaptively calibrate modality contributions according to their reliability. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves the best or competitive performance under the new metrics in both unimodal and multimodal settings. Further analysis demonstrates that point cloud information also improves RGB-only inference, while ablations verify the effectiveness of both modules. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 零样本多模态异常检测中 RGB 与点云被默认同等可靠，作者用惩罚正常区域误报的严格指标发现类别偏移下点云远比 RGB 可靠，并据此提出 WOOPS：用 Multi-view Information Decoupling 提升点云特征质量，用 Modality Reliability Calibration 按可靠性自适应分配模态权重。在单模态与多模态设定下均取得新指标上的最优或有竞争力表现，且点云信息还能反哺纯 RGB 推理。
Motivation: 零样本多模态异常检测普遍假设 RGB 与点云同等可靠、均匀贡献定位，但在零样本类别偏移 (category shift) 下该假设失效，导致无条件融合引入不可靠模态的误报。
Method: 提出 WOOPS 框架：Multi-view Information Decoupling 模块抑制多视角点云投影中的异构信息以增强点云特征；Modality Reliability Calibration 模块按各模态可靠性自适应校准融合权重，避免无条件融合；评测采用一组惩罚正常区域误报的新严格指标，覆盖单模态与多模态设定。
Result: 在新指标下，单模态与多模态设定均取得最优或有竞争力表现；进一步分析显示点云信息可提升纯 RGB 推理，消融实验验证两个模块各自有效。
Conclusion: 零样本类别偏移下点云比 RGB 更可靠，按可靠性而非均匀权重做多模态融合是更合理的设计；代码将于录用后发布。

papers.title: Evaluating Accuracy and Probabilistic Reliability of Zero-Shot Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) promise a paradigm shift toward zero-shot forecasting by eliminating task-specific training. However, existing works often overlook trade-offs between predictive accuracy and probabilistic calibration. This paper presents a benchmark study of six TSFMs evaluated on energy, traffic, and financial datasets. We contrast their performance against statistical baselines and a supervised DL model. The study reveals that while TSFMs outperform statistical methods and supervised models, they are subject to a fundamental trade-off between point accuracy and probabilistic reliability. Specifically, xLSTM architectures provide robust probabilistic calibration across horizons. In contrast, patch-based transformers offer competitive accuracy but face calibration issues at long horizons, while transformer-based models exhibit context saturation points for optimal zero-shot reasoning. These findings offer evidence-based guidance for balancing generalization and uncertainty quantification in real-world deployments.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 30th European Conference on Advances in Databases and Information Systems (ADBIS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对六个时序基础模型 (TSFM) 在能源、交通、金融数据集上做零样本 (zero-shot) 基准，对照统计基线与有监督 DL 模型，发现 TSFM 点精度更高但存在精度与概率可靠性的根本权衡：xLSTM 架构跨预测步长保持稳健的概率校准，patch-based transformer 精度有竞争力却在长步长上校准失效，transformer 类模型存在上下文饱和点。
Motivation: 现有 TSFM 研究常忽略预测精度与概率校准 (calibration) 之间的权衡，而零样本部署需要同时给出可信的不确定性。
Method: 对六个 TSFM 做基准评测，数据集为 energy、traffic、financial，对照统计基线和一个有监督深度学习模型，比较点精度与概率可靠性（校准）两个维度。
Result: TSFM 整体优于统计方法与有监督模型；xLSTM 在各预测步长上给出稳健的概率校准；patch-based transformer 精度有竞争力但长步长校准出问题；transformer 类模型存在上下文饱和点。
Conclusion: 零样本 TSFM 的泛化与不确定性量化需按架构取舍：要校准可靠性选 xLSTM，要精度选 patch-based transformer 并注意长步长校准。

papers.title: A Lightweight Plastic-Memory Framework for Graph Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Graph Incremental Learning has garnered increasing attention as dynamic graph data continues to emerge across diverse fields. Conventional approaches primarily address catastrophic forgetting by preserving node-related knowledge through replay or distillation techniques; however, they often incur high computational costs and inefficiency. This issue is further exacerbated in real-world scenarios where labeled data for new classes is scarce. In this paper, we propose a novel lightweight plastic-memory framework specifically designed for few-shot incremental learning on graphs. The core idea of our framework is the construction of a plastic-memory module that evolves over time, continuously updating and expanding its memory to accommodate new classes while retaining previously learned knowledge. In contrast to existing techniques, our memory module is both lightweight and effective, featuring an innovative evolving micro-clustering structure that dynamically updates representations of class prototypes, sub-prototypes, and their interaction weights. Building on this memory module, we introduce a memory-driven meta-learning framework that enhances adaptability to new tasks in its inner loop while maintaining stability for earlier tasks in the outer loop. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the framework's superior performance in balancing stability for old knowledge and adaptability to new knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向图上少样本类增量学习的轻量 plastic-memory 框架：用随时间演化的微聚类结构动态更新类原型、子原型及其交互权重，再叠加内环适配新任务、外环保持旧任务稳定的记忆驱动元学习。在四个基准数据集上，该框架在旧知识稳定性与新知识适应性的平衡上表现优于已有技术。
Motivation: 图上的类增量学习中，回放与蒸馏类方法为抑制灾难性遗忘付出高计算代价且效率低；当新类标注数据稀缺时问题更严重。
Method: 构建 plastic-memory 模块：以演化式微聚类 (evolving micro-clustering) 结构持续更新并扩展记忆，动态维护类原型、子原型与交互权重；其上搭建记忆驱动元学习，内环针对新任务做适应、外环维持对早期任务的稳定。
Result: 在四个基准数据集上的实验显示，该框架在平衡旧知识稳定性与新知识适应性方面优于现有技术；摘要给出定性结论，未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 轻量的演化记忆加双环元学习，可以在少样本增量场景下同时保住旧类与学好新类，替代高开销的回放与蒸馏路线。

papers.title: Statistical Gains from Looped Estimation under Parameter Budgets
papers.abstract_en: Growing memory demands in artificial intelligence motivate learning with fewer trainable parameters. We ask whether a looped estimator, which repeatedly applies one fitted operator with parameters shared across iterations, can improve statistical accuracy under a common parameter budget. Its conventional untied counterpart uses separate parameters at each iteration. For general likelihood models, we establish an upper bound on squared Hellinger risk for looped sieve maximum likelihood and a minimax lower bound over the tuned untied family. These bounds reveal a parameter--iteration--accuracy tradeoff: repeated computation can improve approximation without adding parameters, while increasing computational cost and fitted-class complexity. For targets of known Hölder smoothness, looped residual feedforward networks and a specified post-layer-normalized Transformer attain the minimax polynomial rate up to logarithmic factors with a fixed number of bounded real parameters. At sufficiently large fixed budgets, looped worst-case risk vanishes as sample size grows, whereas optimal worst-case untied risk remains bounded away from zero. Under specified growing-budget conditions, the loop-to-untied risk ratio also tends to zero. Gaussian and Laplace regression, binary response, and energy-based density estimation illustrate the theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一参数预算下，参数共享的 looped estimator（循环估计器）反复调用同一拟合算子，其 worst-case Hellinger 风险随样本量增长趋于零，而同预算下最优 untied 对应物的最坏风险仍被正的下界卡住；在给定的增长预算条件下 loop-to-untied 风险比也趋于零。对已知 Hölder 光滑度的目标，looped residual feedforward network 与指定的 post-layer-normalized Transformer 以固定个数的有界实参数达到 minimax 多项式速率（差对数因子）。
Motivation: AI 模型参数量膨胀带来存储压力，需要在固定参数预算下提高统计精度；但 untied 迭代（每步独立参数）在同预算下拟合类受限，最坏风险不收敛到零。
Method: 对一般 likelihood 模型给出 looped sieve maximum likelihood 的平方 Hellinger 风险上界，并对调好的 untied 族给出 minimax 下界，由此刻画 parameter–iteration–accuracy 权衡；构造 looped residual feedforward network 与指定 post-layer-normalized Transformer 达到 minimax 速率，并用 Gaussian 与 Laplace 回归、binary response、energy-based density estimation 说明理论。
Result: 在充分大的固定预算下 looped worst-case 风险随样本量增长趋于零，而最优 untied worst-case 风险保持远离零；在指定的增长预算条件下 loop-to-untied 风险比趋于零；对已知 Hölder 光滑度目标，两类 looped 网络以固定个数有界实参数达到 minimax 多项式速率（差对数因子）。
Conclusion: 重复计算可以在不增加参数的前提下改善逼近，代价是计算量与拟合类复杂度上升；固定参数预算下 looped 结构在统计精度上系统性优于 untied。

papers.title: Disentangling Heterogeneous Traffic Dynamics for Multi-Step Traffic Forecasting via Adaptive Spectral Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Accurate multi-step traffic forecasting remains challenging because observed traffic signals contain heterogeneous temporal dynamics with different characteristics and levels of predictability. Existing approaches typically model these dynamics within a unified representation or rely on predefined decomposition rules, which may limit their ability to flexibly separate persistent patterns from rapidly varying fluctuations. To address this issue, we propose the Adaptive Decomposition Network (ADNet), a component-specific forecasting framework that adaptively disentangles traffic dynamics into dominant and residual components. ADNet introduces a learnable complementary spectral decomposition mechanism that determines the contribution of each frequency bin to the two components. Unlike hard frequency partitioning, every frequency bin can contribute to both components with different learned proportions, allowing the decomposition to be optimized jointly with the forecasting objective. The reconstructed components are then modeled by two dedicated spatiotemporal forecasting branches, and their predictions are integrated to generate the final multi-step forecast. Experiments on the Alameda and Orange regions of the TraffiDent dataset show that ADNet achieves the best performance in 20 of the 24 reported region-horizon-metric comparisons, with particularly clear gains at longer forecasting horizons. Capacity-controlled ablation experiments further show that the learnable decomposition substantially outperforms a fixed decomposition and provides additional improvements beyond the dual-branch architecture alone. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of adaptive decomposition and component-specific modeling for multi-step traffic forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出交通多步预报框架 ADNet，用可学习的互补谱分解把异质交通动态自适应拆成 dominant 与 residual 两个分量，每个频率 bin 都可按学到的比例同时贡献两分量，再由两条专用时空分支分别预报后融合。在 TraffiDent 的 Alameda 与 Orange 区域上，24 项区域-时效-指标对比中 20 项取得最优，长预报时效增益更明显。
Motivation: 交通信号混杂持续性模式与快速波动，现有方法要么用统一表示建模、要么依赖预定义分解规则，难以灵活分离不同可预报性的动态。
Method: ADNet 的核心是可学习互补谱分解机制，为每个频率 bin 学习其对 dominant/residual 两分量的贡献比例，与预报目标联合优化；重构后的两分量各由一条专用时空预报分支建模，预测再融合成多步预报。
Result: 在 TraffiDent 数据集的 Alameda 与 Orange 区域上，24 项 region-horizon-metric 对比中 ADNet 在 20 项取得最佳，长预报时效上优势尤其明显；容量受控的消融显示可学习分解显著优于固定分解，并在双分支架构之上带来额外提升。
Conclusion: 自适应分解加分量专用建模对多步交通预报有效，可学习的软频率划分比固定频率切分更关键。

papers.title: Graded Representation Theory of Equivariant Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear activations can create equivariant interactions between irreducible representations that linear maps cannot. We use the Gaussian degree decomposition to extend ordinary polynomial degree to such nonlinear maps, and prove that for a fixed coordinatewise equivariant layer each degree factors into a polynomial determined by the linear maps and a scalar determined by the activation. This separates three distinct obstructions, coming from symmetry, coordinates, and activation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Gaussian degree 分解把多项式次数概念推广到含非线性激活的等变层，证明固定 coordinatewise 等变层下每个次数可分解为线性映射决定的多项式因子与激活决定的标量因子，从而把对称性、坐标、激活三类障碍彼此分离。
Motivation: 非线性激活能产生线性映射无法实现的不可约表示间等变交互，而普通多项式次数无法刻画这类非线性等变层，三类障碍也混在一起难以区分。
Method: 采用 Gaussian degree 分解将 ordinary polynomial degree 扩展到非线性映射；对固定 coordinatewise 等变层证明每个次数分解为线性映射决定的多项式与激活决定的标量两部分。
Result: 证明了固定 coordinatewise 等变层中每个次数可分解为线性映射决定的多项式与激活决定的标量，并由此分离出来自 symmetry、coordinates、activation 的三类不同障碍。
Conclusion: 非线性等变层的次数结构可被完全分解，三类障碍彼此独立，可分别分析。

papers.title: TRACE: Trajectory Representation and Consistency Estimation for AI-Generated Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative video models have enabled the synthesis of visually realistic content, posing significant challenges to synthetic video detection. Existing detectors often rely on appearance artifacts, semantic inconsistencies, and temporal patterns that may be generator-specific, limitating generalization to unseen synthesis models. We investigate whether responses to a pretrained generative model provide more transferable forensic cues. Our key observation is that real and AI-generated videos exhibit distinct \emph{velocity responses} under a pretrained Flow Matching video model. This distinction persists when different pretrained video-generation backbones are used as probes, suggesting that velocity responses offer transferable forensic signals beyond visual artificts. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{TRACE} (\emph{\underline{T}rajectory \underline{R}epresentation \underline{a}nd \underline{C}onsistency \underline{E}stimation}), a generation-process-aware framework for AI-generated video detection. TRACE leverages a pretrained video DiT as a velocity-field probe to extract representations at multiple flow time points, and models cross-frame consistency through velocity differences between adjacent frames. We further introduce a \emph{Real-Centered Trajectory Optimization} objective that encourages generator-invariant representation learning. Extensive experiments on AIGVDBench demonstrate that TRACE generalizes effectively across diverse generators, substantially outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods on unseen open- and closed-source video generation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 用预训练 Flow Matching 视频 DiT 作 velocity-field probe，在多个 flow 时间点提取表征并以相邻帧速度差建模跨帧一致性，配合 Real-Centered Trajectory Optimization 学生成器不变特征。真实与 AI 生成视频在 probe 下呈现可迁移的速度响应差异，在 AIGVDBench 上对未见过的开源与闭源生成器显著优于既有 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有检测器依赖外观伪影、语义不一致和生成器特定的时序模式，遇到未见过的合成模型时泛化受限。
Method: 以预训练视频 DiT 为 velocity-field probe，在多个 flow 时间点抽取表征，用相邻帧速度差刻画跨帧一致性；再用 Real-Centered Trajectory Optimization 目标鼓励生成器不变的表征学习。
Result: 在 AIGVDBench 上，TRACE 对未见过的开源与闭源视频生成模型显著优于先前 SOTA 方法；换用不同预训练视频生成 backbone 作 probe 时，真实与 AI 生成视频的速度响应差异依然存在。
Conclusion: 预训练生成模型的速度响应是比视觉伪影更可迁移的取证信号，按生成过程建模轨迹一致性即可跨生成器检测 AI 生成视频。

papers.title: Video-HopChain: Multi-Hop Questions and Confidence-Gated Exploration for Video Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: HopChain has shown on still images that multi-hop data synthesis improves vision-language reasoning, because long chain-of-thought reasoning exposes errors that compound across steps, while most data used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) rarely demands a chain of visual evidence, so these weaknesses are likely to stay unexposed. We observe the same problem in video, where this framework has not yet been explored. We therefore build Video-HopChain, a dataset of 22,550 multi-hop video questions over 13,378 videos, together with a held-out benchmark of 1,000 questions. Each question chains three to six yes/no questions about moments in one video, and each yields one of two integers depending on its answer. The final answer is the sum of these integers, so an exact match on that sum gives the verifiable reward that RLVR needs. We first train Qwen3-VL-8B with GRPO on a standard video dataset, and a second stage on Video-HopChain then raises the mean over eight video understanding and reasoning benchmarks from 55.4 to 57.9 and improves every one of them. Training on such a dataset, however, exposes a known limitation of GRPO: its learning signal comes from the reward variance within a group, so hard questions whose rollouts are all incorrect and easy questions whose rollouts are all correct both leave the group with no gradient. To recover these groups at the same compute budget, we introduce Confidence-Gated Exploration (CGE). With 8 rollouts per question, CGE samples the first 4 as usual. If these 4 are either all correct or all incorrect, it samples the last 4 with the policy's most confident token masked inside the reasoning span, and removes the masked positions from the loss while all 8 rollouts enter the advantage. With CGE, the mean rises further to 59.3. We release the dataset, the checkpoint, and the data generation and training code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video-HopChain 构造 22,550 条多跳视频问答（13,378 个视频）加 1,000 题留出基准，每题把 3–6 个 yes/no 子问题的答案整数求和作为可验证奖励，供 RLVR 训练。在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上先用 GRPO 训标准视频数据、再训 Video-HopChain，八个视频理解与推理基准均值从 55.4 升到 59.3；其中第二阶段本身升到 57.9，引入 Confidence-Gated Exploration (CGE) 后再升到 59.3。
Motivation: RLVR 训练所用数据很少要求链式视觉证据，长链推理中逐步累积的错误因此暴露不出来；HopChain 只在静态图像上验证过，视频领域尚未探索。
Method: 数据侧：每题在同一个视频内串联 3–6 个关于片段的 yes/no 问题，各产出一个整数，最终答案为求和，精确匹配即得可验证奖励。训练侧：Qwen3-VL-8B 先用 GRPO 在标准视频数据集上训练，再在 Video-HopChain 上做第二阶段；针对 GRPO 组内奖励无方差（全对或全错）导致无梯度的问题，提出 Confidence-Gated Exploration：每题 8 条 rollout，前 4 条正常采样，若全对或全错则补采后 4 条，采样时遮蔽推理段中最自信的 token，遮蔽位置从 loss 中剔除但 8 条 rollout 全部进入 advantage。
Result: 第二阶段训练使八个视频理解与推理基准的均值从 55.4 升到 57.9，且每一个基准都提升；加入 CGE 后均值进一步升到 59.3。数据集规模为 22,550 条多跳问题、13,378 个视频、1,000 题留出基准，CGE 设定为每题 8 条 rollout（前 4 正常、后 4 遮蔽采样）。
Conclusion: 多跳可验证奖励数据加组内无方差时的置信度门控探索，能在同一算力预算下继续抬高视频推理模型的 RLVR 表现；作者公开数据集、checkpoint 与数据生成/训练代码。

papers.title: Reading Right, Answering Wrong: How Visual Configuration Changes Affect Evidence Use in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks such as visual question answering, yet small image resizes can turn correct answers into errors. We investigate whether changes in visual configuration, such as image tiling and token arrangement, contribute to this instability. Across seven checkpoints and four benchmarks, equally small resizes cause more correctness flips when they switch configurations. Surprisingly, in over half of these cases, models answer the question incorrectly but can still read the correct answer when told what to read. Furthermore, attention interventions in LLaVA-NeXT suggest that configuration changes can weaken the use of readable information during answering. We therefore guide models using field cues and their own transcriptions. With annotation assistance, these forms of guidance together correct 97.2% of errors with readable information. These findings show that configuration changes can affect how models use information they can still read.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLM 在图像缩放后答错，主因不是读不出证据而是配置切换（tiling、token 排列）破坏了对可读信息的使用：七个 checkpoint、四个 benchmark 上，等幅缩放只要切换配置就更易翻转正确性；超过一半的翻转案例中模型答错却在被告知读什么时仍能读出正确答案。用 field cues 加模型自身转录做引导，在有可读信息的错误上可纠正 97.2%。
Motivation: VQA 中极小的图像 resize 就能把对答案变错，但不稳定的来源是视觉信息真的丢失，还是配置变化破坏了模型对仍可读证据的使用，此前不清楚。
Method: 在七个 checkpoint、四个 benchmark 上比较等幅 resize 在切换与不切换视觉配置（image tiling、token arrangement）时的正确性翻转；对翻转案例检查模型能否在被告知读什么时读出正确答案；在 LLaVA-NeXT 上做 attention intervention 定位配置变化对可读信息使用的影响；再用 field cues 与模型自身 transcription 引导模型。
Result: 等幅 resize 在切换配置时造成更多正确性翻转；超过一半的翻转案例中模型答错但仍能读出正确答案；LLaVA-NeXT 的 attention intervention 表明配置变化会削弱回答时对可读信息的使用；field cues 与自身转录联合引导在含可读信息的错误上纠正 97.2%。
Conclusion: 配置变化影响的是模型如何使用它仍能读出的信息，而非能否读出；因此用模型自己的转录加 field cues 做引导即可挽回绝大多数这类错误。

papers.title: Towards Omni-dimensional GUI Agent Navigation with Masked Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Graphical User Interface (GUI) Agents autonomously interact with software to fulfill user requests, where GUI navigation stands out as the most critical and challenging capability. Mastering this capability demands a complex synergy of step-wise decision-making, state-action alignment, and long-horizon planning. While directly mixing these corresponding navigation tasks seems intuitive to simultaneously acquire these skills, such a direct combination is severely bottlenecked by inconsistent optimization objectives and profound data heterogeneity. To overcome these barriers, we propose the MaP (stands for ``\textbf{M}asked Tr\textbf{a}jectory \textbf{P}rediction''), a unified framework that seamlessly harmonizes divergent GUI navigation tasks. By modeling multi-turn GUI interactions as a trajectory and defining training objectives through component masking and prediction, MaP shifts the optimization from task-specific marginal distributions to a consistent objective. Furthermore, to handle the data heterogeneity across multiple navigation tasks, we design a role-aware adapter learning module that dynamically routes each token to a specialized representation space. Extensive experiments on five representative GUI navigation benchmarks demonstrate that MaP effectively mitigates gradient conflicts and significantly outperforms the direct mixture training, establishing a robust paradigm for multi-task GUI navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaP（Masked Trajectory Prediction）把多轮 GUI 交互建模为轨迹，用组件掩码与预测统一不同导航任务的训练目标，并以 role-aware adapter 按角色把 token 路由到专门表示空间。在五个 GUI 导航基准上，MaP 缓解了梯度冲突并显著优于直接混合训练。
Motivation: GUI 导航需要步级决策、状态-动作对齐与长程规划的协同，但直接混合这些任务会因优化目标不一致与数据异质性而互相拖累。
Method: 将多轮 GUI 交互表示为轨迹，通过 component masking 与 prediction 定义训练目标，把优化从任务特定边际分布转为一致目标；再用 role-aware adapter learning 模块动态把每个 token 路由到专门表示空间，以处理跨任务数据异质性。
Result: 在五个代表性 GUI 导航基准上，MaP 有效缓解梯度冲突，并显著优于直接混合训练 (direct mixture training)。
Conclusion: 掩码轨迹预测加角色感知适配器可作为多任务 GUI 导航的稳健范式，前提是让不同任务共享一致的优化目标而非简单混训。

summary_sections.conclusion: 掩码轨迹预测加角色感知适配器可作为多任务 GUI 导航的稳健范式，前提是让不同任务共享一致的优化目标而非简单混训。

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Action Model Learning under Partial Observability
papers.abstract_en: AI planning studies how an agent can reach a goal by executing a sequence of actions. To plan correctly, the agent needs an action model describing when each action can be executed and how it changes the world. Constructing such models by hand requires domain expertise, and can be costly and error-prone. Action models can instead be learned from available data using existing neurosymbolic approaches, but they currently assume access to complete traces of fully observable images . These approaches fail to learn action models under partial observability where some of the images might not be present or are not fully informative of the current state of the world. Hence, this paper proposes NeSyAM, a novel neurosymbolic modeling paradigm for action model learning under partial observability. In addition, the paper presents a unified variational framework for theoretically analysing the limitations of existing methods compared to our proposed approach. NeSyAM is then tested extensively on six visual planning domains and three observation regimes to show it consistently recovers relevant parts of the true action model under partial observability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeSyAM 把动作模型学习 (action model learning) 扩展到部分可观测场景：图像轨迹缺失或不足以表征状态时，仍用神经符号方式恢复动作的前置条件与效果。在六个视觉规划域、三种观测机制下测试，能一致恢复真实动作模型的相关部分，并给出统一变分框架分析既有方法的局限。
Motivation: 现有神经符号动作模型学习假设完整轨迹与完全可观测图像，一旦图像缺失或信息不足就失效，而手工建模又昂贵易错。
Method: 提出 NeSyAM 这一神经符号建模范式，配合统一变分 (unified variational) 框架，从理论上对比既有方法与该方法在部分可观测下的可学性边界；在六个视觉规划域、三种观测机制上测试。
Result: 在六个视觉规划域与三种观测机制的测试中，NeSyAM 一致地恢复真实动作模型的相关部分；变分框架给出既有方法相对该方法的局限分析。
Conclusion: 部分可观测下动作模型仍可由神经符号方法学到，且其局限可用统一变分框架刻画。

papers.title: The Limits of Simulated Societies: How Post-Training and Survey Fine-Tuning Erase Cross-Cultural Variance
papers.abstract_en: Using large language models (LLMs) to simulate diverse human populations has the potential to transform many aspects of computational social science, yet many evaluations score the average response rather than the spread of opinion within real groups. Here, we develop a diagnostic framework that measures point accuracy alongside dispersion retention, the ratio of predicted to human standard deviation ($\dr$), on 10{,}000 respondent--question pairs from the World Values Survey (WVS) spanning twelve countries and six continents. We evaluate eleven zero-shot language models and five variants fine-tuned on WVS data with SFT, DPO, and GRPO. We identify a failure mode we term \textit{consensus collapse}, where alignment training compresses outputs toward one stereotype per group. Along the post-training trajectory from the Llama~3.1 70B base to the Tulu~3 checkpoints, the first stage, supervised instruction tuning, removes half of the spread with minimal accuracy gain ($\dr$ 1.22 to 0.59; accuracy $+0.9$ points), the later stages do not restore it, and a gap opens between WEIRD and non-WEIRD countries that survey fine-tuning then deepens while pursuing higher point accuracy. The most accurate model (Tulu~3 70B-DPO fine-tuned on WVS, 57.9\%) keeps half the human spread overall ($\dr = 0.50$) and 11\% of it for Nigeria, against 0.70--0.87 for WEIRD countries. Raising the sampling temperature to 1.0 leaves the Wasserstein-1 distance ($\wone$) to human distributions unchanged for both fine-tuned DPO models, and GRPO on Qwen~3.5 9B does not restore the spread under either an accuracy reward or a distribution-shaped reward. Mixing the aligned model with an unaligned prior raises $\dr$ from 0.51 to 0.62 on a held-out split but leaves Nigeria at 0.36. Point accuracy alone therefore misjudges these simulators, and current post-training trades diversity for consensus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 10,000 个受访者-题目对（World Values Survey，12 国 6 大洲）诊断 LLM 人口模拟：除点准确率外还测 dispersion retention（预测与人类标准差之比 dr）。发现对齐后训练产生 consensus collapse——SFT 把分布离散度砍掉一半（dr 1.22→0.59，准确率仅 +0.9 点），后续阶段不恢复，WEIRD 与非 WEIRD 国家差距被 survey fine-tuning 进一步拉大；最准的 Tulu 3 70B-DPO（57.9%）整体 dr 仅 0.50、尼日利亚 11%，升温到 1.0 或 GRPO 奖励都无法恢复离散度。
Motivation: 用 LLM 模拟真实人群时，评测普遍只算平均响应的点准确率，丢掉了组内意见的离散程度，导致对齐训练压缩观点多样性也看不出来。
Method: 提出同时度量点准确率与 dispersion retention（预测/人类标准差之比 dr）的诊断框架，在 WVS 的 10,000 个受访者-题目对上评测 11 个零样本模型和 5 个用 SFT、DPO、GRPO 在 WVS 上微调的变体；沿 Llama 3.1 70B base 到 Tulu 3 各 checkpoint 追踪后训练轨迹，并用 Wasserstein-1 距离衡量预测分布与人类分布的差异。
Result: SFT 阶段 dr 从 1.22 降到 0.59 而准确率只 +0.9 点，后续阶段不恢复；最准模型 Tulu 3 70B-DPO（WVS 微调）准确率 57.9%，整体 dr=0.50，尼日利亚仅 0.11，WEIRD 国家为 0.70–0.87；采样温度升到 1.0 对两个 DPO 微调模型的 W1 距离无变化，Qwen 3.5 9B 上用准确率奖励或分布形状奖励的 GRPO 都不恢复离散度；与未对齐先验混合使 held-out 上 dr 从 0.51 升到 0.62，但尼日利亚仍只有 0.36。
Conclusion: 点准确率单独会误判这类人口模拟器，当前后训练用观点多样性换共识；混合未对齐先验只能部分缓解，非 WEIRD 国家的意见离散度仍被严重压缩。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Minimal Recurrent Behavioral Memory for Imitation under Partial Observability
papers.abstract_en: What is the least recurrent memory needed to reproduce a specified expert under partial observability? The instantaneous requirement is the conditional entropy of the expert's behavioral quotient, but recurrence must also preserve distinctions that future observations will not restore before use. We characterize this minimal recurrent behavioral memory by a compatibility relation: under transitivity its classes attain the exact minimum, while the general case is an entropy minimization over closed compatible state assignments, with exact certificates on finite instances. A sole-carrier measurement protocol separates behavioral sufficiency, excess code rate, and information carried by observations or other memory paths; experimental bit requirements refer to the induced symbolic behavioral model under the stated occupancy. Across manipulation tasks, learned code rates remain near zero- and two-bit requirements as hidden modes grow to $512$, and anticipatory memory follows a $2\to1\to0$ requirement despite zero instantaneous demand during waiting. Learning this representation remains difficult: event-agnostic future-behavior supervision yields $36/40$ sufficient seeds with one frozen configuration and improves the longest-horizon pixel setting from $0/8$ to $6/8$ sufficient held-out seeds (closed-loop success from $0.08$ to $0.57$). On unmodified community benchmarks, the protocol certifies delay-independent requirements, which sufficient codes match at mid-delay. The supervision aids commitment but can induce predictive surplus; annealing it lets imitation and rate training reduce that surplus, separating the information-theoretic target from the ability to learn it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文刻画部分可观测下复现专家所需的最小循环行为记忆：瞬时需求是专家行为商的条件熵，还需保留未来观测在使用前来不及恢复的区分，用兼容关系刻画，传递性下其等价类达到精确最小，一般情形化为闭兼容状态赋值上的熵最小化并给出有限实例的精确证书。在操作任务上，隐藏模式增至 512 时学习码率仍贴近 0 与 2 bit 需求，预期记忆按 2→1→0 递减而等待期瞬时需求为 0；事件无关的未来行为监督把最长视野像素设定的充分种子从 0/8 提到 6/8，闭环成功率从 0.08 提到 0.57。
Motivation: 部分可观测下复现专家到底需要多少循环记忆，缺少可计算的最小性刻画：瞬时需求与未来观测来不及恢复的区分是两类不同约束，且信息论目标与可学习性常被混为一谈。
Method: 用兼容关系刻画最小循环行为记忆，传递性下取等价类，一般情形在闭兼容状态赋值上做熵最小化并给有限实例精确证书；提出 sole-carrier 测量协议分离行为充分性、超额码率与观测/其他记忆路径携带的信息；用事件无关的未来行为监督辅助学习，并对其退火让模仿与码率训练削减预测性过剩。
Result: 隐藏模式增至 512 时学习码率贴近 0 与 2 bit 需求，预期记忆按 2→1→0 需求演化而等待期瞬时需求为 0；事件无关监督在一种冻结配置下给出 36/40 个充分种子，最长视野像素设定从 0/8 提到 6/8 个充分留出种子，闭环成功率 0.08→0.57；在未改动的社区基准上协议认证需求与延迟无关，充分码在中等延迟处与之匹配。
Conclusion: 最小循环行为记忆可由兼容关系精确刻画并可测，信息论目标与学习能力必须分开：监督帮助承诺但会引入预测性过剩，退火后模仿与码率训练能削减它。

papers.title: Syndrome, Synergy, and Safety: Structured Reasoning and Knowledge-Driven Alignment for TCM Prescription Generation
papers.abstract_en: Applying large language models to Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) prescription generation reveals three clinically critical gaps: models produce end-to-end mappings without auditable reasoning following the li-fa-fang-yao paradigm (SR Gap), treat each encounter in isolation without follow-up adjustment via sui zheng jia jian (LA Gap), and fail to enforce absolute contraindication rules such as Shi Ba Fan (SC Gap). We propose a progressive four-stage framework (SFT $\to$ PG-CoT $\to$ Dynamic $\to$ K-RL) that addresses each gap: PG-CoT constrains CoT distillation under the li-fa-fang-yao paradigm to produce auditable diagnostic chains, Dynamic SFT models patient trajectories with explicit transition reasoning, and K-RL encodes deterministic pharmacological rules as rule-based DPO preference signals. Across 12 fine-tuned models and 6 zero-shot baselines, our framework substantially improves prescription quality over zero-shot baselines---with a 7B model (Mistral-7B) surpassing zero-shot GPT-5 on all three TCM evaluation metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出四阶段渐进框架（SFT → PG-CoT → Dynamic → K-RL）对齐 LLM 的中药处方生成：PG-CoT 在 li-fa-fang-yao 范式下约束 CoT 蒸馏产出可审计诊断链，Dynamic SFT 显式建模随症加减的患者轨迹转移，K-RL 把十八反等确定性药理规则编码为 rule-based DPO 偏好信号。在 12 个微调模型与 6 个 zero-shot 基线上，7B 的 Mistral-7B 在全部三项中医评价指标上超过 zero-shot GPT-5。
Motivation: LLM 开处方存在三个临床关键缺口：端到端映射缺少可审计推理（SR Gap）、每次就诊孤立处理而无随症加减的随访调整（LA Gap）、无法强制执行十八反这类绝对禁忌规则（SC Gap）。
Method: 四阶段渐进训练框架：SFT → PG-CoT → Dynamic → K-RL。PG-CoT 在 li-fa-fang-yao 范式约束下做 CoT 蒸馏；Dynamic SFT 用显式转移推理建模患者轨迹；K-RL 将确定性药理规则编码为 rule-based DPO 偏好信号。评测覆盖 12 个微调模型与 6 个 zero-shot 基线。
Result: 在 12 个微调模型与 6 个 zero-shot 基线的对比中，该框架相对 zero-shot 基线显著提升处方质量；7B 的 Mistral-7B 在全部三项中医评价指标上超过 zero-shot GPT-5。
Conclusion: 把可审计推理、轨迹级随访调整和硬规则偏好对齐分阶段注入，能让 7B 级开源模型在中医处方生成上越过 zero-shot GPT-5。

papers.title: Dual Covariance Gaussian Splatting SLAM: Decoupling Rendering and Registration for Robust Real-Time Tracking
papers.abstract_en: ICP-based 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) SLAM tracks in real time by registering incoming frames against map Gaussians, using each primitive's covariance for both rendering and registration. These two uses place conflicting demands on one covariance. The mapper shapes it to minimize photometric error, often flattening it against surfaces, while robust registration typically benefits from measurement uncertainty. We propose a dual-covariance parameterization. Each Gaussian keeps a single mean but holds two covariances: a rendering covariance optimized by the mapper, and a tracking covariance derived from an RGB-D sensor noise model. We further use the tracking covariances as Gaussian anchors for image corners, providing constraints in directions where depth geometry is weak. We evaluate on TUM RGB-D, ScanNet, Replica, and two outdoor sequences recorded with a RealSense D435i on wheeled and handheld platforms. We achieve robust tracking performance across multiple scenes and reduced odometry drift, while tracking at $\sim$ 60 FPS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3DGS SLAM 中同一协方差被渲染与 ICP 配准同时使用而需求冲突，本文给每个 Gaussian 保留单一均值但拆成两个协方差：渲染协方差由 mapper 按光度误差优化，跟踪协方差由 RGB-D 传感器噪声模型导出，并用其作为图像角点的 Gaussian anchor 补足深度几何薄弱方向。在 TUM RGB-D、ScanNet、Replica 及两段 RealSense D435i 室外序列上实现约 60 FPS 的鲁棒跟踪与更低的里程计漂移。
Motivation: ICP-based 3DGS SLAM 用同一 primitive 协方差同时做渲染与配准：mapper 为压光度误差常把 Gaussian 压平贴表面，而稳健配准需要测量不确定性，两者需求互相冲突。
Method: 提出 dual-covariance parameterization：每个 Gaussian 单均值 + 双协方差，渲染协方差由 mapper 优化，跟踪协方差由 RGB-D 传感器噪声模型推得；再把跟踪协方差作为图像角点的 Gaussian anchor，在深度几何弱的方向上补约束。
Result: 在 TUM RGB-D、ScanNet、Replica 与两段 RealSense D435i 室外序列（轮式与手持平台）上取得跨多场景的鲁棒跟踪与降低的 odometry drift，跟踪速度约 60 FPS。
Conclusion: 把渲染与配准的协方差解耦，可以在保持实时 3DGS SLAM 帧率的同时提升跟踪稳健性并压低里程计漂移。

papers.title: Modular Norm RandOpt: Population-Efficient Ensembling through Architecture-Aware Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: RandOpt samples weight-perturbed language models and ensembles top-ranked candidates through plurality voting, but its global perturbation scale ignores heterogeneous module geometry. We propose \mbox{\textbf{\emph{Modular Norm RandOpt}}}, an architecture-aware sampling method using module-wise natural norms and calibrated scales while preserving selection and voting. It outperforms RandOpt using $3\times$ fewer candidates on Countdown and at least $12\times$ fewer on GSM8K, with corresponding wall-clock savings. Evaluations across seven tasks and three Qwen scales ($0.5$B--$3$B) show higher mean accuracy than RandOpt on Countdown, GSM8K, and MATH-500 at every scale. The gains extend to Llama 3.2 $3$B and Gemma 3 $4$B on Countdown and GSM8K. On Qwen2.5-1.5B, our ensembles also achieve higher mean accuracy than iterative baselines on both tasks at comparable main-run evaluation budgets. On GSM8K, a tail-density diagnostic implies only a $1.2$--$1.8\times$ candidate reduction, while most ensemble improvement is associated with more favorable correct-expert support. These results highlight perturbation geometry as a key design choice for population-efficient, gradient-free search around pretrained models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Modular Norm RandOpt 用模块级 natural norm 与校准尺度替代 RandOpt 的全局扰动尺度，在保持候选排序与多数投票的前提下做架构感知的权重扰动采样。在 Countdown 上以 3× 更少候选超过 RandOpt，GSM8K 上至少 12× 更少；七个任务、Qwen 0.5B–3B 三个规模上 Countdown、GSM8K、MATH-500 平均准确率均更高。
Motivation: RandOpt 对权重加全局统一尺度的扰动，忽略语言模型各模块几何的异质性，导致围绕预训练模型做无梯度搜索时候选population效率低、评估开销大。
Method: 按模块分别估计 natural norm 并校准扰动尺度，采样权重扰动的候选模型，沿用 RandOpt 的候选排序与 plurality voting 集成；对比对象为 RandOpt 与迭代式基线，评测覆盖七个任务、Qwen 0.5B–3B 三种规模，以及 Llama 3.2 3B、Gemma 3 4B、Qwen2.5-1.5B。
Result: 候选效率：Countdown 上以 3× 更少候选超过 RandOpt，GSM8K 上至少 12× 更少，并带来相应 wall-clock 节省。准确率：七个任务、Qwen 0.5B–3B 三个规模上，Countdown、GSM8K、MATH-500 的平均准确率在每个规模都高于 RandOpt；增益延伸到 Llama 3.2 3B 与 Gemma 3 4B（Countdown、GSM8K）。在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 上，两个任务的平均准确率也高于迭代式基线，且主运行评估预算相当。GSM8K 的 tail-density 诊断只蕴含 1.2–1.8× 的候选缩减，多数集成增益与更有利的 correct-expert support 相关。
Conclusion: 扰动几何是围绕预训练模型做 population-efficient、无梯度搜索的关键设计选择；GSM8K 上候选缩减的大部分收益并非来自尾部密度，而来自更有利的正确专家支撑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAMI3D-DW: Interactive Segmentation of Any 3D Medical Images
papers.abstract_en: Interactive segmentation of 3D medical images supports quantitative analysis of anatomical structures and disease while allowing users to specify and refine their targets. Despite substantial progress by nnInteractive and VISTA3D, reliable segmentation across diverse clinical targets remains challenging, particularly for complex anatomical structures and the heterogeneous, long-tailed spectrum of pathology. We present SAMI3D-DW V1 (hereafter SAMI3D-DW), an interactive 3D segmentation model trained on Deepwise's large-scale proprietary medical image datasets. We evaluate the model under simulated user interactions on a CT/MR benchmark comprising 4,326 cases from 219 source datasets, spanning 107 anatomical and pathological categories, organized by a medical taxonomy and evaluated with a category-balanced DSC score. SAMI3D-DW achieves the highest category-macro Dice among evaluated methods in both interaction modes. With one point, it scores 0.5764 versus 0.5315 for nnInteractive, the strongest baseline, rising to 0.7771 versus 0.7494 with five points. With bounding-box initialization, the scores are 0.7130 versus 0.6530. After five corrective clicks, SAMI3D-DW reaches 0.8002 versus 0.7868, making it the only evaluated box-compatible model to exceed 0.80. For radiologists and clinicians, SAMI3D-DW enables segmentation of complex anatomical structures, including intracranial vessel trees on CT and MR angiography, with a few clicks. In a preliminary in-house comparison involving neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1), SAMI3D-DW-assisted tumor annotation took minutes per case and approximately one-fifteenth of the time required for manual annotation, highlighting its potential to support volumetric treatment-response assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAMI3D-DW 是在 Deepwise 大规模私有医学影像数据上训练的交互式 3D 分割模型，支持点与 bounding-box 两种初始化。在含 4,326 例、219 个来源数据集、107 类解剖与病理的 CT/MR 基准上，其 category-macro Dice 在两种交互模式下均为所评方法最高：单点 0.5764（nnInteractive 0.5315），五点 0.7771（0.7494），box 初始化 0.7130（0.6530），五次纠正点击后 0.8002（0.7868），是唯一超过 0.80 的 box 兼容模型。
Motivation: nnInteractive 与 VISTA3D 之后，面对复杂解剖结构与长尾异质病理，跨临床目标的可靠交互式 3D 分割仍不稳定。
Method: 在 Deepwise 大规模私有医学影像数据集上训练 SAMI3D-DW V1；用模拟用户交互在按医学分类学组织的 CT/MR 基准上评测，采用 category-balanced（category-macro）DSC，覆盖点与 bounding-box 两种初始化模式。
Result: 基准含 4,326 例、219 个来源数据集、107 类。单点 0.5764 vs nnInteractive 0.5315；五点 0.7771 vs 0.7494；box 初始化 0.7130 vs 0.6530；五次纠正点击 0.8002 vs 0.7868，为唯一超 0.80 的 box 兼容模型。NF1 初步内部对比中，辅助肿瘤标注每例耗时数分钟，约为人工标注的十五分之一。
Conclusion: SAMI3D-DW 在点与 box 两种交互模式下均取得最高 category-macro Dice，可用少量点击分割颅内血管树等复杂结构，并有望支撑体积化疗效评估。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Fysiverse-3D-Vision Technical Report: Generating Executable 3D Worlds from Images through Unified Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have advanced image-conditioned 3D content creation, yet generating controllable and executable 3D scenes from a single image remains challenging. Existing 3D generative approaches can synthesize visually plausible objects and scenes, but their spatial layout estimation is coupled with specific asset generators. They struggle to jointly model object semantics, metric geometry, and scene-level spatial relationships, which are essential for interactive editing, physical simulation, and embodied applications. We propose Fysiverse-3D-Vision, a unified vision-language-geometry framework for generative 3D scene reconstruction and executable asset construction from a single image. We establish a shared representation where spatial reasoning and geometric reconstruction mutually enhance each other, allowing object layouts to be inferred beyond the constraints of individual asset generators. Our model integrates textual supervision, semantic visual cues, and geometric representations within a unified Transformer to capture scene context, metric geometry, and object-level interactions. An object-conditioned layout module performs cross-attention between target object representations and global geometric features to predict object translation, rotation, and scale. Training progressively learns geometry-language alignment, introduces layout reasoning while preserving reconstruction capability, and refines physical consistency through collision-aware optimization. By separating spatial layout reasoning from asset synthesis, Fysiverse-3D-Vision provides an adaptable interface for interactive scene editing, object-level manipulations, and executable 3D content generation. Experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves superior geometric consistency, layout estimation, rendering quality, and physical property understanding compared with existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fysiverse-3D-Vision 把空间布局推理从资产生成器中解耦出来，用统一的 vision-language-geometry Transformer 联合建物体语义、度量几何与场景级空间关系，再由 object-conditioned layout 模块经 cross-attention 预测物体平移、旋转与缩放。训练分阶段推进几何-语言对齐、布局推理与碰撞感知优化，实验显示其在几何一致性、布局估计、渲染质量与物理属性理解上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 单图生成可控、可执行的 3D 场景仍困难：现有 3D 生成方法的布局估计与特定资产生成器耦合，无法联合建模物体语义、度量几何和场景级空间关系，制约交互编辑、物理仿真与具身应用。
Method: 统一 Transformer 内融合文本监督、语义视觉线索与几何表征，建立空间推理与几何重建互相增强的共享表征；object-conditioned layout 模块对目标物体表征与全局几何特征做 cross-attention，预测 translation、rotation、scale。训练渐进学习几何-语言对齐、引入布局推理同时保持重建能力，并用 collision-aware optimization 精化物理一致性。
Result: 实验表明该框架在几何一致性、布局估计、渲染质量与物理属性理解上相比现有方法取得更优表现。
Conclusion: 把空间布局推理与资产合成分离，可为交互场景编辑、物体级操作与可执行 3D 内容生成提供可适配的接口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniFysics-Nano-V2 Technical Report: Understanding the Physical World Across Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal models have expanded multimodal interaction across vision, audio, speech, and language. However, their training is predominantly organized around semantic descriptions and general-purpose objectives, leaving physical attributes, interaction states, and causal mechanisms only partially specified. This gap is not simply a matter of modality coverage: adding more modalities does not by itself provide the supervision needed to connect observations with the physical structure of the world. We present OmniFysics-Nano-V2, a compact omni-modal model for physical-world perception and understanding. The model supports image, video, audio, speech, and text inputs within a shared reasoning framework, together with text and speech generation. To address the lack of explicit physical supervision, we construct a dual-branch physics-aware data pipeline that grounds salient objects in structured physical attributes and aligns visual changes with acoustic events, intermediate responses, and interaction outcomes. To address homogeneous training objectives, we curate reinforcement-learning prompts by reward diversity and adopt a two-stage Group Relative Policy Optimization curriculum that progresses from general task correctness to fine-grained physical perceptual reasoning. Experiments across multimodal, audio-visual, and physical reasoning benchmarks show that the proposed data and training strategy improves physical-world understanding while preserving broad omni-modal competence. The proposed model achieves leading result on 17 of 21 benchmarks against SOTA omni-modal models. By equipping AI systems with both omni-modal and physical-world perception capabilities, OmniFysics-Nano-V2 is poised to become a cornerstone of next-generation Physical AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniFysics-Nano-V2 是一个覆盖图像、视频、音频、语音与文本输入的紧凑 omni-modal 模型，用双分支物理感知数据管线补上物理属性与因果机制的显式监督，再用按奖励多样性筛选的 RL 提示做两阶段 GRPO 课程（从通用任务正确性推进到细粒度物理感知推理）。在多模态、视听与物理推理基准上，该数据与训练策略在保持通用 omni-modal 能力的同时提升物理世界理解，21 个基准中 17 个取得领先结果。
Motivation: 现有 omni-modal 训练以语义描述和通用目标为主，物理属性、交互状态与因果机制监督不足；单纯增加模态数并不能自动补上观测与物理结构之间的连接。
Method: 构建双分支物理感知数据管线：一支把显著物体接地到结构化物理属性，另一支把视觉变化与声学事件、中间响应和交互结果对齐；再按奖励多样性整理强化学习提示，采用两阶段 GRPO 课程，先学通用任务正确性再学细粒度物理感知推理。
Result: 在多模态、视听与物理推理基准上，所提数据与训练策略提升物理世界理解并保持广泛的 omni-modal 能力；相对 SOTA omni-modal 模型，在 21 个基准中的 17 个上取得领先结果。
Conclusion: 显式物理监督加奖励多样性的两阶段 GRPO，能让紧凑 omni-modal 模型在不牺牲通用能力的前提下成为 Physical AI 的感知底座。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.result: 在多模态、视听与物理推理基准上，所提数据与训练策略提升物理世界理解并保持广泛的 omni-modal 能力；相对 SOTA omni-modal 模型，在 21 个基准中的 17 个上取得领先结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 显式物理监督加奖励多样性的两阶段 GRPO，能让紧凑 omni-modal 模型在不牺牲通用能力的前提下成为 Physical AI 的感知底座。

papers.title: Beyond Class Marginals: Bounding Rehearsal Gaps without Freezing Class Co-occurrence
papers.abstract_en: Class-balanced replay controls class frequency but does not determine the interval between successive replay appearances of a class. We study this interval, the rehearsal gap, separately from the class marginal and class co-occurrence, and introduce randomised-pass replay (RPR), which visits each resident class once per shuffled pass. For a fixed set of C resident classes and replay batch size b less than or equal to C, RPR preserves the balanced time-averaged class marginal and bounds every gap by 2*ceil(C/b)-1; a churn-conditional bound applies while the resident set changes. The scheduler uses no future class information and adds no replay examples or forward passes. In a linear-head ER-ACE diagnostic, joint absence from the incoming and replay batches produces a one-sided classifier-bias gradient. Longer absence episodes are associated with larger negative bias displacement, and removing the incoming-loss mask attenuates the scheduling effect. In the primary ER-ACE experiments, RPR improves final average accuracy by 0.72-1.67 percentage points relative to independent class-balanced retrieval under reservoir storage, with positive effects also observed under balanced storage. Pretrained ViTs show positive effects on the tested LT10 streams with small replay batches, while matched larger-batch controls show no material effect. Fixed-cycle and reused-pass controls change more than one temporal statistic, so the experiments do not isolate rehearsal-gap length from all other forms of temporal dependence. The accuracy effects depend on the learner and operating regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 类均衡回放只控制类频率，不控制同类两次回放之间的间隔；论文把这一 rehearsal gap 与类边缘、类共现分开刻画，提出 randomised-pass replay (RPR)，每个 shuffled pass 访问每个常驻类一次。在 b≤C 时 RPR 保持时间平均类边缘均衡并把间隔上界压到 2*ceil(C/b)-1，且不需未来类信息、不加回放样本或前向传播；在 ER-ACE 主实验中相对独立类均衡检索把最终平均准确率提高 0.72–1.67 个百分点。
Motivation: 类均衡回放不决定同类连续回放出现的间隔，而间隔过长会让某类同时缺席于 incoming 与 replay 批次，产生单侧分类器偏置梯度。
Method: 提出 randomised-pass replay (RPR)：每个 shuffled pass 访问每个常驻类一次，调度器不用未来类信息、不增加回放样本或前向传播；在固定 C 个常驻类、回放批大小 b≤C 下给出间隔上界 2*ceil(C/b)-1，并给出常驻集变化时的 churn-conditional 界。诊断实验用 linear-head ER-ACE，主实验在 reservoir 与 balanced 存储下对比独立类均衡检索，并测试预训练 ViT 与固定周期、复用 pass 控制。
Result: ER-ACE 主实验中 RPR 相对独立类均衡检索在 reservoir 存储下最终平均准确率提高 0.72–1.67 个百分点，balanced 存储下也有正向效果；预训练 ViT 在所测 LT10 流与小回放批上为正，而匹配的大批对照无实质效果。linear-head 诊断中同时缺席产生单侧偏置梯度，缺席越长负偏置位移越大，去掉 incoming-loss mask 会削弱调度效应。
Conclusion: 作者主张把 rehearsal gap 作为独立于类边缘与类共现的时间统计量来约束，但承认固定周期与复用 pass 控制同时改变了多个时间统计量，无法把间隔长度与其他形式的时间依赖完全分离，且准确率效果依赖学习器与运行机制。

papers.title: Annual Earth-observation embeddings encode wildfire disturbance and support simplified burned area mapping
papers.abstract_en: Medium-resolution (10-30 m) burned area mapping is vital for monitoring wildfires and their impacts, but remains difficult to scale. Existing methods require either curated fire-specific imagery or dense time-series analysis. Here, we tested whether annual Earth-observation embeddings retain wildfire disturbance signals sufficiently to map burned areas without either requirement. Using Tessera and AlphaEarth embeddings, we tested individual burn-scar delineation, mapping of all same-year fires within an area, regional wall-to-wall mapping, cross-continental transfer, and intra-annual fire timing. Tessera strongly encoded wildfire disturbance, allowing even linear models to separate burned from unburned pixels; the signal was weaker in AlphaEarth. Models trained on a single Tessera embedding matched or exceeded equivalent models using paired pre- and post-fire HLS imagery, and outperformed post-fire imagery alone. The same approach mapped all same-year fires within benchmark scenes (F1 = 0.90). Applied across California, with no California fire data used for downstream training, it recovered 97% of reference burned area and detected substantially more small and medium-sized fires than GABAM or MCD64A1. Separately, a model trained on 2018-2021 US fires transferred without retraining to 88 European fires from 2024-2025 (F1 = 0.88). For well-detected fires, ignition timing was recovered with a mean absolute error of 13 days. Performance declined for fires ignited near the end of the calendar year, and wall-to-wall deployment produced systematic false positives in some unseen landscapes. Annual embeddings nevertheless achieve high segmentation accuracy while moving the burden of dense time series processing upstream, providing a promising path towards simpler regional burned area mapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用年度 Earth-observation embedding（Tessera/AlphaEarth）替代密集时序与火点专用影像做 10–30 m 过火区制图：单张 Tessera embedding 上训练的线性模型即可分离过火与未过火像素，加州全域无本地火点训练仍恢复 97% 参考过火面积，跨洲迁移到 88 场欧洲火灾 F1=0.88。代价是年末起火的火场性能下降，且在未见景观上出现系统性误报。
Motivation: 10–30 m 中分辨率过火区制图难以规模化：现有方法要么依赖人工整理的火点专用影像，要么依赖密集时序分析，两者都限制了区域到跨洲的推广。
Method: 以 Tessera 与 AlphaEarth 的年度 embedding 为唯一输入，测试单火场烧痕勾绘、同区域同年全部火灾制图、区域 wall-to-wall 制图、跨洲迁移与年内起火时序五类任务；下游仅用线性或轻量模型，训练数据来自 2018–2021 年美国火灾，与配对 pre/post-fire HLS 影像及 post-fire 影像单独输入作对照，并与 GABAM、MCD64A1 比较。
Result: 单张 Tessera embedding 训练的模型匹配或超过使用配对 pre/post-fire HLS 影像的等价模型，并优于仅用 post-fire 影像；AlphaEarth 中信号更弱。同年全部火灾制图 F1=0.90；加州全域（训练不含加州火点数据）恢复 97% 参考过火面积，检出的中小火显著多于 GABAM 与 MCD64A1；2018–2021 美国火灾训练的模型免重训迁移到 2024–2025 年 88 场欧洲火灾 F1=0.88；起火时间平均绝对误差 13 天。
Conclusion: 年度 embedding 已编码足够强的野火扰动信号，可把密集时序处理的负担移到上游，实现更简化的区域过火区制图；但年末起火与未见景观的系统性误报是当前部署边界。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Self-Supervised Combinatorial Optimization with Constraints via Frank-Wolfe
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning for combinatorial optimization has emerged as a promising paradigm for solving discrete optimization problems with neural networks, but a central challenge remains: handling hard combinatorial constraints within continuous, gradient-based training. Continuously extending combinatorial objectives to convex domains is a powerful technique, yet existing approaches often require projection steps that constrain neural network outputs to lie inside the feasible polytope and rely on ad-hoc and problem-specific constructions. We propose a general framework in which the neural network is allowed to predict arbitrary continuous vectors that could potentially lie outside of the feasible polytope. These predictions are then approximated by sparse convex combinations of feasible solutions using a geometric decomposition algorithm based on Frank--Wolfe methods and approximate Caratheodory results. This decomposition induces an a.e.-differentiable, self-supervised loss defined as the expected value of the discrete objective. The same procedure provides an automatic rounding guarantee at inference time. We demonstrate strong empirical performance across multiple combinatorial problems, including the Quadratic Assignment Problem, Maximum Coverage, and the Traveling Salesperson Problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种通用的自监督组合优化训练框架：神经网络直接输出任意连续向量（可落在可行多面体之外），再用基于 Frank-Wolfe 与近似 Caratheodory 定理的几何分解算法把它近似为可行解的稀疏凸组合，由此诱导出几乎处处可微、以离散目标期望值为形式的自监督损失，并在推理时自动给出舍入保证。在 Quadratic Assignment Problem、Maximum Coverage 和 Traveling Salesperson Problem 上展示了强经验性能。
Motivation: 连续梯度训练难以处理组合优化中的硬约束：现有方法依赖把网络输出投影回可行多面体的投影步骤，且构造多为 ad-hoc、逐问题定制，缺少通用做法。
Method: 允许网络预测可行多面体外的任意向量，用基于 Frank-Wolfe 方法与近似 Caratheodory 结果的几何分解算法将其近似为可行解的稀疏凸组合；该分解诱导出几乎处处可微的自监督损失（离散目标的期望值），同一过程在推理时提供自动舍入保证。
Result: 在多个组合问题上展示了强经验性能，包括 Quadratic Assignment Problem、Maximum Coverage 与 Traveling Salesperson Problem。
Conclusion: 用几何分解替代投影，可以在连续、梯度化的自监督训练中通用地处理硬组合约束，并同时给出推理时的舍入保证。

papers.title: Signed Graph Pre-Training and Prompt Learning
papers.abstract_en: Signed graphs arise in trust--distrust networks, financial correlation systems, biological interaction graphs, and many other domains in which edges can be positive or negative and may also be directed. While signed graph neural networks have improved task-specific learning, graph transfer learning on signed graphs remains underdeveloped. In this paper, we introduce TopoSIGN, a pioneer topology-guided graph pre-training and prompt learning framework for signed graphs. TopoSIGN combines a structural encoder built on the magnetic signed Laplacian with a novel persistent-homology branch that summarizes signed topology through Dowker-complex persistence images. The fused embeddings are then transferred to a prompt learning function. Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the efficacy of TopoSIGN in extracting useful structural information in signed graphs, as well as the adaptability and flexibility of the proposed general framework.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 3 figures, Accepted to Learning on Graphs Conference (LoG 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TopoSIGN：面向符号图 (signed graph) 的拓扑引导预训练与 prompt learning 框架，把基于 magnetic signed Laplacian 的结构编码器与基于 Dowker 复形持久图像 (persistence image) 的持久同调分支融合，再把融合嵌入迁移到 prompt learning 函数。合成与真实数据集上的实验表明该框架能提取符号图中有用的结构信息，并具备适应性与灵活性。
Motivation: 符号图上的图迁移学习 (graph transfer learning) 仍不发达，尽管符号图神经网络已改进任务特定学习；信任-不信任网络、金融关联系统、生物互作图等域的边可正可负且可有向，需要可迁移的通用表示。
Method: TopoSIGN 由三部分组成：以 magnetic signed Laplacian 为基础的结构编码器；新的 persistent-homology 分支，用 Dowker 复形的持久图像概括符号拓扑；两者融合后的嵌入输入 prompt learning 函数完成迁移。
Result: 在合成与真实世界数据集上的实验结果显示 TopoSIGN 能有效提取符号图中的结构信息，并体现该通用框架的适应性与灵活性（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 拓扑引导的预训练加 prompt learning 可作为符号图迁移学习的通用框架，把谱结构与持久同调两类符号拓扑信息融合后迁移。
