papers.title: Slow Decay and Silenced Expression: Iterated Subliminal Trait Transfer in Language-Model Lineages
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly trained on the outputs of other models, forming chains that we call lineages, in which a trait present in one generation can pass to the next. Prior work on subliminal learning has shown that a teacher's trait can transmit to a student through filtered data carrying none of the trait's content. However, the evidence covers only a single training step. We study whether such a trait holds or fades across lineages. We instill the trait into three copies of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and iterate the training step to depth ten from each, reading every generation two ways on the same held-out prompts: a keyword screen that looks for expressions of the trait in the model's output, and an activation probe that projects each model's displacement from the base onto a direction built from the other lineages' teachers. We report two findings. First, the trait persists through ten generations across three lineages. The instilled models express it on every completion; the keyword-screen rate falls to 55.6% after the first step and to 21.1% by generation ten. The base itself matches the screen on none of its 300 completions. Second, the trait can be present internally while absent behaviorally. When the model's default system prompt is removed at evaluation, the generation-ten students' keyword-screen rate is zero on every prompt while the probe score stays positive on every prompt. Steering the untreated base with the displacement of a generation-ten student, which is trained and measured under the default system prompt, induces screened expression of the trait even with the system prompt removed, while that same student shows no expression of the trait with the system prompt removed.
papers.comment: 7 pages plus appendix. Extended version with additional experiments to follow
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上把 subliminal trait 灌入三个副本并把该训练步迭代到第十代，trait 在谱系内持续存在：关键词筛查率从第一步后的 55.6% 降到第十代的 21.1%，而 base 在 300 次补全中零命中。去掉默认 system prompt 后，第十代学生的关键词筛查率归零但 activation probe 分数仍全为正，说明 trait 可内部存在而行为沉默；用第十代学生的位移去 steering 未处理的 base，即使去掉 system prompt 也能诱导出被筛查到的 trait 表达。
Motivation: 已有 subliminal learning 证据只覆盖单次训练步，无法说明 trait 在多代模型链（lineage）中是保持还是衰减，而模型互相用彼此输出训练的做法正越来越普遍。
Method: 把 trait 灌入三份 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，从每份出发把该训练步迭代到深度十；在同一批 held-out prompts 上用两种读法评估每一代：一是查找 trait 表达的关键词筛查 (keyword screen)，二是 activation probe，把每个模型相对 base 的位移投影到由其他谱系 teacher 构建的方向上。
Result: trait 在三个谱系的十代中持续存在；instilled 模型每次补全都表达 trait，关键词筛查率第一步后降至 55.6%，到第十代降至 21.1%，base 在其 300 次补全中零命中。去掉默认 system prompt 后，第十代学生在每个 prompt 上关键词筛查率为零而 probe 分数每个 prompt 均为正；用第十代学生的位移 steering 未处理的 base，在去掉 system prompt 时仍诱导出被筛查的 trait 表达，而该学生自身在同样条件下无表达。
Conclusion: trait 能跨十代谱系保持且可内部存在而行为上被 system prompt 沉默，行为筛查与内部 probe 会给出不一致的读数，位移携带的 trait 可跨模型转移。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A dataset of one-dimensional idealized probabilistic fields
papers.abstract_en: Verification of probabilistic weather forecasts remains a crucial aspect of numerical weather prediction, as new AI-based models become more widely used alongside the more traditional physics-based ensemble forecasting systems that continue to be developed and improved. We present a first-of-its-kind idealized probabilistic dataset composed of one-dimensional cases aimed at analyzing the behavior and properties of verification methods for probabilistic forecasts and comparing their behavior. It covers a wide range of probabilistic cases, such as constant, localized events, gradients, fronts, noisy, bimodal, and limiting cases. Moreover, the code associated with the dataset provides great flexibility for customizing the experiments it covers. The dataset represents the first building block of the more extensive comparison dataset of the Bridging The Gap project, which aims to facilitate the development and comparison of spatial verification methods for probabilistic forecasts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建首个一维理想化概率预报验证数据集，覆盖常值、局地事件、梯度、锋面、含噪、双峰及极限情形，用于系统比较各类空间验证方法的行为与性质。配套代码可灵活定制实验，该数据集是 Bridging The Gap 项目更广泛对比数据集的第一块基石。
Motivation: AI 模型与传统物理集合预报并存，使概率预报验证方法的行为差异亟需可比、可控的基准，而现有验证方法缺少统一的理想化对比框架。
Method: 构建一维理想化概率场数据集，覆盖常值、局地事件、梯度、锋面、含噪、双峰与极限情形等多类概率情形；配套代码支持自定义实验，作为 Bridging The Gap 项目空间验证方法对比数据集的首个组件。
Result: 提出首个面向概率预报验证方法行为分析与比较的一维理想化数据集，覆盖上述多类概率情形，并提供可灵活定制实验的配套代码。
Conclusion: 可控的一维理想化概率场可作为比较空间验证方法的标准化起点，是 Bridging The Gap 更完整对比数据集的第一步。

papers.title: FoMo: Forking Moment in Generative Trajectory as a Perceptual Distance
papers.abstract_en: Reference-based image quality assessment (IQA) metrics aim to reflect how humans perceive the perceptual distance between a pair of images. To learn how the human visual system (HVS) operates, recent reference-based IQA metrics heavily rely on human-annotated data. Mean opinion score (MOS)-based pointwise scoring, which assigns a scalar quality value per image, is preferable for annotation but is prohibitively expensive to collect at scale and is known to be noisy due to inconsistent human judgments. As an alternative, two-alternative forced choice (2AFC) pairwise labels have gained popularity due to their reliability and efficiency, but they capture only relative comparisons between pairs. In this paper, we propose a fully automated data generation pipeline that generates pointwise perceptual distance labels between image pairs without any human annotation. Our approach exploits the generative dynamics of diffusion models as a perceptual distance proxy, where the coarse structure of an image is generated in the early timesteps and the fine details are generated in the later timesteps. Images that fork early in the generation process share only coarse structure and are perceptually far apart; images that fork late differ only in fine detail. We demonstrate that the diffusion trajectory aligns well with the human visual system, and use this forking moment, FoMo, as a reference-grounded distance label to supervise the training of a reference-based IQA metric. The pointwise labels, which support universal comparison between arbitrary image pairs, enable an information-rich training objective. Extensive experiments across diverse backbone architectures confirm the effectiveness of our generation pipeline, outperforming human-annotated datasets in multiple benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FoMo 用扩散模型生成轨迹中的分叉时刻 (forking moment) 作为图像对之间的感知距离标签，全自动、无需人工标注，替代昂贵且有噪声的 MOS 点分与只给相对比较的 2AFC。早期分叉的图像只共享粗结构、感知距离远，晚期分叉只差细节；该标签监督参考型 IQA 指标训练，在多个 benchmark 上超过人工标注数据集。
Motivation: 参考型 IQA 依赖人工标注：MOS 点分大规模采集昂贵且因判断不一致而有噪声，2AFC 虽可靠高效却只能给出成对相对比较，无法在任意图像对之间做通用比较。
Method: 利用扩散模型的生成动力学——粗结构在早期 timestep 生成、细节在后期生成——把图像对在生成轨迹中的分叉时刻当作参考型感知距离标签，构建全自动数据生成管线，用这些点分标签监督训练参考型 IQA 指标，训练目标信息量高于成对比较。
Result: 在多种 backbone 架构上的大量实验确认该生成管线有效，多个 benchmark 上超过人工标注数据集；扩散轨迹与人类视觉系统 (HVS) 对齐良好。
Conclusion: 扩散生成轨迹的分叉时刻可以充当感知距离的代理，用它自动生成的点分标签足以替代人工标注来训练参考型 IQA 指标，并支持任意图像对的通用比较。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: LingLan: An Advancing Traditional Chinese Medicine Diagnosis LLM with Multimodal Data
papers.abstract_en: Though artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly transforms modern medicine, its integration into Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) has been relatively slow, primarily due to TCM's reliance on holistic, subjective diagnostic methods---namely Inspection, Auscultation and Olfaction, Inquiry, and Palpation(I-AOI-P)---which are difficult to align with quantitative, standardized medical systems. In this work, we introduce a Unification Framework for Multimodal Data (UFMD), which automatically processes tongue and pulse images into structured, clinically standard descriptions, integrating multi-source diagnostic information into a unified digital record of I-AOI-P process. Building on this structured data, we create LingLan-14B, a TCM-specific large language model fine-tuned via supervised learning to emulate the diagnostic logic and workflow of I-AOI-P process. Experimental results show that our method significantly enhances diagnostic accuracy, achieving a relative improvement of 103.5% over the baseline (62.72% vs. 30.82%) and reaching an F1-score of up to 82%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出中医四诊 (I-AOI-P) 多模态统一框架 UFMD，把舌象与脉象图像自动转成临床标准结构化描述，再据此微调出中医专用大模型 LingLan-14B，模仿四诊的诊断逻辑与流程。诊断准确率相对基线提升 103.5%（62.72% vs 30.82%），F1 最高达 82%。
Motivation: 中医依赖整体而主观的望闻问切，难以与量化标准化的现代医学体系对齐，导致 AI 在中医领域的落地明显慢于现代医学。
Method: UFMD 自动处理舌象与脉象图像，产出结构化、临床标准的描述，把多源诊断信息整合为 I-AOI-P 流程的统一数字记录；在此结构化数据上以监督学习微调得到 LingLan-14B，模拟四诊的诊断逻辑与工作流。
Result: 诊断准确率相对基线提升 103.5%，绝对值 62.72% 对基线 30.82%；F1-score 最高达到 82%。
Conclusion: 把主观四诊先转成统一结构化记录再做监督微调，能让 LLM 复现中医诊断流程并大幅抬高诊断准确率。

papers.title: TCMaster: Confidence-Aware Querying and Workload-Guided Physical Design for Multi-Source Traditional Chinese Medicine Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Multi-source knowledge graphs (KGs) need query mechanisms that expose reliability and exploit domain structure. This paper presents TCMaster, a property-graph query substrate for confidence-aware traversal and workload-guided physical design over Traditional Chinese Medicine KGs. TCMaster integrates pharmacopoeias, prescriptions, molecular databases, and LLM-extracted micro-semantics into a KG with approximately 221K entities and 723K base edges. It annotates edges with provenance-level confidence, rewrites Cypher queries with confidence predicates, ranks multi-hop paths under PRODUCT, MIN, or weighted-average policies, and uses ontology skew through direction selection, herb-attribute bitmaps, and materialized shortcut edges. On Neo4j, direction selection improves attribute lookup by a factor of 1.47, shortcuts accelerate high-fanout target counting by a factor of 4.42, confidence filtering removes 39.3 percent of low-quality heterogeneous paths, and KG retrieval improves TCMbench QA accuracy by 20.0 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TCMaster 是面向多源中医药知识图谱的属性图查询底座，把来源级置信度写进边标注，重写 Cypher 加置信谓词，并按 PRODUCT、MIN 或加权平均对多跳路径排序。在约 221K 实体、723K 基础边的图上，Neo4j 中方向选择使属性查找提速 1.47 倍、物化捷径边使高扇出目标计数提速 4.42 倍、置信过滤剔除 39.3% 的低质量异构路径，KG 检索把 TCMbench QA 准确率抬高 20.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 多源知识图谱的边可靠性不一、领域本体存在偏斜，通用查询既暴露不了可信度也吃不到领域结构，导致多跳路径噪声大、问答精度受限。
Method: TCMaster 整合药典、方剂、分子数据库与 LLM 抽取的微语义构建 KG；边标注来源级置信度，Cypher 查询重写加入置信谓词，多跳路径按 PRODUCT、MIN 或加权平均策略排序；物理设计利用本体偏斜做方向选择、草药属性位图与物化捷径边，运行于 Neo4j。
Result: Neo4j 上方向选择使属性查找提速 1.47 倍，捷径边使高扇出目标计数提速 4.42 倍，置信过滤去掉 39.3% 的低质量异构路径，KG 检索使 TCMbench QA 准确率提升 20.0 个百分点；图规模约 221K 实体、723K 基础边。
Conclusion: 把置信度下沉到查询层并让物理设计跟随工作负载与本体偏斜，可在多源中医药 KG 上同时压低噪声路径并抬高问答准确率。

papers.title: Optimal Tradeoffs Between Network Size and Parameter Magnitude in Neural Approximation and Minimax Regression
papers.abstract_en: The statistical accuracy of neural networks depends on both their approximation power and the complexity of the class fitted from data. While increasing network size is a natural way to improve approximation, parameter magnitude provides another resource whose role must be quantified in both respects. We establish a sharp width--magnitude tradeoff at fixed depth using one elementary bounded $1$-Lipschitz Dyadic--Triangular Activation. For the unit $β$-Hölder ball on $[0,1]^d$ with $0<β\leq1$, the optimal $L^p$ approximation error for $0<p<\infty$ is of order $[N^2\log(eNT)]^{-β/d}$ when the network width satisfies $N\geq2d+3$ and the parameter magnitudes are bounded by $T\geq1$. Matching lower bounds hold for every fixed globally Hölder activation; its Hölder exponent affects the constants but not the rate. Under bounded design densities and independent centered sub-Gaussian noise, approximate least squares over the full clipped class at depth $23$ attains the classical Hölder minimax risk $\mathcal{O}(M^{-\frac{2β}{2β+d}})$ without logarithmic loss whenever $N^2\log(eNT)\asymp M^{\frac{d}{2β+d}}$, where $M$ is the sample size. This yields a continuum of statistically optimal choices, ranging from unit parameter radius to fixed network size. At fixed size, four hidden layers with at most $8d+7$ nonzero parameters give a near-optimal radius, while six layers with at most $8d+27$ attain the optimal order $\log T=\mathcal{O}(η^{-d/β})$ at approximation error $η$. The same decoding method also yields fixed-size Transformer approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定深度下给出神经网络宽度 N 与参数幅度上界 T 的尖锐权衡：单位 β-Hölder 球上最优 L^p 逼近误差为 [N²log(eNT)]^{-β/d}（N≥2d+3、T≥1），且在 N²log(eNT)≈M^{d/(2β+d)} 时深度 23 的近似最小二乘达到无对数损失的经典 Hölder 极小极大风险 O(M^{-2β/(2β+d)})，从而给出从单位参数半径到固定网络尺寸的一整条统计最优选择连续统。
Motivation: 神经网络的统计精度同时取决于逼近能力与拟合类复杂度，增大宽度是常规手段，但参数幅度这一资源在逼近与统计两方面的作用此前没有被量化，缺少宽度与幅度之间的最优权衡刻画。
Method: 用单个有界 1-Lipschitz Dyadic–Triangular Activation 在固定深度建立尖锐的宽度–幅度权衡，给出 [N²log(eNT)]^{-β/d} 的 L^p 逼近上界，并对任意固定全局 Hölder 激活给出匹配下界（Hölder 指数只影响常数不影响速率）；在有界设计密度与独立中心次高斯噪声下，对完整 clipped 类做深度 23 的近似最小二乘，用同一 decoding 方法导出固定尺寸的 Transformer 逼近。
Result: 单位 β-Hölder 球（0<β≤1，[0,1]^d）上最优 L^p 逼近误差（0<p<∞）为 [N²log(eNT)]^{-β/d}，条件 N≥2d+3、T≥1；样本量 M 下近似最小二乘达到 Hölder 极小极大风险 O(M^{-2β/(2β+d)}) 且无对数损失，条件为 N²log(eNT)≈M^{d/(2β+d)}、深度 23。固定尺寸下四个隐藏层、至多 8d+7 个非零参数给出近最优半径；六层、至多 8d+27 个非零参数在逼近误差 η 下达到最优阶 log T=O(η^{-d/β})。
Conclusion: 宽度与参数幅度可以互相替代：在 N²log(eNT) 与 M^{d/(2β+d)} 同阶的整条连续统上统计最优，从单位参数半径到固定网络尺寸皆可；逼近速率对激活的具体 Hölder 指数稳健，只改常数。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Precursors, Pathways, and State-Dependent Reliability of Long-range ENSO Prediction in the CESM2 Seasonal-to-Multiyear Large Ensemble
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the sources of ENSO prediction skill and error is essential for improving long-range climate prediction. Here we examine ENSO precursors in CESM2 Seasonal-to-Multiyear Large Ensemble (SMYLE) hindcasts initialized in February and August during 1970-2019, using ensemble sensitivity analysis and an extended nonlinear recharge oscillator (XRO) benchmark. SMYLE exhibits meaningful long-lead skill, with February-initialized predictions remaining skillful through the following winter, and August-initialized predictions retaining useful skill at the December target sixteen months ahead. However, the predictions are under-dispersive in a state-dependent manner. Rank histograms reveal overconfidence issues for strong ENSO events and a warm bias for weak events. February predictability arises from canonical Bjerknes feedback dynamics reinforced by subtropical-tropical interactions resembling the North Pacific Meridional Mode (NPMM). The best February-initialized predictions feature warm western Pacific subsurface anomalies and La Nina anomalies at initialization, with equatorially confined anomalies and relatively weak sensitivities to extratropical influences thereafter. Second-year ENSO predictability in August-initialized predictions instead emerges through a delayed pathway characterized by cross-basin preconditioning. Skillful cases begin with a cold tropical equatorial South Atlantic and a warmer tropical western Indian Ocean, while Pacific processes play a reduced role until the following year. SMYLE matches the skill of the cross-validated XRO at both December targets, and its sensitivities agree with the observationally fitted benchmark, though the Atlantic couplings appear misrepresented. These findings suggest that improving the initial Pacific state and cross-basin coupling fidelity in GCMs may help improve ENSO prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 CESM2 SMYLE 集合回报检验 ENSO 长时效可预报性来源与误差结构：2 月起报技巧可持续到次年冬季，8 月起报对 16 个月后的 12 月目标仍有用；但集合在强事件上过度自信、弱事件上偏暖。2 月技巧来自 Bjerknes 反馈加类 NPMM 的副热带-热带相互作用，8 月的第二年技巧则来自跨海盆（南大西洋偏冷、西印度洋偏暖）的延迟路径。
Motivation: ENSO 长时效预测的技巧来源与集合误差结构尚不清楚：哪些前期信号、哪条物理路径支撑第二年技巧，以及集合离散度在何种状态下失真，直接决定季节到多年尺度气候预测的可信度。
Method: 分析 CESM2 Seasonal-to-Multiyear Large Ensemble (SMYLE) 在 1970–2019 年 2 月与 8 月起报的回报，用集合敏感性分析 (ensemble sensitivity analysis) 识别 ENSO 前兆，并以扩展非线性 recharge oscillator (XRO) 作为交叉验证基准；用 rank histogram 检验集合离散度。
Result: 2 月起报技巧持续到随后冬季，8 月起报对 16 个月后的 12 月目标仍保有有用技巧；rank histogram 显示强 ENSO 事件过度自信、弱事件存在暖偏差（状态依赖的欠离散）。SMYLE 在两个 12 月目标上与交叉验证 XRO 技巧相当，敏感性与观测拟合基准一致，但大西洋耦合关系表现失真。
Conclusion: 改进初始太平洋状态与模式中跨海盆耦合的保真度，可能提升 ENSO 长时效预测；8 月第二年技巧主要走跨海盆延迟路径而非太平洋内部过程，且大西洋耦合是当前模式的薄弱环节。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: On the Gradient Heterogeneity Dynamics of Adversarially Robust Federated Regression
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is intrinsically heterogeneous: honest clients may have different data-generating models. On top of that, adversarial clients can make heterogeneity even more pronounced by sharing arbitrary updates. Existing analyses typically control the interaction between statistical heterogeneity and adversarial behavior through gradient-dissimilarity conditions. However, the underlying bound is imposed a priori and may yield conservative guarantees even for least-squares regression. We instead derive the gradient heterogeneity from the statistical model of linear and nonlinear regression with fresh data samples at every round. Our bounds separate heterogeneity among the honest clients' ground-truth model parameters, finite-sample label noise, and initialization. We then demonstrate that, for any $(f,κ)$-robust aggregator with coefficient $κ= O(f/n)$, where $f$ is the number of adversarial clients and $n$ the total number of clients (with $f/n < 1/2$), convergence holds after an explicit sample burn-in.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在联邦线性与非线性回归中，梯度异质性不再先验假设，而是从统计模型逐轮推导：可分离为诚实客户端真实参数差异、有限样本标签噪声与初始化三部分。对任意 (f,κ)-鲁棒聚合器（κ=O(f/n)，f/n<1/2），在显式样本 burn-in 之后收敛成立。
Motivation: 现有分析用先验的 gradient-dissimilarity 条件约束统计异质性与对抗行为的耦合，该界是先验强加的，即便对最小二乘回归也可能过于保守。
Method: 从线性与非线性回归的统计模型出发、每轮使用新数据样本，直接推导梯度异质性界，并将其分解为诚实客户端 ground-truth 参数异质性、有限样本标签噪声与初始化三项；再在 (f,κ)-鲁棒聚合器框架下给出收敛分析。
Result: 得到的界显式分离三个异质性来源；当 κ=O(f/n)、f/n<1/2 时，收敛在显式样本 burn-in 之后成立。
Conclusion: 梯度异质性应从数据生成模型推导而非先验假设，这样可在对抗客户端存在时给出不保守的收敛保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fully Byzantine-Resilient Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study distributed Byzantine-resilient actor-critic multi-agent reinforcement learning (AC-MARL), where agents collectively learn policies through local interactions. Existing methods guarantee convergence of the agents' parameters only to a neighborhood of the attack-free limit points, resulting in degraded performance. We propose Fully Resilient AC-MARL (FRAC-MARL), a decentralized method in which each agent leverages redundancy in two-hop messages to identify reliable messages. Under linear parameterizations of the value and team-reward functions and Byzantine edge attacks, where adversarial behavior is confined to the communication layer, we prove that agents' parameters converge almost surely to the same limit points as in the attack-free case over time-varying communication graphs. We introduce a novel topological condition for the convergence of our method, present a systematic method to construct such networks, and prove that this condition can be verified in polynomial time. Finally, we demonstrate our method on cooperative multi-robot formation control tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出去中心化的 Fully Resilient AC-MARL (FRAC-MARL)：每个 agent 用两跳消息的冗余识别可靠消息，在线性参数化价值/团队奖励与拜占庭边攻击下，参数几乎必然收敛到与无攻击情形相同的极限点，而非仅收敛到邻域。新拓扑条件可在多项式时间验证，并在多机器人编队控制任务上演示。
Motivation: 现有拜占庭鲁棒 AC-MARL 只能把参数收敛到无攻击极限点的邻域，性能因此退化；且通信层攻击下的精确恢复缺少可判定的网络条件。
Method: FRAC-MARL 是去中心化方法，每个 agent 利用两跳消息冗余甄别可靠消息；假设价值函数与团队奖励为线性参数化、攻击限于通信层（Byzantine edge attacks），在时变通信图上推导收敛性；提出新的拓扑条件并给出系统性网络构造方法，证明该条件可多项式时间验证。
Result: 在上述线性参数化与边攻击假设下证明参数几乎必然收敛到与无攻击情形相同的极限点（而非邻域）；证明新拓扑条件可在多项式时间判定；并在合作式多机器人编队控制任务上演示方法。
Conclusion: 只要网络满足所提拓扑条件，两跳消息冗余就足以在时变图上完全消除拜占庭边攻击对 AC-MARL 收敛点的影响，且该条件可高效检验。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Interpretable AI plus Handheld, Portable Retinal Photographs: A Low-Cost Glaucoma Screening Solution for West Africa
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: To develop and evaluate an interpretable artificial intelligence (AI) framework for glaucoma screening from low-cost portable, handheld retinal fundus photographs in a West African population and to compare its performance with clinical tabletop fundus imaging. Methods: We used data from a community-based study of 681 participants (1,362 eyes) in Nigeria, comprising 414 glaucoma, 478 glaucoma suspect, and 470 non-glaucoma eyes. Fundus photographs were acquired using the low-cost handheld, portable Volk Viva retinal camera and the Canon CR-2-AF tabletop camera. We fine-tuned component models separately to each device to perform vessel segmentation, cup and disc boundary segmentation, and feature extraction to detect optic nerve head features. A final classification model combined these components to classify scans as glaucoma, glaucoma suspect or non-glaucoma. Feature-weight analysis and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping were used for interpretation. Results: The models performed well on both Volk Viva and Canon CR-2-AF images: Vessel segmentation: 0.98 Dice Coefficient (DC) (Volk) and 0.94 DC (Canon); Cup and disc segmentation: 0.95 DC (Volk) and 0.96 DC (Canon); Optic nerve head feature detection: area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) of 0.83$\pm$0.03 (Volk) and 0.87$\pm$0.04 (Canon); Classification model: AUCs of 0.85$\pm$0.01 (Volk) and 0.93$\pm$0.01 (Canon). Reports for each image, present model decision confidence scores and decision-rationale visualizations to support clinical interpretation. Conclusions: Volk Viva results were reasonably comparable to Canon CR-2-AF in the component models and not far behind in classification. This shows that interpretable AI combined with low-cost, portable imaging may enhance community-level glaucoma screening, especially in settings with limited specialist access and resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在尼日利亚 681 名参与者（1,362 眼）上，用低成本手持 Volk Viva 眼底相机分别微调血管分割、杯盘边界分割与视神经头特征提取组件，再由分类模型判读青光眼、可疑与非青光眼，并用特征权重与 Grad-CAM 给出决策理由。手持设备分类 AUC 0.85±0.01，接近台式 Canon CR-2-AF 的 0.93±0.01，组件级分割 Dice 达 0.94–0.98。
Motivation: 西非等专科与资源匮乏地区缺少可负担的青光眼筛查手段，需要在低成本手持成像上验证可解释 AI 能否达到接近台式设备的判读水平。
Method: 对 Volk Viva 与 Canon CR-2-AF 两种设备分别微调组件模型，完成血管分割、视杯与视盘边界分割及视神经头特征提取，再由最终分类模型输出三类判读；用特征权重分析与 Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) 生成决策理由可视化，并为每张图像报告置信分数。
Result: 血管分割 Dice：Volk 0.98、Canon 0.94；杯盘分割 Dice：Volk 0.95、Canon 0.96；视神经头特征检测 AUC：Volk 0.83±0.03、Canon 0.87±0.04；分类模型 AUC：Volk 0.85±0.01、Canon 0.93±0.01。数据为尼日利亚社区研究 681 名参与者共 1,362 眼（414 青光眼、478 可疑、470 非青光眼）。
Conclusion: 手持 Volk Viva 在组件模型上与台式 Canon CR-2-AF 大体相当、分类略逊，可解释 AI 结合低成本便携成像有望用于专科资源有限场景的社区级青光眼筛查。

papers.title: C2FXNet: Coarse-to-Fine Scene Expert for Unified Object Detection across Adverse Weather
papers.abstract_en: Object detection in adverse weather remains challenging because severe degradations weaken visual quality and disrupt semantic feature representations across diverse scenes. Existing methods usually rely on condition-specific designs, which limits their ability to generalize within a unified detector. In this paper, we propose a Coarse-to-Fine Scene Expert Network (C2FXNet) that achieves unified detection through hierarchical scene guidance. Specifically, C2FXNet introduces a dual-level guidance mechanism consisting of a Multi-step Reasoning Router (MRR), which performs GRU-based recurrent scene reasoning over compressed multi-scale visual cues and frozen coarse scene prototypes, and a Fine Scene Refinement (FSR) module, which uses image-specific semantic cues to modulate high-level features for local variation handling. Furthermore, a Scene-aware Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) dynamically combines scene-specific experts under the joint guidance of MRR and FSR. By coupling coarse scene reasoning with fine-grained semantic refinement, C2FXNet enables robust multi-scene detection without scene-specific training. Extensive experiments on RTTS, ExDark, and our newly constructed Adverse Weather Dataset (AWD) demonstrate that C2FXNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across foggy, dark, and clear conditions, reaching 63.70%, 71.14%, and 54.19% mAP on RTTS, ExDark, and AWD, respectively. The source code will be released at https://github.com/PolarisFTL/C2FXNet.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at ACM Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: C2FXNet 用双层场景引导（GRU 循环推理的 Multi-step Reasoning Router + Fine Scene Refinement）驱动 Scene-aware MoE，在不针对场景单独训练的前提下统一检测恶劣天气目标。在 RTTS、ExDark 与自建 AWD 上分别达到 63.70%、71.14%、54.19% mAP，雾天、暗光、晴天条件下均超过现有方法。
Motivation: 恶劣天气下视觉退化破坏语义特征，现有方法依赖针对特定条件设计的检测器，无法在统一模型内跨场景泛化。
Method: MRR 对压缩的多尺度视觉线索与冻结的粗场景原型做 GRU 循环场景推理；FSR 用图像级语义线索调制高层特征以处理局部变化；SMoE 在二者联合引导下动态组合场景专属专家，实现无需场景特定训练的多场景检测。
Result: 在 RTTS 上 63.70% mAP、ExDark 上 71.14% mAP、自建 Adverse Weather Dataset (AWD) 上 54.19% mAP，在雾天、暗光、晴天条件下一致优于 state-of-the-art 方法。
Conclusion: 把粗场景推理与细粒度语义调制耦合起来驱动 MoE 专家路由，可以在单一检测器内覆盖雾、暗、晴多场景而无需分场景训练；代码将开源。

papers.title: Graph Domain Adaptation Does Not End with Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Graph domain adaptation (GDA) transfers knowledge from a labeled source graph to an unlabeled target graph under shifts in both node attributes and graph structure. Existing methods primarily adapt graph representations through propagation redesign, distribution alignment, or source-to-target transition modeling, but still rely on a single graph-propagating path for target prediction. This leaves open whether an adapted graph representation exhausts the predictive evidence available in the target domain, since the graph-aware expert and graph-free local expert may exhibit different failure modes under topological shifts. To address this limitation, we propose EviGDA, an Evidence-Augmented Graph Domain Adaptation framework that complements graph representation adaptation with a graph-free local expert. The graph-aware expert performs message passing and entropy-aware marginal alignment, while the graph-free local expert learns solely from source node features and labels without graph propagation or target alignment. The two experts are optimized independently and combined only at inference through a task-level constant probability mixture, preserving complementary evidence without joint training, learned routing, or target pseudo-labels. Extensive experiments on ten datasets and 16 transfer tasks show that EviGDA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 图域适应 (GDA) 只改图表示并不穷尽目标域证据：EviGDA 在图感知专家（消息传递 + 熵感知边际对齐）之外加一个完全不用图传播与目标对齐的图无关局部专家，两者独立训练、仅在推理时按任务级常数概率混合。在十个数据集、16 个迁移任务上超过现有 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: 现有 GDA 方法（传播重设计、分布对齐、源到目标转移建模）仍只靠单一图传播路径做目标预测；在拓扑偏移下图感知专家与无图局部专家的失效模式不同，单一路径可能丢掉目标域可用的预测证据。
Method: 提出 EviGDA（Evidence-Augmented Graph Domain Adaptation）：图感知专家做消息传递并加熵感知边际对齐 (entropy-aware marginal alignment)；图无关局部专家只用源节点特征与标签训练，不做图传播也不做目标对齐。两个专家独立优化，推理时用任务级常数概率混合 (task-level constant probability mixture) 组合，不联合训练、不用学习式路由、不用目标伪标签。
Result: 在十个数据集、16 个迁移任务上的实验中，EviGDA 超过 state-of-the-art 基线。
Conclusion: 图表示适应之外还存在互补的无图局部证据，用推理期常数概率混合两个独立训练的专家即可在节点属性与结构双重偏移下提升 GDA 预测。

papers.title: How Strongly Should Task State Influence an LLM Agent?
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon assigned work requires an LLM agent to track the state of a task: which steps are done, blocked, cancelled, or open to repetition. Agent systems either keep this state as text in the prompt and rely on the model to read that text, or move the state into a module that enforces it, and each system is evaluated as a whole, so no one knows how much reliability comes from the state being shown, told, or enforced. We fix the task rules, the model, and paired episodes and vary how strongly task state reaches the agent: a raw transcript, an exact checklist, per-turn directives from a state machine compiled from the brief and advanced only by execution receipts, or an enforcement gate on that machine that refuses state-violating actions; every episode is scored by exact payload matching against dynamic ground truth. Across three models, two reasoning regimes, and two domains, four findings hold without per-turn reasoning: displaying accurate state is unreliable, an unverified ledger the agent writes itself beats an accurate checklist it is shown, directives help in proportion to the model's obedience, and enforcement needs no obedience but is bounded by the correctness of its state and by the matcher that maps requests to steps; per-turn reasoning at a 235B agent compresses these separations without repairing the text rungs. The same gate, compiled from $τ^2$-bench's airline policy, raises a 235B agent's pass$^1$ from 0.39 to 0.54 and changes nothing for a 35B agent that rarely violates the policy; on PM-Bench, where acting turns on recognizing a cue rather than on state, showing the record is the best rung--matching or beating both gates and reversing the ledger-over-checklist finding--and enforcing the matcher's judgement drops a 35B agent below its raw transcript. Enforcement pays when failures are state-decidable and frequent, and hurts when the gate's judgement is wrong.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文固定任务规则、模型与配对 episode，只改变任务状态以何种强度到达 LLM agent（原始 transcript、精确 checklist、状态机指令、强制 gate），用 exact payload matching 打分。跨 3 个模型、2 种推理机制、2 个领域：展示准确状态不可靠，agent 自写的未校验 ledger 优于给它的准确 checklist，指令效果正比于模型服从性，强制执行不需服从但受状态正确性与 matcher 上限约束；在 τ²-bench 上 gate 把 235B agent 的 pass@1 从 0.39 提到 0.54，对 35B agent 无变化。
Motivation: Agent 系统要么把任务状态写进 prompt 让模型自己读，要么放进模块强制执行，且每个系统被整体评估，因此没人知道可靠性究竟来自状态被展示、被告知还是被强制。
Method: 固定任务规则、模型与配对 episode，按四档强度注入任务状态：raw transcript、exact checklist、由 brief 编译并仅凭 execution receipts 推进的状态机 per-turn directives、拒绝违规动作的 enforcement gate；每个 episode 用 exact payload matching 对照 dynamic ground truth 打分，跨 3 个模型、2 种推理机制、2 个领域比较。
Result: 四条发现在无 per-turn 推理时一致成立：展示准确状态不可靠；agent 自写的未校验 ledger 优于展示给它的准确 checklist；指令收益正比于模型服从性；强制不需服从但受状态正确性与 matcher 正确性约束。235B agent 上由 τ²-bench 航空政策编译的 gate 把 pass@1 从 0.39 提到 0.54，对很少违规的 35B agent 无变化。PM-Bench 上展示记录最好、反转 ledger 优于 checklist 的结论，强制 matcher 判断把 35B agent 压到 raw transcript 之下；235B 上 per-turn 推理压缩这些差距但不修复 text rung。
Conclusion: 当失败可由状态判定且频繁时强制执行划算，当 gate 判断错误时反而有害；状态展示、指令与强制是三条收益来源不同的独立 rung，不能按整体系统笼统归因。

papers.title: Initialization and Stopping Tolerance in CPU Dermoscopic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Contour initialization and numerical stopping can jointly affect the evaluation of active-contour segmentation. We examine their interaction using the open-source scikit-image Chan-Vese implementation on a resized ISIC 2017 mirror. A fixed development set of 100 images selects a common input channel; all 600 images in the repository's held-out partition are then evaluated. Otsu thresholding is compared with checkerboard-, disk-, and Otsu-initialized contours under default and tighter level-set tolerances. At the default tolerance, Otsu initialization increases mean image Dice from 0.6011 to 0.6660 relative to checkerboard initialization, a paired difference of 0.0649 (95% image-bootstrap interval [0.0452, 0.0860]). Otsu thresholding alone achieves 0.6897. The default disk initializer stops after one iteration on 471 images. Tightening the tolerance reduces the Otsu-seed advantage over checkerboard initialization to 0.0197, with most runs reaching the 500-iteration limit. The default-tolerance advantage also reverses between small- and large-lesion strata. These findings show that an improvement over a generic initializer can coexist with deterioration relative to the threshold baseline. Evaluations should retain the unrefined mask as a comparator and report the initial-field definition, stopping tolerance, and observed iteration counts together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 scikit-image 的 Chan-Vese 活动轮廓上，初始化方式与 level-set 停止容差共同决定分割评测结论：默认容差下 Otsu 初始化把 ISIC 2017 held-out 600 张的 mean image Dice 从 checkerboard 的 0.6011 提到 0.6660（配对差 0.0649，95% image-bootstrap 区间 [0.0452, 0.0860]），但 Otsu 阈值本身已达 0.6897。收紧容差后 Otsu 相对 checkerboard 的优势缩到 0.0197 且多数运行撞上 500 次迭代上限，默认容差优势还会在小病灶与大病灶分层间反转。作者要求评测保留未细化掩膜作为对照，并同时报告初始场定义、停止容差与实际迭代次数。
Motivation: 活动轮廓的评测差异可能来自初始化与数值停止条件的耦合，而非分割本身；若不把阈值基线与迭代计数一起报告，会把相对通用初始化器的提升误读成真实改进。
Method: 用开源 scikit-image Chan-Vese 实现，在缩放后的 ISIC 2017 镜像上做受控比较：固定 100 张开发集选定统一输入通道，随后对仓库 held-out 分区全部 600 张评测；比较 Otsu 阈值与 checkerboard、disk、Otsu 三种初始化在默认与更紧 level-set 容差下的表现，并按病灶大小分层。
Result: 默认容差下 Otsu 初始化相对 checkerboard 把 mean image Dice 从 0.6011 提到 0.6660，配对差 0.0649（95% image-bootstrap 区间 [0.0452, 0.0860]）；Otsu 阈值单独达 0.6897。默认 disk 初始化在 471 张图上仅迭代一次即停止。收紧容差后 Otsu 相对 checkerboard 的优势降到 0.0197，多数运行达到 500 次迭代上限；默认容差的优势在小病灶与大病灶分层之间发生反转。
Conclusion: 相对通用初始化器的提升可以与相对阈值基线的劣化并存，因此活动轮廓评测必须保留未细化掩膜作对照，并把初始场定义、停止容差与迭代次数一并报告。

papers.title: Real-Time Atomic-Resolution Electron Phase Imaging without Probe Calibration via Ptychography-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Atomic-scale phase imaging is central to resolving defects, interfaces, and weakly scattering atoms that govern the behavior of nanoscale materials. Electron ptychography delivers sub-ångström phase sensitivity but remains an offline technique, because its iterative reconstruction is computationally expensive and sensitive to experimental calibration, preventing live use during data acquisition. Here, a ptychography-supervised local inference framework is presented that converts four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) into an acquisition-compatible phase-imaging workflow. Physics-constrained reference phase maps reconstructed from a single experimental AuPd dataset serve as teacher labels for a compact model that predicts local phase patches directly from diffraction measurements, without explicit probe input or online iterative optimization. Full-field images are assembled by deterministic overlap stitching. The workflow reaches an online latency of about 0.27 ms per probe position and a throughput of about 20,000 positions per second, an approximately 1,000-fold speed-up over GPU-accelerated ePIE, while preserving atomic-scale lattice contrast and reciprocal-space fidelity. Without fine-tuning, the same model transfers across materials (WS2), defocus conditions (high-entropy alloy nanoparticles), and instruments (hBN at 300 kV). The approach amortizes ptychographic redundancy into a fast, generalizable workflow that enables real-time atomic-scale phase imaging for materials microscopy.
papers.comment: Submitted to Advanced Science on June 18, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把电子叠层衍射 (ptychography) 的迭代重建蒸馏成一个紧凑的局部推理模型，直接从 4D-STEM 衍射图预测局部相位块，无需显式探针标定或在线迭代优化，再用确定性重叠拼接成整幅图。单探针位置在线延迟约 0.27 ms、吞吐约 20,000 位置/秒，比 GPU 加速 ePIE 快约 1,000 倍，且不微调即可跨材料 (WS2)、离焦条件 (高熵合金纳米颗粒) 与仪器 (300 kV hBN) 迁移。
Motivation: 电子叠层衍射虽有亚埃级相位灵敏度，但迭代重建计算量大且对实验标定敏感，只能离线处理，无法在数据采集时实时成像。
Method: 以单一 AuPd 实验数据集经物理约束重建的相位图作 teacher label，训练紧凑模型直接从衍射测量预测局部相位块，不输入探针、不做在线迭代优化；整幅图由确定性重叠拼接组装。
Result: 在线延迟约 0.27 ms/探针位置，吞吐约 20,000 位置/秒，相对 GPU 加速 ePIE 约 1,000 倍加速，同时保持原子级晶格衬度与倒空间保真度；零微调迁移到 WS2、高熵合金纳米颗粒与 300 kV hBN。
Conclusion: 叠层衍射的冗余可以被摊销成一个快速、可泛化的推理流程，使材料显微学的原子级相位成像达到实时。

papers.title: Toolcompass: Guiding Tool Trialing, Not Suppressing It
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents must generalize from tools seen during training to unseen tools at deployment. A key challenge is tool trialing, i.e., excessive trials waste the interaction budget, whereas selective trials enable exploration of unfamiliar tools. Existing outcome-based post-training leaves wasteful trials unguided, while turn-level supervision may suppress necessary exploration. We introduce ToolCompass, a post-training framework that guides tool trialing by organizing tool-call representations according to shared functions. Specifically, ToolCompass models each function class as a von Mises--Fisher distribution and jointly reduces intra-function variation across domains and increases inter-function separation. This structure transfers experience from seen tools to functionally similar unseen tools, directing exploration away from unrelated alternatives. ToolCompass requires no ground-truth call traces or unseen-tool access and incurs no inference overhead. Experiments on AppWorld and FTRL show consistent gains across GRPO, RFT, and DMPO. improves AppWorld OOD task success by up to 10.71 percentage points over vanilla post-training and performs best among competitive baselines on both benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ToolCompass 是面向 LLM agent 工具试用 (tool trialing) 的后训练框架：按共享功能对工具调用表征分组，把每个功能类建模为 von Mises--Fisher 分布，同时压小类内跨域差异、拉大类间分离，把探索导向功能相似的未见工具。在 AppWorld 与 FTRL 上对 GRPO、RFT、DMPO 均有一致增益，AppWorld OOD 任务成功率相对 vanilla post-training 最高提升 10.71 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM agent 需要从训练期见过的工具泛化到部署期未见工具，过度试用浪费交互预算，选择性试用才利于探索；现有 outcome-based 后训练对浪费性试用不加引导，turn-level 监督又可能压制必要探索。
Method: 按共享功能组织工具调用表征，每个功能类用 von Mises--Fisher 分布建模，联合优化减小类内跨域变化、增大类间分离，把经验从已见工具迁移到功能相似的未见工具；不需要真实调用轨迹或未见工具访问，推理阶段无额外开销。
Result: 在 AppWorld 与 FTRL 上，对 GRPO、RFT、DMPO 三种后训练方法均取得一致增益；AppWorld OOD 任务成功率相对 vanilla post-training 最高提升 10.71 个百分点，并在两个 benchmark 的竞争性基线中表现最佳。
Conclusion: 按功能类结构化工具调用表征可以引导试用而不压制探索，且无需真实轨迹、未见工具访问和推理开销即可把经验迁移到未见工具。

papers.title: Seeing Is Not Perceiving: When Synthetic Consumers Can and Cannot Pretest Visual Marketing
papers.abstract_en: Marketers now deploy generative AI agents as synthetic consumers to pretest visual assets such as logos, packaging, and advertising at a fraction of human-panel cost. However, this procedure assumes that a model seeing a visual cue can also perceive its consumer meaning, which is largely untested. We stress-test the assumption using six canonical visual marketing experiments, varying the two levers managers control: model generation (GPT-4o-mini vs. GPT-5.4-mini) and input format (plain text vs. JSON). Every resulting configuration passed the manipulation checks; however, none of the configurations reproduced more than two of the six human effects, and the remainder were nonsignificant. The one exception was a significant reversal of the human pattern. Providing conceptual or empirical evidence through in-context learning steers average responses toward the human effect. Yet steering has a limit: even when it succeeds, a configuration reproduces less than half of the natural spread of human responses and so understates consumer heterogeneity. We integrate these results into an AI governance protocol (Calibrate, Intervene, Deploy) that delineates when synthetic consumers can responsibly screen creatives and when human panels remain necessary.
papers.comment: 58 pages (30 pages of main text, 23 pages of appendix), 18 figures, 25 tables. All six studies were preregistered on AsPredicted
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用六个经典视觉营销实验压力测试生成式 AI 作为“合成消费者”的前提：GPT-4o-mini 与 GPT-5.4-mini、纯文本与 JSON 两种输入格式的全部配置都通过操纵检验，但没有任何配置复现出六个人类效应中的两个以上，其余均不显著，且有一例出现与人类模式相反的显著反转。in-context learning 提供概念或实证证据可把平均反应拉向人类效应，但即便成功也复现不到人类反应自然分布的一半，仍低估消费者异质性。
Motivation: 营销方以极低成本用生成式 AI 代理预检 logo、包装、广告等视觉素材，这默认模型“看见”视觉线索就能“感知”其消费者含义，而该前提基本未经检验。
Method: 设计六个经典视觉营销实验，交叉操纵管理者可控的两个杠杆——模型（GPT-4o-mini vs. GPT-5.4-mini）与输入格式（纯文本 vs. JSON），对每种配置做操纵检验并比对人类效应；再用 in-context learning 注入概念或实证证据进行引导，最后把结果整合为 Calibrate-Intervene-Deploy 的 AI 治理协议。
Result: 全部配置均通过操纵检验，但没有任何配置复现出六个人类效应中的两个以上，其余效应不显著；仅一例出现对人类模式的显著反转。经 in-context learning 引导后平均反应趋向人类效应，但即便引导成功，配置复现的人类反应自然分布不足一半。六项研究均在 AsPredicted 预注册，全文 58 页、18 图、25 表。
Conclusion: 合成消费者可以按 Calibrate-Intervene-Deploy 协议筛查创意的条件是先校准其能否复现人类效应，复现不了或只覆盖不到一半人类反应分布时仍需人类面板；看见视觉线索不等于感知其消费者含义。

papers.title: Marginal Log-Likelihood Increments under Dirichlet-Smoothed Markov Estimation
papers.abstract_en: For a Dirichlet-smoothed transition model, the effect of adding one workflow trace to the training archive is an exact change in reference-weighted log likelihood. We derive that change and show that it is a weighted reduction of Kullback--Leibler divergence between the reference conditionals and the model. From this form we obtain an upper bound on the gain available to any acquisition, which expresses a millinat difference as a share of what is attainable, an exact covariance identity for the effect of the reference weighting, and a sign criterion for the interaction between two candidates, from which the batch objective is neither submodular nor supermodular. A case study on the BPI Challenge 2012 loan-application log measures all three and finds a positive selection result in one of the four combinations of reference weighting and budget unit. There, of two regressors fitted to identical descriptors and identical labels, the one that predicts individual increments far more accurately, median $R^2$ 0.87 against 0.62, realizes the smaller share of the attainable gain, 61 against 69 per cent, so ranking accuracy for individual traces is neither necessary nor sufficient for batch quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Dirichlet 平滑的 Markov 转移模型，推导新增一条 workflow trace 带来的边际对数似然增量：它是参考条件与模型之间 KL 散度的加权下降，并由此得到任意 acquisition 增益的上界、参考加权的协方差恒等式，以及两个候选的符号判据（说明 batch 目标既非 submodular 也非 supermodular）。在 BPI Challenge 2012 贷款申请日志案例中，预测单条增量更准的回归器（median R² 0.87 对 0.62）反而实现更小的可达增益份额（61% 对 69%），说明单条 trace 的排序精度对 batch 质量既不必要也不充分。
Motivation: 向训练档案添加数据的边际收益如何度量、以及单条样本的增量预测精度能否指导批量 acquisition，缺少闭式刻画；且 batch 目标的次模性常被默认而未被检验。
Method: 对 Dirichlet 平滑转移模型推导新增一条 trace 的精确参考加权对数似然变化，化为参考条件与模型间 KL 散度的加权下降；据此给出任意 acquisition 的增益上界（以 millinat 差表示为可达份额）、参考加权的精确协方差恒等式，以及两候选交互的符号判据；在 BPI Challenge 2012 贷款申请日志上用两个在相同描述子与标签上拟合的回归器做案例研究，衡量三种结论。
Result: 案例研究在四种参考加权与预算单位组合中有一个组合得到正向选择结果；两个回归器中预测单条增量更准者 median R² 0.87 对 0.62，但实现的可达增益份额更小，61% 对 69%。
Conclusion: 单条 trace 的增量排序精度对 batch acquisition 质量既不必要也不充分；batch 目标既非 submodular 也非 supermodular，选 acquisition 不能只看单点增量预测。

papers.title: Teaching Reinforcement Learning and Humanoid Robotics to High-School Students: An Expert-Validated Curriculum Design on a Low-Cost Open Platform
papers.abstract_en: Lower cost open source robots and reinforcement learning (RL) simulation tools create new opportunities for precollege students to engage with contemporary robotics. However, translating a complete research workflow, spanning mechanical assembly, electrical setup, simulation, policy learning, system identification, and physical deployment, into a coherent course for novice learners remains challenging. We present an integrated robotics course framework that organizes these activities around a shared robotic artifact. The framework combines parallel disciplinary tracks, sequencing based on technical dependencies, progressive integration of simulation and hardware, layered performance checkpoints, and structures for balancing collaborative work with individual accountability. We illustrate the framework through a high school curriculum organized around a robot project in which pairs of students assemble an open source humanoid robot, train a walking policy in simulation, and deploy it on the physical platform. The framework was developed through an iterative design process that included formative review by five experts in robotics research, engineering, secondary STEM education, and curriculum design. Expert feedback highlighted three central design tensions: authenticity versus cognitive load, system integration versus timely visible progress, and team construction versus individual accountability. These tensions informed the final framework presented in this paper. This work offers a structured approach for adapting robotics research workflows into interdisciplinary precollege courses; future classroom studies are needed to examine implementation and student learning.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for presentation at the IEEE International Conference on Teaching, Assessment, and Learning for Engineering (TALE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向高中生的机器人课程框架，把机械装配、电气搭建、仿真、策略学习、系统辨识到实机部署串成一条以共享机器人实物为主线的教学流程，学生两人一组装配开源人形机器人、在仿真中训练行走策略并部署到实体平台。经五位专家形成性评审迭代，框架明确了三组设计张力：真实性与认知负荷、系统集成与及时可见进展、团队搭建与个人问责。
Motivation: 低成本开源机器人与 RL 仿真工具已让 precollege 学生能接触当代机器人研究，但把覆盖装配、电气、仿真、策略学习、系统辨识与实机部署的完整研究流程转成新手可学的连贯课程仍然困难。
Method: 提出以共享机器人实物为主线的整合课程框架：并行学科轨道、按技术依赖排序、仿真与硬件渐进融合、分层性能检查点、协作与个人问责并重的结构；通过迭代设计流程开发，含机器人研究、工程、中学 STEM 教育与课程设计五位专家的形成性评审。
Result: 以高中生两人一组装配开源人形机器人、仿真训练行走策略并部署到实体平台的项目为例说明框架；专家反馈指出三组核心设计张力：真实性 vs 认知负荷、系统集成 vs 及时可见进展、团队搭建 vs 个人问责，这些张力塑造了最终框架。
Conclusion: 把机器人研究流程改写成分阶段、带检查点的 precollege 跨学科课程是可行的结构化路径；作者指出未来需要课堂研究来检验实施效果与学生学习。

papers.title: When Riemann flows with Wasserstein: Generative Modeling of Probability Distributions on Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Many scientific datasets, such as molecular conformational ensembles or single-cell tissue measurements, are naturally modeled as meta-distributions: distributions over probability measures on non-Euclidean domains. Existing generative methods largely assume Euclidean geometry and fail to capture this structure. We introduce Riemannian Wasserstein Entropic Flow Matching (RWEFM), a generative framework on the Wasserstein space $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ of a Riemannian manifold $(\mathcal{M},g)$. RWEFM is trained by regressing a neural vector field onto Riemannian optimal transport velocities, using McCann displacement interpolations as conditional paths. We confirm theoretically that this construction leads to a valid flow matching approach on $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ and introduce the Riemannian Entropic Map, a GPU-efficient approximation of the optimal transport map on manifolds. Our experiments show that by respecting the intrinsic geometry of the data, RWEFM can generate whole single-cell samples in hyperspherical latent spaces and protein conformational ensembles on the torus. As RWEFM requires only a geodesic distance and a projection operator, it is not restricted to manifolds with closed-form geometry, which we demonstrate by generating distributions on a general triangulated mesh.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Riemannian Wasserstein Entropic Flow Matching (RWEFM)，在黎曼流形的 Wasserstein 空间 P2(M) 上做生成建模，用回归神经向量场拟合黎曼最优传输速度、以 McCann 位移插值作条件路径，并给出 GPU 高效的 Riemannian Entropic Map 近似流形上的最优传输映射。理论上确认该构造在 P2(M) 上构成合法 flow matching，实验上生成了超球面隐空间的整细胞样本、环面上的蛋白质构象系综，以及一般三角网格上的分布。
Motivation: 分子构象系综、单细胞组织测量等科学数据本质是“分布上的分布”（meta-distributions），定义在非欧几里得域上；现有生成方法大多假设欧氏几何，无法捕捉这种结构。
Method: RWEFM 在黎曼流形 (M,g) 的 Wasserstein 空间 P2(M) 上定义生成框架，训练时把神经向量场回归到黎曼最优传输速度，条件路径取 McCann 位移插值；引入 Riemannian Entropic Map 作为流形上最优传输映射的 GPU 高效近似。方法只需测地距离与投影算子，不依赖闭式几何。
Result: 理论上确认该构造在 P2(M) 上给出合法的 flow matching；实验展示了在超球面隐空间生成整细胞样本、在环面 (torus) 上生成蛋白质构象系综，并在无闭式几何的一般三角网格 (triangulated mesh) 上生成分布。
Conclusion: 尊重数据内在几何的 Wasserstein 空间生成建模可行且通用，只需测地距离与投影算子即可推广到非闭式几何的流形。

papers.title: Targeted Review for AI-Assisted Biodiversity Surveys: Active Continuous-Score Occupancy Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We increasingly use machine learning to label scientific datasets. The models we develop and deploy are improving all the time, but they are not and will likely never be perfect. Mistakes matter, as errors can propagate into our scientific understanding, particularly when systematically biased. Very reasonably, scientists thus review substantial proportions of ML-generated labels to verify or correct mistakes in pursuit of ensuring their scientific findings are not biased by ML. In this work, we focus on helping scientists optimally allocate this reviewing effort relative to their scientific goals. We focus on a specific class of scientists (ecologists) and a specific, widespread, and impactful modeling target (occupancy modeling, which estimates where species are likely to occur, conditioned on environmental factors). We introduce Active Continuous-Score Occupancy Modeling (ACORN), a method that incorporates ML predictions into occupancy models and strategically selects samples for expert review that are maximally informative for downstream ecological analysis. Across camera-trap and bioacoustic datasets, our method recovers ecological conclusions close to those obtained from fully human-labeled data, while requiring substantially fewer expert reviews than non-targeted review policies. Our results suggest that ML-assisted scientific workflows should optimize expert effort for downstream inference, rather than for classifier accuracy alone, especially when human review budget is limited. Our code is available at https://github.com/timmh/acorn
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ACORN（Active Continuous-Score Occupancy Modeling），把 ML 预测直接嵌入 occupancy model，并按对下游生态推断的信息量挑选送交专家复核的样本。在相机陷阱与生物声学数据上，该方法用远少于非定向复核策略的专家工作量，恢复出接近全人工标注数据的生态结论。作者主张 ML 辅助科学流程应把专家精力对准下游推断，而非仅追求分类器精度，尤其在复核预算有限时。
Motivation: ML 标签的系统性偏差会传导进科学结论，科学家因此复核大量标签；但复核预算有限，按分类器不确定性等非定向策略分配复核并不能直接服务于下游科学推断。
Method: ACORN 将 ML 预测（含连续分数）纳入 occupancy model，估计物种出现概率随环境因子的变化；再按样本对下游生态分析的信息量做主动选择，把最有价值的样本送交专家复核，形成面向推断的定向复核策略。
Result: 在 camera-trap 与 bioacoustic 数据集上，ACORN 恢复的生态结论接近全人工标注数据所得结论，而所需专家复核量远少于非定向复核策略；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 专家复核预算应按下游推断的需求分配，而不是只优化分类器精度；该结论在复核预算受限的 ML 辅助科学流程中尤其成立。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: From Experts to Sub-experts: Fine-grained Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for MoE LLMs
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) scale rapidly, dense full-parameter adaptation becomes increasingly expensive, motivating sparse and modular architectures such as Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. This shift raises a key question for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT): at what granularity should parameters be selected and updated? Existing PEFT methods such as LoRA operate on predefined weight matrices, while expert-level sparse tuning methods update entire selected experts. However, we observe that activated experts are internally sparse, with only a small fraction of intermediate channels strongly responding to downstream tasks, indicating that expert-level adaptation is still too coarse. We propose NSFT (Neural Sub-expert Fine-Tuning), a fine-grained PEFT framework that refines MoE adaptation from experts to sub-experts. NSFT decomposes each expert along the intermediate dimension into structured channel groups and selects task-relevant sub-experts by combining routing importance with intra-expert activation saliency. To optimize sparse partial updates, NSFT further introduces learning-rate scaling and dynamic gradient scaling to compensate for the reduced effective update magnitude. Experiments on OLMoE and Ling-mini-2.0 across challenging domain-specific tasks and general benchmarks show that NSFT consistently outperforms representative PEFT and expert-level sparse tuning baselines, while using substantially fewer trainable parameters and preserving competitive general capability. These results suggest that sub-expert-level adaptation is a more precise and efficient PEFT paradigm for MoE LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NSFT 把 MoE 的参数高效微调粒度从整专家细化到子专家：沿中间维把每个专家切成结构化 channel group，用路由重要性加专家内激活显著性选出任务相关子专家，只更新这些部分。在 OLMoE 与 Ling-mini-2.0 的领域任务和通用基准上，它以明显更少的可训练参数稳定超过代表性 PEFT 与专家级稀疏微调基线，同时保持有竞争力的通用能力。
Motivation: MoE 全参数适配成本随规模上升，而 LoRA 只在预定义权重矩阵上操作、专家级稀疏微调又整专家更新；作者观察到被激活的专家内部本身稀疏，只有少数中间 channel 强响应下游任务，说明专家级粒度仍然太粗。
Method: NSFT (Neural Sub-expert Fine-Tuning) 沿中间维把每个专家分解为结构化 channel group，结合 routing importance 与 intra-expert activation saliency 选出任务相关子专家；为优化稀疏部分更新，引入 learning-rate scaling 与 dynamic gradient scaling 来补偿有效更新幅度的下降。
Result: 在 OLMoE 和 Ling-mini-2.0 上的领域特定任务与通用基准中，NSFT 一致优于代表性 PEFT 与专家级稀疏微调基线，可训练参数量大幅减少，同时保持有竞争力的通用能力。
Conclusion: 子专家级适配是比专家级更精确、更高效的 MoE LLM PEFT 范式，前提是用路由重要性与激活显著性联合选子专家并补偿稀疏更新的幅度损失。

papers.title: CODA: Depth-Aligned Scene Completion and Object Decomposition from a Single RGB-D Image
papers.abstract_en: Robots operating safely in cluttered everyday environments often need to infer scene geometry from partial observations. Methods that detect objects in 2D and reconstruct them independently struggle in such scenes: a missed object is never reconstructed, a merged detection can fuse two objects, and separately reconstructed meshes may overlap or fail to touch their supporting surfaces. We introduce CODA (Complete Once, Decompose Afterward), a generative model that instead reconstructs the complete scene geometry from a single unsegmented RGB-D image, then separates the surface into the surrounding environment and movable objects. Still, generated scene geometry can drift from the observed partial point cloud. To reduce this drift, CODA uses two explicit 3D grounding mechanisms to keep reconstructed geometry consistent with observed surfaces while completing unseen regions. Experiments on HomebrewedDB and our custom cluttered-scene dataset show more accurate reconstructions and a higher fraction of objects remaining in place under simulated gravity than both object-first and scene-first baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CODA (Complete Once, Decompose Afterward) 从单张未分割 RGB-D 图一次性生成完整场景几何，再把表面分解为环境与可动物体，并用两个显式 3D grounding 机制把生成几何锚定在观测点云上以抑制漂移。在 HomebrewedDB 与自建杂乱场景数据集上，其重建更准确，且在模拟重力下保持原位的物体比例高于 object-first 与 scene-first 基线。
Motivation: 杂乱日常环境中先 2D 检测再逐个重建的流程会漏检即漏重建、合并检测会把两个物体融成一个，独立重建的 mesh 还可能互相穿插或不接触支撑面。
Method: CODA 是生成模型：输入单张未分割 RGB-D 图，先补全未观测区域生成完整场景几何，再将表面分解为周围环境与可动物体；用两个显式 3D grounding 机制让生成几何与观测部分点云保持一致，同时补全看不见的部分。
Result: 在 HomebrewedDB 与作者自建的杂乱场景数据集上，CODA 的重建精度更高，且在模拟重力检验中保持在原位的物体比例高于 object-first 与 scene-first 两类基线。
Conclusion: 先整体补全场景再做物体分解、并用观测点云显式约束生成几何，比先检测后重建或先场景后物体的顺序更能得到接触支撑面且稳定的物体几何。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GameDirector: Decoupling Gameplay Logic from Rendering for Player-Configurable Game World Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent game world models support realistic visual simulation and interactive gameplay based on player inputs. However, they typically learn environment dynamics from pixel-level supervision, jointly modeling perception, memory, state transitions, and rendering within a single end-to-end framework. While this design enables open-ended, action-controllable generation, it still falls short of delivering a complete gameplay experience. Games are governed by explicit mechanics, such as health deduction, skill activation, combat rules, and termination conditions. These mechanics depend on precise and consistent state transitions that generative models alone cannot reliably enforce. In contrast, game engines can guarantee such mechanics through hard-coded rules, but provide limited flexibility for player-driven creation. To bridge these paradigms, we introduce GameDirector, the first agentic framework that decouples rule-based gameplay logic from visual rendering. Given player-defined configurations, the framework acts as an intelligent director that interprets visual observations, updates game states, tactically controls NPCs, and enforces gameplay rules. It then translates these decisions into text prompts that guide the video world model to render the resulting gameplay. This separation allows players to configure characters, states, and rules much like a game developer while preserving coherent game mechanics. Experiments on three games, using data collected by our automated gameplay agent, show that GameDirector achieves accurate state tracking, reliable rule following, and improves boss action quality by more than 39.9% over various end-to-end game world model settings. Overall, by externalizing player-controllable game logic, GameDirector establishes a middle ground between hard-coded simulation and generative modeling, enabling more flexible and closed-loop gameplay experiences.

papers.title: Decoupling Disease, Covariates, and Individual Variability: A Unified Disentanglement Framework for Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Accurately isolating disease-related features from confounding covariates (e.g., age, gender, site) and individual variations remains a fundamental challenge in medical image classification. Traditional regression-based approaches may ignore non-linear relations between image features and true covariates. To overcome this issue, we present a generalized Medical Imaging Disentanglement Learning (MedIDL) framework. MedIDL maps image features into three mutually orthogonal latent spaces through specialized disentanglement heads: a disease classification head guided by a supervised loss, a covariate-alignment head constrained by cross-subject similarity matching, and a Gaussian head absorbing individual variations. We evaluated our framework across 7 datasets encompassing diverse imaging modalities. MedIDL outperforms state-of-the-art supervised and self-supervised classification methods in accuracy across all datasets. Association analyses demonstrate that MedIDL successfully isolates target-specific latent representations. Gradient-based interpretability mappings localize pathognomonic patterns aligning with established clinical literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出医学影像解耦学习框架 MedIDL，用三个专用解耦头把图像特征映射到三个互相正交的潜空间：监督损失引导的疾病分类头、跨被试相似度匹配约束的协变量对齐头、吸收个体差异的 Gaussian 头。在覆盖多种成像模态的 7 个数据集上，MedIDL 的分类准确率全面超过现有监督与自监督方法，关联分析显示其确实分离出目标特异的潜表征。
Motivation: 医学影像分类中年龄、性别、扫描站点等混杂协变量与个体差异会污染疾病特征；传统回归式解耦假设线性关系，会漏掉图像特征与真实协变量之间的非线性依赖。
Method: MedIDL 将图像特征经三个专用解耦头投到三个互相正交的潜空间：疾病分类头用监督损失，协变量对齐头用跨被试相似度匹配 (cross-subject similarity matching) 约束，Gaussian 头吸收个体变异；另用基于梯度的可解释性映射定位病征性模式。
Result: 在 7 个覆盖多种成像模态的数据集上，MedIDL 的分类准确率在全部数据集上超过 state-of-the-art 的监督与自监督分类方法；关联分析表明其成功分离出目标特异的潜表征，梯度可解释性映射定位到的病征性模式与既有临床文献一致。
Conclusion: 把疾病、协变量与个体变异解耦到正交潜空间，可以在不丢疾病信号的前提下消除混杂，且该表示在多种模态上都带来一致的准确率提升。

papers.title: Testing-Driven Reliability Audit of Trajectory-Based Early Outcome Prediction for LLM Agents: Target-Specific Calibration Transfer Persists Within a Single Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Predicting early outcomes based on trajectory can decrease the expenses associated with agent evaluation by terminating a run once the outcome becomes sufficiently predictable, assuming that the predictor's confidence is properly calibrated. Calibration is at risk when a predictor is applied to an agent on which it was never trained, but it is not known whether such transfer failures are broad across agent systems or concentrated in specific target agent/head combinations. Using public SWE-bench Verified trajectories and a frozen dual-head early-outcome prediction pipeline, we ran a leave-one-agent-out calibration audit, a shared-predictor leave-two-agents-out control, oracle prior correction, and a robustness battery over training cohorts, task resampling, task halves, jackknife, and thresholds. Fixed-scaffold TerminalBench analysis served as a pre-registered boundary test. Broad same-predictor pairwise heterogeneity was not supported; the median pairwise corrected-gap differences were 0.0180 (SUCCESS head, 45 pairs) and 0.0385 (FAILURE head, 35 pairs), and the pre-registered heterogeneity criterion was not met on either head. Two specific combinations, gpt-5-mini/SUCCESS and claude-opus-4.6/FAILURE, showed persistent calibration-transfer errors (median corrected gaps 0.1377 and 0.1107) without a sign reversal under any frozen control. TerminalBench did not establish cross-benchmark replication: the success target produced zero decisions (INDETERMINATE), and the failure target did not satisfy the pre-registered persistence criterion. Therefore, a strong target-specific calibration-transfer error can exist within one frozen environment, but the evidence does not establish that the error is intrinsic to the model or general across benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 SWE-bench Verified 轨迹上用冻结的双头 (SUCCESS/FAILURE) 早期结局预测器做留一 agent 校准审计：广义的同预测器跨 agent 异质性不成立（中位成对校正差 0.0180/0.0385），但 gpt-5-mini/SUCCESS 与 claude-opus-4.6/FAILURE 两个组合出现持续的校准迁移误差（0.1377、0.1107），且在所有冻结对照下不反号。TerminalBench 边界测试未复现跨基准现象。
Motivation: 用轨迹早期预测提前终止 agent 运行可降低评测成本，但预测器换到未训练过的 agent 上校准可能失效；尚不清楚这种迁移失败是普遍现象，还是集中在特定 target/head 组合。
Method: 用公开 SWE-bench Verified 轨迹与冻结的双头早期结局预测管线，做留一 agent 校准审计、共享预测器留二 agent 对照、oracle prior 校正，以及覆盖训练队列、任务重采样、任务对半、jackknife 与阈值的稳健性检验；以固定 scaffold 的 TerminalBench 分析作为预注册边界测试。
Result: 同预测器成对异质性不成立：中位成对校正差 0.0180（SUCCESS 头，45 对）与 0.0385（FAILURE 头，35 对），两个头均未达预注册异质性判据。gpt-5-mini/SUCCESS 与 claude-opus-4.6/FAILURE 中位校正差分别为 0.1377 与 0.1107，在任一冻结对照下均无符号反转。TerminalBench 未建立跨基准复现：success target 产生零决策（INDETERMINATE），failure target 未满足预注册持续性判据。
Conclusion: 强的目标特异性校准迁移误差可以在单一冻结环境内存在，但现有证据不能证明该误差内禀于模型本身或能跨基准泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Cost-Aware LLM Evaluation via Bayesian Bandit Gittins Indices
papers.abstract_en: Exhaustively evaluating every candidate LLM configuration on every benchmark item to identify a high-performing one is costly. We formulate configuration selection as a cost-aware Bayesian bandit problem and propose GittinsEval, which draws on the Bayesian-optimal Gittins policy to determine which configuration to evaluate next and when to stop. We extend the policy with an anytime recommendation rule over both fully and partially evaluated configurations, using an LCB-style score to account for posterior uncertainty. GittinsEval is computationally efficient, requiring only lightweight online updates after offline precomputation. Across GSM8K, PIQA, AlpacaEval, and MMLU response matrices, GittinsEval is consistently competitive, with particularly strong gains over configuration-level Bayesian optimization on large-example benchmarks and over cost-unaware bandit baselines on large-candidate tasks. Crucially, GittinsEval often attains near-zero simple regret using only 1% to 2% of the exhaustive-evaluation cost; it also offers an adaptive stopping rule that typically triggers at 1% to 10%.
papers.comment: Spotlight at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning (DEMO)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 配置在基准题上的评测建模为 cost-aware Bayesian bandit，用 Gittins 索引决定下一个评测哪个配置、何时停止，并给出覆盖完全与部分评测配置的 anytime 推荐规则（LCB 式分数计入后验不确定性）。在 GSM8K、PIQA、AlpacaEval、MMLU 的 response matrix 上，仅用穷举评测成本的 1%–2% 即常达到近零 simple regret，自适应停止通常在 1%–10% 触发。
Motivation: 在每个基准的每道题上穷举评测所有候选 LLM 配置代价过高，需要在评测预算内尽早选出高性能配置并决定何时停。
Method: 将配置选择形式化为 cost-aware Bayesian bandit，提出 GittinsEval：基于贝叶斯最优 Gittins 策略选择下一个评测对象与停止时机，扩展出对完全和部分评测配置都适用的 anytime 推荐规则，用 LCB 式分数处理后验不确定性；离线预计算后仅需轻量在线更新。
Result: 在 GSM8K、PIQA、AlpacaEval、MMLU response matrix 上表现持续有竞争力：在大样本基准上明显优于配置级 Bayesian optimization，在大候选集任务上优于不计成本的 bandit 基线；常以穷举成本的 1%–2% 达到近零 simple regret，自适应停止规则通常在 1%–10% 处触发。
Conclusion: 把评测成本显式纳入贝叶斯 bandit 并用 Gittins 索引调度，可以在极小评测预算下选出接近最优的 LLM 配置，同时给出可用的停止时机。

papers.title: Ladders of Thought: A Self-Evolving Curriculum of Progressively Simplified Reasoning Traces
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) excel at reasoning when scaled to hundreds of billions of parameters, but small- and mid-scale models remain brittle reasoners even with knowledge distillation (KD). We present Ladders-of-Thought (LoT), a framework that improves reasoning by combining progressive question rewrites with a self-evolving curriculum. LoT automatically generates semantically faithful but easier variants of reasoning problems, organizes them into difficulty buckets using step-based measures, and employs a self-evolving bandit scheduler to allocate training adaptively. Evaluated on two reasoning domains, math and multi-hop reasoning, across 1-8B models from different families, LoT consistently improves over KD. It delivers large gains on arithmetic tasks (e.g., +32 percentage points on AddSub, +25pp on SVAMP), +2-8pp improvements on in-domain test splits, and strong though dataset-dependent benefits on multi-hop reasoning (e.g., +16pp on QASC, +25pp on StrategyQA). LoT also converges faster than staged curricula, highlighting the value of adaptive progression. These results show that progressive rewrites coupled with adaptive curricula provide a simple yet effective recipe for strengthening reasoning in smaller LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Ladders-of-Thought (LoT)：自动生成语义忠实但更简单的问题变体，按步数分难度桶，用自演化 bandit 调度器自适应分配训练，在 1–8B 小中模型上稳定超过知识蒸馏 (KD)。算术任务 AddSub +32pp、SVAMP +25pp，域内测试 +2–8pp，多跳推理 QASC +16pp、StrategyQA +25pp，且比阶段式课程收敛更快。
Motivation: 小中规模 LLM 即便经过知识蒸馏仍推理脆弱，缺少在数学与多跳推理上稳定提升其能力的训练课程机制。
Method: LoT 框架三步：渐进式问题改写生成语义忠实的更易变体；用基于步骤的度量把题目分入难度桶；以自演化 bandit 调度器自适应分配训练量，替代固定阶段式课程。
Result: 在来自不同家族的 1–8B 模型、数学与多跳推理两个领域上一致优于 KD：AddSub +32pp、SVAMP +25pp，域内测试划分 +2–8pp，多跳推理 QASC +16pp、StrategyQA +25pp（收益依数据集而异），且收敛快于阶段式课程。
Conclusion: 渐进改写加自适应课程是强化小模型推理的简单有效配方，自适应推进比固定阶段课程收敛更快。

summary_sections.method: LoT 框架三步：渐进式问题改写生成语义忠实的更易变体；用基于步骤的度量把题目分入难度桶；以自演化 bandit 调度器自适应分配训练量，替代固定阶段式课程。
summary_sections.result: 在来自不同家族的 1–8B 模型、数学与多跳推理两个领域上一致优于 KD：AddSub +32pp、SVAMP +25pp，域内测试划分 +2–8pp，多跳推理 QASC +16pp、StrategyQA +25pp（收益依数据集而异），且收敛快于阶段式课程。
summary_sections.conclusion: 渐进改写加自适应课程是强化小模型推理的简单有效配方，自适应推进比固定阶段课程收敛更快。

papers.title: When Quantum Meets AI: Quantum Methods for Machine Learning and Machine Learning Methods for Quantum Systems
papers.abstract_en: This thesis studies the intersection of quantum computing and artificial intelligence in two directions: quantum methods for machine learning and machine learning methods for quantum systems. For quantum machine learning, Neural Quantum Embedding learns data representations that increase the trace distance between embedded class ensembles, lowering an embedding-dependent bound on empirical risk and improving classification on noisy quantum hardware. A training objective based on the Hilbert-Schmidt inner product extends this approach to deterministic quantum computation with one qubit (DQC1) and is demonstrated on an NMR quantum processor. A margin-based generalization analysis then connects quantum neural network performance to quantum state discrimination. In the studied benchmarks, margin distributions predict generalization more reliably than parameter-count metrics. For quantum systems, a Mamba-based neural decoder for surface codes matches a reproduced Transformer baseline in memory experiments while reducing inference-cost scaling from quartic to quadratic in code distance. Under an explicit decoder-induced-noise model, it achieves lower logical error rates and a higher effective threshold. For neural quantum states, stochastic reconfiguration is interpreted as tangent-space ridge regression, with its diagonal shift controlling the bias-variance trade-off under finite Monte Carlo sampling. Multi-shift stochastic reconfiguration reduces checkpoint-local validation residuals and update variance relative to fixed-shift SR, at additional computational cost. Together, these contributions show how learned representations, statistical control, and hardware constraints shape the exchange between quantum computing and machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇 171 页博士论文双向打通量子计算与 AI：用 Neural Quantum Embedding 拉大嵌入类系综的 trace distance 来压低经验风险界，并在含噪硬件上提升分类；反向则用 Mamba 解码 surface code，把推理代价从码距的四次方降到二次方。在显式 decoder-induced-noise 模型下其逻辑错误率更低、有效阈值更高，margin 分布比参数量指标更能预测泛化。
Motivation: 量子机器学习缺少把表示质量与泛化界直接挂钩的训练目标，而 surface code 解码与 neural quantum states 的优化在码距增大和有限 Monte Carlo 采样下代价与方差失控。
Method: 量子侧：Neural Quantum Embedding 以类系综 trace distance 为目标训练嵌入，配合基于 Hilbert-Schmidt inner product 的目标扩展到 DQC1 并在 NMR 处理器上演示，另做基于 margin 的泛化分析连接量子态判别。量子系统侧：Mamba-based neural decoder 解 surface code 并对照复现的 Transformer 基线；把 stochastic reconfiguration 解释为 tangent-space ridge regression，其对角位移控制偏差-方差权衡，进而提出 multi-shift SR。
Result: 在所研究的 benchmark 上 margin 分布比参数量指标更可靠地预测泛化；Mamba 解码器在 memory 实验中匹配复现的 Transformer 基线，同时把推理代价随码距从四次方降到二次方，在显式 decoder-induced-noise 模型下取得更低逻辑错误率与更高有效阈值；multi-shift SR 相对固定位移 SR 降低 checkpoint-local 验证残差与更新方差，但计算开销更大。
Conclusion: 学习到的表示、统计控制与硬件约束共同决定量子计算与机器学习的相互作用：嵌入质量可直接压低经验风险界，解码器的代价标度与噪声模型比单纯匹配基线更重要，SR 的对角位移是有限采样下的偏差-方差旋钮。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Drives Hierarchy-Aware Image Retrieval? Taxonomy Alignment, Objective Choice, and Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Foundation vision models provide strong generic representations, yet high class-level retrieval accuracy does not necessarily imply that an embedding respects a target semantic taxonomy. We study strict explicit-taxonomy image retrieval on frozen DINOv2 features and ask: when hierarchical retrieval improves, how much of the change is associated with the organization of taxonomy-aware supervision, and how much with the Euclidean-hyperbolic geometry choice? We evaluate higher levels with strict cross-class criteria that exclude finer-grained matches, and compare Euclidean and hyperbolic projections trained with taxonomy-distance regression or a taxonomy-aware supervised contrastive objective. A compute-matched 2 x 2 Geometry x Loss factorial uses the same 768-256-32 projector capacity, optimization schedule, batch order, and fixed 100-epoch budget; the Loss axis denotes the Regression-to-Taxonomy-SupCon objective-family contrast. On CUB, the objective-family contrasts in mean hierarchy mAP (strict middle/high average, excluding Class/Leaf) are +0.0487 in Euclidean space and +0.0414 in hyperbolic space, compared with geometry contrasts of +0.0102 and +0.0030. On NABirds Parent-disjoint retrieval, the corresponding objective-family contrasts are +0.0467 and +0.0440, whereas geometry contrasts are +0.0017 and -0.0009. A semantic-alignment control shows that the true taxonomy substantially outperforms a structure-preserving shuffled hierarchy, while a NABirds curvature/radius control does not support stronger negative curvature as the explanation for the observed hierarchy gains. Across the two taxonomies, the Regression-to-Taxonomy-SupCon contrasts are larger in aggregate than the evaluated geometry contrasts; semantic alignment also matters separately, while geometry remains hierarchy-dependent.
papers.comment: 17 pages total: 9-page main paper (including references) + 8-page supplementary material; 3 figures and 2 main-paper tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结 DINOv2 特征上做严格显式分类树图像检索，用计算对齐的 2×2（几何 × 损失）析因实验拆解层级检索增益来源：目标函数族（taxonomy-distance 回归 vs taxonomy-aware SupCon）的贡献远大于欧氏/双曲几何选择。CUB 上目标族对比为欧氏 +0.0487、双曲 +0.0414，几何对比仅 +0.0102 与 +0.0030；语义对齐对照显示真实分类树显著优于结构保持的打乱层级。
Motivation: 高类级检索准确率并不保证嵌入尊重目标语义分类树；层级检索的增益究竟来自监督组织方式还是欧氏/双曲几何选择，此前未被解耦。
Method: 在冻结 DINOv2 特征上训练 768-256-32 投影头，做计算对齐的 2×2 Geometry × Loss 析因：几何轴为欧氏与双曲投影，损失轴为 taxonomy-distance 回归与 taxonomy-aware supervised contrastive（Regression-to-Taxonomy-SupCon 对比），统一优化调度、batch 顺序与 100 epoch 预算；高层级用排除细粒度匹配的严格跨类准则评估，并设真实 vs 打乱分类树的语义对齐对照与曲率/半径对照。
Result: CUB 上 mean hierarchy mAP（strict middle/high 平均，排除 Class/Leaf）的目标族对比：欧氏 +0.0487、双曲 +0.0414；几何对比 +0.0102 与 +0.0030。NABirds Parent-disjoint 检索目标族对比 +0.0467 与 +0.0440，几何对比 +0.0017 与 -0.0009。真实分类树显著优于结构保持的打乱层级；NABirds 曲率/半径对照不支持“更强负曲率”作为层级增益的解释。
Conclusion: 跨两个分类树，Regression-to-Taxonomy-SupCon 的对比总体大于所评估的几何对比：层级检索增益主要由监督的语义对齐驱动，几何作用是层级依赖的，负曲率本身不是解释。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Shallow to Deep: Aligning Token Pruning with Stage-wise Roles in LVLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) incur high computational costs from redundant visual tokens. Although training-free attention-based multi-layer pruning in the vision encoder stage has been explored as an effective strategy, we find that pruning in shallow layers consistently degrades performance. In this paper, we aim to understand this problem and seek a solution. By analyzing attention patterns across network depth, we find that shallow layers primarily function as edge detectors with chaotic attention maps, while deeper layers transition through local subject recognition and unstable semantic aggregation. To address the misalignment between pruning strategies and network stages, we propose STD, a hierarchical token pruning framework that adapts token selection mechanisms to the functional role of each network stage. STD employs High-Frequency Spectral Analysis in shallow layers to deterministically preserve structural edges, uses Gaussian-Smoothed Attention in intermediate layers to maintain spatial coherence, and introduces a Stability-Adaptive Trigger in deep layers to execute pruning only during semantically stable phases. Extensive experiments show that STD outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods by 1.1% on LLaVA-1.5-7B with 88.9% token reduction, while also being plug-and-play and highly effective when combined with other methods, and by 2.1% on LLaVA-NeXT-7B with 94.4% reduction, delivering a 3.9x speed-up in the prefilling stage. Our code will be released at https://github.com/Twilight03/STD.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STD 按视觉编码器浅、中、深三层的功能角色分别设计 token 剪枝机制：浅层用高频谱分析保住边缘结构，中层用高斯平滑注意力维持空间连贯，深层用稳定性自适应触发只在语义稳定阶段剪枝。在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上以 88.9% token 剪枝比超过 SOTA 方法 1.1%，在 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上以 94.4% 剪枝比超 2.1%，prefilling 阶段加速 3.9 倍。
Motivation: 视觉编码器中免训练的多层注意力剪枝已有成效，但在浅层剪枝会持续拉低性能，原因是剪枝策略与网络各阶段的功能角色错配。
Method: 提出分层 token 剪枝框架 STD：浅层用 High-Frequency Spectral Analysis 确定性保留结构边缘，中层用 Gaussian-Smoothed Attention 保持空间连贯，深层用 Stability-Adaptive Trigger 仅在语义稳定相位执行剪枝；框架即插即用，可与其他方法组合。
Result: LLaVA-1.5-7B 上以 88.9% token 剪枝比超 SOTA 剪枝方法 1.1%；LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上以 94.4% 剪枝比超 2.1%，prefilling 阶段加速 3.9 倍。
Conclusion: 浅层剪枝有害是因为其注意力图混乱、功能是边缘检测，按阶段角色对齐剪枝机制才能在高剪枝比下保住性能并带来 prefilling 加速。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: An Exploratory Replica-Overlap Probe of the Grokking Transition
papers.abstract_en: We trained 64 independently seeded networks in four configurations, continuing each to sustained convergence or a 40,000-epoch ceiling. We then asked whether an RSB-inspired distribution of pairwise weight overlaps changes across the grokking transition. It is the alignment step, not the overlap statistic, that determines what this registered probe can report. The registered implementation permutes hidden units without the corresponding bias and head-internal permutations and therefore does not preserve the network function. Every q_wt value computed through this alignment inherits the defect; q_fn does not, because it is computed from predictions of the unpermuted models. The numerical-precision requirement also failed, and an audit found protocol deviations. Consequently, the pre-registered rule gives no verdict: registered outcome UNDETERMINED (reason code C0_INSTRUMENT_INVALID). These data provide neither a confirmatory null nor a validated reading of the Parisi order parameter. Only frac40 cleared the 12/16 checkpoint-completeness requirement. For this configuration, a post-hoc criterion applied to the same data gave a Hartigan-dip interval containing zero (95% CI for Delta dip = [-0.017, 0.034]), whereas the overlap standard deviation increased by a factor of about 5.6. A post-hoc calibration assigns the dip test zero power at the simulated separations; the interval is therefore uninformative, not evidence of no change. The standard-deviation ratio is the only statistic here with power at the observed effect. Ensemble loss was near-flat only under the pre-specified 1% threshold. Finally, grokking rates of 0/16, 11/16 and 16/16 remain descriptive because train fraction is confounded with split identity.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 5 figures. Pre-registered study; the registered decision rule returns UNDETERMINED (reason code C0_INSTRUMENT_INVALID) because the registered alignment implementation is not function-preserving. Reported as an honest negative/instrument-invalid result
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于 grokking 转变中权重重叠统计的预注册探针研究，训练 64 个独立随机种子网络、四种配置、最多 40,000 epoch，检验 RSB 启发的成对权重重叠分布是否在 grokking 转变中变化。注册的对齐实现只置换隐藏单元而未同步置换偏置与 head 内部权重，不保函数，导致所有 q_wt 失效，注册判定规则返回 UNDETERMINED（reason code C0_INSTRUMENT_INVALID）。唯一通过 12/16 checkpoint 完整性要求的 frac40 配置上，事后 Hartigan-dip 的 95% CI 为 [-0.017, 0.034]（含零），而重叠标准差增大约 5.6 倍。
Motivation: grokking 转变中是否出现自旋玻璃式的 Parisi 序参量（重叠分布多峰化）尚无可靠检验工具；预注册探针需要一个保函数的对齐步骤来计算权重重叠 q_wt，而原实现做不到这一点。
Method: 训练 64 个独立种子网络、四种配置，各自跑到持续收敛或 40,000 epoch 上限；用 RSB 启发的成对权重重叠分布（q_wt 经对齐、q_fn 由未置换模型预测计算）检验 grokking 转变；预注册决策规则、checkpoint 完整性要求（12/16）、Hartigan-dip 检验与事后功效校准构成判定流程。
Result: 注册结果为 UNDETERMINED（C0_INSTRUMENT_INVALID）：对齐不保函数使全部 q_wt 携带缺陷，数值精度要求也未通过，审计发现协议偏差。仅 frac40 满足 12/16 checkpoint 完整性；其事后 Hartigan-dip 的 Delta dip 95% CI 为 [-0.017, 0.034]（含零），重叠标准差增大约 5.6 倍；事后校准显示 dip 检验在模拟分离度下功效为 0，故该区间无信息量。标准差比是唯一在观测效应量下有功效的统计量；ensemble loss 仅在预设 1% 阈值下近似持平；grokking 率 0/16、11/16、16/16 因 train fraction 与 split identity 混淆而仅为描述性。
Conclusion: 作者的结论是诚实的阴性/仪器失效结果：这些数据既不构成确证性 null，也不构成对 Parisi 序参量的有效读数；dip 区间含零不能当作无变化的证据，标准差比是唯一有功效的统计量。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: grokking 转变中是否出现自旋玻璃式的 Parisi 序参量（重叠分布多峰化）尚无可靠检验工具；预注册探针需要一个保函数的对齐步骤来计算权重重叠 q_wt，而原实现做不到这一点。
summary_sections.method: 训练 64 个独立种子网络、四种配置，各自跑到持续收敛或 40,000 epoch 上限；用 RSB 启发的成对权重重叠分布（q_wt 经对齐、q_fn 由未置换模型预测计算）检验 grokking 转变；预注册决策规则、checkpoint 完整性要求（12/16）、Hartigan-dip 检验与事后功效校准构成判定流程。
summary_sections.result: 注册结果为 UNDETERMINED（C0_INSTRUMENT_INVALID）：对齐不保函数使全部 q_wt 携带缺陷，数值精度要求也未通过，审计发现协议偏差。仅 frac40 满足 12/16 checkpoint 完整性；其事后 Hartigan-dip 的 Delta dip 95% CI 为 [-0.017, 0.034]（含零），重叠标准差增大约 5.6 倍；事后校准显示 dip 检验在模拟分离度下功效为 0，故该区间无信息量。标准差比是唯一在观测效应量下有功效的统计量；ensemble loss 仅在预设 1% 阈值下近似持平；grokking 率 0/16、11/16、16/16 因 train fraction 与 split identity 混淆而仅为描述性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者的结论是诚实的阴性/仪器失效结果：这些数据既不构成确证性 null，也不构成对 Parisi 序参量的有效读数；dip 区间含零不能当作无变化的证据，标准差比是唯一有功效的统计量。

papers.title: Robust, Estimator-Agnostic Dynamic 3DGS Compression
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic 3D Gaussian splats (3DGS) model time-varying scenes using a separate Gaussian set per frame. While neighboring video frames are highly correlated due to smooth motion, Gaussian representations retain this correlation to varying degrees, depending on whether the estimator tracks them across time. Some 3DGS compression methods integrate the estimation to exploit temporal redundancy; here, we focus on robust compression regardless of the estimator. We concatenate groups of frames into one Gaussian set, augment each Gaussian with a frame index, and pass it to a static (i.e., non-temporal) 3DGS codec, converting temporal redundancy into spatial redundancy. Concatenated sets are spatially partitioned to limit memory. Our technique requires neither a motion model nor knowledge of the training method. Averaged over six N3DV sequences, all six static codecs achieve gains on tracked sets (-42.0% to -71.8% BD-rate) over per-frame coding. On untracked sets, all codecs except HGSC, which appears incompatible with our technique, remain competitive with per-frame coding (-3.5% to +5.0%). We further replace D-FCGS's I-frame coding with our technique while retaining its P-frame coding, yielding an overall BD-rate of -46.2%. We propose to visualize "trackedness" using an inter-frame similarity metric. The project is available at https://wcjj1236.github.io/d3dgs-benchmark.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027. This version adds an appendix; 16 pages, 15 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把动态 3DGS 的多帧高斯拼成一个集合、给每个高斯加帧索引，再交给静态 3DGS codec，把时域冗余转成空间冗余，从而不依赖估计器是否跨帧跟踪。在六个 N3DV 序列上，六个静态 codec 对 tracked 集合相对逐帧编码取得 -42.0% 到 -71.8% BD-rate；untracked 集合上除 HGSC 外仍保持 -3.5% 到 +5.0%。
Motivation: 动态 3DGS 逐帧存一套高斯，帧间相关性是否被利用取决于估计器是否跨帧跟踪，现有压缩多把估计耦合进来，难以在估计器无关的前提下稳健利用时域冗余。
Method: 将若干帧的高斯拼接为单一集合，为每个高斯附加 frame index，输入静态（非时域）3DGS codec；拼接集合做空间分区以限制内存，不需要运动模型也不需要知道训练方法。
Result: 六个 N3DV 序列上，六个静态 codec 在 tracked 集合相对逐帧编码 BD-rate -42.0% 到 -71.8%；untracked 集合上除 HGSC（与该技术不兼容）外为 -3.5% 到 +5.0%。替换 D-FCGS 的 I-frame 编码、保留其 P-frame 编码后整体 BD-rate -46.2%。
Conclusion: 把时域冗余转成空间冗余即可让静态 codec 处理动态 3DGS，且对估计器是否跟踪稳健；HGSC 与该技术不兼容。
