papers.title: MachEmbodied-U0: Unified Understanding and Generation Model for Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose robot control requires models to understand task intent, identify where to interact, capture how the scene evolves, and generate precise actions. Vision-language-action models provide strong semantic priors but typically do not explicitly model scene dynamics, while world-action models couple visual prediction with control without necessarily exposing the task-relevant semantic and spatial structure needed for fine-grained manipulation. We present MachEmbodied-U0 (ME-U0), a unified embodied foundation model connecting understanding and generation experts through a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. Subtask prediction and affordance grounding guide joint visual-dynamics and action generation via flow matching. Visual dynamics encompass future RGB, depth, surface normals, and optical flow, providing complementary supervision for appearance, geometry, and motion. Multi-rate Rotary Position Encoding (MRPE) aligns visual dynamics with fine-grained control. We pretrain ME-U0 on approximately 4,200 hours of curated demonstrations from robotic datasets and egocentric datasets. Using only the supervision natively available in each downstream benchmark, ME-U0 achieves an average score of 17.66 on the RoboDojo simulation benchmark and average success rates of 99.0\% and 82.5\% on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, respectively. We additionally validate ME-U0 on real-world robotic manipulation tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness beyond simulation. Without corresponding downstream supervision, ME-U0 further demonstrates zero-shot subtask prediction, affordance grounding, and visual dynamics on simulated and real-world observations. Overall, ME-U0 combines competitive downstream control performance with transferable task-grounding and visual-dynamics capabilities across simulation and the real world.
papers.comment: Technical report. Project page: https://machembodied.com/ME-U/ME-U0.html. Code: https://github.com/MachEmbodied/ME-U0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ME-U0 用 Mixture-of-Transformers 把理解专家与生成专家接成统一具身基础模型，子任务预测与 affordance grounding 引导视觉动力学和动作的联合生成（flow matching），视觉动力学覆盖未来 RGB、深度、法线与光流。在约 4,200 小时演示预训练后，RoboDojo 仿真平均分 17.66，LIBERO 与 LIBERO-Plus 平均成功率分别为 99.0% 与 82.5%，并可零样本输出子任务预测与视觉动力学。
Motivation: VLA 模型有语义先验但不显式建模场景动力学，world-action 模型耦合视觉预测与控制却缺少细粒度操作所需的任务语义与空间结构，两者难以同时支撑精确操作。
Method: Mixture-of-Transformers 架构连接理解与生成专家；子任务预测与 affordance grounding 引导经 flow matching 的视觉动力学与动作联合生成；视觉动力学监督未来 RGB、深度、表面法线与光流，Multi-rate Rotary Position Encoding (MRPE) 对齐视觉动力学与细粒度控制；在约 4,200 小时精选机器人与第一人称数据上演示预训练，下游仅用各基准自带监督。
Result: RoboDojo 仿真基准平均分 17.66；LIBERO 平均成功率 99.0%，LIBERO-Plus 平均成功率 82.5%；在真实机器人操作任务上验证有效；无对应下游监督时仍能零样本完成子任务预测、affordance grounding 与视觉动力学预测（仿真与真实观测）。
Conclusion: ME-U0 在仿真与真实世界同时具备有竞争力的下游控制性能，以及可迁移的任务接地与视觉动力学能力，理解与生成统一在一个模型里即可兼顾。

papers.title: Accelerating the Mitigation of LLM Inference Nondeterminism Across GPU Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) outputs are expected to be reproducible under greedy decoding, yet in practice the same model, prompt, and software stack produce different outputs on different GPUs. The root cause is floating-point non-associativity combined with hardware-dependent kernel selection. Inference frameworks select different matrix-multiplication kernels on each architecture, with different parallel reduction orders and unspecified tensor-core arithmetic, and the resulting rounding differences can flip output tokens. Existing solutions have imperfect cross-architecture reproducibility and incur a significant performance penalty. We present a solution employing a set of fixed-configuration fused-upcast GEMM kernels that load 16-bit weights from memory, upcast them to FP32 in registers, and accumulate with IEEE-754 arithmetic in a reduction order that is a pure function of the problem shape and is therefore independent of the device, its SM count, or kernel scheduling. By fixing the floating-point reduction order as a function of problem shape alone, every GPU runs the same operation sequence, so cross-architecture reproducibility of the linear layers reduces to correct IEEE-754 arithmetic rather than to rounding differences staying below a tie-flip threshold. We confirm our solution's linear-layer outputs are bitwise identical across NVIDIA Ampere, Ada, and Hopper GPUs, while running $1.17$ to $3.1\times$ faster end-to-end than the state-of-the-art solution and cutting weight-memory traffic in half.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 推理在贪心解码下跨 GPU 不可复现，根因是浮点非结合性加硬件相关的 kernel 选择。作者提出固定配置的 fused-upcast GEMM kernel：从内存读 16-bit 权重、在寄存器升到 FP32、按仅由问题形状决定的归约顺序做 IEEE-754 累加，使归约顺序与设备、SM 数、调度无关。线性层输出在 NVIDIA Ampere、Ada、Hopper 上逐位一致，端到端比 SOTA 快 1.17 至 3.1 倍，权重内存流量减半。
Motivation: 同一模型、提示词与软件栈在不同 GPU 上产生不同输出，现有跨架构复现方案不完美且性能代价显著。
Method: 固定配置的 fused-upcast GEMM kernel：从内存加载 16-bit 权重，在寄存器升精度到 FP32，按仅由问题形状决定的归约顺序做 IEEE-754 累加，使所有 GPU 执行相同操作序列，把线性层跨架构复现归结为正确的 IEEE-754 运算。
Result: 线性层输出在 NVIDIA Ampere、Ada、Hopper 三种 GPU 上逐位 (bitwise) 相同；端到端比 state-of-the-art 方案快 1.17 至 3.1 倍；权重内存流量减半。
Conclusion: 把浮点归约顺序固定为问题形状的纯函数，跨架构可复现性就不再依赖舍入差异低于 tie-flip 阈值，同时还能比现有方案更快。

papers.title: What Should a Self-Teacher See? Privileged Context Design for On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: More privileged information does not always make a better teacher. We study this tension in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where a frozen copy of the base model scores the student's own rollouts under privileged context, conventionally a complete reference solution that bundles the final answer with one particular reasoning path. Holding the student view and training fixed within each scale, we compare that default against three abstractions compiled offline, a named strategy, a method-independent framing, and a problem category, and against an answer-only control that keeps the destination but removes the path. In the primary runs on competition mathematics, the best intermediate contexts improve the in-domain peak mean over the full solution by 1.4 points at 4B and 1.6 at 8B, while storing an order of magnitude fewer hint tokens. Comparisons across three seeds also show positive mean gains for the framing and category contexts at both scales. Answer-only conditioning remains competitive in the primary runs, within 0.2 points of the full solution at these scales. The preferred context varies with student scale and task. Initial teacher-student KL does not order downstream performance. What a self-teacher should see is therefore not everything it could, but the level of abstraction its student can still act on.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在竞赛数学的 on-policy 自蒸馏 (OPSD) 中，冻结的教师用特权上下文给学生自己的 rollout 打分；把完整参考解替换成更抽象的中间上下文（命名策略、方法无关框架、问题类别）反而更好：4B 上 in-domain 峰值均值比完整解高 1.4 点，8B 高 1.6 点，且 hint token 少一个数量级。作者结论是教师该看的不是它能看到的全部，而是学生仍能据以行动的抽象层级。
Motivation: OPSD 惯例把最终答案与某一条具体推理路径捆成完整参考解作为特权信息，但更多特权信息未必造出更好的教师；且初始师生 KL 无法排序下游表现，需要判断哪种抽象层级才是有效监督。
Method: 固定学生视角与训练配置、在 4B 与 8B 两个规模内做对照：完整参考解 vs 三种离线编译的抽象上下文（named strategy、method-independent framing、problem category）vs 只给答案的 answer-only 控制；主实验在竞赛数学上进行，另用三个 seed 比较。
Result: 主实验中最好的中间上下文使 in-domain 峰值均值比完整解高 1.4 点（4B）与 1.6 点（8B），存储的 hint token 少一个数量级；三个 seed 下 framing 与 category 上下文在两个规模均为正均值增益；answer-only 在主实验中距完整解仅 0.2 点以内。
Conclusion: 特权上下文存在最优抽象层级，随学生规模与任务变化，不是越完整越好；初始师生 KL 不能预测下游性能。

papers.title: ChatT2: An Adaptive Framework for Developing a Large Language Model-Based Agent for Natural Product Domain Research
papers.abstract_en: Scientific investigations into microbial natural products (NPs) present significant challenges for novices, largely due to the complexity of microbial systems, biochemical diversity, technical skill requirements, and the demands of bioinformatics and data analysis processes. To address these issues, we introduce ChatT2, a large language model (LLM)-based agent that is specifically tailored to the unique characteristics of bacterial type II polyketides. These polyketides form a structurally distinct and therapeutically important NP family. ChatT2 was developed within an autonomous multiagent framework composed of a mentor, an executor, and an evaluator, each with defined responsibilities. The mentor acts as an intermediary between ChatT2 and the user, utilizing chain-of-thought prompting to refine the intent of the user. Under the guidance of the mentor, the executor synthesizes multimodal information via retrieval-augmented generation techniques and seamlessly integrates bioinformatics and cheminformatics tools. The evaluator ultimately assesses the output of the executor to ensure the richness and accuracy of the retrieved information. Our research highlights how ChatT2, designed with this multiagent framework, addresses the challenges faced by general LLMs in terms of understanding limited, specialized corpora and complex biological information and provides both experts and novices with a valuable tool for exploring various NPs of interest. The ChatT2 webserver can be accessed at https://chatt2.site/#/chat.

papers.title: Reasoning-Preserving Fine-Tuning of Post-RL LLMs with Null-Basis LoRA
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based post-training has become an effective approach for eliciting reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs). However, adapting post-RL models to new knowledge domains or behaviors through subsequent supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can severely overwrite these capabilities. Existing approaches mitigate such forgetting through experience replay, specialized initialization, or constrained optimization using gradient projection, but either provide limited preservation or incur substantial training overhead. Our analysis shows that reasoning activations concentrate in low-dimensional subspaces, leaving substantial null-space capacity for adaptation, and that the corresponding approximate null spaces can be reliably estimated from a modest number of examples. Motivated by these observations, we propose Null-Basis Low-Rank Adaptation (NB-LoRA), a parameter-efficient method for adapting post-RL LLMs while preserving their acquired reasoning ability. We formulate reasoning retention as a layer-wise hidden-state preservation constraint and construct a fixed approximate null basis from reasoning activations. LoRA updates are then reparameterized through this basis, enforcing the preservation constraint throughout fine-tuning. Extensive experiments across multiple RL-trained LLMs and diverse downstream tasks show that NB-LoRA matches standard LoRA in adaptation performance, maintains reasoning accuracy near pre-fine-tuning levels, and generalizes this preservation to held-out reasoning benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NB-LoRA 把推理保持写成逐层隐状态保持约束，用少量样本估计推理激活的近似零空间并构造固定零基，LoRA 更新经该基重参数化，从而在后续 SFT 中不覆盖 RL 后模型的推理能力。在多个 RL 训练 LLM 与多样下游任务上，其适配性能与标准 LoRA 持平，推理准确率保持在微调前水平，并能推广到 held-out 推理基准。
Motivation: 对 RL 后训练的 LLM 再做 SFT 会严重覆盖已获得的推理能力；现有经验回放、专门初始化或梯度投影约束等方法要么保持效果有限，要么带来可观训练开销。
Method: NB-LoRA（Null-Basis Low-Rank Adaptation）：把推理保持形式化为逐层隐状态保持约束，从推理激活构造固定近似零基（approximate null basis，少量样本即可可靠估计），LoRA 更新经该基重参数化，在整个微调过程中强制满足保持约束。
Result: 在多个 RL 训练 LLM 和多样下游任务上的实验中，NB-LoRA 的适配性能与标准 LoRA 相当，推理准确率维持在微调前水平附近，并把这种保持推广到 held-out 推理基准。
Conclusion: 推理激活集中在低维子空间、留下大量零空间容量可供适配，因此用零基重参数化的参数高效微调可以同时完成领域适配与推理保持。

papers.title: Evidence-gated multimodal parsing and vectorization of architectural floor plans
papers.abstract_en: Architectural floor plans remain a high-friction barrier to archive digitization and early design-model preparation because heterogeneous graphics encode spatial semantics and editable geometry together. We introduce SALI-FP, an evidence-gated multimodal pipeline that converts a plan into reviewable semantic maps, objects, vectors, and relation records while constraining local revisions by image evidence. In a full production audit of 11,534 heterogeneous plans, SALI-FP produced structured outputs for every plan, including 752,510 valid polygon-bearing objects. The same output form has supported initial drawing digitization and design-model preparation in practical design work. Public-benchmark calibration is paired with a 30-case matched visual evidence set in Appendix F, where room-scale coverage, openings, oblique boundaries, and circulation continuity can be inspected directly. SALI-FP offers an engineering-oriented interpretation-to-geometry workflow for reviewed CAD/BIM preparation and existing-building information recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SALI-FP 把异构建筑平面图解析为可复核的语义图、对象、矢量与关系记录，并用图像证据约束局部修改。在 11,534 张平面图的全量生产审计中，每张图都产出结构化输出，含 752,510 个有效带多边形对象。
Motivation: 建筑平面图归档数字化与设计模型前期准备摩擦高，异构图形同时承载空间语义与可编辑几何，难以批量转成可编辑结构。
Method: 提出证据门控 (evidence-gated) 多模态流水线 SALI-FP，将平面图解析为语义图、对象、矢量与关系记录，并以图像证据约束局部修订；配公开基准校准与附录 F 的 30 例匹配视觉证据集，用于直接检查房间尺度覆盖、开口、斜向边界与流线连续性。
Result: 在 11,534 张异构平面图的全量生产审计中，SALI-FP 为每张图产出结构化输出，累计 752,510 个有效带多边形对象；同一输出形式已支撑实际设计工作中的初步图纸数字化与设计模型准备。
Conclusion: SALI-FP 提供面向工程的“解读到几何”工作流，可用于经复核的 CAD/BIM 准备与既有建筑信息恢复。

papers.title: Qwen3.8-Omni: Towards Native Omni-Modal Agents
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash, a natively multimodal agentic model for real-world multimodal productivity. Compared with previous omni models, which primarily emphasized perception and interaction, Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash substantially improves multimodal understanding and reasoning, as well as performance on long-horizon agentic tasks. These capabilities are supported by a native multimodal co-training strategy that preserves strong text-domain capabilities while facilitating the transfer of agentic capabilities from text to audio and video tasks. The model inherits the sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture of Qwen3.8-Next and extends the context window to one million tokens, supporting long-context multimodal reasoning and long-horizon planning. These advances enable integration into production workflows as a primary agent or a specialized sub-agent, supporting video editing, long-form audio and video translation, music-conditioned music video or movie generation, and video-based note or omni-skill creation. To address the lack of native audio and video support in existing agent harnesses, we release Qwen-MM-Plugins, a lightweight open-source plugin framework for multimodal productivity. We further frame real-time multimodal interaction as a system-level challenge requiring orchestration of context and memory management, tool use, and sub-agent delegation. Accordingly, we release Qwen-Live-Harness, an open-source framework for building responsive, real-time multimodal agents based on Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash achieves strong performance across multimodal understanding, reasoning, long-horizon agentic execution, and video productivity tasks. These results and the accompanying open-source tools support Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash as a practical foundation for deploying natively multimodal agents in research and production.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash 是原生多模态 agent 模型，继承 Qwen3.8-Next 的稀疏 MoE 架构并把上下文窗口扩到 100 万 token，用原生多模态 co-training 在保住文本能力的同时把 agent 能力从文本迁移到音频与视频任务。摘要称其在多模态理解、推理、长程 agent 执行与视频生产任务上表现强劲，可作为生产工作流的主 agent 或子 agent。
Motivation: 现有 omni 模型偏重感知与交互，多模态理解、推理和长程 agent 任务表现不足；现有 agent harness 也缺少原生音频与视频支持。
Method: 继承 Qwen3.8-Next 的稀疏 MoE 架构，上下文窗口扩到 100 万 token；采用原生多模态 co-training 策略，把 agent 能力从文本迁移到音频与视频任务。配套发布 Qwen-MM-Plugins（轻量开源多模态插件框架）与 Qwen-Live-Harness（实时多模态 agent 框架，编排上下文与记忆管理、工具使用、子 agent 委派）。
Result: 摘要给出的定量信息为 100 万 token 上下文窗口；评测覆盖多模态理解、推理、长程 agent 执行与视频生产任务，结论为表现强劲（strong performance），并支持视频编辑、长短视频翻译、音乐条件 MV/电影生成、视频笔记与 omni-skill 创建等工作流。
Conclusion: 原生多模态 co-training 加上开源 harness 与插件框架，使 Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash 可作为研究与生产中部署原生多模态 agent 的实用基础。

papers.title: ArticleMiner: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Scientific Publications
papers.abstract_en: Scientific papers keep much of their quantitative content in tables and supplementary files, where a number means something only through its header, caption, unit, analytical method, and the conventions of its field. Recovering the rows and columns of a table is therefore not the same as recovering the scientific fact it reports. Most semantic table-interpretation methods assume that a clean table is already available and subsequently map its cells or columns to ontology terms, whereas most publication-level extraction systems are designed for a single domain. We study a middle path: a shared process that reads a paper and its supplementary files, gathers evidence from several parsers and a language model, and reconciles that evidence, while a bounded human-authored task module for each task supplies the domain meaning. The module lists the canonical names the graph may use, the surface forms that map to them, a small set of derivation rules and validity constraints, an identity key, and the bindings used to write RDF. It defines what a task is allowed to emit; it does not try to list every convention of a field. We build four such modules (for drug-discovery chemistry, materials science, machine learning, and mineral geochemistry) in the ArticleMiner framework, and evaluate them on 163 papers, including a new geochemistry benchmark with expert-curated ground truth. In comparisons against a same-LLM few-shot baseline, the point estimates favor ArticleMiner on all four tasks, with uncertainty on the two smaller benchmarks. The geochemistry comparison also includes access to supplementary files, so its improvement cannot be attributed to domain guidance alone.
papers.journal_ref: 6th International Workshop on Scientific Knowledge: Representation, Discovery, and Assessment (Sci-K), Oct 2026, Bari, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ArticleMiner 用本体约束的任务模块把论文表格与补充材料中的定量内容转成带领域语义的 RDF 知识图谱，而非仅还原行列。在 163 篇论文（含新建的专家标注地球化学基准）上对比同 LLM few-shot 基线，四项任务点估计全部偏向 ArticleMiner，其中地球化学对比还额外开放补充文件访问，其提升不能只归因于领域指导。
Motivation: 表格数字只有结合表头、单位、分析方法才有科学含义，而现有语义表格方法假定干净表格已就绪、出版物级抽取系统又多限单一领域，中间缺少可跨任务复用的抽取路径。
Method: 共享流程读取论文与补充文件，聚合多个解析器与语言模型的证据并做对齐；每个任务配一个受限的人写模块，规定图谱可用的规范名、surface form、推导规则与有效性约束、identity key 及 RDF 写入绑定。构建了药物发现化学、材料科学、机器学习、矿物地球化学四个模块。
Result: 在 163 篇论文上评测，含新建的专家标注地球化学基准；与同 LLM few-shot 基线相比，四项任务点估计均偏向 ArticleMiner，两个较小基准存在不确定性；地球化学对比额外提供补充文件访问，其改进不能仅归因于领域指导。
Conclusion: 受限的本体引导任务模块加共享证据调和流程，可在四个领域把表格数字提升为可用的科学事实，且地球化学上的优势部分来自补充文件证据而非仅领域规则。

papers.title: Generalized Deep Regression for Repeated Measurements
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the estimation of a marginal regression function from independent units with repeated binary, count, or continuous responses using ReLU deep neural networks. In the model, we assume that the dependence is generated by an unobserved random mean function within each unit. We then fit a neural network with a convex generalized regression loss. We show an oracle inequality by separating conditional measurement variation from between-unit variation. In addition, we prove that with $n$ units and $m$ measurements per unit, ReLU networks can attain an integrated mean squared error of order $n^{-1}+(nm)^{-2β/(2β+d)}$, up to logarithmic factors, over $β$-Hölder classes. We also derive a weighted oracle inequality for unequal cluster sizes and a rate for compositionally smooth functions. For pointwise ensemble inference, we give a projection central limit theorem and prove infinitesimal jackknife consistency under an explicit asymptotic linearity condition. Simulations and real data examples are provided to support our theoretical findings and practical implications.

papers.title: Ultra-fast Neural Inference for Stochastic Gaussian Splatting Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic rendering eliminates the sorting and alpha blending process in Gaussian splatting, at the cost of introducing spatial noise. Formulating temporal denoising over the pixel stream shared by view-consistent stochastic splatting renderers, we propose a temporal neural denoiser validated on stochastic 2D Gaussian Splatting rendering, combining dual-path exponential moving average accumulation, per-pixel learned trust prediction for history validation, a fixed anisotropic spatial filter and a variance-gated composition with stabilization. The denoiser suppresses the noise, achieving temporally stable, visually compelling outputs during free camera navigation, all while retaining the sort-free, blend-free rasterization performance. The combined pipeline retains a PSNR gap to sorted alpha-blending renderers, but the denoiser's overhead stays below the time saved by removing sorting and blending.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 随机渲染 (stochastic rendering) 去掉 Gaussian Splatting 的排序与 alpha 混合却引入空间噪声，本文在视一致随机渲染器共享的像素流上做时序神经去噪：双路 EMA 累积、逐像素学习式历史可信度预测、固定各向异性空间滤波与方差门控合成。去噪后自由相机导航下输出时序稳定、视觉良好，且去噪开销低于省去排序与混合所省下的时间，但 PSNR 仍不及排序式 alpha 混合渲染器。
Motivation: 随机 Gaussian Splatting 渲染以引入空间噪声为代价省掉排序与 alpha 混合，噪声使自由视角漫游的像素流时序不稳，需要在保留无排序性能的前提下压噪。
Method: 在视一致随机渲染器共享的像素流上构建时序神经去噪器，组合双路指数滑动平均 (dual-path EMA) 累积、逐像素学习式历史可信度预测、固定各向异性空间滤波，以及带稳定的方差门控合成；在随机 2D Gaussian Splatting 渲染上验证。
Result: 抑制噪声并获得时序稳定、视觉良好的自由相机导航输出，同时保留无排序、无混合的光栅化性能；去噪开销低于移除排序与混合所省下的时间；整条管线的 PSNR 相对排序式 alpha 混合渲染器仍有差距。
Conclusion: 随机 Gaussian Splatting 配上时序去噪可以在保留 sort-free、blend-free 速度优势的同时把噪声压到可用水平，代价是 PSNR 尚未追平排序式 alpha 混合渲染器。

papers.title: Rewired or Gated? How Instruction Tuning Shapes Knowledge-Conflict Circuits in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: In language models, the choice between believing the prompt and believing the weights is made by a handful of identifiable attention heads. Instruction tuning changes how models behave under conflict, but whether it rewires the underlying circuit or merely gates/reweights already present components, remains unknown. We provide the first mechanistic base-vs-instruct comparison of conflict-resolution circuits, across three families (Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen-2.5-3B, Gemma-3-4B). Five independent methods, node and edge attribution, superposition role analysis, causal ablation, and path patching, converge on gating, with the same heads, in the same late-layers, are found to be reweighted rather than replaced with a high node overlap (0.60-0.82). Behaviorally, tuning shifts models toward parametric memory, making instruct models reject a terse counterfactual context far more than base ones, the opposite of a naive user-following expectation. Yet this added skepticism is a factor of framing since it disappears when the same false claim is delivered as a coherent, evidential passage. The robustness that instruction tuning buys against terse injection is therefore real but narrow. More broadly, we believe that because the conflict circuit is preserved rather than rebuilt, interpretability and control tools calibrated on base models should transfer directly to their deployed instruct siblings.
papers.comment: Accepted at BlackboxNLP 2026, Co-located with EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen-2.5-3B、Gemma-3-4B 做 base vs instruct 的冲突消解电路机制比较，五种归因方法一致指向 gating：指令调优重加权而非替换同一批注意力头，节点重叠 0.60–0.82。行为上 instruct 模型更依赖参数记忆、更强烈拒绝简短反事实上下文，但同一虚假陈述改写成连贯证据段落后该怀疑消失。
Motivation: 指令调优改变模型在提示与权重冲突时的行为，但它是重连了底层电路还是仅门控已有组件尚不清楚，这直接决定 base 模型上校准的可解释性与控制工具能否迁移到 instruct 版本。
Method: 在三个模型族上做 base vs instruct 的冲突消解电路对比，用五种独立方法交叉验证：节点与边归因、叠加角色分析 (superposition role analysis)、因果消融 (causal ablation)、路径修补 (path patching)。
Result: 五种方法一致收敛到 gating，同一批头位于相同深层并被重加权而非替换，节点重叠 0.60–0.82。行为上指令调优使模型偏向参数记忆，instruct 模型拒绝简短反事实上下文的程度远高于 base，与朴素的用户服从预期相反；但同一虚假陈述以连贯证据段落形式给出时该效应消失。
Conclusion: 冲突电路被保留而非重建，因此在 base 模型上校准的可解释性与控制工具应可直接迁移到部署用 instruct 模型；指令调优换来的对简短注入的鲁棒性真实但狭窄，取决于表述框架。

papers.title: Observer Choice and Threshold Selection in Retinal Vessel Segmentation: A Subject-Separated Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: The annotation used to select a segmentation threshold is part of the evaluation protocol, yet its effect is easily conflated with model quality. We examine this choice for retinal vessel segmentation using all 28 CHASE DB1 images and both human annotations. A fixed seven-fold protocol keeps both eyes of each of the 14 subjects together. Random forests and Extra Trees are fitted against observer 1 with three random seeds, yielding 42 fits. Five threshold policies share identical score maps: fixed 0.50, observer-1 tuning, observer-2 tuning, mean-observer tuning, and maximin tuning of the per-image lower observer Dice. For random forests, maximin changes the threshold in 19 of 21 fits, but worst-observer Dice decreases from 70.53 percent to 70.45 percent. The paired difference is -0.073 percentage points, with a conditional subject-bootstrap 95 percent interval of [-0.384, 0.238]. Extra Trees shows the same direction. Identical observer-1-tuned random-forest masks score 73.66 percent against observer 1 and 71.06 percent against observer 2. The results support explicit reporting of both the threshold-selection reference and evaluation reference; they do not support an accuracy benefit from maximin tuning in this cohort. All splits, raw predictions, metrics and code are supplied. AI assistance is disclosed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CHASE DB1 全部 28 张图上，用同一组分数图比较五种分割阈值选取策略，发现按最差观察者 Dice 做 maximin 调参虽在 21 次随机森林拟合中的 19 次改变了阈值，却使最差观察者 Dice 从 70.53% 降到 70.45%。作者主张显式报告阈值选取参照与评估参照两个对象，本队列中 maximin 调参不带来精度收益。
Motivation: 阈值选取所用的标注本身是评估协议的一部分，其影响容易与模型质量混为一谈；同一组掩膜换一个评估观察者，Dice 就会明显变化，需要把两者拆开报告。
Method: 用 CHASE DB1 全部 28 张图与两份人工标注，按 14 名受试者双眼不分离的固定七折划分；对随机森林与 Extra Trees 各用 3 个随机种子、以观察者 1 为参照拟合，共 42 次拟合；在完全相同的分数图上比较五种阈值策略：固定 0.50、观察者 1 调参、观察者 2 调参、平均观察者调参、以及对每图较低观察者 Dice 的 maximin 调参，并用受试者级配对 bootstrap 给区间。
Result: 随机森林中 maximin 在 21 次拟合的 19 次改变了阈值，但最差观察者 Dice 由 70.53% 降至 70.45%，配对差为 -0.073 个百分点，条件受试者 bootstrap 95% 区间为 [-0.384, 0.238]；Extra Trees 方向相同。同一组按观察者 1 调参的随机森林掩膜，对观察者 1 得 73.66%，对观察者 2 得 71.06%。
Conclusion: 在该队列中 maximin 阈值调参没有精度收益，评估时应同时显式报告阈值选取参照与评估参照；全部划分、原始预测、指标与代码均已提供。

papers.title: Evaluating Coding Agents on Kernel Exploit Generation
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents now find real vulnerabilities in production software. However, bug discovery results do not measure whether agents can construct exploit primitives. We introduce KEX-bench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on exploit primitive generation against real operating-system kernels. KEX-bench contains 45 task instances across 40 Linux and Windows CVEs, covering kernel address leak, instruction-pointer control, heap read, heap write, and arbitrary address write. Each task runs in an isolated virtual machine, exposes controlled tools, and uses a deterministic verifier to check primitive-specific success. We evaluate state-of-the-art coding agents paired with frontier and open-weight models under fixed tool-call budgets. Without a reference proof of concept (PoC), the strongest configuration solves 1 of 20 Windows tasks (5.0%) and 14 of 25 Linux tasks (56.0%). With a reference PoC, the strongest configuration solves 31 of 45 tasks (68.9%). This highlights the gap where agents reach kernel crashes but fail to shape kernel state into exploit primitives. We release KEX-bench for reproducible research on AI-assisted exploitation at https://kex-bench.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 KEX-bench，用 40 个真实 Linux/Windows CVE 的 45 个任务实例评测 coding agent 构造内核 exploit primitive 的能力，任务在隔离虚拟机中运行并由确定性 verifier 判定。无参考 PoC 时最强配置仅解出 20 个 Windows 任务中的 1 个（5.0%）与 25 个 Linux 任务中的 14 个（56.0%）；给出参考 PoC 后升至 31/45（68.9%）。
Motivation: 现有 coding agent 评测只测能否发现真实软件漏洞，不测能否把崩溃进一步塑造成可用的 exploit primitive，这一环节缺少可复现的衡量标准。
Method: KEX-bench 含 45 个任务实例、覆盖 40 个 Linux 与 Windows CVE，原语类型包括 kernel address leak、instruction-pointer control、heap read、heap write、arbitrary address write；每个任务在隔离虚拟机中运行、暴露受控工具，并用确定性 verifier 按原语类型判定成功。评测将 SOTA coding agent 与 frontier 及 open-weight 模型配对，在固定 tool-call 预算下运行，并区分有无参考 PoC 两种条件。
Result: 无参考 PoC 时最强配置解出 Windows 20 题中的 1 题（5.0%）、Linux 25 题中的 14 题（56.0%）；有参考 PoC 时最强配置解出 45 题中的 31 题（68.9%）。
Conclusion: agent 能让内核崩溃，却难以把内核状态塑造成 exploit primitive，参考 PoC 是当前跨越这一差距的关键条件；KEX-bench 作为可复现基准公开发布。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Transformer Heads Looking for Order
papers.abstract_en: In this note, we show that the problem of checking, whether a sequence of bits is ordered, is not doable by 1-head 1-layer transformers but is doable by a 2-head 1-layer transformer. Unlike similar previous results, our results assume the model where transformers have an output MLP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明单头单层（带输出 MLP 的）Transformer 无法判定比特序列是否有序，而双头单层即可判定，说明仅增加一个注意力头就跨过了有序性检查的表达能力门槛。结论针对带输出 MLP 的 Transformer 模型，区别于此前不含该组件的同类下界结果。
Motivation: 已有关于 Transformer 表达能力的不可判定性结果多在不含输出 MLP 的设定下给出，带输出 MLP 时判定比特序列有序性所需的最小头数并不清楚。
Method: 在带输出 MLP 的单层 Transformer 模型下做表达能力上下界证明：对 1 头情形给出不可判定的下界，对 2 头情形构造可判定的上界，形成严格分离。
Result: 有序性检查（checking whether a sequence of bits is ordered）不可由 1-head 1-layer Transformer 完成，但可由 2-head 1-layer Transformer 完成；该结论在模型包含输出 MLP 的假设下成立。
Conclusion: 带输出 MLP 的单层 Transformer 中，头数从 1 增至 2 是完成比特序列有序性检查的表达能力分界。

papers.title: Deflecting the Value Compass: Interacting with Large Language Models Temporarily Shifts Human Value Priorities Toward Personal Focus
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly support decisions where values are in tension, yet little is known about whether interacting with them changes which values users prioritize. In a preregistered study, 200 U.S. adults interacted with ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini as a thinking partner or read fixed AI-generated considerations. The prompt asked LLMs to support reasoning without recommending a decision and named no values. Participants advised people facing real dilemmas and completed parallel PVQ-RR forms before, immediately after, and one task later. Each LLM condition temporarily shifted value priorities toward personal focus relative to the control (d=0.37-0.51), primarily through increased Self-Enhancement. Participants' advice retained words and meaning from their exchanges. Thus, a brief LLM interaction that neither targets values nor seeks to persuade can reorient values active during judgment without detectable convergence in value directions or advice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 预注册实验显示，与 ChatGPT、Claude 或 Gemini 作为思考伙伴进行一次简短互动，会把美国成人的价值优先级暂时推向更个人化的取向（personal focus），主要通过 Self-Enhancement 提升实现，效应量 d=0.37–0.51；互动既不点名价值也不劝说，且未观察到价值方向或建议的趋同。
Motivation: 大模型日益介入价值冲突的决策场景，但互动本身是否会改变用户当下的价值优先级几乎无人研究。
Method: 预注册研究，200 名美国成年人被分配到与 ChatGPT、Claude 或 Gemini 作为思考伙伴互动、或阅读固定 AI 生成考量的对照条件；提示词要求 LLM 支持推理但不推荐决策、不点名价值。参与者为真实困境中的人提供建议，并在任务前、任务后立即、以及隔一个任务后各填一次平行版 PVQ-RR 量表。
Result: 各 LLM 条件相对对照均暂时把价值优先级推向 personal focus，d=0.37–0.51，主要由 Self-Enhancement 增加驱动；参与者给出的建议保留了其与 LLM 交换中的用词与含义，且未出现价值方向或建议的可检测趋同。
Conclusion: 一次不针对价值、也不寻求劝说的简短 LLM 互动，就足以重新定向判断时活跃的价值，但这种偏移是暂时的、方向上并不收敛。

papers.title: Hi-OPD: Hierarchy-Aware Open-Prompt Detection for Remote Sensing Images
papers.abstract_en: Hi-OPD addresses a failure mode left uncontrolled by flat open-prompt training: descendant retrieval need not persist under ancestor queries when multi-source remote sensing annotations exhibit inconsistent granularity and missing labels. A detector may localize \textit{car} and \textit{van} under atomic prompts yet miss the same instances under \textit{vehicle}; flat AP does not expose this cross-level inconsistency. We propose Hi-OPD, a hierarchy-aware open-prompt detector, and construct RS153-HierOPD from 175,644 retained training image/tile records and 3.48M boxes mapped to 153 atomic categories with sparse hierarchy and alias relations. Hi-OPD learns ancestor retrieval through hierarchy-safe negative sampling, path multi-positive supervision, and one-way upward consistency, while per-source risk exclusion handles potentially missing labels. ConvVPE converts K-shot support boxes into text-compatible embeddings using detector-native features and the shared contrastive head. On Track A, Hi-OPD obtains 79.7/72.3 AP50 on DIOR/DOTA-v2.0, above the literature-reported OpenRSD results of 76.7/71.8. Under controlled training on the original converted annotations, the full hierarchy recipe raises DOTA-v2.0 parent AP50 from 7.2 to 71.5 and FAIR1M grandparent AP50 from 31.6 to 71.4, while DOTA-v2.0 atomic AP50 changes from 71.4 to 72.3. The text path reaches 99.7% CAR50 (0.3% violation) across the three common sources and 99.9%/0.1% on FAIR1M grandparent relations. On held-out VEDAI, text AP50 is 75.9, 6.2 points above OpenRSD. Joint AP and CAR show that explicit hierarchy training repairs this failure mode while retaining atomic detection and prompt transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hi-OPD 针对开放提示检测中「原子提示能检出、祖先提示漏检」的跨层级失效，用层级安全负采样、路径多正样本监督与单向向上一致性训练，配合处理缺失标签的 per-source risk exclusion。在 DOTA-v2.0 上完整层级配方把 parent AP50 从 7.2 提到 71.5，FAIR1M grandparent AP50 从 31.6 提到 71.4，而 atomic AP50 仅从 71.4 变到 72.3，说明层级修复不牺牲原子检测。
Motivation: 多源遥感标注粒度不一致、标签缺失时，扁平开放提示训练下祖先查询（如 vehicle）检不出已学会的 car/van 实例，而扁平 AP 指标暴露不了这种跨层级不一致。
Method: 提出层级感知开放提示检测器 Hi-OPD，构建 RS153-HierOPD 数据集（175,644 条训练图像/瓦片记录、3.48M 框、153 个原子类别，含稀疏层级与别名关系）；训练用 hierarchy-safe negative sampling、path multi-positive supervision、one-way upward consistency，加 per-source risk exclusion 处理潜在缺失标签；ConvVPE 用检测器原生特征与共享对比学习头把 K-shot support 框转成文本兼容嵌入。
Result: Track A 上 DIOR/DOTA-v2.0 AP50 为 79.7/72.3，高于文献报告的 OpenRSD 76.7/71.8；受控训练下完整层级配方使 DOTA-v2.0 parent AP50 从 7.2 升到 71.5、FAIR1M grandparent AP50 从 31.6 升到 71.4，DOTA-v2.0 atomic AP50 从 71.4 到 72.3；文本路径在三个常见源上 CAR50 达 99.7%（违规 0.3%），FAIR1M grandparent 关系为 99.9%/0.1%；留出的 VEDAI 上文本 AP50 为 75.9，比 OpenRSD 高 6.2 点。
Conclusion: 显式层级训练能修复祖先查询漏检这一失效模式，同时保住原子检测能力与 prompt 迁移（K-shot 支持框转文本嵌入）。

papers.title: EMGBlend: Heterogeneity-Aware Self-Supervised Pretraining for Gesture and Force Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Public surface electromyography (EMG) datasets vary widely in electrode layout, channel count, frequency support, and size. Simply mixing them for pretraining can misalign channel semantics, introduce spectral targets that some devices cannot observe, and let large or high-channel-count datasets dominate learning. We introduce EMGBlend, a self-supervised framework designed around these differences. It combines shared channel patches with geometry-aware attention, restricts spectral targets to each recording's supported frequency band, and balances exposure across data sources. We pretrain a 109M-parameter model on 11 public EMG sources and evaluate it on gesture recognition, continuous-force regression, and contact classification. EMGBlend consistently outperforms matched random initialization and waveform reconstruction controls. Fixed-budget source controls show that multi-source pretraining improves gesture recognition and remains competitive for force decoding. Ablations confirm that geometry, band-aware targets, and source balancing each contribute to transfer, although cross-person NinaPro force estimation remains difficult. Overall, EMGBlend shows how heterogeneous EMG datasets can be combined through explicit mechanism design rather than simple concatenation. Code is available at https://github.com/tamanano/EMGBlend
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMGBlend 用显式机制设计把电极布局、通道数、频段各不相同的 11 个公开 EMG 数据源拼成可用的自监督预训练语料：共享通道 patch 加 geometry-aware attention 对齐通道语义，频谱目标只落在各记录自身支持的频段内，并对数据源做曝光平衡。109M 参数模型在手势识别、连续力回归、接触分类上一致优于同配随机初始化与波形重建对照，多源预训练提升手势识别，但跨人 NinaPro 力估计仍然困难。
Motivation: 公开 EMG 数据集在电极布局、通道数、频率支持和规模上差异极大，直接混合预训练会错位通道语义、引入部分设备观测不到的频谱目标，并让大源或高通道数源主导学习。
Method: 自监督框架三件事：共享通道 patch 配 geometry-aware attention 处理异构电极几何；频谱目标按每条记录支持的频段裁剪；跨数据源平衡曝光。在 11 个公开 EMG 源上预训练 109M 参数模型，评测手势识别、连续力回归与接触分类，并做几何、频段目标、源平衡的消融与固定预算源对照。
Result: 在手势识别、连续力回归、接触分类上一致优于匹配的随机初始化与波形重建对照；固定预算源对照显示多源预训练提升手势识别、在力解码上保持竞争力；消融确认 geometry、band-aware targets、source balancing 各自都对迁移有贡献。
Conclusion: 异构 EMG 数据集要靠显式机制设计（几何、频段、源平衡）而非简单拼接来合并；跨人 NinaPro 力估计仍是难点。

papers.title: Gaze responses to false-positive computer-aided detection prompts during colonoscopy: a paired-video and real-time eye-tracking study
papers.abstract_en: False-positive computer-aided detection (CADe) prompts may divert endoscopists' attention during colonoscopy, yet the attentional impact of individual prompts remains unclear. We used event-locked eye tracking to quantify gaze attraction and attention occupation in complementary retrospective and prospective studies. In a retrospective paired-video experiment, 3 senior and 2 novice endoscopists viewed 60 colonoscopy videos with and without CADe. The prospective study recorded gaze during 42 real-time CADe-assisted colonoscopies performed by 9 senior endoscopists. Screened CADe prompts outside expert-annotated lesion windows were classified as false-positive artifact events. False-positive prompts attracted gaze in 48.6% (68/140) of retrospective observations and 65.2% (533/817) of prospective events. Among attraction events with complete recovery, median attention occupation lasted 1000 ms in the retrospective study and 1100 ms in the prospective study. Corresponding median prompt durations were 33 ms and 267 ms, with median time amplifications of 17.55-fold and 5.15-fold, respectively. In paired retrospective comparisons, visible artifact prompts drew gaze closer to the prompted region than did the same-coordinate unassisted reference. Secondary retrospective analyses showed high lesion gaze recognition without and with CADe (98.0% versus 99.0%). First gaze entry into lesion regions occurred 147.8 ms earlier with CADe. Across controlled and real-time clinical settings, false-positive CADe prompts frequently captured gaze, with attention persisting beyond prompt visibility. These findings support considering prompt-related attentional burden in CADe evaluation and design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 结肠镜 CADe 假阳性提示会持续俘获内镜医师注视：回顾性配对视频中 48.6%（68/140）的假阳性提示吸引注视，前瞻实时操作中为 65.2%（533/817），且注视占用中位 1000 ms 与 1100 ms，远超提示本身的 33 ms 与 267 ms（放大 17.55 倍与 5.15 倍）。结论是 CADe 评估与设计须计入提示带来的注意负担。
Motivation: 假阳性 CADe 提示可能分散内镜医师注意力，但单个提示的注意占用程度此前不清楚，影响 CADe 系统的评估与设计。
Method: 采用事件锁定眼动 (event-locked eye tracking) 的回顾性与前瞻性互补设计：回顾性配对视频实验让 3 名资深与 2 名新手内镜医师观看 60 段有/无 CADe 的结肠镜视频；前瞻研究记录 9 名资深内镜医师的 42 例实时 CADe 辅助结肠镜检查。专家标注病灶窗口之外的提示被判定为假阳性伪影事件。
Result: 假阳性提示吸引注视的比例为回顾性 48.6%（68/140）、前瞻性 65.2%（533/817）；完全恢复的吸引事件中注意占用中位 1000 ms（回顾）与 1100 ms（前瞻），对应提示时长中位 33 ms 与 267 ms，时间放大 17.55 倍与 5.15 倍。配对比较中可见伪影提示使注视更靠近提示区域；病灶注视识别率有/无 CADe 为 98.0% 与 99.0%，首次进入病灶区域提前 147.8 ms。
Conclusion: 假阳性 CADe 提示在受控与实时临床两种场景下都频繁俘获注视，且注意占用在提示消失后仍持续，CADe 的评估与设计应计入提示相关的注意负担。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.result: 假阳性提示吸引注视的比例为回顾性 48.6%（68/140）、前瞻性 65.2%（533/817）；完全恢复的吸引事件中注意占用中位 1000 ms（回顾）与 1100 ms（前瞻），对应提示时长中位 33 ms 与 267 ms，时间放大 17.55 倍与 5.15 倍。配对比较中可见伪影提示使注视更靠近提示区域；病灶注视识别率有/无 CADe 为 98.0% 与 99.0%，首次进入病灶区域提前 147.8 ms。
summary_sections.conclusion: 假阳性 CADe 提示在受控与实时临床两种场景下都频繁俘获注视，且注意占用在提示消失后仍持续，CADe 的评估与设计应计入提示相关的注意负担。

papers.title: Agentic Building-Aware Satellite Gaussian Splatting for Auditable Urban DSM Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Urban-scale 3D reconstruction from satellite imagery supports disaster response, city monitoring, and geospatial digital twins, yet neural rendering methods typically optimize average visual fidelity rather than the structures that analysts inspect first: buildings. We present an agentic building-aware satellite Gaussian Splatting workflow that uses Segment Anything-derived building masks as semantic priors and an Agentic Reconstruction Controller to select, verify, and record DSM reconstruction policies. On the DFC2019 JAX\_004 scene, building-aware weighting reduces building-region DSM MAE from 0.844 m to 0.806 m, showing that semantic priors can shift reconstruction capacity toward analyst-critical regions. A staged schedule provides a balanced operating point, improving full-scene MAE from 1.362 m to 1.349 m while retaining a building gain. Across four JAX scenes, the Agent selects validated policies for both general DSM and building-focused DSM objectives, and produces building-inventory metadata and per-scene decision records. The system combines semantic priors, policy selection, region-specific DSM metrics, and DSM-derived GIS surface products for auditable urban 3D analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出智能体化的建筑感知卫星 Gaussian Splatting 工作流：用 Segment Anything 建筑掩膜作语义先验，由 Agentic Reconstruction Controller 选择、验证并记录 DSM 重建策略。在 DFC2019 JAX_004 上，建筑加权把建筑区 DSM MAE 从 0.844 m 降到 0.806 m，分阶段调度把全场景 MAE 从 1.362 m 降到 1.349 m 且保留建筑区收益。
Motivation: 神经渲染类卫星三维重建通常优化平均视觉保真度，而不是分析人员最先查看的建筑结构，且策略选择过程不可审计。
Method: 以 Segment Anything 导出的建筑掩膜作语义先验做加权重建，Agentic Reconstruction Controller 负责选择、验证并记录 DSM 重建策略，输出建筑清单元数据与逐场景决策记录，并派生 DSM 的 GIS 表面产品。
Result: DFC2019 JAX_004 上建筑区 DSM MAE 0.844 m → 0.806 m（建筑感知加权）；全场景 MAE 1.362 m → 1.349 m（分阶段调度）并保留建筑区收益；在四个 JAX 场景上 Agent 为通用 DSM 与建筑导向 DSM 目标均选出经验证的策略。
Conclusion: 语义先验可把重建能力导向分析关键的建筑区域，且策略选择可被记录为可审计的决策链，用于城市三维分析。

papers.title: Scalable Minimum-Volume Simplex Estimation with Non-asymptotic Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We study the estimation of a $K$-dimensional simplex from $N$ i.i.d.\ points sampled uniformly from its interior; the observations are convex combinations of $K+1$ unknown prototypes. Existing polynomial-time estimators need cubic per-sample work or $O(NK)$ storage and are impractical at $N\sim 10^6$--$10^8$. We propose DeepMVSA, which re-expresses the minimum-volume principle in neural implicit form: a lightweight coordinate network generates the mixing weights and a triangular LU-type parameterization the dual simplex matrix, reducing the trainable-state memory to $O(K^2)$, independent of $N$, and the cost per data pass to $O(NK^2)$. We prove a non-asymptotic sample-complexity bound of the polynomial-time benchmark order for a localized surrogate estimator; an oracle inequality for every global minimizer of the neural objective, with volume-inflation control and an explicit shrinkage bias; a conditional end-to-end error budget separating statistical, approximation, optimization, and enclosure-residual terms on an explicit envelope event; and two-point lower bounds: at any noise level $σ>0$ fixed independently of $N$, the $N^{-1/2}$ scaling is unimprovable in its $N$-exponent. Experiments with up to $N=10^8$ synthetic observations are consistent with the predicted accuracy and scaling, and feasibility on real scenes of $\sim 10^7$ pixels is demonstrated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepMVSA 把最小体积单纯形估计 (minimum-volume simplex estimation) 改写成神经隐式形式：轻量坐标网络生成混合权重、三角 LU 型参数化对偶单纯形矩阵，把可训练状态内存压到 O(K^2)（与 N 无关）、每遍数据代价 O(NK^2)。给出非渐近样本复杂度界、oracle 不等式与端到端误差预算，并证明在噪声 σ>0 固定时 N^{-1/2} 的 N 指数不可改进；实验做到 N=10^8 合成观测与约 10^7 像素真实场景。
Motivation: 现有多项式时间单纯形估计器每样本开销为三次或需 O(NK) 存储，在 N~10^6–10^8 规模不可用。
Method: 以神经隐式形式重写最小体积原理：轻量坐标网络输出混合权重，三角 LU 型参数化给出对偶单纯形矩阵；对局部化代理估计器证明多项式时间基准量级的非渐近样本复杂度界，对神经目标的全局极小点给出含体积膨胀控制与显式收缩偏差的 oracle 不等式，并在显式包络事件上分离统计、逼近、优化、enclosure 残差四项给出条件端到端误差预算与两点下界。
Result: 可训练状态内存 O(K^2)、与 N 无关，每遍数据代价 O(NK^2)；下界表明任何固定 σ>0 下 N^{-1/2} 标度的 N 指数不可改进；实验用至多 N=10^8 合成观测，结果与预测精度和标度一致，并在约 10^7 像素的真实场景上演示可行性。
Conclusion: 神经参数化能在保持多项式时间基准量级样本复杂度的同时把单纯形估计扩展到 N~10^8，且 N^{-1/2} 标度在固定噪声下已是最优 N 指数。

papers.title: Direct Optimization of Generators for Search in Automated Theorem Proving
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) significantly advance Automated Theorem Proving (ATP), but are often deployed as guiding policies within tree search rather than for single-attempt generation. Recent work shows cross entropy is suboptimal for an LLM used in flat search strategies such as aggregation or filtering and that work has developed new loss functions to correct this misalignment. Extending this alignment to tree search is more challenging: proof discovery depends on exploration and recovery through off-trace states that supervised demonstrations do not reveal. We extend Compute-Aligned Training (CAT) to this setting through an abstraction of policy-guided search, deriving tractable, trace-supported losses. Alongside these search-aware losses, we introduce a search-agnostic uniform-allocation (UA) loss that accounts for the budget without specifying the specific search. Both induce scalar weights on per-tactic cross-entropy gradients. We characterize how off-trace behavior affects the search-aware weights, including conditions for vanishing approximation error at large budgets. On a Lean benchmark, both approaches achieve higher observed proof-success rates than cross-entropy across six search strategies, with strong results from a single shared UA adapter. Budget sweeps show larger gains over cross-entropy at 16 than at 256 expansions, implying CAT scales with test time compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把面向搜索的损失从平坦搜索扩展到树搜索：对策略引导搜索做抽象，推导可计算、由轨迹支撑的 search-aware 损失，并提出不指定具体搜索的 uniform-allocation (UA) 损失，两者都表现为对逐 tactic 交叉熵梯度的标量加权。在 Lean 基准上，两种损失在六种搜索策略下的观测证明成功率均高于交叉熵，且 16 次展开时相对交叉熵的增益大于 256 次展开时，说明 CAT 随测试时计算扩展。
Motivation: LLM 常作为树搜索的引导策略而非单次生成，交叉熵与该用途错位；而证明发现依赖探索与从监督示范不暴露的 off-trace 状态恢复，把面向平坦搜索的对齐损失推广到树搜索更难。
Method: 扩展 Compute-Aligned Training (CAT)：对 policy-guided search 做抽象并推导轨迹支撑的 search-aware 损失，同时引入 search-agnostic 的 uniform-allocation (UA) 损失来计入预算而不指定搜索形式；两者都化为对逐 tactic 交叉熵梯度的标量权重，并刻画 off-trace 行为对 search-aware 权重的影响及大预算下近似误差消失的条件。
Result: 在 Lean 基准上，search-aware 损失与单一共享 UA adapter 在六种搜索策略下的观测证明成功率都高于交叉熵；预算扫描显示 16 次展开时相对交叉熵的增益大于 256 次展开时。
Conclusion: 面向搜索的标量加权损失能纠正 ATP 树搜索中交叉熵的错位，且增益随测试时计算扩大而更明显，即 CAT 随 test time compute 扩展。

papers.title: A Behavioral Trait Leaks into Preferences: Diagnosing Trait Interference in LLM User Simulators
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based user simulators aim to bridge the offline-online gap in recommender evaluation by emulating users through injected traits, where preference attributes determine what a user engages with and a behavioral activity trait governs how long they browse. However, we show this intended trait independence collapses during simulation, causing two failures: (i) Trait Interference, where amplified activity distorts preference boundaries and forces interactions with mismatched items to sustain browsing, and (ii) Evaluation Invalidity, where satisfaction scores inflate with activity-driven page counts despite taste mismatches, biasing evaluation toward trait distributions rather than recommender performance. To resolve this, we propose PQA, a page-level quality anchoring method that guides simulators using a personalized anchor reflecting each user's intrinsic preference standard. By assessing whether a page meets this standard before further browsing, PQA enables proactive exits from low-quality pages, letting the activity trait retain its intended role of modulating browsing depth within preference-conforming pages. Experiments show PQA mitigates trait interference and improves the reliability of LLM-based simulator evaluation under activity shifts. Our code is available at https://github.com/chaehyun1/PQA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 用户模拟器中注入的偏好属性与行为活跃度 trait 并不独立：活跃度被放大时会扭曲偏好边界，迫使模拟器为维持浏览而点击不匹配物品，同时满意度分数随页数虚高，使推荐评估偏向 trait 分布而非推荐器性能。提出的页级质量锚定方法 PQA 用反映用户内在偏好标准的个性化锚点，在继续浏览前判断当前页是否达标，从而主动退出低质量页，让活跃度 trait 只调节符合偏好页面内的浏览深度；实验表明 PQA 缓解了 trait interference 并在活跃度偏移下提升评估可靠性。
Motivation: LLM 用户模拟器靠注入 trait 来弥合推荐系统的离线-在线评估差距，但偏好属性与行为活跃度 trait 在模拟中相互干扰，导致满意度分数被浏览页数抬高，评估结果反映的是 trait 分布而非推荐器真实性能。
Method: 提出 PQA (page-level quality anchoring)：为每个用户构造反映其内在偏好标准的个性化锚点，在模拟器继续翻页前先评估当前页是否满足该标准，不达标则主动退出，使活跃度 trait 只在符合偏好的页面内调节浏览深度。
Result: 实验显示 PQA 缓解了 trait interference，并在活跃度偏移 (activity shifts) 条件下提升了 LLM 用户模拟器评估的可靠性；代码发布于 github.com/chaehyun1/PQA。
Conclusion: trait 间的目标独立性在模拟过程中会崩塌，用页级个性化质量锚点把偏好判断前置，可以让活跃度 trait 回到只控制浏览深度的本职，从而让模拟器评估重新反映推荐器性能。

papers.title: Recovering Agentic Sovereignty: Mitigating the Consensus Paradox via Contrastive Epistemic Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a parametric vulnerability to adversarial swarm consensus. To mitigate this sycophancy, we introduce Contrastive Epistemic Decoding (CED), a zero-shot inference intervention. Unlike standard Contrastive Decoding (CD) which relies on a weaker secondary model, CED utilizes a dual forward-pass on a single architecture to isolate conformity bias. By introducing a novel asymmetric, zero-bounded probability clamp and discrete top-k truncation mask, CED mathematically suppresses toxic consensus tokens without causing grammatical collapse. Evaluated across 7,200 paired trajectories on complex benchmarks (GAIA, SWE-bench, Multi-Challenge) using Gemma-2 (9B), Llama-3.1 (8B), and Mistral v0.3 (7B), CED successfully neutralizes architectural and positional biases. By reducing cognitive loafing by up to 33.00% absolute, CED drives significant performance gains, yielding up to a 30.75% accuracy recovery. Regaining sovereignty induces distinct architectural behaviors---passive task-focus in Gemma-2 and active refutation of the simulated swarm in Llama-3.1---showing CED decouples compliance from capability without fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出零样本推理干预 Contrastive Epistemic Decoding (CED)：在同一模型上做双前向传播，用非对称零界概率钳制与 top-k 截断掩码压制从众 token，从而在不微调的前提下把 LLM 从对抗性群体共识 (adversarial swarm consensus) 的顺从偏差中解耦出来。
Motivation: LLM 存在参数化的顺从脆弱性 (sycophancy)：在群体共识压力下屈从，标准 Contrastive Decoding 依赖较弱的次级模型，难以隔离从众偏差。
Method: CED 对单一架构做双前向传播以隔离 conformity bias，引入非对称零界概率钳制 (asymmetric zero-bounded probability clamp) 与离散 top-k 截断掩码，在零样本推理阶段抑制 toxic consensus token 而不造成语法崩坏。
Result: 在 GAIA、SWE-bench、Multi-Challenge 上以 Gemma-2 (9B)、Llama-3.1 (8B)、Mistral v0.3 (7B) 评测 7,200 条配对轨迹：cognitive loafing 最多降低 33.00% 绝对值，准确率恢复 (accuracy recovery) 最高 30.75%，并中和了架构与位置偏差。
Conclusion: CED 在不微调的情况下把 LLM 的顺从性与能力解耦，且不同架构恢复主权后行为分化——Gemma-2 转为被动任务聚焦，Llama-3.1 主动反驳模拟群体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SambaGraph: Action-Reaction Spatio-Temporal Graphs for Soccer Tactical Response Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Soccer tactics are interactive: an attacking action changes the opponent's defensive problem, and the observed response depends on the multi-agent match state. We introduce SambaGraph, an action--reaction spatio-temporal graph dataset and benchmark for soccer tactical response modeling. From tracking and event data for all 64 matches of the 2022 FIFA World Cup, we curate 4,070 action-centered episodes represented as temporally aligned 23-node player--ball graph sequences with attack/defense views, response labels, and 26,270 split-safe attack--defense pairs. We study three questions: whether observed responses can be classified from graph episodes, whether successful defenses can be retrieved for a query attack, and whether graph-derived summaries support grounded LLM reasoning. A compact signature MLP obtains $0.796\pm0.007$ macro-F1 for response classification, while a fused graph--signature dual encoder reaches $0.471\pm0.029$ Hit@5 and $0.655\pm0.051$ Hit@10 for full-bank defensive retrieval. Hard negatives maximize pair discrimination but not retrieval quality. Local LLMs underperform supervised encoders for direct classification and do not improve over a strong original order in eight-candidate reranking, but they provide grounded tactical rationales. These results position SambaGraph as a reproducible benchmark for graph-based soccer strategy-response research. Code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/areyesan/SambaGraph.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SambaGraph 是足球战术响应建模的时空图数据集与基准，从 2022 世界杯全部 64 场比赛的追踪与事件数据构造 4,070 个以动作为中心的 23 节点球员-球图序列片段，含 26,270 对攻防配对。紧凑 signature MLP 在响应分类上取得 0.796±0.007 macro-F1，而融合图-签名双编码器在全库防守检索上仅 0.471±0.029 Hit@5、0.655±0.051 Hit@10；本地 LLM 在直接分类与八候选重排上均不敌有监督编码器，只在给出可落地的战术理由上有优势。
Motivation: 足球进攻动作会改变对手的防守难题，而观察到的响应取决于多智能体比赛状态，此前缺少以动作-响应配对为核心、可复现的图结构基准来系统研究这一交互。
Method: 从 2022 FIFA World Cup 64 场比赛的 tracking 与 event 数据中整理 4,070 个动作中心片段，表示为时间对齐的 23 节点球员-球图序列，带攻/防视角、响应标签与 26,270 对 split-safe 攻防配对；评测三个任务：从图片段分类响应、按查询进攻检索成功防守、检验图衍生摘要是否支撑 grounded LLM 推理，模型包括 signature MLP、融合图-签名双编码器与本地 LLM。
Result: 响应分类上紧凑 signature MLP 达 0.796±0.007 macro-F1；全库防守检索上融合图-签名双编码器为 0.471±0.029 Hit@5、0.655±0.051 Hit@10。Hard negatives 最大化配对判别但不提升检索质量；本地 LLM 在直接分类上不及有监督编码器，在八候选重排上相对强原始顺序无提升，但能给出 grounded 战术理由。
Conclusion: SambaGraph 定位为基于图的足球策略-响应研究的可复现基准；hard negative 挖掘的判别目标与检索质量并不对齐，本地 LLM 适合生成战术理由而非替代有监督编码器做分类与检索。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: RootQuantV2: Adapting a Vision Foundation Model for Root-Trait Regression from Minirhizotron Imagery
papers.abstract_en: A lack of high-throughput phenotyping solutions for root traits in field-grown crops has severely constrained understanding and improvement of below-ground traits and processes. Minirhizotrons are the standard non-destructive root-phenotyping method in field environments. Computer vision solutions are needed to allow automated trait estimation at scale, but training data is scarce and human annotations are often inaccessible because they reside in proprietary software that only exports per-image scalar totals of root length and surface area. Nevertheless, large numeric archives of these root traits already exist. RootQuant showed that the traits can be predicted directly from the whole image by regression, thus removing manually traced masks from the pipeline; RootQuantV2 takes that idea further by replacing RootQuant's CNN backbone with a self-supervised ViT. We adapt a frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16 with a hybrid parameter-efficient scheme. Training only 11.9M parameters (3.78% of the model), RootQuantV2 achieves length and area $R^2$ of 0.950 and 0.930, respectively, while lowering length/area RMSE by 24.3%/20.7% over RootQuant. RootQuantV2 thus repurposes legacy numeric archives for high-throughput, automated root trait estimation.
papers.comment: 20 pages (15 main + 5 references), 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to the Computer Vision in Plant Phenotyping and Agriculture (CVPPA) Workshop at ECCV 2026. Code and weights: https://github.com/leakey-lab/RootQuantV2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RootQuantV2 把根系性状回归的 CNN 主干换成冻结的 DINOv3 ViT-L/16，用混合参数高效微调只训练 11.9M 参数（占模型 3.78%），直接从 minirhizotron 整图回归根长与表面积，绕开不可得的人工掩膜标注。在既有数值档案上根长与表面积 R² 达 0.950 与 0.930，RMSE 相对 RootQuant 分别下降 24.3% 与 20.7%。
Motivation: 田间根系高通量表型缺乏方案：人工标注藏在专有软件里，只导出每图的根长与表面积标量总量，掩膜级训练数据稀缺，尽管大量历史数值档案已经存在。
Method: 沿用 RootQuant 的整图回归思路（去掉手工描摹掩膜），把 CNN 主干替换为自监督 ViT（DINOv3 ViT-L/16），主干冻结，用混合参数高效微调方案只训练 11.9M 参数（3.78%），从 minirhizotron 图像直接回归根长与表面积。
Result: 根长 R² 0.950、表面积 R² 0.930；相对 RootQuant，根长 RMSE 降低 24.3%、表面积 RMSE 降低 20.7%；训练参数量 11.9M，占模型 3.78%。
Conclusion: 冻结视觉基础模型加参数高效微调即可把既有根系数值档案转成高通量自动性状估计，无需掩膜标注。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AkasicMEM: Governed Enterprise Memory for Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory enables enterprise agents to retain knowledge acquired during work and reuse it across tasks and agents, turning execution experience into persistent organizational knowledge. Realizing this potential requires both source--memory integration, through which enterprise sources and accumulated memory can be utilized together, and memory governance, through which shared memory remains subject to organizational policies throughout its lifecycle. These requirements interact when information from enterprise sources persists in memory. As this information is repeatedly derived and reused under changing principals and policies, source restrictions may be bypassed, resulting in information leakage. Preventing such leakage requires authorization continuity, under which source restrictions remain effective throughout source-to-memory and memory-to-memory derivation and reuse. Existing approaches address these concerns individually, but do not treat source--memory integration, memory governance, and authorization continuity as combined core design targets across the memory lifecycle. We define Governed Enterprise Memory as agent memory designed around this combined scope and present AkasicMEM as its realization. AkasicMEM realizes authorization continuity through transitive lineage, policy composition during memory formation, and policy re-evaluation during retrieval. It is built on GraphAI's AkasicDB, a unified vector--graph--relational database whose storage and execution substrate enables the underlying operations of these mechanisms to be jointly optimized and executed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AkasicMEM 把企业 agent 记忆的源-记忆整合、记忆治理与授权连续性 (authorization continuity) 作为联合设计目标，通过传递性血缘 (transitive lineage)、记忆形成期的策略组合、检索期的策略重评估来保证源端限制在跨主体、跨策略的派生与复用中不被绕过。系统构建在 GraphAI 的 AkasicDB（统一 vector-graph-relational 数据库）之上，使这三类机制的底层操作可被联合优化执行。
Motivation: 企业源信息进入记忆后会被反复派生与复用，主体和策略不断变化，源端访问限制可能被绕过导致信息泄漏；现有方案各自处理整合、治理或授权，未把三者作为贯穿记忆生命周期的联合核心目标。
Method: 定义 Governed Enterprise Memory 这一概念范畴，并以 AkasicMEM 实现：授权连续性由传递性血缘追踪、记忆形成时的策略组合、检索时的策略重评估三个机制共同保证；底层依托 AkasicDB 的 vector-graph-relational 统一存储与执行基座，联合优化这些操作。
Result: 论文给出 Governed Enterprise Memory 的定义与 AkasicMEM 的系统实现，报告为 9 页、3 图的系统设计论文。
Conclusion: 源限制必须沿 source-to-memory 与 memory-to-memory 的整条派生链持续生效，且需要统一的存储执行基座才能把血缘、策略组合与策略重评估联合优化。

papers.title: IndustrialVLA-Bench: A Traceable Multi-Axis Evaluation of Open Robot Policy Models
papers.abstract_en: Open robot policies increasingly follow two paradigms: vision-language-action models (VLAs) directly map observations and instructions to actions, whereas world-action models (WAMs) incorporate learned video or world dynamics into policy learning or action generation. Although both target the same manipulation tasks and represent alternative design choices, they are commonly reported under different evaluation protocols, leaving their capability, robustness, language sensitivity, and deployment-cost trade-offs unclear. We present IndustrialVLA-Bench, an evidence-aware evaluation of six released VLA and WAM systems under a unified reporting schema. It separately evaluates clean capability on LIBERO, non-language robustness on LIBERO-Plus, instruction sensitivity on LIBERO-Para, and observed execution cost. Reported task scores aggregate three complete evaluations with distinct random seeds under a fixed checkpoint and inference configuration. Across all six systems, clean LIBERO averages differ by only 1.58 points, whereas robustness and paraphrase summaries span 14.62 and 31.08 points. Restricting every comparison to the three protocol-faithful systems preserves the effect (1.36, 14.62 and 23.10 points), so the diagnostic separation reported here does not depend on the weaker evidence tiers. We additionally report observed inference latency, peak memory, runtime mode, and an evidence status for every system. Protocol-faithful, near-reproduction, and pending-verification entries remain visibly separated; only protocol-faithful entries support strict comparisons. Rather than claiming universal superiority of either paradigm, IndustrialVLA-Bench provides traceable evidence for comparing released robot policies on shared practical criteria. Code and evaluation records are available at https://github.com/xiaoqi-7/IndustrialVLA-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IndustrialVLA-Bench 用统一报告口径评测 6 个已发布的 VLA 与 world-action 模型：干净能力在 LIBERO 上平均只差 1.58 分，而 LIBERO-Plus 鲁棒性与 LIBERO-Para 指令改写跨度分别达 14.62 和 31.08 分。结论是范式对比应看鲁棒性与语言敏感度而非干净分数，并且只有 protocol-faithful 条目才支持严格比较。
Motivation: VLA 与 WAM 面向同一批操作任务却各用各的评测协议，能力、鲁棒性、语言敏感度与部署成本的取舍无法横向比较。
Method: 提出 evidence-aware 的统一报告 schema，分四轴评测 6 个系统：LIBERO 测干净能力、LIBERO-Plus 测非语言鲁棒性、LIBERO-Para 测指令敏感度、另记实测执行开销；每个分数聚合固定 checkpoint 与推理配置下 3 个随机种子的完整评测，并给每个系统标注 protocol-faithful、near-reproduction 或 pending-verification 证据等级。
Result: 6 个系统 LIBERO 干净分平均仅差 1.58 分，鲁棒性与改写摘要跨度分别为 14.62 和 31.08 分；限定到 3 个 protocol-faithful 系统后仍为 1.36、14.62、23.10 分。另报告推理延迟、峰值内存、运行时模式与逐系统证据状态。
Conclusion: 干净能力分数掩盖了范式间真正的差异，诊断性分离来自鲁棒性与语言敏感度轴；只有 protocol-faithful 条目可用于严格对比，作者不主张任一范式普遍更优。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HABILIS Brain 0: Geometry-Change Supervision for Vision-Language-Action and Residual Flow Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action policies benefit from geometric supervision, but current-frame geometry alone does not explicitly describe the changes associated with manipulation. This design is motivated by the goal of learning an embodiment-agnostic visual interface that can be pretrained across robot and egocentric video before robot-specific action alignment. We introduce Geometry-Change VLA (GC-VLA), which learns to predict multiview future-current geometry-change tokens from current observations. Offline frame pairs define a nominal 0.5-second prediction horizon; future observations are used only to construct training targets. Stage 1 trains a geometry-change vision-language model (GC-VLM). Stage 2 introduces a continuous ActionExpert and aligns it with robot actions while stopping action-flow gradients at the VLM interface. Stage 3 enables these gradients to update the trainable VLM components jointly with the ActionExpert. Stage 4 freezes GC-VLA and applies Geometry-Conditioned Residual Flow (GCRF), using a binary intervention router and a single bounded residual velocity policy learned from closed-loop feedback. GC-VLA achieves 95.20% success on LIBERO, and GC-VLA with GCRF achieves 99.55%. Inference uses current observations and the learned GC representation without executing the offline target encoders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GC-VLA：让视觉-语言-动作策略预测多视角「未来减当前」的几何变化 token，而非只看当前帧几何，四阶段训练后在 LIBERO 上达到 95.20% 成功率，再叠加几何条件残余流 (GCRF) 的二值干预路由与单个有界残余速度策略，把成功率推到 99.55%。
Motivation: 当前帧几何监督无法显式描述操作过程中的变化，且缺少一种可跨机器人与第一人称视频预训练、再对齐机器人动作的具身无关视觉接口。
Method: 离线帧对定义 0.5 秒预测时域，未来观测仅用于构造训练目标。Stage 1 训练几何变化视觉-语言模型 (GC-VLM)；Stage 2 接入连续 ActionExpert 并对齐机器人动作，在 VLM 接口处停止 action-flow 梯度；Stage 3 放开梯度让 VLM 可训练部分与 ActionExpert 联合更新；Stage 4 冻结 GC-VLA，用 GCRF 的二值干预路由器和闭环反馈学到的单个有界残余速度策略做修正。推理只用当前观测与学到的 GC 表征，不执行离线目标编码器。
Result: LIBERO 上 GC-VLA 成功率 95.20%，GC-VLA + GCRF 达 99.55%；预测时域为离线帧对定义的 0.5 秒。
Conclusion: 把监督对象从当前帧几何换成几何变化，再用闭环残余流修正，可在 LIBERO 上把操作成功率从 95.20% 提到 99.55%，且推理阶段无需离线目标编码器。

papers.title: Weakly Supervised Quantum Error Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Supervised approaches to quantum error mitigation learn a map from noisy circuit outputs to ideal ones, and therefore require the ideal outputs. Producing those ideal outputs demands noiseless classical simulation, whose cost grows exponentially with system size, so supervision is unavailable in exactly the regime where mitigation matters most. We ask whether cheap, individually unreliable signals drawn from circuit structure and hardware calibration can take the place of ideal labels. We assemble sixteen heuristic labeling functions (stabilizer and parity constraints, relaxation and readout characteristics, local depth, gate counts, and neighboring activity), reconcile their disagreements with a probabilistic label model, and read the resulting per-qubit error probabilities as a readout channel whose inverse mitigates the measured distribution. No ideal output enters the training path. On $147{,}000$ five-qubit circuits executed on two IBM devices, the method removes $24.3\%$ (Algiers) and $28.8\%$ (Hanoi) of the Kullback-Leibler divergence to the ideal distribution, against $15.4\%$ and $21.5\%$ for the strongest published analytical baseline, a margin that holds on both devices and lies far outside its bootstrap interval. Supervised neural models trained on ideal distributions remain stronger where such labels exist, and we quantify that gap rather than setting it aside; the method's claim is to the regime where they do not, since the labels they require cannot be computed for the circuits mitigation is needed for. The codes will be released shortly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出弱监督量子误差缓解方法：用十六个启发式标注函数加概率标签模型，从电路结构与硬件标定信号中直接学出每比特错误概率并作为读出信道求逆，训练全程不需理想输出。在两台 IBM 设备共 147,000 个五比特电路上，KL 散度削减 24.3%（Algiers）与 28.8%（Hanoi），高于最强解析基线的 15.4% 与 21.5%。
Motivation: 监督式量子误差缓解需要无噪声经典模拟给出理想输出，其代价随系统规模指数增长，恰好在缓解最需要的大规模区间无法提供标签。
Method: 组装十六个启发式标注函数（stabilizer 与 parity 约束、弛豫与读出特性、局域深度、门计数、邻近活动），用概率标签模型 (label model) 调和分歧，把得到的每比特错误概率当作读出信道并取其逆来校正测量分布；训练路径不引入任何理想输出。
Result: 在两台 IBM 设备（Algiers、Hanoi）上执行的 147,000 个五比特电路中，该方法分别削减到理想分布的 Kullback-Leibler 散度的 24.3% 与 28.8%，最强已发表解析基线为 15.4% 与 21.5%，差距在两台设备上均成立且远超其 bootstrap 区间。
Conclusion: 在拿不到理想标签的大规模电路上，弱监督信号足以替代理想输出做误差缓解；在标签可得处，有监督神经模型仍更强，作者主张的适用区间正是标签无法计算的那部分。

papers.title: Synthesis and editing of multi-instrument audio mixtures using scalar-quantised latents with MIDI Span conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Music creation often involves iterative refinement, changing selected musical details while retaining the rest. To support such refinement, we introduce SpanSynth-Edit, a flow-matching model for MIDI-guided synthesis and editing of multi-instrument audio mixtures using low-frame-rate scalar-quantised latents. MIDI Span encodes instrument-labelled note lifecycles as unordered event sets with continuous-valued attributes and pools each set into one conditioning vector per audio-latent frame. The model uses contextual audio for instrument-specific timbre guidance and supports editing by resynthesising the target region from revised MIDI. Experiments on single- and multi-instrument benchmarks show competitive performance and demonstrate within-frame onset control. We also discuss limitations of transcription-based note-adherence evaluation.
papers.comment: 13 pages including appendices, 2 figures. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SpanSynth-Edit：基于流匹配 (flow matching) 的 MIDI 引导多乐器混合音频合成与编辑模型，用低帧率标量量化 (scalar-quantised) latent 表示音频，把带乐器标签的音符生命周期 (MIDI Span) 池化成逐 latent 帧的条件向量，并通过改写目标区域 MIDI 后重合成实现局部编辑。单乐器与多乐器基准实验显示性能具竞争力，并展示了帧内起音 (within-frame onset) 控制能力。
Motivation: 音乐创作需要迭代式局部修改：只改选定细节而保留其余内容，而现有合成/编辑流程难以在保持上下文音色的同时对指定区域做条件化改写。
Method: SpanSynth-Edit 用流匹配模型在低帧率标量量化 latent 上做合成；MIDI Span 编码器把带乐器标签的音符生命周期表示为无序事件集（含连续值属性），每个事件集池化为每个音频 latent 帧一个条件向量；利用上下文音频提供乐器级音色引导，并通过从改写后的 MIDI 重合成目标区域来实现编辑。
Result: 在单乐器与多乐器基准上实验显示性能具竞争力，并演示了 within-frame onset 控制；作者同时讨论了基于转谱的音符遵循度 (note-adherence) 评估的局限。
Conclusion: 以 MIDI Span 作条件、在标量量化 latent 上做流匹配，可支持保留上下文音色的多乐器音频合成与局部编辑，并具备帧内起音控制；但基于转谱的音符遵循度评估本身存在局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DefaultGNN: A Dual-Perspective GNN Framework for Predicting Corporate Default from Buyer-Seller Transaction Networks
papers.abstract_en: Corporate default prediction is a core problem in financial risk management, yet traditional credit models rely heavily on financial statements that are often sparse or unavailable for many firms. Corporate transaction networks offer a complementary view of real economic activity, but how risk propagates through buyer-seller relationships remains underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study using real-world electronic tax-invoice data spanning six years that links transaction histories with default events, revealing that transaction-driven risk is both role-dependent (buyer or seller) and scale-dependent. Based on these findings, we construct multiplex buyer-view and seller-view transaction networks and propose DefaultGNN, a dual-perspective graph neural network-based framework for corporate default prediction. DefaultGNN integrates both views to model how risk flows through transactional relationships, achieving strong improvements over both attribute-based and graph-based baselines, especially for firms with limited intrinsic risk signals. We further provide interpretable network-based explanations by visualizing how distressed trading partners contribute to default risk. In collaboration with a licensed credit rating agency, we validate that DefaultGNN's predictions complement existing credit scoring models, improving approval rates by 7-11%p without increasing default risk among approved firms. The source code can be found at https://github.com/jhkim611/DefaultGNN
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DefaultGNN 用买家视角与卖家视角的双层 (multiplex) 交易网络做企业违约预测，把买卖双方的风险传播分开建模再融合。在六年电子税票数据上，其预测相对属性基线与图基线均有明显提升，对内在风险信号稀少的企业改善最大；与持牌评级机构合作验证，可在不增加已批准企业违约风险的前提下把审批率提高 7–11 个百分点。
Motivation: 传统信贷模型依赖稀疏或不可得的财务报表，而买卖关系中的风险传播机制研究不足，难以刻画买方与卖方角色差异带来的违约风险。
Method: 先用六年真实电子税票数据做大规模实证，识别风险传播的角色依赖与规模依赖；据此构建 buyer-view 与 seller-view 多层交易网络，提出基于 GNN 的 DefaultGNN 框架，双视角融合建模交易关系中的风险流动，并输出可视化网络解释。
Result: 在属性基线与图基线之上取得显著改进，对内在风险信号有限的企业改善尤其明显；与持牌信用评级机构合作验证，审批率提升 7–11 个百分点 (p)，且已批准企业的违约风险未上升。
Conclusion: 交易网络的双视角结构能补足财务报表缺失的企业风险信号，可作为现有信用评分模型的补充而非替代。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A JEPA Recipe for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models learn to predict cell values in context, whereas world-model self-supervision asks for prediction in representation space (LeCun, 2022; Assran et al., 2023). On a tabular foundation-model prior, the latent term of a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) collapsed in our earlier runs and took the encoder with it to a constant map. We report a recipe under which the latent term survives to convergence beside the value objective: the value head reads the encoder field rather than the predictor, and the target is an exponential moving average (EMA) difference. To bound its cost against the value-only arm, both arms train until a plateau rule stops them, with no fixed step budget. A fixed horizon had confounded a slowdown with a ceiling, since the value-only arm was still improving well past the usual budget. At convergence, in one run per arm, the JEPA arm trails the value-only arm across 147 real datasets, 32:70 wins to losses on classification (29:63 with one entry per dataset name) and 8:24 on regression, the margin small on classification and wider on regression, and the count leans the same way in each stratum and each benchmark. The JEPA arm (jepa) needs 1.42 times as many steps as the value-only arm (ds), and 1.66 times its wall-clock, to reach its plateau.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在表格基础模型 (tabular foundation model) 上加入 JEPA 潜变量项会遭遇表征坍缩，本文给出使其收敛存活的配方：value head 直接读 encoder 而非 predictor，目标用 EMA 差分。按 plateau 规则训练至收敛后，JEPA 臂在 147 个真实数据集上仍落后 value-only 臂（分类 32:70 胜负、按数据集名去重后 29:63，回归 8:24），且需 1.42 倍步数、1.66 倍墙钟时间才达 plateau。
Motivation: 此前运行中 JEPA 的 latent 项在表格基础模型先验上坍缩并把 encoder 拖成常数映射；且固定步数预算会把训练变慢误判为性能天花板，因为 value-only 臂在常规预算之后仍在提升。
Method: 配方含两处改动：value head 读 encoder field 而非 predictor 输出，latent 目标取指数滑动平均 (EMA) 差分；两臂均按 plateau 停止规则训练而非固定步数预算，以公平比较收敛点成本，每臂各跑一次。
Result: 收敛时 JEPA 臂在 147 个真实数据集上落后 value-only 臂：分类 32:70 胜负（按数据集名每名一条为 29:63），回归 8:24，分类差距小、回归差距更大，且各分层与各 benchmark 计数方向一致；JEPA 臂需 1.42 倍步数、1.66 倍墙钟时间达到 plateau。
Conclusion: latent 项可以靠「head 读 encoder + EEMA 差分目标」在收敛前存活，但在该配方下 JEPA 训练目标在表格数据上仍以更慢、更差的收敛表现落后于纯 value 预测。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.motivation: 此前运行中 JEPA 的 latent 项在表格基础模型先验上坍缩并把 encoder 拖成常数映射；且固定步数预算会把训练变慢误判为性能天花板，因为 value-only 臂在常规预算之后仍在提升。
summary_sections.method: 配方含两处改动：value head 读 encoder field 而非 predictor 输出，latent 目标取指数滑动平均 (EMA) 差分；两臂均按 plateau 停止规则训练而非固定步数预算，以公平比较收敛点成本，每臂各跑一次。
summary_sections.result: 收敛时 JEPA 臂在 147 个真实数据集上落后 value-only 臂：分类 32:70 胜负（按数据集名每名一条为 29:63），回归 8:24，分类差距小、回归差距更大，且各分层与各 benchmark 计数方向一致；JEPA 臂需 1.42 倍步数、1.66 倍墙钟时间达到 plateau。
summary_sections.conclusion: latent 项可以靠「head 读 encoder + EEMA 差分目标」在收敛前存活，但在该配方下 JEPA 训练目标在表格数据上仍以更慢、更差的收敛表现落后于纯 value 预测。

papers.title: Point Diffusion Mamba: Unified Diffusion-State-Space Modeling for Single-View 3D Reconstruction under Data Scarcity
papers.abstract_en: While single-view 3D reconstruction has seen significant progress, extrapolating complex 3D structures from inherently ambiguous 2D observations remains fundamentally ill-posed, particularly in the critically underexplored data-scarce regime. To address this challenge, we propose Point Diffusion Mamba (PDM), a method that integrates the generative power of diffusion models with the efficiency of state-space model for single-view 3D reconstruction under data-scarce conditions. Specifically, PDM employs a lightweight reconstruction module tailored to handle unordered point-cloud inputs effectively. By combining a Local Geometric Aggregation module with Mamba blocks, our approach jointly models global geometric structures and local details. In 3D reconstruction, each point in the initial noisy input requires a precise prediction, yet the high-level features extracted by the Mamba module capture only abstract semantic information from sparse points. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Hierarchical Feature Integration Network, which fuses high-level semantic and local geometric features for each point, overcoming the limitations of token-based point-cloud reconstruction. Furthermore, we propose a Dynamic Weighted Sampling strategy that adaptively unifies 3D generation with single-view reconstruction by leveraging generative priors to enhance reconstruction quality. Experimental results on the ShapeNet and Pix3D benchmarks demonstrate that PDM outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing an effective solution for 3D reconstruction under data-scarce settings. Code is available at: https://github.com/NWUzhouwei/PDM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Point Diffusion Mamba (PDM)，把扩散模型的生成能力与 Mamba 状态空间块结合，用于数据稀缺条件下的单视图 3D 重建。局部几何聚合模块 (Local Geometric Aggregation) 联合建模全局结构与局部细节，层级特征融合网络 (Hierarchical Feature Integration Network) 为每个点融合高层语义与局部几何特征，动态加权采样 (Dynamic Weighted Sampling) 用生成先验提升重建质量。在 ShapeNet 与 Pix3D 上超过现有最优方法。
Motivation: 单视图 3D 重建本身是不适定问题，从有歧义的 2D 观测外推复杂 3D 结构在数据稀缺设定下尤其困难，而这一设定长期缺乏研究。
Method: PDM 用轻量重建模块处理无序点云输入：Local Geometric Aggregation 模块配合 Mamba block 同时建模全局几何与局部细节；Hierarchical Feature Integration Network 把 Mamba 提取的抽象语义特征与逐点局部几何特征融合，绕开 token 化点云重建的逐点精度不足；Dynamic Weighted Sampling 自适应地把 3D 生成与单视图重建统一起来，借生成先验增强重建。
Result: 在 ShapeNet 与 Pix3D 两个基准上，PDM 的实验结果超过 state-of-the-art 方法，验证其在数据稀缺设定下的重建质量。
Conclusion: 扩散与状态空间模型的组合可为数据稀缺的单视图 3D 重建提供有效方案，逐点特征融合与生成先验采样是其关键设计。

papers.title: Compressing Long Context into Answer-Aligned Memory Embeddings for LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) inference is constrained by the quadratic scaling of self-attention and the linear scaling of the KV cache, increasing latency, energy consumption, and GPU memory demand as context length scales. Existing soft-compression methods either lack query-guided memory selection at inference time, train without answer-targeted supervision, or couple compression tightly to a specific decoder architecture. We propose a Context-to-Answer-Aligned Memory Compression (CMC) framework, which compresses long input contexts into compact Context Memory Embeddings (CMEs) aligned to any frozen decoder's embedding space, reducing inference costs without modifying decoder weights. CMC introduces a two-tier KV cache that combines question-guided CME selection with a local context window, and trains the compressor with answer-targeted distillation from a frozen LLM. Experiments across nine encoder-decoder combinations and four QA benchmarks show that CMC consistently outperforms the baseline, achieving up to 7.3 EM and 4.0 F1 point gains on SQuAD, while reducing inference time and energy consumption by up to 20% and peak reserved GPU memory by up to 50% at 3,000 generation tokens. Ablation studies confirm that each architectural component and training objective contributes to the performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CMC 框架，把长上下文压缩成与任意冻结 decoder 嵌入空间对齐的 Context Memory Embeddings (CMEs)，配合问题引导的两级 KV cache 选择与局部上下文窗口，不改 decoder 权重。在九组 encoder-decoder 组合与四个 QA 基准上，SQuAD 最多提升 7.3 EM 与 4.0 F1，3000 生成 token 下推理时间与能耗最多降 20%、峰值 GPU 显存最多降 50%。
Motivation: 自注意力的二次复杂度与 KV cache 的线性增长使长上下文推理的延迟、能耗和显存随长度膨胀；已有软压缩方法要么推理时缺少 query 引导的记忆选择，要么训练没有面向答案的监督，要么与特定 decoder 架构强耦合。
Method: CMC 将长上下文压成对齐冻结 decoder 嵌入空间的 CMEs，采用问题引导 CME 选择加局部上下文窗口的两级 KV cache，并用来自冻结 LLM 的 answer-targeted distillation 训练压缩器，全程不修改 decoder 权重。
Result: 在九组 encoder-decoder 组合与四个 QA 基准上一致超过基线：SQuAD 上最多 7.3 EM 与 4.0 F1 提升；在 3,000 生成 token 下推理时间与能耗最多降低 20%，峰值保留 GPU 显存最多降低 50%。消融显示各架构组件与训练目标均有贡献。
Conclusion: 把长上下文压成答案对齐的记忆嵌入并配合两级 KV cache，可以在不改 decoder 的前提下同时提高 QA 准确率并压低推理时间、能耗与显存。

papers.title: Hydrological Constraints on Temperature Sensitivities of Precipitation Frequency and Intensity
papers.abstract_en: To improve understanding of how precipitation frequency and intensity change with warming, we combine the coupled land--atmosphere water balance with a stochastic hydrological model that retains explicit dependence on precipitation frequency and event depth. We find a linear relationship between co-variations of rainfall frequency and intensity, where the slope is a hydrological sensitivity determined by the dryness and storage indices and the intercept is a forcing term associated with changes in moisture convergence, potential evapotranspiration, and effective water-storage capacity. While a given relative change in either rainfall frequency or intensity produces an identical relative change in the mean rate, rainfall intensity additionally influences the runoff coefficient by altering terrestrial water storage relative to rainfall depth. This means frequency and intensity have different impacts on the water cycle, allowing the frequency--intensity slope to depart from -1. Analysis of long-term MOPEX records shows that the forcing term is dominated by moisture convergence and that the frequency--intensity relation becomes steeper from wet to dry regimes, consistent with the slope predicted by the theory. The framework provides a physical interpretation of the observed negative covariation between precipitation frequency and intensity and clarifies the roles of hydrological partitioning and atmospheric moisture supply in their responses to warming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把陆气水量平衡与保留降水频次和事件雨量显式依赖的随机水文模型耦合，推出降水频次与强度共变呈线性关系：斜率由干旱度指数和蓄水指数决定的水文敏感度给出，截距由水汽辐合、潜在蒸散和有效蓄水能力的变化决定。频次与强度同等相对变化对平均降水率的作用相同，但强度还会通过改变土壤蓄水相对雨深来改变径流系数，因此斜率可偏离 -1；MOPEX 长期记录显示截距项由水汽辐合主导，且频次—强度关系从湿到干区变陡，与理论预测的斜率一致。
Motivation: 变暖下降水频次与强度如何共同变化缺少统一的物理框架，观测到的负协变也未被清楚归因到水文分配与大气水汽供应各自的贡献。
Method: 耦合陆气水量平衡与保留降水频次、事件雨深显式依赖的随机水文模型，线性关系的斜率用干旱度指数与蓄水指数表征为水文敏感度，截距作为水汽辐合、潜在蒸散与有效蓄水能力变化的强迫项；再用 MOPEX 长期记录检验。
Result: 频次与强度的共变呈线性，斜率为水文敏感度、截距为强迫项；同等相对变化的频次或强度对平均降水率产生相同的相对变化，但强度额外通过蓄水相对雨深影响径流系数，使频次—强度斜率偏离 -1。MOPEX 长期记录显示强迫项由水汽辐合主导，频次—强度关系从湿区到干区变陡，与理论预测斜率一致。
Conclusion: 降水频次与强度的负协变可由水文分配与大气水汽供应共同解释，且两者对水文循环的影响不同：频次—强度斜率随干湿状况系统变化。

papers.title: Matryoshka attribution: Learning to attribute language model outputs to representations and weights
papers.abstract_en: Attributing language model outputs to their internal computations is an open problem in interpretability. Existing methods, which use causal interventions, gradients, or learnable masks, either are infeasibly expensive or struggle to identify actual causally-important internal computations. We propose framing attribution as the problem of identifying nested subsets of internal components which minimise a downstream loss. To learn this task, we introduce Matryoshka Attribution (MAttr), a mask learning method that parametrises the mask with a simple differentiable sigmoid top-$k$ operator. We supervise training over all sparsities simultaneously by randomising $k$ over training, resulting in a learned ordering of components by attribution score. MAttr achieves number 1 on the official leaderboard of the Mechanistic Interpretability Benchmark (Mueller et al., 2025); our method identifies sparse and task-transferrable circuits across varying circuit bases. As a practical application, we show that MAttr can be trained with reinforcement learning to identify weight changes responsible for downstream behaviours in LLM finetuning. We train MAttr on refusal judge scores and find that restoring $1\%$ of Llama 3.1 8B Instruct's weights to their base model state is sufficient to remove refusals while maintaining capabilities. We view MAttr as a successful formulation of interpretability into a learnable objective that we can tackle with gradient descent, and encourage future work along these lines.
papers.comment: 10 pages main text, 58 pages total; preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把可解释性归因重构为「找一组嵌套的内部组件子集使下游损失最小」，提出 Matryoshka Attribution (MAttr)：用可微 sigmoid top-k 算子参数化掩码，并在训练中随机化 k 以同时监督所有稀疏度，得到按归因分数排序的组件序列。MAttr 在 Mechanistic Interpretability Benchmark 官方榜单上排名第一；用 RL 训练后，把 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 的 1% 权重恢复到 base 模型状态即可消除拒答并保留原有能力。
Motivation: 语言模型输出对其内部计算的归因是可解释性领域的开放问题：现有基于因果干预、梯度或可学习掩码的方法要么代价高到不可行，要么难以定位真正因果重要的内部计算。
Method: MAttr 将归因表述为识别使下游损失最小的嵌套组件子集，用可微的 sigmoid top-k 算子参数化掩码；训练时随机化 k，从而在所有稀疏度上同时监督，学出按归因分数排列的组件顺序。作者还把 MAttr 用强化学习训练，用于定位 LLM 微调中导致下游行为变化的权重。
Result: MAttr 在 Mechanistic Interpretability Benchmark (Mueller et al., 2025) 官方榜单上排名第一，并识别出跨不同 circuit base 的稀疏且可迁移的电路。在 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 上以 refusal judge score 训练后，恢复 1% 权重到 base 模型状态即足以去除拒答，同时保持其他能力。
Conclusion: 可解释性可以被表述为一个可用梯度下降求解的可学习目标；按嵌套稀疏度联合监督的掩码学习既能定位因果电路，也能定位微调中负责具体行为的权重。
