papers.title: Real-World Perception for Autonomous Driving in Adverse Weather: Enhancing Standard Detectors via Foundation-Guided Auto-Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Standard deployment-ready object detectors for autonomous vehicles degrade in adverse weather and lighting conditions without being trained on extensive domain-specific data. While large-scale vision foundation models offer robust zero-shot generalization, their high computational cost makes them impractical for real-time deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose a foundation-guided auto-annotation pipeline that enhances standard detectors without architectural changes. We first benchmark three distinct models, YOLOv8, Co-DETR, and SAM3, on our custom real-world driving dataset spanning 25 unique operational scenarios across various route, weather, and lighting conditions. Based on our analysis, SAM3 demonstrates superior accuracy and resilience across all scenarios. Thus, we deploy it as an offline auto-annotator to generate pseudo-labels on the unannotated subset of our dataset. Fine-tuning the baseline YOLOv8 on these annotations yields a 16.04% higher overall mean Average Precision (mAP) and improves cross-environmental stability compared to the baseline model, highlighted by a 32.73% and 28.65% mAP increase in Residential Direct Sunlight and Highway Fog, respectively. These results demonstrate that standard detectors can achieve environmental resilience without the need for extensive manual annotation or architectural modifications.

papers.title: West-WRF AI 2-km: High-Resolution Prediction of Integrated Vapor Transport and Precipitation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a stretched-grid artificial intelligence (AI) weather forecasting model with 2-km resolution over the western United States and part of the Northeast Pacific and approximately 31-km resolution elsewhere globally. Forecasting over the western U.S. is challenging because complex topography and atmospheric rivers (ARs) strongly influence orographic precipitation. West-WRF AI 2-km builds on a global model pretrained with a 40-year European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts Reanalysis v5 (ERA5) dataset and is fine-tuned with the Center for Western Weather and Water Extremes (CW3E) 2-km regional reanalysis to produce autoregressive 6-hourly forecasts of precipitation and integrated vapor transport (IVT). Forecasts are evaluated over winters 2020-2023 using gridded precipitation observations, rain gauges, and AR Reconnaissance dropsondes and are benchmarked against coarser-resolution AI forecasts and regional and global numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems. West-WRF AI 2-km reproduces observed precipitation-intensity distributions, retains fine-scale spectral variability, and produces sharper narrow coastal precipitation bands and localized, terrain-sensitive extremes. Its broader-scale performance remains comparable to coarser-resolution configurations while preserving large-scale skill despite higher resolution. Dropsonde verification shows lower errors and improved categorical skill at the most extreme IVT threshold. Overall, West-WRF AI 2-km provides its greatest value for localized precipitation extremes and intense AR-related moisture transport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出拉伸网格 AI 天气预报模型 West-WRF AI 2-km：在美国西部及部分东北太平洋分辨率达 2 km，全球其他区域约 31 km，自回归 6 小时滚动预报降水与整层水汽输送 (IVT)。在 2020–2023 年冬季检验中，它复现观测降水强度分布、保留细尺度谱变异、给出更锐利的窄海岸雨带与地形敏感极值；探空 (dropsonde) 验证显示最强 IVT 阈值上误差更低、分类技巧更好，大尺度技巧与更粗分辨率配置相当。
Motivation: 美国西部复杂地形与大气河 (AR) 强烈调制地形降水，2 km 级局地极值预报对现有全球与区域模式都困难，需要在不牺牲大尺度技巧的前提下提高局部分辨率。
Method: 在以 40 年 ERA5 预训练的全球模型基础上，用 CW3E 2 km 区域再分析微调，采用拉伸网格实现美国西部 2 km、其余全球约 31 km；自回归 6 小时步长预报降水与 IVT。
Result: 在 2020–2023 年冬季，用格点降水观测、雨量站与 AR Reconnaissance 探空检验，并与更粗分辨率 AI 预报及区域/全球 NWP 对比：复现观测降水强度分布，保留细尺度谱变异，海岸雨带与局地地形极值更锐利；大尺度表现与粗分辨率配置相当；最强 IVT 阈值上探空验证误差更低、分类技巧提升。
Conclusion: 拉伸网格把高分辨率集中在西部复杂地形区可行，West-WRF AI 2-km 的最大价值在局地降水极值与强 AR 水汽输送预报，同时保住大尺度技巧。

papers.title: A Deployment Study of Identity-Gated Drone Gesture Control
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based gesture control accepts commands from any hand in the camera field of view, which is unsafe in shared indoor spaces. This paper presents IGate, an identity-gated control stack that includes gesture control and face tracking, in which commands are admitted only when an enrolled operator is verified. The system performs few-shot user enrolment from 20 initial face frames, without prior user-specific training: verification compares an embedding of the current face crop against the enrolled template by cosine similarity, while face tracking uses proportional correction. Gesture control is achieved by classifying extracted hand landmarks using an RBF-SVM trained on a custom dataset. Additionally, a hierarchical finite-state machine handles mode selection, default, and fallback behaviours. The approach is tested on a DJI Tello EDU, each component evaluated offline and in-flight across 270 trials (149 flown). Face verification yields a 0.32% offline equal error rate versus 19.3% in-flight. Under hover-locked conditions, the RBF-SVM gesture classifier outperforms the geometric rule (0.850 vs. 0.651 accuracy), with 82% of this gap stemming from the depth channel. All logs and reproduction scripts will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IGate 把人脸验证作为门控加到视觉手势控制上，只有已注册操作员的手势命令才被采纳，并用分层有限状态机处理模式选择与回退。在 DJI Tello EDU 上 270 次试验（149 次飞行）中，人脸验证离线等错误率 0.32%、实飞 19.3%；悬停锁定条件下 RBF-SVM 手势分类准确率 0.850，高于几何规则的 0.651，差距的 82% 来自深度通道。
Motivation: 共享室内空间里，视觉手势控制会接受视野中任何人的手发出的命令，缺少操作员身份约束，存在安全问题。
Method: IGate 控制栈由人脸跟踪与手势控制组成：20 帧人脸做 few-shot 注册、无需用户专属训练，验证用当前人脸裁剪嵌入与注册模板的余弦相似度，跟踪用比例校正；手势侧对手部关键点提取特征后用自建数据集训练的 RBF-SVM 分类；分层有限状态机负责模式选择、默认与回退行为。
Result: 在 DJI Tello EDU 上按组件离线与实飞评估，共 270 次试验（149 次飞行）。人脸验证等错误率离线 0.32%、实飞 19.3%；悬停锁定条件下 RBF-SVM 手势分类准确率 0.850，几何规则 0.651，差距中 82% 归因于深度通道。
Conclusion: 身份门控能让手势命令只来自已注册操作员，且带深度通道的 RBF-SVM 手势分类在悬停锁定条件下明显胜过几何规则；实飞人脸验证误差远高于离线。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Hill Sampling for Test-Time Scaling: A Simple and Better Alternative to Repeated Sampling, Evolution, and Training
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can improve solutions to verifiable scientific and algorithmic problems by spending additional computation at test time. Recent systems achieve strong results with increasingly elaborate evolutionary search harnesses or by updating model parameters during test-time training. We ask how much of this machinery is necessary. We introduce Hill Sampling, a simple procedure that repeatedly samples candidate program edits from a frozen LLM, retains the best program found so far, and conditions all subsequent samples on that program. We evaluate the method on circle packing, sums/differences of sets, and Erdos' minimum-overlap problem using three open-weight models. Hill Sampling sets a new state of the art on circle packing among published methods, improves over the AlphaEvolve reference on Erdos' minimum-overlap problem, and achieves strong results on sums and differences of finite sets. The circle-packing and Erdos results require only hours of wall-clock time on eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs. To our knowledge, we also conduct, the largest study, by parameter count, of evolution strategies (ES) applied directly to LLM weights at test time. Surprisingly, learning the weights is worse than setting the ES learning rate to zero: at zero learning rate, the method is still searching in weight space through fixed random perturbations. Those perturbations can help exploration, but randomness from token sampling is stronger still, and repeated sampling remains substantially weaker than Hill Sampling. These results suggest a simple test-time compute allocation strategy: repeatedly sample edits to the best verified solution found so far, before introducing additional complexity such as adding archives, diversity mechanisms, evolutionary scaffolds, or test-time parameter learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hill Sampling 用冻结 LLM 反复采样程序编辑、只保留当前最优程序并以它为条件继续采样，在 circle packing 上取得已发表方法的新 SOTA，且在 Erdos minimum-overlap 问题上超过 AlphaEvolve 参考结果。作者据此建议：先把测试时算力花在对最优已验证解的重复采样上，再考虑 archive、多样性机制、进化脚手架或测试时参数训练这类复杂度。
Motivation: 测试时提升可验证科学与算法问题的解质量，目前依赖日益复杂的进化搜索脚手架或测试时训练模型参数；作者要判断这些机制到底有多少是必需的。
Method: Hill Sampling：从冻结 LLM 反复采样候选程序编辑，保留迄今最优程序，并让后续所有采样以该程序为条件。评测用三个开源权重模型，在 circle packing、sums/differences of sets、Erdos minimum-overlap 问题上进行；另做直接作用于 LLM 权重的 evolution strategies (ES) 测试时研究，扫描 ES 学习率（含零学习率）。
Result: circle packing 上达到已发表方法的新 SOTA；Erdos minimum-overlap 上优于 AlphaEvolve 参考；sums and differences of finite sets 上结果强。circle packing 与 Erdos 结果只需 8 张 NVIDIA H100 数小时墙钟时间。按参数量计是最大的直接作用于 LLM 权重的 ES 研究：把 ES 学习率设为零反而更好——零学习率下仍在固定随机扰动的权重空间中搜索，token 采样带来的随机性比权重扰动探索更强，而单纯重复采样仍明显弱于 Hill Sampling。
Conclusion: 测试时算力的简单有效分配策略是反复采样当前最优已验证解的编辑，之后才引入 archive、多样性机制、进化脚手架或测试时参数学习；在该设置下学习权重不如把 ES 学习率设为零。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SMTB: Fast Structure-Mapping with Tight Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Structure-mapping forms analogies by aligning systems of relationally connected elements based on shared structure instead of surface features. We introduce a new structure-mapping algorithm: Structure-Mapping with Tight Bounds (SMTB) that is 5--15x faster than the structure-mapping engine (SME) and about 50\% better at finding mappings in large nested domains. SMTB is part of the broader Cognitive Rule Engine (CRE) project, a flexible multi-language-compatible framework with an accessible Python interface to state-of-the-art C++ implementations of core algorithms commonly used in cognitive systems such as pattern matching, planning, and structure-mapping. CRE and SMTB are designed to work with a wide range of representation choices. Unlike SME, which biases higher-order correspondences in tree-like predicate logic, SMTB maximizes relational connectivity without privileging higher-order relations. This allows SMTB to work just as well over arbitrary relational graphs as it does in tree-like domains of nested predicate logic. We discuss situations where privileging "higher-orderness" in structure-mapping can cause issues, and illustrate how SMTB avoids failure modes that SME would encounter in these situations. We also provide an evaluation comparing SMTB to SME v4 over 5845 domain pairs from the SME corpus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出结构映射算法 SMTB（Structure-Mapping with Tight Bounds），以紧致界搜索取代 SME 对高阶对应的树状偏置，改为最大化关系连通性，因此在任意关系图与嵌套谓词逻辑树上同样适用。比 SME 快 5–15 倍，在大型嵌套域中找映射约好 50%，并在 SME 语料 5845 个域对上与 SME v4 对比。
Motivation: SME 把高阶对应偏置在树状谓词逻辑里，在大型嵌套域和任意关系图上会遇到失败模式，且速度慢，限制了类比结构映射在认知系统中的规模。
Method: SMTB 属于 Cognitive Rule Engine (CRE) 框架，提供 Python 接口调用 C++ 核心实现；算法不特权化高阶关系，转而最大化关系连通性 (relational connectivity)，用紧致界 (tight bounds) 加速匹配，支持多种表示形式。
Result: 相对 SME 快 5–15 倍；在大型嵌套域中找映射约好 50%；在 SME 语料的 5845 个域对上与 SME v4 做了评测对比。
Conclusion: 放弃对高阶关系的偏置、改以关系连通性为目标，可在任意关系图上取得与树状域同等的映射质量并显著提速。

papers.title: FAST-ML: A Hybrid Physics-Machine Learning Framework for Tropical Cyclone Intensity Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Rapid intensification (RI) remains one of the most consequential and difficult aspects of tropical cyclone (TC) forecasting. Although full-physics numerical weather prediction models can represent the processes governing RI, resolving storm-environment interactions remains computationally expensive, while purely data-driven approaches often lack physical interpretability. We present FAST-ML, a hybrid framework that bridges data-driven efficiency with physical constraints. A physically informed dual-stream neural parameterization ingests 3D ERA5 fields to diagnose ventilation controls---environmental wind shear and mid-level entropy deficit. By optimizing these parameters end-to-end through a differentiable FAST intensity model, this architecture establishes a robust new paradigm for observation-driven parameter optimization, ensuring storm evolution remains strictly governed by thermodynamic principles. By better capturing the storm's continuous intensity evolution, FAST-ML improves upon its physical baseline, reducing ensemble CRPS across forecast lead times, with a reduction of approximately 31% at 60 h and nearly halving the RI false alarm ratio without sacrificing detection skill. In a 100-member ensemble configuration, FAST-ML produces intensity forecasts comparable to FNV3 for selected storms under the evaluated input configurations. Furthermore, zero-shot tests on selected Eastern Pacific storms provide encouraging evidence of cross-basin transferability. FAST-ML provides a modular intensity forecasting framework that can be coupled with externally supplied storm tracks and environmental fields. It demonstrates that observation-driven parameter learning within physically constrained dynamics simultaneously enhances accuracy, interpretability, and computational efficiency.

papers.title: Bayesian Belief Layer for Controllable Opinion Dynamics in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents in social simulation revise their opinions implicitly, in context: how open an agent is to persuasion can neither be specified nor verified, and collective outcomes inherit the model's training prior. We introduce Bayesian Chronicle Agents (BCA), a minimal belief layer separating what an agent believes from how it speaks. Each stance is a probability, updated by one Bayesian step per utterance heard. A single prior-strength parameter $κ$ encodes stubbornness, modeled after its role in Friedkin--Johnsen (FJ) opinion dynamics. We then sweep this parameter to yield three canonical regimes of opinion dynamics on demand (consensus, persistent disagreement, committed-minority influence), with persistent disagreement matching the FJ closed-form fixed points at $R^2\!=\!0.93$--$0.99$. We further show that prescribed $κ$ remains recoverable after the language round-trip, with perfect rank-order recovery across all four models. Explicit belief also makes simulation auditable: the layer surfaces systematic per-model stance biases that end-to-end simulation would silently absorb.
papers.comment: Accepted to The 2nd Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models (REALM) at EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Bayesian Chronicle Agents (BCA)，把 LLM agent 的立场写成显式概率，每听到一句话做一次 Bayesian 更新，用单一先验强度参数 κ（类比 Friedkin–Johnsen 模型的 stubbornness）控制说服开放度。扫描 κ 可按需产生共识、持久分歧、少数派影响三种典型意见动力学，其中持久分歧与 FJ 闭式不动点的 R² 达 0.93–0.99，且 κ 经语言往返后在四个模型上秩次完全恢复。
Motivation: LLM agent 在社会模拟中只在上下文里隐式改意见，说服开放度既无法指定也无法验证，集体结果直接继承模型训练先验。
Method: BCA 把 agent 的信念与表达分离：每个 stance 表示为概率，按每句输入话语做一步 Bayesian 更新；先验强度 κ 借鉴 Friedkin–Johnsen (FJ) 意见动力学建模 stubbornness，通过扫描 κ 生成三种动力学机制，并检查 κ 在语言生成与再读入的往返后是否仍可恢复。
Result: 持久分歧机制与 FJ 闭式不动点拟合 R² = 0.93–0.99；κ 在语言往返后保持可恢复，在全部四个模型上秩次完全恢复（perfect rank-order recovery）；显式信念层暴露出各模型系统性的 stance 偏差，这些偏差在端到端模拟中会被默默吸收。
Conclusion: 把信念显式化为带 κ 的 Bayesian 层，可按需复现 FJ 意见动力学的三种典型结果，同时让 LLM 社会模拟的说服度可指定、可验证、可审计。

papers.title: Joint Remaining Useful Life Prediction and Capacity Estimation of Lithium-Ion Batteries Using Partial-Charging Data
papers.abstract_en: Joint remaining useful life (RUL) prediction and capacity estimation require representations of both gradual degradation and recent battery behavior. This paper presents a cross-expert framework using partial-charging measurements without requiring measured historical full-cycle capacity as an input. The RUL Expert captures long-term degradation from nominal 10-min segments sampled across a 30-cycle history, while the Capacity Expert characterizes recent battery behavior from statistical descriptors of nominal 40-min segments over ten consecutive cycles. Their complementary representations are integrated through feature-wise linear modulation for joint RUL and capacity prediction. A key contribution is a three-stage training strategy that progressively controls frozen and trainable components: supervised representation pretraining, independent expert pretraining, and final fusion training with both experts frozen. This staged optimization preserves expert-specific degradation knowledge while improving the balance between the two prediction tasks, with RUL treated as the primary prognostic objective. On two public battery-aging datasets, the reference configuration achieves mean RUL root-mean-square errors of 143.69 and 161.10 cycles and capacity errors of 12.36 and 7.28 mAh, respectively. On Dataset I, cross-expert fusion reduces both mean errors relative to either standalone expert. The proposed framework achieves the lowest reported RUL RMSE among the compared methods on both datasets while maintaining competitive capacity-estimation accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出跨专家 (cross-expert) 框架，用部分充电段数据联合预测锂电池 RUL 与估计容量，无需实测历史全周期容量作为输入。RUL Expert 吃 30 个周期历史中每周期 10 分钟标称段，Capacity Expert 吃连续 10 个周期的 40 分钟标称段统计描述子，经 feature-wise linear modulation 融合。在两个公开电池老化数据集上参考配置的平均 RUL RMSE 为 143.69 与 161.10 个周期，容量误差 12.36 与 7.28 mAh，且在两个数据集上均为所比方法中最低的 RUL RMSE。
Motivation: 联合 RUL 预测与容量估计需要同时刻画长期渐进退化与近期电池行为，而现有做法往往依赖实测的历史全周期容量作为输入，这在实际中难以获得。
Method: 双专家架构：RUL Expert 从 30 个周期历史中采样标称 10 分钟充电段提取长期退化表征，Capacity Expert 用连续 10 个周期标称 40 分钟段的统计描述子刻画近期行为；两者经 feature-wise linear modulation 融合。三阶段训练策略依次为监督表征预训练、各专家独立预训练、冻结双专家后的融合训练，RUL 作为主要预测目标。
Result: 在两个公开电池老化数据集上，参考配置的平均 RUL RMSE 分别为 143.69 和 161.10 个周期，容量误差分别为 12.36 和 7.28 mAh。在 Dataset I 上，跨专家融合使两项平均误差都低于任一单独专家；整体上该框架在两个数据集上均取得所比方法中最低的 RUL RMSE，同时容量估计精度保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 冻结专家的三阶段融合训练能在不输入实测历史全周期容量的前提下，同时保住各专家的退化知识并改善 RUL 与容量两个任务的平衡，且以 RUL 为首要目标。

papers.title: ZYT-World: A Real-Time Controllable World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous-Driving Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Generative world models offer controllable and repeatable closed-loop simulation for end-to-end and vision-language-action driving policies, but production deployment exposes three unresolved requirements: faithfully reproducing a mixed fisheye-pinhole rig at native resolutions; reconciling causal, per-timestep interaction with long-horizon stability and low latency; and preserving scene identity when a location is revisited. We present ZYT-World, a single architecture that natively generates four fisheye views with field of view > 180° and three pinhole views. Projection-specific Plucker adapters encode camera geometry, ego-motion adaptive layer normalization provides global motion control, and a lightweight pixel-aligned layout conditions traffic participants and signals through instance-level boxes, headings and colors. Heterogeneous training combines full-rig geometric coverage with high-resolution detail. Teacher forcing, causal consistency distillation, self-rollout distribution matching distillation, and RigCritic transform a 40-step bidirectional teacher into a one-step, per-latent streaming generator, with RigCritic evaluating the seven-view rig jointly. A 19M-parameter variational autoencoder decoder (TinyVAE), W8A8 quantization, and our inference engine reduce decoding, backbone, and incremental-execution costs, respectively. Finally, cross-trajectory pairs derived from real captures train a plug-in implicit-memory module that preserves place-specific evidence. On the internal multi-view test set, the one-step model retains more than 90% of the teacher's PSNR and SSIM, while FID, FVD, and LPIPS stay within 11% of the teacher. Under the generator-only timing in Figure 2, it is 107.7 times faster than the 40-step bidirectional teacher. TinyVAE decodes 59.8 times faster than Wan. 30s rollouts and cross-trajectory revisits show the intended long-horizon and memory behavior.
papers.comment: v2: updated author list. Technical Report. Videos and additional results are available at zyt-aim.github.io/ZYT-World
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZYT-World 是面向闭环自动驾驶仿真的实时可控世界模型，单架构原生生成 4 路鱼眼（FOV>180°）+3 路针孔，用投影专属 Plücker adapter、ego-motion 自适应层归一化与像素对齐布局条件控制交通参与者。经蒸馏把 40 步双向教师压成一步流式生成器后，保留教师 90% 以上的 PSNR 与 SSIM，比教师快 107.7 倍。
Motivation: 端到端与 VLA 驱动策略的生产级仿真有三个未解需求：忠实复现鱼眼-针孔混合相机组的原生分辨率、在逐时刻因果交互下兼顾长时稳定与低延迟、以及重访地点时保持场景身份。
Method: 投影专属 Plücker adapter 编码相机几何，ego-motion adaptive layer normalization 提供全局运动控制，轻量像素对齐布局以实例级 box、朝向、颜色条件化交通参与者与信号；用 teacher forcing、causal consistency distillation、self-rollout distribution matching distillation 与 RigCritic（联合评估七路相机）把 40 步双向教师蒸成一步、逐 latent 的流式生成器；再以 19M 参数 TinyVAE 解码器、W8A8 量化与自研推理引擎降本，并用真实采集派生的跨轨迹样本对训练插件式隐式记忆模块。
Result: 在内部多视角测试集上，一步模型保留教师 90% 以上的 PSNR 与 SSIM，FID、FVD、LPIPS 与教师差距在 11% 以内；按 Figure 2 的仅生成器计时，比 40 步双向教师快 107.7 倍；TinyVAE 解码比 Wan 快 59.8 倍；30 秒 rollout 与跨轨迹重访展示了预期的长时程与记忆行为。
Conclusion: 单一架构可以把混合异构相机组的因果实时生成与长时稳定性、地点记忆同时做到，一步蒸馏在画质几乎不掉的前提下换来两个数量级的加速。

papers.title: Ranking Competing geologic interpretations via foundation-model-assisted generative hydrologic inversion
papers.abstract_en: High-consequence subsurface decisions often rely on sparse data that permit competing geological interpretations. Determining consistency of these interpretations with the available observations remains challenging. We present a workflow that addresses this challenge by translating competing geologic interpretations into alternative priors and ranking them according to their consistency with hydraulic-head observations. A key step in this workflow is exploiting the broad knowledge of image-generation foundation models to transform nuanced geologic interpretations into data ready for computer modeling. For each interpretation, a text-to-image foundation model generates an ensemble of geologic images, and a separately trained variational autoencoder learns an interpretation-specific latent representation. A supervised inverse network maps head observations into this latent space, and the frozen decoder reconstructs an image that is mapped to a log-conductivity field. Steady-state flow simulations predict heads, and the aggregate normalized head error determines the ranking. We evaluate the framework using a synthetic benchmark based on the Johansen Formation with three interpretations of decreasing consistency with the reference geology. Across 595 test cases, the Precise \& Accurate interpretation produces lower normalized errors than Accurate in 58.5\% of cases and Mismatched in 82.5\% of cases. Accurate outperforms Mismatched in 65.5\% of cases. We then compare spatial representations of two published conceptual models of the Culebra Dolomite Member at the Waste Isolation Pilot Plant. The revised representation yields an aggregate normalized error of 7.598, compared with 8.595 for the original, consistent with the documented conceptual-model revision. The framework enables quantitative comparison of competing geological interpretations using available hydraulic observations.

papers.title: Continuous Delayed-Memory Stochastic Gradient Descent and Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning from History of Astrophysical Time Series Studies
papers.abstract_en: Quasars are luminous objects in the universe that exhibit stochastic brightness variations encoding information about the supermassive black holes powering them, and modeling these variations from ground-based survey data time series, known as light curves, is a statistical challenge. This paper reviews how stochastic differential equations (SDEs) have been adapted with neural network parameterizations to overcome this challenge in history. We create the Continuous-Delayed-Memory Stochastic Gradient Descent which depend on the past state of the discrete iteration process. We performed the simulation on some 2-dimensional landscape and observed some wider-exploration and more precise convergent behavior compared to Vanilla SGD by adjusting hyperparameters. Besides, we proposed a reinforcement learning structure with continuous time policy gradients for exploratory policies without solving HJB PDE, and we show that its optimality conditions recover the Gibbs policy of previous works.
papers.comment: Keywords: Stochastic process, Stochastic gradient descent, Continuous-Delayed-Memory Stochastic Gradient Descent, Stochastic Delay Differential Equation, Reinforcement Learning, Adjoint method
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出依赖离散迭代历史状态的 Continuous-Delayed-Memory SGD，并配套一个连续时间策略梯度强化学习结构，无需解 HJB PDE 即可得到探索性策略，其最优性条件恢复既有工作的 Gibbs 策略。在若干二维景观模拟中，调节超参数后相比 Vanilla SGD 表现出更宽的探索与更精确的收敛。
Motivation: 类星体光变曲线等天体物理时间序列的随机亮度变化建模是统计难题，SDE 与神经网络参数化的结合需要优化与探索机制上的改进。
Method: 综述 SDE 结合神经网络参数化建模光变曲线的脉络；提出 Continuous-Delayed-Memory Stochastic Gradient Descent，其更新依赖离散迭代过程的历史状态（对应 Stochastic Delay Differential Equation）；并提出用伴随方法 (adjoint method) 实现的连续时间策略梯度强化学习结构，绕开 HJB PDE 求解。
Result: 在若干二维景观 (2-dimensional landscape) 模拟中，调节超参数后该延迟记忆 SGD 相比 Vanilla SGD 呈现更宽的探索 (wider-exploration) 与更精确的收敛行为；连续时间策略梯度的最优性条件被证明恢复先前工作的 Gibbs 策略。
Conclusion: 把历史状态引入 SGD 更新并用连续时间策略梯度替代 HJB 求解，可在随机优化与探索性强化学习中同时改善探索与收敛，且与既有 Gibbs 策略理论一致。

papers.title: DocAttriBench: Benchmarking Answer Grounding in Document Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Answer grounding in document visual question answering remains an open challenge: most benchmarks lack grounding annotations or provide limited-quality labels, while constructing grounded datasets still requires costly manual effort. We introduce DocAttriBench (DAB), a large-scale benchmark for fine-grained, element-level source attribution in Document VQA, grounding answers to specific layout elements such as text blocks, tables, and images. To build DAB, we propose a Mask-based Perplexity-Derived Attribution method (MAPPET) that combines document layout and language modeling to identify the most informative element for each answer. MAPPET measures the increase in perplexity after masking candidate elements and attributes the answer to the element contributing most to model confidence. Applying MAPPET to multiple existing Document VQA datasets yields DAB, with 237k documents and 296k question-answer pairs with element-level grounding. We benchmark grounding-capable multimodal LLMs on DAB, evaluating answer accuracy, attribution accuracy, and overall answer quality. Results show that while larger models generally achieve higher answer accuracy, even the strongest models often fail to localize the supporting elements. DAB provides a scalable benchmark for developing grounded, verifiable, and trustworthy Document VQA models. Dataset and code are available at https://aimagelab.github.io/DocAttriBench/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DocAttriBench (DAB) 是面向文档视觉问答 (Document VQA) 答案归因的大规模基准：用 Mask-based Perplexity-Derived Attribution (MAPPET) 对候选版面元素做掩码并测困惑度增量，自动把答案锚定到文本块、表格、图像等元素，产出 237k 文档、296k 问答对。在 DAB 上评测多模态大模型后发现，模型越大答案准确率通常越高，但即使最强模型也常常定位不到支撑元素。
Motivation: 现有 Document VQA 基准大多缺少归因标注或标签质量有限，而人工构建带归因的数据集成本高昂，答案可验证性无从评估。
Method: 提出 MAPPET：结合文档版面与语言模型，掩码每个候选元素后测量困惑度 (perplexity) 增量，把答案归因到对模型置信度贡献最大的元素；将该方法应用于多个已有 Document VQA 数据集生成 DAB，再在 DAB 上评测具备归因能力的多模态 LLM，指标为答案准确率、归因准确率与整体答案质量。
Result: DAB 含 237k 文档与 296k 问答对，均带元素级归因；评测显示更大的模型通常答案准确率更高，但即使最强模型也常常无法定位支撑元素。
Conclusion: 答案准确率与元素级归因能力并不随模型规模同步提升，DAB 提供了可扩展的评测基准，用于发展可归因、可验证、可信的 Document VQA 模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Functional Pilot for Certified Freshness-Aware Semantic--Spatial Range Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Geographic applications need every object inside a radius that satisfies a semantic threshold, yet embedding indexes return approximate top-ranked lists and may omit qualifying records silently. We present FRESH-GEORANGE, a semantic- spatial range design that separates source-watermark freshness from optional record age. Geographic cells and semantic mi- croblocks provide admissible pruning bounds; a graph proposes verification order but supplies no correctness evidence. Exact mode scans every nonprunable block and the delta overlay. Certified mode may stop early and reports a deterministic query- specific recall lower bound from verified answers and unresolved records. A reproducible CPU pilot uses 2,500 real OpenFlights airport records, a 2,000-record base, and 740 simulated insert, delete, and text-revision events; it evaluates 180 unique queries over five seeds. Exact mode achieved 100.00% set recall on every query. The 95-percent mode achieved 99.91% empirical mean recall with a 99.41% reported mean certificate and no observed bound violation. However, its 7.24 ms median latency was 5.85 times the 1.24 ms spatial-first exact baseline, and full-history delta replay became slower than rebuilding at larger batches. The prototype therefore validates the completeness mechanism, not performance superiority or production freshness. Submission- scale evaluation requires real map diffs, official recent baselines, and truly incremental versioned maintenance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FRESH-GEORANGE 把语义阈值与半径约束的地理范围检索做成可认证查询：地理 cell 与语义 microblock 提供可采纳剪枝界，Exact 模式扫完所有不可剪枝块与 delta overlay，Certified 模式可提前停止并给出确定性的查询级 recall 下界。在 2,500 条 OpenFlights 机场记录、740 次增删改事件、180 条查询与 5 个种子上，Exact 模式每条查询集合 recall 均为 100.00%，95-percent 模式经验平均 recall 99.91%、报告的证书均值 99.41% 且未观测到界被违反，但中位延迟 7.24 ms 是 spatial-first exact 基线 1.24 ms 的 5.85 倍。
Motivation: 嵌入索引只返回近似 top 列表，可能静默漏掉满足语义阈值的记录，地理应用需要半径内既满足语义阈值又可证明不漏的检索。
Method: FRESH-GEORANGE 分离 source-watermark 新鲜度与可选 record age；地理 cell 与语义 microblock 给出可采纳剪枝界，图只提议验证顺序而不提供正确性证据。Exact 模式扫描全部不可剪枝块与 delta overlay；Certified 模式可提前停止，从已验证答案与未决记录报告确定性的查询级 recall 下界。CPU pilot 用 2,500 条真实 OpenFlights 机场记录、2,000 条 base 记录与 740 次模拟插入/删除/文本修订事件，评测 180 条唯一查询、5 个种子。
Result: Exact 模式每条查询集合 recall 100.00%；95-percent 模式经验平均 recall 99.91%，报告的平均证书 99.41%，未观测到界违反。其 7.24 ms 中位延迟是 1.24 ms spatial-first exact 基线的 5.85 倍；更大批量下完整历史 delta replay 比重建更慢。
Conclusion: 原型验证的是完整性机制，而非性能优越性或生产级新鲜度；作者认为上线规模评估需要真实 map diffs、官方近期基线与真正增量的版本化维护。

papers.title: Efficient Nash Equilibrium Computation for Cybersecurity Games
papers.abstract_en: Game-theoretic analyses of cyber defence often compute equilibria of games whose payoffs exist only as the output of a simulator. Iterative equilibrium-finding methods grow a set of attacker and defender policies and need the payoff of every attacker--defender pair, so they are bottlenecked by payoff estimation: each payoff costs many simulator runs. We introduce Regret-Weighted Payoff Sampling (RWPS), which spends a fixed simulation budget on the payoffs the equilibrium actually depends on and predicts the rest with a model trained on every payoff measured so far. Standard error bounds for estimated games are driven by the worst-estimated payoff, so they cannot credit an estimator that is inaccurate only where accuracy does not matter. We prove a bound that weights payoff errors by the opponent's equilibrium strategy, a certificate that can be computed from simulated payoffs alone, and a condition under which errors in the predicted payoffs cannot change either player's regret. On three synthetic general-sum games, one of them a Colonel Blotto game of military resource allocation, the new bounds are four to six times tighter than the standard one, and RWPS finds less exploitable equilibria than minimum-regret-first search, information-gain search and progressive sampling at the same budget. On two cyber-defence simulators, CyGym and a new game whose hosts are LLM agents exposed to prompt injection, it gives the least exploitable equilibria at the smallest budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Regret-Weighted Payoff Sampling (RWPS)，把固定仿真预算集中到均衡真正依赖的攻击者-防守者收益上，其余收益用已测数据训练的模型预测，并证明按对手均衡策略加权收益误差的界。在三个合成一般和博弈（含 Colonel Blotto）上新界比标准界紧 4–6 倍，且在同等预算下比 minimum-regret-first、information-gain 与 progressive sampling 找到更不易被利用的均衡。
Motivation: 网络防御博弈的收益只能靠仿真器给出，迭代求均衡需要每个攻击者-防守者对的收益，代价被大量仿真运行卡死；而标准误差界由最差收益驱动，无法奖励只在无关紧要处不准的估计器。
Method: RWPS 按对手均衡策略加权分配仿真预算，用截至当前所有已测收益训练的模型预测其余收益；证明一个仅凭仿真收益即可计算的证书型误差界，以及预测误差不改变任一方 regret 的条件。
Result: 在三个合成一般和博弈（其一为 Colonel Blotto 军事资源分配）上，新界比标准界紧 4–6 倍；同等预算下 RWPS 比 minimum-regret-first search、information-gain search 和 progressive sampling 找到更不易被利用的均衡。在 CyGym 与一个主机为暴露于 prompt injection 的 LLM agent 的新博弈上，RWPS 在最小预算下给出最不易被利用的均衡。
Conclusion: 把仿真预算按均衡相关性加权、并用对手均衡策略加权误差，可以在收益只能靠仿真估计的博弈中更省地算出更可信的均衡。

summary_sections.motivation: 网络防御博弈的收益只能靠仿真器给出，迭代求均衡需要每个攻击者-防守者对的收益，代价被大量仿真运行卡死；而标准误差界由最差收益驱动，无法奖励只在无关紧要处不准的估计器。
summary_sections.method: RWPS 按对手均衡策略加权分配仿真预算，用截至当前所有已测收益训练的模型预测其余收益；证明一个仅凭仿真收益即可计算的证书型误差界，以及预测误差不改变任一方 regret 的条件。
summary_sections.result: 在三个合成一般和博弈（其一为 Colonel Blotto 军事资源分配）上，新界比标准界紧 4–6 倍；同等预算下 RWPS 比 minimum-regret-first search、information-gain search 和 progressive sampling 找到更不易被利用的均衡。在 CyGym 与一个主机为暴露于 prompt injection 的 LLM agent 的新博弈上，RWPS 在最小预算下给出最不易被利用的均衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把仿真预算按均衡相关性加权、并用对手均衡策略加权误差，可以在收益只能靠仿真估计的博弈中更省地算出更可信的均衡。

papers.title: Potential of Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for Identification of Relevant Diagnostic and Prognostic Biomarkers of Early-Stage Liver Cancer
papers.abstract_en: This study explores the use of deep learning and explainable artificial intelligence to diagnose hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and define effective biomarkers across five different stages of disease development using a transcriptomic biomarker HCC dataset constructed via semi-supervised learning from three source datasets. Several deep learning experiments were conducted with different feature extraction techniques and gene sets to identify the most effective features for training high-accuracy models with minimal loss. The best-performing model, using 15 selected genes with the SelectKBest algorithm, achieved 90.74% accuracy, while the model with the lowest recorded loss of 0.3187 was obtained using 20 selected genes. To address the issue of class imbalance in the dataset, a weighted training approach was conducted, and for model transparency and interpretability a SHAP-based XAI analysis provided insights into the model's decision-making, consistently finding DNAJB14 as the most influential gene. Functional validation in this study has provided compelling evidence that DNAJB14 plays an important role in the adverse properties of HCC and that its inhibition effectively reverses tumour cell migration, invasion, colony and sphere formation. The main limitation of this study is the dataset's class imbalance, and while weighted training helped mitigate this, further research and additional data are needed to guarantee model generalizability. Future studies should also explore the influence of genetic variations, environmental factors, and clinical differences on model performance across diverse populations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用深度学习与可解释 AI (XAI) 在五期肝细胞癌 (HCC) 转录组数据集上筛选诊断与预后标志基因：SelectKBest 选 15 个基因的模型准确率 90.74%，20 个基因的模型损失最低 0.3187，SHAP 一致指向 DNAJB14 为最关键基因，功能验证显示抑制 DNAJB14 可逆转肿瘤细胞迁移、侵袭、集落与球体形成。
Motivation: HCC 早期诊断与预后标志物的识别依赖人工候选基因，缺少跨疾病阶段、可解释且经功能验证的机器学习筛选流程。
Method: 先用半监督学习从三个源数据集构建覆盖五个疾病阶段的 HCC 转录组标志物数据集；运行多组深度学习实验，比较不同特征提取技术与基因集，用 SelectKBest 选基因，并以加权训练缓解类别不平衡，最后用 SHAP 做可解释性分析并做功能验证。
Result: 最佳模型用 15 个 SelectKBest 选中基因达到 90.74% 准确率；最低损失 0.3187 出现在 20 个基因的模型；SHAP 一致将 DNAJB14 判为最具影响力基因；功能验证显示抑制 DNAJB14 有效逆转肿瘤细胞迁移、侵袭、集落与球体形成。
Conclusion: DNAJB14 是 HCC 不良性质的关键驱动基因兼最有价值的模型标志物；作者指出主要局限是数据集类别不平衡，加权训练仅部分缓解，仍需更多数据保证泛化性。

papers.title: BVB: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding via Programmatic Reconstruction in Blender
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents can create complex videos in software such as Blender by coding without relying on diffusion models. Yet video understanding benchmarks still evaluate models mainly through question answering. If an agent truly understands a video, it can reconstruct it programmatically. We introduce BVB, Blender-VideoBench, a benchmark that tests this ability by asking agents to reconstruct real-world videos as animated Blender scenes. To ensure fair comparison, each agent programs the reconstruction through a lightweight harness, Mini-BVB, in an identical sandbox under a shared cost limit. The benchmark renders each reconstruction from its animated camera and evaluates it on two axes: (1) Dual VQA measures how many spatiotemporal facts the reconstruction preserves. (2) Latent Similarity measures how closely the reconstruction matches the source video perceptually. Our overall score, a square-root mean, favors balanced performance. We evaluate 51 configurations from 10 model families and analyze semantic retention, perceptual similarity, reasoning effort, and cost. The best model reaches 88.6 Latent Similarity but retains only 53.7% of the source-correct spatiotemporal answers. Additional reasoning improves visual similarity but does not close this gap in factual accuracy. In a blind study with 15 raters and five configurations, Latent Similarity correlates strongly with human preference. These results show that programmatic reconstruction is a viable test of agentic video understanding, and that semantic retention remains the main challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BVB (Blender-VideoBench) 把视频理解评测从问答换成程序化重建：让多模态 agent 用代码把真实视频复原成带动画相机的 Blender 场景，再渲染后按 Dual VQA（时空事实保留）与 Latent Similarity（感知相似）两轴打分，总分取平方根均值以奖励均衡。评测 10 个模型家族的 51 个配置后，最佳模型 Latent Similarity 达 88.6，却只保留 53.7% 的源正确时空答案；加强推理能提升视觉相似度，但补不上事实准确率的缺口。
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准主要靠问答评测，无法检验模型是否真的理解视频内容；作者提出以能否程序化重建视频作为更严格的理解测试。
Method: 引入 BVB，要求 agent 在统一沙箱、共享成本上限下通过轻量 harness Mini-BVB 编写代码，把真实视频重建为带动画相机的 Blender 场景；渲染重建结果后用 Dual VQA 度量保留的时空事实数、用 Latent Similarity 度量与源视频的感知接近度，总分为两者的平方根均值。
Result: 评测 10 个模型家族的 51 个配置，分析语义保留、感知相似、推理投入与成本：最佳模型 Latent Similarity 88.6，但仅保留 53.7% 的源正确时空答案；增加推理提升视觉相似度却不缩小事实准确率差距。15 名评审、5 个配置的盲测中，Latent Similarity 与人类偏好强相关。
Conclusion: 程序化重建可作为 agentic 视频理解的有效测试，而语义保留（事实准确率）是当前主要瓶颈。

papers.title: Planning in the Backbone: DiffAdapterVLA for Native Continuous Trajectory Generation with Driving VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained driving vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual, route, language, and driving context into rich driving priors, yet their representation objectives remain separated from continuous driving planning. Existing methods typically begin trajectory generation only after the VLM has formed a final condition, leaving depth-wise condition computation outside the stepwise formation of trajectory state. We introduce DiffAdapterVLA, which realizes Planning in the Backbone: it injects explicit trajectory tokens into selected VLM late layers, bringing trajectory state into backbone forward computation, where it co-evolves with driving conditions at different depths. Lightweight layer-wise DiffAdapters organize this computation into recursive trajectory refinement, while asymmetric joint attention preserves directed guidance from the condition stream to trajectory planning. By placing planning within existing backbone computation rather than relying on an independent trajectory planner, DiffAdapterVLA adapts only lightweight trajectory modules to turn existing driving priors into efficient continuous planning capability. NAVSIM results show that it achieves high-quality closed-loop planning with low end-to-end latency using few trainable parameters, and demonstrate that jointly evolving trajectory state and depth-wise driving conditions in VLM late-layer computation effectively realizes continuous trajectory planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiffAdapterVLA 把显式轨迹 token 注入驾驶 VLM 的选定后层，让轨迹状态与分层驾驶条件在同一 backbone 前向中共同演化，再由轻量 layer-wise DiffAdapter 组织成递归轨迹精修，非对称 joint attention 保持条件流对轨迹的定向引导。在 NAVSIM 上以少量可训练参数和低端到端延迟实现高质量闭环规划。
Motivation: 驾驶 VLM 的表征目标与连续轨迹规划脱节：现有方法要等 VLM 形成最终条件后才开始生成轨迹，深度方向的条件计算落在轨迹状态逐步形成过程之外。
Method: 在 VLM 后层注入显式轨迹 token，使轨迹状态进入 backbone 前向计算；轻量 layer-wise DiffAdapter 把该计算组织为递归轨迹精修，非对称 joint attention 保留条件流到轨迹规划的定向引导；只适配轻量轨迹模块，复用已有驾驶先验。
Result: NAVSIM 结果显示该方法以少量可训练参数实现高质量闭环规划与低端到端延迟，并表明在 VLM 后层计算中联合演化轨迹状态与分层驾驶条件能有效实现连续轨迹规划。
Conclusion: 把规划放进 backbone 内部而非外挂独立轨迹规划器，可以把现有驾驶先验转成高效的连续规划能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ChatGPT Images 2.5 in the Wild: A Launch-Period Dataset and Detector Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: An image tool can change its underlying generator while retaining its public name, making version attribution from online posts ambiguous. We study this problem after the ChatGPT Images 2.5 launch. Our frozen collection contains 3,478 images from 2,440 posts across 8 sources. Recorded posting times fall within the first 51.1 hours after the announcement. It records three attribution tiers and retains standalone images after image-form filtering and targeted review. Caption claims and host records provide admission evidence, not independently verified generator identity. The observed content profile depends on the source mixture: NightCafe supplies 39.0% of images but 77.0% of CLIP-assigned fantasy scenes. We then evaluate six frozen detectors at thresholds calibrated to a 5% flag rate on reference photographs. Collection flag rates range from 3.7 to 56.4%, falling 42-81 percentage points below GenImage recall. Held-out artwork false-positive rates range from 1.5 to 96.5%, so a higher collection flag rate does not by itself establish better detection. An exploratory X-only comparison with our April collection finds a higher September flag rate for Effort, and a suggestive difference for DoU, under fixed-threshold post-clustered bootstrap intervals. Attribution, content and processing differences prevent a causal interpretation of these contrasts. The collection supports analysis of reported model use during a product transition, with source and attribution evidence retained for interpretation. The collection is released at https://scam.ai/research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建 ChatGPT Images 2.5 发布后 51.1 小时内的冻结图像数据集（3,478 张图、2,440 帖、8 个来源），并评测六个冻结检测器。在按参考照片 5% 标记率校准的阈值下，各检测器在该数据集上的标记率为 3.7%–56.4%，比 GenImage recall 低 42–81 个百分点；而留出艺术品上的误报率高达 1.5%–96.5%，说明更高的标记率本身不能证明检测更好。
Motivation: 图像生成工具可在保留公开名称的同时更换底层生成器，导致线上帖子的版本归属不明确；发布期数据集与检测器评测需要保留来源与归属证据以支撑解释。
Method: 收集并冻结 8 个来源的 3,478 张图像（来自 2,440 帖），记录三个归属层级，经图像形态过滤与定向复核保留独立图像；以 caption 声明与宿主记录作为准入证据。评测六个冻结检测器，阈值在校准集上按 5% 标记率标定；另做仅 X 平台的探索性对比，用固定阈值、按帖聚类的 bootstrap 区间。
Result: 发布时间窗为公告后 51.1 小时；NightCafe 提供 39.0% 的图像但占 CLIP 判定奇幻场景的 77.0%。六个检测器在该数据集上的标记率为 3.7%–56.4%，比 GenImage recall 低 42–81 个百分点；留出艺术品误报率 1.5%–96.5%。与 4 月数据集的 X-only 对比中，Effort 检测器 9 月标记率更高，DoU 呈提示性差异。
Conclusion: 该数据集支持分析产品过渡期的报告性模型使用，但归属、内容与处理差异使 4 月与 9 月的对比无法作因果解释；检测器的高标记率不能单独作为检测能力更好的证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Disentangling Topology and Diversity in Multi-Agent LLMs for Multilingual Low-Resource Emotion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems combine multiple inference calls, but prior work often confounds how calls are connected with how they are diversified. We study these factors independently: inference topology and source of inter-agent diversity. In a controlled $2 \times 3$ matrix, we cross parallel aggregation and sequential refinement with stochastic sampling, role prompting, and learned QLoRA specialization, under a fixed three-call budget and output protocol within each backbone. Using Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we evaluate all six configurations on multilingual low-resource emotion detection across nine languages. Parallel learned specialization is strongest on Qwen at 52.83 Macro-F1 and reaches 52.94 on Llama. On Qwen it also exceeds same-backbone zero-shot, few-shot, CoT, and seven-call self-consistency baselines. The preferred topology depends on diversity source: sequential refinement helps stochastic and prompted settings, while the learned Width advantage shrinks from 2.83 points on Qwen to 0.17 on Llama. Depth-wise analysis suggests that later learned specialists can overwrite correct early predictions, although the aggregate effect is backbone-dependent. Overall, how agents are differentiated produces larger performance shifts than topology, which should be evaluated jointly with specialization.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定三次调用预算下解耦多智能体 LLM 的推理拓扑（并行聚合 vs 顺序精化）与智能体间多样性来源（随机采样、角色提示、QLoRA 学习专化），发现多样性来源带来的性能变化大于拓扑：并行 + 学习专化在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上 Macro-F1 达 52.83、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上 52.94，且在 Qwen 上超过同骨干 zero-shot、few-shot、CoT 与七次调用 self-consistency 基线。拓扑偏好取决于多样性来源：顺序精化利于随机与提示设定，而并行（Width）优势从 Qwen 的 2.83 点缩到 Llama 的 0.17 点。
Motivation: 既有多智能体 LLM 工作把「调用如何连接」（拓扑）与「调用如何差异化」（多样性来源）混在一起，无法判断性能提升究竟来自哪一项，也难以在低资源多语言情感检测这类任务上做可比设计。
Method: 构造受控 2×3 矩阵：拓扑取并行聚合与顺序精化，多样性来源取随机采样、角色提示、学习式 QLoRA specialization，每个骨干内固定三次调用预算与统一输出协议；骨干为 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，任务为九种语言的多语言低资源情感检测，并对比同骨干 zero-shot、few-shot、CoT 与七次调用 self-consistency 基线，另做 depth-wise 分析检查后续专化器对早期预测的覆盖。
Result: 六种配置在九语言情感检测上的最优为并行 + 学习专化：Qwen Macro-F1 52.83，Llama 52.94；该配置在 Qwen 上超过同骨干 zero-shot、few-shot、CoT 与七次调用 self-consistency 基线。并行（Width）相对优势在 Qwen 为 2.83 点、在 Llama 仅 0.17 点；顺序精化在随机采样与角色提示设定下更有利；depth-wise 显示后续学习专化器可能覆盖早期正确预测，但整体效应依骨干而异。
Conclusion: 作者主张：智能体如何被差异化（多样性来源）对性能的影响大于拓扑，因此评估多智能体系统时必须把拓扑与专化方式联合考察，而不能单独归因于连接结构。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Zero-Shot Cross-Material Ptychographic Phase Reconstruction Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Ptychographic phase reconstruction is commonly formulated as an iterative inverse problem, requiring repeated object-probe updates and resulting in substantial computational cost for large-scale 4D-STEM data. We present a direct local-to-global learning framework that reconstructs full-field phase maps from diffraction measurements without iterative refinement during inference. The proposed network predicts local wrapped-phase patches from individual diffraction patterns using a sine-cosine representation, and the predictions are assembled into a full-field reconstruction using calibrated scan positions and Gaussian-weighted stitching. To evaluate generalization beyond the training domain, the model is trained on one material and directly applied to another in a zero-shot setting without target-domain fine-tuning. Experiments on AuPd and MoS$_2$ demonstrate consistent cross-material transfer in both directions, with the proposed method achieving the best full-field MSE, PSNR, and MS-SSIM among the evaluated learning-based methods. Compared with the iterative ePIE approach, the proposed direct local-to-global pipeline reduces end-to-end reconstruction time by approximately 10x, demonstrating its potential for efficient and transferable ptychographic reconstruction.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the authors to resolve overlap with related collaborative work that had been submitted for publication prior to this preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出直接的 local-to-global 深度学习框架，从单个衍射图样预测局部缠绕相位（sine-cosine 表示），再用标定扫描位置与高斯加权拼接合成全场相位图，推理阶段无需迭代精修。在 AuPd 与 MoS2 上双向零样本跨材料迁移，取得所评估学习类方法中最好的全场 MSE、PSNR 与 MS-SSIM，端到端重建时间比迭代 ePIE 约快 10 倍。
Motivation: Ptychographic 相位重建通常写成迭代反问题，需要反复更新 object-probe，面对大规模 4D-STEM 数据计算代价高；同时学习类方法在跨材料泛化上缺少验证。
Method: 网络从单张衍射图样预测局部 wrapped-phase patch（sine-cosine 表示），用标定扫描位置与 Gaussian-weighted stitching 拼成全场相位；训练只用一种材料，推理时零样本直接迁移到另一种材料，不做目标域微调。
Result: 在 AuPd 与 MoS2 上双向跨材料迁移实验中，该方法在所评估的学习类方法里取得最好的全场 MSE、PSNR 与 MS-SSIM；相对迭代 ePIE，端到端重建时间约减少 10 倍。
Conclusion: 直接的 local-to-global 学习式 ptychographic 重建可在不迭代精修的情况下兼顾跨材料可迁移性与数量级的加速，作者已因与先前投稿的协作工作重叠而撤回该预印本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automated Distinction of Intimal and Medial Intracranial Arterial Calcification from CT Head
papers.abstract_en: Intracranial arterial calcifications (IACs) are a common finding on clinical non-contrast enhanced head CT scans and are associated with neurovascular disease. Calcifications can occur in the intimal or medial layer of the arterial wall, subtypes that differ in aetiology and may have distinct clinical relevance. These subtypes can be visually distinguished by radiologists based on the shape of the calcifications. We investigate three automated approaches for subtype classification of IAC from head CT-derived segmentation masks: (1) an automated adaptation of the established radiological visual score, (2) a sphericity-based method, and (3) a method based on shape embeddings extracted by a medical shape foundation model. All approaches use the same lightweight classification pipeline on top of the features they compute and are evaluated using 5-fold cross-validation. The three methods achieved comparable performance, with the embedding-based approach yielding the best overall results with a weighted F1 (mean $\pm$ SD) of up to 71.5 $\pm$ 3.7 for a single artery and 59.8 $\pm$ 1.7 for the joint artery classification. Performance was largely preserved when using automated instead of manual IAC segmentation masks, and we found the difference in weighted F1 not significant. Our results show that fully automated IAC subtype quantification from head CT is feasible and remains robust to the use of manual and automated IAC segmentation masks. Code at https://github.com/bjin96/iac-subtyping.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Stroke and neurovascular diseases Workshop on Imaging and Treatment CHallenges @ MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用三种自动化方法从头颅 CT 分割掩膜区分颅内动脉钙化 (IAC) 的内膜与中膜亚型：改编放射学视觉评分、基于球形度 (sphericity)、以及用医学形状基础模型提取的 shape embedding，三者共用同一轻量分类器。5 折交叉验证下 embedding 方法最好，单条动脉 weighted F1 达 71.5 ± 3.7，联合动脉分类 59.8 ± 1.7；改用自动分割掩膜后性能基本保持，weighted F1 差异不显著。
Motivation: 内膜与中膜钙化病因不同、临床意义可能不同，放射科医生靠形状目视区分，但缺少自动化亚型量化手段，人工判读难以规模化。
Method: 输入为头颅 CT 派生的 IAC 分割掩膜，比较三条特征路线：自动化改编的放射学视觉评分、球形度特征、医学形状基础模型的 shape embedding；三者接同一个轻量分类管线，用 5 折交叉验证评估，并对比手工与自动分割掩膜。
Result: embedding 方法 weighted F1（mean ± SD）单条动脉最高 71.5 ± 3.7，联合动脉分类 59.8 ± 1.7；三种方法表现相当。改用自动分割掩膜后性能大体保持，weighted F1 差异不显著。
Conclusion: 从头颅 CT 全自动量化 IAC 亚型可行，且对使用手工还是自动分割掩膜具有稳健性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: SkillAtlas: An Attack Trace Library for Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are reusable units for language-model agents, but their risks emerge through model decisions, user context, tool calls, and execution feedback rather than through stable signatures or a single sandbox run. Existing static, dynamic, and benchmark-style evaluations rarely preserve public evidence that can be inspected, searched, and reused. We present SkillAtlas, a hosted attack trace library that converts private agent-skill security report bundles into reviewed, redacted, and searchable public cases. The library contains 3,014 cases, 6,589 traces, 151,131 steps, 233 affected skills, and 8 risk categories; 42.5% of successful cases first become successful after a non-success initial round, and trajectory-grounded labels improve pre-execution guard accuracy to 0.770.
papers.comment: Accepted at REALM @ EMNLP 2026 (non-archival workshop paper). 9 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillAtlas 把私有的 agent skill 安全报告包转成经审核、脱敏、可检索的公开攻击轨迹库，收录 3,014 个案例、6,589 条轨迹、151,131 个步骤、233 个受影响 skill 与 8 个风险类别。42.5% 的成功案例是在首轮非成功之后才转为成功，说明风险依赖多轮决策与执行反馈；以轨迹为依据的标签把执行前守卫 (pre-execution guard) 准确率提到 0.770。
Motivation: agent skill 的风险在模型决策、用户上下文、工具调用与执行反馈的交互中才显现，而现有静态、动态与 benchmark 式评测很少留下可检查、可检索、可复用的公开证据。
Method: SkillAtlas 是一个托管式攻击轨迹库：把私有 agent skill 安全报告包转换为经人工审核、脱敏并可检索的公开案例，按风险类别组织轨迹与步骤标签，并用这些轨迹级标签训练执行前守卫。
Result: 库含 3,014 个案例、6,589 条轨迹、151,131 个步骤、233 个受影响 skill、8 个风险类别；42.5% 的成功案例在首轮非成功之后才首次成功；轨迹级标签把 pre-execution guard 准确率提升到 0.770。
Conclusion: agent skill 的可利用性要在多轮轨迹层面记录与标注才能被检索和复用，执行前守卫靠轨迹级标签获得可观的判别力。

papers.title: LiveProBench: Can Streaming Video Models Really Interact Like Humans?
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video understanding requires models to process continuous multimodal input while maintaining temporal context. Existing evaluations are predominantly reactive: they query a model at a selected timestamp and therefore do not assess when it should respond. Proactive interaction instead requires monitoring a standing request, responding within an appropriate interval after the target event, and otherwise remaining silent. We introduce LiveProBench, which evaluates models at one-second stream intervals without an explicit response cue. Its six subtasks vary trigger ambiguity and timing tolerance. Event Sensitivity geometrically combines response and silence rates on the same recording; four window-based subtasks distinguish early, in-window, and missed responses; and Duplicate Counting penalizes omissions and repetitions. Premature responses outnumber missed responses for half of the evaluated models, revealing a substantial gap in the temporal decision-making required for human-like interaction.
papers.comment: Code and data is available at https://github.com/v0yager33/LiveProBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiveProBench 以 1 秒流间隔、无显式响应提示的方式评测流式视频模型的主动交互能力：模型需监控常驻请求、在目标事件后的合适时间窗内响应、其余时间保持沉默。六个子任务改变触发歧义与时间容忍度，Event Sensitivity 对同一录像上的响应率与沉默率做几何合成，四个窗口型子任务区分过早、窗内与漏响应，Duplicate Counting 惩罚漏计与重复。半数被评模型的过早响应多于漏响应，显示其时序决策与人类式交互仍有明显差距。
Motivation: 现有流式视频评测多为反应式：在选定时间戳提问，不考察模型该不该、何时该回应，因而无法衡量主动交互所需的时序决策。
Method: 在 1 秒流间隔下、不给显式响应提示地评测模型，六个子任务分别改变触发歧义与时间容忍度；Event Sensitivity 在同一录像上把响应率与沉默率几何合成，四个窗口型子任务区分过早、窗内、漏响应，Duplicate Counting 同时惩罚遗漏与重复。
Result: 在被评模型中，半数模型的过早响应多于漏响应，表明其时序决策存在明显缺口。
Conclusion: 流式视频模型在无提示的主动交互场景下会过早而非过晚地响应，人类式交互所需的时序决策是当前主要短板。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables AI systems to turn experience and feedback into persistent changes that improve both their capabilities and the process of future improvement. We first use the Headroom-Closed Index (HCI) to reveal the problems of existing LLMs, then introduce the RSI concept and its development roadmap: from improvement-execution autonomy, improvement-strategy autonomy, experience-acquisition autonomy, and environment-adaptation autonomy, to recursive meta-improvement. Next we examine RSI across scenarios (e.g., scientific discovery, embodied intelligence, software engineering), highlighting their distinct requirements and development speeds. Drawing on diverse industry practices and preliminary empirical evidence, we connect RSI research with practical systems and identify key challenges to achieving genuine RSI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出递归自我改进 (RSI) 的概念框架与五级路线图：从改进执行自主、改进策略自主、经验获取自主、环境适应自主，走向递归元改进；并用 Headroom-Closed Index (HCI) 指出既有 LLM 的问题。结论是真正 RSI 的瓶颈在自主性层级而非单点能力，需按科学发现、具身智能、软件工程等场景的差异化要求与推进速度分别推进。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 把经验与反馈转化为持久自我改进的能力受限，RSI 缺少统一的概念界定、发展路线与跨场景需求刻画，研究与产业实践之间也缺少连接。
Method: 先用 Headroom-Closed Index (HCI) 度量既有 LLM 的问题，再给出 RSI 概念与五级自主性路线图（改进执行、改进策略、经验获取、环境适应、递归元改进），并按科学发现、具身智能、软件工程等场景梳理各自要求与推进速度，结合产业实践与初步经验证据识别关键挑战。
Result: 产出为 HCI 指数对现有 LLM 的诊断、RSI 五级自主性路线图，以及跨场景（科学发现、具身智能、软件工程）的需求与推进速度对比和达成真正 RSI 的关键挑战清单；摘要中的证据表述为初步经验证据与产业实践。
Conclusion: 真正的 RSI 要沿自主性层级逐级解锁并最终到达递归元改进，且不同场景的推进速度不同，需按场景要求定制路径。

papers.title: Rice's Theorem under Self-Modification: Elevation Operators and a Normal Form
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether it can be certified algorithmically that a self-modifying computational system preserves a safety property at its next step (preservation) and along its whole evolution (persistence). One step of self-modification is a total computable transformation $Φ$ of program indices, and preservation is the elevated property $Λ_Φ(P)=\{x\in P:Φ(x)\in P\}$. When $Φ$ is extensional, $Λ_Φ(P)$ is behavioural and Rice's theorem applies. When $Φ$ reads the code, $Λ_Φ(P)$ is no longer behavioural, yet under uniform disruption (an inert wrapper encoding $K$) the s-m-n reduction that proves Rice's theorem works inside a single behavioural fibre, and $Λ_Φ(P)$ inherits the halting degree: one pullback of Rice, at two scales. One step never exceeds the degree of $P$; persistence can be $Π^0_2$-complete for $Σ^0_1$ properties, even for extensional $Φ$. We then isolate the mechanism shared by rewriting, supervision and system comparison: the semantic elevation operator, which wraps a base system and reacts to one finite event anchored to $K$, entering or leaving the property. For this class the elevated property is $P\cap S_a$ or $P\setminus S_a$, determined by trigger and polarity alone; it inherits $K$ or its complement; and the safe region is not recursively enumerable. The Rice-Shapiro theorem restricts the polarity: a finite trigger can only enter a $Σ^0_1$ property and only leave a $Π^0_1$ one. Four axes (functional, deductive, conformance to a reference, monitoring) are verified instances, and towers of supervisors do not lower the barrier. We exhibit $K$-hard intensional operators outside the class and state the open characterisation problem.
papers.comment: v2: substantially revised, extended and retitled. Corrects the definition of the class U and the instrumentation synthesiser; the claim that the proof rests on the recursion theorem is replaced by the precise statement (the s-m-n reduction within a behavioural fibre). Sections 6-9 are new. 33 pages. Companion paper: arXiv:2606.28639 (applied consequences)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇可计算性理论论文：把自修改程序的一步安全性（preservation）形式化为提升性质 Λ_Φ(P)，证明当 Φ 读代码时该性质仍继承停机问题的度，而沿全演化过程的 persistence 对 Σ^0_1 性质可 Π^0_2-完全。对语义提升算子（semantic elevation operator）这一类，提升后的性质形如 P∩S_a 或 P∖S_a，由触发与极性决定，其安全区域不可递归枚举；Rice–Shapiro 定理限定有限触发只能进入 Σ^0_1 性质、只能离开 Π^0_1 性质，监督者塔不降低该障碍。
Motivation: 自修改系统能否被算法认证为保有安全性质，缺少一个把 Rice 型不可判定性从行为性质扩展到读代码的一步变换与长期演化的框架。
Method: 把一步自修改建模为程序指标上的全可计算变换 Φ，定义提升性质 Λ_Φ(P)={x∈P:Φ(x)∈P}；在一致破坏（uniform disruption，惰性包装编码 K）下用行为纤维内的 s-m-n 归约复现 Rice 证明，并归纳出语义提升算子类（包装基础系统并对锚定于 K 的单一有限事件作出进入/离开反应），再用 Rice–Shapiro 定理约束极性，区分功能、演绎、符合参照、监控四个验证轴。
Result: 当 Φ 读代码时 Λ_Φ(P) 继承停机度（halting degree）；单步不超过 P 的度，而 persistence 对 Σ^0_1 性质可 Π^0_2-完全，即便 Φ 是外延的。对语义提升算子类，提升性质为 P∩S_a 或 P∖S_a，仅由触发与极性决定，继承 K 或其补，安全区域非递归可枚举；有限触发只能进入 Σ^0_1 性质、只能离开 Π^0_1 性质；监督者塔不降低该障碍，并给出该类之外的 K-难外延算子。
Conclusion: 一步自修改的安全认证与长期持久性在 Rice 型归约下不可判定，且对共享同一机制的重写、监督与系统比对类算子，该障碍不因叠加监督者而降低；外延算子之外的 K-难刻画仍是开放问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark researchers and developers of large language models (LLMs) and other AI systems need to find relevant evaluations, locate their benchmark datasets and code, and understand the settings behind reported scores. We present Benchmark Radar, a living database and search engine for retrieval and discovery of AI benchmarks, covering LLM evaluation, agentic and tool-use benchmarks, coding, reasoning, safety, and domain-specific evaluations. The system combines daily discovery of benchmark papers, repositories, datasets, and releases with a searchable benchmark catalog, mentions in model cards and technical reports, and score histories. It retains source identities and citations so readers can inspect candidate benchmarks and their evaluation evidence. Daily discovery draws on 37 sources: 13 direct connectors and 24 first-party research and engineering feeds. The catalog contains 1,283 source records drawn from 4 benchmark catalogs and 12,916 numeric observations on 790 records. We describe collection and retrieval, audit the full catalog, and examine benchmark saturation, adoption trends, and the limits of score comparisons. A worked example walks through a complete prior-art search, showing how to query the catalog and inspect benchmark evidence when designing a new evaluation. We release the web dashboard with a benchmark leaderboard, a Pareto frontier view of score against measured use, saturation and trend views, daily feeds, downloadable evidence, a command-line interface (CLI) for offline queries, and reproducible analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Benchmark Radar 是一个持续更新的 AI 基准数据库与搜索引擎，每日从 37 个来源（13 个直连 + 24 个一方研究/工程 feed）抓取基准论文、仓库、数据集与版本，并把模型卡与技术报告中的分数收录成可追溯的 score history。目录含 1,283 条来源记录（来自 4 个基准目录）与 790 条记录上的 12,916 条数值观测，用于审计基准饱和度、采用趋势与分数可比性边界。
Motivation: LLM 与 AI 系统的评测研究者难以找到合适 benchmark、定位其数据集与代码、并理解分数背后的设置；已有基准目录静态且不追踪分数随时间的变化。
Method: 系统由每日发现管线（37 个来源：13 个直连 connector、24 个一方研究与工程 feed）、可检索的 benchmark 目录、model card/技术报告中的提及与 score history 组成，保留来源身份与引用以便核查证据；作者审计全目录并发布 web dashboard（leaderboard、Pareto frontier、饱和度与趋势视图、可下载证据）、CLI 与可复现分析。
Result: 目录收录 1,283 条来源记录（来自 4 个基准目录），其中 790 条记录带 12,916 条数值观测；每日发现覆盖 37 个来源。审计与分析给出基准饱和度、采用趋势以及分数比较的限制，并附一个完整 prior-art 检索的 worked example。
Conclusion: 把基准发现、分数历史与来源证据放进一个持续更新、可审计的目录，可以让新评测设计者在检索时直接核查候选 benchmark 的证据链，并看清分数何时已饱和、何时不可横向比较。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Exact-Form Regret for Gradient Descent, Mirror Descent and Follow-the-Regularized-Leader
papers.abstract_en: Online gradient descent is usually studied through external regret, where the learner competes with fixed alternatives. Recent work shows that first-order methods control richer action-dependent deviations. We ask for a geometric characterization of the deviations with respect to which online gradient descent, mirror descent, and follow-the-regularized-leader (FTRL) achieve no regret. We identify exactness as the common principle. Exactness means that the relevant displacement field is generated by a scalar potential, or equivalently that the associated one-form is exact in the geometry used by the algorithm. This geometry depends on the algorithm. For gradient descent it is Euclidean geometry, for mirror descent it is the geometry induced by the regularizer, and for FTRL it is the cumulative dual state. Under mild regularity conditions, exactness yields sublinear regret, while nonzero circulation provides the complementary obstruction and leads to linear regret. This gives a unified geometric framework for understanding the deviation classes controlled by these algorithms and reveals that different first-order methods can control genuinely different classes of deviations. These deviation classes have direct consequences for learning, particularly in games. We study the equilibrium notions induced by exact-form deviations and introduce conservative correlated equilibrium, reflecting both the conservative geometry of the underlying displacement fields and the restricted family of deviations available to the players. We characterize its relation to correlated equilibrium, determine when the resulting equilibrium notions coincide and when they separate, and show how these relationships depend on the geometry and the learning algorithm. Overall, this work gives a unified geometric account of what first-order online learning algorithms are no-regret with respect to, beyond fixed comparators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文给出在线梯度下降、镜像下降与 FTRL 无遗憾所对应偏差类的几何刻画：偏差位移场由标量势生成（即 one-form 在算法所用几何下为 exact）时取得次线性 regret，非零 circulation 则构成障碍并导致线性 regret。几何随算法而变——梯度下降用欧氏几何、镜像下降用正则项诱导几何、FTRL 用累积对偶状态。作者据此引入 conservative correlated equilibrium 并刻画其与 correlated equilibrium 何时重合、何时分离。
Motivation: 外部 regret 只与固定对手比较，近期工作显示一阶方法能控制更丰富的、依赖动作的偏差，但缺少一个统一的几何判据说明各算法究竟对哪些偏差类无遗憾。
Method: 以 exact-form（位移场由标量势生成、one-form 在算法几何下 exact）为统一原则，几何按算法选取：梯度下降对应欧氏几何、镜像下降对应正则项诱导几何、FTRL 对应累积对偶状态；在温和正则条件下由 exactness 推出次线性 regret，以 circulation 给出线性 regret 的障碍，并在博弈中定义 conservative correlated equilibrium 并刻画其与 correlated equilibrium 的关系。
Result: 在温和正则条件下 exactness 蕴含次线性 regret，非零 circulation 导致线性 regret；不同一阶方法控制的偏差类确实不同，并给出 conservative correlated equilibrium 与 correlated equilibrium 何时重合、何时分离的刻画。
Conclusion: 一阶在线学习算法的无遗憾偏差类可由 one-form 是否 exact 这一几何条件统一判定，且该判定随算法所用几何而变；博弈中的均衡概念也因此依赖几何与学习算法的选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fixed-Dimensional Latent Flow for Generating Variable-Size 3D Molecules
papers.abstract_en: Molecular size is coupled to composition, structure, and function, yet most 3D molecular generators require a predefined atom count. We introduce Equivariant-Free Transformer-Autoencoded Latent Flow Matching, a two-stage framework that samples a fixed-dimensional latent vector using flow matching and uses an autoregressive Transformer to determine molecular size, atom types, coordinates, and chemical attributes. Canonical atom ordering and rigid-pose alignment enable Transformers without equivariant layers, while decoded attributes guide bond reconstruction. On PCQM4Mv2, unconditional generation yields 87.9\% unique, novel molecules passing sanitization and PoseBusters checks, exceeding baselines with lower end-to-end training and sampling time and higher end-to-end throughput. Across ten target HOMO-LUMO gaps, internal ranking retains 30\% of screened candidates and increases the density functional theory-verified hit rate within 0.1 eV from 25.0\% to 52.4\%, while largely preserving novelty and diversity. These results demonstrate fixed-dimensional latent generation with autoregressive decoding as a practical approach to molecular design without prespecifying size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Equivariant-Free Transformer-Autoencoded Latent Flow Matching：两阶段框架用 flow matching 采样固定维 latent，再由自回归 Transformer 决定分子大小、原子类型、坐标与化学属性，从而无需预设原子数即可生成可变尺寸 3D 分子。PCQM4Mv2 无条件生成 87.9% unique、novel 分子通过 sanitization 与 PoseBusters 检查；十个 HOMO-LUMO gap 目标上，DFT 验证的 0.1 eV 内命中率从 25.0% 提到 52.4%。
Motivation: 多数 3D 分子生成器要求预定义原子数，而分子尺寸与组成、结构、功能耦合，限制了无需预设尺寸的分子设计。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用 flow matching 在固定维 latent 上采样；第二阶段用自回归 Transformer 依次决定分子大小、原子类型、坐标与化学属性。canonical atom ordering 与 rigid-pose alignment 使 Transformer 无需 equivariant 层，解码出的属性用于指导键重建 (bond reconstruction)。
Result: PCQM4Mv2 无条件生成中 87.9% 为 unique、novel 且通过 sanitization 与 PoseBusters 检查的分子，超过基线，同时端到端训练与采样时间更低、吞吐更高。在十个目标 HOMO-LUMO gap 上，internal ranking 保留 30% 的筛选候选，DFT 验证的 0.1 eV 内命中率从 25.0% 提升到 52.4%，并大体保持 novelty 与 diversity。
Conclusion: 固定维 latent 生成加自回归解码是无需预设分子尺寸的可行分子设计路径，且能在保持新颖性与多样性的同时提高 DFT 验证命中率。

papers.title: Risk-Conditioned Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where rare but severe harmful generations can have significant consequences. Existing Risk-Averse RLHF addresses this issue by optimizing Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), but it trains policies for fixed risk levels and therefore cannot adjust the desired degree of risk aversion at inference time. In this paper, we propose risk-conditioned RLHF, a framework that trains a single policy that provides a continuous risk-control interface, enabling users to select different degrees of risk aversion without retraining or deploying multiple risk-specific models. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that a single risk-conditioned policy can adapt to different risk levels at inference time, enabling more flexible and risk-aware LLM deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 risk-conditioned RLHF：把 CVaR 目标下的风险水平作为条件训练单一策略，推理时可连续调节风险厌恶程度，无需重训或部署多个风险专用模型。多基准实验显示该单一策略能在推理阶段适配不同风险水平。
Motivation: 现有 Risk-Averse RLHF 用 CVaR 优化但只针对固定风险水平训练，推理时无法调整风险厌恶程度，只能重训或维护多个模型。
Method: 在 RLHF 框架中引入 risk-conditioned 训练，将 CVaR 的风险水平作为条件输入，训练单一策略提供连续风险控制接口，替代按固定风险水平分别训练的做法。
Result: 多基准实验表明，单一 risk-conditioned 策略可在推理时适配不同风险水平，实现更灵活、风险感知的 LLM 部署。
Conclusion: 把风险水平做成推理时可调条件，可以在不重训、不部署多模型的前提下获得连续的风险厌恶控制。

papers.title: What Does Multi-Agent LLM Debate Actually Change? A Layered Analysis of Disagreement and Answer Quality
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate, in which several LLMs exchange arguments before producing an answer, is widely assumed to improve answer quality by surfacing genuine disagreement. That disagreement is hard to verify, and no single signal can settle it, so we organize the analysis around four questions: (A) does the debater say it disagrees; (B) does its reply text actually argue; (C) does the dissent survive once the tone instruction that produced it is removed; and (D) do the probabilities assigned to stance options change? We evaluate three-model committees on 50 open-ended GlobalOpinionQA questions under three debate tones, friendly (seek common ground), neutral, and hostile (stress-test every position). The answers differ. (A) Full agreement differs by 50.4 percentage points between the friendly and hostile endpoints, pooling replies across all three rounds. (B) The text argues too: an LLM evaluator reading the contribution and reply without the structured self-report or tone instruction confirms the pushback is real. (C) Removing the instruction produces more returns to agreement in our sample, but the primary question-level test is inconclusive. (D) In a separate open-weight study, adjusted movement toward the opposing side is detected in two of three models, relative to a filler-based reference. This measures contextual response probabilities, not lasting belief change. For final answers, debate brings no measurable quality gain: an evaluator that judges each pair in both answer orders scores the debated answer no better than the same committee's no-debate answer on all 299 pairs, a test that detects severe but misses moderate damage in our checks. Taken together, LLM debate readily changes what agents say, but we find much weaker evidence that it changes what they persistently endorse or improves the quality of the final answer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对三模型 LLM 辩论委员会在 50 道 GlobalOpinionQA 开放题上做四层分解，发现辩论语气（friendly/neutral/hostile）能大幅改变发言层的分歧：全同意比例在 friendly 与 hostile 两端相差 50.4 个百分点，且独立 LLM 评估确认回复文本确实在反驳。但去掉语气指令后异议多回归同意（题目级主检验不确定），开放权重模型中仅 2/3 出现向对方立场的调整性概率移动；最终答案质量无提升，双答案顺序评估在全部 299 对上给辩论答案的分数不高于同委员会无辩论答案。
Motivation: 多智能体辩论被普遍认为靠真实分歧提升答案质量，但这种分歧难以验证，单一信号不足以判定它是否真实存在、是否持久、是否改善最终答案。
Method: 把分歧拆成四层问题：(A) 辩手自报是否不同意、(B) 回复文本是否真的在论证、(C) 移除产生异议的语气指令后异议是否保留、(D) 立场选项概率是否变化。评估三模型委员会在 50 道 GlobalOpinionQA 开放题、三种辩论语气（friendly/neutral/hostile）下的表现；用不看结构化自报与语气指令的 LLM 评估者判断文本反驳，另做开放权重模型的 filler 参照研究，并用双答案顺序的评估者比较辩论与无辩论的最终答案。
Result: 全同意比例在 friendly 与 hostile 两端相差 50.4 个百分点（跨三轮回复汇总）；移除语气指令后样本中出现更多回归同意，但题目级主检验不确定；开放权重研究中 3 个模型有 2 个相对 filler 参照检测到向对方立场的调整性移动；最终答案在全部 299 对上辩论答案不优于同委员会无辩论答案，该检验能检出严重损害但会漏掉中度损害。
Conclusion: LLM 辩论容易改变智能体说什么，但改变其持久立场的证据弱得多，也没有带来最终答案质量的可测提升；概率移动只反映上下文响应概率，不等于持久信念改变。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MARBO: Relational Belief Grounding for LLM Agents in Social Deduction Games
papers.abstract_en: Social deduction games (SDGs) require agents to reason under partial observability by maintaining relational beliefs about hidden roles and team alignments. While recent LLM-agent approaches improve gameplay through prompting and preference optimization, they often optimize actions and in-game speech without explicitly grounding them in such beliefs. This frequently leads to strategically inconsistent behavior, especially for compact LLM agents. We introduce Multi-Agent Relational Belief Optimization (MARBO), a belief-grounded preference optimization framework that leverages relational beliefs to guide strategic decisions and in-game speech. MARBO provides preference feedback only when behaviors are supported by reliable relational beliefs and lead to strategically favorable social outcomes, encouraging more consistent learning under uncertainty. Experiments on representative SDGs show that MARBO enables compact LLM agents to consistently outperform existing baselines. The Code is available on https://github.com/PleaseTakemeAway/MARBO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MARBO 把社交推理游戏中的关系信念 (relational beliefs) 显式接入偏好优化：只有当行为由可靠关系信念支撑、且带来有利社交结果时才给偏好反馈，从而让紧凑 LLM agent 的策略与局内发言保持一致。在代表性社交推理游戏实验中，MARBO 使小模型 agent 稳定超越现有基线。
Motivation: 社交推理游戏要求在部分可观测下维护关于隐藏身份与阵营的关系信念，而现有 LLM-agent 方法只优化动作与发言、不把二者锚定到信念上，导致小模型 agent 行为策略性不一致。
Method: 提出 Multi-Agent Relief Belief Optimization（MARBO，即 Multi-Agent Relational Belief Optimization）这一信念接地的偏好优化框架：以关系信念指导战略决策与局内发言，偏好反馈仅在行为被可靠关系信念支撑且产生有利社交结果时给出，以此在不确定性下鼓励更一致的学习。
Result: 在代表性社交推理游戏 (SDGs) 上的实验显示，MARBO 让紧凑 LLM agent 稳定优于现有基线；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把关系信念作为偏好反馈的门槛，可以在部分可观测的社交推理博弈中提升小模型 LLM agent 的策略一致性与对局表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PerfReasoning: How Well Do LLMs Reason on Hardware Performance?
papers.abstract_en: Performance modeling is central to hardware design and software optimization, yet constructing these models requires structured reasoning about computation, data reuse, storage, and movement. We introduce PerfReasoning, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs both as direct performance reasoners and as generators of analytical performance-model code. Given workload, architecture, and mapping specifications, models compare mappings and predict off-chip traffic and buffer requirements. The strongest closed-source models exceed 90% on reasoning-based Q&A, and the best open-weight model reaches 82.4%. However, model construction is substantially harder: while GPT-5.6 Sol exceeds 80% pass rate, all other model configurations average below 45% and vary markedly across runs. Task-specific RL raises a 4B model's mapping-reasoning accuracy by 15.7 points, whereas feedback-free multi-round self-revision prompting is not reliably effective. PerfReasoning exposes the gap between plausible architectural reasoning and reliable performance-model construction. We will publicly release the benchmark to support reproducible evaluation and track future progress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PerfReasoning 基准，让 LLM 既做硬件性能直接推理，又生成解析性能模型代码：给定 workload、架构与 mapping 规格，比较不同 mapping 并预测片外流量与 buffer 需求。最强闭源模型在推理式问答上超过 90%，最佳开源权重模型达 82.4%；但模型构建难得多，只有 GPT-5.6 Sol 通过率超 80%，其余配置平均低于 45% 且跨运行波动明显。
Motivation: 性能建模需要围绕计算、数据复用、存储与数据移动的结构化推理，而 LLM 在看似合理的架构推理与可靠构建性能模型之间存在明显断层，缺少可复现的评测基准。
Method: PerfReasoning 以 workload、architecture、mapping 规格为输入，双路径评测：一是直接性能推理的问答，二是生成解析性能模型代码；任务包括比较 mapping、预测 off-chip traffic 与 buffer 需求。另考察任务专用 RL 与无反馈多轮自我修订提示两种提升方式。
Result: 最强闭源模型在推理式问答上超过 90%，最佳开源权重模型 82.4%。模型构建任务中 GPT-5.6 Sol 通过率超过 80%，其余所有模型配置平均低于 45% 且跨运行差异明显。任务专用 RL 使一个 4B 模型的 mapping 推理准确率提升 15.7 个百分点，而无反馈多轮自我修订提示效果不可靠。
Conclusion: LLM 的硬件性能推理与性能模型可靠构建是两种不同能力，后者才是瓶颈；任务专用 RL 可部分弥合，自我修订提示不行。基准将公开发布以支持可复现评测。

papers.title: Tree species mapping in Denmark: A comparison of spectral-temporal features with geospatial foundation model embeddings
papers.abstract_en: We map tree species across Denmark using National Forest Inventory plots and EO data, while evaluating the potential of foundation models for large-scale forest characterization. We compare two alternative input representations for tree species classification: (i) manually engineered spectral-temporal features (STF) derived from multi-temporal Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations, and (ii) embeddings generated by the EO FMs TESSERA and AlphaEarth. Both representations are complemented with canopy height information. Random forest, XGBoost, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) classifiers are evaluated for all input representations, with separate assessments for pure and mixed forest stands. The STF-based MLP achieves the highest classification performance, yielding macro F1 scores of 0.843 and 0.653 for pure and mixed stands, respectively. The MLP trained on TESSERA embeddings delivers competitive performance for pure stands, achieving results within 1.1 percentage points of the best-performing model. TESSERA consistently outperforms STF-based models when fewer than approximately 25% of training plots are available, demonstrating a substantial advantage under limited training data. Multi-year observations systematically improve classification accuracy relative to single-year inputs, while ablation experiments reveal the complementary contributions of Sentinel-1 backscatter, spectral indices, and canopy height data. The best-performing model is subsequently applied at the national scale to generate a 10 m tree species map of Denmark. Area-adjusted validation indicates an overall map accuracy of 79.9%. The resulting map, released as an open-access product, is the first high-resolution national tree species map of Denmark and provides a valuable resource for forest monitoring, ecological research, and land management applications.

papers.title: When Users Don't Ask: Benchmarking Context-Driven Memory Retrieval in Conversational Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increas- ingly deployed as long-horizon conversational agents, motivating growing interest in mem- ory systems. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate memory through QA-style probing rather than in-situ conversational usage. We introduce LOCOMO-CONV, a conversa- tional memory benchmark derived from Lo- CoMo with four query styles: dialog, implicit, counterfactual, and composed. Across five rep- resentative memory systems, we evaluate both retrieval recall and end-to-end response qual- ity. Our experiments show that conversational framing exposes substantial retrieval gaps over- looked by QA benchmarks, especially on im- plicit and composed queries, which multi-facet query rewriting narrows for raw-turn mem- ory but not abstractive memory. We further find that strong retrieval does not fully trans- late into response quality, and that implicit queries exhibit silent grounding, where mem- ory improves contextual grounding without ex- plicitly surfacing the gold fact. These results point to reasoning-based memory elaboration as a promising direction, and we release aux- iliary supportive_memory annotations captur- ing conversationally useful context beyond the original gold evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出对话式记忆基准 LOCOMO-CONV（源自 LoCoMo），用 dialog、implicit、counterfactual、composed 四种查询风格在五个记忆系统上同时测检索召回与端到端回复质量。对话框架暴露出 QA 式基准忽略的检索缺口，implicit 与 composed 查询最严重；多侧面查询改写 (multi-facet query rewriting) 能缩小 raw-turn 记忆的缺口但对 abstractive 记忆无效，且强检索并不完全转化为回复质量。
Motivation: 现有记忆基准主要用 QA 式探针评测，无法反映记忆系统在真实对话中的使用，检索缺口被掩盖。
Method: 构建 LOCOMO-CONV 对话式记忆基准，含 dialog、implicit、counterfactual、composed 四种查询风格；在五个代表性记忆系统上同时评测检索召回与端到端回复质量，并测试多侧面查询改写；另发布 supportive_memory 辅助标注。
Result: 对话框架暴露出 QA 基准忽略的显著检索缺口，在 implicit 与 composed 查询上尤其突出；多侧面查询改写对 raw-turn 记忆缩小缺口、对 abstractive 记忆无效；强检索不完全转化为回复质量；implicit 查询出现 silent grounding，即记忆改善上下文锚定但未显式给出 gold fact。
Conclusion: 基于推理的记忆细化 (reasoning-based memory elaboration) 是有前景的方向，且需要 supportive_memory 这类超出原始 gold 证据的对话有用上下文标注。

papers.title: Disciplined Bilevel Programming
papers.abstract_en: Bilevel optimization provides a natural modeling language for hierarchical decision problems. However, applying existing numerical solvers usually requires substantial manual analysis and reformulation. In this paper, we introduce disciplined bilevel programming (DBLP), a symbolic framework that allows users to specify and solve optimistic bilevel problems in a high-level, human-readable way that is close to the mathematical formulation. For problems with a disciplined nonlinear upper problem and a convex lower problem satisfying the disciplined parameterized programming rules, DBLP automatically canonicalizes the lower problem into conic form and constructs an equivalent single-level reformulation using the conic Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions. We relax the resulting complementarity constraint and use a gap continuation procedure to approximately solve a sequence of smooth nonlinear problems. We implement DBLP in the open-source Python package BLVPY, an extension of CVXPY for bilevel programming. We demonstrate the modeling and solution capabilities of BLVPY on a range of bilevel optimization problems from several application domains. The proposed framework and implementation allow users to specify and solve bilevel optimization problems within a few lines of code, without prior expertise in bilevel modeling and numerical optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DBLP：一个符号化双层规划框架，把满足 disciplined parameterized programming 规则的乐观双层问题自动规范化为锥形式，用锥 KKT 条件做单层重构，再松弛互补约束并以 gap continuation 逐次求解光滑非线性问题。实现为 CVXPY 的双层扩展 BLVPY，几行代码即可建模求解，无需双层数值优化的先验经验。
Motivation: 双层优化适合描述层级决策问题，但现有数值求解器通常需要大量手工分析与问题重构，门槛高。
Method: 对 disciplined nonlinear 上层 + convex 下层且满足 DPP 规则的问题，自动把下层规范化为锥形式，用 conic KKT 条件构造等价单层重构；松弛互补约束，用 gap continuation 依次求解一串光滑非线性问题。实现为开源 Python 包 BLVPY（CVXPY 的双层扩展）。
Result: 在来自若干应用领域的双层优化问题上演示 BLVPY 的建模与求解能力，用户可用几行代码指定并求解双层问题；摘要未给出定量指标对比。
Conclusion: 在 DPP 规则覆盖的（上层非线性、下层凸）双层问题上，符号化规范化加锥 KKT 单层化加 gap continuation 可以把双层建模求解压缩到几行代码，无需专门的双层优化经验。
Relevance: 0
