papers.title: Intrinsic Interaction Geometry Controls the Low-Rank Complexity of Softmax Attention
papers.abstract_en: How much matrix rank is required to preserve every bounded value output of normalized softmax attention? We study the unrestricted maximum-row-\(\ell_1\) approximation rank \(r_\varepsilon(A)\), exactly the least rank achieving uniform error over all bounded vector-valued values. Row softmax exposes the intrinsic interaction \(C=P_m(\log A)P_N\), whereas invertible \(Q/K\) gauges leave \(A\) fixed while changing the Euclidean geometry of a chosen query/key factorization. We replace that coordinate-dependent description by a projective residual \(q(C-T)\) and an attained factor-radius size \(κ(T)\). For every rank-\(r\) retained interaction with \(τ(T)<\varepsilon\), we prove $$ r_\varepsilon(A)\le \min\left\{ N,\; C_r\left( 1+\frac{κ(T)} {(\varepsilon-τ(T))^2} \right)^{r/2} \right\}, $$ with the same unknown dimension constant as the underlying weighted Gibbs-row cover. The profile is gauge invariant, termwise no worse than native retained-subspace bounds at the same declared dimension, and has a worst-case sharp \(r/2\) size exponent at fixed \(r\) and \(\varepsilon\). We then measure \(r_\varepsilon(A)\) directly on learned attention using 9,978 certified brackets across BERT, GPT-2, Qwen2.5, and two ViT checkpoints; where certificates do not close, the optimum remains interval-valued. A pre-specified 2,302-cell held-out study further shows that the historical native-coordinate geometry block contains coarse, mostly head-level information but no detectable incremental information beyond a strong calibrated baseline. The new intrinsic descriptor is not evaluated in that study. Together, the theory and measurements distinguish an operator-intrinsic complexity control from a stronger empirical explanation that the learned-head evidence does not support.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 4 figures. Expanded theoretical appendix with complete weighted Gibbs-cover, intrinsic factorization, gauge-boundary, sharpness, and finite-certificate proofs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文定义了归一化 softmax 注意力保持所有有界 value 输出所需的最小秩 r_ε(A)，并证明其由内禀交互几何 C=P_m(log A)P_N 的投影残差与因子半径 κ(T) 控制：对任意 rank-r 保留交互，r_ε(A) ≤ min{N, C_r(1+κ(T)/(ε−τ(T))²)^{r/2}，且该界规范不变、指数 r/2 在固定 r、ε 下最坏情形尖锐。在 BERT、GPT-2、Qwen2.5 与两个 ViT 检查点上用 9,978 个认证区间直接测量 r_ε(A)。
Motivation: softmax 注意力的秩需求此前依赖所选 query/key 分解的欧氏几何，而可逆 Q/K 规范变换在保持注意力矩阵 A 不变的同时改变该几何，导致复杂度描述坐标依赖、无法作为算子内禀量刻画。
Method: 以行 softmax 暴露的内禀交互 C=P_m(log A)P_N 替代坐标相关描述，引入投影残差 q(C−T) 与可达因子半径 κ(T)，证明基于加权 Gibbs-row cover 的秩-误差上界；再用认证区间直接测量学习到的注意力的 r_ε(A)，并设计 2,302 格预注册留出研究检验原生坐标几何块相对强校准基线的增量信息。
Result: 证明 r_ε(A) ≤ min{N, C_r(1+κ(T)/(ε−τ(T))²)^{r/2}，与底层加权 Gibbs-row cover 共享同一未知维数常数，逐项不劣于同声明维度的原生保留子空间界，固定 r 与 ε 下最坏情形指数尖锐为 r/2。在 BERT、GPT-2、Qwen2.5 及两个 ViT 检查点上取得 9,978 个认证区间，证书不闭合处最优值保持区间值。预注册的 2,302 格留出研究显示历史原生坐标几何块含粗粒度、主要为头级的信息，但相对强校准基线无可检测的增量信息；新内禀描述符未在该研究中评估。
Conclusion: 注意力的低秩复杂度由算子内禀的交互几何控制，而非所选 query/key 分解的坐标几何；学习头层面的原生坐标几何证据不足以支持更强的经验解释。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Compositional Failure in Audio-Visual LLMs: Late-Layer Prior Dominance Under Cross-modal Conflict
papers.abstract_en: We study audio-visual conflict as a compositional generalization test for AV-LLMs: the model must combine synchronized but semantically incompatible audio and video evidence and decide whether the pair matches. On VideoLLaMA 2-7B-AV, three alignment configurations remain nearchance on the scored exact-string Yes/No subset of AVHBench, even though their output priors shift substantially. Similarly, off-the-shelf InternVideo2 experienced a 32.3% accuracy decrease specifically under cross-modal conflict, accompanied by a 17.3% instruction-following failure. We call this failure mode prior dominance: late-layer commitment to an internally preferred answer pattern that is weakly grounded in the conflicting inputs. To explain this behavior, we conduct a mechanistic interpretability analysis and find that commitment remains concentrated at 25.5 $\pm$ 1 layers. We show that stronger temporal alignment changes answer bias, but do not improve compositional conflict resolution. Code and data to reproduce our mechanistic audit and behavioral evaluations are available at https://github.com/AdarshSudheer09/AVHBench-dmai.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Compositional Learning at ICML 2026. 7 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把音视频语义冲突当作组合泛化测试，发现 AV-LLM 在跨模态冲突下退化为晚期层先验主导 (late-layer prior dominance)：InternVideo2 准确率下降 32.3%、指令跟随失败 17.3%，而加强时间对齐只改变答案偏置、不改善冲突消解。
Motivation: 音视频模型需要在音画同步但语义不相容时判断是否匹配，这一组合泛化场景下模型行为与输入脱钩，且其机制来源不明。
Method: 在 AVHBench 的打分 exact-string Yes/No 子集上测试 VideoLLaMA 2-7B-AV 的三种对齐配置与现成 InternVideo2，并对冲突条件下的承诺层做 mechanistic interpretability 分析。
Result: VideoLLaMA 2-7B-AV 三种对齐配置在该子集上均接近随机 (near-chance)，但输出先验明显偏移；InternVideo2 在跨模态冲突下准确率下降 32.3%，伴随 17.3% 指令跟随失败；承诺集中在 25.5 ± 1 层；更强的时间对齐改变答案偏置但不提升冲突消解。
Conclusion: 跨模态冲突下的失败源于晚期层对内部偏好答案的承诺而非输入证据，因此调时间对齐不足以修复组合冲突消解。

summary_sections.result: VideoLLaMA 2-7B-AV 三种对齐配置在该子集上均接近随机 (near-chance)，但输出先验明显偏移；InternVideo2 在跨模态冲突下准确率下降 32.3%，伴随 17.3% 指令跟随失败；承诺集中在 25.5 ± 1 层；更强的时间对齐改变答案偏置但不提升冲突消解。

papers.title: Query-Side Attacks on GNN-Based KGQA: Tracing Failures from Entity Linking to Answer Generation
papers.abstract_en: GNN-based Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) pipelines process queries through four discrete stages: entity linking, subgraph retrieval, GNN reasoning, and answer generation. Standard robustness evaluations conflate stage-level failures into a single end-to-end metric, obscuring both the source of brittleness and the appropriate mitigation target. We ask which stage fails, and why, when the pipeline is subjected to adversarial perturbations on the input question. We introduce a stage-isolation protocol with two answer-preserving adversarial perturbations verified against the knowledge graph: Compositional Restructuring (CR) and Relation Synonym Swap (RS) target distinct stages while leaving entity seeds intact. Evaluated across ComplexWebQuestions and WebQSP, the results run counter to prevailing assumptions: the GNN reasoning stage retains near-baseline accuracy when the subgraph is intact, while subgraph construction accounts for over 99\% of the end-to-end collapse under CR, occurring even when the gold answer is present in 74\% of retrieved subgraphs. This exposes a fundamental distinction between answer presence and answer reachability that end-to-end metrics cannot detect, and places the mitigation target firmly at the subgraph construction stage rather than the reasoning model. Perturbed datasets and evaluation infrastructure are released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/atkgrag-E85C .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 GNN-based KGQA 管线在对抗扰动下端到端指标掩盖失败来源的问题，提出阶段隔离协议，用两种保答案扰动 CR 与 RS 分别打击不同阶段。在 ComplexWebQuestions 与 WebQSP 上，CR 造成的端到端崩溃中超过 99% 归因于子图构建，且 74% 被检索子图中已含金标答案仍崩溃，说明缓解目标应放在子图构建而非 GNN 推理模型。
Motivation: 标准鲁棒性评测把各阶段失败混成一个端到端指标，既看不出脆弱点在哪一阶段，也无法确定该针对哪一环节做缓解。
Method: 提出阶段隔离协议，设计两种经知识图谱验证、保答案的对抗扰动：Compositional Restructuring (CR) 与 Relation Synonym Swap (RS)，各自针对不同阶段且保持实体种子不变；在实体链接、子图检索、GNN 推理、答案生成四阶段管线上定位失败。
Result: 在 ComplexWebQuestions 与 WebQSP 上，子图完整时 GNN 推理阶段保持接近基线的准确率；CR 下超过 99% 的端到端崩溃由子图构建造成，即使金标答案出现在 74% 被检索子图中崩溃仍发生。
Conclusion: 答案在子图中存在不等于答案可达，端到端指标无法区分二者；KGQA 的缓解目标应放在子图构建阶段而非推理模型。

papers.title: Are Concept Bottleneck Models Effective as Decision-Support Systems?
papers.abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are interpretable-by-design neural networks that detect human-understandable concepts from the input and use them to generate predictions. By allowing users to inspect the concepts underlying a prediction and explore how predictions change under alternative concept configurations, CBMs have emerged as one of the most prominent approaches to supporting human-AI collaboration. However, user studies investigating their actual effectiveness as decision-support systems remain limited. We present two large-scale user studies (N participants = 705, N observations = 6,959) evaluating how concept-based explanations and user interventions on the model's concepts affect the performance of the human-AI team in two distinct binary classification tasks. Our results show that CBMs, and particularly their interactive component, can improve human-AI team accuracy relative to both unaided human performance and performance with non-interpretable AI support. However, these benefits emerge only under certain conditions: classification tasks perceived as difficult, easily identifiable concepts, and active interaction with the model. We also discuss how inaccurate concept detection may undermine users' trust in the model. Overall, this work provides practical guidance for the deployment of CBMs as effective decision-support tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 两项大规模用户研究（705 名参与者、6,959 条观测）检验概念瓶颈模型 (CBM) 作为决策支持系统的真实效果：交互式概念干预能提升人机团队在二分类任务上的准确率，相对无 AI 辅助的人类表现和不可解释 AI 辅助均更高，但收益仅在任务被感知为困难、概念易于识别、且用户主动与模型交互时出现；概念检测不准会削弱用户信任。
Motivation: CBM 因可检查概念、可干预预测而被视为人机协作的重要路径，但检验其作为决策支持系统实际有效性的用户研究仍然有限。
Method: 开展两项大规模用户研究，共 705 名参与者、6,959 条观测，在两个不同的二分类任务中比较三种条件：无 AI 辅助、不可解释 AI 辅助、以及提供概念解释并允许用户干预概念的 CBM 支持，衡量人机团队表现。
Result: CBM（尤其是其交互组件）能提升人机团队准确率，优于无辅助人类表现与不可解释 AI 辅助；该收益仅在三条件下出现——任务被感知为困难、概念易于识别、用户主动与模型交互；概念检测不准确会削弱用户对模型的信任。
Conclusion: CBM 作为决策支持工具的有效性是有条件的：必须配合易识别概念和用户主动交互才能兑现准确率收益，概念检测误差则会侵蚀信任，部署时应据此筛选适用任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BixBench3: Benchmarking AI agents on research-study-scale computational biology tasks
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) promises to accelerate biological research by automating computational analyses. Yet the ability of AI agents to execute on computational biology at the scale of complete research studies has not been systematically evaluated. Here we introduce BixBench3, a benchmark that measures the capacity of AI agents to process raw biological data through to scientific results. We designed BixBench3 tasks to mirror the delegation of work from a scientist to an agent: the scientist chooses the research question and high-level methods, then delegates implementation of all analyses to the agent. In each task, an agent receives a research objective, methodological guidance, and raw data derived from a published scientific study, and must execute a sequence of analyses to achieve the research objective. The data artifacts resulting from these analyses, such as peak call matrices or differential expression tables, are programmatically graded against the corresponding artifacts generated and reported in the original study. Across 20 BixBench3 tasks encompassing the generation of 138 unique artifacts, we find that 13 frontier models achieve scores ranging from 0.00 for Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite to 0.48 for GPT 5.6 Sol. Agents perform worse on tasks with larger raw datasets (0.36 on tasks with <100 GB versus 0.10 on tasks with >100 GB) and on analyses requiring more sequential steps (0.36 at 1-2 steps vs 0.24 at 3+). On average, agents use 6.8 hours, 102 million tokens, and \$43 to complete each task, with the longest attempts consuming 24 hours, 1.07 billion tokens, and \$525. Notably, the highest-scoring agents used fewer tokens and were cheaper than less performant options. These results reveal that LLMs vary substantially in their ability to (1) execute multiple sequential analysis steps coherently, (2) manage large quantities of raw data, and (3) work across scientific domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BixBench3 把已发表研究的原始数据与方法指引交给 AI agent，要求其自主执行完整分析链，并按与原研究一致的分析产物（peak call matrix、差异表达表等）程序化打分。13 个前沿模型在 20 个任务、138 个唯一产物上得分 0.00（Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite）到 0.48（GPT 5.6 Sol）；数据量超过 100 GB 或需 3 步以上串行分析时得分明显更低。
Motivation: AI agent 能否把计算生物学从原始数据一路做到完整研究级别的科学结论，此前缺少系统评测；现有基准未覆盖科学家把整段分析委托给 agent 的真实工作方式。
Method: 每个任务给出研究目标、方法指引和来自已发表研究的原始数据，agent 需执行一串分析；产出的分析产物（如 peak call matrices、differential expression tables）与原研究报告的产物做程序化比对打分。
Result: 20 个任务共 138 个唯一产物，13 个前沿模型得分 0.00（Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite）至 0.48（GPT 5.6 Sol）；原始数据 <100 GB 的任务平均 0.36，>100 GB 为 0.10；1–2 步分析 0.36，3 步及以上 0.24。平均每个任务耗时 6.8 小时、1.02 亿 token、43 美元，最长尝试达 24 小时、10.7 亿 token、525 美元；得分最高的 agent 反而用更少 token、成本更低。
Conclusion: 前沿 LLM 在研究级计算生物学任务上能力差异巨大，短板集中在多步串行分析的连贯执行、大规模原始数据管理和跨科学领域工作；更多 token 与更高花费并不换来更高分。

papers.title: Interpretable AI with Local Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI models such as tabular foundation models and gradient-boosted ensembles can outpredict classical methods, but provide little basis for reasoning about their predictions. High-stakes decisions call for models that are both accurate and interpretable as built. Local linear modeling offers a path forward: a smooth regression function is locally well approximated by a linear one, allowing a linear fit near each query point to achieve high accuracy without sacrificing transparency. The challenges lie in learning what is "local" and developing statistical tools for interpretation. Here, we propose local distillation, in which a black-box "teacher" guides a regularized linear "student" model at each query point. The teacher (1) defines locality by upweighting training observations with similar predicted outcomes, and (2) anchors the fit with its prediction at the query point, included as a pseudo-observation whose weight is estimated from the data. For interpretation, we add a small amount of Gaussian randomization to the local objective and use refits to assess stability: selection frequencies identify reliable features at a query point, and clustering the randomized fits identifies stable subgroups across the data. Under the lasso penalty, we prove that this randomization yields feature-selection probabilities that are stable under small perturbations of the training responses. Across 17 benchmark datasets, local distillation nearly matches its AI teacher's accuracy while producing a sparse linear model at each test point. In a high-dimensional cancer gene expression example, the framework identifies patient subgroups whose local models use different genes; this heterogeneity is invisible to a global linear model, and difficult to surface in a black-box model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 local distillation：用黑盒教师在每个查询点定义局部性（按预测相近加权）并以伪观测锚定，训练带 lasso 的局部线性学生模型，再加高斯随机化做 refit 以评估稳定性。在 17 个基准数据集上精度几乎追平 AI 教师且每个测试点给出稀疏线性模型；癌症基因表达例子中识别出局部模型使用不同基因的患者亚组。
Motivation: 表格基础模型与梯度提升集成精度超过经典方法但难以推理其预测，高风险决策需要既准又可解释的模型。
Method: 教师按预测结果相似度对训练观测加权以定义局部性，并把查询点预测作为权重由数据估计的伪观测锚定拟合；对局部目标加少量高斯随机化并 refit，用选择频率识别可靠特征、对随机化拟合聚类识别稳定亚组；lasso 惩罚下证明特征选择概率在训练响应小扰动下稳定。
Result: 在 17 个基准数据集上，local distillation 精度几乎匹配其 AI 教师，同时在每个测试点产出稀疏线性模型；高维癌症基因表达例子中识别出局部模型使用不同基因的患者亚组，这种异质性对全局线性模型不可见、对黑盒模型难以呈现。
Conclusion: 以黑盒教师引导的局部线性学生加随机化 refit，可以在保持接近教师精度的同时给出查询点级可解释模型，并暴露全局模型掩盖的亚组异质性。

papers.title: BehaviorWorldGen: Closing the Loop between Action Models and World Simulators via Controllable Behavior-Aware Structured World Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern driving action models are increasingly improved in a self-improvement loop, where a learned world simulator imagines future observations and the resulting data is fed back to refine the action model. However, the bottleneck of this loop lies in the simulators' inability to generate behaviorally plausible responses by surrounding agents, making generated data both unrealistic in interaction and imbalanced in distribution. We introduce BehaviorWorldGen, a framework that closes the loop between action models and world simulators through controllable behavior-aware structured world generation. Its core component is BehaviorFlow, a meta-action-conditioned traffic-flow model that injects interpretable behavior controls and jointly generates multi-agent rollouts. BehaviorFlow realizes the specified agent behaviors while allowing surrounding vehicles to respond to the ego and to one another. The resulting rollouts are rendered by a world simulator into realistic multi-view observations, which are paired with corrected interaction-aware trajectories for action-model refinement. Since BehaviorWorldGen uses structured trajectories as the interface between its modules, it is compatible with diverse action models and world simulators. Experiments on world generation, scene extrapolation, and policy refinement demonstrate consistent improvements, with the largest benefits concentrated on difficult interactive scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BehaviorWorldGen 把动作模型与世界模拟器接成自改进闭环：核心组件 BehaviorFlow 以 meta-action 为条件生成交通流，注入可解释的行为控制并联合生成多智能体轨迹，再由世界模拟器渲染成多视角观测、配对修正后的交互感知轨迹回灌动作模型。世界生成、场景外推与策略精炼三类实验一致提升，收益集中在困难交互场景。
Motivation: 驾驶动作模型的自改进闭环受限于世界模拟器无法生成周围智能体行为上合理的响应，导致回灌数据在交互上不真实、分布上不平衡。
Method: BehaviorFlow 是 meta-action 条件化的交通流模型，注入可解释行为控制并联合生成多智能体 rollouts，既实现指定行为又让周围车辆对自车及彼此做出响应；rollouts 由世界模拟器渲染为真实多视角观测，与修正的交互感知轨迹配对用于动作模型精炼；各模块以结构化轨迹为接口，兼容不同动作模型与世界模拟器。
Result: 在世界生成 (world generation)、场景外推 (scene extrapolation) 与策略精炼 (policy refinement) 三类实验上均取得一致改进，最大收益集中在困难交互场景。

papers.title: Task- and dataset-specific information in protein language models
papers.abstract_en: Protein language models (PLMs) have transferred the latest advances from natural language processing to computational biology. These models, trained on large corpora of protein sequence data, are widely used to translate amino acid sequences into latent-space embeddings, ready for use in diverse downstream tasks (DTs). By consensus, embeddings from the models' last layers are used, while the models' internal behavior remains poorly understood. We analyzed 13 PLMs across 15 DTs and 9 datasets to assess the value of embeddings from intermediate PLM layers. We trained probe models on embeddings from each layer, compared their performance, and showed that the last layers of PLMs rarely produced embeddings that led to the best results on downstream tasks. Furthermore, we identified a connection between how models learn a certain DT and the similarity between that DT and the pre-training objective. For example, for residue-level downstream tasks, we observed a steady increase in performance across almost all PLM layers, which we attributed to their similarity to most PLMs' pre-training objectives. To allow the community to capitalize on our findings, we provide PLMSommelier, a Python package that automatically identifies the best PLM layer for a given DT with ~98% accuracy and creates a truncated model using only the early layers up to the best-performing layer. This will help users save time and memory during inference and yield better predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统分析 13 个蛋白语言模型 (PLM) 在 15 项下游任务、9 个数据集上各层 embedding 的可用性，发现惯例采用的最后一层几乎从不是下游任务的最优层；任务与预训练目标越相似，性能随层数上升越明显（残基级任务即如此）。配套的 PLMSommelier 可自动选出给定任务的最佳层（约 98% 准确率）并截断模型，从而省时省显存并提升预测性能。
Motivation: 社区默认取 PLM 最后一层 embedding，但模型内部行为缺乏理解，可能在下游任务上白白损失性能与推理开销。
Method: 对 13 个 PLM、15 项下游任务、9 个数据集，在每一层 embedding 上训练 probe 模型并横向比较；据此归纳任务与预训练目标相似度和逐层性能走势的关系，并发布 Python 包 PLMSommelier 自动选层与截断模型。
Result: PLM 最后一层极少给出下游任务最优结果；残基级任务在几乎所有 PLM 层上性能随层数稳定上升，被归因于其与多数 PLM 预训练目标相似；PLMSommelier 自动识别最佳层的准确率约 98%。
Conclusion: 下游任务应按任务特性选择 PLM 层而非默认最后一层，且任务与预训练目标的相似度可预测逐层性能走势；截断到最佳层可同时省推理时间与内存并提高预测性能。

papers.title: A Quantum/Classical Example Oracle Separation for Making Things Up
papers.abstract_en: Consider two PAC learning algorithms, both having access to quantum computation, but differing in the types of examples they obtain: one is provided with classical samples, while the other is given quantum samples. Are there any learning tasks that can be efficiently performed by the latter, but not by the former? This question, the focus of our work, is surprisingly still open. Our main result is to show that \emph{relative to an oracle}, there are distributions that can be efficiently generated by a quantum learner with access to quantum samples, but not by a quantum learner with access to only classical samples, making progress to answering this question in the affirmative.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 3 figures; significant updates to abstract, introduction and related works. Substantive contents remain the same
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 PAC 学习框架下证明了一个 oracle 相对性分离：存在某些分布，能用量子样本 (quantum samples) 的量子学习器高效生成，却无法被只拿到经典样本的量子学习器高效生成，从而朝「量子样本严格强于经典样本」的肯定回答推进一步。结论限定在相对 oracle 的意义下，不是无条件分离。
Motivation: 两个都能用量子计算的 PAC 学习器，仅因输入是经典样本还是量子样本而产生效率差异——这类任务是否存在，此前仍是公开问题。
Method: 构造式证明：给出一个 oracle，相对该 oracle 定义一类分布，使带量子样本的学习器可高效生成、而只有经典样本的学习器不可高效生成，属于 oracle 相对性 (oracle separation) 的量子学习理论结果。
Result: 主结果为相对 oracle 的存在性分离，朝肯定回答该问题推进；摘要未给出具体误差界、样本复杂度或运行时间数值。
Conclusion: 量子样本相对经典样本的效率优势至少在 oracle 相对意义下成立，无条件分离仍待解决。

papers.title: MME-Safety: A Fine-grained Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show remarkable advancements, their cross-modal capabilities introduce complex vulnerabilities that easily bypass unimodal filters. Existing benchmarks lack fine-grained intent-related annotations and rely on unidimensional metrics, hindering comprehensive robustness evaluation. To address this, we propose MME-Safety, a rigorously verified benchmark featuring a unique four-dimensional annotation schema that categorizes risk scenarios, harm severity, and modality-specific stealth levels. Furthermore, we introduce a hierarchical evaluation framework to assess fundamental response reliability, actual risk exposure, and the structural integrity of defensive behaviors. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across 17 state-of-the-art MLLMs provide a comprehensive safety profile of current multimodal systems. Our analysis systematically investigates cross-modal input configurations and uncovers safety implications associated with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. These multifaceted findings underscore the urgent need for robust, reasoning-aware safety alignment in the multimodal landscape.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MME-Safety 提出面向多模态大模型 (MLLM) 的细粒度安全基准，用四维标注 schema 覆盖风险场景、危害严重度与模态特定隐蔽等级，并配套分层评估框架衡量响应可靠性、实际风险暴露与防御行为的结构完整性。对 17 个前沿 MLLM 的 zero-shot 评测给出当前多模态系统的安全画像，并分析跨模态输入配置与 Chain-of-Thought 推理的安全含义。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 安全基准缺少与意图相关的细粒度标注，且依赖单维度指标，难以全面评估跨模态漏洞——这类漏洞容易绕过单模态过滤器。
Method: 构建经严格校验的 MME-Safety 基准，采用四维标注 schema（风险场景、危害严重度、模态特定隐蔽等级）；提出分层评估框架，分三层度量基础响应可靠性、实际风险暴露与防御行为的结构完整性；对 17 个 SOTA MLLM 做 zero-shot 评测，并系统考察跨模态输入配置与 CoT 推理。
Result: 在 17 个 SOTA MLLM 上完成 extensive zero-shot 评测，得到当前多模态系统的综合安全画像；分析揭示了跨模态输入配置与 Chain-of-Thought 推理相关的安全影响。
Conclusion: 多模态领域亟需鲁棒的、reasoning-aware 的安全对齐；评估 MLLM 安全必须同时看意图细粒度标注、风险暴露与防御行为结构，而非单一维度分数。

papers.title: Improving Constraint Models with LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: The runtime of Constraint Programming (CP) solvers is highly sensitive to modeling choices, such as symmetry breaking, implied constraints, global constraints, constraint reformulation, and variable representation. Improving these constraint models has traditionally required human expertise, and existing automated reformulation systems are restricted to a predefined library of hand-crafted transformation rules. We introduce an agentic framework that instead reformulates a constraint model from an open-ended space and establishes correctness empirically rather than by construction: a Large Language Model (LLM) agent, given a model and three training instances, proposes alternative formulations, validates each by injecting its solution back into the original model, and diagnoses and repairs failures, returning the best variant it finds in a median of about fifteen minutes. The models are expressed in the CPMpy modeling library, and each proposed model is evaluated on three larger test instances. Across nine combinatorial optimization problems, the generated models outperform the originals on 21 of 27 test instances, and on some problems solve more than two orders of magnitude faster. A comparison against non-agentic baselines that reuse the same validation and selection tools indicates that the gains stem from the agent's iterative diagnosis and repair, not merely from sampling several candidates. These results demonstrate that autonomous agentic methods can support the improvement of constraint models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 LLM agent 的约束模型 (CP model) 自动改进框架：agent 在 CPMpy 中提出改写方案，把解注入原模型验证正确性，失败则诊断修复，中位约 15 分钟返回最优变体。在 9 个组合优化问题的 27 个测试实例上，生成模型在 21 个上超过原模型，部分问题快两个数量级以上；与复用同一验证工具的非 agent 基线对比，收益来自迭代诊断与修复而非多次采样。
Motivation: CP 求解器运行时对对称破除、隐含约束、全局约束、约束改写与变量表示等建模选择高度敏感，而改进模型传统上依赖专家经验，现有自动改写系统只能套用预定义的手工规则库。
Method: LLM agent 接收模型与三个训练实例，从开放空间提出替代形式，通过把候选解注入原模型来经验性验证正确性并诊断修复失败；模型用 CPMpy 表达，每个候选在三个更大的测试实例上评估；与复用相同验证和选择工具的非 agent 基线对比。
Result: 9 个组合优化问题、27 个测试实例中生成模型在 21 个上优于原模型，部分问题求解快两个数量级以上；agent 中位约 15 分钟返回最优变体；非 agent 基线未复现同等收益。
Conclusion: 自主 agent 方法可以支撑约束模型的改进，且收益来自迭代诊断与修复这一机制，而非仅仅采样多个候选。

papers.title: PTQ4SNN: Membrane-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) enable sparse and event-driven computation, but their low-bit deployment remains incomplete because recurrent membrane states are commonly retained in floating point even after weight quantization. Quantizing these states is challenging because their distributions differ across channels and from the preceding weights, while small perturbations near the firing threshold may alter spike decisions and accumulate over time. We propose PTQ4SNN, a membrane-aware post-training quantization framework that jointly quantizes weights and recurrent membrane states using only a small calibration set. First, a channel-wise Unified Scale Bridge constrains the membrane scale as s_mem,c = s_w,c * 2^k_c, adapting to membrane distributions while enabling shift-compatible scale conversion. Second, Mixed-Precision Bit Allocation assigns 2/4/8-bit precision to membrane channels according to firing activity and quantization sensitivity under an average-bit budget. The framework operates on reusable projection-LIF pairs and supports both convolutional SNNs and spike-driven Transformers without backbone retraining. Experiments on static and event-based classification and semantic segmentation show that PTQ4SNN effectively preserves model accuracy under W4 quantization and approximately 4-bit membrane precision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PTQ4SNN 在仅用小校准集的条件下，把 SNN 的权重与循环膜电位状态一起做训练后量化：用通道级 Unified Scale Bridge 把膜尺度约束为 s_mem,c = s_w,c * 2^k_c，再按发放活动与量化敏感度以 Mixed-Precision Bit Allocation 在平均比特预算内分配 2/4/8-bit。在静态与事件分类及语义分割上，W4 权重加约 4-bit 膜精度即可基本保持模型精度，且无需重训骨干。
Motivation: SNN 权重量化后循环膜状态仍留在浮点，低比特部署不完整；膜分布在通道间及其与前序权重间差异大，且发放阈值附近的小扰动会改变 spike 决策并随时间累积。
Method: 通道级 Unified Scale Bridge 将膜尺度约束为 s_mem,c = s_w,c * 2^k_c，兼顾膜分布并支持 shift-compatible 尺度转换；Mixed-Precision Bit Allocation 按发放活动与量化敏感度在平均比特预算内给膜通道分配 2/4/8-bit；作用于可复用的 projection-LIF 对，覆盖卷积 SNN 与 spike-driven Transformer，无需骨干重训练，仅用小校准集。
Result: 在静态分类、事件分类与语义分割任务上，PTQ4SNN 在 W4 权重量化加约 4-bit 膜精度的设置下有效保持模型精度。
Conclusion: 训练后联合量化权重与膜状态即可让 SNN 达到约 4-bit 膜精度而不必重训骨干，前提是用尺度桥约束膜分布并按发放活动做混合比特分配。

summary_sections.method: 通道级 Unified Scale Bridge 将膜尺度约束为 s_mem,c = s_w,c * 2^k_c，兼顾膜分布并支持 shift-compatible 尺度转换；Mixed-Precision Bit Allocation 按发放活动与量化敏感度在平均比特预算内给膜通道分配 2/4/8-bit；作用于可复用的 projection-LIF 对，覆盖卷积 SNN 与 spike-driven Transformer，无需骨干重训练，仅用小校准集。
summary_sections.result: 在静态分类、事件分类与语义分割任务上，PTQ4SNN 在 W4 权重量化加约 4-bit 膜精度的设置下有效保持模型精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 训练后联合量化权重与膜状态即可让 SNN 达到约 4-bit 膜精度而不必重训骨干，前提是用尺度桥约束膜分布并按发放活动做混合比特分配。

papers.title: HLSmith: An Expert-Guided Agentic Framework for C/C++-to-HLS Translation
papers.abstract_en: Application-specific FPGA accelerators offer substantial performance and energy-efficiency gains across many application domains, but developing them is costly, often requiring months of specialized effort. Even with high-level synthesis (HLS), designers still need extensive hardware expertise to build high-performance accelerators. Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong software-generation capabilities, even frontier models lack the hardware intuition and procedural knowledge needed to reliably translate baseline C/C++ programs into high-performance HLS designs: they struggle to identify effective architectures, follow the optimization processes used by HLS experts, and apply hardware transformations consistently across diverse kernels. We present HLSmith, an expert-guided framework for translating C/C++ programs into optimized HLS accelerators. HLSmith combines three components: an HLS optimization expertise library that encodes guarded transformation recipes, their applicability and prerequisite conditions, and unsafe cases to avoid; a staged, feedback-driven orchestration flow modeled on expert HLS development practice that guides agents through synthesis, bottleneck analysis, and optimization; and a tool-grounded model-adaptation pipeline that converts optimization trajectories from commercial frontier models into training data for fine-tuning open-weight LLMs. We evaluate HLSmith on PolyBench against ChatHLS, a leading prior agent-orchestration framework for HLS accelerator development. HLSmith achieves a geometric mean speedup of 4.24x over ChatHLS while producing functionally correct designs, in both software and RTL simulation, for every benchmark, compared with ChatHLS's 57% valid-design rate. It further reaches speedups of up to 252x and 138x with commercial frontier models and open-weight models, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HLSmith 是专家引导的 agentic 框架，把 C/C++ 程序翻译成高性能 HLS 加速器：用带前置条件与禁用场景的优化配方库约束变换，按综合、瓶颈分析、优化的分阶段反馈流程编排 agent，并把商业前沿模型的优化轨迹转成训练数据微调开源权重 LLM。在 PolyBench 上对比 ChatHLS，几何平均加速 4.24x，且全部 benchmark 在软件与 RTL 仿真中功能正确（ChatHLS 有效设计率 57%），单例最高 252x（商业模型）与 138x（开源模型）。
Motivation: LLM 缺少硬件直觉与流程性知识，难以稳定识别有效架构、跟随 HLS 专家的优化流程并跨 kernel 一致施加硬件变换；而 FPGA 加速器开发即便用 HLS 也常需数月专业投入。
Method: 三组件：HLS 优化专业知识库，编码带守卫条件的 transformation recipe、适用与前置条件以及需规避的 unsafe case；以专家 HLS 开发实践为蓝本的分阶段反馈式编排流，引导 agent 走综合、瓶颈分析与优化；tool-grounded 模型适配管线，把商业前沿模型的优化轨迹转为训练数据，微调开源权重 LLM。
Result: 在 PolyBench 上对比 ChatHLS：几何平均加速 4.24x，且每个 benchmark 都产出在软件与 RTL 仿真中功能正确的设计，而 ChatHLS 有效设计率为 57%；单个 benchmark 最高加速达 252x（商业前沿模型）与 138x（开源权重模型）。
Conclusion: 把专家优化知识显式编码成带条件的配方、再用分阶段反馈编排与轨迹蒸馏微调，能让 LLM 可靠产出功能正确的高性能 HLS 设计，显著超过既有 agent 编排框架。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CorePath: A Breast-Specialized Pathology Foundation Model for Core Needle Biopsy Diagnosis and Risk-Controlled Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Breast core needle biopsy (CNB) is central to breast cancer diagnosis yet remains challenging because limited tissue sampling, lesion heterogeneity, and subtle morphologic overlap can obscure subtype distinctions. We developed CorePath, a breast-specialized multimodal pathology foundation model fine-tuned from PRISM using 7901 paired CNB whole-slide images and diagnostic reports from two centers. Evaluated across six CNB cohorts and two public breast pathology benchmarks without task-specific retraining, CorePath consistently outperformed PRISM across cancer detection, invasion assessment, and histological subtyping. It achieved weighted area under the receiver operating characteristic curves (AUCs) of 0.9526-0.9735 for five-class CNB histological subtyping across private centers. On public benchmarks, CorePath outperformed leading pathology foundation models, achieving the highest weighted AUCs of 0.7780 for BCNB invasive carcinoma subtyping, 0.8178 for BRACS lesion stratification, and 0.8252 for BRACS fine-grained classification. In report generation, CorePath reduced the overall non-breast hallucinations from 30.1% to 2.8%, demonstrating improved domain fidelity after breast-specific adaptation. CorePath-CRG further combined conformal filtering of subtype and binary cancer status predictions with Learn-Then-Test-based threshold calibration to support selective narrative release, diagnostic fallback, and deferral. CorePath-CRG achieved zero non-breast hallucinations among released outputs and showed the strongest overall performance in pathologist-validated LLM-based Evaluation Scores and quantitative report-generation metrics across most centers. These results demonstrate that domain-specialized foundation models with statistical risk control offer a promising approach for accurate breast CNB diagnosis and reliable report generation.
papers.comment: The code will be made publicly available upon publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CorePath 是从 PRISM 微调的乳腺专科病理基础模型，用 7901 例配对 CNB 全切片与报告训练，在六个 CNB 队列和两个公开基准上零任务重训即全面超过 PRISM。五类 CNB 亚型加权 AUC 达 0.9526–0.9735，BCNB/BRACS 公开基准最高加权 AUC 0.7780/0.8178/0.8252；报告生成把非乳腺幻觉从 30.1% 降到 2.8%，叠加 conformal 过滤与 Learn-Then-Test 阈值校准的 CorePath-CRG 在已发布输出中实现零非乳腺幻觉。
Motivation: CNB 取材有限、病灶异质且形态重叠细微，通用病理基础模型在乳腺亚型区分与报告生成上易产生非乳腺幻觉，诊断可靠性不足。
Method: 以 PRISM 为底座，用两个中心 7901 例配对 CNB WSI 与诊断报告微调得到 CorePath；CorePath-CRG 在亚型与二分类癌症状态预测上做 conformal filtering，并用 Learn-Then-Test 校准阈值，支持选择性发布、诊断回退与转交，评测覆盖六个 CNB 队列和两个公开乳腺病理基准且不做任务重训。
Result: 私有中心五类 CNB 亚型加权 AUC 0.9526–0.9735；公开基准上 BCNB 浸润癌亚型加权 AUC 0.7780、BRACS 病灶分层 0.8178、BRACS 细粒度分类 0.8252，均高于领先病理基础模型；报告生成非乳腺幻觉由 30.1% 降至 2.8%，CorePath-CRG 已发布输出中非乳腺幻觉为 0，并在多数中心的病理医生验证 LLM 评测分与量化报告指标上最强。
Conclusion: 领域专科化基础模型叠加统计风险控制，可同时提升乳腺 CNB 诊断精度与报告生成可靠性；风险受控的选择性发布是消除非乳腺幻觉的可行路径。

papers.title: Sharp Characterization of Bias in Post-Bandit Inference
papers.abstract_en: Bandit algorithms generate data for downstream inference, but adaptive sampling biases post-bandit sample means. We analyze this bias for stable index algorithms, including UCB1 and its generalizations, and derive sharp leading-order expressions for the sample-mean bias and expected $Z$-statistic, in bandit experiments of fixed horizon $T$. Our characterization reveals the algorithmic origin of bias through a key index-function-dependent quantity, which we term effective exploration rate. For example, under UCB1, the effective exploration rate is of order $\sqrt{\log T}$, and the standardized bias of any arm (that is not uniquely optimal) decays at the extremely slow rate $1/\sqrt{\log T}$. We also show how the choice of the index function affects both regret and bias, which reveals a regret-bias trade-off: more exploratory algorithm reduces bias but increases regret. We further show how bias most severely distorts confidence intervals and hypothesis tests when the tested arm is one of the tied-optimal arms. Our sharp characterization for bias uses a novel empirical fluid approximation of the algorithm's sampling dynamics, which may be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 bandit 自适应采样导致的事后推断偏差，用经验流体近似 (empirical fluid approximation) 给出 stable index 算法（含 UCB1 及其推广）样本均值偏差与期望 Z 统计量的 sharp 首阶表达式。UCB1 下 effective exploration rate 为 √(log T) 量级，任何非唯一最优臂的标准化偏差以 1/√(log T) 的极慢速度衰减；探索性越强的 index 函数偏差越小但 regret 越大，且当被检验臂是并列最优臂之一时置信区间与假设检验失真最严重。
Motivation: bandit 算法产生的自适应数据会污染下游推断：事后样本均值有偏，而固定时域 T 下这种偏差的首阶大小此前缺少 sharp 刻画，导致置信区间与假设检验的可靠性无法判断。
Method: 对 stable index 算法类（含 UCB1 及其推广）用一种新的经验流体近似刻画算法采样动力学，导出样本均值偏差与期望 Z 统计量的 sharp 首阶表达式；引入 index 函数相关的 effective exploration rate 作为偏差的算法起源量，并据此比较不同 index 函数对 regret 与 bias 的影响。
Result: UCB1 下 effective exploration rate 为 √(log T) 量级，任一非唯一最优臂的标准化偏差以 1/√(log T) 极慢速率衰减；index 函数选择同时改变 regret 与 bias，呈探索越多偏差越小、regret 越大的 trade-off；被检验臂为并列最优臂之一时，置信区间与假设检验的失真最严重。
Conclusion: 事后 bandit 推断的偏差可由 effective exploration rate 做 sharp 首阶刻画，且与 regret 存在内在权衡；推断时须特别警惕被检验臂属于并列最优的情形。

papers.title: Models as Governed Interfaces for AI-Native MBSE: Read-Side Adequacy and Write-Side Admissibility
papers.abstract_en: Machine-readable models such as SysML v2 are now programmatically accessible, and a growing body of work treats that access as the enabling condition for AI participation in systems engineering. Access is necessary, but not sufficient. The remaining work lies not in the modelling language but in the data architecture around it. An AI reader that queries a structurally complete model for a derivation still runs into absent derivation chains, untagged epistemic status, missing provenance, and evidence that the model cannot resolve. Faced with these gaps, it does not abstain; it fills them from training data, a source that is neither verifiable nor governed. To make the case on a model that is exemplary by current practice rather than deficient, we probe the public Apollo 11 SysML v2 reconstruction. We name the missing property epistemic adequacy and offer it as a candidate data-architecture pattern in two halves. Read-side adequacy lets derivation, status, and provenance answer a query rather than invite a guess; write-side admissibility gates an AI contribution before it enters the record. The property is broken down into five criteria. Four sit on the read side, evidenced by the case and convergent literature; the fifth sits on the participation side, advanced as a hypothesis this paper does not yet test. The architecture space runs from an inline metadata extension up to a substrate-native multi-model store, and over it, we propose the Governed-Query Architecture Framework, which governs agent participation through the viewpoint conventions that engineers already use. We commit the reframing to falsification: the epistemic layer counts as refuted if it cannot beat a retrieval-augmented baseline on the same model, tested first on the Apollo chain and then in an industrial pilot.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 29th International Conference on Model Driven Engineering Languages and Systems (MODELS), 4-9 October 2026, Malaga, Spain, as a New Ideas and Emerging Results (NIER) paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出把 AI 参与 MBSE 的关键从建模语言转向数据架构：以 epistemic adequacy 为性质，拆成读侧充分性（read-side adequacy，让推导链、认知状态、来源可直接回答查询）与写侧可容许性（write-side admissibility，在 AI 贡献入库前把关），并给出 Governed-Query Architecture Framework，用工程师已有的 viewpoint 约定约束 agent 参与。作者承诺可证伪：若该认知层在 Apollo 11 SysML v2 模型上打不过同模型上的 retrieval-augmented 基线，即视为被推翻。
Motivation: SysML v2 等机器可读模型已可编程访问，但结构完整的模型仍可能缺推导链、未标注认知状态、缺 provenance，AI 查询时会用训练数据填补而非弃答，产生不可核验、不受治理的记录。
Method: 以公开的 Apollo 11 SysML v2 重建为案例（按当前实践属典型而非缺陷模型），提出 epistemic adequacy 性质并拆为五条准则：四条在读侧，由案例与汇聚文献佐证，第五条在参与侧、作为本文尚未检验的假设；其上提出 Governed-Query Architecture Framework，架构空间从 inline metadata extension 到 substrate-native multi-model store。
Result: 五条准则中四条落在读侧并由 Apollo 11 案例与文献佐证，第五条（写侧把关）作为假设提出且尚未检验；作者给出可证伪判据：认知层须在同一 Apollo 模型上胜过 retrieval-augmented 基线，先在 Apollo 链上测试，再做工业试点。
Conclusion: AI 参与系统工程的瓶颈在模型周边的数据架构而非建模语言：读侧要让查询被回答而非被猜测，写侧要在贡献入库前把关，且该框架以能否打赢 RAG 基线为成立条件。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 以公开的 Apollo 11 SysML v2 重建为案例（按当前实践属典型而非缺陷模型），提出 epistemic adequacy 性质并拆为五条准则：四条在读侧，由案例与汇聚文献佐证，第五条在参与侧、作为本文尚未检验的假设；其上提出 Governed-Query Architecture Framework，架构空间从 inline metadata extension 到 substrate-native multi-model store。
summary_sections.result: 五条准则中四条落在读侧并由 Apollo 11 案例与文献佐证，第五条（写侧把关）作为假设提出且尚未检验；作者给出可证伪判据：认知层须在同一 Apollo 模型上胜过 retrieval-augmented 基线，先在 Apollo 链上测试，再做工业试点。
summary_sections.conclusion: AI 参与系统工程的瓶颈在模型周边的数据架构而非建模语言：读侧要让查询被回答而非被猜测，写侧要在贡献入库前把关，且该框架以能否打赢 RAG 基线为成立条件。

papers.title: Parameter-Free Dynamic Regret under Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.abstract_en: We study online convex optimization with one unbiased stochastic subgradient per round and noise having a finite $p$-th central moment, where $p\in(1,2]$ is unknown. For a bounded convex domain of diameter $D$, subgradients bounded by $G$, noise scale $σ$, and comparator path length $P_T$, let $Λ_T=1+P_T/D$. A single algorithm, using none of $G,σ,p,P_T$, attains expected dynamic regret $O_p\left(\min\{GD\sqrt{TΛ_T}+σDT^{1/p}Λ_T^{(p-1)/p},\,GDT\}\right)$ against every fixed comparator sequence. Restarted AdaGrad experts produce the noise-path exponent $(p-1)/p$, and a prior favoring longer restart intervals removes horizon-dependent logarithmic overhead. We give an explicit bound uniform in $p$; its logarithm-free form has noise coefficient $O(1+\log(p/(p-1)))$, while the static-regret constant is universal. The analysis requires only marginal noise moments and permits dependent errors. Complete pathwise proofs retain both the expert-loss range and the gradient energies preceding comparator movement. Matching lower bounds hold on every bounded convex domain of positive diameter, under the same gradient-only information model. Together with a path-budget-tuned upper bound, they characterize the minimax rate with universal constants, including its linear-regret saturation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线凸优化中噪声仅知有限 p 阶中心矩且 p∈(1,2] 未知时，单个不依赖 G、σ、p、P_T 的算法即可达到期望动态 regret O_p(min{GD√(TΛ_T)+σDT^{1/p}Λ_T^{(p-1)/p}, GDT})。重启 AdaGrad experts 给出噪声路径指数 (p-1)/p，偏向更长重启区间的先验去掉 horizon 相关对数开销；匹配下界在所有正直径有界凸域上成立，刻画了 minimax 率及其线性饱和。
Motivation: 重尾（有限 p 阶矩、p 未知）噪声下的动态 regret 需要同时对未知 p、未知路径长度 P_T 和未知噪声尺度自适应，而常规算法通常需要调参或引入 horizon 相关对数损失。
Method: 用重启 AdaGrad experts 构造单个算法，不使用 G、σ、p、P_T；以偏向更长重启区间的先验消除 horizon 依赖的对数开销；分析只需边际噪声矩并允许相依误差，路径无关证明保留专家损失范围与比较点移动前的梯度能量；在梯度信息模型下给出匹配下界。
Result: 期望动态 regret 上界 O_p(min{GD√(TΛ_T)+σDT^{1/p}Λ_T^{(p-1)/p}, GDT})，Λ_T=1+P_T/D；对 p 一致的显式界其无对数形式噪声系数为 O(1+log(p/(p-1)))，静态 regret 常数为普适常数；匹配下界在每个正直径有界凸域上成立，配合 path-budget 调参的上界刻画 minimax 率（含线性 regret 饱和）。
Conclusion: 未知重尾指数与未知路径长度下的动态 regret 可由单个免调参算法达到 minimax 率，代价是噪声项按 T^{1/p} 增长并在大 Λ_T 时线性饱和。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Chaos Is a LADDER: Domain Generalization Beyond Invariance via Reweighting
papers.abstract_en: Domain generalization (DG) aims to learn from multiple source domains and generalize to unseen target domains. Most DG methods pursue invariance: they seek a causal representation whose prediction rule is invariant across domains. This principle is effective when the causal mechanism is stable, but becomes restrictive when the domain itself modulates how causal content maps to the response. In this case, directly feeding domain style into the predictor can create misleading shortcuts, since style does not by itself cause the response. Yet the apparent chaos of multiple styles can become a ladder: style can locate the unseen target domain among source domains and guide which domain-dependent prediction rules should be trusted. We propose \emph{Latent Adaptive Domain Disentanglement and Environment Reweighting} (LADDER), a fixed-model DG pipeline that learns causal/style representations, freezes the encoders, fits source-specific classifiers, and uses an unlabeled target-domain covariate set only at inference to compute weights over these fixed classifiers, with no target labels or model-state updates. We establish theoretical guarantees for source reweighting and validate LADDER on simulations, FMoW, and a location-grouped iWildCam protocol, with gains in overall and group-averaged accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LADDER：领域泛化中不追求预测规则跨域不变，而是冻结因果/风格编码器、拟合各源域专用分类器，仅用无标签目标域协变量在推理时对这些固定分类器加权。理论给出源域重加权的保证，并在模拟、FMoW 与按地点分组的 iWildCam 协议上验证，总体与分组平均准确率均有提升。
Motivation: 当领域本身调制因果内容到响应的映射时，追求不变性的 DG 方法会受限；直接把 domain style 喂给预测器又会因 style 不直接导致响应而制造误导性捷径。
Method: LADDER 是固定模型的 DG 流水线：学习因果表征与风格表征，冻结编码器，拟合 source-specific 分类器，推理时仅用无标签的目标域协变量集对这些固定分类器计算权重，不使用目标标签也不更新模型状态；并为源域重加权建立理论保证。
Result: 在模拟数据、FMoW 以及按地点分组 (location-grouped) 的 iWildCam 协议上验证，总体准确率与分组平均准确率 (group-averaged accuracy) 均取得提升。
Conclusion: 当领域调制因果映射时，用无标签目标风格定位目标域并重加权源域专用预测规则，比追求跨域不变更有效，且无需目标标签或模型更新。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Quasi-SVD: Learning a Lie-constrained matrix factorisation for real-time imaging
papers.abstract_en: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) underlies matrix factorisation tasks across many fields, with imaging applications demanding real-time processing. Yet SVD algorithms are inherently sequential, constraining real-time GPU throughput and limit online deployment in imaging pipelines. This study introduces a fully parallelized matrix factorization framework for GPUs by enforcing matrix orthogonality on left singular vectors via Lie-parametrised algebra and recovering the remaining components through soft constraints. This asymmetric constraint design enables an efficient parallel and provably valid decomposition, achieves high reconstruction fidelity and substantially accelerates computation relative to the exact SVD, with real-time throughput exceeding standard video frame rates. Performance is evaluated on multiple imaging tasks spanning complementary computational regimes: (1) spatio-temporal background subtraction for ultrasound localisation microscopy, requiring high-dimensional matrix separation, (2) Mueller matrix polarimetry for neurosurgical tissue characterisation, requiring massive batch processing of small matrices, and (3) an MNIST denoising benchmark at an intermediate scale with known ground truth. Across regimes and instruments, the proposed framework demonstrates robust domain transfer at various matrix scales, sufficient for live image-guided workflows that classical solvers cannot currently support in these settings. By prioritising downstream reconstruction fidelity over exact spectral recovery, the proposed SVD framework makes structured matrix factorisation practical for real-time processing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Quasi-SVD 用 Lie 参数化代数把左奇异向量的正交性写成可并行的约束，其余分量用软约束恢复，从而在 GPU 上跑通实时矩阵分解。吞吐超过标准视频帧率，覆盖超声定位显微、Mueller 矩阵偏振与 MNIST 去噪三类成像任务，牺牲精确谱恢复换取下游重建保真度。
Motivation: SVD 算法本身是串行的，限制了 GPU 实时吞吐与成像流水线的在线部署；成像场景需要的是重建保真而非精确谱恢复。
Method: 以 Lie 参数化代数对左奇异向量施加矩阵正交约束（非对称约束设计），其余分量通过软约束恢复，得到可完全并行、且被证明有效的分解；在超声定位显微的时空背景减除、神经外科组织表征的 Mueller 矩阵偏振（大批量小矩阵）与 MNIST 去噪三个计算体制上评测。
Result: 相对精确 SVD 显著加速，实时吞吐超过标准视频帧率；在跨体制、跨仪器的多种矩阵规模上展示稳健的域迁移，支撑经典求解器目前无法支持的实时图像引导工作流。
Conclusion: 把正交性做成可并行的 Lie 约束、优先保下游重建而非精确谱，可让结构化矩阵分解实用到实时成像。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: DailyBench: A Unified Benchmark for AI-Generated and Manipulated Images from Modern Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative models have shifted AI-generated image detection from identifying easily distinguishable, fully synthetic images to identifying highly realistic content generated by both modern generation and manipulation pipelines. However, existing detection benchmarks are often built with outdated generative models and primarily emphasize full-image synthesis, creating a growing mismatch between benchmark data and the images encountered in real-world generation and editing scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce DailyBench, a high-quality unified benchmark for evaluating whether AI-generated image detectors can generalize across both modern full-image synthesis and object-level manipulation. DailyBench contains two complementary subsets: FakeBench, which includes high-quality images synthesized by recent open-source and commercial generative models, and ManipulationBench, which introduces challenging object-level edits applied to real images using advanced image-conditional models. This design makes DailyBench a realistic testbed for studying both generator-level generalization and manipulation-aware detection under subtle local edits. Experiments on DailyBench reveal substantial robustness gaps in current detectors: methods reporting 91-96% balanced accuracy on GenImage drop to 52-79% on FakeBench and 43-67% on ManipulationBench. These results show that existing detectors remain poorly generalized to realistic synthesis and manipulation, highlighting DailyBench as a rigorous testbed for developing robust and manipulation-aware AI-generated image detection methods. The project is available at https://dailybench.github.io/

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DailyBench 是评测 AI 生成与编辑图像检测器的统一基准，含 FakeBench（近期开源与商业生成模型的全图合成）与 ManipulationBench（用 image-conditional 模型对真实图像做物体级局部编辑）两个子集。在 GenImage 上报 91–96% balanced accuracy 的检测方法，迁移到 FakeBench 掉到 52–79%，在 ManipulationBench 上掉到 43–67%。
Motivation: 现有检测基准多用过时生成模型、且偏重全图合成，与真实世界中现代生成和物体级编辑图像的分布脱节，无法衡量检测器的泛化能力。
Method: 构建两个互补子集：FakeBench 收集近期开源与商业生成模型的高质量全图合成图像；ManipulationBench 用先进的 image-conditional 模型在真实图像上施加物体级编辑，用于考察 generator-level generalization 与 manipulation-aware detection。
Result: 在 GenImage 上 balanced accuracy 为 91–96% 的检测方法，在 FakeBench 上降至 52–79%，在 ManipulationBench 上降至 43–67%。
Conclusion: 现有 AI 生成图像检测器对真实感合成与局部编辑的泛化很差，需要在覆盖现代生成与操纵管线的基准上重新训练与评测。

papers.title: Adaptive Confidence-weighted Expansion for Trustworthy Multi-Omics Multimodal Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning is a robust approach to improve predictive performance in applications such as medical prognosis. However, the clinical applicability of models that use multimodal learning is hampered by their poor performance under noisy or uninformative data streams. Present fusion approaches often lack robust mechanisms for the dynamic assessment of data quality and for the provision of a trustable confidence score on the final prediction. This dissuades their deployment in safety-critical settings. To address these limitations, we introduce Adaptive Confidence-weighted Expansion (ACE), a novel framework to enhance the trustworthiness of multimodal fusion models. ACE first enhances the multimodal space by generating new, complementary modalities from intra-modality correlations. It then employs a dual-level confidence mechanism that (1) adaptively reweighs all modalities by their reliability before fusion and (2) estimates a global trust score over the fused, final decision. To evaluate ACE, we used four challenging multi-omics datasets (BRCA, KIPAN, LGG, and ROSMAP). ACE significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art algorithms in both classification performance and confidence calibration. Our framework provides a more stable and robust data fusion method that facilitates the use of multimodal learning in addressing high-stakes problems.
papers.comment: Published in the proceedings of the International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多组学多模态融合框架 ACE：先从模态内相关性生成互补新模态扩展多模态空间，再用双层置信机制在融合前按可靠性重加权各模态、并对融合后的最终决策给出全局信任分。在 BRCA、KIPAN、LGG、ROSMAP 四个多组学数据集上，ACE 在分类性能与置信度校准两方面均显著优于现有最先进算法。
Motivation: 多模态学习在医疗预后等应用中受噪声或无信息数据流拖累，现有融合方法缺少对数据质量的动态评估机制，也无法给出可信任的最终预测置信分，阻碍其在安全关键场景部署。
Method: ACE 框架分两步：先基于模态内相关性生成互补的新模态以增强多模态空间；再用双层置信机制，融合前按各模态可靠性自适应重加权，融合后估计覆盖最终决策的全局信任分 (global trust score)。
Result: 在四个多组学数据集 BRCA、KIPAN、LGG、ROSMAP 上，ACE 在分类性能与置信度校准 (confidence calibration) 两方面均显著优于现有 state-of-the-art 算法。
Conclusion: 按可靠性动态重加权并输出全局信任分的融合方式，能在多组学数据上同时提升分类表现与校准质量，使多模态学习更适合高风险问题。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: ACE 框架分两步：先基于模态内相关性生成互补的新模态以增强多模态空间；再用双层置信机制，融合前按各模态可靠性自适应重加权，融合后估计覆盖最终决策的全局信任分 (global trust score)。
summary_sections.result: 在四个多组学数据集 BRCA、KIPAN、LGG、ROSMAP 上，ACE 在分类性能与置信度校准 (confidence calibration) 两方面均显著优于现有 state-of-the-art 算法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 按可靠性动态重加权并输出全局信任分的融合方式，能在多组学数据上同时提升分类表现与校准质量，使多模态学习更适合高风险问题。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Delivery Drone-Based Participatory Sensing in Dynamic Environments
papers.abstract_en: Using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) for urban sensing has emerged as a powerful paradigm to monitor the status of the city, e.g., air quality and noise levels, through agile aerial crowdsourcing. Despite this potential, existing UAV-based sensing approaches overlook environmental disturbances like wind that drastically impact drone velocity and energy efficiency. Consequently, directly applying existing methods to this joint delivery and sensing paradigm in dynamic environments faces two severe challenges: (1) scalability bottlenecks as fleet sizes expand; and (2) multi-timescale decision heterogeneity between macro task dispatching and micro velocity control. To tackle these, we formalize the problem as SensUAV and propose a Two TimeScale Reinforcement Learning framework (TSRL). Specifically, TSRL separates decision-making into two cooperative layers. At the macro level, a task-embedding sensing dispatcher handles scalability by separately encoding distinct task features and sequentially evaluating UAV suitability before task selection. At the micro level, a wind-aware velocity controller learns fine-grained velocity scheduling to adapt to dynamic environmental variations. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that TSRL significantly outperforms baselines, achieving average system profit improvements of 20.1% in Hangzhou and 46.6% in Shanghai.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026 (Research Paper Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把配送无人机的联合配送-感知问题形式化为 SensUAV，并提出双时间尺度强化学习框架 TSRL：宏观层用任务嵌入的感知调度器逐个编码任务特征、按 UAV 适配度顺序评估以缓解机队扩容的可扩展性瓶颈，微观层用风感知速度控制器学习细粒度速度调度以适应风扰动。在杭州与上海真实数据集上，TSRL 平均系统收益较基线分别提升 20.1% 与 46.6%。
Motivation: 现有 UAV 城市感知方法忽略风等环境扰动对无人机速度与能效的影响，直接套用到动态环境下的配送-感知联合范式会遇到机队规模扩大时的可扩展性瓶颈，以及宏观任务派发与微观速度控制之间的多时间尺度决策异质性。
Method: 将问题形式化为 SensUAV，提出双时间尺度强化学习 (TSRL)：宏观层的任务嵌入感知调度器分别编码不同任务特征并在选任务前顺序评估 UAV 适配度，微观层的风感知速度控制器学习细粒度速度调度以适应动态环境变化，两层协同决策。
Result: 在真实世界数据集上的实验中，TSRL 平均系统收益 (system profit) 显著超过基线：杭州提升 20.1%，上海提升 46.6%。
Conclusion: 把宏观任务派发与微观风感知速度控制拆成两个协同层的双时间尺度 RL，能在动态风扰动下的配送-感知联合任务中同时应对可扩展性与多时间尺度决策异质性，并带来两位数的系统收益提升。

papers.title: Semi-Automated Detection of Gaps in LLM Security Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for a range of software, hardware and human-centered security tasks. Consequently, LLM performance on security tasks is an active area of measurement and research, often with a focus on identifying areas in which LLM security "knowledge" may be insufficient. Popular strategies for identifying LLM security knowledge gaps include building corpora of challenge questions or task benchmarks, strategies that require substantial manual work and security expertise to design and execute. We introduce a partially-automated method for assessing LLM knowledge of a security area. The method uses authoritative information from Consumer Protection Agencies (CPAs) to identify instability in LLM responses that can be indicative of knowledge gaps. We demonstrate the method for 2 security topics, identity theft and impostor scams, and 5 LLMs in 2 leading LLM families, Gemini and GPT, using publicly available information about identity theft and impostor scams from 6 CPAs. The method distinguishes between models that have and don't have sufficient knowledge to accurately identify the security topics in text narratives.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种半自动方法，用消费者保护机构 (CPAs) 的权威信息构造扰动，检测 LLM 在安全知识上的不稳定性，并把这种不稳定性作为知识缺口的指示。在身份盗窃与冒名诈骗两个主题、Gemini 与 GPT 两大系列共 5 个模型、6 个 CPA 来源上演示，该方法能区分是否具备足够知识以在文本叙述中准确识别这两个安全主题。
Motivation: 现有识别 LLM 安全知识缺口的做法依赖人工构建挑战问题集或任务基准，需要大量安全专业知识与手工投入。
Method: 从 6 个消费者保护机构 (CPAs) 采集身份盗窃与冒名诈骗的公开权威信息，用这些信息对 LLM 提问并观察回答的不稳定性 (instability)，以不稳定性指示知识缺口；在 Gemini 与 GPT 两个系列的 5 个 LLM 上演示。
Result: 在 2 个安全主题（identity theft、impostor scams）、5 个 LLM、2 个模型家族、6 个 CPA 上演示；方法能区分具备与不具备足够知识、无法在文本叙述中准确识别这两个安全主题的模型。
Conclusion: 利用外部权威来源的响应不稳定性可以半自动地评估 LLM 在某一安全领域的知识，替代需要大量人工的挑战问题集与基准构建。

papers.title: FlowMimic: Mask-free Visual Editing and Generation with Pixel-pair Warped Flow Field for Online Video Editing Data Generation and Modality Mimicry
papers.abstract_en: In line with the prevailing direction of vision research, we explore the integration of both generation and editing capabilities for video and image modalities within a single model. Current approaches to collecting video editing data typically depend on labour-intensive, time-consuming curated procedures--involving object mask annotation, the use of error-introducing pair synthesis via I2V model and ControlNet-like guidance, and VLM-based quality filtering or refinement--and demonstrate limited task scalability. As a result, the diversity of editing tasks remains substantially narrower than that available for image editing models. We develop a pixel-pair temporal warped flow field that can directly generate corresponding video editing samples in real time from image editing samples, and we demonstrate across multiple levels of video editing tasks that a model can learn video editing using only such data. We regard the image modality as a particular form of the video modality. Accordingly, we design a modality mimic generation loss and a modality mimic editing loss to relatively align the capabilities--and thereby the output distributions--of the two modalities through mutual imitation. Moreover, language-based visual editing entails the comprehension of the editing instruction and the reference visual content, the localization of the region corresponding to that instruction within the reference visual contents, and the modification of that region alone. Existing approaches predominantly rely on external aids, such as fine-tuning an additional MLLM or explicitly supplying a mask sequence as auxiliary input during inference. In contrast, we aspire for the model to internalize this capability. To that end, we introduce sense-related tasks--for instance, referring expression segmentation--along with corresponding editing-region-aware latent-level loss and attention-level loss.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowMimic 把图像编辑样本经像素对时序扭曲流场 (pixel-pair temporal warped flow field) 实时转成视频编辑样本，仅用这类数据即可训练视频编辑，并用模态模仿生成/编辑损失让图像与视频模态互相模仿以对齐输出分布。语言驱动编辑的区域定位不靠外部 MLLM 微调或显式 mask 输入，而是通过引入 referring expression segmentation 等感知任务与编辑区域感知的 latent/attention 损失内化到模型中。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑数据采集依赖物体 mask 标注、I2V 与 ControlNet 引导的成对合成、VLM 质量过滤，费时且任务可扩展性差，导致编辑任务多样性远窄于图像编辑模型。
Method: 提出 pixel-pair temporal warped flow field，从图像编辑样本实时生成对应视频编辑样本；设计 modality mimic generation loss 与 modality mimic editing loss，把图像视为视频的特例形式，通过互相模仿对齐两模态能力与输出分布；再引入 referring expression segmentation 等感知任务，配合 editing-region-aware 的 latent-level loss 与 attention-level loss，让模型内化指令-区域定位能力，无需外部 MLLM 微调或推理时 mask 序列输入。
Result: 在多个层级的视频编辑任务上展示了仅用流场生成的编辑样本即可学会视频编辑；图像与视频两模态的能力与输出分布通过互相模仿损失被相对对齐。
Conclusion: 视频编辑数据可以绕开 mask 标注与 VLM 过滤的采集流程，由图像编辑样本经流场变换实时合成；指令-区域定位与单区域修改这类能力可通过感知任务和区域感知损失内化进单一生成-编辑模型，无需外部辅助输入。

papers.title: Simulate to Generalize: Scaling Stateful Supervision for API-calling Agents using LLM World Models
papers.abstract_en: Training agents that generalize to unseen, stateful environments requires a massive dataset of state-changing trajectories covering a vast and diverse set of APIs. However, scaling this broad supervision is severely bottlenecked by the immense effort required to implement and populate fully-executable environments across a broad spectrum of domains. To bypass this barrier, we introduce a data generation pipeline that decouples data synthesis from environment construction by leveraging LLMs as digital world models. Starting from only a list of broad domain names, our automated pipeline synthesizes diverse APIs and tasks. To produce trajectories, a teacher agent iteratively solves these tasks while an LLM simulator dynamically tracks state and provides coherent API responses on-the-fly. Finally, an automated judge filters the trajectories for quality. Fine-tuning on our broad synthetic dataset yields significant performance gains on AppWorld and OfficeBench, two challenging stateful benchmarks featuring environments completely unseen during training. These results establish our LLM world model-based synthesis approach as a highly scalable path for training generalizable, stateful API-calling agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用 LLM 充当数字世界模型的合成数据管线：从领域名列表出发自动合成 API 与任务，教师 agent 在 LLM 模拟器动态维护状态、即时返回 API 响应的条件下解题，再由自动 judge 过滤轨迹。用该合成数据微调后，在训练时完全未见环境的两个有状态基准 AppWorld 与 OfficeBench 上取得显著性能提升。
Motivation: 训练能泛化到未见有状态环境的 agent 需要覆盖大量 API 的状态变迁轨迹，但构建并填充可执行环境成本极高，成为扩展监督信号的瓶颈。
Method: 管线分三步：仅给定宽泛领域名，自动合成多样化 API 与任务；教师 agent 迭代解题，同时由 LLM 模拟器在线维护状态并生成连贯的 API 响应，产出轨迹；最后用自动 judge 按质量过滤轨迹，得到大规模合成数据集用于微调。
Result: 在 AppWorld 与 OfficeBench 两个环境于训练时完全未见的有状态基准上，微调该宽泛合成数据集带来显著性能提升（abstract 未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 以 LLM 世界模型做轨迹合成可绕开环境构建成本，是训练可泛化有状态 API 调用 agent 的高扩展性路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Plausible to Actionable: A Position on LLM Self-Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate natural language explanations that rationalize their own decisions, a phenomenon commonly referred to as self-explanations. Such explanations have emerged as a promising direction for explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), particularly for interpreting LLM behavior. However, while self-explanations often appear plausible, whether they faithfully reflect a model's underlying reasoning process remains an open question. In this opinion paper, we argue that self-explanations can be highly plausible, questionably faithful, and yet highly actionable. From a traditional XAI perspective, we identify the limitations of standard evaluation protocols for LLM-generated self-explanations and propose practical guidelines for assessing their plausibility and faithfulness. Moreover, we argue that evaluation should extend beyond these criteria to actionability, highlighting applications of LLM rationalization capabilities that support informed decision-making and appropriate action across diverse stakeholders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇立场论文主张 LLM 自解释 (self-explanation) 可以高度 plausible、faithfulness 存疑、却高度 actionable：应把评估从 plausibility 与 faithfulness 两项标准扩展到 actionability，即能否支撑不同利益相关方的知情决策与恰当行动。作者给出评估 plausibility 与 faithfulness 的实用指南，并指出标准评估协议存在局限。
Motivation: LLM 自解释看起来合理但未必忠实反映模型内部推理，现有 XAI 评估协议只盯 plausibility 与 faithfulness，无法判断这些解释对实际决策是否有用。
Method: 以立场论文形式，先指出标准 LLM 自解释评估协议的局限，再提出评估 plausibility 与 faithfulness 的实用指南，并把 actionability 作为第三类评估维度，围绕 LLM 合理化 (rationalization) 能力支撑跨利益相关方决策的应用展开论证。
Result: 提出三轴论断：自解释可高度 plausible、faithfulness 可疑、同时高度 actionable；给出评估 plausibility 与 faithfulness 的实践指南，并主张评估须扩展到 actionability。全文为 5 页观点论文，无实验数字。
Conclusion: 对 LLM 自解释的取舍不应停在忠实性上：即便 faithfulness 存疑，只要能支撑知情决策与恰当行动，这类解释就具备使用价值。

summary_sections.motivation: LLM 自解释看起来合理但未必忠实反映模型内部推理，现有 XAI 评估协议只盯 plausibility 与 faithfulness，无法判断这些解释对实际决策是否有用。
summary_sections.method: 以立场论文形式，先指出标准 LLM 自解释评估协议的局限，再提出评估 plausibility 与 faithfulness 的实用指南，并把 actionability 作为第三类评估维度，围绕 LLM 合理化 (rationalization) 能力支撑跨利益相关方决策的应用展开论证。
summary_sections.result: 提出三轴论断：自解释可高度 plausible、faithfulness 可疑、同时高度 actionable；给出评估 plausibility 与 faithfulness 的实践指南，并主张评估须扩展到 actionability。全文为 5 页观点论文，无实验数字。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对 LLM 自解释的取舍不应停在忠实性上：即便 faithfulness 存疑，只要能支撑知情决策与恰当行动，这类解释就具备使用价值。

papers.title: CFR-Net:Collaborative Feature Refinement Network for Medical Image Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Medical image anomaly detection is central to timely diagnosis and clinical decision support, yet abnormal samples are costly to collect because of disease rarity, privacy concerns, and expert workload. This motivates unsupervised learning from normal images, where abnormalities are detected as deviations from learned normal patterns. However, medical anomalies are often subtle, local, and intertwined with normal anatomical variations, which complicates reliable normality modeling. Distillation-based methods support normality modeling by using frozen pretrained teachers as stable feature references, yet mismatches between generic teacher priors and student representations adapted to medical images can produce residuals unrelated to abnormalities in conventional distillation pipelines. To address this limitation, we propose the Collaborative Feature Refinement Network, which learns normality through a coupled process of shared feature conditioning before decoding and cross-space consistency after decoding. Shared feature conditioning performs medical-aware conditioning on teacher and student features under common rules, while cross-space consistency constrains each decoded stream with the complementary encoder representation for reciprocal normal reconstruction. The coupled process is further stabilized by the homework set reorganization strategy, which periodically refreshes normal training subsets. Experiments on six medical image benchmarks show competitive anomaly classification and strong anomaly localization performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CFR-Net 用解码前的共享特征条件化 (shared feature conditioning) 与解码后的跨空间一致性 (cross-space consistency) 耦合约束蒸馏式正常性建模，并用 homework set reorganization 定期刷新正常训练子集来稳定训练。在六个医学图像基准上，异常分类表现具竞争力、异常定位表现强。
Motivation: 医学异常样本因疾病稀少、隐私与专家标注成本难以收集，且异常细微、局部并与正常解剖变化交织；通用预训练 teacher 先验与适配医学图像的 student 表征不匹配，会在常规蒸馏管线中产生与异常无关的残差。
Method: 提出 Collaborative Feature Refinement Network：解码前对 teacher 与 student 特征施加同一规则下的医学感知条件化，解码后用互补的 encoder 表征约束各解码流做互惠正常重建；再以 homework set reorganization 策略周期性刷新正常训练子集，稳定这一耦合过程。
Result: 在六个医学图像基准上，异常分类 (anomaly classification) 具有竞争力，异常定位 (anomaly localization) 表现强。
Conclusion: 把 teacher/student 的特征对齐放到解码前后两端并配合训练子集刷新，可以改善蒸馏式无监督医学异常检测的正常性建模。

papers.title: Converge to Surprise: Evolutionary Self-supervised Image Clustering
papers.abstract_en: A variety of self-supervised image clustering approaches are invented in the past years. However, all dominant approaches are exploitative: The direction of parameter updates is determined by known states (observed input samples and existing parameters). We propose an explorative self-supervised learning framework that steps out of this zone. We define a surprise score that measures how unlikely the model's output representation is, assuming that all pixels are i.i.d. random noise. Maximizing the surprise score forces the deep learning model to reject the random noise null hypothesis, or equivalently, to discover non-randomness from data. Also, we propose a fundamental assumption: a surprise score cannot, in general, be fully optimized by exploitative optimization approaches. Thus, we propose the converge-to-surprise scheme to optimize a model: an evolution-strategy (ES) outer loop, which maximizes the surprise score using the mutation-selection mechanism, paired with a periodic gradient-descent inner loop, which uses the surprising clusters already discovered by ES as surrogate targets. On simple image benchmarks, our framework trained from scratch achieves new state-of-the-art results in non-parametric self-supervised image clustering --- the strictest deep-clustering setting, where the number of classes is unknown during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出探索式自监督图像聚类框架：定义 surprise score 衡量模型输出表征在「所有像素为 i.i.d. 随机噪声」零假设下有多不可能，并用 converge-to-surprise 方案优化——ES 外环以变异-选择最大化 surprise score，周期性梯度下降内环把 ES 已发现的惊奇簇当作代理目标。在简单图像基准上从零训练，在类别数训练时未知的非参数自监督聚类这一最严格设定下取得新的 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有主导自监督聚类方法都是 exploitative：参数更新方向由已知状态（观测样本与既有参数）决定，无法一般性地最大化 surprise score。
Method: converge-to-surprise 双层优化：evolution-strategy (ES) 外环用 mutation-selection 机制最大化 surprise score，配对周期性 gradient-descent 内环，以 ES 已发现的惊奇簇作 surrogate targets 训练深度模型；surprise score 假设全部像素为 i.i.d. 随机噪声，最大化它等价于拒绝该零假设、从数据中发现非随机性。
Result: 在简单图像基准上从零训练，在非参数自监督图像聚类（训练时类别数未知，作者称为最严格的 deep-clustering 设定）取得新的 state-of-the-art 结果。
Conclusion: surprise score 无法被 exploitative 优化一般性地充分优化，探索式 ES 外环加梯度内环的组合是解锁该目标的可行路径。

papers.title: Route-MHT: Multimodal Transformer Guardrails for Thermal Visual Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Strong mapped-region thermal visual place recognition (VPR) does not ensure safe rejection of unmapped queries. We identify and quantify this gap in AnyThermal: high Map-In retrieval accuracy coexists with confident false loop closures in Map-Out. We address it with ROUTE-MHT, a multimodal transformer guardrail. Causal motion forms a route-local candidate pool beyond the frontend's Top-$K$. Closed-form $\text{SE}(2)$ SVD verifies candidates, while frozen visual features, nine-dimensional SVD residuals, and motion proxies enter a masked multi-head transformer (MHT). Their interactions yield a contextual confidence correction to reject unsupported matches without altering geometric pose alignment. We collect an indoor thermal dataset with a physical mobile robot (Dataset-A), forming five same-day/cross-day map-query pairs; the protected interface reaches macro R@1@5m of .610/.861. Dataset-B comprises 20 map-hole scenarios derived from public STheReO-KAIST recordings. Across five scenario-held-out folds and three seeds, ROUTE-MHT reduces FPR from .116 for the SVD baseline to .061 (paired 95% CI [-.100, -.014]), while improving AUC from .945 to .967 and recall from .884 to .914. Public benchmark transfer checks on STheReO-KAIST, MS2, and IRSLAM-KRI extend the evaluation under their released metric or route-progress protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROUTE-MHT 用多模态 Transformer 护栏解决热成像视觉地点识别 (VPR) 中 Map-Out 查询被自信误闭环的问题：因果运动构造超越 Top-K 的路线局部候选池，闭式 SE(2) SVD 验证后，将冻结视觉特征、九维 SVD 残差与运动代理送入 masked multi-head transformer 输出上下文置信度修正。在 Dataset-B 的五个 map-hole 场景留出折与三个种子上，FPR 从 SVD 基线的 .116 降到 .061（配对 95% CI [-.100, -.014]），AUC 从 .945 升到 .967，recall 从 .884 升到 .914。
Motivation: 热成像 VPR 在已映射区域检索精度高，但对未映射查询 (Map-Out) 会给出自信的错误闭环，AnyThermal 中 Map-In 高检索精度与 Map-Out 高置信误闭环并存，直接威胁回环检测安全性。
Method: ROUTE-MHT：因果运动在前端 Top-K 之外构造路线局部候选池，闭式 SE(2) SVD 验证候选；冻结视觉特征、九维 SVD 残差与运动代理输入 masked multi-head transformer (MHT)，交互产生上下文置信度修正以拒绝无支撑匹配，不改动几何位姿对齐。评测含自采室内热成像数据集 Dataset-A（实体移动机器人，五个同日/跨日 map-query 对）与 Dataset-B（由公开 STheReO-KAIST 录制派生的 20 个 map-hole 场景），五个场景留出折、三个种子。
Result: Dataset-A 上受保护接口 macro R@1@5m 达 .610/.861。Dataset-B 上 ROUTE-MHT 将 FPR 从 SVD 基线 .116 降至 .061（配对 95% CI [-.100, -.014]），AUC 从 .945 升至 .967，recall 从 .884 升至 .914；另在 STheReO-KAIST、MS2、IRSLAM-KRI 上按各自发布指标或 route-progress 协议做迁移检查。
Conclusion: 在几何验证之上加一层多模态置信度修正，可在不改变位姿对齐的前提下压低未映射查询的误闭环率并同时抬高 AUC 与 recall，即安全拒绝与检索精度可以同时改善。

papers.title: Enhancing Fitness Intelligence through Domain-Specific LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Scientific Fitness Coaching (SFC) is typically delivered by human professionals, making it costly and inaccessible to many. While recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) show considerable promise for more inclusive fitness coaching, directly deploying prevailing general-purpose LLMs in SFC reveals critical limitations. These models often lack sufficient domain-specific knowledge integration, leading to weak performance on complex SFC scenarios. In this paper, we introduce FitOne, a series of fitness LLMs (with 8B and 32B parameters) designed to improve reliability and domain specialization for SFC applications. Built upon the Qwen3 foundation models, FitOne is developed through a three-stage post-training pipeline consisting of continual pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning, using large-scale, high-quality datasets derived from rigorous knowledge engineering. We conduct comprehensive evaluations of FitOne on professional fitness certification exams, including ACSM-EP and NSCA-CSCS, as well as general capabilities such as knowledge reasoning and instruction following. Experimental results show that, while retaining strong general capabilities, FitOne-8B/32B achieves average improvements of up to 10.09%/9.29% and 12.73%/7.01% on the ACSM-EP and NSCA-CSCS exams, respectively, compared with the Qwen3 base models. Furthermore, in-depth ablation studies confirm the necessity of each training stage, highlighting the pipeline's effectiveness in balancing domain expertise enhancement with general ability retention. We believe this research advances LLM systems toward more reliable fitness intelligence and will inspire future research on developing domain-specific LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FitOne 是面向科学健身教练 (SFC) 的领域 LLM 系列（8B/32B），基于 Qwen3 用三阶段后训练管线——继续预训练、监督微调、强化学习——配合知识工程构建的大规模数据集。在 ACSM-EP 与 NSCA-CSCS 认证考试上，FitOne-8B/32B 相对 Qwen3 base 平均分别提升至多 10.09%/9.29% 与 12.73%/7.01%，同时保留通用能力。
Motivation: 通用 LLM 直接用于科学健身教练缺乏领域知识整合，在复杂 SFC 场景上表现弱；而真人教练成本高、可及性差。
Method: 以 Qwen3 基座模型为起点，走三阶段后训练：继续预训练、监督微调 (SFT)、强化学习 (RL)，训练数据来自严格知识工程流程产出的大规模高质量数据集；评测覆盖专业健身认证考试与通用知识推理、指令跟随能力，并做逐阶段消融。
Result: FitOne-8B/32B 相对 Qwen3 base 在 ACSM-EP 考试上平均提升至多 10.09%/9.29%，在 NSCA-CSCS 上提升 12.73%/7.01%；消融研究确认每个训练阶段都必要，且通用能力得以保留。
Conclusion: 三阶段后训练管线能在提升领域专业性的同时保住通用能力，是把通用 LLM 做成可靠健身智能的可行路径。

papers.title: Conditional Co-Ablation: Recovering Self-Repair Backups in Transformer Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability seeks to explain transformer behavior through circuits: sets of internal components that causally support a behavior. However, self-repair creates a blind spot: ablating a primary component can activate a dormant backup, so a circuit that explains behavior in the intact model can become incomplete under the intervention used to test it. We formulate this gap as conditional circuit completion: given a primary set, identify components that become causally important after its removal. We introduce conditional co-ablation (CoAx), which ranks candidates by growth in ablation effect after primary-set removal. We show that a perfectly dormant backup can be indistinguishable from an irrelevant component to per-unit intact-state scores, whereas its conditional effect change exactly aggregates all interaction orders linking it to the removed set. On GPT-2-small's Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit, CoAx recovers the documented backup heads at 0.941 ROC-AUC, versus 0.815 for the strongest intact-state attribution baseline and 0.758 for the matched conditional-energy control. Recovery drops to 0.40 +/- 0.13 AUC for alternative component sets matched in behavioral effect, output displacement, and depth, showing that recovery is specific to the removed circuit. Beyond recovery, the CoAx-selected heads are causally load-bearing: freezing them after primary removal sharply reduces the IOI margin, while adding them to the incomplete circuit reduces incompleteness from 0.75 to 0.21. More broadly, conditional growth aligns with intervention-derived repair in 11/12 held-out instances across 4 mechanism clusters, and CoAx completions outperform matched random completions on all 8 non-GPT-2 models spanning 6 architecture families. Together, causal explanations of self-repairing transformers must account for backup circuitry when primary components fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出条件性共同消融 (CoAx)，按主组件被移除后消融效应的增长量给候选组件排序，用于找回 Transformer 中的自修复备份回路。在 GPT-2-small 的 IOI 电路上以 0.941 ROC-AUC 恢复已记录的备份头，高于最强 intact-state 归因基线 0.815 与匹配条件能量对照 0.758；把选出的头补入不完整电路可把 incompleteness 从 0.75 降到 0.21。
Motivation: 自修复使消融主组件时潜伏备份被激活，用干预检验电路反而让原本解释行为的回路显得不完整；per-unit 的 intact-state 打分无法区分完全休眠的备份与无关组件。
Method: CoAx 以主集合移除后消融效应的增长量排序候选，其条件效应变化恰好聚合该候选与被移除集合之间的全部交互阶；在 GPT-2-small 的 Indirect Object Identification (IOI) 电路上检验，并用行为效应、输出位移与深度匹配的替代组件集做对照。

papers.title: Rethinking Post-Hoc Calibration in Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable confidence estimates are essential in semantic segmentation, yet modern models often remain miscalibrated. We investigate two overlooked issues in post-hoc calibration. First, adding a constant to all logits leaves softmax probabilities unchanged, but several standard calibrators depend on this arbitrary offset. In segmentation, this offset can vary across pixels or voxels, introducing spatially varying representation dependence. We characterize translation-invariant (TI) calibrators and construct TI counterparts of shift-sensitive methods. Second, calibrating with cross-entropy can degrade segmentation quality due to mismatched training and calibration objectives and limited calibration data. We investigate decision-preserving calibration under argmax- and order-preservation constraints. Since these constraints restrict affine softmax calibrators to temperature scaling, we introduce more expressive class-conditional affine calibrators that preserve decisions. Across natural-image and medical segmentation benchmarks, including corruption-based covariate shift, TI variants generally improve calibration, while decision-preserving variants prevent segmentation degradation by construction and retain strong calibration performance. Our findings provide practical design principles for post-hoc calibration in semantic segmentation.
papers.comment: Accepted at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 语义分割的事后校准有两个被忽视的问题：标准校准器依赖 softmax 不变的任意 logit 偏移，且用交叉熵校准会损害分割质量。作者刻画平移不变 (TI) 校准器并构造 shift-sensitive 方法的 TI 对应版本，同时在 argmax 与序保持约束下引入类条件仿射校准器；在自然图像与医学分割基准（含 corruption 引起的协变量偏移）上，TI 变体普遍改善校准，decision-preserving 变体按构造不损害分割质量并保持强校准表现。
Motivation: 分割中 logit 偏移可随像素/体素变化，使校准器产生空间变化的表示依赖；而校准目标与训练目标不匹配加上校准数据有限，会让交叉熵校准拉低分割质量。
Method: 刻画平移不变校准器并为 shift-sensitive 方法构造 TI 对应版本；在 argmax 与 order-preservation 约束下分析 decision-preserving 校准，指出约束把 affine softmax 校准器限制为 temperature scaling，进而引入更有表达力且保持决策的类条件仿射 (class-conditional affine) 校准器。
Result: 在自然图像与医学分割基准、含 corruption-based covariate shift 的设置下：TI 变体普遍改善校准；decision-preserving 变体按构造避免分割质量下降，同时保持强校准表现。
Conclusion: 事后校准设计应同时处理 logit 偏移的表示依赖与校准/训练目标不匹配：用 TI 校准器换稳定性，用 decision-preserving 的类条件仿射校准器保分割质量。

papers.title: Learning 1-Bit LiDAR-based Localization with Auxiliary Objective
papers.abstract_en: 6-DoF LiDAR-based localization is a fundamental capability for autonomous systems operating in large-scale outdoor environments. Many deep-learning-based localization methods have achieved promising performance so far. However, as one of the always-on modules competing for limited on-board computational resources, the localization module is expected to consume only a small portion of the overall compute budget. Most existing learning-based methods are still too heavy for this purpose. In contrast, binary neural networks (BNNs) offer an appealing solution, but the 1-bit compression causes severe information loss and performance drop. In this paper, we address this challenge by proposing Binarized LiDAR-based Localization (BiLoc), the first binary neural network framework for 6-DoF LiDAR localization. Specifically, we reinterpret the training of BNNs from the perspective of the information-bottleneck principle, aiming at retaining minimal yet sufficient representations for pose estimation while suppressing redundant variations. And we introduce an auxiliary objective that adaptively regulates information retention in the binary encoder, effectively mitigating the information loss caused by binarization. This auxiliary objective provides additional optimization signals that compensate for the limited representational capacity and the gradient mismatch inherent in BNNs. Extensive experiments on large-scale outdoor LiDAR datasets demonstrate that BiLoc establishes a new state of the art for LiDAR localization with BNNs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BiLoc，首个面向 6-DoF LiDAR 定位的二值神经网络 (BNN) 框架：从信息瓶颈 (information-bottleneck) 视角重解 BNN 训练，并加一个自适应调节二值编码器信息保留的辅助目标，以补偿二值化造成的信息损失、有限表示能力与梯度失配。在大规模室外 LiDAR 数据集上，BiLoc 创下 BNN 用于 LiDAR 定位的新 SOTA。
Motivation: 定位模块作为常开模块只能占很少机载算力，现有深度学习定位方法普遍过重；BNN 能压到 1-bit 但信息损失严重、性能大幅下降。
Method: 以信息瓶颈原理重新解释 BNN 训练，在位姿估计上保留最小而充分的表示并抑制冗余变化；引入辅助目标自适应调控二值编码器的信息保留，为 BNN 补充额外优化信号以抵消有限表示容量与梯度失配。
Result: 在大规模室外 LiDAR 数据集上的大量实验表明，BiLoc 在 BNN 类 LiDAR 定位中建立新的 state of the art。
Conclusion: 用信息瓶颈视角加辅助目标来管住 1-bit 编码器的信息保留，可以让二值网络在极低算力下仍支撑 6-DoF LiDAR 定位。
