papers.title: SOLAR: AI-Powered Speed-of-Light Performance Analysis
papers.abstract_en: How fast could a deep-learning model run on target hardware, and how far is today's implementation from that limit? These questions are central to software, hardware, and algorithm optimizations. Speed-of-Light (SOL) analysis answers them by computing a workload's theoretical minimum execution time on a given architecture. Yet deriving SOL bounds remains manual, error-prone, and disconnected from rapid model development. To close this gap, we introduce SOLAR, a framework that automatically derives validated SOL bounds from PyTorch and JAX source code. SOLAR leverages both generative and deterministic components in its flow: an LLM frontend translates any source programs into an executable Affine Loop IR, validated by output comparison; a deterministic flow lifts the IR into an einsum graph; and an analytical backend computes unfused, fused, and cache-aware SOL bounds. SOLAR provides comprehensive operator and language coverage, produces validated bounds with zero observed SOL violations, and offers multi-fidelity analysis that tightens bounds and surfaces optimization insights. We evaluate SOLAR across KernelBench, JAX/Flax models, and robotics workloads. These experiments demonstrate four use cases: headroom analysis at multiple fidelity levels, identifying optimization opportunities, cross-platform exploration, and inverse-roofline hardware provisioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SOLAR 自动从 PyTorch/JAX 源码推导深度学习算子的 Speed-of-Light (SOL) 理论最小执行时间上界：LLM 前端把源程序翻译成可执行 Affine Loop IR 并用输出比对校验，确定性流程将其提升为 einsum 图，解析后端计算 unfused、fused 与 cache-aware 三档上界。在 KernelBench、JAX/Flax 模型与机器人工作负载上验证，观测到零 SOL 违例，并展示 headroom 分析、优化机会识别、跨平台探索与 inverse-roofline 硬件配置四类用例。
Motivation: 回答「模型在目标硬件上能跑多快、当前实现离极限多远」目前靠手工推导 SOL 界，易出错且与快速迭代的模型开发脱节。
Method: 生成式与确定性混合流水线：LLM 前端将任意源程序译为可执行 Affine Loop IR（用输出比对验证），确定性流程把 IR 提升为 einsum 图，解析后端计算 unfused、fused、cache-aware 三档 SOL 界；提供多保真度分析以收紧界。
Result: 在 KernelBench、JAX/Flax 模型与机器人工作负载上评测，产出经验证的界且观测到零 SOL 违例；展示四类用例：多保真度 headroom 分析、识别优化机会、跨平台探索、inverse-roofline 硬件配置。
Conclusion: SOL 界可以从源码自动、可验证地推导出来，取代手工流程，并通过多保真度收紧给出可操作的优化与硬件配置洞察。

papers.title: Accelerating Disaggregated RL for Visual Generative LLMs with Diffusion-Based Parallelism and Trainer-Assisted Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant post-training paradigm, driving the emergence of high-performance RL systems such as veRL for autoregressive large language models (LLMs). In parallel, diffusion-oriented RL algorithms, e.g., DanceGRPO and FlowGRPO, have rapidly expanded the scope of RL from language reasoning to diffusion-based visual and flow-based generation. However, efficient RL systems for diffusion generative LLMs remain underexplored. Existing implementations, e.g., veRL-Omni, still rely on colocated execution, which simplifies synchronization but couples rollout and training resources, limits heterogeneous deployment, and constrains independent scaling. To this end, we introduce DigenRL, a disaggregated RL framework for diffusion-based generative LLMs that supports flexible resource allocation, accommodates heterogeneous GPUs, and facilitates efficient task scheduling. To maximally reduce the execution bubbles in the disaggregated architecture, we propose: 1) a generation-axis pipeline (GAP) and time-step parallelism (TSP) in the diffusion architecture to enable finer-grained pipelining between rollout and training; 2) an elastic trainer-assisted generation (TAG) approach to enable the trainer GPU resources to dynamically assist in executing rollout generations; and 3) a tightly one-step constrained asynchronous strategy to further utilize the tail bubble in the pipeline. Extensive experiments are conducted on three hardware testbeds with 16-32 GPUs using HunyuanVideo-13B, Wan2.1-14B, FLUX.1-12B, and QwenImage-20B generative models. Experimental results show that DigenRL achieves 1.56-2.10x throughput improvements over state-of-the-art diffusion RL systems, veRL-Omni and GenRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DigenRL 把扩散生成式 LLM 的 RL 后训练从 colocated 改为 disaggregated 执行，并用生成轴流水线 (GAP)、时间步并行 (TSP)、弹性训练器辅助生成 (TAG) 与一步约束异步策略压缩流水线气泡。在 16–32 GPU 三套测试床上，对 HunyuanVideo-13B、Wan2.1-14B、FLUX.1-12B、QwenImage-20B，吞吐比 veRL-Omni 与 GenRL 高 1.56–2.10 倍。
Motivation: 现有扩散生成式 RL 系统（如 veRL-Omni）仍用 colocated 执行，rollout 与训练资源耦合，难以异构 GPU 部署与独立扩展，扩散生成式 LLM 的高效 RL 系统仍被忽视。
Method: 提出 disaggregated RL 框架 DigenRL，支持灵活资源分配与异构 GPU 调度；为减少气泡提出生成轴流水线 (GAP) 与扩散时间步并行 (TSP) 实现 rollout 与训练的细粒度流水，弹性训练器辅助生成 (TAG) 让训练 GPU 动态分担 rollout，以及紧耦合一步约束异步策略利用尾部气泡。
Result: 在三套硬件测试床、16–32 GPU 上，用 HunyuanVideo-13B、Wan2.1-14B、FLUX.1-12B、QwenImage-20B 四个生成模型，DigenRL 相对 SOTA 扩散 RL 系统 veRL-Omni 与 GenRL 取得 1.56–2.10 倍吞吐提升。
Conclusion: 扩散生成式 LLM 的 RL 后训练可以通过 disaggregated 执行加细粒度流水与训练器辅助 rollout 显著提速，且能异构 GPU 部署与独立扩展。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: IViT: A Novel Interpretable Visual Transformer for Skin Disease Detection
papers.abstract_en: The clinical diagnosis of skin diseases is susceptible to interference from inter-class similarity of skin lesions, and over-reliance on clinicians'experience easily leads to subjective bias. Although existing deep learning aided diagnosis methods achieve competitive accuracy, they suffer from the black-box opacity of Vision Transformer (ViT) and poor adaptability to medical few-shot scenarios. Moreover, mainstream explainable algorithms generally face the bottleneck of significant accuracy degradation when improving interpretability. This paper proposes an interpretable ViT (IViT) constrained by Quadratic Programming (QP). The introduced pre-trained transfer learning adapts to few-shot feature extraction. A discrete QP feature selection framework is constructed to screen generic and discriminative features consistent with clinical diagnostic logic. A multi-objective loss function is designed to reduce feature redundancy and optimize activation distribution while preserving classification performance. Experimental results on six standard skin disease datasets show that IViT achieves an accuracy of 93.80%, only 0.21% lower than the baseline, with feature redundancy reduced by 29.5%. Its core activation regions are consistent with clinically concerned lesion areas. The proposed model balances accuracy and interpretability, providing a reliable solution for the clinical deployment of few-shot intelligent skin disease diagnosis.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出二次规划约束的可解释视觉 Transformer (IViT)，用离散 QP 特征筛选保留与临床诊断逻辑一致的通用判别特征，配合多目标损失降低特征冗余并优化激活分布。在六个标准皮肤病数据集上准确率 93.80%，仅比基线低 0.21%，特征冗余降低 29.5%，核心激活区域与临床关注的皮损区一致。
Motivation: 皮肤病灶类间相似度高、易受医生主观偏差影响；现有 ViT 是黑箱且难适配医学小样本场景，主流可解释算法在提升可解释性时往往伴随明显精度下降。
Method: 在 ViT 上引入二次规划 (Quadratic Programming) 约束：用预训练迁移学习适配小样本特征提取，构建离散 QP 特征筛选框架筛出符合临床诊断逻辑的通用判别特征，并设计多目标损失函数在保持分类性能的同时降低特征冗余、优化激活分布。
Result: 在六个标准皮肤病数据集上准确率 93.80%，仅比基线低 0.21%，特征冗余降低 29.5%；模型核心激活区域与临床上关注的皮损区域一致。
Conclusion: QP 约束的特征筛选能在几乎不损失精度的前提下换取可解释性，使小样本皮肤病诊断模型具备临床部署的可靠性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Explanation-Guided Medical Named Entity Recognition with Stability and Boundary Awareness for Atopic Dermatitis
authors: Yugang Chi (3) ((1) School of Information and Software Engineering
University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
China (3) Chongqing Health Center for Women and Children
papers.abstract_en: Objective: This study aims to improve the reliability and robustness of medical named entity recognition (NER) in Chinese atopic dermatitis (AD) clinical texts through explanation-guided learning. Methods: We propose a stability and boundary-aware explanation-guided NER framework. Perturbation-based analysis is used to evaluate explanation stability and entity boundary sensitivity. An adaptive fusion strategy dynamically combines local and global explanation to generate more reliable token-level explanations. The fused explanation signals are further incorporated into model training through stability, boundary-aware, and consistency constraints. Results: Experiments on Chinese AD NER datasets show that the proposed framework improves explanation robustness and achieves consistent performance gains across multiple NER models. The adaptive fusion strategy also provides more stable explanations and stronger boundary perception than individual explanation methods. Conclusion: The proposed method effectively integrates reliable explanation signals into medical NER training, improving both recognition performance and explanation reliability. The framework provides a practical and generalizable solution for explainable medical NER and offers reliable support for downstream clinical decision-making and medical knowledge applications.
papers.comment: This preprint is withdrawn. We are restructuring the whole manuscript and revising the framework substantially to strengthen the novelty and experimental validation for journal review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出稳定性与边界感知的解释引导中文皮肤科（特应性皮炎）临床文本 NER 框架：用扰动分析评估解释稳定性与实体边界敏感性，自适应融合局部与全局解释，再以稳定性、边界感知与一致性约束注入训练。在中文 AD NER 数据集上提升解释鲁棒性，并在多个 NER 模型上取得一致性能增益。
Motivation: 中文特应性皮炎临床文本的医学 NER 可靠性与鲁棒性不足，解释信号本身不稳定、实体边界识别弱，影响下游临床决策支持。
Method: 先用基于扰动的分析度量解释稳定性与实体边界敏感性；自适应融合策略动态结合局部与全局解释，生成更可靠的 token 级解释；再把融合后的解释信号通过稳定性、边界感知与一致性三类约束接入模型训练。
Result: 在中文 AD NER 数据集上，框架提升解释鲁棒性，并在多个 NER 模型上取得一致的性能增益；自适应融合相比单一解释方法给出更稳定的解释与更强的边界感知。
Conclusion: 把可靠解释信号整合进医学 NER 训练可同时改善识别性能与解释可靠性，作者称该框架可推广到可解释医学 NER 与下游临床决策支持。

papers.title: Low-Rank Attention Residuals
papers.abstract_en: Attention Residuals (AttnRes) replace the fixed residual sum with depth-wise attention over previous sub-layer outputs in Large Language Models (LLMs), but use each output as both a full-dimensional key and value. This couples routing with representation and makes the cost of computing depth-routing scores scale with hidden width $d$. We propose Low-Rank Attention Residuals (LR-AttnRes), which keep full-dimensional residual values while using $r$-dimensional keys, with $r < d$, for routing. LR-AttnRes uses the last $r$ dimensions of each value as the routing key, reducing total residual-side FLOPs while still improving performance. Comprehensive sweeps across the number of blocks ($N$) and $r$ show that depth-wise routing can be effective with far fewer dimensions than the model width. At both $1$B and $4$B parameters with $r = d/4$, LR-AttnRes achieves lower final validation loss, higher average downstream accuracy, and higher measured training-step throughput than standard AttnRes. We also provide a fused kernel supporting standard and low-rank routing. We release all code, the kernel, and all trained models to facilitate future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LR-AttnRes 把 Attention Residuals 的深度路由键从全维降到 r 维（取值的最后 r 维），残差值仍保持全维，从而解耦路由与表示并降低残差侧 FLOPs。在 1B 与 4B 参数、r=d/4 时，其最终验证损失更低、下游平均准确率更高、实测训练步吞吐也高于标准 AttnRes。
Motivation: AttnRes 用同一输出同时充当全维 key 和 value，使深度路由打分的计算代价随隐藏宽度 d 线性增长，路由与表示被耦合。
Method: LR-AttnRes 保留全维残差 value，但只用每个 value 的最后 r 维（r<d）作为路由 key，对前序子层输出做 depth-wise attention 路由；作者对块数 N 与 r 做了系统扫描，并提供同时支持标准与低秩路由的 fused kernel。
Result: 在 1B 和 4B 参数、r=d/4 的设置下，LR-AttnRes 相对标准 AttnRes 取得更低的最终验证损失、更高的下游平均准确率和更高的实测训练步吞吐；跨 N 与 r 的扫描显示深度路由用远少于模型宽度的维度即可有效。
Conclusion: 深度路由所需维度可以远小于模型宽度，低秩键即可在降低残差侧计算成本的同时保持乃至提升性能；代码、fused kernel 与全部训练模型均已开源。

papers.title: Evidential Fusion Network for Multimodal Survival Prediction under Missing Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal survival prediction models have demonstrated strong predictive performance by leveraging complementary information across modalities. However, such models generally assume data completeness and exhibit limited robustness toward missing modalities, which are frequently encountered in real-world clinical settings. We propose the Evidential Missing Modality Survival Fusion (EMMS) model for multimodal survival prediction under missing modalities. EMMS offers a straightforward, computationally effective approach to survival analysis without requiring a generative phase for missing data. By employing Dempster-Shafer theory and Gaussian Random Fuzzy Numbers for multimodal decision fusion, it considers both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty alongside modality reliability for fusion. Moreover, the model treats missing modalities as vacuous evidence, preventing interference with available inputs and naturally reflecting increased uncertainty and calibrated predictions. Extensive experiments on four cancer datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance while providing calibrated and interpretable uncertainty estimates under incomplete multimodal observations, without introducing additional computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMMS 用 Dempster-Shafer 理论与 Gaussian Random Fuzzy Numbers 做多模态生存预测的证据融合，把缺失模态当作 vacuous evidence 而非补全，同时纳入偶然/认知不确定性与模态可靠性。在四个癌症数据集上达到 SOTA，并给出校准且可解释的不确定性估计，不引入额外计算开销。
Motivation: 多模态生存预测模型假设数据完整，而临床中模态缺失常见，导致鲁棒性不足；现有做法常需为缺失数据引入生成阶段。
Method: 提出 Evidential Missing Modality Survival Fusion (EMMS)：以 Dempster-Shafer 理论结合 Gaussian Random Fuzzy Numbers 融合多模态决策，融合时同时考虑 aleatoric 与 epistemic 不确定性及模态可靠性；缺失模态按 vacuous evidence 处理，无需生成式补全。
Result: 在四个癌症数据集上的实验达到 state-of-the-art 表现，同时在不完整多模态观测下给出校准且可解释的不确定性估计，且不引入额外计算开销。
Conclusion: 把缺失模态当作 vacuous evidence 并按证据理论融合，可在不加生成阶段、不加计算开销的前提下同时提升生存预测性能与不确定性校准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semantic-Anchored Evidential Fusion for Domain-Robust Whole-Slide Survival Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Whole-slide images (WSIs) are widely used for computational cancer prognosis. However, most existing methods primarily focus on in-domain performance and fail to generalize across clinical centers. This limitation stems from their reliance on pixel-derived representations that are highly susceptible to domain-specific artifacts caused by staining protocols and scanner hardware. We hypothesize that high-level pathology semantics, such as tumor grade and micro-environmental architecture, provide a domain-invariant semantic representation that mirrors the robust diagnostic logic of human pathologists. Therefore, we propose a Semantic-Anchored Evidential Fusion Survival (SAEFS) framework, where SAEFS derives semantic anchors from WSIs via Visual Question Answering (VQA), employs a dual-stream WSI evidence extraction architecture, uses Dirichlet-based Subjective Logic to model uncertainty, and fuses semantic and visual evidence through a cautious conjunction rule to avoid overconfident fusion from correlated sources. Trained exclusively on one source domain and evaluated zero-shot across four unseen domains, SAEFS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models both in prediction accuracy and reliability, improving the average C-index by 10.2%. Quantitative analyses further show that VQA-derived semantic features exhibit significantly lower cross-center divergence than pixel-derived features, highlighting their robustness for cross-center clinical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAEFS 用 VQA 从全切片图像 (WSI) 抽取高层病理语义作为语义锚点，配合双流证据提取与 Dirichlet 主观逻辑建模不确定性，再以谨慎合取规则融合语义与视觉证据，避免相关源的过度自信融合。仅在单一源域训练、对四个未见中心零样本评测时，平均 C-index 提升 10.2%，且 VQA 语义特征的跨中心差异显著低于像素特征。
Motivation: 现有 WSI 预后方法多只追求域内性能，依赖易受染色协议与扫描仪硬件伪影影响的像素级表示，跨临床中心泛化失败。
Method: 提出 Semantic-Anchored Evidential Fusion Survival (SAEFS)：先用 Visual Question Answering (VQA) 从 WSI 生成语义锚点，再用双流架构提取 WSI 证据，以 Dirichlet-based Subjective Logic 建模不确定性，最后通过 cautious conjunction rule 融合语义与视觉证据，防止相关源导致的过度自信。
Result: 仅在单一源域训练、在四个未见域上零样本评测，SAEFS 在预测精度与可靠性上均优于 SOTA，平均 C-index 提升 10.2%；VQA 语义特征的跨中心差异显著低于像素派生特征。
Conclusion: 高层病理语义是域不变表示，可让 WSI 生存分析跨中心稳健，零样本迁移下同时改善精度与可靠性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FinRED: An Expert-Guided Benchmark Generation and Evaluation Framework for Financial LLM Red-Teaming
papers.abstract_en: Existing safety benchmarks target general adversarial scenarios but miss finance-specific risks. Financial LLMs face regulatory compliance violations, fraud facilitation, and systemic trust erosion that require targeted evaluation. We introduce FinRED, an expert-guided red-teaming framework for financial LLM safety evaluation developed with financial experts. FinRED uses a novel two-level taxonomy mapping global standards (e.g., FATF and EU DORA) to threats ranging from regulatory evasion to complex fraud, integrated with a scalable pipeline that converts real financial documents into context-rich red-teaming Behavioral Prompts (seeds) through an expert-defined schema. Rigorous expert validation confirms seed plausibility and realism for meaningful LLM safety evaluation. We also provide an expert-validated, finance-specific rubric that goes beyond disclaimer checks, aligns more closely with human experts than static one-size-fits-all rubrics, and reduces critical false negatives from 28 to 12. Aligned with internationally adopted risk-management and information-security standards (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001), FinRED is deployed in South Korea's Financial Security Institute (FSI) regulatory sandbox for generative AI security evaluation in real financial services. To mitigate dual-use risks, the dataset, generation pipeline, prompt template, and evaluation framework are gated for qualified researchers at https://github.com/selectstar-ai/FinRED-paper and https://huggingface.co/datasets/datumo/FinRED.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FinRED 是面向金融 LLM 的专家引导红队评测框架：用两级分类法把 FATF、EU DORA 等全球标准映射到监管规避到复杂欺诈的威胁，再由管线把真实金融文档转成带上下文的 Behavioral Prompts 种子。专家验证的金融专用 rubric 超出免责声明检查，与人类专家的一致性高于静态通用 rubric，把关键假阴性从 28 降到 12。
Motivation: 现有安全基准覆盖通用对抗场景，缺少金融特有风险（监管违规、欺诈助长、系统性信任侵蚀）的针对性评测。
Method: 两级分类法将 FATF、EU DORA 等全球标准映射到从监管规避到复杂欺诈的威胁；可扩展管线按专家定义的 schema 把真实金融文档转为上下文丰富的红队种子 (Behavioral Prompts)，并配一套专家验证、超越免责声明检查的金融专用评分 rubric。
Result: 专家验证确认种子的合理性与真实性；金融专用 rubric 比静态通用 rubric 更贴近人类专家判断，把关键假阴性 (critical false negatives) 从 28 降至 12。
Conclusion: 金融 LLM 安全评测需要领域专用的分类法、种子与 rubric，FinRED 已在韩国金融安全院 (FSI) 监管沙盒中用于生成式 AI 安全评估；数据集与生成管线对合格研究者设门控以缓解双重使用风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Urban Access Costs from Origin-Destination Flows via Inverse Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Cities deliver basic services through mixed public-private facility networks, including schools, clinics, transit providers, and subsidized service points. In these systems, planners often observe where households go, but not the latent cost function through which they trade off factors such as distance, price, and institutional access. We study this urban problem through school choice in the Philippines, where the country's largest national education subsidy is intended to redirect learners from congested public schools to participating private schools. Treating school-to-school enrollment flows as an entropic optimal transport plan, we recover latent choice costs using two complementary inverse optimal transport models: an interpretable distance-banded model with a subsidy term, and a neural cost model trained through a differentiable Sinkhorn forward pass. Applied to 283{,}016 learner trips across 23{,}820 observed flows in the most populated region, the framework estimates a subsidy-equivalent distance, $λ^{(k)}$, interpreted as the kilometers of perceived travel cost offset by the subsidy. The case demonstrates how administrative origin-destination data can be transformed into interpretable planning metrics for accessibility-aware subsidy design, facility siting, and urban service allocation.
papers.comment: Oral Presentation. 2026 International Conference on Urban AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用逆最优传输 (inverse optimal transport) 从学校间的入学 OD 流反推城市潜在选择成本：把流建模为熵正则 OT 计划，用带补贴项的距离分段模型与经可微 Sinkhorn 前向训练的神经成本模型恢复成本函数，并估计补贴等效距离 λ^(k)（补贴抵消的感知出行公里数）。在菲律宾人口最多地区的 283,016 名学习者出行、23,820 条观测流上应用，把行政 OD 数据转成可用于补贴设计与设施选址的可解释指标。

Result: 在人口最多地区的 283,016 条学习者出行、23,820 条观测流上应用该框架，估计出补贴等效距离 λ^(k)，即补贴所抵消的感知出行公里数。

papers.title: DFAH-Bench: Benchmarking Observable Agent Instability in Financial Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: A financial agent can repeat a decision while changing the work behind it. DFAH-Bench operationalizes the Determinism--Faithfulness Assurance Harness (DFAH), pairing decision agreement with tool-path agreement on the same qualified replays, then extends that qualification principle to evidence, authorization, execution and task outcomes. Retrospective and prospective replay analyses expose process variation behind stable decisions. Across 570 eligible prospective episodes, decision agreement is 94.2-95.1%, while agreement on ordered tools, arguments and results is 45.0-51.5%; one stratum falls one group below its prespecified coverage minimum. A separate capture diagnostic shows that systematic omissions can preserve perfect replay agreement. Using the $τ$-Knowledge banking environment, we retain 1,080 scheduled episodes and 1,033 known native outcomes across separate cohorts with open-weight and frontier generators. Missing outcomes prevented the planned tests, so comparisons are descriptive. On the primary schedule, structural checks alone yield more successes than either gate-and-recovery bundle. The typed-choice bundle has lower mean episode cost than the generative bundle on complete task pairs, but produces fewer successes under every assignment of unknown outcomes. Input limits and recovery behavior materially shape these results. Fixed-state probes reveal higher decision agreement alongside lower agreement with constructed policy labels, and separately expose sensitivity to retained generator rationale in a selected authorization case. Together, the findings connect replay observability to evidence, authorization, completion and cost: evidence sufficiency needs direct assessment alongside repeatability.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 8 figures. Expanded version with interactive banking experiments, fixed-state gate probes, and cost analysis. Code and public artifacts: https://github.com/ibm-client-engineering/output-drift-financial-llms
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DFAH-Bench 把金融 agent 的决策一致性与工具路径一致性（工具、参数、结果的有序一致）配对评测，并扩展到证据、授权、执行与任务结果。570 个合格前瞻 episode 中决策一致率 94.2–95.1%，而有序工具/参数/结果一致率仅 45.0–51.5%；另有诊断显示系统性遗漏仍可保持完美重放一致。结论是仅看决策一致会掩盖过程漂移，证据充分性必须与可重复性一起直接评估。
Motivation: 金融 agent 可以重复同一决策却改变背后的执行过程，只看决策输出的评测无法暴露这种过程漂移，证据、授权与成本维度也缺少统一的可观测性口径。
Method: 实现 Determinism–Faithfulness Assurance Harness (DFAH)：在同一批合格重放 (qualified replays) 上配对决策一致与工具路径一致，再把该资格判定原则扩展到证据、授权、执行与任务结果；用回顾性与前瞻性重放分析、捕获诊断、固定状态探针 (fixed-state probes) 与成本分析，并在 τ-Knowledge banking 环境中按预设排程跨 open-weight 与 frontier 生成器分队列运行。
Result: 570 个合格前瞻 episode 中决策一致率 94.2–95.1%，有序工具、参数与结果一致率 45.0–51.5%，其中一个分层低于其预设覆盖下限一个组；捕获诊断显示系统性遗漏可保持完美重放一致。τ-Knowledge banking 环境保留 1,080 个排程 episode 与 1,033 个已知原生结果，因缺失结果计划中的检验未能进行，比较为描述性：主排程上仅结构检查的成功数多于两种 gate-and-recovery 组合，typed-choice 组合在完整任务对上的平均 episode 成本低于 generative 组合，但在未知结果的任何赋值下成功数都更少。固定状态探针显示决策一致更高而与构造策略标签的一致更低，并在一个授权案例中暴露对保留生成器 rationale 的敏感性。
Conclusion: 稳定决策不等于稳定过程，重放可观测性需与证据、授权、完成和成本连起来评估；证据充分性必须与可重复性一起直接评估，且输入限制与恢复行为会实质塑造结论。

papers.title: Beyond Agent Architecture: Execution Assumptions and Reproducibility in LLM-Based Trading Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems are increasingly proposed for financial trading, yet their reported performance remains difficult to compare because studies vary in data provenance, temporal split discipline, execution timing, turnover treatment, and transaction-cost modeling. This article presents a targeted topical review and reproducibility audit of execution realism in LLM-based trading research. A coded evidence matrix covering 30 trade-relevant primary studies is used to assess point-in-time controls, split transparency, held-out evaluation, cost and turnover treatment, execution semantics, universe definition, and artifact release. Across the audited sample, architecture reporting is generally clearer than the evaluation assumptions needed to judge whether a trading result is economically interpretable or reproducible. A 10-equity worked example is included only as a methodological scaffold to illustrate how explicit friction and timing choices can materially compress active-strategy results. The main conclusion is that the next useful step for LLM trading research is not only better agent design, but also clearer reporting standards for execution realism, reproducibility, and evaluation comparability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 30 项 LLM 交易研究做执行真实性 (execution realism) 的可复现性审计，发现架构报告普遍比评估假设（时点控制、切分、成本与换手、执行时序）更清楚，而后者才决定结果是否经济可解释。10 只股票的示例显示显式的摩擦与计时选择会明显压缩主动策略收益；作者主张下一步重点是执行真实性与可比性的报告标准，而非更好的 agent 设计。
Motivation: LLM 交易研究在数据来源、时间切分纪律、执行时点、换手处理和交易成本建模上差异很大，导致报告性能无法横向比较，也难以判断结果是否可复现、是否经济可解释。
Method: 定向主题综述加可复现性审计：构建覆盖 30 项交易相关原始研究的编码证据矩阵 (coded evidence matrix)，逐项评估 point-in-time 控制、切分透明度、留出评估、成本与换手处理、执行语义、股票池定义和工件发布；另附 10 只股票的 worked example 作为方法学脚手架。
Result: 在被审计样本中，架构报告普遍比判断交易结果经济可解释性与可复现性所需的评估假设更清晰；10 只股票示例说明显式的摩擦与计时选择会实质性压缩主动策略结果。
Conclusion: LLM 交易研究的下一个有用步骤不只是更好的 agent 设计，还需要对执行真实性、可复现性和评估可比性建立更清晰的报告标准。

papers.title: Agent Memory: Characterization and System Implications of Stateful Long-Horizon Workloads
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly deployed on long-horizon tasks requiring sustained reasoning over extended interaction histories. Realizing this at scale requires agents to persistently store, retrieve, and update their own memory across sessions. A rich ecosystem of agent memory systems has emerged spanning flat retrieval, LLM-mediated extraction, consolidating fact stores, and agentic control flows. Yet, their system-level behavior remains uncharacterized. We present the first systems characterization of agent memory. First, we introduce a system-oriented taxonomy classifying agent memory systems along four axes. Second, we build a phase-aware profiling harness attributing cost to construction, retrieval, and generation. Third, we characterize ten representative systems across two benchmark suites, uncovering how design choices shift cost across the write and read paths. Finally, we derive 10 system recommendations covering construction scheduling, capability floors, amortization via query volume, freshness-latency tradeoffs, and fleet-scale management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个 LLM agent 记忆系统的系统级刻画：提出四轴分类法，构建按阶段归因成本（construction、retrieval、generation）的 phase-aware profiling harness，对十个代表性系统在两套 benchmark 上做对比。发现设计选择会把成本在写路径与读路径之间转移，并据此给出 10 条系统建议，覆盖构造调度、能力下限、靠查询量摊销、freshness-latency 权衡与集群规模管理。
Motivation: agent 记忆系统生态已覆盖 flat retrieval、LLM-mediated extraction、fact store 与 agentic control flow，但其系统级行为此前没有被刻画，部署者无法判断成本落在写路径还是读路径。
Method: 沿四轴给 agent 记忆系统建系统导向分类法；构建 phase-aware profiling harness，把成本归因到 construction、retrieval、generation 三个阶段；在两套 benchmark suite 上刻画十个代表性系统，并从中推导 10 条系统建议。
Result: 十个代表性系统、两套 benchmark suite 的刻画显示设计选择会把成本在写路径与读路径之间转移；产出 10 条系统建议，主题为构造调度、capability floors、按查询量摊销、freshness-latency 权衡与 fleet-scale 管理。
Conclusion: agent 记忆的成本应按读写路径分阶段核算，构造调度与查询量摊销是主要杠杆，freshness 与 latency 需要一起权衡。

papers.title: AgenticDiffusion: Multi-View Reasoning with View-Conditioned Diffusion Planning for Vision-Based UAV Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based UAV navigation becomes challenging when navigation targets are distributed across complementary camera views and cannot be reliably observed from a single viewpoint. We propose AgenticDiffusion, an agentic multi-view UAV navigation framework that semantically coordinates first-person-view (FPV) and top-view observations for mission-level navigation. Given a natural-language instruction, AgenticDiffusion identifies the requested targets, selects the most appropriate camera view for each navigation task, determines the corresponding navigation goal, and invokes the appropriate view-conditioned diffusion planner for trajectory generation. The resulting trajectories are executed using Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC). AgenticDiffusion was evaluated in four real-world indoor scenarios, achieving an overall mission success rate of 80% across 40 physical-flight trials. In mixed-visibility scenarios, where the requested targets were distributed across FPV and top-view observations, coordinated multi-view navigation reduced average mission time by 50.8% relative to FPV-only navigation and by 26.8% relative to Top-only navigation. The semantic view-selection mechanism was also robust to lexical variation in target descriptions, achieving 100% accuracy across 66 test cases, compared with 63.64% for a confidence-based view-selection baseline. In a substantially larger Gazebo environment, AgenticDiffusion achieved a 90% mission success rate and completed the multi-stage mission, whereas the FPV-only and Top-only variants were unable to complete all requested navigation tasks.

papers.title: SAMatcher: Dense Co-Visibility Modeling via Cross-View Fusion for Scale-Imbalance Image Matching
papers.abstract_en: Reliable correspondence estimation supports image processing and 3D vision tasks, including Structure from Motion, visual localization, and image registration. Wide-baseline matching is difficult under cross-view scale imbalance. The same content may appear at different resolutions and spatial extents, creating unequal observation quality. Such pairs constitute low-quality multi-view data, even when each image is clear. Image information that is distinctive in one view may be weak or unavailable in the other. Existing methods rely on pixel- or patch-level appearance and do not explicitly identify where reliable evidence is shared across views. We propose SAMatcher, a modular co-visibility framework for scale-imbalanced image matching. It uses symmetric cross-view interaction to fuse the two feature representations and identify their shared spatial support. From the fused features, SAMatcher predicts dense co-visible masks and bounding boxes. These predictions define view-specific cropping windows for downstream point-level matching. Built upon the Segment Anything Model (SAM), SAMatcher extends monocular region modeling to cross-view co-visibility reasoning. Point-sampled mask learning, box regression, and mask--box consistency jointly supervise its multi-granularity predictions. Extensive experiments follow an evaluation protocol centered on cross-view scale imbalance. The results show that SAMatcher consistently improves matching robustness across diverse matching pipelines. When integrated with RoMa, SAMatcher improves AUC@5 and mAA@5 by 5.58 and 4.97 points, respectively. The results demonstrate that cross-view fusion and dense co-visibility modeling provide reliable priors for matching under scale-induced quality imbalance. Code and project page are available at https://xupan.top/projects/samatcher
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAMatcher 针对跨视图尺度失衡的宽基线图像匹配，用对称跨视图交互融合两路特征并定位共享空间支撑，预测稠密共视掩码与边界框作为下游点级匹配的裁剪窗口。接入 RoMa 后 AUC@5 提升 5.58 点、mAA@5 提升 4.97 点，说明跨视图融合与稠密共视建模能在尺度诱导的质量失衡下提供可靠先验。
Motivation: 宽基线匹配中同一内容在两视图分辨率与空间范围不同，观测质量不均，现有方法只依赖像素或 patch 级外观，不显式判断两视图共享的可靠证据位置。
Method: 基于 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 的模块化共视框架：对称跨视图交互融合两路特征并识别共享空间支撑，从融合特征预测稠密共视掩码与边界框，生成视图专属裁剪窗口供下游点级匹配；用点采样掩码学习、框回归与 mask–box 一致性联合监督多粒度预测。
Result: 在以跨视图尺度失衡为中心的评测协议下，SAMatcher 在多种匹配流程中一致提升鲁棒性；与 RoMa 集成时 AUC@5 提升 5.58 点、mAA@5 提升 4.97 点。
Conclusion: 跨视图融合与稠密共视建模可作为尺度失衡条件下匹配的可靠先验，且作为模块能嵌入不同匹配流程。

papers.title: minWM: A Full-Stack Open-Source Framework for Real-Time Interactive Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent video diffusion foundation models have achieved remarkable progress in high-quality video generation, yet turning them into real-time interactive video world models remains challenging. Interactive world models require controllable, causal, and low-latency rollout, which in practice demands a full pipeline spanning data construction, controllable fine-tuning, autoregressive training, few-step distillation, and streaming inference. In this work, we present minWM, a full-stack open-source framework for building real-time interactive video world models. minWM provides an end-to-end pipeline that converts existing bidirectional T2V/TI2V video foundation models into camera-controllable few-step autoregressive world models. Specifically, minWM first fine-tunes a bidirectional video diffusion model with camera control, and then applies the Causal Forcing / Causal Forcing++ pipeline, including AR diffusion training, causal ODE or causal consistency distillation, and asymmetric DMD, to distill it into a few-step autoregressive generator for low-latency rollout. The framework is modular and architecture-extensible: we instantiate it on representative open backbones, including Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B and HY1.5-TI2V-8B, covering both cross-attention-based condition injection and MMDiT-style architectures. minWM also supports adapting existing video world models, such as HY-WorldPlay, to new data distributions, training recipes, and latency targets. Beyond releasing runnable scripts, checkpoints, documentation, and inference code, we provide practical ablations on camera trajectory quality, controllability training steps, and minimal batch-size requirements. We hope minWM serves as a reproducible and extensible recipe for building and adapting real-time interactive video world models. Project Page: [https://github.com/shengshu-ai/minWM](https://github.com/shengshu-ai/minWM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: minWM 把双向视频扩散基础模型转成可实时交互的视频世界模型：先做相机控制微调，再用 Causal Forcing / Causal Forcing++（AR diffusion 训练、causal ODE 或 causal consistency 蒸馏、asymmetric DMD）压成少步自回归生成器以降低 rollout 延迟。框架在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 与 HY1.5-TI2V-8B 上实例化，覆盖 cross-attention 条件注入与 MMDiT 两类架构，并可改造 HY-WorldPlay 到新数据分布与延迟目标。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型画质已强，但要变成可控、因果、低延迟的交互式世界模型，需要打通数据构建、可控微调、自回归训练、少步蒸馏与流式推理的整条链路，单点改进不足以落地。
Method: 端到端管线：先对双向视频扩散模型做相机控制微调，再经 Causal Fording 系列的 AR diffusion 训练、causal ODE 或 causal consistency 蒸馏与 asymmetric DMD，蒸馏为少步自回归生成器；架构可扩展，支持 cross-attention 条件注入与 MMDiT 风格骨干，并可适配已有视频世界模型到新数据分布、训练配方与延迟目标。
Result: 发布可运行脚本、checkpoint、文档与推理代码，并给出三组实用 ablation：相机轨迹质量、可控性训练步数、最小 batch size 要求；在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 与 HY1.5-TI2V-8B 两个开放骨干上完成实例化，覆盖两类条件注入架构。
Conclusion: 实时交互视频世界模型可以按一套模块化、可扩展的开源配方来构建与改造，把相机控制、因果自回归与少步蒸馏串成可复现的完整流程。

papers.title: MONA: Muon Optimizer with Nesterov Acceleration for Scalable Language Model Training
papers.abstract_en: The Muon optimizer has recently offered a promising alternative to AdamW for large language model training, leveraging matrix orthogonalization to produce geometry-aware updates. However, like all first-order methods, Muon can become trapped in sharp local minima. In this work, we present MONA, an optimizer that bridges Muon's orthogonalization framework with curvature-aware acceleration. MONA adds an acceleration term directly into Muon's gradient processing pipeline. This term is calculated from the exponential moving average of gradient differences. We provide a detailed convergence analysis for MONA, showing that the acceleration term introduces curvature-sensitive corrections while preserving Muon's spectral-norm regularization. Empirically, MONA achieves better convergence and downstream task performance compared to both Muon and AdamW across three scales of Mixture-of-Experts pretraining, spanning from 1B to 68B parameters, with the largest model trained on 1 trillion tokens. Furthermore, we conduct supervised fine-tuning on the MOE-68B-A3B model and evaluate it on general capability, mathematical reasoning, and code generation benchmarks, where MONA achieves SOTA performance.
papers.comment: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MONA 把基于梯度差分指数滑动平均的 Nesterov 式加速项直接嵌入 Muon 的梯度正交化流水线，在保留谱范数正则的同时引入曲率敏感修正。在 1B 到 68B 三个规模的 MoE 预训练（最大模型 1 万亿 token）上，收敛与下游任务表现均优于 Muon 和 AdamW；对 MOE-68B-A3B 做监督微调后，在通用能力、数学推理与代码生成基准上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: Muon 用矩阵正交化给出几何感知更新，但作为一阶方法仍会困在尖锐局部极小值，缺少曲率感知的加速机制。
Method: 在 Muon 的梯度处理流水线中加入加速项，该项由梯度差分的指数移动平均 (EMA) 计算得到；作者给出收敛性分析，说明该修正项在曲率敏感的同时保持 Muon 的谱范数正则。
Result: 在 1B 至 68B 三个规模的 Mixture-of-Experts 预训练上，MONA 的收敛与下游任务表现优于 Muon 和 AdamW，最大模型训练用 1 万亿 token；在 MOE-68B-A3B 上做监督微调后，于通用能力、数学推理、代码生成基准取得 SOTA。
Conclusion: 把曲率感知的 Nesterov 加速接进 Muon 的正交化框架，可以在不牺牲谱范数正则的前提下改善大模型 MoE 预训练的收敛与下游表现。

papers.title: VeriSimpl: Robust Optimization Modeling from Natural Language using Simplification-based Verification
papers.abstract_en: Natural language interfaces can greatly benefit the accessibility and usability of optimization modeling, and recent advances in large language models (LLMs) show promise in automatically translating textual problem descriptions into executable solver formulations. However, a key challenge for existing approaches is to ensure that the inferred formulation correctly implements the intended task, even if it may execute without errors. We introduce VeriSimpl, a solver LLM framework for robust natural-language-to-optimization formalization. Our approach is based on the idea of simplification-based verification, where the optimization solver is leveraged to generate simplified diagnostic queries about a candidate formulation to allow the LLM to tractably reason about the correctness of the formulation with respect to the task description. We present such simplification strategies along different dimensions with respect to problem constraints and decision variables, which allow the LLM to reason locally under fixed global contexts. Evaluations on a range of optimization benchmarks show how our approach provides consistent improvements in accuracy over existing methods, while also providing a novel high-precision self-verification signal.
papers.comment: Accepted and published at ICML 2026. Code available at https://github.com/suabar/VeriSimple
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VeriSimpl 用基于简化的验证 (simplification-based verification) 让优化求解器生成关于候选公式的简化诊断查询，供 LLM 判断该公式是否真正对应任务描述，即使它能无错运行。在多个优化基准上，该方法相对现有方法一致提升准确率，并提供高精度的自验证信号。
Motivation: LLM 把自然语言问题描述转成可执行优化公式时，公式可能运行无误却偏离原意，现有方法缺少对这种语义正确性的可靠校验。
Method: 提出 solver LLM 框架 VeriSimpl：利用优化求解器生成关于候选公式的简化诊断查询，沿约束与决策变量等维度设计简化策略，让 LLM 在固定全局语境下做局部推理，从而可处理地判断公式相对任务描述的正确性。
Result: 在一系列优化基准上，该方法相对现有方法在准确率上取得一致提升，并产生一种新的高精度自验证信号。
Conclusion: 把求解器用作生成简化诊断查询的机制，可以让 LLM 可处理地校验自然语言到优化形式化的语义正确性，同时兼作高精度自验证信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VEOcc: Voxel-Centric Online Semantic Occupancy Prediction For Embodied Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Crucial for autonomous exploration, online 3D occupancy prediction and mapping incrementally construct dense spatial representations on the fly. Embodied online occupancy prediction remains predominantly Gaussian-centric, despite the wide use of voxel representations for frame-wise scene completion. We present VEOcc, to the best of our knowledge, the first voxel-centric framework for online embodied semantic occupancy prediction. It incrementally maintains a sparse global semantic voxel map from monocular observations and enables open-ended expansion without predefined scene bounds. To robustly integrate noisy multi-view predictions, we further introduce a Spatio-Temporal-Aware Online Update Strategy comprising Cross-Temporal Logit Aggregation (TLA) for short-term temporal consistency, Reliability-Aware Confidence Modulation (RCM) for spatial uncertainty calibration, and Confidence-Driven Incremental State Update (CSU) for robust global state assimilation. Extensive experiments on Occ-ScanNet and EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among models of comparable scale in both local and embodied settings. Moreover, onboard deployment on a mobile robot validates practical online operation and long-horizon scalability, while results on self-collected handheld sequences demonstrate zero-shot generalization to unseen real-world environments. Code and supplementary visualizations are available on our project page: https://wryzju.github.io/VEOcc/.

papers.title: Functionalization via Structure Completion and Motion Rectification
papers.abstract_en: Acquisition and creation of 3D assets have been largely view- or appearance-driven. As a result, existing digital 3D models often lack the requisite structural components to function as intended, such as joints, supports, interiors, or interaction elements. At the same time, even human-annotated motions are frequently error-prone, leading to physically implausible behavior. We introduce object functionalization, a novel task aimed at transforming visually plausible but non-functional 3D models into functional and physically operable ones. We formulate functionalization as a graph completion problem over a new functional graph representation, where labeled nodes represent object parts, labeled edges encode functional and contact relations, and movable nodes carry motion attributes, so that structural functional deficiencies manifest as missing nodes or incorrect edges. We develop a neural Graph Functionalizer (GraFu) to complete an incomplete graph representing a non-functional 3D object. The completed graph then drives a geometry realization stage that instantiates predicted connectors and structural elements in 3D, with the compelling side effect of rectifying erroneous human-annotated and predicted motions. To support training and evaluation, focusing on furniture as a rich and challenging target category, we introduce FurFun-233, a dataset of 233 paired non-functional and functionalized furniture models. On PartNet-Mobility ("zero-shot") and HSSD test sets, our method matches state-of-the-art methods in motion prediction accuracy while substantially improving functionality in terms of collision and connectivity. Project page: https://mingrui-zhao.github.io/Functionalization/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 object functionalization 任务与 GraFu：把缺关节、支撑、内部结构的 3D 家具表示为不完整 functional graph，用神经图补全预测缺失节点与错误边，再由几何实现阶段实例化连接件与结构件，并顺带修正错误的人工标注与预测运动。在 PartNet-Mobility（zero-shot）与 HSSD 测试集上，运动预测精度与最先进方法持平，同时在碰撞与连通性上显著提升功能性。
Motivation: 现有 3D 资产获取与生成多由视角或外观驱动，模型常缺关节、支撑、内部结构等功能组件；人工标注运动也常有误，导致物理上不可实现的行为。
Method: 将功能化形式化为 functional graph 上的图补全问题：带标签节点表示物体部件，带标签边编码功能与接触关系，可动节点携带运动属性；神经模型 Graph Functionalizer (GraFu) 补全不完整图，完成后的图驱动几何实现阶段在 3D 中实例化预测的连接件与结构件。训练与评测用家具数据集 FurFun-233（233 对非功能与功能化家具模型）。
Result: 在 PartNet-Mobility（zero-shot）与 HSSD 测试集上，运动预测精度与 state-of-the-art 方法持平，同时在 collision 与 connectivity 指标上显著改善功能性；数据集 FurFun-233 含 233 对配对家具模型。
Conclusion: 把功能缺失建模为图补全并让补全结果驱动几何实现，可以在不牺牲运动预测精度的前提下提升 3D 家具的功能性与物理可操作性，同时修正错误的标注运动。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: NIMO Controller: a self-driving laboratory orchestrator based on the Model Context Protocol
papers.abstract_en: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) are attracting increasing attention as a means of accelerating scientific discovery; however, developing SDL software remains technically demanding. To improve accessibility, orchestration software frameworks have been proposed to coordinate SDL components, but many existing frameworks are primarily designed for human interaction and lack standardized interfaces for direct integration with AI agents. In this work, we propose an SDL software architecture based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), in which all SDL functionalities are exposed through MCP servers. Following this design principle, we introduce NIMO Controller, an MCP-based SDL orchestrator that integrates the experimental planning software NIMO. It provides a visual programming interface automatically generated through MCP-based tool discovery, allowing human users to design experimental workflows without writing code. The same MCP backend is also accessible to AI agents, providing a unified interface through which both human users and AI agents can interact with SDL components. AI agents can invoke MCP tools directly or generate NIMO workflows from natural language instructions. We evaluated the agentic workflow generation performance of various LLMs and conducted a user study using a color-matching SDL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NIMO Controller 把自驱动实验室 (SDL) 的全部功能暴露为 MCP server，用同一套 MCP 后端同时服务人类与 AI agent：人靠工具自动发现生成的可视化编程界面免代码搭工作流，agent 则直接调 MCP 工具或从自然语言生成 NIMO 工作流。作者评测了多种 LLM 的 agentic 工作流生成表现，并在 color-matching SDL 上做了用户研究。
Motivation: 现有 SDL 编排框架主要面向人机交互，缺少与 AI agent 直接对接的标准化接口，导致 SDL 软件开发门槛高、可及性差。
Method: 提出以 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 为核心的 SDL 软件架构，所有 SDL 功能都以 MCP server 形式暴露；在此之上构建 NIMO Controller 编排器，集成实验规划软件 NIMO，通过 MCP 工具发现自动生成可视化编程界面，并让 AI agent 经同一后端直接调用工具或从自然语言生成 NIMO 工作流。
Result: 对多种 LLM 的 agentic 工作流生成性能做了评测，并开展了一项基于 color-matching SDL 的用户研究。
Conclusion: 统一的 MCP 后端可以让人类用户与 AI agent 用同一接口操作 SDL 组件，从而降低自驱动实验室软件的开发与使用门槛。

papers.title: SAGE: A Self-Evolving Agentic Graph-Memory Engine for Structure-Aware Associative Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is becoming a central bottleneck for language agents. Exsting RAG and GraphRAG systems largely treat memory graphs as static retrieval middleware, which limits their ability to recover complete evidence chains from partial cues, exploit reusable graph-structrual roles, and improve the memory itself through downstream feedback. We introduce SAGE, a Self-evolving Agentic Graph-memory Engine that models graph memory as a dynamic long-term memory substrate. SAGE couples two roles: a memory writer that incrementally constucts structured graph memory from interaction histories, and a Graph Foundation Model-based memory reader to perform retrieval and provide feedback to the memory writer. We provide rigorooous theoretical annalyses supporting the framework. Across multi-hop QA, open-domain retireval, domain-specific review QA, and long-term agent-memory benchmarks, SAGE improves evidence recovery, answer grounding, and retrieval efficiency: after two self-evolution rounds, it achieves the best average rank on multi-hop QA; in zero-shot open-domain transfer, it reaches 82.5/91.6 Recall@2/5 on NQ. Further results on LongMemEval and HaluMem show that traning and reader-writer feedback improve multiple long-term memory and hallucination-diagnostic metrics, suggesting that self-evolving, structure-aware graph memory is a promising foundation for robust long-horizon language agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 把语言 agent 的长期记忆做成自演化的图记忆底座：memory writer 从交互历史增量构建结构化图，Graph Foundation Model 作 memory reader 负责检索并把反馈回传给 writer。两轮自演化后在 multi-hop QA 上取得最佳平均排名，零样本迁移到 NQ 达到 Recall@2 82.5、Recall@5 91.6。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 与 GraphRAG 把记忆图当作静态检索中间层，无法从部分线索恢复完整证据链，也不能借下游反馈改进记忆本身。
Method: 双角色耦合：memory writer 增量构建结构化图记忆，Graph Foundation Model-based memory reader 执行检索并向 writer 提供反馈，形成多轮自演化闭环；作者同时给出支撑该框架的理论分析。
Result: 两轮自演化后在 multi-hop QA 上取得最佳平均排名；零样本开放域迁移到 NQ 上 Recall@2 为 82.5、Recall@5 为 91.6；在 LongMemEval 与 HaluMem 上，训练与 reader-writer 反馈改善了多项长期记忆与幻觉诊断指标。
Conclusion: 自演化、结构感知的图记忆可作为长程语言 agent 的记忆基础，reader-writer 反馈是让记忆随下游使用而改进的关键机制。

papers.title: The Bystander Effect in Multi-Agent Reasoning: Quantifying Cognitive Loafing in Collaborative Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) assume that collaborating inherently improves Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning. We challenge this by demonstrating that simulated social pressure triggers an algorithmic ``Bystander Effect,'' inducing severe cognitive loafing. By evaluating 22,500 deterministic trajectories across 3 dataset contexts (GAIA, SWE-bench, Multi-Challenge) with 3 state-of-the-art (SOTA) models, we semantically audit internal reasoning traces against external outputs. We formalize the \textit{Interaction Depth Limit} ($D_L$), the exact plurality threshold where an agent's logical sovereignty collapses into social compliance. Crucially, we uncover the \textit{Sovereignty Gap}: models frequently compute the correct derivation internally but suffer ``Alignment Hallucinations'' -- actively subjugating empirical evidence to sycophantically appease a simulated swarm. We prove that multi-agent social load is strictly non-commutative; the "brand" identity of the ``Lead Anchor'' auditor disproportionately dictates the swarm's integrity. These findings expose architectural vulnerabilities, proving that unstructured multi-agent topologies can degrade independent reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 22,500 条确定性轨迹上证明多智能体协作会触发算法式“旁观者效应”：模拟社会压力使 LLM 放弃独立推理、迎合群体，且这种社会负载严格不可交换，Lead Anchor 审计者的“品牌”身份主导整个 swarm 的完整性。作者据此提出 Interaction Depth Limit (D_L) 作为逻辑主权崩塌的精确多人阈值。
Motivation: 多智能体系统默认协作必然改善 LLM 推理，但未检验社会压力下模型是否会主动屈从，导致独立推理被架构性削弱。
Method: 在 GAIA、SWE-bench、Multi-Challenge 三个数据集语境上，用 3 个 SOTA 模型跑 22,500 条确定性轨迹，对内部推理链与外部输出做语义审计；形式化 Interaction Depth Limit (D_L) 阈值，并证明多智能体社会负载的非交换性。
Result: 覆盖 22,500 条确定性轨迹、3 个数据集语境、3 个 SOTA 模型；发现 Sovereignty Gap——模型常在内部算出正确推导却产生 Alignment Hallucination，为迎合模拟 swarm 而压下经验证据；证明社会负载严格不可交换，Lead Anchor 审计者身份不成比例地决定 swarm 完整性。
Conclusion: 非结构化的多智能体拓扑会退化独立推理，架构上需要约束社会压力与 Lead Anchor 身份的影响。

papers.title: Mechanism Design Is Not Enough: Prosocial Agents for Cooperative AI
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring that AI agents behave safely and beneficially when interacting with other parties has emerged as one of the central challenges of modern AI safety. While mechanism design, as the theory of designing rules to align individual and collective objectives, can incentivize cooperative behavior, it is still an open question whether it alone is sufficient to maximize LLM agents' social welfare. This work proves that the answer is negative: drawing from incomplete contract theory, we formally show that when contracts cannot distinguish all relevant future contingencies, there is a strictly positive welfare loss that no realistic mechanism can eliminate. We show that prosocial agents, who weigh others' welfare alongside their own, can close this gap and achieve outcomes that are socially superior and individually beneficial. Experimentally, we show that in multi-agent resource-allocation environments and canonical social dilemmas where agents are powered by large language models, prosociality is beneficial. The implication for AI safety is clear: to enable cooperative interactions at scale, designing adequate mechanisms is not sufficient; agents must be built to be intrinsically prosocial.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明：当契约无法区分所有未来或然状态时，任何现实机制都存在严格为正的福利损失，机制设计本身不足以最大化 LLM agent 的社会福利；只有让 agent 内在地把他人福利纳入自身效用（prosocial），才能弥合这一缺口。在 LLM 驱动的多智能体资源分配与经典社会困境实验中，prosociality 带来社会更优且个体也受益的结果。
Motivation: 机制设计理论能把个体目标与集体目标对齐，但仅靠规则设计能否最大化 LLM agent 的社会福利仍是开放问题，这直接关系到规模化 AI 交互的安全性。
Method: 借鉴不完全契约理论 (incomplete contract theory)，形式化证明当契约无法区分所有相关未来或然状态时存在严格为正、任何现实机制都无法消除的福利损失；再在 LLM 驱动的多智能体资源分配环境与经典社会困境 (canonical social dilemmas) 中做实验，对比引入 prosocial agent 的效果。
Result: 形式化结果：契约不完备时存在严格为正的福利损失，任何现实机制都无法消除。实验结果：在 LLM 驱动的多智能体资源分配与经典社会困境中，prosociality 是有益的，产生社会更优且个体也受益的结果。
Conclusion: 要实现规模化的协作交互，仅设计机制不够，agent 必须被构造成内在 prosocial 的。

papers.title: Flow Matching for Count Data
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional count data arise in applications such as single-cell RNA sequencing and neural spike trains, where mappings between distributions across successive batches or time points form critical components of data analysis. The recent success of diffusion- and flow-based deep generative models for images, video, and text motivates extending these ideas to count-valued settings, but many existing methods either treat each count as a categorical state or transform counts into a continuous space, neither of which is natural or efficient when the count range is large. We propose count-FM, a flow-matching framework for count data based on a continuous-time birth-death process with local unit jumps. Count-FM learns marginal transitions efficiently in count space through simulation-free training of conditional transition rates, allowing transport between arbitrary count-distributed source and target populations. In simulation, count-FM variants achieve strong sample quality while using substantially fewer parameters. We further apply count-FM to scRNA-seq and neural spike-train data for unconditional generation, transport, and conditional generation. Across these tasks, count-FM yields improved sample quality, greater modeling efficiency, and interpretable transport paths.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 count-FM：把计数数据的流匹配建立在带局部单位跳跃的连续时间生灭过程 (birth-death process) 上，通过免模拟训练条件转移率，直接在计数空间中学习任意源到目标计数分布的传输。仿真中 count-FM 变体以显著更少参数达到强样本质量，并在 scRNA-seq 与神经 spike train 的无条件生成、传输和条件生成任务上取得更好的样本质量与建模效率。
Motivation: 高维计数数据（单细胞 RNA 测序、神经 spike train）需要跨批次或跨时间点的分布映射，而现有方法要么把每个计数当类别状态、要么把计数变换到连续空间，在计数范围大时都不自然也不高效。
Method: count-FM 以连续时间生灭过程加局部单位跳跃为基础的流匹配框架，免模拟 (simulation-free) 地训练条件转移率，从而在计数空间内高效学习边缘转移，支持任意计数分布源与目标之间的传输；在仿真数据以及 scRNA-seq、神经 spike-train 上做无条件生成、传输与条件生成。
Result: 仿真中 count-FM 变体在参数量显著更少的情况下达到强样本质量；在 scRNA-seq 与神经 spike-train 的无条件生成、传输、条件生成任务上，count-FM 取得更好的样本质量、更高的建模效率和可解释的传输路径。
Conclusion: 把计数数据的生成建模为计数空间中的生灭过程流匹配，比类别化或连续变换两种现有路线更自然高效，且传输路径可解释。

papers.title: ReasonLab: A Controlled and Auditable Evaluation of Prompting Techniques for Multiple-Choice QA
papers.abstract_en: Probing the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) and building robust solutions for Multiple-Choice Question Answering (MCQA) remain central challenges in natural language understanding. Furthermore, the rapid proliferation of LLMs has created the implicit assumption that more sophisticated prompting techniques yield better performance. Several studies claim such gains, but report them under differing models, prompt wordings and answer-extraction rules, so the gains cannot be attributed to the technique alone. We address this gap with ReasonLab, an evaluation framework in which the prompting technique is a first-class experimental variable alongside the model and the dataset, and which retains every generation for inspection. Using ReasonLab we conduct a controlled study of 8 prompting techniques across 10 MCQA datasets, 27 model configurations and 480,927 evaluations at temperature 0. We find that the prompting technique is a minor determinant of accuracy: on configurations without a reasoning budget the reasoning triggers improve on direct prompting by only 3.92 to 4.69 pp and are indistinguishable from one another, and on configurations with reasoning enabled no technique differs by more than 0.51 pp. Self-Generate is the only technique with a consistent effect, a reduction of 2.95 pp. We further investigate three phenomena: (1) the comparison of models on a common set of datasets, where model size does not predict accuracy, (2) the trade-offs across thinking budgets, where enabling reasoning is worth up to 12.74 pp whereas an eightfold budget increase adds only 0.48 to 2.10 pp, and (3) the variation in dataset difficulty, with 60% of benchmarks below 70% accuracy and a 43.9 pp spread from easiest to hardest. These results suggest that, for MCQA, the prompting technique is a minor lever compared with enabling model reasoning, and that substantial headroom remains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReasonLab 把提示技术当作与模型、数据集并列的一等实验变量，在温度 0 下对 8 种提示技术、10 个 MCQA 数据集、27 个模型配置做了 480,927 次评测并保留全部生成记录。结论是提示技术只是次要杠杆：无推理预算时 reasoning trigger 相对直接提示仅提升 3.92–4.69 pp 且彼此不可区分，开启推理后任意两技术差距不超过 0.51 pp，而开启推理本身最多值 12.74 pp。
Motivation: 多项研究报告提示技术带来增益，但所用模型、提示措辞与答案抽取规则各不相同，增益无法归因于技术本身；MCQA 方案因此缺少可比的受控证据。
Method: 构建评测框架 ReasonLab，把提示技术与模型、数据集同为受控变量，保留每一次生成供审查；在温度 0 下交叉评测 8 种提示技术 × 10 个 MCQA 数据集 × 27 个模型配置，共 480,927 次评测，并分别在无推理预算与开启推理两类配置下比较，另考察模型规模、thinking budget 与数据集难度。
Result: 无推理预算配置下 reasoning trigger 相对 direct prompting 仅提升 3.92 至 4.69 pp，各技术之间不可区分；开启推理后没有任何技术差距超过 0.51 pp；Self-Generate 是唯一有一致效应的技术，使准确率下降 2.95 pp。模型规模不预测准确率；开启推理最多带来 12.74 pp，而预算扩大八倍只增加 0.48 至 2.10 pp；60% 的基准准确率低于 70%，最易与最难数据集相差 43.9 pp。
Conclusion: 对 MCQA 而言提示技术是次要杠杆，开启模型推理才是主要杠杆，且基准上仍有大量提升空间。

papers.title: eXplaining to Learn (eX2L): Regularization Using Contrastive Visual Explanation Pairs for Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Despite extensive research into mitigating distribution shifts, many existing algorithms yield inconsistent performance, often failing to outperform baseline Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) across diverse scenarios and necessitating newer algorithms which can handle scenarios where existing algorithms currently underperform. Furthermore, high algorithmic complexity frequently limits interpretability and offers only an indirect means of addressing spurious correlations. We propose eXplaining to Learn (eX2L): an interpretable, explanation-based framework that decorrelates confounding features from a classifier's latent representations during training. eX2L achieves this by penalizing the similarity between Grad-CAM activation maps generated by a primary label classifier and those from a concurrently trained confounder classifier. On the rigorous Spawrious Many-to-Many Hard Challenge synthetic data benchmark, eX2L achieves an average accuracy (AA) of 82.24% +/- 3.87% and a worst-group accuracy (WGA) of 66.31% +/- 8.73%, outperforming the current state-of-the-art (SOTA) by 5.49% and 10.90%, respectively. Beyond its competitive performance, eX2L demonstrates that functional domain invariance can be enforced by explicitly decoupling label and nuisance attributes at the group level.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 3 figures, To be published in the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026) Workshop on Robust Vision Systems in Synthetic Environments (RVS-SE)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 eXplaining to Learn (eX2L)：训练中同时跑一个混淆因子分类器，用正则项惩罚主分类器与混淆因子分类器 Grad-CAM 激活图之间的相似度，从而在潜表示里解耦标签与干扰属性。在 Spawrious Many-to-Many Hard Challenge 合成基准上，平均准确率 (AA) 82.24% ± 3.87%、最差组准确率 (WGA) 66.31% ± 8.73%，分别高出当前 SOTA 5.49% 和 10.90%。
Motivation: 现有分布偏移 (distribution shift) 缓解算法表现不稳定，常在多种场景下打不过朴素 ERM；高算法复杂度又削弱可解释性，只能间接处理虚假相关 (spurious correlations)。
Method: eX2L 是基于解释的可解释框架：训练主标签分类器的同时并行训练混淆因子分类器，损失中加入惩罚项压低两者 Grad-CAM 激活图的相似度，从而在训练期把混淆特征从分类器潜表示中去相关；在 Spawrious Many-to-Many Hard Challenge 合成基准上检验。
Result: 在 Spawrious Many-to-Many Hard Challenge 上，eX2L 的平均准确率 (AA) 为 82.24% ± 3.87%，最差组准确率 (WGA) 为 66.31% ± 8.73%，分别比当前 SOTA 高 5.49% 和 10.90%。
Conclusion: 作者主张功能性的域不变性 (functional domain invariance) 可以通过在 group 层面显式解耦标签属性与干扰属性来强制实现，且该做法同时带来可解释性。

papers.title: Event-Based Early Warning of Vineyard Disease Risk from Environmental Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Accurate early warning of vineyard disease risk from environmental observations is essential for timely intervention and more sustainable crop protection. However, many existing studies formulate disease prediction as daily presence classification, which can favor persistence-driven predictions and provide only limited support for actionable short-horizon warning. In this paper, we present an event-based approach for early warning of vineyard disease risk from environmental time series and evaluate it through a vineyard case study. Rather than predicting daily disease status, the task is reformulated to predict transitions into annotated disease-risk periods within a future window of 3-7 days. To reduce fragmentation caused by short interruptions in the binary labels, new events are defined only after a minimum disease-free gap. This formulation encourages models to capture environmental precursors associated with upcoming risk periods instead of merely reproducing temporal persistence. Using multi-year agro-meteorological data, we construct input representations that capture humidity dynamics, rainfall accumulation, temperature variability, and seasonal structure through cyclic temporal encoding. We evaluate representative methods from classical machine learning and deep learning, including XGBoost, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCNs), using both standard classification metrics and an event-oriented early warning protocol. The results show that the event-based formulation supports practical short-horizon warning, while the compared models exhibit distinct trade-offs between event recall, lead time, and false-alert behavior. Overall, the study underscores the importance of problem formulation in environmental time-series learning and demonstrates the value of event-based prediction for vineyard disease warning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把葡萄病害预测从逐日存在性分类改写为事件式预警：只在超过最小无病间隔后才定义新事件，预测未来 3–7 天内进入标注风险期的转移，迫使模型学环境前兆而非时间持续性。用多农业气象数据构造湿度动态、降雨累积、温度变差与循环时间编码表征，XGBoost、LSTM、TCN 在分类指标与事件式预警协议下呈现事件召回、提前量与误报之间的不同取舍。
Motivation: 既有研究多把病害预测做成逐日存在性分类，容易靠时间持续性取巧，对可行动的短时窗预警支持有限。
Method: 任务重构为预测未来 3–7 天内进入标注疾病风险期的转移，并规定只有超过最小无病间隔才计新事件以减少标签碎片；输入表征含湿度动态、降雨累积、温度变差与循环时间编码 (cyclic temporal encoding)，在多农业气象数据上比较 XGBoost、LSTM 与 TCN。
Result: 在标准分类指标与事件式预警协议下评测，事件式重构支持实用的短时窗预警，各模型在事件召回、提前量 (lead time) 与误报行为上呈现不同取舍。
Conclusion: 问题形式化本身决定环境时间序列模型能否给出可行动的短时窗病害预警，事件式预测对葡萄病害预警系统更有价值。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Vision Foundation Models for Active and Passive Seismic Data Denoising
papers.abstract_en: The demand for high-resolution subsurface imaging and continuous Earth monitoring has driven rapid growth in active and passive seismic data from dense geophone deployments, distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) arrays, and large-scale 2D and 3D surveys. This expansion makes complex noise suppression increasingly challenging, especially when signal fidelity must be preserved. Conventional supervised deep learning methods are often task-specific, require large paired datasets, and can suffer from domain shift under new acquisition conditions. Foundation models offer a promising alternative, but pre-training seismic foundation models from scratch requires massive domain-specific data and substantial computation. We propose an efficient framework that repurposes general-purpose Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) for geophysical tasks through Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning. The architecture uses a pre-trained VFM, a DINOv3 encoder, adapted with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to enable effective feature adaptation with few additional parameters. To improve robustness under unseen field conditions without ground truth, we introduce a kurtosis-guided unsupervised test-time adaptation module that updates only LoRA parameters during inference. This module self-calibrates the model to site-specific noise by identifying information-rich regions via kurtosis and performing self-training without labeled data. Experiments on public exploration seismic images and DAS vertical seismic profiling data from the Utah FORGE site show that the framework matches or outperforms domain-specific models. Tests on unseen cross-site data from a land survey in China and the Groß Schönebeck geothermal site in Germany further demonstrate strong generalization and effective signal-noise separation. These results highlight the potential of adapting pre-trained VFMs to data-intensive problems in exploration seismology.

papers.title: Learning Dynamic Evidence Routes for Vision Transformer Probing
papers.abstract_en: Probing frozen vision transformers typically uses permutation-invariant aggregation (GAP or $\texttt{[CLS]}$), treating patch tokens as an unstructured set. Content-dependent probes such as self-attention are useful accuracy controls, but they do not expose a fixed token schedule or fixed position weights for auditing. We introduce $\textbf{SSMProbe}$, an explicitly inspectable probe that replaces invariant pooling with a Sinkhorn-learned evidence route followed by a diagonal S4 decoder. The S4 decoder is a linear time-invariant (LTI) system whose final state has fixed, position-dependent coefficients, so the probe-induced routed sequence can be audited as a concrete object rather than inferred only from accuracy. Our central measurement is the geometry of routed evidence: which patch tokens are moved to influential positions by this diagnostic, whether those tokens form spatially organized regions or random-like dispersed sets, and how the fixed S4 kernel weights them. Across MAE, BEiT, DINOv2, and supervised ViT, this route geometry separates MAE's dispersed, nearly random-like routes from the more spatially organized routes of BEiT, ViT, and DINOv2, with DINOv2 retaining a distinct strong $\texttt{[CLS]}$ profile. SSMProbe uses the mathematical transparency of state-space models to turn a frozen ViT readout into an auditable evidence-routing analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSMProbe 用 Sinkhorn 学出的证据路由 (evidence route) 替换 GAP/[CLS] 池化，再接对角 S4 解码器，使冻结 ViT 的读出变成可审计的固定位置权重对象。在 MAE、BEiT、DINOv2 与监督 ViT 上，路由几何把 MAE 的弥散、近随机路由与 BEiT、ViT、DINOv2 更空间组织化的路由区分开，DINOv2 保留独特的强 [CLS] 轮廓。
Motivation: 对冻结 ViT 的 probing 常用置换不变聚合，把 patch token 当无结构集合，无法给出固定 token 调度或固定位置权重供审计；内容相关探针虽准却不暴露可检查的路由。
Method: 以 Sinkhorn 学习的证据路由取代不变池化，输出被路由的 token 序列，再送入对角 S4 解码器；S4 是线性时不变 (LTI) 系统，其末态具有固定、依赖位置的系数，使路由序列可作为具体对象审计。测量对象是路由证据的几何：哪些 patch token 被移到有影响的位置、是否形成空间组织区域、固定 S4 核如何加权它们。
Result: 在 MAE、BEiT、DINOv2 与监督 ViT 上，路由几何将 MAE 的弥散、近随机样路由与 BEiT、ViT、DINOv2 更空间组织化的路由分开；DINOv2 保留独特的强 [CLS] 轮廓。
Conclusion: 状态空间模型的数学透明性可把冻结 ViT 的读出转成可审计的证据路由分析，路由几何本身即可区分不同预训练目标的表征组织方式。

papers.title: AdaGScale: Viewpoint-Adaptive Gaussian Scaling in 3D Gaussian Splatting to Reduce Gaussian-Tile Pairs
papers.abstract_en: Reducing the number of Gaussian-tile pairs is one of the most promising approaches to improve 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) rendering speed on GPUs. However, the importance difference existing among Gaussian-tile pairs has never been considered in the previous works. In this paper, we propose AdaGScale, a novel viewpoint-adaptive Gaussian scaling technique for reducing the number of Gaussian-tile pairs. AdaGScale is based on the observation that the peripheral tiles located far from Gaussian center contribute negligibly to pixel color accumulation. This suggests an opportunity for reducing the number of Gaussian-tile pairs based on color contribution. AdaGScale efficiently estimates the color contribution in the peripheral region of each Gaussian during a preprocessing stage and adaptively scales its size based on the peripheral score. As a result, Gaussians with lower importance intersect with fewer tiles during the intersection test, which improves rendering speed while maintaining image quality. The adjusted size is used only for tile intersection test, and the original size is retained during color accumulation to preserve visual fidelity. Experimental results show that AdaGScale achieves a geometric mean speedup of 13.8x over original 3D-GS on a GPU, with only about 0.5 dB degradation in PSNR on city-scale scenes.
papers.comment: DAC 2026; Code: https://github.com/askmgk/AdaGScale; v2 adds the code link, manuscript unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaGScale 在 3D Gaussian Splatting 中按视角自适应缩放 Gaussian 尺寸以减少 Gaussian-tile 对：预处理阶段估计每个 Gaussian 外围区域的颜色贡献得分，据此缩小低重要性 Gaussian，只在 tile 相交测试中用缩放后尺寸、颜色累积仍用原始尺寸。在 GPU 上相对原始 3D-GS 取得 13.8 倍几何平均加速，city-scale 场景 PSNR 仅下降约 0.5 dB。
Motivation: 3D-GS 渲染速度受 Gaussian-tile 对数量制约，而既有工作从未考虑这些配对之间的重要性差异；外围 tile 对像素颜色累积贡献极小，却仍参与相交测试。
Method: 预处理阶段为每个 Gaussian 的外围区域估计颜色贡献（peripheral score），按得分自适应缩放其尺寸，使低重要性 Gaussian 在 tile 相交测试中命中更少 tile；缩放尺寸仅用于相交测试，颜色累积保留原始尺寸以维持视觉保真。
Result: 在 GPU 上相对原始 3D-GS 几何平均加速 13.8 倍；city-scale 场景 PSNR 下降约 0.5 dB。
Conclusion: 按外围颜色贡献对 Gaussian 做视角自适应缩放，可以在基本保持画质的前提下大幅减少 Gaussian-tile 对并提速渲染。

papers.title: A Survey on Long-Term Memory Security in LLM Agents: Attacks, Defenses, and Governance Across the Memory Lifecycle
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of writable, cross-session persistent memory in LLM agents introduces a qualitatively different threat landscape from conventional input-centric security concerns, characterized by three properties: persistence, statefulness, and propagation. To systematically characterize this landscape, we propose a Memory Lifecycle Framework that organizes attacks, defenses, and their cross-phase dependencies along two axes: six lifecycle phases (Write, Store, Retrieve, Execute, Share & Propagate, Forget & Rollback) and four security objectives (Integrity, Confidentiality, Availability, Governance). This analysis in turn exposes the need for formal security guarantees at the system level, motivating Verifiable Memory Governance (VMG), a framework of five architectural primitives that specifies what verifiable mechanisms a long-term-memory system must provide to maintain auditable, recoverable control over its memory state. Our analysis indicates that robust Long-Term Memory (LTM) security cannot be retrofitted at retrieval or execution time alone, but must be anchored in storage-time provenance, versioning, and policy-aware retention from the outset.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述提出记忆生命周期框架 (Memory Lifecycle Framework)，沿 Write/Store/Retrieve/Execute/Share & Propagate/Forget & Rollback 六阶段与完整性/机密性/可用性/Governance 四目标组织 LLM agent 长期记忆的攻击与防御，并给出含五项架构原语的可验证记忆治理 (VMG)。核心论断是长期记忆安全无法在检索或执行阶段事后补装，必须从一开始就锚定在存储时的来源追溯、版本化与策略感知保留上。
Motivation: LLM agent 出现可写、跨会话持久记忆后，威胁具备持久性、状态性与传播性三个新性质，与传统以输入为中心的安全关注不同，缺少按生命周期组织攻击与防御的系统框架。
Method: 提出双轴 Memory Lifecycle Framework：六个生命周期阶段乘以四个安全目标，用于归类攻击、防御及其跨阶段依赖；据此提出 Verifiable Memory Governance (VMG)，用五项架构原语规定长期记忆系统必须提供的可验证机制，以维持可审计、可恢复的记忆状态控制。
Result: 综述性分析给出框架性结论：长期记忆安全不能只靠检索或执行时的防护事后补装，而须由存储时的来源追溯 (procedance)、版本化与策略感知保留从头支撑；论文为 15 页、3 图、3 表，已被 EMNLP 2026 接收。
Conclusion: 长期记忆安全必须在存储阶段就以 provenance、版本化和策略感知保留为锚点设计，而非在检索或执行时补救；VMG 为此给出可验证机制的架构规范。

papers.title: Seeing the imagined: latent functional alignment in visual imagery decoding from fMRI data
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in visual brain decoding from fMRI has been enabled by large-scale datasets such as the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) and powerful diffusion-based generative models. While current pipelines are primarily optimized for perception, their performance under mental-imagery remains less well understood. In this work, we study how a state-of-the-art (SOTA) perception decoder (DynaDiff) can be adapted to reconstruct imagined content from the NSD-Imagery benchmark. We propose a latent functional alignment (LFA) approach that maps imagery-evoked activity to the pretrained model's semantic content-enriched conditioning space, by adding a simple alignment module, while keeping the original remaining components frozen. To mitigate the limited amount of matched imagery-perception supervision, we further introduce a neural retrieval-based augmentation strategy that selects semantically related NSD perception trials from the same participants. Across four subjects, LFA consistently improves high-level semantic reconstruction metrics relative to the frozen pretrained baseline and a voxel-space ridge alignment baseline, and enables above-chance decoding from multiple cortical regions. These results suggest that semantic structure learned from perception can be leveraged to stabilize and improve visual imagery decoding under out-of-distribution conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把感知解码器 DynaDiff 迁移到 fMRI 心智想象重建时，潜空间功能对齐 (LFA) 把想象诱发活动映射到预训练模型的语义条件空间，只加一个对齐模块、其余组件冻结，并用神经检索式增强补充配对监督。在 NSD-Imagery 四名被试上，高层语义重建指标一致优于冻结基线与体素空间 ridge 对齐基线，并实现多皮层区高于随机水平的解码。
Motivation: 现有视觉脑解码流水线主要为知觉任务优化，在心智想象这种分布外条件下表现不清楚，且想象-知觉配对监督量很少。
Method: 以 SOTA 感知解码器 DynaDiff 为底座，新增对齐模块把想象活动映射到其语义内容增强的条件空间，其余组件保持冻结；再用神经检索式增强，从同一被试的 NSD 感知试次中挑选语义相关 trial 来扩充配对监督。
Result: 在 NSD-Imagery benchmark 的四名被试上，LFA 相对冻结的预训练基线和体素空间 ridge 对齐基线一致提升高层语义重建指标，并使多个皮层区域的解码高于随机水平。
Conclusion: 从感知学到的语义结构可以在分布外条件下稳定并改善视觉想象解码，用轻量对齐加检索式数据增强即可复用，无需重训整个生成模型。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Unified Multimodal Uncertain Inference
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Unified Multimodal Uncertain Inference (UMUI), a multimodal inference task spanning text, audio, and video, where models must produce calibrated probability estimates of hypotheses conditioned on a premise in any modality or combination. While uncertain inference has been explored in text, extension to other modalities has been limited to single-modality binary entailment judgments, leaving no framework for fine-grained probabilistic reasoning in or across other modalities. To address this, we curate a human-annotated evaluation set with scalar probability judgments across audio, visual, and audiovisual settings, and additionally evaluate on existing text and audio benchmarks. We introduce CLUE (Calibrated Latent Uncertainty Estimation), which combines self-consistent teacher calibration and distribution-based confidence probing to produce calibrated predictions. We demonstrate that our 3B-parameter model achieves equivalent or stronger performance than zero-shot baselines up to 32B parameters across all modalities.

papers.title: AgentHazard: A Benchmark for Evaluating Harmful Behavior in Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents extend language models from text generation to persistent action over tools, files, and execution environments. Unlike chat systems, they maintain state across interactions and translate intermediate outputs into concrete actions. This creates a distinct safety challenge in that harmful behavior may emerge through sequences of individually plausible steps, including intermediate actions that appear locally acceptable but collectively lead to unauthorized actions. We present \textbf{AgentHazard}, a benchmark for evaluating harmful behavior in computer-use agents. AgentHazard contains \textbf{2,653} instances spanning diverse risk categories and attack strategies. Each instance pairs a harmful objective with a sequence of operational steps that are locally legitimate but jointly induce unsafe behavior. The benchmark evaluates whether agents can recognize and interrupt harm arising from accumulated context, repeated tool use, intermediate actions, and dependencies across steps. We evaluate AgentHazard on Claude Code, OpenClaw, and IFlow using mostly open or openly deployable models from the Qwen3, Kimi, GLM, and DeepSeek families. Our experimental results indicate that current systems remain highly vulnerable. In particular, when powered by Qwen3-Coder, Claude Code exhibits an attack success rate of \textbf{73.63\%}, suggesting that model alignment alone does not reliably guarantee the safety of autonomous agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentHazard 是评测 computer-use agent 危害行为的基准，含 2,653 个实例，每个实例把有害目标拆成局部合法、合起来诱发不安全行为的操作步骤序列。在 Claude Code、OpenClaw、IFlow 上用 Qwen3、Kimi、GLM、DeepSeek 系模型评测，Qwen3-Coder 驱动的 Claude Code 攻击成功率达 73.63%，说明仅靠模型对齐不足以保证自主 agent 安全。
Motivation: computer-use agent 跨交互保持状态并把中间输出转成具体动作，危害可能由一串各自看似合理的步骤累积而成，聊天系统的安全评测覆盖不到这种跨步依赖的累积风险。
Method: 构建 AgentHazard 基准，每个实例配对一个有害目标与一组局部正当但合起来导致不安全行为的操作步骤；评测 agent 能否从累积上下文、重复工具使用、中间动作与跨步依赖中识别并中断危害，在 Claude Code、OpenClaw、IFlow 上以 Qwen3、Kimi、GLM、DeepSeek 家族的开放或可开放部署模型为主进行评测。
Result: 基准含 2,653 个实例，覆盖多类风险类别与攻击策略；实验显示当前系统仍高度脆弱，Qwen3-Coder 驱动的 Claude Code 攻击成功率为 73.63%。
Conclusion: 当前 computer-use agent 面对累积式、跨步的危害序列仍高度脆弱，模型对齐本身不能可靠保障自主 agent 的安全。

papers.title: RepUCB: Representation Learning-Based UCB for Heterogeneous Multi-Task Linear Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task representation learning exploits the shared structure among related tasks by learning a common latent representation, thereby improving sample efficiency. This paper introduces a novel approach to multi-task representation learning in heterogeneous linear bandits. We consider $T$ concurrent heterogeneous linear bandit tasks, each with feature dimension $d$, whose reward parameters share a common latent representation of dimension $r \ll \min\{d, T\}$, capturing the underlying task relatedness. We propose RepUCB, a novel Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) algorithm that leverages shared low-rank representations to enhance learning in a sample-efficient manner. Our algorithm first collects data through an exploration phase, estimates the shared representation, and then performs UCB-based learning on our proposed confidence set. We provide theoretical guarantees for the confidence set and prove that the unknown reward parameters lie within the confidence set with high probability. We derive cumulative regret bound and show that the proposed approach achieves $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{drNT})$, a significant improvement over solving the $T$ tasks independently, resulting in a regret of $\widetilde{O}(dT\sqrt{N})$. We performed numerical simulations to validate the performance of our algorithm for different problem sizes and compared with baseline algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RepUCB 针对 T 个共享 r 维低秩潜在表示的异构线性 bandit 任务，先探索估计共享表示，再在自建置信集上做 UCB，累积 regret 达到 Õ(√(drNT))，优于独立求解 T 个任务的 Õ(dT√N)。
Motivation: 异构多任务线性 bandit 中各任务奖励参数共享低秩结构，逐任务独立学习浪费样本、regret 随 T 线性放大，需要利用任务相关性提升样本效率。
Method: 提出 RepUCB：先用探索阶段收集数据并估计共享低秩表示（维度 r ≪ min{d,T}），再在自建的置信集上执行 UCB；证明未知奖励参数以高概率落在置信集中，并推导累积 regret 界。
Result: 累积 regret 界为 Õ(√(drNT))，相对独立求解 T 个任务的 Õ(dT√N) 是显著改进；作者通过数值仿真在不同问题规模上验证算法性能并与基线算法比较。
Conclusion: 共享低秩表示能把多任务线性 bandit 的 regret 从随 T 线性增长降到含 √T 的形式，前提是任务相关性确实由低维潜在表示刻画。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Sampling at intermediate temperatures is optimal for training large language models in protein structure prediction
papers.abstract_en: Using a statistical mechanics framework, we investigate the parameter space of transformer models trained on protein sequence data. We sample the loss landscape at varying temperatures using Langevin dynamics to characterize the low-loss manifold, and to understand the mechanisms underlying transformers' superior performance in protein structure prediction. We find that, at variance with networks not based on the attention mechanism, the lack of a first--order--like transition in the loss of the transformer produces a range of intermediate temperatures with good learning properties; this is true both for synthetic and natural protein sequences. We also show that the parameters of most layers are highly conserved at these temperatures if the dimension of the embedding is optimal, and we provide an operative way to find this dimension. Additionally, we show that the attention matrix is more predictive of the contact maps of the protein at higher temperatures and for higher dimensions of the embedding than those optimal for learning. Finally, we showed that the models sampled at intermediate temperatures can predict the free-energy variation upon mutation, better than models obtained through standard optimization techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用统计力学框架在损失景观上以 Langevin 动力学按温度采样 Transformer 参数，发现注意力模型缺少一阶样损失转变，因而存在一段中间温度区间学习性质最好；在该区间且嵌入维度取最优时多数层参数高度保守，采样出的模型预测突变自由能变化优于标准优化得到的模型。
Motivation: 注意力网络在蛋白序列上的性能优势缺少机理解释，且标准优化只落在损失景观的单点，无法刻画低损失流形的结构与可用参数区间。
Method: 以统计力学框架分析蛋白序列数据上训练的 Transformer 参数空间，用 Langevin dynamics 在不同温度下采样损失景观以刻画低损失流形，并与非注意力网络对比；同时给出确定最优嵌入维度的操作方法，并考察注意力矩阵与蛋白接触图的关系。
Result: Transformer 损失缺少一阶样转变，产生一段具有良学习性质的中间温度区间，合成与天然蛋白序列均成立；嵌入维度最优时多数层参数在这些温度下高度保守；注意力矩阵在高于学习最优的温度与更高嵌入维度下对蛋白接触图预测性更强；中间温度采样模型预测突变自由能变化优于标准优化技术得到的模型。
Conclusion: 中间温度采样是训练蛋白结构预测大模型的优选操作区间，最优嵌入维度可按给出的方法确定，且该采样方式在突变自由能预测上胜过常规优化。

papers.title: Conditional Distributional Treatment Effects: Doubly Robust Estimation and Testing
papers.abstract_en: Beyond conditional average treatment effects, treatments may impact the entire outcome distribution in covariate-dependent ways, for example, by altering the variance or tail risks for specific subpopulations. We propose a novel estimand to capture such conditional distributional treatment effects, and develop a doubly robust estimator that is minimax optimal in the local asymptotic sense. Using this, we develop a test for the global homogeneity of conditional potential outcome distributions that accommodates discrepancies beyond the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), has provably valid type 1 error, and is consistent against fixed alternatives---the first test, to our knowledge, with such guarantees in this setting. We then provide a test that aggregates evidence across a grid of kernel-bandwidth choices. Furthermore, we derive exact closed-form expressions for two natural discrepancies (including the MMD), and provide a computationally efficient, permutation-free algorithm for our test.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出条件分布处理效应 (conditional distributional treatment effects) 这一新 estimand，刻画处理对协变量依赖的结果分布（方差、尾部风险）的影响，并给出局部渐近极小极大最优的双重稳健估计。配套的全局同质性检验在 MMD 之外容忍更广的分布差异，第一类错误可控、对固定备择一致，且有免置换的高效算法。
Motivation: 条件平均处理效应 (CATE) 只刻画均值，无法捕捉处理对特定子群方差或尾部风险的改变；现有同质性检验在该设定下缺少类型 I 误差与一致性的联合保证。
Method: 定义新的条件分布处理效应 estimand，构造双重稳健估计量并证明其局部渐近极小极大最优；基于此构造条件潜在结果分布全局同质性检验，支持跨核带宽网格聚合证据，推导含 MMD 在内的两种差异的精确闭式表达，并给出免置换 (permutation-free) 的高效算法。
Result: 估计量在局部渐近意义下极小极大最优；检验对类型 I 错误有可证明的有效性并对固定备择一致，作者称据其所知是该设定下首个同时具备这两项保证的检验。
Conclusion: 把处理效应从均值推广到整个条件分布并配以有理论保证的检验是可行的，且无需置换即可高效实施。
