papers.title: High-speed Imaging through Turbulence with Event-based Light Fields
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces and demonstrates the first system capable of imaging fast-moving extended non-rigid objects through strong atmospheric turbulence at high frame rate. Event cameras are a novel sensing architecture capable of estimating high-speed imagery at thousands of frames per second. However, on their own event cameras are unable to disambiguate scene motion from turbulence. In this work, we overcome this limitation using event-based light field cameras: By simultaneously capturing multiple views of a scene, event-based light field cameras and machine learning-based reconstruction algorithms are able to disambiguate motion-induced dynamics, which produce events that are strongly correlated across views, from turbulence-induced dynamics, which produce events that are weakly correlated across view. Tabletop experiments demonstrate event-based light field can overcome strong turbulence while imaging high-speed objects traveling at up to 16,000 pixels per second.
papers.journal_ref: Computer Vision - ECCV 2026, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 17066, pp. 632-649, Springer, Cham, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出首个通过强大气湍流对高速非刚性目标成像的系统：用 event-based light field camera 同时采集多视角事件流，机器学习重建算法依据跨视角事件相关性区分目标运动（强相关）与湍流诱导动态（弱相关），从而解开单个 event camera 无法区分的两者。桌面实验在高达 16,000 pixels/s 的高速目标上验证了该方案穿过强湍流成像的能力。
Motivation: event camera 能以数千 fps 估计高速图像，但单独使用时无法区分场景运动与大气湍流造成的动态，导致强湍流下的高速成像不可行。
Method: event-based light field camera 同时捕获场景多视角事件流，配合 machine learning-based reconstruction 算法，利用跨视角事件相关性强弱（运动强相关、湍流弱相关）分离两类动态并重建图像。
Result: 桌面实验演示了穿过强湍流对高速目标成像，目标速度最高达 16,000 pixels/s；系统被声明为首个在高帧率下对快速移动的扩展非刚性目标完成此类成像的系统。
Conclusion: 多视角事件相关性足以把湍流与真实运动分开，使 event-based light field 成为强大气湍流下高速非刚性目标成像的可行路径。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: UNet-AF: Alias-free UNet architectures
papers.abstract_en: The simplicity and effectiveness of UNet architectures make them ubiquitous in image restoration, segmentation, and diffusion models. They are often assumed to be equivariant to translations, yet they traditionally consist of layers that are known to be prone to aliasing, which hinders their equivariance in practice. To overcome this limitation, we show how to build sub-pixel translation-equivariant UNet architectures by appropriately choosing their main components (convolution, pooling, downsampling, activation, and normalization layers) to be alias-free. We evaluate the proposed equivariant architectures against non-equivariant baselines on image restoration tasks and observe competitive performance with a significant increase in measured equivariance. Through extensive ablation studies, we also demonstrate the importance of every architectural choice to achieve high equivariance. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/jscanvic/UNet-AF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UNet-AF 通过把卷积、池化、下采样、激活与归一化层全部换成无混叠 (alias-free) 组件，构建子像素平移等变的 UNet。在图像复原任务上性能与非等变基线相当，而实测等变性显著提升；消融显示每个组件的选择对高等变性都不可省。
Motivation: UNet 常被默认具备平移等变性，但其传统层易产生混叠 (aliasing)，实际等变性受损，影响图像复原、分割与扩散模型中的表现。
Method: 系统选择 UNet 主要组件——卷积、池化、下采样、激活、归一化——使其无混叠，从而构造子像素平移等变架构；并做大量消融验证各组件对等变性的贡献。实现开源。
Result: 在图像复原任务上，所提等变架构相对非等变基线性能有竞争力，同时实测等变性显著提升；消融研究显示每个架构选择对达到高等变性都重要。
Conclusion: UNet 的等变性可通过无混叠的组件选择在子像素层面实现，且不必以牺牲复原性能为代价。

papers.title: Distributed Legal Infrastructure for a Trustworthy Agentic Web
papers.abstract_en: The agentic web marks a structural transition from a human-centered information network to a digital environment populated by artificial intelligence (AI) agents that perceive, decide, and act autonomously. As delegated action unfolds at machine speed, exceeds discrete moments of human judgment, and distributes decision-making across non-human actors, existing legal frameworks face growing strain, creating an urgent need for new mechanisms capable of sustaining legality in this emerging order. A trustworthy agentic web therefore depends on the infrastructuring of legality through interoperable protocols that organize identity, delegation, and accountability across systems, enabling coherent governance beyond isolated platforms. Towards this end, this article advances a distributed legal infrastructure (DLI), a governance paradigm composed of five interlocking layers: (1) self-sovereign, soulbound agent identities; (2) cognitive AI logic and constraint systems; (3) decentralized adjudication mechanisms for dispute resolution; (4) bottom-up agentic market regulation to mitigate information asymmetries and network effects, including insurance-based models; and (5) portable institutional frameworks that enable legal interoperability while preserving plural sources of authority. This reference framework contributes to emerging research on embedding legality within agentic web infrastructure, aligning distributed technical systems with accountability, contestability, and rule-of-law principles.
papers.journal_ref: Stanford Journal of AI/Web3 Law and Policy, Kleros-Stanford Symposium Series, Forthcoming (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分布式法律基础设施 (DLI)，用五个互锁层把合法性嵌入 agentic web：自主主权的 soulbound agent 身份、认知 AI 逻辑与约束系统、去中心化争议裁决、含保险模型的自下而上 agent 市场监管、以及可移植的制度框架。该参考框架把问责、可争议性与法治原则对齐到分布式技术系统上。
Motivation: AI agent 以机器速度自主感知、决策并执行，决策跨非人类主体分布，现有法律框架难以承接这种委托行动，孤立平台之间也缺少一致治理。
Method: 提出五层参考框架：soulbound agent 身份、认知 AI 逻辑与约束系统、去中心化争议裁决机制、缓解信息不对称与网络效应的 agent 市场监管（含保险模型）、支持法律互操作且保留多元权威来源的可移植制度框架。
Result: 给出一个由五层互锁构成的 DLI 参考框架，作为嵌入 agentic web 基础设施的治理范式。
Conclusion: 可信的 agentic web 依赖跨系统互操作的协议来组织身份、委托与问责，从而在平台之外实现一致治理。

papers.title: Separators in Enhancing Autoregressive Pretraining for Vision Mamba
papers.abstract_en: The state space model Mamba has recently emerged as a promising paradigm in computer vision, attracting considerable attention for its efficient handling of long-sequence tasks. Its inherent causal structure makes it particularly well suited for autoregressive pretraining. However, existing autoregressive pretraining methods in vision are largely limited to short-sequence settings and may not fully use Mamba's capacity to model longer contexts. To investigate this setting, we introduce SeparaTors for AutoRegressive pretraining (STAR), a new autoregressive pretraining method for Vision Mamba that explicitly marks the boundaries between different images. STAR increases the patch-token sequence length from 144 to 640 by packing four images and four separator clusters. This is approximately $4.4\times$ the ARM patch-token sequence length. The increase is achieved without changing the resolution of any individual image: we use $192\times192$ inputs for autoregressive pretraining and $224\times224$ inputs for downstream classification fine-tuning. With this long-sequence pretraining scheme, STAR-B achieves 83.5\% EMA top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K after 1,600 epochs of pretraining. The learned representation also transfers beyond in-distribution classification: compared with ARM, STAR-B improves COCO box AP from 46.11 to 46.84 and mask AP from 40.74 to 41.45, while raising the mean top-1 accuracy across five ImageNet robustness benchmarks from 55.1\% to 56.8\%. Under the evaluated four-image setting, these results indicate that separator-based long-sequence pretraining improves recognition robustness and dense visual prediction relative to ARM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STAR 用分隔符簇把四张图拼进同一条自回归序列，把 Vision Mamba 的 patch-token 序列从 144 拉到 640（约 ARM 的 4.4 倍），单图分辨率不变。STAR-B 预训练 1,600 epoch 后 ImageNet-1K EMA top-1 达 83.5%，COCO box AP 从 46.11 升到 46.84、mask AP 从 40.74 升到 41.45，五个 ImageNet 鲁棒性基准平均 top-1 从 55.1% 升到 56.8%。
Motivation: 视觉自回归预训练大多停留在短序列设置，无法发挥 Mamba 因果结构在长上下文建模上的能力。
Method: 提出 SeparaTors for AutoRegressive pretraining (STAR)：在打包的图像之间显式插入分隔符簇标记边界，用 192×192 输入做自回归预训练、224×224 输入做下游分类微调，序列长度由 144 增至 640。
Result: STAR-B 在 ImageNet-1K 上预训练 1,600 epoch 后 EMA top-1 为 83.5%；相对 ARM，COCO box AP 46.11→46.84、mask AP 40.74→41.45，五个 ImageNet 鲁棒性基准平均 top-1 55.1%→56.8%；序列长度 144→640，约为 ARM 的 4.4 倍。
Conclusion: 在所评估的四图设置下，基于分隔符的长序列自回归预训练能提升识别鲁棒性与稠密视觉预测，且无需提高单图分辨率。

papers.title: Towards Effective Orchestration of AI x DB Workloads
papers.abstract_en: AI-driven analytics are increasingly crucial to data-centric decision-making. Executing relational and AI operators in separate runtimes prevents the database optimizer and runtime from coordinating operator ordering, model placement, batching, and state reuse. Integrating AI operators into database engines enables such coordination but raises challenges in jointly optimizing query processing and model execution, scheduling under resource contention, and reusing relational intermediates and AI artifacts. This paper formalizes AIxDB workloads as iterative, concurrent, and shareable executions that interleave relational and AI operators. We then advocate database-native orchestration as a paradigm for redesigning database engines for these workloads and distill two design principles: holistic AIxDB co-optimization and unified AIxDB cache management. We present NeurEngine as a proof-of-concept prototype and report preliminary results illustrating the performance benefits of database-native orchestration
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把关系算子与 AI 算子分属两套运行时、无法协同排序与复用的问题形式化为 AIxDB 工作负载（迭代、并发、可共享），主张用数据库原生编排 (database-native orchestration) 重构引擎，并给出两条设计原则：AIxDB 全局协同优化与统一缓存管理。原型 NeurEngine 的初步结果展示了这种编排带来的性能收益。
Motivation: 关系算子与 AI 算子在分离运行时中执行，数据库优化器与运行时无法协同算子排序、模型放置、批处理与状态复用，查询处理与模型执行的联合优化、资源竞争下的调度、中间结果与 AI 产物复用都成为瓶颈。
Method: 将 AIxDB 工作负载形式化为交错关系与 AI 算子的迭代、并发、可共享执行；提炼两条设计原则——holistic AIxDB co-optimization 与 unified AIxDB cache management；实现 proof-of-concept 原型 NeurEngine。
Result: 报告了初步结果，说明数据库原生编排带来的性能收益；摘要以定性方式呈现该收益，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 数据库原生编排是面向 AIxDB 工作负载重构数据库引擎的可行范式，其收益来自查询处理与模型执行的协同优化以及关系中间结果与 AI 缓存的统一管理；当前证据来自 NeurEngine 原型的初步结果。

papers.title: Spectral Overfitting in Noisy Linear Probing of Pretrained Representations
papers.abstract_en: Frozen pretrained features are often treated as a safe interface for downstream learning: only a small linear readout is trained, while the backbone is fixed. We show that this readout can still overfit noisy labels in a structured way. A label-blind PCA rank sweep reveals a sharp spectral pattern: under label noise, exposing all pretrained directions can hurt clean accuracy, and intermediate ranks often recover much of the lost performance. Rank-matched random projections help less, and measured between-class signal is strongly concentrated in leading PCs. The pattern appears across three ImageNet-pretrained backbones on CIFAR-10, with gains up to $36.0\pm0.8$ points over the default full-rank probe at 40\% noise. Tuned full-rank probes outperform validation-selected PCA probes, so we present the sweep as a diagnostic of spectral overfitting rather than a competitive noisy-label method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 冻结预训练特征上的线性探针在标签噪声下会以结构化方式过拟合：暴露全部预训练方向反而损害干净精度，中间 PCA 秩常能恢复大部分损失。在三个 ImageNet 预训练 backbone 与 CIFAR-10 上，40% 标签噪声时中间秩相对默认全秩探针最高提升 36.0±0.8 个点；作者把秩扫描定位为谱过拟合的诊断工具，而非有竞争力的噪声标签方法。
Motivation: 冻结 backbone + 线性读出被当作下游学习的安全接口，但读出层本身仍会在噪声标签上结构化过拟合，且这一现象此前缺少可识别的诊断信号。
Method: 做 label-blind 的 PCA 秩扫描 (rank sweep)，观察不同秩下干净精度随标签噪声的变化；对照 rank-matched 随机投影与调好的全秩探针，并测量类间信号在主成分上的分布；在三个 ImageNet 预训练 backbone 上于 CIFAR-10 重复。
Result: 40% 标签噪声下，中间 PCA 秩相对默认全秩探针最高提升 36.0±0.8 个点；类间信号强烈集中在前导 PC；rank-matched 随机投影收益更小；调优后的全秩探针优于验证集选秩的 PCA 探针。
Conclusion: 谱过拟合是冻结特征线性探针在噪声标签下的真实现象，秩扫描可作为其诊断；但 PCA 探针不是有竞争力的噪声标签方法，调好的全秩探针仍更强。

papers.title: StreamTTO: Efficient Online Test-Time Optimization for Video Depth Completion
papers.abstract_en: Monocular depth foundation models generalize across diverse scenes, but recovering accurate metric depth consistent with a target sensor remains challenging under sensor variation and domain shift. Test-time optimization (TTO) guided by sparse depth addresses this limitation, yet independent per-frame adaptation incurs substantial computational cost. We propose StreamTTO, an online test-time optimization framework for video depth completion that reuses visual features and adaptation state. A frozen feature extractor with causal temporal attention incorporates past visual context into features cached for repeated decoder optimization. Causal Sliding-Window Optimization directly updates a shared depth decoder using cached features and sparse observations from recent frames, requiring only two passes over the window per incoming frame after initialization. Reusing recent observations and the adapted decoder substantially reduces optimization steps. We also introduce MS-Depth, comprising approximately 1.45M synchronized RGB--LiDAR frames from 40 hours of recordings. Its uninterrupted sequences capture transitions among indoor, underground, and outdoor environments under daytime and nighttime conditions, enabling evaluation of adaptation to changes in illumination, scene structure, and depth range. Experiments on KITTI, Bonn, NYUv2 Raw, TUM RGB-D, DDAD, and MS-Depth demonstrate competitive depth completion accuracy. On MS-Depth, StreamTTO achieves average processing speeds of approximately 15~FPS with VGGT and 25~FPS with MoGe-2 at an input resolution of 518 X 392.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StreamTTO 把逐帧独立的测试时优化 (test-time optimization) 改成在线流式复用：冻结的特征提取器用 causal temporal attention 把历史视觉上下文缓存进特征，Causal Sliding-Window Optimization 用缓存特征与最近帧稀疏深度直接更新共享 depth decoder，初始化后每帧只需在窗口上前向两遍。在 KITTI、Bonn、NYUv2 Raw、TUM RGB-D、DDAD 与自建 MS-Depth 上取得有竞争力的深度补全精度，MS-Depth 上以 VGGT 约 15 FPS、MoGe-2 约 25 FPS（518×392）运行。
Motivation: 单目深度基础模型受传感器差异与 domain shift 影响，难以恢复与目标传感器一致的 metric depth；用稀疏深度引导的逐帧 TTO 虽能适配，但每帧独立优化计算开销大，难以在线运行。
Method: 冻结的特征提取器加 causal temporal attention，把过去视觉上下文并入缓存特征供 decoder 反复优化；Causal Sliding-Window Optimization 用缓存特征与最近几帧的稀疏观测直接更新一个共享 depth decoder，初始化后每来一帧只在窗口上跑两遍；同时提出 MS-Depth 数据集，约 1.45M 组同步 RGB–LiDAR 帧、来自 40 小时连续录制，覆盖室内、地下、室外与昼夜场景。
Result: 在 KITTI、Bonn、NYUv2 Raw、TUM RGB-D、DDAD 与 MS-Depth 上展示有竞争力的深度补全精度；MS-Depth 上平均处理速度约 15 FPS（VGGT）与 25 FPS（MoGe-2），输入分辨率 518×392；复用近期观测与已适配 decoder 显著减少优化步数。

papers.title: VeriSoftBench: Repository-Scale Formal Verification Benchmarks for Lean
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have achieved striking results in interactive theorem proving, particularly in Lean. However, most benchmarks for LLM-based proof automation are drawn from mathematics in the Mathlib ecosystem, whereas proofs in software verification are developed inside definition-rich codebases with substantial project-specific libraries. We introduce VeriSoftBench, a benchmark of 500 Lean 4 proof obligations drawn from open-source formal-methods developments and packaged to preserve realistic repository context and cross-file dependencies. Our evaluation of frontier LLMs and specialized provers yields three observations. First, provers tuned for Mathlib-style mathematics transfer poorly to this repository-centric setting. Second, success is strongly correlated with transitive repository dependence: tasks whose proofs draw on large, multi-hop dependency closures are less likely to be solved. Third, providing curated context restricted to a proof's dependency closure improves performance relative to exposing the full repository, but nevertheless leaves substantial room for improvement. Our benchmark and evaluation suite are released at https://github.com/utopia-group/VeriSoftBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VeriSoftBench 提出 500 个 Lean 4 软件验证证明义务，保留真实仓库上下文与跨文件依赖，用于检验 LLM 证明自动化在非 Mathlib 场景下的表现。评测发现：Mathlib 风格调优的 prover 迁移差；证明所依赖的传递闭包越大、多跳依赖越深，越难解；只提供依赖闭包内的精选上下文优于暴露整个仓库，但仍有较大提升空间。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 定理证明基准几乎全部取自 Mathlib 数学生态，而软件验证证明位于定义密集、依赖项目专属库的代码仓库中，两类场景差异导致已有 prover 表现无法迁移。
Method: 从开源形式化方法开发中抽取 500 个 Lean 4 证明义务，打包时保留真实仓库上下文与跨文件依赖；评测前沿 LLM 与专用 prover，并对比全仓库暴露与依赖闭包精选上下文两种设置。
Result: 三项定性观察：Mathlib 调优 prover 在仓库中心设定下迁移差；成功率与传递仓库依赖强相关，多跳大闭包任务更难解；依赖闭包精选上下文相对全仓库暴露提升性能，但仍有较大改进空间。基准含 500 个证明义务，已开源。
Conclusion: 软件验证的定理证明基准必须保留仓库级依赖结构，且上下文应按依赖闭包裁剪而非整库暴露；即便如此，专用 prover 在该设定下仍远未饱和。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FMMD: A multimodal multidisciplinary dataset of open peer reviews from F1000Research
papers.abstract_en: Automated scholarly paper review (ASPR) has entered the coexistence phase with traditional peer review, where artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly incorporated into real-world manuscript evaluation. In parallel, research on automated and AI-assisted peer review has proliferated. Despite this momentum, empirical progress remains constrained by several critical limitations in existing datasets. While reviewers routinely evaluate figures, tables, and complex layouts to assess scientific claims, most existing datasets remain overwhelmingly text-centric. This bias is reinforced by a narrow focus on data from computer science publications. Furthermore, existing datasets rarely preserve precise alignment between review comments and specific manuscript versions, obscuring the iterative relationship between peer review and manuscript evolution. In response, we introduce FMMD, a multimodal and multidisciplinary open peer review dataset curated from F1000Research. The dataset addresses the current limitations by integrating manuscript-level visual and structural data with version-specific reviewer reports and editorial decisions. By explicitly aligning review comments with the exact article version under review, FMMD enables granular analysis of the peer review lifecycle. Importantly, its coverage of F1000Research extends ASPR research beyond its traditional focus on computer science to a diverse range of scientific disciplines. FMMD supports a range of research tasks, including visual-semantic consistency classification, figure-related review comment generation, and editorial decision prediction based on multimodal manuscript inputs, thereby providing a comprehensive empirical resource for developing and evaluating multimodal ASPR systems and advancing peer review research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FMMD 是从 F1000Research 整理的多模态、跨学科学术同行评审数据集，把稿件的图表与版面结构数据同逐版本的审稿意见和编辑决定显式对齐，从而支持视觉-语义一致性分类、图表相关审稿意见生成、以及基于多模态稿件输入的编辑决定预测三类任务。它把 ASPR（自动学术论文评审）的实证研究从计算机科学扩展到多学科，并可做同行评审生命周期的细粒度分析。
Motivation: 现有 ASPR 数据集以文本为主、集中在计算机科学文献，且很少保留审稿意见与具体稿件版本的精确对应，掩盖了同行评审与稿件演化之间的迭代关系。
Method: 从 F1000Research 收集稿件级视觉与结构数据，与逐版本的审稿报告和编辑决定配对，按稿件版本显式对齐评论；数据集为多模态、跨学科的开放同行评审资源，供训练与评测多模态 ASPR 系统使用。
Result: 提出并发布 FMMD 数据集，覆盖 F1000Research 的多学科稿件，整合视觉、结构与版本化文本评审数据，支持视觉-语义一致性分类、图表相关审稿意见生成、编辑决定预测三类任务。
Conclusion: 多模态、版本对齐的同行评审数据可以把 ASPR 研究从计算机科学推广到多学科，并支撑对同行评审生命周期的细粒度实证分析。

papers.title: Discovering Data Manifold Geometry through Geometric Properties
papers.abstract_en: A prevailing paradigm in modern representation learning is the map-first approach, in which a representation map is learned from reconstruction, embedding, or task objectives. At the optimum, when the learned map accurately recovers a global coordinate chart, it should exhibit three structural properties whose geometric meaning can be illustrated through a face-editing example: Commutativity requires that changing pose and then expression gives the same result as applying them in the reverse order; Time Coherence requires that the same variation along one coordinate induces the same expression change across faces; Common-Reference requires that all faces are organized relative to a common reference face. However, small approximation errors in the learned map need not translate into small errors in these structural properties, and can therefore disrupt the global organization of the representation. Based on this observation, we consider the converse of the map-first formulation and ask whether a global representation can instead emerge by directly learning these properties. We represent variations along individual coordinates through vector fields defined in the ambient space and introduce a non-contraction condition preventing one transformation from destroying directions associated with the others. We derive an unsupervised objective that learns these structural properties and establish theoretical results connecting its minimization to tangent-space recovery. Experiments on controlled manifolds validate the predicted tangent-space recovery and global structure, while an autoencoder baseline shows that small map-first errors can still produce substantial violations of the targeted properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出与 map-first 相反的表征学习路线：不先学重建映射，而是直接学习全局坐标图应满足的三条结构性质——交换性 (Commutativity)、时间一致性 (Time Coherence)、公共参考 (Common-Reference)。用环境空间中的向量场表示单坐标变化，并引入非收缩条件防止一个变换破坏其他坐标方向，导出无监督目标；受控流形实验验证切空间恢复，自编码器基线显示 map-first 的小误差仍会大幅违反这些性质。
Motivation: map-first 范式下学习到的映射即使近似误差很小，也可能在交换性、时间一致性、公共参考这三条结构性质上产生大偏差，从而破坏表征的全局组织。
Method: 把单坐标变化表示为环境空间中的向量场，引入非收缩条件约束不同坐标方向互不破坏；据此导出直接学习三条结构性质的无监督目标，并给出目标最小化与切空间恢复之间联系的理论结果。
Result: 受控流形实验验证了理论预测的切空间恢复与全局结构；自编码器基线显示 map-first 的小误差仍可造成对目标性质的实质性违反。
Conclusion: 全局表征可以直接由结构性质涌现，而不必先拟合映射；map-first 的近似精度不足以保证这些性质成立。

papers.title: A Multimodal Large Language Model-Driven Framework for Context-Aware UAV Emergency Landing Site Selection
papers.abstract_en: Safe UAV emergency landing requires more than just identifying flat terrain; it demands understanding complex semantic risks (e.g., crowds, temporary structures) invisible to traditional geometric sensors. In this paper, we propose a novel framework leveraging Remote Sensing (RS) imagery and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for global context-aware landing site assessment. Unlike local geometric methods, our approach employs a coarse-to-fine pipeline: first, a lightweight semantic segmentation module efficiently pre-screens candidate areas; second, a vision-language reasoning agent fuses visual features with Point-of-Interest (POI) data to detect subtle hazards. To validate this approach, we construct and release the Emergency Landing Site Selection (ELSS) benchmark at https://github.com/chunlianghua/ELSS-dataset. ELSS includes a remote-sensing subset for simulation validation and a UAV aerial-video subset for real-world testing. Experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms geometric baselines in risk identification accuracy. Furthermore, qualitative results confirm its ability to generate human-like, interpretable justifications, enhancing trust in automated decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用遥感影像加多模态大模型 (MLLM) 做 UAV 应急降落点的语义风险评估：先用轻量语义分割粗筛候选区，再由视觉-语言推理智能体融合影像与 POI 数据识别人群、临时构筑物等几何传感器看不见的风险。在自建的 ELSS benchmark（含遥感仿真子集与 UAV 实拍视频子集）上，风险识别准确率显著高于几何基线，并能给出可读的判断理由。
Motivation: 传统应急降落点选择只依赖几何传感器判断地形是否平坦，无法识别人群、临时构筑物等语义风险，而这类风险才是安全降落的关键。
Method: 粗到细流水线：轻量语义分割模块先高效预筛候选区域，随后视觉-语言推理智能体把遥感影像特征与 Point-of-Interest (POI) 数据融合，做上下文相关的危险检测；并构建发布 ELSS benchmark（github.com/chunlianghua/ELSS-dataset），分遥感仿真验证子集与 UAV 实拍视频子集。
Result: 在 ELSS benchmark 的遥感与 UAV 视频两个子集上，框架的风险识别准确率显著高于几何基线；定性结果显示其能生成类人、可解释的判断依据。
Conclusion: 语义级风险理解加可解释推理能补上纯几何降落点选择的盲区，作者以公开 ELSS 数据集支撑该框架用于自动化降落决策并提升可信度。

papers.title: Relative Wasserstein Angle and the Problem of the $W_2$-Nearest Gaussian Distribution
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the distributional structure of high-dimensional datasets has become an important topic, yet direct visual characterization is difficult. In this work, we develop a geometric framework for characterizing the distributional structure of empirical datasets by quantifying their deviation from the Gaussian family under the geometry induced by optimal transport theory. Building on the cone structure of the relative translation invariant quadratic Wasserstein $(RW_2)$ space, we define two geometric quantities---the \emph{relative Wasserstein angle} and the \emph{orthogonal projection distance}---and show that they are well-defined because of the flat geometry of the filling cone between distributional rays. This formulation recasts the problem of measuring deviation from the Gaussian family as an orthogonal projection problem onto the Gaussian cone and reveals that the commonly used moment-matching Gaussian is, in general, not the $W_2$-nearest Gaussian to a non-Gaussian distribution. In one dimension, we derive closed-form expressions for the proposed quantities and extend closed-form expressions to several other location--scale families, including uniform, Laplace, and logistic distributions. In higher dimensions, we develop a numerical approximation method for the proposed quantities based on empirical optimal transport and covariance-shape optimization. Our experimental results show the empirical convergence and stability of the proposed methods and reveal that the $RW_2$ angle provides a robust and consistent measure of distributional non-Gaussianity. Moreover, these results provide empirical support for its potential use as an indicator of distributional heterogeneity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在相对平移不变二次 Wasserstein (RW2) 空间的锥结构上定义 relative Wasserstein angle 与正交投影距离，把「偏离高斯族」重写为向高斯锥的正交投影问题，并证明常用的矩匹配高斯一般并非 W2 意义下最近的高斯。一维给出闭式解并推广到 uniform、Laplace、logistic 等位置-尺度族，高维用经验最优传输加 covariance-shape 优化做数值近似；实验显示该角度收敛且稳定，可作为非高斯性与分布异质性的稳健度量。
Motivation: 高维数据分布结构难以直接可视化，而衡量偏离高斯族时常用的矩匹配高斯在 W2 几何下一般并不最近，需要一个几何上良定义的度量。
Method: 基于 RW2 空间的锥结构与分布射线间填充锥的平坦几何，定义 relative Wasserstein angle 和 orthogonal投影距离；一维及 uniform、Laplace、logistic 等位置-尺度族推闭式表达，高维用经验最优传输加 covariance-shape 优化做数值近似。
Result: 实验显示所提方法经验收敛且稳定，RW2 角给出稳健一致的非高斯性度量，并支持其作为分布异质性指标的潜力；一维与若干位置-尺度族有闭式表达。
Conclusion: 偏离高斯族可作为向高斯锥的正交投影问题处理，且矩匹配高斯通常不是 W2 最近高斯；RW2 角可作为非高斯性与异质性的经验指标。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Quantum Model Parallelism for MRI-Based Classification of Alzheimer's Disease Stages
papers.abstract_en: With increasing life expectancy, AD has become a major global health concern. While classical AI-based methods have been developed for early diagnosis and stage classification of AD, growing data volumes and limited computational resources necessitate faster, more efficient approaches. Quantum-based AI methods, which leverage superposition and entanglement principles along with high-dimensional Hilbert space, can surpass classical approaches' limitations and offer higher accuracy for high-dimensional, heterogeneous, and noisy data. In this study, a Quantum-Based Parallel Model (QBPM) architecture is proposed for the efficient classification of AD stages using MRI datasets, inspired by the principles of classical model parallelism. The proposed model leverages quantum advantages by employing two distinct quantum circuits, each incorporating rotational and entanglement blocks, running in parallel on the same quantum simulator. The classification performance of the model was evaluated on two different datasets to assess its overall robustness and generalization capability. The proposed model demonstrated high classification accuracy across both datasets, highlighting its overall robustness and generalization capability. Results obtained under high-level Gaussian noise, simulating real-world conditions, further provided experimental evidence for the model's applicability not only in theoretical but also in practical scenarios. Moreover, compared with five different classical transfer learning methods, the proposed model demonstrated its efficiency as an alternative to classical approaches by achieving higher classification accuracy and comparable execution time while utilizing fewer circuit parameters. The results indicate that the proposed QBPM architecture represents an innovative and powerful approach for the classification of stages in complex diseases such as Alzheimer's.
papers.comment: Under review at Quantum Machine Intelligence (Springer Nature)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出量子并行模型 (QBPM)：两条含旋转与纠缠模块的量子线路在同一量子模拟器上并行运行，用于 MRI 的阿尔茨海默病分期分类。在两个数据集上均取得高分类准确率，高斯噪声下仍可用；相比五种经典迁移学习方法，准确率更高、执行时间相当、线路参数更少。
Motivation: AD 早期诊断与分期依赖经典 AI，但数据量增长与算力受限要求更快更高效的方案，且高维、异构、含噪的 MRI 数据对经典方法构成压力。
Method: 受经典模型并行启发设计 QBPM：两条独立量子线路各含旋转块与纠缠块，在同一量子模拟器上并行执行；在两个 MRI 数据集上评测，并加入高水平高斯噪声模拟真实条件，与五种经典迁移学习方法对比准确率、执行时间与线路参数量。
Result: 在两个不同数据集上均取得高分类准确率；高水平高斯噪声条件下结果仍支持其在实际场景的可用性；相比五种经典迁移学习方法，分类准确率更高、执行时间相当、所用线路参数更少。
Conclusion: QBPM 可作为经典迁移学习的替代路线用于复杂疾病分期分类，兼具准确率、执行时间与参数效率上的优势。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Text-only adaptation in LLM-based ASR through text denoising
papers.abstract_en: Adapting large language model (LLM)-based automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems to new domains using text-only data is a significant yet underexplored challenge. Standard fine-tuning of the LLM on the target domain text often disrupts the critical alignment between the speech and text modality learned by the projector, degrading performance. We introduce a novel text-only adaptation method that frames this process as a text denoising task. Our approach trains the LLM to recover clean transcripts from noisy inputs. This process effectively adapts the model to a target domain while preserving cross-modal alignment. Our solution is lightweight, requiring no architectural changes or additional parameters. Extensive evaluation on two datasets demonstrates up to 22.1% relative improvement, outperforming recent state-of-the-art text-only adaptation methods.
papers.comment: Notice: this version has been superseded by a revised version published at Interspeech: https://www.isca-archive.org/interspeech_2026/burdisso26_interspeech.html
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM-based ASR 的纯文本域适配重构成文本去噪 (text denoising) 任务：训练 LLM 从含噪输入恢复干净转写，从而在适应目标域文本的同时保住 projector 学到的语音-文本跨模态对齐。在两个数据集上最高取得 22.1% 相对提升，超过近期的纯文本适配 SOTA，且不改结构、不加参数。
Motivation: LLM-based ASR 用目标域文本直接微调会破坏 projector 建立的语音-文本模态对齐，导致识别性能下降；纯文本域适配这一设定研究不足。
Method: 将域适配形式化为文本去噪任务，训练 LLM 从加噪的输入恢复干净转写，以此隐式适应目标域分布并保持跨模态对齐；方案轻量，无需架构改动或额外参数。
Result: 在两个数据集上的评测中取得最高 22.1% 的相对提升，优于近期的纯文本适配 SOTA 方法。
Conclusion: 纯文本适配不必以牺牲跨模态对齐为代价，用去噪目标代替直接微调即可在零语音数据下适应新域并提升 ASR 表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Linear probing enables Ship-Radiated Noise recognition with pretrained audio embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Even though the ocean covers the majority of the planet's surface, it remains the least explored ecosystem. As light and radio waves do not propagate through water, underwater acoustics is the main choice for various ocean applications ranging from marine biology to pollution monitoring. Increasing levels of anthropogenic noise from ships contribute significantly to underwater sound pollution, posing risks to marine ecosystems. This makes monitoring crucial to understand and quantify the impact of the ship radiated noise. Passive Acoustic Monitoring (PAM) systems are widely deployed for this purpose, generating years of underwater recordings across diverse soundscapes. Manual analysis of such large-scale data is impractical, motivating the need for automated approaches based on machine learning. Recent advances in automatic Underwater Acoustic Target Recognition (UATR) have largely relied on supervised learning, which is constrained by the scarcity of labeled data. Transfer Learning (TL) offers a promising alternative to mitigate this limitation. In this work, we conduct the first empirical comparative study of transfer learning for UATR, evaluating multiple pretrained audio models originating from diverse audio domains. The pretrained model weights are frozen, and the resulting embeddings are analyzed through classification, clustering, and similarity-based evaluations. The analysis shows that the geometrical structure of the embedding space is largely dominated by recording-specific characteristics. However, a simple linear probe can effectively suppress this recording-specific information and isolate ship-type features from these embeddings. As a result, linear probing enables effective automatic UATR using pretrained audio models at low computational cost, significantly reducing the need for a large amounts of high-quality labeled ship recordings.
papers.journal_ref: Ecological Informatics, 95, 2026, 103709
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个面向水下声学目标识别 (UATR) 的迁移学习实证对比：冻结多个预训练音频模型取 embedding，发现其几何结构主要被录音设备/环境等 recording-specific 特征支配，而一个简单线性探针 (linear probe) 能压制这类干扰、分离出船型特征，从而以极低算力实现自动 UATR，大幅减少对大量高质量标注船噪声录音的需求。
Motivation: 被动声学监测 (PAM) 积累了数年水下录音，人工分析不可行；监督式 UATR 又受标注数据稀缺制约，需要不依赖大规模标注的识别途径。
Method: 首个迁移学习在 UATR 上的实证对比研究：选取来自不同音频领域的多个预训练音频模型，冻结权重提取 embedding，再通过分类、聚类与相似性评估三种方式分析表征，并在冻结特征上训练线性探针。
Result: embedding 空间的几何结构主要由 recording-specific 特征主导；线性探针可有效抑制该信息并分离船型特征，实现低算力的自动 UATR，显著降低对大量高质量标注船录音的需求。
Conclusion: 预训练音频 embedding 加线性探针即可缓解 UATR 的标注稀缺问题，前提是用线性探针剥离录音特异性变化、只保留船型信息。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Learning to bin: differentiable and Bayesian optimization for multi-dimensional discriminants in high-energy physics
papers.abstract_en: Categorizing events using discriminant observables is central to many high-energy physics analyses. Yet, bin boundaries are often chosen manually. A simple, popular choice in multi-classification tasks is to assign events according to the largest per-class score ("argmax") and to apply equidistant binning to the resulting one-dimensional discriminants. We propose a binning optimization for signal significance directly in multi-dimensional discriminants. We use a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to define flexible regions in the score space, which can be interpreted either as bins or as analysis categories. While this GMM-based strategy is applicable in both one and multiple dimensions, we also study a direct bin-boundary optimization in one dimension as a simpler alternative for binary discriminants. On this binning model, we study two optimization strategies: a differentiable and a Bayesian optimization approach. We study two toy setups: a binary classification and a three-class problem with two signals and backgrounds. In the one-dimensional case, both approaches achieve similar gains in signal sensitivity compared to equidistant binning for a given number of bins, while in the multi-dimensional case the differentiable approach performs best. We show that the GMM-based optimization can outperform argmax classification even after optimized binning is applied to the one-dimensional projections. We further study the performance of our methods on the FAIR Universe $H\rightarrowττ$ dataset, where the GMM-based optimization gives the highest signal significance. Both methods are released as lightweight Python plugins intended for straightforward integration into existing analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 高能物理判别量分箱通常手工设定，本文直接对多维判别量做信号显著性 (signal significance) 的分箱优化：用 Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) 在分数空间划分可解释为 bin 或分析类别的区域，并比较可微优化与 Bayesian optimization 两种策略。在二分类与双信号三分类两个 toy setup 上，一维时两种策略相对等距分箱增益相当、多维时可微方法最好；GMM 优化即使施加在 argmax 一维投影的优化分箱上也能超过 argmax 分类，在 FAIR Universe H→ττ 数据集上 GMM 优化给出最高信号显著性。
Motivation: 多分类任务里事件常按最大类别分数 (argmax) 派到一维判别量再等距分箱，bin 边界多为手工设定，无法直接针对信号显著性优化，尤其浪费多维判别信息。
Method: 两条路线：一是用 GMM 在多维 score 空间定义灵活区域，兼作 bin 或分析类别；二是一维二值判别量上的直接 bin 边界优化。在该分箱模型上比较可微优化与 Bayesian optimization 两种策略，用二分类和含两信号一背景的三分类两个 toy setup 检验，并在 FAIR Universe H→ττ 数据集上测试；两方法以轻量 Python 插件发布。
Result: 一维情形下，可微与 Bayesian 两种方法在给定 bin 数时相对等距分箱的信号灵敏度增益相当；多维情形下可微方法表现最好。GMM 优化可超过 argmax 分类，即使 argmax 一维投影已施加优化分箱；在 FAIR Universe H→ττ 数据集上 GMM 优化给出最高信号显著性。
Conclusion: 把分箱边界直接按信号显著性优化、并用 GMM 在多维判别量上划分区域，是优于手工等距分箱与 argmax 派类的做法；一维二值情形可退化为更简单的直接边界优化，两方法以可集成的 Python 插件形式发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exact and Approximate Range Queries in Ball Mapper
papers.abstract_en: Ball Mapper summarizes a finite metric dataset by covering the sample with closed balls centered at selected landmarks and connecting landmarks whose balls share observations. Its construction therefore depends critically on repeated fixed radius range queries, yet the effect of replacing exact queries by approximate search has not been systematically characterized. We formulate Ball Mapper through an abstract range query procedure that separates the mathematical construction from the search backend used to realize it. Under fixed ordering, exact procedures preserve the landmark sequence, cover, graph, and membership-based colorings. For approximate procedures, we derive deterministic bounds on covering radius and landmark separation under additive and multiplicative query errors, prove inclusions for the induced nerve, characterize edge survival through witness redundancy for conservative approximations, and bound perturbations of mean vertex colorings. The accompanying implementation provides independent exact reference backends together with exhaustive and approximate search methods under a common closed ball convention. Experiments on Gaussian, mixture, and noisy curve data across three seeds show that approximation fidelity depends strongly on geometry and that edges supported by multiple witnesses are substantially more robust to missed memberships. At 20,000 observations, the approximate indexes did not outperform exhaustive FAISS Flat search. The results therefore establish a framework for controlled approximation rather than a universal speed advantage, and identify the geometric and combinatorial quantities that govern when approximate range search preserves the Ball Mapper summary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Ball Mapper 的构造抽象成可替换后端的 range query 过程，并证明在固定排序下精确查询保持 landmark 序列、覆盖、图与基于成员关系的着色；对近似查询则给出覆盖半径与 landmark 间距的确定性界、诱导 nerve 的包含关系，以及保守近似下由 witness 冗余决定的边存活性刻画。在 Gaussian、mixture、noisy curve 数据各三个 seed 上，近似保真度强烈依赖几何，多 witness 支撑的边对漏检成员关系明显更稳健；在 20,000 个观测时近似索引并未胜过穷举 FAISS Flat 搜索。
Motivation: Ball Mapper 的构造依赖大量固定半径 range query，但用近似搜索替换精确查询会怎样破坏覆盖、图结构与着色，此前没有被系统刻画，因而无法判断何时可以安全换后端。
Method: 将 Ball Mapper 表述为抽象 range query 过程，把数学构造与搜索后端解耦；对加性与乘法查询误差推导覆盖半径和 landmark 间距的确定性界，证明诱导 nerve 的包含关系，用 witness 冗余刻画保守近似的边存活性，并界定平均顶点着色的扰动；配套实现提供独立的精确参考后端以及统一闭球约定下的穷举与近似搜索方法。
Result: 在 Gaussian、mixture、noisy curve 三类数据、三个 seed 上，近似保真度强烈依赖几何形状，多 witness 支撑的边对漏检成员关系显著更稳健；在 20,000 个观测规模下，近似索引没有超过穷举 FAISS Flat 搜索。
Conclusion: 结果给出的是可控近似 (controlled approximation) 的框架而非普遍加速优势，决定近似 range search 能否保住 Ball Mapper 摘要的是几何与组合量。

papers.title: Efficient and scalable clustering of survival curves
papers.abstract_en: Survival analysis encompasses a broad range of methods for analyzing time-to-event data, with one key objective being the comparison of survival curves across groups. Traditional approaches for identifying clusters of survival curves often rely on computationally intensive bootstrap techniques to approximate the null hypothesis distribution. While effective, these methods impose significant computational burdens. In this work, we propose a novel approach that leverages the k-means and log-rank test to efficiently identify and cluster survival curves. Our method eliminates the need for computationally expensive resampling, significantly reducing processing time while maintaining statistical reliability. By systematically evaluating survival curves and determining optimal clusters, the proposed method ensures a practical and scalable alternative for large-scale survival data analysis. Through simulation studies, we demonstrate that our approach achieves results comparable to existing bootstrap-based clustering methods while dramatically improving computational efficiency. These findings suggest that the log-rank-based clustering procedure offers a viable and time-efficient solution for researchers working with multiple survival curves in medical and epidemiological studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 k-means 与 log-rank 检验结合来做生存曲线聚类，用 log-rank 直接替代 bootstrap 重采样来近似零假设分布，从而去掉重采样开销。模拟研究中该方法与既有 bootstrap 聚类方法结果相当，同时大幅缩短处理时间，面向大规模生存数据与医学、流行病学中的多曲线场景。
Motivation: 传统生存曲线聚类依赖计算密集的 bootstrap 来近似零假设分布，在多曲线、大规模数据上计算负担过重。
Method: 提出 k-means 与 log-rank 检验结合的聚类流程：系统评估生存曲线、确定最优簇，用 log-rank 检验替代重采样近似零假设分布，无需 bootstrap。
Result: 模拟研究中，该方法与既有基于 bootstrap 的聚类方法结果相当，同时显著降低处理时间、提升计算效率；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 基于 log-rank 的聚类流程可作为多生存曲线场景下省时且统计可靠的可扩展替代方案，适用于医学与流行病学研究。

papers.title: Navigating Taxonomic Expansions of Entity Sets Driven by Knowledge Bases
papers.abstract_en: Recognizing similarities among entities is central to both human cognition and computational intelligence. Within this broader landscape, Entity Set Expansion is one prominent task aimed at taking an initial set of (tuples of) entities and identifying additional ones that share relevant semantic properties with the former, potentially repeating the process to form increasingly broader sets. However, this ``linear'' approach does not unveil the richer ``taxonomic'' structures present in knowledge resources. A recent logic-based framework introduces the notion of an expansion graph: a rooted directed acyclic graph where each node represents a semantic generalization labeled by a logical formula, and edges encode strict semantic inclusion. This structure supports taxonomic expansions of entity sets driven by knowledge bases. Yet, the potentially large size of such graphs may make full materialization impractical in real-world scenarios. To overcome this, we formalize reasoning tasks that check whether two tuples belong to comparable, incomparable, or the same nodes in the graph. Our results show that these tasks are intractable in general, that they remain intractable when the number of input tuples is bounded, and that they become solvable in polynomial time when the descriptions of the entities are small as well. The bounds we establish are tight. This enables local, incremental navigation of expansion graphs, supporting practical applications without requiring full graph construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对知识库驱动的实体集分类扩展图 (expansion graph) 全量物化代价过高的问题，形式化了判定两组元组在图中可比、不可比或同属一节点的推理任务。证明这些任务一般情形下不可判定为多项式（intractable），即使输入元组数有界仍不可解，但当实体描述规模也较小时可在多项式时间内求解，且所给复杂度界是紧的，从而支持不建全图的局部增量导航。
Motivation: 知识库上的实体集扩展只能做线性扩张，无法呈现知识资源中的分类（taxonomic）结构；而 expansion graph 全量物化在真实场景中规模过大、不可行。
Method: 在既有逻辑框架的 expansion graph（有根 DAG，节点为逻辑公式标注的语义泛化，边表示严格语义包含）上，形式化三类比较推理任务：判定两组元组可比、不可比或同节点，并做复杂度分类。
Result: 三类推理任务在一般情形下是 intractable 的；当输入元组数量有界时仍保持 intractable；当实体描述规模也受限时可在多项式时间内求解；所建立的复杂度界是紧的 (tight)。
Conclusion: 复杂度界使得 expansion graph 可以只做局部、增量的导航，无需完整构图即可支撑实际应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LiDAS: Lighting-driven Dynamic Active Sensing for Nighttime Perception
papers.abstract_en: Nighttime environments pose significant challenges for camera-based perception, as existing methods passively rely on the scene lighting. We introduce Lighting-driven Dynamic Active Sensing (LiDAS), a closed-loop active illumination system that combines off-the-shelf visual perception models with high-definition headlights. Rather than uniformly brightening the scene, LiDAS dynamically predicts an optimal illumination field that maximizes downstream perception performance, i.e., decreasing light on empty areas to reallocate it on object regions. LiDAS enables zero-shot nighttime generalization of daytime-trained models through adaptive illumination control. Trained on synthetic data and deployed zero-shot in real-world closed-loop driving scenarios, LiDAS enables +18.7% mAP50 and +5.0% mIoU over standard low-beam at equal power. It maintains performances while reducing energy use by 40%. LiDAS complements domain-generalization methods, further strengthening robustness without retraining. By turning readily available headlights into active vision actuators, LiDAS offers a cost-effective solution to robust nighttime perception.
papers.comment: Published at CVPR 2026. 12 pages, 9 figures. Project page: https://simondemoreau.github.io/LiDAS/
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiDAS 把汽车前大灯变成闭环主动照明执行器，动态预测最优光照场：把空旷区域的光减下来重新分配到物体区域，而非均匀提亮，使白天训练的感知模型在夜间零样本工作。在真实闭环驾驶中，同等功率下相对标准近光灯 mAP50 提升 18.7%、mIoU 提升 5.0%，并在能耗降低 40% 的同时保持性能。
Motivation: 夜间相机感知受限于被动依赖场景光照，现有方法无法主动改变照到传感器上的光，导致白天训练的模型在夜间失效。
Method: LiDAS 是闭环主动照明系统，把现成视觉感知模型与高清晰度前大灯结合，动态预测使下游感知性能最大化的光照场（降低空旷区域照明、重新分配到物体区域），通过自适应照明控制实现零样本夜间泛化；在合成数据上训练后零样本部署到真实闭环驾驶。
Result: 真实闭环驾驶场景中，同等功率下相对标准近光灯 mAP50 +18.7%、mIoU +5.0%；能耗降低 40% 的同时保持性能；与域泛化方法互补，无需重训练即可进一步增强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 把前大灯当作主动视觉执行器、按感知需求重新分配光照，是低成本实现夜间鲁棒感知的路径，且可与域泛化方法叠加而不需重训练。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Radiance-Field Guided Pretraining: Scaling Localization Models with Unlabeled Wireless Signals
papers.abstract_en: Radio frequency (RF)-based indoor localization offers significant promise for applications such as indoor navigation, augmented reality, and pervasive computing. While deep learning has greatly enhanced localization accuracy and robustness, existing localization models still face major challenges in cross-scene generalization due to their reliance on scene-specific labeled data. To address this, we introduce Radiance-Field Reinforced Pretraining (RFRP). This novel self-supervised pretraining framework couples a large localization model (LM) with a neural radio-frequency radiance field (RF-NeRF) in an asymmetrical autoencoder architecture. In this design, the LM encodes received RF spectra into latent, position-relevant representations, while the RF-NeRF decodes them to reconstruct the original spectra. This alignment between input and output enables effective representation learning using large-scale, unlabeled RF data, which can be collected continuously with minimal effort. To this end, we collected RF samples at 7,327,321 positions across 100 diverse scenes using four common wireless technologies--RFID, BLE, WiFi, and IIoT. Data from 75 scenes were used for training, and the remaining 25 for evaluation. Experimental results show that the RFRP-pretrained LM reduces localization error by over 40% compared to non-pretrained models and by 21% compared to those pretrained using supervised learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Radiance-Field Reinforced Pretraining (RFRP)：把大定位模型 (LM) 与神经射频辐射场 (RF-NeRF) 组成非对称自编码器，用无标签 RF 数据做自监督预训练，缓解室内射频定位对场景标注的依赖。在 100 个场景、7,327,321 个位置（RFID/BLE/WiFi/IIoT）上，75 场景训练、25 场景评测，定位误差较未预训练降低 40% 以上，较监督预训练降低 21%。
Motivation: 深度室内射频定位依赖场景专属标注数据，跨场景泛化差；而无标签 RF 数据可低成本持续采集，却缺少有效的表征学习方式。
Method: RFRP 采用非对称自编码器：LM 编码接收 RF 频谱为与位置相关的隐表示，RF-NeRF 解码重建原始频谱，以此在大规模无标签 RF 数据上自监督预训练；数据覆盖 100 个场景、7,327,321 个位置、四种无线技术，75 场景训练、25 场景评测。
Result: RFRP 预训练的 LM 定位误差较未预训练模型降低 40% 以上，较监督预训练降低 21%；评测在 25 个 held-out 场景上进行，训练用 75 个场景、7,327,321 个位置的 RFID/BLE/WiFi/IIoT 数据。
Conclusion: 用 RF-NeRF 重建频谱作为监督信号，可在无标签射频数据上预训练大定位模型并显著改善跨场景定位精度，优于监督预训练。

papers.title: GeoBridge++: Fact-Guided Geo-Semantic Bridging for Unified Cross-View Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view geo-localization infers a location by retrieving geo-tagged reference images matching a query image. However, the traditional satellite-centric paradigm limits robustness when high-resolution or up-to-date satellite imagery is unavailable and underexploits complementary cues across views and modalities. To address these challenges, we propose GeoBridge, a novel model that performs bidirectional matching across views and supports language-to-image retrieval. GeoBridge builds on a novel semantic-anchor mechanism that bridges multi-view features through textual descriptions for robust, flexible localization. We further extend GeoBridge to propose GeoBridge++, a fact-guided geo-semantic bridging framework incorporating real-world geographic knowledge to reduce the ambiguity and instability in appearance-dominated supervision. It integrates structured geographic attributes with visual observations to construct factual descriptions and applies targeted guidance based on modality-specific observable content, thereby enhancing geographic discriminability. GeoBridge++ exploits explicit spatial structures encoded by static maps to build a geo-semantic bridge that adaptively aggregates complementary multi-view information and promotes cross-view consistency. In support of this task, we further construct GeoLoc-MM, a million-scale, multi-view, and multi-scale dataset with aligned drone, satellite, street-view, and static-map imagery at six spatial extents per location, enabling systematic evaluation of arbitrary cross-view retrieval, scale robustness, and cross-view generalization. Extensive experiments show that GeoBridge supports robust cross-view and cross-modal geo-localization, while GeoBridge++ achieves consistent improvements across multiple benchmarks. Code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/MiliLab/GeoBridge.
papers.comment: An extension of the conference version accepted by CVPR 2026. Code, dataset, and pretrained models will be released at https://github.com/MiliLab/GeoBridge

TL;DR: GeoBridge++ 用事实引导的地理语义桥接做统一跨视图地理定位：以文本语义锚点双向匹配卫星/无人机/街景，并把结构化地理属性与静态地图空间结构注入描述，压低纯外观监督的歧义与不稳。配套构建百万级 GeoLoc-MM 数据集（每地点六个空间尺度、四类视角对齐），实验显示其在多个基准上一致提升。
Motivation: 以卫星为中心的跨视图定位在高分辨率或最新卫星影像缺失时鲁棒性差，且外观主导的监督存在歧义与不稳定，跨视角与跨模态的互补线索未被充分利用。
Method: GeoBridge 用语义锚点机制经文本描述桥接多视角特征，支持双向匹配与文到图检索；GeoBridge++ 进一步整合结构化地理属性与视觉观测构造事实描述，按模态可观测内容做定向引导，并利用静态地图的显式空间结构自适应聚合多视角信息、促进跨视图一致性。
Result: 构建 GeoLoc-MM：百万级、多视角多尺度数据集，每个地点对齐无人机、卫星、街景与静态地图影像，含六个空间尺度，支持任意跨视图检索、尺度鲁棒性与跨视图泛化的系统评测；实验显示 GeoBridge 支持鲁棒的跨视图与跨模态定位，GeoBridge++ 在多个基准上取得一致提升。
Conclusion: 把真实地理知识与静态地图空间结构引入跨视图定位，可在卫星影像受限时提升地理判别力与跨视图一致性，且改进在多个基准上稳定成立。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Towards Synergistic Teacher-AI Interactions with Generative Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used in education, posing significant challenges for teachers adapting to these changes. GenAI offers unprecedented opportunities for accessibility, scalability and productivity in educational tasks. However, the automation of teaching tasks through GenAI raises concerns about reduced teacher agency, potential cognitive atrophy, and the broader deprofessionalisation of teaching. Drawing findings from prior literature on AI in Education, and refining through a recent systematic literature review, this chapter presents a conceptualisation of five levels of teacher-AI teaming: transactional, situational, operational, praxical and synergistic teaming. The framework aims to capture the nuanced dynamics of teacher-AI interactions, particularly with GenAI, that may lead to the replacement, complementarity, or augmentation of teachers' competences and professional practice. GenAI technological affordances required in supporting teaming, along with empirical studies, are discussed. Drawing on empirical observations, we outline a future vision that moves beyond individual teacher agency toward collaborative decision-making between teachers and AI, in which both agents engage in negotiation, constructive challenge, and co-reasoning that enhance each other's capabilities and enable outcomes neither could realise independently. Further discussion of socio-technical factors beyond teacher-AI teaming is also included to streamline the synergy of teachers and AI in education ethically and practically.
papers.journal_ref: Handbook of Generative AI in Education (2026) 261-279
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出教师与生成式 AI 协作的五级框架（transactional、situational、operational、praxical、synergistic teaming），刻画 GenAI 对教学任务的自动化如何走向教师能力的替代、互补或增强。作者主张把教师个体能动性推进到教师与 AI 的协同决策：双方协商、建设性质疑、共同推理 (co-reasoning)，达成任一方单独无法实现的结果。
Motivation: GenAI 在教育中的普及使教师面临适应压力，教学任务自动化带来教师能动性下降、认知萎缩 (cognitive atrophy) 与教学去专业化 (deprofessionalisation) 的风险，缺少刻画教师与 AI 互动层级的概念框架。
Method: 综合 AI in Education 既有文献并用近期系统性文献综述 (systematic literature review) 的发现加以提炼，构建五级 teacher-AI teaming 概念框架；讨论支撑各级 teaming 所需的 GenAI 技术可供性 (affordances) 与相关实证研究，并纳入 teaming 之外的社会技术因素。
Result: 给出五级 teaming 概念化：transactional、situational、operational、praxical、synergistic，用以判定 GenAI 对教师能力与专业实践产生替代、互补还是增强；章节为 19 页、6 图，收录于 Handbook of Generative AI in Education (2026) 第 261–279 页。
Conclusion: 教师与 GenAI 的关系应从个体能动性走向协同决策，通过协商、建设性质疑与共同推理实现双方能力互增；实现该愿景需同时处理 teaming 之外的社会技术因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CID: Measuring Feature Importance Through Counterfactual Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Assessing the importance of individual features in Machine Learning is critical to understand the model's decision-making process. While numerous methods exist, the lack of a definitive ground truth for comparison highlights the need for alternative, well-founded measures. This paper introduces a novel post-hoc local feature importance method called Counterfactual Importance Distribution (CID). We generate two sets of positive and negative counterfactuals, model their distributions using Kernel Density Estimation, and rank features based on a distributional dissimilarity measure. This measure, grounded in a rigorous mathematical framework, satisfies key properties required to function as a valid metric. We showcase the effectiveness of our method by comparing with well-established local feature importance explainers. Our method not only offers complementary perspectives to existing approaches, but also improves performance on faithfulness metrics (both for comprehensiveness and sufficiency), resulting in more faithful explanations of the system. These results highlight its potential as a valuable tool for model analysis. Link to repository: https://github.com/EddieConti/CID
papers.comment: Accepted at Northern Lights Deep Learning (NLDL) 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出事后局部特征重要性方法 Counterfactual Importance Distribution (CID)：生成正负两组反事实，用核密度估计 (KDE) 建模其分布，再按分布差异度量给特征排序。该度量满足有效 metric 所需的关键性质，在 faithfulness 的 comprehensiveness 与 sufficiency 指标上相较已有局部解释器提升性能，提供互补视角。
Motivation: 特征重要性方法众多但缺少可比的 ground truth，需要有理论依据、可作为合法度量的替代性重要性衡量。
Method: 生成正、负两组反事实样本，用 Kernel Density Estimation 拟合各特征分布，基于分布差异度量排序特征；该度量在严格数学框架下推导并满足有效 metric 的关键性质，作为 post-hoc 局部解释方法与既有局部特征重要性解释器对比。
Result: 在 faithfulness 指标上提升性能，涵盖 comprehensiveness 与 sufficiency 两类，得到更忠实的解释；并展示相对既有局部特征重要性解释器的互补视角。
Conclusion: 以反事实分布差异定义的特征重要性可作为有理论支撑的合法度量，既补充现有解释方法又提高解释忠实度，适合作为模型分析工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Finding Kissing Numbers with Game-theoretic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Since Isaac Newton first studied the Kissing Number Problem in 1694, determining the maximal number of non-overlapping spheres around a central sphere has remained a defining challenge in discrete geometry. As the local analogue of Hilbert's 18th problem, it has profound implications across geometry, number theory and information theory. Although lattices and codes have achieved significant progress, the field is confined to isolated extremal configurations, leaving underlying geometric principles obscured. Here we shift the object to the broader extremal configuration space, thereby opening a new path for the Kissing Number Problem. Accordingly, we recast this problem as a cooperative matrix-completion game, and train a reinforcement learning system, PackingStar, to solve it. One player fills cosine entries while the other corrects suboptimal ones, making explosive geometric complexity tractable. Working within extremal configuration spaces, PackingStar discovers new interpretable geometric structures that improve 15 strong bounds held for decades in kissing numbers and their generalizations, several of them provably optimal under natural inner products. These findings reveal the first explicit spherical-code realization of the Fischer group Fi22, extend the classical Euclidean representation of subgroup structure, and directly inspire subsequent breakthroughs by mathematicians. Overall, the work provides an early example of AI-driven progress on a Hilbert-calibre problem, showing how reinforcement learning advances mathematical discovery by unlocking more expressive objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Kissing Number 问题从孤立极值构型改写为合作式矩阵补全博弈，用双智能体强化学习系统 PackingStar 一方填余弦条目、一方纠正次优条目，在极值构型空间中搜索球码。它改进了 15 个保持数十年的强界，其中若干在自然内积下可证最优，并给出 Fischer 群 Fi22 的首个显式球码实现。
Motivation: Kissing Number 问题自 1694 年 Newton 起长期依赖格与码等孤立极值构型，几何原理被遮蔽，问题对象本身限制了进展路径。
Method: 将问题重述为合作式矩阵补全博弈并训练强化学习系统 PackingStar：一个 agent 填充余弦矩阵条目，另一个 agent 纠正次优条目，搜索对象是更广的极值构型空间而非固定格或码。
Result: 改进了 15 个保持数十年的 kissing number 及其推广的强界，其中数个在自然内积下可证最优；发现 Fischer 群 Fi22 的首个显式球码实现，并扩展了子群结构的经典 Euclidean 表示。
Conclusion: 把搜索对象换成更富表达力的极值构型空间，强化学习可以推动 Hilbert 量级的数学问题取得实质进展，并直接启发数学家后续突破。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: STAR-VAE: A Scalable Latent-Variable Transformer for Controllable Molecular Generation
papers.abstract_en: Many molecular Transformers lack probabilistic latent variables for posterior inference and latent interpolation. We introduce STAR-VAE, a SELFIES-encoded, Transformer-based, AutoRegressive Variational AutoEncoder combining a bidirectional encoder with an autoregressive decoder pretrained on 79 million PubChem molecules. A property signal jointly conditions the prior, posterior, and decoder, while LoRA adapters support fine-tuning on small datasets without modifying the backbone. STAR-VAE achieves 100% validity and near-perfect novelty under unconditional MOSES sampling, the lowest KL divergence on five of ten GuacaMol descriptors, Spearman \r{ho} = 0.62 at 98% validity for synthetic-accessibility conditioning, and directional docking-score control for three Tartarus protein targets. Across four ChEMBL targets, seed-based posterior sampling recovers target-associated held-out scaffolds while label-conditioned sampling produces structurally diverse outputs. Code is available at https://github.com/BiomedSciAI/STAR-VAE.
papers.comment: 46 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables, and Supporting Information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STAR-VAE 是 SELFIES 编码的自回归变分 Transformer 分子生成模型，在 7900 万 PubChem 分子上预训练，用属性信号同时条件化先验、后验与解码器，并以 LoRA 适配器在小数据集上微调。无条件 MOESA 采样达到 100% validity 与近乎完全 novelty，合成可及性条件化在 98% validity 下 Spearman ρ=0.62，三个 Tartarus 蛋白靶点上实现对接分数的方向性控制。
Motivation: 现有分子 Transformer 缺少可用于后验推断与 latent interpolation 的概率隐变量，属性可控生成只能靠事后筛选，难以在小数据集上微调。
Method: SELFIES 编码的自回归 VAE：双向编码器 + 自回归解码器，在 7900 万 PubChem 分子上预训练；属性信号联合条件化 prior、posterior 与 decoder，LoRA adapter 支持小数据微调而不改动 backbone；用 seed-based posterior sampling 与 label-conditioned sampling 生成。
Result: 无条件 MOSES 采样 100% validity、近乎完全 novelty；十个 GuacaMol 描述符中五个上 KL divergence 最低；合成可及性条件化在 98% validity 下 Spearman ρ=0.62；三个 Tartarus 蛋白靶点上实现对接分数的方向性控制；四个 ChEMBL 靶点上 seed-based posterior sampling 恢复靶点相关 held-out scaffold，label-conditioned sampling 给出结构多样输出。
Conclusion: 把属性信号同时注入 prior/posterior/decoder 并配 LoRA，可在保持高 validity 与 novelty 的同时实现属性与靶点方向的可控分子生成，且 posterior 具备可解释的采样语义。

papers.title: Metamodel-Guided Model Generation with Layered Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) enable natural-language interaction in engineering modeling, but generated models may violate structural constraints, domain rules, or task requirements. We propose a metamodel-guided model generation method that coordinates generation-time constraints and post-generation validation. The method transforms metamodel information, uses its terminology to guide structured constraint extraction from specifications, and links constraints to metamodel elements while recording their sources in an Integrated Constraint Model (ICM). For each task, relevant constraints are bound to concrete objects, values, and references. The generation-time constraint layer (L1) restricts candidate content. The post-generation validation layer (L2) checks constructed models and serialized artifacts, and task acceptance checks retain the original requirements throughout repair. Deterministic procedures construct and serialize models, while LLMs propose candidate content and repairs. Validation uses existing domain tools and checkers written by humans with LLM assistance. Experiments cover AUTOSAR, railway models, and structured decisions in private international law. All 60 AUTOSAR generation runs passed acceptance within the declared task scope, and all 255 resulting ARXML files passed XSD validation. In a separate controlled AUTOSAR repair experiment, all 85 core fault units and 15 prespecified substitute units were restored within one repair round. A local AUTOSAR experiment recorded interventions during stepwise generation. The results support coordinating generation constraints, domain checks, and task acceptance to construct models and guide bounded repair.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出元模型引导的模型生成方法，把生成期约束层 L1 与生成后校验层 L2 协同起来：元模型信息先转成术语并从规格中抽取结构化约束，绑定到 Integrated Constraint Model (ICM) 的具体对象与引用，由确定性过程构造序列化模型、LLM 只提候选内容与修复。在 AUTOSAR、铁路模型与私国际法结构化决策上，60 次 AUTOSAR 生成全部通过任务验收，255 个 ARXML 文件全部通过 XSD 校验，85 个核心故障单元与 15 个预设替换单元在一轮修复内全部恢复。
Motivation: LLM 生成的工程模型可能违反结构约束、领域规则与任务要求，需要在生成与修复全程保留原始需求而不只是事后过滤。
Method: 变换元模型信息并用其术语从规格中做结构化约束抽取，把约束关联到元模型元素并记录来源，形成 Integrated Constraint Model (ICM)；每任务把相关约束绑定到具体对象、值与引用，L1 限制候选内容，L2 校验构造模型与序列化产物，任务验收检查在修复中保留原需求；确定性过程负责构造与序列化，LLM 提候选与修复，校验用既有领域工具与人写（LLM 辅助）检查器。
Result: 实验覆盖 AUTOSAR、铁路模型与私国际法结构化决策：60 次 AUTOSAR 生成运行全部在声明任务范围内通过验收，255 个 ARXML 文件全部通过 XSD 校验；独立的受控 AUTOSAR 修复实验中，85 个核心故障单元与 15 个预设替换单元全部在一轮修复内恢复；另有本地 AUTOSAR 实验记录了分步生成过程中的干预。
Conclusion: 把生成约束、领域检查与任务验收协同起来，可以在声明的任务范围内构造模型并引导有界的修复。

papers.title: Simulation-free Structure Learning for Stochastic Population Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Modeling dynamical systems and unraveling their underlying structural dependencies is central to many domains in the natural sciences. Various physical systems, such as those arising in cell biology, are inherently high-dimensional and stochastic in nature, and admit only partial, noisy state measurements. Our primary motivating setting is single-cell biology, where destructive measurements yield unpaired population snapshots rather than longitudinal trajectories of the same cells. This poses a significant challenge for addressing the problems of modeling the underlying dynamics and inferring the network structure of these systems. Existing methods are typically tailored either for structure learning or modeling dynamics at the population level, but are limited in their ability to address both problems together. In this work, we address both problems simultaneously: we present StructureFlow, a novel and principled simulation-free training approach for jointly learning the structure and stochastic population dynamics of physical systems. We showcase the utility of StructureFlow for the tasks of structure learning from interventions and dynamical (trajectory) inference of conditional population dynamics. We empirically evaluate our approach on high-dimensional synthetic systems, a set of biologically plausible simulated systems, and an experimental single-cell dataset. We show that StructureFlow can learn the structure of underlying systems while simultaneously modeling their conditional population dynamics --- a key step toward model-based mechanistic understanding of systems behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 StructureFlow：一种免仿真 (simulation-free) 的训练方法，从非配对的单细胞群体快照中联合学习系统结构与随机群体动力学。在高维合成系统、生物学合理的模拟系统和一个实验单细胞数据集上，它能同时从干预中恢复结构并推断条件群体轨迹。
Motivation: 单细胞破坏性测量只给出非配对群体快照而非同一细胞的纵向轨迹，且系统高维、随机、仅部分含噪观测；现有方法只能做结构学习或群体动力学建模之一，无法同时处理。
Method: StructureFlow 采用免仿真的训练方式，联合学习物理系统的结构与随机群体动力学；任务设定为从干预中做结构学习，以及对条件群体动力学做轨迹推断。
Result: 在高维合成系统、一组生物学合理的模拟系统和一个实验单细胞数据集上进行实证评估，展示其可同时学习底层系统结构并建模条件群体动力学。
Conclusion: 联合结构学习与群体动力学建模可以同时完成，这是迈向基于模型的系统行为机理理解的关键一步。

papers.title: Robust Photoplethysmography Signal Denoising via Mamba Networks
papers.abstract_en: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely used in wearable health monitoring, but its reliability is often degraded by noise and motion artifacts, limiting downstream applications such as heart rate (HR) estimation. This paper presents a deep learning framework for PPG denoising with an emphasis on preserving physiological information. In this framework, we propose DPNet, a Mamba-based denoising backbone designed for effective temporal modeling. To further enhance denoising performance, the framework also incorporates a scale-invariant signal-to-distortion ratio (SI-SDR) loss to promote waveform fidelity and an auxiliary HR predictor (HRP) that provides physiological consistency through HR-based supervision. Experiments on the BIDMC dataset show that our method achieves strong robustness against both synthetic noise and real-world motion artifacts, outperforming conventional filtering and existing neural models. Our method can effectively restore PPG signals while maintaining HR accuracy, highlighting the complementary roles of SI-SDR loss and HR-guided supervision. These results demonstrate the potential of our approach for practical deployment in wearable healthcare systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DPNet：以 Mamba 为时序骨干的 PPG 去噪框架，配合 SI-SDR 波形保真损失与心率预测器 (HRP) 的 HR 监督，在 BIDMC 数据集上同时对抗合成噪声与真实运动伪迹，恢复波形的同时保持 HR 估计精度，优于传统滤波与已有神经模型。
Motivation: PPG 可穿戴监测常被噪声与运动伪迹破坏，导致下游心率估计不可靠；去噪若只压噪声容易损伤生理信息。
Method: 框架含三部分：Mamba 时序骨干 DPNet 做去噪；scale-invariant signal-to-distortion ratio (SI-SDR) 损失约束波形保真；辅助心率预测器 (HRP) 以 HR 估计提供生理一致性监督。
Result: 在 BIDMC 数据集上，对合成噪声与真实运动伪迹均表现出强鲁棒性，去噪同时保持 HR 准确度，性能优于传统滤波与已有神经模型；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: SI-SDR 波形保真与 HR 引导监督作用互补，可在可穿戴健康场景中实用部署。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Provable Anytime Ensemble Sampling Algorithms in Nonlinear Contextual Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We provide a unified algorithmic framework for ensemble sampling in nonlinear contextual bandits and develop corresponding regret bounds for two most common nonlinear contextual bandit settings: Generalized Linear Model Ensemble Sampling (GLM-ES) for generalized linear contextual bandits and Neural Ensemble Sampling (Neural-ES) for neural contextual bandits. Both methods maintain multiple estimators for the reward model parameters via maximum likelihood estimation on randomly perturbed data. We prove high-probability frequentist regret bounds of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d^{3/2} \sqrt{T} + d^{4})$ for GLM-ES and $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\widetilde{d}^{3/2} \sqrt{T})$ for Neural-ES, where $d$ is the dimension of feature vectors, $\widetilde{d}$ is the effective dimension of a neural tangent kernel (NTK) matrix and $T$ is the number of rounds. The regret bound of GLM-ES matches the state-of-the-art result of randomized exploration algorithms in generalized linear bandit setting. In the theoretical analysis, we introduce techniques that address challenges specific to nonlinear models. Practically, we remove fixed-time horizon assumption by developing anytime versions of our algorithms, suitable when $T$ is unknown. Finally, we empirically evaluate GLM-ES, Neural-ES and their anytime variants, demonstrating strong performance. Overall, our results establish ensemble sampling as a provable and practical randomized exploration approach for nonlinear contextual bandits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在非线性 contextual bandit 中给出统一的 ensemble sampling 框架：GLM-ES 处理广义线性设定，Neural-ES 处理神经网络设定，两者都对随机扰动数据做 MLE 维护多个奖励参数估计器，并给出高概率 regret 界。GLM-ES 达到与广义线性 bandit 随机探索最优结果匹配的 Õ(d^{3/2}√T + d^4)，Neural-ES 为 Õ(d̃^{3/2}√T)；进一步去掉固定时间视界假设得到 anytime 版本，实验中表现强。
Motivation: ensemble sampling 在线性 bandit 中实用且可证，但非线性设定（广义线性、神经网络奖励模型）缺少统一的算法框架与匹配的 regret 保证，且现有理论多依赖已知时间视界 T。
Method: 统一框架下维护多个奖励参数估计器，每个估计器在随机扰动后的数据上做最大似然估计 (MLE)：广义线性 contextual bandit 用 GLM-ES，神经 contextual bandit 用 Neural-ES（依赖 neural tangent kernel, NTK 的有效维度 d̃）。理论分析引入针对非线性模型的技术，并开发去掉固定时间视界假设的 anytime 版本；最后对 GLM-ES、Neural-ES 及其 anytime 变体做实证评估。
Result: 高概率 frequentist regret 界：GLM-ES 为 Õ(d^{3/2}√T + d^4)，与广义线性 bandit 中随机探索算法的 state-of-the-art 结果匹配；Neural-ES 为 Õ(d̃^{3/2}√T)，d 为特征维度、d̃ 为 NTK 矩阵有效维度、T 为轮数。实证评估显示 GLM-ES、Neural-ES 及其 anytime 变体表现强。
Conclusion: ensemble sampling 可作为非线性 contextual bandit 中既可证明又实用的随机探索方法；anytime 版本使其适用于 T 未知的场景。

papers.title: Transport-Coupled Bayesian Flows for Molecular Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: Molecular graph generation (MGG) is essentially a multi-class generative task, aimed at predicting categories of atoms and bonds under strict chemical and structural constraints. However, many prevailing diffusion paradigms learn to regress numerical embeddings and rely on a hard discretization rule during sampling to recover discrete labels. This introduces a fundamental discrepancy between training and sampling. While models are trained for point-wise numerical fidelity, the sampling process fundamentally relies on crossing categorical decision boundaries. This discrepancy forces the model to expend efforts on intra-class variations that become irrelevant after discretization, ultimately compromising diversity, structural statistics, and generalization performance. Therefore, we propose TopBF, a unified framework that (i) performs MGG directly in continuous parameter distributions, (ii) learns graph-topological understanding through a Quasi-Wasserstein optimal-transport coupling under geodesic costs, and (iii) supports controllable, property-conditioned generation during sampling without retraining the base model. TopBF innovatively employs cumulative distribution function (CDF) to compute category probabilities induced by the Gaussian channel, thereby unifying the training objective with the sampling discretization operation. Experiments on QM9 and ZINC250k demonstrate superior structural fidelity and efficient generation with improved performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopBF 把分子图生成 (MGG) 直接放在连续参数分布上做，用 Quasi-Wasserstein 最优传输耦合与测地代价学习图拓扑，并用累积分布函数 (CDF) 计算高斯信道诱导的类别概率，使训练目标与采样时的离散化操作一致。在 QM9 与 ZINC250k 上展示更优的结构保真度与高效生成，且采样阶段支持性质条件生成而无需重训基模型。
Motivation: 主流扩散范式回归数值嵌入、采样时靠硬离散化恢复离散标签，训练与采样存在根本性错位：模型把精力花在离散化后无关的类内变化上，损害多样性、结构统计与泛化。
Method: TopBF 统一框架：在连续参数分布上直接做 MGG；通过 Quasi-Wasserstein 最优传输耦合 (optimal-transport coupling) 在测地代价下学习图拓扑理解；用 CDF 计算高斯信道诱导的类别概率，把训练目标与采样离散化统一；采样时支持性质条件生成且不重训基模型。
Result: 在 QM9 与 ZINC250k 上展示更优的结构保真度与高效生成、性能提升（abstract 未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把离散标签的生成放到连续分布并用传输耦合与 CDF 对齐训练和采样，可在不重训的前提下支持可控、性质条件化的分子图生成。

papers.title: Data Provenance Auditing of Fine-Tuned Large Language Models with a Text-Preserving Technique
papers.abstract_en: We propose a system for marking sensitive or copyrighted texts to detect their use in fine-tuning large language models under black-box access with statistical guarantees. Our method builds digital ``marks'' using invisible Unicode characters organized into (``cue'', ``reply'') pairs. During an audit, prompts containing only ``cue'' fragments are issued to trigger regurgitation of the corresponding ``reply'', indicating document usage. To control false positives, we compare against held-out counterfactual marks and apply a ranking test, yielding a verifiable bound on the false positive rate. Empirically, we obtain a true positive rate of 96.7% at 0% false positive rate and reply regurgitation rates exceeding 28% per document with only 40 (4%) watermarked documents. The approach is minimally invasive, scalable across many sources, robust to standard processing pipelines, and achieves high detection power even when marked data is a small fraction of the fine-tuning corpus.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026 - Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning, Jul 2026, Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种在黑盒条件下审计微调大模型数据来源的文本标记法：用不可见 Unicode 字符组成 (cue, reply) 对嵌入敏感或版权文本，审计时只发 cue 片段触发模型复述 reply，从而判定该文档是否被用于微调。配合留出反事实标记与排序检验，可给出可验证的假阳性率上界；实测在 0% 假阳性率下真阳性率达 96.7%，仅 40 篇（占 4%）带标记文档时每文档 reply 复述率超过 28%。
Motivation: 黑盒条件下难以证明某份敏感或版权文本被用于微调大模型，需要一种带统计保证、对正常文本处理流程干扰小的检测手段。
Method: 把不可见 Unicode 字符组织成 (cue, reply) 对嵌入目标文本；审计时仅发送 cue 片段，触发模型复述 reply 作为使用证据；用留出的反事实标记 (held-out counterfactual marks) 做对照并施加排序检验 (ranking test)，得到可验证的假阳性率界。
Result: 真阳性率 96.7% 且假阳性率为 0%；每文档 reply 复述率超过 28%，此时仅 40 篇带标记文档、占微调语料的 4%。方法对标准处理流程稳健，可在标记数据只占语料很小比例时保持高检测力。
Conclusion: 不可见字符标记加反事实排序检验能在黑盒微调审计中以可验证的假阳性界实现高检测力，且对语料中占比很小的标记数据同样有效。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: WATCH: World-aware Allied Trajectory and pose reConstruction for Camera and Human
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing global human motion from monocular video is fundamental to VR, graphics, and robotics, yet remains ill-posed due to depth ambiguity, motion ambiguity, and the entanglement of camera and human movements. Human-motion-centric methods achieve strong physical plausibility but leave two signals unused: camera orientation is processed through a fixed coordinate transformation with no independent supervision of its components, and camera velocity is discarded entirely despite being directly observable from SLAM. Camera-trajectory-centric methods use camera translation directly, but hard-decoding SLAM trajectories into human positions propagates depth errors and fails entirely under static cameras. We present WATCH (World-aware Allied Trajectory and pose reConstruction for Camera and Human). The key observation is that once camera orientation is made explicit, camera velocity becomes a natural additional input rather than an ambiguous one. We therefore decompose camera rotation into a network-estimated roll-pitch component and an analytically recoverable yaw, supervising each independently. This decomposition exposes a clean geometric interface through which camera velocity is incorporated as a learned spatial prior in the backbone, without the physically implausible artifacts that arise from hard-decoding. WATCH outperforms prior human-motion-centric methods on both static-camera (RICH) and dynamic-camera (EMDB) benchmarks in global trajectory accuracy, temporal smoothness, and physical plausibility, and remains robust when ground-truth camera is replaced with DPVO estimates.
papers.comment: Pacific Graphics 2026 camera-ready version. 10 pages main paper and 3 pages supplementary material; supplementary videos included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WATCH 把相机旋转拆成网络估计的 roll-pitch 与解析恢复的 yaw 分别监督，使相机速度能作为可学习的空间先验接入骨干，而非硬解码 SLAM 轨迹。在静态相机 RICH 与动态相机 EMDB 上，全局轨迹精度、时间平滑性和物理合理性均超过既有人体中心方法，且把真值相机换成 DPVO 估计后仍保持稳健。
Motivation: 单目视频重建全局人体运动因深度歧义、运动歧义以及相机与人体运动纠缠而病态；人体中心方法浪费了可从 SLAM 直接观测的相机速度，相机中心方法硬解码 SLAM 轨迹会传播深度误差、静态相机下完全失效。
Method: WATCH 将相机旋转分解为网络估计的 roll-pitch 分量与解析可恢复的 yaw 并各自独立监督，由此打开一个几何接口，把相机速度作为可学习的空间先验接入骨干网络，避免硬解码带来的物理不合理伪影。
Result: 在静态相机 RICH 与动态相机 EMDB 两个基准上，全局轨迹精度、时间平滑性与物理合理性均优于此前的人体中心方法；当真值相机被 DPVO 估计替换时仍保持稳健。
Conclusion: 把相机朝向显式化之后，相机速度就从歧义输入变成自然的附加条件，人体中心路线可以借此在静态与动态相机两种设定下同时拿到更好的全局轨迹。

papers.title: Ultra Strong Machine Learning: LLM-Generated Explanations Do Not Yet Suffice for Teaching Humans Active Learning Strategy
papers.abstract_en: Active learning is a general learning mechanism shared by artificial and human learners. Whether AI can teach humans such a strategy that transfers across domains is an open question. Ultra Strong Machine Learning (USML), a system whose explanations quantifiably improve human out-of-sample performance compared to self-learning, is uniquely positioned to answer this question. Prior USML work relied on hand-crafted explanation templates that require expert effort for each new domain and do not scale. We developed an explanation pipeline combining Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) with large language models (LLMs) to automate explanation generation and scoring. We tested whether these explanations achieve USML in a human trial teaching active learning strategies across three related domains. Our exploratory results show that concise, expert-written explanations benefit learners with higher initial performance, while pipeline-generated explanations provide no advantage over self-learning despite being rated as higher quality from an LLM-as-judge evaluation. This case study reveals a systematic gap that LLM quality metrics do not predict human learning outcomes. Our findings point to explanation complexity relative to task difficulty as a key factor, and call for explanation methods and evaluation criteria grounded in human cognitive constraints rather than LLM preference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 ILP 与 LLM 拼成解释生成与打分流水线，在跨三个相关领域的主动学习策略人试中检验能否达到 Ultra Strong Machine Learning（USML）。结果是流水线生成的解释相对自学无优势，尽管 LLM-as-judge 给它更高分；只有简洁的专家手写解释对初始水平较高的学习者有效。作者据此指出解释复杂度相对任务难度是关键，并主张用人类认知约束而非 LLM 偏好来定评价标准。
Motivation: 既有的 USML 解释依赖专家为每个新领域手工写模板，无法扩展；而 AI 能否把可跨领域迁移的学习策略教给人仍是开放问题，且 LLM 解释质量指标与人类学习效果之间的关系未知。
Method: 构建 Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) 与 LLM 结合的流水线，自动产生并打分解释；在三个相关领域上做人类被试试验，教主动学习策略，比较流水线解释、专家手写解释与自学，并用 LLM-as-judge 评估解释质量。
Result: 探索性结果：简洁的专家手写解释让初始表现较高的学习者受益；流水线生成的解释相对自学没有优势，尽管 LLM-as-judge 评其质量更高。摘要未给出样本量或效应数值。
Conclusion: LLM 的质量指标不能预测人类学习效果，解释复杂度相对任务难度是决定性因素；解释方法与评价标准应建立在人类认知约束之上，而非 LLM 偏好。

papers.title: Towards Mitigating Excessive Forgetting in LLM Unlearning via Entanglement-Guidance with Proxy Constraint
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on massive datasets that may include private or copyrighted content. Due to growing privacy and ownership concerns, data owners may request the removal of their data from trained models. Machine unlearning provides a practical solution by removing the influence of specific data without full retraining. However, most existing methods still suffer from over-unlearning due to the lack of a principled mechanism to regulate the forgetting boundary, leading to unnecessary utility degradation and heightened privacy and robustness risks. In this work, we propose EGUP (Entanglement-Guided Unlearning with Proxy Constraint), a novel framework that leverages entanglement and proxy constraint to guide the unlearning process while mitigating over-unlearning. Within each iteration, EGUP employs inter-sample entanglement to adaptively reweight the unlearning strength, assigning greater unlearning efforts to forget samples that are semantically closer to retained knowledge. Across iterations, EGUP leverages intra-sample entanglement to track the representation shift of each forget sample and dynamically adjust its unlearning effort. In addition, we incorporate a proxy constraint that approximates the model's expected outputs after unlearning, forming a reference boundary that softly regularizes the unlearning process. EGUP is compatible with existing gradient-based objectives and serves as a plug-and-play enhancement. We evaluate EGUP on the TOFU and MUSE benchmarks, demonstrating consistent improvements in the unlearning-utility trade-off across multiple LLMs. Moreover, EGUP achieves performance close to the retrained model while remaining scalable and robust.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LLM 遗忘框架 EGUP：用样本间纠缠 (inter-sample entanglement) 自适应加权遗忘强度、样本内纠缠 (intra-sample entanglement) 跟踪表征偏移，并加一个近似遗忘后期望输出的 proxy constraint 作为软边界，抑制过度遗忘。在 TOFU 与 MUSE 基准上跨多个 LLM 一致改善遗忘-效用权衡，性能接近完全重训模型。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法缺少规制遗忘边界的原理性机制，导致过度遗忘，带来不必要的效用下降以及更高的隐私与鲁棒性风险。
Method: EGUP 在每次迭代内用 inter-sample entanglement 对遗忘样本按其与保留知识的语义接近程度重加权，语义更近者分配更强遗忘；跨迭代用 intra-sample entanglement 追踪每个遗忘样本的表征偏移并动态调整其遗忘强度；再引入近似遗忘后期望输出的 proxy constraint 形成参考边界做软正则。框架兼容现有基于梯度的目标，可即插即用。
Result: 在 TOFU 与 MUSE 基准上、跨多个 LLM，遗忘-效用权衡 (unlearning-utility trade-off) 一致改善；性能接近重训模型 (retrained model)，且保持可扩展与鲁棒。
Conclusion: 用纠缠驱动的自适应遗忘强度加 proxy constraint 软边界，可以在不完全重训的前提下把遗忘控制在预期边界附近，缓解过度遗忘。
Relevance: 0
