papers.title: EndoCogniAgent: Closed-Loop Agentic Reasoning with Self-Consistency Validation for Endoscopic Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Endoscopic diagnosis is an iterative process in which clinicians acquire, compare, and verify local visual evidence before reaching a conclusion. Current AI systems do not adequately support this process because fine-grained evidence acquisition and multi-step reasoning remain weakly coupled, complicating reconciliation of image-derived findings with their textual interpretations. This gives rise to two failure modes, hallucinated evidence and uncorrected error accumulation, that undermine diagnostic reliability. We propose EndoCogniAgent, a closed-loop agentic framework that formulates endoscopic diagnosis as a controlled state update process for integrating complementary visual and textual evidence. At each reasoning round, a central planner selects an evidence acquisition action, specialized expert tools extract spatial and semantic observations as structured textual evidence, and a self-consistency validation mechanism examines this evidence along two dimensions, knowledge consistency against the input image and temporal consistency with prior validated findings, before updating the diagnostic state. Validated observations are admitted into the evolving state to condition subsequent planning, while insufficiently supported or conflicting findings are retained with corrective feedback that redirects the planner toward additional verification. We further introduce EndoAgentBench, a workflow-oriented benchmark comprising 6,132 question-answer pairs from 11 endoscopic datasets, to evaluate diagnostic agents across a comprehensive diagnostic chain, from fine-grained visual perception to high-level diagnostic reasoning. EndoCogniAgent achieves 85.23% overall accuracy on perception tasks and 71.13% clinical acceptance rate on reasoning tasks. Blinded clinician evaluation further shows consistent improvements in diagnostic response quality over the evaluated baselines.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 24 figures, 9 tables. Revised version: adds a blinded clinician evaluation, paired statistical significance testing, and extended ablation and generalization analyses. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Tyyds-ai/EndoCogniAgent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EndoCogniAgent 把内镜诊断建模为受控状态更新的闭环 agentic 推理：planner 选证据获取动作，专家工具抽取空间与语义观察，自洽性验证按知识一致性和时间一致性两维过滤后再更新诊断状态。在自建 EndoAgentBench（11 个内镜数据集、6,132 对 QA）上，感知任务总体准确率 85.23%，推理任务临床接受率 71.13%，盲法 clinician 评估显示诊断回答质量相对所评基线一致改善。
Motivation: 内镜诊断中细粒度证据获取与多步推理耦合松散，图像发现与其文字解释难以对齐，导致幻觉证据与错误累积两种失效，削弱诊断可靠性。
Method: 闭环框架每轮由 central planner 选择证据获取动作，专门化 expert tools 抽取空间与语义观察并转成结构化文本证据；self-consistency validation 沿知识一致性（对照输入图像）与时间一致性（对照既往已验证发现）两维审查，通过者并入演化诊断状态，证据不足或冲突者保留并附纠正反馈重定向 planner。评测用新提出的 EndoAgentBench，覆盖从细粒度视觉感知到高层诊断推理的完整链条。
Result: 在 EndoAgentBench（6,132 对 QA、11 个内镜数据集）上，感知任务总体准确率 85.23%，推理任务临床接受率 71.13%；盲法 clinician 评估显示诊断回答质量相对所评基线一致提升。arXiv 修订版补充了配对显著性检验、扩展消融与泛化分析。
Conclusion: 把内镜诊断当作带自洽性验证的受控状态更新过程，可同时抑制幻觉证据与错误累积，在感知与推理两端都给出可测的诊断质量提升。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 在 EndoAgentBench（6,132 对 QA、11 个内镜数据集）上，感知任务总体准确率 85.23%，推理任务临床接受率 71.13%；盲法 clinician 评估显示诊断回答质量相对所评基线一致提升。arXiv 修订版补充了配对显著性检验、扩展消融与泛化分析。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把内镜诊断当作带自洽性验证的受控状态更新过程，可同时抑制幻觉证据与错误累积，在感知与推理两端都给出可测的诊断质量提升。

papers.title: A variational approach to dimension-free self-normalized concentration
papers.abstract_en: We study the self-normalized concentration of vector-valued stochastic processes. We focus on bounds for "sub-$ψ$" processes, a well-known and quite general class that encompasses a wide variety of well-known tail conditions (including sub-exponential, sub-Gaussian, sub-gamma, sub-Poisson, and several heavy-tailed settings without a moment generating function such as symmetric or bounded 2nd or 3rd moments). Our results recover and generalize the influential bound of de la Peña et al. [20] (proved again in Abbasi-Yadkori et al. [2]) in the sub-Gaussian case. Further, we fill a gap in the literature between determinant-based bounds and more recent bounds based on condition numbers. As applications we prove a Bernstein inequality for random vectors satisfying a moment condition (a more general condition than boundedness), and also provide the first dimension-free self-normalized empirical Bernstein inequality. Our techniques are based on the variational (PAC-Bayes) approach to concentration.
papers.comment: 32 pages. Published in the Transactions on Machine Learning Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用变分 (PAC-Bayes) 方法研究向量值随机过程的自归一化集中不等式，覆盖 sub-ψ 过程这一包含次指数、次高斯、次 gamma、次 Poisson 及仅有二三阶矩的重尾情形的广泛类别。结果推广了 de la Peña et al. 与 Abbasi-Yadkori et al. 的次高斯界，填补了行列式型界与基于条件数 (condition number) 的界之间的空白，并给出首个 dimension-free 的自归一化 empirical Bernstein 不等式。
Motivation: 向量值自归一化集中界在行列式型与条件数型两条路线之间存在文献空缺，且缺少 dimension-free 的 empirical Bernstein 结果。
Method: 基于变分 (PAC-Bayes) 的集中证明技术，对 sub-ψ 过程给出界；应用包括为满足矩条件（比有界性更一般的条件）的随机向量证明 Bernstein 不等式。
Result: 在 sub-Gaussian 情形下恢复并推广 de la Peña et al. [20]（Abbasi-Yadkori et al. [2] 独立证明）的界；填补行列式型界与条件数型界之间的空白；证明满足矩条件的随机向量的 Bernstein 不等式；给出首个 dimension-free 的自归一化 empirical Bernstein 不等式。
Conclusion: 变分 (PAC-Bayes) 路线足以统一并推广 sub-ψ 过程的自归一化集中界，并产出 dimension-free 的 empirical Bernstein 结果。

papers.title: Riemannian Optimization on Tree Tensor Networks with Application in Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tree tensor networks (TTNs) are widely used in low-rank approximation and quantum many-body simulation. In this work, we present a formal analysis of the quotient geometry underlying the TTN parameter space. Our framework allows for arbitrary horizontal distributions, and we develop efficient first- and second-order optimization algorithms that exploit this geometry. Additionally, we devise a backpropagation algorithm for training TTNs in a kernel learning setting. We validate our methods through numerical experiments on a representative digit classification task and reveal an important tradeoff between two different horizontal distributions that are available for TTNs: while one offers cleaner geometric statements, the other ultimately leads to more efficient algorithms.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 6 figures, 4 pseudo-code algorithms, 1 table; updated version: independent integer numbering for theorems, equations
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出树张量网络 (TTN) 参数空间商流形 (quotient geometry) 的形式化分析，支持任意水平分布 (horizontal distribution)，并据此构造一阶与二阶黎曼优化算法及核学习设定下的反向传播。在数字分类任务上验证，揭示两种水平分布的取舍：一种给出更干净的几何命题，另一种最终产生更高效的算法。
Motivation: TTN 的参数化存在冗余，直接在参数空间做优化浪费算力且几何结构不清；此前缺少对 TTN 商流形的系统刻画与配套优化算法。
Method: 分析 TTN 参数空间的商流形结构，允许任意水平分布；基于该几何给出一阶与二阶优化算法（含 4 个伪代码算法），并设计核学习 (kernel learning) 设定下训练 TTN 的反向传播算法。
Result: 在代表性数字分类任务上做数值实验验证；定性发现是两种可用水平分布存在取舍——一种几何命题更干净，另一种使算法更高效。
Conclusion: 把 TTN 训练放进商流形几何可以同时导出一阶/二阶算法与反向传播，而水平分布的选择直接决定几何简洁性与算法效率孰先。

papers.title: Optimizing Canaries for Privacy Auditing with Metagradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: In this work we study black-box privacy auditing, where the goal is to lower bound the privacy parameter of a differentially private learning algorithm using only the algorithm's outputs (i.e., final trained model). For DP-SGD (the most successful method for training differentially private deep learning models), the canonical auditing approach uses membership inference - an auditor comes with a small set of special "canary" examples, inserts a random subset of them into the training set, and then tries to discern which of their canaries were included in the training set (typically via a membership inference attack). The auditor's success rate then provides a lower bound on the privacy parameters of the learning algorithm. Our main contribution is a method for optimizing the auditor's canary set to improve privacy auditing, leveraging recent work on metagradient optimization (Engstrom et al., 2025). Our empirical evaluation demonstrates that in certain instances, using such optimized canaries can improve empirical lower bounds for differentially private image classification models by several times when compared to canaries proposed in prior work. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our method is DP-SGD agnostic and efficient: canaries optimized for non-private SGD with a small model architecture remain effective when auditing larger models trained with DP-SGD.
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR) 2026, pp. 92994-93013
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对黑盒隐私审计中 canary 需人工设计的问题，用 metagradient descent (Engstrom et al., 2025) 直接优化审计用的 canary 集合，以 membership inference 成功率给出 DP 隐私参数的更紧下界。对 DP-SGD 图像分类模型，优化后的 canary 比先前工作提出的 canary 把经验下界提高数倍；且在非私有 SGD、小模型上优化的 canary 迁移到更大 DP-SGD 模型仍然有效。
Motivation: 黑盒隐私审计只能用最终训练模型的输出来下界 DP 隐私参数，而 canonical 做法依赖人工挑选的 canary，审计下界因此偏松。
Method: 审计者随机把 canary 子集插入训练集，再用 membership inference 攻击判断哪些被收录，成功率转成隐私参数下界；核心贡献是用 metagradient optimization 对 canary 集合本身做端到端优化，方法与 DP-SGD 解耦。
Result: 在 DP-SGD 图像分类模型上，优化 canary 在某些情形把经验隐私下界相对先前工作的 canary 提高数倍；在非私有 SGD 与小架构上优化的 canary，用于审计更大 DP-SGD 模型时仍然有效，且计算高效。
Conclusion: canary 应当被当作可优化对象而非固定审计输入：用 metagradient 优化得到的 canary 更紧、且跨模型规模与训练算法可迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WebArxiv: A Reproducible Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Web Agents on arXiv Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models now enable autonomous agents to interact with real-world websites, but existing benchmarks emphasize general-purpose browsing, underrepresent research-oriented environments and scholarly discovery workflows, and often depend on live sites whose changing content and structure undermine reproducibility. arXiv provides a realistic, reproducible, hierarchically structured, information-centric testbed without privacy-sensitive interactions. We introduce WebArxiv, a static-snapshot benchmark comprising 510 time-invariant tasks, each with a unique deterministic ground truth. Its diverse, realistic scholarly tasks go beyond simple information lookup and rule following to emphasize multi-constraint paper retrieval, fine-grained content extraction, and cross-paper comparison. Evaluations of a range of foundation-model-based web agents show that WebArxiv remains challenging. Behavioral analysis reveals that agents over-rely on fixed interaction histories, causing incomplete or repetitive reasoning. We therefore equip agents with a lightweight dynamic-memory mechanism for adaptive retrieval and reasoning over relevant context. The benchmark and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/74E4423BVNW/README.md.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WebArxiv 是一个基于 arXiv 静态快照的可复现多模态 web agent 基准，含 510 个时间不变任务，每个任务有唯一确定真值，覆盖多约束论文检索、细粒度内容抽取与跨论文比较。对一批基础模型 web agent 的评测显示任务仍具挑战性，行为分析发现 agent 过度依赖固定交互历史导致推理不完整或重复；为此加入轻量动态记忆机制以自适应检索与推理相关上下文。
Motivation: 现有 web agent 基准偏重通用浏览、缺少科研检索类任务，且依赖内容与结构不断变化的在线站点，结果难以复现。
Method: 构建 arXiv 静态快照基准 WebArxiv：510 个时间不变任务、每个任务唯一确定真值，任务类型为多约束论文检索、细粒度内容抽取与跨论文比较；对多个基础模型 web agent 做评测与行为分析，并在其上加装轻量动态记忆机制用于自适应检索与推理相关上下文。
Result: 基准含 510 个时间不变任务，每个任务有唯一确定真值；对一系列基于基础模型的 web agent 评测显示 WebArxiv 仍具挑战性，行为分析显示 agent 过度依赖固定交互历史，造成不完整或重复的推理；论文 14 页、5 图、7 表。
Conclusion: 静态快照 + 唯一确定真值可让科研类 web agent 评测可复现，而固定交互历史是当前 agent 推理不完整与重复的主因，需用动态记忆机制按需检索相关上下文。

papers.title: OV-MAP: Open-Vocabulary Zero-Shot 3D Instance Segmentation Map for Robots
papers.abstract_en: We introduce OV-MAP, a novel approach to open-world 3D mapping for mobile robots by integrating open-features into 3D maps to enhance object recognition capabilities. A significant challenge arises when overlapping features from adjacent voxels reduce instance-level precision, as features spill over voxel boundaries, blending neighboring regions together. Our method overcomes this by employing a class-agnostic segmentation model to project 2D masks into 3D space, combined with a supplemented depth image created by merging raw and synthetic depth from point clouds. This approach, along with a 3D mask voting mechanism, enables accurate zero-shot 3D instance segmentation without relying on 3D supervised segmentation models. We assess the effectiveness of our method through comprehensive experiments on public datasets such as ScanNet200 and Replica, demonstrating superior zero-shot performance, robustness, and adaptability across diverse environments. Additionally, we conducted real-world experiments to demonstrate our method's adaptability and robustness when applied to diverse real-world environments.
papers.journal_ref: 2024 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2024, pp. 13780-13786
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OV-MAP 把开放词汇 2D 特征融进机器人 3D 体素地图做零样本实例分割：用类无关分割模型把 2D mask 投影到 3D，并合并点云原始深度与合成深度补全深度图，再用 3D mask 投票抑制跨体素的特征外溢。在 ScanNet200 与 Replica 上取得更优的零样本表现，并在真实环境中验证了适应性与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 移动机器人开放世界建图中，相邻体素的重叠特征会外溢出体素边界、把邻近区域混在一起，降低实例级精度；同时依赖 3D 监督分割模型的方案难以零样本泛化到新环境。
Method: 用类无关的 2D 分割模型生成 mask 并投影到 3D 空间，配合由点云原始深度与合成深度合并而成的补充深度图，再通过 3D mask 投票机制融合，从而在不使用任何 3D 监督分割模型的情况下完成零样本 3D 实例分割，并把开放词汇特征写入体素地图。
Result: 在公开数据集 ScanNet200 与 Replica 上展示了更优的零样本性能、鲁棒性与跨环境适应性；另在多样真实环境中做了实机实验以验证适应性与鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 把开放特征与 mask 投影加投票结合，可以在不依赖 3D 监督分割模型的前提下实现准确的零样本 3D 实例分割，并让移动机器人的开放世界地图跨环境可用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Small Language Models are the Future of Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are often praised for exhibiting near-human performance on a wide range of tasks and valued for their ability to hold a general conversation. The rise of agentic AI systems is, however, ushering in a mass of applications in which language models perform a small number of specialized tasks repetitively and with little variation. Here we lay out the position that small language models (SLMs) are sufficiently powerful, inherently more suitable, and necessarily more economical for many invocations in agentic systems, and are therefore the future of agentic AI. Our argumentation is grounded in the current level of capabilities exhibited by SLMs, the common architectures of agentic systems, and the economy of LM deployment. We further argue that in situations where general-purpose conversational abilities are essential, heterogeneous agentic systems (i.e., agents invoking multiple different models) are the natural choice. We discuss the potential barriers for the adoption of SLMs in agentic systems and outline a general LLM-to-SLM agent conversion algorithm. Our position, formulated as a value statement, highlights the significance of the operational and economic impact even a partial shift from LLMs to SLMs is to have on the AI agent industry. We aim to stimulate the discussion on the effective use of AI resources and hope to advance the efforts to lower the costs of AI of the present day. Calling for both contributions to and critique of our position, we commit to publishing all such correspondence at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/slm-agents.

Motivation: agentic AI 的应用形态是少量专用任务被反复调用，而通用 LLM 在这类调用上能力过剩、成本过高，作者认为从 LLM 到 SLM 的部分迁移就能显著改变 AI agent 产业的运营与经济格局。
Method: 以立场论证方式展开：论据来自 SLM 当前能力水平、agentic 系统的常见架构与 LM 部署经济学；讨论 SLM 采用的潜在障碍，并给出一个通用的 LLM-to-SLM agent 转换算法，同时主张异构 agentic 系统作为通用对话场景的方案。
Result: 这是一篇立场论文，以价值主张形式给出论点而非实验数字：SLM 在 agentic 系统的多数调用中已足够强大、更适用且更经济，部分从 LLM 迁移到 SLM 即可带来运营与经济影响；作者承诺在 NVIDIA 研究页面公开支持与批评的全部往来通信。
Conclusion: SLM 是 agentic AI 的未来，通用对话需求由异构多模型系统兜底；作者公开征集对该立场的贡献与批评。

papers.title: TEMPURA: Temporal Event Masked Prediction and Understanding for Reasoning in Action
papers.abstract_en: Understanding causal event relationships and achieving fine-grained temporal grounding in videos remain challenging for vision-language models (VLMs). We propose TEMPURA (Temporal Event Masked Prediction and Understanding for Reasoning in Action), a two-stage training framework that enhances the video temporal understanding of VLMs. Inspired by infilling techniques in language modeling, TEMPURA first performs masked event prediction, learning to reconstruct missing events and generate step-by-step causal explanations from dense event annotations. It then learns video segmentation and dense captioning, decomposing videos into non-overlapping events with detailed, timestamp-aligned descriptions. We train TEMPURA on VER, our large-scale dataset of 500K videos annotated with temporally aligned event descriptions and structured reasoning steps. Experiments on video temporal grounding and highlight detection benchmarks show that TEMPURA substantially improves strong base VLMs across model families and scales, confirming that combining event-level reasoning with fine-grained temporal segmentation is an effective recipe for video temporal understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TEMPURA 用两阶段训练提升 VLM 的视频时间理解：先借语言模型的 masked infilling 做掩码事件预测并生成逐步因果解释，再学视频分割与稠密描述，把视频切成不重叠、带时间戳的事件。在自建 500K 视频数据集 VER 上训练后，在时间定位与 highlight 检测基准上跨模型家族与规模均显著提升基础 VLM。
Motivation: VLM 难以理解视频中的因果事件关系，也做不了细粒度时间定位 (fine-grained temporal grounding)，事件级推理与时间分割被割裂。
Method: 两阶段训练：第一阶段做掩码事件预测，从稠密事件标注重建缺失事件并生成逐步因果解释；第二阶段学视频分割与稠密描述，把视频分解为不重叠事件并给出时间戳对齐的详细描述。训练数据为自建 VER，含 500K 视频及时间对齐事件描述与结构化推理步骤。
Result: 在视频时间定位 (video temporal grounding) 与 highlight 检测基准上，TEMPURA 在多个基础 VLM 家族与规模上均带来显著提升；训练集 VER 规模为 500K 视频。
Conclusion: 事件级因果推理与细粒度时间分割结合，是提升视频时间理解的有效配方，且可跨模型家族与规模迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Adaptive Helpfulness-Harmlessness Alignment with Preference Vectors
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring that large language models (LLMs) are both helpful and harmless is a critical challenge, as overly strict constraints can lead to excessive refusals, while permissive models risk generating harmful content. Existing approaches, such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and direct preference optimization (DPO), attempt to balance these trade-offs but suffer from performance conflicts, limited controllability, and poor extendability. To address these issues, we propose Preference Vector, a novel framework inspired by task arithmetic. Instead of optimizing multiple preferences within a single objective, we train separate models on individual preferences, extract behavior shifts as preference vectors, and dynamically merge them at test time. This modular approach enables fine-grained, user-controllable preference adjustments and facilitates seamless integration of new preferences without retraining. Experiments show that our proposed Preference Vector framework improves helpfulness without excessive conservatism, allows smooth control over preference trade-offs, and supports scalable multi-preference alignment.
papers.comment: Accepted at The 19th Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (EACL 2026), Rabat, Morocco
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Preference Vector 把 helpfulness 与 harmlessness 拆成各自单独训练的模型，用 task arithmetic 思路把行为偏移提取成向量，测试时动态合并，从而在不过度拒答的前提下调节偏好权衡。
Motivation: RLHF 与 DPO 在 helpfulness-harmlessness 之间存在性能冲突、可控性差、扩展新偏好需重训。
Method: 对每个偏好单独训练模型，提取行为偏移为 preference vector，测试时动态合并；新增偏好无需重训。
Result: 实验显示该框架在不引入过度保守的情况下提升 helpfulness，可平滑控制偏好权衡，并支持可扩展的多偏好对齐。
Conclusion: 把偏好拆成可加的行为向量再合并，比单目标多偏好优化更可控、更易扩展。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: BigO(Bench): Can LLMs Generate Code with Controlled Time and Space Complexity?
papers.abstract_en: We introduce BigO(Bench), a novel coding benchmark designed to evaluate the capabilities of generative language models in understanding and generating code with specified time and space complexities. This benchmark addresses the gap in current evaluations that often overlook the ability of models to comprehend and produce code constrained by computational complexity. BigO(Bench) includes tooling to infer the algorithmic complexity of any Python function from profiling measurements, including human- or LLM-generated solutions. BigO(Bench) also includes of set of 3,105 coding problems and 1,190,250 solutions from Code Contests annotated with inferred (synthetic) time and space complexity labels from the complexity framework, as well as corresponding runtime and memory footprint values for a large set of input sizes. We present results from evaluating multiple state-of-the-art language models on this benchmark, highlighting their strengths and weaknesses in handling complexity requirements. In particular, token-space reasoning models are unrivaled in code generation but not in complexity understanding, hinting that they may not generalize well to tasks for which no reward was given at training time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BigO(Bench)：用 profiling 推断任意 Python 函数算法复杂度的工具链，加上 3,105 道题、1,190,250 条 Code Contests 解答及其合成时间/空间复杂度标签，用来评测 LLM 能否按指定复杂度生成代码。评测多个前沿模型后发现，token-space reasoning 模型代码生成最强，但在复杂度理解上并不占优，提示它们可能无法泛化到训练时没有奖励的任务。
Motivation: 现有代码评测大多忽略模型是否理解并生成满足时间/空间复杂度约束的代码，这一能力缺少可规模化的度量。
Method: 提供从 profiling 测量推断任意 Python 函数（人写或 LLM 生成）算法复杂度的工具；构建 3,105 道编码问题与 1,190,250 条 Code Contests 解答，标注推断的（合成）时间与空间复杂度标签，并附多种输入规模下的运行时间与内存占用；在此基准上评测多个前沿语言模型。
Result: 基准含 3,105 道题、1,190,250 条解答及各输入规模的 runtime 与 memory footprint；多个前沿模型的评测显示 token-space reasoning 模型在代码生成上无可匹敌，但在复杂度理解上并非最强。
Conclusion: 代码生成能力与复杂度理解能力在 LLM 上并不对齐，训练时未给奖励的任务上可能泛化不佳。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Probabilistic Modeling of Jailbreak on Multimodal LLMs: From Quantification to Application
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated their superior ability in understanding multimodal content. However, they remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, which exploit weaknesses in their safety alignment to generate harmful responses. Previous studies categorize jailbreaks as successful or failed based on whether responses contain malicious content. However, given the stochastic nature of MLLM responses, this binary classification of an input's ability to jailbreak MLLMs is inappropriate. Derived from this viewpoint, we introduce jailbreak probability to quantify the jailbreak potential of an input, which represents the likelihood that MLLMs generated a malicious response when prompted with this input. We approximate this probability through multiple queries to MLLMs. After modeling the relationship between input hidden states and their corresponding jailbreak probability using Jailbreak Probability Prediction Network (JPPN), we use continuous jailbreak probability for optimization. Specifically, we propose Jailbreak-Probability-based Attack (JPA) that optimizes adversarial perturbations on input image to maximize jailbreak probability, and further enhance it as Multimodal JPA (MJPA) by including monotonic text rephrasing. To counteract attacks, we also propose Jailbreak-Probability-based Finetuning (JPF), which minimizes jailbreak probability through MLLM parameter updates. Extensive experiments show that (1) (M)JPA yields significant improvements when attacking a wide range of models under both white and black box settings. (2) JPF vastly reduces jailbreaks by at most over 60\%. Both of the above results demonstrate the significance of introducing jailbreak probability to make nuanced distinctions among input jailbreak abilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态大模型 (MLLM) 的越狱能力不该用成功/失败二分，因为响应本身随机；论文提出 jailbreak probability（多次查询得到的恶意响应似然），用 JPPN 从输入隐状态回归该概率，再以连续概率为优化目标做攻击 (M)JPA 与防御 JPF。实验显示 (M)JPA 在白盒与黑盒下攻击多类模型均有显著提升，JPF 最多减少 60% 以上的越狱。
Motivation: 既有工作把越狱输入二值化为成功或失败，忽略了 MLLM 响应的随机性，无法区分不同输入的越狱潜能强弱。
Method: 多次查询 MLLM 近似 jailbreak probability；用 Jailbreak Probability Prediction Network (JPPN) 建模输入隐状态到该概率的映射；攻击侧提出基于越狱概率的 JPA（对输入图像的对抗扰动做最大化）并加入单调文本改写升级为 MJPA，防御侧提出 JPF，通过参数更新最小化越狱概率。
Result: 在白盒与黑盒设置下攻击多种模型时 (M)JPA 均有显著提升；JPF 最多减少超过 60% 的越狱。
Conclusion: 把越狱能力从二值判定改为连续 jailbreak probability，可同时支撑更强的攻击优化与更有效的微调防御。

papers.title: FedNIA: Noise-Induced Activation Analysis for Mitigating Data Poisoning in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning systems are increasingly threatened by data poisoning attacks, where malicious clients compromise global models by contributing tampered updates. Existing defenses often rely on impractical assumptions, such as access to a central test dataset, or fail to generalize across diverse attack types, particularly those involving multiple malicious clients working collaboratively. To address this, we propose Federated Noise-Induced Activation Analysis (FedNIA), a novel defense framework to identify and exclude adversarial clients without relying on any central test dataset. FedNIA injects random noise inputs to analyze the layerwise activation patterns in client models leveraging an autoencoder that detects abnormal behaviors indicative of data poisoning. FedNIA can defend against diverse attack types, including sample poisoning, label flipping, and backdoors, even in scenarios with multiple attacking nodes. Experimental results on non-iid federated datasets demonstrate its effectiveness and robustness, underscoring its potential as a foundational approach for enhancing the security of federated learning systems.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedNIA 在不依赖任何中心测试集的前提下识别并剔除投毒客户端：向客户端模型注入随机噪声输入，用自编码器分析逐层激活模式，检测指示数据投毒的异常行为。在 non-iid 联邦数据集上，它能防御样本投毒、标签翻转与后门攻击，包括多个恶意节点协同攻击的场景。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习投毒防御要么依赖不现实的中心测试集访问，要么在多恶意客户端协同的多样攻击下无法泛化。
Method: 提出 Federated Noise-Induced Activation Analysis (FedNIA)：向客户端模型注入随机噪声输入，分析其逐层激活模式，用自编码器检测指示投毒的异常激活，从而识别并剔除对抗客户端，全程不需要中心测试数据集。
Result: 在 non-iid 联邦数据集上的实验显示 FedNIA 对样本投毒、标签翻转和后门攻击均有效且稳健，包括多个攻击节点协同的场景。
Conclusion: 基于噪声诱导激活分析的客户端筛查可以作为不依赖中心测试集的联邦学习安全基础方案，覆盖多攻击类型与多恶意节点。

papers.title: Sonicmesh: Enhancing 3D Human Mesh Reconstruction in Vision-Impaired Environments With Acoustic Signals
papers.abstract_en: 3D human mesh reconstruction (HMR) from RGB images often degrades under poor illumination, occlusion, and non-line-of-sight conditions. Acoustic sensing provides complementary spatial cues but suffers from low spatial resolution. We propose SonicMesh, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first acoustic--visual framework for robust 3D human mesh reconstruction. SonicMesh first converts ultrasonic echoes into range--azimuth acoustic images through an Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR)-based imaging process. It then introduces a cross-dimensional anatomical registration module that maps modality-specific 2D joint features into a common canonical 3D human space. The registered anatomical representations are further integrated with acoustic and visual features through a two-stage fusion network for final mesh reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate that SonicMesh achieves accurate and robust 3D human reconstruction across normal, poor-light, occluded, and non-line-of-sight environments, consistently outperforming existing RGB-, radio-frequency (RF)-, and mmWave-based approaches under challenging sensing conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SonicMesh 把超声回波经 ISAR 成像转成距离-方位声学图像，用跨维度解剖配准模块把两种模态的 2D 关节特征映射到统一的规范 3D 人体空间，再经两阶段融合网络输出人体网格。在正常、弱光、遮挡与非视距 (NLOS) 四类环境下均稳定优于现有 RGB、RF 与 mmWave 方法。
Motivation: RGB 图像的 3D 人体网格重建 (HMR) 在弱光、遮挡和非视距条件下退化，而声学传感空间分辨率低，单靠任一模态都难以在恶劣感知环境下稳健重建。
Method: 先用基于逆合成孔径雷达 (ISAR) 的成像流程把超声回波转为距离-方位声学图像；再用跨维度解剖配准模块把模态各自的 2D 关节特征映射到规范 3D 人体空间；配准后的解剖表征与声学、视觉特征经两阶段融合网络完成网格重建。
Result: 实验覆盖正常、弱光、遮挡与非视距四类环境，SonicMesh 在挑战性感知条件下持续优于现有 RGB、RF 与 mmWave 类方法。
Conclusion: 声-视融合可在 RGB 失效的弱光、遮挡与 NLOS 场景下维持 3D 人体网格重建的准确性与稳健性，声学提供互补空间线索。

papers.title: ELEMENT: Episodic and Lifelong Exploration via Maximum Entropy
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning agents depend on reward signals whose density is rarely under the designer's control, and when such signals are absent, an agent must generate its own drive to explore. State entropy maximization offers a principled objective for this, but existing methods break down at scale in two ways: the intrinsic reward vanishes once a state has been visited, discouraging revisits to the very gateways that lead onward, and estimating entropy over millions of accumulated observations becomes computationally prohibitive. We address both with Episodic and Lifelong Exploration via Maximum Entropy (ELEMENT), a multiscale intrinsically motivated framework for reward-free exploration that transfers to downstream tasks. ELEMENT couples lifelong entropy maximization with a complementary episodic term acting on a faster timescale. For the episodic term, we derive average episodic state entropy, an intrinsic reward that is the exact minimizer of a tractable upper bound on the reward-decomposition objective; for the lifelong term, we propose a $k$NN graph-based estimator that keeps entropy tractable without forgetting. ELEMENT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art intrinsic reward baselines on state coverage and unsupervised pre-training. Videos, code, and supplementary material: https://sites.google.com/view/element-rl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ELEMENT 把奖励无关探索拆成快慢两个时间尺度：慢尺度用终身 (lifelong) 状态熵最大化，快尺度加一个 episodic 项，使已访问状态仍能获得内在奖励。episodic 项推导出平均 episodic 状态熵，是奖励分解目标某个可处理上界的精确最小化器；lifelong 项用 kNN 图估计器在累积百万级观测上保持熵可算且不遗忘。在状态覆盖与无监督预训练上持续优于现有内在奖励基线。
Motivation: 状态熵最大化的内在奖励在状态被访问一次后即消失，抑制了通往新区域的“门户”状态被重访；同时在数百万累积观测上估计熵在计算上不可行。
Method: ELEMENT 是多尺度内在动机框架：终身熵最大化耦合一个作用于更快时间尺度的 episodic 项；episodic 项给出平均 episodic 状态熵（奖励分解目标可处理上界的精确最小化器），lifelong 项提出基于 kNN 图的熵估计器以保持可处理且不遗忘。
Result: 在状态覆盖 (state coverage) 与无监督预训练两项指标上，ELEMENT 持续优于当前最优的内在奖励基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把内在奖励按快慢时间尺度分解并用 kNN 图估计大规模熵，可在奖励缺失时同时改善探索覆盖与下游预训练。

papers.title: Highway Congestion Reduction through Reinforcement Learning Based Eulerian Headway Control
papers.abstract_en: Connected automated vehicles (CAVs) equipped with adaptive cruise control (ACC) create new opportunities for highway congestion mitigation. Traditional practice relies on Eulerian variable speed limits (VSL) which regulate traffic through roadside signs, but suffer from infrequent updates and limited driver compliance. Recent research explored Lagrangian strategies that directly control individual vehicles, offering high reactivity and compliance, yet in realistic multi-lane settings they depend on drivers' latent lane-change intentions, making robust vehicle-level decisions difficult. Hence, we propose an Eulerian control system optimized through reinforcement learning, that (i) leverages ACC for reactivity and compliance, and (ii) obviates dependence on latent driver intentions by regulating aggregate density near bottlenecks, crucially via headway commands rather than speed commands. We evaluate two variants of our system, time-headway and distance-headway control, in large-scale simulations across a range of traffic conditions. Both variants outperform baselines, improving traffic flow by up to 10.6% over human traffic and 6.7% over traditional VSL. To strengthen evaluation, we propose a novel boundary-aware speed metric addressing a recognized flaw in simulation studies with dynamic vehicle entry and exit. The empirical results, together with our emphasis on deployable system design, suggest a path towards practical, safe, and scalable highway congestion mitigation.
papers.comment: Accepted as a full paper to the 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), 2026. Website: https://coopcruise.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用强化学习优化的 Eulerian 车头时距 (headway) 控制，通过 ACC 下发时距指令而非速度指令来调节瓶颈附近车流密度，摆脱对驾驶员变道意图的依赖。大规模仿真中 time-headway 与 distance-headway 两个变体均胜过基线：相对人类驾驶车流通行效率提升最高 10.6%，相对传统可变限速 (VSL) 提升 6.7%。
Motivation: 传统 Eulerian VSL 更新稀疏且驾驶员遵从率低；Lagrangian 单车控制虽反应快，但在多车道场景依赖驾驶员潜在变道意图，难以做出稳健的车辆级决策。
Method: 提出经强化学习优化的 Eulerian 控制系统，用 ACC 执行指令、以瓶颈附近聚合密度为调控对象，通过 headway 指令（而非 speed 指令）实施；评估 time-headway 与 distance-headway 两个变体，并在多种交通状况下做大规模仿真。另提出一种 boundary-aware 速度指标，修正仿真中车辆动态进出造成的度量缺陷。
Result: 两个 headway 变体在大规模仿真中均优于基线：交通流改善最高达 10.6%（相对人类驾驶车流）、6.7%（相对传统 VSL）。
Conclusion: 以 headway 而非速度为控制量的 RL Eulerian 控制可同时获得 ACC 的反应性与遵从性、又不依赖潜在变道意图，作者认为这为实际、安全、可扩展的高速公路拥堵缓解提供了可行路径。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Polynomial Scaling is Possible For Neural Operator Approximations of Structured Families of BSDEs
papers.abstract_en: Neural operator (NO) architectures learn nonlinear maps between infinite-dimensional function spaces and are widely used to accelerate simulation and enable data-driven model discovery. While universality results ensure expressivity, they do not address \emph{complexity}: for broad operator classes described only through regularity (e.g.\ uniform continuity or $C^r$-regularity), information-theoretic lower bounds imply that minimax-optimal NO approximation rates scale \emph{exponentially} in the reciprocal accuracy $1/\varepsilon$. This has shifted the focus of NO theory toward identifying additional problem-specific structure, beyond regularity, under which suitably tailored NO architectures can leverage to unlock polynomial scaling in $1/\varepsilon$. We exhibit the first polynomial-scaling regime for NO approximations of solution operators in stochastic analysis; by identifying structured families of \emph{non-Markovian} BSDEs with randomized terminal condition parameterized by the Sobolev-regular terminal condition and by Sobolev-regular additive nonlinear perturbations of the generator. We prove that their solution operator can be approximated (uniformly over the family) by a tailored NO whose number of trainable parameters grows \emph{polynomially} in $1/\varepsilon$. We unlock this polynomial scaling regime by \emph{informing the NO's inductive bias} by factoring out the singular part of the associated semilinear elliptic PDE Green's function and by incorporating the Doléans--Dade exponential of the BSDE's common non-Markovian factor into the NO's decoding layers. As a byproduct, we extend polynomial-scaling guarantees from families of linear elliptic PDEs on regular domains to the semilinear setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在仅用正则性刻画的算子类上，神经算子 (NO) 的 minimax 最优逼近率对 1/ε 是指数级的；本文在随机分析中给出首个多项式标度区间：对由 Sobolev 正则终端条件与 Sobolev 正则生成元加性扰动参数化的非马尔可夫 BSDE 结构族，定制 NO 的可训练参数个数按 1/ε 多项式增长。关键是把半线性椭圆 PDE Green 函数的奇异部分因子化，并把 BSDE 共同非马尔可夫因子的 Doléans–Dade 指数并入解码层。
Motivation: 仅有 uniform continuity 或 C^r 正则性的宽算子类受信息论下界约束，NO 逼近率对 1/ε 只能是指数级，通用性 (universality) 结果不回答复杂度问题；需要找出正则性之外的结构以解锁多项式标度。
Method: 识别由 Sobolev 正则终端条件与 Sobolev 正则生成元加性非线性扰动参数化的非马尔可夫 (non-Markovian) BSDE 结构族及其随机终端条件；定制 NO 架构，把相应半线性椭圆 PDE Green 函数的奇异部分因子化，并将 BSDE 共同非马尔可夫因子的 Doléans–Dade 指数写入解码层，据此证明参数个数对 1/ε 的多项式增长。
Result: 证明该结构族的解算子可被定制 NO 在整族上一致逼近，可训练参数个数随 1/ε 多项式增长（对照仅由正则性刻画时的指数下界）；作为副产品，把多项式标度保证从正则区域上的线性椭圆 PDE 族推广到半线性情形。
Conclusion: 把问题特有的结构注入 NO 的归纳偏置（informed inductive bias），可在随机分析的 BSDE 解算子上实现 1/ε 的多项式逼近标度，且该保证可延伸到半线性椭圆 PDE。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Bayesian Fusion of Active Contour Models and ConvNet Priors for Standing Dead Tree Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Instance segmentation is a core computer vision task with great practical significance. Recent advances, driven by large-scale benchmark datasets, have yielded good general-purpose Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based methods. Natural Resource Monitoring (NRM) utilizes remote sensing imagery with generally known scale and containing multiple overlapping instances of the same class, wherein the object contours are jagged and highly irregular. This is in stark contrast with the regular man-made objects found in classic benchmark datasets. We address this problem and propose a novel instance segmentation method geared towards NRM imagery. We formulate the problem as Bayesian maximum a posteriori inference which, in learning the individual object contours, incorporates shape, location, and position priors from state-of-the-art CNN architectures, driving a simultaneous level-set evolution of multiple object contours. We employ loose coupling between the CNNs that supply the priors and the active contour process, allowing a drop-in replacement of new network architectures. Moreover, we introduce a novel prior for contour shape, namely, a class of Deep Shape Models based on architectures from Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). These Deep Shape Models are in essence a non-linear generalization of the classic Eigenshape formulation. In experiments, we tackle the challenging, real-world problem of segmenting individual dead tree crowns and delineating precise contours. We compare our method to two leading general-purpose instance segmentation methods - Mask R-CNN and K-net - on color infrared aerial imagery. Results show our approach to significantly outperform both methods in terms of reconstruction quality of tree crown contours. Furthermore, use of the GAN-based deep shape model prior yields significant improvement of all results over the vanilla Eigenshape prior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向自然资源监测遥感影像中轮廓锯齿、高度不规则且相互重叠的实例，提出把 CNN 先验与活动轮廓 (active contour) 松耦合的贝叶斯 MAP 分割：同时演化多条轮廓，并引入基于 GAN 的 Deep Shape Model 轮廓形状先验。在彩色红外航拍的单株枯立木树冠分割上，重建质量显著优于 Mask R-CNN 与 K-net，且 GAN 形状先验相对经典 Eigenshape 先验带来显著提升。
Motivation: 通用实例分割方法面向规则人造物体，而自然资源监测影像尺度已知、同类实例大量重叠、轮廓极不规则，直接套用通用 CNN 分割难以给出精确边界。
Method: 把问题表述为贝叶斯最大后验 (MAP) 推断，从 CNN 架构中取形状、位置与位置先验驱动多条 level-set 轮廓同时演化；CNN 与活动轮廓过程松耦合，可直接替换新网络架构；新增基于 GAN 架构的 Deep Shape Model 作为轮廓形状先验，可视为经典 Eigenshape 的非线性推广。
Result: 在彩色红外航拍影像的单株枯死树冠分割与精确轮廓勾绘任务上，该方法在树冠轮廓重建质量上显著优于两个领先的通用实例分割方法 Mask R-CNN 与 K-net；使用 GAN 深度形状模型先验相对 vanilla Eigenshape 先验使全部结果显著提升。
Conclusion: 在轮廓不规则、实例重叠的遥感实例分割中，把 CNN 先验与活动轮廓做贝叶斯耦合、并用 GAN 深度形状先验替代 Eigenshape，能显著提高树冠轮廓的重建质量。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: DeepSPoC: A Deep Learning Based Sequential Propagation of Chaos
papers.abstract_en: Classical particle methods based on propagation of chaos (PoC) have been developed for solving mean-field stochastic differential equations and their associated nonlinear Fokker--Planck equations. However, direct PoC implementations are difficult to apply to high-dimensional problems because they require simulating and storing large numbers of interacting particles, often with high particle-particle interaction costs. Motivated by these limitations, we build on the recently proposed sequential propagation of chaos (SPoC) framework, which replaces the fully interacting particle system in PoC with a sequential interaction mechanism. Based on this structure, we present DeepSPoC, a neural particle method that embeds a neural density representation into the sequential particle dynamics. DeepSPoC simulates particles batch by batch, while the neural network represents the evolving empirical law and is substituted into the coefficients of the mean-field SDE, thereby replacing direct particle-particle interactions with particle-network interactions. In DeepSPoC, a recently developed normalizing flow model called KRnet is used to approximate the empirical measure of particles. Compared with direct particle implementations, DeepSPoC substantially reduces memory consumption and evaluates interaction terms more efficiently, thereby improving scalability for high-dimensional problems. We apply DeepSPoC to a wide range of mean-field equations and verify its effectiveness and computational advantages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepSPoC 把 sequential propagation of chaos (SPoC) 框架与神经密度表示结合，用 normalizing flow 模型 KRnet 近似粒子经验测度并代入 mean-field SDE 系数，以粒子-网络交互替代直接的粒子-粒子交互，分批模拟粒子。相比直接粒子实现，它显著降低内存消耗、更高效地计算交互项，从而提升高维问题的可扩展性，并在多类 mean-field 方程上验证了有效性与计算优势。
Motivation: 经典基于 propagation of chaos (PoC) 的粒子法需要模拟并存储大量相互作用粒子，粒子间交互代价高，难以直接用于高维问题。
Method: 在 SPoC 的顺序交互机制上构建神经粒子方法：分批模拟粒子，用 normalizing flow 模型 KRnet 表示演化中的经验分布并代入 mean-field SDE 的系数，形成粒子-网络交互；在一系列 mean-field 方程上做验证。
Result: 与直接粒子实现相比，DeepSPoC substantially reduces memory consumption 并更高效地计算交互项，提升高维可扩展性；在多类 mean-field 方程上验证了有效性与计算优势。
Conclusion: 用神经密度表示替代显式粒子-粒子交互，是让 PoC 类方法在高维 mean-field SDE 上可行的路径。

papers.title: Lifelong Learning of Video Diffusion Models From a Single Video Stream
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models can enable embodied agents to anticipate plausible futures from the recent past, but they are typically trained offline on curated datasets--a mismatch with the agents' learning setup at deployment: online, from a single video stream that sequentially outputs one frame at a time. We bridge this training gap and demonstrate that training autoregressive video diffusion models from such a stream, resembling the experience of embodied agents, is not only possible but can also perform comparably to standard offline training given the same number of gradient steps. We find that this robustness to video stream autocorrelation and nonstationarity can be achieved using experience replay methods that retain a subset of the video stream. To support training and evaluation in this setting, we introduce five new datasets for streaming lifelong generative video modeling: Lifelong Bouncing Balls (O), Lifelong Bouncing Balls (C), Lifelong 3D Maze, Lifelong Drive, and Lifelong PLAICraft, each consisting of one million consecutive frames from environments of increasing complexity. Together, our datasets and experiments lay the groundwork for video generative models and world models that continuously learn from single-sensor video streams rather than fixed datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明自回归视频扩散模型可以直接从单路视频流在线训练，在相同梯度步数下达到与离线训练相当的生成质量，关键条件是用 experience replay 保留视频流的一个子集以对抗流的自相关与非平稳性。为此提出五个流式终身生成视频数据集（Lifelong Bouncing Balls (O)/(C)、Lifelong 3D Maze、Lifelong Drive、Lifelong PLAICraft），各含一百万连续帧、环境复杂度递增。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型通常在人工整理的离线数据集上训练，与具身智能体部署时在线、单视频流、逐帧接收数据的学习方式不匹配；该流还带自相关与非平稳性，离线训练范式无法直接套用。
Method: 训练自回归视频扩散模型，使其从单视频流逐帧在线学习；用 experience replay 保留流的一个子集以缓解自相关与非平稳性，并与相同梯度步数的标准离线训练对比。配套构建五个流式终身生成视频数据集，环境复杂度递增，各一百万连续帧。
Result: 在线流式训练在相同梯度步数下与标准离线训练表现相当（comparably）；该鲁棒性由保留视频流子集的 experience replay 方法实现。提出五个新数据集，每个含 1,000,000 连续帧：Lifelong Bouncing Balls (O)、Lifelong Bouncing Balls (C)、Lifelong 3D Maze、Lifelong Drive、Lifelong PLAICraft。
Conclusion: 视频生成模型与世界模型可以不依赖固定数据集、直接从单传感器视频流持续学习，experience replay 是使其对流自相关与非平稳性鲁棒的关键机制。

papers.title: Likelihood Based Inference in Fully and Partially Observed Exponential Family Graphical Models with Intractable Normalizing Constants
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic graphical models that encode an underlying Markov random field are fundamental building blocks of generative modeling to learn latent representations in modern multivariate data sets with complex dependency structures. Among these, the exponential family graphical models are especially popular, given their fairly well-understood statistical properties and computational scalability to high-dimensional data based on pseudo-likelihood methods. These models have been successfully applied in many fields, such as the Ising model in statistical physics and count graphical models in genomics. Another strand of models allows some nodes to be latent, so as to allow the marginal distribution of the observable nodes to depart from exponential family to capture more complex dependence. These approaches form the basis of generative models in artificial intelligence, such as the Boltzmann machines and their restricted versions. A fundamental barrier to likelihood-based (i.e., both maximum likelihood and fully Bayesian) inference in both fully and partially observed cases is the intractability of the likelihood. The usual workaround is via adopting pseudo likelihood-based approaches, following the pioneering work of Besag(1974). The goal of this paper is to demonstrate that full likelihood-based analysis of these models is feasible in a computationally efficient manner under a logarithmically sparse setting. The chief innovation lies in utilizing the tractable independence model underlying an intractable graphical model, to estimate the normalizing constant, as well as its gradient. Extensive numerical results, supporting theory and comparisons with pseudo likelihood-based approaches demonstrate the applicability of the proposed method.
papers.comment: To appear in Journal of Machine Learning Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在对数稀疏设定下，指数族图模型（含部分节点潜变量）的完整似然推断可计算可行：核心是用不可归一化模型背后的可 tractable 独立模型估计归一化常数及其梯度，从而绕开伪似然 (pseudo-likelihood) 这一常规替代。数值结果、理论与和伪似然方法的比较支持该方法的可用性。
Motivation: 指数族 Markov 随机场图模型的似然含不可处理的归一化常数，完全观测与部分观测两种情形下最大似然与全贝叶斯推断都被这一障碍卡住，通常只能退到 Besag(1974) 的伪似然。
Method: 利用不可处理图模型底层可处理的独立模型 (tractable independence model) 同时估计归一化常数及其梯度，在对数稀疏 (logarithmically sparse) 设定下做完整似然的 MLE 与全贝叶斯推断；覆盖完全观测与部分观测（潜节点）两类指数族图模型。
Result: 给出大量数值结果、支撑理论，并与伪似然方法作比较，显示该方法在计算上高效且适用；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 完整似然分析在对数稀疏设定下对这类含不可处理归一化常数的图模型是计算可行的，不必依赖伪似然。

papers.title: DA-Cramming: Enhancing Cost-Effective Language Model Pretraining with Dependency Agreement Integration
papers.abstract_en: Pretraining language models is still a challenge for many researchers due to its substantial computational costs. As such, there is growing interest in developing more affordable pretraining methods. One notable advancement in this area is the Cramming technique (Geiping and Goldstein, 2022), which enables the pretraining of BERT-style language models using just one GPU in a single day. Building on this innovative approach, we introduce the Dependency Agreement Cramming (DA-Cramming), an efficient framework that integrates information about dependency agreements into the pretraining process. Unlike existing methods that leverage similar semantic information during finetuning, our approach represents a pioneering effort focusing on enhancing the foundational language understanding with semantic information during pretraining. We meticulously design a dual-stage pretraining work flow with four dedicated submodels to capture representative dependency agreements at the chunk level, effectively transforming these agreements into embeddings to benefit the pretraining. Extensive empirical results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous methods across various tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DA-Cramming 把依存一致性 (dependency agreement) 信息注入单卡 Cramming 预训练：双阶段流程用四个子模型在 chunk 级捕获依存一致性并转成 embedding，供 BERT 式语言模型预训练使用。作者称在多种任务上显著优于此前方法。
Motivation: 语言模型预训练算力成本高，Cramming 已把 BERT 式预训练压到单卡一天，但既有注入语义信息的做法集中在微调阶段，预训练阶段的基础语言理解仍缺少语义监督。
Method: 在 Geiping 和 Goldstein (2022) 的 Cramming 框架上做双阶段预训练流程，设计四个专用子模型在 chunk 级捕获代表性依存一致性，把这些一致性转成 embedding 并入预训练目标，而非在微调时利用相似语义信息。
Result: 作者报告该方法在多种任务上显著优于先前方法；摘要给出的设定是单 GPU 一天内完成 BERT 式预训练（源自 Cramming），未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把语义层面的依存一致性放进预训练而非微调，是在受限算力预算下提升语言模型基础理解的可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SBMVTrack: Spike-Budgeted Multi-View Learning for Energy-Efficient UAV Tracking
papers.abstract_en: With sparse and event-driven computation, spiking neural networks show great potential for achieving accurate and energy-efficient UAV visual tracking. However, existing SNN-based trackers typically use spike firing rates only for energy evaluation and lack explicit optimization of actual spike activity. To address this, we propose SBMVTrack, a fully spiking framework for energy-efficient UAV tracking. SBMVTrack introduces Energy-Weighted Spike Budgeting (EWSB). EWSB weights actual spike activity according to the computational cost of each spiking layer. It constrains the energy-weighted firing rate and saturation activity, thereby reducing redundant spike computations. To improve tracking performance under the spike budget constraint, we propose Masked Multi-View Target Modeling (MVTM). This method treats the initial template, online template, and search region from the same sequence as correlated temporal views. It enhances the robustness of target representations through cross-view feature completion and identity-consistency learning. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SBMVTrack effectively reduces the average spike firing rate and theoretical energy consumption. Meanwhile, it maintains competitive tracking performance, achieving a better accuracy-energy trade-off. The source code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SBMVTrack 是全脉冲 (fully spiking) 的 UAV 视觉跟踪框架，用 Energy-Weighted Spike Budgeting (EWSB) 按各脉冲层的计算代价加权实际脉冲活动，约束能量加权发放率与饱和活动以削减冗余脉冲计算；再用 Masked Multi-View Target Modeling 把初始模板、在线模板与搜索区当作同一序列的相关时间视图，通过跨视图特征补全与身份一致性学习保住跟踪精度。多基准实验显示平均脉冲发放率与理论能耗下降，同时保持有竞争力的跟踪性能，取得更好的精度-能耗权衡。
Motivation: 现有 SNN 跟踪器只把脉冲发放率当能耗评估指标，没有对实际脉冲活动做显式优化，导致冗余脉冲计算无法被约束。
Method: EWSB 按每层脉冲神经元的计算成本加权实际 spike activity，对能量加权发放率与饱和活动施加预算约束；MVTM 将初始模板、在线模板、搜索区域建模为相关时间视图，用跨视图特征补全与 identity-consistency learning 增强目标表征鲁棒性，两者组成全脉冲 UAV 跟踪框架。
Result: 在多个跟踪基准上，SBMVTrack 降低了平均脉冲发放率与理论能耗，同时保持有竞争力的跟踪精度，取得更好的 accuracy-energy trade-off；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把能耗预算直接做成对能量加权脉冲活动的约束、并用多视图目标建模补偿预算带来的精度损失，是 SNN UAV 跟踪取得更优精度-能耗权衡的可行路径。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: EWSB 按每层脉冲神经元的计算成本加权实际 spike activity，对能量加权发放率与饱和活动施加预算约束；MVTM 将初始模板、在线模板、搜索区域建模为相关时间视图，用跨视图特征补全与 identity-consistency learning 增强目标表征鲁棒性，两者组成全脉冲 UAV 跟踪框架。
summary_sections.result: 在多个跟踪基准上，SBMVTrack 降低了平均脉冲发放率与理论能耗，同时保持有竞争力的跟踪精度，取得更好的 accuracy-energy trade-off；摘要未给出具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把能耗预算直接做成对能量加权脉冲活动的约束、并用多视图目标建模补偿预算带来的精度损失，是 SNN UAV 跟踪取得更优精度-能耗权衡的可行路径。

papers.title: Continuous Optimization for p-adic Models
papers.abstract_en: We present the first method for native, continuous gradient descent for machine learning models with $p$-adic parameters. Existing native optimizers are discrete, mostly combinatorial searches, as the $p$-adic numbers $\mathbb{Q}_p$ are totally disconnected, with standard losses that are flat away from their minima. To enable continuous optimization, we propose working with $\mathbb{Q}_p$ via its Berkovich affine line: a canonical, path-connected expansion of $\mathbb{Q}_p$ that preserves its isometries and uniquely extends its analytic maps. This hull is a metric tree with interpretable points and local derivatives, which we show enables effective optimizers and backpropagation. We formulate gradient descent and show that its approximations efficiently learn linear models with coefficients in $\mathbb{Q}_p$ to do modular arithmetic, an XOR-like task not expressible by linear models in $\mathbb{R}$. We also demonstrate momentum and Adam variants, linear regression, and classification on binary-encoded hierarchies (Quillian semantic networks), addressing open problems posed by Martins (2025). Library at https://github.com/google-deepmind/padic-ml
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个针对 p-adic 参数机器学习模型的原生连续梯度下降方法：把 Q_p 通过其 Berkovich 仿射直线这一保等距、解析映射唯一延拓的路径连通扩张来表示，该 hull 是一棵带可解释点与局部导数的度量树，从而让梯度下降与反向传播可用。近似梯度下降能高效学到系数取值于 Q_p 的线性模型并完成模运算（在 R 上线性模型无法表达的类 XOR 任务），并给出 momentum、Adam 变体、线性回归与二值编码层次结构（Quillian 语义网络）上的分类。
Motivation: p-adic 数 Q_p 完全不连通、标准损失在极小点之外是平的，现有 p-adic 优化器只能是离散的、多为组合搜索，无法做连续梯度优化。
Method: 经由 Berkovich 仿射直线在 Q_p 上工作：这是保等距并唯一延拓解析映射的典范路径连通扩张，作为带可解释点与局部导数的度量树，据此构造梯度下降及其近似、反向传播，并扩展出 momentum 与 Adam 变体，用于 Q_p 系数的线性模型、线性回归与分类。
Result: 近似梯度下降高效学习系数在 Q_p 中的线性模型以执行模运算，完成在 R 上线性模型不可表达的类 XOR 任务；在二值编码层次结构（Quillian 语义网络）上展示线性回归与分类，并回应 Martins (2025) 提出的开放问题。
Conclusion: 借助 Berkovich hull 把完全不连通的 Q_p 变成可做局部导数的度量树，p-adic 参数模型即可走原生连续梯度优化路线，覆盖梯度下降、momentum、Adam 与反向传播。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: mbariml: a curation pipeline for turning deep-sea imagery and video into object-detection training data
papers.abstract_en: Training data quantity and quality greatly affect object detection model performance, regardless of model architecture. When using object detection models on video and images from the deep sea, in which the objects of interest, primarily organisms, are sparse, faint, and hard to identify, incremental improvements to object detector performance may require an iterative approach to data labeling and management. This paper presents mbariml, a python-based video and image analysis pipeline built around the data labeling management process. mbariml uses an Ultralytics YOLO detection model, runs it over still images or video, stores every detection as a reviewable region of interest, groups those regions by visual similarity so that a human can accept or reject them in bulk, and exports the result as training data, statistics, image sidecars, and additional metadata. The human review stage is the centre of the design: an annotator can validate, relabel, resize, delete, and draw entirely new localizations, and every one of those edits is written back to the same database the detector wrote to. Video receives particular attention: the software treats each tracker-produced track as a provisional observation and selects one representative frame instead of retaining every detection in the track. We describe the pipeline stage by stage, including the operational middle-third heuristic used for track observation selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: mbariml 是一个围绕标注管理构建的 Python 深海影像/视频目标检测训练数据流水线：用 Ultralytics YOLO 跑图与视频，把每次检测存为可审阅 ROI，按视觉相似度分组供人批量接受/拒绝，视频轨迹只取中段三分之一 (middle-third heuristic) 的代表帧。它把人工校验、重标、改框、删除与新建框全部写回检测器同一数据库，导出为训练数据与统计信息。
Motivation: 深海影像中目标（主要是生物）稀疏、微弱、难辨识，检测器性能的渐进提升依赖迭代式标注与数据管理，而通用标注工具缺少针对视频轨迹与批量复核的管理流程。
Method: Python 流水线 mbariml：Ultralytics YOLO 检测模型在静图与视频上推理，检测结果存为可审阅 ROI 并按视觉相似度分组供批量接受/拒绝；人工阶段可验证、重标、缩放、删除、新建定位并写回同一数据库；视频按 tracker 轨迹取代表帧，采用 middle-third heuristic 选帧；导出训练数据、统计、图像 sidecar 与元数据。
Result: 论文按阶段描述该流水线，包括视频轨迹观测选择所用的 operational middle-third heuristic；摘要给出的是流程与设计描述，未列出检测精度或对比数字。
Conclusion: 把人工复核置于设计中心、并让所有编辑写回检测器同一数据库，是深海稀疏目标检测训练数据迭代构建的可行路径；视频轨迹应压缩为代表帧而非保留全部检测。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Universal Fractal Natural Language Decision Map: Real-Time Edge Triage Across Heterogeneous Domains
papers.abstract_en: Deploying Large Language Models for runtime operational triage incurs prohibitive latency (>100-500 ms), high VRAM requirements (>4-8 GB), and excessive energy dissipation. Extending Mandelbrot Fractal Neural Synthesis (Dagli et al., 2026), this paper presents the Universal Fractal Natural Language Decision Map, realized via the werr machine-native edge reflex runtime and the production answerr platform (https://answerr.me). Operating entirely without stored weight tensors (0 Bytes VRAM), the engine synthesizes deterministic decisions---noul (Boolean), choice (categorical), and score (ordinal)---by dynamically modulating 24-byte coordinate seeds along the chaotic boundary of the Mandelbrot set and evaluating 4-quadrant escape dynamics. Drawing inspiration from biological System-One reflex arcs, the engine introduces: (i) an Auto-Seed Router with domain projector Phi_D yielding a +28.8% accuracy gain over linear baselines; (ii) an Information-Theoretic Acoustic Damping Filter grounded in token entropy and phonetic spectral density that insulates against prompt injections (0.0% empirical bypass; 95% Wilson CI: [0.0%, 30.8%]) while pruning escape iterations by 45.8% (accelerating throughput 2.5x to 3.31 ms latency); and (iii) an Organic Dynamic Calibration framework using O(1) Exponential Moving Average (EMA, alpha=0.03) and quadrant phase rotation to eliminate positional bias. Benchmarked on bare-metal infrastructure (api.answerr.me:4431) across 1,150+ verified decisions (3,200+ questions) and ranked World #1 on the independent JevBench suite (81.65%), the framework achieves 92.6% macro-accuracy (95% CI: [90.8%, 94.1%]) with 7.08 ms median CPU latency. We provide an OpenAI-compatible API (/v1/chat/completions) and demonstrate feasibility on microcontrollers and 32-byte EVM smart contracts.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Companion to Mandelbrot Fractal Neural Synthesis. Live portal: https://answerr.me; Source code: https://github.com/pCwOrM/werr
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无权重张量的边缘决策运行时 werr 与 answerr 平台，靠调制 24 字节坐标种子沿 Mandelbrot 集混沌边界演化、评估 4 象限逃逸动力学来合成 noul/choice/score 三类确定性决策。在 1,150+ 验证决策、3,200+ 题目上取得 92.6% macro-accuracy（95% CI [90.8%, 94.1%]）、7.08 ms 中位 CPU 延迟，JevBench 独立榜单以 81.65% 排名世界第一。
Motivation: LLM 做运行时决策分诊延迟 >100–500 ms、显存 >4–8 GB、能耗高，难以部署到边缘与微控制器。
Method: werr 运行时完全不存权重张量（0 Bytes VRAM），用 24 字节坐标种子在 Mandelbrot 集混沌边界上调制并评估 4 象限逃逸动力学；含 Auto-Seed Router（域投影 Phi_D）、基于 token 熵与音素谱密度的信息论声学阻尼滤波器、以及 O(1) EMA（alpha=0.03）加象限相位旋转的动态校准。
Result: Auto-Seed Router 相对线性基线 +28.8% accuracy；阻尼滤波器 prompt injection 经验绕过 0.0%（95% Wilson CI [0.0%, 30.8%]），逃逸迭代削减 45.8%，吞吐提速 2.5x 至 3.31 ms 延迟；整体 92.6% macro-accuracy（95% CI [90.8%, 94.1%]）、7.08 ms 中位 CPU 延迟，JevBench 81.65% 排名 World #1，评测覆盖 1,150+ 验证决策与 3,200+ 题目。
Conclusion: 不用存储权重、仅靠分形种子动力学即可在边缘延迟预算内做出确定性三类决策，并在 JevBench 上排到第一；框架提供 OpenAI 兼容 API 并在微控制器与 32 字节 EVM 智能合约上验证可行。

papers.title: Towards participatory speech dataset curation: A queer case study and conceptual framework
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we motivate the need for a participatory speech dataset creation framework through a case study of the LGBTQIA+, or queer, community - a community with documented concerns about AI and reported harms, including attempts to develop 'gaydar' technologies that purportedly identify individuals as queer. We review common speech data collection practices, why these methods may be unsuitable for engaging with queer speakers, and discuss previous efforts in participatory AI with queer community engagement, as well as participatory endeavours specific to speech data collection for other marginalized communities. From this review, we develop a conceptual framework for participatory speech data curation by, for, and with marginalized communities drawing on insights from co-design and knowledge sharing. We propose a framework comprising overlapping and two-way processes of defining a community, project formulation, modes of participation, and personal autonomy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以 LGBTQIA+ 群体为案例，指出常规语音数据采集方式不适合与 queer 说话者合作，并提出一个由社区定义、项目形成、参与模式与个人自主四个双向重叠环节组成的参与式语音数据集共建框架，主张数据集应由、为、与边缘社区共同策展。
Motivation: 语音数据采集长期由外部团队主导，对 queer 等有据可查的 AI 受害群体（如曾出现的 'gaydar' 类技术）构成伤害风险，现有采集方法不适合与其协作。
Method: 先综述常见语音数据采集实践、既往参与式 AI 与面向其他边缘群体的语音数据采集努力，再结合 co-design 与知识共享提出概念框架，包含社区定义、项目形成、参与模式、个人自主四个相互重叠的双向过程。
Result: 提出一个含四个双向重叠环节（社区定义、项目形成、参与模式、个人自主）的参与式语音数据集策展概念框架，以 queer 社区为案例研究对象。
Conclusion: 边缘群体的语音数据集应由、为、与该社区共同策展，个人自主须作为框架的组成环节而非附加项。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RGSQ: Riemannian Geometry-Sensitive Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (VLMs) can be efficiently deployed under stringent memory and latency constraints through post training quantization (PTQ). However, most PTQ methods are designed for unimodal large language models (LLMs). These methods treat quantization errors as isotropic perturbations under the Euclidean assumption, which provides weak guidance on directions most sensitive to quantization in VLMs. Consequently, directly adapting unimodal PTQ approaches or solely employing modality-specific scaling often leads to uneven bit-width distribution and inconsistent performance in low-bit settings. To address these challenges, we propose Riemannian Geometry-Sensitive Quantization (RGSQ), which formulates quantization as a reconstruction problem under a unified Fisher-Riemannian metric. RGSQ identifies modality-specific sensitive directions via Riemannian manifold mappings built from modality-partitioned empirical Fisher factors and fused into a modality-aware Kronecker-structured metric. We then apply geometry-aligned rotations to reorient the local tangent frame, steering low-bit perturbations toward loss-insensitive axes. Finally, we apply a whitening transformation that maps the Riemannian objective to an equivalent Euclidean form, enabling standard unimodal PTQ methods to evaluate multimodal quantization error under their original assumptions. Across an extensive and diverse set of mainstream VLM benchmarks, RGSQ achieves the highest accuracy and stability under extremely low-bit settings (W2A8 and W3A8). It outperforms VLM-aware baselines, such as MBQ and MQuant, by up to 5.9% and surpasses single-modality improvements by up to 8.6%.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 多数 PTQ 方法面向单模态 LLM，在欧氏假设下把量化误差当作各向同性扰动，对 VLM 中真正对量化敏感的方向缺乏指引；直接套用或仅靠模态特定缩放会导致低位宽下比特分配不均、性能不一致。

Result: 在一组主流 VLM 基准上，RGSQ 在极低位宽 W2A8 与 W3A8 下取得最高精度与稳定性；相对 VLM 感知基线 MBQ 与 MQuant 最高提升 5.9%，相对单模态改进最高超出 8.6%。
Conclusion: 把量化误差按 Fisher-Riemannian 几何而非欧氏各向同性来刻画，并通过旋转与白化把问题还原给现有单模态 PTQ，可在极低位宽下同时改善 VLM 的精度与稳定性。

papers.title: Queer inclusion in speech datasets: An audit and taxonomy of practical tensions
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we examine speech datasets for their inclusion of LGBTQIA+, or queer, voices and provide a taxonomy of tensions to better understand why there is a lack of such voices in current speech technology datasets. Through an audit of six diverse speech datasets, we find that measurable queer representation is low (0-1.4% of speakers) - insufficient for robust disparity measurement. We take this community as a case study to consider what challenges and tensions are associated with collecting speech data from marginalized communities. For comparison, we audit an additional two datasets from the speech sciences that were created by, for, and with the queer community. We note that many customs in speech dataset collection efforts in AI and speech technology research may conflict with values emphasized in participatory approaches with marginalized communities, and provide a taxonomy describing these tensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对六个主流语音数据集的审计显示，酷儿 (queer/LGBTQIA+) 说话人占比仅 0–1.4%，不足以支撑可靠的差异性测量；另审计两个由酷儿社群自建的语音科学数据集作对照，并归纳出 AI 语音数据采集惯例与边缘社群参与式价值观之间的张力分类体系 (taxonomy)。
Motivation: 语音技术数据集中酷儿声音长期缺席，且现有采集惯例与边缘社群参与式 (participatory) 原则存在系统性冲突，需要可操作的张力框架来解释缺口成因。
Method: 审计六个多样化的语音数据集统计酷儿说话人比例，再对照审计两个由、为、与酷儿社群共建的语音科学数据集；以该社群为案例提炼采集挑战，并给出描述采集惯例与参与式价值冲突的 taxonomy。
Result: 六个语音数据集中可测量的酷儿代表性为 0–1.4% 的说话人，低到不足以做稳健的差异测量；另审计两个语音科学领域的社群共建数据集作为比较。
Conclusion: 当前语音数据集的酷儿缺席既是比例问题也是采集方式问题：AI 语音数据采集惯例与边缘社群参与式价值存在结构性张力，需用该 taxonomy 定位冲突点。

papers.title: SAM-V: Geometry-Aware Segment Anything for Multi-View Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Consistent multi-view object segmentation is critical for 3D perception and robotics, yet remains challenging under severe viewpoint and occlusion changes. Existing methods typically perform 3D instance segmentation on point clouds or rely on offline 2D mask-matching pipelines. However, 3D instance segmentation is limited by scarce 3D annotations, while offline 2D matching suffers from object identity ambiguity across frames. To leverage strong 2D and 3D priors jointly, we propose SAM-V (Geometry-Aware Segment Anything for Multi-View Instance Segmentation). Instead of combining the two priors through post-hoc matching, SAM-V directly integrates features from a feed-forward geometry model (VGGT) into a 2D segmentation foundation model (SAM), trained end-to-end for cross-view instance prediction. SAM-V introduces a prompt-fusion mechanism that enriches sparse SAM prompt tokens with view-specific camera tokens and local VGGT features, making the prompt representation both view-aware and spatially grounded, together with a mask decoder that attends to dense 2D and 3D features. By conditioning the mask decoding directly on multi-view geometry, SAM-V produces consistent multi-view segmentation of a prompted object in a single forward pass without offline mask matching or explicit 3D reconstruction. On the IGGT 3D tracking benchmark, where consistent instance identity across frames directly determines performance, SAM-V improves overall IoU by 5 points and frame-level recall by 12 points on the ScanNet++ split over the state-of-the-art multi-view instance segmentation baseline and leads on all metrics in the zero-shot ScanNet split. Our code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/gong208/SAM-V.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAM-V 把前馈几何模型 VGGT 的特征直接注入 2D 分割基础模型 SAM，用 prompt-fusion 让稀疏 prompt token 携带相机 token 与局部 3D 特征，单次前向即输出跨视角一致的实例分割，无需离线 mask matching 或显式 3D 重建。在 IGGT 3D tracking benchmark 的 ScanNet++ split 上，相对 SOTA 多视角实例分割基线整体 IoU 提升 5 点、帧级 recall 提升 12 点，并在 zero-shot ScanNet split 上全部指标领先。
Motivation: 多视角实例分割在剧烈视角变化与遮挡下难以保持物体身份一致：3D 实例分割受 3D 标注稀缺限制，离线 2D mask-matching 则在帧间产生物体身份歧义。
Method: SAM-V 端到端训练跨视角实例预测，把 VGGT 特征直接整合进 SAM 而非事后匹配；prompt-fusion 机制用视角专属 camera token 与局部 VGGT 特征增强稀疏 SAM prompt token，使 prompt 表示同时具备视角感知与空间锚定；mask decoder 同时注意稠密 2D 与 3D 特征。
Result: 在 IGGT 3D tracking benchmark 的 ScanNet++ split 上，相对 SOTA 多视角实例分割基线整体 IoU 提升 5 点、帧级 recall 提升 12 点；在 zero-shot ScanNet split 上所有指标均领先。
Conclusion: 把 3D 几何先验直接条件化到 2D 分割模型的 mask 解码中，可在单次前向内取得跨视角一致的实例分割，绕开离线匹配与显式 3D 重建。

papers.title: Learning Defensive Policies against Diverse Inference Attacks for Smart Meter Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Smart meter (SM) data provides fine-grained visibility into household energy consumption, but also exposes users to privacy risks. Inference attacks, known as non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM), can perform appliance-level inference from aggregate signals and recover sensitive behavioral patterns. In practice, attacker models are unknown and heterogeneous, making robust defense challenging. We formulate SM privacy protection as a black-box inference defense problem, aiming to reduce the recoverability of appliance-level information while generalizing across diverse and unseen attackers. We propose a proxy-guided hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that learns battery-based load-shaping policies to inject realistic but misleading appliance-level signatures into the aggregate signal, thereby disrupting the structured patterns exploited by NILM. A self-supervised aggregate-structure privacy probe provides a reconstruction-error-based surrogate reward for disrupting recoverable load structure, while a signature library makes the perturbations appliance-relevant and physically realizable through battery control. We provide theoretical rationale showing that proxy-guided optimization improves inference robustness under attacker diversity. Experiments on real-world datasets UK-DALE and REDD demonstrate strong cross-model and cross-appliance generalization. Across six unseen NILM attackers, covering four appliances on UK-DALE and five on REDD, our proposed defense increases average appliance-level RMSE by 107% and 166%, respectively, while reducing F1 score by 79% and 80%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把智能电表隐私保护建模为黑盒推理防御，用代理引导的分层强化学习控制电池做负荷整形，向聚合信号注入真实但误导的电器级特征以破坏 NILM 可利用的结构。在 UK-DALE 与 REDD 上对六个未见 NILM 攻击者，平均电器级 RMSE 分别提高 107% 和 166%，F1 分别下降 79% 和 80%。
Motivation: NILM 攻击可从聚合用电信号推断电器级行为，而实际中攻击者模型未知且异构，针对单一攻击者的防御难以泛化。
Method: 代理引导分层强化学习 (proxy-guided hierarchical RL) 学习基于电池的负荷整形策略；自监督聚合结构隐私探针提供基于重构误差的代理奖励，signature library 使扰动与电器相关且通过电池控制物理可实现，并给出代理优化在攻击者多样性下提升推理鲁棒性的理论依据。
Result: 在真实数据集 UK-DALE 与 REDD 上，对六个未见 NILM 攻击者（UK-DALE 覆盖四种电器、REDD 五种），平均电器级 RMSE 分别提高 107% 与 166%，F1 分别降低 79% 与 80%，显示跨模型与跨电器泛化。
Conclusion: 在攻击者未知且多样的前提下，用代理奖励引导的电池负荷整形能同时破坏多种 NILM 攻击者可恢复的负荷结构，并跨模型与跨电器泛化。

papers.title: Terminal Shrinkage Averaging Reveals a Schedule-Estimator Interaction in LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) pretraining conventionally returns the raw final iterate. This couples two design choices: the learning-rate schedule that generates the parameter trajectory and the estimator that constructs the deployed model (e.g. the raw final iterate or a checkpoint average). A schedule that promotes optimization progress may differ from one that minimizes variation in the raw final iterate. Separating these choices creates an opportunity to maintain progress late in training while reducing variation in the returned model. To this end, we propose \emph{Terminal Shrinkage Averaging (TSA)}, which interpolates between the raw final iterate and the average of recent checkpoints to balance recent progress against terminal variation. We analyze how TSA changes the preferred terminal learning-rate schedule under a local quadratic approximation and test this interaction through a sequence of controlled NanoChat experiments. Finally, we demonstrate that the resulting gains transfer to depth-22 NanoChat, where the combined schedule and estimator improve validation quality. A qualifying time-to-GPT-2 run also finishes faster than the public baseline used in our experiments, providing preliminary evidence of benchmark acceleration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 预训练把学习率调度与部署估计器解耦，提出 Terminal Shrinkage Averaging (TSA)，在原始末次迭代与近期 checkpoint 平均之间插值，以牺牲少量末期进度换取更低的终端方差。局部二次近似下 TSA 会改变最优末期学习率调度，二者联合在 depth-22 NanoChat 上提升验证质量，qualifying time-to-GPT-2 运行比实验所用公开基线更快。
Motivation: 常规预训练直接返回原始末次迭代，把生成参数轨迹的调度与构造部署模型的估计器绑在一起：促进优化进度的调度未必使末次迭代方差最小。
Method: 提出 TSA，在原始末次迭代与近期 checkpoint 平均之间插值；在局部二次近似下分析 TSA 如何改变偏好的末期学习率调度，并通过一系列受控 NanoChat 实验检验该调度—估计器交互。
Result: 联合调度与估计器在 depth-22 NanoChat 上提升验证质量；一次 qualifying time-to-GPT-2 运行比实验中使用的公开基线更快完成，给出基准加速的初步证据。
Conclusion: 把调度与估计器当作两个独立设计旋钮、用 TSA 在末期进度与终端方差间折中，可在 NanoChat 上改善验证质量并可能缩短 time-to-GPT-2；基准加速一项目前只是初步证据。

papers.title: Spectra: A Rules-Driven LLM Pipeline for Automated KYC Document Processing
papers.abstract_en: Know Your Client (KYC) onboarding in capital markets requires analysts to manually classify documents, extract structured data from heterogeneous sources, and validate compliance against complex regulatory policies. This process requires significant analyst time per client, with end-to-end onboarding often stretching to multiple weeks due to sequential handoffs. In this work, we analyze an on-boarding process and find that it comprises repeatable components well-suited to AI automation. We therefore propose a restructured workflow to be amenable to automation: we consolidate the traditional four-party process into two parties that share most of the work and can be automated together, eliminating intermediate handoffs that compound delays. To automate the remaining steps, we introduce Spectra, an AI-assisted document processing platform that combines a structured rules engine with LLM-based classification, extraction, and validation agents. The rules engine encodes compliance policy as a queryable database, enabling focused context injection that reduces token usage while improving extraction precision. Rather than a single monolithic prompt, the system decomposes document processing into isolated, auditable stages, each optimized independently and traceable to specific policy clauses. In evaluation on real KYC documents, Spectra achieves 100% classification accuracy and 89.4% extraction accuracy. Human review burden dropped by 96%.

papers.title: A Practical Recipe for Semi-Supervised Federated ASR: Online Pseudo-Labels with Server Update Stabilization
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised federated learning (SSFL) trains models on clients' unlabeled data using a teacher to generate pseudo-labels, with a small labeled seed dataset on the server. Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) is particularly fragile here: pseudo-label errors compound across the output sequence and across training rounds into divergence, leaving a large gap to fully-supervised FL. We show that closing this gap turns on two coupled design axes -- the teacher (which model generates the pseudo-labels) and the anchor (the server-side updates on labeled data that stabilize training). On the teacher axis, a per-client online teacher (each client's own evolving model) diverges on its own, but once stabilized it matches or beats the broadcast global teacher (one server model, fixed within a round) -- decisively in-domain and competitively under domain shift. As the seed grows stronger and the online teacher's advantage narrows, a transitioning teacher (global $\rightarrow$ online at round $r$) matches or beats both. On the anchor axis, the server must keep training on labeled data between rounds -- otherwise the online teacher drifts -- and this interleaving, more than the seed model, governs convergence. The two axes are inseparable: aggressive teacher choices pay off only once the anchor stabilizes training, which is highly sensitive to data augmentation and batch size -- the settings that govern how much input and gradient noise the server injects. How much stabilization is needed is domain-dependent, governed by the dispersion of the seed data and its overlap with client data. These findings yield guidelines for SSFL in ASR training, improving over the strongest prior method on 9 of 11 pairs, by $20.8\%$ on average in-domain and $10.0\%$ cross-domain, narrowing the gap to fully-supervised FL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对半监督联邦 ASR 中伪标签错误跨序列与跨轮次累积导致发散的问题，把设计拆成 teacher（谁生成伪标签）与 anchor（服务器在有标签数据上的稳定化更新）两条耦合轴：稳定化后的 per-client online teacher 在域内追平或超过 broadcast global teacher，而 global→online 的 transitioning teacher 在种子变强时同时追平两者。在 11 组配对中改进最强先前方法 9 组，域内平均提升 20.8%、跨域 10.0%，缩小与全监督 FL 的差距。
Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端只有无标签数据、服务器只有少量有标签种子时，ASR 的伪标签误差会在输出序列和训练轮次上累积成发散，与全监督 FL 留下很大差距。
Method: 两条设计轴：teacher 轴比较 per-client online teacher、broadcast global teacher 与在第 r 轮切换的 transitioning teacher；anchor 轮次间在服务器有标签数据上继续训练以稳定 online teacher，并考察数据增强与 batch size 对服务器注入的输入/梯度噪声的敏感性。所需稳定化程度由种子数据的离散度及其与客户端数据的重叠决定。
Result: 在 11 组配对中改进最强先前方法 9 组，域内平均提升 20.8%，跨域平均提升 10.0%；稳定化后的 online teacher 在域内决定性地追平或超过 broadcast global teacher，在域移下具竞争力，transitioning teacher 在种子变强、online 优势收窄时追平或超过两者。
Conclusion: 激进的 teacher 选择只有在 anchor 先把训练稳定住之后才见效，且 anchor 的轮次间交错比种子模型本身更决定收敛；所需稳定化量是领域相关的，由种子数据离散度与客户端数据重叠决定。

papers.title: RAG-NAROK: Retrieval-Aware Knowledge Corpus Poisoning in RAG with Source-specific Refutation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems have emerged as the dominant architecture for grounding large language model (LLM) outputs in verifiable external knowledge, yet their structural reliance on a dynamic retrieval pipeline introduces a largely unexplored class of adversarial vulnerability. Existing knowledge-base poisoning attacks are fundamentally static. Adversarial documents are pre-computed and injected without any awareness of what the victim system will actually retrieve for a given query, leaving the attack blind to the competitive documentary landscape that surrounds its payload in the generator's context window. Unlike traditional static poisoning attacks that are blind to the retrieved context, we introduce RAG-NAROK (Retrieval-Anchored Generation Negation And Response Quality Collapse), a RAG attack framework that adapts to the query text. RAG-NAROK exploits the transparency inherent in RAG pipeline to first extract the legitimate source identities, then generate Anchor-Specific Refutation documents that explicitly name and devalue retrieved sources while leveraging recency and authority biases to steer the text generation toward a target answer. Our results demonstrate that RAG-NAROK significantly outperforms static baselines across diverse domains, revealing a fundamental tension between RAG transparency and AI security.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAG-NAROK 是一种随查询自适应的 RAG 知识库投毒攻击：先利用 RAG 管线的透明性提取合法来源身份，再生成 Anchor-Specific Refutation 文档，点名并贬低被检索来源，借 recency 与 authority 偏差把生成导向目标答案。在多领域测试中显著优于静态投毒基线。
Motivation: 现有知识库投毒攻击是静态的：对抗文档预先算好、注入时不感知受害者实际会检索到什么，对生成器上下文窗口中围绕其载荷的竞争性文档格局完全失明。
Method: RAG-NAROK（Retrieval-Anchored Generation Negation And Response Quality Collapse）随查询文本自适应：第一步从 RAG 管线中抽取合法来源身份，第二步生成 Anchor-Specific Refutation 文档，显式点名并贬低被检索来源，利用 recency bias 与 authority bias 引导文本生成命中目标答案。
Result: 在 diverse domains 上显著优于静态投毒基线（significantly outperforms static baselines），揭示 RAG 透明性与 AI 安全之间的根本张力；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: RAG 暴露检索来源这一透明性设计本身即成为可被利用的攻击面，静态投毒基线不足以刻画 RAG 的对抗风险。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ShowTellArena: Evaluating Business Workflow Understanding from Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: We often teach a colleague by showing the work and explaining the decisions as we go. How can we check what an agent understood from the same lesson? We introduce ShowTellArena, a benchmark protocol and public dataset for comprehension after narrated business demonstrations. The v1.0 release contains 50 business workflow tasks, with recordings, screenshots, narration, fixture seeds, and 502 questions. Tasks span finance, hiring, procurement, customer decisions, inventory, and logistics. The protocol holds the business scenario and quiz fixed while allowing each product to capture the lesson through its own teaching interface. Questions test operational rules, boundaries, exceptions, and errors in proposed automations. We analyze 218 selected pilot attempts across 39 workflow cases, including 28 cases attempted by all three evaluated systems. These exploratory results expose both answer errors and failures to complete the teaching experience. We describe the release's verification gaps and the pilot's uneven coverage, exclusions, and grading provenance. The contribution is an inspectable dataset and assessment workflow that others can extend; the selected pilot is not a controlled product ranking.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code and dataset linked in the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ShowTellArena 提出一套评测协议与公开数据集，用于检验 agent 从带旁白的业务流程演示中学到了什么：v1.0 含 50 个业务工作流任务与 502 道题，覆盖财务、招聘、采购、库存、物流等领域，题目考操作规则、边界、异常与自动化错误。对 218 次试点尝试（跨 39 个流程案例，其中 28 例由三个被评系统共同完成）的探索性分析同时暴露了答题错误与未完成教学过程两类失败；作者明确该试点不是受控的产品排名。
Motivation: 用演示加旁白教同事业务流程很常见，但缺少一个固定场景与题目、允许各产品用自己的教学界面来检验 agent 理解程度的可检查评测载体。
Method: 定义 ShowTellArena 评测协议：业务场景与测验题固定，各产品用自己的教学界面完成学习；数据集附录制、截图、旁白、fixture 种子与题目，题目覆盖操作规则、边界、异常和所提自动化的错误。对 218 次选定试点尝试做探索性分析，并记录发布版的验证缺口、覆盖不均、样本排除与评分来源。
Result: v1.0 发布 50 个业务工作流任务、502 道题，覆盖财务、招聘、采购、客户决策、库存与物流；试点分析含 218 次选定尝试、39 个流程案例，其中 28 例由三个被评系统全部尝试，结果同时暴露答案错误与未完成教学过程的失败。
Conclusion: 贡献是一套可检查、可扩展的数据集与评测流程，试点结果应视为探索性而非受控的产品排名。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Real-Time Hand Gesture Recognition for OpenXR Using Transformer-Based Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Hand gesture recognition is a key component in human-computer interaction (HCI), enabling intuitive interfaces for applications in gaming, virtual reality (VR), robotics, and more. This study integrates transformer-based machine-learning models for real-time hand gesture recognition, using hand-tracking data captured through the OpenXR standard in Unity. We leverage positional data of hand joints and wrist rotation angles to train a custom gesture recognition system. By utilizing the sequential modeling capabilities of transformers, the system captures temporal dependencies within short gesture windows and classifies gestures robustly across hand orientations and sizes. The results show a significant improvement in gesture classification accuracy. Building on this, we outline how the approach can be extended toward detecting the flow of movement, i.e., the transitions between gestures, as future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Unity 中用 OpenXR 手部追踪数据训练 Transformer 手势识别系统，输入为手部关节位置与腕部旋转角，靠序列建模捕捉短手势窗口内的时间依赖，从而在不同手部朝向与尺寸下稳健分类手势。作者报告手势分类准确率有显著提升，并把方法扩展到检测手势之间的动作流（transition）列为后续工作。
Motivation: HCI 中的手势接口需要在实时条件下、跨不同手部朝向与尺寸稳健分类，而短窗口内的时序依赖是传统分类器难以处理的难点。
Method: 在 Unity 中通过 OpenXR 标准采集手部追踪数据，取手部关节位置与腕部旋转角作为输入，用 Transformer 的序列建模能力学习短手势窗口内的时间依赖，训练自定义手势识别系统做手势分类。
Result: 手势分类准确率相比此前有显著提升（significant improvement），系统面向实时识别、跨手部朝向与尺寸做稳健分类；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: Transformer 的时序建模足以支撑基于 OpenXR 追踪数据的实时手势分类，下一步是把同一框架从单个手势扩展到手势之间的动作流（transition）检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rollout Efficiency in Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Large Language Models: A Taxonomy and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-oriented reinforcement learning enables large language models to solve mathematical, coding, and other multi-step tasks, but shifts a substantial portion of the training cost to rollout, where trajectories are generated for policy updates. Efficient rollout mechanisms are therefore essential to reduce this cost while maintaining the freshness, consistency, and statistical validity of training data. This survey provides a systematic taxonomy of recent research on rollout efficiency for reasoning-oriented reinforcement learning, classifying existing approaches from both mechanism and bottleneck perspectives. Based on this taxonomy, we analyze how different technique families address distinct sources of rollout inefficiency, examine opportunities and potential conflicts for combining them, identify gaps in the evaluation and reporting of efficiency gains, and discuss open challenges and future research directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于推理型强化学习 (reasoning-oriented RL) 中 rollout 效率的综述，从机制与瓶颈两个视角给现有方法分类，分析各技术族分别解决哪类 rollout 低效来源，并指出组合它们的机会与潜在冲突。综述还识别出效率增益在评估与报告上的缺口，并讨论开放问题与未来方向。
Motivation: 推理型 RL 把大量训练成本转移到 rollout 阶段（为策略更新生成轨迹），而现有工作分散、效率增益的评估与报告不一致，缺少统一分类来判断各方法解决什么瓶颈、能否组合。
Method: 系统综述近期 rollout 效率研究，建立机制视角与瓶颈视角的双重分类法；基于该分类分析各技术族如何应对不同的 rollout 低效来源，考察组合机会与冲突，并梳理评估报告缺口。
Result: 产出一个覆盖机制与瓶颈两个维度的分类体系，以及对技术组合机会与冲突、效率评估与报告缺口、开放挑战的分析；摘要未给出定量对比。
Conclusion: rollout 效率问题应按瓶颈来源分类处理，技术族之间既有组合空间也存在冲突，且当前效率增益的评估与报告方式本身是需要填补的缺口。
Relevance: 2
