papers.title: Transformer-Informed Trajectory Optimization for Relative Motion in Cislunar Orbits
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous spacecraft guidance and control requires a fast solution to non-convex trajectory optimization, which can be accelerated by providing a near-optimal initial guess to an optimization protocol, i.e., warm-starting. A robust warm starting method is especially useful for rendezvous, proximity operations, and docking (RPOD) in cislunar space, where the underlying dynamics become severely nonlinear and chaotic compared to those in Earth orbit, especially at perilune. This paper extends the Autonomous Rendezvous Transformer (ART), a transformer-based warm-start trajectory generation method, to cislunar RPOD scenarios for the first time. To accurately and reliably solve the nonconvex optimal control problems (OCPs) posed by these scenarios, a new and enhanced version of ART, ART-TWIN (Two-Way INference), is introduced. Inspired by forward-backward shooting methods used in other trajectory design applications, ART-TWIN autoregressively generates two arcs, one from the initial state and one from the desired terminal state, that are patched together at the midpoint of the timeseries. When evaluated on a set of simulated rendezvous scenarios that are initialized at perilune, ART-TWIN is demonstrated to substantially accelerate convergence and increase feasibility guarantees when used as a warm-start to sequential convex programming (SCP), compared to convex relaxations and the original ART. These results illustrate the necessity of ART-TWIN's dual-arc generation to enable the viability of and gain benefits from using transformer-based warm-start methods in the most challenging areas of the cislunar dynamical regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把基于 Transformer 的热启动轨迹生成方法 ART 首次扩展到地月空间 RPOD 交会场景，并提出双向推理版本 ART-TWIN：从初始状态与终端状态各自自回归生成一段弧，在时间序列中点拼接，再作为序列凸规划 (SCP) 的热启动。在以近月点 (perilune) 为初值的一组仿真交会场景上，ART-TWIN 相比凸松弛与原版 ART 显著加快收敛并提高可行性保证，说明双弧生成是让 Transformer 热启动在地月动力学最难区域可用的关键。
Motivation: 地月空间动力学（尤其近月点）比地球轨道严重非线性且混沌，非凸轨迹优化求解慢；缺少可靠的近优初值会使 RPOD 交会的 OCP 难以快速收敛。
Method: ART-TWIN 借鉴其他轨迹设计中的前向-后向打靶法 (forward-backward shooting)，自回归生成两段弧——一段从初始状态、一段从期望终端状态——在时间序列中点拼接，作为 SCP 求解非凸最优控制问题的热启动；与凸松弛和原版 ART 对比。
Result: 在一组于近月点初始化的仿真交会场景上，ART-TWIN 作为 SCP 热启动时相比凸松弛与原版 ART 显著加快收敛并提高可行性保证；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 双弧生成是让 Transformer 热启动方法在地月动力学最具挑战区域可行并带来收益的必要设计。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MIND the Gap: A Geographic Implicit Neural Representation with Adjustable Spatial Scale
papers.abstract_en: Geographic measurements are often sparse, leaving large areas without labels for the quantities we want to map. Geographic implicit neural representations (INRs) address this by learning smooth, general-purpose embeddings that can be queried at any coordinate. Downstream models combine these embeddings with sparse labels to predict target values at unsampled locations without satellite imagery at inference. However, generalization to distant regions remains largely unexplored, despite its importance for remote sensing applications. We introduce Matryoshka Implicit Neural Distillation (MIND), which distills embeddings from specialist pretrained geospatial models into a single generalist coordinate embedding with adjustable spatial granularity. MIND uses nested supervision at several embedding dimensions, which define a series of contiguous chunks. In our experiments, early chunks capture coarser geographic variation, while later chunks add more fine-grained details. A downstream predictor can retain only leading chunks or be fitted with our Chunked Penalty to downweight later chunks while keeping the full embedding, without retraining the INR. To measure MIND and compare to existing approaches around the world, we introduce CoordBench, a large-scale INR evaluation suite of $52$ datasets and $78$ targets that aims to test both local interpolation and prediction in held-out regions at various spatial scales. MIND and its Chunked Penalty variant achieve the highest aggregate regression and classification scores among tested INRs, and the highest scores overall under regional holdout, setting a new state-of-the-art for geographic INRs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIND 把多个专家型预地理空间模型的嵌入蒸馏进一个可调空间粒度的通用坐标嵌入，嵌入维度被切成若干连续 chunk：前段承载粗尺度地理变化，后段补细节，下游只保留前段或用 Chunked Penalty 降权后段即可改变空间尺度，无需重训 INR。在含 52 个数据集、78 个目标的 CoordBench 上，MIND 及其 Chunked Penalty 变体在被测 INR 中取得最高总体回归与分类分，并在区域留出 (regional holdout) 设置下取得最高分。
Motivation: 地理测量稀疏导致大片区域无标签，现有地理 INR 的跨远距离区域泛化基本未被研究，而这正是遥感应用的关键。
Method: Matryoshka Implicit Neural Distillation (MIND)：在多个嵌入维度上做嵌套监督 (nested supervision)，把专家预训练地理空间模型蒸馏为单一通用坐标嵌入；下游预测器可只保留前导 chunk，或用 Chunked Penalty 在保留完整嵌入的同时降权后段 chunk，无需重训 INR。评测用新提出的 CoordBench。
Result: CoordBench 覆盖 52 个数据集、78 个目标，同时考察局部插值与区域留出预测；实验中前导 chunk 捕获较粗地理变化、后续 chunk 增加更细粒度细节。MIND 与 Chunked Penalty 变体在被测 INR 中取得最高总体回归与分类分，并在区域留出下取得最高总体分。
Conclusion: 把专家地理空间模型蒸馏成带可调粒度的单一坐标嵌入，可在不重训 INR 的前提下按需截断或降权细节，从而在区域留出这类远距离泛化场景下确立地理 INR 的新最优。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Combinatorial Network-Based Manifold Topological Deep Learning for Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Medical image analysis remains fundamentally challenging because of the intricate geometric and topological structures present in medical data. Conventional convolutional neural networks model images as regular Euclidean grids, limiting their ability to preserve geometric relationships and higher-order structural information. Recently, manifold topological deep learning (MTDL) has emerged as a promising paradigm that integrates deep learning with geometric and topological representations. Nevertheless, existing methods have not yet fully exploited discrete manifold structures within combinatorial complex neural networks. To bridge this gap, we introduce CNMTDL, a MTDL framework that integrates Hodge decomposition with a combinatorial attention mechanism. In our approach, medical images are represented as discrete manifolds and decomposed into three Hodge components. Features extracted from these components are concatenated and embedded into a combinatorial complex architecture, enabling enhanced higher-order message passing between $0$-cells and $2$-cells through attention-based blocks. We evaluate CNMTDL on six two-dimensional and three-dimensional datasets from the MedMNIST v2 benchmark, demonstrating its effectiveness for medical image analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CNMTDL：把医学图像表示为离散流形，用 Hodge 分解拆成三个分量，再经组合注意力在组合复形上做 0-cell 与 2-cell 之间的高阶消息传递。在 MedMNIST v2 的六个二维与三维数据集上评估，用于医学图像分析。
Motivation: 常规 CNN 把图像当作规则欧氏网格，难以保留几何关系与高阶结构信息；已有流形拓扑深度学习方法尚未充分利用组合复形神经网络中的离散流形结构。
Method: CNMTDL 将医学图像表示为离散流形并做 Hodge 分解得到三个分量，各分量特征拼接后嵌入组合复形 (combinatorial complex) 架构，通过组合注意力模块在 0-cell 与 2-cell 之间做高阶消息传递。
Result: 在 MedMNIST v2 基准的六个二维与三维数据集上评估 CNMTDL，用于医学图像分析。
Conclusion: 把 Hodge 分解与组合注意力结合进组合复形架构，可有效支撑医学图像分析。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Mean Velocity Matching: Rethinking Generative Dynamics in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: This work studies prediction parameterization for stochastic generative dynamics in diffusion models. Existing velocity-based generative models provide the simplicity of learning a single transport field, but their standard formulation is deterministic, whereas stochastic extensions generally require additional score information or an intermediate velocity-to-score reconstruction. To retain single-field prediction while directly supporting stochastic reverse dynamics, this paper introduces Mean Velocity Matching (MVM). MVM constructs a Gaussian perturbation process for which the conditional expectation of a restoration-oriented velocity, $(x_0-x_t)/t$, directly forms the reverse-SDE drift. Consequently, a single learned field is sufficient to parameterize the stochastic reverse process without separately estimating or reconstructing the score. Because direct regression of this velocity becomes unbounded near $t=0$, MVM further introduces a $\sqrt{t}$-scaled parameterization that preserves the reverse dynamics while yielding a bounded training target. The same learned field also induces a deterministic probability-flow ODE, enabling stochastic and deterministic sampling to be studied within a unified formulation. Experiments with Transformer-based generative models achieve an FID of $\MVMImageNetThirtyTwoFID$ at \MVMImageNetThirtyTwoNFE\ NFE on ImageNet $32\times32$ and $\MVMImageNetTwoFiftySixFID$ at \MVMImageNetTwoFiftySixNFE\ NFE on ImageNet $256\times256$. Controlled SDE--ODE comparisons further show that the ODE performs better under very low NFE, whereas the stochastic reverse process achieves lower FID when sufficient function evaluations are available. These results demonstrate that MVM provides a direct single-field parameterization of stochastic reverse dynamics while maintaining competitive generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Mean Velocity Matching (MVM)：构造高斯扰动过程，使恢复导向速度 (x0-xt)/t 的条件期望直接等于 reverse-SDE 漂移，从而用单个学习场同时参数化随机与确定性采样。因该速度在 t→0 无界，MVM 用 √t 缩放参数化给出有界训练目标；受控 SDE–ODE 对比显示极低 NFE 下 ODE 更好，NFE 充足时随机反向过程 FID 更低。
Motivation: 基于速度的生成模型只需学一个传输场，但标准形式是确定性的；随机扩展要么额外要 score，要么需从速度重构 score，单场预测与随机反向动力学难以兼得。
Method: MVM 构造一个高斯扰动过程，令恢复导向速度 (x0-xt)/t 的条件期望直接充当 reverse-SDE 漂移，单场即可参数化随机反向过程而无需估计或重构 score；针对 t→0 时直接回归该速度无界的问题，引入 √t 缩放参数化，在保留反向动力学的同时给出有界训练目标；同一学习场还诱导出确定性 probability-flow ODE。
Result: 在 Transformer 生成模型上，ImageNet 32×32 达到 FID \MVMImageNetThirtyTwoFID\（\MVMImageNetThirtyTwoNFE\ NFE），ImageNet 256×256 达到 FID \MVMImageNetTwoFiftySix\（\MVMImageNetTwoFiftySixNFE\ NFE）。受控 SDE–ODE 对比：极低 NFE 时 ODE 表现更好，函数求值充足时随机反向过程取得更低 FID。
Conclusion: MVM 证明单个学习场足以直接参数化随机反向动力学并保持有竞争力的生成质量，且随机与确定性采样可在同一框架内比较，取舍取决于可用 NFE。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ZeroGate: Trust-Preserving Fast Paths for Governed AI Agent Runtimes
papers.abstract_en: Moving authorization earlier can shorten an agent's dispatch boundary without removing authorization work. It can also admit an action whose payload, authority, or relevant state has changed. ZeroGate separates exact-action approval from durable local admission: an issuer signs a short-lived ActionPass, and a trusted runtime adapter reconstructs the final action before a local gate checks its binding and consumes its nonce. A SQLite transaction couples nonce consumption, applicable quota updates, and an admission receipt. We state a conditional decision-preservation proposition: successful local admission implies that a specified synchronous policy would authorize the same action at the admission point, provided approval is sound, all policy dependencies are represented and current, observations are faithful, and consumption is atomic. The implementation alone establishes neither current-world freshness nor exactly-once remote effects. Evaluation separates authored semantic fixtures, controlled concurrency and crash experiments, and an Azure Blob study comparing synchronous and prepared execution through the same issuer and gate. Both modes mint an exact-action pass; lifecycle latency includes preparation and prepared-batch dwell. Across 4800 cloud attempts, prepared worker-admission-to-dispatch p95 ranges from 9.802 to 11.374 ms, versus 25.018 to 334.000 ms synchronously, across the tested concurrency levels. Prepared mean complete lifecycle is longer at every level: the boundary improvement is not a net speedup. The contribution is an explicit revalidation contract, a durable reference boundary, and an auditable comparison of where authorization cost is paid, not a new cryptographic primitive or a universal performance frontier.
papers.comment: 47 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. Full research report with an ancillary archive containing reference code, raw experimental records, and offline verification tools
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZeroGate 把 AI agent 的授权拆成两段：签发者签发短时效 ActionPass，受信运行时适配器在本地门前重建最终动作并校验绑定、消费 nonce，SQLite 事务把 nonce 消费、配额更新与准入回执绑在一起。在 Azure Blob 上 4800 次云尝试中，prepared 模式 worker-admission-to-dispatch p95 为 9.802–11.374 ms，同步模式为 25.018–334.000 ms，但 prepared 的完整生命周期均值在每个并发档都更长，边界提速不是净加速。
Motivation: 把授权前移可以缩短 agent 的 dispatch 边界，但没有消除授权开销，还可能放行动作的 payload、authority 或相关状态已改变的动作。
Method: 签发者签发短时效 ActionPass，受信 runtime adapter 在本地门前重建最终动作，本地门检查绑定并消费 nonce；SQLite 事务耦合 nonce 消费、适用配额更新与准入回执。给出条件式决策保持命题：本地准入成功蕴含指定同步策略在准入点会授权同一动作，前提是审批可靠、策略依赖齐备且最新、观测忠实、消费原子。评测分三块：自撰语义 fixture、受控并发与崩溃实验、Azure Blob 上经同一签发者与门的同步 vs prepared 执行对比。
Result: 4800 次云尝试中，prepared 的 worker-admission-to-dispatch p95 在各测试并发档为 9.802–11.374 ms，同步模式为 25.018–334.000 ms；prepared 的完整生命周期均值在每一档都更长，即边界改善不是净加速。
Conclusion: 贡献是显式再验证契约、持久参考边界与可审计的授权成本支付位置对比，不是新密码学原语或普适性能前沿；实现本身既不保证当前世界新鲜度，也不保证远端效果 exactly-once。

papers.title: WeightBridge: An Efficient Weight Transfer Library for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Weight transfer - the propagation of updated parameters from trainers to rollout generators - is becoming an important performance bottleneck in reinforcement learning (RL) systems for LLMs. The central challenge is supporting the diverse trainer and rollout layouts and synchronization requirements of modern RL workloads without sacrificing efficiency. Existing solutions are efficient under some configurations but perform poorly or lack support under others. We present WeightBridge, a flexible, efficient weight-transfer library designed to deliver high performance across diverse RL configurations. WeightBridge first automatically extracts the correspondence between trainer and rollout weight layouts, then plans and executes redundancy-free and load-balanced weight transfer. It exposes a small, general API while coordinating workers across diverse synchronization modes. Across configurations spanning different models, parallelization layouts, and synchronization modes, WeightBridge reduces average GPU stall time by up to 42$\times$ over the state-of-the-art open-source RL framework and achieves high performance in all settings. A coding agent was able to integrate WeightBridge into two different RL frameworks without manual guidance, demonstrating the generality and ease of use of its APIs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WeightBridge 是面向 LLM 强化学习系统的权重迁移库：自动推断 trainer 与 rollout 生成器之间的权重布局对应关系，再规划并执行无冗余、负载均衡的参数分发，同时用一套小而通用的 API 协调不同同步模式下的 worker。在跨模型、并行布局与同步模式的配置上，它把平均 GPU stall 时间相对最先进开源 RL 框架最多降低 42×，且在所有设置中都保持高性能。
Motivation: RL 训练中把更新后的参数从 trainer 传到 rollout generator 已成性能瓶颈，而现代 RL 负载的 trainer/rollout 布局与同步要求高度多样，现有方案只在部分配置下高效、其余配置下表现差或不支持。
Method: WeightBridge 先自动抽取 trainer 与 rollout 权重布局之间的对应关系，再据此规划并执行无冗余 (redundancy-free)、负载均衡的权重传输；对外暴露小型通用 API，并在多种同步模式下协调各 worker。
Result: 在跨不同模型、并行化布局与同步模式的配置上，WeightBridge 使平均 GPU stall 时间相对最先进开源 RL 框架最多降低 42×，并在所有设置中都取得高性能；另有一 coding agent 在无人工指引下把 WeightBridge 集成进两个不同的 RL 框架。
Conclusion: 权重迁移可以做成跨多样 RL 配置都高效且易集成的通用库层，其 API 的通用性由自动集成到两个 RL 框架这一结果支撑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PermuFormer: Multi-Task Pretraining for Permutation Representation in Algebraic Combinatorics
papers.abstract_en: Diverse pretraining has been shown to be an effective method for learning reusable, domain-aware representations that provide a starting point for fine-tuning on downstream tasks. While much of the excitement in AI for math has been concentrated in the use of frontier reasoning models to solve well-specified problems through the medium of language, narrow, specialized models remain an important component of the AI for math ecosystem. In contrast to large language models, specialized models are usually trained directly on the mathematical objects themselves (e.g., graphs, sequences of numbers) rather than the textual descriptions that characterize these objects. However, the common practice of training specialists from scratch may limit their ability to develop domain-aware representations that capture the multifaceted nature of mathematics. In this paper, we describe an approach to pretraining for permutation-focused tasks in algebraic combinatorics. We introduce PermuFormer, an autoregressive transformer trained on a 2.8 billion token multi-task, multi-encoding corpus. We show that PermuFormer is an effective starting point for fine-tuning on basic tasks unseen during pretraining and more complex research-level tasks, frequently outperforming the same architecture trained from scratch, baseline MLPs, and a fine-tuned generic language model of comparable size. We also analyze some of the internal mechanisms by which PermuFormer learns to solve training tasks. For example, we show that while some tasks can be linearly decoded directly from the internal representation of the prompt, other tasks require multiple rounds of generation before the answer can be decoded.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PermuFormer：在 2.8 billion token 的多任务、多编码排列语料上预训练的自回归 Transformer，作为代数组合学中排列任务的微调起点。在预训练未见的基础任务与研究级任务上微调后，它通常优于从零训练的同架构、基线 MLP 与同规模微调通用语言模型；内部表征分析显示部分任务可从提示表征线性解码，另一些需多轮生成后才能解码。
Motivation: AI for math 中专用模型通常直接在数学对象上从零训练，缺少能捕捉数学多面性的领域感知表征，限制了其在下游任务上的复用与微调效果。
Method: 引入自回归 Transformer PermuFormer，在 2.8 billion token 的多任务、多编码 (multi-encoding) 排列语料上预训练；随后在预训练未见的基础任务与更复杂的研究级任务上微调，并与从零训练的同架构、基线 MLP、同规模微调通用语言模型对比；另对内部机制做表征分析（线性解码与多轮生成）。
Result: 在基础任务与研究级任务微调中，PermuFormer 频繁优于从零训练的同架构、基线 MLP 与同规模微调通用语言模型；表征分析显示部分任务可从提示内部表征线性解码，另一些任务需多轮生成后答案才可解码；语料规模为 2.8 billion token。
Conclusion: 在数学对象上做多任务、多编码预训练能为专用模型提供可复用的领域感知表征，比从零训练更好的起点；任务能否线性解码取决于其是否需要多轮生成。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Lightweight Ranking Heads: Accelerating Multi-Task Experimentation in Production Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: Modern production-scale recommender systems rely on complex, multi-task ranking models. Introducing new prediction tasks into these massive systems often causes bottlenecks - it risks negative task conflicts with existing tasks, and can lead to long development and experimentation cycles due to the expensive retraining of backbone models and downstream models or tuning of reward combination formulas. To address the critical challenge of slow experimentation velocity, we introduce the Lightweight Ranking Heads (Light Heads) framework. Designed for continuous online learning environments, Light Heads enable the dynamic injection of new tasks into existing multi-task ranking models, effectively obviating the need for model cold-starting and retraining of backbone models. By utilizing stop-gradients and stateless daily training, this design strictly isolates new tasks, mitigating the risk of adverse task conflicts. Crucially, this framework uses a centralized configuration that allows Light Heads to be added to multiple models simultaneously, unblocking faster training data generation and co-training of downstream models. Successfully deployed at YouTube scale, this approach reduces the iteration cycle for multi-task experimentation from several weeks to days. In this paper, we detail the system architecture, analyze the training dynamics of stateless cold-started heads, compare their performance to full heads, and demonstrate how Light Heads have enabled the rapid A/B experimentation and deployment of new ranking tasks that yield measurable production value.
papers.comment: ACM RecSys 2026 - Online and Adaptive Recommender Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: YouTube 规模的多任务排序系统里，Light Heads 框架用 stop-gradient 与无状态每日训练把新任务作为轻量头注入已上线的 backbone 排序模型，严格隔离新任务以规避负向任务冲突，无需冷启动或重训 backbone。多任务实验迭代周期从数周缩到数天，并解锁了新排序任务的快速 A/B 实验与上线。
Motivation: 在生产级多任务排序模型中新增预测任务会引发与既有任务的负冲突，且 backbone 与下游模型重训昂贵、奖励组合公式调参耗时，导致实验周期长达数周。
Method: Light Heads 框架：用 stop-gradient 和 stateless daily training 把新任务头挂到既有 backbone 上并严格隔离，避免冷启动与重训；配合 centralized configuration 同时向多个模型注入 Light Heads，以加速训练数据生成与下游模型 co-training。
Result: 在 YouTube 规模生产环境部署，把多任务实验的迭代周期从 several weeks 缩短到 days；论文分析 stateless cold-started heads 的训练动态，并将其性能与 full heads 对比，报告新排序任务带来可测量的生产价值。
Conclusion: 在持续在线学习环境中，用 stop-gradient 隔离的轻量头替代 backbone 重训，是加快生产推荐系统多任务实验速度并降低任务冲突风险的可行路径。

papers.title: Predictive Uncertainty for Neural CAE Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Neural surrogates can substantially accelerate computer-aided engineering (CAE) workflows, but their use in design requires uncertainty estimates that remain meaningful across varying geometries, spatial prediction fields, and engineering quantities of interest. We investigate how established uncertainty quantification (UQ) approaches behave when adapted to geometry-conditioned neural surrogates. We compare one closed-form and two sampling-based approaches-a Gaussian process (GP)-based method, concrete Monte Carlo (MC) dropout, and deep ensembles-and evaluate them on three large, industry-relevant CAE datasets for external aerodynamics and crash dynamics. We examine whether predicted uncertainties have credible magnitudes, identify locations with larger prediction errors, respond to unfamiliar inputs, and remain informative for derived engineering quantities. On the DrivAerStar dataset, where all three methods are compared, each generally assigns higher uncertainty to locations with larger prediction errors, and validation-based rescaling brings interval coverage close to nominal on a disjoint in-distribution test set. Results on AirFRANS and automotive crash also show useful error ranking and interval estimates, but the relative performance of the methods changes with the dataset and evaluation criterion. UQ methods and evaluation metrics should therefore be selected based on the intended downstream CAE decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在几何条件化的神经 CAE 代理模型上比较三种 UQ 方法：GP 闭式解、MC dropout 与 deep ensembles。在 DrivAerStar 上三者都能把更高不确定性指到误差更大的位置，验证集重标定后区间覆盖率在分布内测试集上接近名义水平；但方法相对优劣随数据集与评价准则变化，因此应按下游 CAE 决策来选 UQ 方法与指标。
Motivation: 神经代理模型进入设计流程需要跨几何、跨空间场、跨工程量都可信的不确定性估计，而现有 UQ 方法在几何条件化代理上的表现差异尚不清楚。
Method: 对比一个闭式方法（Gaussian process）与两个采样方法（concrete MC dropout、deep ensembles），在三个面向工业的 CAE 数据集上评价：DrivAerStar（外气动，三法全比）、AirFRANS（外气动）与 automotive crash（碰撞动力学）；考察不确定性量级是否可信、能否定位大误差位置、对陌生输入是否响应、以及对派生工程量是否仍有信息，并用验证集重标定区间。
Result: 在 DrivAerStar 上三种方法普遍把更高不确定性赋给误差更大的位置，验证集重标定使不相交的分布内测试集区间覆盖率接近名义水平；AirFRANS 与 automotive crash 上也给出有用的误差排序与区间估计，但三种方法的相对表现随数据集与评价准则而变。
Conclusion: UQ 方法与评价指标应按预期的下游 CAE 决策来选择，不存在跨数据集通用的最优方法。

papers.title: Directional Total Variation-Regularized Implicit Neural Representations (DTV-INR) for Continuous Super-Resolution in Degraded Imaging Domains
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce the Directional Total Variation-Regularized Implicit Neural Representation (DTV-INR), an advanced variational paradigm that synergistically integrates coordinate-driven implicit neural networks with an anisotropic, structure-tensor-informed total variation regularizer tailored for resolution-agnostic image super-resolution. Casting the continuous-to-discrete acquisition process into an ill-posed inverse problem framework, our formulation equips a SIREN-architected coordinate network with a dynamic Riemannian metric tensor field D(x). By leveraging its spectral decomposition, the proposed regularizer preferentially directs diffusion parallel to dominant structural contours while penalizing cross-edge dissipation, successfully circumventing the classical staircasing artifacts inherent to scalar total variation schemes. We rigorously prove the well-posedness of this formulation in H^1(Omega) by establishing the existence, uniqueness, and metric stability of the variational minimizer, and realize this via an alternating projected optimization algorithm that decouples network parameter tuning from adaptive tensor field updates. Comprehensive experiments conducted on clinical brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and biomedical transmission electron microscopy confirm substantial quantitative and qualitative improvements, yielding PSNR enhancements reaching +5.05 dB over baseline unregularized INRs and +1.71-2.85 dB over isotropic TV-INR across continuous (non-integer) upsampling factors, alongside remarkable noise robustness up to sigma_eta = 0.10 and monotonic preconditioned convergence behavior.

papers.title: Beyond Natural Language: An Agent-Native Language for Autonomous Science
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous AI agents take on every stage of scientific inquiry, research output is expanding far beyond human review capacity. Yet scientific communication still relies on natural-language prose: an informal medium prone to ambiguity, hidden assumptions, and untracked limitations that machines cannot reliably audit. We introduce Lara, a machine-checkable language and protocol for checking and revising support for research claims. By turning research arguments into executable artifacts, Lara provides an epistemic kernel for autonomous science: it enables automated validation pipelines for research agents, lets declared bridges connect arguments across papers into an auditable network, and allows both humans and machines to recheck the standing of an encoded claim in milliseconds. In a Lara program, authors explicitly declare their claims, supporting evidence and assumptions, and known objections or limitations. A lightweight, deterministic checker adjudicates these interactions, assigning each claim a reproducible status: "justified", "defeated", "contested", or "gap", which marks a claim whose support is incomplete and locates the unanswered question. Case studies cover empirical review, a philosophical debate without measurements, and the loss of support when an assumed axiom is withdrawn. We establish the metatheory of claim checking and cross-context argument transport, and mechanize the semantic guarantees in Lean 4 (roughly 117,000 lines), leaving three arguments on paper. The audited public metatheory is "sorry"-free and uses only Lean's three standard axioms; some executable examples additionally trust native evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Lara 是一种面向自主科学的机器可检查语言与协议，把研究论证写成可执行工件：作者显式声明 claim、证据、假设与已知反驳，由轻量确定性 checker 判定每个 claim 为 justified、defeated、contested 或 gap，并定位未回答的问题。语义保证在 Lean 4 中机械化约 117,000 行，公开元理论无 sorry、只用 Lean 三条标准公理。
Motivation: 自主 AI agent 已承担科研各环节，产出量远超人工审阅能力，而科研交流仍依赖自然语言散文：非正式、易含歧义、隐藏假设与未跟踪的局限，机器无法可靠审计。
Method: Lara 语言要求作者显式声明 claims、支撑证据、假设以及已知 objections/limitations；一个轻量确定性 checker 裁决这些交互并给出可复现状态；声明式 bridge 把跨论文论证连成可审计网络。元理论与跨语境论证搬运 (cross-context argument transport) 在 Lean 4 中机械化，约 117,000 行。
Result: 案例覆盖经验性综述、一场无测量的哲学辩论，以及撤掉一个被假设的公理后支撑丧失三种情形；Lean 4 机械化约 117,000 行，留三条论证在纸面上；审计过的公开元理论无 sorry、仅用 Lean 三条标准公理，部分可执行示例额外信任 native evaluation；人类与机器可在毫秒级重查一个编码 claim 的状态。
Conclusion: 把科研论证编码成机器可检查的工件，可让自主科学的 claim 具备可复现状态与可审计的跨论文支撑网络，前提是元理论本身在证明助手中机械化并保持公理最小。

papers.title: Learnable Classifier-Free Guidance Null Embeddings for Enhanced Controllable Speech Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Classifier-free Guidance (CFG) is widely adopted in text-to-speech (TTS) systems to enhance generation quality and conditioning fidelity by interpolating between conditioned and unconditioned predictions. A common unconditional technique is to use an empty representation, in the form of a fixed null vector. In this work, we propose replacing this representation with a learnable unconditional embedding, optimized to represent a meaningful unconditional state. Objective and subjective evaluations demonstrate that learnable null embeddings consistently outperform fixed null embeddings across speaker similarity, speech stability, and expressiveness, while exhibiting greater robustness to larger guidance scales. We further show that learning a distinct unconditional embedding for each of the TTS conditioning modalities allows fine-grained control over speaker and text guidance, showcasing the trade-off between similarity and quality, and stability and expressiveness in the generated speech.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 TTS 的 classifier-free guidance 中把固定的空向量换成可学习的 unconditional embedding，并为每种条件模态（说话人、文本）各学一个独立的无条件嵌入。客观与主观评测显示其在说话人相似度、语音稳定性与表现力上一致优于固定空向量，且在更大 guidance scale 下更稳健，从而可分别微调说话人与文本的引导强度。
Motivation: CFG 通常用固定空向量充当无条件预测，这个表示没有被优化，导致条件保真度受限，且在较大 guidance scale 下容易失稳。
Method: 提出可学习的 null embedding 替代固定空向量，训练出一个有意义的无条件状态；并为 TTS 的每种条件模态学习各自的无条件嵌入，从而把说话人引导与文本引导解耦，可独立调节。
Result: 客观与主观评测中，可学习 null embedding 在说话人相似度、语音稳定性、表现力三项上一致超过固定 null embedding，并在更大 guidance scale 下表现出更强的稳健性；按模态分离的嵌入展示了相似度与质量、稳定性与表现力之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 无条件表示应当被学习而非固定，且每种条件模态配一个独立的无条件嵌入即可实现对说话人与文本引导的细粒度控制。

papers.title: From Offline Proxies to Online Decisions: A Layered Engagement Evaluation Framework for Conversational AI
papers.abstract_en: Online A/B experiments are the decision standard for user engagement, but traffic and readout time limit how many conversational-AI changes can be tested. We ask whether an offline signal designed to be computable without treatment-arm user exposure agrees with the outcomes of those experiments. We contribute a reusable construction and diagnosis checklist that treats an offline proxy as a chain of three alignments: behavioral label to product outcome, learned classifier to candidate-assistant behavior, and aggregated offline signal to experiment effect. A companion evaluation protocol audits the whole composite by interval-aware decision agreement, which compares offline and online confidence intervals instead of point estimates, and by within-experiment ranking. The instantiation we evaluate comprises a fixed evaluation suite on which candidate behavior is scored, an engagement classifier trained to predict session/prompt level engagements, and a calibration layer mapping sample-level score differences to online model-level engagement deltas. We then report the audit: 489 paired offline-online contrasts (one candidate arm against its control) from 27 experiments on a deployed multi-turn assistant, spanning model checkpoints to system-prompt tuning. Our primary test uses the 113 contrasts from eight experiments that ran after the map was frozen: on these the composite reaches 81.1% F1, against 34.3% for the raw classifier score it is built on, and makes no wrong-direction calls where that raw score makes 31. Every offline prediction was computed before its experiment ran to prevent overfitting. The evidence supports using the composite to prioritize candidates before scarce experiment traffic is allocated---in our deployment of the experiment, selecting among training checkpoints and tuning system prompts.
papers.comment: 11 pages main text, 9 pages supplementary material; 2 figures, 25 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把离线代理拆成三层对齐（行为标签→产品结果、学习分类器→候选助手行为、聚合离线信号→实验效应），并用区间感知决策一致性和实验内排序审计整条链。在 27 个已部署多轮助手实验的 489 组配对离线-在线对比上，用地图冻结后才跑的 8 个实验共 113 组做主检验，复合信号 F1 达 81.1%，而其底层原始分类器分数只有 34.3%，且原始分数出现 31 次方向错误时复合信号为零次误判。
Motivation: 在线 A/B 实验是用户参与度决策的标准，但流量和读出时间限制了能测试的对话式 AI 改动数量，需要一个无需暴露处理组用户即可计算的离线信号来预筛候选。
Method: 评估的实例化包含三部分：固定评测套件对候选行为打分、预测 session/prompt 级 engagement 的 engagement 分类器、以及把样本级分数差映射到线上模型级 engagement 增量的校准层；审计协议用 interval-aware decision agreement（比较离线与在线置信区间而非点估计）和 within-experiment ranking，所有离线预测在对应实验运行前算完以防过拟合。
Result: 共 489 组配对离线-在线对比，来自 27 个已部署多轮助手实验，覆盖模型 checkpoint 到 system-prompt 调优；主检验用地图冻结后运行的 8 个实验的 113 组对比，复合信号 F1 81.1%，底层原始分类器分数 34.3%，原始分数出现 31 次方向错误而复合信号零次误判。
Conclusion: 证据支持在稀缺实验流量分配前用该复合离线信号给候选排序，具体用于训练 checkpoint 选择与 system prompt 调优。

papers.title: Efficient Iterative Retrieval with Heterogeneous Batching
papers.abstract_en: Modern information retrieval increasingly employs both embedding and generative models to handle complex queries. However, current serving systems suffer from low throughput and poor GPU utilization because they execute these models in isolation. Coarse-grained partitioning, such as dedicating GPUs to specific tasks, fails to adapt to dynamic workloads and creates computational "bubbles". To address these, we present Orthrus, a serving system that performs heterogeneous batching within a unified inference loop. The primary challenge lies in unifying embedding and generation workloads with conflicting computational patterns while optimizing batch composition for high performance. Orthrus addresses these challenges through chunked embedding with incremental pooling and by adjusting batch composition in a workload-aware manner. Evaluation on four A100 GPUs shows that, relative to baseline deployments, Orthrus achieves 1.28$\times$--4.52$\times$ higher throughput on controlled workloads and up to 55.8% lower end-to-end p99 latency on an iterative-RAG benchmark. We release our code at https://github.com/illinoisdata/Orthrus .
papers.comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (main conference)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Orthrus 把 embedding 模型与生成模型放进同一个推理循环做异构批处理 (heterogeneous batching)，用分块 embedding 加增量池化统一两类冲突的计算模式，并按工作负载调整批组成。在 4 张 A100 上，相对基线部署受控负载吞吐提升 1.28×–4.52×，迭代 RAG 基准端到端 p99 延迟最多降低 55.8%。
Motivation: 检索服务系统把 embedding 与生成模型分开执行，粗粒度按任务独占 GPU 无法适应动态负载，产生算力空洞，导致吞吐低、GPU 利用率差。
Method: 在统一推理循环内做异构批处理：以 chunked embedding 配合 incremental pooling 把 embedding 与生成两类计算模式不同的负载合并进同一批，并按工作负载感知地调整批组成 (batch composition)。
Result: 在 4 张 A100 GPU 上，相对基线部署：受控负载吞吐提升 1.28×–4.52×；在迭代 RAG (iterative-RAG) 基准上端到端 p99 延迟最多降低 55.8%。
Conclusion: 把 embedding 与生成负载在单一循环内混合调度，可以同时抬高检索服务吞吐并压低尾延迟；代码已开源在 github.com/illinoisdata/Orthrus。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Robust Failure, Conservative Repair: Textual Knowledge Distillation from Cross-Model Failures
papers.abstract_en: Failure-based textual knowledge distillation aims to discover gaps in a model's knowledge by examining its task errors. The distilled knowledge can be useful for the reasoning of both this model ("source model") and other models. However, this transfer of knowledge may not be stable. We define a rule atom to be a standalone rule injected into a model's textual input at inference time. A rule atom can encode transferable task knowledge or model-specific reasoning patches that can confuse other models. Also, the injected rule atoms can be misapplied to unrelated cases, causing the model to incorrectly flip its answer based on irrelevant information. Building on a pipeline that distills training examples into task-specific cheat sheets that aid model reasoning, we examine when failure-derived rules can improve these cheat sheets. Our early experiment shows rule distillation from a single model's failures underperforms the baseline cheat sheet on non-source model families. This motivates Robust Failure, Conservative Repair (RFCR), a textual distillation procedure that derives rules from failures shared across models, sharpens their application boundaries using boundary cases, and abstains when no useful rule is found. On a 400-item BIG-Bench Hard task set, RFCR improves the baseline cheat sheets from 68.50% to 71.25% (+2.75 pp; 95% CI [+1.25,+4.50]) without performance degradation on previously correct cases. Ablations and cross-model diagnostics support that accuracy gains come from both new knowledge injection and strict rule-application control.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RFCR 只从多个模型共享的失败中蒸馏规则，并用边界样本收紧规则适用范围、无可用规则时弃权，从而让失败蒸馏的 cheat sheet 跨模型家族稳定增益。在 400 题 BIG-Bench Hard 上准确率从 68.50% 提到 71.25%（+2.75 pp，95% CI [+1.25,+4.50]），且原本答对的题不退化。
Motivation: 失败蒸馏出的 rule atom 可能是模型专属补丁，注入后会混淆其他模型，还会被误用到无关样本上导致答案错误翻转，跨模型迁移不稳定。
Method: RFCR 从跨模型共享的失败中推导规则，用 boundary cases 收紧规则的应用边界，找不到有用规则时弃权；建立在把训练样例蒸馏成任务级 cheat sheet 的既有 pipeline 之上，并做消融与跨模型诊断。
Result: 早期实验：只从单模型失败蒸馏规则在非源模型家族上不如 baseline cheat sheet。RFCR 在 400 题 BIG-Bench Hard 上把 baseline cheat sheet 从 68.50% 提到 71.25%（+2.75 pp，95% CI [+1.25,+4.50]），此前答对的样本无性能下降；消融与跨模型诊断显示增益同时来自新知识注入与严格的应用控制。
Conclusion: 失败蒸馏要跨模型可用，必须只取多模型共享的失败并控制规则应用边界；单模型失败蒸馏在其他模型家族上反而拖后腿。

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning on Item-Compatibility Graphs for One-Dimensional Bin Packing
papers.abstract_en: The one-dimensional bin packing problem (1D-BPP) is a classical NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem with applications ranging from logistics and manufacturing to cloud resource management. Although deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has become a competitive paradigm for data-driven optimization, most learned packing methods target 2D and 3D variants, and intelligent learned solvers for 1D-BPP remain scarce. In this paper, we present a novel end-to-end, size-agnostic graph reinforcement learning framework for 1D-BPP. We formulate the packing process as a Markov decision process on an item-compatibility graph, serving as a structural knowledge representation in which every action merges two partial bins that fit together. A graph neural network actor-critic policy extracts relational features from this representation and is trained through reinforcement learning and decoded by stochastic beam search, enabling a single trained model to generalize zero-shot to instances of any size. We conduct a systematic empirical study across graph encoders, DRL algorithms, reward functions, training distributions, and hyperparameters. Evaluated zero-shot on the full BPPLIB benchmark against a constructive heuristic, a grouping genetic algorithm, and recent learned methods, our data-driven policy lowers the mean optimality gap of the constructive heuristic from 2.66\% to 2.31\%, with the largest gains on structured instances. Against learned baselines evaluated on the same benchmark, it attains a lower gap on most of the nine families and is far more stable across instance distributions. On the hardest benchmark family, it outperforms a state-of-the-art learned solver that relies on column generation and integer programming, while using no solver at all. A grouping genetic algorithm remains ahead overall, and we analyze where and why the residual gap arises.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向一维装箱 (1D-BPP) 的端到端、尺寸无关图强化学习框架：把装箱过程建模为物品兼容图上的 MDP，每个动作合并两个能装在一起的部分箱，GNN actor-critic 策略经强化学习训练并用随机 beam search 解码，单一模型可零样本泛化到任意规模实例。在 BPPLIB 全基准零样本评测中，把构造式启发式的平均最优性间隙从 2.66% 降到 2.31%，九个实例族中多数优于学习型基线，最难族上超过依赖列生成与整数规划的 SOTA 学习求解器；分组遗传算法总体仍领先。
Motivation: DRL 已成为数据驱动优化的竞争范式，但已学习的装箱方法多针对 2D/3D，1D-BPP 的智能学习型求解器稀缺，且多数方法难以跨实例尺寸泛化。
Method: 将装箱过程表述为物品兼容图上的马尔可夫决策过程，图中每条边对应两个可合并的部分箱；GNN actor-critic 从该结构表示中抽取关系特征，经强化学习训练并用随机 beam search 解码，实现尺寸无关的零样本推理；并系统考察图编码器、DRL 算法、奖励函数、训练分布与超参数。
Result: 在 BPPLIB 全基准零样本评测下，相对构造式启发式平均最优性间隙由 2.66% 降至 2.31%，结构化实例上增益最大；对同基准的学习型基线，在九个实例族中的多数取得更低间隙且跨分布更稳定；在最难实例族上超过依赖列生成与整数规划的学习型 SOTA 求解器（自身不用求解器）；分组遗传算法总体仍领先。
Conclusion: 仅靠图上关系特征加 RL 的无求解器策略即可在 1D-BPP 上达到有竞争力且更稳的零样本性能，但整体仍不及分组遗传算法，残余差距的来源被单独分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Passes Alone, Fails Together: Benchmarking Semantic Coordination in Parallel LLM-Agent Development
papers.abstract_en: Parallel coding agents can produce patches that work alone but fail when merged. This happens when one agent changes an interface or rule that another agent still relies on. We study these failures with stale, a benchmark for semantic coordination. Our evaluation runs the same tests on each patch alone and on their combination, counting only failures introduced by combining the patches. We use three tiers: synthetic tasks with controlled interface changes, pairs of merged pull requests, and constructed tasks that use real Django helpers. Among 834 runs on 417 mined Django pairs, only one showed interference after correcting the grading procedure. On constructed tasks using 12 Django helpers, interference occurred in 97% of runs. A message describing the completed concurrent change recovered 82% of runs. Reviewed pull requests may contain few unresolved parallel changes, even when agents fail on controlled tasks using real code. The constructed failure rates do not estimate how often these problems occur in practice.
papers.comment: 6 pages, accepted to The 2nd Workshop on Explainable and Reliable Software Systems (EXPRESS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出语义协调基准 stale，用同一测试分别跑单个补丁与补丁组合、只计组合新引入的失败，衡量并行 LLM agent 各自通过、合并即失败的现象。在 417 对挖掘的 Django PR 共 834 次运行中，修正评分流程后仅 1 次出现干扰；而在用 12 个真实 Django helper 构造的任务上 97% 的运行出现干扰，补一条描述并发变更的消息可恢复 82%。
Motivation: 并行编码 agent 各自改接口或规则时会破坏彼此依赖，单补丁测试抓不到这类合并后才暴露的失败，缺少衡量该现象的基准。
Method: 构建三层基准 stale：受控接口变更的合成任务、成对合并的 PR、基于真实 Django helper 的构造任务；评测对每个补丁单独与组合分别跑同一测试，只统计组合引入的失败，并在评分流程修正后统计干扰率。
Result: 417 对挖掘的 Django PR 共 834 次运行中，修正评分后仅 1 次出现干扰；12 个 Django helper 的构造任务上 97% 的运行出现干扰；补一条描述已完成并发变更的消息恢复了 82% 的运行。
Conclusion: 已评审 PR 中可能很少残留未解决的并行变更，即便 agent 在使用真实代码的受控任务上频繁失败；构造任务上的失败率不能用来估计实践中此类问题的发生频率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PICPIs: Prediction-Interval-Conditional Prediction Intervals
papers.abstract_en: A classical question in statistics is which observable quantities to condition on when drawing inferences about unobservable targets. For conformal prediction in nonparametric uncertainty quantification, standard marginal validity offers limited resolution at the prediction values on which decisions are based, and fully conditional guarantees with respect to the covariates are provably unattainable. We address this gap by introducing a prediction-based conditioning framework that we refer to as Prediction-Interval-Conditional Prediction Intervals (PICPIs). Formally, a PICPI is an interval $I$ satisfying a self-consistency condition: $$\mathbb{E} [Y \mid p(X) \in I] \in I,$$ for predictive model $p$, contextual covariate $X$, and outcome $Y$. Thus, an interval simultaneously defines a stratum of prediction values and certifies that the mean outcome in that stratum lies in the same interval. This self-consistency condition yields data-adaptive strata without altering the original prediction. Such intervals can be constructed using practical algorithms. Under regularity of the prediction distribution, the constructed intervals cover all but an arbitrarily small fraction of prediction values and have widths that decrease at rate $n^{-1/3}$, up to logarithmic factors and the prediction error. Moreover, identifying these locally calibrated intervals can, in turn, inform downstream decision-making. We derive inference procedures for PICPIs in probabilistic prediction and multi-class classification, accompanied by theoretical guarantees. Empirical results are provided that compare PICPIs with existing interval-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PICPIs：区间 I 自身满足 E[Y | p(X) ∈ I] ⊂ I，即区间既定义预测值分层又认证该层均值落在其中。构造出的区间覆盖除任意小比例外的所有预测值，宽度以 n^{-1/3} 速率收缩（含对数因子与预测误差），并给出概率预测与多分类两套推断流程。
Motivation: conformal prediction 的边际有效性对决策所依赖的具体预测值分辨率不足，而对协变量的完全条件保证已被证明不可达，需要一种介于两者之间、可构造的条件化目标。
Method: 以预测模型 p、协变量 X、结果 Y 定义自洽条件 E[Y | p(X) ∈ I] ∈ I，用实用算法构造数据自适应分层区间而不改动原预测；在预测分布正则性下推导覆盖与宽度理论，并为概率预测和多分类分别给出推断程序。
Result: 构造区间覆盖除任意小比例外的所有预测值，宽度以 n^{-1/3} 速率收缩（至多差对数因子与预测误差）；概率预测与多分类均附理论保证，实证与已有基于区间的基线比较。
Conclusion: 在完全条件保证不可达的前提下，按预测值而非协变量条件化可得到可构造、局部校准的区间，并可反过来支撑下游决策。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Sex Estimation from Footwear Outsole Impressions Using CNN Transfer Learning and Interpretable Image Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Footwear outsole impressions are a common form of forensic pattern evidence, yet quantitative methods for estimating wearer attributes from these images remain relatively underdeveloped. We investigate binary sex estimation from footwear outsole impressions by comparing convolutional neural network (CNN) transfer learning with traditional feature-based classification. Using a publicly available outsole-impression dataset, we adopt a shoe-level training and test partition that keeps replicate scans of the same physical shoe together to reduce data leakage. We evaluate pretrained CNNs through end-to-end fine-tuning, frozen feature extraction followed by support vector machine classification, and hybrid feature fusion incorporating handcrafted, geometric, and metadata-derived descriptors. Fine-tuned CNNs achieve the strongest overall predictive performance and substantially outperform traditional classifiers trained on the manually specified descriptors alone, while frozen-feature approaches offer a less computationally demanding alternative. Exploratory analysis of low-dimensional CNN representations reveals associations with frequency threshold ratio, image contrast, and wavelet-based summaries, providing a connection between learned representations and measurable properties of outsole impressions. These findings suggest that CNN transfer learning captures discriminative information beyond the descriptors considered and offers a promising approach to footwear-based forensic screening. Further validation on independently collected and casework-like impressions is needed before operational use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 CNN 迁移学习从鞋底外底压痕做二分类性别估计，端到端微调在公开外底压痕数据集上取得最强性能，明显优于仅用人工描述子的传统分类器；低维 CNN 表征与频率阈值比、图像对比度和小波统计量相关。作者指出投入实战前还需在独立采集、贴近案件的压痕上进一步验证。
Motivation: 鞋底压痕是常见的法庭物证模式，但从这类图像定量估计穿着者属性的方法仍相对欠缺，缺少防数据泄漏的评测设计。
Method: 在同一实体鞋的重复扫描保持在同一侧的鞋级划分上，对比三条路线：预训练 CNN 端到端微调、冻结特征提取后接 SVM、以及手工/几何/元数据描述子的混合特征融合，并与仅用人工描述子的传统分类器对照。
Result: 端到端微调的 CNN 整体预测性能最强，大幅优于仅用人工指定描述子训练的传统分类器；冻结特征方案计算开销更低；低维 CNN 表征的探索性分析显示其与 frequency threshold ratio、image contrast 及小波统计量存在关联。
Conclusion: CNN 迁移学习捕捉到超出所用描述子的判别信息，可用于基于鞋底的法庭筛查，但需在独立采集、贴近案件的压痕上验证后才能投入业务使用。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 在同一实体鞋的重复扫描保持在同一侧的鞋级划分上，对比三条路线：预训练 CNN 端到端微调、冻结特征提取后接 SVM、以及手工/几何/元数据描述子的混合特征融合，并与仅用人工描述子的传统分类器对照。
summary_sections.result: 端到端微调的 CNN 整体预测性能最强，大幅优于仅用人工指定描述子训练的传统分类器；冻结特征方案计算开销更低；低维 CNN 表征的探索性分析显示其与 frequency threshold ratio、image contrast 及小波统计量存在关联。
summary_sections.conclusion: CNN 迁移学习捕捉到超出所用描述子的判别信息，可用于基于鞋底的法庭筛查，但需在独立采集、贴近案件的压痕上验证后才能投入业务使用。

papers.title: Penalized Nonreversible Langevin for Constrained Sampling
papers.abstract_en: We propose penalized nonreversible Langevin algorithms for sampling from $π(x)\propto e^{-f(x)}\mathbf 1_{\mathcal C}(x)$, where $\mathcal C\subset\mathbb R^d$ is a compact convex set. The algorithms combine a squared distance penalty with constant or compatible state dependent skew symmetric perturbations that preserve the penalized Gibbs distribution. For smooth, possibly nonconvex $f$, we derive nonasymptotic total variation bounds for the full gradient algorithm under a log Sobolev inequality. When unbiased stochastic gradients are available, we establish $2$-Wasserstein bounds under global contraction and Lipschitz conditions on the full drift in an adapted quadratic metric. For a fixed penalty parameter, the error relative to the penalized Gibbs distribution decays exponentially to an $\mathcal{O}(\sqrtη)$ neighborhood, where $η$ is the stepsize. We also bound the discrepancy between the penalized Gibbs distribution and the constrained target. In a two dimensional quadratic model, we establish nonreversible acceleration by tuning the skew perturbation to the curvature imbalance induced by penalization. With the target accuracy and smaller curvature fixed and initial Wasserstein distances uniformly bounded, tuning the skew perturbation improves the sufficient Euler iteration bound from linear to logarithmic in the curvature ratio. Numerical experiments evaluate the algorithms on constrained Bayesian regression, classification, neural networks, and truncated sampling, and examine the acceleration mechanism in a stochastic quadratic model.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出带惩罚的非可逆 Langevin 采样算法，用于紧凸约束集上的目标分布 π(x)∝e^{-f(x)}1_C(x)：平方距离惩罚加常数或状态依赖的斜对称扰动，保持惩罚后 Gibbs 分布不变。固定惩罚参数下误差相对惩罚 Gibbs 分布指数衰减到 O(√η) 邻域；在二维二次模型中把斜对称扰动调到惩罚引起的曲率失衡上，可把充分 Euler 迭代界从关于曲率比的线性降到对数。
Motivation: 紧凸约束下的采样中，惩罚会引入曲率失衡，标准可逆 Langevin 在此失衡下迭代界随曲率比线性增长，需要一种能利用非可逆扰动加速的算法并给出非渐近收敛保证。
Method: 算法在目标上加平方距离惩罚，并叠加常数或状态依赖的斜对称 (skew symmetric) 扰动以保持惩罚后 Gibbs 分布；全梯度情形在 log Sobolev 不等式下推导全变差非渐近界，随机梯度情形在全漂移全局收缩与 Lipschitz 条件（adapted quadratic metric 下）建立 2-Wasserstein 界，另给出惩罚 Gibbs 分布与约束目标之间的差异界。
Result: 固定惩罚参数时，相对惩罚 Gibbs 分布的误差指数衰减到步长 η 的 O(√η) 邻域；二维二次模型中，在目标精度、较小曲率与初始 Wasserstein 距离一致有界的前提下，调节斜对称扰动把充分 Euler 迭代界从关于曲率比的线性改善为对数。数值实验覆盖约束 Bayesian 回归、分类、神经网络与截断采样，并检验随机二次模型中的加速机制。
Conclusion: 把斜对称扰动对准惩罚诱导的曲率失衡，可在紧凸约束采样中把非可逆 Langevin 的迭代复杂度从线性降到对数曲率比，同时对光滑非凸 f 保留非渐近收敛保证。

papers.title: VLAQuantBench: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Post-Training Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization reduces the memory requirements of vision-language-action (VLA) models, but precision selection must account for the interaction between layer scope, numerical format, and calibration. We introduce \textbf{VLAQuantBench}, a controlled evaluation with 409 runs and 94,574 simulation episodes: four models on LIBERO, with X-VLA additionally evaluated on three simulation benchmark families. Under uncalibrated W4A4 round-to-nearest quantization, expanding a $π_{0.5}$ action-head subset from 126 to 167 layers raises success from 7.0\% to 70.5\%. Fixed-observation replay confirms a corresponding numerical recovery. Two-episode calibration removes the severe joint failures in the tested subsets, whereas the same smoothing-and-clipping recipe lowers $π_0$ success and does not recover OpenVLA-OFT end-to-end. For OpenVLA-OFT, protecting one 28,672-parameter output projection instead restores near-baseline success: the remaining 441 eligible linear layers retain W3 on LIBERO-Long or eight-bit activations across all four suites. Task-clustered intervals support the large failure and recovery contrasts. These results establish recipe-dependent interactions and identify concrete precision assignments, rather than universal layer-sensitivity rules. Real-kernel and physical-robot measurements complement the accuracy analysis. Code, configurations, and episode records are publicly available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/VLAQuantBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLAQuantBench 用 409 次运行、94,574 个仿真 episode 系统评估 VLA 模型后训练量化 (post-training quantization)，证明精度选择取决于层数范围、数值格式与校准的交互而非普适层敏感性规则：π0.5 动作头子集从 126 层扩到 167 层使 LIBERO 成功率从 7.0% 升到 70.5%；对 OpenVLA-OFT 只保护一个 28,672 参数的输出投影即可恢复接近基线的成功率，其余 441 个线性层可保留 W3 或八位激活。
Motivation: VLA 模型量化需同时压缩内存又保住闭环成功率，但层数范围、数值格式与校准如何相互作用缺少受控证据，选错配方会直接把成功率打崩。
Method: 在 LIBERO 上对四个模型做受控量化评测（409 runs、94,574 仿真 episodes），X-VLA 另加三个仿真基准族；对比未校准 W4A4 round-to-nearest、两 episode 校准的 smoothing-and-clipping 配方，并用固定观测回放 (fixed-observation replay) 验证数值恢复，辅以真实 kernel 与实体机器人测量，统计用按任务聚类的置信区间。
Result: π0.5 动作头子集 126→167 层使成功率 7.0%→70.5%，固定观测回放确认对应数值恢复；两 episode 校准消除受测子集的严重联合失败，但同一配方降低 π0 成功率且无法端到端恢复 OpenVLA-OFT；OpenVLA-OFT 保护单个 28,672 参数输出投影后恢复接近基线，其余 441 个合格线性层在 LIBERO-Long 上保留 W3、在全部四个 suite 上保留八位激活。
Conclusion: 量化配方与层范围存在强交互，应按具体模型指派精度（如只保护关键输出投影），不能套用统一的层敏感性规则。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PARTE: Plane-Assisted Robust Transformation Estimation for Point Cloud Registration
papers.abstract_en: Global point-cloud registration remains challenging when limited overlap, repetitive geometry, and sensor noise produce correspondence sets dominated by outliers. Planar regions are particularly difficult for conventional point descriptors and are therefore often suppressed or discarded before matching. We present PARTE (Plane-Assisted Robust Transformation Estimation), a global registration method that instead treats planar structure as complementary registration evidence. PARTE extracts planar patches and represents them using our novel Plane Context Histogram (PCH), a descriptor that encodes the geometry surrounding each patch, while a two-level matching procedure identifies reliable plane correspondences. Candidate point and plane correspondences are combined in a confidence-weighted compatibility graph for joint outlier rejection, followed by rigid transformation estimation. When no usable plane correspondences are available, PARTE naturally reduces to point-only registration. We evaluate PARTE on 8,097 registration pairs across six indoor and outdoor benchmarks spanning dense RGB-D and sparse LiDAR measurements. Evaluations show PARTE achieves the highest overall success rate against 13 standard and state-of-the-art methods while maintaining low runtime. An open-source C++ implementation with Python bindings is provided at https://parte.pages.dev.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PARTE 把平面结构当作配准证据而非噪声：提取平面片并用 Plane Context Histogram (PCH) 编码其周边几何，两级匹配得到平面对应，再与点对应合并进置信度加权兼容性图做联合外点剔除与刚体变换估计；无可用平面对应时自动退化为纯点配准。在 6 个室内外基准共 8,097 对配准上对 13 个标准与 SOTA 方法取得最高总体成功率且运行时间低。
Motivation: 有限重叠、重复几何与传感器噪声使全局点云配准的对应集被外点主导，而平面区域对常规点描述子尤其困难，常被直接抑制或丢弃。
Method: 提取平面片并用新描述子 Plane Context Histogram (PCH) 编码片周围几何；两级匹配过程筛选可靠平面对应；点与平面候选对应合并为置信度加权兼容性图做联合外点剔除，再估计刚体变换；无平面对应时退化为纯点配准。提供开源 C++ 实现与 Python bindings。
Result: 在 6 个室内外基准（覆盖稠密 RGB-D 与稀疏 LiDAR）共 8,097 对配准任务上，对 13 个标准与 SOTA 方法取得最高总体成功率，同时保持低运行时。
Conclusion: 平面结构可作为点云全局配准的互补证据，在缺少平面对应时方法自然回退到纯点流程，兼顾成功率与运行时。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Extending FunctionGemma for Practical On-Device Mobile Function Calling
papers.abstract_en: On-device assistants require function-calling models that map natural language to local system actions, but existing resources emphasize web APIs or narrow mobile-action catalogs. We extend FunctionGemma 270M-it to practical Android workflows by introducing MOBILEACTIONSEXTENDED, a synthetic, schema-validated dataset of ~9,500 conversations covering fifteen device-control categories, including messaging, phone calls, camera/screenshot, brightness control, device-status queries, flashlight control, and application management. We fine-tune the 270M model with TRL supervised fine-tuning under completion-only loss, producing an extended specialist and a combined model trained jointly with Google's MOBILEACTIONSGOOGLE. On MOBILEACTIONSEXTENDED, end-to-end accuracy improves from 29.3% for the base model and 17.2% for Google's Mobile-Actions variant to 76.5%. The combined model retains 76.5% on MOBILEACTIONSEXTENDED and reaches 82.3% on MOBILEACTIONSGOOGLE, down from the 90.3% of Google's Mobile-Actions specialist, representing an 8.0-percentage-point trade-off in return for doubling category coverage. We release the dataset, fine-tuned models, reproducible training/evaluation pipeline, and an Android demo, highlighting compact local function calling as a practical path towards low-latency and privacy-preserving mobile assistants.
papers.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 16 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Includes main paper, references, and appendices. Code, datasets, models, and demo available at GitHub and Hugging Face
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 FunctionGemma 270M-it 扩展到实用 Android 设备控制：构造约 9,500 条、覆盖 15 个设备控制类别的 schema 校验合成数据集 MOBILEACTIONSEXTENDED，用 TRL 监督微调（completion-only loss）得到扩展专家模型与联合 MOBILEACTIONSGOOGLE 的合并模型。端到端准确率从基座 29.3%、Google Mobile-Actions 变体 17.2% 提到 76.5%；合并模型在 MOBILEACTIONSGOOGLE 上 82.3%，较其 90.3% 专家下降 8.0 个百分点，换取类别覆盖翻倍。

papers.title: From Decorative to Load-Bearing: Task Difficulty Shapes the Causal Role of Chain-of-Thought
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is only meaningful if written reasoning causally constrains the answer. We introduce continuation-based causal testing, an ablation-patch intervention that perturbs one reasoning step, truncates the chain, and forces the model to continue from the corrupted prefix. It measures how load-bearing a CoT is for the final answer, a behavioral notion distinct from mechanistic faithfulness. Across Gemma-2-9B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on GSM8K, MMLU, and BIG-Bench Hard, CoT load-bearingness tracks model-relative task difficulty: on easy tasks models silently bypass their own reasoning; on hard tasks they follow corrupted steps and propagate errors. A matched 2x2 analysis shows task difficulty dominates perturbation type: error propagation rises 16x from GSM8K to BBH multistep arithmetic, and a variance partition over 28,584 continuations attributes 98.8% of explained deviance to task difficulty versus 0.8% to perturbation type. Reasoning-specific RL suppresses error propagation and compresses the gradient. A four-variant judge-sensitivity analysis and blind two-annotator study (n=500) show the error-propagation vs. non-propagation label is invariant to judge prompt, with perfect inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's kappa = 1.00). This gradient creates a structural problem for CoT-based oversight and AI safety monitoring: where the trace is easy to read it carries little signal, and where it matters errors propagate before a monitor can intervene. Linear probes on hidden states separate silent bypass, self-correction, and error propagation, but additive activation steering provides limited causal control, flipping only about 25% of error-propagation cases at best. Behavioral mode is readable but not reliably controllable.

papers.title: SSP-Bench: A Hybrid Data Generation Framework for Safety, Security, and Privacy Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for safety, security, and privacy (SSP) relies heavily on static benchmarks, which suffer from score saturation, data contamination, and aggregation artifacts, and fail to capture sensitivity to linguistic variation. As a result, models that perform well on fixed test sets often fail under semantically equivalent rephrasings. We introduce SSP-Bench, a dynamic benchmarking framework that generates evaluation instances on demand while preserving domain consistency. The framework ensures label validity through externally grounded sources, enforces scope via service-specific validation, and calibrates difficulty using a multi-model steering panel. Benchmark construction is formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem over difficulty, separability, novelty, and diversity. Across 24 models and four SSP services, SSP-Bench reveals systematic failures of static evaluation, including near-zero correlation in safety rankings due to construct mixing, strong safety--over-refusal coupling, and hidden within-family regressions. These results show that static benchmarks can misrepresent model behavior, motivating dynamic, deployment-relevant evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSP-Bench 是一个按需生成评测实例的动态基准框架，用外部可信来源保证标签有效、服务特定校验限定范围、多模型 steering panel 校准难度，并把基准构建写成关于难度、可分性、新颖性、多样性的多目标优化。在 24 个模型和四类 SSP 服务上，它揭示静态评测的系统性失效：安全排名因 construct mixing 近零相关，安全与过度拒绝强耦合，且家族内部存在被掩盖的回退。
Motivation: 静态基准存在分数饱和、数据污染与聚合假象，且无法刻画对语言改写的敏感性：在固定测试集上表现好的模型，遇到语义等价的改写就失效。
Method: 按需生成评测实例并保持领域一致；用外部可信来源 (externally grounded sources) 保证标签有效性，用服务特定校验 (service-specific validation) 限定范围，用多模型 steering panel 校准难度；基准构建被形式化为难度、可分性 (separability)、新颖性、多样性上的多目标优化问题。
Result: 在 24 个模型、四类 SSP 服务上，静态评测被揭示出系统性失效：安全排名因 construct mixing 呈近零相关，安全与过度拒绝 (over-refusal) 强耦合，家族内部存在隐藏回退 (within-family regressions)。
Conclusion: 静态基准会误表征模型行为，评测应转向动态、与部署相关的形式。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning from Humans for Proactive Assistance in Human-Robot Collaborative Transport
papers.abstract_en: We focus on human-robot collaborative transport, a challenging task of broad relevance spanning logistics, manufacturing, and the home, in which a user and a robot work together to relocate a large or heavy object. To act as an effective partner, the robot should reduce the user's effort by contributing to efficient relocation of the object while remaining physically responsive to them. Prior work often addresses these capabilities separately, producing robots that may move the object efficiently but resist user input, or accommodate the user but depend on continuous guidance. Our key insight is that obstacle-constrained collaborative transport requires integrating predictions of human collaborative behavior with compliant robot control. To this end, we introduce PROACT, a framework for human-robot collaborative transport that incorporates anticipation into compliant whole-body control through a learned model of human collaborative behavior. Trained on a large-scale, real-world dataset of dyadic human transport demonstrations, our transformer architecture distills collaborative behavior into predictions of future object motion. Across 108 real-world trials with a 9-DoF mobile manipulator, PROACT reduces mean interaction work by 59.2\% and 20.4\%, and mean completion time by 12.9\% and 6.9\%, relative to compliance-only and MPC baselines, respectively. Footage from our experiments can be found at https://youtu.be/qAGvQfVPjbk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PROACT 把人类协作行为的预测模型嵌入柔顺全身控制 (compliant whole-body control)，用于有障碍物约束的人机协同搬运：用 Transformer 从大规模真实双人搬运演示中学习未来物体运动预测，让机器人既高效搬运又对用户输入保持柔顺。在 108 次真实实验（9-DoF 移动机械臂）中，相比仅柔顺基线与 MPC 基线，平均交互功分别下降 59.2% 和 20.4%，平均完成时间分别下降 12.9% 和 6.9%。
Motivation: 既往工作把搬运效率与对用户输入的柔顺响应分开处理，导致机器人要么高效但抵抗用户输入，要么顺从但依赖持续引导。
Method: PROACT 框架在柔顺全身控制中引入预判：用 Transformer 架构在大规模真实双人搬运演示数据集上训练人类协作行为模型，输出未来物体运动预测，再将其接入控制回路。
Result: 108 次真实实验、9-DoF 移动机械臂：相对 compliance-only 基线，平均交互功降低 59.2%、平均完成时间降低 12.9%；相对 MPC 基线，平均交互功降低 20.4%、平均完成时间降低 6.9%。
Conclusion: 在障碍物约束的协同搬运中，把人类行为预测与柔顺控制结合，可同时减少用户做功并缩短完成时间，优于单独的柔顺控制与 MPC。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Concept Drift from a Causal Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Concept drift is a common phenomenon in real-world data streams, in which changes in the data-generating distribution can degrade predictive model performance. Most existing definitions characterize drift as changes in the joint distribution $P(\mathbf{x}, y)$, without distinguishing which component of the data-generating process has changed. In this work, we introduce a causal perspective on concept drift based on Structural Causal Models (SCMs). We propose a taxonomy that categorizes drift events by their causal origin, including changes in exogenous variables, endogenous mechanisms, confounders, and target-generating processes. Building on this framework, we develop an SCM-based data stream generator that simulates controlled mechanism-level drift events. Our experiments empirically characterize the distributional effects of each drift type and show that drifts with different causal origins induce distinct patterns of distribution shift and predictive behavior. Furthermore, by integrating causal discovery methods, we use our framework to construct data streams grounded in real-world dependency structures, enabling more realistic and informative evaluation scenarios. We also demonstrate that leveraging the generated data can improve downstream performance. These results highlight the importance of accounting for causal structure when studying and evaluating adaptive learning methods, and establish a foundation for causally-aware evaluation in non-stationary environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用结构因果模型 (SCM) 给概念漂移做因果分类，按外生变量、内生机制、混杂因子、目标生成过程四类因果来源划分漂移事件，并据此构建可控机制级漂移的数据流生成器。实验显示不同因果来源的漂移产生不同的分布偏移模式与预测行为，且用生成数据可提升下游性能。
Motivation: 现有漂移定义只刻画联合分布 P(x,y) 的变化，不区分数据生成过程中究竟哪一部分变了，导致非平稳环境下的评估难以归因。
Method: 基于 SCM 提出按因果来源分类的漂移 taxonomy，开发 SCM 数据流生成器模拟受控机制级漂移；再结合因果发现方法，用真实依赖结构构造数据流以贴近现实评估场景。
Result: 实验对每类漂移的分布效应做了经验刻画，显示不同因果来源的漂移诱导出不同的分布偏移模式与预测行为；并演示利用生成数据可改善下游性能。
Conclusion: 研究与评估自适应学习方法时必须纳入因果结构，该框架为非平稳环境下的因果感知评估奠定基础。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: GINIO: A Geometric SO(3)-Equivariant Interface for Neural Inertial Odometry
papers.abstract_en: Neural inertial odometry increasingly uses networks as learned measurements inside filtering pipelines. Such measurements should transform consistently under arbitrary IMU mounting conventions: their mean must transform as a vector, and their covariance must transform congruently as a second-order tensor. We present GINIO, a geometric SO(3)-equivariant interface for neural inertial odometry under arbitrary rotations of the IMU measurement frame. Given calibrated IMU windows, our framework predicts a motion measurement and uncertainty obeying these tensorial laws. To support efficient sensor-frame learning, we introduce Last-Frame Alignment (LFA), a deterministic preprocessing step that is provably equivalent to world-frame training for SO(3)-equivariant predictors. The connected estimator tracks sensor-local states such as IMU bias, separating nuisance estimation from the geometric law enforced by the learned measurement. We instantiate the same interface in filter-connected NIO, AirIO-style recurrent aerial prediction, EqNIO-style full-SO(3) canonicalization, and ResNet-style temporal backbones. On TLIO, GINIO achieves 2.018 m ID/SO(3) ATE while EqNIO degrades to 76.389 m, using 11.6x fewer FLOPs. On NanoBench, our AirIO-style instantiation improves ATE from 5.579 m to 1.430 m without external attitude input, and our ResNet-style instantiation reaches 0.581 m ATE versus 0.645 m for ResNet1D. On Fetch, GINIO empirically reduces unseen physical-remount ATE from 8.15 m to 0.50 m without retraining, demonstrating robustness beyond the exact coordinate-frame guarantee. For uncertainty, spectral covariance reduces covariance-equivariance error by over three orders of magnitude compared with a diagonal head.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). 26 pages, 14 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GINIO 为神经惯性里程计 (neural inertial odometry) 提出 SO(3) 等变接口，使网络输出的运动测量均值按向量、协方差按二阶张量在任意 IMU 安装旋转下一致变换，并用可证等价于世界系训练的 Last-Frame Alignment (LFA) 做传感器系学习。在 TLIO 上 ID/SO(3) ATE 为 2.018 m（EqNIO 退化到 76.389 m）且 FLOPs 少 11.6 倍；Fetch 上未见物理重装 ATE 从 8.15 m 降到 0.50 m，无需重训练。
Motivation: 网络作为滤波管线中的学习测量时，其均值与协方差必须在任意 IMU 安装约定下按向量与二阶张量规律变换；否则换安装姿态即失效，EqNIO 在 ID/SO(3) 条件下 ATE 退化到 76.389 m。
Method: SO(3) 等变接口预测满足张量律的运动测量与不确定性；Last-Frame Alignment (LFA) 是可证等价于世界系训练的确定性预处理；连接的估计器跟踪 IMU bias 等传感器本地状态，把干扰量估计与学习测量所强制的几何律分离。同一接口实例化到 filter-connected NIO、AirIO 式循环空中预测、EqNIO 式全 SO(3) 规范化与 ResNet 式时序骨干。
Result: TLIO：ID/SO(3) ATE 2.018 m，EqNIO 76.389 m，FLOPs 少 11.6 倍。NanoBench：AirIO 式实例在无外部姿态输入下 ATE 从 5.579 m 降到 1.430 m；ResNet 式实例 0.581 m 对比 ResNet1D 0.645 m。Fetch：未见物理重装 ATE 从 8.15 m 降到 0.50 m，无需重训练。谱协方差头使协方差等变误差比对角头降低三个数量级以上。
Conclusion: 把等变性做成学习测量与不确定性头的接口约束，可在任意 IMU 安装旋转下保持精度并外推到未见重装；谱协方差表示是满足张量变换律的关键。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: SO(3) 等变接口预测满足张量律的运动测量与不确定性；Last-Frame Alignment (LFA) 是可证等价于世界系训练的确定性预处理；连接的估计器跟踪 IMU bias 等传感器本地状态，把干扰量估计与学习测量所强制的几何律分离。同一接口实例化到 filter-connected NIO、AirIO 式循环空中预测、EqNIO 式全 SO(3) 规范化与 ResNet 式时序骨干。
summary_sections.result: TLIO：ID/SO(3) ATE 2.018 m，EqNIO 76.389 m，FLOPs 少 11.6 倍。NanoBench：AirIO 式实例在无外部姿态输入下 ATE 从 5.579 m 降到 1.430 m；ResNet 式实例 0.581 m 对比 ResNet1D 0.645 m。Fetch：未见物理重装 ATE 从 8.15 m 降到 0.50 m，无需重训练。谱协方差头使协方差等变误差比对角头降低三个数量级以上。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把等变性做成学习测量与不确定性头的接口约束，可在任意 IMU 安装旋转下保持精度并外推到未见重装；谱协方差表示是满足张量变换律的关键。

papers.title: Clarification Is Not Correction: LLMs Fail to Let Go
papers.abstract_en: Dialogue failures in language models are usually framed as memory failures: context too long, summaries lossy, a constraint forgotten. We argue this misses a deeper problem: in many conversations the model does not forget, it commits too early. An ambiguous early turn collapses into a single hidden interpretation, and later clarification is filtered through that commitment. We call this early posterior collapse: unresolved user intent collapsing into a committed task state before ambiguity is resolved. We study it with controlled dialogue tasks in writing, planning, and coding using Gemini-2.5-Pro and Gemini-2.5-Flash. Across thousands of trials, the same information in different orders yields different outcomes, even when the final dialogue contains equivalent task-relevant information. This order effect suggests later clarification is treated as extra context rather than a corrective signal: it refines a stale task state without invalidating it. Coding tasks are especially vulnerable, suggesting early assumptions get embedded in structured artifacts such as interfaces and control flow. Standard prompting and memory strategies do not reliably help: summaries can collapse ambiguity, and chain-of-thought can reduce explicit wrong commitment in reasoning traces without improving final task success. These findings motivate uncertainty-preserving state management. If assistants cannot let go of early interpretations, robustness cannot rely on post hoc correction alone; it must keep ambiguous early turns from hardening into one task state. Assistants should hold tentative hypotheses while ambiguity remains, ask before executing when high-impact ambiguity persists, and rebuild from a revised state when later evidence invalidates an earlier reading. Rather than one prompting fix, we aim to redirect research for interactive LLMs from retaining more context toward preserving uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出「早期后验坍缩」(early posterior collapse)：对话模型不是遗忘上下文，而是在歧义未解时就把模糊的早期意图压成单一任务状态，后续澄清只被当作补充上下文而非纠错信号。在写作、规划、编码三类受控对话任务上用 Gemini-2.5-Pro 与 Gemini-2.5-Flash 跑数千次试验，同一信息以不同顺序给出会得到不同结果，编码任务最脆弱；标准提示与记忆策略（摘要、chain-of-thought）不能可靠缓解。作者主张把交互式 LLM 研究从「保留更多上下文」转向「保留不确定性」：歧义期持有暂定假设、高影响歧义先问再执行、后续证据推翻旧解读时从修订状态重建。
Motivation: 对话失败通常被归因为记忆问题（上下文过长、摘要有损、约束被遗忘），但真正的问题是模型过早承诺：模糊的早期轮次坍缩成隐藏的单一解读，之后的澄清都被过滤过。
Method: 在写作、规划、编码三类受控对话任务上研究该现象，使用 Gemini-2.5-Pro 与 Gemini-2.5-Flash，跨数千次试验比较同一任务信息在不同顺序下（最终对话含等价任务相关信息）的结果差异，并检验标准提示与记忆策略（摘要、chain-of-thought）。
Result: 数千次试验中，同一信息不同顺序产生不同结果，即使最终对话含等价的任务相关信息；编码任务尤其脆弱；摘要会坍缩歧义，chain-of-thought 可减少推理轨迹中的显式错误承诺却不提升最终任务成功率。
Conclusion: 后续澄清被当作额外上下文而非纠错信号，只精修过时任务状态而不使其失效；鲁棒性不能只靠事后纠错，须在歧义期保留不确定性，并在高影响歧义处先询问、在证据推翻旧解读时从修订状态重建。

papers.title: MT-ProtBERT: Multi-task Learning ProtBERT for Intrinsically Disordered Proteins Classification with Scarce Data
papers.abstract_en: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) differ from folded proteins in that they are dynamic, lack a stable three-dimensional conformation, and have low sequence similarity between similar proteins. The conformational heterogeneity of IDPs - while beneficial for their diverse functions - limits the use of traditional experimental tools to determine their conformation. The experimental difficulty, along with low sequence similarity, results in data scarcity, and makes it difficult to classify/detect IDPs that are similar or dissimilar, a task relevant to understand biology and evolution. We address this challenge using Multi-task ProtBERT (MT-ProtBERT), a multi-task extension of ProtBERT tailored for low-data regimes. MT-ProtBERT integrates Dynamic Window Masking, a Multi-Scale 1D Convolutional classifier (MS-Conv1D), and auxiliary objectives that jointly optimize masked language modeling and biochemistry-informed tasks. We evaluate this framework on two tasks under limited data: (i) phosphorylation site prediction (S/T/Y) in short sequences and small datasets, and (ii) protein compaction prediction on two small datasets (684 and 530 sequences), including sequences comparable in length to typical disordered regions. MT-ProtBERT consistently outperforms PARROT, an RNN-based IDP-specific model, across all tasks. These results demonstrate that combining self-supervised and biochemistry-informed tasks, and multi-scale learning enables robust modeling of unstructured proteins under data scarcity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MT-ProtBERT 把 ProtBERT 扩展为低数据条件下的多任务模型，用 Dynamic Window Masking、多尺度一维卷积分类器 (MS-Conv1D) 与生物化学先验辅助目标联合优化掩码语言建模，在磷酸化位点预测和蛋白紧致度预测上一致优于面向 IDP 的 RNN 模型 PARROT。
Motivation: 本征无序蛋白 (IDP) 构象异质、序列相似度低，实验手段难以确定其构象，进而造成数据稀缺，使相似或相异 IDP 的分类检测困难。
Method: 在 ProtBERT 上加入 Dynamic Window Masking、多尺度一维卷积分类器 MS-Conv1D，以及联合优化掩码语言建模与生物化学先验任务的辅助目标，构成面向低数据条件的多任务扩展 MT-ProtBERT。
Result: 在两项低数据任务上评测：短序列小数据集上的磷酸化位点 (S/T/Y) 预测，以及两个小数据集（684 与 530 条序列）上的蛋白紧致度预测；MT-ProtBERT 在全部任务上一致优于基于 RNN 的 IDP 专用模型 PARROT。
Conclusion: 自监督任务与生物化学先验任务结合、配合多尺度学习，可在数据稀缺条件下稳健建模无结构蛋白。

papers.title: MirrorDistill: Illumination-Aware Latent Distillation for Efficient Low-Light Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is an im- portant component of visual sensing systems operating under degraded illumination, including nighttime surveillance, au- tonomous navigation, remote sensing, and inspection in poorly lit industrial environments. Most LLIE methods rely on output- level reconstruction losses that supervise only the final restored image, leaving the intermediate feature recovery process weakly constrained. This paper proposes MirrorDistill, an illumination- aware latent distillation framework that links the low-light and clean domains through feature mirroring. During training, a shared encoder and an exponential-moving-average teacher decoder process the clean reference image to generate clean- domain latent targets. These targets supervise the low-light student at two levels: raw encoder features and standardized multi-scale decoder projections. The alignment is applied layer by layer, while a proposed illumination-aware weighting scheme gives greater emphasis to underexposed regions. The teacher and reference branches are used only during training, so inference requires only the lightweight student encoder-decoder and in- troduces no teacher-side computational cost. Under evaluation on the standard LOL benchmarks, MirrorDistill outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on the real-captured LOL-v2-Real set, while having the lowest compute complexity (GMACs) and while remaining competitive on the LOL-v1 and LOL-v2-Synthetic datasets. Ablation studies further show the contributions of the encoder mirror, decoder mirror, and illumination-aware weighting. Finally, we release our code as open-source for the benefit of future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MirrorDistill 用光照感知的潜空间蒸馏 (illumination-aware latent distillation) 约束低光图像增强 (LLIE) 的中间特征恢复：共享编码器与 EMA 教师解码器处理干净参考图生成干净域潜变量目标，逐层监督低光学生的原始编码器特征与多尺度解码器投影，并对欠曝区域加权。在 LOL 基准上，该方法在真实拍摄的 LOL-v2-Real 上超过 SOTA 且 GMACs 最低，在 LOL-v1 与 LOL-v2-Synthetic 上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 多数 LLIE 方法只用输出级重建损失监督最终图像，中间特征恢复过程缺少约束，导致恢复质量与推理开销难以兼顾。
Method: 训练期用共享编码器加指数移动平均 (EMA) 教师解码器处理干净参考图，产出干净域潜变量目标；这些目标在两层监督低光学生——原始编码器特征与标准化的多尺度解码器投影，逐层对齐，并用光照感知加权方案提高欠曝区域权重。教师与参考分支仅在训练期使用，推理只保留轻量学生编解码器。
Result: 在标准 LOL 基准上，MirrorDistill 在真实拍摄的 LOL-v2-Real 集上超过 state-of-the-art 方法，同时具有最低的计算复杂度 (GMACs)；在 LOL-v1 与 LOL-v2-Synthetic 上保持竞争力。消融研究显示 encoder mirror、decoder mirror 与光照感知加权各有贡献。
Conclusion: 把干净域潜变量按层镜像到低光分支并按光照加权，可以在不增加推理开销的前提下提升低光恢复质量；代码已开源。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Kronecker Covariance Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series contain complex patterns that span across both space and time. While covariance-based statistical tools like spatiotemporal Principal Component Analysis (ST-PCA) help identify these patterns, they are limited to linear operations and prone to estimation errors with limited data. Recent covariance-based spatiotemporal neural networks offer more stable, non-linear alternatives, but they ignore correlations across different time steps. To solve this, we introduce the Kronecker coVariance Neural Network (KVNN), a temporal graph neural network that represents the spatiotemporal covariance matrix via a sum of Kronecker products where spatial and temporal dependencies are decoupled. By implementing filtering operations on spatial and temporal components, KVNNs achieve expressive processing capabilities, admit a rigorous spectral analysis, and are provably stable to finite-sample estimation errors, ultimately addressing all of ST-PCA's limitations. We show on five real-world datasets that KVNNs achieve strong forecasting performance, often requiring significantly fewer trainable parameters than competitive methods, and are consistent under estimation noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Kronecker coVariance Neural Network (KVNN)，用空间与时间协方差的 Kronecker 积之和表示时空协方差矩阵，并在两个分量上分别做滤波，从而在解耦时空依赖的同时保留跨时间步相关性。该时序图神经网络有严格谱分析、对有限样本估计误差可证稳定，在五个真实数据集上取得强预测性能且参数量显著少于竞争方法。
Motivation: ST-PCA 只能线性处理且小样本下估计误差大，现有协方差时空神经网络虽非线性更稳却忽略不同时间步之间的相关，多变量时间序列的跨时空模式因此难以同时建模。
Method: KVNN 是时序图神经网络，把时空协方差矩阵写成空间与时间依赖解耦的 Kronecker 积之和，分别在空间分量与时间分量上实施滤波操作；由此获得表达能力、可做严格谱分析，并对有限样本估计误差可证稳定。
Result: 在五个真实世界数据集上 KVNN 取得强预测性能，所需可训练参数量通常显著少于竞争方法，且在估计噪声下表现一致（consistent under estimation noise）。
Conclusion: 用 Kronecker 分解解耦时空协方差并分别滤波，可同时解决 ST-PCA 的线性、估计误差与跨时间步相关缺失三类限制，做到参数更省且抗估计噪声。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware 3D Residual Wavelet Diffusion for Ultra Low-Field MRI Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Ultra low-field MRI expands global access to neuroimaging but produces scans with low signal-to-noise ratio, reduced contrast, and thick slices. While regression-based super-resolution can recover anatomical detail for segmentation, it returns a single deterministic estimate that gives no indication of regions where the low-field input leaves anatomy underdetermined. Generative diffusion models offer an alternative by sampling the posterior distribution of plausible high-field images, quantifying this anatomical ambiguity. However, applying them to 3D whole-brain MRI is restricted by memory bottlenecks, slow sampling, and scanner domain shifts. We propose a 3D residual wavelet diffusion model that combines three ideas to overcome these hurdles. A lossless wavelet reparameterisation shrinks the spatial grid to fit a whole brain on a single GPU, residual shifting accelerates sampling by starting from the low-field input, and domain randomisation promotes scanner generalisation without paired training data. As the high-field reference is not a voxel-aligned ground truth, we evaluate downstream volumetric agreement. On a healthy cohort (n=19) imaged at 0.064T and 3T, our method matches a leading general-purpose regression approach in volumetric accuracy while additionally generating per-voxel uncertainty maps highlighting underdetermined regions. Furthermore, on a pilot dataset (n=11) of participants with cognitive impairment, disease-relevant atrophy is preserved rather than normalised towards a healthy prior. Our framework brings whole-brain posterior sampling to low-field super-resolution without sacrificing volumetric accuracy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 3D residual wavelet diffusion，用无损小波重参数化把整脑压进单卡、残差偏移从低场输入起始加速采样、domain randomisation 免配对数据实现跨扫描仪泛化，在超低场 (0.064T) MRI 超分辨上采样高场后验分布并输出逐体素不确定性图。在 n=19 健康队列上体积精度与主流回归方法相当，同时给出欠定区域的不确定性；n=11 认知障碍试点中疾病相关萎缩被保留而非被拉向健康先验。
Motivation: 超低场 MRI 信噪比低、对比度弱、层厚大；回归式超分辨只给单一确定性估计，无法指出低场输入下解剖欠定的区域，而生成式扩散用于 3D 全脑又受显存、采样慢和扫描仪域偏移限制。
Method: 3D residual wavelet diffusion 组合三点：无损小波重参数化缩小空间网格使整脑可在单 GPU 上处理；residual shifting 从低场输入出发起始采样以加速；domain randomisation 在无配对训练数据下促进扫描仪泛化。因高场参考并非体素对齐的真值，评估改用下游体积一致性 (volumetric agreement)。
Result: 在 n=19 健康队列（0.064T 与 3T 成像）上，体积精度与一个主流通用回归方法相当，同时额外生成标出欠定区域的逐体素不确定性图；在 n=11 认知障碍试点数据集上，疾病相关萎缩被保留，未被归一化到健康先验。
Conclusion: 整脑后验采样可以在不牺牲体积精度的前提下用于低场超分辨，并给出回归方法无法提供的逐体素不确定性；在认知障碍数据上该不确定性建模不会把病理萎缩抹平成健康先验。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Topological Signal Processing With Unoriented Operators
papers.abstract_en: Topological signal processing (TSP) processes signals on simplicial complexes with oriented boundary operators, which is the natural choice for flow signals or when the topological invariants play a role for the task at hand. However, many higher-order signals carry no orientation, and applying oriented operators to them is not well-defined since it introduces an arbitrary choice of simplex orientation. We study an unoriented TSP (UTSP) framework that replaces oriented boundaries with unoriented incidence matrices. First, we show that unoriented incidence and Laplacian matrices between arbitrary simplicial levels admit graph-like spectral properties. Second, since dropping orientation removes the Hodge decomposition, we introduce an unoriented counterpart, termed interaction-order decomposition, which quantifies how much of a higher-order signal is explained by aggregating lower-order signals. Third, we use this decomposition to derive regularizers for signal reconstruction that penalize each interaction order separately. Experiments on real-world data show that the order-aware regularizers outperform oriented baselines, with the largest gains when the signal energy is unevenly distributed across orders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无向拓扑信号处理 (unoriented TSP, UTSP)：用无向关联矩阵替代有向边界算子，使无方向的高阶信号也能做谱分析与分解。由于丢掉方向后 Hodge 分解失效，作者提出 interaction-order decomposition 来度量高阶信号被低阶聚合解释的程度，并据此构造按阶分别惩罚的重建正则项；真实数据实验中该按阶正则优于有向基线，且信号能量在各阶分布越不均匀提升越大。
Motivation: 许多高阶信号本身没有方向，对它们套用有向边界算子等于强加任意的单纯形定向，结果不 well-defined；而丢弃方向又会失去 Hodge 分解这一核心工具。
Method: 以无向关联矩阵和无向 Laplacian 替代有向版本，证明任意单纯形层级之间的无向矩阵具有类图谱性质；提出 interaction-order decomposition 量化高阶信号被低阶信号聚合解释的比例；再由该分解导出对每个 interaction order 单独惩罚的信号重建正则项。
Result: 在真实数据实验中，order-aware 正则项优于有向基线，且当信号能量在各阶之间分布不均匀时增益最大；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 无向算子足以支撑类图谱分析，而按 interaction order 分开惩罚的正则比有向 Hodge 框架更适合无方向高阶信号的重建，能量跨阶不均时收益最明显。
Relevance: 18
