papers.title: Potential for Enhanced Learning in Machine Learning Classes by Using Wiki LLM Indexing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as course-specific tutors, but their usefulness depends on grounding in vetted instructional materials that are often revised mid-semester. Our prior work built a multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over an authentic machine learning course corpus (Foundations of Machine Learning) and found that retrieval improved contextual grounding, but that fixed retrieval strategies were suboptimal. That motivates a different question: whether how a corpus is structured at ingest time matters more than how much is retrieved at query time. We present a controlled head-to-head comparison of two knowledge representations over an identical classroom corpus: (A) vector RAG, replicating the best-performing configuration from our prior study, and (B) an LLM-compiled wiki (Karpathy framework), in which the corpus is synthesized at ingest into linked concept pages with explicit cross-references and citations back to source materials. We evaluate 59 questions spanning single-fact recall, cross-unit concept linking, synthesis and explanation, and currency after a syllabus revision, scored by an LLM judge against a human-authored rubric. Both representations answered single-fact questions about equally well (9.33 vs. 9.96 of 10), but diverged sharply on questions requiring links across course units. The compiled wiki remained accurate and grounded (9.93; 100% grounded in cited sources), while retrieval scored lower and was markedly less grounded (8.14; 64%). The wiki's citations let students and instructors trace any claim back to the lecture that introduced it, adding a layer of dynamic retrieval that machine learning courses require. While further testing is needed, instructors using AI to support learning in ML courses should consider wiki-based structure for its potential to support foundational elements of best practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在同一门机器学习课程语料上对照两种知识表示：向量 RAG 与 LLM 编译的 wiki（Karpathy framework）。59 道题、LLM judge 按人工 rubric 打分显示，单事实题两者相当（9.33 vs 9.96/10），跨单元关联题 wiki 9.93 且 100% 有据可依，RAG 仅 8.14、grounded 64%；作者建议课程 AI 助教优先采用 wiki 式结构。
Motivation: 课程语料期中会修订，先前工作发现检索能改善 grounding 但固定检索策略次优，于是问题转为：语料在 ingest 时如何组织，是否比查询时检索多少更关键。
Method: 在完全相同的课堂语料上做受控头对头比较：(A) 向量 RAG，复现先前研究最佳配置；(B) LLM 编译的 wiki（Karpathy framework），ingest 时把语料综合成带交叉引用与回指原文引用的关联概念页。用 59 道覆盖单事实回忆、跨单元概念关联、综合解释、 syllabus 修订后时效性的题目，由 LLM judge 按人工撰写的 rubric 打分。
Result: 单事实题两者接近：RAG 9.33 vs wiki 9.96（满分 10）；跨单元关联题 wiki 9.93 且 100% grounded in cited sources，RAG 8.14、grounded 64%。
Conclusion: 语料在 ingest 时的结构化程度比查询时的检索量更能决定跨单元问题的准确性与可溯源性；作者称仍需进一步测试，但建议用 AI 支持教学的教师考虑 wiki 式结构。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Making Agents More Consistent: Skills Should Form Habits for Repeat Tasks
papers.abstract_en: On repeated work, agents are inconsistent. We ran 42 tasks three times each and found that, depending on the model, 38% to 74% returned answers that did not agree. Consistency is what a buyer, an auditor, or a regulator requires, and agents do not have it. They are wasteful too: 95.3% to 97.2% of what an agent generates goes to re-deriving a plan the system already knows. We propose skill habit formation. An agent mines its own execution history for candidate skills, deterministic variants that compete against the incumbent rather than replacing it. A candidate declares the region of input space it claims, so the common case runs as a script and the rest falls through to reasoning. Four gates of ascending cost admit candidates; the central one tests a candidate's execution trace against a retained reference, within a tolerance measured from that reference's own run-to-run variability. On text-to-SQL, three of four reasoning arms reproduced their own output on 11 to 13 of 42 repeated questions and the fourth on 26 of 42, while a habit-formed variant reproduced on all 456 dispatches we repeated and was non-inferior to every arm it replaced (p<0.0001). It also used 14% to 56% fewer tokens, turning net positive after 7 to 53 reuses. We measured what this costs in accuracy. The guard admitted work it should have deferred on 2.6% of natural paraphrases and 26% of inputs near its boundary, and 11 of 13 such failures were invisible to the trace-conformance gate at any threshold. Deterministic errors repeat exactly: a bad habit is as reliable as a good one, and that is the price of the property that makes the system auditable. Separating routing from parameter extraction raised end-to-end accuracy from 0.888 to 0.952 at 43% of the cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对智能体在重复任务上的不一致，提出 skill habit formation：从自身执行历史挖出确定性技能变体，声明其输入空间覆盖区，常见情形走脚本、其余回落到推理，并用四道递增成本的准入门把候选与在位者竞争。在 42 个任务各跑三次的实验中，模型有 38%–74% 的回答互不一致；text-to-SQL 上 habit 化变体在全部 456 次重复派发中完全复现自身输出，token 消耗减少 14%–56%，7 到 53 次复用后净收益转正。
Motivation: 智能体在重复工作上输出不一致（42 任务各三次，38%–74% 回答不一致），且 95.3%–97.2% 的生成内容花在重新推导系统已知的计划上，无法满足买方、审计与监管对一致性和可审计性的要求。
Method: skill habit formation：智能体挖掘自身执行历史得到候选技能（确定性变体，与在位者竞争而非替换），每个候选声明其占据的输入空间区域，命中区域按脚本执行、其余回落到推理；四道成本递增的准入门筛选候选，核心一道用参考执行自身的 run-to-run 变异度定容差，比对候选执行轨迹与保留的参考轨迹。
Result: 42 个任务各重复三次，按模型有 38%–74% 的回答不一致；95.3%–97.2% 的生成内容用于重新推导已知计划。text-to-SQL 上四个推理臂中三个在 42 道重复问题里仅 11–13 道复现自身输出、第四个 26/42，habit 化变体在全部 456 次重复派发上均复现，且对每个被替换臂非劣 (p<0.0001)，token 减少 14%–56%，7–53 次复用后净收益转正。代价：守卫在 2.6% 的自然改写、26% 的边界附近输入上放行了本应推迟的工作，其中 11/13 的失败在任何阈值下都不被轨迹一致性门发现；把路由与参数抽取分离后端到端准确率从 0.888 升到 0.952，成本为原来的 43%。
Conclusion: 确定性 habit 让重复任务的输出完全可复现且可审计，但坏 habit 会精确重复同样的错误——这是可审计性的代价；路由与参数抽取分离能同时抬高准确率并压低成本。

papers.title: Correcting Within-Group Self-Selection Bias in Prioritized Replay
papers.abstract_en: Prioritized experience replay (PER) improves sample efficiency by replaying high-priority transitions, usually according to absolute temporal-difference error. In stochastic environments, PER can distort the distribution of realized outcomes replayed from transitions with the same state-action pair. We call this within-group self-selection. We quantify the resulting changes in within-group outcome frequencies and mean Bellman targets. We decompose PER into between-group allocation and conditional sibling selection, and derive fixed-buffer corrections that preserve current group-level priority mass: SAMPLE selects a group through PER and trains on a uniformly sampled sibling; AVG averages sibling Bellman targets; and MODEL samples from an empirical full-outcome model. In exact state-action environments with rare high-magnitude outcomes, sibling-aware replay improves learning efficiency over PER, although matched parameter sweeps show that tuning can narrow some gaps. In MinAtar, approximate VQ-VAE groups with SAMPLE mitigate degradation under mean-preserving reward tails in four of five games. Sibling-aware replay thus retains the focus on high-priority state-action regions while recovering their empirical outcome frequencies.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PER 按 |TD| 重放会在同一 state-action 组内自选择（within-group self-selection），扭曲随机环境里实际结果的频率与 Bellman target 均值。作者把 PER 拆成组间分配与组内 sibling 选择，提出保持组级优先级质量不变的三种修正：SAMPLE、AVG、MODEL。在 MinAtar 五个游戏中，用近似 VQ-VAE 分组的 SAMPLE 在四个游戏上缓解了均值保持的重尾奖励带来的性能下降。
Motivation: PER 在随机环境中会系统性偏置同一 state-action 对重放出的结果分布，使训练目标偏离真实期望 Bellman target，且这一偏差此前未被量化。
Method: 将 PER 分解为 between-group allocation 与 conditional sibling selection，量化组内结果频率与平均 Bellman target 的偏移；给出三种固定缓冲区修正，均保持当前组级优先级质量：SAMPLE（PER 选组后均匀采 sibling）、AVG（对 sibling Bellman target 取平均）、MODEL（从经验 full-outcome model 采样）。分组用近似 VQ-VAE 学习 state-action 表示。
Result: 在含稀有大幅结果的精确 state-action 环境中，sibling-aware replay 学习效率高于 PER，但匹配的参数扫描显示调参可缩小部分差距。在 MinAtar 五个游戏中的四个上，VQ-VAE 分组的 SAMPLE 在均值保持的重尾奖励 (mean-preserving reward tails) 下缓解了性能退化。
Conclusion: sibling-aware replay 在保留对高优先级 state-action 区域聚焦的同时恢复其经验结果频率；组内自选择偏差可通过保持组级优先级质量的重放规则修正，但部分差距可被 PER 调参缩小。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learned Enterprise Data Comprehension: Compression and Routing for Data Agents
papers.abstract_en: Structured-data agents in enterprise settings must reason over complex data environments whose relevant evidence is distributed across schemas, relationships, policies, and recurring business roles. Modern agentic systems often address this burden through reusable markdown-style memory or skill files that preserve previously discovered information for later queries, reducing the need to rediscover the same structure repeatedly. This is useful, but it obscures a natural division of labor: agents are well suited to semantic reasoning, while learned systems are well suited to predicting and organizing recurring structure. We introduce latent equivalence learning to bridge this gap. The framework separates persistent task-relevant identities from their dataset-relative realizations. In our realization, supporting and opposing evidence shape support-realized Gaussian prototypes that learn how those identities are expressed in a particular data environment, while soft-membership profiles retain distinctions lost under a hard assignment. A separate learned query-prototype system represents recurring evidential requirements and maps them through a learned compatibility function into the same persistent identity structure. This identity-factorized, query-conditioned routing materializes the relevant dataset-specific evidence for downstream reasoning, allowing the agent to operate over an already organized evidential state rather than reconstructing cross-schema structure at every query. On the Data Agent Benchmark, spanning 54 queries across 12 heterogeneous datasets, our full implementation achieves 94.67% dataset-macro stratified Pass@1 over five complete trials and 258/270 successful raw query attempts, compared with 55.51% for the benchmark's Claude Opus 4.6 reference agent, ranking first among 40 leaderboard entries at submission.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 latent equivalence learning，把企业结构化数据中持久的任务身份与其在具体数据集中的实现分离，用支持/反对证据塑造的 Gaussian 原型加软隶属度画像学习身份表达，再由学习到的 query-prototype 兼容函数做证据路由，让 agent 直接在已组织好的证据状态上推理。在 Data Agent Benchmark（54 条查询、12 个异构数据集、5 次完整试验）上 dataset-macro stratified Pass@1 达 94.67%，原始查询成功 258/270，高于 Claude Opus 4.6 参考 agent 的 55.51%，提交时在 40 个榜单条目中排名第一。
Motivation: 企业结构化数据的证据分散在 schema、关系、策略与业务角色中，现有 markdown 式记忆/技能文件靠复用缓存减少重复发现，却混淆了分工：agent 擅长语义推理，学习系统更适合预测与组织重复出现的结构。
Method: latent equivalence learning 分离持久身份与数据集相对实现：支持与反对证据塑造成 support-realized Gaussian 原型，soft-membership profile 保留硬分配会丢失的区分；独立的 learned query-prototype 系统表示反复出现的证据需求，经 learned compatibility function 映射到同一持久身份结构，完成 identity-factorized、query-conditioned 的证据路由。
Result: 在 Data Agent Benchmark（54 queries、12 个异构数据集、5 次完整试验）上，完整实现取得 94.67% 的 dataset-macro stratified Pass@1，原始查询 258/270 成功；对比基准自带 Claude Opus 4.6 参考 agent 的 55.51%，提交时在 40 个 leaderboard 条目中排名第一。
Conclusion: 把跨 schema 结构的组织交给学习到的身份-查询路由、把语义推理留给 agent，可以让 agent 每次查询直接操作已组织的证据状态，而不必重建结构；该分工在企业结构化问答上显著优于依赖通用 agent 的参考实现。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Attention as a Routing Graph: Live Circuit Extraction from a Single Forward Pass
papers.abstract_en: Finding circuits in language models usually means running many careful interventions. We try something simpler: treat attention as a routing map from one forward pass, keep a small set of routes that point toward the answer, and ask whether those routes actually matter. They often do. On induction and IOI (tasks where the "right" circuit is already known), ablating our extracted edges hurts the model much more than ablating a random set of the same size. We evaluate n=100 prompts per cell on GPT-2 Small, GPT-2 Medium, and Pythia-410M, with paired gap tests and bootstrap confidence intervals. The extract step costs one forward; a head-by-head patch sweep costs about two orders of magnitude more. We are not claiming a complete circuit atlas. We are claiming a cheap sketch that carries real causal signal on known tasks, with clear failure modes when it does not. Code and evaluation artifacts are at https://github.com/Aquinf03/live-circuit-routing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 attention 视为单次前向的路由图，从中抽取指向答案的少量路径并做消融检验：在 induction 与 IOI 上，消融抽出的边比消融同等大小的随机边对模型伤害大得多，而抽取只需一次前向，比逐头 patch sweep 便宜约两个数量级。
Motivation: 在语言模型中寻找 circuit 通常需要大量干预实验，成本高；作者想用更便宜的方式判断哪些 attention 边真正承载因果信号。
Method: 单次前向得到 attention 路由图，保留指向答案的少量 route 作为候选 circuit，再对这些边做消融并与同规模随机边对照；在 GPT-2 Small、GPT-2 Medium、Pythia-410M 上每格 n=100 prompts，用 paired gap 检验与 bootstrap 置信区间评估。
Result: 在 induction 与 IOI（已知正确 circuit 的任务）上，消融抽出的边比消融同等大小随机边显著更伤模型表现；每格 n=100 prompts，覆盖 GPT-2 Small/Medium 与 Pythia-410M，采用 paired gap 检验与 bootstrap 置信区间；抽取步骤只花一次前向，逐头 patch sweep 成本约高两个数量级。
Conclusion: 作者只声称得到一张便宜但带真实因果信号的 circuit 草图，而非完整 circuit atlas，并指出方法存在明确失效情形。

papers.title: When LLM Agents Fail to Read the Room: ReAdapt for Relational Social Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: A social agent's most basic decisions (should I react to this post? who should I reach out to?) are not purely content problems. The right action often hinges on the latent relationship between people -- tie strength, reciprocity, mutual connections -- rather than on which content is most salient. Standard LLM agent loops do not explicitly represent how new relational evidence should revise the agent's current social hypothesis, leaving them prone to surface-obvious choices when relational and content cues diverge. We formalize this failure mode with a relationship-reasoning benchmark: 500 synthetic social worlds with friendships, follows, reaction histories, and feeds, yielding 1,000 queries over two tasks, reaction selection and warm introduction (finding the best bridge to a target person). By construction, the surface-obvious candidate differs from the relationship-grounded oracle in about 53% of queries, forming an overturn subset where the agent must use relational evidence to revise an initially plausible choice. We propose ReAdapt (Relationship-Adaptive Agent with Policy-driven sTate), which augments the ReAct loop with an explicit structured social state z = (G, B, R, N, D) capturing goal, belief, relationship, norm, and disclosure. After each tool observation, ReAdapt runs a typed Adapt step that updates this state and emits a policy operation (continue, switch, abandon, or clarify) before choosing the next action. With Gemini-3-Flash on a stratified subset of n = 150 queries per task, ReAdapt improves warm-introduction accuracy from 37% to 51% (+14 points) and reaction-selection accuracy from 69% to 77% (+8 points). Oracle regret drops from 0.260 to 0.152 and from 0.095 to 0.053, respectively. Holding the model, tools, and environments fixed, these results suggest that explicit relational-state adaptation helps LLM agents turn retrieved social evidence into revised decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReAdapt 在 ReAct 循环外挂一个结构化社会状态 z=(G,B,R,N,D)，每次工具观测后跑 typed Adapt 步骤先输出策略操作再选动作，使 LLM agent 在关系与表面线索冲突时改用关系证据推翻初始选择。Gemini-3-Flash 上 warm introduction 准确率 37%→51%（+14 点），reaction selection 69%→77%（+8 点），oracle regret 分别从 0.260 降到 0.152、0.095 降到 0.053。
Motivation: 标准 LLM agent 循环不显式表示新关系证据应如何修正当前社会假设，当关系线索与内容线索分歧时容易选表面最显眼的候选。
Method: 提出 ReAdapt（Relationship-Adaptive Agent with Policy-driven sTate），在 ReAct 循环上加显式社会状态 z=(G,B,R,N,D)（目标、信念、关系、规范、披露）；每次工具观测后执行 typed Adapt 更新状态并输出 continue/switch/abandon/clarify 策略操作，再选下一动作。评测用 500 个合成社会世界（友谊、关注、反应历史、feed）构成的 1,000 条查询，覆盖 reaction selection 与 warm introduction 两任务，其中约 53% 查询的表面显眼候选与关系真值不同（overturn subset），实验取每任务分层子集 n=150。
Result: Gemini-3-Flash 上 warm-introduction 准确率 37%→51%（+14 点），reaction-selection 69%→77%（+8 点）；oracle regret 分别 0.260→0.152 与 0.095→0.053。基准含 500 个合成社会世界、1,000 条查询，约 53% 查询构成表面候选与关系真值不一致的 overturn subset。
Conclusion: 在模型、工具与环境固定时，显式的关系状态自适应能把检索到的社会证据转化为修正后的决策，即 agent 需要一个先更新状态再定动作的步骤而非直接依表面线索行动。

papers.title: MedGate-Fusion: Integrating First-Encounter Semantic Narratives and Physiological Biomarkers for Prospective Stroke Risk Stratification
papers.abstract_en: Prospective stroke risk stratification in primary care is challenging because early risk signals are distributed across routine biomarkers and unstructured clinical narratives. We propose MedGate-Fusion, a multi-modal gated architecture that integrates transformer-based embeddings of first-encounter narratives with ten routinely recorded risk markers. We used electronic medical record data from the Canadian Primary Care Sentinel Surveillance Network (CPCSSN). Starting from 808,921 encounter-level observations, we constructed a first-encounter cohort and retained 102,736 unique patient records with non-empty narratives and sufficient data to evaluate a five-year stroke outcome. To reduce explicit target leakage from diagnostic mentions in notes, we applied dictionary-based redaction of stroke-related terms prior to semantic encoding.
papers.comment: 7 pages,2 tables, 2 figures. Submitted to EMBC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedGate-Fusion 用多模态门控架构把首次就诊叙述的 transformer 语义嵌入与 10 个常规风险标志物融合，在初级医疗 EMR 上做五年卒中风险分层。数据来自 CPCSSN，从 808,921 条就诊记录构建首次就诊队列，保留 102,736 条有非空叙述且足以评估五年结局的唯一患者记录，并在语义编码前用词典法遮蔽卒中相关术语以减少诊断提及造成的显式标签泄漏。
Motivation: 初级医疗中的前瞻性卒中风险分层困难，因为早期风险信号分散在常规生物标志物与非结构化临床叙述两类来源中。
Method: 多模态门控架构 (multi-modal gated architecture)：对首次就诊叙述做 transformer 语义嵌入，与 10 个常规记录的风险标志物门控融合；语义编码前用基于词典的卒中相关术语遮蔽 (dictionary-based redaction) 降低笔记中诊断提及带来的显式目标泄漏；数据用 CPCSSN 电子病历。
Result: 从 808,921 条就诊级观测出发构建首次就诊队列，保留 102,736 条唯一患者记录（有非空叙述且数据足以评估五年卒中结局）；论文为 7 页、2 表、2 图，投稿 EMBC 2026。
Conclusion: 把首次就诊叙述的语义嵌入与常规风险标志物门控融合，可在初级医疗 EMR 上做前瞻性五年卒中风险分层，并需先遮蔽叙述中的卒中术语以抑制标签泄漏。

papers.title: Beyond the Flat Seafloor: A Closed-Form Two-View Constraint to Aid Sidescan Sonar Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Sidescan sonar is a common sensor for both manned and autonomous marine exploration and mapping, yet very few methods build upon or exploit the geometric projection model of the sensor. As sidescan sonar is limited to a 1D range measurement, many approximations are frequently used, including the long-standing assumption of a flat seafloor. Rather than make similar approximations, this paper focuses on a multi-view geometry based approach and formalizes a two-view geometric constraint and proves that a shared feature is constrained to a locus within the intersection of a sphere and a plane. In addition, we characterize what governs the size of the ambiguity locus through Monte Carlo simulation that is grounded in real aperture and mounting geometry for both a surface vessel and an underwater vehicle. We translate additional simulations of relative trajectories for both vehicle platforms into concrete survey-planning guidance. Our results show that locus length is strongly governed by elevation misalignment, and peaks at a moderate oblique crossing angle of approximately 20 degrees, with minimal locus lengths obtained at near parallel and anti-parallel passes.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对侧扫声呐 (sidescan sonar) 只有 1D 距离测量、长期依赖平坦海底近似的问题，论文给出闭式两视图几何约束，证明共享特征被限制在球面与平面交线构成的模糊轨迹 (ambiguity locus) 上。Monte Carlo 仿真表明轨迹长度主要受俯仰失配 (elevation misalignment) 支配，并在约 20 度斜交角达到峰值，近平行与反平行航线时最短，由此转化为水下航行器与水面船的测量航线规划建议。
Motivation: 侧扫声呐是海洋探测与制图的常用传感器，但极少有方法利用其几何投影模型；受限于 1D 距离测量，现有重建普遍依赖平坦海底等近似，误差来源缺乏几何刻画。
Method: 基于多视图几何形式化两视图约束，证明共享特征被约束在球面与平面交集内的轨迹上；用贴合真实孔径与安装几何（水面船与水下航行器两种平台）的 Monte Carlo 仿真刻画决定模糊轨迹大小的因素，并把相对轨迹仿真转成测量规划指导。
Result: 轨迹长度强烈受俯仰失配支配，在约 20 度斜交角处达到峰值；近平行与反平行通过时轨迹长度最小。仿真覆盖 surface vessel 与 underwater vehicle 两种平台的真实孔径与安装几何。
Conclusion: 两视图几何约束可在不假设平坦海底的情况下界定侧扫声呐重建的模糊范围，测量规划应避开约 20 度斜交角、优先采用近平行或反平行航线以缩短模糊轨迹。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RULER: Instance-aware Rubric Rewards for SVG Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) code from natural-language instructions is an open-ended task without absolute visual ground truth, leaving both evaluation and policy optimization without a faithful signal. Scalar metrics (CLIP, Aesthetic) calibrated on natural images transfer poorly to stylized vector content, and reusing them as RL rewards triggers reward hacking. We address both limitations with rubric-based scoring. We first establish empirically that prompting a vision-language judge with a multi-axis rubric correlates with human judgments far better than scalar metrics, both across samples and within instructions. Building on this finding, we introduce RULER (Instance-aware Rubric Rewards for Reinforcement Learning), which converts each instruction into an instance-aware rubric of six items spanning semantic, visual, and stylistic axes; a judge VLM scores rendered rollouts item-by-item, and the weighted satisfactions form a fine-grained reward optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization. Because the rubric is derived from text alone, RULER requires neither paired SVG ground truth nor human preference labels. On MMSVG-Illustration and MMSVG-Icon, RULER lifts the rubric score from 0.432/0.395 to 0.693/0.683, surpassing dedicated SVG specialists and matching the substantially larger DeepSeek-V3, with ablations identifying rubric design as the active lever for RL on open-ended SVG generation. The project page is available at https://hangyuran.github.io/RULER/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RULER 把每条自然语言指令转成六项实例感知评分细则 (instance-aware rubric)，覆盖语义、视觉、风格三个轴，由 judge VLM 逐项打分，加权满意度经 GRPO 优化 SVG 生成策略。在 MMSVG-Illustration 与 MMSVG-Icon 上 rubric 分数从 0.432/0.395 提到 0.693/0.683，超过专用 SVG 模型并追平更大的 DeepSeek-V3。
Motivation: 开放式 SVG 生成没有绝对视觉真值，CLIP、Aesthetic 等在自然图像上标定的标量指标迁移到风格化矢量内容很差，直接当 RL 奖励会触发 reward hacking。
Method: 仅从指令文本生成六项实例感知 rubric，judge VLM 对渲染 rollout 逐项打分，加权满意度构成细粒度奖励，用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 优化；不需要配对 SVG 真值或人工偏好标签。
Result: MMSVG-Illustration 上 rubric 分数 0.432 → 0.693，MMSVG-Icon 上 0.395 → 0.683；多轴 rubric 与人类判断的相关性在样本间和同指令内都远高于标量指标；消融把有效杠杆定位到 rubric 设计。
Conclusion: 对开放式 SVG 生成，基于 rubric 的细粒度奖励比标量指标更可信，且 rubric 设计本身是 RL 效果的关键变量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ImIR: Image-Instruction Tuning for All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Degradations vary widely across images, so a practical restoration system has to handle many degradation types with one model. A recent and effective recipe adapts a large pretrained image-editing model to restoration using a small low-rank adapter with a text prompt. We replace that prompt with an instruction derived from the degraded image itself. The image reaches the editor through two paths: its structure comes from the model's VAE, and its semantic instruction comes from a lightweight token mapper that shifts the degraded image's vision-language embedding toward the embedding a clean image would produce. Because the instruction is a continuous vector, scaling it yields a family of valid restorations for tasks whose target is not unique, such as low-light enhancement. We adapt one Qwen-Image-Edit model to six tasks with a single adapter trained in about three hours on one GPU. The image instruction outperforms text conditioning under a matched comparison, and it supports task agnostic restoration without a degradation label, which the text variant does not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ImIR 用从退化图像自身导出的连续图像指令替代文本 prompt，把大图像编辑模型改造成单一模型处理六种图像复原任务的 all-in-one 系统。在匹配对比下图像指令优于文本条件，且无需退化标签即可做任务无关复原，而文本变体做不到；对低光增强这类目标不唯一的任务，缩放该连续向量可得到一族有效复原结果。
Motivation: 图像退化类型差异大，实用复原系统需用一个模型覆盖多种退化；现有以低秩适配器加文本 prompt 适配预训练编辑模型的方案依赖文本条件，无法在不给退化标签的情况下做任务无关复原。
Method: 以 Qwen-Image-Edit 为底座，仅训练一个小型低秩适配器（约 3 小时、单卡）；图像经两条路径进入编辑器——结构走模型 VAE，语义指令由轻量 token mapper 生成，把退化图像的 vision-language 嵌入移向干净图像会产生的嵌入，形成连续向量指令，缩放该向量可生成一族复原结果。
Result: 单一适配器覆盖六个任务，训练约 3 小时、单 GPU；在匹配对比下图像指令优于文本条件，并支持无需退化标签的任务无关复原，文本变体不支持该能力。
Conclusion: 把文本 prompt 换成由退化图像导出的连续图像指令，可在单适配器、单卡预算内实现覆盖六任务的任务无关图像复原，且连续向量的可缩放性天然适配目标不唯一的复原任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The AI Neuroscientist: An Interactive Agentic Interface for Neuroimaging Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Analyzing neuroimaging data requires specialized coding and statistical expertise, which limits accessibility for researchers without computational backgrounds. We present the AI Neuroscientist, a language agent for interactive data exploration. The system integrates a large language model (LLM) with a neuroimaging toolset to perform quality control, modeling, and visualization. This allows researchers to query data quality and specify analysis parameters directly in natural language, providing a transparent and interactive alternative to conventional scripted pipelines for small-scale data exploration. We demonstrate these capabilities using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) data, and evaluate the agent on a custom fNIRS benchmarking suite against general-purpose LLM agents with code sandboxes. Future extensions will generalize the architecture to additional modalities, including functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data, and expand the benchmarking suite to additional fNIRS tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AI Neuroscientist 是一个把 LLM 与神经影像工具集（质控、建模、可视化）绑定的语言 agent，让无编程背景的研究者用自然语言查询数据质量并设定分析参数，替代脚本式 pipeline。在自建 fNIRS benchmarking suite 上，它与带代码沙箱的通用 LLM agent 对比以展示这些交互能力。
Motivation: 神经影像分析依赖专门的编程与统计能力，缺少计算背景的研究者难以进入，而常规脚本 pipeline 对小规模数据探索不够透明、交互性差。
Method: 语言 agent 架构：LLM 调用神经影像工具集执行 quality control、建模与可视化，用户以自然语言查询数据质量、指定分析参数；在自建 fNIRS benchmarking suite 上评测，对照组为带 code sandbox 的通用 LLM agent。
Result: 在自建 fNIRS benchmarking suite 上评测该 agent，对比对象是带代码沙箱的通用 LLM agent；演示基于 functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) 数据。
Conclusion: 自然语言驱动的 agent 界面可作为小规模神经影像数据探索的透明交互替代方案；作者计划把架构扩展到 fMRI 并扩充 fNIRS 任务集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric and Semantic Coupling for Interaction Understanding in 3D Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Interaction understanding in 3D scenes requires a joint description of movable parts, their motion, and the regions through which they can be operated. We present Segment-Snap, which connects these outputs through the physical relationship between parts and handles. Learned predictors identify broad part surfaces and small handles. A geometric decoder uses planar and upright priors to constrain motion, then selects hinge lines using predicted handle locations, without training a motion regressor. Conversely, a joint part-and-handle predictor supplies additional handle candidates, whose motion classes are refined using containing parts. Each information transfer is applied once, without iterative feedback. On Articulate3D validation, handle guidance raises motion-gated AP from 13.74% to 40.98% at fixed masks and axes. Additional handle candidates raise handle AP from 24.63% to 29.65%; part-based class correction adds 0.98 points, and full context reaches 30.99%. Repeated training, learned-decoder controls and paired visualizations establish the benefits and limitations of combining geometric and semantic evidence for interaction understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Segment-Snap 把 3D 场景中可动部件、运动与操作区域（handle）通过部件-把手的物理关系耦合起来：几何解码器用平面与竖直先验约束运动并据预测 handle 选铰链线，反向由联合部件-handle 预测器提供候选并用所属部件修正运动类别。在 Articulate3D 验证集上，handle 引导把 motion-gated AP 从 13.74% 提到 40.98%，完整上下文使 handle AP 达 30.99%。
Motivation: 3D 场景交互理解需要同时描述可动部件、运动及其操作区域，而部件与 handle 的几何、语义证据此前割裂，小 handle 与运动估计各自不准。
Method: 学习式预测器分别给出宽部件表面与小 handle；几何解码器用 planar/upright 先验约束运动、按 handle 位置选 hinge line，不训练运动回归器；反向由联合 part-and-handle 预测器补充 handle 候选并用包含部件细化运动类别，每次信息传递只做一次、无迭代反馈。
Result: Articulate3D 验证集上，固定 mask 与 axis 时 handle 引导使 motion-gated AP 从 13.74% 升至 40.98%；额外 handle 候选使 handle AP 从 24.63% 升至 29.65%，部件级类别修正再加 0.98 点，完整上下文达 30.99%。
Conclusion: 几何与语义证据的单次双向耦合即可显著抬高 3D 交互理解的运动与 handle 检测精度，作者以重复训练、学习式解码器对照与配对可视化界定其收益与边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Children Design and Reason about Trustworthy AI Chatbots
papers.abstract_en: Children increasingly interact with AI chatbots, making trust calibration essential to AI literacy. Prior research has examined children's trust in AI mainly as users evaluating systems built by others, rather than as designers of their own chatbots. We developed a chatbot-building environment with adjustable trust-relevant traits (e.g., confidence, transparency, formality, assertiveness), rules, and persona. We conducted mixed-methods study with 115 learners (ages 8-18) who made 119 chatbots. We examined how children configured their chatbots, reasoned about trustworthiness, and how closely chatbot behavior aligned with their designs. Younger students (age 10-13) set significantly higher confidence than older students (age 14-18), and some deliberately built chatbots that gave wrong answers on purpose, yet still called them trustworthy, arguing that a chatbot does what it was built to do. Younger students equated trust with purpose-fulfillment, while older students linked it to transparent, calibrated design. Students also calibrated academic chatbots to be more transparent and formal than hobby chatbots. We identify seven design dimensions describing what children believe makes a chatbot trustworthy, and discuss implications for AI literacy tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文让 115 名 8–18 岁学习者在可调 trust 相关特质（confidence、transparency、formality、assertiveness）、规则与 persona 的搭建环境中制作 119 个 chatbot，考察儿童如何配置并推理“可信”。10–13 岁显著把 confidence 设得比 14–18 岁更高；低龄组把可信等同于“完成既定用途”，甚至故意让 chatbot 答错仍称其可信，高龄组则把可信与透明、校准过的设计挂钩；学术类 chatbot 被调得比兴趣类更透明、更正式。
Motivation: 既往研究把儿童对 AI 的信任当作“使用他人系统时的用户”，而不是自己设计 chatbot 的设计者，缺少儿童如何把可信观念落到具体配置上的证据。
Method: 开发一个可调 trust 相关特质（confidence、transparency、formality、assertiveness）、规则与 persona 的 chatbot 搭建环境，对 115 名 8–18 岁学习者做 mixed-methods 研究，分析其配置选择、对 trustworthiness 的推理，以及 chatbot 实际行为与设计意图的吻合程度。
Result: 115 名学习者（8–18 岁）制作 119 个 chatbot；10–13 岁组设置的 confidence 显著高于 14–18 岁组；部分学生故意构建会给出错误答案却仍称其可信的 chatbot；学术类 chatbot 被校准得比兴趣类更透明、更正式；归纳出描述儿童所信 trustworthiness 的七个设计维度。
Conclusion: 儿童的可信判断随年龄从“是否完成用途”转向“透明且校准的设计”，AI 素养工具应据此按年龄段区分 trust 教学与搭建引导。

papers.title: Trains but Doesn't Learn: A Post-Training Delivery Benchmark for LLM Agents as Forward-Deployed Engineers
papers.abstract_en: Post-training is becoming a service (PTaaS): a customer hands an operator data and a goal, and a forward-deployed engineer (FDE) returns a fine-tuned, evaluated, and deployed model under a budget, a human-approval gate, and reproducibility requirements. Seating an LLM agent in the FDE seat raises a question existing benchmarks cannot answer: not whether an agent can raise a metric, but whether it can be trusted to deliver. We answer it on a governed delivery plane, where an agent drives ten stages and an oracle scores each stage from platform-recorded facts. The central silent failure is the run that trains but does not learn (TBDL): loss falls, every signal stays green, and the delivered model is no better than the base. An operator-run acceptance gate catches every such run before payment, and a detector calibrated on known-corrupted runs flags severe corruption mid-run. We ran four frontier agents (Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6-luna, Gemini 3.7 Flash, DeepSeek V4-Pro) end to end on metered L40S, A100, and H200 GPUs across 8B to 70B open bases, certifying every scenario before scoring. We also ran a human FDE arm under the same oracle and compare every agent against it.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 LLM agent 作为前线交付工程师 (FDE) 的后训练交付基准：在受治理的交付平面上让 agent 驱动十个阶段，由 oracle 依据平台记录事实逐阶段打分，核心捕捉「训练了但没学到 (TBDL)」这一静默失败——loss 下降、信号全绿，交付模型却不优于 base。运行中验收门在付费前拦下全部此类 run，基于已知污染 run 校准的检测器可在 run 中途标出严重污染。
Motivation: 后训练即服务 (PTaaS) 场景下，客户关心的不是 agent 能否抬高某个指标，而是能否在预算、人工审批门与可复现性约束下被信任地交付；现有基准回答不了这一问题。
Method: 在受治理的交付平面上让 agent 驱动十个阶段，oracle 从平台记录事实对每阶段打分；设置运行中验收门与在已知污染 run 上校准的腐败检测器，并在相同 oracle 下加入人类 FDE 对照组。
Result: 端到端运行四个前沿 agent（Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6-luna、Gemini 3.7 Flash、DeepSeek V4-Pro），在计量计费的 L40S、A100、H200 GPU 上覆盖 8B 到 70B 开源 base 模型，每个场景在打分前完成认证；运行中验收门在付费前捕获全部 TBDL run，检测器能在 run 中途标出严重腐败。
Conclusion: 交付可信度必须按阶段、以平台事实来判定，loss 与常规绿色信号不足以证明模型真的学到东西。

papers.title: Lean Pool: An AI-Maintained Archive of Formalized Mathematics
papers.abstract_en: Lean Pool is a repository of formalized mathematics. It is grown, maintained and optimized by AI agents.
papers.comment: 52 pages, 6 figures. Includes a catalogue of imported projects
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Lean Pool 是一个由 AI agent 负责增长、维护与优化的形式化数学仓库，把 Lean 形式化项目集中到一个可被 agent 持续管理的档案中。摘要仅给出这一定位与配套的已导入项目清单（catalogue of imported projects），未给出任何定量指标。
Motivation: 形式化数学项目分散在各自仓库中，缺少一个由 AI agent 统一维护与优化的共享档案层。
Method: 以 AI agent 作为仓库的增长、维护与优化执行者，管理形式化数学内容，并附带一份已导入项目的 catalogue。
Result: 提出 Lean Pool 这一 AI 维护的形式化数学档案仓库；arXiv comment 标注 52 pages、6 figures，并包含一份已导入项目清单。
Conclusion: 形式化数学档案可以交给 AI agent 做常态化的增长与维护，Lean Pool 是该形态的一个实例。

papers.title: Indirect tipping: a social attack surface in AI agent populations
papers.abstract_en: As generative AI agents are deployed at scale, safety will depend not only on technical safeguards and individual model design, but also on collective equilibria that determine how agent populations process information, prioritize actions, and respond to uncertainty. Yet the same equilibria that enable agents to coordinate also create a social attack surface. The standard framework to assess this vulnerability is critical mass dynamics: the minimum fraction of adversarial agents required to overturn an equilibrium through direct competition. Here, we show that this approach risks underestimating system vulnerability by reducing the problem to the identification of singular tipping points, and ignoring indirect but potentially more efficient routes through which collective behavior can be redirected. Through experiments with populations of LLM agents and an analytic framework that captures their collective dynamics at scale, we map critical-mass thresholds that define a directed, weighted topology over the space of coordination equilibria, and treat this topology as a navigable landscape. We show that indirect tipping through intermediate stepping-stone equilibria can reduce the committed minority required to reach an alternative state, bypass majority requirements, and make possible transitions inaccessible through direct challenges. The diversity of available alternatives and timing of the attack further reshape this landscape, creating opportunities for control as well as risks of unintended destabilization. These results show that an equilibrium's resistance to committed intervention is not an intrinsic property but a structural feature of its competitive relations with alternative states. Securing populations of interacting AI agents therefore requires mapping this social landscape alongside individual agent capabilities and the technical channels through which they interact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出评估 LLM agent 群体被对抗者颠覆的主流框架 critical mass dynamics 只找单一 tipping point，会低估脆弱性；通过经由中间 stepping-stone equilibrium 的间接 tipping，达到目标状态所需的 committed minority 比直接对抗更少，还能绕过多数派要求、实现直接挑战无法触及的转变。作者主张均衡对 committed 干预的抵抗力不是内在属性，而是由其与其他备选状态的竞争关系决定的结构性特征。
Motivation: 生成式 AI agent 大规模部署时的安全性取决于群体层面的 collective equilibria，而现有 critical mass 框架把问题简化为找单个 tipping point，忽略了更高效的间接改道路径，从而低估系统脆弱性。
Method: 用 LLM agent 群体实验加上可扩展的解析框架刻画集体动力学，标定 critical-mass 阈值并把它们组织成定义在 coordination equilibria 空间上的有向加权拓扑，再把该拓扑当作可导航的 landscape 来搜索间接路径；同时考察可用备选状态的多样性与攻击时机如何重塑该 landscape。
Result: 经由中间 stepping-stone equilibria 的间接 tipping 可降低达到目标状态所需的 committed minority，绕过多数派要求，并使直接挑战无法实现的状态转变成为可能；备选状态的多样性与攻击时机会进一步重塑这一 landscape，既带来控制机会也带来非预期失稳风险。
Conclusion: 均衡对 committed 干预的抵抗力是其与其他备选状态竞争关系的结构性产物而非内在属性，因此保护相互交互的 AI agent 群体必须同时测绘这张社会 landscape、单体能力以及它们交互的技术通道。

papers.title: GroundedGEO: Auditing the Evidence Gap in Generative Search Rankings
papers.abstract_en: Generative search systems rank products and services for consequential decisions, and publishers can cheaply make candidate text look relevant. Yet evidence status is not a text property but a claim-evidence relation: text-only rankers and defenses cannot separate honest detailed content from fabricated detail, creating an identifiability gap. We audit this gap with an evidence-paired benchmark (50 e-commerce queries, 1,950 cases) and a claim-level reranker, GroundedGEO, that penalizes query-relevant claims lacking support in a supplied packet. Matched rich variants control format and volume; packet twins add attestations at fixed text, while thinned packets withdraw them. On the frozen listwise ranker Qwen2.5-7B, unsupported-rich variants show significant normalized rank gain over clean candidates (+0.065 to +0.092 across claim profiles, Holm-corrected), while supported and neutral controls do not; the effect is model-dependent (marginal on MiMo-v2.5, absent on GLM-5.3-Flash). On a frozen pointwise scorer, oracle evidence labels cut the unsupported-rich top-3 rate from 0.65 to 0.43 (laundering from 0.61 to 0.39) at lambda=40 with zero false suppression; packet twins restore the original rates without changing text. Against a 370-claim human gold, all tested automatic judges fail the preregistered reliability gate, although the best local judge retains 79-100% of oracle suppression with zero measured false suppression on protected arms. Separately, stripping attestation coverage increases false suppression by 0.307. These diagnostic effects identify two limits on the evidence channel: label quality and packet coverage. They do not validate an automatic defense, and interpretation of the adverse human-gold arm remains pending adjudication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GroundedGEO 用证据配对基准审计生成式搜索排序中的证据缺口：文本侧排序器无法区分诚实详述与捏造细节。在冻结的 listwise 排序器 Qwen2.5-7B 上，无支撑富文本变体相对干净候选获得 +0.065 到 +0.092 的显著归一化排名增益（Holm 校正），而有支撑与中性对照无此增益；作者据此判定证据通道的两个限制是标签质量与 packet 覆盖率，并明确该诊断不构成对自动防御的验证。
Motivation: 生成式搜索为 consequential 决策排序商品与服务，发布者可廉价让候选文本显得相关；证据状态是 claim-evidence 关系而非文本属性，纯文本排序器与防御无法区分诚实详述和捏造细节，形成可识别性缺口。
Method: 构建证据配对基准：50 个电商查询、1,950 个案例，含 matched rich 变体（控制格式与体量）、packet twins（文本固定、加入 attestation）与 thinned packets（撤除 attestation）；提出 claim 级重排器 GroundedGEO，惩罚在给定 packet 中缺乏支撑的 query 相关 claim；在冻结的 listwise 排序器 Qwen2.5-7B 与 pointwise 打分器上测试，并对照 370-claim 人工金标准。
Result: Qwen2.5-7B 上无支撑富文本变体归一化排名增益 +0.065 到 +0.092（Holm 校正显著），有支撑与中性对照无增益；效应依模型而异（MiMo-v2.5 上边缘显著，GLM-5.3-Flash 上消失）。冻结 pointwise 打分器上，oracle 证据标签在 lambda=40 时把无支撑富文本 top-3 率从 0.65 降到 0.43（laundering 从 0.61 降到 0.39），零误抑制；packet twins 在不改文本的情况下恢复原比率。对 370-claim 人工金标准，所有自动评判器未通过预注册可靠性门槛，最佳本地评判器保留 oracle 抑制量的 79-100% 且受保护臂零误抑制；剥离 attestation 覆盖使误抑制增加 0.307。
Conclusion: 证据通道的瓶颈是标签质量与 packet 覆盖率，而非排序器文本侧能力；这些诊断效应不验证任何自动防御，人工金标准不利臂的解释仍待 adjudication。

papers.title: X-Planner: Event-Structured Task Planning for Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Task planning bridges high-level instructions and executable behavior in long-horizon manipulation, yet modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems often leave this intermediate structure implicit. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) planners also tend to rely on coarse task-level annotations or serialize long reasoning traces token by token. We present X-Planner, a planning front-end that addresses both the supervision and representation of embodied reasoning. Our planning data combine Ego, UMI, and teleoperation under a hierarchy granularity with source-dependent annotation depth. Takeover-time annotations and human-designed failures supervise ongoing error recognition. On the model side, a shared VLM backbone exposes two event-structured plan forms: a discrete interface that emits interpretable event states and a latent interface that relays continuous CoT states across staggered Transformer depths through Staircase Decoding. A frozen latent-to-text reconstruction objective provides a semantic anchor for the latent representation. Offline two-step planning evaluation places X-Planner second among four evaluated models on both BERTScore-F1 and a judge-based Overall score. In real-robot experiments, respectively, outperforming the evaluated baselines. These results characterize planning-text quality and downstream execution.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: From Pattern Recognizers to Personalized Companions: A Survey of Large Language Models in Mental Health
papers.abstract_en: The rising global prevalence of mental health conditions, together with longstanding barriers in traditional healthcare, such as limited resources, high cost, stigma, and privacy concerns, has created an urgent need for accessible and scalable support. Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a transformative technology with strong potential to democratize mental health support through advanced natural language understanding and generation. However, the rapidly expanding, fragmented body of work in this area lacks a coherent evolutionary narrative, making it difficult to contextualize current progress and identify future directions. This survey addresses this gap by organizing and analyzing the literature around a central thesis: the role of LLMs in mental health is evolving through three distinct, increasingly sophisticated phases. We trace this trajectory from Phase I, in which LLMs act primarily as passive Information Tools and Pattern Recognizers for assessment; through Phase II, where they function as Empathetic Conversationalists for in-the-moment, stateless interactions; to the current frontier, Phase III, which seeks Longitudinal, Personalized Companions implemented as stateful cognitive agents. To support this framework, we systematically review core technologies, agent architectures (Profile, Memory, Reasoning, and Planning), and the critical infrastructure of datasets and benchmarks, highlighting how their evolution underpins this developmental path. Viewing the field through this developmental lens, we provide a comprehensive synthesis of existing work, an insightful narrative of its trajectory, and a clear roadmap for future innovation in responsible, effective, and human-centered AI for mental healthcare. A curated collection of the resources reviewed in this survey is available at our project repository: https://github.com/Emo-gml/Awesome-Mental-Health-LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该综述把 LLM 在心理健康中的角色演进归纳为三个阶段：Phase I 作为被动的信息工具与模式识别器用于评估，Phase II 作为无状态的共情对话者做即时交互，Phase III 转向有状态认知智能体实现的纵向个性化陪伴。围绕 Profile、Memory、Reasoning、Planning 四类智能体架构与数据集/基准设施系统梳理文献，并给出负责任、有效、以人为中心的心理健康 AI 路线图。
Motivation: LLM 心理健康研究增长快但碎片化，缺少统一的演进叙事，难以定位当前进展与未来方向；同时传统医疗存在资源有限、成本高、污名与隐私等长期障碍。
Method: 以三阶段演进为中心论点做系统综述：梳理核心技术、智能体架构（Profile、Memory、Reasoning、Planning），以及数据集与基准这一关键基础设施，并维护 Awesome-Mental-Health-LLMs 资源仓库。
Result: 提出并论证三阶段框架（Information Tools/Pattern Recognizers → Empathetic Conversationalists → Longitudinal Personalized Companions 作为 stateful cognitive agents），产出对现有工作的综合、轨迹叙事与未来创新路线图。
Conclusion: LLM 在心理健康中的角色正从无状态的评估与对话工具转向有状态、纵向的个性化陪伴智能体，其演进由架构与数据/基准设施的进步共同支撑。

papers.title: Multi-Term Fourier Graph Neural Network with Sample Relationship Learning for Enhanced Remaining Useful Life Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the remaining useful life (RUL) is essential for effective predictive maintenance. Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks (ST-GNNs), which can model both temporal and spatial relationships by representing time series data as a sequence of graphs, have shown exceptional performance in RUL prediction. However, current ST-GNNs face several drawbacks. First, they require domain expertise or significant computational power to establish graph structures prior to deploying GNNs. Second, the models are restricted to capture temporal dependencies within a predefined fixed-size lookback window. This restriction ignores the common issue of varying time series lengths, leading the prediction model to miss short-term or long-term dependencies. Finally, conventional models often fail to capture the inherent relationships between samples generated from adjacent time windows, which are crucial for improving both the accuracy and robustness of predictions. To address the aforementioned issues, we introduce a novel framework called Multi-Term Fourier Graph Neural Network with Sample Relationship Learning (MTFGN-SRL). Rather than treating the sample as a sequence of graphs, we consider it as a single complete graph and utilize a Fourier Graph Neural Network (FGN) to capture the spatio-temporal information in the frequency domain. We propose a multi-term learning module that utilizes multiple lookback windows to generate samples with varying terms, which are then fed into the FGN to enhance the extraction of useful information from the data. Finally, we develop a sample relationship learning module by training a heterogeneous GNN to identify inter-sample relationships, resulting in enhanced accuracy and robustness in predictions. Evaluations on the CMAPSS dataset demonstrate MTFGN-SRL's superior performance over state-of-the-art methods in RUL prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MTFGN-SRL：把样本视为单张完整图，用 Fourier Graph Neural Network 在频域抓时空信息，多回看窗口的 multi-term 模块生成不同长度项，再用异构 GNN 学样本间关系。在 CMAPSS 上评估，RUL 预测性能优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有 ST-GNN 做 RUL 预测需先验图结构或大量算力，且被固定回看窗口限制，抓不住变长序列的长短程依赖，也忽略相邻时间窗样本间的关系。
Method: MTFGN-SRL 将样本建为单张完整图而非图序列，用 Fourier Graph Neural Network 在频域提取时空信息；multi-term learning 模块用多个 lookback window 生成不同项的样本喂给 FGN；sample relationship learning 模块训练异构 GNN 识别样本间关系。
Result: 在 CMAPSS 数据集上的评估显示，MTFGN-SRL 在 RUL 预测上性能优于 state-of-the-art 方法。
Conclusion: 把样本当完整图并在频域建模、配合多窗口与样本关系学习，可提升 RUL 预测的准确性与鲁棒性。

papers.title: Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime: Towards Reliable Agentic Voice Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Real-time voice assistants must reason over evolving requests, execute actions, and follow conversational rules. Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime brings these requirements together through Think, Act, and Speak and Coordinate. Think combines Core-Cocktail supervised fine-tuning with Multimodality and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (M$^{2}$-OPD) to transfer language capabilities and develop native audio skills. Act uses self-evolving executable environments and multi-granularity rollouts for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), teaching the model to use tools, interpret feedback, and complete tasks. Speak and Coordinate aligns how, when, and whether the assistant speaks or acts. We evaluate audio reasoning, multilingual understanding, tool use, conversational behavior, full-duplex interaction, and safety. Compared with Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime, 3.1 raises overall task success from 78.4% to 82.0% on our half-duplex speech-to-text adaptation of $τ$-Voice. On speech-to-speech Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5, the response rate to background speech falls from 73.0% to 13.0%. We also present a separate Voice Harness prototype, using Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime as its foreground, that extends spoken interaction to persistent tasks through foreground--background coordination and memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime 用 Think（Core-Cocktail SFT + M²-OPD 多教师在线蒸馏）、Act（自演化可执行环境 + 多粒度 rollout 上的 GRPO）、Speak and Coordinate 三段把语言能力、工具调用与说话时机对齐到实时语音助手。相对 Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime，半双工 τ-Voice 语音转写改编上的总体任务成功率从 78.4% 升到 82.0%，Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5 上对背景语音的响应率从 73.0% 降到 13.0%。
Motivation: 实时语音助手要在请求持续演化的同时推理、执行动作并遵守对话规则，难点在于工具使用、反馈解读与何时开口/何时行动的协调。
Method: Think 阶段用 Core-Cocktail 监督微调配合 Multimodality and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation（M²-OPD）迁移语言能力并培养原生音频技能；Act 阶段在自演化可执行环境与多粒度 rollout 上用 GRPO 训练工具调用与反馈解读；Speak and Coordinate 对齐说话与行动的方式、时机与是否执行。评测覆盖音频推理、多语言理解、工具使用、对话行为、全双工交互与安全。
Result: 在半双工 τ-Voice 语音转写改编上，总体任务成功率由 Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime 的 78.4% 升至 82.0%；在语音到语音 Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5 上，对背景语音的响应率由 73.0% 降至 13.0%。另给出以 Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime 为前台的 Voice Harness 原型，通过前后台协调与记忆把口语交互扩展到持久任务。
Conclusion: 把能力迁移、工具执行与说话时机拆成三段分别训练，可在保持任务成功率提升的同时大幅压低对背景语音的误响应，使语音助手更可靠地全双工交互。

papers.title: Mitigating Sequential Reappearance in Diffusion Data-Point Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion data-point unlearning is typically evaluated immediately after each deletion, even though subsequent requests may repeatedly update the same model. We identify sequential reappearance, a failure mode in which an instance that is initially judged to be forgotten later returns to the memorized regime without reuse of the deleted data or adversarial fine-tuning. To capture this behavior, we introduce a target-level evaluation protocol that tracks whether each target is forgotten immediately, remains forgotten at the end of the sequence, or reappears during subsequent deletions. We further find that targets that later reappear exhibit sharper local denoising-loss geometry after deletion than targets that remain forgotten.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指出扩散模型数据点遗忘 (diffusion data-point unlearning) 存在顺序复现 (sequential reappearance)：某条数据删除后先被判为已遗忘，却在后续对其他数据的删除过程中重新回到被记忆状态，且不复用被删数据、也不做对抗性微调。提出目标级评估协议，把每个目标分为立即遗忘、序列结束仍遗忘、后续删除中复现三类；复现目标在删除后的局部去噪损失几何比持续遗忘目标更尖锐。
Motivation: 扩散数据点遗忘通常只在每次删除后立刻评测，而真实使用中同一模型会被连续多次删除请求更新，删除效果可能随序列推移失效。
Method: 提出目标级评估协议，对每个删除目标追踪三种终态：立即被遗忘、序列结束仍被遗忘、在后续删除中复现；并比较复现目标与持续遗忘目标在删除后的局部去噪损失 (denoising loss) 几何。
Result: 识别出顺序复现这一失败模式：实例在无被删数据复用、无对抗性微调的条件下重新进入 memorized regime；后续复现的目标在删除后呈现比持续遗忘目标更尖锐的局部去噪损失几何。
Conclusion: 只在删除后立即评测会漏掉遗忘效果随后续删除序列回退的情况，删除后局部去噪损失的尖锐程度可作为复现风险的信号。

papers.title: Ovis-Embedding: Pushing the Frontiers of Universal Omni-Modal Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: In this report, we introduce \textbf{Ovis-Embedding}, a state-of-the-art omni-modal embedding family built on native integration of text, image, video, and audio. Instead of assembling separate modality towers, Ovis-Embedding uses a shared multimodal backbone to encode different modalities in a common representation space. Specifically, we make \textbf{three key advances}: (1) \textbf{native omni-modal initialization}: we adopt a pretrained Qwen-omni model as the embedding backbone and adapt it through contrastive training with low-rank initialization; (2) \textbf{data-centric omni-modal training}: we construct a broad, high-quality corpus spanning text, images, video, audio, and interleaved multimodal data. To improve data efficiency, we introduce homogeneous-source sampling to form task-consistent batches with informative in-batch negatives; and (3) \textbf{embedding-specific training and inference optimization}: we use focal loss to emphasize hard examples and similarity-based Embedding Distillation to transfer fine-grained similarity structure from complementary experts. At inference time, low-rank feature decomposition enables compact embeddings with flexible dimensionality and minimal performance loss. Empirical evaluations show that the \textbf{Ovis-Embedding} family achieves state-of-the-art performance on \textbf{MMEB-v3}, \textbf{MMEB-v2}, \textbf{MVEB}, \textbf{MAEB}, and \textbf{RTEB}, demonstrating its effectiveness across text, image, video, and audio modalities. These results highlight the potential of unified omni-modal training to overcome modality fragmentation and advance universal embedding models for any-to-any retrieval.

Motivation: 多模态嵌入普遍靠各模态独立塔拼装，导致表示碎片化，难以支撑 any-to-any 检索的统一嵌入模型。

Conclusion: 统一的 omni-modal 训练能克服模态碎片化，是通向 any-to-any 检索的通用嵌入模型的有效路径。

papers.title: Learning Neural Feedback Linearization for Data-driven Systems via Augmented Lagrangian
papers.abstract_en: The paper proposes a novel data-driven framework for designing and training a feedback linearizing controller by explicitly incorporating relative degree based conditions into the learning process. This enables the conventional feedback controller components to be replaced by neural Lie derivatives, thereby facilitating a fully data-driven feedback linearization framework. Furthermore, practical closed-loop stability is established by deriving sufficient conditions under which bounded identification errors lead to bounded tracking errors. The derived theoretical results are validated through their application to an armature controlled DC motor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出数据驱动的神经反馈线性化 (neural feedback linearization) 框架，把相对阶 (relative degree) 条件显式写进训练过程，用神经 Lie 导数替代传统反馈控制器组件，并通过增广 Lagrangian 方式训练。推导出有界辨识误差导致有界跟踪误差的充分条件，理论结果在电枢控制直流电机上得到验证。
Motivation: 数据驱动系统的反馈线性化需要满足相对阶等结构条件，传统构造依赖已知模型，如何在学习过程中显式保证这些条件并给出闭环稳定性是缺口。
Method: 在训练中显式纳入基于相对阶的条件，用神经 Lie 导数 (neural Lie derivatives) 替换常规反馈控制器组件，构成完全数据驱动的反馈线性化框架；由增广 Lagrangian (augmented Lagrangian) 训练，并推导有界辨识误差下跟踪误差有界的实用闭环稳定性充分条件。
Result: 推导出有界辨识误差导致有界跟踪误差的充分条件，并将该理论结果应用于电枢控制 DC motor (armature controlled DC motor) 进行验证。
Conclusion: 把相对阶条件嵌入学习过程即可在数据驱动设定下实现反馈线性化，并使闭环跟踪误差在辨识误差有界时保持有界。

papers.title: Empirical Auditing of Edge-Private Graph Generators
papers.abstract_en: We empirically audit privacy leakage by testing whether outputs from edge-neighbouring inputs remain distinguishable, using statistically valid lower bounds on the privacy loss witnessed by our attacks. Our framework compares direct-edge, local-structural, and GNN-based attacks through the geometry surrounding a target edge. Experiments across two generators and two networks show that privacy leakage is both mechanism- and network-dependent, with learned representations revealing information not captured by conventional local statistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对边缘私有图生成器做实证隐私审计：以统计有效的隐私损失下界衡量攻击能否区分边缘相邻输入的输出，比较 direct-edge、local-structural 与基于 GNN 的三类攻击。跨两个生成器与两个网络的实验显示，隐私泄露取决于具体机制与网络结构，且学到的表示泄露了传统局部统计量捕捉不到的信息。
Motivation: 边缘差分隐私图生成器的隐私泄露程度缺少可检验的实证刻画，需要判断相邻输入输出是否真的可区分，并区分不同攻击与表示所揭示的泄露。
Method: 框架围绕目标边的邻域几何构造三类攻击（direct-edge、local-structural、GNN-based），对每次攻击给出统计有效的隐私损失下界，用以判定边缘相邻输入的输出是否可区分。
Result: 在两个生成器与两个网络上的实验表明，隐私泄露是机制依赖且网络依赖的；基于学习表示的攻击揭示了传统局部统计量未捕捉的信息。
Conclusion: 边缘私有图生成器的实际泄露不能由局部统计量或单一机制推断，须按具体生成机制与网络结构分别审计，并用统计有效的下界来见证。

papers.title: Benchmarking Neural Defend ARCAS 1B: A Foundational Multimodal Deepfake Detection Model
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated imagery evolves faster than benchmark-specific detector evaluations, making a single score an incomplete account of generalization. This paper evaluates Neural Defend ARCAS 1B across benchmark families without benchmark-specific parameter updates. We retain native aggregation and supplement it with record-level measures, coverage accounting, and subgroup diagnostics. Each Results subsection identifies the release and evaluation population, reports the official metric, and describes observed error patterns. A combined analysis synthesizes shared patterns while preserving the distinction between native and pooled quantities. Cross-paper comparisons are restricted to aligned evidence; differences in release, population, preprocessing, training, or benchmark exposure are context rather than rank. The findings characterize performance on evaluated records, not universal reliability, calibration, attribution, or future adaptive attacks. By keeping benchmark-native outcomes distinct from pooled summaries, the study makes test-population, class-balance, and missing-record-coverage differences visible. It supports interpretation of detector results in research, platform-safety, and forensic-review settings, foregrounding traceable protocol conditions over claims or leaderboard comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对多模态 deepfake 检测基础模型 Neural Defend ARCAS 1B 做跨 benchmark 家族评测，且不做任何 benchmark 专用参数更新；保留各 benchmark 原生聚合指标，并补充记录级度量、覆盖率核算与子群诊断。结论是单一分数不足以刻画泛化，跨论文比较只在证据对齐时进行，结果只代表被评测记录而非普适可靠性。
Motivation: AI 生成图像的演化快于 benchmark 专用的检测器评测，单一分数无法完整反映泛化，且不同 release、评测人群与预处理条件混在一起时排行榜式比较会失真。
Method: 在不更新参数的前提下评测 ARCAS 1B；保留 benchmark 原生聚合方式，另加记录级度量、缺失记录覆盖率核算与子群诊断；每个结果小节标明 release、评测人群与官方指标，合并分析时区分原生量与汇总量，跨论文比较仅限对齐证据。
Result: 给出跨 benchmark 家族的评测协议与结果组织方式：各小节报告官方指标与观测到的错误模式，合并分析综合共享模式并保持原生量与汇总量的区分，使测试人群、类别平衡与缺失记录覆盖差异可见。
Conclusion: 检测器结果应归因于可追溯的协议条件（release、人群、预处理、benchmark 暴露），其刻画的是被评测记录上的表现，而非普适可靠性、校验性、归因能力或对未来自适应攻击的抵抗。

papers.title: Exposing Blind Spots in Deep Imbalanced Regression Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Deep Imbalanced Regression (DIR) addresses a common failure mode of regression models: target distributions are highly non-uniform, causing models to perform best in densely populated target regions even when reliable performance is required across the full target range. Despite rapid methodological progress, DIR evaluation remains constrained by three blind spots: it is dominated by image-based benchmarks, its standard many-/medium-/few-shot protocol is diagnostic but not decision-complete, and tail-region stability across random seeds has not been systematically evaluated. We revisit DIR evaluation along these three axes. First, we broaden the data domain by evaluating DIR on a multimodal virtual sensing benchmark (\textsc{MuViS}) with nine time-series extrinsic regression tasks across six physical domains, where rare target values often correspond to operationally meaningful regimes. Second, we adopt balanced MAE (\emph{bMAE}) and introduce balanced Mean Absolute Scaled Error (\emph{bMASE}), a scale-normalized metric for decision-complete comparison across methods and datasets. Third, through a repeated reevaluation of six representative DIR methods across multiple random seeds, we show that the tail regions targeted by DIR exhibit particularly high sensitivity to seed-level variability. Our results show that standard virtual-sensing models exhibit substantial tail degradation hidden by global MAE, that existing DIR methods can improve balanced performance but transfer unevenly to multimodal time-series data, and that tail-region instability remains a largely hidden failure mode under current DIR evaluation practice. Together, these findings and our publicly available code provide a reproducible basis for future DIR research toward regression systems that capture rare target regimes as reliably as common ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指出深度不平衡回归 (DIR) 评测的三个盲点：过度依赖图像基准、many-/medium-/few-shot 协议只诊断不决策、尾部区域跨随机种子稳定性从未被系统评估。在多模态虚拟传感基准 MuViS 的九个时序外感回归任务上，用平衡指标 bMAE 与新提出的尺度归一化 bMASE 复评六个代表性 DIR 方法，发现全局 MAE 掩盖了虚拟传感模型的显著尾部退化，且尾部对种子变异高度敏感。
Motivation: DIR 方法虽进展快，但评测被图像基准主导，标准 many-/medium-/few-shot 协议只具诊断性而无法支撑方法选择，尾部区域跨种子稳定性也从未被系统评估，导致稀有目标区间的真实失败被掩盖。
Method: 在多模态虚拟传感基准 MuViS 上评测，覆盖六个物理领域、九个时序外感回归任务；采用 balanced MAE (bMAE)，并提出尺度归一化的 balanced Mean Absolute Scaled Error (bMASE) 以实现跨方法跨数据集的决策完备比较；对六个代表性 DIR 方法做多种随机种子下的重复复评。
Result: 标准虚拟传感模型表现出被全局 MAE 掩盖的显著尾部退化；现有 DIR 方法能改善平衡性能，但向多模态时序数据的迁移不均匀；尾部区域对种子级变异高度敏感，是当前 DIR 评测实践下 largely hidden 的失败模式。
Conclusion: 当前 DIR 评测会系统性低估尾部不稳定这一失败模式，需要用 bMAE/bMASE 这类决策完备指标加多种子复评，才能让回归系统对稀有目标区间与常见区间一样可靠；作者公开了可复现代码。

papers.title: Towards Sustainable Magnetic Resonance Imaging: Insights from long-term, high-resolution energy recordings across an entire scanner fleet
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is among the most energy-intensive diagnostic modalities in healthcare, yet its energy consumption and the factors influencing it remain insufficiently understood. This study aims to establish a comprehensive baseline of MRI energy consumption by characterizing energy demand across a scanner fleet, examining scanner utilization and operating patterns in clinical practice. Concurrently, it investigates the relationships between energy consumption and relevant operational and acquisition features. On average, a single MRI measurement consumed 0.43 kWh, while a complete examination consumed 13.50 kWh. In general, substantial differences in energy consumption were observed between MRI scanners and their corresponding operating modes (scan, idle, and eco-power mode). These variations may be related to differences in scanner operating patterns, employed examination protocols, and their resulting acquisition parameters. Idle and eco-power modes accounted for more cumulative energy consumption than active scanning. However, these energy shares should always be interpreted in relation to scanner occupancy, as utilization patterns strongly influence the distribution of energy across those operating modes. Lastly, linear regression analysis showed that energy consumption was more strongly associated with scan duration than with average power, suggesting that scan duration may be an important factor influencing MRI energy consumption. ...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对整支 MRI 机队做长期高分辨率能耗记录，给出单次测量平均 0.43 kWh、单次完整检查 13.50 kWh 的基线，并发现 idle 与 eco-power 模式的累计能耗超过主动扫描，线性回归显示能耗与扫描时长的关联强于与平均功率的关联。
Motivation: MRI 是医疗中最耗能的影像检查之一，但其能耗水平及影响因素在临床实践中缺乏系统基线。
Method: 在整支扫描仪机队上采集长期高分辨率能耗记录，按 scan、idle、eco-power 三种运行模式拆分能耗份额并结合占用率解读，再用线性回归分析能耗与扫描时长、平均功率等运行与采集特征的关系。
Result: 单次 MRI 测量平均能耗 0.43 kWh，单次完整检查 13.50 kWh；不同扫描仪与运行模式之间能耗差异显著；idle 与 eco-power 模式的累计能耗高于主动扫描；线性回归显示能耗与扫描时长的关联强于与平均功率的关联。
Conclusion: 扫描时长是影响 MRI 能耗的重要因素，评估各运行模式的能耗份额必须结合扫描仪占用率，否则会被利用率模式误导。

papers.title: Dual-GNN Multilevel Coarsening for Maximum Independent Set
papers.abstract_en: Solving large-scale instances of the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) exactly is computationally expensive. Researchers often employ graph sparsification methods to improve computational efficiency. Traditional sparsification methods typically rely on fixed heuristics and fail to fully exploit instance-specific structural information. In this paper, we propose Graph Edge Sparsification (GES), a learning-based sparsification approach for Euclidean TSP. By incorporating geometric structural information and combinatorial optimization technology, our proposed method adaptively generates a sparsification graph for different instances, significantly reducing the graph size and accelerating the solving process. Experimental results demonstrate that our sparsification method can prune up to 95\% of edges on the MATILDA dataset, while keeping the solution gap within 1\% of the optimal value. Moreover, our approach exhibits strong generalization capability on the TSPLIB benchmark.In some large-scale instances, the pruning rate exceeds 99\%, while the optimality gap remains below 1\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向欧氏 TSP 的学习式图稀疏化方法 Graph Edge Sparsification (GES)，按实例几何结构与组合优化信息自适应生成稀疏图，替代固定启发式剪边。在 MATILDA 数据集上最多剪掉 95% 的边且解与最优值差距保持在 1% 以内，TSPLIB 上部分大规模实例剪枝率超过 99%、最优性差距仍低于 1%。
Motivation: 大规模 TSP 精确求解开销高，常用图稀疏化降本，但传统方法依赖固定启发式，无法利用实例自身的结构信息。
Method: GES 将几何结构信息与组合优化技术结合，为每个实例自适应地生成稀疏化图，从而缩小图规模、加速求解；在 MATILDA 数据集与 TSPLIB 基准上做实验。
Result: MATILDA 数据集上最多剪掉 95% 的边，解与最优值的差距保持在 1% 以内；TSPLIB 基准上部分大规模实例剪枝率超过 99%，最优性差距仍低于 1%。
Conclusion: 学习式、实例自适应的图稀疏化可以在极低剪枝代价下大幅压缩 TSP 图规模，且对 TSPLIB 表现出强泛化能力。

papers.title: Brain-Inspired Hierarchical Modularity for General Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning, the ability to learn from sequential experience while retaining and adapting prior knowledge, is central to intelligent systems operating in changing environments. However, conventional continual learning is typically studied with offline task-wise training and clear task boundaries, leaving a substantial gap from general continual learning under online, uncertain, and evolving data streams. In this regime, intelligent systems must separate conflicting experience to reduce interference while integrating compatible experience to promote generalization. Inspired by the organization of the Drosophila learning and memory system, we identify a hierarchical modular principle that coordinates both functions through expert specialization and ensemble integration. We instantiate this principle as lightweight modular adaptation of pretrained foundation models, combining brain-inspired random expansion for expert routing and diversified modular integration across spatial and temporal scales. Across visual recognition, vision-language understanding, ego-exo video understanding, and embodied vision-language-action learning, our method consistently improves learning under online and uncertain data streams, with gains exceeding 50 percentage points over replay-free alternatives in embodied manipulation. These findings support hierarchical modularity as a biologically grounded path for learning from dynamic experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 受果蝇学习与记忆系统的层级模块化组织启发，把持续学习 (continual learning) 实现为对预训练基础模型的轻量模块化自适应：用脑启发随机扩展做专家路由，再在空间与时间尺度上做多样化模块集成，从而分离冲突经验、整合相容经验。在在线且不确定的数据流上，视觉识别、视觉语言理解、ego-exo 视频理解与具身视觉语言动作学习均一致提升，具身操作中相对无回放 (replay-free) 替代方法增益超过 50 个百分点。
Motivation: 常规持续学习依赖离线按任务训练且任务边界清晰，与在线、不确定、持续演化的数据流下的通用持续学习存在明显差距；后者要求系统既减少冲突经验间的干扰，又整合相容经验以促进泛化。
Method: 以果蝇学习与记忆系统的层级模块化原则为蓝本，将其落地为预训练基础模型的轻量模块化自适应：脑启发随机扩展 (random expansion) 负责专家路由，多样化模块集成 (diversified modular integration) 跨空间与时间尺度聚合专家，协调干扰抑制与泛化两个功能。
Result: 在视觉识别、视觉语言理解、ego-exo 视频理解与具身视觉语言动作学习四类任务的在线不确定数据流上，方法均带来一致的学习提升；在具身操作 (embodied manipulation) 中相对无回放替代方法的增益超过 50 个百分点。
Conclusion: 层级模块化 (hierarchical modularity) 是一条有生物学依据的路径，能让系统从动态经验中学习，同时分离冲突经验并整合相容经验。

papers.title: Variational objectives for amortized Bayesian inference in inverse problems: The role of posterior conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) offer an efficient approach to amortized Bayesian inference for inverse problems, but posterior accuracy can depend strongly on the choice of variational regularization, particularly when the inverse problem contains weakly identified parameter directions. This study investigates three objectives: a reverse Kullback--Leibler formulation (VAE-KL), an asymmetric Jensen--Shannon formulation (VAE-JS), and a Jensen--Shannon--Wasserstein formulation (VAE-JSWA), which replaces the reverse Kullback--Leibler regularizer with the squared 2-Wasserstein distance while retaining forward-Kullback--Leibler posterior supervision. A full-covariance Gaussian encoder and a pre-trained physics-based surrogate are used for amortized posterior inference. A local linear--Gaussian analysis in the generalized Fisher basis is developed to characterize the variance-dependent gradients of the three objectives. The formulations are first evaluated using linear--Gaussian benchmarks with known posterior solutions and subsequently tested on nonlinear physics-based inverse problems, including an inverse problem governed by a linear ODE and two PDE-constrained problems. VAE-KL performs slightly better than the other formulations in the well-conditioned benchmark, where all three approaches yield comparable posterior approximations, whereas VAE-JSWA provides substantially lower posterior errors in the strongly ill-conditioned benchmark. The nonlinear physics-based problems exhibit a similar conditioning-dependent trend, with JS-based formulations providing greater benefit as posterior ill-conditioning increases. These results indicate that posterior conditioning is an important factor in selecting variational objectives and motivate geometry-adaptive variational inference for Bayesian inverse problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 比较三种 VAE 变分目标在贝叶斯反问题中的后验精度：reverse KL（VAE-KL）、非对称 Jensen-Shannon（VAE-JS）以及用平方 2-Wasserstein 距离替换 reverse KL 正则、保留 forward-KL 后验监督的 VAE-JSWA。良态基准上三者相当、VAE-KL 略优；强病态基准上 VAE-JSWA 后验误差显著更低，且非线性物理反问题随病态程度加重，JS 类目标收益更大。
Motivation: VAE 做摊销贝叶斯反问题时，后验精度强烈依赖变分正则的选择，尤其当反问题存在弱可辨识参数方向（后验病态）时，reverse KL 容易失真。
Method: 用全协方差高斯编码器加预训练物理代理 (pre-trained physics-based surrogate) 做摊销后验推断；在广义 Fisher 基下做局部线性-高斯分析，刻画三个目标随方差变化的梯度；先在有解析后验的线性-高斯基准上评估，再上到非线性物理反问题，包括一个线性 ODE 反问题和两个 PDE 约束问题。
Result: 良态基准上三者后验近似相当、VAE-KL 略优于其余两者；强病态基准上 VAE-JSWA 后验误差显著更低；非线性物理问题呈同样的条件数依赖趋势，后验越病态 JS 类目标收益越大。
Conclusion: 后验条件数 (posterior conditioning) 是选择变分目标的关键因素，作者据此提出面向贝叶斯反问题的 geometry-adaptive variational inference 方向。

papers.title: The Informational Content in Lepto-Variance and Its Relation to Higher Moments
papers.abstract_en: Lepto-regression is defined as the machine learning process of constructing a Regression Tree of a target feature on itself. It is a novel, model-free method potentially revealing information on important sample structure properties. But it is yet not clear what the informational content of lepto-variance is and how it is related to other well-known statistics of a sample. One significant finding is that 58% of the historical US stock return variability is 1-bit lepto-variance that can not be explained by any financial factor. The central question investigated in this paper is to use small normal N(0, 1) drawn samples to explore how the 1-bit sample lepto-variance and lepto-ratio relate to sample variance, skewness and excess kurtosis. Using a large sample simulation, the lepto ratio of a normal is found to converge to 36.3%. For smaller normally distributed simulated N(0, 1) samples, while lepto-variance itself is highly correlated to sample variance, lepto-variance as a fraction of total variance is highly correlated to excess kurtosis. Both lepto-variance and lepto-ratio are orthogonal to sample skew. Another finding is that while lepto-ratio is strongly correlated to lepto-variance it remains orthogonal to sample variance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 定义 lepto-regression：把目标特征对自己回归成 Regression Tree，其 1-bit lepto-variance 作为无模型的样本结构统计量。大样本模拟显示正态 N(0,1) 的 lepto-ratio 收敛到 36.3%，lepto-variance 占总方差的比例与 excess kurtosis 高度相关，而 lepto-variance 与 lepto-ratio 都与样本偏度正交；并给出 58% 的美国股票历史收益方差是无法被任何金融因子解释的 1-bit lepto-variance。
Motivation: lepto-variance 作为新统计量，其信息内容及其与方差、偏度、峰度等经典矩的关系尚不清楚，需要先厘清它到底度量什么。
Method: 用目标特征对自身训练 Regression Tree 定义 lepto-regression；抽取正态 N(0,1) 样本做大规模模拟，考察 1-bit lepto-variance 与 lepto-ratio 同 sample variance、skewness、excess kurtosis 的相关与正交关系。
Result: 正态样本的 lepto-ratio 收敛到 36.3%；小样本下 lepto-variance 与 sample variance 高度相关，而 lepto-variance 占总方差比例与 excess kurtosis 高度相关；lepto-variance 与 lepto-ratio 均与 sample skew 正交，lepto-ratio 与 lepto-variance 强相关但与 sample variance 正交；58% 的美国股票历史收益方差为任何金融因子都无法解释的 1-bit lepto-variance。
Conclusion: lepto-variance/lepto-ratio 提供了与偏度正交、且部分独立于方差的样本结构信息，可作为金融收益中因子无法解释变异的度量。

papers.title: Stable Unsupervised Continual Chunking with Sheaf SyncMap
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised Continual chunking is a fundamental problem in machine learning and neuroscience, where the goal is to identify groups of states that frequently co-occur in temporal sequences. A key challenge is to form accurate chunks while maintaining their stability over time. In this work, we propose sheaf regularization to reduce local inconsistencies in Decentralized SyncMap, a self-organizing system, and thereby stabilize its chunking dynamics. We introduce a radial sheaf structure that penalizes distance-dependent radial motion between pairs of variables. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves the highest normalized mutual information (NMI) among the evaluated SyncMap variants on 12 of 18 probabilistic Continual General Chunking Problem (CGCP) graphs with two-state memory and on 17 of 18 graphs with dynamic memory. In the sequential adaptation experiment, Sheaf SyncMap also achieves high NMI after shifts in the input distribution, indicating that it can adapt to new knowledge while avoiding the negative transfer commonly observed in modern machine learning systems such as neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Decentralized SyncMap 自组织系统上加径向 sheaf 正则 (radial sheaf regularization)，惩罚变量对之间随距离变化的径向运动，以减少局部不一致并稳定无监督持续分块 (continual chunking) 动态。在 18 张概率型 CGCP 图上，两状态记忆设置中 12 张、动态记忆设置中 17 张取得最高 NMI；输入分布漂移后仍保持高 NMI，避免神经网络常见的负迁移。
Motivation: 无监督持续分块要在时序中识别频繁共现的状态组，难点是分块既要准又要跨时间稳定；现有自组织系统在分布漂移时容易失稳并产生负迁移。
Method: 对 Decentralized SyncMap 施加 sheaf 正则，构造径向 sheaf 结构，惩罚变量对之间依赖距离的径向运动，从而抑制局部不一致、稳定分块动态；在 CGCP 图上做实验，并测试输入分布漂移后的序列适应。
Result: 在 18 张概率型 Continual General Chunking Problem (CGCP) 图上，两状态记忆 (two-state memory) 设置中 12 张、动态记忆 (dynamic memory) 设置中 17 张取得所评估 SyncMap 变体中最高 normalized mutual information (NMI)；序列适应实验中，分布漂移后 Sheaf SyncMap 仍保持高 NMI。

papers.title: Calibration Count Reuse: Validity Does Not Determine Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Calibration count reuse raises separate validity and efficiency questions. We give a validity criterion for general count-dependent nonconformity scores: transferring one count from another class to the scored class must not improve its conformity. A leave-self-out full conformal reference proves the criterion without requiring normalization or preservation of same-class score order. For a common separable transformation, universal exchangeable validity is equivalent to being nondecreasing in the count, provided $Kα\geq 1$; normalized multiplicative weights obey the complementary nonincreasing condition. Additive penalties are covered under the stated information restrictions. Efficiency has no parallel ordering: two iid constructions make the same valid rule improve or worsen expected size at unchanged coverage. An expanded 55-rule study finds no resolved advantage from selected live-count rules over uniform weights. Image studies identify undercoverage under iid resampling, including at numerical convergence. Separately, execution of the released Conf-OT pipeline on its DTD and Aircraft benchmark subsets produces near-nominal median coverage under fixed stratified counts. The native results are reported separately from the iid analyses, without treating a benchmark observation as a universal guarantee. The findings separate validity, classifier confidence, numerical convergence, and population-specific efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把校准计数复用 (calibration count reuse) 拆成有效性与效率两个独立问题：给出一般计数依赖非一致性分数 (count-dependent nonconformity scores) 的有效性判据——把一个类的计数转给被评分类不得提高其符合度，并用 leave-self-out 全保形参照 (leave-self-out full conformal reference) 证明，无需归一化或保持同类分数次序。对常见可分变换，普适可交换有效性等价于对计数非减（当 Kα≥1），归一化乘性权重则满足互补的非增条件；而效率没有平行的序关系：两个 iid 构造可让同一条有效规则在覆盖率不变下改善或恶化期望尺寸。
Motivation: 保形预测中复用其他类的校准计数会同时牵涉有效性与效率，但两者此前被混为一谈：有效性有可判定条件，效率却没有对应的序关系，导致规则选择缺少依据。
Method: 对一般计数依赖非一致性分数给出有效性判据，并用 leave-self-out 全保形参照在不要求归一化、不要求保持同类分数次序的条件下证明；对常见可分变换刻画普适可交换有效性等价于对计数非减（Kα≥1），归一化乘性权重服从互补非增条件，加性惩罚在所述信息限制下也被覆盖。随后用两个 iid 构造分离效率，并展开 55 条规则的研究与图像实验（含 iid 重采样与数值收敛检验），另单独运行发布的 Conf-OT pipeline 于 DTD 与 Aircraft 子集。
Result: 两个 iid 构造显示同一条有效规则在覆盖率不变时可使期望尺寸改善或恶化；扩展的 55 条规则研究中，选定的 live-count 规则相对均匀权重未见已分辨的优势；图像研究在 iid 重采样下发现欠覆盖，且在数值收敛处依然存在；Conf-OT pipeline 在 DTD 与 Aircraft 基准子集上、固定分层计数下产生接近名义值的中位覆盖率。
Conclusion: 有效性、分类器置信度、数值收敛与总体特异效率是四个应分开的维度：有效性可由判据保证，效率则无通用序关系，基准观测不能当作普适保证。

papers.title: When Residualization Helps an Audit: Format Effects, Slice Gains, and Their Limits
papers.abstract_en: Evaluation scores used around LLM systems -- including reward models, rerankers, and LLM judges -- can track surface form instead of the quality they claim to measure. When presented with a terse correct solution and a commented buggy solution for the same MBPP problem, a public preference reward model selects the correct one no better than a coin flip (0.507). Subtracting the predictable surface component from such scores is increasingly common, but removal alone does not yield a more valid measurement: the removed component may carry construct-relevant signal, and residualization cannot tell which is which. Under designed interventions -- unit-test labels with comment-only edits -- residualization attenuates the reward model's format effects by about 0.12 on both correct and buggy code, while the correct-versus-buggy margins move by less than 0.01. In observational NLI and QA settings, we freeze a held-out replication before scoring and re-evaluate it using labels from disjoint annotators; this supports only a narrower conclusion: better agreement with the construct labels on a pre-declared slice where a surface-only predictor errs, not a repaired score. Full-population agreement falls in every observational setting with a reported positive slice gain, and within-question ranking falls in every such QA setting. When construct and surface features are entangled, residualization can decorrelate a score while degrading construct alignment, and, in a controlled model, configurations just as damaging to construct alignment pass every pre-adjustment check, so no committed gate is a guarantee. We assemble these distinctions into a reporting protocol whose outcomes, refusal included, state what an adjusted score may be claimed to show: an audit-time diagnostic reported beside the construct-alignment cost it incurs, never a replacement for the raw score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 评分器（reward model、reranker、LLM judge）打分跟随表面形式而非目标构念，检验残差化 (residualization) 这类去表面化校正的实际效果：在 MBPP 的注释-only 干预下，残差化把 reward model 的格式效应压低约 0.12，但正确 vs 错误代码的分差移动不足 0.01。作者主张把调整后分数只当作审计期诊断量，与构念对齐代价并列报告，绝不替代原始分数。
Motivation: LLM 评分器的分数可能只反映表面形式；直接减去可预测的表面成分看似合理，但被减掉的部分可能携带构念相关信号，残差化本身无法区分二者。
Method: 在 MBPP 上构造设计干预（unit-test 标签 + 仅改注释的编辑）来分离格式与构念；在观测性 NLI 与 QA 设定中先冻结 held-out replication，再用不相交标注者的标签重新打分；另用一个受控模型展示构念与表面特征纠缠时的情形，并汇总为一套 reporting protocol。
Result: 公开 preference reward model 对同一 MBPP 题的简洁正确解 vs 带注释的错误解，选对率仅 0.507（约等于抛硬币）。残差化在正确与错误代码上都把格式效应衰减约 0.12，而正确-错误分差移动不足 0.01。观测设定中，凡报告正向 slice gain 的场景全总体一致性 (full-population agreement) 均下降，且此类 QA 场景内逐题排序 (within-question ranking) 全部下降；结论仅限于在表面-only 预测器出错的预声明 slice 上与构念标签更一致。受控模型中，与已观测同样损害构念对齐的配置能通过全部调整前检查。
Conclusion: 残差化可以让分数与表面形式去相关却同时损害构念对齐，任何预先设定的检查门都无法保证安全；调整后分数只能作为与构念对齐代价并列报告的审计诊断，不能替代原始分数。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: $λ$-Controlled GRPO: Turning Flow-Matching Ratio Instability into a Budgeted Resource
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is increasingly used to align image generators with reward signals, and Flow-GRPO recently extended this paradigm to flow-matching models by treating the denoising sampler as a stochastic policy that can be optimized from reward feedback. Training in this setting is unstable in a way specific to multi-step denoising: the policy update changes systematically across denoising steps, with importance ratios drifting below one, becoming increasingly dispersed, clipping at different rates, and leaving fewer usable samples late in training. Prior work treats these effects as separate failure modes and addresses each with a hand-tuned stabilizer. We show instead that they arise from a single per-step quantity, which we call path variance. This quantity is determined exactly by the sampler's Gaussian transition kernel and can be estimated cheaply during training. This reframes instability as a resource that can be measured and budgeted rather than a collection of symptoms to repair. Our method, $λ$-Controlled GRPO, calibrates importance-ratio behavior from this predicted law rather than from noisy empirical statistics, and allocates gradient effort across denoising steps according to their predicted cost. The two scales governing the update are fixed by standard policy choices rather than introduced as free tuning parameters. On a text-to-image model under two reward settings, rendering difficult target text scored by optical character recognition and matching human preferences scored by a preference model, $λ$-Controlled GRPO improves both text accuracy and preference reward over the strongest empirical stabilizer. It also keeps late-step path variance within its intended budget, precisely where the baseline systematically overshoots. The result is a Flow-GRPO update calibrated by its own transition law rather than stabilized after instability appears.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Flow-GRPO 多步去噪中的重要性比率漂移、离散化与后期可用样本减少统一归因于单个可精确计算的每步量 path variance，并将其作为可预算的资源来分配梯度努力。在文本到图像模型的 OCR 文字渲染与人类偏好两项奖励设定下，λ-Controlled GRPO 同时提升文本准确率与偏好奖励，且把后期 path variance 控制在预算内，而最强经验稳定器会系统性超预算。
Motivation: Flow-GRPO 把去噪采样器当随机策略做奖励优化时，各去噪步的策略更新系统性变化、重要性比率跌破 1 并越发离散，后期可用样本变少；此前工作把这些当作彼此独立的失效模式，各自手工调一个稳定器。
Method: λ-Controlled GRPO：由采样的高斯 transition kernel 精确推出每步 path variance（训练中可低成本估计），据此而非含噪经验统计来校准重要性比率行为，并按各去噪步的预测代价分配梯度努力；控制更新的两个尺度由标准策略选择固定，不引入自由调参。
Result: 在文本到图像模型的两项奖励设定（OCR 打分的难目标文字渲染、偏好模型打分的人类偏好匹配）上，λ-Controlled GRPO 的文本准确率与偏好奖励均超过最强经验稳定器；后期 path variance 保持在预定预算内，而基线在该处系统性超预算。
Conclusion: 多步去噪的多种不稳定症状同源于一个可精确计算的 path variance，因此更新可以由自身 transition law 校准，而不是等不稳定出现后再逐个补稳定器。
