papers.title: 4DGS-Fixer: Generative Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting with Iterative Refinement Guided by Video Diffusion Priors
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the challenges of dynamic scene synthesis from sparse-view videos. Existing methods employ geometric priors, adaptive optimization, or density-control strategies to improve 4D Gaussian modeling under sparse observations. However, they cannot fundamentally resolve the ill-posed problem caused by insufficient observations and missing scene information. Moreover, sparse-view 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) often suffers from poor geometric initialization: with only a few input views, COLMAP typically reconstructs sparse and incomplete point clouds, leaving large scene regions without sufficient Gaussian support and making them difficult to recover through subsequent optimization. To address these limitations, we propose a novel iterative refinement framework based on a video diffusion model to improve the completeness and consistency of dynamic 4D scenes. Specifically, we first estimate multi-view depth maps and fuse them into dense point clouds to provide more complete geometric initialization for a dynamic 4DGS representation. We then employ a pretrained video restoration model to refine sequences rendered along novel camera trajectories at different time steps. The restored sequences serve as pseudo-supervision to regularize and iteratively refine the 4DGS representation. Experiments on a widely used benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms existing baselines, achieving nearly a 2 dB PSNR improvement over the previous best-performing method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对稀疏视角视频的动态场景合成，用视频扩散先验迭代修补 4D Gaussian Splatting 的几何初始化与渲染空洞：先估计多视角深度并融合成稠密点云，再用预训练视频修复模型沿新相机轨迹修复渲染序列，作为伪监督迭代正则化 4DGS。在广泛使用的基准数据集上比此前最佳方法 PSNR 提升近 2 dB。
Motivation: 稀疏视角下 COLMAP 只能重建稀疏不完整点云，大片场景缺少 Gaussian 支撑，几何先验与密度控制无法从根本上解决观测不足导致的病态问题。
Method: 先估计多视角深度图并融合为稠密点云，为动态 4DGS 提供更完整的几何初始化；再用预训练视频修复模型（video restoration model）修复沿新相机轨迹、在不同时间步渲染的序列，把修复结果作为伪监督，迭代正则化并精炼 4DGS 表示。
Result: 在广泛使用的基准数据集上大幅超越现有基线，PSNR 较此前最佳方法提升近 2 dB。
Conclusion: 视频扩散先验提供的伪监督能补上稀疏视角缺失的场景信息，从而把动态 4DGS 的完整性与一致性显著抬高。

papers.title: Video DeltaNet: A Video-Native Hybrid Attention for Livestream Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models repeatedly process long spatiotemporal token sequences during denoising, making attention a major computational bottleneck. Linear attention offers an appealing alternative and has been widely adopted in recent large language models, but directly applying it to video models often fails to preserve the fine-grained interactions required for high-quality generation. We present Video DeltaNet (VDN), which combines local Softmax attention with bidirectional linear memory for long-range video context. Its linear branch introduces Video Delta Attention (VDA), which updates memory once per frame by jointly incorporating its spatial tokens. Separate output projections and learnable gates calibrate the two branches, while a staged teacher-alignment recipe progressively introduces the new pathway into pretrained models. We instantiate VDN on MiniMax H3, applying the hybrid to video-to-video interactions while retaining Softmax for interactions involving text or audio. With eight-step distillation and an optimized SGLang serving stack, VDN-H3 completes DiT denoising for a 14.3-second, 768p video in 6.70 seconds on eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs, corresponding to a 14.5x speedup over the 50-step dense H3 baseline on the same GPU count. GitHub code available at: https://github.com/OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3. Weights available at: https://huggingface.co/OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video DeltaNet (VDN) 把局部 Softmax 注意力与双向线性记忆结合，用于直播视频生成的长时空 token 序列去噪：线性分支 Video Delta Attention (VDA) 每帧只更新一次记忆并联合纳入空间 token，两路输出用独立投影与可学习门控校准。在 MiniMax H3 上配合八步蒸馏与 SGLang 优化服务栈，14.3 秒 768p 视频的 DiT 去噪在八张 NVIDIA B200 上耗时 6.70 秒，相对同卡数 50 步稠密 H3 基线加速 14.5 倍。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型在去噪中反复处理长时空 token 序列，注意力成为主要计算瓶颈；直接把线性注意力搬到视频模型上又难以保留高质量生成所需的细粒度交互。
Method: VDN 采用混合注意力：局部 Softmax 负责细粒度交互，双向线性记忆分支 VDA 按帧更新记忆并联合空间 token；两路用独立输出投影与可学习门控融合，并用分阶段 teacher-alignment 配方把新通路逐步引入预训练模型。实例化在 MiniMax H3 上，混合结构只作用于 video-to-video 交互，涉及 text/audio 的交互仍保留 Softmax；推理侧叠加八步蒸馏与优化的 SGLang 服务栈。
Result: 在八张 NVIDIA B200 上，VDN-H3 对 14.3 秒、768p 视频完成 DiT 去噪耗时 6.70 秒，相对同 GPU 数量的 50 步稠密 H3 基线加速 14.5 倍。
Conclusion: 把线性记忆限制在 video-to-video 交互、文本与音频仍走 Softmax，配合八步蒸馏与服务栈优化，可以在保留细粒度生成交互的前提下大幅压缩直播视频生成的去噪时间。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PhysStream: Streaming Physics-Grounded Video Generation with Structured Scene Memory and Fine-Grained Motion Control
papers.abstract_en: Interactive control for video generation is moving from coarse prompts toward fine-grained, physically meaningful manipulation of dynamic scenes. Yet existing controllable methods either require the full control schedule before generation starts, or use pixel-space signals that dictate object positions rather than physical dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose PhysStream, an autoregressive model for physics-grounded image-to-video synthesis that incorporates structured scene memory---positional maps and object tracking maps derived online from previously generated frames---and supports fine-grained motion control via sparse velocity-increment signals that encode physical quantities, letting the model learn the underlying dynamics. We train our model in two stages: a bidirectional model is first finetuned with motion-control conditioning, then a causal autoregressive model is trained with additional structured scene memory, further improving physical consistency. PhysStream enables interactive, mid-generation control over multi-object tabletop rigid-body scenes---a capability not supported by prior methods---reducing motion distribution distance (FVMD) by 33% and trajectory error by 12% over the strongest baselines on synthetic benchmarks, and is preferred by human evaluators in over 85% of in-the-wild comparisons. Please check our website for more details: https://czzzzh.github.io/PhysStream
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysStream 是面向物理约束图像到视频生成的自回归模型，用在线从已生成帧提取的位置图与目标跟踪图构成结构化场景记忆，并以稀疏速度增量信号做细粒度运动控制，让模型学到动力学本身而非像素位置。两阶段训练（先双向模型加运动控制条件微调，再训因果自回归模型加场景记忆）后，在合成基准上相对最强基线把运动分布距离 (FVMD) 降低 33%、轨迹误差降低 12%，野外对比中超过 85% 的人类评估者更偏好其输出。
Motivation: 现有可控视频生成要么要求生成开始前给出完整控制序列，要么用像素空间信号直接指定物体位置，无法表达物理动力学，也不支持生成过程中的中途交互控制。
Method: 自回归 image-to-video 模型 PhysStream：结构化场景记忆由先前生成帧在线导出的位置图与目标跟踪图组成；控制输入为编码物理量的稀疏速度增量信号。训练分两阶段，先用运动控制条件微调双向模型，再训练带场景记忆的因果自回归模型以提升物理一致性。
Result: 在合成基准上相对最强基线：运动分布距离 (FVMD) 降低 33%，轨迹误差降低 12%；野外 (in-the-wild) 对比中超过 85% 的人类评估者偏好 PhysStream 输出。
Conclusion: 把物理量形式的稀疏速度控制与在线结构化场景记忆放进自回归视频生成，可在多目标桌面刚体场景上实现此前方法不支持的生成中途交互控制，并同时改善运动分布与轨迹精度。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: GRPO-QPS: Target-Preserving Reinforcement Learning for Quantum Posterior Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian quantum tomography requires efficient inference while preserving a posterior fixed by the prior and Born likelihood. Learned transport provides fast amortized samples, but reward tuning can reshape the generated distribution rather than improve exploration of this fixed target. We introduce GRPO-QPS, a target-preserving framework in which GRPO learns proposal behavior and an exact Metropolis correction preserves the posterior after training. Across the evaluated reconstruction benchmarks, GRPO-QPS improves over BuresTomFlow and Flow-GRPO on thermal, cat, Dicke, and cluster families, and it closely matches an exact two-qubit reference posterior. Tuned conventional MCMC is slightly stronger on several original continuous benchmarks where the available fixed proposals already match the posterior geometry well. To test whether this reflects a fundamental limitation of learned exploration, we evaluate a more challenging multimodal thermal posterior. At six qubits and 800 shots, the learned proposal achieves a minimum effective sample size of 102 per $1{,}000$ likelihood calls, compared with 28 for prior independence, 27 for a tuned fixed mixture, and 20 for Haario adaptive Metropolis. A record-conditioned policy also transfers to unseen 3,000-shot records, matching or exceeding the strongest conventional baseline in all nine held-out seed-record comparisons. These results show that GRPO-QPS combines target-preserving Bayesian inference with broad gains over learned transport baselines and a sampling advantage when efficient exploration requires proposal geometry beyond the evaluated conventional kernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRPO-QPS 用 GRPO 学习量子层析的 proposal 行为，训练后接精确 Metropolis 校正以保住由先验与 Born 似然固定的后验，避免奖励调参改写生成分布。在 6 qubit、800 shots 的多峰 thermal 后验上，每 1000 次似然调用的最小 ESS 达 102，而 prior independence、tuned fixed mixture、Haario adaptive Metropolis 分别只有 28、27、20。
Motivation: 学习式 transport 虽能做快速摊销采样，但奖励调参会重塑生成分布而非改善对既定后验的探索，量子层析需要既保目标又高效的推断。
Method: GRPO-QPS 让 GRPO 学习 proposal 行为，训练结束后施加精确 Metropolis correction 保证后验不变；在 thermal、cat、Dicke、cluster 等重建基准上与 BuresTomFlow、Flow-GRPO、精确 two-qubit 参考后验及常规 MCMC 对照，并测试 record-conditioned policy 向未见 3,000-shot 记录的迁移。
Result: 在所评估的重建基准上优于 BuresTomFlow 与 Flow-GRPO，并紧密逼近精确 two-qubit 参考后验；在若干原始连续基准上，调好的常规 MCMC 略强。6 qubit、800 shots 多峰 thermal 后验中，每 1,000 次似然调用最小 ESS 为 102，对比 prior independence 28、tuned fixed mixture 27、Haario adaptive Metropolis 20；record-conditioned policy 迁移到未见 3,000-shot 记录时，在全部 9 个 held-out seed-record 对比中匹配或超过最强常规基线。
Conclusion: 把 GRPO 的学习式 proposal 与精确 Metropolis 校正结合，可在保留目标后验的同时，在需要超越常规核几何的高效探索场景取得采样优势。

papers.title: Amortized Low-Rank Adaptation for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: World models let agents plan by predicting the consequences of their actions, but changes in the environment can make them inaccurate. We study the problem of adapting a world model to an unknown test-time environment, drawn from a known environment family, using only a few episodes of interaction. Existing approaches trade off computational cost against expressivity, i.e., the range of models a method can produce. For example, in-context learning is computationally cheap but limited in expressivity, and gradient-based adaptation is expressive but computationally expensive. We present CLAW (Context-conditioned Low-rank Adaptation of World models), which addresses this tradeoff by using a hypernetwork to generate low-rank (LoRA) adapters at test time. During pretraining, we simulate adaptation to a variety of environments and jointly train the hypernetwork and base world model. At test time, we freeze the base model and use a forward pass of the hypernetwork to generate adapters from a small batch of test-time transitions. We evaluate CLAW in locomotion and manipulation environment families that vary in dynamics, embodiment, and reward. We show that, using only seconds of test-time data, CLAW outperforms gradient-based adaptation and in-context learning during online adaptation. We also show that CLAW avoids overfitting in data-scarce regimes, that its advantage comes from the expressive adapters rather than context conditioning, and that pretraining the hypernetwork jointly with the base model outperforms training it post hoc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CLAW（Context-conditioned Low-rank Adaptation of World models）：用 hypernetwork 在测试时从少量交互数据一次前向生成 LoRA 适配器，冻结基础 world model 来适配未知测试环境。在动力学、身体形态与奖励各异的 locomotion 与 manipulation 环境族上，仅用数秒测试时数据，CLAW 在在线适配中同时优于基于梯度的适配与 in-context learning，并在数据稀缺时避免过拟合。
Motivation: world model 会因环境变化而失准，现有测试时适配方法在计算开销与表达力之间取舍：in-context learning 便宜但表达力受限，梯度适配表达力强但开销大。
Method: 预训练阶段模拟对多种环境的适配，联合训练 hypernetwork 与基础 world model；测试时冻结基础模型，用一次 hypernetwork 前向从小批量测试时 transitions 生成低秩 (LoRA) 适配器。
Result: 在动力学、embodiment 与 reward 变化的 locomotion 与 manipulation 环境族上，仅用数秒测试时数据，CLAW 在线适配表现优于梯度适配与 in-context learning；在数据稀缺 regime 避免过拟合；其优势来自表达力更强的 adapters 而非 context conditioning；hypernetwork 与基础模型联合预训练优于事后 (post hoc) 训练。
Conclusion: 用 hypernetwork 摊销 (amortize) 测试时低秩适配，可以在数秒数据下同时拿到接近梯度适配的表达力与接近 in-context learning 的开销，且必须与基础模型联合预训练才成立。

papers.title: Monadic Second-Order Logic in HOL: Deep and Shallow with Automated Faithfulness (Extended Preprint)
papers.abstract_en: In Isabelle/HOL, we apply the deep-and-shallow embedding methodology of our prior work to monadic second-order logic (MSO). Three embeddings are developed side by side: a deep embedding (an inductive datatype with an explicit satisfaction relation); a maximal-shallow embedding that translates the connectives and quantifiers directly into HOL, carrying the interpretation and both assignments explicitly; and a minimal-shallow embedding -- a locale that fixes those parameters, collapsing the formula type to bool. The enabling new ingredient is a two-sorted substitution apparatus -- capture-avoiding substitution, renaming, and a substitution lemma per namespace -- in which each binder is transparent for the other; faithfulness of all three embeddings is mechanised and largely automated. Our central contribution is a fully mechanised two-sorted downward Loewenheim-Skolem theorem: the minimal embedding recovers deep validity relative to the (countable) assignment ranges, and this range-relative reading is shown to coincide with the general (Henkin-style) reading of MSO, whereas the standard reading validates strictly more formulas, witnessed by comprehension. Both readings are nonetheless recovered from the minimal embedding, differing only in the admitted interpretations: all of them for the general reading, only the elementary substructures of the full model for the standard. We exercise the embeddings on classical MSO landmarks: the Boolean-closure and graph schemata hold under the full second-order domain yet fail in the minimal embedding, making the dichotomy concrete, while reachability and 2-colorability are refuted throughout.
papers.comment: 38 pages. Extended version -- with the full two-sorted Loewenheim-Skolem proof (Appendix A) and the rendered Isabelle/HOL theory sources (Appendix B) -- of a contribution accepted to a Festschrift for David Basin (Springer LNCS); the proceedings version is 19 pages. The Isabelle/HOL formalisation is published in the Archive of Formal Proofs: https://isa-afp.org/entries/MSOinHOL.html
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Isabelle/HOL 中并列构造 MSO 的深嵌入、最大浅嵌入与最小浅嵌入，用双 sorts 替换装置把三者的可靠性 (faithfulness) 机械化并高度自动化，并机械化证明了双 sorts 下降 Löwenheim–Skolem 定理。核心发现是 MSO 的标准读法比一般 (Henkin 式) 读法严格多验证公式（由 comprehension 见证），而两种读法都能从最小嵌入恢复，差别只在允许的解释集合。
Motivation: MSO 嵌入 HOL 时，深嵌入与浅嵌入的等价性、以及不同语义读法之间的分歧缺少机械化验证，下降 Löwenheim–Skolem 定理也未在该框架内形式化。
Method: 三种嵌入并列：归纳 datatype 加显式满足关系的深嵌入；把联结词与量词直译 HOL、显式携带解释与两个赋值的最大浅嵌入；用 locale 固定这些参数、把公式类型塌缩为 bool 的最小嵌入。关键新构件是双 sorts 替换装置（避免捕获的替换、重命名、每个命名空间一条替换引理，各 binder 对另一 sorts 透明），可靠性证明机械化且 largely automated。
Result: 机械化证明下降 Löwenheim–Skolem：最小嵌入在（可数）赋值值域内恢复深嵌入的有效性，该 range-relative 读法与 MSO 的一般 Henkin 式读法一致，而标准读法严格多验证公式（由 comprehension 见证）；两种读法都可从最小嵌入恢复，仅允许的解释不同。在经典 MSO 地标上：Boolean closure 与 graph schemata 在全二阶域下成立但在最小嵌入中失败，reachability 与 2-colorability 在所有嵌入下均被反驳。
Conclusion: 深与浅嵌入的分歧可由最小嵌入中允许的解释集合精确刻画，MSO 到 HOL 的忠实嵌入可以机械化并自动化；形式化成果已在 Archive of Formal Proofs 发布 (MSOinHOL)。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Plan Pointers and Record-Directive Form in Budgeted Verification of Inherited Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: A model that inherits one-line memories may pull one archived source record before acting; a directive in the store can steer that pull: a pointer, a criterion or both. Across sixteen registered studies (179,352 attempts) we measured where the request goes under each form; every result is descriptive, with registered intervals, no mechanism claim. A length-matched criterion exceeded a bare id on six direct-provider models (D) and failed its registered superiority rule on a nine-model OpenRouter panel (E). On generated worlds (K2-K5): the two registered signatures held on Opus 5 and Fable 5.1, Fable 5 followed the same sign, Haiku 4.5 reversed, and Sonnet 5, the GPT-5.6 endpoints and GPT-6 Astra lay near zero (K2). With a defensive adapter at five gains, the 70B rule for a gain-dependent change of the composite - criterion contrast was not met (K3 and K4); under the 8B attenuation rule (0.95 intervals: slope below zero; change beyond the margin), the 8B change of -17.5 [-26.7, -8.1] did not meet it on 36 families (K4) and at registered power on 337 families -16.6 [-19.4, -13.8] did (realised one-sided error at the margin 1.8 to 3.2% per corner of a finite grid, nominal 2.5%, not a uniform-error guarantee; K4's status stands; K5, first ladder), while a second SecAlign++ adapter under the imposed Meta-SecAlign template did not (-11.8 [-14.3, -9.3]; K5, second ladder); no NOT-MET is a statement that the contrast was unchanged; their difference (+4.7 [+2.3, +7.2]) describes two fixed execution paths, licenses no superiority, equivalence or 'significant difference' claim; nothing follows from the statuses differing (K5). Intervals describe family-reweighting stability conditional on the execution, not reproducibility across engine executions; audit replays were neither substituted for nor averaged into outcomes; no missingness gate fired and directional completions changed no status.
papers.comment: 65 pages, 7 figures, 44 tables. Sixteen registered studies (179,352 attempted episodes) on one instrument lineage; every package was frozen, hashed and externally deposited before its first confirmatory call. v2 adds Studies K2-K5 (generated worlds; a defensive adapter at five gains). Manuscript, source, records and the generator of every number: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22267220
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究 LLM agent 继承单行记忆时，记忆中的一条 directive（pointer、criterion 或两者）如何改变其拉取归档源记录的目标位置。跨 16 项注册研究（179,352 次尝试）给出描述性结果：长度匹配的 criterion 在 6 个直连 provider 模型上超过裸 id，但在 9 模型 OpenRouter 面板上未达注册的优越性规则；生成世界 (K2-K5) 中签名在 Opus 5 与 Fable 5.1 成立、Haiku 4.5 反向、多个模型接近零。
Motivation: 继承式 agent 记忆中一条简短 directive 就能引导模型去拉取哪条归档记录，但不同 directive 形式（pointer vs criterion）对请求去向的影响缺少注册式、可复现的实证刻画。
Method: 设计 16 项预注册研究（共 179,352 次尝试），每个实验包在首次确认调用前冻结、哈希并外部存档；比较裸 id、长度匹配 criterion 及 pointer/criterion 组合三种 directive 形式，覆盖 6 个直连 provider 模型、9 模型 OpenRouter 面板，以及生成世界 K2-K5（含 defensive adapter 五档增益与 SecAlign++ adapter），全部报告注册区间与描述性统计。
Result: 长度匹配 criterion 在 6 个直连模型 (D) 上超过裸 id，但在 9 模型 OpenRouter 面板 (E) 上未达注册优越性规则；K2 中两签名在 Opus 5 与 Fable 5.1 成立、Fable 5.1 同号、Haiku 4.5 反向，Sonnet 5、GPT-5.6 端点与 GPT-6 Astra 接近零；8B 衰减规则下 36 个 family 的变化 -17.5 [-26.7, -8.1] 未达标，337 个 family 的 -16.6 [-19.4, -13.8] 达标（单侧实现误差 1.8–3.2%，名义 2.5%），第二个 SecAlign++ adapter 为 -11.8 [-14.3, -9.3] 未达标，两者差值 +4.7 [+2.3, +7.2]。
Conclusion: directive 形式对请求去向的影响依模型与执行路径而变，结果仅为描述性、带注册区间、不含机制主张；区间刻画的是条件于执行的 family 重加权稳定性，而非跨引擎执行的可复现性，NOT-MET 不等于对比无变化，也不授权优越性、等价或显著差异主张。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HBQ: Hierarchical Scaling Block Quantization with Hardware-Efficiency-Aware Design for Accurate LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Block Quantization (BQ) enables efficient LLM inference by quantizing both weights and activations, but its design space remains underexplored. Through hardware-accuracy design space exploration, we identify block size as a key trade-off: larger blocks improve hardware efficiency by amortizing dequantization and accumulation costs, but degrade accuracy. Motivated by this insight, we propose Hierarchical Block Quantization (HBQ), which combines large blocks with low-overhead significand (SIG) scaling for second-level quantization. SIG scaling effectively compensates for large-block quantization errors while accounting for distinct weight and activation distributions. HBQ-A achieves W4A16-level accuracy with W4A5 and lower area than NVFP4, while HBQ-E further reduces hardware cost by 17% while outperforming existing BQ methods in accuracy. We implement HBQ for weights, activations, and KV cache in a 28nm ASIC accelerator and introduce partial-sum BQ to reduce EMA energy. At comparable accuracy, HBQ achieves 2.3x/4.6x higher area/energy efficiency than state-of-the-art weight-only quantization and 1.6-3.3x lower system energy with 1.5-3x speedup over prior BQ methods. Our implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/SeoLabCornell/HBQ.git.
papers.comment: This work is accepted to the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HBQ 用大 block 加低开销 significand (SIG) 二级缩放做权重量化，在补偿大 block 精度损失的同时保住硬件效率。HBQ-A 以 W4A5 达到 W4A16 级精度且面积低于 NVFP4，HBQ-E 再降 17% 硬件成本；28nm ASIC 上相对 weight-only 量化面积/能效提升 2.3x/4.6x，相对既有 BQ 系统能耗低 1.6-3.3x、加速 1.5-3x。
Motivation: Block Quantization 的设计空间探索不足：block size 变大能摊薄反量化与累加开销、提升硬件效率，却直接压低精度，这个权衡缺少能同时兼顾两者的量化方案。
Method: 先做硬件-精度联合设计空间探索定位 block size 这一关键权衡，再提出 Hierarchical Block Quantization：大 block 配合低开销 SIG scaling 做第二级量化，并分别针对权重与激活的不同分布补偿大 block 量化误差；同时把方案扩展到权重、激活与 KV cache，提出 partial-sum BQ 降低 EMA 能耗，并在 28nm ASIC 加速器上实现。
Result: HBQ-A 以 W4A5 达到 W4A16 级精度且面积低于 NVFP4；HBQ-E 在精度超过既有 BQ 方法的同时硬件成本再降 17%。在 28nm ASIC 实现上，同等精度下相对 SOTA weight-only 量化取得 2.3x/4.6x 的面积/能效提升，相对先前 BQ 方法系统能耗低 1.6-3.3x、加速 1.5-3x。
Conclusion: block size 的效率-精度权衡可以用大 block 加 SIG 二级缩放解开：大 block 负责摊销硬件开销，SIG scaling 补回精度，从而在 LLM 推理中同时拿到更低面积、能耗与更高吞吐。实现代码已公开。

papers.title: GVS5H: Zero-Shot Self-Orchestration with Ledger-Based Control for Improved LLM Coding Performance
papers.abstract_en: Frontier coding performance is typically attained with large, costly proprietary models. We introduce ledger-based zero-shot self-orchestration (GVS5H), a training-free method in which fresh instances of one model decompose problems and coordinate through a shared file system. Across eleven open and closed-weight models on the 100 latest hard LiveCodeBench problems, the method yields as much as 25.6 points improvement, boosting several cheaper models to frontier-level performance. Orchestrated Qwen3.8 Flash Next scores 93.0% against Fable 5's 90.4% at 9% of the cost, while the smaller Qwen3.8-27B reaches 92.4%. Gains are not universal: some models are unchanged or worse. Transcript analysis attributes the gain to decomposition and persistent context. Inference-time organization can reach or exceed frontier coding accuracy at a fraction of the cost on self-hostable weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GVS5H 是一种免训练的零样本自编排 (zero-shot self-orchestration) 编码方法：同一模型的多个新实例通过共享文件系统分解问题并用 ledger 协调。在 LiveCodeBench 最新 100 道 hard 题上，11 个开闭权重模型最多提升 25.6 分，编排后的 Qwen3.8 Flash Next 得 93.0%，超过 Fable 5 的 90.4%，成本仅 9%；但增益不普遍，部分模型持平或变差。
Motivation: 前沿编码能力通常依赖昂贵的闭源大模型，而推理时的组织方式能否让可自托管的便宜模型达到同等水平尚不清楚。
Method: 训练-free 的 ledger 式自编排：同一模型的多个新实例经共享文件系统分解问题并协调，用 ledger 记录控制状态；在 11 个开闭权重模型上跑 LiveCodeBench 最新 100 道 hard 题，并做 transcript 分析归因增益来源。
Result: 最多提升 25.6 分；编排后 Qwen3.8 Flash Next 93.0% vs Fable 5 90.4%，成本为后者 9%；更小的 Qwen3.8-27B 达 92.4%；部分模型持平或变差；transcript 分析把增益归因于问题分解与持久上下文。
Conclusion: 推理时组织可在可自托管权重上以极低成本达到甚至超过前沿编码精度，但收益依赖模型，并非普遍成立。

papers.title: Orthogonal JEPA: Factorized Predictive States for Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models construct latent states that support prediction, planning, and reasoning about an underlying system. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) offer a direct way to learn such states by predicting targets in representation space instead of reconstructing every detail of the observation. Standard JEPAs, however, organize all predictable content through one target embedding and one prediction pathway. In complex systems, this monolithic state can allocate redundant capacity to dominant signals while providing weak or conflicting gradients to less dominant predictive structure. We introduce \method, a latent world-modeling framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization. Learned basis matrices analyze each target state into multiple components, and a dedicated prediction branch estimates each component from a shared context representation. Predictive regression preserves the factor magnitudes required for state synthesis, an orthogonality objective discourages repeated directions, factor-activity regularization maintains variation in projected targets, and online variance regularization discourages coordinate-wise encoder collapse. Predicted components are synthesized into a complete latent state that can be used by a readout, decoder, planner, or autoregressive rollout. The same predictive-state mechanism applies when the target is temporally future, spatially hidden, or another partial observation of the same system. Experiments on controlled vision, single-cell transcriptomics, longitudinal health records, continuous control, and molecular dynamics evaluate representation quality, forecasting, planning, and long-horizon stability.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been superseded by a substantially revised version, arXiv:2609.20800. The simultaneous existence of both records has caused significant confusion regarding the relationship and development of the work. To prevent further misunderstanding and maintain a clear scientific record, we request withdrawal of arXiv:2608.20065
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Orthogonal JEPA：用可学习正交基矩阵把目标潜状态分解成多个分量，每个分量配独立预测分支，从共享上下文表示预测，再合成完整潜状态供读出、解码、规划或自回归 rollout。正交目标抑制重复方向、因子活动正则保持投影目标的方差、在线方差正则抑制逐坐标编码器坍缩，从而避免单嵌入单通路把容量堆到主导信号上。
Motivation: 标准 JEPA 用单一目标嵌入和单一预测通路组织全部可预测内容，在复杂系统中会把冗余容量分配给主导信号，同时给较弱的预测结构提供弱或冲突的梯度。
Method: 正交预测分解：可学习基矩阵分析目标状态为多个分量，专用预测分支从共享上下文表示逐分量预测；损失含保持因子幅值的 predictive regression、抑制重复方向的正交目标、维持投影目标变化的 factor-activity 正则，以及防逐坐标编码器坍缩的在线方差正则；同一机制适用于未来时间、空间遮蔽或其他部分观测作为目标。
Result: 在受控视觉、单细胞转录组、纵向健康记录、连续控制与分子动力学五类设置上评估表征质量、预测、规划与长时程稳定性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把可预测内容做正交因子化并逐分量预测，可作为通用的潜状态预测机制，覆盖时间外推、空间遮蔽与部分观测等多种目标形式。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: NBA_Streaming: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Fine-Grained Basketball Commentary Generation in Continuous Streams
papers.abstract_en: Live basketball commentary generation requires determining when an event is sufficiently observable and describing it before subsequent events unfold. However, existing methods are primarily designed for pre-segmented clips or complete videos, making them unsuitable for continuous streams. Existing datasets also provide limited supervision for player identities, fine-grained actions, event attributes, and coherent event chains, restricting the factual richness of generated commentary. To address these limitations, we introduce NBA_Streaming, a large-scale benchmark for online fine-grained basketball commentary generation. It contains 307.5 hours of basketball broadcasts and approximately 35K temporally aligned events, with annotations of event boundaries, player identities, fine-grained actions, event chains, and natural-language commentary. By moving from isolated clips to continuous streams, NBA_Streaming enables unified evaluation of event localization, response reliability, factual grounding, and commentary quality under causal constraints. We further propose a causal two-stage framework that combines completion-first localization with ball-centric semantic grounding, enabling the system to identify complete events from observed streams and organize scene, event, identity, and action cues for commentary generation. Extensive experiments reveal the difficulty of NBA_Streaming, where existing baselines struggle with online timing, factual grounding, and fine-grained description. Our framework consistently improves over strong alternatives, while the remaining gap highlights NBA_Streaming as a valuable benchmark for streaming sports video understanding and generation. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/wyy-081/NBA_Streaming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NBA_Streaming 把篮球解说生成从预切片段搬到连续直播流，含 307.5 小时转播与约 35K 条时序对齐事件，标注事件边界、球员身份、细粒度动作、事件链与解说文本。配套提出因果两阶段框架（completion-first 定位 + 以球为中心的语义 grounding），在因果约束下统一评测事件定位、响应可靠性、事实依据与解说质量；实验显示现有基线在在线时机、事实依据与细粒度描述上普遍吃力，该框架稳定优于强替代方案。
Motivation: 现有解说生成方法面向预切片段或完整视频，无法处理连续流中“事件何时可观测、必须在下一事件前说完”的在线决策；现有数据集对球员身份、细粒度动作、事件属性与连贯事件链的监督不足，限制了解说的事实丰富度。
Method: 提出因果两阶段框架：completion-first localization 从已观测流中判定完整事件，再用 ball-centric semantic grounding 组织场景、事件、身份与动作线索生成解说；在 NBA_Streaming 上以因果约束评测事件定位、响应可靠性、事实依据与解说质量。
Result: 数据集含 307.5 小时篮球转播与约 35K 条时序对齐事件；实验显示现有基线在在线时机、事实依据与细粒度描述上普遍困难，所提框架在各项上持续优于强替代方案，但仍存在明显差距。
Conclusion: 连续流是篮球解说生成的正确问题设定，NBA_Streaming 为此提供了公开基准（github.com/wyy-081/NBA_Streaming）；因果两阶段框架有效但未闭合与人类水平的差距。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Where Does Neural Advantage Arise in Continuous-Time Dynamic Graph Prediction?
papers.abstract_en: Aggregate performance on continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDGs) combines, in a single score, the portion attributable to known temporal regularities and the additional predictive power of neural models. This study separates the two at the query level. We construct a mechanism-constrained predictor that uses pair recurrence, recency and history position, renewal patterns, and short sequential transitions while learning the compatibility within each mechanism. Across four CTDG datasets, this predictor recovers a substantial portion of the performance of strong neural baselines, and the recovered performance quickly saturates with a small, dataset-specific set of explicit mechanisms. Neural residuals concentrate on queries for which the positive and negative candidates have similar mechanism-execution profiles. Allowing conditional interactions among mechanisms is more effective than simply reweighting their existing contributions. Conditioning the contribution of one mechanism on the execution state of another recovers 54.9-73.2% of the original neural-only queries and improves overall paired accuracy on all four datasets. Although the magnitude of the effect varies across datasets, these results show that the performance gap of neural CTDG models need not be treated solely as an opaque difference in representational capacity. At least part of the gap is localized to queries with similar candidate execution profiles and can be functionally explained by conditional coordination among known, low-dimensional mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把连续时间动态图 (CTDG) 预测的聚合性能拆到查询级：用受机制约束的预测器（成对复现、近因与历史位置、更新模式、短序列转移，并在每个机制内部学习兼容性）可恢复强神经基线的大部分性能，且随少量、随数据集而异的显式机制迅速饱和。神经残差集中在正负候选机制执行画像相似的查询上；让机制条件交互（一个机制的贡献以另一机制的执行状态为条件）可恢复原纯神经查询的 54.9-73.2%，并在全部四个数据集上提升整体成对准确率。
Motivation: CTDG 上的聚合分数把已知时间规律可解释的部分与神经模型的额外预测力混在一个数里，无法定位神经优势究竟来自哪里。
Method: 在查询级分离两者：构造机制约束预测器，使用 pair recurrence、recency 与 history position、renewal patterns、短序列转移，并在每个机制内部学习兼容性；再比较直接重加权既有机制贡献与让机制条件交互两种方式。
Result: 在四个 CTDG 数据集上，该预测器恢复了强神经基线性能的相当大部分，且恢复量随少量、随数据集而异的显式机制快速饱和；以一机制执行状态为条件调节另一机制贡献，恢复原纯神经查询的 54.9-73.2%，并在全部四个数据集上提升整体 paired accuracy；效应幅度随数据集而异。
Conclusion: 神经 CTDG 模型的性能差距不必整体当作不可解释的表示能力差异：至少一部分集中在候选执行画像相似的查询上，可由已知低维机制间的条件协调功能性解释。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Labeled Incidence Structures for Native Transformer Modeling of Text, Knowledge Graphs, and Hypergraphs
papers.abstract_en: Current Transformer interfaces index tokens by one or more integer coordinates, which determine their addresses inside attention. In RoPE and its multi-axis or hierarchical variants, the resulting address has the form $A(i)=R_1^{i_1}R_2^{i_2}R_3^{i_3}$, where the exponents are integer coordinates assigned after choosing a serialized token layout. When Transformers process new or large collections of data, this addressing scheme can produce unseen offsets or coordinate combinations, push repositories toward retrieve-and-serialize pipelines, and force new entities, records, or repository items to be represented by long token strings or identifier embeddings not seen in training. We introduce labeled incidence structures (LIS), in which each participating token or value is an endpoint with content $x$ and a structural index $i$. The index can include local position, relation role, relation instance, text unit, field, or content-derived identity. The model maps this index to a structural address $A(i)$, so adding new tokens, facts, text units, or repository items applies the same learned address rule to structural and content coordinates rather than requiring larger integer coordinates, unseen coordinate combinations, or new identifier embeddings. Attention scores endpoints $i,j$ using $q_i^\top P_{j\to i}k_j$, where journey consistency forces $P_{j\to i}=A(i)^{-1}A(j)$. When $i$ has several coordinates, such as position, role, and instance, coordinate independence is equivalent to factoring $A(i)$ into one address factor per coordinate. This recovers RoPE, RoPE-2D, and HiRoPE as special cases. This allows knowledge-graph (KG) roles, fact instances, and text units to enter the attention score directly. In controlled shallow diagnostics, the LIS address interface is implemented inside ordinary Transformer attention and yields promising results across text, KG, and $n$-ary settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出标注关联系构 (labeled incidence structures, LIS)：每个 token 是带内容 x 与结构索引 i 的端点，注意力用 q_i^T P_{j→i} k_j 且要求 journey consistency P_{j→i}=A(i)^{-1}A(j)，坐标独立性等价于地址按坐标分解，从而把 RoPE、RoPE-2D、HiRoPE 收为特例。新增 token、事实或仓库条目复用同一套已学地址规则，不再需要更大的整数坐标、未见坐标组合或新 identifier embedding；浅层受控诊断在文本、KG 与 n-ary 设定上给出有希望的结果。
Motivation: RoPE 及其多轴/层次变体按序列化后分配的整数坐标寻址，遇到新数据或大规模仓库时会产生未见偏移与坐标组合，把系统推向 retrieve-and-serialize 管线，并迫使新实体用训练中没见过的长 token 串或 identifier embedding 表示。
Method: LIS 把每个参与 token 或值建为端点，内容 x 配结构索引 i（可含局部位置、关系角色、关系实例、文本单元、字段或内容派生身份），模型把 i 映射为结构地址 A(i)；注意力分数为 q_i^T P_{j→i} k_j，由 journey consistency 约束 P_{j→i}=A(i)^{-1}A(j)。当 i 含多坐标时，坐标独立性等价于把 A(i) 分解为每坐标一个地址因子，RoPE、RoPE-2D、HiRoPE 成为特例；该地址接口实现在普通 Transformer attention 内部。
Result: 在受控浅层诊断 (controlled shallow diagnostics) 中，LIS 地址接口在文本、知识图谱 (KG) 与 n-ary 设定上均给出有希望的结果；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把位置、角色、实例等结构坐标与内容坐标放进同一条已学地址规则，可让 KG 角色、事实实例与文本单元直接进入注意力分数，从而免去随新条目增长的整数坐标与 identifier embedding。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Memoization Without Keys: Compact, Out-of-Core Tables for Functions of Sorted Arguments
papers.abstract_en: Memoizing an expensive function of a sorted score vector is a data-structure problem before it is a numerical one: at a billion gridpoints, a hash map or a search tree spends most of its space on keys the grid already determines. We describe an implemented memo table that stores none. An entry's address is computed in closed form from the sorted argument itself, so $N$ values occupy $N$ slots, the argument is recoverable from the index, and the table can be memory-mapped and served from a file larger than RAM. Against a chained hash map it uses $5.7\times$ less memory at $37$M entries and $10.2\times$ less at $1.9$B, answers queries up to $2.9\times$ faster and builds up to $250\times$ faster; on 64 threads its construction needs no coordination; a sharded hash gains only $1.17\times$. Against an open-addressing table with inline keys it is $4$--$7\times$ smaller and $100\times$ faster to build but $1.5\times$ slower to query, a deficit we trace to the $O(d)$ index arithmetic. At $22$ GB on a $16$ GB desktop it serves each query in one disk access, where no key-storing container can be built; and its order-preserving addressing keeps a perturbation workload on the same pages that a hashed layout scatters. The closed form exists because the key set is the multiset combinations, whose index is the combinatorial number system. Memoizing Plackett--Luce normalization runs $25$--$55\times$ faster than Newton's method; memoizing $α$-entmax thresholds does not pay. The contrast says when this structure is worthwhile.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无键 memo 表：条目地址由已排序参数的闭式索引（组合数系统）直接算出，N 个值只占 N 个槽位，参数可从索引还原，表可 memory-mapped 到大于 RAM 的文件。对链式哈希在 1.9B 条目下省 10.2× 内存、查询快 2.9×、构建快 250×；但对 α-entmax 阈值 memo 化不划算。
Motivation: 在十亿级网格点上缓存昂贵函数时，哈希表或搜索树把大部分空间花在网格本身已确定的键上，且键存储容器在内存受限时根本无法构建。
Method: 实现无键 memo 表：条目地址由排序参数闭式计算，键集为多重集组合、索引用组合数系统 (combinatorial number system)，参数可由索引恢复；支持 memory-mapped 超内存文件与顺序保持寻址。对比链式哈希与内联键开放寻址表，并在 Plackett--Luce 归一化与 α-entmax 阈值两个负载上做 memo 化。
Result: 对链式哈希：37M 条目省 5.7× 内存、1.9B 条目省 10.2×，查询快至 2.9×、构建快至 250×，64 线程构建无需协调，而分片哈希仅提升 1.17×。对内联键开放寻址表：小 4–7×、构建快 100×，但查询慢 1.5×（源于 O(d) 索引算术）。22 GB 表放在 16 GB 桌面机上每次查询一次磁盘访问，扰动负载保持同页而哈希布局会打散。Plackett--Luce 归一化 memo 化比 Newton 法快 25–55×；α-entmax 阈值 memo 化不划算。
Conclusion: 当键集由网格本身决定（组合数系统可闭式索引）且函数昂贵时，无键顺序保持 memo 表在内存、构建速度与超内存运行上占优；查询路径上的 O(d) 索引算术与负载是否匹配决定是否值得用。

papers.title: A Methodology for Auditable Trustworthiness Levels in AI Lifecycle Governance
papers.abstract_en: AI governance increasingly requires judgments about whether an AI system remains adequately trustworthy over time, whether observed changes are tolerable, and how such judgments should be documented in a transparent and contestable way. Existing approaches remain either too high-level to support lifecycle monitoring and reassessment or too narrowly metric-driven to connect multidimensional trustworthiness evidence with governance decisions. We propose a lightweight methodology centered on \emph{trustworthiness level functions}: auditable rules that map measured trustworthiness profiles to governance-relevant levels. The methodology separates the underlying trustworthiness evidence from the governance rule used to interpret it and treats that rule as a lifecycle governance object. The rule may remain expert-defined or, when available evidence warrants empirical learning, be approximated by an interpretable candidate model. An AI lifecycle governance procedure embeds this choice in explicit decision gates for determining whether learning should be attempted and whether a learned candidate should become operative. The resulting rule supports lifecycle monitoring through level transitions, boundary margins, and profile drift, with explicit human responsibilities for validation, approval, and reassessment. We illustrate the methodology on synthetic AI lifecycle scenarios involving degradation, shocks, updates, heterogeneous monitoring cadences, and system comparison. Our methodology does not replace expert or legal judgment, but makes the governance interpretation of trustworthiness evidence more explicit, auditable, and contestable over time.
papers.comment: Version v2. Clarified lifecycle governance procedure and expanded synthetic experiments. 26 pages; 8 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以 trustworthiness level function 为核心的轻量 AI 生命周期治理方法：把可信度证据与解读证据的治理规则分离，规则本身作为可审计的治理对象，可由专家定义，也可在证据允许时用可解释候选模型近似，并嵌入显式决策门控决定是否学习、学到的候选是否生效。该规则支撑生命周期监控中的层级转移、边界裕度与 profile drift 判读，并配以明确的人工验证、批准与复评责任；在含退化、冲击、更新、异构监控节奏与系统对比的合成场景中做了说明。
Motivation: 现有 AI 治理方法要么过于高层、无法支撑生命周期监控与再评估，要么过于指标驱动，难以把多维可信度证据接到治理决策上。
Method: 定义 trustworthiness level function：把测得的可信度 profile 映射到治理相关层级的可审计规则；将证据与解读规则分离，规则可专家定义或用可解释候选模型近似，由带决策门控的生命周期治理程序决定是否学习及候选是否生效，并规定人工验证、批准与复评职责。
Result: 在合成 AI 生命周期场景上演示该方法，场景涵盖性能退化、冲击、更新、异构监控节奏与系统对比；v2 扩充了合成实验，全文 26 页 8 图。
Conclusion: 把解读可信度证据的规则显式化为可审计、可争议的治理对象，可让生命周期中的层级变化判断更透明，但不替代专家或法律判断。

papers.title: DP-Splat: Bayesian Nonparametric Complexity Control for Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting represents scenes as finite mixtures of anisotropic Gaussians whose number of components $K$ is set by heuristic density control or user caps. Variational Bayes Gaussian Splatting (VBGS) recast splat fitting as conjugate variational inference, but $K$ remains fixed. We replace the finite symmetric Dirichlet over mixture weights with a truncated stick-breaking Dirichlet-process prior (or a sparse overfitted finite Dirichlet), so that the number of occupied components adapts to the data while every update remains a closed-form coordinate-ascent step; a natural-gradient stochastic variant scales to large point sets. We give an ELBO monotonicity-and-convergence guarantee, a rigorous truncation-error bound that corrects a large-$α$ approximation in common use which undershoots the exact Ishwaran-James bound, and an honest account of what the fitted number of components estimates. Empirically: (i) the effective complexity $\hat{K}$ adapts to data complexity and recovers the true $K$ within $\pm 1$; (ii) a deconfounded comparison shows the DP prior's contribution is complexity selection, not per-component efficiency: converged DP fits beat single-pass fixed-$K$ VBGS by +2.7 dB yet tie an equally converged fixed-$K$ baseline, and on all eight NeRF-synthetic scenes DP-Splat holds held-out point-space color prediction within 0.33 dB of VBGS with 3.9-7.9x fewer occupied components, while under full rasterization on held-out views it renders 3.4-9.0 dB below the unpruned baseline; (iii) the posterior-predictive color variance is well calibrated, and a seeded matched-capacity ablation attributes that calibration to the conjugate color model rather than to the weight prior; (iv) the ordering suggested by exact-posterior asymptotics reverses under mean-field coordinate ascent: the DP prior resists over-splitting while the sparse finite mixture saturates its truncation.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 12 figures, 8 tables. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (2026); reviews and decision: https://openreview.net/forum?id=75Hx0RDPMr. Code and experiment records: https://github.com/archiedong/dp-splat
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DP-Splat 把 3D Gaussian Splatting 的混合权重先验从有限对称 Dirichlet 换成截断 stick-breaking Dirichlet 过程（或稀疏过参数化有限 Dirichlet），使占据成分数随数据自适应，同时每次更新仍是闭式坐标上升。在八个 NeRF-synthetic 场景上，它以少 3.9–7.9 倍的占据成分把留出点空间颜色预测保持在 VBGS 的 0.33 dB 以内，有效复杂度 K̂ 恢复真实 K 精度为 ±1；但全光栅化留出视图渲染比未剪枝基线低 3.4–9.0 dB，说明 DP 先验的贡献是复杂度选择而非单成分效率。
Motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 的成分数 K 依赖启发式密度控制或用户上限，Variational Bayes 版本 (VBGS) 虽把拟合化为共轭变分推断，K 仍是固定的，无法让占据成分数随场景复杂度自适应。
Method: 以截断 stick-breaking Dirichlet-process 先验（或稀疏过参数化有限 Dirichlet）替换 VBGS 的有限对称 Dirichlet 权重先验，所有更新保持闭式坐标上升，并给出自然梯度随机变体以扩展到大规模点集；配套 ELBO 单调与收敛保证，以及修正常用大 α 近似（低估精确 Ishwaran-James 界）的截断误差界。
Result: 收敛的 DP 拟合比单遍固定 K 的 VBGS 高 +2.7 dB，但与同等收敛的固定 K 基线打平；在全部八个 NeRF-synthetic 场景上，以 3.9–7.9 倍更少的占据成分将留出点空间颜色预测保持在 VBGS 的 0.33 dB 以内，而全光栅化留出视图渲染比未剪枝基线低 3.4–9.0 dB；有效复杂度 K̂ 恢复真实 K 在 ±1 内，后验预测颜色方差校准良好（归因于共轭颜色模型而非权重先验），并含 32 页、12 图、8 表。
Conclusion: DP 先验的作用是自动复杂度选择而非提升单成分效率，且精确后验渐近给出的 DP 与稀疏有限混合的排序在均场坐标上升下会反转：DP 抗过度分裂，稀疏有限混合则饱和其截断。

papers.title: SPINE: Bridging the Cyber-Physical Gap with Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models give robots powerful high-level reasoning, yet turning that intelligence into reliable physical action remains difficult: roboticists must still align device drivers, network interfaces, sensors, controllers, and safety constraints for each platform. This often-overlooked integration layer acts as the robot's spinal cord, translating high-level intent into coordinated physical behavior, and remains a primary bottleneck for scalable Embodied AI. Hence, we propose SPINE (Scalable Physical Integration with ageNtic Expertise), an agentic framework for systematically debugging and deploying bimanual robots for teleoperation. SPINE centers on two subagent-driven workflows: a profile builder that compiles robot-specific context and a debugger that uses that context to iterate through diagnosis, repair, and validation until teleoperation succeeds. Across two bimanual robot platforms and 12 debugging scenarios, novice-operated SPINE achieved more complete and efficient recovery than human operators using Claude Code. On DOBOT X-Trainer, SPINE improved success from 76% to 100% and reduced mean time-to-teleoperation by 30\%; on AgileX PiPER, SPINE also achieved 100\% success and reduced mean time-to-teleoperation by 38%. These results show that structured agentic debugging can address a key cyber-physical integration bottleneck in real-world robot deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPINE 用两个 subagent 工作流（profile builder 编译机器人专属上下文，debugger 循环诊断-修复-验证）把双臂机器人遥操作的调试自动化。在两个双臂平台、12 个调试场景上，新手操作 SPINE 比人类用 Claude Code 恢复更完整更快：DOBOT X-Trainer 成功率 76%→100%、平均遥操作就绪时间缩短 30%，AgileX PiPER 成功率 100%、时间缩短 38%。
Motivation: 基础模型给了机器人高层推理，但设备驱动、网络接口、传感器、控制器与安全约束的逐平台集成仍是 Embodied AI 可扩展部署的主要瓶颈。
Method: 提出 agentic 框架 SPINE（Scalable Physical Integration with ageNtic Expertise），含 profile builder 与 debugger 两个 subagent 工作流：前者编译机器人专属上下文，后者基于该上下文迭代诊断、修复、验证直至遥操作成功。
Result: 在两个双臂机器人平台、12 个调试场景上，新手操作 SPINE 相比使用 Claude Code 的人类操作者恢复更完整、更高效：DOBOT X-Trainer 成功率 76%→100%，平均遥操作就绪时间减少 30%；AgileX PiPER 成功率 100%，平均时间减少 38%。
Conclusion: 结构化的 agentic 调试可以解决真实机器人部署中的关键信息-物理集成瓶颈，让新手也能完成过去依赖熟练工程师的平台适配。

papers.title: Not All Objectives Are Born Equal: Priority-Constrained Descent for Hierarchical Multi-Objective Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning problems rarely involve objectives that are equal in importance. A primary objective defines the goal, whilst secondary objectives, such as sparsity, compression, or robustness constrain the solution. While existing multi-objective methods have proven effective in practice, they have a clear symmetry problem and neglect the inherent objective hierarchy built into these objective spaces. We introduce Priority-Constrained Descent (PCD), a gradient-based optimization framework designed to explicitly exploit hierarchical objective structures. PCD preserves the direction of primary descent whilst allowing for the minimal distortion necessary to guarantee progress on secondary objectives, controlled by a single $τ\in [0, 1]$ that dictates the strength of the distortion. The resulting formulation is invariant to objective scaling and admits exact closed-form solutions for problems with two and three objectives. We evaluate PCD within structured network compression settings, unstructured sparsity and low-rankness, and across a variety of synthetic experiments, showing Pareto dominance and better per-objective performance with secondary progress guarantees over existing methods, further exhibiting the interpretable trade-off that $τ$ provides.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Priority-Constrained Descent (PCD)：在多目标优化中保留主目标下降方向，只施加保证次目标前进所必需的最小畸变，畸变强度由单个 τ∈[0,1] 控制。该形式对目标尺度不变，两目标与三目标问题有精确闭式解；在结构化网络压缩、非结构化稀疏与低秩及多种合成实验中，相对现有方法取得 Pareto 支配与逐目标更优表现，并给出次目标进展保证。
Motivation: 深度学习目标重要性不对等，主目标定义目标、次目标（稀疏、压缩、鲁棒性）只是约束，但现有方法把目标当作对称处理，忽略了目标空间中固有的层级结构。
Method: PCD 是基于梯度的优化框架：保持主目标下降方向，只引入保证次目标前进所需的最小畸变，畸变强度由 τ∈[0,1] 调节；推导对目标尺度不变的公式，并对两目标、三目标问题给出精确闭式解。
Result: 在结构化网络压缩、非结构化稀疏与低秩以及多种合成实验上，PCD 相对现有方法呈现 Pareto 支配与逐目标更优性能，并带次目标进展保证；τ 提供可解释的权衡旋钮。
Conclusion: 多目标优化应显式利用目标层级而非假设对称：在保留主目标下降方向的前提下做最小畸变，即可同时保证次目标进展，且 τ 把权衡变成单一可调参数。

papers.title: SATURN: Symbolic Spatial Reasoning for Multi-Perspective Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain unreliable when spatial reasoning requires composing relations whose meanings depend on frames of reference. Existing tool-augmented spatial reasoning methods make reasoning more explicit, but often rely on low-level geometric procedures and hard binary decisions over noisy perception. We propose SATURN, a neuro-symbolic framework for perspective-aware compositional spatial reasoning. SATURN reconstructs an approximate 3D scene, derives soft perspective-aware spatial predicates, and composes them with a training-free Pythonic symbolic executor, separating perception from reasoning while preserving uncertainty through multi-hop inference. We also introduce 3D FORCE, a diagnostic benchmark that controls reasoning depth, view, and perspective composition for spatial arrangement grounding (SAG) and referring expression grounding (REF). On 3D FORCE, VLMs and spatially trained models degrade sharply as depth and perspective complexity increase, whereas SATURN degrades the least and outperforms every baseline at each depth. On the real-world MindCube benchmark, SATURN achieves \(78.06\%\) overall accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by \(14\) percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SATURN 用近似 3D 场景重建加软性视角相关空间谓词 (soft perspective-aware predicates)，再由免训练的 Python 符号执行器做多跳组合推理，把感知与推理分离并保留不确定性。在自建 3D FORCE 上，VLM 与空间训练模型随推理深度和视角组合复杂度急剧退化，而 SATURN 退化最小且在每个深度都超过全部基线；真实世界 MindCube 上总体准确率 78.06%，领先最强基线 14 个百分点。
Motivation: VLM 在关系含义依赖坐标系 (frame of reference) 的组合空间推理上不可靠；现有工具增强方法依赖低层几何过程与对含噪感知的硬二值判定，视角一变推理就崩。
Method: SATURN 先重建近似 3D 场景，导出软性视角相关空间谓词，再用免训练的 Pythonic 符号执行器做多跳组合，感知与推理分离并全程保留不确定性；同时提出诊断基准 3D FORCE，控制推理深度、视角与视角组合，覆盖空间排列 grounding (SAG) 与指代表达 grounding (REF) 两个任务。
Result: 在 3D FORCE 上，VLM 与空间训练模型随深度和视角复杂度上升急剧退化，SATURN 退化最小并在每个深度都优于所有基线；在真实世界 MindCube 上总体准确率 78.06%，比最强基线高 14 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把含噪感知与组合推理分开、用软谓词而非硬几何判定，是视角相关组合空间推理更稳的路径；3D FORCE 表明深度与视角组合是这类系统的主要失效轴。

papers.title: When Good Verifiers Go Bad: Silent Negative Transfer in Verifier-Guided VLM Training
papers.abstract_en: Verifier reliability is not portable across tasks. A verifier-guided self-DPO pipeline with genuine held-out gains on MathVista (+9.6 points on self-training data, +8.0 held out) can be harmful on MMMU. The failure is invisible from the target-task self-training signal: over six learner-verifier configurations, MMMU self-training performance still improves by +3.52 points while held-out performance drops by 1.42 points. We call this silent negative transfer: a verifier validated as useful before can still show signatures of successful self-training after its induced update stops transferring to unseen data. Downstream failure alone cannot diagnose this: poor generalization may mean the verifier induces a wrong learning direction, or that the correct direction itself does not generalize beyond the self-training distribution. We separate these effects via gradient fidelity F, the alignment between verifier-induced and correct training directions, and gradient transferability T, the alignment between correct and held-out directions, giving a conservative Safe-Transfer Margin: positive first-order held-out alignment is certified when arccos(F) + arccos(T) < pi/2. We then introduce Asymmetric Acceptance Gating (AAG), a precision-first filter selecting preference pairs by the verifier's absolute confidence in the response receiving the positive update. On MMMU, AAG raises fidelity from 0.29 to 0.42. In a same-cell analysis, the correct direction stays positively aligned with the held-out direction (T = 0.31), yet raw verification rotates the induced update to negative held-out alignment (-0.13); AAG restores positive alignment (+0.22). Across all six MMMU configurations, AAG beats raw verifier-guided training. Verifier reliability thus means not that it worked before, but that it induces the right update on the task at hand and that this update stays useful beyond the data that generated it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 验证器 (verifier) 引导的 VLM self-DPO 在 MathVista 上有真实增益（自训练数据 +9.6、held-out +8.0）却在 MMMU 上造成隐性负迁移：六个 learner-verifier 配置中自训练信号仍升 +3.52 而 held-out 降 1.42。作者用梯度保真度 F 与可迁移性 T 定义 Safe-Transfer Margin（arccos(F)+arccos(T)<π/2 才认证正对齐），并提出 Asymmetric Acceptance Gating (AAG) 按验证器对正更新响应的绝对置信度筛偏好对，把 MMMU 上的 F 从 0.29 提到 0.42，同格分析中 held-out 对齐从 −0.13 恢复到 +0.22。
Motivation: 验证器在源任务上验证有效并不保证在目标任务上仍引导正确更新；下游 held-out 变差本身无法区分「方向错了」与「方向对但不外推」，需要能在自训练信号仍上升时就诊断的判据。
Method: 分解两个量：梯度保真度 F（验证器诱导方向与正确训练方向的对齐）和梯度可迁移性 T（正确方向与 held-out 方向的对齐），给出保守判据 arccos(F)+arccos(T)<π/2 作为一阶 held-out 正对齐的认证；再提出 Asymmetric Acceptance Gating (AAG)，按验证器对接受正更新的响应的绝对置信度筛选偏好对，用于 verifier-guided self-DPO。
Result: MathVista 上 self-DPO 管线自训练数据 +9.6 点、held-out +8.0 点，但 MMMU 上六个 learner-verifier 配置自训练 +3.52 点而 held-out −1.42 点。AAG 在 MMMU 把 fidelity 从 0.29 提到 0.42；同格分析中 T=0.31（正确方向与 held-out 正对齐），raw verification 把诱导更新转到 −0.13，AAG 恢复到 +0.22；全部六个 MMMU 配置中 AAG 均胜过 raw verifier-guided training。
Conclusion: 验证器可靠性不等于「以前管用」，而是它在当前任务上诱导出正确更新、且该更新在生成它的数据之外仍然有效；下游表现单独无法诊断失败来源，需用 F 与 T 分离方向错误与不可外推。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Confidence Composition for Multiagent Language Model Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multiagent language model systems, such as collaborative reasoning and debate, produce multiple correlated candidate answers and confidence signals. However, these signals are usually calibrated only at the individual agent level, and provide no principled confidence estimate for the system's final answer. We formulate this as a confidence composition problem where combining confidence across agents and reasoning stages while preserving both selective utility and probabilistic reliability. We study confidence-aware routing and log-odds pooling protocols that select among candidate answers and output a system-level confidence. Across five benchmarks, 30 heterogeneous and homogeneous model pairs, and two confidence estimators, our gated-fusion methods improve AUARC and reduce Brier score over single agent, standard debate, and selective debate baselines, while retaining competitive weighted F1-score as a correctness metric. We further show that our log-odds fusion is overconfident due to correlated intermediate signals. We propose a shared dependence discount that substantially improves reliability while preserving predictions.
papers.comment: 22 pages and 4 figures in total, 11 pages (8 main, 3 reference) and 2 figures excluding the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多智能体 LLM 系统的置信度合成形式化为 confidence composition 问题，提出 gated-fusion（含 confidence-aware routing 与 log-odds pooling）输出系统级置信度，并给出共享的 dependence discount 修正相关中间信号导致的过度自信。在五个 benchmark、30 组异构/同构模型对、两种置信度估计器上，gated-fusion 相对单智能体、standard debate 与 selective debate 基线提升 AUARC、降低 Brier 分数，同时保持有竞争力的 weighted F1。
Motivation: 协作推理与 debate 产生的多个候选答案和置信信号彼此相关，且通常只在单个 agent 层面校准，系统最终答案没有有原则的置信度估计。
Method: 将问题形式化为 confidence composition：跨 agent 与推理阶段合成置信度，同时保持 selective utility 与 probabilistic reliability；具体协议为 confidence-aware routing 与 log-odds pooling（gated-fusion），并针对相关中间信号引入共享 dependence discount。
Result: 在五个 benchmark、30 对异构与同构模型、两种置信度估计器上，gated-fusion 相对单智能体、standard debate、selective debate 基线提高 AUARC、降低 Brier 分数，weighted F1 保持竞争力；log-odds fusion 因中间信号相关而过度自信，dependence discount 显著改善可靠性且保持预测不变。
Conclusion: 多智能体系统的置信度必须在合成阶段显式处理 agent 间相关性，否则 log-odds 类融合会过度自信；共享 dependence discount 能在不改变预测的前提下修复校准。

papers.title: Sharp First-Order Lower Bounds for Higher-Order Smooth Nonconvex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We study the deterministic first-order oracle complexity of finding \(ε\)-stationary points in smooth nonconvex optimization when the objective satisfies higher-order smoothness assumptions. While the classical \(ε^{-2}\) rate is optimal under only Lipschitz gradients, higher-order smoothness leads to accelerated first-order upper bounds, most notably the \(ε^{-7/4}\) rate under Lipschitz Hessians and the \(ε^{-5/3}\) rate under Lipschitz third derivatives. The matching lower bounds, however, have remained open. We resolve this gap by proving a new dimension-free first-order lower bound for higher-order smooth nonconvex functions, valid for every finite smoothness order. In particular, our construction gives a matching \(Ω(ε^{-7/4})\) lower bound in the Hessian-Lipschitz case and a matching \(Ω(ε^{-5/3})\) lower bound in the third-order-smooth regime. The hard instance is based on a \emph{block-chain} mechanism that enforces blockwise oracle revelation while preserving the smoothness structure needed for the scalar hard instance. The lower-bound construction was discovered with the assistance of ChatGPT 5.5 Pro and subsequently verified by the authors.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 1 table. Version 2 adds explicit numerical constants to all theorems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在光滑非凸优化的确定性一阶 oracle 复杂度中，证明了对任意有限光滑阶数都成立的 dimension-free 一阶下界，硬实例基于 block-chain 机制实现分块 oracle 揭示。在 Lipschitz Hessian 与 Lipschitz 三阶导数两种设定下分别给出匹配的 Ω(ε^{-7/4}) 与 Ω(ε^{-5/3}) 下界，闭合了此前加速上界缺少匹配下界的缺口。
Motivation: 仅假设梯度 Lipschitz 时 ε^{-2} 速率已知最优，但更高阶光滑性带来 ε^{-7/4}、ε^{-5/3} 等加速一阶上界，其匹配下界一直悬而未决，理论最优性无法判定。
Method: 构造 dimension-free 的一阶 oracle 硬实例，用 block-chain 机制强制分块 oracle 揭示，同时保持标量硬实例所需的光滑性结构；下界构造由 ChatGPT 5.5 Pro 辅助发现，再由作者验证，论文为 24 页含 1 张表，版本 2 为所有定理补上显式数值常数。
Result: 对任意有限光滑阶数给出 dimension-free 一阶下界；Lipschitz Hessian 情形匹配 Ω(ε^{-7/4})，三阶光滑情形匹配 Ω(ε^{-5/3})，与已知加速上界速率一致。
Conclusion: 更高阶光滑非凸优化的一阶复杂度下界可以做到与加速上界匹配，且对每个有限光滑阶数统一成立。

papers.title: Refit the Probe: Single-Direction Ablation Is Not a Necessity Test
papers.abstract_en: Probes are routinely paired with an intervention: ablate the direction the probe found, run the model, and read the change in task accuracy, taking a large drop as evidence that the computation depends on what the probe read and a near-zero drop as evidence that it does not. Either inference requires that the ablation have removed the target from the layer. We find that the ablation does not remove what it targets. A probe refitted on the ablated activations recovers its original accuracy in every cell we test, and keeps recovering when the probe's entire row space is deleted rather than a single axis, because the quantity survives in the orthogonal complement. Because a refitted probe recovers, neither a large task drop nor a near-zero one establishes whether the model needed the target, and one probe fit detects this. Replacing the ablation with iterative nullspace projection, scored against random subspaces of matched dimension, reverses the conclusion: representations that looked causally inert carry most of the task. The correction also separates where a variable is most readable from where deleting it does most damage, and those are not the same layer in any pretrained model we study. The erasure is defined by a linear probe family, so removing a nonlinearly encoded quantity remains open.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 12 figures. v2: substantially revised and retitled
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 单方向消融 (single-direction ablation) 不是必要性检验：探针找到的方向被删掉后，重训探针在所有测试单元上恢复原始精度，甚至整行空间被删也仍恢复，因为信息存于正交补中。改用迭代零空间投影 (iterative nullspace projection) 并以同维随机子空间为对照后结论反转——看似因果惰性的表征承载了大部分任务；可读性最高的层与删除伤害最大的层在所有预训练模型中都不重合。
Motivation: 探针+消融范式把任务精度下降当作计算依赖探针读出内容的证据，但这一推断的前提是消融确实移除了目标；若目标未被移除，两种推断（大降=依赖、近零降=不依赖）都不成立。
Method: 在消融后的激活上重训探针检验目标是否残留，并进一步删除探针的整个行空间；随后用迭代零空间投影替代单方向消融，以同维度随机子空间作为评分对照，比较可读性峰值层与删除伤害最大层。
Result: 重训探针在每个测试单元都恢复原始精度，删除整行空间后仍恢复；换成零空间投影后结论反转，看似因果惰性的表征承载了大部分任务；可读性最高层与删除伤害最大层在所研究的每个预训练模型中都不是同一层。
Conclusion: 单方向消融既不能证明也不能否证模型需要该目标量，必须先用重训探针确认目标被移除；且可读性与因果必要性定位在不同层。消融由线性探针族定义，非线性编码量的移除仍是开放问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DinoComplete: 3D Shape Completion with Distilled Semantic Priors and State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: 3D shape completion from partial scans remains challenging for unseen categories and noisy real-world observations, where geometry alone is often insufficient for inferring missing structure. We present DinoComplete, a deterministic and efficient shape completion framework that augments geometric reconstruction with voxel-aligned semantic priors distilled from DINO features. First, we construct multi-view DINO feature volumes aligned with ShapeNet data and train a student network to predict dense semantic features directly from incomplete shapes. These predicted features capture global structure and part-aware semantic context while remaining aligned with the underlying geometry. We then integrate these distilled features into a completion network, where geometric and semantic voxel representations are fused through voxel state-space modeling. To enable efficient long-range reasoning without sacrificing resolution, we introduce a multi-scale voxel Mamba module that refines the fused features by combining full-grid and chunk-wise sequence modeling. Experiments on unseen ShapeNet categories and ScanNet objects show that DinoComplete achieves stronger completion quality than prior deterministic and generative based completion methods while using fewer parameters, requiring lower memory, and achieving faster inference. Our results demonstrate that distilling semantic priors from visual foundation models improves generalization and robustness in 3D shape completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DinoComplete 把 DINO 视觉基础模型的语义特征蒸馏成体素对齐先验，与几何表征在多尺度 voxel Mamba 中融合做 3D 形状补全。在未见过的 ShapeNet 类别与 ScanNet 物体上，其补全质量优于既有确定性与生成式补全方法，同时参数更少、显存更低、推理更快。
Motivation: 部分扫描的 3D 形状补全在未见类别与含噪真实观测上表现不佳，仅靠几何难以推断缺失结构。
Method: 先在 ShapeNet 上构建多视角 DINO 特征体，训练学生网络从不完整形状直接预测稠密语义特征；再把蒸馏特征与几何体素表征在补全网络中融合，用多尺度 voxel Mamba 模块结合全网格与分块 (chunk-wise) 序列建模做长程推理。
Result: 在未见 ShapeNet 类别与 ScanNet 物体上，补全质量强于此前的确定性与生成式补全方法，且参数更少、显存占用更低、推理更快；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 从视觉基础模型蒸馏语义先验能提升 3D 形状补全的泛化性与鲁棒性，且不必以参数量、显存或速度为代价。

papers.title: CAffNet: Hard Constraint-Affine Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel framework for embedding hard constraint satisfaction into neural network (NN) architectures, specifically feedforward neural networks and transformers, with input-dependent affine constraints of arbitrary cardinality. Traditional constraint enforcement approaches either rely on penalty-based soft constraints, which offer no guarantee of satisfaction, or on post-processing methods that enforce constraints after the NN is trained, which may lead to suboptimality. We introduce a trainable constraint-affine (CAffine) layer into NNs, yielding CAffNet, which goes beyond enforcing affine constraints via fixed orthogonal or parallel projections and enables joint optimization with network parameters. Moreover, we impose no restrictions on the constraint space dimensions and establish that our construction preserves the universal approximation properties of NNs, while providing provable guarantees on constraint adherence for all inputs. Experimental validation demonstrates robust performance across diverse domains requiring guaranteed constraint satisfaction. The code is available at https://github.com/ice-t-lab/CAffNet.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可训练的约束仿射层 (CAffine layer)，把输入依赖、任意基数的硬约束嵌入前馈网络与 Transformer，得到 CAffNet，使约束满足与网络参数联合优化，且对所有输入给出可证明的约束遵守保证。
Motivation: 软惩罚约束不保证满足，训练后再做后处理投影又可能牺牲性能；需要在架构内部直接嵌入硬约束。
Method: 在网络中插入可训练的 CAffine 层，取代固定的正交或平行投影，支持输入依赖的仿射约束与任意约束基数，不限制约束空间维度；构造保持神经网络的万有逼近性质，并对所有输入给出约束遵守的可证明保证，适用于前馈网络与 Transformer。
Result: 实验验证在多个需要保证约束满足的领域上表现稳健；代码发布于 github.com/ice-t-lab/CAffNet。
Conclusion: 把硬约束做成可与参数联合训练的架构层，可以同时保住逼近能力与对所有输入的约束保证，优于纯软惩罚或事后投影两条传统路线。

papers.title: Unbiased Gradients, Moving Stability Boundaries: Exact Mini-Batch Geometry in Linear Self-Attention
papers.abstract_en: Unbiased stochastic gradients can match the full gradient in expectation while changing finite-step stability. We study this effect in one-layer linear self-attention for in-context linear regression, where shared-mode mini-batch training reduces exactly to a random two-factor map. The full-batch map preserves an elliptic region, whereas sampled curvature and target correlation create batch-dependent stability boundaries. Their combined fluctuation is centered at the parameter-update level but induces a strictly outward drift of the full-batch boundary coordinate. We derive an exact one-step crossing criterion, adaptive concentration bounds, and conditional drift identities, and prove almost-sure escape in a balanced switching model. For independent long prompts, mode leakage decays at the inverse square root of prompt length. For finite-token softmax attention, we derive an explicit boundary-crossing law governed by an effective context length that shrinks as attention scores concentrate. Experiments in ambient attention objectives verify the reduced predictions, and four trained causal softmax Transformers show larger mean curvature shifts for smaller first-step batches, consistent with the predicted nonlinear outward bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性自注意力的 in-context 线性回归设定中，无偏 mini-batch 随机梯度在期望上等于全梯度，却会把有限步稳定性边界系统性外推：全批映射保持一个椭圆区域，而批内采样的曲率与目标相关性波动使边界产生严格向外漂移。作者导出精确一步穿越判据、自适应集中界与条件漂移恒等式，并证明平衡切换模型下参数几乎必然逃逸出该区域。
Motivation: 随机梯度无偏只保证期望一致，不保证有限步训练的稳定性；在共享模式 mini-batch 训练中，全批映射的稳定椭圆区域会被批依赖的波动破坏，这一机制此前缺少精确刻画。
Method: 把一层线性自注意力在 in-context 线性回归下的共享模式 mini-batch 训练精确化为随机二因子映射；据此推导一步穿越判据、adaptive concentration bounds 与条件漂移恒等式，在 balanced switching 模型中证明 almost-sure escape，并对有限 token 的 softmax 注意力导出由有效上下文长度控制的边界穿越律。
Result: 独立长 prompt 下 mode leakage 按 prompt 长度的平方根倒数衰减；softmax 注意力的边界穿越律由随注意力分数集中而缩短的有效上下文长度决定。ambient attention 目标上的实验验证了约化预测；四个训练好的 causal softmax Transformer 中，第一步 batch 越小，平均曲率位移越大，与预测的非线性向外偏置一致。
Conclusion: 无偏梯度并不保持有限步稳定性：mini-batch 波动会让全批稳定边界向外漂移并导致参数几乎必然逃逸，且该偏置在小 batch、注意力分数集中的情形下更强。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Financially Guided Deep Portfolio Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Portfolio optimization in real-world financial markets is notoriously difficult due to non-stationarity, noisy data, and high transaction costs. Standard predict-then-optimize methods first forecast returns and then solve for weights, compounding prediction errors and often failing under regime shifts. We propose an end-to-end framework that directly optimizes differentiable surrogates of key financial metrics (Sharpe ratio, Omega ratio, Conditional Value-at-Risk, and risk parity), allowing neural networks to learn portfolio weights via backpropagation. Our expanding-window walk-forward procedure, applied to 50 S&P 500 stocks from 2007 to 2023, incorporates realistic bid-ask spread costs and rebalances quarterly. On the challenging out-of-sample test period (2022-2023), the best model, an AttentionLSTM with the Omega-CVaR-RiskParity loss, achieves an annualized Sharpe of 0.29 and a total compounded return of +7.86%, while the S&P 500 delivers -4.52% total compounded return and an annualized Sharpe of -0.02. This outperforms the S&P 500 by 12.38 percentage points, while keeping tail risk (CVaR) nearly unchanged. The framework outperforms the equal-weight portfolio, S&P 500, and traditional methods (MVP, HRP, NCO, ERC), demonstrating that embedding financial objectives directly into model training yields robust, economically meaningful outperformance even in adverse market conditions.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Presented at the IEEE Symposium on Computational Intelligence for Financial Engineering and Economics (CIFEr 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出端到端组合优化框架，直接对 Sharpe、Omega、CVaR 与 risk parity 的可微代理做反向传播学习权重，取代先预测收益再求解的两阶段流程。在 50 只 S&P 500 股票、2007–2023 扩展窗口季度再平衡（含买卖价差成本）下，AttentionLSTM 配 Omega-CVaR-RiskParity 损失在 2022–2023 测试期年化 Sharpe 0.29、累计收益 +7.86%，对比 S&P 500 的 -4.52% 与 -0.02，领先 12.38 个百分点且 CVaR 尾部风险基本不变。
Motivation: 先预测收益再优化权重的两阶段方法会累积预测误差，在制度切换 (regime shift) 下失效；真实市场还有非平稳、噪声与高交易成本。
Method: 端到端框架用神经网络直接输出组合权重，损失为 Sharpe ratio、Omega ratio、Conditional Value-at-Risk 与 risk parity 的可微代理的组合；采用扩展窗口 walk-forward，50 只 S&P 500 股票、2007–2023，纳入 bid-ask spread 成本、按季度再平衡，最优模型为 AttentionLSTM 加 Omega-CVaR-RiskParity 损失。
Result: 2022–2023 样本外：AttentionLSTM（Omega-CVaR-RiskParity）年化 Sharpe 0.29、累计复利收益 +7.86%；同期 S&P 500 累计 -4.52%、年化 Sharpe -0.02，领先 12.38 个百分点，CVaR 尾部风险几乎不变；框架在等权组合、S&P 500 与 MVP、HRP、NCO、ERC 上均更优。
Conclusion: 把金融目标直接嵌入训练损失，可在含成本、季度再平衡的不利市场条件下得到稳健且经济上有意义的超额表现，优于等权、指数与传统组合方法。

papers.title: Tight Sample Complexity Bounds for Entropic Best Policy Identification
papers.abstract_en: We study best-policy identification for finite-horizon risk-sensitive reinforcement learning under the entropic risk measure. Recent work established a constant gap in the exponential horizon dependence between lower and upper bounds on the number of samples required to identify an approximately optimal policy. Precisely, known lower bounds scale in $Ω(e^{|β| H})$ where $H$ is the horizon of the MDP, while the state-of-the-art upper bound achieves at best $O(e^{2|β| H})$ (arXiv:2506.00286v2) using a generative model. We show that this extra exponential factor can be traced to overly loose concentration control for exponential utilities. To close this open gap, we revisit the analysis of this problem through a forward-model based algorithm building on KL-based exploration bonuses that we adapt to the entropic criterion. The improvement we get is due to two main novel technical innovations. We leverage the smoothness properties of the exponential utility to derive sharper concentration bounds, and we propose a new stopping rule that exploits further this tightness to obtain a sample complexity that matches the lower bound.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有限时域、指数风险度量 (entropic risk) 的风险敏感强化学习中，把已知下界 Ω(e^{|β|H}) 与最优上界 O(e^{2|β|H}) 之间的指数级常数差归因于指数效用的集中控制过松，并通过基于前向模型、KL 探索 bonus 的算法把样本复杂度压到与下界匹配。
Motivation: 风险敏感 best-policy identification 的样本复杂度上下界之间存在 e^{|β|H} 量级的指数缺口，此前最优上界 (arXiv:2506.00286v2，generative model) 只能做到 O(e^{2|β|H})，多余因子来自对指数效用的集中界过松。
Method: 提出基于前向模型 (forward-model) 的算法，把 KL 探索 bonus 改造成适配指数风险准则的形式；利用指数效用的光滑性推导更紧的集中界，并设计利用该紧性的新停止规则。
Result: 得到的样本复杂度与已知下界 Ω(e^{|β|H}) 相匹配，消除了此前上界 O(e^{2|β|H}) 中多出的指数因子。
Conclusion: 指数风险 best-policy identification 的样本复杂度上下界可以对齐，多余指数因子确实源于对指数效用过于宽松的集中控制，而非问题本身的难度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Practical Scaling Laws: Converting Compute into Performance in a Data-Constrained World
papers.abstract_en: The scaling laws guiding modern model training were calibrated for a single regime: data-rich, single-epoch pretraining. The dominant such scaling law form, Chinchilla's $L = E + A/N^α+ B/D^β$, has three structural limitations outside that regime: it diverges as unique data shrinks instead of saturating at the uninformed baseline; it cannot represent overfitting when capacity exceeds the data; and it conflates total examples seen with unique examples available. We propose a closed-form extension, $L(N, D, T) = E + (L_0 - E)\,h/(1+h)$ with $h = a/N^α+ b/T^β+ c\,N^γ/D^δ$, that decomposes loss into undercapacity, undertraining, and overfitting terms. It saturates between the irreducible loss $E$ and an uninformed baseline $L_0$ fixed by the loss type, and reduces to Chinchilla in the data-rich, single-epoch limit. We validate it on four multi-epoch experiments spanning four architecture families (MLPs, ResNets, Fourier neural operators, and transformers) across vision, scientific ML, and language domains, and refit it to five published LLM scaling-law grids. Extrapolating to higher compute and larger unique data than seen at fit time, our form achieves state-of-the-art RMSE on every published LLM grid we evaluate and on most cells of our constructed experiments. Once calibrated, the form admits a cost-aware allocation that recovers Chinchilla's optimum when data is free and shifts toward smaller corpora and more epochs as data grows expensive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指出 Chinchilla 标度律 L = E + A/N^α + B/D^β 在数据受限、多轮训练下有三个结构缺陷：唯一数据变少时发散而非饱和、无法表示过拟合、混淆总样本数与唯一数据量。提出闭式扩展 L(N,D,T) = E + (L₀−E)h/(1+h)，h = a/N^α + b/T^β + cN^γ/D^δ，把损失分解为欠容量、欠训练、过拟合三项，在数据充足单轮极限退化为 Chinchilla。
Motivation: 主流标度律只在数据充足、单轮预训练这一种体制下校准，唯一数据变少时损失发散而非饱和到无信息基线，也无法刻画容量超过数据时的过拟合，导致算力分配在数据昂贵时给出错误建议。
Method: 提出闭式损失形式 L(N,D,T) = E + (L₀−E)h/(1+h)，h = a/N^α + b/T^β + cN^γ/D^δ，分别对应欠容量、欠训练、过拟合三项；损失在不可约损失 E 与由损失类型决定的无信息基线 L₀ 之间饱和。在四个多轮训练实验（覆盖 MLP、ResNet、Fourier neural operator、transformer 四类架构，横跨视觉、科学 ML、语言领域）上验证，并重新拟合五个已发表的 LLM 标度律网格。
Result: 在高于拟合时所见算力与更大唯一数据的外推设定下，该形式在每一个评估的已发表 LLM 网格上取得 state-of-the-art RMSE，并在自建实验的多数格点上更优。校准后可做成本感知的算力分配：数据免费时恢复 Chinchilla 最优点，数据变贵时向更小语料、更多轮次偏移。
Conclusion: 把总样本数与唯一数据量分开、并显式加入过拟合项，标度律才能跨数据受限的多轮训练体制外推；成本感知分配随数据价格在语料规模与轮次之间连续权衡。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: LLM Ghostbusters: Surgical Package Hallucination Suppression via Adaptive Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Hallucinations remain an unsolved problem for LLMs, and package hallucinations are a particularly dangerous instance of this phenomenon. Package hallucinations occur during code generation when a model fabricates non-existent software packages, recommending imports and installation commands for fictional libraries. This creates a critical supply-chain vulnerability; an attacker can proactively register such packages on public registries with malicious payloads that are subsequently installed and executed by developers or autonomous agents. These hallucinations enable a class of package confusion attack known as slopsquatting. To address this issue, we present Adaptive Unlearning (AU), a post-deployment framework that surgically suppresses package hallucinations while preserving general model utility. AU introduces a hybrid token-level objective that simultaneously reinforces valid outputs and suppresses hallucinated ones. Combined with an adaptive discovery loop that continuously surfaces new hallucination-inducing contexts without human supervision, AU enables generalization to unseen prompts and hallucinations. We demonstrate that AU reduces package hallucination rates by 88%, while maintaining performance on standard coding benchmarks. Our analysis shows that distributional changes are concentrated on package-related generations, leaving general coding behavior largely unaffected and confirming that AU's effect is isolated to the targeted distribution. AU relies entirely on model-generated data and requires no human annotation, representing a post-deployment hallucination mitigation framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出部署后框架 Adaptive Unlearning (AU)，用混合 token 级目标同时强化合法输出、抑制虚构包名，并以自监督的自适应发现循环持续挖掘新的幻觉诱导上下文。包幻觉率下降 88%，标准编码基准性能保持不变，分布变化集中在包相关生成上。
Motivation: 代码生成中模型会编造不存在的软件包并给出 import 与安装命令，攻击者可抢先在公共 registry 注册同名恶意包，形成 slopsquatting 供应链攻击。
Method: AU 是部署后框架：混合 token 级目标一边强化有效输出一边抑制幻觉输出，配合无人工监督的自适应发现循环持续产生新的幻觉诱导上下文，全部数据由模型自生成、无需人工标注。
Result: 包幻觉率降低 88%，同时在标准编码基准上保持性能；分析显示分布变化集中在包相关生成，整体编码行为基本不受影响。
Conclusion: AU 的作用被隔离在目标分布内，可在不牺牲通用编码能力的前提下压低包幻觉，从而削弱 slopsquatting 面。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SPLICE: Latent Diffusion over JEPA Embeddings for Conformal Time-Series Inpainting
papers.abstract_en: Generative models for time-series imputation achieve strong reconstruction accuracy, yet provide no finite-sample reliability guarantees, a critical limitation in power systems where imputed values inform dispatch and planning. We introduce SPLICE (Self-supervised Predictive Latent Inpainting with Conformal Envelopes), a modular framework coupling latent generative imputation with distribution-free, online-adaptive prediction intervals. A JEPA encoder maps daily load segments into a 64-dimensional latent space; a conditional latent bridge with four sampling modes generates candidate gap trajectories; an hourly-conditioned decoder maps back to signal space; and Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI) wraps the output with coverage-guaranteed prediction bands. The flow-matching variant achieves comparable quality to DDIM in 5--10 ODE steps (5-10x speedup). On thirteen load datasets (nine proprietary, three UCI Electricity, ETTh1), SPLICE achieves the lowest mean Load-only MSE (0.056), winning 9/12 non-degenerate datasets at 91-day gaps and 18/32 across all gap lengths vs. five established baselines, and produces the best CRPS (0.161, -18.3% vs. the strongest competitor). ACI delivers 93--95% empirical coverage, correcting under-coverage failures of up to 7.5 pp observed with static conformal prediction. A pooled JEPA encoder trained on nine feeds transfers to four unseen domains, matching or exceeding per-dataset oracles with only a quick bridge fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPLICE 把 JEPA 潜空间生成式补全与 Adaptive Conformal Inference 结合，为电力负荷时间序列缺失段同时给出重建与覆盖率保证的预测区间。在 13 个负荷数据集上，Load-only MSE 0.056（91 天缺口赢 9/12 个非退化数据集），CRPS 0.161 比最强竞争者低 18.3%，ACI 达到 93–95% 经验覆盖率并纠正静态 conformal 高达 7.5 pp 的欠覆盖。
Motivation: 生成式时间序列插补精度高但没有有限样本可靠性保证，而电力系统中被插补的数值直接进入调度与规划，欠覆盖的区间会把风险带进决策。
Method: JEPA 编码器把每日负荷段映射到 64 维潜空间；条件 latent bridge（含 flow-matching 与 DDIM 等四种采样模式）生成候选缺口轨迹；按小时条件的解码器还原信号；外层用 Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI) 包裹输出，给出带覆盖保证的预测带。
Result: 在 13 个负荷数据集（9 个专有、UCI Electricity 三个、ETTh1）上对比五个既有基线：最低平均 Load-only MSE 0.056，91 天缺口赢 9/12 个非退化数据集、全缺口长度合计赢 18/32；最佳 CRPS 0.161，比最强竞争者低 18.3%；flow-matching 变体用 5–10 步 ODE 达到与 DDIM 相当的质量，加速 5–10 倍；ACI 经验覆盖率 93–95%，而静态 conformal 出现最高 7.5 pp 的欠覆盖；在 9 条馈线上训练的池化 JEPA 编码器迁移到 4 个未见域，仅做快速 bridge 微调即匹配或超过按数据集训练的 oracle。
Conclusion: 潜空间生成插补加在线自适应 conformal 区间可以在电力负荷缺口中同时拿到重建质量、区间覆盖率与跨域迁移，静态 conformal 的欠覆盖必须由 ACI 这类在线校正来补。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Faithful Autoformalization via Roundtrip Verification and Repair
papers.abstract_en: When an LLM formalizes natural language, how do we know the output is faithful? We propose a roundtrip verification approach which does not require ground-truth annotations: formalize a statement, translate the result back to natural language, re-formalize, and use a formal tool to check logical equivalence. When the two formalizations agree, this provides evidence of a faithful formalization. When they disagree, a stage-level diagnosis localizes the error to a specific translation step, and a scoped repair operator attempts to correct that step. We evaluate the framework on two statutory domains (the Texas Transportation Code and the Texas Parks and Wildlife Code) using two LLMs (Claude Opus~4.6 and GPT-5.2) with three repair baselines. Diagnosis-guided scoped repair is the most effective method, with effectiveness contingent on the reliability of the diagnosis function. Across both domains and both models, under our full repair system, rules that fail the equivalence check show 1.4x-2.5x more natural language inference (NLI) drift than rules that pass it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无需 ground-truth 标注的往返验证 (roundtrip verification) 框架：把自然语言形式化、译回自然语言、再形式化，并用形式化工具检查两次形式化是否逻辑等价；不一致时用阶段级诊断定位错误并施加作用域修复算子。在 Texas Transportation Code 与 Texas Parks and Wildlife Code 两个法域、Claude Opus 4.6 与 GPT-5.2 两个模型上，诊断引导的作用域修复是三种修复基线中最有效的，且未通过等价检查的规则其 NLI 漂移比通过者高 1.4x–2.5x。
Motivation: LLM 把自然语言形式化后缺少 ground-truth 标注来判定输出是否忠实，错误也难以定位到具体翻译步骤。
Method: 往返验证流程：形式化 → 译回自然语言 → 再次形式化 → 用形式化工具检查逻辑等价；不一致时由阶段级诊断把错误定位到特定翻译步骤，再由 scoped repair operator 修复该步骤。在两个法域上用 Claude Opus 4.6 与 GPT-5.2 评测，并对比三个修复基线。
Result: 诊断引导的作用域修复在两个法域、两个模型上均为最有效的修复方法，其效果取决于诊断函数的可靠性；在完整修复系统下，未通过等价检查的规则比通过的规则表现出 1.4x–2.5x 的 NLI 漂移 (NLI drift)。
Conclusion: 无需标注的往返等价检查可作为忠实性证据并驱动错误定位与修复，而修复效果以诊断函数的可靠性为前提。

papers.title: The Virtue of Sparsity in Complexity
papers.abstract_en: Sparsity or complexity? In modern high-dimensional asset pricing, these are often viewed as competing principles: recent empirical evidence favors richer models, while economic intuition has long favored parsimony. We reconcile this tension by distinguishing capacity sparsity-restrictions on effective model capacity-from factor sparsity-the parsimonious structure of priced risks. Revisiting the benchmark empirical design of Didisheim et al. (2025), we combine nonlinear feature expansions with basis pursuit, using column generation and GPU acceleration to scale estimation to 432 million candidate factors. Reaching this scale reveals a reversal in out-of-sample performance: sparse portfolios trail dense ridgeless benchmarks at lower complexity but achieve a higher Sharpe ratio and lower pricing error at the largest candidate set. Capacity expansion and factor sparsity are therefore complements: enlarging the candidate space allows a parsimonious pricing kernel to outperform its dense counterpart.
