papers.title: OpenQlaw: An Agentic AI Assistant for Analysis of 2D Quantum Materials
papers.abstract_en: Physics-aware multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can localize and characterize two-dimensional (2D) material flakes from optical microscopy images, producing rich candidate observations and scientific reasoning. However, downstream workflows also require reliable operations over these outputs, including counting, selection, measurement, and rendering. We present OpenQlaw, a tool-using agentic artificial intelligence (AI) system that connects a general vision-language orchestrator with Physics-Aware Instruction Tuning (QuPAINT), a physics-aware domain expert. Through evaluation on fully reviewed optical microscopy images, we show that summary counts derived from longer free-form candidate enumerations can become inconsistent with the underlying returned observations. Controlled replay experiments further show that structuring the same observations alone does not resolve this behavior, while deterministic delegation returns the exact requested record count in all cohort trials. To address this, we introduce \textbf{State-Grounded OpenQlaw}, which converts expert outputs into image-scoped observation records and performs deterministic scientific operations over explicitly identified records with refusal conditions when required information is unavailable. This preserves the expert's original analysis while making downstream operations exact over the selected record and independently evaluable from candidate-list discrepancies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenQlaw 是面向 2D 量子材料光学显微图像的工具调用型 agentic AI 系统，把视觉-语言 orchestrator 与物理感知领域专家 QuPAINT 相连，用于对候选片层观测做计数、筛选、测量与渲染。受控重放实验显示，仅把自由文本候选列表结构化并不能消除计数不一致，而确定性委派 (deterministic delegation) 在全部 cohort 试验中返回精确的请求记录数；State-Grounded OpenQlaw 因此把专家输出转为图像范围的观测记录并在信息缺失时拒绝执行。
Motivation: 物理感知 MLLM 输出的自由形式候选枚举在下游计数等操作上不可靠，摘要计数会与底层返回观测不一致，破坏科学工作流的可复核性。
Method: 系统由通用视觉-语言 orchestrator 加 Physics-Aware Instruction Tuning 领域专家 (QuPAINT) 组成，通过工具调用执行下游操作；State-Grounded OpenQlaw 将专家输出转为 image-scoped 观测记录，对显式标识的记录执行确定性科学操作，并在所需信息不可用时设置拒绝条件 (refusal conditions)。评估用完全审阅的光学显微图像，并做受控重放实验对比仅结构化与确定性委派。
Result: 在完全审阅的光学显微图像上，较长自由形式候选枚举导出的摘要计数会与底层返回观测不一致；受控重放显示仅对相同观测做结构化并不能消除该行为，而确定性委派在全部 cohort 试验中都返回精确的请求记录数。
Conclusion: 下游计数类操作必须落在显式标识、图像范围的记录上并以确定性方式执行，才能既保留专家原始分析又让操作可独立评测；仅靠把候选列表结构化不足以修复计数不一致。

papers.title: Leveraging higher-order time integration methods for improved computational efficiency in a rainshaft model
papers.abstract_en: Cloud and precipitation microphysics packages in atmospheric general circulation models typically use first-order time integration methods with a large time step, requiring ad hoc limiters and substepping of the sedimentation scheme to prevent numerical instability. We investigate alternative methods for rain microphysical processes in the current Energy Exascale Earth System Model (E3SMv3), provided by the Predicted Particle Properties (P3) scheme. Using an offline rainshaft model containing P3's rain microphysics as a proxy for E3SMv3, we find that rain microphysics is underresolved in time at E3SMv3's default 300s time step. Accurately resolving the rainshaft model processes in time requires an over 100x reduction in time step, increasing wall clock time by 40x. However, higher-order time integrators based on Runge-Kutta methods offer improved solution accuracy for a given computational cost. Adaptive time stepping is key to obtaining computationally efficient microphysics results, eliminating the need for specialized substepping procedures in the sedimentation process. An adaptive second-order Runge-Kutta method approximates a high-temporal-resolution reference solution at only 2.6x the cost of the default P3 scheme; this method achieves high accuracy greater than 15x more efficiently than simply reducing the time step of P3 in the rainshaft model. We also analyze the timescales of the rain processes to obtain insight about the maximum time step each process is able to take while maintaining stability and accuracy, and about how individual processes should be grouped together for most efficient results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 E3SMv3 的 P3 雨微物理离线 rainshaft 模型中，默认 300s 时间步对雨微物理欠分辨，要准确解析需把时间步缩小 100 倍以上、墙钟时间增至 40 倍。改用自适应二阶 Runge-Kutta 只花默认 P3 方案 2.6 倍代价即可逼近高时间分辨率参考解，达到同等高精度比单纯缩小 P3 时间步高效 15 倍以上；自适应步长还免去了沉降 (sedimentation) 方案的专门 substepping。
Motivation: 大气 GCM 的云与降水微物理普遍用大时间步的一阶积分器，只能靠临时限制器和沉降 substepping 压住数值不稳定，代价高且精度受限。
Method: 以 E3SMv3 中 P3 方案的雨微物理构建离线 rainshaft 模型作为代理，对比一阶大步长、直接缩小时间步与基于 Runge-Kutta 的高阶自适应时间积分；并分析各雨过程的时间尺度，判断每个过程在保持稳定与精度下的最大时间步及过程分组方式。
Result: E3SMv3 默认 300s 时间步下雨微物理欠分辨；准确解析需时间步缩小 100 倍以上，墙钟时间增加 40 倍。自适应二阶 Runge-Kutta 以默认 P3 方案 2.6 倍代价逼近高时间分辨率参考解，达到高精度的效率比直接缩小 P3 时间步高 15 倍以上。
Conclusion: 自适应高阶时间积分是雨微物理计算效率的关键，可在不加专门沉降 substepping 的前提下同时拿到精度与速度；过程时间尺度分析给出各过程的最大可行时间步与分组依据。
Relevance: 41

papers.title: Real Money, Fake Models: Deceptive Model Claims in Shadow APIs
papers.abstract_en: Access to frontier large language models (LLMs), such as GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5, is often hindered by high pricing, payment barriers, and regional restrictions. These limitations drive the proliferation of $\textit{shadow APIs}$, third-party services that claim to provide access to official model services without regional limitations via indirect access. Despite their widespread use, it remains unclear whether shadow APIs deliver outputs consistent with those of the official APIs, raising concerns about the reliability of downstream applications and the validity of research findings that depend on them. In this paper, we present the first systematic audit between official LLM APIs and corresponding shadow APIs. We first identify 17 shadow APIs that have been utilized in 187 academic papers, with the most popular one reaching more than 5,900 citations and 58,000 GitHub stars by December 6, 2025. Through multidimensional auditing of three representative shadow APIs across utility, safety, and model verification, we uncover widespread behavioral inconsistency and fingerprint-based evidence consistent with deceptive model claims in a subset of audited endpoints. Specifically, we reveal performance divergence reaching up to 47.21%, significant unpredictability in safety behaviors, and identity verification failures in 45.83% of fingerprint tests. These practices critically undermine the reproducibility and validity of scientific research, harm the interests of shadow API users, and damage the reputation of official model providers. By the time of writing, 4 of the 17 providers have already ceased operations, underscoring the operational volatility of this market. Meanwhile, unverifiable compliance claims and independent model-substitution testing platforms have emerged in the ecosystem, reflecting growing community awareness of this risk.
papers.comment: Accepted by the ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 shadow API（声称间接提供 GPT-5、Gemini-2.5 等官方模型访问的第三方服务）做首次系统审计：识别出 17 个被 187 篇学术论文使用的 shadow API，审计其中三个代表性端点后发现性能偏离最高达 47.21%、45.83% 的指纹测试身份验证失败，且安全行为显著不可预测，指纹证据与欺骗性模型声明一致。结论是依赖 shadow API 的研究结论可复现性与有效性被直接破坏。
Motivation: 官方 LLM API 的高价、付费与地区限制催生 shadow API，但其输出是否与官方 API 一致长期不清，依赖它的下游应用与学术研究结果因此不可信。
Method: 先盘点被学术文献引用的 shadow API 清单，再对三个代表性 shadow API 端点做多维审计，覆盖 utility、safety 与 model verification 三个维度，其中身份判定用模型指纹 (fingerprint) 测试。
Result: 识别出 17 个 shadow API，被 187 篇论文使用；最流行者截至 2025-12-06 有超过 5,900 次引用与 58,000 个 GitHub stars。审计三个代表性端点：性能偏离最高 47.21%，指纹测试中 45.83% 身份验证失败，安全行为显著不可预测。写作时 17 个提供方中已有 4 个停止运营。
Conclusion: shadow API 中存在与欺骗性模型声明一致的模型替换行为，破坏科研可复现性与用户利益；该市场运营高度不稳定，生态中已出现合规声明与独立模型替换测试平台。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Communication-Efficient Byzantine-Robust Federated Conformal Prediction via Partial Sharing
papers.abstract_en: We propose PRISM-FCP (Partial shaRing and robust calIbration with Statistical Margins for Federated Conformal Prediction), a communication-efficient Byzantine-robust federated conformal prediction framework that uses partial model sharing to mitigate stochastic model-poisoning attacks during training and histogram-based filtering to mitigate adversarial calibration submissions. Existing robust FCP approaches primarily address adversarial behavior during calibration, leaving training-stage poisoning to separate robust-training mechanisms. PRISM-FCP instead considers the coupling between the two stages. During training, clients partially share updates by transmitting only $M$ of $D$ parameters per round. Under the stated stochastic attack model, this attenuates the expected energy of each Byzantine client's perturbation contribution to the aggregate by a factor of $M/D$ relative to full sharing. When this benefit outweighs the optimization slowdown caused by partial updates, it can reduce training error and improve interval efficiency. During calibration, the server uses client-provided characterization vectors to filter suspected Byzantine clients before estimating the conformal quantile from the retained clients. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and the UCI Superconductivity and YearPredictionMSD datasets, including Gaussian, ALIE, and sign-flipping training-stage attacks, demonstrate near-nominal empirical coverage and favorable communication--performance tradeoffs in the studied settings.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables, Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing (TSP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM-FCP 把联邦共形预测 (federated conformal prediction) 的训练与校准两个阶段一起做拜占庭鲁棒：训练时每轮只传 D 个参数中的 M 个，把单个拜占庭客户端扰动对聚合的期望能量按 M/D 衰减；校准时用客户端特征向量做直方图过滤再估共形分位数。在合成基准与 UCI Superconductivity、YearPredictionMSD 上，面对 Gaussian、ALIE、sign-flipping 训练阶段攻击仍取得接近名义的经验覆盖率，并给出有利的通信-性能折中。
Motivation: 现有鲁棒 FCP 主要只防校准阶段的对抗行为，训练阶段的模型投毒要另靠鲁棒训练机制处理，两个阶段被割裂，而它们实际是耦合的。
Method: PRISM-FCP：训练阶段客户端每轮仅传输 M/D 的参数 (partial model sharing) 以衰减拜占庭扰动；校准阶段服务器用客户端提交的 characterization vectors 做 histogram-based filtering，剔除可疑客户端后再从保留客户端估计 conformal quantile。
Result: 在随机攻击模型下，部分共享使每个拜占庭客户端扰动对聚合的期望能量相对全共享衰减 M/D 倍；当该收益超过部分更新带来的优化变慢时，可降低训练误差并提升区间效率。在合成基准与 UCI Superconductivity、YearPredictionMSD 上，含 Gaussian、ALIE、sign-flipping 训练阶段攻击时达到接近名义的经验覆盖率，并呈现有利的通信-性能折中。
Conclusion: 训练与校准两个阶段的鲁棒性需要联合设计：部分参数共享在随机攻击模型下按 M/D 抑制投毒能量，配合校准端直方图过滤即可在所研究设定中维持近名义覆盖。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有鲁棒 FCP 主要只防校准阶段的对抗行为，训练阶段的模型投毒要另靠鲁棒训练机制处理，两个阶段被割裂，而它们实际是耦合的。
summary_sections.method: PRISM-FCP：训练阶段客户端每轮仅传输 M/D 的参数 (partial model sharing) 以衰减拜占庭扰动；校准阶段服务器用客户端提交的 characterization vectors 做 histogram-based filtering，剔除可疑客户端后再从保留客户端估计 conformal quantile。
summary_sections.result: 在随机攻击模型下，部分共享使每个拜占庭客户端扰动对聚合的期望能量相对全共享衰减 M/D 倍；当该收益超过部分更新带来的优化变慢时，可降低训练误差并提升区间效率。在合成基准与 UCI Superconductivity、YearPredictionMSD 上，含 Gaussian、ALIE、sign-flipping 训练阶段攻击时达到接近名义的经验覆盖率，并呈现有利的通信-性能折中。
summary_sections.conclusion: 训练与校准两个阶段的鲁棒性需要联合设计：部分参数共享在随机攻击模型下按 M/D 抑制投毒能量，配合校准端直方图过滤即可在所研究设定中维持近名义覆盖。

papers.title: SWE-Universe: Scale Real-World Verifiable Environments to Millions
papers.abstract_en: We propose SWE-Universe, a scalable and efficient framework for automatically constructing real-world software engineering (SWE) verifiable environments from GitHub pull requests (PRs). To overcome the prevalent challenges of automatic building, such as low production yield, weak verifiers, and prohibitive cost, our framework utilizes a building agent powered by an efficient custom-trained model. This agent employs iterative self-verification and in-loop hacking detection to ensure the reliable generation of high-fidelity, verifiable tasks. Using this method, we scale the number of real-world multilingual SWE environments to a million scale (807,693). We demonstrate the profound value of our environments through large-scale agentic mid-training and reinforcement learning. Finally, we applied this technique to Qwen3-Max-Thinking and achieved a score of 75.3% on SWE-Bench Verified. Our work provides both a critical resource and a robust methodology to advance the next generation of coding agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-Universe 用定制训练的 building agent 从 GitHub PR 自动构建可验证的软件工程环境，靠迭代自验证与 in-loop hacking 检测保证任务保真度，把真实多语言 SWE 环境扩到 807,693 个。经大规模 agentic mid-training 与强化学习后，Qwen3-Max-Thinking 在 SWE-Bench Verified 上得 75.3%。
Motivation: 自动构建 SWE 可验证环境长期受产出率低、验证器弱、成本高制约，难以支撑 coding agent 的大规模训练。
Method: 框架以定制训练的高效模型驱动 building agent，从 GitHub PR 构建环境，采用迭代自验证 (iterative self-verification) 与 in-loop hacking 检测确保生成高保真可验证任务；随后用这些环境做大规模 agentic mid-training 与强化学习，并将技术应用于 Qwen3-Max-Thinking。
Result: 真实多语言 SWE 环境规模扩至百万级，具体 807,693 个；Qwen3-Max-Thinking 在 SWE-Bench Verified 上取得 75.3%。
Conclusion: 自动构建加自验证与 hacking 检测能把真实 SWE 可验证环境扩到百万量级，并作为 coding agent 下一代训练的关键资源与方法论。

papers.title: Neighbor-Aware Token Reduction via Hilbert Curve for Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved remarkable success in visual recognition tasks, but redundant token representations limit their computational efficiency. Existing token merging and pruning strategies often overlook spatial continuity and neighbor relationships, resulting in the loss of local context. This paper proposes novel neighbor-aware token reduction methods based on Hilbert curve reordering, which explicitly preserves the neighbor structure in a 2D space using 1D sequential representations. Our method introduces two key strategies: Neighbor-Aware Pruning (NAP) for selective token retention and Merging by Adjacent Token similarity (MAT) for local token aggregation. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-offs compared to existing methods. This work highlights the importance of spatial continuity and neighbor structure, offering new insights for the architectural optimization of ViTs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 Hilbert 曲线重排的邻域感知 token 压缩，用一维序列显式保留二维空间邻接结构，含邻域感知剪枝 (NAP) 与相邻 token 相似度合并 (MAT) 两个策略。在视觉识别任务上取得相对现有 token 合并/剪枝方法的 state-of-the-art 精度-效率权衡。
Motivation: ViT 的冗余 token 限制计算效率，而现有合并与剪枝策略忽略空间连续性和邻域关系，导致局部上下文丢失。
Method: 先用 Hilbert 曲线把二维 token 重排为一维序列以保持邻域结构，再施加两个策略：NAP 做选择性 token 保留，MAT 按相邻 token 相似度做局部聚合。
Result: 在视觉识别任务上，相比现有 token 合并与剪枝方法取得 state-of-the-art 的精度-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 空间连续性与邻域结构是 ViT token 压缩中应显式建模的因素，可作为架构优化方向。

papers.title: Agent0: Unleashing Self-Evolving Agents from Zero Data via Tool-Integrated Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) Agents, often trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL), are constrained by a dependency on human-curated data, limiting scalability and tethering AI to human knowledge. Existing self-evolution frameworks offer an alternative but are typically restricted by the model's inherent capabilities and single-round interactions, hindering the development of complex curricula involving tool use or dynamic reasoning. We introduce Agent0, a fully autonomous framework that evolves high-performing agents without external data through multi-step co-evolution and seamless tool integration. Agent0 establishes a symbiotic competition between two agents initialized from the same base LLM: a curriculum agent that proposes increasingly challenging frontier tasks, and an executor agent that learns to solve them. We integrate external tools to enhance the executor's problem-solving capacity; this improvement, in turn, pressures the curriculum agent to construct more complex, tool-aware tasks. Through this iterative process, Agent0 establishes a self-reinforcing cycle that continuously produces high-quality curricula. Empirically, Agent0 substantially boosts reasoning capabilities, improving the Qwen3-8B-Base model by 18% on mathematical reasoning and 24% on general reasoning benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/Agent0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agent0 让两个由同一 base LLM 初始化的 agent（课程 agent 出题、执行 agent 解题）在无外部数据下多轮共生竞争，并把外部工具接入执行端，工具能力提升反过来逼课程 agent 出更难、工具感知的题目，形成自增强循环。Qwen3-8B-Base 经此训练，数学推理提升 18%、通用推理基准提升 24%。
Motivation: LLM agent 依赖人工标注数据训练，可扩展性受限；现有自进化框架受模型自身能力与单轮交互约束，难以形成涉及工具使用或动态推理的复杂课程。
Method: 两个 agent 从同一 base LLM 出发做多步协同进化：curriculum agent 提出越来越难的前沿任务，executor agent 通过 RL 学习解题；外部工具接入 executor，其能力提升再对 curriculum agent 施压生成更复杂、工具感知的任务，循环迭代产出高质量课程。
Result: 在数学推理上使 Qwen3-8B-Base 提升 18%，在通用推理基准上提升 24%；框架全程不使用外部人工数据。
Conclusion: 无需人工数据、靠课程 agent 与工具增强执行 agent 的共生竞争即可持续产出高质量训练课程并实质提升推理能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: POPI: Personalizing LLMs via Optimized Natural Language Preference Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are typically aligned with population-level preferences, despite substantial variation across individual users. We introduce POPI, a user-level personalization framework that separates the problem into two components connected by a natural-language interface: a shared inference model that distills heterogeneous user signals into a concise preference summary, and a shared generator that conditions on this summary to produce personalized responses. Both components are trained under a unified preference-optimization objective, with reinforcement learning handling the non-differentiable inference step. This objective decomposes into generator approximation error and summary informativeness, revealing how a single loss simultaneously drives accurate generation and informative summarization. Because the interface is natural language, learned summaries can be inferred once per user and reused across different generators -- including frozen, black-box commercial APIs. Across four personalization benchmarks, POPI generally improves personalization quality while reducing context overhead by up to an order of magnitude.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: POPI 把 LLM 个性化拆成共享推理模型与共享生成器两段，用自然语言偏好摘要作接口，统一偏好优化目标同时驱动准确生成与摘要信息量。在四个个性化基准上总体提升个性化质量，并将上下文开销降低最多一个数量级。
Motivation: LLM 只对齐群体级偏好，个体用户偏好差异大；直接把用户历史塞进上下文成本高，且换生成器就要重算。
Method: 共享推理模型把异构用户信号蒸馏成简明自然语言偏好摘要，共享生成器以该摘要为条件生成个性化回复；两部分用统一偏好优化目标训练，非可分的推理步骤由强化学习处理，目标可分解为生成器逼近误差与摘要信息量两项。
Result: 在四个个性化基准上，POPI 总体提升个性化质量，同时上下文开销最多降低一个数量级；摘要可每用户推断一次并复用于不同生成器，包括冻结的黑盒商业 API。
Conclusion: 自然语言偏好摘要作为接口，可让个性化在换生成器时复用，并在提升质量的同时大幅压缩上下文成本。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Design Assistant for the Simulation of Inertial Fusion Energy
authors: Jonathan L. Belof (1) ((1) Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory Livermore
USA (3) Los Alamos National Laboratory Los Alamos
papers.abstract_en: Inertial fusion energy promises nearly unlimited, clean power if it can be achieved. However, the design and engineering of fusion systems requires controlling and manipulating matter at extreme energies and timescales; the shock physics and radiation transport governing the physical behavior under these conditions are complex requiring the development, calibration, and use of predictive multiphysics codes to navigate the highly nonlinear and multi-faceted design landscape. We hypothesize that artificial intelligence reasoning models can be combined with physics codes and emulators to autonomously design fusion fuel capsules. In this article, we construct a multi-agent system where natural language is utilized to explore the complex physics regimes around fusion energy. The agentic system is capable of executing a high-order multiphysics inertial fusion computational code. We demonstrate the capacity of the multi-agent design assistant to translate natural-language design goals into simulation execution, physics-emulator construction, analysis, and iterative refinement of capsule-geometry parameters, ultimately achieving simulated ignition within the computational design workflow.

papers.journal_ref: Shachar, M.H., Fernández-Godino, M.G., Jekel, C.F., Menon, H., Sterbentz, D.M., Hao, Y., Korner, K.A., Rieben, R.N., White, D.A., Belof, J.L. and Schill, W.J., 2026. Physical Review E, 114(2), p.025303
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向惯性约束聚变 (ICF) 燃料靶丸设计的多智能体系统，用自然语言驱动高阶多物理场计算代码，把设计目标转成仿真执行、物理代理模型 (emulator) 构建、结果分析与靶丸几何参数的迭代细化，最终在计算设计流程内实现模拟点火 (simulated ignition)。
Motivation: ICF 靶丸设计要在极端能量与时间尺度下的强非线性多物理场空间中导航，冲击物理与辐射输运复杂，依赖人工开发、标定和使用预测性多物理场代码，设计探索成本高。
Method: 构建以自然语言为接口的多智能体系统，AI 推理模型与物理代码及 emulator 结合：智能体执行高阶多物理场 ICF 计算代码，构建物理 emulator，并对靶丸几何参数做分析与迭代细化。
Result: 演示了多智能体设计助手把自然语言设计目标转成仿真执行、emulator 构建、分析与迭代细化的完整流程，并在该计算设计工作流中达到模拟点火。
Conclusion: AI 推理模型可以与物理代码和 emulator 组合，自主完成聚变燃料靶丸的闭环设计，把自然语言目标直接推进到点火结果。

papers.title: Real-time autonomous magnetic microrobot navigation across dynamic and biologically relevant environments
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous microrobots could enable minimally invasive interventions in confined biological environments, but their operation requires real-time navigation among moving obstacles and environmental disturbances. Here we present a closed-loop framework for autonomous magnetic microrobot navigation that separates long-range geometric planning from short-range reactive control. An analytic geometry-based planner continuously generates collision-free global routes from microscopy images, while rule-based or reinforcement-learning local controllers respond to moving obstacles before returning control to the replanned global route. The planner produces short paths with substantially lower computation time than representative graph-, sampling- and geometry-based planners, and the integrated framework operates within the video-rate control budget. We demonstrate microrobot autonomous navigation in static and dynamic microfluidic environments, including avoidance of moving particles and human red blood cells, navigation with and against fluid flow, and repeated long-duration target transitions. We further demonstrate magnetic microrobot actuation in ex vivo ocular and vascularized cortical tissues and photoacoustic detection of magnetically induced microrobot dynamics in post-mortem tissue. These results establish a modular framework for autonomous magnetic microrobot navigation in complex biological environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出磁性微机器人自主导航的闭环框架，把长程几何规划与短程反应控制解耦：解析几何规划器从显微图像实时生成无碰全局路径，规则式或强化学习局部控制器应对移动障碍后再交还给重规划路径。规划器路径更短、计算时间显著低于图采样几何类规划器，整体跑在视频帧率控制预算内，并在微流控、离体眼部与血管化皮层组织中完成导航演示。
Motivation: 微机器人要在狭窄生物环境中实时绕开移动障碍与环境扰动，而单一规划器难以同时兼顾全局路径质量与局部反应速度。
Method: 闭环框架分两层：解析几何规划器持续从显微图像生成无碰全局路径；局部控制器用规则式或强化学习 (RL) 响应移动障碍，处理完交还给重规划的全局路径。在静态与动态微流控环境、离体眼部与血管化皮层组织中演示，并用光声 (photoacoustic) 检测死后组织中磁致微机器人动力学。
Result: 规划器生成的路径更短，计算时间比代表性基于图、采样和几何的规划器大幅更低，整体框架运行在视频帧率控制预算内；演示内容包括避让移动颗粒与人红细胞、顺流与逆流航行、多次长时间目标切换，以及离体组织中的磁驱动与光声探测。
Conclusion: 把长程几何规划与短程反应控制解耦的模块化框架，足以支撑复杂生物环境中磁性微机器人的实时自主导航。

papers.title: Glucose-ML: A collection of longitudinal diabetes datasets for development of robust AI solutions
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms are a critical part of state-of-the-art digital health technology for diabetes management. Yet, access to large high-quality datasets is creating barriers that impede development of robust AI solutions. To accelerate development of transparent, reproducible, and robust AI solutions, we present Glucose-ML, a collection of 10 publicly available diabetes datasets, released within the last 7 years (i.e., 2018 - 2025). The Glucose-ML collection comprises over 300,000 days of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) data with a total of 38 million glucose samples collected from 2500+ people across 4 countries. Participants include persons living with type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, and no diabetes. To support researchers and innovators with using this rich collection of diabetes datasets, we present a comparative analysis to guide algorithm developers with data selection. Additionally, we conduct a case study for the task of blood glucose prediction - one of the most common AI tasks within the field. Through this case study, we provide a benchmark for short-term blood glucose prediction across all 10 publicly available diabetes datasets within the Glucose-ML collection. We show that the same algorithm can have significantly different prediction results when developed/evaluated with different datasets. Findings from this study are then used to inform recommendations for developing robust AI solutions within the diabetes or broader health domain. We provide direct links to each longitudinal diabetes dataset and openly provide our code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Glucose-ML 汇总 10 个 2018–2025 年公开的纵向糖尿病数据集，含 30 万+天 CGM、3800 万条血糖采样、2500+ 人、4 个国家，并给出跨全部 10 个数据集的短期血糖预测基准。核心发现是同一算法在不同数据集上开发/评估时预测结果显著不同，因此选数据集本身会改变结论。
Motivation: 糖尿病数字健康中缺少大规模高质量数据，阻碍稳健、可复现 AI 方案的开发；不同数据集之间的差异会系统性改变算法评估结论。
Method: 构建 Glucose-ML 数据集集合（10 个公开数据集，含 1 型、2 型、糖尿病前期与非糖尿病人群的 CGM 数据），提供面向算法开发者的比较分析，并以短期血糖预测为案例任务，在全部 10 个数据集上建立基准，公开数据链接与代码。
Result: 集合覆盖 10 个数据集、30 万+天 CGM、3800 万条血糖样本、2500+ 受试者、4 个国家（2018–2025）；案例研究显示同一算法在不同数据集上开发或评估时预测结果显著不同，并给出跨 10 个数据集的短期血糖预测基准。
Conclusion: 数据集选择会显著改变血糖预测算法的表现，开发稳健 AI 方案时应把数据集差异作为首要考量；建议可推广到糖尿病及更广的健康领域。

papers.title: The Challenge of Identifying the Origin of Black-Box Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The tremendous commercial potential of large language models (LLMs) has heightened concerns over their unauthorized use. To address this, we focus on the task of identifying the origin of black-box LLMs. We further propose PlugAE, an effective and efficient identification method that proactively leverages LLM-specific adversarial embeddings and allows users to customize copyright tokens on a targeted query set. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PlugAE outperforms both state-of-the-art model watermarking and fingerprinting methods in accuracy and robustness. We further analyze its stealthiness and reliability from three complementary perspectives and conduct ablation studies under various configurations, confirming its practicality for real-world misuse detection.
papers.comment: To Appear in the Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对黑盒 LLM 来源识别（模型版权归属）提出 PlugAE：主动构造 LLM 特有的对抗嵌入 (adversarial embeddings)，并允许用户在目标查询集上定制版权 token，用于检测未授权使用。实验显示其在准确率与鲁棒性上均超过现有模型水印 (watermarking) 与指纹 (fingerprinting) 方法，并从三个互补视角分析隐蔽性与可靠性。
Motivation: LLM 商业价值带来未授权使用风险，而黑盒条件下难以判定一个模型的来源归属，现有水印与指纹方法在准确率和鲁棒性上不足。
Method: PlugAE 主动利用 LLM 特有的对抗嵌入，用户可在指定目标查询集上定制版权 token；实验与 SOTA 水印、指纹方法对比，并做多配置消融与隐蔽性、可靠性分析。
Result: 在准确率与鲁robustness 上均优于 SOTA 模型水印与指纹方法；从三个互补视角分析 stealthiness 与 reliability，并在多种配置下完成消融研究，确认其可用于真实场景的滥用检测。
Conclusion: 以对抗嵌入加可定制版权 token 做黑盒来源识别，可在准确率、鲁棒性与隐蔽性上同时成立，具备实际滥用检测的可用性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Hierarchical Sparse Bayesian Multitask Learning for Disease Prediction in Pooled Microbiome Studies
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a hierarchical Bayesian multitask learning model that is applicable to the general multi-task binary classification learning problem where the model assumes a shared sparsity structure across different tasks. We derive a computationally efficient inference algorithm based on variational inference to approximate the posterior distribution. We demonstrate the potential of the new approach on various synthetic datasets and for predicting human health status based on microbiome profile. Our analysis incorporates data pooled from multiple microbiome studies, along with a comprehensive comparison with other benchmark methods. Results in synthetic datasets show that the proposed approach has superior support recovery property when the underlying regression coefficients share a common sparsity structure across different tasks. Our experiments on microbiome classification demonstrate the utility of the method in extracting informative taxa while providing well-calibrated predictions with uncertainty quantification and achieving competitive performance in terms of prediction metrics. Notably, despite the heterogeneity of the pooled datasets (e.g., different experimental objectives, laboratory setups, sequencing equipment, patient demographics), our method delivers robust results.
papers.journal_ref: Zhu, H., Goncalves, A.R., Kok, C.R. et al. Hierarchical sparse Bayesian multitask learning for disease prediction in pooled microbiome studies. BioData Mining (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出层级稀疏贝叶斯多任务学习模型，用于跨任务共享稀疏结构的多任务二分类，用变分推断高效近似后验。在合成数据上，当回归系数跨任务共享共同稀疏结构时，该方法的支持集恢复 (support recovery) 优于基准方法；在合并的多研究微生物组数据上，它能提取有信息量的菌群并给出校准良好的概率预测与不确定性量化，且在实验目标、实验室、测序设备和人群均异质的合并数据上仍保持稳健表现。
Motivation: 合并多个微生物组研究做疾病预测时，各数据集在实验目标、实验室、测序设备和人群上高度异质，而单任务方法无法利用不同任务间共享的稀疏结构，也难以给出带不确定性的校准预测。
Method: 构建层级贝叶斯多任务学习模型，假设不同任务的回归系数共享稀疏结构；推导基于变分推断 (variational inference) 的高效后验近似算法；在多组合成数据集上检验支持集恢复，并在合并的多研究人类微生物组数据上做健康状态二分类，与其他基准方法比较。
Result: 合成数据上，当底层回归系数跨任务共享共同稀疏结构时，该方法的支持集恢复性质优于基准方法；微生物组分类实验中，方法提取出有信息量的菌群，预测校准良好并带不确定性量化，预测指标上表现有竞争力，且在异质合并数据上结果稳健。
Conclusion: 共享稀疏结构的层级贝叶斯多任务建模配合变分推断，能在异质合并微生物组数据上同时做到特征选择、校准预测和不确定性量化，对多任务二分类问题具有一般适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decidable Reasoning About Time in Finite-Domain Situation Calculus Theories
papers.abstract_en: Representing time is crucial for cyber-physical systems and has been studied extensively in the situation calculus. The most commonly used approach represents time by adding a real-valued function $\mathit{time}(a)$ that attaches a time point to each action and consequently to each situation. We show that in this approach, checking whether there is a reachable situation that satisfies a given formula is undecidable, even when the domain contains only finitely many objects. We present an alternative approach based on well-established results from timed automata theory by introducing clocks as real-valued fluents with restricted successor state axioms and comparison operators. With this restriction, we can show that the reachability problem for finite-domain basic action theories is decidable. Finally, we apply our results to Golog program realization by presenting a decidable procedure for determining an action sequence that is a successful execution of a given program.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 situation calculus 中，给每个动作附加实值 time(a) 的常见时间表示下，即使对象有限，判断是否存在满足给定公式的可达 situation 也是不可判定的；改用 timed automata 式的时钟（clocks 作为带受限后继状态公式的实值 fluent 与受限比较算子）后，有限域基本动作理论的可达性问题变为可判定，并可给出判定 Golog 程序是否存在成功执行序列的可判定过程。
Motivation: cyber-physical 系统需要在 situation calculus 中表示时间，但最常用的实值 time(a) 表示会让可达性检查在对象有限时仍不可判定，导致无法自动验证或规划。
Method: 借鉴 timed automata 理论，把时钟建模为实值 fluent，其后继状态公式的与比较算子都加以限制；在此受限形式下分析有限域基本动作理论的可达性，并把结果用于 Golog 程序实现。
Result: 证明在实值 time(a) 表示下可达性不可判定，即使域中只有有限个对象；证明受限时钟表示下有限域基本动作理论的可达性可判定；给出判定 Golog 程序是否存在成功执行动作序列的可判定过程。
Conclusion: 时间表示的选择决定 situation calculus 理论的可判定性：必须限制时钟的更新与比较形式，才能对有限域动作理论和 Golog 程序做自动判定。

papers.title: Stable Marriage Problems with Ties and Incomplete Preferences: An Empirical Comparison of ASP, SAT, ILP, CP, and Local Search Methods
papers.abstract_en: We study a variation of the Stable Marriage problem, where every man and every woman express their preferences as preference lists which may be incomplete and contain ties. This problem is called the Stable Marriage problem with Ties and Incomplete preferences (SMTI). We consider three optimization variants of SMTI, Max Cardinality, Sex-Equal and Egalitarian, and empirically compare the following methods to solve them: Answer Set Programming, Constraint Programming, Integer Linear Programming. For Max Cardinality, we compare these methods with Local Search methods as well. We also empirically compare Answer Set Programming with Propositional Satisfiability, for SMTI instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对带不完整偏好与无差异（ties）的稳定婚姻问题 SMTI 三个优化变体（Max Cardinality、Sex-Equal、Egalitarian），实证比较 ASP、CP、ILP 三种求解方法，并对 Max Cardinality 额外加入 Local Search、对 SMTI 实例额外加入 SAT 与 ASP 对比。
Motivation: SMTI 中偏好列表可不完整且含 ties，使稳定匹配的三个优化目标求解方法选型缺乏系统实证依据。
Method: 对三个优化变体分别用 Answer Set Programming、Constraint Programming、Integer Linear Programming 求解并实证比较；Max Cardinality 变体再加入 Local Search 方法，SMTI 实例上另将 ASP 与 Propositional SAT 比较。
Result: 给出 ASP、CP、ILP 在 Max Cardinality、Sex-Equal、Egalitarian 三个 SMTI 变体上的实证比较，以及 Max Cardinality 上与 Local Search、SMTI 实例上 ASP 与 SAT 的对比；arXiv comment 标注实验结果已修订，摘要未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: SMTI 的三个优化变体可由 ASP、CP、ILP 统一求解，方法选型应按变体（及是否引入 Local Search、SAT）分别实证确定。

papers.title: MAC-RRG: Iterative Multi-Agent Collaboration for X-ray Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable progress of LLM-based and knowledge graph-augmented Radiology Report Generation (RRG) methods, existing techniques still suffer from inherent defects. Conventional LLM-only models lack structured medical prior knowledge, resulting in frequent medical hallucinations and low diagnostic interpretability. Current knowledge graph-enhanced schemes adopt static one-round knowledge fusion with single-source knowledge, incapable of dynamic knowledge updating according to generation feedback. This paper proposes a novel Multi-Agent Collaborative iterative framework for X-ray Radiology Report Generation, termed MAC-RRG. Inspired by multi-agent technology, our framework constructs a closed-loop optimization paradigm based on task decoupling and collaborative reasoning. Specifically, the framework first generates a preliminary radiology report from input X-ray images via a vision encoder and a basic LLM. Subsequently, a multimodal knowledge graph (MM-KG) agent mines structured disease correlation and anatomical knowledge from medical knowledge graphs, while an auxiliary knowledge agent extracts unstructured domain knowledge from public medical databases. The multi-source knowledge acquired by dual agents is fused and embedded to guide the LLM in iteratively refining the initial report. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments on mainstream X-ray RRG datasets, including IU X-ray, MIMIC, and CheXpert Plus, fully verify the superiority of our proposed method. The source code and pre-trained models have been released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/Medical_Image_Analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAC-RRG 用多智能体迭代协作做 X 光放射报告生成：视觉编码器加基础 LLM 出初稿，MM-KG 智能体与辅助知识智能体分别从医学知识图谱和公共医学数据库取多源知识，融合嵌入后按生成反馈迭代改写报告。在 IU X-ray、MIMIC、CheXpert Plus 上的定量与定性实验验证了方法优势，代码与预训练模型已开源。
Motivation: 纯 LLM 的报告生成缺少结构化医学先知，易产生医学幻觉、诊断可解释性低；现有知识图谱增强方案是单轮静态、单源知识融合，无法依据生成反馈动态更新知识。
Method: 构建基于任务解耦与协同推理的多智能体闭环迭代框架：视觉编码器加基础 LLM 生成初稿报告；多模态知识图谱智能体 (MM-KG agent) 从医学知识图谱挖掘结构化疾病关联与解剖知识，辅助知识智能体从公共医学数据库抽取非结构化领域知识；双智能体的多源知识融合嵌入后引导 LLM 迭代精修报告。
Result: 在主流 X 光 RRG 数据集 IU X-ray、MIMIC、CheXpert Plus 上进行了大量定量与定性实验，验证所提方法的优越性；源码与预训练模型已在 GitHub (Event-AHU/Medical_Image_Analysis) 发布。
Conclusion: 多源知识经多智能体协同并按生成反馈迭代融合，可替代单轮静态知识注入，作为提升 X 光放射报告生成诊断可解释性、抑制医学幻觉的路径。

papers.title: The Probabilistic Structure of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a probabilistic perspective on large language models (LLMs), developed with the aim of bringing together, in a single self-contained account, tools that are usually treated separately across the literature. LLMs are described through probability measures on the set of sequences of tokens, specified via their autoregressive conditional distributions. Training is formulated as a maximum-likelihood estimation problem, addressed by stochastic gradient methods, while text generation is viewed as the sequential simulation of the resulting stochastic process. The role of the asymmetry of the Kullback--Leibler divergence in text generation is examined in relation with characteristic phenomena such as hallucination and the distinction between statistical plausibility and truth. As a complementary illustration of the same viewpoint, we also discuss diffusion models, built around the score function, which cast generation not as sequential token prediction but as the simulation of a reverse-time stochastic process transforming noise into data both in discrete and continuous time.
papers.comment: Expository article on the probabilistic structure of large language models, 27 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 27 页的综述性文章，把 LLM 统一写成 token 序列上的概率测度：训练是最大似然估计加随机梯度，生成是该随机过程的序贯模拟。核心论断是 KL 散度的不对称性解释了幻觉以及统计合理性与真实性的分离；扩散模型则以 score function 把生成改写为离散或连续时间的反向随机过程。
Motivation: LLM 的训练、生成、幻觉等现象在文献中被分散处理，缺少一个自洽的概率框架把它们放进同一套语言里。
Method: 用 token 序列上的概率测度与自回归条件分布刻画 LLM；训练表述为最大似然估计并用随机梯度方法求解；文本生成视为随机过程的序贯模拟；再以 score function 为轴讨论扩散模型的反向时间随机过程（离散与连续时间）作为同一视角的补充例证。
Result: 文章考察 KL 散度不对称性与幻觉、统计合理性同真实性之别之间的关系，并给出扩散模型作为同一概率视角下的补充说明；全文为 27 页综述性文章。
Conclusion: LLM 的训练与生成可以统一放进概率测度与随机过程的语言中，而 KL 不对称性是理解幻觉与合理性/真实性区分的关键结构性质。

papers.title: Entropy Can Flow, or It Can Guide. Be Entropy. LEDFlow: Introducing Entropy-guided Generation Order into Uniform Discrete Flow
papers.abstract_en: Uniform discrete flow permits repeated updates at every generation position. While continued revision supports correction of wrong tokens, it also exposes correct intermediate predictions to later errors. An experiment on Sudoku puzzles shows that 9.4% of generated cells are correct at an intermediate step but incorrect in the final output. We introduce generation order into uniform discrete flow through selective absorption, which fixes chosen predictions while preserving the uniform-flow velocity at active positions. To prevent absorbing incorrect predictions, we propose Low-Entropy Discrete Flow (LEDFlow), a training-free sampler that adaptively orders absorption by local entropy. By decomposing absorption error into joint dependence and conditional prediction terms, we show that selecting the lowest-entropy positions under a fixed absorption budget minimizes an upper bound on the conditional term. We further support the choice of local entropy by showing that the decision-error bound of global lookahead grows with the lookahead window under an imperfect denoiser. Across reasoning benchmarks, LEDFlow attains 0.845 Nikoli Sudoku solve accuracy, with the largest gains on strongly constrained tasks. On text-to-image generation it attains the best overall score, and on multimodal understanding it improves over the native sampler on all six benchmarks, at an inference cost comparable to standard flow sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LEDFlow 在 uniform discrete flow 中引入由局部熵决定的生成顺序：通过 selective absorption 固定已选预测，优先吸收熵最低的位置。Sudoku 中间步正确但最终错误的格子占 9.4%，LEDFlow 达到 0.845 Nikoli Sudoku 求解准确率，收益在强约束任务上最大。
Motivation: uniform discrete flow 允许每个生成位置反复更新，纠错的同时也让原本正确的中间预测暴露在后续错误中；Sudoku 实验显示 9.4% 的生成格子中间步正确却在最终输出中变错。
Method: 提出 selective absorption，在保持活跃位置 uniform-flow 速度的同时固定被选中的预测；训练免的 Low-Entropy Discrete Flow (LEDFlow) 用局部熵自适应决定吸收顺序，并把吸收误差分解为 joint dependence 与 conditional prediction 两项，证明在固定吸收预算下选最低熵位置可最小化条件项上界；另证在不完美 denoiser 下全局 lookahead 的决策误差界随 lookahead 窗口增大。
Result: Sudoku 上 9.4% 的生成格子中间步正确但最终错误；LEDFlow 达 0.845 Nikoli Sudoku 求解准确率，强约束任务提升最大；文生图取得最佳总体分数；多模态理解在全部六个基准上均优于原生采样器，推理开销与标准 flow sampling 相当。
Conclusion: 按局部熵排序的吸收能在不增加推理成本的前提下减少 uniform discrete flow 的后期翻转错误，且约束越强收益越大。

papers.title: Impact Is Not Invalidation: Ask About the Claim, Not the Diff
papers.abstract_en: Memory systems for coding agents must decide, when a repository changes, which of their stored claims have become false. Content anchoring invalidates a claim whenever the artifact it came from changes, which fires constantly. Semantic-equivalence classification asks whether a diff preserves behavior, a question about the diff rather than about any stored claim. We show the second signal fails for a reason unrelated to model capability: asked whether a commit preserves behavior, five models spanning a 40x price range fire on 59-72% of real commits and reach precisions of only 0.291 to 0.329 against a 0.25 base rate. Asked instead whether one specific claim still holds, the same models on the same diffs reach 0.705 to 0.974. A control that hands the behavior-preservation judge the claim text, changing only the question, moves precision by 0.010 and 0.016; changing the question moves it by 0.49 and 0.65. We also compare against pytest-testmon, a deployed regression-test selector with coverage-derived dependency data: it reaches 0.868 recall at 0.415 precision, so near-complete knowledge of what a change can reach does not identify what it falsifies. Ground truth is execution, not annotation: a claim is a test function passing at commit t, and it has flipped if that same assertion text fails at t+1. Building this required an observation we did not find in prior work. On a CI-gated mainline a commit that leaves a pre-existing test failing cannot merge, so the naive construction has an empty positive class by design. We report 10,369 claims with 184 execution-verified flips mined from 23 Python libraries, splits held out by repository, a post-knowledge-cutoff split, a shuffled-diff null, a paraphrase control, and a leave-one-repository-out analysis over 17 repositories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对编码 agent 记忆系统中「仓库变更后哪些存储 claim 已失效」的问题，论文对比两种信号：内容锚定（diff 一变就作废）与语义等价判断（问 diff 是否保持行为）。五个跨 40 倍价格区间的模型在真实 commit 上做行为保持判断时触发率 59–72%，precision 仅 0.291–0.329（base rate 0.25）；改为直接问「这条特定 claim 是否仍成立」，同模型同 diff 上 precision 升到 0.705–0.974。对照实验显示换问题本身带来 0.49 与 0.65 的 precision 提升，而只把 claim 文本喂给行为保持 judge 仅移动 0.010 与 0.016。
Motivation: 编码 agent 的记忆系统在仓库变更后需要判定哪些已存 claim 失效：内容锚定过于频繁地作废，而语义等价判断问的是 diff 而非 claim 本身，其失败原因与模型能力无关。
Method: 以执行为 ground truth：claim 定义为 commit t 处通过的测试函数，若同一断言文本在 t+1 失败则记为 flip。为绕开 CI 主线上「遗留失败测试无法合并导致正类为空」的构造问题，从 23 个 Python 库挖出 10,369 条 claim 与 184 个执行验证的 flip；评测含按仓库留出的 split、知识截止后 split、shuffled-diff null、paraphrase control，以及 17 个仓库上的 leave-one-repository-out 分析。
Result: 行为保持判断在五个跨 40 倍价格区间模型上触发 59–72% 的真实 commit，precision 0.291–0.329（base rate 0.25）；改为针对单条 claim 的判断后 precision 达 0.705–0.974。把 claim 文本交给行为保持 judge、只换提问方式的对照仅移动 0.010 与 0.016，而换问题本身移动 0.49 与 0.65。对照基线 pytest-testmon（基于 coverage 依赖数据的回归测试选择器）在 0.415 precision 下达到 0.868 recall。数据规模为 10,369 claims、184 flips、23 个 Python 库、17 仓库 LORO 分析。
Conclusion: 作者主张失效判定应直接问「这条 claim 是否仍成立」而非问 diff 是否改变行为；即便近乎完整掌握一次变更能触及的范围（如 testmon 的 coverage 依赖），也无法识别它证伪了什么。

papers.title: WILSON - a pathology foundation model framework for patient-level analysis and diagnostic text generation
papers.abstract_en: Pathologists integrate morphology across magnifications and across the slides of a patient case, whereas pathology foundation models encode thousands of tiles from single slides and aggregate their features. Here we present WILSON, a vision--language foundation model that represents whole-slide images and multi-slide cases as single multi-magnification composite images, trained on approximately 189k slides from Mayo Clinic spanning 42 organs and 829 diagnostic entities using pathology reports as supervision. Without task-specific training, WILSON exceeded a dedicated case-level model on all internal cohorts (macro-F1 0.52 versus 0.38) and matched slide-level models up to 9.4 times larger at 272- to 2,155-fold lower compute. End-to-end fine-tuning on 508 triple-negative breast cancer cases improved histologic subtyping and stromal tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte grading by 0.16 and 0.11 macro-F1. WILSON retrieved matching diagnostic text at 75.6% recall@1 (PRISM, 58.1%) and generated captions closer to report-derived references than PRISM and PRISM2 on the internal cohort and on most external comparisons. Composite images thus offer a compact, clinically aligned computational unit for pathology.
papers.comment: 56 pages, 6 main figures, with 11 additional figures and 28 tables in the appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WILSON 是病理学视觉-语言基础模型，把整张切片与多切片病例压成单一多倍率合成图像 (composite image) 来编码，用病理报告作监督。无需任务专用训练即在全部内部队列超过专用病例级模型（macro-F1 0.52 对 0.38），诊断文本检索 recall@1 达 75.6%（PRISM 58.1%）。
Motivation: 现有病理基础模型按单张切片切块编码上千 tile 再聚合特征，无法像病理医生那样跨倍率、跨切片整合形态；病例级分析因此需要额外的专用模型与大量计算。
Method: 视觉-语言基础模型 WILSON 将全切片图像与多切片病例表示为单一多倍率合成图像，以病理报告为监督，在约 189k 张 Mayo Clinic 切片、42 个器官、829 个诊断实体上训练；另做 508 例三阴性乳腺癌病例的端到端微调。
Result: 无需任务专用训练，WILSON 在全部内部队列超过专用病例级模型（macro-F1 0.52 对 0.38），并匹配最多大 9.4 倍的切片级模型而计算量低 272 至 2,155 倍；508 例 TNBC 端到端微调使组织学亚型与基质肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞分级 macro-F1 分别提高 0.16 与 0.11；诊断文本检索 recall@1 为 75.6%（PRISM 58.1%），生成 caption 在内部队列及多数外部对比中比 PRISM、PRISM2 更接近报告参考。
Conclusion: 合成图像是病理学中紧凑且与临床对齐的计算单元，可让单一模型同时承担病例级分析与诊断文本生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rachel: A general-purpose language model directs and revises retrosynthetic routes
papers.abstract_en: Retrosynthetic planning advances through decisions that reshape the remaining chemical problem: a locally plausible disconnection can leave precursors whose chemoselectivity constraints complicate the rest of the route. Existing planners often channel model proposals through search or template procedures, leaving open whether a general-purpose large language model (LLM) can itself sustain and revise route strategy. We developed Rachel, a stateful environment that executes and checks LLM-directed chemistry but prescribes neither a search policy nor a stopping rule. Without supplied reference routes or route-level solutions, GPT-5.5 achieved strict closure for 111 of 120 PaRoutes120 targets and 24 of 25 targets in the separate RF25 difficult-target cohort. RF25 was drawn largely from studies published after GPT-5.5's reported knowledge cutoff. Closure required complete routes and independent source resolution of every terminal precursor after planning. On a shared PaRoutes subset, forward-model support exceeded that of most comparator methods, and Rachel received the highest mean overall route score from both method-blinded LLM evaluators. Recorded trajectories showed continued model-proposed chemistry, with revised strategies carried into subsequent steps. Replacing LLM route decisions with fixed policies reduced strict closure to 6-15/120 despite continued local chemical execution; restricting planning support also reduced closure in RF25. Within Rachel, a general-purpose LLM coordinated successive chemical choices and revised its strategy as earlier decisions reshaped the remaining problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Rachel 是一个只执行并校验化学操作、不规定搜索策略与停止规则的有状态环境，让通用 LLM 自主规划逆合成路线。GPT-5.5 在无参考路线条件下对 PaRoutes120 的 120 个目标实现 111 个严格闭合，对 RF25 困难靶点集 24/25 闭合；把 LLM 的路线级决策换成固定策略后，闭合数骤降至 6–15/120。
Motivation: 现有逆合成规划器多把模型提议塞进搜索或模板流程，通用 LLM 能否自己维持并修订整条路线策略仍未被单独检验；而局部看似合理的断裂可能让前体的化学选择性拖垮后续路线。
Method: 构建有状态环境 Rachel：执行并检查 LLM 给出的化学操作，但不内置搜索策略或停止规则；GPT-5.5 在不提供参考路线与路线级解答的条件下规划，闭合判定要求完整路线且每个末端前体经独立来源解析；在共享 PaRoutes 子集上用 forward-model 支持度与两位方法盲评的 LLM 评审打总体路线分，并做替换为固定策略、限制规划支持的消融。
Result: GPT-5.5 在 PaRoutes120 上 111/120 严格闭合，RF25 上 24/25 闭合（RF25 主要取自 GPT-5.5 报告知识截止之后的文献）；共享 PaRoutes 子集上 forward-model 支持度超过多数对比方法，Rachel 获两位方法盲评 LLM 评审给出的最高平均总体路线分；轨迹显示模型持续提出化学决策并把修订后的策略带入后续步骤；换成固定策略后严格闭合降至 6–15/120，限制规划支持也使 RF25 闭合下降。
Conclusion: 通用 LLM 可以在只执行不指挥的环境中自行协调连续化学选择并随早期决策重塑问题而修订策略，路线级自主决策本身是闭合率的主要来源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: You've Seen Enough: Quality-Constrained Image Coding for Machines
papers.abstract_en: Visual data is increasingly consumed by machine-vision systems rather than by human observers. Image Coding for Machines (ICM) compresses images assuming the main observer is a computer vision application and that the human observer needs to inspect or validate the decisions. Inspired by just-noticeable distortion, which sets the quality to the just-acceptable level for human observers, we aim to cap the human-observed quality at a desired level, with the goal of using the remaining coding capacity to improve the machine performance. We recast joint compression-segmentation training as a constrained optimization problem in which the codec must meet a predefined acceptable target visual quality while a task term consumes the remaining coding capacity. We solve this by designing a penalty function to guide the quality to the desired target. We propose two penalty functions, an absolute function and a bilinear function, the latter applying a steeper slope once the target visual quality is exceeded. Experimental results show that, under the quality constraint, the proposed method achieves a BD-rate of $-22.82\%$ over an unconstrained joint rate--distortion--task optimization and $-29.81\%$ over a simple rate--distortion baseline, showcasing bitrate reduction with the same task performance. This is achieved while the codec also meets the target visual quality with a reasonable error and without adding any complexity overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向机器的图像编码 (ICM) 把联合压缩-分割训练改写成带质量约束的优化：人类可察觉质量被罚函数压在目标值以下，剩余码率预算全部让给任务项。在质量约束下，相对无约束的联合 rate-distortion-task 优化 BD-rate 为 -22.82%，相对简单 rate-distortion 基线为 -29.81%，任务性能不变且不增加复杂度。
Motivation: 视觉数据越来越多由机器而非人消费，但现有联合编码优化没有把人眼可接受质量设成硬约束，码率在人已看够的质量上被浪费。
Method: 把联合压缩-分割训练写成约束优化：codec 必须达到预定可接受视觉质量，任务项消耗剩余码率；设计罚函数把质量引导到目标，提出 absolute 与 bilinear 两种罚函数，后者在超过目标质量后施加更陡斜率。
Result: 在质量约束下，BD-rate -22.82%（对比无约束 joint rate–distortion–task 优化）、-29.81%（对比简单 rate–distortion 基线），任务性能相同；codec 同时以合理误差达到目标视觉质量，且不增加复杂度开销。
Conclusion: 把人眼质量当硬约束、把剩余码率让给任务项，可以在不损失分割任务性能的前提下显著省码率，且无需额外复杂度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Accurate and Interpretable Hyper Graph Neural Network for GBM Survival Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Survival prediction for glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) demands models that are both accurate and interpretable, yet existing approaches treat these objectives as com- peting, where performant models sacrifice transparency, while interpretable models accept degraded predictive power. We argue that this trade-off is not inherent. Graph neural net- works offer a structural foundation for extracting interpretable, explainable representations without compromising discriminative ability. Furthermore, current methods typically rely on a single imaging modality, underutilizing the complementary information available across multi-modal MRI and clinical metadata. We propose a multi-modal framework that inte- grates three components to address both objectives simultaneously: (1) a sheaf hypergraph neural network that captures higher-order relationships among tissue patches through direc- tional, asymmetric message passing; (2) a concept bottleneck layer that compresses learned representations into clinically grounded concepts, enforcing ante-hoc interpretability; and (3) an extension sufficiency test (EST) regularizer that penalizes unfaithful explanations during training, ensuring that model explanations genuinely reflect the internal decision process. Clinical and genomic features are incorporated through gated fusion, preserving the dominant prognostic signal of molecular markers while retaining concept-level traceabil- ity. Evaluated on 593 patients from the UPenn-GBM dataset under 5-fold cross-validation, our framework achieves a concordance index of 0.643 with the lowest fold-level variance among all compared models (std = 0.015). To our knowledge, this is the first work to unify sheaf hypergraph convolution, concept bottleneck supervision, and EST regularization for interpretable survival prediction from brain MRI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出三组件多模态 GBM 生存预测框架：sheaf 超图神经网络做方向性非对称消息传递、concept bottleneck 层把表征压到临床概念、EST 正则惩罚不忠实解释，再用 gated fusion 融合临床与基因组特征。在 UPenn-GBM 593 例患者 5 折交叉验证下 concordance index 0.643，折间方差最低（std = 0.015）。
Motivation: 现有 GBM 生存模型把准确性与可解释性当作对立目标，且多依赖单一影像模态，浪费了多模态 MRI 与临床元数据的互补信息。
Method: 三组件框架：sheaf hypergraph neural network 通过方向性、非对称消息传递捕捉组织 patch 间的高阶关系；concept bottleneck layer 将表征压缩为临床概念以实现 ante-hoc 可解释；extension sufficiency test (EST) 正则在训练中惩罚不忠实的解释。临床与基因组特征经 gated fusion 融合，保留分子标志物的主导预后信号。
Result: 在 UPenn-GBM 数据集 593 名患者、5 折交叉验证下，框架 concordance index 为 0.643，折间方差在所有对比模型中最低（std = 0.015）。
Conclusion: 作者主张准确性与可解释性的取舍并非内在固有，三者统一可同时给出有判别力的预测与忠实于内部决策的解释；据称是首个统一 sheaf hypergraph convolution、concept bottleneck 监督与 EST 正则的可解释脑 MRI 生存预测工作。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: FREESIA: Covariance-Aware Posterior Transport for Expressive and Scalable Data Assimilation
papers.abstract_en: Data assimilation aims to infer the state of complex dynamical systems based on observational data. However, accurate inference of the multimodal posteriors induced by nonlinear or non-injective observation operators remains a key challenge under high-dimensional and sparse observation conditions. Ensemble filters scale to high dimensions but are confined by restrictive distributional assumptions, while training-free generative filters (e.g., EnSF, EnFF) alleviate this limitation but may introduce structural errors and hinder information propagation under sparse observations. To address these issues, we propose a training-free, asymptotically exact posterior transport method. Firstly, a covariance-aware posterior transport scheme is designed, which embeds the forecast cross-covariance into flow-based transport and accurately recovers unobserved states while preserving the non-Gaussian posterior structure. Furthermore, the method combines a tractable observation-adaptive proposal with posterior correction, ensuring accurate approximation of the nonlinear posterior distribution. Finally, we establish the corresponding posterior flow theory, from which the asymptotic exactness of the proposed method relative to finite-ensemble surrogates and the Wasserstein error bound are derived. Experiments on Double-Well, Lorenz-96, and Kolmogorov flow show that the proposed method captures complex posterior structure and remains accurate under sparse, nonlinear, and non-injective observations. In the sparse non-injective setting, it reduces RMSE by 56% relative to the best baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FREESIA：一种免训练、渐近精确的协方差感知后验传输 (covariance-aware posterior transport) 数据同化方法，把预报交叉协方差嵌入 flow-based transport，并用可处理的观测自适应提议加后验修正来逼近非线性、非单射观测算子诱导的多峰后验。在 Double-Well、Lorenz-96 与 Kolmogorov flow 上，稀疏非单射设定中相对最优基线降低 RMSE 56%。
Motivation: 非线性或非单射观测算子在高维稀疏观测下诱导多峰后验，集合滤波受分布假设限制，免训练生成式滤波 (EnSF、EnFF) 又会引入结构误差并阻碍稀疏观测下的信息传播。
Method: 免训练的后验传输方法：协方差感知传输方案把预报交叉协方差 (forecast cross-covariance) 嵌入 flow-based transport 以恢复未观测状态并保留非高斯后验结构；再结合可处理的观测自适应提议与后验修正；并建立后验流理论，推导相对有限集合代理的渐近精确性与 Wasserstein 误差界。
Result: 在 Double-Well、Lorenz-96、Kolmogorov flow 上，方法能捕捉复杂后验结构，在稀疏、非线性、非单射观测下保持准确；在稀疏非单射设定中相对最优基线降低 RMSE 56%。
Conclusion: 把预报交叉协方差嵌入流式传输并配合观测自适应提议与后验修正，可在免训练前提下对稀疏非单射观测给出渐近精确的非高斯后验近似。
Relevance: 86

summary_sections.result: 在 Double-Well、Lorenz-96、Kolmogorov flow 上，方法能捕捉复杂后验结构，在稀疏、非线性、非单射观测下保持准确；在稀疏非单射设定中相对最优基线降低 RMSE 56%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把预报交叉协方差嵌入流式传输并配合观测自适应提议与后验修正，可在免训练前提下对稀疏非单射观测给出渐近精确的非高斯后验近似。

papers.title: From IceCube to IT-Sphere: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical GNN for Banking IT Root Cause Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We present Hybrid Quantum Root Cause Analysis (HQ-RCA), an industrially grounded workflow for root cause analysis in banking IT operations, built on a hybrid Quantum Graph Neural Network (QGNN): the classical backbone of DynEdge (the IceCube neutrino-reconstruction GNN, which we call standalone DynEdge), with its classification head replaced by a Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC). On 13 months of anonymised IT data (13k alarm clusters) from a major European bank, the hybrid QGNN matches standalone DynEdge -- the strongest classical baseline -- on $F_1$, while standalone DynEdge leads the ranking metrics. A readout-sensitivity and layout-robustness study, analysed via Dimensional Expressivity Analysis (DEA), shows that the effective parameter dimensionality (rank) of the quantum observable has no measurable correlation with $F_1$; we therefore keep the simplest readout $\langle Z_0\rangle$ (the Pauli-$Z$ expectation on the first qubit), which in the deployed layout is rank-1, collapsing optimisation to a 1-D problem solvable by a gradient-free grid scan. Execution on IBM Heron r2 (no error mitigation) shows this gradient-free readout is executable on NISQ hardware after threshold recalibration.
papers.comment: 3 pages (cover page + 2-page extended abstract), 4 figures. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering (QCE26), Toronto, ON, Canada, 13-18 September 2026; Poster Track, paper ID POS2-1600. Author's accepted version; IEEE copyright notice on the first page
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HQ-RCA：把 IceCube 中微子重建 GNN DynEdge 的分类头换成变分量子线路 (VQC)，用于银行 IT 告警根因分析。在某欧洲银行 13 个月、13k 告警簇上，混合 QGNN 的 F1 与最强经典基线 standalone DynEdge 持平，但排序指标仍由 DynEdge 领先；DEA 分析显示量子可观测量的有效参数维度 (rank) 与 F1 无可测相关，故保留最简读出 ⟨Z₀⟩（部署布局下 rank-1），优化退化为一维无梯度网格扫描，并在 IBM Heron r2 上免误差缓解执行。
Motivation: 银行 IT 根因分析需要在大规模告警簇上做高 F1 分类，而量子模型的表达力与读出设计对性能的影响尚不清楚，且需在 NISQ 硬件上可执行。
Method: 以 DynEdge（IceCube 中微子重建 GNN）为经典骨干，替换其分类头为 VQC，构成混合 QGNN；用 Dimensional Expressivity Analysis (DEA) 做读出敏感性与布局稳健性研究，选择 Pauli-Z 期望 ⟨Z₀⟩ 作读出，并以无梯度网格扫描替代梯度优化。
Result: 在 13 个月、13k 告警簇的匿名银行 IT 数据上，混合 QGNN 的 F1 与最强经典基线 standalone DynEdge 持平，排序指标由 DynEdge 领先；DEA 显示量子可观测量 rank 与 F1 无可测相关；部署布局下 ⟨Z₀⟩ 为 rank-1，优化化为 1-D 网格扫描；在 IBM Heron r2 上免误差缓解执行，经阈值重标定后可运行。
Conclusion: 量子读出的参数维度并不驱动 F1，因此选最简 rank-1 读出即可在 NISQ 硬件上落地，代价是排序指标不及纯经典 DynEdge。

papers.title: MultiViewDx: Evidence-Linked Multi-View Clinical Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can perform well on existing medical visual question answering (MedVQA) benchmarks, but their training data often does not match clinical diagnosis. Most supervision is organized around isolated images or short QA pairs, leaving two structures weakly specified: how evidence leads to a decision, and how views, series, modalities, and patient context from the same case are linked. We introduce MultiViewDx, a partly physician-validated multimodal instruction dataset for evidence-linked multi-view medical imaging diagnosis. MultiViewDx uses the clinical case as the supervision unit. It links imaging studies with patient context, normalizes heterogeneous reports into an evidence-linked workflow (evidence -> findings -> differential discussion -> diagnosis), and uses a unified image-text retriever to constrain instruction synthesis to source-supported evidence. It covers X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, histopathology, and other clinical visual sources. We fine-tune MultiViewDx-8B-AN and evaluate it on both existing MedVQA benchmarks and real-world case-based diagnostic reasoning. Across four MedVQA benchmarks, it achieves the best average accuracy among compared systems (79.0%), outperforming HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B (66.7%) and Claude3-Opus (55.7%). Beyond MedVQA, on JAMA Clinical Challenge cases, it receives the strongest overall rating under a physician-designed rubric for key clinical points, diagnostic inference, and evidence grounding. Controlled ablations and clinician evaluation show that both case-level multi-view organization and evidence-linked reasoning targets contribute to the gain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MultiViewDx 以完整临床病例为监督单元，把影像检查与患者背景、异构报告归一为 evidence→findings→differential discussion→diagnosis 的证据链工作流，并用统一图文检索器约束指令合成只用源支持的证据。微调后的 MultiViewDx-8B-AN 在四个 MedVQA 基准上取得最佳平均准确率 79.0%，高于 HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B 的 66.7% 与 Claude3-Opus 的 55.7%。
Motivation: 现有 MedVQA 训练数据多为孤立图像或短 QA 对，与真实临床诊断不匹配，证据如何导向决策、以及同一病例内视图/序列/模态/患者背景的关联这两层结构都很弱。
Method: 提出部分经医师验证的多模态指令数据集 MultiViewDx，以临床病例为监督单位，将影像检查与患者背景关联，把异构报告归一为 evidence→findings→differential discussion→diagnosis 的证据链流程，并用统一的图文检索器 (unified image-text retriever) 把指令合成限制在源支持的证据上，覆盖 X-ray、CT、MRI、超声、组织病理等；随后微调得到 MultiViewDx-8B-AN。
Result: 在四个 MedVQA 基准上平均准确率 79.0%，为所比较系统中最高，超过 HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B 的 66.7% 与 Claude3-Opus 的 55.7%；在 JAMA Clinical Challenge 病例上，按医师设计的评分标准（关键临床要点、诊断推理、证据锚定）获得最强总体评分；受控消融与医师评估显示病例级多视图组织与证据链推理目标都对增益有贡献。
Conclusion: 把病例级多视图组织与证据链推理目标作为监督单元，能同时提升 MedVQA 平均准确率与真实病例诊断推理质量。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Federating Quantum and Classical Computing: A Privacy-Preserving Hybrid Approach
papers.abstract_en: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly recognized as one of the most promising near-term applications of quantum computing, viewed as a next-frontier candidate beyond purely classical approaches. Hybrid quantum-classical models operationalize this potential by embedding a parameterized quantum circuit within a model where all other components remain classical-a design already applied to chemistry simulation, financial modeling, and image classification. However, their deployment in privacy-sensitive, multi-party settings is constrained by the need to avoid centralizing raw data and by the requirement that modern quantum circuits remain parameter-efficient to stay trainable at scale. In this paper, we address these constraints by evaluating federated learning (FL) as a means of combining a hybrid quantum-classical active party with a classical passive party, using Sherpa.ai's Blind Vertical FL (SBVFL) protocol to avoid centralizing raw data, while drastically reducing communication. We construct the split multiplicative periodic parity (SMPP) benchmark, following common QML design practice. On this task, our simulations show that SBVFL raises accuracy from 0.7227 to 0.8757 compared to local training, closely approaching non-private centralized accuracy, and that the hybrid quantum-classical model achieves this with substantially fewer trainable parameters than the classical neural networks and random forest alternatives. These results show that FL enables high-performing, privacy-preserving quantum-classical collaboration without centralizing raw data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在混合量子-经典联邦学习中，用 Sherpa.ai 的 Blind Vertical FL (SBVFL) 协议把参数化量子电路一方与经典方协作训练，避免集中原始数据并大幅降低通信。在自建的 split multiplicative periodic parity (SMPP) 基准上，SBVFL 将准确率从本地训练的 0.7227 提到 0.8757，接近非隐私集中式训练，且可训练参数量显著少于经典神经网络与随机森林。
Motivation: 混合量子-经典模型在隐私敏感的多方场景中受限：既要避免集中原始数据，又要让现代量子电路保持参数高效以在规模上可训练。
Method: 以联邦学习 (FL) 组合一个混合量子-经典 active party 与一个 classical passive party，采用 Sherpa.ai 的 Blind Vertical FL (SBVFL) 协议；按 QML 常规设计构造 split multiplicative periodic parity (SMPP) 基准，通过仿真评估。
Result: 在 SMPP 任务仿真中，SBVFL 相对本地训练将准确率从 0.7227 提升到 0.8757，接近非隐私的集中式准确率；混合量子-经典模型达到该准确率所用可训练参数量显著少于经典神经网络与随机森林方案。
Conclusion: 联邦学习可以在不集中原始数据的前提下实现高性能、保护隐私的量子-经典协作，同时保持参数高效。

papers.title: COVER: Codec-Robust Video Watermarking with Generative Video Priors
papers.abstract_en: Video watermarking underpins copyright protection and provenance for generated media, yet almost every video is compressed by a codec before it is stored or shared. A codec discards precisely the perceptually redundant components that most watermarks rely on, so the payload is often lost even when the marked video looked flawless beforehand. Existing methods leave this path open, since they treat compression as one entry in a generic list of distortions, while a real codec is not differentiable and cannot enter gradient-based training. We present COVER, the first learned video watermark built around codec compression as its design target, which survives that compression by embedding the payload in the latent space of a frozen generative video autoencoder and recovering it by re-encoding the received video into that same latent space. To make codec robustness trainable, we build a differentiable codec surrogate bank that simulates the dominant degradation modes of practical compression, and we train the embedder and the latent decoder through three shared recovery paths under a fidelity objective that constrains the residual in the pixel and frequency domains. Across four codecs at 12 settings, COVER attains 93.72% average bit accuracy, ranks first on 11 of the 12, improves the strongest prior method by 2.68 points, and lifts the worst operating point from 68.90% to 73.72% while each marked video stays visually close to the source clip that produced it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COVER 是以编解码器压缩为设计目标的学习型视频水印：把载荷嵌入冻结的生成式视频自编码器隐空间，接收端用同一隐空间重编码解码，并用可微编解码器替代库让压缩鲁棒性可训练。在 4 种编解码器、12 种设置下平均比特准确率 93.72%，12 个设置中 11 个排名第一，最强既有方法提升 2.68 个百分点，最差工作点从 68.90% 提到 73.72%。
Motivation: 视频在存储分享前几乎都会被编解码器压缩，而编解码器丢弃的恰是水印依赖的感知冗余成分，导致标记视频外观完好但载荷丢失；既有方法把压缩当作普通失真列表中的一项，且真实编解码器不可微、无法进入梯度训练。
Method: COVER 将载荷嵌入冻结的生成式视频自编码器隐空间，接收端把收到的视频重编码回同一隐空间恢复载荷；构建可微编解码器替代库 (differentiable codec surrogate bank) 模拟实际压缩的主要退化模式，通过三条共享恢复路径联合训练嵌入器与隐空间解码器，目标函数在像素域与频域同时约束残差以保证保真度。
Result: 在 4 种编解码器、12 种设置上平均比特准确率 93.72%，在 12 个设置中的 11 个排名第一，比最强既有方法高 2.68 个百分点，最差工作点从 68.90% 提升到 73.72%；标记视频在视觉上仍接近产生它的源片段。
Conclusion: 把编解码压缩本身当作设计目标、用可微替代库与生成式视频先验来训练，可以在压缩后保住视频水印载荷，同时维持标记视频的视觉保真度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPARC: SuperPixel-Aware Region Contrastive Learning for Self-Supervised Dense Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has become an effective approach for learning visual representations without manual annotations. Among SSL approaches, contrastive learning has been widely used for visual representation learning. However, existing contrastive SSL methods have focused primarily on image-level or pixel-level representation learning, while region-level representation learning remains less explored. We propose SPARC, a region-level contrastive learning framework that leverages superpixels to establish explicit correspondence between augmented image views. SPARC introduces a region contrastive branch that performs superpixel-based feature pooling and optimizes a region-level contrastive objective jointly with a global image-level objective. Under identical settings, SPARC consistently outperforms previous methods such as MoCo-v2 and DenseCL, achieving improvements of up to +9.79 mIoU for semantic segmentation and +4.88 AP for object detection. Ablation studies further demonstrate that region-level objectives produce the strongest performance. Thus, region-level contrastive learning is an effective approach for improving self-supervised visual pretraining for dense prediction tasks. Code repository can be accessed at https://github.com/xRIPEIx/SPARC.

papers.summary_zh:

Method: 提出 SPARC：以 superpixel 为单位在增广视图间建立显式对应，做 superpixel 特征池化得到区域表征，训练时把区域级对比目标与全局图像级对比目标联合优化，用于语义分割与目标检测的自监督预训练。
Result: 在相同设置下，SPARC 语义分割 mIoU 最多提升 +9.79，目标检测 AP 提升 +4.88，对比基线包括 MoCo-v2 与 DenseCL；消融研究显示区域级目标带来最强性能。
Conclusion: 区域级对比学习是提升密集预测任务自监督视觉预训练的有效途径，superpixel 提供的显式区域对应是关键设计。

papers.title: TTTIR: Unlocking Instance-Specific State Evolution via Test-Time Training for Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Image restoration is inherently challenging due to the diverse and highly input-dependent nature of real-world degradations. While recent architectures like Transformers and state-space models have advanced the field, they predominantly rely on static, globally shared parameters, which struggle to fully accommodate instance-specific degradation patterns. Test-Time Training (TTT) offers a promising paradigm for generating data-dependent operators, yet its standard self-supervised inner loop lacks the explicit guidance required to transition degraded features toward clean structures. To address this, we propose TTTIR, a novel framework that reformulates image restoration as an instance-specific state evolution process. Specifically, we design Progressive State Sequence Generation (PSSG) to construct complementary spatial-frequency target states (defining what to recover), and State Transition Evolution (STE) to adapt lightweight transition operators via a restoration-oriented TTT inner loop (determining how the features should evolve). Extensive experiments demonstrate that TTTIR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models across multiple image restoration benchmarks, achieving dynamic instance-specific recovery with favorable computational scalability. The code is available at https://github.com/Elysiaaaaaaaa/TTTIR.git.
papers.comment: TL;DR: TTTIR improves image restoration by framing it as an instance-specific state evolution process. Powered by Test-Time Training (TTT), it dynamically adapts operators to handle real-world degradations, outperforming state-of-the-art models with scalable efficiency. 11 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TTTIR 把图像复原重构为实例特定的状态演化过程：用 PSSG 构造空间-频率互补的目标状态，用 STE 通过面向复原的 Test-Time Training 内环在测试时自适应轻量转移算子。在多个图像复原基准上持续优于 SOTA 模型，并保持可扩展的计算开销。
Motivation: 真实退化高度依赖输入，而 Transformer 与 state-space 模型用静态全局共享参数，难以覆盖实例特定的退化模式；标准 TTT 自监督内环又缺少把退化特征引向干净结构的显式引导。
Method: 两个核心组件：Progressive State Sequence Generation (PSSG) 构造空间-频率互补的目标状态，规定要恢复什么；State Transition Evolution (STE) 通过 restoration-oriented TTT 内环在测试时更新轻量转移算子，规定特征如何演化。
Result: 在多个图像复原基准上持续优于 state-of-the-art 模型，实现动态的实例特定恢复并具备良好的计算可扩展性；论文为 11 页、6 图、6 表。
Conclusion: 把图像复原当作实例特定状态演化、并用 TTT 内环在测试时自适应算子，可以在保持可扩展效率的同时超过静态参数的 SOTA 复原模型。

papers.title: ChainDoRA: Tensor-Train Factorized Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) adapts large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks while updating only a small fraction of their pretrained parameters. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) uses two trainable low-rank matrices, while Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation (DoRA) further separates weight magnitude and direction but retains the dense LoRA-style factorization in its directional branch. We propose ChainDoRA, a weight-decomposed adaptation framework that constructs the directional low-rank factors from a connected Tensor-Train (TT) chain, where the adapter rank forms the boundary rank between input- and output-side TT contractions and an independent TT rank controls representation capacity and parameter cost. Under a controlled 15,119-example response-only adaptation setting with LLaMA-7B, ChainDoRA is evaluated against matched LoRA and DoRA baselines on seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks. ChainDoRA with TT rank 16 achieves a seven-task average accuracy of 72.30%, compared with 69.88% for LoRA and 69.39% for DoRA, while requiring only 5.35M trainable parameters versus 56.10M for LoRA and 56.98M for DoRA, corresponding to a 90.62% reduction relative to DoRA. Ablations over TT rank and adapter placement show controllable parameter-accuracy trade-offs, indicating that connected TT parameterization can substantially reduce the parameter cost of magnitude-direction adaptation while preserving, and in this setting improving, downstream reasoning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChainDoRA 把 DoRA 方向分支的稠密 LoRA 分解换成连通 Tensor-Train (TT) 链，adapter rank 作为输入/输出侧 TT 收缩的边界 rank，另设独立 TT rank 控制容量与参数量。在 LLaMA-7B、15,119 条 response-only 适配下，TT rank 16 的七任务平均准确率 72.30%，高于 LoRA 69.88% 与 DoRA 69.39%，可训练参数 5.35M，相对 DoRA 的 56.98M 减少 90.62%。
Motivation: DoRA 把权重拆成 magnitude 与 direction，但方向分支仍沿用稠密 LoRA 分解，适配参数量与 LoRA 同量级，对 LLM 下游微调的成本没有实质压缩。
Method: 方向低秩因子由连通 Tensor-Train 链构造：adapter rank 作为输入侧与输出侧 TT contraction 的边界 rank，独立 TT rank 控制表示能力与参数开销；在 15,119 条样本的 response-only 适配设定下用 LLaMA-7B 训练，并对 TT rank 与 adapter 位置做消融，对照 matched LoRA 与 DoRA。
Result: TT rank 16 时七任务平均准确率 72.30%，LoRA 69.88%、DoRA 69.39%；可训练参数 5.35M，LoRA 56.10M、DoRA 56.98M，相对 DoRA 减少 90.62%。评测覆盖七个 commonsense reasoning benchmark，TT rank 与 adapter 位置的消融呈现可控的参数-准确率权衡。
Conclusion: 连通 TT 参数化能在 magnitude-direction 适配中大幅压低参数成本，并在该设定下保持甚至提升下游推理表现；参数与精度的取舍可由 TT rank 和 adapter 位置直接调节。

papers.title: Physics-guided deep metric learning with continuous time embeddings for open-world radar pulse de-interleaving
papers.abstract_en: Radar pulse de-interleaving is a foundational Electronic Support Measures (ESM) task that aims to separate chronologically interleaved pulse streams from multiple non-cooperative transmitters under unknown emitter cardinality in dense, contested electromagnetic environments. Classical histogram transforms and closed-world deep classifiers degrade under severe pulse loss, agile Pulse Repeti tion Interval (PRI) modulation, and spurious clutter. In this paper, we systematically characterise continuous temporal representations and physics-guided model selection in deep metric learning for open-world radar de-interleaving. Building on the transformer-based metric-learning framework for open-world deinterleaving introduced by Gunn et al. [1], we introduce a continuous Time-of-Arrival (ToA) sinusoidal positional encoding that directly models physical inter-pulse durations rather than ordinal token indices, a design choice that contrasts with [1], who found ordinal positional encodings provided no benefit and omitted them entirely. Neural network parameters are optimised solely via Supervised Contrastive (SupCon) learning, while scale-aware physical domain priors based on PRI Consistency and Angle-of-Arrival (AoA) continuity serve as physics-guided validation and checkpoint-selection criteria operating on unsupervised HDBSCAN cluster assignments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向开放世界雷达脉冲去交叠 (open-world radar pulse de-interleaving)，在 Gunn et al. 的 transformer 度量学习框架上加入连续 ToA 正弦位置编码，直接建模脉冲间物理时长而非序数 token 下标，并用 PRI 一致性与 AoA 连续性这两个尺度感知物理先验，在无监督 HDBSCAN 聚类上做验证与 checkpoint 选择。参数仅由 Supervised Contrastive (SupCon) 损失优化，物理先验只承担模型选择职责。
Motivation: 直方图变换与闭世界深度分类器在严重脉冲丢失、敏捷 PRI 调制和杂波下退化，且未知发射机数目的开放世界设定下缺少有效的模型选择准则。
Method: 在 Gunn et al. [1] 的 transformer 度量学习框架上引入连续 Time-of-Arrival (ToA) 正弦位置编码，编码物理脉冲间间隔而非序数下标；神经网络参数仅用 Supervised Contrastive (SupCon) 损失优化；以基于 PRI Consistency 与 Angle-of-Arrival (AoA) 连续性的尺度感知物理域先验作为物理引导的验证与 checkpoint 选择准则，作用于无监督 HDBSCAN 的聚类分配。
Result: 摘要给出的是设计对比：[1] 曾发现序数位置编码无增益并完全弃用，本文改用连续 ToA 编码直接建模物理脉冲间时长；物理先验被用作无监督的验证与 checkpoint 选择准则。
Conclusion: 把物理时间结构写进位置编码、把 PRI/AoA 先验从训练损失移到模型选择环节，可在仅靠 SupCon 训练的开放世界去交叠中承担 checkpoint 判据。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: LatentPort: Beyond KV Cache - Cross-Model Transfer of Recurrent Memory in Hybrid Language Models: A 4B-to-9B Hybrid-State Handoff Without Target Prefix Replay
papers.abstract_en: Can one language model hand its live memory to another without the receiver rereading the context? We demonstrate useful persistent hybrid-state transfer across one architecture-matched Qwen3.5 4B-to-9B sibling pair. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstrated cross-model handoff of persistent recurrent inference state between differently sized hybrid language models without target prefix replay. Translated attention KV alone leaves a large gap; adding the Gated DeltaNet (GDN) persistent-state package lowers teacher-forced negative log-likelihood (NLL), the average next-token log-loss, by 0.747 nats/token (95% paired document bootstrap CI [0.6921, 0.8047]), improving all 64 PG19 documents. Direct recurrent and convolution reuse outperforms the tested learned GDN maps, consistent with partial functional compatibility of persistent-state coordinates. A fresh component factorial selects translated KV with direct recurrent and convolution state. An additional 434,176-parameter correction improves that base on 64 fresh web documents: continuation loss is 0.076 nats/token above native 9B (excess NLL), Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence is 0.022, and native context recovery (NCR) is 0.918. Corrected 9B significantly beats continued 4B inference while processing zero historical prefix tokens. Evidence covers one direction, one geometry-matched Base-model pair, and 4K teacher-forced continuation; the near-native gate failed, the 16K branch was not run, and free-generation equivalence and a general state interface remain unproven.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LatentPort 在架构匹配的 Qwen3.5 4B→9B 混合模型对上，演示无需目标端重放前缀即可移交持久循环推理状态：仅平移 KV 不够，叠加 Gated DeltaNet (GDN) 持久状态包把 teacher-forced NLL 降低 0.747 nats/token，64 篇 PG19 文档全部改善。再加 434,176 参数修正后，续写损失仅比原生 9B 高 0.076 nats/token，且处理零历史前缀 token 的修正 9B 显著优于继续跑 4B。
Motivation: 混合语言模型的循环持久状态是跨上下文的活记忆，但接收方通常必须重放整个前缀才能重建；跨不同规模模型直接移交该状态此前未被演示。
Method: 在架构匹配的 Qwen3.5 4B→9B sibling pair 上做跨模型 handoff：平移 attention KV，加入 GDN 持久状态包，并比较直接复用循环与卷积状态和学习式 GDN 映射；用 fresh component factorial 选型，再训练一个 434,176 参数的修正头，在 64 篇新网络文档上校正。
Result: GDN 状态包使 teacher-forced 平均 next-token NLL 降低 0.747 nats/token（95% paired document bootstrap CI [0.6921, 0.8047]），改善全部 64 篇 PG19 文档；直接循环与卷积状态复用优于所测学习式 GDN 映射。修正后在 64 篇新文档上 excess NLL 为 0.076 nats/token、JS 散度 0.022、native context recovery (NCR) 0.918，处理零历史前缀 token 时显著优于继续 4B 推理。
Conclusion: 持久状态坐标在几何匹配的模型间具有部分功能兼容性，跨规模 handoff 可逼近原生接收模型；证据限于单一方向、一对 Base 模型与 4K teacher-forced 续写，near-native gate 未通过、16K 分支未跑，自由生成等价性与通用状态接口仍未证明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Cleaning and Captured Anyway: One Measured Primitive for Error in a Store an Agent Writes to Itself, and What a Falling Score Actually Measures
papers.abstract_en: "An agent that writes its conclusions into a store it later retrieves from closes a loop usually reported as one-way contamination. Taking the loop to the infinite-tenure limit against an append-only store gives a different picture: because writing never deletes, the reachable state space has a hard upper edge at (n-1)/n, so the outcome is a choice between two edges rather than a decay. At f_0 = 0.9 the interval between the two modes holds 3.6% of 220 runs where a uniform spread would put 20.6%, and is strictly empty on the first 15; the pooled mean describes 8.2% of the runs it summarises, the median 68.2%. Everything the model contributes is carried by one measured primitive with no fitted parameter, the copy function γ(φ): on 36 Wikidata facts, sign(\hatγ - γ_{crit}), with γ_{crit} = 1/k at r = 0, w = 1, predicts the direction of drift on 353 of 360 real-fact runs (39 of 40 synthetic in the same batch). Scale does not rescue the store: pooled frontier capture is 0.850, with claude-sonnet-4.5 captured on 20 of 20 seeds against our registered prediction of <0.5. What the interval tests is distinguishability rather than count: on the real facts, multi-valued runs have 6.4x its occupancy of the rest. It survives at f_0 in {0.1, 0.3, 0.5}, capture peaks at f_0 = 0.5, and of four interventions with criteria frozen first, timing dominates fraction at matched budget while a consistency gate drives every model to 0.993. The resampling unit is the seed, at a design effect of 3.75 on a pooled level: under a 44-seed control the ordering supporting claim 4 collapses from Spearman +0.98 at three seeds to +0.31-0.80 at forty-four, while claim 2's ordering is exact there (+1.00, p = 0.017). All 87 graded rows are in Appendix W, 37 of them graded withdrawn, failed, self-correcting, undecidable or an acknowledged limit, against 50 that are not."

TL;DR: 把 agent 自写自读的存储取无限任期、append-only 极限，证明可达状态空间上界为 (n-1)/n，结果是两个边缘之间的二选一而非衰减；单一无拟合参数的复制函数 γ(φ) 在 360 次真实事实运行中判对 353 次漂移方向，且一致性门控把所有模型推到 0.993。
Motivation: agent 把结论写进自己之后要检索的存储，通常被当作单向污染；在 append-only 与无限任期下这个闭环的可达状态与分数含义需要一个可测量的刻画。
Method: 以 copy function γ(φ) 为唯一无拟合参数的原语，用 sign(γ̂ − γ_crit)（γ_crit = 1/k，r = 0, w = 1）预测漂移方向；在 36 条 Wikidata 事实与合成事实上做 360 次与 40 次运行，并以 seed 为重采样单元、先冻结判据再比较四种干预。
