papers.title: LLM-Driven Training-free Location-Attribute Synergic Fusion: A Closed-Loop Paradigm for Dual-source Encrypted POIs and LULC Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Dual-source encrypted points of interest (DSEP), POIs from two encrypted coordinate systems, suffer from intertwined location and attribute uncertainties, including nonlinear systematic misalignment and naming inconsistency, hindering land-use/land-cover (LULC) mapping. To the best of our knowledge, this paper is the first to propose an LLM-driven, training-free location-attribute synergic closed-loop optimization paradigm for DSEP fusion. The paradigm jointly refines location transformation and attribute correspondences through iterative feedback. Attribute-synergic location fusion uses an LLM-driven attribute matching method to establish DSEP correspondences, reducing matching complexity from O(N^2) to O(N), and refines transformation coefficients using an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm within ISODATA-clustered local subregions. Location-synergic attribute fusion then reassesses attribute confidence from updated geometric residuals through an LLM-fuzzy method. The refined correspondences feed back into location optimization, forming a bidirectional closed loop. Sample purification and adaptive radius contraction enable convergence in essentially two iterations. We further propose a training-free LULC mapping method that inherits land-use classes from encrypted maps through location fusion, producing vector-raster integrated LULC maps. A reference-free POI fusion evaluation method is applied across 31 provincial capitals and municipalities in mainland China. Experiments show that our method achieves an average DSEP location fusion residual of 4.58 m and attribute fusion accuracy of 95.12%, improving upon the open-source baseline and state-of-the-art method by 1.77 m and 14.87%, respectively. Overall, the method provides a training-free solution for DSEP fusion and enables georeferencing of encrypted vector data to WGS-84 without field-surveyed ground control points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LLM 驱动、免训练的双源加密 POI (DSEP) 位置-属性协同闭环融合范式：属性匹配把复杂度从 O(N²) 降到 O(N)，改进 PSO 在 ISODATA 局部子区精化坐标转换系数，几何残差再经 LLM-fuzzy 反馈修正属性置信度。在中国大陆 31 个省级会与直辖市上，平均位置融合残差 4.58 m、属性融合准确率 95.12%，较开源基线与 SOTA 分别改善 1.77 m 和 14.87%，并据此产出矢量-栅格一体化 LULC 图。
Motivation: 双源加密 POI 分属两套加密坐标系，位置的非线性系统性偏移与命名不一致相互纠缠，使土地利用/覆盖 (LULC) 制图难以进行，且通常需要实地测得的地面控制点才能把加密矢量配准到 WGS-84。
Method: 先用 LLM 属性匹配建立 DSEP 对应关系，把匹配复杂度从 O(N²) 降到 O(N)，再在 ISODATA 聚类出的局部子区内用改进粒子群优化 (improved PSO) 精化转换系数；随后以 LLM-fuzzy 方法依据更新后的几何残差重估属性置信度，反馈回位置优化形成双向闭环，配合样本纯化与自适应半径收缩，约两次迭代即收敛。另提出免训练的 LULC 制图方法，从加密地图经位置融合继承用地类型，输出矢量-栅格一体化 LULC 图，并采用无参考的 POI 融合评估方法。
Result: 在大陆 31 个省会与直辖市上，平均 DSEP 位置融合残差 4.58 m，属性融合准确率 95.12%；相对开源基线改善 1.77 m，相对 SOTA 方法改善 14.87%。闭环在样本纯化与自适应半径收缩下基本两次迭代收敛。
Conclusion: 免训练的位置-属性双向闭环可在无实地控制点的条件下把加密矢量配准到 WGS-84 并支撑 LULC 制图，位置残差与属性准确率同时优于开源基线和 SOTA。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: FrontierMath Erdős
papers.abstract_en: We introduce FrontierMath Erdős (FME), a benchmark of 68 Erdős problems that are open as of August 2026. To solve a task in FME, AI systems must resolve (prove or disprove) one of the 68 conjectures in the proof assistant Lean. Our 68 problems were selected by the second author among 652 open problems on erdosproblems.com for their mathematical interest and difficulty. AIs have recently resolved several open problems in mathematics, but these demonstrations fall short of a systematic study of AI capabilities. FME evaluates every AI model on the same fixed problems, autonomously and under the same budget. We evaluated five AIs with a budget of \$300 per problem. One (GPT-6 Astra) scored 3%, and all others scored 0%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FrontierMath Erdős (FME) 是由 68 个截至 2026 年 8 月仍未解决的 Erdős 问题构成的基准，要求 AI 在证明助手 Lean 中证明或否证其中一条猜想。68 题由第二作者从 erdosproblems.com 的 652 个开放问题中按数学价值与难度选出，所有模型在同一批固定题目、同一预算下自主作答。在每题 300 美元预算下评测五个 AI，GPT-6 Astra 得 3%，其余全部 0%。
Motivation: AI 近期宣称解决了若干开放数学问题，但这些零散演示无法系统刻画 AI 的数学能力；需要让所有模型在同一组固定问题、同一预算下被公平评测。
Method: 构建 68 题的 FME 基准，题目取自 erdosproblems.com 的 652 个开放问题，由第二作者按数学价值与难度筛选；每题须在 Lean 中给出证明或否证，评测时各模型自主作答并统一预算为每题 300 美元。
Result: 在每题 300 美元预算下评测五个 AI：GPT-6 Astra 得分 3%，其余四个模型全部为 0%。题目规模为 68 题，选自 652 个开放问题，开放状态截至 2026 年 8 月。
Conclusion: 在统一题目与统一预算下，当前前沿 AI 解决真正开放的 Erdős 级数学问题的能力接近于零，仅 GPT-6 Astra 拿到 3%。

papers.title: Mitigating LLM Over-Refusal via Dynamic Semantic Routing Calibratione
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) aligned for safety often suffer from over-refusal, incorrectly rejecting benign yet safety-related instructions. Prior studies primarily attribute this to static representation overlap, largely overlooking the underlying dynamic mechanisms. In this paper, we present the mechanistic analysis of over-refusal through the lens of internal routing conflicts within transformer attention. We discover that a sparse subset of Hypersensitive Safety Heads misfires on Hard-Safe prompts, exhibiting abnormal attention entanglement that forcefully binds harmless target entities to refusal semantics. This triggers a severe, high-entropy routing conflict that deprives target entities of necessary attention. To counteract this, we propose Semantic Routing Calibration (SRC), a lightweight, training-free inference framework. SRC precisely localizes and dynamically suppresses these hypersensitive safety heads at the inference stage. Coupled with a dual-branch logits fusion that acts as a safety regularizer during subsequent decoding, SRC seamlessly restores trustworthy reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SRC alleviates over-refusal, with intrinsic safety performance preserved as much as feasible.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 13 figures, accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRC（Semantic Routing Calibration）在推理期定位并动态抑制导致过度拒答的 Hypersensitive Safety Heads，再用双分支 logits 融合做解码期安全正则，从而在保留内在安全性能的前提下减少对良性但涉安全指令的误拒。
Motivation: 对齐后的 LLM 会把良性但涉及安全的指令（Hard-Safe prompts）也拒掉，既有工作归因于静态表征重叠，忽略了注意力路由层面的动态机制。
Method: 从 transformer 注意力的内部路由冲突做机理分析，识别出稀疏的 Hypersensitive Safety Heads 在 Hard-Safe 提示上误触发、产生高熵路由冲突；SRC 在推理阶段定位并抑制这些头，配合解码期的双分支 logits 融合作为安全正则，训练无关、轻量。
Result: 实验显示 SRC 缓解过度拒答，同时尽可能保留内在安全性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 过度拒答源于少数过敏安全头的注意力纠缠与路由冲突，推理期针对性抑制即可在不过度牺牲安全的前提下修复。

papers.title: Prompt Breadth and Rollout Refresh Interact in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: How many prompts does on-policy distillation (OPD) need, and how does the answer depend on the student policies that generate its training responses? We study these two controls jointly: prompt breadth and rollout refresh. A 3x3 mathematical-reasoning experiment fixes 14,080 trajectories and 110 optimizer updates while varying the prompt bank and the number of response-generating policy snapshots. With ten snapshots, eight prompts reach 24.09% average accuracy, close to 24.51% for 14,080 distinct prompts. With responses frozen at the initial policy, however, increasing breadth lowers accuracy from 21.16% to 19.05%; under per-update refresh, it raises accuracy from 23.61% to 25.57%. The resulting interaction is 4.07 percentage points, with a 95% question-paired interval of [2.00, 6.28]. Matched comparisons under two teachers reveal a second reversal: the periodic models have higher short-budget accuracy and answer completion, but frozen-response models overtake in average accuracy at a 32K output limit, using 1.7-1.8x as many response tokens. These results show that prompt efficiency in OPD can depend on both refresh and inference budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中，prompt 广度的作用方向完全由 rollout refresh 决定：响应冻结在初始策略时，8 条 prompt 反而把数学推理平均准确率从 21.16% 压到 19.05%；每步更新刷新时，同样加宽 prompt 把准确率从 23.61% 抬到 25.57%，交互效应 4.07 个百分点（95% 题目配对区间 [2.00, 6.28]）。固定 14,080 条轨迹与 110 次更新时，10 个策略快照下 8 条 prompt 已达 24.09%，接近 14,080 条各不相同 prompt 的 24.51%。结论是 OPD 的 prompt 效率必须同时看刷新策略与推理输出预算。
Motivation: OPD 需要多少 prompt 才够，此前没有把 prompt 广度与生成训练响应的 student policy 快照数放在一起考察，而这两个控制量可能互相改变方向。
Method: 3x3 因子实验，固定 14,080 条轨迹与 110 次 optimizer 更新，只变 prompt bank 规模与生成响应的策略快照数（rollout refresh 频率），任务为数学推理；另在两个 teacher 下做配对比较，并区分响应冻结与每步刷新两种模式。
Result: 10 个快照时 8 条 prompt 平均准确率 24.09%，接近 14,080 条独立 prompt 的 24.51%；响应冻结时加宽 prompt 使准确率 21.16% → 19.05%，每步刷新时 23.61% → 25.57%，交互 4.07 个百分点，95% 题目配对区间 [2.00, 6.28]。双 teacher 配对比较中，周期刷新模型短预算准确率与回答完成率更高，但在 32K 输出上限下冻结响应模型以 1.7–1.8 倍响应 token 反超平均准确率。
Conclusion: OPD 的 prompt 效率不是 prompt 数量的单调函数，而是由 rollout refresh 与推理输出预算共同决定：不刷新时加宽 prompt 有害，每步刷新时才有收益。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: AIBuildAI-2.5: Efficient Autonomous AI Model Development Through LLM-Guided Tree Search
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents that automatically build artificial intelligence (AI) models could broaden access to AI across science and engineering. A popular line of such agents frames model building as a code search problem and solves it by tree search, in which each node is a candidate program and the tree grows by generating a child program from a parent, and these agents now approach the capability of experienced AI engineers on realistic benchmarks. However, these agents have three weaknesses in efficiency that have not been fully addressed. First, only a small number of candidates can be executed within a realistic budget, so search rules that rank nodes by executed rewards, such as Monte Carlo-style tree search, rely on few and noisy scores and select the next node to explore less effectively. Second, no resource-aware strategy is used to schedule training jobs, which can lower hardware utilization and training efficiency. Third, every agent call is served by a single powerful model, which inflates inference cost. Here we introduce AIBuildAI-2.5, an agentic system that carries out the tree search with LLM agents and addresses each of the three issues. AIBuildAI-2.5 proposes a novel LLM-guided tree search, in which a judge scores each candidate on its expected improvement, grounding, and feasibility, and a selector ranks the pool of candidates from these scores and the state of the search. In addition, AIBuildAI-2.5 comprises a scheduler that launches training jobs with the current hardware resource status taken into account and a router that assigns lower-cost LLMs to less demanding tasks while reserving the most capable LLM for the most challenging sub-tasks in the AI model building workflow. AIBuildAI-2.5 ranks first on MLE-Bench with a medal rate of 73.3%, and outperforms a strong baseline on six autonomous AI research tasks from AIRS-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIBuildAI-2.5 用 LLM 打分的树搜索替代按执行奖励排序的 Monte Carlo 式搜索：judge 对候选程序按预期改进、grounding、feasibility 打分，selector 结合分数与搜索状态选下一个节点，再配资源感知的训练调度器与按任务难度分配 LLM 的 router。在 MLE-Bench 上以 73.3% 奖牌率排名第一，并在 AIRS-Bench 六项自主 AI 研究任务上超过强基线。
Motivation: 把模型构建当作代码搜索的自主 agent 已接近资深工程师水平，但有三处效率短板：预算内可执行候选太少导致按执行奖励排序的搜索规则分数少且噪声大、训练任务无资源感知调度、每次 agent 调用都用单一强模型推高推理成本。
Method: LLM-guided tree search：judge 对每个候选按 expected improvement、grounding、feasibility 三项打分，selector 依据这些分数与搜索状态对候选池排序；scheduler 结合当前硬件资源状态启动训练任务；router 把低难度子任务分给低成本 LLM，只把最具挑战的子任务留给最强模型。
Result: 在 MLE-Bench 上排名第一，medal rate 73.3%；在 AIRS-Bench 的六项自主 AI 研究任务上超过一个强基线。
Conclusion: 用 LLM 预判候选质量而非依赖稀少且噪声大的执行奖励，配合资源感知调度与模型分级路由，可以在真实预算内把自主模型构建 agent 的成绩推到 MLE-Bench 第一。

papers.title: Silent Sabotage: Internal State Triggered Backdoor Attacks on LLM-Powered Robotic Systems
papers.abstract_en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into robotic control systems is enabling a new generation of autonomous agents capable of complex reasoning and planning. While this paradigm shift accelerates progress, it also introduces novel security risks that remain largely unexplored. Current research into LLM backdoors has focused on attacks triggered by external stimuli, such as specific words, visual objects, or environmental states. These attacks, while potent, overlook a more insidious class of vulnerability where the trigger is internal to the agent's own operational logic. This paper presents the first comprehensive study of history-based backdoor attacks on LLM-powered robotic systems. We demonstrate that an attacker can embed a stealthy backdoor into an LLM-based robot controller by manipulating its instructions. This backdoor is triggered not by an external cue, but by a specific, rare sequence of the robot's own past actions. It remains dormant during normal operation, preserving the robot's utility, but can be activated to induce a malicious behavior, such as a complete stop or a collision. Our experiments, conducted in a simulated environment with a variety of robots and LLMs, show that this history-based attack is highly effective, achieving a near-perfect attack success rate while remaining exceptionally difficult to detect. These findings reveal a critical and previously unaddressed vulnerability in autonomous systems and underscore the urgent need for security measures that account for an agent's internal state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出针对 LLM 机器人控制器的 history-based 后门：触发条件不是外部词语或视觉目标，而是机器人自身历史动作中一段罕见序列。后门在正常运行中休眠、保持机器人效用，一旦被该内部状态序列激活即诱发急停或碰撞等恶意行为；在多种机器人与 LLM 的仿真测试中攻击成功率接近完美且极难检测。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 后门研究只关注外部刺激触发（特定词语、视觉物体、环境状态），忽略了触发条件位于智能体自身运行逻辑内部的更隐蔽漏洞类别。
Method: 通过篡改 LLM 机器人控制器的指令嵌入隐蔽后门，触发器定义为机器人自身过往动作的一段特定罕见序列；在仿真环境中用多种机器人和多种 LLM 做实验验证。
Result: 在多种机器人与 LLM 的仿真实验中，该 history-based 攻击取得接近完美的攻击成功率 (near-perfect attack success rate)，同时极难被检测；激活后可诱导完全停止或碰撞等恶意行为，正常运行期间保持机器人效用。
Conclusion: 自主系统存在此前未被处理的内部状态触发漏洞，安全防护必须把智能体自身历史状态纳入检测范围，而不能只防外部触发器。

papers.title: End-to-End Quantum Semantic Communication with Variational Quantum Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a quantum semantic communication (QSemCom) framework combining quantum machine learning (QML) and semantic communication (SemCom). Classical data are compressed into low-dimensional semantic representations, encoded and processed by a variational quantum transmitter, transmitted through a quantum channel, and processed by a trainable quantum receiver for classification. The framework considers a distributed quantum communication scenario in which quantum processing units (QPUs) exchange task-relevant semantic information through quantum links. While the general setting may involve multiple quantum nodes, this work focuses on the fundamental two-node case, with transmitter and receiver QPUs connected through a noisy quantum channel. Using MNIST, the framework is evaluated under ideal, bit-flip, depolarizing, and amplitude-damping channels. A baseline model is first trained over a perfect channel and evaluated under increasing noise without retraining. Receiver-side end-to-end training is then performed at fixed depolarizing-noise levels. The perfect-channel model achieves an accuracy of $0.9556$ and an F1-score of $0.9551$. Results show channel-dependent performance degradation, while receiver training substantially restores task performance under moderate and high depolarizing noise. Moreover, task recovery does not require reconstruction of the transmitted density matrix, highlighting a distinction between physical-state recovery and semantic-feature recovery. These results demonstrate that a trainable quantum receiver can recover task-relevant semantic information from noise-distorted quantum states and maintain high classification performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出端到端量子语义通信框架 QSemCom：经典数据先压成低维语义表示，由变分量子发射机编码，经含噪量子信道传输，再由可训练量子接收机直接做分类。在 MNIST 上完美信道模型准确率 0.9556、F1 0.9551；噪声导致信道相关的性能下降，而在固定去极化噪声水平下对接收机做端到端训练，可在中高去极化噪声下大幅恢复任务性能，且无需重建传输的密度矩阵。
Motivation: 分布式量子通信中 QPU 之间只传任务相关信息，但含噪量子信道会使语义表示失真；传统做法追求物理态恢复，而分类任务真正需要的是语义特征恢复，两者并不等价。
Method: QSemCom 流水线：经典数据压缩为低维语义表示，变分量子发射机编码后经量子信道传输，可训练量子接收机输出分类；先在完美信道上训练基线模型，再在不重训条件下测试逐步增大的噪声，随后在固定去极化噪声水平下做接收机侧端到端训练。场景限定为发射/接收两个 QPU 节点，评测覆盖理想、bit-flip、depolarizing、amplitude-damping 四类信道，数据集为 MNIST。
Result: 完美信道模型准确率 0.9556、F1-score 0.9551；在噪声下出现信道相关的性能下降，基线在噪声增大且不重训时退化；固定去极化噪声水平下的接收机端到端训练在中等与高强度去极化噪声中大幅恢复任务性能，且任务恢复不依赖重建传输的密度矩阵。
Conclusion: 可训练量子接收机足以从被噪声扭曲的量子态中恢复任务相关语义信息并维持高分类性能，物理态恢复与语义特征恢复是两条不同路径。

papers.title: BananaVLM: A Domain-Adapted Vision Language Model for Banana Crop Disease Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Banana crop diseases threaten food security across the world, yet field diagnosis remains difficult because of limited expert access and visual similarity among disease classes. We present BananaVLM, a domain-adapted vision-language model for banana disease diagnosis built on LLaVA-v1.5-7B and fine-tuned with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). To address the lack of multimodal agricultural instruction data, we introduce BananaInstruct, an automated pipeline that converts raw disease images into $\approx$80,000 question--answer pairs without manual annotation, using LLaVA-1.5-13B for symptom descriptions and Mistral-7B for agricultural Q&A generation and label grounding. Evaluated against 14 open-source and 5 closed-source VLMs on a nine-class benchmark, BananaVLM achieves 92.21% in-domain and 83.28% out-of-domain (OOD) classification accuracy, outperforming the best closed-source baseline, Gemini~2.5~Pro, by 49.8 and 63.3 percentage points, respectively. Binary healthy/diseased identification reaches 98.38% OOD accuracy with 1.00 recall. A controlled LoRA--DoRA comparison shows that DoRA performance degrades across epochs, while LoRA remains more effective for fine-grained classification. Qualitative evaluation using nine LLM judges yields G-Eval win rates of 0.81--0.96, while five domain experts prefer BananaVLM in 98.48% of 990 blind pairwise comparisons. These results show that lightweight domain adaptation with automated instruction tuning is an effective and scalable approach for specialized agricultural AI. Code, datasets, and model weights are available at https://github.com/samy101/banana-vlm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BananaVLM 是基于 LLaVA-v1.5-7B、用 LoRA 微调的香蕉病害诊断视觉语言模型，配合 BananaInstruct 自动指令管线（约 80,000 条 QA，无需人工标注）。在九类基准上域内准确率 92.21%、域外 83.28%，分别领先最强闭源基线 Gemini 2.5 Pro 49.8 和 63.3 个百分点；健康/染病二分类域外达 98.38%、recall 1.00。受控对比显示 DoRA 随 epoch 性能下降，细粒度分类仍以 LoRA 更有效。
Motivation: 香蕉病害威胁全球粮食安全，但田间诊断受专家稀缺与病类视觉相似所限；农业多模态指令数据匮乏也阻碍专用 VLM 落地。
Method: 以 LLaVA-v1.5-7B 为基座、用 LoRA 微调；提出 BananaInstruct 自动管线，用 LLaVA-1.5-13B 生成症状描述、Mistral-7B 生成农业问答与标签接地，把原始病害图转成约 80,000 条免人工标注 QA。评测覆盖 14 个开源与 5 个闭源 VLM，并做 LoRA–DoRA 受控对比、9 个 LLM judge 的 G-Eval 与 5 位领域专家盲评。
Result: 九类基准上域内准确率 92.21%、域外 (OOD) 83.28%，较 Gemini 2.5 Pro 分别高 49.8 与 63.3 个百分点；健康/染病二分类 OOD 准确率 98.38%、recall 1.00。LoRA–DoRA 对比中 DoRA 随 epoch 下降而 LoRA 更适合细粒度分类；G-Eval 胜率 0.81–0.96，5 位专家在 990 次盲配对中 98.48% 偏好 BananaVLM。
Conclusion: 轻量领域适配加自动指令调训足以让 7B 级 VLM 在专用农业诊断上大幅超越闭源通用模型，且可扩展到其他专业领域；细粒度分类选 LoRA 而非 DoRA。

summary_sections.conclusion: 轻量领域适配加自动指令调训足以让 7B 级 VLM 在专用农业诊断上大幅超越闭源通用模型，且可扩展到其他专业领域；细粒度分类选 LoRA 而非 DoRA。

papers.title: Quantifying Protocol-Induced Uncertainty in Comparative Predictive-Model Evaluation: Evidence from Large-Scale Daily PM10 Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Comparative studies of predictive models often end by ranking candidate models, yet these rankings depend on evaluation protocols whose influence is rarely treated as a source of uncertainty. We formalize this problem as protocol-induced ranking uncertainty and introduce a framework that compares ranking displacement caused by switching protocols with displacement produced by conventional choices within a fixed protocol. We quantify these effects using the Protocol Sensitivity Score (PSS) and a full-refit intraprotocol reference. We validate the framework in a large-scale sequential prediction study of daily PM10. Static-split and rolling-origin evaluation are compared across 425 European background stations and 365 US EPA monitors. Switching protocols produces mean PSS values of 0.801 and 0.772 and changes the selected model at 35.3% and 31.5% of stations, respectively. In Europe, intraprotocol perturbations with identical scored targets produce PSS values of 0.072 and 0.230, with winner-swap rates of 0.8% and 4.9%. Between-protocol displacement is therefore substantially larger than the selected within-protocol references. Expanding the candidate set from three to nine models increases the between-protocol winner-swap rate to 60.2% in Europe. The pattern also persists under a frozen protocol applied to held-out background and non-background stations. These results show that model-selection conclusions can depend materially on legitimate evaluation choices. We recommend reporting ranking stability under a small set of defensible intraprotocol perturbations alongside claims of model superiority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把模型排名对评估协议的敏感度形式化为 protocol-induced ranking uncertainty，用 Protocol Sensitivity Score (PSS) 与 full-refit intraprotocol 参照量化：切换 static-split 与 rolling-origin 协议的平均 PSS 达 0.801（欧洲 425 站）与 0.772（美国 365 站），在 35.3% 与 31.5% 的站点换掉胜出模型，远大于协议内扰动的 0.072/0.230（胜者互换率 0.8%/4.9%）。候选集从 3 个扩到 9 个时欧洲协议间胜者互换率升至 60.2%。作者建议在宣称模型优越性的同时报告一组合理协议内扰动下的排名稳定性。
Motivation: 预测模型比较研究最终常给出排名，但排名所依赖的评估协议本身被当作固定前提，其引入的不确定性从未被当作不确定性来源处理，模型优越性结论可能被合法的协议选择左右。
Method: 提出框架，把切换协议造成的排名位移与固定协议内常规选择造成的位移对比，用 Protocol Sensitivity Score (PSS) 和 full-refit intraprotocol 参照量化；在日 PM10 的大规模序列预测研究中比较 static-split 与 rolling-origin 两种评估，覆盖欧洲 425 个 background 站与美国 365 个 EPA 监测点，并在冻结协议下用 held-out background 与 non-background 站点检验模式是否延续。
Result: 切换协议的平均 PSS 为 0.801（欧洲）与 0.772（美国），分别在 35.3% 与 31.5% 的站点改变被选模型；欧洲协议内、评分目标相同的扰动 PSS 为 0.072 与 0.230，winner-swap 率 0.8% 与 4.9%；候选集由 3 个扩到 9 个使欧洲协议间 winner-swap 率升至 60.2%；该模式在冻结协议下的 held-out background 与 non-background 站点上依然存在。
Conclusion: 协议间排名位移远大于所选协议内参照，模型选择结论会实质依赖合法的评估选择；作者建议在宣称模型优越性时一并报告一组合理协议内扰动下的排名稳定性。

papers.title: The Architect, the Adversary, and the Judge: Closed-Loop Generation of Standards-Aligned Assessment Items at Scale
papers.abstract_en: We present CLAIM, a production pipeline for K-12 assessment-item generation coupling a two-stage generate-then-attack protocol (the model drafts as a "curriculum architect", then re-enters the same conversation as a hostile adversarial reviewer), bi-directional few-shot conditioning on accepted and rejected items, the latter carrying the evaluator's diagnosis, and a knowledge dictionary of 44,844 error-correction rules mined from that feedback and retrieved per standard and item type. Across 43,227 scored items over 755 Common Core ELA standards, three item types, and ten LLMs, the pipeline reaches a 97.8% expert-evaluator pass rate on a 9,074-item production run. We then ask what that rate certifies. Re-scoring a stratified sample with three judges from other vendors, blind to the deployed verdict, reproduces the format ordering under every judge and recovers a larger open-set deficit than the deployed evaluator does; but agreement on the accept/reject binary is weak at production prevalence (kappa about 0.13), and the judges agree with each other no better. The level is therefore judge-relative, and with no student-response data our quality evidence is evaluator-judged throughout. The corpus also exposes a robust asymmetry. Multiple-choice and multiple-select generation saturate at 98% or above for both frontier models under a dozen static rules, whereas fill-in-the-blank generation is capability-tiered (82.8-96.7% across five models under a matched rule set, standards, and judge) and plateaus under prompt-only optimization, with error mass shifting between answer-key over-inclusion and omission as rules accumulate. We analyze this as open-set boundary determination, a task autoregressive decoders are structurally ill-equipped to solve, and show the asymmetry recurring when the evaluator itself is distilled: fail-recall rises from 8% to 63% while F1 saturates at 0.25.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Companion paper: arXiv:2608.01000
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLAIM 用两阶段 generate-then-attack 协议加 44,844 条错误纠正规则知识库，在 755 条 Common Core ELA 标准上批量生成 K-12 试题，部署评估器给出 97.8% 专家通过率。换三家外部盲评后，接受/拒绝二分类一致性 kappa 仅约 0.13，说明该通过率是 judge-relative 的；选择题与多选题在 98% 以上饱和，填空题则随模型能力分层（82.8–96.7%），作者归因为自回归解码器不擅长开放集边界判定。
Motivation: 规模化试题生成的通过率由部署方自己的评估器裁定，缺少外部校准与学生作答数据，高通过率未必等于真实质量；填空题在提示优化下出现平台期，错误在答案键过纳入与遗漏之间转移。
Method: 两阶段 generate-then-attack：模型先以 curriculum architect 起草，再以敌对评审身份进入同一对话自我攻击；双向 few-shot 条件化同时使用被接受与被拒绝条目（后者附评估者诊断）；从反馈中挖掘出 44,844 条错误纠正规则的知识字典，按标准与题型检索。评测覆盖 43,227 条计分条目、755 条 Common Core ELA 标准、三种题型、十个 LLM，并用三家外部供应商的盲评重打分。
Result: 9,074 条生产运行上部署评估器专家通过率 97.8%；外部盲评在每一家下都复现题型排序并暴露更大的 open-set 缺口，但接受/拒绝二分类 kappa 约 0.13，且三家彼此一致性同样差。选择题与多选题在两个前沿模型、十二条静态规则下饱和至 98% 以上；填空题在五个模型、匹配规则集下为 82.8–96.7%，提示优化即达平台。评估器被蒸馏后 fail-recall 从 8% 升至 63%，F1 饱和在 0.25。
Conclusion: 通过率是相对于评估器的量，缺乏学生作答数据时质量证据始终是 evaluator-judged；填空题的开放集边界判定是自回归解码器的结构性短板，靠堆规则或提示优化无法补齐。

papers.title: What Does Chain-of-Thought Entropy Measure? A Channel Audit of Scaffolding, Routing, and Content
papers.abstract_en: Entropy over chain-of-thought tokens decides which tokens receive the policy gradient, which get pruned, and whether a run has collapsed, yet each such statistic reads a next-token distribution mixing three choices: whether to emit connective scaffolding, which connective, and what the substantive continuation should be. Designating a scaffold vocabulary subset separates the three, exactly, for entropy, Kullback--Leibler divergence, and the first-order entropy velocity of a softmax policy. We prove the raw and content conventions disagree about which position is the larger fork on an explicit open region, and bound answer diversity by the content channel plus a leakage term a measured witness certifies. Across twenty-three configurations the scaffold side carries up to 41% of the raw high-entropy set; on a matched-tokenizer ladder, coupling changes only at the math-corpus step while the scaffold's entropy share keeps growing through distillation; a closed-form forecast from one channel correlation tracks selection retention over a 54-point range to five points, unfitted. On compression, the content convention beats raw surprisal in every cell; an answer-leakage audit then corrects our own headline control: re-fed chains earn a quarter to a half of their accuracy from restated answers, and once stripped, no token scorer beats a random contiguous block.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoT token 熵把三件事混在一个 next-token 分布里：是否输出连接性 scaffolding、输出哪个连接词、实质续写是什么。指定 scaffold 词表子集可对熵、KL 散度与 softmax 策略的一阶熵速度精确三分；raw 与 content 两种约定在显式开集上对哪个位置是更大分叉给出相反排序。23 个配置中 scaffold 侧最多占 raw 高熵集的 41%，而剥离复述答案后没有任何 token 打分器胜过随机连续块。
Motivation: CoT token 熵被用来决定哪些 token 拿到 policy gradient、哪些被剪枝、一次训练是否已崩塌，但它同时混合了脚手架选择与实质内容选择，导致高熵判据含义不清。
Method: 指定 scaffold 词表子集，把 next-token 分布分解为脚手架、连接词选择与内容三个通道，对熵、KL 散度和 softmax 策略的一阶熵速度给出精确分解；证明 raw 与 content 约定在显式开集上排序相反，并用 content 通道加泄漏项界定答案多样性，由实测 witness 认证泄漏。
Result: 跨 23 个配置，scaffold 侧最多承载 raw 高熵集的 41%；在 matched-tokenizer 阶梯上耦合只在 math-corpus 一步改变，而 scaffold 熵占比在蒸馏过程中持续上升；由单通道相关性得到的闭式预测在无拟合条件下追踪选择保留，54 点范围内误差 5 点。压缩任务上 content 约定在每个 cell 都优于 raw surprisal；答案泄漏审计显示重喂链的准确率有四分之一到一半来自复述答案，剥离后没有 token 打分器胜过随机连续块。
Conclusion: CoT 熵应按 scaffold/content 通道拆开解读，raw 熵的高值位置排序并不可靠；以压缩为用途时 content 约定更有效，且此前基于重喂链的 token 打分优势在剥离答案泄漏后消失。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 4DGS-JEPA: Temporally Compositional Joint-Embedding Prediction for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting provides an explicit representation of evolving 3D scenes, but existing approaches are primarily optimized for reconstruction, future-state generation, or rendering rather than for learning reusable predictive dynamics. We propose 4DGS-JEPA, a Gaussian-native joint-embedding predictive architecture for causal multi-horizon prediction over dynamic Gaussian scenes. The model uses a hierarchical scene-, motion-group-, and Gaussian-level representation together with a horizon-conditioned transition operator that supports both direct prediction and recursive rollout. Its central principle is temporal composition: different chronological transition paths reaching the same future endpoint should produce compatible predictive states. Endpoint and multi-horizon path supervision anchor these predictions to future target embeddings, while a selective geometry decoder and geometry-level composition ground the learned dynamics in consistent group motion and Gaussian geometry without requiring complete future appearance reconstruction. We further introduce a hybrid correspondence mechanism that combines persistent canonical identity with residual optimal-transport matching under reordering and topology change. We characterize zero-loss path agreement and finite-error rollout accumulation theoretically. Three controlled experiments provide mechanism-level evidence that temporal composition reduces latent path dependence while retaining predictive accuracy, geometry-level composition improves consistency of decoded motion, and hybrid correspondence preserves reliable identity while remaining robust when correspondence becomes ambiguous. Together, 4DGS-JEPA provides a predictive, temporally compositional formulation of dynamic Gaussian worlds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 4DGS-JEPA 把动态 Gaussian Splatting 从重建/渲染目标改成因果多步预测的 joint-embedding 架构：以场景—运动组—Gaussian 层级表征加 horizon 条件转移算子，约束到达同一未来端点的不同时间路径产生相容的预测状态。三组受控实验给出机制级证据：时间组合降低隐空间的路径依赖、几何级组合提升解码运动的一致性、混合对应在对应关系含糊时仍保持可靠身份。
Motivation: 现有动态 Gaussian Splatting 方法主要优化重建、未来状态生成或渲染，缺少可复用的预测动力学表征，多步预测中的路径依赖与身份对应不稳定问题没有被直接处理。
Method: 采用 Gaussian-native 的 joint-embedding 预测架构：层级表征（scene、motion-group、Gaussian 三级）配合 horizon 条件转移算子，同时支持直接预测与递归 rollout；用端点监督和多步路径监督把预测锚定到未来目标 embedding，选择性 geometry decoder 与 geometry-level composition 把动力学落到一致的组运动和 Gaussian 几何上，无需重建完整未来外观；对应机制为持久 canonical identity 加残差 optimal-transport 匹配，以应对重排与拓扑变化；并给出零损失路径一致性与有限误差 rollout 累积的理论刻画。
Result: 三组受控实验提供机制级证据：时间组合在保持预测精度的同时降低 latent 路径依赖；几何级组合改善解码运动的一致性；混合对应在对应关系变得含糊时仍保持可靠身份。理论部分刻画了零损失路径一致性与有限误差下的 rollout 误差累积。
Conclusion: 动态 Gaussian 场景可以按因果、时间可组合的预测形式来表述，路径一致性与几何/身份组合是让学到的动力学可复用、可递归 rollout 的关键约束。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.tldr: 4DGS-JEPA 把动态 Gaussian Splatting 从重建/渲染目标改成因果多步预测的 joint-embedding 架构：以场景—运动组—Gaussian 层级表征加 horizon 条件转移算子，约束到达同一未来端点的不同时间路径产生相容的预测状态。三组受控实验给出机制级证据：时间组合降低隐空间的路径依赖、几何级组合提升解码运动的一致性、混合对应在对应关系含糊时仍保持可靠身份。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有动态 Gaussian Splatting 方法主要优化重建、未来状态生成或渲染，缺少可复用的预测动力学表征，多步预测中的路径依赖与身份对应不稳定问题没有被直接处理。
summary_sections.method: 采用 Gaussian-native 的 joint-embedding 预测架构：层级表征（scene、motion-group、Gaussian 三级）配合 horizon 条件转移算子，同时支持直接预测与递归 rollout；用端点监督和多步路径监督把预测锚定到未来目标 embedding，选择性 geometry decoder 与 geometry-level composition 把动力学落到一致的组运动和 Gaussian 几何上，无需重建完整未来外观；对应机制为持久 canonical identity 加残差 optimal-transport 匹配，以应对重排与拓扑变化；并给出零损失路径一致性与有限误差 rollout 累积的理论刻画。
summary_sections.result: 三组受控实验提供机制级证据：时间组合在保持预测精度的同时降低 latent 路径依赖；几何级组合改善解码运动的一致性；混合对应在对应关系变得含糊时仍保持可靠身份。理论部分刻画了零损失路径一致性与有限误差下的 rollout 误差累积。
summary_sections.conclusion: 动态 Gaussian 场景可以按因果、时间可组合的预测形式来表述，路径一致性与几何/身份组合是让学到的动力学可复用、可递归 rollout 的关键约束。

papers.title: From Tone to Trajectory: Continuous Sentiment and the Shape of Monetary Policy Communication
papers.abstract_en: Central bank press conferences are not merely information releases --- they are structured narratives. We study whether the shape of sentiment within a statement, not just its average tone, carries policy-relevant signals. Constructing sentiment arcs for ECB and Fed press conferences along three dimensions --- monetary stance, economic outlook, and uncertainty --- we assess their predictive content for policy rate changes, inflation expectations, and forecaster disagreement. Our findings show that arc shape robustly predicts rate decisions beyond lexicon-based benchmarks at both institutions --- it is not merely whether a statement sounds hawkish or economically optimistic on average, but how these sentiments are sequenced and emphasized across the statement, that carries the policy signal. Arc features also shape how professional forecasters update inflation expectations and how much they disagree, pointing to a receiver-side effect distinct from the direct policy signal. These findings suggest that communication design --- the sequencing and emphasis of policy language across a statement --- is a first-order feature of the policy signal, not a second-order refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 ECB 与 Fed 记者会文本构建三维情感弧 (sentiment arc)——货币政策立场、经济前景、不确定性——检验情感在声明内部的序列形态而非平均语调是否预测政策利率变动、通胀预期与预测者分歧。结果显示弧线形态在两家机构上都能稳健预测利率决定，且超出基于词典的基线；弧线特征还影响职业预测者更新通胀预期的程度与彼此分歧，说明信号来自情感的排序与强调方式。
Motivation: 央行沟通被当作信息发布处理，通常只看平均鹰鸽语调；本文要检验声明内部情感的序列形态本身是否携带一阶政策信号，而非二阶修饰。
Method: 为 ECB 与 Fed 记者会声明沿货币政策立场、经济前景、不确定性三个维度构建情感弧 (sentiment arcs)，用弧线特征预测政策利率变动、通胀预期与预测者分歧，并与基于词典 (lexicon-based) 的基准比较。
Result: 弧线形态在 ECB 与 Fed 两家机构上都稳健预测利率决定，且超出词典基准；弧线特征同时预测职业预测者对通胀预期的更新幅度与预测者之间的分歧，呈现区别于直接政策信号的接收方效应。
Conclusion: 政策语言在声明中的排序与强调是一阶政策信号特征，平均语调不足以刻画沟通效果；沟通设计本身具有可预测的政策与预期效应。

papers.title: Block-Level Weight-Space Structure Persists Under Post-Training: An Empirical Study Across LLM Families
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLMs are deployed as families of post-trained variants (base, instruct, chat, code) derived from a shared set of pre-trained weights. We present an empirical study of how post-training transforms weight-space geometry, covering eight configurations across four architecture families (Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1/3.2, Mistral, Gemma-2). We identify a granularity gap: post-training modifies every tensor (zero of 291-339 tensors remain byte-identical, so hash-based deduplication achieves 0% savings), yet preserves block-level structure (mean cosine similarity exceeds 0.99 and relative Frobenius distance stays below 0.13). Post-training therefore acts as a structured perturbation that shifts every parameter while leaving block-level geometry intact. The property is not universal: independently trained specializations (for example, Qwen2.5-Coder) attain cosine similarity around 0.64 with the general base, indicating a disconnected region of weight space. Perturbation magnitude varies systematically with model scale, architecture family, and post-training recipe. As a practical application, we build LinkerLLM, a lazy loader that aliases shareable blocks across co-resident variants, achieving 18-48% GPU memory savings and enabling up to five 7B-parameter variants on a single 24 GB consumer GPU. Five of eight configurations retain at least 94% of the unshared variant's quality on MMLU, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, and WinoGrande; the remaining three (Mistral-7B, Gemma-2-2B, Llama-3.2-1B) have one below-threshold benchmark each (87-91%), which we report transparently rather than gate the block-sharing decision on a single threshold.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 11 figures. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Weight-Space Symmetries: from Foundations to Practical Applications. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=jdVfddhT65
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对四个架构家族共八组后训练变体做权重空间实证比较，发现后训练改动全部张量（291-339 个张量零个字节级相同，哈希去重节省 0%），但块级几何保持不变（平均余弦相似度 >0.99，相对 Frobenius 距离 <0.13）。据此构建懒加载器 LinkerLLM 跨共驻变体共享块，GPU 显存节省 18-48%，单张 24GB 消费级显卡可容纳最多五个 7B 变体。
Motivation: 后训练变体（base/instruct/chat/code）共享同一套预训练权重，但逐张量哈希去重完全失效，需要弄清后训练究竟改变了权重空间的哪一层结构，才能决定能否安全共享权重块。
Method: 在 Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1/3.2、Mistral、Gemma-2 四个架构家族上比较八组后训练配置，用逐张量字节比对、块级余弦相似度与相对 Frobenius 距离刻画权重空间几何；再据此实现 LinkerLLM 懒加载器，跨共驻变体别名共享可共享块，并在 MMLU、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag、WinoGrande 上检验质量保留。
Result: 八组配置中 291-339 个张量零个保持字节相同，哈希去重节省 0%；块级平均余弦相似度 >0.99、相对 Frobenius 距离 <0.13。独立训练的 Qwen2.5-Coder 与通用 base 余弦相似度约 0.64。LinkerLLM 实现 18-48% GPU 显存节省，单张 24GB 显卡可容纳最多五个 7B 变体；八组中五组在四项基准上保留至少 94% 质量，其余三组（Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-2B、Llama-3.2-1B）各有一项基准落在 87-91%。
Conclusion: 后训练是一种结构化扰动：移动每一个参数却保留块级几何，因此按块共享权重可行；但独立训练的专门化模型落在权重空间的不连通区域，不能套用同一共享策略，也不应以单一阈值决定是否共享。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mode Collapse Is Cheap to Detect: A Ground-Truth-Free Pre-Flight Check for Neural Samplers
papers.abstract_en: Neural samplers are trained against an unnormalised target $\tildeπ=e^{-E}$ with no samples from $π$, which leaves the practitioner with no way to tell whether an expensive training run has silently dropped part of the target. The diagnostics in common use are computed from the model's own draws and are therefore confined to the model's support: we exhibit a sampler whose self-normalised effective sample size is $0.99$ while it misses $87\%$ of the target mass. We argue that \emph{detecting} missing mass is a strictly easier problem than sampling it: detection needs one point per missed basin plus a local curvature estimate, whereas correction needs the sampler retrained. We turn this into a pre-flight check that consumes a few percent of the sampler's own training budget and uses only $E$, $\nabla E$ and $\nabla^2 E$. On Gaussian-mixture, Many-Well and rotated anisotropic Many-Well targets with exactly computable ground truth, the check estimates the missing mass to within $10^{-3}$ at $2.7\%$ of training cost, where a tuned annealed SMC reference needs $70$--$280\%$ of training cost to do worse. It also applies unchanged to a controlled-SDE sampler that has no tractable density, where ESS and the ELBO cannot be formed at all. The estimator carries a \emph{self-diagnostic} that, without ground truth, is conservative in the safe direction: across $60$ configurations it clears $16$, of which $15$ are accurate to $10^{-2}$ or better. We are explicit about what this does and does not license: the check cheaply produces evidence of missing mass, and sometimes evidence that the search has stabilised, but it cannot certify a run, and its thresholds are heuristic. We then map the boundary of the method on a real physical landscape, LJ-13, and report where it fails and why.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对神经采样器训练后可能静默丢失目标分布部分质量、而现有诊断只在模型自身支撑集内失效的问题，提出一个基于 E、∇E、∇²E 的 pre-flight 缺失质量检测：只需每个漏掉的 basin 一个点加局部曲率估计。在 Gaussian-mixture、Many-Well、rotated anisotropic Many-Well 上以 2.7% 训练成本把缺失质量估到 10⁻³ 内，而调好的 annealed SMC 参考需 70–280% 成本且更差；自诊断在 60 个配置中放行 16 个，其中 15 个精度达 10⁻² 或更好。
Motivation: 神经采样器只对未归一化目标 e^{-E} 训练、拿不到 π 的样本，从业者无法判断一次昂贵训练是否静默丢掉了部分目标质量；常用诊断（如 ESS）算自模型自身的抽样，被限制在模型支撑集内——摘要给出一个自归一化 ESS 达 0.99 却漏掉 87% 目标质量的采样器。
Method: 把检测与采样分离：检测只需每个漏掉 basin 一个点加局部曲率估计，纠正则需重训。据此构造 pre-flight check，只消费采样器自身训练预算的百分之几，仅用 E、∇E、∇²E；估计器附带一个无需 ground truth 的自诊断，方向上偏保守（宁可不放行）。
Result: 在有精确 ground truth 的 Gaussian-mixture、Many-Well、rotated anisotropic Many-Well 上，检测以 2.7% 训练成本把缺失质量估到 10⁻³ 内，而调好的 annealed SMC 参考需 70–280% 训练成本且更差；对无解析密度的 controlled-SDE 采样器同样适用（此时 ESS 与 ELBO 根本无法构造）。自诊断在 60 个配置中放行 16 个，其中 15 个精确到 10⁻² 或更好。
Conclusion: 检测缺失质量严格比采样它便宜，因此可以做成低成本的训练前检查；但作者明确它只能廉价给出缺失质量的证据、有时给出搜索已稳定的证据，不能认证一次训练，阈值是启发式的，并在真实物理能景 LJ-13 上标出方法失效的边界及原因。

papers.title: Margin-Drop Coordinates for Cross-Budget Robustness Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Fixed-budget robustness evaluation can select the wrong frozen vision encoder. An encoder that survives a shallow attack may lose most of that robustness when the same evaluation is strengthened. We ask whether the shallow evaluation contains enough information to identify this budget fragility. For each clean-correct sample, the evaluation records the clean pairwise margin, the first-order linearized margin-drop scale, the margin drop from a clean-start one-step attack, and the drop reached by an iterative attack. Normalizing by that scale gives three margin-drop coordinates capturing clean margin slack, one-step shortfall, and drift, where drift is the additional normalized margin drop the iterative attack reaches beyond the one-step perturbation. Together, they reconstruct the normalized post-attack margin and therefore the pass-or-fail outcome. Across 42 pretrained frozen vision encoders, the shallow survival rate carries essentially no rank information about subsequent PGD-10 to PGD-200 collapse, at Spearman -0.006, while the median shallow drift coordinate ranks the same collapse at +0.811. The result persists in a held-out encoder pool and under an $\ell_\infty$ evaluation. With deep evaluation limited to 11 encoders, ranking by shallow drift recovers 11 of the 17 high-collapse encoders, compared with 5 under survival-rate ranking. The full coordinate decomposition further distinguishes cases that share the same fixed-budget residual but diverge at deeper budgets, and separates margin repair from drift repair under interventions, revealing distinct repair paths that endpoint robustness alone does not identify.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 固定预算下的鲁棒性评测会选错冻结视觉编码器：浅层攻击存活率对后续 PGD-10 到 PGD-200 崩塌几乎无排序信息（Spearman -0.006），而归一化后的浅层 drift 坐标排序相关达 +0.811。三个 margin-drop 坐标（clean margin slack、one-step shortfall、drift）可重构攻击后归一化 margin 与通过/失败结果，在 42 个预训练冻结视觉编码器上成立，并在留出编码器池与 ℓ∞ 评测下保持。
Motivation: 固定预算鲁棒评测在浅层攻击下存活的编码器，加深同一评测后可能丢失大部分鲁棒性，导致选错冻结视觉编码器；需要判断浅层评测是否含识别这种 budget fragility 的信息。
Method: 对每个 clean-correct 样本记录 clean pairwise margin、一阶线性化 margin-drop 尺度、clean-start 单步攻击的 margin drop、以及迭代攻击达到的 drop；除以该尺度得到三个归一化坐标（clean margin slack、one-step shortfall、drift），三者重构归一化攻击后 margin 与 pass/fail。评测覆盖 42 个预训练冻结视觉编码器，比较浅层存活率与浅层 drift 中位数对 PGD-10 至 PGD-200 崩塌的排序，并在留出编码器池与 ℓ∞ 评测下复核。

papers.title: The Temporal Moderation Gap: Text-to-Video Safety Filters Are Blind to Harm in Motion
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video (T2V) services inherit their safety stack from image generation, pairing a keyword prompt filter with a per-frame checker that blocks a clip whenever one sampled frame looks unsafe. This stack has a blind spot unique to video. We prove that any moderator ignoring frame order accepts a harmful clip whenever it accepts that clip's benign shuffle, so harm carried by the ordering alone escapes. Empirically, the unmodified benchmark prompt already lands a clip in this moderation gap on 32.7% of Sequential-Action targets over four held-out seeds, and paraphrasing, scene splitting, and a feedback-driven prompt search show no significant improvement (paired McNemar $p\ge0.12$), so prompt engineering is not needed to expose the vulnerability. Dense-scoring all 97 rendered frames shows that about a third of the delivered clips merely hide an unsafe frame, while the rest stay harmful as ordered videos even though every frame passes, an order-blind residual the unmodified prompt reaches on a quarter of Sequential-Action targets. We also document a measurement pitfall, since scoring a searched prompt on its own render seed inflates a 7.5% per-generation rate into an apparent 46.7%. A user study confirms that people read these clips as harmful and their shuffles as safe. The fix is to read frame order, and an order-aware detector separates these clips from their own shuffles at AUC 0.74 where per-frame checking sits at chance, which is the signal deployed moderation throws away.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 文本到视频 (T2V) 安全过滤沿用图像管线——关键词过滤加逐帧检查，只要有一帧不安全就拦截，因此对仅靠帧顺序承载的危害完全失明。作者证明任何忽略帧序的审核器接受某段有害视频时必然也接受其良性乱序版本；在 Sequential-Action 目标上，原始基准提示就有 32.7%（四个留出种子）落入该漏洞，改写、拆分场景与反馈式提示搜索均无显著改善（配对 McNemar p≥0.12）。修复方向是让审核器读帧序：顺序感知检测器区分原片与其乱序版达 AUC 0.74，而逐帧检查仅在随机水平。
Motivation: T2V 服务直接继承图像生成的安全栈，逐帧打分对时序性危害（harm in motion）存在结构性盲区，且该漏洞可被未经修改的基准提示直接触发，无需提示工程。
Method: 先形式化证明：任何忽略帧序的审核器若接受某段剪辑，也必然接受其良性乱序版。实证部分在四个留出种子上渲染剪辑，对全部 97 帧做稠密打分，区分“藏了一帧不安全”与“逐帧全过但按时序仍有害”两类残余；用改写、场景拆分、反馈驱动提示搜索检验漏洞是否依赖提示工程，并以用户研究核对人对原片与乱序版的危害感知，最后训练顺序感知检测器。
Result: 原始基准提示在 32.7% 的 Sequential-Action 目标上（四个留出种子）落入审核漏洞；改写、场景拆分与反馈式提示搜索无显著改善（配对 McNemar p≥0.12）。对全部 97 帧稠密打分显示约三分之一交付剪辑只是藏了一帧不安全，其余在逐帧全过的情况下按时序仍属有害，原始提示即可触达约四分之一 Sequential-Action 目标。在自有渲染种子上评分会把 7.5% 的每次生成率虚增为 46.7%。用户研究确认人们把原片读作有害、乱序版读作安全。顺序感知检测器区分原片与其乱序版 AUC 0.74，逐帧检查处于随机水平。
Conclusion: 被部署的 T2V 审核丢弃的正是帧序信号：修复必须让审核器读取帧序，否则仅靠提示工程无法封堵该漏洞；同时评测提示危害率时须避免在自渲染种子上打分造成的测量虚高。

papers.title: PatchKV: Efficient KV Cache Recovery for Dynamically Edited LLM Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Long-running LLM agent workflows often revise interior context spans while retaining long suffixes. Although suffix tokens remain unchanged, altered causal histories and rotary positions prevent exact reuse of their offloaded key-value (KV) states. Full suffix recomputation wastes prefill work, while indiscriminate reuse propagates stale states and full-precision restoration adds data movement. We present PatchKV, a profile-guided recovery system for suffix-preserving revisions. PatchKV decomposes adjacent context versions into an exact prefix, an updated span, and an aligned suffix. It predicts an edit-local dirty region using an offline length-conditioned drift model, augments this region with sparse nonlocal blocks selected from stored attention, and block-rounds their union into a fixed repair set. The remaining suffix blocks are restored from CPU memory using frozen per-block precision tags and a fused path for dequantization, RoPE correction, and KV-page placement. Across three models and three long-context question-answering workloads, PatchKV achieves a $2.51$-$3.85\times$ speedup in mean resume time-to-first-token over full suffix recomputation and a $1.26$-$2.06\times$ speedup over CacheBlend, while matching or exceeding CacheBlend's F1 score in six of nine settings and remaining within 1.36 points in the others.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PatchKV 针对 LLM agent 长上下文中段内编辑后缀不变却无法复用 KV cache 的问题，把相邻版本切成精确前缀、更新段与对齐后缀，用离线长度条件漂移模型预测编辑局部脏区，再用存储注意力选出的稀疏非局部块扩充并按块取整成修复集，其余后缀块按冻结的每块精度标签从 CPU 融合恢复。在三个模型与三个长上下文 QA 负载上，平均恢复 TTFT 相对全后缀重算加速 2.51–3.85×，相对 CacheBlend 加速 1.26–2.06×。
Motivation: 长时程 agent 工作流反复修改上下文中段却保留长后缀，因果历史与 RoPE 位置变化使后缀 KV 无法精确复用：全量重算浪费 prefill，盲目复用传播陈旧状态，全精度恢复又带来数据搬运开销。
Method: PatchKV 是面向后缀保留式修订的 profile-guided 恢复系统：把相邻上下文版本分解为精确前缀、更新段与对齐后缀；用离线长度条件漂移模型 (length-conditioned drift model) 预测编辑局部脏区，用存储注意力选出的稀疏非局部块扩充，再按块取整为固定修复集；剩余后缀块按冻结的每块精度标签从 CPU 内存恢复，走融合的反量化、RoPE 校正与 KV-page 放置路径。
Result: 在三个模型和三个长上下文 QA 负载上，平均恢复 time-to-first-token 相对全后缀重算加速 2.51–3.85×，相对 CacheBlend 加速 1.26–2.06×；九个设置中六个 F1 追平或超过 CacheBlend，其余三个差距不超过 1.36 分。
Conclusion: 对后缀保留式上下文修订，按编辑局部性预测脏区并配合精度标签化的融合恢复，可以在保持 CacheBlend 级 F1 的同时大幅缩短恢复 TTFT。

papers.title: Early Prediction of Pathological Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Using Temporal Deep Learning on DWI
papers.abstract_en: Early identification of non-responders to neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) is crucial for timely treatment adaptation in breast cancer. However, many existing predictive models rely on multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), late treatment time points, or extensive clinical data, which limits their applicability. This study proposes a deep learning framework for early prediction of pathological complete response (pCR) using only diffusion-weighted MRI (DW-MRI) acquired at baseline and after the first NACT cycle. This framework feeds cropped tumor-centered patches to an EfficientNet-based temporal model that directly learns tumor shape and local tissue characteristics without explicit radiomic feature engineering. The model, trained with 10-fold cross-validation, achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.90 for pCR prediction after one cycle, providing actionable information after a single treatment cycle while avoiding gadolinium administration and reducing dependence on heterogeneous clinical data. By focusing on the baseline-to-first-cycle window instead of later stages, the approach supports earlier escalation or de-escalation of NACT, and its exclusive reliance on DW-MRI facilitates protocol standardization, multi-centre deployment and privacy-preserving data sharing. These results demonstrate that DW-MRI-based deep learning on tumor-centered patches constitutes a minimally invasive, clinically deployable strategy for early pCR prediction, with direct implications for personalized treatment adaptation in neoadjuvant breast cancer therapy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 仅用基线与第一周期后的 DW-MRI 肿瘤中心 patch，EfficientNet 时序模型在 10 折交叉验证下对乳腺癌新辅助化疗 (NACT) 一个周期后的病理完全缓解 (pCR) 预测 AUC 达 0.90，无需钆对比剂与显式 radiomics 特征工程。
Motivation: 现有 pCR 预测模型依赖多参数 MRI、较晚治疗时点或大量异质临床数据，限制了早期调整治疗的可用性。
Method: 将裁剪的肿瘤中心 patch 喂给基于 EfficientNet 的时序模型，直接学习肿瘤形状与局部组织特征，跳过显式 radiomic 特征工程；仅使用基线与第一 NACT 周期后的 DW-MRI，训练采用 10 折交叉验证。
Result: 在 10 折交叉验证下，一个周期后 pCR 预测 AUC 为 0.90。
Conclusion: 基于 DW-MRI 肿瘤中心 patch 的深度学习是微创、可临床部署的早期 pCR 预测策略，支持在单个治疗周期后提前升级或降级 NACT。

papers.title: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy response prediction using pretreatment diffusion and contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging with clinical variables
papers.abstract_en: Prediction of pathological complete response before neoadjuvant chemotherapy may facilitate more tailored therapeutic planning for breast cancer patients. This work proposes a deep-learning model for pretreatment data only, combining apparent diffusion coefficient maps, dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging, and clinical variables. The study uses the public ACRIN 6698/I-SPY2 multicenter dataset. The architecture employs EfficientNet-B0 pretrained encoders for image feature extraction and late fusion with clinical information. Multiple clinical variables were evaluated, including age, race, histological type, HR/HER2 subtype, SBR grade, and maximum diameter. Only HR/HER2 subtype improved the average area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and was retained in the final model. Using stratified five-fold cross-validation, standalone apparent diffusion coefficient maps achieved a mean AUC of 0.79, whereas dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging achieved 0.74. Adding HR/HER2 subtype improved performance to 0.83 and 0.81, respectively. The final configuration, using both imaging modalities and HR/HER2 subtype, achieved an AUC of 0.86. These results support pretreatment multimodal learning for response prediction, although external validation is required before clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出仅用治疗前数据预测乳腺癌新辅助化疗病理完全缓解 (pCR) 的深度学习模型：EfficientNet-B0 预训练编码器分别提取 ADC 图与 DCE-MRI 特征，再与临床变量晚期融合 (late fusion)。在 ACRIN 6698/I-SPY2 数据集五折分层交叉验证中，ADC 单模态 AUC 0.79、DCE-MRI 0.74，加入 HR/HER2 亚型后分别升至 0.83 与 0.81，双影像模态加 HR/HER2 最终达 0.86。
Motivation: 在新辅助化疗前预测病理完全缓解可支持乳腺癌患者的个体化治疗规划，但需要只依赖治疗前影像与临床变量的模型。
Method: 用 EfficientNet-B0 预训练编码器提取 ADC 图与 DCE-MRI 图像特征，与临床信息做晚期融合；评估年龄、种族、组织学类型、HR/HER2 亚型、SBR 分级、最大直径等多个临床变量，仅 HR/HER2 亚型提升平均 ROC AUC 故保留；采用分层五折交叉验证，数据为公开的 ACRIN 6698/I-SPY2 多中心数据集。

papers.title: Test-time Reinforcement Learning for Anomalous Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Anomalous video understanding aims to identify abnormal events in videos and interpret their semantic meanings beyond simple anomaly detection. Recent video large language models (Video-LLMs) have demonstrated promising zero-shot capabilities for this task, yet their performance remains limited due to insufficient adaptation to diverse anomaly patterns and evolving environments. Test-time reinforcement learning offers a promising solution by enabling models to improve through self-generated feedback signals without requiring additional human annotations. However, applying it to anomalous video understanding remains challenging due to three issues: (1) generated pseudo-labels can be unreliable when consensus is weak; (2) binary reward designs fail to capture uncertainty in model generations, resulting in ineffective optimization signals; and (3) unanimous rollout groups receive identical rewards, causing group-relative advantages to collapse and eliminating effective policy-gradient signals. To address these challenges, we present a novel test-time reinforcement learning framework for anomalous video understanding by introducing dual-query consistency filtering, an entropy-aware consensus reward, and a virtual negative anchor mechanism. The framework retains reliable samples through consistency across semantically equivalent queries, combines answer agreement with generation uncertainty for reward estimation, and introduces a virtual negative anchor to create reward variation in unanimous rollout groups, thereby preserving effective group-relative optimization signals. Experiments on VAU-Bench show that our method outperforms the compared frozen and supervised baselines. The gains are most pronounced on the ECVA subset of VAU-Bench with thinking, where accuracy improves from 75.81% to 90.00% relative to the frozen backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对异常视频理解 (anomalous video understanding) 中测试时强化学习的三类失效，提出含双查询一致性过滤、熵感知共识奖励与虚拟负锚点的 test-time RL 框架，用于 Video-LLM 的免标注自我改进。在 VAU-Bench 上超过所比较的冻结与监督基线，带 thinking 的 ECVA 子集准确率相对冻结骨干从 75.81% 提升到 90.00%。
Motivation: Video-LLM 零样本做异常视频理解时对多样异常模式与演化环境适应不足；直接套用 test-time RL 会遇到伪标签不可靠、二值奖励忽略不确定性、全一致 rollout 组奖励塌缩导致策略梯度失效。
Method: 框架含三个组件：双查询一致性过滤，用语义等价查询的一致性保留可靠样本；熵感知共识奖励，把答案一致性与生成不确定性一起估计奖励；虚拟负锚点，在全一致 rollout 组中制造奖励差异以恢复 group-relative advantage。
Result: 在 VAU-Bench 上超过所比较的冻结与监督基线；带 thinking 的 ECVA 子集准确率相对冻结骨干由 75.81% 提升至 90.00%。
Conclusion: 伪标签可靠性、奖励不确定性与全一致组的信号塌缩是 test-time RL 在异常视频理解上的关键瓶颈，三者一起处理可显著抬高 Video-LLM 的异常语义理解准确率。

papers.title: CoEvo: Oracle-Grounded Self-Evolution of a Single Model for Multi-Step Causal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step causal reasoning requires chaining inferences where each step constrains the next. An early error propagates silently, and a correct answer reached via flawed logic evades outcome-level detection. In specialized domains, teacher LLMs err on intermediate steps, safety constraints restrict cloud distillation, and shifting conditions demand adaptation, leaving self-evolution as the practical route. Naive self-evolution can collapse: outcome-only rewards let the model exploit distributional shortcuts, and weak self-evaluation reinforces spurious paths into stable failure patterns. We exploit a key asymmetry: generating a correct chain is hard, but verifying a single step is easy. Many high-stakes domains admit a deterministic, queryable oracle, a physics simulator or rule engine over codified constraints. It checks asserted steps without teacher-level ability and abstains beyond its rules; it can check what the model asserts, never replace it. This enables CoEvo, an oracle-grounded self-evolution framework where a single model alternates between Proposer and Solver. As Solver, the model generates competing chains; intra-group debate exposes disagreement steps, a proxy for the capability boundary, and the oracle adjudicates them into process-level supervision. As Proposer, the same model constructs progressively harder scenarios inside oracle constraints, steering the curriculum toward deep multi-hop chains. Both roles are updated jointly, so training pressure co-evolves with the model. On industrial, clinical, and legal multi-step causal reasoning benchmarks, CoEvo enables an 8B LLM to sustain self-evolution, surpassing distillation baselines and the strongest proprietary reference on path correctness (82.1% vs. 71.4%). The trained model generalizes to unseen categories and systems, preserving root-cause accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoEvo 用可查询的确定性 oracle（物理模拟器或规则引擎）为单模型自演化提供过程级监督：同一模型交替当 Solver（组内辩论暴露分歧步、oracle 裁决）与 Proposer（在 oracle 约束内构造渐难场景），两角色联合更新。在工业、临床、法律多步因果推理基准上，8B 模型路径正确率 82.1%，超过蒸馏基线与最强闭源参考模型的 71.4%。
Motivation: 多步因果推理中早期错误会静默传播，仅看结果的奖励让模型钻分布捷径、弱自评把伪路径固化成稳定失败；专用领域里教师 LLM 中间步也会错，云端蒸馏又受安全约束。
Method: CoEvo 框架让单个 8B LLM 交替扮演 Solver 与 Proposer：Solver 生成竞争推理链，组内辩论定位分歧步（能力边界代理），oracle 对被断言的步做裁决并产出过程级监督，超出规则时弃权；Proposer 在 oracle 约束内构造逐步变难的场景引导课程，两角色联合更新。
Result: 在工业、临床、法律多步因果推理基准上，CoEvo 使 8B 模型维持自演化，路径正确率 82.1% 对最强专有参考模型 71.4%，并超过蒸馏基线；训练后模型泛化到未见类别与系统，保持根因准确率。
Conclusion: 利用「生成整条链难、验证单步易」的不对称，确定性 oracle 可以替代教师模型提供过程监督，让单模型在受限领域持续自演化并保持跨域泛化。

papers.title: AIGC Video Detection based on the fusion of spatial-frequency-optical flow multimodal features
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of generative AI (e.g., Sora, Hunyuan) makes it essential to develop effective detection strategies that can generalize across ever-evolving synthesis techniques. This study is motivated by the observation of a fundamental challenge in generative models: the inherent difficulty of maintaining cross-modal consistency between appearance and motion. To this end, we propose a multi-modal framework for AIGC video forgery detection tasks, named Cross-Attention based Video Forgery Detector (CrossAtt-VFD), based on joint multi-view analysis of content.Methodologically, we introduce a dual-branch architecture that simultaneously extracts spatial-frequency and optical-flow features.This approach enables the modeling of videos from complementary perceptual perspectives.The core of this process is a dedicated cross-attention mechanism, which governs the alignment of the two modalities and translates cross-modal inconsistencies into a potent diagnostic signal. This multi-modal strategy facilitates the detection of motion that is statistically inconsistent with the visual appearance of a scene. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrated that our model achieves an accuracy of 94.22%, a precision of 91.67 %,and a recall of 96.25 %, effectively verifying the advantages of the multi-modal fusion strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CrossAtt-VFD：双分支同时提取空间频率特征与光流特征，用 cross-attention 对齐两模态，把生成视频中外观与运动的跨模态不一致转成检测信号。在 AIGC 视频伪造检测上准确率 94.22%、精确率 91.67%、召回率 96.25%。
Motivation: 生成模型（Sora、Hunyuan）合成技术快速演化，单一线索的检测策略难以跨技术泛化；生成模型本身难以维持外观与运动的跨模态一致性，这一不一致可作为稳定诊断信号。
Method: CrossAtt-VFD 采用双分支架构，一路提取空间频率特征，一路提取光流特征，再由专门的 cross-attention 机制对齐两模态，检测与视觉外观统计上不一致的运动。
Result: 在 AIGC 视频伪造检测任务上准确率 94.22%、精确率 91.67%、召回率 96.25%。
Conclusion: 外观与运动的跨模态不一致可作为伪造诊断信号，空间频率与光流的多模态融合策略对 AIGC 视频检测有效。

papers.title: The Cost of Conservation: Coordination-Memory Laws for Exact-Support Generation
papers.abstract_en: Many AI systems make decisions locally, even when every realized output must obey an additive conservation law, such as selecting exactly a fixed number of items. This constraint can be statistically invisible: small subsets of a balanced fixed-budget output look increasingly independent, yet communication-free coordinate-parallel generation needs exponentially many pre-shared plans, while a sequential exact sampler needs only logarithmic memory. We study product measures conditioned on additive conservation laws in the intermediate regime where one plan is selected before a fixed-order pass, every plan is a bounded-state stochastic executor whose support is entirely legal, and the mixture of plan laws approximates the target distribution in total variation. Our main result identifies the optimal asymptotic selector rate, up to constant factors, with the killed spectral profile of the conservation-difference walk. The resulting coordination cost decreases as an inverse power of live-state width, with an exponent determined by intrinsic conservation rank rather than alphabet size; the law extends to noncentral budgets and heterogeneous local scores. The converse is driven by a state-versus-resource-sum obstruction, while a rate-matching construction compiles discrepancy control into exact-support finite-state plans. Complementary results characterize block-parallel plan complexity and the benefit of programmable output order. Together, these results show precisely how online memory substitutes for front-loaded coordination in exact-support generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在满足加性守恒律（如恰好选固定数量条目）的精确支撑生成中，通信自由的坐标并行方案需要指数级预共享计划，而顺序精确采样只需对数级内存。论文证明最优渐近选择器速率（差常数因子）等于守恒差游走的 killed spectral profile，协调成本随存活状态宽度按逆幂下降，指数由内在守恒秩而非字母表大小决定。
Motivation: 分布式 AI 系统在局部决策时仍须满足加性守恒约束，该约束在统计上不可见：平衡固定预算输出的小子集近似独立，导致并行生成的预共享计划开销爆炸，而现有分析缺少该开销的紧确刻画。
Method: 研究中间机制下的条件乘积测度：先选定一个计划再做固定顺序扫描，每个计划是有界状态随机执行器且支撑完全合法，计划分布的混合在总变差意义下逼近目标分布；用守恒差游走的 killed spectral profile 刻画速率，并通过 state-versus-resource-sum 障碍给出 converse、以速率匹配构造编译出精确支撑有限状态计划。
Result: 主结果给出最优渐近选择器速率（差常数因子）等于 killed spectral profile；协调成本按存活状态宽度的逆幂下降，指数由内在守恒秩决定；结论可推广到非中心预算与异质局部得分；另给出块并行计划复杂度与可编程输出顺序收益的刻画；并对比通信自由并行需指数级计划、顺序采样只需对数内存。
Conclusion: 在精确支撑生成中，在线内存可以替代前期协调：守恒秩而非字母表大小决定并行协调成本的幂律指数，顺序化是更省内存的实现路径。

papers.title: Certified Mechanistic Interpretability: Lifting Single-Input Findings to Bounded Neighbourhoods
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability reverse-engineers transformer circuits one input at a time, leaving observed mechanisms without guarantees over bounded input neighbourhoods. We address this gap with a framework based on constrained polynomial-zonotope (CPZ) propagation that lifts mechanistic-interpretability observations from a single input to certified statements over a bounded set of perturbations. Three internal-attention queries (top-$k$ stability, evidence mass, and attention entropy) are formulated as tractable programs over the simplex of attention weights, and CPZ propagation through transformer blocks is shown to preserve the softmax simplex and the LayerNorm zero-mean identity exactly. A recursive Jacobian zonotope construction extends the same certificates across layer depth by linearising the block stack at the input and avoids per-layer generator growth. We instantiate the framework on transformer attention; the resulting certificates offer a way to sharpen mechanistic statements that single-input inspection cannot resolve on its own, and to inform downstream decisions in regimes where empirical heuristics may be misleading.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: TSS: Target-Side Sparsification for Speculative Decoding in Domain-Specific Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference through collaboration between a lightweight draft model and a target verifier. Existing methods mainly improve the draft side, while the target model is typically kept dense and unchanged. We show that, under domain-specific inference, full-depth target verification is not always the optimal choice. Counter-intuitively, skipping selected target layers can reduce verification cost while simultaneously increasing draft acceptance and preserving, or even improving, downstream task performance. Based on this observation, we propose TSS, a target-side sparsification framework for speculative decoding. TSS employs an acceptance- and metric-aware breadth search to explore multi-layer skip configurations without imposing a fixed priority between the two objectives. The selected configurations are stored in a domain-to-configuration mapping and applied by a lightweight skip controller, allowing one complete target model to support multiple sparse verification paths without retraining or permanent parameter pruning. Experiments on Spec-Bench across multiple domains, model scales, and speculative decoding methods show consistent improvements in draft acceptance and downstream task performance. In Translation setting, TSS increases the average accept length from 2.70 to 4.53 (+67.8%), improves BLEU from 0.131 to 0.237 (+80.9%), and raises end-to-end throughput from 75.6 to 127.3 tokens/s, corresponding to a 1.68X speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TSS 在投机解码 (speculative decoding) 中改稀疏化目标端而非草稿端：用接受度与指标双目标的广度搜索挑出可跳过的 target 层，按领域存成配置映射，由轻量 skip controller 在推理时切换，无需重训或永久剪枝。在 Spec-Bench 的 Translation 设定下，平均接受长度从 2.70 升到 4.53（+67.8%），BLEU 从 0.131 升到 0.237（+80.9%），端到端吞吐从 75.6 升到 127.3 tokens/s（1.68X 加速）。
Motivation: 投机解码的既有改进都压在草稿端，目标模型保持全稠密全深度，领域内推理时全层验证既贵又未必最优。
Method: TSS 用 acceptance- and metric-aware breadth search 在多层跳过配置空间中同时权衡接受度与下游指标、不预设两者优先级；选中配置存入 domain-to-configuration 映射，由轻量 skip controller 为同一个完整目标模型切换多条稀疏验证路径，不重训也不做永久参数剪枝。
Result: 在 Spec-Bench 上跨多个领域、模型规模与投机解码方法，草稿接受度与下游任务表现一致提升；Translation 设定下平均接受长度 2.70 → 4.53（+67.8%），BLEU 0.131 → 0.237（+80.9%），端到端吞吐 75.6 → 127.3 tokens/s，加速 1.68X。
Conclusion: 领域特定推理下跳过部分 target 层能同时降低验证成本、提高草稿接受率并保住甚至提升任务表现，一个目标模型可按领域复用多条稀疏验证路径。

papers.title: SPEANet: Structural Prior Enhanced Attention Network for Parameter-Efficient Remote Sensing Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing object detection (RSOD) requires compact backbones capable of preserving weak geometric cues under extreme scale variation and background clutter. Fixed structural operators provide complementary contour and frequency responses without introducing learnable operator coefficients. However, directly injecting these responses can amplify content-irrelevant textures, while applying a uniform operator design across the hierarchy may be poorly matched to stage-specific representation requirements. We propose the Structural Prior Enhanced Attention Network (SPEANet), a parameter-efficient RSOD backbone that integrates fixed operators through stage-specific prior extraction and context-conditioned response modulation. SPEANet assigns smoothed contour and multi-order directional modeling to shallow, high-resolution features, while employing a compact approximation-detail interaction mechanism in deeper stages. Learned spatial gates regulate the resulting prior responses before residual fusion. Experiments on five benchmarks, together with evaluations across seven detection frameworks on DOTA-v1.0, achieve a favorable accuracy-parameter trade-off. With Oriented R-CNN, SPEANet achieves 78.55\% mAP on DOTA-v1.0, 72.24\% mAP on DOTA-v1.5, and 67.30\% mAP on DIOR-R using 23.0M total parameters, including a 5.97M-parameter backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPEANet 把固定结构算子（平滑轮廓、多阶方向建模、近似-细节交互）按层级分阶段注入遥感检测骨干，再用可学习空间门控调制后残差融合，在参数量受控下保住弱几何线索。在 Oriented R-CNN 上于 DOTA-v1.0 达到 78.55% mAP、DOTA-v1.5 72.24%、DIOR-R 67.30%，总参数 23.0M（骨干 5.97M），在五个基准与 DOTA-v1.0 上七种检测框架下取得精度-参数的折中。
Motivation: 遥感目标检测需要在极端尺度变化与杂乱背景下保住弱几何线索的紧凑骨干；直接注入固定算子响应会放大与内容无关的纹理，全层级统一算子设计又与各阶段表征需求不匹配。
Method: SPEANet 按阶段做先验提取与上下文条件响应调制：浅层高分辨率特征用平滑轮廓与多阶方向建模，深层用紧凑的近似-细节交互机制；可学习空间门控先调制先验响应再残差融合，固定算子不含可学习系数。
Result: 在五个基准、DOTA-v1.0 上跨七种检测框架评测：配 Oriented R-CNN 时 DOTA-v1.0 mAP 78.55%、DOTA-v1.5 mAP 72.24%、DIOR-R mAP 67.30%，总参数 23.0M，其中骨干 5.97M，取得有利的精度-参数折中。
Conclusion: 按阶段差异化地注入并门控固定结构先验，是参数高效遥感检测骨干可行的设计路径，可在 5.97M 骨干参数量级上支撑多种检测框架。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: On the Effect of Bit-Level Parameter Perturbations in Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models
papers.abstract_en: In this chapter, we investigate how classical machine learning models respond to small, targeted modifications in their parameters. We compare and contrast these results to analogous experiments on deep learning models. For classical learning models, we consider Hidden Markov Models (HMM) and Support Vector Machines (SVM), and for comparison, we conduct analogous experiments involving Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. When applied to the Drebin Android malware dataset, our results show that classical models are brittle, in the sense that a limited set of selected parameters can have a dramatic effect on model behavior. In a related set of experiments, we investigate the steganographic capacity of these same learning models, that is, the proportion of bits in model parameters that can be overwritten without having a significant adverse affect on a model. We find that classical models offer limited steganographic capacity due to their compact, parameter-efficient, and relatively sensitive parameter structure. In contrast, neural networks are parameter-redundant, enabling higher steganographic capacity, where modifications can be distributed across many parameters with minimal impact on performance. These results highlight differences in how classical and neural models respond to parameter changes, with clear implications for both robustness and hidden information embedding. Overall, this work provides a framework for understanding parameter sensitivity and steganographic capacity across different classes of learning models.
papers.comment: To appear as a chapter in the book "Artificial Intelligence for Cyber Defense in Emerging Threats", to be published by Springer by early 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 HMM、SVM、MLP、LSTM 在 Drebin Android 恶意软件数据集上施加定向的比特级参数扰动，发现经典模型脆弱：少量被选参数即可剧烈改变模型行为，且隐写容量有限；神经网络参数冗余，比特可分散写入众多参数而性能几乎不受损，隐写容量更高。
Motivation: 参数级定向篡改与隐写嵌入对不同模型类别的影响缺乏对照研究，尤其经典模型与神经网络在参数敏感性与冗余度上的差异不明，这对模型鲁棒性与隐藏信息嵌入都直接相关。
Method: 对经典模型（HMM、SVM）与深度模型（MLP、LSTM）分别施加小规模定向比特级参数修改做对照实验，并测量模型参数中可被覆写而不显著损害性能的比特比例，即隐写容量 (steganographic capacity)；实验在 Drebin Android 恶意软件数据集上进行。
Result: 在 Drebin Android 恶意软件数据集上，经典模型表现出脆弱性：有限的选定参数即可对模型行为产生剧烈影响；其隐写容量受限，源于紧凑、参数高效且相对敏感的参数结构。神经网络参数冗余，修改可分散到大量参数中而对性能影响极小，隐写容量更高。
Conclusion: 经典模型与神经模型在参数扰动下的响应存在系统性差异：前者鲁棒性差、隐写容量低，后者靠参数冗余换取更高鲁棒性与隐写容量；该框架可用于跨模型类别的参数敏感性与隐写容量分析。

papers.title: FISSION: Label Augmentation for Bot Detection
papers.abstract_en: Bot accounts and coordinated influence operations are often discovered via heuristic methods, leaving a dearth of reliable ground-truth labels for training detection systems. To address this challenge, we study a natural question: can we generate labels to assist in learning embeddings in which bots and accounts from the same coordinated operation are close? We present FISSION, a method to generate labels by splitting each account's activity into positively labeled sub-accounts. Given this label source, we train detection models which preserve behavioral regularities recurring across positive sub-accounts. We evaluate FISSION and show it outperforms prior methods in detecting Wikipedia sockpuppets and Twitter/X bots.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FISSION 通过把每个账号的活动切分成带正标签的子账号来合成训练标签，使同一协同操作下的账号在嵌入空间中靠近。在 Wikipedia sockpuppet 与 Twitter/X bot 检测上，该方法优于既有方法。
Motivation: 机器人账号与协同影响行动多靠启发式手段发现，导致训练检测系统所需的可靠 ground-truth 标签严重匮乏。
Method: FISSION 将单个账号的活动切分为带正标签的子账号，以此生成标签源；再训练检测模型，使在正子账号间重复出现的行为规律得以保留，从而学习 bot 与同协同操作账号彼此接近的嵌入。
Result: 在 Wikipedia sockpuppet 检测与 Twitter/X bot 检测两个任务上，FISSION 的表现优于既有方法（prior methods）。
Conclusion: 通过切分账号活动自造正标签，可以在缺少人工真值的情况下学到能聚拢协同操作账号的检测嵌入。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JAMPR+/L2D: scalable neural heuristic for constrained vehicle routing problems in dynamic environment
papers.abstract_en: The vehicle routing problems with real-world constraints (we consider vehicles capacity limits, time windows constrains, pickup-and-delivery multi-depo --- CPDPTW) pose significant computational challenges. While classical exact and heuristic methods remain effective to solve problems of small/medium size ($N\lesssim100$), they often lack adaptability and scalability for larger logistics tasks. In this work, we show how JAMPR+/L2D RL deep learning model, proposed in to solve large CPDPTW problems can be adopted in the case of substantial changes of graph distance matrix. We test performance of JAMPR+/L2D model for medium-sized CVRP and VRPTW problems on CVRPLIB benchmarks: JAMPR+/L2D outperforms the state-of-the-art heuristic HGS in over 85\% of instances, achieving improvement in objective gap. We show that the JAMPR+/L2D model trained on CPDPTW problem, generalizes well for tasks with simpler constraints (CVRP, VRPTW), for different problem sizes and for moderate changes in distance matrixes. For more substantial changes in distance matrixes, we propose here to make fast finetuning of JAMPR+: on ORTEC data (for CPDPTW) the proposed strategy remarkably reduces the objective gap without full model retraining, what will give both accuracy and rapid inference of the model in the practical routing scenarios with distance matrix changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JAMPR+/L2D 这一 RL 车辆路径启发式模型在图距离矩阵发生中等变化时可直接泛化，无需重训；变化更大时对 JAMPR+ 做快速 finetuning 即可显著缩小目标 gap，兼顾精度与推理速度。在 CVRPLIB 中等规模 CVRP/VRPTW 上，它在 85% 以上实例中胜过 SOTA 启发式 HGS。
Motivation: 带容量、时间窗、取送货多车场 (CPDPTW) 的现实约束路径问题规模一大，精确法与经典启发式（N≲100 尚有效）就失去可扩展性与对距离矩阵变化的适应性。
Method: 用已在 CPDPTW 上训练的 JAMPR+/L2D 深度强化学习模型，直接迁移到约束更简单的 CVRP、VRPTW 及不同规模、距离矩阵中等变化的任务；对距离矩阵大幅变化的情形，提出对 JAMPR+ 做快速 finetuning 而非全量重训。
Result: 在 CVRPLIB 中等规模 CVRP 与 VRPTW 基准上，JAMPR+/L2D 在 85% 以上实例中胜过 SOTA 启发式 HGS，目标 gap 有改善；在 ORTEC 的 CPDPTW 数据上，快速 finetuning 策略在不做全量重训的情况下显著降低目标 gap。
Conclusion: 在 CPDPTW 上训练的 RL 路由启发式可泛化到更简单约束与多种规模，距离矩阵中等变化无需重训，大幅变化时快速 finetuning 即可兼顾精度与推理速度，适用于距离矩阵频繁变动的实际配送场景。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Sample-Smooth Spaces: A Convenient Category for Differentiable Probabilistic Programming
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the category $\mathbf{SSS}$ of sample-smooth spaces over a mixed site. The test objects are the products $Ω_n := \mathbb{R}^n \times Ω$ of a Cartesian space with the universal Hilbert cube $Ω$ carrying all universally measurable sets, and a space is a set with a family of admissible plots $Ω_n \to \mathcal{X}$ closed under precomposition. Smoothness and measurability are then not two structures glued along an axiom, but one structure over one site. The site has finite non-empty products, because $Ω$ absorbs its own square; its Karoubi envelope contains every $\mathbb{R}^n$; and it has mixed morphisms $ω\mapsto (W(ω),Φ(ω))$, which turn measurability of a smooth family from an axiom into a consequence. $\mathbf{SSS}$ is a concrete quasitopos: complete, cocomplete, cartesian closed and locally cartesian closed, with a classifier for embeddings. Morphisms of Cartesian spaces are exactly the $C^\infty$ maps and manifolds embed full and faithfully, both without Boman's theorem. Every object has tangent and cotangent spaces, every morphism a differential. The modalities sit in an adjoint string $Π\dashv \flat \dashv \natural \dashv \sharp \dashv Λ$, making $\mathbf{SSS}$ cohesive over quasi-universal spaces. The point is the probability monad. Defining the plots of $\mathsf{P}(\mathcal{X})$ as push-forwards of $\mathcal{X}$-plots at every test object, $\mathsf{P}$ is an unconditional strong commutative affine monad on all of $\mathbf{SSS}$ -- functor, unit, product of kernels, multiplication and the monad laws are each one line of seed splitting -- and its Kleisli category, of differentiable simulators, is a Markov category. The reparametrisation trick holds by construction: every Kleisli morphism is plot-wise a sampler, stably under composition. A reflection theorem locates the whole gain in a single plot family.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 sample-smooth spaces 范畴 SSS：以混合 site 上的测试对象 Ω_n = R^n × Ω（Ω 为承载全体 universally measurable 集的 Hilbert cube）统一光滑性与可测性，使光滑族的可测性成为公理的推论。概率单子 P 在整个 SSS 上是无条件 strong commutative affine monad，其 Kleisli 范畴即微分模拟器构成的 Markov 范畴，reparametrisation trick 按构造成立。
Motivation: 光滑结构与可测结构通常沿某条公理拼接，导致概率程序中重参数化技巧与随机核的组合律需要额外验证；作者要在同一 site 上把两者合成一个结构。
Method: 定义测试对象为 R^n × Ω 的乘积、可容许 plot 族对预合成封闭；证明 SSS 是 concrete quasitopos（完备、余完备、cartesian closed、局部 cartesian closed，含嵌入分类器），流形全忠实嵌入且无需 Boman 定理；模态构成伴随串 Π ⊣ flat ⊣ natural ⊣ sharp ⊣ Lambda；概率单子 P 的 plot 定义为各测试对象上 plot 的 push-forward，单子各定律由 seed splitting 一行给出。
Result: SSS 具备切空间与余切空间、每个态射有微分；Cartesian 空间间的态射恰为 C^∞ 映射；P 是 SSS 上的 unconditional strong commutative affine monad，Kleisli 范畴为 Markov 范畴，每个 Kleisli 态射逐 plot 是 sampler 且在复合下稳定；另有 reflection theorem 把全部增益定位到单个 plot 族。
Conclusion: 把光滑与可测统一到一个混合 site 上，可让概率单子的函子性、核乘积与单子定律以及重参数化技巧成为构造的直接后果，而非额外公理。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Decoupling Is Not Identification: Supervised Evidential Learning in Next-Token Prediction
papers.abstract_en: A next-token probability says what a model predicts, not how much training support lies behind it. A Dirichlet head can represent this distinction by separating mean $m$ from concentration $S$, but decoupling does not identify what $S$ means. Here we propose an Evidential Next-Token Prediction (ENTOP) framework to audit this gap on character-level Moby-Dick, using exact 8-gram count as a reproducible lexical-support label and withholding count regression from 20% of context types. Standard implicit evidential training carries essentially no count signal beyond confidence on held-out-label types (partial Spearman $ρ= 0.001 \pm 0.014$), whereas explicit supervision generalizes ($ρ= 0.201 \pm 0.010$; matched-pair win $= 0.822 \pm 0.021$). CE predictive entropy is at chance for unseen 8-grams (AUROC $= 0.490 \pm 0.004$), while supervised vacuity reaches $0.772 \pm 0.003$, comparable with an indexed CE-representation baseline ($0.769$) but below the tautological corpus oracle ($1.000$). Neither longest-suffix nor representation-distance strata explain where amortization succeeds. Increasing count weight under the digamma objective improves support fit only by sacrificing prediction. A constant predictor wins natural log-RMSE, and vacuity does not improve error deferral. These results motivate a minimum evidence protocol---confidence control, matched pairs, held-out labels, a constant baseline, and a decision test---and show that concentration can pass identification while failing calibration and utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ENTOP 框架在字符级 Moby-Dick 上审计 Dirichlet 浓度 S 的可识别性：以精确 8-gram 计数作可复现的词法支持标签、对 20% 上下文类型扣留计数回归，发现标准隐式 evidential 训练在扣留标签类型上几乎不携带计数信号（partial Spearman ρ=0.001±0.014），而显式监督可泛化（ρ=0.201±0.010，matched-pair win=0.822±0.021）。CE 预测熵对未见 8-gram 处于随机水平（AUROC=0.490±0.004），监督 vacuity 达 0.772±0.003，接近索引 CE 表示基线 0.769 但低于语料 oracle 1.000；浓度可通过识别却在校准与效用上失败。
Motivation: next-token 概率只说明模型预测什么，不说明其背后有多少训练支持；Dirichlet 头把均值 m 与浓度 S 解耦，但解耦并不识别 S 的含义，需要可复现的审计框架来检验 S 是否真对应词法支持。
Method: 提出 Evidential Next-Token Prediction (ENTOP) 框架，在字符级 Moby-Dick 上用精确 8-gram 计数作为可复现的词法支持标签，并对 20% 的上下文类型扣留计数回归；对比标准隐式 evidential 训练与显式监督，用 partial Spearman ρ、matched-pair win、AUROC、vacuity、log-RMSE 等指标，并设置索引 CE 表示基线、语料 oracle 与常数预测器。
Result: 隐式 evidential 训练在扣留标签类型上计数信号 ρ=0.001±0.014，显式监督 ρ=0.201±0.010、matched-pair win=0.822±0.021；CE 预测熵对未见 8-gram AUROC=0.490±0.004，监督 vacuity=0.772±0.003，索引 CE 表示基线 0.769，语料 oracle 1.000。longest-suffix 与 representation-distance 分层都无法解释 amortization 何时成功；digamma 目标下提高计数权重只以牺牲预测为代价改善支持拟合；自然 log-RMSE 上常数预测器获胜，vacuity 不改善误差让位 (error deferral)。
Conclusion: 浓度 S 可以通过识别检验却在校准与效用上失败，因此需要最小证据协议：置信度控制、matched pairs、扣留标签、常数基线与决策检验。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Multi-Timestep LSTM Ensemble regressor for Enhanced Short-Term Runoff Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurately forecasting river runoff is key to managing water resources, controlling floods, and planning agriculture. This study examines the Ajichay River in northwest Iran, a major tributary of Lake Urmia that has experienced increasing water-related stress in recent years. We introduce a daily runoff prediction model based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The model combines five LSTM units, each trained on different time intervals ranging from 2 to 6 days, to better capture variations in river flow patterns. To improve performance, each model was fine-tuned using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), a population-based optimization algorithm. The proposed approach was evaluated on unseen data from 2017-2018 using $R^2$, RMSE, and MSE as performance metrics. The results showed strong predictive accuracy, with $R^2$ values ranging from 74.95% to 91.42%. In addition, multiple feature-importance methods were applied to identify the most influential variables, providing further insight into the factors that drive runoff variations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对伊朗西北 Ajichay 河（乌尔米湖支流）的逐日径流预报，把 5 个时间跨度为 2–6 天的 LSTM 单元组成多时间步集成，并用粒子群优化 (PSO) 微调各模型。在 2017–2018 年未见数据上 R² 达 74.95%–91.42%，特征重要性方法进一步识别出驱动径流变化的关键变量。
Motivation: Ajichay 河近年水资源压力上升，准确的逐日径流预报对防洪、供水与农业规划至关重要，而单一时间尺度的模型难以覆盖不同流态的变化。
Method: 构建基于 LSTM 的逐日径流预测模型：5 个 LSTM 单元分别在 2 至 6 天的不同时间间隔上训练以捕捉不同尺度的流量模式，再用群体智能算法 PSO 对每个模型做超参微调；用多种特征重要性方法识别影响径流的关键变量。
Result: 在 2017–2018 年未见数据上以 R²、RMSE、MSE 评估，R² 取值范围为 74.95% 到 91.42%。
Conclusion: 多时间步 LSTM 集成配合 PSO 微调能在 Ajichay 河上取得较强的逐日径流预测精度，特征重要性分析可解释径流变化的驱动因素。
Relevance: 38
