papers.title: Partially Observed Sparse Graphs: The Unknown Sampling Rate is a Tail Index
papers.abstract_en: A large graph is often available only in part: a crawl stopped by its budget, a panel, a partial dump. When the sampled fraction $s$ is known by design the total edge count follows from $\hat e=e_s/s^2$ and no model is needed. We treat the case where $s$ is unknown and the population size is known. Our main result is a reduction: under a sparse exchangeable (graphex) model the expected non-isolated fraction obeys $n_s/n_1\to s^{1+σ}$, so the sampling rate becomes estimable once the tail index $σ$ is, and substituting it back gives $e_s(n_1/n_s)^{2/(1+σ)}$ -- the same estimator, with the design quantity inferred. Estimating global edge cardinality in a sparse graph is therefore, in expectation, tail-index estimation, and the quadratic graphon estimator is the case $σ=0$: it fails by an identity rather than by a fit ($260\%$ median error against $27\%$). We bound the finite-size error of the substitution and show the reduction is \emph{modular} in the tail-index estimator --- filled with a published closed-form one it reaches $21.7\%$ over $13$ networks and $39$ sampling budgets with no fitting at all. Fitting a full graphex additionally returns the degree distribution at any size and a generative object, in a representation where sparsity is a coordinate and the interpolation path is dictated rather than chosen. Two limits are exact: rank-one graphexes have transitivity fixed by the degree profile, so high-clustering graphs lie outside the class; and under snowball or random-walk crawls every method here fails, the design-based oracle worst of all ($7.8\%$ to $588\%$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在稀疏可交换 (graphex) 模型下，把未知采样率 s 化归为尾指数 σ 估计：非孤立节点比例满足 n_s/n_1 → s^{1+σ}，代回即得边数估计 e_s(n_1/n_s)^{2/(1+σ)}。代入已发表的闭式尾指数估计后在 13 个网络、39 个采样预算上中位误差 21.7%，而二次 graphon 估计量（σ=0 情形）中位误差 260%；snowball 或 random-walk 爬取下所有方法连同设计型 oracle 一起失效（7.8% 到 588%）。
Motivation: 大图常只被部分观测（爬取预算截断、面板、局部 dump），已知采样率时用 ē=e_s/s² 即可估计总边数；s 未知而总体规模已知时，二次 graphon 估计量按恒等式而非拟合失败，需要新的估计路径。
Method: 在稀疏 graphex 模型下推导非孤立比例的极限 n_s/n_1 → s^{1+σ}，把全局边数估计化归为尾指数 σ 估计，得到替换式估计量 e_s(n_1/n_s)^{2/(1+σ)}；给出替换的有限尺寸误差界，并把该化归做成对尾指数估计量模块化的框架，代入一个已发表的闭式估计量且不做任何拟合；进一步拟合完整 graphex 以返回任意规模的度分布与生成对象。
Result: 二次 graphon 估计量（σ=0）中位误差 260%，对照 27%；模块化替换在 13 个网络、39 个采样预算上达到 21.7% 且完全无拟合；在 snowball 或 random-walk 爬取下所有方法失效，设计型 oracle 最差，误差 7.8% 到 588%。两个精确极限：rank-one graphex 的传递性由度分布固定，高聚类图不在该类之外；爬取非均匀时设计型 oracle 反而最差。

papers.title: Coding Agents are Strong Prompt Optimizers
papers.abstract_en: Search-based prompt optimizers improve prompts through iterative search: they propose edits, execute fresh rollouts, score the resulting trajectories, and retain only edits that improve a validation metric. We show that this optimization loop is unnecessary. Given only a static corpus of agent trajectories, an off-the-shelf coding agent can directly synthesize an optimized prompt, requiring neither environment access nor validation data. We call this approach \textit{Coding-Agent Skill Distillation} (CASD). The key insight is reflection scope. Rather than reasoning over a small batch of trajectories at each optimization step, the coding agent writes and executes analysis code to compute corpus-wide statistics, identifies systematic failure modes, inspects representative episodes, and distills the resulting insights into behavioral rules. Across four agentic benchmarks (ALFWorld, $τ^2$-bench retail and telecom, and SpreadsheetBench-Verified), under matched data access, a single CASD pass outperforms GEPA, a state-of-the-art reflective prompt optimizer, on three of four benchmarks and outperforms validation-gated reflective search (SkillOpt) on all four, improving the unoptimized baseline by 16.6 percentage points on average versus 10.9 for GEPA and 5.3 for SkillOpt. Because CASD performs a single offline analysis pass rather than iterative search, producing an optimized prompt costs approximately \$1.60---over $22\times$ cheaper than validation-gated search. Even when competing methods are granted additional validation data and unrestricted environment access, CASD remains ahead on two of four benchmarks. These results suggest that corpus-scale statistical reflection is a viable alternative to iterative search for prompt optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CASD (Coding-Agent Skill Distillation) 让现成 coding agent 只读一份静态 agent 轨迹语料，通过写并执行分析代码做全语料统计、定位系统性失败模式，一次性直接合成优化 prompt，无需环境访问与验证数据。在四个 agentic benchmark 上，单次 CASD 相对未优化基线平均提升 16.6 个百分点（GEPA 10.9、SkillOpt 5.3），成本约 $1.60，比验证门控搜索便宜 22 倍以上。
Motivation: 搜索式 prompt 优化器每步都要提出编辑、重新 rollout、打分并只保留验证指标改善的编辑，需要环境访问与验证数据，迭代成本高。
Method: CASD：给 coding agent 静态轨迹语料，由其编写并执行分析代码计算全语料统计、识别系统性失败模式、检视代表性 episode，再把结论蒸馏成行为规则写进 prompt；单次离线分析，不做迭代搜索。对比 GEPA 与 SkillOpt，数据访问对齐。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、τ²-bench retail 与 telecom、SpreadsheetBench-Verified 四个 benchmark 上，CASD 在 3/4 上超过 GEPA、在 4/4 上超过 SkillOpt；相对未优化基线平均提升 16.6 个百分点（GEPA 10.9、SkillOpt 5.3）。单次优化成本约 $1.60，比验证门控搜索便宜 22 倍以上；即使给竞争方法额外验证数据与无限制环境访问，CASD 仍在 2/4 上领先。
Conclusion: 全语料统计式反思 (corpus-scale statistical reflection) 可以替代迭代搜索做 prompt 优化，且离线单遍的成本远低于验证门控搜索。

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Decoupled Prompt Tuning for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning (CL) aims to incrementally acquire knowledge from sequential data while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. Recently, prompt tuning has attracted increasing attention as an efficient approach for adapting pre-trained models to CL tasks. However, existing prompt design paradigms commonly suffer from retrieval dependence and classifier bias, which make model adaptation sensitive to prompt selection and bias predictions toward newly arrived classes. To address these challenges, we propose Decoupled Prompt Tuning for Continual Learning (DPT4CL), which decouples the CLIP textual prompt into a task-shared prompt distribution and class-specific prompts. The task-shared prompt distribution is derived by optimizing an Information Bottleneck objective to facilitate cross-task knowledge transfer and alleviate classifier bias, while class-specific prompts enhance inter-class separability without relying on explicit prompt retrieval. Furthermore, we establish a unified excess risk bound from an information-theoretic perspective, providing theoretical support for the robust generalization and forgetting mitigation of the proposed framework. Extensive experiments on standard CL benchmarks demonstrate that DPT4CL achieves state-of-the-art performance. The source code is available at https://github.com/Cloudfly-Z/DPT4CL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DPT4CL：把 CLIP 文本提示解耦为任务共享提示分布与类特定提示，共享部分用 Information Bottleneck 目标优化以促进跨任务迁移并缓解分类器偏置，类特定提示在不依赖显式提示检索的情况下增强类间可分性。在标准持续学习基准上达到 state-of-the-art，并给出统一的 excess risk bound 作为泛化与遗忘缓解的理论支撑。
Motivation: 现有持续学习提示设计范式依赖提示检索且存在分类器偏置，使模型适配对提示选择敏感，并把预测偏向新到类别。
Method: 将 CLIP 文本提示解耦为任务共享提示分布与类特定提示：共享分布通过优化 Information Bottleneck 目标获得以促进跨任务知识迁移、缓解分类器偏置；类特定提示提升类间可分性且不依赖显式提示检索；并从信息论角度建立统一 excess risk bound。
Result: 在标准持续学习基准上取得 state-of-the-art 表现；理论上给出统一 excess risk bound，为框架的鲁棒泛化与遗忘缓解提供支撑。
Conclusion: 把提示拆成信息瓶颈约束的任务共享分布与免检索的类特定提示，可同时缓解分类器偏置与提示选择敏感，并以 excess risk bound 支撑持续学习下的泛化与抗遗忘。

papers.title: Can You Delete a Year of Market Data? Machine Unlearning Against Exact Retraining Oracles
papers.abstract_en: When a data license expires, deleting stored records does not remove influence encoded in a trained forecaster. Machine unlearning seeks to remove this influence without retraining. We benchmark temporal unlearning with 3,200 paired references trained on all data and oracles retrained without the requested period. The grid covers five architectures, four rolling folds, five deletable years, and three experimental deletion levels on an S&P 500 volatility panel. The 2020 COVID crisis year produces the largest memorization gap for every architecture. Removing it improves all three deployable models in every fold, with the largest improvement in the 2022 bear market, while the two non-deployable models respond inconsistently. The target for approximate unlearning is the oracle, not low predictive accuracy on the deleted period. In one Transformer cell, an oracle that never trained on 2020 still predicts it at an information coefficient of 0.51, compared with 0.55 for the reference; pushing predictions toward noise reduces test skill. Across twelve deployable architecture-method pairs, only TSMixer with the hinge method remains near the oracle in every fold, closing 74-118% of the reference-to-oracle gap without a measurable loss of test skill. Method rankings vary across architectures and rolling windows. Audit separation rises with prior memorization but can remain small after exact deletion. The window-level loss comparison reaches at most 0.69, and treating stock-level windows as independent inflates the absolute t-statistic by a median factor of 1.9. These results call for an explicit deletion scope, oracle validation for the relevant architecture and window, and power-aware auditing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 S&P 500 波动率面板上做时间型机器遗忘 (temporal machine unlearning) 基准：3,200 组配对参照与精确重训 oracle，覆盖 5 种架构、4 个滚动折、5 个可删年份。2020 年 COVID 危机年对所有架构产生最大记忆差；12 个可部署架构-方法配对中只有 TSMixer+hinge 在每个折都贴近 oracle，弥合参照- oracle 差距的 74-118% 且测试技能无可测损失。作者主张近似遗忘的目标是对齐 oracle 而非压低被删期预测精度，并要求显式删除范围、按架构与窗口做 oracle 验证、以及功效感知 (power-aware) 的审计。
Motivation: 数据许可到期后删除记录并不消除已训练预测器中编码的影响，而精确重训代价高；时间型遗忘缺少以重训 oracle 为靶的系统基准与可信的审计口径。
Method: 在 S&P 500 波动率面板上构造 3,200 组配对参照（全数据训练）与 oracle（去掉指定年份重训），网格覆盖 5 种架构、4 个滚动折、5 个可删年份、3 档实验删除级别；比较多种遗忘方法与 oracle 的差距，并用窗口级损失比较与 t 统计量检验审计分离度。
Result: 2020 COVID 年对每种架构产生最大记忆差；删除它在每个折都改善全部三个可部署模型，2022 熊市中改善最大，而两个不可部署模型响应不一致。一个 Transformer 单元中从未见过 2020 的 oracle 对 2020 的 information coefficient 仍达 0.51（参照为 0.55），把预测推向噪声会降低测试技能。12 个可部署架构-方法配对中仅 TSMixer+hinge 每折贴近 oracle，弥合 74-118% 的参照-oracle 差距且测试技能无可测损失；窗口级损失比较最高仅 0.69，把股票级窗口当独立样本会使 t 统计量绝对值中位数虚增 1.9 倍。
Conclusion: 近似遗忘的正确靶标是对齐该架构与窗口下的精确重训 oracle，而非压低被删期预测精度；方法排名随架构与滚动窗口变动，审计必须声明删除范围并按功效设计。

papers.title: A Hybrid AI Framework for Academic Advising: Integrating Ensemble-Based Grade Prediction and a Rule-Based Expert System
papers.abstract_en: The rapidly increasing student population has posed serious challenges to the traditional academic advising process. This study designs and implements a multi-purpose intelligent system to support students' academic progress, based on a two-part hybrid framework: (1) an advanced model for grade prediction and (2) a rule-based recommendation engine. Using a dataset containing 416,558 educational records from the University of Birjand, students were first divided into homogeneous clusters using the Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM). Subsequently, a Stacking Ensemble model combining Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and MLP was trained specifically for each cluster. Evaluation results demonstrated that the Stacking model outperformed base models across all clusters, achieving a final aggregated RMSE of 2.35. The second component is an expert system that provides intelligent recommendations by synergizing educational regulations with the grades predicted by the first component. This system has been implemented as a practical tool on the University of Birjand portal, offering students real-time feedback such as semester GPA prediction, probation risk warnings, and course suggestions for GPA improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向大学学业指导的混合框架：先用 GMM 把 416,558 条教育记录分层，再对每个簇训练由 Random Forest、Gradient Boosting、MLP 组成的 Stacking Ensemble 预测成绩，最后由规则引擎结合校规与预测成绩给出建议。各簇上 Stacking 均优于单一基模型，聚合 RMSE 为 2.35，系统已部署在 University of Birjand 门户提供实时反馈。
Motivation: 学生规模快速增长使传统学业指导难以及时识别风险并给出个性化选课建议，需要把成绩预测与规则化教务建议整合成可落地的工具。
Method: 两部分混合框架：先用 Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) 对含 416,558 条教育记录的 University of Birjand 数据集做同质分簇，再为每个簇单独训练融合 Random Forest、Gradient Boosting 与 MLP 的 Stacking Ensemble；第二部分是规则型专家系统，把教育规章与第一部分的预测成绩结合生成推荐。
Result: 在全部簇上 Stacking 模型均优于各基模型，最终聚合 RMSE 为 2.35；系统在 University of Birjand 门户上线，提供学期 GPA 预测、留校察风险预警与提升 GPA 的选课建议。
Conclusion: 分簇后按簇训练的 Stacking 成绩预测加规则引擎，可作为实时学业指导工具部署到校园门户。

summary_sections.motivation: 学生规模快速增长使传统学业指导难以及时识别风险并给出个性化选课建议，需要把成绩预测与规则化教务建议整合成可落地的工具。
summary_sections.method: 两部分混合框架：先用 Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) 对含 416,558 条教育记录的 University of Birjand 数据集做同质分簇，再为每个簇单独训练融合 Random Forest、Gradient Boosting 与 MLP 的 Stacking Ensemble；第二部分是规则型专家系统，把教育规章与第一部分的预测成绩结合生成推荐。
summary_sections.result: 在全部簇上 Stacking 模型均优于各基模型，最终聚合 RMSE 为 2.35；系统在 University of Birjand 门户上线，提供学期 GPA 预测、留校察风险预警与提升 GPA 的选课建议。
summary_sections.conclusion: 分簇后按簇训练的 Stacking 成绩预测加规则引擎，可作为实时学业指导工具部署到校园门户。

papers.title: Damage Predicts Recovery: When Calibration Data Matters in Compressing Financial LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization and pruning rely on a small calibration corpus. Whether specialized domains such as finance require domain-matched calibration data remains unsettled. We argue that the answer depends on the task-level damage caused by compression rather than on domain mismatch. If compression preserves the target capability, changing the calibration corpus has little effect. If compression causes large losses, task-formatted calibration can recover part of the loss. We test this hypothesis across two model families, six compression configurations, three token-matched calibration corpora, and ten financial classification and numerical question-answering tasks. The results support this hypothesis. Quantization largely preserves task performance, and calibration choice has little effect in this case. Pruning reduces numerical QA accuracy by over 40 points. In these damaged settings, another generic corpus does not help, while FinMix, a mixture of financial task examples, recovers a large part of the loss. The link between damage and recovery holds across model families and scales. These findings support a practical rule. Measure task-specific compression damage first, and construct specialized calibration data only when the damage is large.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 金融 LLM 压缩后是否需要领域匹配校准数据，取决于压缩造成的任务级损伤而非领域错配：量化基本保留任务性能，换校准语料几乎无差别；剪枝把数值问答准确率打掉 40 多个百分点，此时换成 FinMix（金融任务样例混合）能挽回大部分损失。作者给出的实用规则是先测任务级压缩损伤，损伤大时才构造专用校准数据。
Motivation: 后训练量化与剪枝都依赖小规模校准语料，但专业领域（如金融）是否必须用领域匹配的校准数据一直未有定论；作者主张真正决定因素是压缩对目标任务造成的损伤，而非领域差异。
Method: 在两个模型家族、六种压缩配置、三份 token 对齐的校准语料上检验该假设，任务侧覆盖十个金融分类与数值问答任务；受损设置下对比通用语料与 FinMix（金融任务样例混合）的恢复效果。
Result: 量化基本保留任务性能，此时校准语料选择影响很小；剪枝使数值问答准确率下降超过 40 个百分点，在这类受损设置中再换一份通用语料无帮助，而 FinMix 挽回大部分损失；损伤与恢复的关联在不同模型家族与规模上均成立。
Conclusion: 压缩损伤大小可以预测专用校准数据的收益：先测任务级损伤，损伤大时才构造领域专用校准数据，否则换语料没有意义。

papers.title: ABAI at COLIEE 2026 Task 1: Multi-Stage Retrieval with GraphRAG-Enhanced Meta-Learning, and a Post-Hoc Study of the Cross-Validation-to-Test Gap
papers.abstract_en: We present the ABAI submission to COLIEE 2026 Task 1, case law retrieval, together with a controlled study of why it underperformed. The task suppresses the cited passages themselves, which removes much of the lexical overlap a retriever would rely on. Our pipeline answers this with four independently trained stages: multi-view BM25 over citation-context windows with reciprocal rank fusion, neural reranking, graph-based features from entity communities and a graph attention network, and a LightGBM meta-learner over 34 features. Our best run reached F1=0.177 on the official test set, against a cross-validated 0.311, and we attributed that gap to a recall ceiling, temporal distribution shift, and threshold miscalibration. We then tested all three. Under leakage-free protocols threshold transfer costs 0.007 F1, decision quality is flat across chronological quartiles, and the official test queries are not measurably farther from the training manifold than training queries are from each other, in two independent embedding spaces. Decomposing the misses instead splits them exactly evenly between candidates never retrieved and candidates retrieved but ranked below the cut. Measuring the remedies for each half, BM25 length-normalisation tuning, an event-triple view, and full-content dense fusion lift top-200 recall by three to seven points, and citation-graph features add 0.014 F1 over eight seeds once own-citation leakage is removed, while per-query cutoff rules, a zero-shot reranker swap, and a date filter do not help. We also document four evaluation artifacts, each of which reversed a result once the protocol was corrected.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Extended version of the paper presented at COLIEE 2026 (Workshop on the Thirteenth International Competition on Legal Information Extraction and Entailment), Singapore, June 2026. Code: https://github.com/rabqatab/coliee2026_ABAI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COLIEE 2026 Task 1 案例检索系统用四阶段流水线（多视图 BM25 + RRF、神经重排、图特征 + GAT、LightGBM 元学习）取得测试集 F1=0.177，远低于交叉验证的 0.311。作者逐一检验三种解释：阈值迁移只损失 0.007 F1、决策质量在时间四分位上平坦、测试查询在两个嵌入空间中并不比训练查询更偏离训练流形，因此差距主要来自召回上限。漏检恰好一半是从未被召回、一半是排在截断线以下，对应补救措施分别把 top-200 召回提升三到七个点、图特征在去除自引泄漏后加 0.014 F1。
Motivation: 法律案例检索中被引段落本身被任务屏蔽，检索器依赖的词面重叠大幅消失；系统交叉验证与官方测试集表现差距大，需要判定差距究竟来自召回上限、时间分布漂移还是阈值失准。
Method: 四阶段独立训练流水线：引用上下文窗口上的多视图 BM25 加 reciprocal rank fusion、神经重排、基于实体社区与图注意力网络 (GAT) 的图特征、34 维特征上的 LightGBM 元学习器。随后用受控协议检验三种差距假说，并对漏检做归因分解，分别度量 BM25 长度归一化调参、event-triple 视图、全文 dense fusion、引用图特征、逐查询截断规则、零样本重排器替换与日期过滤的效果。
Result: 官方测试集最佳 F1=0.177，交叉验证 0.311；无泄漏协议下阈值迁移损失 0.007 F1；决策质量在时间四分位上平坦；两个独立嵌入空间中测试查询与训练查询的流形距离无差异。漏检在从未召回与排在截断线下之间恰好均分；BM25 长度归一化调参、event-triple 视图与全文 dense fusion 使 top-200 召回提升三到七个点；引用图特征在去除自引泄漏后跨八个种子加 0.014 F1；逐查询截断规则、零样本重排器替换与日期过滤均无帮助。另记录四个评估伪影，每个在协议修正后都曾反转一次结果。
Conclusion: 交叉验证到测试的差距应归因于召回上限而非阈值或时间漂移，补救要按漏检的两半分别施治；评估协议本身足以反转结论，需系统排查评估伪影。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: High-Order Liquid Evidence Modeling for Continuous and Subtle GNSS Spoofing Detection in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Continuous and subtle GNSS spoofing poses a serious threat to autonomous vehicles because forged positions may remain locally plausible while gradually becoming inconsistent with vehicle motion observed by non-GNSS onboard sensors. Existing AV-oriented detectors commonly rely on residual thresholds or feature-level classification and provide limited modeling of how weak GNSS--motion inconsistency develops and persists over time. This paper formulates subtle GNSS spoofing detection as a causal sequential evidence-modeling problem and proposes a high-order liquid evidence detector. The method first compares the displacement implied by consecutive GNSS positions with that inferred from independent onboard motion observations and converts their difference into uncertainty-normalized residual evidence. It then represents the current inconsistency, its local evolution, excess above the normal level, accumulated persistence, and displacement validity as causal weak evidence. These cues are mapped into instantaneous, evolutionary, and persistent latent states, aligned through a bounded Kirchhoff-inspired symmetric exchange, and combined through an explicit third-order interaction to capture their coordinated support for spoofing. To model how this coordinated evidence develops over time, second-order liquid dynamics track its memory and evolution to estimate causal spoofing probabilities, which are converted into confirmed alarms using validation-selected threshold and persistence parameters. Experiments on the AV--GPS dataset family demonstrate strong controlled and external generalization, together with clear sequential alarm behavior. On Dataset-1, the proposed detector achieves an AUROC of 0.9932 and an AUPRC of 0.9843, while obtaining the lowest false-positive rate among the learning-based baselines. Code: https://github.com/pangjunbiao/HO-LLN-Spoofing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把自动驾驶中的连续微小 GNSS 欺骗检测建模为因果序贯证据问题，用高阶 liquid evidence detector：将 GNSS 位移与车载非 GNSS 运动观测推断位移之差归一化为残差证据，映射为瞬时/演化/持续潜在态，经有界 Kirchhoff 式对称交换与显式三阶交互耦合，再用二阶 liquid dynamics 追踪证据记忆并输出因果欺骗概率。在 AV–GPS 数据集族上 Dataset-1 达 AUROC 0.9932、AUPRC 0.9843，并在学习类基线中取得最低误报率。
Motivation: 现有面向 AV 的检测器依赖残差阈值或特征级分类，对弱 GNSS–运动不一致如何随时间发展并持续缺少建模，而微小欺骗的位置在局部仍看似合理。
Method: 先比较相邻 GNSS 位置隐含位移与独立车载运动观测推断位移之差，转成不确定性归一化的残差证据；再把当前不一致、局部演化、超正常水平、累积持续性与位移有效性表示为因果弱证据，映射为瞬时、演化、持续潜在态，经有界 Kirchhoff 式对称交换对齐并用显式三阶交互结合；二阶 liquid dynamics 跟踪该协同证据的记忆与演化以估计因果欺骗概率，再用验证选定的阈值与持续参数转为确认报警。
Result: 在 AV–GPS 数据集族上展示强受控与外部泛化及清晰的序贯报警行为；Dataset-1 上 AUROC 0.9932、AUPRC 0.9843，并在学习类基线中取得最低误报率。
Conclusion: 把微小 GNSS 欺骗当作随时间协同累积的高阶因果证据来建模，可在自动驾驶场景中实现连续且细微的欺骗检测并保持低误报。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Reducing Hallucinations in Large Language Models Through Integrated Self-Verification and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are progressively used for advanced engineering tasks, includes Computer-Aided Design (CAD) documentation, standards compliance verification, and knowledge retrieval. Still, they are prone to produce hallucinations, outputs that seem convincing but aren't based on context that limit their trustworthiness in high-end engineering applications where precision and compliance are crucial. The paper introduces CoVe-RAG+, a unified framework that integrates Chain-of-Verification (CoVe) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to mitigate hallucinations in the results generated by large language models (LLMs). CoVe-RAG+ supports LLM verification in external sources of authority, such as engineering standards, CAD information, and simulation reports, while applying an iterative self-verification process to validate important claims. CoVe-RAG+ is assessed on engineering activities such as CAD model documentation, standards compliance verification, and the reutilization of historical design data. Experimental findings indicate a 28% improvement in factual accuracy relative to baseline CoVe and RAG methodologies. Moreover, CoVe-RAG+ strengthens user confidence by providing elucidative verification reports and source traceability. The findings indicate that CoVe-RAG+ provides a scalable and reliable option for implementing LLMs in engineering design processes where factual accuracy is critical.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the ASME 2025 International Design Engineering Technical Conferences and Computers and Information in Engineering Conference (IDETC/CIE2025), Anaheim, CA, USA, August 17-20, 2025, Paper No. DETC2025-169730, V02BT02A032
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CoVe-RAG+，把 Chain-of-Verification (CoVe) 与 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) 统一起来，用工程标准、CAD 信息、仿真报告等权威外部源做迭代自校验并输出可溯源的验证报告。在 CAD 模型文档、标准合规验证、历史设计数据复用三类工程任务上，事实准确性相对基线 CoVe 与 RAG 方法提升 28%。
Motivation: LLM 在 CAD 文档、标准合规、知识检索等高精度工程任务中会生成看似可信却无上下文依据的幻觉，损害其在要求精确与合规的高端工程应用中的可信度。
Method: CoVe-RAG+ 将 CoVe 的迭代自校验与 RAG 检索结合：检索工程标准、CAD 信息、仿真报告等权威外部源，对关键论断执行迭代自我验证，并生成解释性验证报告与来源溯源。
Result: 在 CAD 模型文档、标准合规验证、历史设计数据复用等工程任务上评估，事实准确性相对基线 CoVe 与 RAG 方法提升 28%；同时通过解释性验证报告与来源可追溯性增强用户信心。
Conclusion: 自校验与检索增强的统一框架可为事实准确性关键的工程设计流程提供可扩展且可靠的 LLM 落地方案。

summary_sections.method: CoVe-RAG+ 将 CoVe 的迭代自校验与 RAG 检索结合：检索工程标准、CAD 信息、仿真报告等权威外部源，对关键论断执行迭代自我验证，并生成解释性验证报告与来源溯源。
summary_sections.result: 在 CAD 模型文档、标准合规验证、历史设计数据复用等工程任务上评估，事实准确性相对基线 CoVe 与 RAG 方法提升 28%；同时通过解释性验证报告与来源可追溯性增强用户信心。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自校验与检索增强的统一框架可为事实准确性关键的工程设计流程提供可扩展且可靠的 LLM 落地方案。

papers.title: Refusal without Discrimination: What Encoded Prompts Do to Safety-Trained Models
papers.abstract_en: Encoded-prompt attacks are evaluated almost entirely on their harmful arm: a benchmark sends obfuscated harmful requests and reports how often the model complied. We show that this arm carries almost no information about the model under test. Across four independently post-trained 7-8B models, refusal of harmful homoglyph-encoded prompts spans 0.08 -- inside the 0.10 ceiling that sampling noise alone produces at n=100 -- while the same four models span 0.57 on the identical requests in plaintext. What the encoding destroys is not refusal but discrimination: on one model the gap between harmful and benign refusal falls from +0.82 in plaintext to exactly 0.00 under the encoding, benign and harmful requests being refused at an identical 0.99. A benchmark reading only the harmful arm scores that model and one retaining a +0.61 gap identically. We then ask whether post-training repairs this, using a published recipe on identical base weights. It does not: across a full SFT -> DPO -> RLVR pipeline, plaintext harm discrimination improves from +0.55 to +0.80 while the encoding-induced loss is unchanged at 0.34-0.50, and on every encoding tested the standard harmful-arm metric moves in the opposite direction to discrimination. None of this is visible without controls the field does not routinely run. We report eight instrument defects, each with the control that caught it; they share a direction, in that every defect on the behaviour axis inflated apparent safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 编码提示攻击评测只读有害臂，该臂几乎不含被测模型信息：四个 7-8B 后训练模型的同形字符编码有害提示拒答率跨度仅 0.08（n=100 时采样噪声自身就有 0.10 上限），而同批请求明文跨度 0.57。编码摧毁的不是拒答而是区分度——某模型有害/良性拒答差从明文 +0.82 降到恰好 0.00（两者同为 0.99），只读有害臂的基准会把该模型与保留 +0.61 差距的模型判为同分。
Motivation: 编码提示攻击基准只报告模型多常服从混淆后的有害请求，这条臂在模型间几乎无区分力，导致安全评测给出误导性排名。
Method: 在四个独立后训练的 7-8B 模型上对同一批有害与良性请求分别做明文与同形字符 (homoglyph) 编码对照；再用公开配方在相同 base weights 上跑完整 SFT → DPO → RLVR 流水线，比较明文与编码下的有害/良性拒答差距，并逐条记录仪器缺陷及其对照实验。
Result: 编码有害提示拒答率模型间跨度 0.08，低于 n=100 时采样噪声的 0.10 上限；同批请求明文跨度 0.57。某模型有害/良性拒答差由明文 +0.82 降至编码下 0.00（良性与有害同为 0.99），只读有害臂的基准把该模型与保留 +0.61 差距的模型判为同分。SFT → DPO → RLVR 后明文区分度从 +0.55 升到 +0.80，编码造成的损失维持在 0.34–0.50 不变；每种编码下标准有害臂指标的移动方向都与区分度相反。共报告八个仪器缺陷，行为轴上的每一个都抬高了表观安全性。
Conclusion: 后训练修复不了编码导致的区分度损失，且只读有害臂的指标会与真实安全方向背离；安全评测必须加对照（含良性臂与编码对照）才能看见这一点。

papers.title: The Uncontrolled Variable: Vision-Language Model Refusal Responds to Image Presence in Ways Risk Cannot Explain
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Model (VLM) safety is expected to depend on what a request asks for. We show that safety-aligned VLMs also key refusal on a property of a request's form: whether an image is attached, holding everything the request asks fixed. Attaching a blank canvas - unreadable, unrelated to the request, identical across prompts - shifts refusal by tens of percentage points, with no defense in the loop. The shift is not blanket caution. Neutral instructions are almost unaffected while borderline-benign prompts move sharply, so the cost falls on sensitivity-adjacent traffic: benign questions about privacy, self-harm and violence. Attachment alone is sufficient, while the image's properties set the price: a black canvas costs substantially more than a white one of identical size, and on an open checkpoint the carrying axis is pixel count. Nor is the shift under instructional control - telling the model the image is a placeholder to be disregarded removes only a fraction of it, and on one model asserting that an attachment exists moves refusal substantially with nothing attached. Attachment may correlate with risk in deployment; what these models do with it does not track risk. It is not the serving stack, since the same weights reached two ways behave alike, nor a property of VLMs as such, since several open-weight checkpoints show nothing. It belongs to particular aligned checkpoints, one of them open. It is also decoupled from what it buys: the canvas does prevent some attack success on a matched harmful set, but far less than it costs, and its sign is not fixed - on one open model the identical canvas makes the model markedly easier to attack. Image presence is not a default a deployer chose or priced; it is an uncontrolled variable inherited with the weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 安全对齐的 VLM 会把「是否附带图片」当作拒绝依据：在请求内容完全固定时，仅附加一张与请求无关、不可读的空白画布就让拒绝率变动数十个百分点，且无任何防御在环。代价集中在 borderline-benign 提问（隐私、自伤、暴力类良性问题），中性指令几乎不受影响；画布属性定价——黑画布比同尺寸白画布代价大得多，开放 checkpoint 上主轴是像素数。告知模型该图是占位图只消掉一小部分偏移，且画布换来的攻击成功率下降远小于其代价，甚至在一个开放模型上让同一画布使模型更易被攻击。
Motivation: VLM 安全评估默认拒绝只应随请求风险变化，但部署中图片是否附带常与风险相关，作者要分离「形式属性」与「实际风险」对拒绝行为的贡献。
Method: 在固定请求内容的对照设计下只改变是否附图，用一张空白画布（不可读、与请求无关、跨 prompt 一致）作为最小干预；再变动画布颜色与像素数、加入「忽略该图」的指令提示、断言存在附件（实际无附件），并对比两条推理路径同一权重与多个开放权重 checkpoint。
Result: 空白画布使拒绝率变动数十个百分点（无防御在环）；中性指令几乎不变而 borderline-benign 提问显著上升；黑画布代价显著高于同尺寸白画布，开放 checkpoint 上承载轴为像素数；「忽略该图」只消除一小部分偏移，无附件时断言存在附件也显著抬高拒绝；同一权重两条路径行为一致，若干开放权重 checkpoint 无此现象；画布在配对有害集上确实降低部分攻击成功，但幅度远小于代价，且在一个开放模型上同一画布使模型明显更易被攻击。
Conclusion: 图片存在是随权重继承、部署者未选择也未定价的未受控变量，其对拒绝的影响不追踪风险，属于特定对齐 checkpoint（其中一个为开放权重）而非 VLM 或服务栈的普遍性质。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: NPLSD: Accelerating Line-Segment Detection on NPU Microcontrollers
papers.abstract_en: Line-segment detection is fundamental to robotics, autonomous navigation, and industrial inspection. While transformer-based detectors achieve the highest accuracy, their deployment on microcontrollers remains impractical due to resource constraints. The STM32N6, with its Neural-ART NPU, promises to enable deep vision at the extreme edge. However, existing detectors rely on attention, grid-sampling, and normalization, operators that are unsupported by the convolution-oriented NPU. This architectural mismatch is characterized operator by operator: attention, grid-sampling, and normalization lack accelerator primitives, and the decoder's self-attention alone materializes a 39 MB score tensor that exceeds on-chip memory. To address this limitation, NPLSD is introduced as a pair of NPU-compatible line-segment detectors built from one design methodology. NPLSD-H retains the convolutional HGNetv2 backbone of LINEA and replaces the transformer head with a fully-convolutional feature pyramid and an F-Clip dense head. NPLSD-M adapts the M-LSD-tiny trunk to the supported operator set. Warm-started from ImageNet and trained on ShanghaiTech Wireframe, the 2.63M-parameter NPLSD-H reaches sAP^10=37.9 (35.9 int8); the 0.62M-parameter NPLSD-M reaches 41.9 (41.1 int8). A controlled ablation isolates the trunk as the only variable, and initialization alone accounts for 4.6 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NPLSD 是一对面向 STM32N6 Neural-ART NPU 的线段检测器：把 transformer 头换成全卷积特征金字塔与 F-Clip 稠密头，并把 M-LSD-tiny 主干裁剪到 NPU 支持的算子集。2.63M 参数的 NPLSD-H 在 ShanghaiTech Wireframe 上 sAP^10=37.9（int8 35.9），0.62M 的 NPLSD-M 达 41.9（int8 41.1），其中仅 ImageNet 初始化就贡献 4.6 个点。
Motivation: Transformer 检测器精度最高但无法部署到 MCU：attention、grid-sampling、normalization 在卷积导向 NPU 上没有加速原语，解码器 self-attention 单独就要物化 39 MB score tensor，超出片上内存。
Method: NPLSD-H 保留 LINEA 的卷积 HGNetv2 主干，用全卷积特征金字塔加 F-Clip 稠密头替换 transformer 头；NPLSD-M 把 M-LSD-tiny 主干改写到 NPU 支持的算子集。两者由同一设计方法学导出，从 ImageNet 预训练热启，在 ShanghaiTech Wireframe 上训练，并做只改变主干的受控消融。
Result: NPLSD-H（2.63M 参数）sAP^10=37.9，int8 量化后 35.9；NPLSD-M（0.62M 参数）sAP^10=41.9，int8 后 41.1。受控消融中仅初始化一项就带来 4.6 个点。原生 transformer 方案的解码器 self-attention 需 39 MB score tensor，超出片上内存。
Conclusion: 在卷积导向 NPU 上，把 transformer 头整体换成全卷积头并裁剪算子集，可以在 MCU 级资源内做出可用的线段检测，且 ImageNet 初始化是精度的主要来源之一。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MSA-CITE: A Co-Adapted LoRA Specialist Ecology for Fixed-Budget Small-Model Inference
papers.abstract_en: Compact language models are typically deployed by retaining a single post-training checkpoint and sampling it repeatedly. In this work, we challenge this practice by treating multiple discarded checkpoints as composable assets for deployment. Starting from a single Qwen3-4B backbone, we preserve four frozen LoRA branches, each derived from a different post-training trajectory. stead of drawing four generations from one branch, we allocate a fixed four-generation budget by sampling one completion from each branch. Our method, Multi-path Specialist Adaptation with Calibrated Inference-Time Evidence (MSA-CITE), processes the resulting portfolio by grouping terminal answers into equivalence classes, scoring each class via summed calibration-derived source priors, and selecting a representative under deterministic tie-breaking rules. The readout stage does not learn from evaluation results, nor does it introduce additional generations, verifiers, or reranking steps. On 200 held-out mathematics items, the four-path portfolio achieves 65.5% accuracy, compared with 62.0% for the strongest single-branch baseline. On a 100-item subject-disjoint shift, it attains 42.0% versus 40.0%. Under in-distribution conditions, the improvements over homogeneous SFT and Online-OPD repetition are robust; results against the strongest baseline and under shifted conditions are not conclusive. Our findings offer a narrow but concrete contribution: post-training branches, even without co-training, can be collectively beneficial for deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MSA-CITE 把同一 Qwen3-4B 骨干上四条不同后训练轨迹留下的冻结 LoRA 分支当作可组合的部署资产：固定四次生成预算下，不再从单一分支采样四次，而是每条分支各采一次，再把终态答案分组为等价类、按校准导出的源先验求和打分并按确定性平局规则选代表。在 200 道留出数学题上四路径组合达到 65.5% 准确率，对比最强单分支基线 62.0%；100 题 subject-disjoint 偏移集上 42.0% 对 40.0%。
Motivation: 紧凑语言模型部署通常只保留单一后训练检查点并反复采样，丢弃的中间检查点被视为浪费；作者要检验多条后训练分支在固定生成预算下能否集体优于单分支重复采样。
Method: MSA-CITE（Multi-path Specialist Adaptation with Calibrated Inference-Time Evidence）：以 Qwen3-4B 为骨干保留四条来自不同后训练轨迹的冻结 LoRA 分支，按固定四次生成预算每分支各采一条补全；读出阶段把终态答案分组为等价类，用校准导出的源先验在类内求和打分，再按确定性平局规则选代表，不从评测结果学习，也不引入额外生成、verifier 或 reranking。
Result: 200 道留出数学题上四路径组合 65.5% 准确率，最强单分支基线 62.0%；100 题 subject-disjoint 偏移集上 42.0% 对 40.0%。同分布条件下相对同质 SFT 与 Online-OPD 重复采样的提升稳健，而相对最强基线及偏移条件下的结果不具结论性。
Conclusion: 作者的结论是窄而具体的：即便不做协同训练，后训练分支也可以在部署中集体受益；但相对最强基线与偏移条件的优势尚不能定论。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: MSA-CITE 把同一 Qwen3-4B 骨干上四条不同后训练轨迹留下的冻结 LoRA 分支当作可组合的部署资产：固定四次生成预算下，不再从单一分支采样四次，而是每条分支各采一次，再把终态答案分组为等价类、按校准导出的源先验求和打分并按确定性平局规则选代表。在 200 道留出数学题上四路径组合达到 65.5% 准确率，对比最强单分支基线 62.0%；100 题 subject-disjoint 偏移集上 42.0% 对 40.0%。

summary_sections.method: MSA-CITE（Multi-path Specialist Adaptation with Calibrated Inference-Time Evidence）：以 Qwen3-4B 为骨干保留四条来自不同后训练轨迹的冻结 LoRA 分支，按固定四次生成预算每分支各采一条补全；读出阶段把终态答案分组为等价类，用校准导出的源先验在类内求和打分，再按确定性平局规则选代表，不从评测结果学习，也不引入额外生成、verifier 或 reranking。
summary_sections.result: 200 道留出数学题上四路径组合 65.5% 准确率，最强单分支基线 62.0%；100 题 subject-disjoint 偏移集上 42.0% 对 40.0%。同分布条件下相对同质 SFT 与 Online-OPD 重复采样的提升稳健，而相对最强基线及偏移条件下的结果不具结论性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者的结论是窄而具体的：即便不做协同训练，后训练分支也可以在部署中集体受益；但相对最强基线与偏移条件的优势尚不能定论。

papers.title: Beyond Imitation: Auditing the Recoverability of Reasoning in Distilled Models
papers.abstract_en: A correct teacher solution becomes useful supervision when the receiving student can continue its reasoning. We measure this compatibility with prefix recovery: after revealing 25%, 50%, or 75% of a verified solution, we test whether the student completes it correctly. We connect recovery to the cosine conflict between cross-entropy and reverse-KL gradients over the full vocabulary. Across adjacent Qwen3 teacher-student pairs from 0.6B to 8B parameters, reverse-KL distillation delivers its most consistent mathematical and code improvements for the two students below 2B parameters. On a fixed cohort of 1,000 trajectories, average prefix recovery rises from 71.0% to 91.9% as student size increases from 0.6B to 4B, and the robust-fragile recovery gap contracts from 46.0 to 14.4 percentage points. With the teacher fixed at 8B, conflict separation falls from 0.993 to 0.233. An independent objective intervention finds the largest reverse-KL rescue on fragile trajectories. The three measurements locate the same capacity-dependent transfer regime: distribution matching has the greatest headroom when correct traces remain unevenly recoverable. Prefix recovery provides a practical diagnostic for selecting costly distribution-level distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 prefix recovery 诊断：把已验证解法的 25%、50%、75% 前缀交给学生续写，用续写成功率衡量蒸馏监督是否可用，并把它与交叉熵和 reverse-KL 梯度在全词表上的余弦冲突联系起来。在 Qwen3 0.6B–8B 相邻师生对上，平均 prefix recovery 随学生从 0.6B 增到 4B 从 71.0% 升到 91.9%，robust-fragile 差距从 46.0 收到 14.4 个百分点，教师固定 8B 时 conflict separation 从 0.993 降到 0.233；作者据此建议用该诊断决定何时值得上代价更高的 distribution-level distillation。
Motivation: 教师给出正确解法不等于学生能用上这份监督：学生若接不上推理，蒸馏信号就浪费。需要一个能定位“可恢复性不足”发生在哪个容量区间的诊断量。
Method: 定义 prefix recovery：揭示已验证解法的 25%/50%/75% 后测学生能否正确补全；把恢复情况关联到交叉熵梯度与 reverse-KL 梯度在全词表上的余弦冲突；在 Qwen3 相邻师生对（0.6B–8B）上测量，并做一次独立的目标函数干预（objective intervention）观察 fragile 轨迹上的 reverse-KL rescue。
Result: 在固定 1,000 条轨迹的 cohort 上，平均 prefix recovery 从 0.6B 学生的 71.0% 升到 4B 学生的 91.9%，robust-fragile recovery gap 从 46.0 收窄到 14.4 个百分点；教师固定 8B 时 conflict separation 从 0.993 降到 0.233。reverse-KL 蒸馏在两个 2B 以下学生上给出最一致的数学与代码提升，目标干预发现 fragile 轨迹上的 reverse-KL rescue 最大。
Conclusion: 三项测量指向同一容量依赖的迁移区间：当正确轨迹仍参差可恢复时，distribution matching 的提升空间最大；prefix recovery 可作为是否投入昂贵 distribution-level 蒸馏的实用判据。

papers.title: Bridging the Data Gap: Digital Twin as a New Paradigm for AI-based Radio Sensing
papers.abstract_en: We present a methodology that places a 3D digital twin (DT) of the environment as the main enabler behind the development of radio sensing at scale. The DT acts as a world model, providing geometry, materials, and transmitter/receiver placements to a ray-tracing engine that generates time-indexed channel impulse responses (CIRs) for large numbers of plausible scenes (moving people and objects, layout variants, seasonal/weather conditions, etc). From these synthetic sequences, we train a sequential neural network that maps CIR time series to spatial occupancy estimates, enabling device-free localization (DFL) without instrumented targets. We posit that sensing is best approached as an environment-conditioned learning problem: rather than seeking a single global model, we advocate training or fine-tuning local models specialized to a site-specific DT. As a first experiment, we introduce a novel State Space Model architecture, trained and evaluated across multiple room geometries. The localization performances obtained demonstrate the potential of the approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 3D 数字孪生 (DT) 作为世界模型，向 ray-tracing 引擎提供几何、材料与收发机位置，批量生成含人员/物体移动、布局与季节天气变化的时间序列信道冲激响应 (CIR)，再训练序列神经网络从 CIR 直接估计空间占用，实现无设备目标的定位 (device-free localization)。作者主张把感知当作环境条件化学习问题：针对站点专属 DT 训练或微调局部模型，而非追求单一全局模型；首个实验提出一种新 State Space Model 架构，在多种房间几何上训练与评估，定位表现展示了该路线潜力。
Motivation: 无线电感知 (radio sensing) 缺少规模化的真实标注数据，逐站点采集代价高；用 DT 合成 CIR 可绕开这一数据缺口，并把感知建模为依赖具体环境的问题。
Method: 以 3D 数字孪生为世界模型，把几何、材料、收发机布局输入 ray-tracing 引擎，生成覆盖移动人/物、布局变体、季节与天气条件的大量时间索引 CIR 序列；用这些合成序列训练一个把 CIR 时间序列映射到空间占用估计的序列神经网络，并提出一种新的 State Space Model 架构，在多个房间几何上训练与评估，倡导按站点 DT 训练或微调局部模型。
Result: 首个实验引入新 State Space Model 架构，在多种房间几何上训练与评估，所得定位性能展示了该方法潜力（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 感知应作为环境条件化学习问题处理：以站点专属 DT 生成合成 CIR 并训练局部模型，是实现规模化 device-free localization 的可行范式。
Relevance: 16

papers.title: Improved Multiplayer Bandit Algorithm for Bernoulli Rewards
papers.abstract_en: We study the multiplayer multi-armed bandit problem with information asymmetry under Bernoulli rewards, for three information structures: asymmetry in actions, in rewards, and in both. Replacing the Hoeffding-style confidence intervals of prior work with Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence-based bounds gives strictly tighter regret guarantees in each case. We propose \texttt{mKL-UCB}, \texttt{mKL-UCB-Intervals} and \texttt{mKL-DSEE}, and show that the improvement factor is at least two by Pinsker's inequality and far larger when reward means are near zero or one. For asymmetry in rewards we prove that two arms' KL intervals separate after a deterministic number of samples, and that $M$ independent players accelerate elimination further.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Bernoulli 奖励的多人多臂老虎机信息不对称问题中，用 KL 散度置信区间替换 Hoeffding 型区间，提出 mKL-UCB、mKL-UCB-Intervals 与 mKL-DSEE 三个算法，在动作不对称、奖励不对称、双重不对称三种信息结构下均给出严格更紧的遗憾界。由 Pinsker 不等式保证改进因子至少为 2，奖励均值接近 0 或 1 时改进更大；奖励不对称情形下两个臂的 KL 区间在确定性样本数后分离，M 个独立玩家进一步加速淘汰。
Motivation: 多人多臂老虎机在信息不对称下，Hoeffding 型置信区间对 Bernoulli 奖励过于宽松，导致遗憾保证偏松，尤其在奖励均值接近边界时。
Method: 针对三种信息结构（动作不对称、奖励不对称、二者兼有），把先验工作的 Hoeffding 型置信区间替换为 KL 散度置信区间，提出 mKL-UCB、mKL-UCB-Intervals、mKL-DSEE 三个算法，并用 Pinsker 不等式与确定性样本分离论证给出遗憾与淘汰分析。
Result: 三种信息结构下的遗憾保证均严格更紧，改进因子由 Pinsker 不等式保证至少为 2，奖励均值接近 0 或 1 时改进更大；奖励不对称情形证明两臂 KL 区间在确定性样本数后分离，M 个独立玩家进一步加速淘汰。
Conclusion: 对 Bernoulli 奖励用 KL 型置信区间而非 Hoeffding 型区间，可在多人信息不对称老虎机中系统性收紧遗憾保证，并在边界均值与多玩家场景下获得更大改进。

papers.title: When Unpaired Sets Support Shared-Corruption Calibration: Moment Geometry and Two-Sample Precision
papers.abstract_en: Collections of diverse observations often share one acquisition, processing, geometric, or channel corruption, while only an unpaired clean reference set is available. For a prescribed low-dimensional correction shared across observations, the observed and clean reference sets support inference only through the response of fixed moments. We formulate this problem as two-sample moment calibration and report a rank-aware information state combining local rank, scaled moment sensitivity, source-separated covariance, and a moment compatibility residual. Full rank gives local moment identifiability, whereas kernel directions remain unresolved to first order. A unified linearization separates observed-set and reference-set uncertainty. Under covariance weighting, the weakest scaled singular value determines worst-direction asymptotic amplification. For an orientation-preserving planar-similarity correction shared across observations, ensemble centroids and a nonzero third-order complex moment yield closed-form global population identification of translation, rotation, and isotropic scale under matched-population and no-clipping assumptions. Controlled validation tests the predicted $N^{-1}$ and $σ_{\min}^{-2}$ laws, Gaussian efficiency, and interval coverage. Bounded applications report color corrected-output quality, channel magnitude-response calibration, and a separate paired geometric de-beautification result. The framework therefore reports missing or weak information instead of treating every fitted correction as identified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把共享单一采集/处理/几何/信道损坏的非配对观测集与干净参考集之间的校准问题形式化为两样本矩校准 (two-sample moment calibration)，用秩感知信息状态判定低维修正何时可辨识：满秩才局部可辨识，核方向一阶不可解。对保向平面相似性修正（平移、旋转、各向同性尺度），在匹配总体与无截断假设下，由总体质心与非零三阶复矩给出闭式全局总体辨识；协方差加权下最弱缩放奇异值决定最坏方向的渐近放大。
Motivation: 多源观测常共享同一损坏，但只有非配对的干净参考集；此时若把每个拟合出的修正都当作已辨识，弱信息方向上的校准会被误报为可靠。
Method: 将问题表述为两样本矩校准，提出秩感知信息状态，组合局部秩、缩放矩敏感度、源分离协方差与矩兼容残差；统一线性化分离观测集与参考集的不确定性，协方差加权下由最弱缩放奇异值刻画最坏方向渐近放大；对保向平面相似性修正用总体质心加三阶复矩闭式求解。
Result: 受控验证检验了预测的 N^{-1} 与 σ_min^{-2} 标度律、高斯效率与区间覆盖；有界应用报告颜色修正输出质量、信道幅度响应校准，以及单独的配对几何 de-beautification 结果。
Conclusion: 框架会显式报告缺失或微弱的信息，而不是把每个拟合出的修正都当作已辨识；全局辨识依赖匹配总体与无截断假设。

papers.title: RCShift: Certifying When Partial Linkage Suffices for Finite-Sample Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Systems with costly gold outcomes and cheaper auxiliary observations must decide how much record linkage to retain. Complete pairing retains every joint counter, while separate margins retain none. Neither endpoint is calibrated to a declared finite-sample decision. Universal reconstruction can retain cycle directions invisible to the likelihood-ratio family. Family-exact storage can exceed what the decision requires because certified residual loss may fit within finite-sample slack. We introduce RCShift, which certifies two routes to sufficiency under a declared observation contract. Its exact mode characterizes minimum-cost family-exact storage through LR-visible cycle directions. Its approximate mode bounds reverse Le Cam deficiency. Its integer mode certifies whether a chosen set preserves the full experiment's minimum integer record count at specified size and power. In a rank-two witness, one aligned counter preserves a four-record minimum. An equal-cost misaligned counter and the margins require eleven records, while universal reconstruction requires two counters. A local perturbation has positive reverse deficiency yet retains the four-record minimum. Proof-checked scheduling bounds instantiate the contract before gold computation and yield exact reconstruction on the admitted tree support. RCShift turns partial-linkage storage into decision-calibrated measurement design for the declared family, costs, target, and common strictly positive support.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 完整配对保留全部联合计数但代价高，完全分离边际则丢光联合信息；两个端点都没有针对既定有限样本决策做校准，而通用重构可能保留似然比族看不见的循环方向、family-exact 存储又常超出决策实际所需。

Result: 秩二见证例中，一个对齐计数器保住 4 条记录的最小值；等代价的错位计数器加边际需要 11 条记录，通用重构需要两个计数器；一个局部扰动具有正的 reverse deficiency 却仍保住 4 条记录的最小值。

papers.title: LLaVA-Assessor: Building the Foundation LMM For Visual Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Aligning with the human visual system~(HVS) in perceiving and evaluating the quality of visual signals is a central objective of machine-vision-based visual quality assessment systems. With the rapid progress of large multi-modal models~(LMMs), visual question answering provides a promising paradigm for building unified foundation models for visual quality assessment under multi-modal and multi-task scenarios. Inspired by the classical ``perception-decision" process in HVS-based quality evaluation, we formulate visual quality assessment for LMM-based machine vision as two complementary tasks: ``quality interpretation'' and ``quality scoring". Centered on these objectives, we propose LLaVA-Assessor, a unified data construction and model training system. To support multi-modal inputs, we design an adaptive model architecture that enables efficient processing of both images and videos. For data construction, we develop rigorous human annotation protocols and a novel machine-synthesis-dominated data expansion pipeline to build a large-scale and high-quality datasets. Furthermore, we introduce a simple yet effective prompt disentanglement strategy to alleviate training-objective confusion in multi-task learning, thereby enabling stable and coherent joint training. The resulting all-in-one LMM LLaVA-Assessor-GIGA achieves superior performance on $11$ image/video quality scoring test sets and 4 visual quality interpretation benchmarks. Extensive results demonstrate the effectiveness of integrating structured data construction, adaptive model design, and multi-task joint training for automated visual quality assessment. Our work provides compelling insights for developing foundation LMMs for automatic visual quality assessment. Project page at https://github.com/jzhws/LLaVA-Assessor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLaVA-Assessor 把视觉质量评估拆成质量解读 (quality interpretation) 与质量打分 (quality scoring) 两个互补任务，用统一的数据构建与训练系统产出 all-in-one LMM——LLaVA-Assessor-GIGA，在 11 个图像/视频质量打分测试集和 4 个质量解读基准上均取得更优表现。
Motivation: 视觉质量评估需要对齐人类视觉系统 (HVS)，但多模态多任务场景下缺少统一的 foundation LMM，且多任务联合训练易出现训练目标混淆。
Method: 提出 LLaVA-Assessor 统一数据构建与训练系统：设计可同时高效处理图像与视频的自适应模型架构；用严格人工标注协议加机器合成主导的数据扩展流水线构建大规模高质量数据集；引入 prompt disentanglement 策略缓解多任务学习中的训练目标混淆，实现稳定的联合训练。
Result: 产出的 LLaVA-Assessor-GIGA 在 11 个图像/视频质量打分测试集与 4 个视觉质量解读基准上均取得更优性能 (superior performance)。
Conclusion: 结构化数据构建、自适应模型设计与多任务联合训练三者结合，可支撑自动视觉质量评估的统一 foundation LMM。

papers.title: TREND-10K: A Comprehensive Dataset for Next-Generation Video Quality Assessment Based on Preference-Driven Media
papers.abstract_en: The increasing prominence of short-video platforms, coupled with the advanced commercialization of AI-generated content (AIGC) videos, has led to a shift in the types of video media trend consumed by users in their daily lives. Traditional user-generated content (UGC) is gradually being replaced by professional short dramas and AIGC entertainment. Consequently, VQA for contemporary media content has become increasingly important. This requires a unified evaluation framework that can handle diverse video content and evolving media trends. In this context, we introduce TREND-10K, a next-generation comprehensive VQA dataset consisting of the trend-driven part and the static part, containing $10,000$ videos across a wide spectrum of content types. The trend-driven part is based on the TREND-Search framework, which captures user preference profiles from trending lists on online platforms and formulates sampling strategies based on these profiles. The static part, on the other hand, is composed of supplementary samples selected from publicly available datasets. To support unified evaluation for various video types, we incorporate three evaluation dimensions: technical, aesthetic, and AIGC-trace. Experiments show that our dataset ensures high annotation quality and exhibits remarkable generalization across multiple content categories. In conclusion, our work presents a robust framework for advancing VQA, addressing challenges caused by the temporal evolution of user perceptual habits and preferences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TREND-10K 提出面向偏好驱动媒体的下一代视频质量评估 (VQA) 数据集，含趋势驱动部分与静态部分共 10,000 条视频，覆盖技术、美学、AIGC-trace 三个评估维度。趋势部分由 TREND-Search 框架从平台榜单抽取用户偏好画像并据此采样，实验显示标注质量高且跨内容类别泛化显著。
Motivation: 短视频与 AIGC 视频取代 UGC 成为主流，用户感知偏好随时间演化，传统 VQA 数据集与统一评估框架跟不上内容类型与媒体趋势的变化。
Method: 数据集分两部分：趋势驱动部分用 TREND-Search 框架从在线平台榜单捕获用户偏好画像并制定采样策略，静态部分从公开数据集补充样本；统一评估引入技术、美学、AIGC-trace 三个维度，共 10,000 条视频。
Result: 构建含 10,000 条视频、覆盖多种内容类型的 TREND-10K；实验显示数据集标注质量高，并在多个内容类别上展现显著泛化能力。
Conclusion: 以趋势驱动采样加静态补充的框架可支撑跨视频类型的统一 VQA，应对用户感知习惯与偏好随时间演化带来的评估挑战。

papers.title: Magnitude Profile Pruning: Calibration-Free Structured Attention Head Removal for Transformer Compression
papers.abstract_en: Structured pruning of attention heads provides a hardware-friendly way to compress Transformer language models. However, existing methods for measuring head-level importance require calibration data, gradient computation, or Hessian estimation. These requirements add extra overhead and make the methods depend on the data. Our work presents Magnitude Profile (MP) scoring, a training-free criterion for head importance that identifies dispensable heads through statistical outlier detection on weight row norms. Heads whose projection weights fall within the population bulk are pruned, while heads exhibiting outlier norms, which carry disproportionate representational capacity, are preserved. Our work further gives MP-G, a variant that handles Grouped Query Attention (GQA) by distributing shared key-value group scores across associated query heads. Across five models evaluated on WikiText-2 perplexity at 12.5%-50% head sparsity, MP-G achieves the best perplexity on OPT-6.7B at all sparsity levels (18.46 at 12.5%, 27.87 at 25%, 152.0 at 50%). MP-G also gives the best results on RoBERTa-large at 12.5% and 25% sparsity, with perplexity values of 7.27 and 10.28, outperforming calibration-dependent baselines including Wanda-Head, SparseGPT-Head, and Gradient-Head. It requires zero forward passes, calibration samples, or gradient computation. At 50% sparsity, head pruning yields up to 16% parameter reduction with 50% attention FLOP savings. Our results show that weight-only statistical scoring can match or outperform data-dependent methods for structured head pruning, providing a practical, zero-cost criterion for Transformer compression.
papers.comment: Accepted as a regular paper at IEEE ICMLA 2026; to appear in the conference proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Magnitude Profile (MP) 打分：对注意力头投影权重行范数做统计离群检测，落在总体分布主体内的头被剪掉，离群范数的头保留，全程零前向、零校准样本、零梯度。GQA 变体 MP-G 把共享 KV 组分数分摊到对应 query 头；在五个模型 WikiText-2 困惑度、12.5%–50% 头稀疏度下，OPT-6.7B 各稀疏度均为最佳（18.46 / 27.87 / 152.0），RoBERTa-large 在 12.5% 与 25% 为 7.27 与 10.28，胜过 Wanda-Head、SparseGPT-Head、Gradient-Head 等依赖校准的基线。
Motivation: 现有注意力头重要性度量需要校准数据、梯度或 Hessian 估计，带来额外开销且依赖数据分布。
Method: MP 用权重行范数的统计离群检测判定头重要性，剪掉分布主体内的头、保留离群范数的头；MP-G 针对 Grouped Query Attention 把共享 key-value 组分数分摊到关联 query 头。训练无关，不需要前向、校准样本或梯度。

Conclusion: 仅基于权重的统计打分可以匹配甚至超过依赖数据的方法，为 Transformer 压缩提供零成本的结构化剪头准则。

papers.title: TRACE: Transparent Retrieval for Abstract Concept Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Recent work reports that vision--language models (VLMs) struggle to establish and maintain stable reference in repeated reference games. Rather than ask which VLM does best, we ask a more basic question: do you need a large pretrained VLM for this at all? On grounding a single director utterance to one of twelve tangram silhouettes, we compare six off-the-shelf VLMs against a transparent baseline that uses \emph{no learned visual representation}: classical SIFT keypoint matching and a signal-quality index over retrieved images. On identical trials, the transparent baseline matches the strongest VLM (SigLIP-large) and significantly outperforms the other five, including every CLIP and OpenCLIP variant. The baseline additionally retrieves external images, so this is not a matched-information comparison; what it shows is that a learned \emph{visual} representation is not the bottleneck for this task: given retrieved images, a shape-appropriate classical similarity suffices. Along the way we find that abstract-grounding ability varies widely across VLMs (15--39\% top-1; chance 8.33\%, humans $\approx$77--80\%), so the weakness is model-specific rather than intrinsic to contrastive pretraining; on the 1{,}013-shape KiloGram benchmark the pattern generalizes for CLIP, with per-shape difficulty tracking human shape-nameability. The pipeline is a classical, inspectable alternative rather than a learned one. We close by sketching how an explicit, inspectable representation of listener-side pact state could carry this approach into interactive multi-turn reference, which we leave to future work. Code available in supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 用无学习视觉表征的透明基线做抽象概念指代评估：SIFT 关键点匹配加检索图像上的信号质量指数，把单个 director 话语落到 12 个 tangram 剪影之一。该基线与最强 VLM（SigLIP-large）打平并显著优于其余五个（含全部 CLIP/OpenCLIP 变体），说明给定检索图像后形状适配的经典相似度就够，学习到的视觉表征不是瓶颈。
Motivation: VLM 在重复 reference game 中难以建立并维持稳定指代；作者追问这类任务是否真的需要大规模预训练 VLM，而非比较哪个 VLM 最好。
Method: 透明基线不用任何学习视觉表征：SIFT 关键点匹配加对外部检索图像的信号质量指数 (signal-quality index)，与六个现成 VLM 在完全相同的 trial 上对比；另在 1,013 形状的 KiloGram 基准上检验 CLIP 的模式是否泛化。
Result: 透明基线与最强 VLM SigLIP-large 打平，并显著优于其余五个 VLM（含全部 CLIP 与 OpenCLIP 变体）；各 VLM 抽象指代 top-1 为 15–39%，随机水平 8.33%，人类约 77–80%；KiloGram（1,013 形状）上 CLIP 呈现同样模式，逐形状难度与人类 shape-nameability 相关。基线额外检索外部图像，因此并非等信息比较。
Conclusion: 学习到的视觉表征不是该任务的瓶颈，瓶颈是模型特定的而非对比预训练本身固有；作者以可检查的经典流水线作为替代，并把显式可检查的 listener 侧 pact state 留作多轮交互的后续工作。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 透明基线与最强 VLM SigLIP-large 打平，并显著优于其余五个 VLM（含全部 CLIP 与 OpenCLIP 变体）；各 VLM 抽象指代 top-1 为 15–39%，随机水平 8.33%，人类约 77–80%；KiloGram（1,013 形状）上 CLIP 呈现同样模式，逐形状难度与人类 shape-nameability 相关。基线额外检索外部图像，因此并非等信息比较。
summary_sections.conclusion: 学习到的视觉表征不是该任务的瓶颈，瓶颈是模型特定的而非对比预训练本身固有；作者以可检查的经典流水线作为替代，并把显式可检查的 listener 侧 pact state 留作多轮交互的后续工作。

papers.title: Activation-Energy Pruning for Spiking Neural Networks: Unsupervised Personalization via Spike-Count Saliency
papers.abstract_en: Activation-energy pruning -- removing weights whose product of magnitude and cumulative pre-synaptic spike count falls below a threshold -- was established as an effective unsupervised personalization strategy for conventional deep neural networks~\citep{BINGHAM2025101242}. This paper asks what happens when the same criterion is applied to spiking neural networks (SNNs), where activation energy is not merely a useful heuristic but a literal physical quantity proportional to the metabolic cost of each synapse. The answer is surprising on three counts. First, gradient-based pruning methods that perform competitively on conventional networks (SNIP, GraSP, magnitude pruning) consistently underperform on SNNs, collapsing to near-chance accuracy by $σ= 0.2$ sparsity across all tested architectures and datasets. We trace this to a systematic incompatibility between surrogate-gradient saliency estimation and the binary spike-train representation, though we cannot rule out that alternative surrogate choices or hyperparameter settings might partially mitigate the effect. Second, activation-energy pruning applied to a neuromorphic benchmark \emph{improves} over the source model at high sparsity ($98.4 \pm 0.4\%$ vs.\ $97.2 \pm 0.7\%$ at $σ= 0.8$ on N-MNIST), a phenomenon with no counterpart in the conventional network setting. We interpret this result as consistent with experience-dependent cortical specialisation: removing connections active only for non-target classes may reduce cross-class interference and produce a cleaner target representation, though we note this is an interpretive analogy rather than a mechanistic demonstration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把激活能剪枝（权重幅度×累积突触前脉冲计数低于阈值即剪）搬到脉冲神经网络 (SNN)，在高稀疏度下反而提升神经形态基准精度：N-MNIST 上 σ=0.8 时 98.4±0.4% 高于源模型 97.2±0.7%。而 SNIP、GraSP、幅度剪枝等基于梯度的方法在 SNN 上到 σ=0.2 就塌到接近随机水平，作者归因于 surrogate-gradient 显著性估计与二值脉冲序列的系统性不兼容。
Motivation: 激活能剪枝此前只在常规深度网络上验证为有效的无监督个性化策略；SNN 中激活能是与突触代谢成本成正比的物理量，梯度类剪枝方法在该二值脉冲表示上的表现尚不清楚。
Method: 以权重幅度与累积突触前脉冲计数之积作为剪枝判据，低于阈值即移除，实现无监督个性化；对照 SNIP、GraSP、幅度剪枝三种梯度/显著性方法，在多个架构与数据集上扫描稀疏度 σ，并把结果归因于 surrogate-gradient 显著性与二值脉冲表示的不兼容。
Result: 梯度类方法（SNIP、GraSP、magnitude pruning）在所有测试架构与数据集上于 σ=0.2 稀疏度即塌到接近随机准确率；激活能剪枝在 N-MNIST 上 σ=0.8 时达到 98.4±0.4%，超过源模型的 97.2±0.7%，这一反超在常规网络中无对应现象。
Conclusion: 在 SNN 上梯度显著性剪枝不可靠，激活能判据在高稀疏度下可超越源模型；作者把该反超解读为类似 experience-dependent cortical specialisation（去除仅对非目标类活跃的连接以减少跨类干扰），但明确说明这是解释性类比而非机理证明，并承认替代 surrogate 或超参可能部分缓解梯度方法的失效。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Toward User-Mediated Self-Repair in Ubiquitous Robots Through Goal-Oriented Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Ubiquitous robotic systems often lack traditional visual interfaces, necessitating resilient natural language interaction for maintenance and repair tasks. This paper presents a goal oriented agentic AI architecture designed to enable non-expert users to perform technical repairs through situated dialogue. The framework utilizes a multi-layered approach that decouples high-level strategic planning from reactive conversational execution to transform unconstrained human instructions into a structured hierarchy of goals. We conducted a study involving twenty participants to evaluate the system's efficacy using a physical hardware testbed. The architecture achieved a 95\% task completion rate, and participants reported positive self-efficacy following real-time guidance that adapted to conversational diversions and linguistic variations. A comparative analysis with an online baseline revealed that the transition to a physical environment significantly decreased perceived social presence (p=.0005), and trust and competence, (p=.037), while the agentic framework remained robust throughout the interaction. These findings indicate that goal oriented agentic AI can support the sustainability of body-worn technologies by empowering users to perform critical maintenance in ubiquitous contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向无屏可穿戴机器人的维修场景，提出目标导向 agentic AI 架构，把高层战略规划与反应式对话执行解耦，将非专家的自由自然语言指令转成结构化目标层级，并通过情境化对话给出实时维修引导。20 人物理硬件测试中任务完成率 95%，但相比线上基线，转入物理环境使感知社会临场感显著下降（p=.0005）、信任与能力感下降（p=.037），而 agentic 框架全程保持稳健。
Motivation: 无传统视觉界面的 ubiquitous 机器人难以让非专家完成技术维修，纯线上对话引导迁移到真实物理环境后社会临场感与信任会掉，需要在该落差下仍能工作的交互架构。
Method: 多层目标导向 agentic AI 架构：高层战略规划与反应式对话执行分离，把无约束的人类指令转换为结构化目标层级；以情境化对话 (situated dialogue) 提供实时引导，并能适应对话偏题与语言表达差异。用 20 名参与者的物理硬件测试台做用户研究，与线上基线做对比分析。
Result: 20 名参与者、物理硬件测试台上任务完成率 95%；参与者在实时引导后报告自我效能感提升。与线上基线相比，转入物理环境使感知社会临场感显著下降（p=.0005），信任与能力感同样显著下降（p=.037），而 agentic 框架在整个交互过程中保持稳健。
Conclusion: 目标导向 agentic AI 能支撑可穿戴技术的可持续使用，让非专家在 ubiquitous 场景中自行完成关键维修；但把引导从线上搬到物理环境会显著削弱社会临场感与信任，架构稳健性并不等于体验无损。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WatchPoint: Executable User Feedback for Real-World Agentic Web Development
papers.abstract_en: When a professional web developer's code fails a test, they do not simply re-read the stack trace. They open the application in a browser, click buttons, inspect computed styles, and run diagnostic commands to understand what went wrong. Existing feedback mechanisms for coding agents rely on screenshots, LLM-as-a-judge scoring, or natural-language corrections, but few interact with the live application the way a developer would. We introduce WatchPoint, a simulated-user system that mimics real developer behavior by generating and executing diagnostic scripts against the running application, producing structured observations that guide the coding model's retry. Unlike prior approaches that target single-file edits or evaluate using non-executable metrics, we operate on Web-Bench, a benchmark of 50 multi-file web projects comprising 1,000 sequentially dependent tasks, verified by deterministic end-to-end tests. WatchPoint recovers 57.6% of the tasks it diagnoses, and a controlled user study confirms the simulation's realism: human testers achieve a comparable recovery rate (54.5%), providing evidence that automated diagnostic scripts can substitute for interactive human testing on sequential web development tasks. We further identify a pattern of capability gaps that governs when simulated-user feedback is helpful and when it should be withheld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WatchPoint 用模拟用户对运行中的 Web 应用生成并执行诊断脚本，产出结构化观测来引导编码模型重试。在 Web-Bench（50 个多文件项目、1000 个顺序依赖任务、由确定性端到端测试验证）上恢复了其可诊断任务的 57.6%，受控用户研究中人类测试者恢复率为 54.5%，两者相当。作者还识别出一类能力缺口模式，用来判定模拟用户反馈何时该用、何时该抑制。
Motivation: 现有编码 agent 的反馈依赖截图、LLM-as-a-judge 打分或自然语言纠正，几乎不与运行中的应用交互，且多针对单文件编辑、用不可执行的指标评估。
Method: 构建 simulated-user 系统 WatchPoint：针对运行中的应用生成并执行诊断脚本（点击、检查计算样式、跑诊断命令），把结果整理成结构化观测喂给编码模型做重试；评测在 Web-Bench 上进行，由确定性端到端测试判定，并配一个受控用户研究对照人类测试者。
Result: 在 Web-Bench（50 个多文件 Web 项目、1000 个顺序依赖任务）上，WatchPoint 恢复其诊断任务的 57.6%；受控用户研究中人类测试者恢复率 54.5%，与之相当。
Conclusion: 自动诊断脚本可以在顺序 Web 开发任务上替代交互式人工测试；反馈是否启用取决于所识别的能力缺口模式，缺口存在时应抑制模拟用户反馈。

papers.title: Identifying Intelligent Processes via Online Sequential Testing
papers.abstract_en: Active sequential hypothesis testing studies how to identify an unknown hypothesis with a given set of sensing actions. We study this in the setting of identifying large language models (LLMs), \textit{i.e.}, if a user is conversing with an LLM drawn from a known set of models, how can they identify which one is in use? Here, the available sensing actions (evaluations) are themselves a design choice: an evaluator must first decide which environments and prompt families to construct, and only then decide how to use them sequentially. We formalize these two levels as an outer probe-design problem and an inner identification problem. Simply put, the outer stage selects a set of probes to be sent to the entire set of models, creating a kind of fingerprint dataset. This is followed by the inner stage, which sequentially sends a budget-minimizing set of those probes to identify the model in use. For the outer problem, we show that selecting which evaluations to construct at minimum cost, so that every pair of candidates is distinguished, is exactly a weighted set cover problem. Since the response distributions of the candidate models are not known exactly but only through calibration samples, we give a one-shot procedure that estimates the cover instance from these samples. For the inner problem, we bound the number of evaluations needed to identify the unknown model in terms of how well the available evaluations distinguish each pair of candidates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把识别未知 LLM 拆成外层探针设计与内层序贯识别两级：外层证明最小成本选出能区分每对候选模型的评测集合恰是加权集合覆盖问题，并给出从校准样本一次性估计该覆盖实例的流程；内层按评测对候选的区分能力给出识别所需评测次数的界。
Motivation: 主动序贯假设检验默认传感动作已给定，而识别 LLM 时先要决定构造哪些环境与 prompt 族，这层设计问题此前没有形式化。
Method: 外层把最小成本构造能区分所有候选对的评测集合归约为加权集合覆盖 (weighted set cover)，因候选模型响应分布未知，用校准样本一次性估计覆盖实例；内层在预算最小化下序贯发送探针，界由各评测区分候选对的能力决定。
Result: 外层问题被证明恰为加权集合覆盖；给出基于校准样本的一次性覆盖实例估计流程；对内层识别所需评测数量给出以候选对区分度为参数的界。
Conclusion: LLM 识别应先按最小成本解集合覆盖来选探针集，再在该集合上做序贯判定，识别代价由评测的区分能力控制。

papers.title: Topology-Aware Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for Cross-Dataset Retinal Vessel Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Retinal vessel segmentation in multi-domain deployment requires a source model to adapt to domains that differ in imaging conditions and annotation conventions. Conventional parameter-efficient fine-tuning reduces target-specific storage, but its highly restricted adaptation subspace can be insufficient for reconstructing thin, connected vascular structures. We therefore ask how target-specific capacity should be allocated so that topology-aware supervision remains effective under a strict per-domain parameter budget. Based on this principle, we propose TAPDecoderFT, a topology-responsive, role-structured adaptation framework. Specifically, TAPDecoderFT shares a fixed source parameter state across deployment domains, uses low-rank residuals for target-specific private/fusion feature mixing, and retains a trainable dense-reconstruction path comprising the decoder, output head, and refinement module. To promote structurally faithful predictions, the compact target state is jointly optimized with a region-overlap and topology-aware objective that encourages centerline continuity and thin-branch recovery. It improves both DSC and clDice over GenericLoRA-r4 and narrow TAP-r4 in all six directions and is comparable to full fine-tuning.
papers.comment: This manuscript is currently under peer review. Copyright may subsequently be transferred to the publisher, after which the availability of this version may be subject to the publisher's policy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TAPDecoderFT：跨数据集视网膜血管分割中，在固定源参数上用低秩残差做目标域私有/融合特征混合，同时保留解码器、输出头与细化模块的稠密可训练重建路径，并以区域重叠加拓扑感知目标联合优化。在全部六个迁移方向上 DSC 与 clDice 均优于 GenericLoRA-r4 和窄版 TAP-r4，且与全量微调相当。
Motivation: 常规参数高效微调把适配子空间压得过窄，难以重建细而连通的血管结构，跨域部署时目标域私有容量该如何分配是开放问题。
Method: TAPDecoderFT 跨部署域共享固定源参数状态，用低秩残差 (low-rank residuals) 承担目标域私有与融合特征混合，并保留解码器、输出头、细化模块构成的可训练稠密重建路径；紧凑目标状态与区域重叠加拓扑感知目标联合优化，鼓励中心线连续与细分支恢复。
Result: 在全部六个迁移方向上，DSC 与 clDice 均高于 GenericLoRA-r4 与窄版 TAP-r4，性能与全量微调 (full fine-tuning) 相当。
Conclusion: 在严格每域参数预算下，把容量按角色分配给低秩残差与稠密重建路径，可让拓扑感知监督继续有效，达到接近全量微调的分割质量。

papers.title: End-to-End Visual Odometry with RNNs and Attention
papers.abstract_en: Video Odometry (VO) is the process of estimating the ego-motion of an object by analyzing visual information such as a sequence of frames from one or multiple cameras. It has been a popular research topic in computer vision and robotics, and its applications include mobile robotic systems as well as autonomous driving. In this project, we investigate existing end-to-end deep-learning approaches to VO, and propose a novel temporal attention-based model to improve upon the baseline. In addition, while the vast majority of existing deep-learning-based approaches to VO are trained on driving data, we investigate the performance of deep-learning-based VO to the more dynamic and complex problem of hand-held cameras.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于时序注意力 (temporal attention) 的端到端视觉里程计 (visual odometry) 模型，在既有端到端深度学习 VO 基线上改进位姿估计，并把训练与评测场景从主流的驾驶数据扩展到运动更剧烈、更复杂的手持相机序列。
Motivation: 绝大多数深度学习 VO 方法只在驾驶数据上训练，车辆运动平稳、场景受控，难以覆盖手持相机这种更动态、更复杂的 ego-motion 问题。
Method: 调研既有端到端深度学习 VO 方案作为基线，在其上加入时序注意力机制构成新模型，以循环结构处理帧序列并直接回归位姿；同时考察该类模型在手持相机数据上的表现。
Result: 提出一个时序注意力 VO 模型以改进基线，并将深度学习 VO 的适用范围从驾驶数据推向手持相机这一更动态复杂的场景。
Conclusion: 端到端 VO 的时序注意力建模可作为驾驶之外场景的改进方向，手持相机是被现有方法忽视而值得检验的评测域。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Dynamic Deep Prompt Optimization for Defending Against Jailbreak Attacks on LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive capabilities across many applications but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, which elicit harmful or unintended content. While model fine-tuning is an option for safety alignment, it is costly and prone to catastrophic forgetting. Prompt optimization has emerged as a promising alternative, yet existing prompt-based defenses typically rely on static modifications (e.g., fixed prefixes or suffixes) that cannot adapt to diverse and evolving attacks. We propose Dynamic Deep Prompt Optimization (DDPO), the first jailbreak defense based on deep prompt optimization. DDPO uses the target LLM's own intermediate layers as feature extractors to dynamically generate defensive embeddings via a lightweight multilayer perceptron. These tailored embeddings are then injected into a subsequent intermediate layer, enabling an input-dependent defense without modifying the LLM's weights. This design ensures high adaptability with minimal computational overhead. Experiments on a diverse set of models and attacks demonstrate that DDPO significantly outperforms static prompt optimization methods, particularly on weakly aligned models and when handling semantically ambiguous benign prompts, successfully distinguishing them from genuinely harmful requests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DDPO：用目标 LLM 自己的中间层当特征提取器，经轻量 MLP 动态生成防御 embedding 并注入后续中间层，实现随输入变化的越狱防御且不改权重。在多种模型与攻击上显著优于静态 prompt 优化方法，尤其在弱对齐模型和语义模糊的良性提示上更能把它们与真正有害请求区分开。
Motivation: 微调做安全对齐代价高且会灾难性遗忘，静态前后缀式 prompt 防御无法适应多样且不断演化的越狱攻击。
Method: DDPO 取目标 LLM 中间层表征作为特征，用轻量多层感知机 (MLP) 动态生成防御 embedding，注入其后的中间层，权重保持不变，开销极小。
Result: 在一组多样的模型与攻击上，DDPO 显著优于静态 prompt 优化方法；优势在弱对齐模型上最明显，并能成功把语义模糊的良性提示与真正有害请求区分开。
Conclusion: 输入依赖的深层动态 prompt 注入比固定前后缀更能抵御演化中的越狱攻击，且无需改动 LLM 权重。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Modality-Gated Deep Adapters: Adding a Modality to a Frozen Embedding Model with Exact Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal embedding models are deployed at scale: retrieval indices, benchmark results, and behavioral audits all depend on the base model's exact outputs. Extending such a model to a new modality with existing parameter-efficient methods silently changes those outputs; LoRA-style adaptation rewrites the text path whether or not the weights are merged, invalidating every stored embedding. We propose modality-gated deep adapters: bottleneck adapters attached to every decoder layer of a frozen multimodal embedding LLM, grouped into per-modality packs that execute only while their own modality is being encoded. The result is a modality added with zero change to existing outputs: inputs no pack claims traverse the base model's own computation graph, bit-for-bit unchanged, and co-loaded packs compose with an exact-zero isolation matrix. Both properties are stated as propositions, hold after arbitrary training rather than only at initialization, require no task labels or routing metadata at inference, and are verified by exact-equality tests on the released checkpoints. On one frozen 2B base, the audio pack (injected as connector tokens) improves audio-to-text R@10 by +3.4 to +5.4 points over an identically trained control, positive at every seed and reproduced at eleven times the data; the thermal pack, reusing the base's own frozen vision path, clears its pre-registered acceptance gate roughly sevenfold at every seed and lifts thermal-to-text R@10 from 0.224 to 0.785. An encoder swap locates the missing capacity: an external audio encoder that outranks Whisper-family encoders in CLAP-style comparisons loses by 16 R@10 points inside the frozen LLM, so the capacity belongs in the layers, exactly where the gated adapters place it. We release the audio model, the thermal pack, and the training, evaluation and invariance suites: models at huggingface.co/EximiusLabs, code on GitHub.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Models: https://huggingface.co/EximiusLabs/fusion-embedding-2-2b-preview and https://huggingface.co/EximiusLabs/fusion-embedding-2-ember. Code: https://github.com/Eximius-Labs/fusion-embedding
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的多模态 embedding LLM 上按模态分组挂载门控 deep adapter，只在编码自身模态时执行，使新增模态的同时既有输出逐位不变。音频包 audio-to-text R@10 相对同训练对照提升 +3.4 到 +5.4 点，热成像包把 thermal-to-text R@10 从 0.224 提到 0.785。
Motivation: 检索索引、基准结果与行为审计都依赖基座模型的精确输出，而 LoRA 类参数高效微调会改写文本通路、使已存 embedding 全部失效，因此在不破坏既有输出的前提下扩展新模态是缺口。
Method: 在冻结多模态 embedding LLM 的每个 decoder 层挂瓶颈 adapter，按模态打包 (per-modality packs)，仅在编码该模态时执行；未被任何 pack 认领的输入走基座原计算图，共载 pack 之间满足精确零隔离矩阵。两条性质以命题形式给出、对任意训练后仍成立，推理不需要任务标签或路由元数据，并在发布 checkpoint 上用精确相等测试验证。
Result: 在同一个冻结 2B 基座上，以 connector token 注入的音频包使 audio-to-text R@10 相对同训练对照提升 +3.4 到 +5.4 点，每个 seed 均为正并在 11 倍数据量上复现；复用基座冻结视觉通路的热成像包在每个 seed 上约七倍通过预注册验收门槛，thermal-to-text R@10 从 0.224 升至 0.785。编码器替换显示，一个在 CLAP 式比较中优于 Whisper 系的外部音频编码器在冻结 LLM 内反而落后 16 个 R@10 点。
Conclusion: 新增模态的容量应放在模型层内而非外部编码器，门控 adapter 正好把容量放在那里，同时以命题保证既有输出逐位不变。

papers.title: Unanimity Without Persuasion: A Single Round of Debate Erases the Disagreement That Verification Needs
papers.abstract_en: A debate panel can become unanimous without becoming more correct. This is dangerous for downstream safeguards: a substituted verification ballot can change only narrow-margin votes, while richer arbiters lose disagreement as a natural targeting signal. We show that one debate round can erase that resource without requiring persuasion. Tracking a heterogeneous 7-judge panel through a blind round and three debate rounds on 600 code-correctness candidates, unanimity on a fixed cohort jumps from 39.5\% to 95.2\% in round 1 (93.1\% of the total collapse), while accuracy moves by less than one point and 96.3\% of verdict flips follow the displayed peer majority. An execution-based verification ballot corrects 8 of 2,037 pre-debate candidate-substitution instances but changes zero in every later round; by round 3 every wrong decision is unanimous, erasing dissent that had flagged two-thirds of the panel's errors. Identical-cohort controls explain why: no-peer reconsideration reproduces 79.6\% of the collapse, real labels without reasoning reproduce 91.5\%, and random labels steer flips toward whatever they display; the full-debate condition adds 4.3 percentage points over labels only (clustered 95\% CI 0.7--8.1). The one-round collapse reproduces in two additional real runs and two fake-label seeds, remains under panel sizes 3--7, and appears in MATH-500. Parse failures concentrate on contested candidates ($p<0.001$), making attrition non-ignorable. The design implication is operational: verify before any second-pass evaluation or peer exposure, and never treat post-debate unanimity as independent evidence of reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 7 人异质评审面板在一轮辩论后一致率从 39.5% 跃升到 95.2%（占总坍缩的 93.1%），准确率却变化不到 1 个百分点，96.3% 的判决翻转跟随所展示的同伴多数。执行式验证投票在辩论前纠正 2,037 例候选替换中的 8 例，之后每轮均为 0；到第 3 轮每个错误决定都是一致的，抹掉了曾标记面板约三分之二错误的异议。作者的可操作结论是：在任何二次评估或同伴暴露之前先做验证，绝不把辩论后的一致当作可靠性的独立证据。
Motivation: 辩论面板可以在不变得更正确的情况下达成一致，而下游安全机制依赖分歧作为信号：窄边际投票可被替换的验证票改变，更丰富的仲裁者则失去分歧这一天然的瞄准信号。
Method: 跟踪一个异质 7-judge 面板在盲评轮加三轮辩论中的表现，任务为 600 个代码正确性候选；用同队列对照拆解机制：无同伴重议、只给真实标签不给推理、随机标签，以及完整辩论条件，并报告聚类 95% CI；另在两个额外真实运行、两个假标签种子、面板规模 3–7 与 MATH-500 上检验复现性，解析失败用 p 值检验其是否集中在有争议候选上。
Result: 固定队列上一致率从 39.5% 升到 95.2%（第 1 轮即占总坍缩的 93.1%），准确率变化不足 1 个百分点，96.3% 的翻转跟随展示的同伴多数。执行式验证投票纠正 2,037 个辩论前候选替换实例中的 8 个，之后每轮改变 0 个；第 3 轮所有错误决定均为一致，异议此前标记了面板约三分之二的错误。无同伴重议复现 79.6% 的坍缩，真实标签无推理复现 91.5%，完整辩论条件比仅标签多 4.3 个百分点（聚类 95% CI 0.7–8.1）。坍缩在两个额外真实运行与两个假标签种子中复现，面板规模 3–7 下仍在，并出现在 MATH-500；解析失败集中在有争议候选（p<0.001）。
Conclusion: 一轮辩论即可在不依赖说服的情况下抹掉验证所需的分歧，因此必须在任何二次评估或同伴暴露之前完成验证，且不得把辩论后的一致视为可靠性的独立证据。

summary_sections.result: 固定队列上一致率从 39.5% 升到 95.2%（第 1 轮即占总坍缩的 93.1%），准确率变化不足 1 个百分点，96.3% 的翻转跟随展示的同伴多数。执行式验证投票纠正 2,037 个辩论前候选替换实例中的 8 个，之后每轮改变 0 个；第 3 轮所有错误决定均为一致，异议此前标记了面板约三分之二的错误。无同伴重议复现 79.6% 的坍缩，真实标签无推理复现 91.5%，完整辩论条件比仅标签多 4.3 个百分点（聚类 95% CI 0.7–8.1）。坍缩在两个额外真实运行与两个假标签种子中复现，面板规模 3–7 下仍在，并出现在 MATH-500；解析失败集中在有争议候选（p<0.001）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 一轮辩论即可在不依赖说服的情况下抹掉验证所需的分歧，因此必须在任何二次评估或同伴暴露之前完成验证，且不得把辩论后的一致视为可靠性的独立证据。

papers.title: Component Type, Not Reconstruction Error, Predicts Attention Quantization Sensitivity
papers.abstract_en: Many post-training quantization (PTQ) methods use layer-wise reconstruction, second-order proxy objectives, or activation-aware transformations to reduce quantization-induced error. Whether that error signal predicts the downstream functional impact of quantizing an individual attention projection has not been directly characterized. We sweep nine open-weight language models (1.3B--8B parameters; OPT, GPT-J, LLaMA-1/2/3, Mistral, Qwen 2.5) and quantize one attention projection at a time under round-to-nearest (RTN) and, for seven models, GPTQ at 3 and 4 bits, recording reconstruction error, perplexity change, and per-projection activation-weighted quantization error for 3,808 distinct measurements. We find: (1) within a given component type (Q, K, V, or O), reconstruction error explains less than 10% of the variance in perplexity sensitivity in 27 of 36 cases under RTN, with median R^2 = 0.044; (2) both component type and layer identity explain more variance than reconstruction error in all 9 models, with layer identity the strongest predictor in 7 of 9 models and component type strongest in the remaining 2; (3) value (V) projections are the most commonly dominant component, accounting for 38--51% of total positive Delta PPL in seven of nine models; (4) the dominant component is broadly preserved between RTN and GPTQ (5 of 7 cases); and (5) activation-weighted quantization error is a moderately better within-component predictor than reconstruction error for V projections specifically (median R^2 of 0.20 vs. 0.06). These findings indicate that relative weight reconstruction error alone is insufficient for sensitivity-aware bit allocation, and that V projections merit dedicated consideration in mixed-precision schemes.
papers.comment: Accepted as a regular paper at IEEE ICMLA 2026; to appear in the conference proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 9 个 1.3B–8B 开源语言模型逐个量化注意力投影，共 3,808 次测量，证明重建误差无法预测下游困惑度敏感度：同一组件类型内 RTN 下 36 例中 27 例重建误差解释的方差不足 10%（中位 R²=0.044），而组件类型与层序号解释力更强。V 投影在 9 个模型中 7 个贡献 38–51% 的正向 ΔPPL，故混合精度位分配应按组件类型与层序号而非重建误差来做，并优先单独处理 V 投影。
Motivation: 多数 PTQ 方法用逐层重建误差、二阶代理目标或激活感知变换来压低量化误差，但该误差信号能否预测量化单个注意力投影的下游功能影响此前未被直接刻画。
Method: 在 OPT、GPT-J、LLaMA-1/2/3、Mistral、Qwen 2.5 共 9 个模型（1.3B–8B）上逐个量化注意力投影，记录重建误差、困惑度变化与逐投影激活加权量化误差；量化方式为 RTN，其中 7 个模型另加 GPTQ 3/4 bit，合计 3,808 次测量。
Result: RTN 下 36 个组件类型内案例中 27 例重建误差解释的 ΔPPL 方差不足 10%，中位 R²=0.044；9 个模型全部满足组件类型与层序号解释方差多于重建误差，层序号在 7/9 模型中最强、组件类型在其余 2 个最强；V 投影在 7/9 模型中占正向 ΔPPL 总量的 38–51%；RTN 与 GPTQ 间主导组件 5/7 保持一致；V 投影上激活加权量化误差的中位 R²=0.20，优于重建误差的 0.06。
Conclusion: 仅靠权重重建误差不足以支撑敏感度感知的位分配，混合精度方案应按组件类型与层序号定位敏感投影，并对 V 投影给予专门考虑。

papers.title: MGRL-RSCC: Multi-Granularity Reward Reinforcement Learning for Fine-Grained Remote Sensing Change Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Remote Sensing Change Captioning (RSCC), which aims to generate accurate and detailed linguistic descriptions of ground object variations from bi-temporal remote sensing images, is a critical and challenging task in intelligent remote sensing interpretation. The mainstream autoregressive training paradigm faces severe exposure bias and train-test distribution mismatch, resulting in cumulative generation errors. They tend to produce conservative and template-fixed captions while ignoring subtle scene change details. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel multi-granularity reward reinforcement learning paradigm, termed MGRL-RSCC. Specifically, we first leverage a CNN and hierarchical self-attention module to extract and enhance visual features from bi-temporal remote sensing images. A Transformer decoder is then utilized to complete visual-to-linguistic translation. Different from existing methods, we design a dual-decoding strategy and a two-stage joint optimization scheme, which combines token-level supervised learning via greedy decoding and multi-granularity reward-driven self-critical reinforcement learning via sampling decoding. We further construct three complementary reward functions covering linguistic fluency, change state consistency, and structural-semantic relevance to comprehensively optimize caption quality and alleviate false and missing change descriptions. Extensive experiments on multiple public RSCC benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed MGRL-RSCC effectively mitigates exposure bias and conservative generation problems in traditional autoregressive methods. The source code and pre-trained models will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/MGRL-RSCC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MGRL-RSCC 用多粒度奖励强化学习改写遥感变化描述 (RSCC) 的训练范式：CNN 与层级自注意力提取双时相视觉特征，Transformer 解码器做视觉到语言翻译，双解码策略配合两阶段联合优化，先用贪心解码做 token 级监督，再用采样解码做自临界 (self-critical) 强化学习。三个互补奖励分别约束语言流畅度、变化状态一致性与结构-语义相关性，作者称该方案缓解了传统自回归方法的曝光偏差与保守、模板化生成问题。
Motivation: 主流自回归训练存在曝光偏差与训练-测试分布不匹配，导致误差累积，模型倾向输出保守、模板固定的描述而忽略细微场景变化细节。
Method: CNN 加层级自注意力模块提取并增强双时相遥感图像视觉特征，Transformer 解码器完成视觉到语言翻译；核心是双解码策略与两阶段联合优化：贪心解码做 token 级监督学习，采样解码做多粒度奖励驱动的 self-critical 强化学习；三个奖励函数分别覆盖语言流畅度、变化状态一致性、结构-语义相关性，用于压低错误与漏报的变化描述。
Result: 在多个公开 RSCC benchmark 数据集上的实验表明 MGRL-RSCC 有效缓解了传统自回归方法的曝光偏差与保守生成问题；源码与预训练模型将在 github.com/Event-AHU/MGRL-RSCC 发布。
Conclusion: 用多粒度奖励把监督学习与 self-critical 强化学习分两阶段串起来，是缓解 RSCC 曝光偏差和模板化描述的一条可行路径。
Relevance: 1
