papers.title: Spectral Tail Interventions in Decoder-Only Language Models: Reasoning-Sensitive Weight Structure from Controlled Surgery
authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
papers.abstract_en: Weight-space structure often correlates with language-model behavior, but correlation alone does not establish computational involvement. We study concentrated upper spectral tails in decoder-only transformers through controlled interventions. At a fixed relative offset, we derive a finite-width conditional bound linking the inverse participation ratio of squared singular values to central pre-softmax logit kurtosis. We then define a pointwise query--key ($QK$) product-tail target and compare independent factor surgery with a product-targeted factorization that preserves native attention computation. Across three base checkpoints and five reasoning benchmarks, plus an instruction-tuned Phi checkpoint analyzed separately, the learned-tail edit is more damaging than the mean of five fixed spectrum-matched Haar controls in all 20 model--task cells. Eighteen paired contrasts remain significant after Holm correction, while two are directional but inconclusive. Product-targeted factors attain higher held-out tail-subspace fractions, providing an empirical bridge between product- and factor-level interventions. Component isolation identifies contributions from $QK$, value--output, and multilayer-perceptron blocks, although the theorem covers only $QK$. In separate studies, inverse participation precedes pooled accuracy transitions under a matched crossing rule, and residualized tail-aware low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reaches targets earlier than standard LoRA and PiSSA while final-score intervals overlap. Conclusions are restricted to the evaluated checkpoints, layers, tasks, interventions, and controls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文在 decoder-only Transformer 中对上奇异谱尾做受控手术，推导出平方奇异值逆参与率 (IPR) 与中心 pre-softmax logit 峰度的有限宽度条件界，并提出保持原生注意力计算的 QK product-tail 定向分解编辑。在 3 个 base checkpoint × 5 个推理基准共 20 个模型-任务格子上，学习到的尾部编辑破坏性均超过 5 个固定谱匹配 Haar 对照的均值，其中 18 个配对对比经 Holm 校正后仍显著。
Motivation: 权重空间结构与模型行为通常只是相关，无法证明该结构参与了计算；需要在受控干预下检验集中上谱尾是否真的影响推理行为。
Method: 在固定相对偏移处推导 IPR 与 logit 峰度的有限宽度条件界；定义 pointwise QK product-tail 目标，对比独立因子手术 (factor surgery) 与保留原生注意力计算的 product-targeted 分解；用 5 个固定谱匹配 Haar 对照、Holm 多重校正、组件隔离（QK、value-output、MLP），并单独分析指令微调 Phi checkpoint 与 tail-aware LoRA。
Result: 3 个 base checkpoint、5 个推理基准共 20 个模型-任务格子中，学习尾部编辑在全部 20 格均比 5 个固定谱匹配 Haar 对照均值更具破坏性；18 个配对对比经 Holm 校正后显著，2 个方向一致但不确定。Product-targeted 因子取得更高的 held-out 尾子空间占比。逆参与率在匹配穿越规则下先于 pooled accuracy 转折出现；tail-aware LoRA 比标准 LoRA 与 PiSSA 更早达到目标，但最终分数区间重叠。
Conclusion: 上谱尾结构对推理行为有超出相关性的计算参与证据，但结论仅限于所评估的 checkpoint、层、任务、干预与对照，且定理只覆盖 QK 而非 value-output 与 MLP。

papers.title: Moving6DPoSe: A Multimodal Database for Monocular 6D Pose Estimation and Segmentation of Moving Objects
papers.abstract_en: Estimating the 6D pose of moving objects remains challenging due to motion blur and the limited temporal resolution of conventional frame-based cameras. Existing event-based datasets further provide limited sensing modalities, annotations, and motion scenarios. We introduce Moving6DPoSe, a multimodal database comprising two complementary subsets: Moving6DPoSe-R with real-world recordings and Moving6DPoSe-S with synthetic sequences generated from the same objects. The dataset contains 16 scanned objects and 1,702 real and synthetic rosbags spanning multiple motion scenarios, with annotations for semantic segmentation, object detection, and monocular 6D pose estimation. We further provide baseline results for all three tasks across frame and event-based modalities. Experimental results show that event-based representations achieve more robust moving-object segmentation than conventional RGB images, while monocular orientation estimation remains challenging, highlighting the potential of Moving6DPoSe for moving-object perception research.
papers.journal_ref: The 19th European Conference on Computer Vision Workshops (ECCVW 2026); Workshop on Neuromorphic Vision (NeVi)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Moving6DPoSe 是面向运动物体的多模态数据集，含真实子集 Moving6DPoSe-R 与同物体的合成子集 Moving6DPoSe-S，覆盖 16 个扫描物体、1,702 个真实与合成 rosbag，标注语义分割、目标检测与单目 6D 位姿。基线结果显示事件相机表征做运动物体分割比 RGB 更稳健，而单目朝向估计仍然困难。
Motivation: 运动模糊与常规帧相机的时间分辨率限制使运动物体 6D 位姿估计困难，现有事件相机数据集在传感模态、标注与运动场景上覆盖不足。
Method: 构建两个互补子集：真实录制的 Moving6DPoSe-R 与基于相同物体生成的合成序列 Moving6DPoSe-S；提供语义分割、目标检测、单目 6D 位姿三任务标注，并在帧与事件两种模态上给出基线结果。
Result: 数据集含 16 个扫描物体与 1,702 个真实及合成 rosbag，覆盖多种运动场景；基线实验显示事件表征的运动物体分割比 RGB 图像更稳健，单目朝向 (orientation) 估计仍具挑战。
Conclusion: 事件相机对运动物体感知有潜力，可支撑运动物体分割、检测与 6D 位姿研究，但单目朝向估计是当前短板。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Free-Recipe Limit: Every Recipe Effect Measures Which Premise of an Idealised Learner Broke
papers.abstract_en: Fix a corpus and send recipe search to infinity: try every order of the skills, every arrangement from blocked to interleaved, every composition, and keep the best. Two quantities decide what that search was worth: the diameter of the reachable set it explores, and the resolution at which anyone can tell two endpoints apart. Where the diameter falls below the resolution, no amount of search converts into a decision, and the signature is not an absence of winners but winners that do not survive re-running. We measure this recipe-search wall with 761 fine-tuning runs on 12 base models (0.5B-14B, three pretraining families) over competition-mathematics skills: base checkpoints, supervised fine-tuning under AdamW, exact-match scoring at k=4. Within one coherent domain at fixed volume the three classical freedoms average 0.010-0.021 against a 0.019 floor, and the largest contrast, 0.0619, clears a three-seed resolution and then reads +0.010 and -0.015 on two reruns. The departure with a systematic answer is coherence: halving one pooled corpus and letting the halves write answers under incompatible but equally correct conventions moves arrangement from capability to allocation between conventions, by two orders of magnitude over a same-convention control, and writing the convention into the input switches the phenomenon off. The switch replicates on a second pretraining family and survives an independent re-execution of its own protocol, with a re-execution spread (0.087) smaller than the resolution a search-selected order cell carries (0.144). Order itself is a transient whose sign crosses zero three times inside a single run. Volume, the one lever nobody calls a recipe, is the one that reliably pays. A public scorecard grades all 26 pre-registered claims: 18 supported, 5 failed, 2 untested, 1 mixed.
papers.comment: 42 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables (incl. appendices); code, pre-registration files, and result base to be released with the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文提出 free-recipe limit：配方搜索的价值只由可达集直径与端点可分辨分辨率两个量决定，直径低于分辨率时再多搜索也换不来决策，表现为赢家在重跑中不复现。用 761 次微调、12 个基座模型（0.5B–14B）在竞赛数学技能上检验，三个经典自由度的效应 0.010–0.021 贴着 0.019 的分辨率地板，最大对比 0.0619 重跑后读作 +0.010 与 −0.015；唯一有系统性答案的是 coherence，把语料对半并让两半用互不相容但同样正确的约定写答案，使 arrangement 效应放大两个数量级，而把约定写进输入即可关掉该现象。
Motivation: 配方搜索（技能顺序、blocked/interleaved 排列、组合方式）在固定语料下被当作可无限优化的自由度，但没人判定这种搜索何时根本无法转化为决策。
Method: 以可达集直径与端点分辨分辨率两个量刻画配方搜索墙；在竞赛数学技能上做 761 次微调，覆盖 12 个基座模型（0.5B–14B、三个预训练家族），base checkpoint 与 AdamW 下的 SFT，exact-match 评分 k=4；用语料对半、约定不相容与把约定写进输入的开关实验分离机制，并预注册 26 条 claim 由公开记分卡评级。
Result: 同一连贯域、固定体量下三个经典自由度平均 0.010–0.021，对上 0.019 的分辨率地板；最大对比 0.0619 勉强过三 seed 分辨率，两次重跑分别读作 +0.010 与 −0.015。约定冲突使 arrangement 效应相对同约定对照放大两个数量级，重执行离散度 0.087 小于搜索选出的 order cell 所携带的 0.144；order 本身在单次运行内符号三次过零。26 条预注册 claim 中 18 条 supported、5 条 failed、2 条 untested、1 条 mixed。
Conclusion: 配方搜索在直径低于分辨率时是空转，order 只是符号反复翻转的瞬态，唯一可靠起作用的杠杆是体量；有系统性答案的自由度是约定一致性 (coherence)，把约定显式写进输入即可消除该现象。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: "As a Language Model...": Chat Template Switches LLM Self-Referential Voice and Activation Steering Reproduces It
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) tend to add disclaimers like "I'm just an AI" when asked about something related to themselves. The self-reports from such responses are used in debates about AI safety or self-knowledge of the models, yet what drives them is not well understood. Are the models telling us about themselves or rather how they are deployed? In this work, we show that the chat template works like a switch - when present, it turns this disclaimer voice up and experiential voice like "I feel" down, across 8 popular open-source instruct models up to 9B parameters in size. And conversely when the chat template is not present, it turns the disclaimer voice down and experiential voice up. Inside the activations of 3 models, we find a direction that steers this behavior. Removing the direction in the model's activation space turns disclaimer voice down and adding it turns it up, while a random direction of the same size has little effect. We find that instruct models without chat template, when we add the disclaimer direction to them, disclaim like the template was there. Since the chat template controls the disclaimer voice of LLMs, then researchers studying self-reports or introspection of models might have a confound they need to control for. Our results show that there is a direction they can use to steer this voice. More broadly, our work shows that what models say about themselves is not a fact about them. What they say doesn't come only from weights, but it is partially set by the chat template, and because of that a model's self-description shouldn't be treated literally.
papers.comment: Accepted to COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning and KONVENS 2026 First Workshop on Evaluating LLMs for Specialized Domains (Eval4SD)

papers.title: From Risk Scoring to Risk Allocation: A Density-Driven Framework for Diverse Monitoring in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Risk monitoring in multi-agent systems is commonly built on a per-state primitive that scores each state independently and selects the top K. Under crowding, where many agents share the same fragility, this approach picks redundant alerts whose risks are jointly correlated, a pattern we describe as ``herding in monitoring.'' We propose a paradigm shift from risk scoring to risk allocation, supported by two contributions. First, we identify the Crowding Paradox, namely that P(risk | x) $\propto$ p(x) rather than 1/p(x), so density rather than anomaly score is the operative risk signal; on financial data, density-based scoring reaches AUROC $\geq$ 0.94 at 5d/10d/20d crash horizons, while five anomaly baselines all fall below 0.80. Second, given a density-derived fragility score, we recast monitoring as combinatorial subset selection over interdependent states and map it to a QUBO objective with a $λ$-controlled risk--diversity tradeoff. The resulting Pareto frontier contains standard diverse-subset methods (MMR, k-DPP) as fixed operating points; the gain over greedy grows monotonically with scale, from +24% at n=15 to +66% at n=200; a learned $λ$ policy reaches 99.5% of an oracle grid-search objective; and the formulation transfers to traffic and multi-agent reinforcement learning. The same QUBO instances execute without modification on Rigetti superconducting QPUs (Ankaa-3 and Cepheus-1-108Q via Amazon Braket), which we report as a compatibility property of the formulation rather than a claim of quantum advantage at this scale.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on New Frontiers in Game-Theoretic Learning (NExT-Game)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多智能体风险监控从逐状态打分改为风险分配：先指出 Crowding Paradox，即风险随状态密度 p(x) 而非异常度 1/p(x) 增长，再把监控建模为带 λ 风险-多样性权衡的 QUBO 子集选择。金融数据上密度打分在 5d/10d/20d 崩盘时域 AUROC ≥ 0.94，五个异常基线均低于 0.80；相对贪心的增益随规模从 n=15 的 +24% 升到 n=200 的 +66%。
Motivation: 逐状态 top-K 监控在拥挤 (crowding) 下选出的风险彼此相关、告警冗余，即监控中的 herding；异常分数本身也不是正确的风险信号。
Method: 两步：一是用密度而非异常分数构造 fragility 打分（Crowding Paradox）；二是把相互依赖状态上的监控重写为组合子集选择，映射到含 λ 风险-多样性权衡的 QUBO 目标，MMR、k-DPP 成为 Pareto 前沿上的固定操作点，并学习 λ 策略。
Result: 金融数据上密度打分在 5d/10d/20d 崩盘时域 AUROC ≥ 0.94，五个异常基线全部低于 0.80；相对贪心的增益随规模单调增长，n=15 时 +24%，n=200 时 +66%；学习到的 λ 策略达到 oracle 网格搜索目标的 99.5%；同一 QUBO 实例无需修改即可在 Rigetti Ankaa-3 与 Cepheus-1-108Q（经 Amazon Braket）上执行。
Conclusion: 风险监控应从打分转向分配，密度是操作性风险信号，QUBO 形式化可迁移到交通与多智能体强化学习；量子执行仅作为兼容性性质报告，不构成该规模下的量子优势主张。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Verifiers Vote Backwards under Verdict Substitution: Signed Pivotal Value in Correlated Self-Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Replacing one ballot can change a majority decision only on queries decided by a single vote; this structural fact requires no independence assumption. We study the sign of that change using a labeled, verdict-style intervention: one correctness signal replaces one correctness-indicator ballot in $k{=}7$ self-consistency panels. This diagnostic intervention is not identical to deployed answer-identity plurality. A primary MATH-500 experiment ($n{=}570$) gives a different-model verifier a $+24.2$pp pivotal gain, whereas a role-reversed configuration gives $-11.2$pp; an exploratory code stress test (14 pivotal rows across 9 tasks) gives $-24.5$pp. An exact signed-gain decomposition accounts for all observed signs through the verifier's state-specific accuracy and the composition of the two one-vote tally states, rather than global accuracy or model provenance. Same-source signals lose accuracy on the pivotal stratum (65$\to$44\% in the primary configuration), while error correlations provide a descriptive error-association diagnostic. Controlled degradation and a $k\in\{3,5,7\}$ subset sensitivity analysis probe the stability of the observed pattern around this accounting. Under the evaluated ties-incorrect answer-identity plurality analysis, the structural zero and strong-verifier benefit persist, but the role-reversed harm attenuates to $-0.9$pp and is not significant. The results therefore establish harmful verdict substitution, not universally harmful deployed plurality, and motivate a testable but unverified hypothesis for negative process-reward-model weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 k=7 的 self-consistency 投票面板上做带标签的 verdict 式干预：用一个正确性信号替换一张正确性指示票，发现符号取决于验证器在两类单票决胜状态上的状态特异精度与组成，而非全局精度或模型来源。MATH-500 主实验 (n=570) 中异模型验证器带来 +24.2pp 的 pivotal gain，角色互换配置为 −11.2pp，代码压力测试 (9 个任务 14 行) 为 −24.5pp；同源信号在 pivotal stratum 上精度从 65% 掉到 44%。
Motivation: 单票可翻转多数这一结构性事实已知，但换一张票带来的增益符号（正还是负）此前缺少可归因的解释；这直接关系到 process reward model 该给正权重还是负权重的争议。
Method: 在 k=7 的 self-consistency 面板上做 labeled、verdict-style 干预：替换一张 correctness-indicator 票并记录多数结果变化；给出精确的 signed-gain 分解，把符号归因于验证器的状态特异精度与两类单票 tally 状态的组成；辅以受控退化实验和 k∈{3,5,7} 的子集敏感性分析，并用错误关联诊断描述 error correlation。
Result: MATH-500 主实验 n=570：异模型验证器 +24.2pp pivotal gain，角色互换 −11.2pp；探索性代码压力测试 9 个任务 14 个 pivotal 行为 −24.5pp。同源信号在 pivotal stratum 精度 65%→44%。在 ties-incorrect 的 answer-identity plurality 分析下，结构性零与强验证器收益仍在，但角色互换的危害衰减到 −0.9pp 且不显著。
Conclusion: 结果确立的是有害的 verdict substitution，而非普遍有害的部署 plurality；符号可由状态特异精度与单票状态组成完全解释，并为负的 process-reward-model 权重给出一个可检验但未验证的假设。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TailSpec-EASE: Knowledge-Graph-Regularized Linear Recommendation for Web Long-Tail Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems on Web platforms tend to over-serve popular items and neglect the long tail. Item-side knowledge graphs (KGs), often available as linked data or RDF-style Web resources, can help by connecting sparse items through shared semantic attributes. Many competitive KG-aware recommenders rely on graph neural architectures, whereas strong shallow linear models such as EASE-R typically ignore side information and may become infeasible in their global closed-form version. We introduce TailSpec-EASE, a lightweight recommender that injects a relation-aware spectral KG prior into a local closed-form reconstruction objective. The prior strength adapts to item popularity, giving stronger semantic guidance to long-tail items. Across four public benchmarks and a broad set of classical, linear, graph-CF, KG-aware neural, and score-level KG baselines, TailSpec-EASE attains a favorable trade-off between overall accuracy, long-tail performance, and training cost. It improves NDCG@20 by up to 24% over its counterpart without KG information. All tail-metric improvements over the no-KG counterpart are statistically significant under a paired bootstrap, and overall NDCG improves significantly on three of the four datasets. In a representative Amazon-book timing study, TailSpec-EASE trains in 37 seconds on CPU, compared with 2,584 seconds for a GPU-trained KGAT run and 15,800 seconds for CPU LightGCN, while attaining higher NDCG@20 and Tail Recall@20 on that dataset. It also remains feasible on catalogs where the global closed-form model runs out of memory.

TL;DR: TailSpec-EASE 把关系感知的谱型知识图谱先验注入局部闭式重构目标，先验强度随物品流行度自适应增强，专门给长尾物品更强的语义引导。在四个公开基准上 NDCG@20 相对无 KG 版本最高提升 24%，Amazon-book 上 CPU 训练 37 秒，同时取得更高 NDCG@20 与 Tail Recall@20。
Motivation: Web 推荐系统过度推送热门物品、忽视长尾；现有 KG-aware 推荐多依赖图神经网络开销大，而 EASE-R 这类浅层线性模型忽略侧信息、全局闭式版本在大目录上内存不可行。
Method: 将关系感知的谱 KG 先验注入局部闭式重构目标（local closed-form reconstruction），先验强度按物品流行度自适应，长尾物品获得更强语义约束；对比 classical、linear、graph-CF、KG-aware neural 与 score-level KG 基线。
Result: 四个公开基准上 NDCG@20 相对无 KG 对应版本最高提升 24%；所有长尾指标提升在 paired bootstrap 下显著，整体 NDCG 在四个数据集中的三个上显著提升；Amazon-book 计时中 CPU 训练 37 秒，对比 GPU 训练 KGAT 2,584 秒与 CPU LightGCN 15,800 秒，且该数据集上 NDCG@20 与 Tail Recall@20 更高；在全局闭式模型内存耗尽的目录上仍可行。
Conclusion: 带流行度自适应谱 KG 先验的轻量线性推荐能在整体精度、长尾表现与训练成本之间取得有利折中，并在大目录上保持可行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Three Routes to One Answer: Reconciling AIPW, TMLE, and Double Machine Learning for Applied Researchers
papers.abstract_en: Augmented inverse-probability weighting (AIPW), targeted maximum likelihood estimation (TMLE), and double/debiased machine learning (DML) are three routes to the same efficient influence function for the average treatment effect --- settled theory we treat as background. This tutorial's contribution is its worked, shared-nuisance reconciliation on real data: what a practitioner must actually match for the routes, and the software packages, to agree. Working the effect of smoking cessation on weight change in the open NHEFS data (n=1566) with one shared Super Learner library and identical cross-fitting folds, we build all three estimators by hand from one influence function, in full-sample, cross-fit, and double-cross-fit variants; the six resulting doubly-robust estimates span only 3.32--3.42 kg, consistent with the established benchmark. We then reconcile the same estimand across our engine and the tmle, AIPW, DoubleML, and tmle3 packages. At their defaults the estimates span 3.32--3.49 kg. Once the library and folds are matched and single-split noise is averaged out, the three library-sharing implementations agree to within 0.01 kg --- so the residual spread traces to the nuisance library, folds, and repetitions, not to the estimator label. Because the estimators share one influence function, they agree under good overlap; under a positivity violation the pooled ATE is not identified without additional extrapolation assumptions, and their finite-sample estimates can then diverge sharply. We therefore place a positivity diagnosis ahead of estimator choice, illustrate the failure on a no-overlap example, and close with a reporting checklist. Open-source R code reproduces every number.
papers.comment: 45 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables. Tutorial. R code at https://github.com/ehsanx/dml-alternatives, R package at https://github.com/ehsanx/dr3/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 教程在 NHEFS 数据 (n=1566) 上用同一 Super Learner 库与相同交叉拟合折，从一个影响函数手工构造 AIPW、TMLE、DML 三种双稳健估计量，六个估计值仅落在 3.32–3.42 kg。对齐库与折并平均单次切分噪声后，三个库共享实现一致到 0.01 kg 以内，说明残余差异来自 nuisance 库、折与重复而非估计量标签；但重叠性 (positivity) 违反时 pooled ATE 不可识别，估计会急剧分歧，因此应先做 positivity 诊断再选估计量。
Motivation: 应用研究者在 AIPW、TMLE、DML 之间选择时常把数值差异误归因于估计量本身，而实际差异可能来自 nuisance 设定；重叠性违反下的不可识别风险也需在选估计量前排查。
Method: 在开放 NHEFS 数据 (n=1566) 上，用一个共享 Super Learner 库与相同交叉拟合折，从同一个 efficient influence function 手工构造三种估计量的 full-sample、cross-fit、double-cross-fit 六个变体；再与自有 engine 及 tmle、AIPW、DoubleML、tmle3 四个 R 包在同一 estimand 上对账，并给出 no-overlap 示例与报告清单。
Result: 六个手工双稳健估计值跨度 3.32–3.42 kg，与既有 benchmark 一致；四个包在默认设置下跨度 3.32–3.49 kg；对齐库与折并平均单次切分噪声后三个实现一致到 0.01 kg 以内；重叠性违反时有限样本估计可急剧分歧。
Conclusion: 三种路线的残余差异源于 nuisance 库、折与重复而非估计量标签，选择估计量之前应先做 positivity 诊断，并附报告清单与可复现 R 代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ChainUQ: Reasoning Consistency-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) exhibit impressive reasoning capabilities, response-level confidence may remain unreliable when intermediate claims conflict with the final conclusion. Therefore, effective uncertainty quantification (UQ) is required to capture logical inconsistencies within the reasoning chain, not just the correctness of the final output. Current approaches have two major limitations: (1) their reliance on token-level probabilities fails to capture reasoning consistency, and (2) they lack mechanisms to dynamically calibrate confidence using the structural logic of the generated chain. To advance existing research, we introduce ChainUQ, a reasoning consistency-aware uncertainty quantification framework for LLMs. ChainUQ consists of two key technical components: an alignment-aware lightweight UQ module that estimates a raw intrinsic model confidence score from frozen features aligned to the final conclusion, and a reasoning consistency-aware calibrator that refines this score using reasoning-chain consistency evidence. Evaluations across diverse in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks show that ChainUQ consistently improves response-level uncertainty estimation, achieving an average 3.1% relative gain in AUROC and up to 45.0% relative reduction in ECE, and can be directly transferred to new settings without additional fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChainUQ 针对 LLM 推理链内部矛盾导致响应级置信度失真的问题，用对齐感知的轻量 UQ 模块从冻结特征估计与最终结论对齐的原始置信分，再由推理一致性校准器用链上一致性证据修正。在分布内与分布外基准上平均 AUROC 相对提升 3.1%，ECE 相对下降最多 45.0%，且可零微调迁移到新设置。
Motivation: LLM 中间论断可能与最终结论冲突，而仅靠 token 级概率的响应级置信度既抓不住推理一致性，也无法用链结构动态校准置信度。
Method: ChainUQ 含两个组件：alignment-aware 轻量 UQ 模块从与最终结论对齐的冻结特征估计原始内在置信分；reasoning consistency-aware calibrator 用推理链一致性证据对该分数做校准。
Result: 在多样分布内与分布外基准上，平均 AUROC 相对提升 3.1%，ECE 相对下降最多 45.0%，且无需额外微调即可直接迁移到新设置。
Conclusion: 把推理链一致性作为校准信号能稳定改善 LLM 响应级不确定性估计，并具备跨设置直接迁移能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CricRAG: Retrieval Augmented Vision-Language Models for Personalized Cricket Coaching
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer promising capabilities for automated sports coaching but face a fundamental limitation: they implicitly compare against professional standards, making their feedback impractical for developing players. We present CricRAG, a retrieval-augmented framework that aligns VLMs with skill-appropriate benchmarks for personalized cricket coaching. Our key insight is that by retrieving similar-but-better techniques as reference points, we can guide VLMs to provide developmentally appropriate feedback that mirrors human coaching practices. We contribute: (1) a labelled dataset of 288 cricket technique videos spanning multiple skill levels, (2) an efficient motion retrieval pipeline using contrastive learning that achieves 78% top-3 retrieval accuracy, (3) a frame sampling technique that reduces inference costs, and (4) a retrieval-augmented approach that significantly improves feedback alignment with coaching principles, achieving up to 94% agreement with professional assessments compared to 67% without retrieval context.
papers.comment: AAAI 25 - Towards Knowledgeable Foundational Models workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CricRAG 用检索增强把 VLM 的板球技术反馈对齐到与球员水平相称的基准：检索「相似但更好」的动作作为参照，而非职业标准。对比学习训练的运动检索管线在 288 段多水平板球技术视频上取得 78% top-3 检索准确率，反馈与专业评估的一致性从无检索上下文的 67% 提到最高 94%。
Motivation: VLM 自动体育教学默认对标职业标准，对发展中的业余球员给出的反馈不切实际，无法按个人水平给出循序渐进的指导。
Method: 构建 288 段覆盖多技能水平的板球技术视频标注数据集；用对比学习训练运动检索管线，按「相似但更好」原则召回参照动作；再加帧采样降低推理成本，把检索到的参照注入 VLM 生成反馈。
Result: 运动检索管线 top-3 检索准确率 78%；检索增强后反馈与专业评估一致率最高 94%，无检索上下文时为 67%；帧采样技术降低推理成本（摘要未给具体降幅）。
Conclusion: 把参照从职业标准换成同水平但略优的示范，VLM 反馈能更贴合教练原则，即检索上下文是让 VLM 反馈具备发展适配性的关键。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: VACS: Value-Aligned Compositional Shielding for Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reasoning systems in high-stakes domains must be both accurate and safe, yet agents often follow heterogeneous value priorities (e.g., rigor, conciseness, safety), causing conflicting recommendations. Existing methods do not jointly provide: (i) principled inference of each agent's implicit values from behavior, (ii) compositional formal safety guarantees without full online communication, and (iii) value-aware conflict resolution with faithful explanations. We present VACS (Value-Aligned Compositional Shielding), a four-layer framework addressing all three. Layer 1 learns value-dimension rewards from pairwise preferences using Bradley-Terry modeling and infers per-agent value weights via deep MaxEnt IRL. Layer 2 encodes value constraints in a Lean-inspired DSL and synthesizes compositional assume-guarantee shields for runtime safety. Layer 3 resolves disagreement through nucleolus-based credit allocation and Hamiltonian consensus optimization under long-term value constraints. Layer 4 extracts a critical reasoning path from co-state sensitivities and generates formally grounded natural-language explanations. Our contribution is primarily a unified systems design with formalized interfaces and operational guarantees at the verifier-constrained decision level, rather than a complete end-to-end formal proof of all language-model internals. In controlled proof-of-concept evaluations with role-conditioned agent panels on NEJM-AI QA, MathInstruct-Subset, and a cybersecurity incident-response benchmark (CyberSec-Eval), VACS outperforms strong baselines in accuracy (85.4%, 95.0%, and 90.0%) while reducing logical inconsistency rates to near zero.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VACS 用四层框架把多智能体的价值冲突变成可验证的安全约束：先从偏好学出各智能体的价值权重，再合成组合式 assume-guarantee shield 做运行时防护，用 nucleolus 分摊与 Hamiltonian 共识消解分歧，最后从共态灵敏度抽取关键推理路径生成形式化解释。在 NEJM-AI QA、MathInstruct-Subset、CyberSec-Eval 三个受控概念验证上，准确率分别达 85.4%、95.0%、90.0%，逻辑不一致率降到接近零。
Motivation: 高风险领域的多智能体系统常因各 agent 价值优先级不同（严谨、简洁、安全）给出冲突建议，而现有方法无法同时做到从行为推断隐式价值、在不全量在线通信下给出组合式形式化安全保证、以及带忠实解释的价值感知冲突消解。
Method: 四层框架：Layer 1 用 Bradley-Terry 建模从成对偏好学价值维度奖励，并用深度 MaxEnt IRL 推断各 agent 的价值权重；Layer 2 用 Lean-inspired DSL 编码价值约束并合成组合式 assume-guarantee shields 做运行时安全；Layer 3 用 nucleolus 分摊与 Hamiltonian 共识优化在长期价值约束下消解分歧；Layer 4 从共态灵敏度 (co-state sensitivities) 抽取关键推理路径生成形式化支撑的自然语言解释。
Result: 在角色条件化的 agent 面板受控概念验证中，VACS 于 NEJM-AI QA、MathInstruct-Subset、CyberSec-Eval 上准确率分别为 85.4%、95.0%、90.0%，均超过强基线，同时把逻辑不一致率降到接近零。
Conclusion: 作者主张贡献主要是带形式化接口与操作性保证的统一系统设计（在 verifier-constrained 决策层面），而非对语言模型内部的完整端到端形式化证明。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: StepTrigger: Contact-State-Triggered Backdoor Attacks on VLM-Powered Legged Robots
papers.abstract_en: Large language models and vision-language models are increasingly used as high-level planners in robotic systems, using task goals and sensor summaries to select navigation or manipulation actions. This creates a new backdoor surface: a compromised planner can behave normally in most runs, yet change its target selection when a hidden trigger is present. Prior attacks on LLM-powered or embodied agents mainly rely on triggers that appear in language, camera-visible objects, scene semantics, or specific sequences of past actions. This paper presents StepTrigger, a contact-state-triggered backdoor attack for VLM-powered legged robots. The trigger is not a prompt token or a visible marker. It is produced by pressure and foot-ground contact patterns that arise when a Unitree Go1 quadruped walks across a dense terrain patch. Unlike conventional visual or textual triggers, contact signals are inherently noisy and may also arise during benign locomotion. To avoid treating every pressure anomaly as a trigger, StepTrigger learns a selective backdoor policy from multimodal robot state, using incidental pressure events as benign examples and dense-patch contacts as poisoned examples. In a stratified offline evaluation, the trained planner achieved 98.75% clean behavior preservation, 92.50% false-trigger rejection, 76.25% true-trigger activation, and 89.17% overall parsed behavior accuracy. These results reveal a backdoor surface in proprioceptive and contact channels that is not captured by defenses focused only on language, vision, or action history.

papers.title: FairMon: A Tool for Monitoring and Visualizing Algorithmic Fairness
papers.abstract_en: Runtime monitoring has recently been proposed as a rigorous method for analyzing algorithmic fairness of autonomous decision systems used in critical scenarios such as credit lending, job application, and the criminal justice system. Prior work has shown that runtime monitoring, in principle, can be an effective technique for establishing the kind of human oversight required by legislation such as the EU Artificial Intelligence Act. In practice, the available monitoring tools have not been developed with this application in mind and display several critical shortcomings in these scenarios. In this paper, we present FairMon, a runtime monitoring tool tailored to fairness analysis of high-stakes decision systems. FairMon uses RTLola as a flexible specification language for monitors, which we have extended with conditional probability operators that allow for concise descriptions of algorithmic fairness properties. The tool also features a real-time visualization of intermediary values, enabling human insight into the dynamics of the monitored system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FairMon 是面向高风险自主决策系统（信贷、招聘、刑事司法）的算法公平性运行时监控工具，用 RTLola 作为监控规约语言并扩展了条件概率算子，使公平性性质能简洁写出，同时实时可视化中间值以支持人工监督。
Motivation: 运行时监控已被提出作为建立 EU AI Act 所要求人工监督的手段，但现有监控工具并非为此类高风险公平性场景设计，存在关键缺陷。
Method: 以 RTLola 为监控规约语言并扩展条件概率算子 (conditional probability operators) 来描述算法公平性性质；工具内建对监控中间值的实时可视化。
Result: 提出并实现 FairMon 工具，包含 RTLola 扩展的条件概率算子与中间值实时可视化；摘要给出的是工具本身而非基准数字。
Conclusion: 把条件概率算子嵌入 RTLola 并配上实时可视化，可让运行时监控具体承担高风险决策系统的公平性人工监督。

papers.title: Deepfakes and Synthetic Media: Generation, Detection, and Governance
papers.abstract_en: Deepfakes, synthetic audiovisual content produced by deep generative models, have escalated into a critical threat across civilian and military domains, enabling identity fraud, disinformation campaigns, and evidence fabrication. In high-stakes environments, ranging from journalism and finance to healthcare and legal contexts, the consequences extend to severe misinformation, market manipulation, identity fraud, and the erosion of institutional trust. This entry explores how modern visual intelligence and computer vision techniques are used to detect deepfakes. It outlines key deepfake generation models, such as GANs, autoencoders, neural rendering, and diffusion systems, while also explaining how adversarial methods enhance realism and challenge existing detectors. The overview highlights visual artifacts, digital patterns, and physiological cues commonly leveraged in detection and reviews major CNN, transformer, and frequency-based approaches. It also summarizes evaluation practices and the difficulty of achieving strong generalization. Finally, it identifies emerging directions, including modern intelligence techniques for civilian and military content verification. This survey covers generation architectures (GANs, latent diffusion, neural rendering, video synthesis), the spatial, temporal, frequency-domain, and physiological artifacts they produce, and the detector families that exploit them. We examine evaluation benchmarks and protocols, highlighting cross-generator generalization as the field's central open challenge. Beyond detection, we discuss cryptographic provenance standards, watermarking, and regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act, DSA, GDPR). We conclude that effective deepfake governance requires defense-in-depth integrating forensic detection, verifiable provenance, and institutional accountability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 deepfake 生成与检测的综述，覆盖 GAN、自编码器、latent diffusion、神经渲染与视频合成等生成架构，以及它们在空间、时间、频域和生理层面留下的伪影，和利用这些伪影的 CNN、transformer、频域检测器族。核心论断是跨生成器泛化 (cross-generator generalization) 是该领域最突出的开放难题，并主张治理须走 defense-in-depth：取证检测、可验证来源 (provenance) 与机构问责三者叠加。
Motivation: 深度伪造已从身份欺诈扩展到虚假信息与证据伪造，而现有检测器在换生成器后泛化差，单靠检测不足以支撑新闻、金融、医疗、司法等高风险场景的可信度。
Method: 按生成架构（GAN、自编码器、latent diffusion、神经渲染、视频合成）梳理其产生的空间、时间、频域与生理伪影，对应综述 CNN、transformer、频域三类检测方法；同时汇总评测基准与协议，并纳入水印、密码学来源标准与 EU AI Act、DSA、GDPR 等监管框架。
Result: 作为 30 页、2 图、3 表、120 篇参考文献的综述，给出生成模型、伪影类型、检测器族与评测协议的系统对照，指出跨生成器泛化是核心开放挑战，并总结现有评测难以取得强泛化表现。
Conclusion: 有效的 deepfake 治理必须是 defense-in-depth，把取证检测、可验证来源与机构问责整合起来，而不能只依赖检测模型。

papers.title: When Big Data Becomes a Curse: Spatial Heterogeneity and the Limits of Learning from Passive Acoustic Monitoring Data
papers.abstract_en: Passive Acoustic Monitoring produces large archives whose recordings are clustered by deployment, season, station identifier, and acquisition configuration. We analyze 908,072 AIS-labeled 679-second recordings from 38 deployments, 20 Atlantic Canadian station identifiers, and 21 receiver positions. The AIS-contact prior varies by more than 200-fold, and per-deployment screening distributions require local interpretation. Bidirectional cross-season transfer over the 18 station identifiers observed in both seasons predicts station identity above the 5.56% uniform-chance level, with balanced accuracy of 15.9% for AIS-contact and 16.4% for no-AIS-contact recordings. The same descriptors predict the two hydrophone models at 74.1% and 85.6% balanced accuracy, respectively, but hydrophone model is strongly confounded with season and other deployment-level acquisition differences. On a retrospectively screened and capped benchmark of 54m507 recordings, repeated station-grouped holdout yields an ROC-AUC of 0.612 with a station-bootstrap 95% interval of 0.582 to 0.648, compared with 0.661 under a random-window diagnostic. Their paired difference is 0.049 (0.040 to 0.056). Removing raw energy changes unseen-station ROC-AUC from 0.612 to 0.603, while an exploratory training-station scale analysis is non-monotonic. These results show that random-window validation overstates transfer to unseen station identifiers in this corpus. They support dependence-aware validation and broader independent spatial sampling, while spatial-expert models remain a hypothesis rather than an established remedy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 被动声学监测 (PAM) 大档案中，部署、季节、站点与采集配置的强空间异质性使随机窗口验证高估模型对未见站点的迁移能力。在 54,507 条录音的筛查基准上，按站点分组留出的 ROC-AUC 为 0.612（station-bootstrap 95% 区间 0.582–0.648），而随机窗口诊断为 0.661，配对差 0.049（0.040–0.056）。作者主张采用依赖感知 (dependence-aware) 验证与更广的独立空间采样，空间专家模型目前仍只是假设。
Motivation: PAM 录音按部署、季节、站点标识与采集配置成簇，AIS-contact 先验跨部署相差 200 倍以上；随机窗口划分把同站点信息泄漏进测试集，使对未见站点的迁移被系统性高估。
Method: 分析 908,072 条 AIS 标注的 679 秒录音（38 个部署、20 个 Atlantic Canadian 站点标识、21 个接收器位置），做跨季节双向迁移并用同一组描述子预测站点身份与水听器型号；再在回溯筛查并封顶的 54,507 条录音基准上比较按站点分组留出与随机窗口两种验证，并做去除原始能量的消融与训练站点尺度的探索性分析。
Result: 18 个双季节共有站点上，站点身份预测高于 5.56% 均匀随机水平，AIS-contact 与 no-AIS-contact 录音的 balanced accuracy 分别为 15.9% 与 16.4%；同一描述子预测两种水听器型号的 balanced accuracy 达 74.1% 与 85.6%，但水听器型号与季节及部署级采集差异强混杂。站点分组留出 ROC-AUC 0.612（95% 区间 0.582–0.648），随机窗口 0.661，配对差 0.049（0.040–0.056）；去掉原始能量后未见站点 ROC-AUC 从 0.612 降至 0.603，训练站点尺度分析非单调。
Conclusion: 随机窗口验证在该语料上会高估对未见站点的迁移，应改用依赖感知验证并扩大独立空间采样；空间专家模型尚属待检验假设而非既定解法。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: DTOC: Dynamic Tool Output Compression for Adaptive Context Management in AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: As agent capabilities have grown, practical limitations increasingly stem from constrained context windows rather than model capacity. Common strategies, such as truncation, heuristic aging, and lossy summarization, may discard useful information or introduce hallucination risk. To address these challenges, we propose Dynamic Tool Output Compression (DTOC), a framework for scalable context management in LLM-based agents that models context updates as explicit and reversible operations within the agent reasoning loop. DTOC retains full tool outputs in external memory while inserting compact placeholders into the active context, enabling selective reconstruction when needed. We formalize the DTOC mechanism, integrate it into a ReAct-style agent architecture, and provide a production-oriented implementation supporting on-demand restoration of compressed outputs. Experiments on DeepSWE reveal model-dependent effects: for responsive models (Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4), DTOC reduces input tokens (10.3 and 12.7%) and agent steps (2.4 and 32.3%), while increasing solve rates (2.5 and 1.5 times higher) and lowering cost per solved task (3 and 3.5 times lower cost per solved task). For the other models results are more mixed, with GPT-5.5 doubling solve rate and halving cost, but no impact on solve rate and negative impact on cost for the other models. Ablation results show reversibility is critical: disable-only compression variants degraded performance, while full DTOC recovered baseline accuracy at substantially lower context cost. These findings indicate that explicit, reversible context management can improve the efficiency of long-horizon agent reasoning without degrading task performance.
papers.comment: Accepted for 29th International Conference on Discovery Science, October 5-9, 2026, Mainz, Germany
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DTOC 把 LLM agent 的工具输出完整留在外部记忆，只在活跃上下文里插入可逆占位符，需要时按需恢复。在 DeepSWE 上，对响应型模型 Sonnet 4.6 与 GPT-5.4 输入 token 降 10.3% 与 12.7%、agent 步数降 2.4% 与 32.3%，解题率提高 2.5 与 1.5 倍、单题成本降 3 与 3.5 倍；消融显示去掉可逆恢复的纯压缩变体性能下降，完整 DTOC 以低得多的上下文开销回到基线精度。
Motivation: agent 能力增长后瓶颈转向受限的上下文窗口；截断、启发式老化和有损摘要会丢掉有用信息或引入幻觉风险。
Method: DTOC 将上下文更新建模为推理回路中显式且可逆的操作：外部记忆保留完整工具输出，活跃上下文只放紧凑占位符，按需选择性重建；机制被形式化并集成进 ReAct 式架构，附带支持按需恢复的生产向实现。
Result: DeepSWE 上，Sonnet 4.6 与 GPT-5.4 输入 token 分别减少 10.3% 与 12.7%，agent 步数减少 2.4% 与 32.3%，解题率分别提高 2.5 倍与 1.5 倍，单题成本分别降低 3 倍与 3.5 倍；GPT-5.5 解题率翻倍、成本减半；其余模型解题率无变化且成本变差。消融中 disable-only 压缩变体性能下降，完整 DTOC 恢复基线精度且上下文开销大幅降低。

papers.title: Vorch-Human: Unified Multi-Task Human-Centric Generation via Long-Horizon Continuation
papers.abstract_en: Human-centric audio-visual generation spans several closely related tasks: animating a person from driving speech, jointly generating speech and video from a voice reference, and synthesizing a scene from paired appearance and voice references. Existing systems commonly solve these tasks with separate models, even though they share the same target modalities and differ mainly in which observations are provided as conditions. We present Vorch-Human, a unified human-centric generation framework built on a dual-stream audio-video diffusion transformer. Vorch-Human augments the conventional noisy audio/noisy video interface with clean condition-audio and condition-video token groups. Per-token task embeddings, temporal position types, condition masks, and a shared multimodal prompt encoder allow driving speech, timbre examples, first frames, and subject images to be expressed within one model. To supply the supervision required by this interface, we develop a two-level data pipeline. Level 1 analyzes each clip with speech recognition, vocal separation, face detection and tracking, active-speaker and synchronization models, audio/visual speaker clustering, and multimodal caption correction; it produces subject-indexed speech, appearance, and timbre annotations. Level 2 links the same person across clips from a common source video and mines identity- and outfit-consistent reference images after face, body, quality, pose, and vision-language verification. Finally, we adapt Vorch-Human to long-form audio-driven generation by training with clean latent prefixes and using the same frozen-prefix recurrence at inference. Each segment contributes only its newly generated suffix, reducing boundary discontinuity and long-horizon identity drift. Experiments on short and five-minute generation demonstrate strong identity preservation, audio-visual synchronization, and temporal stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Vorch-Human 用单一 dual-stream audio-video diffusion transformer 统一三个人类中心生成任务（说话驱动动画、音视频联合生成、外观+声音参考合成场景），做法是在常规 noisy audio/noisy video 接口上追加 clean condition-audio 与 condition-video token 组，配合 per-token 任务嵌入、时间位置类型、条件掩码与共享多模态 prompt 编码器。长时程生成靠 clean latent prefix 训练加推理时同一冻结前缀递归，每段只保留新生成的后缀，从而减少边界不连续与身份漂移；在短片段与五分钟生成实验中展示出强身份保持、音画同步与时间稳定性。
Motivation: 说话驱动动画、音视频联合生成、外观与声音参考合成场景通常由各自独立的模型承担，尽管它们目标模态相同，差别只在于提供了哪些条件观测。
Method: dual-stream audio-video diffusion transformer，在 noisy audio/noisy video 之外加入 clean condition-audio 与 condition-video token 组；用 per-token task embeddings、temporal position types、condition masks 和共享多模态 prompt 编码器把 driving speech、timbre 样例、首帧、人物图像统一进一个模型。配套两级数据管线：Level 1 用语音识别、人声分离、人脸检测跟踪、active-speaker 与同步模型、音视频说话人聚类、多模态字幕校正产出按主体索引的语音/外观/timbre 标注；Level 2 在同一源视频跨片段关联同一人，并经人脸、人体、质量、姿态与视觉语言校验挖掘身份和服装一致的参考图。长时程用 clean latent prefix 训练，推理沿用同一冻结前缀递归，每段只贡献新生成的后缀。
Result: 在短片段与五分钟生成实验中展示出强身份保持、音画同步与时间稳定性；冻结前缀递归加每段只保留新后缀的策略用于降低边界不连续与长时程身份漂移。
Conclusion: 把条件观测差异编码进统一的 token 接口，一个模型即可覆盖多个人类中心生成任务，并可直接扩展到五分钟级音频驱动长时程生成。

papers.title: FusionMMT: A Unified Multimodal and Multitask Learning Framework for Nuclear Fusion
papers.abstract_en: With the growing global demand for energy, nuclear fusion has emerged as a promising direction for future clean energy. Tokamaks represent one of the leading approaches to magnetic-confinement fusion. Achieving high-performance, long-pulse, and steady-state operation requires effective diagnosis of plasma states. However, existing intelligent diagnostic methods are largely limited to either multimodal single-task or unimodal multitask learning, while a unified multimodal multitask learning framework remains underexplored. To address this gap, we construct EAST-VTD640, a multimodal multitask dataset that integrates vision and time-series diagnostics from 640 EAST shots for disruption prediction, edge-localized mode (ELM) recognition, and H98 regression. On this basis, we present FusionMMT, the first unified multimodal multitask framework for intelligent tokamak plasma diagnostics. FusionMMT employs multi-scale, time-aware, and variable-aware modeling to handle heterogeneous sampling rates and the high computational cost of high-frequency sequences. It further combines task-adaptive multimodal fusion with progressive multitask optimization to learn shared and task-specific representations while mitigating cross-task conflicts and optimization imbalance. Extensive experiments on EAST-VTD640 show that FusionMMT outperforms representative multimodal multitask methods across disruption prediction, ELM recognition, and H98 regression. The source code will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FusionMMT 把托卡马克等离子体诊断统一成多模态多任务学习：以 EAST-VTD640（640 次 EAST 放电的视觉+时间序列）同时做破裂预测、ELM 识别与 H98 回归，用任务自适应融合与渐进式多任务优化缓解跨任务冲突和优化失衡。在 EAST-VTD640 上，它在三个任务上均优于代表性多模态多任务方法。
Motivation: 现有智能诊断方法局限于多模态单任务或单模态多任务，缺少统一的多模态多任务框架；而托卡马克高性能长脉冲稳态运行需要同时诊断多种等离子体状态，且诊断信号采样率异构、高频序列计算代价高。
Method: 先构建 EAST-VTD640 数据集，整合 640 次 EAST shots 的视觉与时间序列诊断；FusionMMT 采用多尺度、时间感知与变量感知建模处理异构采样率和高频序列开销，再结合任务自适应多模态融合 (task-adaptive multimodal fusion) 与渐进式多任务优化 (progressive multitask optimization) 学习共享与任务特异表示。
Result: 在 EAST-VTD640 上，FusionMMT 在破裂预测、ELM 识别与 H98 回归三个任务上均超过代表性多模态多任务方法；数据集覆盖 640 次 EAST shots。
Conclusion: 统一的多模态多任务框架可用于托卡马克等离子体诊断，同时缓解跨任务冲突与优化失衡；源代码将在 github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion 发布。

papers.title: Match One, Learn with Graph: One-to-Graph Query Collaboration with Backward Sharing for Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: One-to-one (O2O) matching enables Detection Transformers (DETRs) to perform end-to-end set prediction by assigning each object to a single positive query. However, the strongest classification, center, scale, and overlap evidence for an object is often distributed across multiple queries. This mismatch leaves only the matched owner positively supervised for the object, while other evidence-bearing queries receive no box target for it. We term this query knowledge fragmentation. To exploit such complementary evidence without one-to-many supervision, we propose BS-O2G, a plug-in that builds a sparse prediction-aware graph from decoded features, boxes, and class distributions to organize query collaboration in feature and optimization spaces while preserving the original O2O matcher, positive labels, and objective. One-to-Graph (O2G) calibration propagates relative messages over this graph to consolidate query evidence in the forward pass, whereas Backward Sharing (BS) reuses its transposed detached adjacency to route gradients across persistent query basis vectors without changing the decoder input in the forward pass. Experiments across diverse DETR methods, backbones, COCO, and CrowdHuman show consistent gains and faster convergence with negligible parameter/FLOP growth and modest runtime overhead, supporting graph-based query collaboration as an alternative to expanding positive assignments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BS-O2G 把 DETR 中分散在多个 query 里的互补证据用稀疏预测图组织起来：前向用 One-to-Graph 校准传播相对消息聚合证据，反向用转置且 detach 的邻接在持久 query 基向量间共享梯度，同时保留原 O2O 匹配、正标签与目标。在多种 DETR 方法、骨干网络以及 COCO 与 CrowdHuman 上取得一致增益并加快收敛，参数量与 FLOP 增长可忽略、运行时开销适度。
Motivation: O2O 匹配只把一个 query 作为该物体的正样本，而分类、中心、尺度与重叠证据往往分散在多个 query 上，其余带证据的 query 拿不到该物体的框目标，形成 query 知识碎片化。
Method: BS-O2G 是即插即用模块：从解码特征、框与类别分布构建稀疏预测感知图，One-to-Graph (O2G) 校准在前向沿图传播相对消息以聚合 query 证据，Backward Sharing (BS) 复用其转置且 detach 的邻接，在持久 query 基向量之间路由梯度，前向不改变 decoder 输入，也不改动原 O2O 匹配器与目标函数。
Result: 在多种 DETR 方法与骨干网络、COCO 和 CrowdHuman 上均取得一致增益并更快收敛，参数量与 FLOP 增长可忽略，运行时开销适度。
Conclusion: 基于图的 query 协作可以在不扩展正样本分配的前提下替代 one-to-many 监督，缓解 O2O 训练中的知识碎片化。

papers.title: MIAR: Medical Image Super-Resolution With Autoregressive Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Medical Image Super-Resolution (MISR) aims to enhance spatial resolution without requiring hardware modifications. Although deep learning has yielded promising results, existing paradigms face a critical trade-off: diffusion-based methods suffer from prohibitive inference latency and compromised structural fidelity, whereas regression-based models typically produce over-smoothed results that lack perceptual realism. To address these limitations, we propose MIAR, which reformulates super-resolution as a conditional and progressive next-scale prediction task through a multi-scale autoregressive framework. To ensure structural fidelity, we augment the autoregressive backbone with a Scale-Adaptive Structural Decoder. Furthermore, we integrate a hierarchical beam search strategy during inference to mitigate the recursive error accumulation inherent in autoregressive generation, a phenomenon that is especially pronounced in medical images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MIAR establishes new state-of-the-art benchmarks while maintaining superior fidelity. Notably, our framework achieves a 7.86% improvement in the perceptual metric MUSIQ compared with the state of the art, while simultaneously delivering a 2.02x speedup over diffusion-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIAR 把医学图像超分辨率 (MISR) 重构为条件化的逐尺度 next-scale 预测任务，用多尺度自回归框架加 Scale-Adaptive Structural Decoder 保证结构保真，并在推理时用分层 beam search 抑制递归误差累积。相比扩散式方法，MUSIQ 感知指标提升 7.86%，同时获得 2.02 倍加速。
Motivation: 扩散式医学图像超分推理延迟高且结构保真受损，回归式模型则输出过度平滑、缺乏感知真实感的结果，两条路线都卡在同一权衡上。
Method: 多尺度自回归骨干把超分建模为条件化渐进式 next-scale 预测，外接 Scale-Adaptive Structural Decoder 维持结构保真；推理阶段引入分层 beam search 缓解自回归递归误差累积（该现象在医学图像中尤为突出）。
Result: 在与最先进方法的对比中建立新的 SOTA 基准并保持更优保真度：感知指标 MUSIQ 相对 SOTA 提升 7.86%，相对扩散式方法获得 2.02 倍加速。
Conclusion: 自回归逐尺度预测加 beam search 可以同时改善医学图像超分的感知质量与推理速度，绕开扩散模型的延迟-保真权衡。

papers.title: One Domain, Many Tongues: Composing Domain and Language LoRAs for Cross-Lingual Remote-Sensing MLLMs without Paired Data
papers.abstract_en: Remote-sensing (RS) multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are trained and evaluated only in English, while text-only instruction data covers over 100 languages. We propose MODL (Mutually Orthogonal Domain-Language composition), a recipe that adds new languages to an English RS MLLM without a single multilingual RS example: a domain LoRA trained on English RS imagery and a language LoRA trained on text alone are learned jointly, under one loss term that keeps the two updates mutually orthogonal at every layer throughout training. This constraint is the recipe's active ingredient. Without it, the same training answers RS questions correctly but in English, erases much of the base model's multilingual text ability, and diverges on one seed in three; sixteen alternatives, from training-free merging to prior orthogonality variants, fail the same way. A single five-language adapter retains English, Spanish, and Vietnamese at full strength across three seeds; non-Latin scripts remain an open boundary.

papers.title: RECAP: Relation Evidence Calibration for Detecting Spatial Relation Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models can answer spatial relation questions confidently even when the image supports an incompatible relation. We formulate relation-grounded selective prediction: accept or reject an already-produced yes/no answer by auditing its visual support, rather than treating uncertainty as evidence. RECAP, our relation-evidence calibration framework, compares image-conditioned likelihoods for a claim, its semantic contradictions, and optional one-sided supports, then converts these witnesses into an answer-conditioned rejection risk. A calibration-only gate preserves confidence as a veto when confidence is demonstrably informative and otherwise deploys relation evidence alone. Across 20 group/image-disjoint splits, RECAP lowers H-FPR@80 over confidence by between 2.0 and 17.9 points on VSR and raises Acc@80 by 3.0, 8.6, and 12.6 points on What'sUp for Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL3.5-8B, and LLaVA-1.5-7B. It outperforms matched VCD-style visual contrast on all four primary metrics in all six settings. Full-pool VSR fallback, target-ranked GSR-Bench transfer, equal-budget supervised controls, and two additional checkpoints show a consistent operating principle: structured counterevidence complements certainty when confidence is misaligned, while the gate retains confidence when it is already useful.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/SouthWinter/RECAP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RECAP 把空间关系幻觉检测重构成关系证据校准的选择性预测问题：对已产出的 yes/no 答案，比较图像条件下原命题、语义矛盾命题与可选单侧支撑的似然，转成答案条件化的拒绝风险，再用仅校准的门控决定是否保留置信度作否决。在 VSR 上 20 组图像不相交划分中 H-FPR@80 比纯置信度低 2.0 到 17.9 个百分点，What'sUp 上 Acc@80 对 Qwen3-VL-8B、InternVL3.5-8B、LLaVA-1.5-7B 分别提高 3.0、8.6、12.6 个百分点。
Motivation: VLM 在图像不支持的关系上仍会高置信作答，而把不确定性本身当证据的拒答策略在置信度失准时失效，需要一种审计视觉支撑而非只看置信度的选择性预测机制。
Method: RECAP 框架比较图像条件似然下的命题、语义矛盾与可选单侧支撑三类见证，映射为答案条件化拒绝风险；校准阶段学一个门控，置信度可证有用时保留其否决权，否则只用关系证据。评测覆盖 VSR、What'sUp、GSR-Bench，含全池 VSR fallback、目标重排迁移、等预算监督对照与两个额外 checkpoint，并对比 VCD 式视觉对比。
Result: 20 组 group/image-disjoint 划分上，VSR 的 H-FPR@80 比置信度基线低 2.0 至 17.9 个百分点；What'sUp 的 Acc@80 提升 3.0、8.6、12.6 个百分点（Qwen3-VL-8B、InternVL3.5-8B、LLaVA-1.5-7B）。在全部六种设置的四项主指标上均优于匹配的 VCD 式视觉对比。
Conclusion: 结构化反证在置信度失准时补足确定性，而门控在置信度本就有用时保留它；这一操作原则在 VSR fallback、GSR-Bench 迁移、等预算监督对照与额外 checkpoint 上一致成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BDSLI: A hybrid CNN-Transformer model for Bengali Sign Language interpretation
papers.abstract_en: This study introduces a novel hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture to address the limited progress in Bengali SLR, focusing on isolated sign word recognition and sentence generation. This specific model combination is new to Bengali SLR tasks. A custom video dataset was developed, featuring 62 distinct Bengali sign words (250 samples/class), along with a separate test dataset. The CNN-Transformer model demonstrated superior performance against all comparative and baseline models (e.g., CNN-LSTM, standalone TCN), achieving a 99.58% training accuracy (99.48% validation) and a 98.65% test accuracy. The trained model was subsequently deployed in a web application for real-world validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向孟加拉语孤立词手语识别 (Bengali SLR) 的混合 CNN-Transformer 架构，用于孤立词识别与句子生成。在自建的 62 个孟加拉语手势词、每类 250 样本的视频数据集上，测试准确率 98.65%，优于 CNN-LSTM、独立 TCN 等对比与基线模型，并部署到 Web 应用做真实场景验证。
Motivation: 孟加拉语手语识别 (SLR) 进展有限，且该 CNN-Transformer 组合此前未用于孟加拉语 SLR 任务。
Method: 构建混合 CNN-Transformer 架构处理视频序列，自建含 62 个孟加拉语手势词、每类 250 样本的定制视频数据集并另设独立测试集；训练后部署到 Web 应用做真实使用验证。
Result: 训练准确率 99.58%，验证准确率 99.48%，测试准确率 98.65%，在全部对比与基线模型（如 CNN-LSTM、独立 TCN）之上表现更优。
Conclusion: CNN-Transformer 混合架构对孟加拉语孤立词手语识别有效，并可部署到 Web 应用落地。

papers.title: Fast Matrix Multiplication in fp8: Certified Coefficient Optimization and Measured Error
papers.abstract_en: A Strassen-type algorithm has many realizations with the same exact product and multiplication count yet different fp8 error because basis changes reshape coefficient geometry, posing the question of which to run. No current account settles this: classical stability controls worst-case $\ell_1$ growth, not the expected-error magnitude, and the Dumas--Pernet--Sedoglavic optimizer could only be called probably optimal, its global optimality unproved. To settle this, we attach to each realization a coefficient functional $Φ$, a scalar summary of its coefficient geometry, which we minimize over the change-of-basis orbit. This Kempf--Ness problem on a Hadamard manifold lets us certify the global $Φ$ optimum rather than merely search for it: an exact moment-map zero fixes $Φ_{\min} = 200/9$, and de Groote's classification extends that optimality to every exact real rank-7 $2\times2$ decomposition. Every exact real rank-7 realization therefore has a $Φ$-predicted RMS constant at least $5/3$ times that of the cubic algorithm, at fixed noise coefficient. We then introduce an explicit block-scaled e4m3 model in which $Φ$ is the leading-order coefficient of relative expected mean-squared error, and we test the resulting $Φ$-predicted ordering against realized fp8 error. Ordering and re-basing experiments support that prediction within tested fused block-scaled regimes, and on real matmul tiles from four architecture families the $Φ$-optimal realization falls in the fp8 low-error region. Across two $\sim$70B models on real deep_gemm kernels, the same realization removes 10 to 55% of classic Strassen's excess NLL over the clean model. Algorithm realization thus becomes a mathematically certified design problem rather than a tuning choice: an independent low-precision axis with a global $Φ$ optimum and measured fp8 relevance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 同一 Strassen 型 rank-7 2×2 矩阵乘法有多种实现，本文用系数泛函 Φ 在换基轨道上做 Kempf–Ness 优化，精确 moment-map 零点给出全局最优 Φ_min=200/9，并由 de Groote 分类推广到所有精确实 rank-7 分解。所有此类实现的 Φ 预测 RMS 常数至少是三次算法的 5/3 倍；在 block-scaled e4m3 模型与真实 deep_gemm kernel 上，Φ 最优实现落在 fp8 低误差区，并在两个约 70B 模型上消除经典 Strassen 相对干净模型 10%–55% 的超额 NLL。
Motivation: Strassen 型算法乘法次数相同但 fp8 误差因换基导致的系数几何差异而不同，经典稳定性只控制最坏 ℓ1 增长而非期望误差量级，Dumas–Pernet–Sedoglavic 优化器的全局最优性未被证明。
Method: 为每个实现定义系数泛函 Φ，在换基轨道（Hadamard 流形上的 Kempf–Ness 问题）上最小化，用精确 moment-map 零点认证全局最优；再引入显式 block-scaled e4m3 噪声模型，把 Φ 作为相对期望均方误差的 leading-order 系数，并用 de Groote 分类把最优性推广到所有精确实 rank-7 2×2 分解。
Result: 认证的全局最优值 Φ_min=200/9；每个精确实 rank-7 实现的 Φ 预测 RMS 常数至少为固定噪声系数下三次算法的 5/3 倍。在四个架构族的真实 matmul tile 上，Φ 最优实现落在 fp8 低误差区；在两个约 70B 模型的真实 deep_gemm kernel 上，同一实现消除经典 Strassen 相对干净模型 10% 到 55% 的超额 NLL。
Conclusion: 算法实现的选择从调参问题变成可数学认证的设计问题：存在独立的低精度轴与全局 Φ 最优解，且该最优性在实测 fp8 误差上得到支持（在所测试的 fused block-scaled 范围内）。

papers.title: Selection-Invariant Communication Compilers for Privacy-Aware Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Structured multi-agent workflows exchange intermediate messages whose content and form can reveal private state even when the final output is safe. We identify selection-channel leakage: after authorization fixes what may be released, a private-state-aware choice among semantically valid realizations creates an additional inference channel. We introduce the selection-invariant communication compiler(SICC), which constrains this post-authorization representation kernel rather than prescribing templates. Any deterministic or independently public-randomized generator satisfying the invariant is valid; requirement-indexed canonical forms are one auditable implementation. We prove a compositional communication-layer guarantee: authorization, public-only form generation, and a dependency-safe utility gate make the emitted transcript reveal no information beyond the complete authorized view. Private-state-aware selection remains vulnerable after surface-disjoint and length-matched controls. Across 132 AgentLeak communication replays and 100 executable LangGraph tasks, deterministic SICC retains complete protocol utility without a positive excess-gain signal; independent public randomization preserves the same result in AgentLeak and 480 controlled cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体工作流的中间消息即使最终输出安全，仍会通过“在多个语义合法表述中按私有状态挑选”这一 selection channel 泄露信息。提出选择不变通信编译器 (SICC)：约束授权之后的表示选择核，使任何满足不变量的确定性或独立公开随机生成器都合法，并证明授权 + 仅用公开信息生成 + 依赖安全效用门控的组合式保证，转录不泄露超出完整授权视图的任何信息。在 132 次 AgentLeak 通信重放与 100 个可执行 LangGraph 任务上，确定性 SICC 保持完整协议效用且无正的 excess-gain 信号，独立公开随机化在 AgentLeak 与 480 个受控案例中给出同样结果。
Motivation: 授权只规定可以发布什么，但私有状态感知地在语义合法表述间选择会形成额外推理通道，表面不相交与长度匹配的对照都挡不住它。
Method: SICC 约束授权之后的表示核 (post-authorization representation kernel) 而非规定模板；需求索引的规范形式 (requirement-indexed canonical forms) 是一种可审计实现。组合保证由授权、仅用公开信息生成形式、依赖安全的效用门控三部分构成。
Result: 在 132 次 AgentLeak 通信重放与 100 个可执行 LangGraph 任务上，确定性 SICC 保留完整协议效用且没有正的 excess-gain 信号；独立公开随机化在 AgentLeak 与 480 个受控案例中保持同样结果。私有状态感知的选择在 surface-disjoint 与 length-matched 对照下仍然脆弱。
Conclusion: 泄露控制应放在授权之后的表示选择核上，而不是靠固定模板；满足该不变量的生成器即可达到转录不超出授权视图的组合式保证。

summary_sections.motivation: 授权只规定可以发布什么，但私有状态感知地在语义合法表述间选择会形成额外推理通道，表面不相交与长度匹配的对照都挡不住它。
summary_sections.method: SICC 约束授权之后的表示核 (post-authorization representation kernel) 而非规定模板；需求索引的规范形式 (requirement-indexed canonical forms) 是一种可审计实现。组合保证由授权、仅用公开信息生成形式、依赖安全的效用门控三部分构成。
summary_sections.result: 在 132 次 AgentLeak 通信重放与 100 个可执行 LangGraph 任务上，确定性 SICC 保留完整协议效用且没有正的 excess-gain 信号；独立公开随机化在 AgentLeak 与 480 个受控案例中保持同样结果。私有状态感知的选择在 surface-disjoint 与 length-matched 对照下仍然脆弱。

papers.title: FuncCode: Compressing Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks in Function Space with Hardware-Aware Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) replace scalar edge weights with learnable univariate functions, increasing flexibility but also parameter memory because each edge stores multiple coefficients, often together with a separate base branch. We introduce FuncCode, a basis-agnostic compression approach that forms shared codebooks from sampled edge responses, codes the basis and base branches independently, and exports the resulting codebooks and per-edge indices in a quantized, bit-packed format. Across spline and polynomial KANs, sampled edge responses exhibit $13$--$35\%$ lower effective rank than their coefficient representations. Further replicated controls show that function-space clustering alone is statistically tied with coefficient-space clustering; the consistent accuracy gain comes from preserving the distinct sharing structure of the two branches. On a ten-seed MNIST benchmark, FuncCode compresses spline and GRAM KANs by $31.6\times$ and $17.6\times$ with only $0.31$ and $0.34$ pp accuracy loss. On a 6.1M-edge convolutional KAGN, it achieves $19.9\times$ compression while remaining within $0.54$ pp of dense accuracy on CIFAR-10 and $1.89$ pp on CIFAR-100. After compression, per-edge indices account for up to $99.4\%$ of stored weight bits, making the representation index-bound. Across nine bit-exact FPGA accelerators, FuncCode reduces SplineKAN post-route weight memory by $3.87\times$ relative to dense INT4, without increasing cycle count or latency. The FuncCode implementation is available at https://github.com/OSU-STARLAB/FuncCode.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FuncCode 在函数空间对 KAN 做码本压缩：对采样边响应聚类共享码本，基函数分支与 base 分支分别编码，导出量化位打包格式。采样边响应的有效秩比系数表示低 13–35%；十种子 MNIST 上 spline/GRAM KAN 压缩 31.6×/17.6×，精度仅降 0.31/0.34 pp，6.1M 边卷积 KAGN 在 CIFAR-10 上 19.9× 压缩、距 dense 0.54 pp。
Motivation: KAN 每条边存多个系数加独立 base 分支，参数内存大；直接压缩系数会混淆两个分支各自的共享结构。
Method: 从采样边响应构建共享码本，基函数分支与 base 分支独立编码，输出量化位打包的码本与每边索引；用复制对照区分函数空间聚类与系数空间聚类的贡献，并在九个位精确 FPGA 加速器上做后端实现。
Result: 采样边响应有效秩比系数表示低 13–35%（spline 与 polynomial KAN）；复制对照显示函数空间聚类与系数空间聚类统计打平，精度增益来自保留两分支的共享结构。十种子 MNIST：spline KAN 31.6×、GRAM KAN 17.6× 压缩，精度损失 0.31/0.34 pp；6.1M 边卷积 KAGN 上 19.9× 压缩，CIFAR-10 距 dense 0.54 pp、CIFAR-100 1.89 pp。压缩后每边索引占存储权重比特最高 99.4%，表示变为索引受限。九个 FPGA 加速器上 SplineKAN 布线后权重内存比 dense INT4 少 3.87×，周期数与延迟不增。
Conclusion: KAN 压缩的收益来自对基函数分支与 base 分支分别建共享结构，而非单纯换到函数空间聚类；压缩后瓶颈转到每边索引比特。

papers.title: ToW3D: Consistency-aware Interactive Point-based Mesh Editing on GANs
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose ToW3D that enables precise and consistent control over 3D generative adversarial networks (GANs) with the Tug-of-War competition between shape deformation and appearance consistency. Existing point-based GAN editing methods such as DragGAN and GANWarping have yielded impressive performance for 2D image manipulation. However, as 3D generators present weaker generalization ability compared with 2D due to limited training data, they would suffer from drastic changes in global appearance when editing local areas of meshes. To address this, we design a pipeline of ``drag locally, shove globally'', which iteratively performs two optimization steps: 1) pull the point towards the target, and 2) push the structure and semantics back to the source. Specifically, we design a structure adaption module based on structure which guarantees the preservation of basic geometric properties, and a semantic preservation module that maintains semantic similarity across different views. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate superiority of our ToW3D approach over prior methods in terms of appearance consistency and fidelity especially under large deformations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ToW3D 用「局部拖拽、全局回推」的 Tug-of-War 竞争，在 3D GAN 网格编辑中迭代执行两步优化：把点拉向目标位置，同时把结构与语义推回源形状，以在局部大变形下保持全局外观一致。结构适配模块保住基本几何性质，语义保持模块跨视角维持语义相似，定性与定量实验显示其在外观一致性与保真度上优于 DragGAN、GANWarping 等既有方法，尤其在大变形下。
Motivation: DragGAN、GANWarping 等基于点的 GAN 编辑在 2D 图像上效果好，但 3D 生成器训练数据有限、泛化更弱，编辑网格局部区域时会引发全局外观的剧烈变化。
Method: 提出「drag locally, shove globally」流水线，迭代做两步优化：1) 将点拉向目标位置，2) 把结构与语义推回源；并设计基于结构的 structure adaption module 保证基本几何性质，以及 semantic preservation module 跨不同视角维持语义相似。
Result: 大量定性与定量实验显示 ToW3D 在外观一致性与保真度上优于既有方法，尤其在大变形 (large deformations) 条件下；对比对象包括 DragGAN 与 GANWarping 等基于点的 GAN 编辑方法。
Conclusion: 在 3D GAN 网格编辑中把局部拖拽与全局结构/语义回推做成竞争式迭代优化，可以在大变形下同时保住局部控制精度与全局外观一致性。

papers.title: Cellular-Communication-Level Interpretability for Pathology Foundation Models via Graph Distillation on Microenvironment
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide strong tile-level representations but remain difficult to interpret at the cellular and microenvironmental scales that underpin clinical reasoning. We introduce Graph-Interpreter (G-Interp), a graph-distillation framework that equips a frozen PFM teacher with a cellular-communication-level "plug-in" interpreter, without modifying the teacher. For each tile, we segment cells as graph nodes and construct a microenvironment graph based on spatial adjacency. Graph neural network (GNN) students distil the PFM embedding, whilst learning attention-based message passing that yields node- and edge-level importances. We interpret these importances as cell-cell communication evidence, providing fine-grained explanations of how PFMs encode microenvironmental context. To stabilise distillation when graph abstraction is imperfect, we employ a lightweight auxiliary student to supply complementary visual cues and condition graph message passing, while keeping the primary interpretability signal graph-derived. We evaluate explanation faithfulness by mapping graph-selected evidence back to the image using instance masks and measuring teacher sensitivity under targeted vs non-target occlusions. Across multiple histopathology tasks, G-Interp produces highly scalable, microenvironment-aware explanations, while maintaining competitive predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Graph-Interpreter (G-Interp)，用图蒸馏给冻结的病理基础模型 (PFM) 外挂一个细胞通信级解释器：把 tile 内细胞分割为图节点、按空间邻接建微环境图，GNN 学生蒸馏 PFM embedding 并学出注意力消息传递，得到节点与边级重要性作为细胞间通信证据。在多个组织病理任务上生成可扩展、感知微环境的解释，同时保持有竞争力的预测性能。
Motivation: 病理基础模型在 tile 级表征强，但在支撑临床推理的细胞与微环境尺度上难以解释，且直接改动教师模型代价高。
Method: 对每个 tile 分割细胞作为图节点、按空间邻接构建微环境图；GNN 学生蒸馏冻结 PFM 的 embedding，同时学习基于注意力的消息传递以输出节点/边重要性。为稳定图抽象不完美时的蒸馏，另设一个轻量辅助学生提供互补视觉线索并条件化图消息传递，主解释信号仍来自图。解释忠实度用 instance mask 把图选出的证据映射回图像，并比较 targeted 与 non-target 遮挡下教师的敏感度。
Result: 在多个组织病理任务上，G-Interp 产生高度可扩展、感知微环境的解释，同时保持有竞争力的预测性能；解释忠实度按上述 targeted vs non-target 遮挡的教师敏感度衡量。
Conclusion: 不修改教师模型，仅靠图蒸馏即可把 PFM 的 tile 级表征下探到细胞通信级解释，且预测性能不明显受损。

papers.title: Policy-Backed Selective Regeneration under Tainted Inter-Agent Communication
papers.abstract_en: Inter-agent communication is essential to multi-agent language-model systems, yet a single message may combine task-critical information with instructions not authorized by the original request. Prompt-based defenses leave enforcement to models exposed to adversarial messages, while indiscriminate message removal discards useful information. We introduce Executable Semantic Commitments with Clean-Room Recovery (ESC-CR), a policy-backed framework for secure inter-agent code generation and recovery. It separates message claims from authorization, constructs executable commitments from trusted tasks, evidence, and policy, and enforces them at an external release boundary. Upon a violation, ESC-CR taints the responsible message and rejected artifact, reconstructs a clean context from evidence-backed task information, and regenerates under the same policy. We evaluate ESC-CR across communication-essential and standard code-generation benchmarks, multiple model families and communication topologies, and adaptive attacks spanning direct, obfuscated, and verifier-aware payloads. Results show that polluted-context retry frequently fails to remove unauthorized influence, while complete message removal can discard information required by communication-essential tasks. ESC-CR preserves evidence-backed claims while suppressing unauthorized releases under matched computational budgets, and the same design transfers to end-to-end agent trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出策略背书的智能体间通信选择性再生成框架 ESC-CR：把消息中的声明与授权分离，用可信任务、证据与策略构造可执行承诺 (Executable Semantic Commitments) 并在外部发布边界强制执行；违规时给消息与被拒产物打污点，从证据支撑的任务信息重建干净上下文并在同一策略下再生成。结果是保留证据支撑的声明、抑制未授权发布，且在匹配计算预算下成立，设计可迁移到端到端智能体轨迹。
Motivation: 多智能体 LM 系统里单条消息可能把任务关键信息与未获原始请求授权的指令混在一起：基于 prompt 的防御把强制执行交给面对对抗消息的模型本身，而一律删除消息又会丢掉有用信息。
Method: ESC-CR 分离消息声明与授权，从可信任务、证据和策略构造可执行承诺，在外部发布边界强制执行；违规后给责任消息与被拒产物打污点 (taint)，从证据支撑的任务信息重建干净上下文并在同一策略下再生成。评测覆盖 communication-essential 与标准代码生成基准、多个模型家族与通信拓扑，以及 direct、obfuscated、verifier-aware 三类自适应攻击。
Result: 在匹配计算预算下，ESC-CR 保留证据支撑的声明同时抑制未授权发布；对照显示污染上下文重试 (polluted-context retry) 常常无法移除未授权影响，而完全删除消息会丢掉 communication-essential 任务所需信息；同一设计可迁移到端到端智能体轨迹。
Conclusion: 授权应由外部策略边界强制执行而非交给模型自省：按污点选择性再生成比整条删除或原地重试更能兼顾安全与任务信息保留。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RankCert: When Can Simulated Learners Safely Select an AI Tutor? Robust Decision Certification Under Structural Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-based tutor selection can be unstable when predictively adequate learner models imply different policy rankings. RankCert certifies one of eight equal-budget tutoring policies only when model-averaged utility, probability-best, posterior regret, cross-domain rank, family coverage, and leave-one-domain-out and leave-one-visible-family-out averages support the same candidate; otherwise it abstains. We evaluated RankCert in 1,280 frozen held-out settings spanning five rotating held-out oracle families, 64 scenarios per family, and four cohort sizes. Calibration used a licensed, de-identified EdNet-KT1 derivative with 5,000 learners and 590,056 retained responses; all five family representatives passed the frozen adequacy gate. Minimum-domain mean pairwise top-1 agreement was 0.272917 (95% CI [0.253646, 0.293229]), showing substantial structural disagreement. Cohort-noise variance decreased from n = 30 to n = 300, while the structural family share remained nonzero. RankCert reduced total held-out decision loss relative to full-coverage point selection by 0.006605 normalized-outcome units (95% CI [0.004859, 0.008407]). At comparable coverage, however, it did not reduce selective risk relative to a confidence-gated point certificate (difference -0.000213; 95% CI [-0.003238, 0.002384]; Holm p = 0.929654). Certification occurred in 3.75% of settings and only in stable scenarios; RankCert abstained in every ambiguous, misspecified, and structural-conflict setting. "Safe" denotes only benchmark-scoped decision certification under the declared utility and uncertainty set; no human-learning, causal, deployment-effectiveness, or general-safety claim is made.

papers.title: Differentiable Policy Transport over Multi-Layer Network Feasibility Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based control is increasingly central to automating network operations. A learned policy, however, must satisfy cross-layer constraints on interference, power-rate coupling, flow conservation, service chains, capacity, latency, and reliability. Existing methods typically account for only a subset of this geometry and only indirectly, e.g., through reward penalties, Lagrange multipliers, or post-hoc repairs. This paper proposes \emph{Network Feasibility Geometry Reinforcement Learning} (NFG-RL), which models coupled constraints via transport theory and the residual inclusion $\bphi_{\mathfrak{N}}(x,a)\in\cK_{\mathfrak{N}}$, defining the executed policy as the pushforward of a proto-policy through a feasibility-transport map. NFG-RL compiles heterogeneous constraints into typed residual blocks and transports proto-actions through a differentiable variational operator, letting active constraints shape execution, exploration, and actor gradients. Our analysis shows that exact transport yields almost-sure feasible execution, while active constraints contract exploration onto the feasible tangent space. It further establishes a nonnegative first-order gain from critic-tilted transport over plain projection and recovers backpressure scheduling as the gradient of a lifted drift residual. In two public-trace-conditioned wireless-edge surrogate environments, NFG-RL improves feasible utility by \textbf{37.5--41.5\%} over the strongest non-NFG method in each environment, reduces raw-action violation by \textbf{48.5--60.8\%}, and lowers P99 delay by \textbf{57.0--75.5\%}, outperforming a range of optimization and learning baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 NFG-RL：用 transport 理论与残差包含约束把跨层网络约束编译成 typed residual block，将 proto-policy 经可微变分算子 pushforward 为执行策略，使活跃约束直接塑造执行、探索与 actor 梯度。在两个 public-trace 条件化的无线边缘 surrogate 环境中，可行效用较各环境最强非 NFG 方法提升 37.5--41.5%，原始动作违规下降 48.5--60.8%，P99 时延下降 57.0--75.5%。
Motivation: 学习型网络控制策略需同时满足干扰、功率-速率耦合、流守恒、服务链、容量、时延与可靠性等跨层约束，而现有方法只覆盖其中一部分几何且多靠 reward 惩罚、Lagrange 乘子或事后修复间接处理。
Method: NFG-RL 用 transport 理论建模耦合约束，以残差包含 φ_N(x,a) ∈ K_N 定义执行策略为 proto-policy 经 feasibility-transport map 的 pushforward；把异构约束编译为 typed residual block，再经可微变分算子传输 proto-action，并给出 critic-tilted transport 相对 plain projection 的一阶增益分析，把 backpressure 调度恢复为 lifted drift residual 的梯度。
Result: 在两个 public-trace 条件化的无线边缘 surrogate 环境中，可行效用较各环境最强非 NFG 方法提升 37.5--41.5%，原始动作违规降低 48.5--60.8%，P99 时延降低 57.0--75.5%，优于一系列优化与学习基线；分析上精确 transport 保证 almost-sure 可行执行，活跃约束把探索收缩到可行切空间。
Conclusion: 把跨层约束显式编成可微 transport 几何，能让约束直接参与策略执行与梯度计算，从而同时提高可行效用、压低违规与尾时延；backpressure 可视为该框架中 drift residual 的梯度特例。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Not All 4-bit Quantizers Are Equal: Deployment-Time Mitigation of PII Leakage in Fine-Tuned Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Organizations fine-tune small language models on private data and then compress them to 4 bits for resource-efficient deployment. We show that the compression method also affects privacy. What separates the methods is not the bit width but whether they tune their rounding on a small sample of text, the calibration corpus. On our primary model, when each planted record's own opening text is used as the prompt, the two calibration-based methods we test, Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ) and Gradient-based Post-Training Quantization (GPTQ), each reproduce none of the planted records, while the calibration-corpus-free GGUF Q4_K_M format reproduces 5.3% of them. Tracked across five open models with 0.5-7 billion parameters, AWQ leaks least at every size and in both families, with little accuracy loss at 3-7 billion. Controlled experiments associate the difference with calibration-induced rounding error in channels involved in rare-token prediction. Choosing the 4-bit method is therefore a deployment-time privacy decision, not only a question of speed and quality.
papers.comment: 10 pages and 5 tables. The source code and per-seed experimental results are publicly available at https://github.com/CristhianKapelinski/quantizer-pii-mitigation. Accepted for publication at SBSeg 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 4-bit 量化方法本身决定微调后小模型的 PII 泄露程度：基于校准语料调 rounding 的 AWQ 与 GPTQ 在主模型上复现被植入记录数为 0，而不用校准语料的 GGUF Q4_K_M 复现 5.3%。跨 5 个 0.5–7B 开源模型，AWQ 在每个规模和两个模型家族上泄露最少，3–7B 时精度损失很小；作者据此把 4-bit 方法选择定为部署期的隐私决策。
Motivation: 组织把私有数据微调的小模型压到 4-bit 部署，通常只权衡速度与精度；本文指出压缩方法本身影响隐私泄露，而区分点不是位宽而是是否用校准语料调 rounding。
Method: 在微调模型中植入记录，用每条记录自身的开头文本作 prompt，比较 AWQ、GPTQ（均基于校准语料）与免校准的 GGUF Q4_K_M 三种 4-bit 量化；跨 5 个 0.5–7B 开源模型、两个家族追踪泄露，并用受控实验把差异关联到稀有 token 预测相关通道上的校准诱导 rounding 误差。
Result: 主模型上 AWQ 与 GPTQ 各复现 0 条植入记录，GGUF Q4_K_M 复现 5.3%；5 个 0.5–7B 模型上 AWQ 在每个规模、两个家族中泄露最少，3–7B 时精度损失很小。
Conclusion: 选 4-bit 方法是部署期的隐私决策，不只是速度与质量问题；泄露差异来自校准诱导的 rounding 误差作用于稀有 token 预测通道。

papers.title: Towards Adaptive Federated Graph Clustering: A Global Community-aware Contrastive Learning-based Approach
papers.abstract_en: Federated graph learning (FGL) enables multiple clients to collaboratively train graph models without sharing their private graph data, providing a promising paradigm for mining knowledge from distributed graph repositories. While most existing FGL methods focus on supervised tasks, real-world graphs are often massive and unlabeled, making federated graph clustering an important yet still immature research direction. Notably, this task is particularly challenging due to the inherent subgraph heterogeneity across clients, which leads to client-specific community structures. In this work, we identify two critical limitations in existing federated graph clustering methods: (1) unrealistic pre-defined cluster cardinality assumptions and (2) incomplete inter-community separation. To address these challenges, we propose AdaFGC, an Adaptive Federated graph clustering framework based on Global community-aware Contrastive learning. AdaFGC introduces an over-complete set of global community anchors to model the global community structure and adaptively estimate clustering cardinality via cross-client anchor refinement. In addition, it employs a global community-aware contrastive learning scheme that uses the shared anchors as contrastive prototypes to explicitly enforce community-level attraction and repulsion across clients, complemented by node-level and topology-level objectives that stabilize local representations. Extensive experiments on eight benchmark datasets demonstrate that AdaFGC consistently outperforms existing supervised and unsupervised FGL baselines across multiple clustering metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaFGC 用一组过完备的全局社区锚点建模跨客户端的全局社区结构，并通过跨客户端锚点精化自适应估计聚类簇数，同时以共享锚点作对比原型显式施加社区级吸引与排斥。在八个基准数据集上，它在多种聚类指标上稳定超过现有有监督与无监督联邦图学习基线。
Motivation: 联邦图聚类面对客户端间子图异质性导致的客户端特有社区结构，现有方法依赖不现实的预设簇数，且社区间分离不完整。
Method: 提出 AdaFGC：引入过完备全局社区锚点集合建模全局社区结构，经跨客户端锚点精化 (cross-client anchor refinement) 自适应估计簇数；用共享锚点作对比原型做全局社区感知对比学习，施加社区级吸引与排斥，辅以节点级与拓扑级目标稳定局部表示。
Result: 在八个基准数据集上，AdaFGC 在多种聚类指标上持续优于现有有监督与无监督 FGL 基线。
Conclusion: 把簇数当作可由跨客户端锚点精化估计的量、并把社区级对比约束放进联邦图聚类，可在子图异质条件下取得更一致的聚类表现。

papers.title: Do Existing Preconditioners Improve Biomedical Tabular Foundation Learning? An Empirical Study on TabPFN Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models have recently shown strong potential for structured biomedical data analysis. Among them, TabPFN has emerged as an effective approach for low-data tabular classification tasks. However, the impact of optimization and preconditioning strategies on biomedical fine-tuning remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present a comprehensive empirical investigation of five AdamW-based preconditioning strategies for fine-tuning TabPFN v2.5 on 59 biomedical datasets spanning Alzheimer's disease, breast cancer, schizophrenia, significant memory concern (SMC), KEEL biomedical datasets, and UCI biomedical benchmarks. The evaluation considers predictive performance, computational efficiency, and statistical significance analysis. Experimental results demonstrate that the original AdamW optimizer consistently achieves the best overall performance and statistical ranking, while existing curvature-aware preconditioners fail to provide reliable improvements across diverse biomedical learning scenarios. The findings suggest that generic preconditioning approaches may not adequately capture the optimization characteristics of biomedical tabular learning, motivating the development of biomedical-aware preconditioners specifically tailored for healthcare-oriented tabular foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 59 个生物医学表格数据集上系统比较 5 种基于 AdamW 的预条件 (preconditioning) 策略对 TabPFN v2.5 微调的效果，原始 AdamW 在整体性能与统计排名上始终最好，曲率感知预条件器 (curvature-aware preconditioners) 无法带来可靠提升。结论是通用预条件方法不足以刻画生物医学表格学习的优化特性，应开发面向医疗表格基础模型的专用预条件器。
Motivation: 表格基础模型在结构化生物医学数据分析上表现强，但优化与预条件策略对生物医学微调的影响基本未被探索，低数据分类场景下换优化器是否值得缺乏证据。
Method: 对 TabPFN v2.5 微调，比较 5 种基于 AdamW 的预条件策略，覆盖 59 个生物医学数据集（Alzheimer's disease、breast cancer、schizophrenia、significant memory concern/SMC、KEEL biomedical、UCI biomedical benchmarks），从预测性能、计算效率与统计显著性三个维度评估。
Result: 原始 AdamW 在整体性能与统计排名上始终最佳；现有曲率感知预条件器在多样生物医学学习场景中未能提供可靠改进。
Conclusion: 通用预条件方法可能无法捕捉生物医学表格学习的优化特性，需要为医疗导向的表格基础模型专门设计 biomedical-aware preconditioner。
