papers.title: Adversarial Course-of-Action Generation: Game-Theoretic Multi-Agent Algorithms for COA matching & COA generation
papers.abstract_en: Course-of-action (COA) generation is a distributed planning problem: a system must propose structured candidate actions, evaluate them against an adversarial response, and surface options that remain tactically coherent under changing conditions. We present COA-Bench, a small offline benchmark and reproducibility artifact for comparing COA generation policies through self-play. Following the BattleCOA terminology, we reserve COA matching for asset-effect matching and COA generation for course-of-action generation; the present artifact does not implement either DecisionFunction directly. Instead, it represents COAs as typed action chains with conditional branches, assigns a synthetic COA quality score, compares opposing COAs with a BLUE-vs-RED advantage score and Nash-gap distance, and scores doctrinal coherence with an FM 3-0-inspired heuristic rubric. Across 50 synthetic scenarios spanning five operational templates, a sampled best-response policy that draws eight RED candidates reduces BLUE advantage from .516 to .485 and BLUE wargame win rate from .920 to .820; a two-stage multi-agent council with five BLUE proposer agents, RED-team adjudication, and critique-driven revision obtains .509 BLUE advantage and .820 BLUE win rate. We also identify and fix a benchmark-design issue in which scenario framing was stored as metadata but had no effect on generated COA content. COA-Bench is not an operational battle-management system and uses no real, classified, proprietary, or human-subject data. The contribution is an inspectable evaluation harness, preliminary benchmark evidence, and lessons for building auditable agentic planning artifacts.
papers.comment: 5 pages. DAI 2026 Industry Track submission. Includes public reproducibility artifact link. Uses synthetic offline scenarios only; no classified data, proprietary data, human-subject data, or operational planning systems

papers.title: Do Synthetic Personas Predict Real Audience Response? A Sim-to-Real Study Where a No-Persona Baseline Beats Persona-Based Copy Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Marketers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) as "synthetic personas" to predict how an audience will react to a piece of copy before it ships, encouraged by evidence that profile-conditioned LLMs mimic human samples. But is that prediction actually valid against real behaviour - and does the persona machinery help? We present a sim-to-real validity study using the Upworthy Research Archive - thousands of headline A/B tests on shared real traffic, with measured click-through - as held-out ground truth. We compare a ten-persona panel, grounded in the real audience's demographics, against a no-persona zero-shot baseline that simply asks the model how likely a typical reader is to click. Two findings stand out. First, ground-truth reliability is the binding constraint: most A/B tests have no statistically distinguishable winner, so validity can only be measured on the reliable subset (n = 399). Second, and counter to the persona-simulation premise, persona conditioning degrades predictive validity: the no-persona baseline ranks variants markedly better (Kendall τ = 0.361, a medium effect; top-1 accuracy 49.2%) than the persona panel (τ = 0.084; top-1 34.6%), with non-overlapping confidence intervals. Asking the model directly taps an accurate population-level prior; forcing it to role-play specific personas injects bias and noise. The result replicates across three independent Upworthy splits, holds in direction on a different-domain news dataset, and is robust to seed, prompt phrasing, and model choice - across three Gemini tiers and a different model family (OpenAI gpt-4.1, significant paired gap). The takeaway: for predicting aggregate engagement, a plain LLM ranker beats persona simulation - synthetic personas are not merely a weak predictor, they are worse than not using them. All numbers regenerate from a public, artifact-first replication package.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Upworthy Research Archive 的真实 A/B 标题点击率做 sim-to-real 检验，发现 LLM 的 persona 模拟反而降低预测效度：无 persona 的零样本基线 Kendall τ=0.361、top-1 准确率 49.2%，十人 persona 面板只有 τ=0.084、top-1 34.6%，且置信区间不重叠。结论是预测聚合参与度时直接问模型优于角色扮演，synthetic personas 比不用还差。
Motivation: 营销界普遍用 LLM synthetic personas 预测受众对文案的反应，依据是 profile-conditioned LLM 能模拟人类样本，但这一预测对真实行为是否有效、persona 机制是否真的有用尚未验证。
Method: 以 Upworthy Research Archive（共享真实流量上的数千条标题 A/B 测试、实测点击率）为 held-out ground truth，先筛出统计上可区分胜负的可靠子集（n=399），再对比基于真实受众人口统计的十人 persona 面板与直接询问典型读者点击概率的无 persona 零样本基线；用 Kendall τ 与 top-1 准确率衡量排序效度，并在三个独立 Upworthy 划分、另一领域新闻数据集、不同 seed/提示措辞、三个 Gemini 档位与 OpenAI gpt-4.1 上复现。
Result: 无 persona 基线 Kendall τ=0.361（中等效应）、top-1 准确率 49.2%；persona 面板 τ=0.084、top-1 34.6%，两者置信区间不重叠。结论在三个独立 Upworthy 划分上复现，在另一领域新闻数据集上方向一致，并对 seed、提示措辞与模型选择稳健，跨三个 Gemini 档位及 gpt-4.1 均有显著配对差距；可靠子集 n=399。
Conclusion: 预测聚合参与度时，直接让 LLM 排序优于 persona 模拟：persona 角色扮演注入偏差与噪声，而直接提问调用的是准确的群体层面先验，synthetic personas 不只是弱预测器，而是比不用更差。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Same Quantity, Different Answer: Numerical Representation Invariance in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Numerically equivalent word problems should yield the same canonical answer whether a quantity is written as a decimal, fraction, percentage, number word, scientific notation, or an exactly converted unit. We generate 3,600 exact-rational problems and 8,600 prompts spanning five identity-preserving transformation families, and evaluate five open-weight systems. After a fixed syntax audit that normalizes common answer forms without an LLM judge, canonical accuracy is 0.969-0.996, but orbit correctness falls to 0.848-0.981 and orbit invariance to 0.851-0.981; invariant-but-wrong orbits account for at most 0.003. Most of the broad strict-parser collapse arises because multiplication-form scientific notation lies outside the implemented number grammar, illustrating how evaluator interfaces can masquerade as reasoning failures. A distinct semantic pathology remains: Mistral Small 4 scores 0.699 on unit-converted inputs and produces 265 errors differing from the label by exact powers of ten. In a separate 9,000-call experiment that allocates equal calls to the compared arms, representation consensus does not outperform paraphrase consensus on a low-error subset and produces substantially more false alarms. The accompanying ancillary archive contains the frozen benchmark, evaluation and audit records, consensus raw responses, manifests, analysis code, and a one-command paper build.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Ancillary archive includes the frozen benchmark, evaluation and audit records, consensus raw responses, manifests, analysis code, and tests
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 3,600 道精确有理数题、8,600 条 prompt 覆盖五类数值表示等价变换，评测五个开源权重系统：语法审计后 canonical accuracy 达 0.969–0.996，但 orbit correctness 与 orbit invariance 仅 0.848–0.981 / 0.851–0.981，且严格解析器的崩塌多来自科学计数法乘法形式落在语法之外，属评测接口问题而非推理失败。
Motivation: 数值等价的题目换一种写法（小数、分数、百分数、数词、科学计数法、单位换算）本应给出同一答案，但现有评测难以区分模型真的推理错误与解析器/接口造成的假失败。
Method: 生成 3,600 道精确有理数题与 8,600 条 prompt，覆盖五类保恒等变换族，评测五个开源权重系统；先做固定语法审计（不使用 LLM judge）规范化常见答案形式，再计算 canonical accuracy、orbit correctness、orbit invariance，并另做一次 9,000 次调用、两臂等额分配的表示共识 vs 改写共识对比实验。
Result: 语法审计后 canonical accuracy 0.969–0.996，orbit correctness 0.848–0.981，orbit invariance 0.851–0.981，invariant-but-wrong 占比至多 0.003；严格解析器崩塌主要源于乘法形式科学计数法不在所实现的数字文法内。Mistral Small 4 在单位换算输入上得 0.699，产生 265 个与标签相差恰好 10 的整数次幂的错误。9,000 次调用实验中，表示共识在低错误子集上不优于改写共识，且产生多得多的 false alarm。
Conclusion: 数值表示不变性的评测缺口很大程度上是评测接口（数字文法）伪装成推理失败，但单位换算下 10 的幂次错误是独立的真实语义病理；表示共识作为一致性信号在低错误子集上不比改写共识更好。

papers.title: What Does 99% Accuracy Measure? A Reproducible Audit of Shortcut Learning in a Widely Used Fake News Corpus
papers.abstract_en: Text classifiers trained on the ISOT/Kaggle "Fake and Real News" corpus routinely report accuracy and F1 above 0.98, a level of performance that sits uneasily beside the difficulty of assessing veracity. Using a transparent TF-IDF and linear-classifier pipeline as a measurement instrument, we audit the corpus along three leakage channels and two distribution-shift protocols, releasing all code and derived numbers. First, the benchmark is partly degenerate: a classifier given only the subject metadata field, with the article text discarded, attains F1 = 1.000, since the two classes have disjoint subjects. Second, removing all three leakage channels, metadata, a newswire source tag present in 99.2% of real articles, and 6,251 duplicate documents contaminating 19.4% of a naive test split, lowers F1 by only 1.21 points (0.9935 to 0.9814); the residual signal is diffuse editorial style rather than a few giveaway tokens, since deleting the 1,000 highest-weight unigrams still leaves F1 = 0.926. Third, this style signal does not transfer: under a topic-disjoint protocol, average precision falls from 0.9995 to 0.9475 and deployed F1 from 0.9905 to 0.8067, with a prior-matched analysis confirming a genuine 5.2-point loss of discrimination, while temporal transfer is nearly lossless. A fine-tuned DistilBERT is stronger in-distribution (F1 = 0.9993) but degrades far more under topic shift, losing 12.9 average-precision points against the linear model's 5.2. Transferred to the independent LIAR benchmark, all three models fall to near-chance ranking (ROC-AUC 0.54-0.57), none beating a majority-class baseline. We conclude that within-corpus scores here quantify source and topic separability rather than veracity, that added capacity exploits the shortcut rather than avoiding it, and we recommend metadata-only, small-sample, and topic-disjoint baselines as inexpensive diagnostics for future work.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Code, experiment scripts, and machine-readable results: https://github.com/vermayuvraj/fake-news-detection
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用透明的 TF-IDF + 线性分类器作为测量工具，审计 ISOT/Kaggle「Fake and Real News」语料的三条泄漏通道与两种分布偏移协议。只给 subject 字段（丢弃正文）即可 F1 = 1.000；清掉元数据、99.2% 真实新闻中的通讯社来源标记与 6,251 篇重复文档（污染 19.4% 朴素测试划分）后 F1 仅降 1.21 点（0.9935→0.9814）。语料内高分衡量的是来源与话题可分性而非真实性，作者建议用 metadata-only、小样本与 topic-disjoint 基线做廉价诊断。
Motivation: ISOT/Kaggle 假新闻语料上准确率与 F1 普遍超过 0.98，与判定真伪的实际难度不符；需要判断这些分数到底在测什么。
Method: 以 TF-IDF 加线性分类器为透明测量工具，沿三条泄漏通道（subject 元数据、真实新闻中出现率 99.2% 的通讯社来源标记、6,251 篇重复文档）与两种分布偏移协议（topic-disjoint、temporal）审计语料，并微调 DistilBERT 作对照，全部代码与派生数值开源。
Result: 仅用 subject 字段 F1 = 1.000（两类 subject 不相交）；移除三条泄漏通道后 F1 从 0.9935 降至 0.9814（降 1.21 点）；删除权重最高的 1,000 个 unigram 后 F1 仍为 0.926；topic-disjoint 下 average precision 从 0.9995 降至 0.9475、部署 F1 从 0.9905 降至 0.8067，先验匹配分析确认判别力真实损失 5.2 点，而时间偏移几乎无损；DistilBERT 分布内 F1 = 0.9993，但 topic shift 下 AP 损失 12.9 点（线性模型 5.2 点）；迁移到 LIAR 上三个模型 ROC-AUC 均为 0.54–0.57，无一超过多数类基线。
Conclusion: 语料内高分量化的是来源与话题可分性而非真实性，增加模型容量会利用捷径而非规避它；建议未来工作用 metadata-only、小样本与 topic-disjoint 基线作为廉价诊断。

summary_sections.motivation: ISOT/Kaggle 假新闻语料上准确率与 F1 普遍超过 0.98，与判定真伪的实际难度不符；需要判断这些分数到底在测什么。
summary_sections.method: 以 TF-IDF 加线性分类器为透明测量工具，沿三条泄漏通道（subject 元数据、真实新闻中出现率 99.2% 的通讯社来源标记、6,251 篇重复文档）与两种分布偏移协议（topic-disjoint、temporal）审计语料，并微调 DistilBERT 作对照，全部代码与派生数值开源。
summary_sections.result: 仅用 subject 字段 F1 = 1.000（两类 subject 不相交）；移除三条泄漏通道后 F1 从 0.9935 降至 0.9814（降 1.21 点）；删除权重最高的 1,000 个 unigram 后 F1 仍为 0.926；topic-disjoint 下 average precision 从 0.9995 降至 0.9475、部署 F1 从 0.9905 降至 0.8067，先验匹配分析确认判别力真实损失 5.2 点，而时间偏移几乎无损；DistilBERT 分布内 F1 = 0.9993，但 topic shift 下 AP 损失 12.9 点（线性模型 5.2 点）；迁移到 LIAR 上三个模型 ROC-AUC 均为 0.54–0.57，无一超过多数类基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 语料内高分量化的是来源与话题可分性而非真实性，增加模型容量会利用捷径而非规避它；建议未来工作用 metadata-only、小样本与 topic-disjoint 基线作为廉价诊断。

papers.title: Observing the Conduct of Systematic Reviews with Generative AI Support: An Experience Report from a Graduate Software Engineering Course
papers.abstract_en: Context: Secondary studies are fundamental practices in Evidence- Based Software Engineering, but teaching them requires activities that expose students to authentic methodological decisions. Objective: This paper reports an experience in a graduate course in which ten doctoral students in Software Engineering, organized into three groups, piloted secondary studies with and without support from generative AI. Method: A single-day classroom session was organized and observed, in which the groups conducted pilot systematic reviews with and without generative AI support. Classroom observations, produced artifacts, and interaction threads with assistants configured in ChatGPT were analyzed to reconstruct how each group appropriated the technology throughout the activity. Results: LLMs reduced initial barriers, accelerated the generation of alternatives, and made methodological problems more explicit, but they also favored excessive delegation, superficial validation, operational difficulties, and a shift in focus from conducting the SLR to using the tool. Conclusion: The experience offers a situated, observational account of how doctoral students engaged with generative AI during a systematic review activity, and the resulting insights also inform the design of a subsequent controlled study. The findings indicate that generative AI can support practical learning about SLRs, provided that its use is accompanied by human supervision, decision records, and critical reflection on its limitations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在研究生软件工程课上，10 名博士生分 3 组在单日课堂中分别带与不带生成式 AI 支持地试点系统性文献综述 (SLR)，LLM 降低了入门门槛、加快方案生成并让方法学问题更显性，同时诱发过度委托、验证肤浅与注意力从做 SLR 转向用工具。结论是生成式 AI 可支持 SLR 实践教学，但必须配人工监督、决策记录与对其局限的批判性反思。
Motivation: EBSE 中二次研究 (secondary studies) 是核心实践，但教学上缺少能让学生暴露在真实方法学决策中的活动；本文要给出博士生在课堂里如何挪用生成式 AI 做 SLR 的情境化观察。
Method: 单日课堂观察：10 名软件工程博士生分 3 组，各组在有与无生成式 AI 支持下试点系统性文献综述；分析材料为课堂观察、产出工件，以及与 ChatGPT 中配置的 assistants 的交互线程，用以重建每组如何挪用该技术。
Result: LLM 降低初始门槛、加速备选方案生成、使方法学问题更显性；同时带来过度委托、验证肤浅、操作困难，以及关注点从执行 SLR 转向使用工具。
Conclusion: 生成式 AI 能支持 SLR 的实践性学习，前提是使用时伴随人工监督、决策记录与对其局限的批判性反思；本次观察性经验用于指导后续受控研究的设计。

papers.title: Optimizing Denoising Trajectories in dLLMs: A Lightweight Evolutionary Heuristic Approach
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to conventional Auto-Regressive (AR) Large Language Models (LLMs). By leveraging bidirectional attention and parallel decoding, dLLMs enable more efficient generation. However, they require a carefully designed denoising scheduler at inference time (absent during training) whose choice significantly impacts generation quality. While confidence-based heuristic schedulers have shown strong empirical performance, they suffer from two critical failure modes: EOS Overflow and Proximal Bias. Through in-depth analysis of the Transformer's attention patterns, we reveal that these failures stem from certain positions assigning disproportionately high attention weights to invalid tokens (e.g., [MASK] and [EOS]), which produce misleading confidence signals. Building on this insight, empirical evidence shows that valid attention scores can provide complementary guidance to conventional confidence-based heuristics, yet no single metric consistently excels across all scenarios, implying that the optimal denoising trajectory is highly context-dependent. To address this problem, we propose a lightweight evolutionary heuristic scheduler optimized using the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES). Our scheduler dynamically integrates multiple heuristic features with a contextual mean-field embedding, while requiring only 393 trainable parameters. Evaluated on LLaDA and Dream across four reasoning and planning benchmarks, our method consistently outperforms strong baselines, including conventional heuristics, block auto-regressive methods, and recent State-Of-The-Art (SOTA) approaches. To the best of our knowledge, it represents the most parameter-efficient neural scheduler to date. Our code is available at https://github.com/RS2002/Evo-Denoise .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 dLLM 推理期去噪调度器的 EOS Overflow 与 Proximal Bias 两种失效，提出用 CMA-ES 进化优化的轻量调度器，把多种启发式特征与 contextual mean-field embedding 动态融合，仅 393 个可训练参数。在 LLaDA 与 Dream 的四个推理与规划基准上，一致优于传统启发式、block auto-regressive 方法与近期 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: dLLM 推理需要训练时不存在的去噪调度器，其选择显著影响生成质量；基于置信度的启发式调度器存在 EOS Overflow 与 Proximal Bias 两种失效，且没有单一指标在所有场景下都最优。
Method: 先分析 Transformer 注意力模式，定位失效源于某些位置对无效 token（[MASK]、[EOS]）赋予过高注意力权重、产生误导性置信信号；再用 CMA-ES 进化搜索优化调度器，动态融合多种启发式特征与 contextual mean-field embedding，仅 393 个可训练参数。
Result: 在 LLaDA 与 Dream 两个模型、四个推理与规划基准上，一致优于传统启发式、block auto-regressive 方法与近期 SOTA；调度器仅 393 个可训练参数，作者称其为迄今参数效率最高的神经调度器。
Conclusion: 最优去噪轨迹高度依赖上下文，用注意力导出的有效注意力分数与置信度启发式互补融合，并以进化搜索定权重，可在极小参数量下同时缓解两种失效并超过 SOTA 调度器。

papers.title: Financial sentiment analysis using FinBERT with application in predicting stock movement
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we integrate sentiment analysis within a financial framework by leveraging FinBERT, a fine-tuned BERT model specialized for financial text, to construct an advanced deep learning model based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. Our objective is to forecast financial market trends with greater accuracy. To evaluate our model's predictive capabilities, we apply it to a comprehensive dataset of stock market news and perform a comparative analysis against standard BERT, standalone LSTM, and the traditional ARIMA models. Our findings indicate that incorporating sentiment analysis significantly enhances the model's ability to anticipate market fluctuations. Furthermore, we propose a suite of optimization techniques aimed at refining the model's performance, paving the way for more robust and reliable market prediction tools in the field of AI-driven finance.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 FinBERT 从股市新闻中提取情感特征，再接入 LSTM 预测股价走势；与标准 BERT、单独 LSTM 和 ARIMA 对比后发现，加入情感分析能显著提升对市场波动的预判能力。作者另提出一组优化技术以进一步改进模型表现。
Motivation: 股票走势预测依赖新闻文本中的情感信号，但通用 BERT 与传统时序模型（ARIMA）对金融语境的情感刻画不足，需要把金融领域情感与序列建模结合起来。
Method: 以金融文本微调的 FinBERT 生成情感表征，与 Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) 网络结合构建深度学习模型，输入为综合股市新闻数据集；对照组为标准 BERT、单独 LSTM 与 ARIMA。
Result: 在股市新闻数据集上，加入情感分析的模型在预判市场波动方面显著优于不含情感的版本，并与 BERT、LSTM、ARIMA 做了对比分析；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 金融领域情感分析是提升股价走势预测能力的关键增益项，作者主张在此基础上叠加优化技术以获得更稳健的 AI 金融预测工具。
